reviews.comment: Very chaotic, almost comically disorganized lectures; skips through most slides, doesn't check for student comprehension, and hardly uses Canvas (the literal program used for all coursework). Find any other professor if you actually want to learn or do well.

DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASSES!! I have never had a worse professor. He is very disorganized, and his students end up paying the price. Although the class covers pretty basic info, he does not know how to teach it and doesn't make an effort to help students succeed. I would HIGHLY recommend taking the class with a different professor.
grade is based on what you already know.

I would never recommend this teacher to anyone. He is incredibly unorganized, unclear in his expectations, and difficult to work with. His teaching style and lack of preparation made the course frustrating and ultimately ruined my semester.

Professor Sharma cares so deeply for his students and tries to set them up for long term success. I took MKT 620 with him during the summer term and he was one of my favorite professors that i have had. Attendance is mandatory and he requires handwritten notes, but you can use your notes on all quizzes.

I don't understand his bad reviews. He is so caring and wants to see everyone succeed. There is a 5 question quiz every class but they are open note and so easy if you pay attention. Answers his emails very fast and genuinely wants to help and provide feedback. I wish I could take him for again for another class.

This class is so cake but attendance is mandatory. Do not let the reviews scare you there is no tests and all the quizzes are open note so they are really easy. He is also chill and will answer your emails so fast if you ever need help
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dont let bad ratings scare you. His experience speaks for itself(and he LOVES to bring it up) He is so knowledgeable about marketing, his feedback often comes off as harsh but he means well, he genuinely wants to see his students succeed in real life if it comes at the cost of their grade, for a class designed to not teach much you still learn lots
AVOID HIM!!!!
You do not want to take this professor and it's such a shame he is still employed at such a prestigious school. He is an awful educator and is so disrespectful towards students. Avoid him.

Awful experience and a complete waste of time. I have never felt so discouraged and belittled than sitting in class with him. He provided no help. It was as if he got a kick out of students not doing well or not understanding. Aside from being an awful professor, he is not a nice man. He is the furthest thing from empathetic and understanding.

I had to email the business school administration because of this man's behavior. He was nasty, belittling, unapproachable, and was not a good educator at all. It angers me to see these positive reviews. I am not the student who looks for an easy A, I work so hard, and still nothing was ever good enough for him. He should not be a professor anymore

I seriously do not understand any of these good reviews. He was an awful professor, never provided clear instructions on things, and nothing was ever good enough to meet his standard. He was so disrespectful and belittling towards his students and provided no help during office hours, it would just be ripping your work apart. Trust me, avoid him.

Lecture-heavy class, no laptops allowed must hand write everything. Take good notes as you'll need them for the 2-minute quiz every single class. He will cold call on you during lectures, so pay attention! Two group projects: StratSim and a research paper. You MUST pick a good group and put serious time into it early on or you won't do well!

NO ELECTRONICS, he interrupts his lecture to call out every individual he catches using them and docks points off your participation grade. If you're a couple of minutes late, you're not allowed to take the quiz. Random in-class group exercises whenever he wants. Overall, the course and material were easy to follow but he's so annoying.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor was a tough grader. I can understand his effort to deliver well designed lectures, but the lecture was clearly off track by answering all the questions student asked, as it direct the class to completely unrelated topic. Quiz does not reflect class content, you have to go over the notes and expect untaught content and meaningless details.
Professor Sharma is one of the best Marketing professors I've had at UM. He is very experienced in the field and is always willing to meet with students outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: One of the nicest teachers I have ever had, and he takes the time to make sure everyone understands the material. There are two exams, and one non cumulative final that are half conceptual half mathematical. The problems are based on the case problems, which he provides ample examples on Blackboard. Put in the time to study for the test to do well.

He is a very nice guy and always willing to help, his classes are usually very interesting except when we do  the cases which are very confusing. There are 2 exams and one noncumulative final, he gives sample tests that are very helpful when studying, lastly there is a big group project. Enjoyable and fairly easy class, take him.
Great class, great professional. He is nice, polite, fun, clear and knowledgeable.
Loved Him.  He is the best.
hes an good guy..atleast for graduate students

If I could give him a 6/5 in rating, I would. Just had him for calculus. He is everything you would want in a teacher: BEYOND nice. Super understanding. Easy to listen to and explains things very well. He really cares about his students and if you have ever had an instructor where they make a class that is hard 10x more enjoyable, he is him. A+ guy
AWFUL. HE CANNOT TEACH AT ALL. he made it rocket science confusing and blindsides u with ur grade pos dont waste ur time
he is the nicest guy ever but he is so boring oh my goodness. it's unreal. you will not be able to focus and the class is so hard.

He teaches holding his head and screeching his beard. He has the most nonsense jokes ever. He looks like a character coming from GTA. If you have the chance, please take a class with this man. Your life will never be the same.
super nice guy he is just really hard to understand sometimes. On another note I'm not gay or anything but he is the most sweetest nicest guy out there.

One of the nicest professors at UMiami. Took his time teaching lectures, and made everything clear. He is always accessible out of class, and willing to go over past tests and quizzes. He also gives extra credit opportunities. Take him if you have the chance.

Overall Professor Gondim was great. He is super caring, very accessible outside of class, offers extra credit, and his classes are very straightforward. Grade is based on online homework + quizzes/tests. Pay attention and study the practice problems done in class and you'll be good!
You're not gonna like him at first but then he grows on you. He actually cares and makes the class super engaging. Good guy.

Professor Angeletti is not only amazing at teaching, but a genuine, kind, caring, and compassionate person. He takes the time to personally get to know every student no matter how big the lecture. His ability to foster personal relationships with all his students makes you WANT to engage and get excited about his class!

Great class and great professor. I am taking his section of Digital Marketing next semester because I enjoyed this class so much. Everyone seemed to enjoy the class and the professor really teaches from real-life experience which is makes the class interesting. I wasn't sure about doing a marketing minor until I took this class. He really cares!

If you have the chance to take this class, you should. Lectures are interesting and relevant. You can tell that he cares about his students' success and is always open to giving meaningful feedback. The projects you do prepare you for the kinds of things you do in the real world making them worthwhile. As a senior, best class I have taken at UM.
this professor makes the class feel way more uncomfortable than it needs to be.

Romain Angeletti is truly one of my favorite professors at UMIAMI. His high standards and VERY direct approach has pushed me to think more critically, communicate more clearly, and get out of my comfort zone. He deeply he cares about his students academic and professional growth. He is also really funny.

This class is not your average marketing class. Professor Angeletti treats students like colleagues, and expects professionalism. His class pushes you to go beyond content taught in class and build your work ethic skills, which is difficult to come across these days. I have learned so many lessons that I will carry with me throughout my career.

If you're gonna take a marketing course take it with him. His classes aren't only fun and entertaining but you will learn through hands on experiences. Everyone was genuinely sad when his class ended.

This was my favorite class this semester. Professor Angeletti truly cares about his students and wants us to actually understand and take something meaningful away from the class. He offers great feedback and advice. The social media project was also fun. Not a lot of work and there's no exams.

Professor Angeletti is great. He genuinely cares about his students' success. Provides clear and action oriented feedback, and is always open to thoughts/opinions from students. He doesn't just talk about the first most obvious answer, but helps uncovers the true meaning behind why we study marketing.

I didn't like him at first, but grew to appreciate him. He teaches the class like it's a real professional environment. He is really funny and sarcastic so don't take his comments to heart. I took a lot of his advice with me when making presentations. Not a lot of work and no tests/exams.

Professor Angeletti is an amazing professor. He genuinely cares about students learning and prepares them with useful skills for future careers. As someone with ADHD, he is able to lecture in a way that is engaging and helpful towards keeping students attention and promoting understanding. He is always willing to guide students in projects!!

This was my favorite class this semester. Prof. Angeletti is a great teacher. His classes are casual and engaging making it easy to learn. Participation is required but worth it. You'll learn a lot, and the lectures are interesting. He cares about students and gives good feedback. The main project was fun and insightful. Take his class if you can!

Honestly one of my favorite classes and professors at UM. Class consists of small slide shows and discussions. There are no tests. You mainly work on your final project the whole semester where you and a group need to make a Instagram profile and reach 500 followers. This project is super fun and interesting. Take this class if you can!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: By far one of the coolest professors I have ever had. Would take him again a million times. I learned a ton and the projects were relevant and informative.

Hands down one of the most insightful classes I have taken at UM so far. 
Professor Angeletti makes it interesting yet super informative, teaches you real life concepts.
Very fun group project at the end!
Once you show up and participate you will succeed!

This has genuinely been one of my favorite classes I've taken at UM so far. Classes are funny and entertaining which keeps everyone engaged. We had a couple projects scattered throughout the semester but don't worry - they were interesting and he gave great feedback. Would definitely recommended!!
One of the best professors I've ever had at UM! He's hilarious and cares about all his students. I would defintely recommend taking his class.

Amazing professor. He is very funny, casual and makes the class very entertaining.
Easy assignments and projects which also also graded easily and always come back with good feedback. Attendance is mandatory but he will excuse it as long as you email before
Would definitely recommend taking any one of his classes, especially digital marketing.

The class is very lecture heavy but the professor does a great job of making it entertaining. Its a super easy class and he grades nicely, you just NEED to go to class and get participation points (talking during class) I loved this class overall and would recommend!

At first, he seems intimidating, you even have to sign a no-phone waiver, but over time, he really becomes a friend. He pushes you to do your best, but never more than you can handle. He puts in the effort to help every student grow, always keeps the class laughing, and truly cares. I can't recommend him enough, an inspiring experience!

I loved this professor so much, he was very engaging and funny and discussions were a big part of the class. If you pay attention, YOU WILL DO WELL. I would totally recommend him, the projects were also fun. No exams.

One of the best professors at UM. Made the class and material very engaging. The majority of the class revolves around a social media project. Definitely a breath of fresh air in terms of teaching style compared to other professors. Highly recommend.
Professor Angeletti gives great lectures, making Digital Marketing an engaging and insightful experience. I learned a lot and would gladly take his course again!

Professor Angeletti is really nice! He will help you whenever you have problems, and he will take time to guide you. He also has great sense of humor, so the classes are not boring. No homework or exams for this course, just a group project and a social media audit, which are fun. Not so hard to get a good grade, enjoy the class time!
Great teacher. Looks for students to go out of the box and not just create cookie cutter assignments. Also cares about participation.
One of the most interesting classes I've took so far. The social media audit was kinda tough to do but if you want to start a career in digital marketing is really useful.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I loved prof. Angeletti. He really cares about his students and is very funny. I learned a lot and I would for sure take him again.

Professor Angeletti is my favorite. His unconventional teaching style, sense of humor, and focus on participation make the class engaging. There are no exams, just projects, and while expectations may be unclear at times, he's always responsive and genuinely cares about students' success. If you are considering this class, I advise you take it!

Professor Angeletti is great! He is pretty funny, so his lectures are engaging. There are no tests, which is nice, but the projects are time-consuming. It is a little hard to figure out what he is looking for when grading, but if you talk to him about your work, he will give you guidance. He can be a bit blunt, so be prepared for that.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Seems extremely tough but if you show up to class and participate... will be a great/informative semester!

Prof Angeletti is hilarious and made this class fun. The lectures can be a little boring, but your entire grade essentially comes from the social media campaign project (create an account + 500 followers). Talk to him after class and figure out EXACTLY what he's looking for in presentations. Graded on participation. Highly recommend, he was great!

He does not provide clear grading criteria for projects. Attendance is mandatory but his lectures feel like they are just trying to fill up class time. No exams or homework. A group project creating an IG account and personal projects doing a social audit. Participation in class is graded and mandatory. Easy class but no substance.

Good marketing teacher. His lectures had nothing to do with assignments and if you dont pay attention to them youll do just fine. He is very funny and will keep you entertained. This projects are fun to do and you create fake instagram page.

Professor Alonso cares about her students very much. I've always struggled with Math but she help me very much through out the course. There is homework but if you stay up to date it should be easy. Take her if you have the chance!!

Amazing professor to take if you struggle with Math, she is the most caring and helping professor and will explain as many times as you need, also you can tell she loves teaching by how she treats her students. honestly recommended 100%
Shes the nicest, most caring. Super easy to take her and always wants to help. recommended.
She was really nice but I agree she went super fast and it was hard to catch up.
Rude, not helpful, very passive aggressive while teaching and goes way too fast, don't recommend at all.

Taking this class at 8 AM was my first L. She's really nice, but the class is lecture-heavy and tests weigh a lot. I suck at math and had to take 101 twice, but I finally passed with her. Do the Pearson homework before class, go to office hours, and take advantage of the extra credit because it really helps! Final exam was easier than the 4 exams

Do not take her! She is a very nice and energetic person, but she becomes very condescending and passive-aggressive when we ask her questions. Her way of teaching is just solving equations on the board and very vaguely explaining her process. Her exams were way harder than anything we learned in class. Her grading is fair but the tests weigh heavy.
heavy accent you cannot understand her does not explain material at all. the whole class is confused. DO NOT TAKE HER. she sometimes does attendance, mostly does.

I love Professor Alonso! I took her for 099 and 101, and she's the sweetest. It's a lot of lectures, and I'm not good at math, but I learned a lot and got good grades. She curves grades a lot and gives extra credit and good study guides. She's really amazing, you just have to be willing to learn.

She's a sweet lady and clearly understands math very well, however her teaching methods are not the easiest to understand. I found her overcomplicating simple things. Has a pretty heavy accent and she speaks broken English, so that's up to you. The final was the easiest test of the whole semester. Do the hw/quizzes and you'll be fine.

Super sweet and also very caring and wants to make sure than all her student succeed. There were a lot of tests but the final was easier than I expected. Probably the best professor who teaches MTH101

very sweet professor and very understanding. Her way of grading syllabus is very forgiving; drops the worst test grade if final test grade is higher, drops 2 worst quiz grades for every student. pay attention in class and take her tips seriously. her test reviews are VITAL.

So engaging and brings so much energy to each class! Genuinely such a kind lady and really really cares about her students. PAY ATTENTION in class and do every homework and review multiple times (she gives EC on exams for 85%+ on exam review assignments) to study.

Had 099 &101 with her and those classes were a pain. If you are mathematically challenged like me you will struggle. She's nice, but her tests were always harder than the in-class reviews, and I never understood her lessons. She also won't email you back unless you ask her to check her emails in class. You'll be fine if you have a good math skills.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She was kind of rude, but she taught well and her methods actually helped. She was caring in the sense that she would help if you are confused, however she did it in a way that felt condescending. I am also very easily embarrassed, so I never felt comfortable asking questions in her class.

Do not take her class. You WILL have to learn the material by yourself. She skims every topic and states "so easy" right after. The exams make up all the grade. Her accent is very heavy. The only plus is that she is sometimes understanding but sassy. If you would like to fail, go ahead.

Four exams, online hw/ quizzes, and a final. As someone who was is bad at math she explained things like no math teacher has before. Listen to her methods and math will not make you want to rip your hair out. She's very sweet but if you don't know the topics make sure to show up every day, do your hw consistently and you'll do great. Take her!

She is a very cool professor. Lots of homework, but it does help to prepare for the exams. 4 exams, 10 quizzes, and the two lowest quiz grades are dropped. Can be hard to access outside of class. Her tests have no make-ups (i had to come in after a wisdom tooth surgery). Other than that, she's a good professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Great Professor. The class has lots of homework and is made up of four exams plus the final, but she teaches you everything you need to know. She takes attendance in every class and really cares for her students.
Cares about her students and is willing to slow down and help. Sometimes messes up her own problems or changes them mid equation. Gives lots of partial credit on exams

She's hard to understand some times and she can be a little rude. However, she is caring of her students and makes sure they understand every concept. Attendance isn't mandatory and all you really need is the extra credit review to do good on the exams.
She can be a little hard to understand sometimes, but honestly, if you just show up to the class review for the test, that is all that matters.

Professor Alonso is a great instructor who takes the time to explain concepts clearly. She's patient and ensures students understand. However don't miss class, her lectures are essential, and if you do, you'll likely feel lost. If you miss one, make sure to catch up quickly.

Professor Alonso is a great instructor who takes the time to explain concepts clearly. She's patient and ensures students understand. However, don't miss class, her lectures are essential, and if you do, you'll likely feel lost. If you miss one, make sure to catch up quickly.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She's such a sweet and wonderful teacher. You can tell she wants the best for her students. She explains things very well and her exam grading is very fair. She will try to give you the most points as possible. She gives extra points on the exam. She is very understanding as well. Attendance is important if you want to succeed

super sweet woman one of the worst teachers I've ever had. I haven't payed attention to a single class and teacher my self everything but I also took this math in 8th grade. So this class is kinda a joke but for kids who acutally have no idea and have never seen this stuff before they are honestly probably screwed cuz there not gonna learn it

Not only does she struggle as a teacher, but her lack of compassion is concerning. I missed three weeks of school due to a family emergency, and despite informing her in advance, she refused to allow me to make up any work. Her teaching style is frustrating; she primarily works through problems on the board at her own pace.
she cool and super nice

She is the best, she helps you on the test if you don't remember something (not like Leticia Oropesa), she grades SO FAIR, I had so many wrong answers and still gives you credit on your exams for trying. There's a lot of homework in my math lab but she gives extra credit on the exams if you do the review tests.

She is honestly a great lady however she can't teach! She made simple concepts much harder than they needed to be and you have to do it how she teaches it. Class is very boring and she rushes through the lectures without really answering questions. She also loves to call people out by name so that is something to be mindful of!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I love Maria Alonso! I took her in MTH099 and again this semester because I love her that much! She is the sweetest and always engaged with me. The homework on is much more difficult than the problems we did in class and that were on the tests. Attendance is sometimes taken, depending on if she wants you to actually want to learn the material.

Honestly such a nice and genuine woman, but if math is a hard subject for you, you'll probably have to teach yourself a bit because she teaches really fast, however she's always willing to help you. She really wants all her students to succeed. Her tests are really short and she basically says everything that's going to be on it.

She is very nice and understanding. Gives extra credit for tests and explains the questions that will be on the exam. Does multiple review days. Her tests are multiple-choice and some written questions. If you are looking to do MTH 101 she is a good option.
She is SO KIND however if you are like me and you struggle in math take someone else's class. She moves EXTREMELY fast and does not teach as much as review concepts she expects you to already know.
Great overall.

She's amazing! I loved her class so much. Not only because I found her thick Spanish accent, familiar and amusing. She states directly what type of questions she will put on the exam. The homework assignments were super helpful. You can tell that she really does care about her students! She provides a lot of extra points on exams, if you were close

Really sweet lady who will help you if you ask but she does make you feel dumb. She does go fast, but if you do the online assignments you should get the material. Online quizzes frequently, around seven online practice assignments for each topic, and exams are about thirteen questions long. You have to pay for a digital textbook.

She is a very caring professor. She moves at a very fast pace and doesnt give a lot of warnings about quizzes (usually emails about them on Friday when they are due on Sunday night). However her tests are not challenging and if you do the work and keep up then you should do well in the course.
Has no idea how to teach. You need to teach yourself to do well in her class. take a different teacher

She is a very nice person, don't get me wrong. She has quizzes before homework is even posted. She lectures and makes no sense. Questions, don't bother asking because she will make you feel dumb. Her accent is think and at times hard to understand. Although she is very nice, she has no idea how to teach. The class is math 101 not calculus.

To be honest, she's a bit condescending and she goes very fast. She'll repeat what she said or show a problem again, but if your participation isn't high in general--she makes you feel dumb for your question.

So sweet and cares if you show that you do too. Stay on top of everything and grading is pretty fair. She isn't the best at explaining and the topics are difficult. Might have to watch a couple of youtube videos because lectures aren't clear. Doesn't answer emails so hard to communicate with.

She has a Spanish accent which can sometimes affect the lecture but 90% percent of the time it is not a problem. Really explained the course material and very approachable in terms of any questions you may have. However she did go over topics very quickly and would cover multiple topics in a single class, so keep up.
I liked professor Alonso. Try to go talk to her after class and get to know her. She is really king and if you got o every class you will get a good grade.

Alonso is a great person, really kind. She has no teaching skills, she just lectures and doesn't take the time to see if everyone is understanding. She doesn't even give time to copy the problem. If math isn't your strongest, and you need to really understand, don't take class with her. Extra credit is given and lots of homework.

Prof. Alonso is such a great person and professor. If you go to class and participate it would help you to understand the material better! I enjoyed this class very much! Prof. Alonso cares about her students and is willing to go out and beyond for them which is rare. Take her if you can!

Professor Alonso was good. Her lectures were easy to follow, but she tends to go fast. If this is a subject you struggle with that can make it difficult. There are online hw assignments for each lesson and they are easy 100s. Alonso taught well and was straightforward. There are many extra credit opportunities w/ participation being one of them.

Alonso sucks. Bottom line is that you end up teaching yourself the material. It was very easy at the start, but then she got into difficult concepts towards the end of the semester and she was all over the place. Her accent is thick so have fun trying to understand what she teaches and with that, you are left in shambles by the final. DONT TAKE HER

As someone with a lot of math experience, this class was very easy for me. However, I can understand how one would struggle if it was their first time being exposed to the topics. She was pretty unclear during her lectures. Class had 4 exams, 8 quizzes, a final, and hw nearly every day. Gave EC opportunities for every exam. Very caring professor!

Professor Alonso is such a sweet woman and her care for her students is very heartwarming. As a professor, I think that she did a good job with teaching, but I could see how there may have been some gaps of knowledge had you not been prepared beforehand. There was a lot of math homework and quizzes, but it is a math class so that is expected.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Alonos is a very very sweet woman but not a great professor if you aren't naturally good at math. SO much homework and many online quizzes that she does not always remind you of so it's easy to miss the deadline. Tests are very hard. She's super sweet and is very willing to help you but is just not a great teacher. Try not to take her
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: NOOOOOOOO so bad, like so bad. Being online made it that much harder to understand her. Made the final in-person, wore a Christmas tree outfit. you literally cannot understand her at all. So many quizzes and tests. like its math 101, chill

Professor Alonso is very sweet, but is not the best professor. This was the hardest class I took last semester and I basically had to teach myself because her way of teaching is confusing and hard to follow along. Lots of homework and quizzes that are all online. Take with another professor if possible.

Professor Alonso is a sweetheart. You can tell she's passionate about math which I have rarely see in math professors. she has an accent but its not hard to follow along. There is a good amount of hw's but you have a lot of time to do them. The hw really helps with the quizzes and exams. She gives easier ways to do math problems too. I recommend!

She is very caring about her students, however, she explains simple math in a very complex way and makes it harder than it has to be. Her accent also might make it difficult at times to understand what she is saying.

After reading everyone elses review Im not sure we all took the same Professor. Mrs. Alonso was the kindest Professor, very approachable, comprehensive and nice. Theres a lot of topics to cover, a lot of quizes, homework and tests are HARD! But that does not make her a bad Professor. Thats the math departments fault, do not blame her on it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: One of the worst classes I have ever taken. I strongly advise to not take this professor. Will get mad at you for not asking questions/doing poorly on a test, then when you ask questions, will make you feel like youre stupid. 4 tests + the final, 8 quizzes, and about 50 homework assignments. All online. This is very much a self-taught course.

This is the worst and most stressful class I have ever taken. Online math is a joke. So many assignments. Lockdown browser and taking tests is a mess. No not take this class online. I am forced to teach myself now because she can not teach and what was taught to us on our zoom was never on the tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Very unapproachable and inpatient. Despises questions, especially when it's about her quiz and exam dates being completely wrong. If you value your sanity, run.
She's sweet, but sweet doesn't equate to good teaching. Explains math in a very confusing way. I would recommend taking anyone else
Try to take any other professor if possible.

The class had homework everyday online. There was a quiz every chapter and a test per two chapters. The grading was always straightforward since it was math. You had to purchase the homework website subscription. The attendance was graded and her teaching style was very understanding. She explained if you needed but sometimes it was confusing.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She is really nice and extended deadlines a few times for the class. However, if you haven't taken math in a while or it's not your strongest subject, you may have trouble with how fast she teaches and her accent. I had to teach myself a lot of the material. Exams make up almost all of the grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Mrs. Alonso is the kindest and most loving teacher I've had. She cares about her students so much and all she asks for is that you attend class and complete the assignments on time. I finally love math because of her! If you care about passing the course from the beginning and show her respect you will have an incredible experience in this course.

She's a very nice lady but has a strong accent. You'll get used to it after a while. She uses MyMathLab for the quizzes & hw. Just stay on top of it b/c the assignments have due dates & can add up quickly. she extended some deadlines for us a couple of times. She gives extra credit if you complete the review for each exam. Very lenient with grading
Professor was caring and really wanted to educate her students. On the other hand, she was hard to understand and seemed to favorite her students. Also hard to reach out to after class.

Professor Alonso is a sweet and caring lady. She has a strong accent and hard at times to understand. Book was not required. Reviews are similar to exams, and she usually goes over the review a day before the exam. Quizzes and homework do count towards your grade. She helps and motivates all of her students.

THE BEST!!! I have taken Dr. Susy for multiple classes now and absolutely love her. (Literally enrolled in two more for this upcoming semester). She is so inspirational and knowledgeable. Not to mention, she gets it done, like she's such a queen.

Love Susy. My 2nd class with her and she's an easy A. You gain so much from her: advice, connections and real application. She truly loves her students. Her class was just listening to diff UM alum entrepreneurs and writing a 1 pager after. There were also simulations where you ran a business due before every class. Take her any chance you get!!!
Amazing professor, super kind and fun to listen to. Would recommend to anyone. Has been in business for many years, and has a lot of knowledge and stories to share.

She is my favorite professor at UM. I always learn so much taking her classes. I also really enjoyed the guest lectures. You have to take her, especially if you are interested in becoming an entrepreneur. Attendance is mandatory, but most of the time, she would let the students leave early. She also gave some extra credit opportunities.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is absolutely amazing. She really cares for her students and actually teaches you things that will pertain to your career. She is more than willing to use any resources and relationships at her disposal to help you succeed. And to make it even better, she dresses like a badass.
One of the best professors at UM. Extremely outgoing and funny, definitely take her if you have the chance.

Professor Alvarez is the best! Her class consists of guest speakers who come talk to the class and weekly assignments based on the lectures. It is so easy to pass and there is no final exam, only a paper. Definitely take her!!

2 tests and a group project based on powerpoints that are very reasonable, she is sweet and always tries to make class fun, taking her for another class right now, always uses real world examples that are so interesting

100% recommended. I have taken all classes taught by Susy. She gives you energy, inspire you and guide you for life success. Genuine & hilarious, in this class, she brings guest speakers (usually UM alumnis) in every class who give lectures about how their professional career (usually has to do with startups) and personal advice. It's amazing!!!!!

Susy is my favorite professor at UM. She is smart and poised, and makes lectures so enjoyable. She brings to much energy to the classroom, and shes also not too shabby to look at. She is beautiful and well-accomplished. She puts thoughts into her assignments and is always happy to help. If you show an active effort, you'll get an A. She rocks

Susy is really nice and well connected in the Miami area, especially with UM alum.  The course was interesting as it provided some real-world experience, but the class itself didn't offer much in terms of content.

Do whatever you can to take a class with Susy as early as you can because you're going to want to take her again for everything.  Susy treats her students like they are her children and she wants them to succeed in school and more importantly life after school. She shows this by giving them everything she has from her teaching techniques to advice.
Undoubtedly the best professor at UM, a teaching wonder.

Great professor, laid back but you can really learn a lot. Not your typical "study the textbook" class in any of the 3 I've taken with her. Definitely would take again. She really cares about her students and is very understanding

Extremely easy class (took it once a week at night, had a guest speaker every time) Really informative and you learn cool stuff however you grade is never clear. There are no tests but grading is based on competing with others in the class (which i didn't find fair at all). Teacher is very nice tho!! no group projects
Excellent professor
She is great, you should absolutely take her. She is clear and is there for you. Also, she will help you with anything you ask for and her class are participative and fun. 100% recomendation.

One of, if not the best teacher I had at UM. Friendly, knowledgeable, funny, and professional all at the same time. She can be a mentor, friend, a professor, and expert networker. If you pay attention and ask her questions she will always go out of her way to help you. She cuts to the chase without b.s. and is very real.
Great teacher and a even better woman.  She will spend time with you to help you understand what is expected and makes class extremely enjoyable.  Take her.  She's nice and hott

You can walk away with a lot from this class depending on what you do post graduation. She teaches you how to incorporate everything you have learned thus far into analysis as a consultant and apply it to a real company. Highly recommend. Perfect mix or classroom, group work, and co-op opportunity. Yes, she's hot too.

Perfect combination of real-world experience and academics. The curriculum and presentation scenarios are what you would encounter in day-to-day business. If you want lots of definitions and abstract managerial theory, then find someone else. However, if you want to be challenged in how you think about business this is the professor you want.

Here is the key to all of her classes: Find someone who has taken her before, and take their old assignments. She NEVER changes her curriculum, its the same every semester. When shes grading, she looks for a VERY SPECIFIC FORMAT,if anything is missing, she will harshly grade you down. Don't expect her to spend more than 10 seconds grading your work

big business plan to present in groups at the end of the semester...teaches straight from the book and must participate in class - basically the class is taught by students rather than the other way around
No Comments
must participate in class, big business plan and presentation at the end of class; must be done in groups
The best!!! Dr. A is super knowledgeable, caring, and hilarious. I would take his class again 100%. He is the best BUS 300 prof by far.

Knowledgeable, helpful, caring. He practices law outside of teaching, if you show up and do the work he WILL teach you to think/write more critically. if you fear public speaking like I used to, this is the professor to take. After this semester I have no anxiety or care in the world regarding public speaking. Could not be happier with results.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Alexandrakis is a great teacher. He is a nice guy and really cares about his students. Class consists of 3 oral presentations (35%), 3 writing assignments (40%), and attendance and participation points (25%). The class actually helps you improve presentation and writing skills. Only complaint is that he is a VERY slow grader. Take him!

Alexandrakis has been my favorite professor this semester. He cares a lot about his students and it's obvious he really enjoys his job. Is very technical with how he likes things done but if you follow all of his instructions you'll do great. Interesting material and makes assignments appealing to students. Love him!!
BEST PROFESSOR EVER. he genuinely cares and wants his students to succeed. he gives very constructive criticism and has engaging lectures. take him he is the goat

Professor Platon Alexandrakis is an amazing professor. The workload may feel heavy, and he provides a lot of instructions, as he likes everything done a specific way. However, you will learn a lot! He really focuses on your final work—if you put in A-level effort at the end, you'll get the A. Truly an amazing professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Knows exactly what she's doing. Would highly recommend her!

Professor Alam was an amazing professor, cares about her students, and is very engaging. She was very flexible, an easy grader, and VERY sweet. Good class for extra credit, would highly recommend her! Although the syllabus says that attendance is mandatory, she only counts some days. The BEST of the BEST!!!

She is VERY caring and the sweetest professor ever!!! Professor Alam made every lecture very interesting and interactive. I never felt bored in her class. She gives real world examples which made things easy to understand. Although attendance is mandatory, she sometimes does not count it. I would definitely take her another course!!!

This is a great class! Professor Alam is The BEST!!! She cares about her students and brings lots of real life examples from her job experiences. There are so many extra credits, and lectures are very easy to understand. I would definitely take another course with her!!
While professor cares about his students, if you are not going to attend classes it can be challenging to catch up with the material. Read new topics in advance to understand the subject in depth.

The professor clearly wants students to succeed and is helpful during office hours. I found the lectures difficult to follow at times, and the grading felt strict. Be prepared to study consistently and make use of office hours. This was a challenging Calc II course, but extra effort can make a difference.
Professor did a good job explaining the material. PPT slides were uploaded regularly which is a huge plus. Quizzes helped to prepare for exams.

Your grade is 60% divided up into three exams that are each worth 20%. The final is worth 30% and homework is worth 10% of your grade and it is a 5 week course. However, the prof made it way harder, the first two exams more than half of the class couldn't even finish and the problems were way harder than hws or study guides. Avoid taking if u can.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: All he does is solve problems and reads off slides. The reviews are NOTHING like the exams. The problems on the exams are way more complex than anything he teaches. He says there's 10-15 questions but 2 of them are multiple choice and the rest are like at least 5 part open answer questions and 70% of the class doesn't finish the exam on time.
I took it with another professor last semester and got F. Going for B this time around! Strongly recommend him!

I wouldn't recommend him for calc 2. He seems like a nice guy, which I'll give him, but his class wasn't great. His exams were very difficult and would often test on things he hadn't covered yet. He didn't really seem to care that students were struggling and told us to "give up". He also tends to overcomplicate things. Prepare to struggle.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Don't take this course if you have a hard time self-teaching. Nice guy but hard to understand what he says and overexplains. Good for Calc 1, but can't say the same for Calc 2.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I took AP Calc in hs and was expecting this course to be easy but realistically MTH161 is hard. I think he was a great professor tho - goes somewhat slow but keeps organized. 3 exams and 7 quizzes (2 drop) so its hard to maintain strong grade with weaker units. Overall I think he provides lots of practice but you def have to do a lot outside.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: It was very much a self-teach class. You do the HWs, 7 quizzes, drop 2 of them, and 3 exams, and there is extra credit/ curve per the department. Fell behind in teaching, so the exams did not cover what should have been covered. Expects you to already know calculus. and pre-calc.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The professor is very nice and wants you to do well. However this was one of the most impossible classes I've taken but I think that is just Calc 161 in general. Only 3 tests so it is super easy to fail.
Good professor. The class itself is just difficult. Grading is fair.

One of the worst professors I've had at UM, take any other professor but him. He writes more definitions and theorems than solving actual problems and doing examples, so we have very few problems to go off of. We are super behind other calc 1 classes and nothing he says during lectures makes sense, even those who have taken calc before are confused
He does overexplain sometimes to make sure everybody understands the material. I would rather he gives quiz every week.
Over explain and can't really do it correctly. Respectfully advise to take another teacher. He is also reluctant to help.

He seems largely indifferent to whether students succeed. He even said, “If you do poorly on the first exam, just give up,” which felt discouraging. Explanations are often unclear, and problems take him a long time to solve despite strict exam time limits. Consider other Calc II options.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He really wants you to understand what he's teaching you and will continuously ask if anyone has any questions, if you are confused about something he'll break it down very simply. The only reason I got a C was because I barely studied for the exams since I was dealing with Physics 1 with Fulin... Anyway he's an overall great teacher!

lots of hw. teaches calc 1 as a refresher course and not a normal class. even if u took calc 1 in high school take this class seriously because it varies a lot from AP. exams are difficult and final is one huge classroom with multiple sections. He drops 2 quizzes and ur lowest exam grade can be replaced with the final tho
Had him for Calc I. Nice guy, clear lectures, and good review sessions. Took calc before but definitely learned more.

lectures are pretty good if you focus. His study guides are great practice for exams. However, the exams tended to be very long and difficult to finish in the time given. These exams require complete simplifications of fractions and radicals which lead to non calc mistakes. He cares more than other math profs but is such a slow grader.
teaches the material as though you have already seen everything, but very willing to help outside of class

But what was that final exam? No wonder someone tried cheating Ali is a picky grader U must write the way he wants or deducted points, even if correct, even if his instruction didn't tell you to write it a certain way. He is very funny. As a person he is sweet, but his grading gave me a migraine every time Overall Good! he is opened to regrading

Horrible teacher. Dude told me to drop the class when I was struggling with 3 homework problems. I got a 4 on AP Calc AB so I thought this class would be a breeze, nope. Lectures were unhelpful and often confused me more. I had to teach myself everything. Shoutout Armenian Prince, Pre-Med, and Cologne Warrior that got caught cheating on the final.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor is one of the best at the University of Miami. He provides review package before every test and clearly explains every topic. If you don't miss classes and focus on the material you will definitely succeed.
I enjoyed Dr. H's lectures; he teaches the course well. Was easy B+ for me
Excellent teacher who knows his subject.

If you are taking his ONLINE course, prepare to lock in. The structure itself being an online accelerated course makes it hard. there are 5 grades. 3 exams (20% of your grade), the final (30%), and homework (10%). there is little room for error. The professor genuinely cares, but is not the easy route. Even though its online, its not cheatable ngl.

This professor is one of the worst at UM. Dr. H teaches as if it's a refresher course, assuming prior calculus knowledge he never covers. He rarely answers emails, and his grading is inconsistent—missing one part on a quiz can mean a huge point loss. Avoid him unless you're already strong in calculus.

I took him for MTH 107 and now MTH 161. He is nice person and means well, but he can be a stickler about random things. He is a good teacher though and you can certainly do very well if you study. Do the review exams, they are usually similar/ harder than the exams. Gave 9 quizzes and drops 3. You must go to class to stay on top of material.
He's alright. Expects you to know some material in advance. Helps if you go to his office hours. He's j really annoying in class but somewhat funny.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I don't understand why Dr. Ali has such mixed reviews. He is an amazing proffesor that really cares about the material and students. He expects you to have a good background before entering the class which is reasonble. There is a textbook but you can get an A without it. Easy class if you actually put in the work, would 100% recommend taking him.
I do really like the guy as a person but as someone who didn't already take a calc class in high school I absolutely bombed this class. Taught like a refresher course.

Great professor that cares about his students, but he expects you to have a solid background in the course material beforehand. Lots of homework but you're given plenty of time to complete it. As long as you take the lecture notes and engage in his examples you'll do fine.
Was great at explaining things and cared about students. Lots of homeworks but they're doable. If you try you will pass

Such a chill professor but most of the time, at least for me, you kinda have to teach everything yourself. He's good at explaining concepts but if you're not originally good at math this will be a highly difficult class mainly because of the material. Also, LOTS of quizzes, so make sure you stay on top of everything.

Calculus 1 is a hard class and if you try to breeze by without studying, you won't get a good grade. Professor Ali is great at explaining concepts thoroughly, but he doesn't dumb anything down and expects you to have a strong base in precalculus. 3 tests and final make up over 80% of your grade and if you study review guides you will do well.

Nice guy, but he spent sm time writing out the definitions of the topic and less time actually solving problems, only did like 2 problems a class and we fell behind in the material. Promised a week of review for each test and that never happened. Still will get an A but feel like a different professor may have been better

My first time learning calculus ever, made the mistake of chosing Dr. Ali. He explains the material to the class as if everyone is a genius and this is just review. He's super fast when teaching & during office hours as if he's in a rush. His exams are also super lengthy and difficult. Take someone else if possible.

calc in general is tough in UM. he was one of the first prof to give exams out & our last mid-term exam was given on a regular day rather than during discussion. he does try to help as much as possible and does do review sessions twice before exam. he doesn't record his lectures & only solves problems from the textbook. gave 9 quizzes, dropped 3.

I was scared to take him after seeing his reviews but he really isn't that bad. The bad reviews are only from kids who didn't put in the work. He is very caring and honestly explains stuff pretty well and wants to help his students. If you took pre-calc in high school this class will be easy. Study reviews, they're v similar/harder than the exams.

Took attendence when he felt like it. The way he teaches is weird and not very helpful. Graded hard if you didnt follow his exact steps. Had a classmate go to him and asked what she can do to not fail this class, he said too bad thats college for you.

Calc 1 at UM is notoriously hard, Dr. Ali does his best to help students but is not a great lecturer at all. Doesn't like stupid questions but is very caring/understanding with students when it comes to missing quizzes or needing help. Recently did three 2 hour long review sessions in 1 week for our last exam. Goes out of his way to help like that

Calculus 1 is a difficult class to learn. However Dr. Ali made it so easy. Not only does he teach the curriculum well, he is also really accessible after class. Whenever we had a test, he will do study sessions until 11 pm at night. He is dedicated towards his students and wants everyone to pass. If you have the opportunity, please take him!

I was scared to take Dr Ali because of his reviews but he is surprisingly very good! I took precalc in the past so I have seen these concepts before, but if you go to class, pay attention and study the review before the test you will be just fine. He is a nice guy and wants his students to do well. He is clear with the material while teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr.Ali is a nice guy and knows his stuff but I somehow failed his class. I am VERY good at math and managed to flop. He did a great job explaining basic concepts (derivatives) but anything past that, I did not understand. I had no idea how to do application/ word problems or graphing problems before the exam. I dont recommend.

If you actually pay attention and do the study guides you will pass this class. There are never any trick questions that you would not have expected. Professor Ali is very knowledgable and makes Calc 1 topics super easy to grasp. I was worried that after taking Pre-calc I would struggle in this class but he has made it more than tolerable!
Professor Ali was great and very knowledgeable. He was clear on the criteria. If you actually put in the work in his class you WILL pass.

Prof. Ali moves very fast through the material. He is a nice guy but repeatedly, concepts were left unclear. He also grades very hard and you have to meticulously write solutions exactly how he wants them on tests or you'll get a lot of points off. It's not an impossible class but definitely challenging.
Good g

Dr. Ali is a great teacher, most people who say bad things about him either didn't come to class or didn't pay attention. He goes through subjects thoroughly and slows down when asked. Quizzes every week and every class is stuffed with information, but as long as you ask questions when you're confused, you'll be fine.

I took dr Ali for precal, I came from high school in New Mexico so I never took precal in high school. (Got an A because of his teaching) He is a great teacher who teaches how he would solve problems, in other words he makes hard topics simple, which is rare.Super caring and clearly loves what he does. His exams are always exactly like the review.

Means well but can't explain our teach simple concepts which makes it hard for kids taking calculus for the first time. Tests are very heavy in this class and he is harsh when grading so make sure to be careful when taking assessments to remember notation. Says attendance is mandatory but will never take it.
I was surprised by the rate other students gave. I like him a lot and you can really tell he cares about students always. ON the process but I think I will be fine with this course.
Really good at explaining things.  He is passionate about what he teaches and will bend over backwards to help you, if you show interest. Strongly recommend!
nice guy and tries to teach but he's just an awful teacher. avoid.
I wish I took him last semester. Super nice and understanding
Thought Ali was terrible while taking him, but taking MTH 162 now shows that he really isn't that bad compared to some of the other professors in the math department.

Dr. Ali was not my favorite professor, but you can tell he does actually care about his students. He hosted at least one or more review sessions before each exam. He didn't always explain things the best way and I definitely would have struggled in this class if I hadn't already taken precalc in high school, but I would take him again if I had to.

His class wasn't super difficult in my opinion, but I feel like he didn't always convey topics very well in lectures. I would have had a much harder time in this class if I hadn't previously taken similar classes in high school.

The only review you need. Attendance is mandatory on discussion days. Always a quiz on discussion days. There is a lot of tests and quizzes in this class. This class goes really fast so its important to stay on top of your stuff. Professor grades hard on tests. I wouldn't recommend but if you put in the work you'll see results.
He wasn't the best but explained the material fine. Super nice and understanding! Hw extensions would be a plus.
super tough grader, and you can get the same material from just reading the textbook. avoid if you can.
Ali was the man. His lessons taught me a lot more calculus than previous teachers. He is super caring and understanding. it would be a shame if you had the opportunity to take him and don't.

Does a terrible job explaining how he gets to the answer, and seldom can actually answer any questions you may have. Harsh grader on assessments. Incredibly difficult to get a good grade in this class and impossible to comprehend the material without using Youtube videos to make up for his poor teaching.

I will say he does truly care about his students and their success. He is flexible with test dates, and always has review sessions before tests. However, he just isn't a good teacher. He reads from the textbook and just copies it onto the whiteboard. I wouldn't recommend him, but it's not the end of the world if you're willing to put in the effort.

Dr ali is super nice but terrible teacher. you can tell he tries to explain but he literally can't. His class is so hard the quizzes and tests literally don't make any sense and you can never tell when they are coming, he will literally tell you a couple of days before. The homework is pointless and so long for no reason.

Prof. Hagverdiyev is mediocre at best. Half of the time he shows up late and he doesn't know how to explain the material. He just reads from whatever guide the math department gives him and copies it onto the board. There have been multiple times when he has been wrong explaining a problem, has gotten confused, and has been corrected by a student.

RUN AWAY FROM THIS PROFESSOR!!!

This teacher doesn't know how to explain the material. In addition to that, he doesn't have patience to help the students individually. This class is a chaos and everyone is lost learning nothing about math. Don't take him if you really care about your grades and GPA.

I took him for MTH151 not 61. He know his stuff but isn't the best at holding attention. I think he's good not great. Would take him again but not first choice. I got burned on tests 2 and 3 for timing and now I NEED to do great on the final to pass.

Ended up teaching myself most of the material as he doesn't know how to answer questions from students and can never properly explain concepts well in the first place. His tests/quizzes are significantly harder than the review questions and gives out hours worth of homework a week.

In my opinion Dr. Ali was a great professor who really cares about his students. His office hours were extremely helpful and he would solve tons of problems in class. Definitively would chose him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: He was a relatively new teacher and it was pretty apparent. His lectures could be confusing but he tried really hard to help the class understand. if you go to class, study, and are somewhat competent you will do fine. A lot of the class struggled, but the class was empty when there wasn't an exam. Take the other reviews with a grain of salt.

The quizzes which you do really well on end up not mattering at all, 75% of your grade is based on 3 impossible exams and if you don't do well on one, you're basically toast. Dr. H is very confusing and can't even solve his own examples relying on students to do it for him, plus 90% of my homework for the week was from him.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Probably the best calculus 1 professor, but unfortunately the grades are done by the entire department. Dr. Ali really tried in his lectures, but the speed of the course makes it extremely difficult to learn. Youll never see as massive so much panic on campus as the day of the Calc 1 exam. Literally no curve and haven't heard higher than a C+.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class was really difficult for me honestly. I think since he was a new professor at UM, he wasn't used to many things. He teaches fine, but sometimes the tests are a bit difficult. However, he is really nice and always gives extra points. He will probably get better after this semester, to be honest.

Dr. Ali is a good guy who means well. I took Calc AB in high school and was able to skip mostif not allmy lectures. I only went to class on days where we had quizzes/exams, and taught myself the course content (since it was review). He teaches straight from the textbook, so it's easy to take notes on your own. Posts good review before exams.
3 extremely hard tests where the lowest is replaced by final, quizzes every other week, tons of HW, got an A in calc in HS and still couldn't understand anything in this class

This class was terrible. Does not know how to teach. Feels like he's just doing math for fun and we are just watching. The whole class could fail an exam and no curve is given and he blames it on only a few bad scores. Take this class if you want to spend every day crying while teaching yourself how to do the math through mathway. Do not recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Ali has trouble with explaining simple topics, and the lectures move fast. A review is provided before every exam that correlates with the test. There is a lot of homework online that does not always correlate with the exam. Show up to class, take notes, do the exam reviews, and you should have success in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Sometimes can make it difficult learn what is going on in class, but answers questions if you ask. Decent amount of homework given online, but doesn't always correlate to the quizzes/tests given in class (1 per week). Even with calc experience in the past, I still had to teach myself material in order to understand how to do the tests.

Overall, there are definitely better professors you can take for math 161. He rushes through lectures, and does not explain the lesson clearly. There is a quiz every other week, and everyone is unsure what is going to be on it. Exams are difficult, but gives a review thats related to the test. Take at your own risk.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Super 1nappropriate and unprofesional. Honestly just mean.
Intense and rude

This was the worst class I ever took at UM. The prof has CLEAR favorites and the quality of your class experience will depend heavily on whether or not you are one of them. Made rude, snarky comments about absent students. She's very experienced, but not enough to behave the way she does. She breaks the same rules she expects students to follow..

Extremely unprepared for a professor. Always showed up late and checked phone during class despite getting mad at students for doing the same. Has clear favorites and doesn't try to hide it.  Made us come to class 30 minutes early on presentation days because of poor time management and still  dismissed us late. Feedback was unclear and unhelpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Way too complex of a teacher, and has too much due for class forgetting we have other classes as well. Not supportive and made my class experiences difficult. I wish she would understand we are students and are here to learn, but does not have to be as strict and hard as she is.

Blau is definitely one of the most cut throat professors in the ad program, but I learned the most from her. She really prepares her students to be fantastic art directors and is all around a great professor. I took her for STC 390, STC 490, and STC 492 and never was disappointed. Definitely take her classes if you're serious about art direction.

Yes, she's incredibly good at what she does and really challenges you to be better, but by far the most demanding class. Nothing is ever good enough for her unless she favors you. She picks favorites and its obvious who they are. She told the class about someone's health problems while doing critique and it was so rude & uncomfortable. yikes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She gave too much work and with really high expectations. This class is gonna most of your time.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She's one of the toughest, most demanding teachers I've ever met. But she's also incredibly good at what she does and she knows how to pull your best work out of you. Get ready to work a ton.
Hardest class I have taken, but I have learned more about how to be a good creative than I could have ever imagined. Just make sure you do the work, and you won't regret it!

incredibly passionate teacher! she is incredibly demanding from you and expects alot, prepare to dedicate allot of time to this, between making a 30 second commercial to building a full website theres allot of things to do. keep in mind that this class assumes a high level of competency regarding the adobe creative suite

This professor expects way too much out of inexperienced students. This class takes up most of your time in which you spend trying to figure out how to use the programs. For those of you thinking it is just an introductory class, I suggest you take another course. The class consists of 3 major projects using photoshop, illustrator, and indesign, sh

Well, I think she is a good teacher but her expectations are too high. Too much work, she assumes students don't have other classes or even a life. If you take this class you must be psychological prepared and ready for tons of exhausting work.
She is an amazing teacher. My favorite at UM so far. She makes you work hard but is very helpful and willing to meet. Made me LOVE advertising so much more

Class is okay, he tricks you on test by asking questions of material that he only spoke about for a brief second in class. Material is mostly memorization, open book for online classes, curves a lot for in person ones.
