reviews.comment: Great professor! Made concepts easy to understand through analogies and interactive activities. Assignments every couple of weeks based on the content learned in class to solidify understanding. Really nice guy too! You don't need a ton of coding background to be successful in this class since he teaches from the basics.

AMAZING PROFESSOR! I loved taking his class. The lectures are easy to understand and fun. He uses student engagement in his lectures through demos or games to keep everyone engaged. Projects were very straight forward and he is available to help during office hours. Overall great Prof. and a great class. I hope to take more classes with him!
GOAT
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Rudolph is great! His teaching style is very interactive. He makes lectures interesting and easy to follow. I learned a lot from this class. His grading criteria is very clear and he's always willing to help. He cares about student needs and one of the nicest professors I've ever had. 100% would take again and definitely recommend!

Love Professor Rudolph. Great guy. Even if you don't know how to code, he starts from ground up so everyone is able to follow along and learn a lot. This class is pretty much just learning Unity game engine, so a lot of fun. There are project/assignments once every few weeks that are very manageable and he gives you class time to complete as well.

Dr. Baker is a great professor who genuinely cares about his students' success. Definitely a challenging and time-consuming class. Exams are all free response, but you can earn back up to half the points you missed if you go to office hours and explain what you got wrong. There is extra credit on exams, plus participation points and assignments.
Very kind and genuinely wants students to succeed. Exams are based on canvas quizzes and lectures- if you put in the work you will succeed.

I liked Professor Baker both as a teacher and person. This class was based 80% on exams and 20% from homework completion. Exams aren't difficult if you rewatch the lectures very intensely -- I spent 3 days before the exams rewatching and writing lectures word for word. DONT buy the textbook. Exams scaled to the highest grade, about 8-12% added

I like him as a person, but his lecture style does not work for me at all. He goes through slides extremely fast, so you don't have much time to take notes, and exam questions are often super niche one-off things he mentions in lectures. I'm also not a fan of the flipped lecture format, I don't think it's particularly helpful to do Q&A style.

Nice enough guy but just terrible at teaching. The lectures include a ton of useless information and waste a ton of time. Meanwhile, he flies through the important information making going to the lectures pointless.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I did well in this class, but it was not easy to do. He helps out students by providing extra credit and requiring you to take 10 quizzes (for participation basically), but it's because the class is hard. There's a lot of content and he's not the best at explaining. He's a nice guy, though, and office hours were helpful.

Prof Baker clearly knows a lot about the topics he teaches, however it is very difficult to keep up with him in lectures. The material is hard to understand and you have to know pretty much every slide on each lecture to do good on the exams. Definitely a hard class, and you have study a lot to do good. He also posts lecture videos which is nice.
He speeds through his lectures, which doesn't even give you the chance to take notes properly. His exams are super test-heavy.
This is a hard class but its doable if you work hard. Definitely participate in class and he will give you credit, study hard for exams, sit near the front
This class wasn't fun. Got out with a B, but I had to study a ton to get it. He isn't helpful whatsoever so don't try to depend on him.

took 4 exams including the final and dropped one, very hard exams that were 50 MC. Must know everything on the lecture slides in order to do well in his class. Not very good at lecturing because goes off on tangents very easily

3 exams and a final and got to drop our lowest exam grade. Exams were all written responses (lol) 14-15 questions each. You will have to study and work your butt off in this class like no joke content is ROUGH. If doing this for writing credit 5-page paper on your fav gene you picked at the beginning of the semester. Class is rough praying 4 yall.

Baker truly generates interest in his biology of cancer class. The class is 3 exams, a final, and weekly homework that adds up to a test grade. Is you skip class, good luck with his notes on blackboard because they're mostly just pictures on blackboard. I read and outlined before class, went to lectures, and ended up with an A. Be prepared to work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Although Dr. Baker is a good guy, he is unfortunately extremely unhelpful during lecture. His slides consists of pictures and no words, and then he expects you to memorize full chapters of cancer bio without giving out any hints or study guides. Again very good person it seems, but extremely useless ultimately.

Dr. Baker is an amazing professor and you can tell that he loves molecular biology. The exams are not book based, they are basically only over what he lectures. So- read the book to substitute some things he says in class or for better understand that material. It is REALLY important to actually go to class, take notes, and pay attention!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Baker is a poor teacher. His tests focus almost entirely on lecture material, and he does not provide documents with much information for the exams. He is very condescending in class and over email, and often doesn't post grades for weeks after exams. If you can't remember every little example he mentions in class, you won't do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Baker is a great guy and really cares about the course material. His class is very lecture heavy and reading the textbook on its own will not help you much. He prioritizes different things and examples which is why attendance is important. His tests can be confusing because he writes his own questions, but he will answer questions about it
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Baker is a great professor. He is funny and his lectures are relevant. The class is tough though. Really understand the slides and pay attention to specifics in what is said during lecture, you will be tested on them. Most finals are recycled questions from earlier exams, but not his, so the final is pretty tough.

He is funny but I did not have a good experience with him. He writes his tests and the wording is so confusing. If you want a cool professor take him. If you want a good professor and save your GPA, avoid!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: He talks EXTREMELY fast and brings so much information that is not in the book. So if you do not understand it during class, you are screwed. I found this "extra" information not nearly as important as the information in the book, but he will test you on that. You need to know how the lab techniques from all the experiment work also. I had to drop.
I had Dr. Baker for HHMI and this class was amazing!
great, easy discussion class! 100% take this, he's so fun and it's actually an interesting class. do need to show up for class because its based mainly on participation, but its an easy a

Baker is so cool, but BIL255 is a hard class either way. He makes lectures interesting by explaining the relevance the topic has today. Read the book ahead of coming to class if you can. Getting together in groups and drawing the topics helps too. His second test is written (not mc) so beware.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: BIL255 is difficult course regardless, but, Baker makes it interesting to a point. He also gives some opportunity to gain extra credit and drops the lowest exam grade. His exams are very specific & lecture heavy. One should go to as many lectures as possible to see which topics being covered is most important and focus more on that over the textbk.

It's a hard class no matter who you take, but Dr. Baker's grading style makes it easy  to get at least a B if you study. Three exams, all curved and the lowest gets dropped. About ten online HW quizzes that you can take as many times as you want and if you get at least an 80% on all of them you get 100% quiz average. Plus extra credit and iClicker.
I dont think Dr. Baker is easy as everyone says. He makes you work hard to get a good grade. 3 tests, one drop, online quizzes and a final. Final is 40% of your grade. He curves each exam.

DO NOT TAKE! DO not listen to the other raters, this class is really hard for those that are not obsessed with biology and its inner workings, take Mallery he will guarantee to save your gap with at least a B. This section will ruin your GPA I am practically saying goodbye to any chances of going to medical school after this one class
Dr. Baker is an exceptional professor who is very interactive with his students. He keeps it real and is very funny. I would take any class with him and I highly recommend him.

Forget Skromne or Mallery, Baker is the guy you want for cell & molec.  He's a really great instructor, both in terms of the material itself and why  it matters, and is very accessible & open to questions. His three tests (one is dropped) and cumulative final are also very reasonable. I'd definitely recommend him.

Presti was a great professor for pharm, but for 609 it feels like we are the outlet for her frustrations. She is a much harsher grader than Quinones, and rather than constructive feedback you will get harsh criticism that feels meant to bring you down instead. Her lecture did not help with the exam, and I feel like nothing is good enough for her.

Dr Presti is an enthusiastic lecturer and keeps us entertained throughout the course. She really knows her medications and know her way around her medications for her field of work. She's tough, but very fair. Her class is engaging and her PowerPoint content are extremely helpful for studying. 10/10 would take again.

I do not know how this woman teaches pharmacology. You can get a A in her class because she tells you what to study but she does not prepare you well for the boards. She does not know the material well and easily gets confused during lectures. She teaches you the old GINA guidelines and is not up to date with material. She is off her meds.

Lectures were clear and well-structured, but the exams were very challenging and covered material not in the assigned readings. Balancing questions between lectures and readings would make assessments fairer.
Dr. Presti has been one of my favorite professors at UM. Her lectures are engaging and she makes it fun. 100% would recommend her and take her class again.

Just finished Dr. Presti's class for pharmacology for NP students and I had a great time. She's really kind but very fair. She tells you everything ahead of time. If you show up to class, pay attention, and write down what she tells you to know there's no reason not to pass. I thought it was an easy A but unfortunately some students didn't. funny.
Can be hard to learn from
awesome professor, not an easy class but she gives you in lecture want you to need to know for the exams

This professor has been a nightmare for me. Her lectures are good, fine, and dandy until you take the exam and realize what she lectured is the complete opposite of what shes asking on her exam. No way would I recommend anyone taking her class. You can read the PowerPoint all you want, but her lecture does not match the exams. Good luck.

I really enjoyed Dr. Presti for Advanced Pharm. She is VERY clear about what you need to know for exam purposes. Very knowledgable in the field. Didn't use a textbook. If she says "you need to know this" you should 100% expect it on an exam. Great class. Thanks Dr. Presti!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Presti is incredible! Her lectures are detailed and test questions come from what she says in class so if you attend and take good notes you will ace her test! I learned so much and have used her Patho notes for every nursing class I took after her. She talks fast so use computer for notes.
VERY hard course. I worked very hard for a B in the course. She is pretty rude. A lot of people like her, but I was not a fan. Glad this course is over.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is a pretty good, caring professor overall but she can have short bouts of rudeness from time to time. She points out key points you should remember for her exams during lecture. You can get by without the textbook, although it's somewhat useful for the quizzes. She's also open to visits during office hours, you just need to sign up online.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: my review got taken down so clearly there's some bias. not a good professor, rude, not understanding in the slightest. absolutely no empathy, making her a poor health care provider.

Very difficult class, but Dr. Presti is very knowledgeable. She adds humor here and there throughout lecture, making the class fun. I really loved learning from her. You really have to understand your material inside and out, but she is very fair and will tells you throughout the lecture of what to know for the test, so attendance is important!

Can sometimes be a little snarky/ rude over email whenever students ask her questions so i would avoid that. BUT overall I thought the class wasn't too difficult. In her lectures she LITERALLY tells you what to know and what you don't have to worry about for the test. So get a good understanding of what she says to know and you'll do fine.

I really hate this professor. I don't like her at all. She doesn't care about her students, and if you want and advice read and memorize the whole power point because she says one thing and the tests don't have to do with what she give you to learn. So pick another professor guys. Good luck

She is a pretty good instructor. Gets right to the point in lecture, doesn't explain many things beyond what is on the exam. No study guides but she spoon feeds you in lecture and tells you what will be and what will not be on the test, so attending lecture was important for me. Study what she says is important and you will pass this class no prblm

This teacher is PASSIVE AGGRESSIVE, if youre a type of person who memorizes more than understands a total picture than you will fail which by the way is less than a 75. Her tests are tricky and she will catch you if you dont know all your info in and out. Thankfully im retaking the class with a different professor. Good luck.

Fair, straight-forward and strictly business. No study guides except for an outline for the final, but no surprises. Knowledgeable, enthusiastic and funny as well- very important for a class as potentially dry as patho.
One of the best

I HATE doing this, but THIS GUY WAS THE WORST.  He called my first movie a monstrosity. I mean, considering I was a poor 19 year old with no car and no money, I did the best I could for my first film. The guy didn't even criticize it. He just hurled a bunch of insults and told my classmates, "Remember this is not what you are supposed to do."

Prof Capewell is a hoot.  He makes learning fun.  He has the gift of entertaining, educating and inspiring at the same time, while still managing to throw in some very colorful stories into his lectures!  Thanks for teaching me a great deal about the film world, Capewell, and for the great summer in London!  Bless you and your beautiful wife.

Capewell is outstanding teacher and a great human being. He goes out of his way to help a student with the even the most minor of problems.  He makes any class that much more fun and everyone should take a class with him. God bless George Capewell
Awesome Teacher!!!!!!!!!

Awesome teacher.  He's very funny and makes class interesting.  You'll actually want to go to class.  His tests can be a little difficult if you don't study or know any pop-culture.  If you study, you'll do great.

Absolutely the funniest professor at UM. Class is so easy, and he tells you what to write down for the tests. His tangents are entertaining and you'll actually enjoy going to class. Definitely recommend!
good teacher

Capewell is amazing...funniest teacher at UM. He tells you excactly what to put in your notes, and then tests you on those exact notes. You do need to study the notes,  but if you do that it couldn't be easier.

he's hilarious!!

Great teacher, very straightforward, easy to take notes, easy tests if you take good notes.  Very funny and amusing. An interesting topic and a great professor. I DEFINATELY RECOMMEND HIM TO ANYONE!!!
Just an overall GREAT class.

Capewell was my favorite prof at UM. First college class with this guy, and it was the right start. His class is actually enjoyable to go to, espcially with the visual gratification and his great industry stories. Professor...maybe... Teacher...definitely. Listen and learn from Georgie, before he goes home to take a nappy-poo...
Lectures are always interesting and entertaining.  He knows what he's talking about and drills most of the information in through repitition.  It isn't his fault that the equipment is always broken.

A pretty overrated prof. Sure, he's entertaining, but he lets his T.A's do all the real work & just comes to the lectures to blathers on about whatever he feels like. Is popular 'cause hes fun.  Learned very little in this class and he grades your final films very subjectively. The film equipment was always broken and grad students get first dibs.
Final project grades in this class are very subjective, but he's a fun and crazy teacher.  Tests are simple.
Visual Gratification!  Need I say more

A-freakin-mazing! Like a friend of mine told me: he's got the personality of Robin Williams. He tells you what's on the test, study that and you're set. He'll randomly start talking about something that happened to him during his Hollywood days or other stories, always entertaining. He knows his stuff, and simplifies everything as much as possible. The best part: all tests are based on the lectures, no books, no reading, no homework!!
He's insane, but he's great.  If the equipment weren't all broken I'd have no complaints, but what can you do?  Capewell rocks.

I've never learned (or retained) more from any other teacher at UM.  His tests are actually pretty difficult, but you won't notice because you'll come to class every day because he's that informative/entertaining/amazing.  His are the only classes when I n

Freakin' amazing! I'm taking him for another semester!

BEST teacher EVER! i dont care what anyone says- you DONT have to buy the book and the tests are mad easy. Go to class everyday. take notes, and you WILL get an A. i did. he makes the class enjoyable too. PLUS you can get writing credit if you want it.
Absolutely hilarious.  Even his tangents are informing.  I don't know anyone in the class who didn't have fun.
Capewell is the one of the most fun teachers I have ever had! He is soo funny and so entertaining! Take whatever classes you can with him!

Hilarious. He sounds like he is on acid. Random tangents.Test #2 is hard because of all of the women's names. He comes dressed in the Hollywood way-all black, occasionally hot pink. He seems to keep your attention. He always adds in "visual gratification" (movie watching time) for every class. Fun!
This class seems to be really easy and fun, but that second test really got me with all the women's names. Other than that, no complaints, I really look forward to going to this class.
Good guy, goes off on tangens, but very funny, I have to say this was the most entertaining class I have taken at UM
he's a cool teacher.. but doesnt teach all that well.. and his exams are a lil tricky.. i overall like him.. but hes not like OMG so wonderful.
actually learned ****...very easy to understand and analyze
Condenses everything into 1 sentence, its great.
Looks like he is on a acid trip while lecturing. FUN, but whach out for bell curve.
Great as an advisor too!
So much fun! Great Class!
Capewell is the best! Take his classes above anyone elses.
Awesome professor. Super caring. I sucked at math before this course and she made it super easy. Just make sure you pay attention and participate in class

MTH 108 is a hard course but she is the best teacher for it. Cares about her students, most are group quizzes, exams are just like the review, and gives a lot of information on the final exam. She is strict and does cold call, but she does it to help you. I'm bad at math but ended up with an A with her teaching style. Great professor.
I really like Dr. Beverly. Yes she's a bit strict and intense, but she's a great professor and overall a great professor. I really learned a lot in her class. Highly recommend but don't slack off.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Compared to other math professors at miami, she is one of the best ones. She is a tough grader and calls on people randomly during class but its to make sure your engaged. attendance is extra credit but I definitely recommend going.

Was going through a serious time of grief after death of a friend, no remorse, her teaching style is strict which I actually liked, but then she bullied me in class everyday to the point where I would cry after class and dropped. Got an A+ when I decided to take MTH 161 in 1 semester instead the following year w/ a dif professor. Do not take her.

Revived a low grade after doing every assignment and attending class she will fail you if she has to has no compassion for students who struggle in the class

She's a nice lady but don't recommend if you struggle with math
Def a hard subject but Mrs. Beverly is so good at explaining all the concepts and offering additional help outside of the classroom. Tests are definitely hard but very similar to study guide.

Not considerate of personal family matters at all preventing you from attending an exam. Ended up having to fly back to Miami for an exam with her from across the country and fly right back to be by my family member's side during their final moments.

I really like Dr. Beverly. She's very helpful if you pay attention and attend class. I wish I put in more effort but she really wants students to succeed. She's very clear and helpful with many tough topics. With not a lot of good professors here, she's definitely the best one. Highly recommend.

good teacher! calls on you during class. sometimes talks a lot not about math and lets the class time get away from her. the type of teacher who more so explains a slideshow than to do the math herself, so its your preference. tests are similar to study guide

Dr. Beverly is a great professor! She explains concepts very well and is happy to go over problems that you are unclear about. She is caring and likes to inform students of fun events happening on campus. She cold calls, but not in a condescending way. The tests are fair and straightforward if you pay attention in class and do the homework.

She didn't explain well because she is always asking questions to students. Might be rude sometimes and is a tough grader she looks at every detail. Some quizzes were in groups which was fun because you could work with other people. Attendance is mandatory. Exams are worth a lot and are kind of different from study guides.

Dr. Beverly is an amazing professor! I'm taking her for MTH 107 and next semester for MTH 108. She really cares about her students and wants them to do well. She does cold call but they're easy questions and you can always pass. You will have to study as it can be a challenging course but she is the best professor to take it with.

Cares a lot about her students but is very strict on attendance and small rules like wearing a hoodie for exams. She cold calls a lot, but she makes the questions are easy to answer so it's nothing to worry about.

math department makes the exams and homework for cal1 and lower, but she explains she has chosen the easiest questions. People that fail were just never going to pass the class. Copied and paste quizzes from HW. She is amazing, I did not make a review earlier so her class wouldn't fill up quickly. Math Mondays, office hours, she is there for you.

Dr. Beverly is fair and explains concepts well. She teaches simple concepts in class but then you have to teach yourself the difficult concepts for hw. Take advantage of the camner tutoring center!! tests are 80% of your grade!! This class does require time and effort but there are a lot of resources available and you can get a good grade.
I think I might be in love with her. Very informative and cares about students, wish I could've had her for the first half of mth140 as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Going to math mondays saved me. She truly cares about students and goes above and beyond to help you in whatever situation you are in. Has a lot of resources and is truly a wonderful and kind professor as long as you demonstrate the same respect for her. She is also very understanding and drops your two lowest quizzes, also most quizzes are group

The class is pretty hard because the tests are difficult, no curves. the lowest test is matched to the final test grade. She is a really nice person outside of the class but not as much in class. if she thinks you're dumb she wont be very nice to you; not much slack. hard to do well without having taken calc before. got rounded up from a bad final.

Joy creates a tense, unwelcoming environment, often calling out students in a condescending way. Classes cover few math problems, with most time spent on irrelevant tangents or moving slowly due to cold calling out students. She shows little care for student success, making it hard to engage or learn effectively. Avoid her class if possible.
Happy I passed, but it messed up my GPA. Kids did well but she is a very tough grader and lowkey like does not teach at all, all the good ratings are math nerds

She cares and wants everyone to do well in her class. She makes sure everyone is paying attention by asking people to participate. She was available outside of class and I loved going to her math Mondays! I appreciate how she puts a lot of effort into each and every student to make sure they are successful.

I took Calc in high school so I did remember most of the material but Professor Beverly is probably one of the best professors for Calc I at Miami. I heard bad things from some of my friends about their professors (they were also taking calc for the second time). Very good at explaining how to do problems. Favorite professor of my semester for me!
Dr. Beverly has a strict teaching style, but her lectures and group quizzes are engaging. With effort, you can pass the class. Unstuck study helped me prep for exams.

I took Dr. Beverly for MTH107- best decision I made. She cold calls during every class, which keeps you on top of everything that she discusses in each lecture. She is available outside of class+wants all of her students to succeed. If you want to get a good grade in this class+are willing to put in the effort, she is the best professor for you.

First of all, if your advisor is trying to tell you to do 140/141, don't. Just do 160. Dr. Beverly helps her students understand the material but will not be flexible with grading and adheres very strictly to the syllabus, even with extenuating circumstances. She isn't awful, but if you decide to take 140/141, take someone else if possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you are a freshman taking MTH107 as a requirement, DO NOT TAKE HER! She is the hardest and rudest professor at UM. I took her in 2020, and it is now 2024 and I just needed to come here to say that I have never had a professor as awful as her. She's fails half the class. I had to appeal my grade to admin bc she screwed me over so badly.

definitely cares about her students but well she's very condescending if you're not someone with a strong calculus background. she'll continue to say that maybe you shouldn't be in that class but for most people its literally a requirement. TYRANT during exams, does not trust students to an extreme level. AVOID HER. reviews are a lie. AVOID!!!

Dr. Beverly is, although stern, a very effective professor. She gets to know her students but doesn't tolerate disrespect. She teaches thoroughly and offers many opportunities to get help outside of class. She definitely cares about her students and their success, just don't get on her bad side. She also does A LOT of group quizes which was great.
Dr. Beverley is a decent professor but some of the material that was on quizzes and exams was not taught in class or even in the textbooks. Same for the homework.

Avoid her like the plague! She is militant and untrusting of students. Who burned her? She makes her students hate math.  It's like she wants to fail kids. She berates kids who are not good at Calculus. I taught myself from the book because she barely teaches. This course took up too much of my time away from other courses.

She makes you doubt the meaning of having an education. This is a calculus class, but the most difficult part of the exams is never calculus but simplifying calculations. You can get 100% of the calculus part on exam questions correct, but can still end up losing half of the points because the questions are insanely complicated to simplify.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Just don't take her. AVOID at literally all costs. GPA killer is an understatement. She made me absolutely dread coming to class every day.

Don't listen to the bad reviews- Dr. beverly is an amazing professor. She takes the time to answer questions and explain things again in her lessons. I'm terrible at math but her engaging lectures and group quizzes saved me. She's super accessible outside of class too. If you actually show up and put in the effort, you can totally pass the class
the homework is literally impossible to do and she is an extremely tough grader. definitely avoid
Do not take!!!!

Very nice lady, can seem intimidating at first but takes the time to learn her students. Does do group quizzes which is really helpful and tests are hard but fair. Prepares you really well for everything and can tell she cares for her students.
extremely tough grader and not very open to hearing follow up questions asking about her grading on tests

I highly recommend avoiding taking Dr. Beverly. Her slideshows are unclear, she was condescending when I met with her, and made me nervous to ask questions. Also, her rules during test taking are RIDICULOUS. She tried to flag me for cheating one time because I guessed on a question and got it right. The same thing happened to my classmate.
Take someone else if you can. I took this course last year.  She is not understanding of kids who struggle with Math. Her office hours were so limited.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Never again!
Just don't take her!  She'll ruin your GPA!

I got an A, but it was too much effort and impacted my performance in other classes.  She gives too much work for kids that are not math majors and need to fill their math requirement. She's untrusting of her students and acts like a drill sargent. Also, be prepared to teach yourself a lot because she is not great at explaining concepts.

I have dyslexia and she was not sensitive to that.  She embarrassed me in class bc I have a different way of showing my work. There's no TA and her office hrs are 15 min limited times slots on zoom, not for help w/math.  She had work sessions right after class but I had another class then. It was unfair to offer that w/o finding time for everyone.

Her lectures are based on PowerPoint which is a hard way to understand and visualize math work. She talks more through the problem rather than working it out. She is very understanding, but, sometimes rambles on stuff unrelated to the subject. The math is equivalent to the first semester of high school calculus.
I don't recommend Beverly. I would choose any other professor. Please beware before taking her class.

He tortures students with unbearable math questions and his lectures are a disgrace. There are no possible words to describe how detrimental this professor is to the GPA of students. University of Miami is a prestigious institution and this teacher drags the reputation of this outstanding school down.

Dr. Beverly is the best math professor I've had at UM so far! She really cares about her students, gives fair exams, and easy group quizzes. She expects all her students to participate in class and takes pride in making sure she knows everyone's names. It took hours and hours of effort if math was not your thing. I am not sure where the high rating comes from.I have not come across any good calc teachers

Not very thorough, and tests are difficult even if you've done well on the HW. TA's grade the quizzes, which are noticeably easier than the tests, and She grades the exams, which she is much less forgiving with. If you have a ton of time to pour into this class, you'll be okay; if not, try to find a prof. that allows notecards such as Prof Bibby.

IDK how people rate her negatively. Lots of HW. She's nice & explains things clearly. She doesn't go over EVERYTHING but come on this isn't high school. If u have a Q she helps u out. If u can do the HW u can pass her tests. They're open ended Q's & she gives u credit for the steps u get right. She gives extra credit throughout. Good professor.

Outwardly nice, but also strict and unforgiving. Test questions are always a jump up from the homework, which is all online. She may review 3 or 4 HW questions in each class, and doesn't explain anything in detail, she simply reviews problems. If you did well in pre-calc, it should carry you through, otherwise find a better professor.

Extremely nice, and very helpful. She cares about your grade and appreciates good students so I don't know why anyone would rate her badly unless they were bitter students. She makes math easy, and is very kind. Lots of homework but it helps. Also she gives extra credit opportunities. Take her!

whoever rated her poorly probably did not show up to class or pay attention. She was a great professor for MTH111 and made calculus seem easy. Everything was put simply and the homework was a great way to boost your grade. It was not hard to get an A in her class and if you do the homework, you'll do great in this class.

I took her because my friend said she was a good professor, and she is. Her tests can be a little hard but if you understand everything, you'll be fine. It seems like she doesn't like to repeat herself so though attendance isn't mandatory, if you miss a day, you might be lost forever.

This teacher was not very helpful at all if you got it great you were king of the class however if you did not understand she was not good at explaining what you did wrong she would just repeat what the book told her and kept doing problems like a robot. not helpful at all just explain the math!! stop reading from the book!!

All the good reviews for Beverly are from students NOT in MTH111. Beverly seems to be proving herself as a hard calc teacher this semester. Not easy, test are difficult, and she is the hardest grader you will ever come across.
Beverly is awesome. Homework has unlimited attempts, test are easy and straightforward, and lots of extra credit opportunities.
such a great professor. She truly cares about her students and she is always willing to help. I loved her class and I truly recommend her for all level.
Not too hard, very easy to understand but test questions can be tricky with a lot of algebra. no calculators allowed. Attendance optional, online graded homework.

She is AWESOME!!! Always goes over problems, addresses questions and makes learning easy. Tries to make everyone participate and gives a lot of extra credit. Her tests  are easy but no calculators. Theyre still easy!!! She is that kind of Professor you wish can teach you math the whole way! I got an A in her class. She was a marvelous professor!!!

SUPER EASY CALC CLASS. I HAD CALC PRIOR SO CLASS DEFINITELY WASN'T MANDATORY BUT EVEN IF YOU HAVEN'T HAD CALC...SHE'S VERY CLEAR AND THOROUGH AND JUST A GOOD TEACHER. CAN'T USE CALCULATORS BUT THAT MEANS THE TESTS ARE A LITTLE EASIER. TAKE HER IF YOU CAN!! HOMEWORK IS ON WEBASSIGN IF THAT MATTERS TO YOU.

Best math professor I have ever had and I have had 6 different ones. I hated math until this professor. Loved going class and made it a fun learning environment. Recommend her to any body who has had trouble with math before.
awesome teacher. really nice and helpful. class is super easy.

She is a great teacher! She was literally the only teacher I have ever found that could get me to understand math! She is a beautiful person and really cares about her students. She looks at all her students as people and wants to see each of them succeed. Go to class and do the homework, & you will be set to take the tests. Material comes off h.w

Very good teacher! I recommend taking her! She is very nice and cares about her students! There is a lot of Math XL homework, but it helps for tests. She also gives a bunch of extra credit opportunities!
Great teacher. Everything you want in a teacher.  You don't need the book but make sure you buy MathXL.  Highest recommendation

Make a list of your favorite teachers of all time. Now, take Dr. Beverly and, sadly, say goodbye to one of those teachers. She is one of my favorite teachers ever -- elementary teachers included. She is just so nurturing, kind, and hilarious, just like a teacher from Elementary school. She teacher so well, including real-life application always. :)

OMG she is great! this is the kind of teacher with whom all the athletes take math because shes is so great at explaning everything, shes slow and clear and you dont have to feel embarrassed to ask questions...TAKE HER!

A wolf in sheep's clothing. She pretends she cares but if you have a real problem like someone in your family dying... she won't take the time to make a make up test for you... Yes, I'm bitter. I ended up with an "A" in her class but I never got to say goodbye...
She's a very good professor. Gives great, simple and concise explanations anyone can understand. I don't like math but I don't get bored in her classes. She's a good math teacher, I recommend her.
What a great teacher. I HATE math, but she made the class somewhat enjoyable. She was helpful, and made things easier. Highly recommended.

7 quizzes, and she lets you drop two. four exams and a final. overall easy class if you go, take notes, and do the homework. expect the most complex problems on the tests but she prepares you for them

i dont think that shes that sweet, but shes really clear. for those of us who need math to be explained clearly and slowly, she is a really great teacher. i like that the final exam has no surprises, its just variations of the questions off your old tests.

A sweetheart who takes the time to learn your name and really cares about you. I had her for 101 and insisted on her for 103. Lectures are very clear and she gives partial credit on tests and extra credit chances. 103 consisted of three tests, a group project, and final. Overall, if you see, everyone and their brother recommends her! She's great!
She is the best math teacher i've ever had...i would definitely reccommend taking her!!
She's extremely nice and cares about her students. Can't ask for a better Math teacher. She speaks clearly and her exams doesn't stray away from what she teaches.
BEST math teacher I have ever had.  One of the few English-speakers in the department.  I definitely recommend her.

She goes over the vast majority of the problems that will be on the homework in class, but sometimes something random will appear in the homework that she didn't talk about, and you will have to teach yourself.  Overall, a great class.  I'd love to take another class with her.

One of the best math teachers you'll have. Her statistics class was amazing. She is all the reviews say: easy to understand, helpful, and positive. For once math wasn't a burden. She uses Mathxl for the homework and has good reviews for the test. Lots of opportunities to recover if you mess up. Best thing is prob. the cheerful/helpful attitude.

She is a good teacher. There are a lot of extra credit points, which helped me, and as long as you do mathxl, and do well on the final, you will get a good grade. Oh, and if you do better on the final then your worst test grade, the final replaces that test! (b/c you knew it for the final). I would take her class! :)

her 1st name pretty much says it all. she really wants her students to do well - for example, the other day, when we got our tests back, she let us make corrections and we got half the the points we got wrong, added back to our score! so if you got 80, you ended up with a 90. as you can tell, shes a reallyx2 sweet teacher
An absolute Joy! No Pun intended! She is really nice and does a great job teaching. She also gets to know your name and personality. Material was easy in 101.

she is the best teacher i've ever had for any math class!!! she's awesome! she's always there to help you whether it's during class hours or office hours. she's gives everyone a chance to do well in her class..the tests are easy, she gives extra credit, and the homework is online and super easy.
Great teacher. Awesome personality and it shows through her teaching. Really helpful if you go to her office hours, tests are very easy.
Amazing teacher. The homework is really easy and online and she's always really helpful.
She is very attentive to students and their needs.  Problems help clarify her words.
Very easy, very helpful, i would definitely recommend taking her class if maths isn't your easiest subject.
She is an incredibly nice lady. Very helpful and clear in class.
She's very clear and mostly fair in her grading. I get a weird vibe from her sometimes but she genuinely enjoys teaching and it makes the class as interesting as a math class can be

This is an incredibly easy class! The material is so easy and she explains it well. She gives everyone MORE than what they need for the test (printouts about what cards are in a 52 deck). It is so easy and not that boring. She is so nice and very helpful, but, quite frankly, its so easy, a lot of help is unnecessary.

I took a statistics course in high school, and thank goodness cuz I would have no idea what she's talking about if I didn't. The way she explains things is really hard to understand. Ask questions during the exam and she'll pretty much give you the answer.
This is the only human being alive who has ever gotten me interested in Math, she is incredible, so caring and wonderful.
No Comments

She is incredibly caring and she really knows what she is doing. She is the best math teacher I have ever had. She is really concerned about her students' performance and she is willing to do whatever it takes.
She is a wonderful professor. Explains the material very well & is willing to go out of her way to help the student. She's a great professor, especially for those who aren't good at math.
She is a great math professor. She explains clearly and is always there to help. I recommend it to anyone who hates math, but needs it. A GREAT GREAT PROFESSOR.
SHES A REALLY GOOD TEACHER!!!!!!!

This class is hard regardless of what professor you take. Professor Vega is straightforward and prepares you for the exam. Ignore the bad reviews, they probably did not study. You are gonna have to study a lot so make sure you know that. Trust me he's one of the better math professors at this school.

Vega is a tough teacher but at least he has lots of office hours. Don't even try to talk to him about your grade on an exam because he is not lenient at all and can't even tell you why he took certain number of points off. That being said I do think he prepares you somewhat well for the final but it is long and you will be rushed. Use Camner Center

Honestly do not take MTH 161 unless you have to, if you are a business major just do a bba and take MAS110. Vega is an okay teacher just boring and doesn't want to help you out or give you extra credit.

honestly, he is the worst teacher i have had in my 13 years of education. His exams are nothing like any of the problems in class and the way he grades is strictly based off his standards. If you don't do it his way you have no chance at scoring well on the exams. His quizzes are harder than any other prof. and he's just a boring person in general.

has office hours which is nice but his tests were graded so unfairly. if you are trying to transfer to the business school and need a B do not take him. No TA so it is hard to try and get points back with Vega because he is not understanding at all. So much homework and he grades harder and drops less exams than other teachers in the department.

There is a lot of homework. Exams and quizzes are not fairly created. Very lame class to take if you want to learn and very tedious class if you need credit. I do not recommend. Exams are heavy and the homework is dumped on you before the exam!

Look, Calc II is a fairly difficult course, so naturally those who struggle are prob going to blame the professor. If you genuinely want to understand Calc, this is your guy.

reviews.comment: He wasn't the most exciting guy, but he was very effective at teaching the concepts. I don't know what the poor ratings are about, Mr. Vega knows his stuff and is an excellent professor for Calc I. He is a little awkward, but he truly cares about Calculus and gives a lot of partial credit on questions.

i love Carlitos!

Really good at explaining things and helping
the greatest math professor at umiami

Dr. Vega was a nice professor. His lectures are okay and if you show up to office hours he provides you with the help you need. However, he grades pretty tough.

He just is simply the worst math teacher you can take, all of his assessments are significantly harder than any other teacher and he does not do a good job of explaining how to do anything. you have to learn his quizzes are solely based on in class problems and tests are based off the homework to have any chance of passing. DO NOT TAKE

Very kind professor. He knows what he is teaching but the homework is a lot harder than the lecture. If you want to do well in his class, don't study the lecture, study the homework. He takes very long to grade.

He is an amazing professor. He explains everything clearly and does not waste time on material that is not on the exams. He prepares you well for every single exam and quiz. Dr.Vega should have a much higher rating. He is one of the best professors in the department. He actually explains concepts and wants you to do well. Worst Professor to exist. The classes are depressing. He has this unreasonable system of "justice" with his grading. Dr. Vega is an excellent professor. His lectures are clear and easy to understand if you pay attention and take notes. Dr. Vega is kind and helps a lot in office hours and knows all students by name.

reviews.comment: He's an okay professor to be honest. He taught the subject matter relatively well, but the lectures were extremely boring, but maybe that's just because it is a Calc class. Is open frequently for office hours but is also very passive aggressive during class and hours.

Ignore the bad reviews and take him. He is the best calc, and possibly math, professor in the school. He takes his time to explain concepts, and his explanations are very clear and concise. Just do assignments and use them to prepare for quizzes and exams. Easy A or A+.

People are hating on my boy but he's really not that bad. His class is boring and it can be hard to pay attention. He knows math. Vega has his moments where he's pretty cool. I don't understand the hate. Classes are a waste of time because he doesn't even teach in any useful ways. He barely teaches the content and then assigns homework significantly harder then what he went over.

DO NOT TAKE. Hes not good at teaching the material. Hes a tough grader on tests and quizzes.

First half of semester I failed every test and quiz. Doesn't take attendance and honestly you barely learn anything in class. The reason that I passed was solely because I taught myself EVERYTHING and studied 30 hours for every test. However there are worse teachers and he is surprisingly helpful during his office hours and outside of class

Never have I once been driven to the point to actually write a review until this guy. If you don't have a firm understanding of calculus beforehand, expect to do terrible. His teaching is worse than trying to learn calc yourself. When you are confused by a problem, he would rather watch you continue to struggle than walk you through it. Don't take
so bad...

Never take a Carlos Vega class. This man deserves the chair. Hes rude to his students with constant snap backs and cant teach for his life. For a class full of students who have taken calculus 1 in high school, he some how makes the content even harder to understand and only allows anything to be done in his dumb specific way.

A nice guy who really tries his best to get students to learn. Sometimes the lectures can be boring but you can tell he tries his best to make them somewhat entertaining and keep people engaged. I thought he was a solid professor.

He's not very engaging in the classroom and his work is done traditionally- on the whiteboard. I found it very hard to follow his notes or even really contact him outside of class. He lacks grace and understanding and is very adamant on no-phone use in the classroom. I could not learn a single concept in Pre-Calculus off of his teaching alone.
Avoid at all costs!!! You will fail if you have this man as your professor. Every lecture is filled with mistakes and so poorly explained that you gain nothing from attending class.

His teaching is lackluster, if even existent. Attendance is not mandatory, but I went to every class, and got almost nothing from class. If you take this course be prepared to teach yourself literally everything.
Even though I did fine I would have rather taken the W and withdrawn than finished the semester in the class. Literally terrible. He made so many people cry so many times.

DO NOT TAKE! If u need to take a math class, Carlos is not an option. This man does not teach one bit, he writes down the notes and lets u figure it out on your own. Not to forget the multiple times the notes he writes have mistakes, also u will not finish the exams in the time given. Only plus, it makes no difference if you go to class or don't.

AVOID. I took AP calculus last year and all of this material was foreign to me. Yes, math is different in college than hs, but he explained each and every concept in a way that made no sense. Never handed tests back in a timely fashion. Did not finish the material. I went into every test feeling unprepared. Even if you study expect a C. DON'T TAKE.

Vega NEVER finished the last unit before the final exam. He NEVER finished the material before any unit test either. Office hours were WACK and caused more stress than what it was worth. Maybe he is a shy, nice guy, but at the end of the day we are paying thousands for this and most kids end up with a C due to his terrible teaching. AVOID HIM!!

By far the worst teacher I've ever had. Avoid at all costs, any other professor for math 108 will be better. He makes tons of mistakes and barely knows how to do the problems himself. He takes months and months to grade each test. He does not teach you whatsoever. He grades tests extremely harshly and makes them harder than any other 108 professor.

reviews.comment: I am doing decently not because of Mr. Vega, but because I took this class in high school, so I passed with a decent grade because of previous knowledge. However, when using his often incorrect notes and lectures, the material seemed much more complicated, and more frequently, way harder than it needed to be. He is a smart guy but awful teacher.

Well, if showing up late on the first day of school without a syllabus to give the class doesn't describe Vega, I honestly don't know what will (yes, that happened). He is perhaps the worst professor I have ever encountered. Will give no credit for pages of work. Does not teach or finish material. Will fail the entire class w/ no explanation. AWFUL

Came back for another review b/c after just simply asking about my final exam and the curve, he rudely made assumptions about me and my work ethic. I have loved every math teacher I've had, this professor is an outlier. Not good at responding to emails but he is nice and can be lenient at times. Overall, would not reccomend.

Literally engraved every homework/review problem we were ever given into my head and still nearly failed the class. A nightmare come true is what the teacher really is

Prof. Vega is a nice person, but not a very good teacher for calc 2, compared to other classes from students I have spoken to, they get much more help on exams. This was the hardest class I have ever taken. He doesn't teach at all. DO NOT TAKE FOR CALC 2

Hard professor, he means well and is very knowledgeable but if you're not amazing at calculus, or math in general, don't take him. I put in a lot of work to this class and it is still super hard. don't take this class . unless you want your spirit crushed. easily the worst teacher I have ever had. four four categories. lecture, home work, test review, and tests/exams. and none of the material matches doesn't matter if you can do the homework and reviews forwards, backwards and in another language. THE PRACTICE MATERIAL DOESNT MATCH TESTS

reviews.comment: Very helpful during office hours. Makes an effort for students, always available if you need him. Laid back personality.
Carlos is a cool dude. Definitely take his class. Smart fella, and responds to emails quickly. Best teacher in  the department.

Super approachable. Makes it easy to get help if needed(you wont need extra help w him tho) The 2 class's before tests are review and test questions are the same questions done in the review but slightly different. Class tests  based off book so lecture not necessary but if you go, you are guaranteed  an A. HW optional, tests use HW questions tho

Amazing professor. Great personality, a bit quirky but in a cool way. Attractive (hot), which encourages me  to go to class.. Overall lectures get better. He is very helpful during office hours. Smart, calm, collected, and actually cares about student's success. Quirky sense of humor, but very intelligent.

Difficult course, but a really nice guy. Tries to help students as much as possible, and hot for a math professor too. He's a young guy with a good attitude. Fair grader, but doesn't provide much of a review before exams.  If you are interested in the subject, it should be an easy class. For me, it was grueling. Also do the Homework!
Carlos Vega is a great teacher, just go to class, try to learn the subject and don't forget to go to his office. He teaches well and wants you to do good on the tests. I'd definetely take him.

Take Vega, especially if you're bad at Math. Exams are just as he presents problems in class & he reviews everything extensively. He's willing to spend countless hours helping you outside of class in office hours.  I have never seen a professor who is so interested in making sure students understand the material.
Incredibly condescending and passive aggressive.  Speaks down to a lot of students.

This was my favorite class of the semester. 2.5 hours sounds like misery but it just flies by. Carrie is the best professor and is really fun to talk to. She is always willing to help and knows a ton about photographers and their photographs. I definitely recommend this class!
Carrie is very helpful and nice but a hard grader.  Don't expect an A on your first try (she lets you redo prints as many times as you want).
Learning a lot... Fun class!  Lots of work for an elective though and the photography building is old/depressing.

Class is very difficult with lots of outside work but I couldn't be happier with the experience. She is really nice, always there to help and knowladgeable about her craft. It's obvious that she loves photography and it's infectious. She grades hard but fair, when you get an A you know you earned it.  Not for those who want an easy art class.

DONT take this chemistry class with this professor unless you want to get anxiety and depression. Dr. Gonzalez does not know how to teach properly since he is one of these chemistry geniuses that know it all. If I were you I would choose a different teacher at UMIAMI.

This professor was sassy and did not answer a questions when students were confused about problems. He needs to work on being more flexible because not all students learn at the same pace. He would give attitude when students would ask for help on questions and wouldn't offer office hours to be able to get help.
Sassy. Not great with answering questions. Class is pretty difficult, and the exams are nothing like the homework/content discussed in class. Do not recommend.

CHM 221 is a 200 course for a reason, its getting you into the more course-heavy workloads and it isn't afraid to bite. Dr. Gonzalez has the sass that I personally like but is also a really good professor working through problems and concepts in lecture, in work hours, or wherever you might find him. One thing, do NOT fall behind, it will snowball.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lab is very annoying but lab reports and quizzes are not hard. Make sure to study for the final hard because I was cutting it close to not getting an A after doing super well the whole semester because of the grade on my final
the only negative is he is sassy so hes not the easiest to go to w questions, but he is the best by far. his tests are the worst

The best chemistry professor there ever was. Cesar is the sassiest human ever, but he knows his chemistry. Dont listen to people who say they dont like him because he's actually hilarious and very nice once you get to know him. If I were you, I would build my schedule around his class because he explains things so well and has the best office hours

Truly the best chemistry professor. He breaks down the material and is very good at explaining everything. He posts his recorded lectures which is really helpful when studying. Would highly recommend!!!
Cesar is the harshest and funniest little chemistry professor there ever was. Please take his class. He is amazing.

Chemistry is never easy, regardless of the professor. You must teach yourself; if you won't, consider changing your major or dropping. Don't rely on AI for homework—honest hard work is the only way. Crucially, you must get access to past exams to study. If you're dedicated, you'll earn that B at best lol maybe a B+
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: CHM 221 is already a hard class in it of itself. After Knecht, Gonzalez is your best chance at succeeding. Yes, he is sassy. Yes, sometimes he pulls out random stuff on tests, but honestly if you really dedicate your time and use the resources provided (workshop, office hours, 1 on 1, etc..) you can succeed by teaching yourself the material.

CHM 221 is a hard class to teach and to learn, but I'm really glad I took it with Dr. Gonzalez. He is very passionate, and does his best to really make sure his students understand the topic. His office hours and appointments were extremely helpful. If you want to do well, you really just have to put in the work outside of class

Dr. Gonzalez knows his topics very well, in my opinion however, there is too much material to cover in Chem 221, to the point where all of nomenclature is expected to be learned outside of class. His lectures flow VERY quickly, with little time for questions. For a class as difficult as Structure and Dynamics, i would avoid Dr. Gonzalez.

I had Cesar for gen chem and orgo and he was such a great teacher for both, probably the best option. Orgo is hard in general but he teaches the material so throughly. Also, there are orgo workshops that benefit yourself so much, so take advantage of them. He is also available outside of class and wants to help you succeed in this class.

I am Cesar's #1 defender. Gen chem is annoying no matter what, but there was never a time I felt the class was impossible. To study, redo the hw (sometimes hw qs are on the exams), do as many old exams as you can get, and make sure you're able to do ALL of the ex questions he gives in class. He is by FAR the best prof u could have for this class

Cesar is literally the best teacher for this class. This class is hard with averages on test always 65% or below but your best chance of doing well is with this teacher. Also stay ahead because its very easy to get behind in this class.

This class was really hard. However, not impossible. Cesar was the best professor for CHM121 and CHM221 in my opinion. For those who are taking CHM221, this class will test your discipline, endurance, consistency, time management skills etc. I got a 98% on one of the exams by just purely doing practice problems over and over. Good luck.

Dr. Gonzalez is one of the best profs here. He's hilarious when you get to know him. People hate because chem at UM is ridiculously hard. You can't pass without practicing every day. Dr. G is the best lecturer though, and his student hours are VERY helpful. GO TO THEM. His office hours are for group discussion, not just questions, so no excuses.
If you pre med you not gonna be no longer after taking this.

Cesar is my favorite prof here. Orgo is a very difficult class and after struggling in gen chem, I was very nervous but I ended with an A+! His lectures were great (recorded) and we were always ahead of other sections = more time to review. Go to office hours - life changing and helpful. Do textbook problems. Also hes available for 1/1 appts. #king

reviews.comment: I feel for Cesar. Within the Chem department, he's one of the best, and CHM121 is already a very tough course. I still wholeheartedly believe he's the best option for 121, and one of the best for 221.

As a professor, Cesar genuinely is one of the better ones in the chemistry department. The course is hard. You will work pretty hard for your A. Cesar makes the course digestible; his office hours genuinely help. Do know, he is a sassy guy, he is a sarcastic guy. It is in his personality, and it is nothing against you.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: if you plan on losing weight, clumps of hair and breaking out from the tears you'll shed, take this class next semester because i promise you the academic stress will keep you full, hairless and depressed (im on lexapro now).

I think he is one of the best professors in the department, he teaches stuff really well and is willing to help if you put in the time and effort. Obviously the class is hard. He can get a bit sassy and mean at times but he really pushes you to do your best and wants you to succeed.

Consists of 5 midterms & a final, 15% each (1 midterm dropped). Exams are hard, but Gonzalez well prepares u. Practice problems are a MUST to do well, plus going over his slides and redoing homework problems. He's a great teacher and pushes you to do well, but he does move fast so stay on track. Taking him for orgo, liked him a lot.

He's just okay. I personally found him pretty rude even when I went to office hours and tried to get to know him. He's a good teacher and the content was easy to understand but I wouldn't want to have to deal with him again.
The worst chemistry professor in the world. He makes everything way more difficult than it needs to be and I would not recommend.
Class is tough, but he is the best professor, in my opinion.

I loved Dr. Gonzalez! I had to withdraw was bc I was taking the summer course & they fit 15 weeks worth of material into 5. I was working so I didn't have the time to keep up with the pace. Dr. G gives you everything you need to succeed and always checks in on you. I am taking the course in the fall with him and I'm so excited! I know I'll succeed

Honestly orgo kinda sucks but I took it with Cesar knowing that he was a great lecturer for gen chem. Super thorough, and gave a lot of practice and explanations in lectures. He'll answer questions after class too (very helpful). Definitely do textbook problems and go to workshops. Orgo is hard but if you go to class and practice, you'll be good.

This is a great option for an intro to chemistry professor. It is graded mostly by five midterms (the lowest dropped) and a final, which amounts to 75% of your grade. The lectures are fine, but the homework is where you'll learn the best. Overall, I enjoyed my experience in this class, just make sure to study hard for the exams.

Homework is pretty useless when it comes to exam material. Retook class w/ Leslie and passed w/ an A.

reviews.comment: The nature of the class is that it's difficult, which is not the fault of the professor. Reviews outside of class were super helpful and were a major contributor in understanding the material. Explains things really well and gives questions that are good prep for the test.

Although he was available outside of lecture, it was hard to get 1-on-1 time with him since everyone was confused. It was the hardest class I have ever taken. DO NOT take this class unless necessary to get your degree. Study the textbook problems and pray. Workshops were the most helpful for me. Find a good workshop leader and keep going.

Dr. Gonzalez explains material clearly and is helpful outside of class. CHM 121 is hard, so stay on top of lessons. Many students drop the course, but if you keep up and ask for help, you can succeed.

I took him for CHM121 and I was expecting it to be super hard, but it actually turned out fine. The homework and lecture are very similar to the exam questions. As long as you do the homework and spend a couple of hours studying each week, you should be fine. Definitely recommend the optional workshops at least once a week. Those were so great!

The literal goat. I don't get the hate on Caesar. I've never met a man more passionate about orgo at 8am 3x a week. Makes u want to learn orgo. This class was hard but there r so many resources like camner, workshops, office hours. He goes super fast but he genuinely wants u to succeed. Actually devastated he's not teaching orgo2 next sem.

everyone should know that around half of the class dropped this course… so many people were failing and there are still people failing. The only people who like him are students who have taken chemistry before. If you haven't taken chem.. haha good luck.

Professor Gonzalez was an okay professor. Though he was available, he was not much help to me. If you plan on taking his course and have never taken chemistry be warned. I attended every class, two tutors a week, outside workshops, and every discussion available and still barely managed to pass exams. This class requires a lot of outside work.
I like to think of the burn book from mean girls when I think of Cesar. He actually makes it so hard for no reason. If you aren't religious, pick one and pray. idk.

Dr. Gonzalez is one of the best chemistry professors at UM, I took him for both 121 and 221. Both courses are hard, but he makes it easy to follow along and doesn't go too fast or slow. As with any other chm course, you have to study hard and put in the work. But he is def your best option, if I could take him for 222 I would too.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This professor isn't bad, but the class is just hard and he goes through the material fairly quick. There aren't really any other great options, though, so taking him is not a bad choice. Prepare to teach yourself, though.

Cesar is a good professor, but you have to do everything yourself. It is a lot of work that you have to be prepared to put in to get an A. It doesn't sound as bad now but it would take up a lot of your free time and stuff you take for granted. He is a good teacher though and is willing to help, a little sassy though.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I loved the way Gonzales teaches! The class is very easy to go along with, and he practices problems over and over. He wants everyone to pass, and as long as you attend every lecture, the tests are pretty easy. best Chem 121 teacher here and also very accessible outside of class with office hours. If you want to pass easily, take him!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He's actually so great! Teaches fast but Chemistry is like that, just do all the homework, go to lectures and discussions are you'll be fine. He knows his stuff and is really funny. Study using past homework questions and class examples. 5 exams but worst is dropped. He really cares for his students and wants them to succeed if you put in the work.

Cesar is actually the boy and he catches way too much flack on here from people who don't work hard. Chem is obviously gonna be difficult, but if you go to class and discussion, you will be fine. Redo all of the homeworks and practice problems before tests and use old tests to practice. Cesar makes chemistry make sense.

I would recommend taking Cesar's class to anyone. I had a great experience, he is extremely passionate about chemistry and truly wants all his students to succeed. Go to his office hours if you are confused!! He tries to make lectures fun and is sassy at times. Always a good time with Cesar! TAKE HIM!

The class itself was hard but if you go to lectures and study a good amount for the tests, it isn't too bad. He gave so many in class examples that prepared and overprepared you for the tests. He goes fast but as long as you go to the lectures, you'll be able to keep up. Use the textbook for practice problems. Retook him for chm 221.

Dr. Gonzalez is the man! I had him in the spring of 2024. Lecture is heavy but necessary for good grade. OFFICE HOURS!!! Make up practice exam questions. UNDERSTAND THE PATTERNS. You will be fine if you try to assess the difficult parts of each chapter and practice practice practice. Read the textbook for supplemental.

Best chem professor for organic chemistry. His lectures are dense but his slides are very organized. You can't escape the fact that orgo is a lot of work outside of class but his office hours are key to practicing content. Do the textbook problems!

He is an amazing teacher and thoroughly explained all of the material. He made chem very doable and I'm taking him next semester for orgo. Go to class because he takes attendance through iClicker sometimes and show up on time because he sometimes calls people out.

This class is naturally hard, but Dr. Gonzalez is very thorough and explains all the concepts in an engaging way. He is also readily available right after lectures and through office hours. His explanations were incredibly helpful, and I don't think I would've done as well in this class if it wasn't for the way he taught the course.

Dr. Gonzalez was great for this lab (HHMI). Super clear instructions, was helpful in lab and pushed us to do well. Not overly difficult and the lab paper wasn't too hard, but the grading was a bit confusing for it.

Dr. Gonzalez is a great professor who is very knowledgeable and caring. He is the best in the department for gen chem! He stays after class to answer questions, records  lectures, and posts recaps of every class. Classes are efficient, you cover tons of material and do practice problems in between. This course is very time consuming though.

Dr Gonzalez is not only the best professor in the chemistry department but also the most helpful human at umiami. Truly wants his students to succeed. Had him for CHM 103, CHM 121 and about to have him for CHM 222. Take this professor if you can! All the bad reviews are written by students who didn't put the work in and expected an A. Hes the best

I've had Cesar for 121, 221, and now 222. He is a great teacher and does a great job lecturing (aka. I never had to read the textbook to supplement). This class was not easy but fair. Use his office hours to your advantage! They are very helpful and he explains Orgo so well! He records lecture which is nice. Overall, caring person; def take him!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Gonzalez is a great professor. If you have any problems with the material he is very accesible and down to help you. Even after taking his class for gen chem, he is accesible. I've been back to ask about orgo material and rec letters and he has kept his door to me and other peers who've had him in the past.

CHM121 is a challenging course, but Professor Gonzalez is a great teacher who genuinely cares about student success. Attend lectures, use the free textbook, and try unstuck AI for study prep - it really helps.

CHM121 is an extremely difficult course that requires a lot of work and time. Mr Gonzalez does a great job of teaching the information and is very thorough in more complicated topics. The tests are hard but I highly recommend going to workshops as they helped a lot. He does take attendance randomly. Overall, great teacher and would take him again.

Overall, a solid chem professor, but some of the homework felt unnecessary and iClicker is just really annoying. He's a pretty good lecturer though at least. Tests are difficult, but doable if you study a lot. After taking other chem professors though, he's def one of the better ones.

Great professor. It's a hard class but Dr. Gonzalez helps you understand. Go to his office hours!! He really funny and wants to get to know his students. He'll answer all your questions and makes sure you understand during office hours. Replies fast to emails.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I think he is one of the best chem professors at UM. He is very accessible and will always help you improve and understand the material.

Took him for both orgo classes because he is that amazing. I was able to do the 5 week CHM 222 summer class with no problem. He is the best professor I have ever had. Inspired me to get a PHD in chemistry. TAKE HIM!

Cesar is the best orgo professor at UM. Take him!! He truly cares about the success of his students and will do everything in his power to help them succeed. With that being said, orgo is a hard class and you have to put in the work. Go to office hours and workshops!!!

Very hard class, five exams (lowest dropped) and a final. iClicker is a portion of grade so make sure you attend so you are there for when he uses it occasionally. Very accessible professor and cares for his students and wants them to succeed. Truly the best professor for CHM121, he knows the course is hard but tries to help as much as he can. 5/5!
I think this class is hard in general, but I feel like Cesar was not the best professor to take for this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I wanted to give Prof. Gonzalez a lower rating because I didn't get an A. But honestly, he is an amazing lecturer and the best professor you can take for this course. CHM121 is inherently difficult and there isn't much you can do about it. you just have to study a LOT because the tests are extremely difficult for the whole department.

Pls take Cesar for orgo if you get the chance! He makes organic chemistry make sense. The grade that you get  is completely what you are willing to put in. Cesar wants all his students to be masters and his office hours are very helpful. Do ALL the textbook problems, they are your best friend for preparing for tests. Hard class but doable with Mo.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Gonzalez is the BEST professor to take for this course. I won't lie, the course itself is difficult because the University makes general chemistry one class rather than two separate courses like they do in other schools. If you genuinely study and go to his office hours you should be fine. Taking CHM110 before this helped me.

reviews.comment: Hard class, good teacher. You need to want it in order to get an A

reviews.comment: Good professor totally normal overall.
