reviews.comment: Honestly, CHM121 is hard af by nature and youre going to need to study HARD. This has nothing to do with the prof you choose. Dr. Gonzalez is a really genuine guy tho. Hes super accessible and responds quickly. He was very patient and reasonable COVID-19 transition. He also gives great lectures and explains things really well in office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Hes a great professor and a great man. You just need to really care and work hard and hell help you succeed. Orgo is OD hard but hes the guy you want to work with. Do the textbook problems and understand the concepts really well
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Gonzalez is an awesome professor. Regardless of who you take, CHM121 is a notoriously difficult class. However, Dr. Gonzalez definitely makes it manageable for you and really wants his students to learn. Does a bunch of practice problems that help a lot and will thoroughly answer any question you have to make sure you understand. Great guy
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Gonzalez has a bit of spark to him. Hes only gonna help you if you prove you want to learn and even then you gotta deal with some sass. The course in fall 2019 was really messed up, almost everyone failed so they changed the curriculum now. Dr Gonzalez goes fast and assumes you have a strong basis in chemistry. Study and go to office hours often

Orgo is hard. Period. But dr. Gonzalez made it more enjoyable. He's really funny and sassy and definitely teaches the topics really thoroughly. It was annoying that the exams were created by three professors, not just him, so some of the exam questions were weird, but overall very doable if you study hard. You definitely need to put the effort in
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: What a professor indeed, this man is very confusing on his best days and generally doesn't care if the majority of the class understands what's taught, he will often laugh or retort when a questions is asked and you don't understand, or he will state "what do you mean , it makes sense" I advise taking another professor, very rude as well
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I LOVED having Prof. Gonzalez and wish he was teaching Orgo next semester. He really cares and really appreciates the people who participate. If you put in the work and read the textbook there is no reason you can't get an A. HW is annoying on ALEKS but it's the same with every chem prof. Gonzalez does a good job explaining and is very accessible.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Gonzalez is a really good professor, UMs chemistry department isnt very good.. orgo 1 isnt curved so..

No matter who you take, the class is hard. I give props to anyone who can successfully teach 2 semesters of chem into 1. UM's chem department in general is trash, but Gonzalez does a really good job at helping his students understand the material. You definitely have to attend class & put in lots of time studying outside class if you want to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Best organic chemistry prof at the University of Miami. Take his lectures!!! He prepares you for the exam but, also to better understand the material in general. After all organic chemistry is a difficult class but, he prepares you. Instead of being a discouraging class he makes it an encouraging class although, you still need to work hard to pass.
Horrible professor. Don't take him. Regardless of how much you study, you can never get above 70. The class median was 58.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The tests for CHM121 are now standardized so it doesn't matter as much who you have because you will all be taking the same exam. Class averages ranged for 60% to 70% throughout the semester with only one exam being curved. Do all the homework and also the suggested textbook problems (listed on his blackboard) for the chapter because they HELP!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Great professor! For his CHM 110 class the textbook is completely useless. His lectures can be very entertaining as he is a very nice person with a sense of humor. He really appreciates participation and makes a large class feel smaller.

While he appears to be strict and un-approachable at times, Dr. Gonzalez is, in fact, a caring professor that prefers to have his students do well. Approach him outside of class if you are struggling, be honest with him and use him as a resource. His exams are clear, and he gives you the right material to prepare you without any surprises.
Dr Gonzalez was the best. He really helped take an incredibly hard subject and make it more manageable and easier to understand. Very thorough lectures. Definitely take him!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Gonzalez is the best teacher I've had so far in college. His lectures are so helpful and he really knows how to teach the material so that it makes sense. If you do a lot of practice problems, go to lecture, and go to office hours if you're confused, an A is totally doable. Tests are challenging but fair. He's also really nice and funny!

Made orgo accessible for all. Orgo is already challenging but he made it a lot easier. Great in lecture and available to explain further after class and during office hours every week. Exams were similar to hw worksheets he gives for practice. Am taking him again for orgo 2 and CAN'T WAIT. DEFINITELY RECOMMEND!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr Gonzalez is an excellent teacher. Clear, efficient, and available, he offers a variety of opportunities for his students to bring out their BEST in the class. He gives little homework, and many optional practice problems and worksheets for students to improve. I would definitely take another class with him without any hesitation.

Best chemistry professor I've ever had! He explains the concepts so well and tests you on the important things about orgo. He is extremely helpful and very clear. Organic chemistry is just a difficult concept so be prepared to study, but he makes the class a lot more understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He is not for everyone. But if you are willing to study and trust the process, probably you'll get where you want to be. He does his job really good. I recommend him.

He has rules in his class to take the students to the success. Just listen to him. He is so nice, approachable, a good Mathematician(always has a great explanation for the complex topics). He is very disciplined. Take him if you want to learn not just for taking a Math course. Otherwise you will struggle because he asks you to study really hard.

Spent hours doing homework and practicing just for nothing on the exam to match up. So much content, super fast. Will not let you into class if you're late, and takes 10% off your grade if you don't show up. I tried to email him explaining personal problems, and he did not reply.

For calculus, this was one of the most frustrating classes I have taken. The course expectations were often unclear. The biggest issue was that the exams were completely different from the material covered in class.
Hard class decent teacher and best in the math department but still a hard class.
He is a great professor, go to office hours for help. He does go fast and the course is very hard. He is the toughest professor but you learn the most and he is very entertaining.

Was ridiculously hard. We had a quiz for every module and since we did a module a day it was a quiz every day, some of them going more than 30 questions. He doesn't really give partial credit. Super nice person but doesn't explain the topics well and assumes you already have learned the stuff before. Tests are also hard.

for calc 2, he is not good. bro just writes a bunch of stuff out and have you copy it. he doesn't explain why he does things a certain way so you just gotta ask or guess. he is responsive to questions but it's difficult because sometimes you don't even know that you don't know. 

also tests have like no partial credit. (he lied)

The class is lowk easy, just review the worksheets (quiz qs are taken from them) & do review packets for tests. Dr. Sayar himself is nice, but definitely has days where he is moody. Make sure not to lie about your attendance lmao

As a B grade student, 161 was tough in general. His tests are hard. However, he will do his most to prepare you for his exams. He goes pretty fast but the class is structured to where you move at your own pace. He's really nice and light hearted. By far one if not the best Calc teacher (not saying much tbh cause there's no alternative)

Dr. Sayar actually cares about his students. People that say he has "favoritism" is people they either don't make the effort to attend office hours and get to know the professor or come to class late/don't stop talking. Calc 1 is a class you have to put outside effort behind. He prepares you well for the final, though it may seem difficult to begin

I unfortunately have to agree with the bad reviews here. He does have the potential of being an incredible professor, which is why I'm giving a 2 instead of a 1, but he simply refuses to execute. His go-to phrase is 'guys it's easy', and then considers his teaching done. It's very possible to succeed in his class, but ridiculously hard.

He is always accessible, responds to emails super quickly. Material he gives is very intense but helpful. You need to study regularly to be successful. He has a demanding teaching style, you really need to study. No easy points fyi.

Most unfair, frustrating, and discouraging course I've ever taken. He clearly favors the boys. He'd tell some students certain things about exam content and other students the opposite. After majority of the class failed the first exam, he proceeded to tell us we'd fail the second. Don't take him unless you want to feel rage baited every class.

The hardest and most discouraging math class I've ever taken. He's very intelligent but his teaching style and exams make it difficult to succeed. Go to office hours!! The exams & quizzes are much harder than in other Calc II sections. If you're not already extremely strong in math and able to teach yourself most of the material, I would avoid him.

Strong instructor with a clear teaching style, especially for a challenging course. He explains the material in a way that makes the hard concepts easy and he is always willing to help if you put in the effort. He is available outside of class and genuinely wants his students to succeed. If you stay on top of the work, you can do well in his class.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: In his classes, you feel the nice pressure of 'you have to study', you will be provided a lot of useful resources, and you'll find your responses with him. He really knows what he is doing. If you are not willing to study and just hoping to pass without doing nothing, do not take him. If you want to learn, no doubt, take him.

Really nice guy and extremely intelligent. However, his tests are incredibly challenging (in comparison to the other Calc classes), and he won't admit to it. He provides comprehensive worksheets that will help you study for the tests and is always available during office hours, but you have to work extremely hard to get a good grade.

Took the spark out of my eyes. I have been very good in math but this math class was far beyond difficult. He chooses favorites and if you're not one of those then you can kiss your good grade goodbye. He is very unfair. I went to all his office hours and still continued to struggle. He told my poor quiz grade to the whole class and singled me out.

Do NOT do it. Does not teach, writes on the board for 5 minutes, then expects you to understand it. quiz every week, sometimes a quiz and an exam in the same week. Also, the mood swing comment is 100% accurate.
Nice guy, tries his best. Has office hours outside of class. He does his best to make a tired night class participate. Wants his students to try their best and do well.

Dr. Sayar just wants us to study. If a student wants to learn and is willing to study, can take his course. His course has a discipline. He is willing to guide you anytime. My experience with him is going great.
Great person, decent teacher. Gives extra credit at the end of the semester for attendance.

He has mood swings and is nice somedays and then rude other days. Do not take him, there are other easier professors; at least I took a calculus in high school first because this man does not teach. AT ALL. I spend the entire class just trying to write down what he's writing on the board at the speed of light and learning is NOT possible; RUN AWAY.

He only pays attention to certain people in class, he doesn't care about his other students and just does problems on the board, when asked questions, he deems you and tries to say another way but just says the same thing over. He is just a pick me with certain students and tries to act nice just truly a wolf in sheep clothing
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great at explaining topics but does move very quickly, as expected with a class like this. If you put in effort and pay attention he's good just don't fall behind. He's easily accessible outside class and really wants his students to learn the material.

He is very friendly and accessible outside of class but very inconsistent in the standards he sets for class. He sometimes grades very easy or exceptionally hard if you don't solve a problem in the convoluted way he demonstrates things. His lectures will not make sense unless you have taken calculus before.

Dr. Sayar wants some students to succeed, but his mood swings and pop-up quizzes—sometimes even two a day make the class unpredictable. He deletes criticism from here, doesn't understand how the math department works and grades tests harshly. He fails students quickly, quiz grades and extra pointsbarely impact the final, even if you do well.

POP QUIZ! In Calc 2! 

I wrote a review before but it got deleted: DO NOT take him
He isn't Rosenberg but also NOT a legend these reviews INSIST. He made the course unnecessarily difficult, assumed prior knowledge of topics not covered in Calc 1, goes so fast that if u blinked  you're so behind that you might as well give up for the rest of class.

This is my second review as the honest reviews are bring deleted. Do NOT take this professor. He is NOT the legend he claims to be. Quizzes do not represent the actual tests. He tends to make you feel inadequate.  

Note to Dr. Sayar....please do not erase this review....

Take him. He teaches at a good pace, and wants to make sure everyone understands the material. Genuinely a nice guy too, he won't screw you over. His quizzes and tests are problems that are covered in class, but they're not crazy tough. Compared to the other math professors, this is definitely your guy. Go to class and you'll be fine.

He's a great professor who genuinely cares about his students and wants them to succeed. He does his best to help, but be ready to put in the effort Calc 1 is a tough class and it's a challenging class. He doesn't like repeating material he's already covered, so make sure to take good notes and review them if you need a refresher.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Sayar is a very unique professor at UM Math department. It is super easy to communicate with him because he is super friendly. The way he teaches is quite different than the other Math professors. He makes it fun and smooth. He is very helpful and super caring. If you need to take a Math course, you should definitely take it with him.

As a person that struggles in math, his class wasn't too hard. A lot of questions in the lecture were extremely similar to the ones on the exams and quizzes. He's a great teacher and will always try to help and explain. His office hours were helpful too.

He can be a good person, but honestly, he's not amazing. His lectures are really hard to understand, and the midterms are super difficult. The assignments are tough and often don't match what he teaches in class, which makes things even more confusing. He's not terrible, but he's definitely not amazing either. Just okay.

He is chill and fun, but his lectures are hard. He gives a ton of homework that is harder and different than what he teaches in class. He is not the best professor ever or the best option for math, I'm sure there's better. He is good but he is not amazing like these reviews make him seem. Honestly, it looks like he wrote these reviews himself lmao.

I took Calc I with him and I really enjoyed his class. His teaching way is very different than the other professors. He teaches like telling a story from the real life :) makes you curious and gets your attention 
Now I am taking Calc II and it is great to see him again as my professor. 
He knows Math super deeply! And he is always there to help.

Professor Sayar is an incredible teacher. I had him his first semester teaching at UMiami, but he was already great as he had a lot of experience teaching at other universities. He is very helpful but does not waste time answering questions that have been already answered, so paying attention is important. Would for sure take again.
Guys, Dr. Cem is funny and kind, but his class is so difficult I would rather not take him his lectures are so difficult, even his tests and midterms, but he is helpful sometimes

Professor Sayar is an exceptional educator who genuinely cares about his students' success. He creates an engaging, energetic classroom atmosphere and provides thoughtful guidance that helps students thrive. His dedication to teaching and personal investment in each student's growth make him stand out.

Cem Sayar is an amazing professor. He's very engaging and always willing to explain and help out anywhere you need. His lectures were entertaining and easy to pay attention to, and I truly feel like I learned this semester. He's absolutely hilarious so the class was never boring. I'm looking forward to taking Calculus 2 with him next semester.

The professor has an answer for every math question. His knowledge is very strong, and he explains the concepts in a way that matches your level of understanding. I learned a lot from him, I really appreciate that. If you really study, you can learn, pass, and enjoy his class. He is in a positive way very different than the other Professors.

Dr. Sayar has been a great Professor! He is super easy and understanding. Learning Math is more fun with him.
Don't hesitate to take his course - if you can find an available seat :)
He's a great professor and teaches the class with compassion. His way of clearing doubts is awesome and easy to understand.

I wasn't planning to write here, but other students should know about him. While many professors in the Math department don't seem to care, this one does. I was super stressed during a final, and he noticed. He calmly approached me, offering support and calming words. He's truly a unique and caring professor. I am sure he will be a legend at UM.

Most incredible professor I've had in my entire life - even in one of the most challenging courses I've taken. He is a very friendly guy and makes class entertaining at all times. His class is not overly challenging since he explains everything so clearly and is always available to help. Review packages were very helpful in preparing for the exams.
great guy, class isn't bad just study

Dr. Sayar has been a great professor for my first math course at UM. He is extremely caring about his students and even set up a Zoom Meeting with me over Thanksgiving break to explain a topic I was confused about. He is a fair grader, but the material is difficult in itself. Prepare early and go to his office hours! I would take him again!

Professor Sayar is incredibly approachable and easygoing. I'm thrilled to have him at UM! Unlike many other professors, he brings a unique and refreshing style to his teaching. He believes that learning new concepts should be an enjoyable experience for students, which is both inspiring and engaging. I am 100% sure he will be a legend at UM.

The professor doesn't use documents during his lectures, making his teaching natural. He's great at math and explains things clearly. He's also super friendly and approachable. His office hours are fun, and he creates a great vibe in class, helping students learn and work together.

Dr. Sayar is a great professor. Teaching our class isn't easy, but he handles it really well, even when he's disrespected at times. He sometimes goes beyond the syllabus to explain the logic behind the topics, which makes the course more interesting. It's clear he knows a lot more math than just what's in a PreCalculus class. Good job, Dr. Sayar!

Dr. Sayar is one of the best professors I have ever had. His ability to teach calculus so one can understand it and always be open to work with students combined with his sense of humor makes for an engaging and interesting lecture. His exams are fair and he teaches to them in class and always provides office hours.

Professor is a great teacher. He is easygoing,but he expects you to work hard.Every week, the first class includes a quiz, so make sure to stay on top of the lessons. His office hours are usually busy,but he's always willing to meet with students,even outside of those hours.He cares about helping you succeed and is available whenever you need help.

Wow! Everybody should take his class! He is a unique version of being a professor. He is not only a great professor but also a great friend in the class. He is so funny and fantastic! UM is lucky to have him.

Professor Sayar is exceptionally approachable and kind, with a genuine passion for mathematics that shines through in his teaching. His enthusiasm is evident in every moment of his lectures, making complex topics more accessible and engaging. With disciplined and consistent study, students can fully appreciate and benefit from his teaching style.

This professor is great at teaching Calc 1. I am easily enrolling in Calc 2 for his course because in a comedic way, he can teach quite well. The lessons are interesting and intuitive, and his personal assignments are not that bad. Definitely pay attention because he does not like dealing with lazy students. Overall amazing professor.

Professor Sayar is a rare teacher who makes math enjoyable and easy to understand. His classes are interactive and fun, with plenty of group work, so you never feel lost or left out. He genuinely cares about his students—he's always available for questions. Honestly, he's not just a great professor; he's a teacher who makes a lasting impact.

Every class with him feels like a performance. I've never had such an engaging Math course before. He's not only an incredibly caring and kind person, but also genuinely funny! His office hours are a great opportunity for collaboration, and I always leave feeling more confident and connected with the material. I really enjoy them!

He is funny and is always happy and energetic. He assigns an excessive amount of homework, there is a quiz every Monday on the topics covered the week before. he explains topics in class well, but when you asks questions he is vague and lazy to help you, he literally tells us to google the answers or use chatgpt. would take him again.
The instructor's explanations were often difficult to follow, and the course materials did not seem well organized or up to date.

The class wasn't bad, but there was no server set up, so we couldn't do anything hands-on, and it was just conceptual, so all he would do was lecture and read off the slides. I feel like I wasted my tuition money taking this course because I didn't really get anything out of it. There were 5 quizzes, one midterm, and a final.

The class wasn't so hard, but sometimes I wish that his lectures were more interactive because it's easy to lose focus in his lectures since all he does is read off the slides. His quizzes aren't bad, and the exams are half written and half coding.

I don't think he's a good instructor. The exam is challenging, and I've had to put a lot of time into this course, but it's still hard to get an A. During my internship, I also realized that the material we covered was pretty OUTDATED!

These reviews make me so sad! He is a great professor, and you will do well if you go to lecture and ask questions. Not sure how he is with larger classes (we only had 6 students in ours) but he would encourage us to ask questions and participate. I would say the content is a bit challenging, especially with the later units, but just pay attention.

I have emailed him with questions and followed up, but he has never responded. The only opportunity to ask him is during class breaks, but he seems indifferent and dismissive toward students. He doesn't appear to enjoy teaching, nor does he seem to have a strong research record. It feels like he is just going through the motions. Bad experience

He is mean and impatient toward students who do not follow his instructions. He does not grade assignments seriously and often ignores emails. He seems disinterested in teaching and appears to focus on publishing low-quality papers. Although I got an A, I will never take his class again. It required a lot of time studying on my own.
Somewhat hard to understand, very theoretical lectures. Testing and quizzes are very easy if you know the basic formulas for the course. Allows one page equations sheet for tests.

He is really nice but his planning for this class not good. He has only one powerpoint file for the whole semester. The class consists of three exams and a group presentation. The exams are super hard and the group project it depends of the people you are working with.

Gives very unhelpful advice for exams and often leads students in the wrong direction. During presentations, he points out everything wrong in front of the class. Homework and assignments are very easy but the lectures are extremely boring and hard to stay awake in. Attendance is mandatory. Made me not want to be a marketing major.

Tests are tricky! The case studies are interesting, and if you answer all the hw questions, you'll get 100% on the assignments! Carlos has great experience; he knows what he is talking about, and he is a great connection for business students.

Professionally speaking, he is very resourceful but I wouldn't say the same about his teaching. He is extremely ambiguous about how the exams are going to be like or how the questions are going to be formatted so there isn't really a way of preparing properly, EVEN with the video review. Surprisingly un-engaging for someone who teaches marketing.

Useful simulations and skill development in class. Lectures can get boring and repetitive. Tests are not hard. Takes attendance every class (20% of your grade). If you stay on top of your work, you will do well.

Mr. Erban is nice and funny, but his lectures r boring. His class is A LOT of work with 2 big, hard exams, group projects, and assignments each week that take a lot of time. He also sometimes throws in a random extra assignment that's not even on the syllabus to do; he threw in an extra group presentation, only giving us a few days to do it.
Okay carlos is a chill dude personality wise but bewareee.... tons of case studies and things to read and attendance is VERY MANDATORY. lectures are boring. the final screwed my whole grade over.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Erban is one of the most caring professors I've ever had. He loves what he does and loves his students, too. Sometimes he'll excuse absences if you just ask, and the class isn't that hard if you go to the lectures and pay attention.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: extremely nice professor! if you go to him to talk about your test he's super understanding and willing to help you. 3 tests (mc and usually 2 frq), 1 project, a couple case study homeworks but its very easy.

He's nice, but he's one of those people who are knowledgeable about their field but not the best at teaching. Lectures are kinda useless, so study outside of class. Do NOT SKIP class; he takes attendance every single time, and it's 20% of the grade. Case studies are annoying, but tests are straightforward. Giant group project + two exams.

Nice guy but teaching style is terrible. Boring lectures, 600+ slides, no sheets for tests but posts review videos and will curve. Participation and attendance matter! Easy case studies. One group project, posts a confusing rubric and there's ZERO guidance. Made a simple intro marketing class confusing and stressful. Take someone else if you can!!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Unorganized lectures, a lot of group projects with highly unclear instructions. He does really love this topic though and his passion for it really shows. Very nice guy just his teaching style was difficult for me.

Teaching style didn't resonate w/ me. Unorganized lectures made note taking hard (slide deck is one long presentation for the whole sem) & no study guides provided for exams. Group project worth 20% of final grade with little guidance or talk of it. Accessible outside of class but not very helpful. Lots of marketing experience though

Do yourself a favor and don't take his class. This guy is a complete mess, his slides are super unorganized. He is the complete opposite of business, he shouldn't even be apart of the business school. 50% of grade is participation and he can't remember anyone's name. Exams and study guides are very subjective, vague, and opinion based.

He is a very nice guy and most of the content is pretty straightforward marketing information and he has a very strong background with large companies in marketing like P&G. Class consists of case study assignments, exams, and group project which is fairly time consuming but really not that bad. His exams are all open note short response q's.

Very nice professor but his lectures can be VERY BORING at times. However, some days when he brought in guest speakers the class was very interesting. We had 1 big group project and he wasn't very clear on what the directions were for it and the entire class was confused. Overall the class is still very easy though and I would take again.

**MKT 385. I wanted to like him and think he was a nice guy, but he was actually one of my least favorite professors at UM. You are graded on very few things, with one large group project at the end. His slideshow is 200 slides+ and I think we spent the entire class on the same 5. He lets you bring whatever you want to the exams. Don't take.

Prof. Erban seems like a great guy but his teaching style did not resonate with me. I mean this in the nicest way but he NEEDS to project his voice so people in the back are forced to hear him. Large chunk of your final grade rests on the group project, and I personally HATE group projects. Class materials are very useful though.

Professor Erban is a really nice guy, but his lectures are very boring. If the lectures were more engaging and less random, he would easily get a 5! Fair grader, assignments are relevant and interesting, group project was extensive but applied everything we learned in class. Great professor, just needs to present the material differently in class.

no homework assignments besides the google certifcates and stukent simulation. Easy class and he is cute and nice. Clearly very passionate about digital marketing. Tests were open note and there was a hefty final project but the group was big making work load less on each person. Attendance mandatory. recommend taking if you need an easy mkt class!
Super friendly professor, but forgets the substance of the class. Lectures about random things every class and does not stay focused ever. Gets off topic often. Super nice but would not take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Erban genuinely cares about all of his students. When students gave feedback about things in class they didn't love, he actively sought to rectify the issue so that every student could enjoy and learn more from his class. He is readily available to meet with students and is extremely passionate about what he does.

Lectures about the same thing every class that isnt even on the test.
google certificate, marketing simulation, two exams, and a group project
BUSY WORK that you don't learn from at all

Great professor that is super experienced in his field and brings a lot of personal examples into his lectures. Class consists of 1 heavily weighted time-consuming group project, 3 exams, weekly case study assignments and some in class participation. Would definitely take another class with him. Very approachable and understanding professor.

Highly experienced in Marketing, tries to incorporate his experience within lectures.Handful number of assignments, 1 time consuming semester project that is harshly graded so make sure you put time on it.2 long exams that include conceptual and opinion based questions. Overall good teacher just wish he stood to his words on feedback for projects.
Very engaging lectures and he was able to make a boring subject seem interesting. 10/10 recommend

A really chill guy. Assignments are easy and there's only a handful of them. Big group project over the entire semester but so easy and straight forward, but he does grade tough on it so make sure you do good. Has a lot of experience in marketing. Always willing to help you succeed in his class. Also, go to class. Attendance is graded.

Personally didn't have a great time in this class. Made you present twice the same project to give feedback but then ended up giving us a bad grade anyway. Exams are hard, not sure what he wanted as answers. Otherwise, he was fine, decent. Wouldn't take again tho.

He is a great professor for a really interesting class. It is easy to participate while barely paying attention and the exams are open note case studies which makes it really easy to learn real-world marketing. The course is easy and although it seems like a lot of material in the lectures, most of the notes are not necessary to know for the exam.

Great professor. Wants the student to succeed. Lectures can be a little boring sometimes but clear. One mid term, one final, one group project, one simulation and a Google certification as well. Interactive class. Clear expectations. Learned a lot and also gained hands on experience. Tests are not the easiest. I would take him again

Great professor, would definitely take him again. Lectures are very interesting, especially if you're passionate about marketing. Not a lot of homework, exams are based on case studies, and you also have one group project due at the end of the semester. He takes the attendance seriously. Overall, a great course taught by a great professor.

Best MKT201 professor at UM. Tests are easy and based on case studies. Study the ppt. If you don't perform well, you can email him and he'll give you an extra credit assignment. Easy grader and the only homework assignments were a few questions based on a case study. There is a group presentation but it's easy & the due date isn't until December.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Great professor! he doesn't rely much on the textbook and talks a lot more about his personal experiences so we can understand the concepts better. Exams are open book and mostly case studies. They can be a little challenging but he explains the content well and is happy to clarify anything- If you study you'll be ok! Overall would deff recommend!

Amazing marketing professor. He has years of experience at a well-known brand, making him credible for his teaching. Assignments are mainly case studies and 1 group project. Assignments are posted in advance, and you are given a lot of time to do it. Lectures are a mix of his presentation and real-life stories. Take this professor if you can!

I took him for marketing but he teaches other classes. Best of the best professor. If u want to learn take this class. Test can be a little challenging but he always does reviews before the class, if u study you will be good. He is not a tough grader either. He is very knowledgable in his subject and a very smart guy. Would def recommend

Prof. Connolly is awesome. Totally recommend this class, even if you're not an Econ major. Class structure is simple, 95% midterm/final, 5% participation. He passes an attendance sheet so be sure to show up if you need a grade boost at end of semester. Make some time to talk to him after class, that guarantees the A.
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Connelly is honestly one of the best professors at UM. He's super down to earth, funny, and genuinely such a nice guy. I always looked forward to going to class. Only 2 exams and the review sheets are really helpful and similar. I 100% recommend his class, no regrets at all. I honestly wish I could take him again!

Protect this man at all costs. He's amazing. He's so cool and down to earth.  He cares about his students and tells good stories during class. His Latin America lectures were super interesting and relevant to current events when a lot of other econ classes are dry.

really cared about the students and was very helpful outside of class. Isn't strict on attendance at all but will randomly take it once in a while. Always loved seeing what tie he was going to wear for the day :)
The lectures are kind of stale, but the the actual content is interesting if you listen. Tests are extremly easy and exactly like the study guide.
Professor Connolly is awesome. Class is mainly good stories and good vibes. The only thing is exams r 90% of grade so lock in
Nice guy, but long lectures. Grade is based off 1 exam and the final. Participation/attendence was literally 3% of the grade. Not a horrible class. Tests are open response and no multiple choice.

Very nice/genuine guy but I was not a fan of the class. Your whole grade is based on just two exams and while he does give a study guide with the type of questions he'll ask, you're mostly in the dark on what info you'll need to know and his PowerPoints don't rly help. Not necessarily super tough material, just annoying having to rely only on exams

Amazing professor that is probably one of the kindest I have ever had. Super approachable outside of class and his lectures showcase his passion and knowledge very clearly. Took this class online so the grade makeup was 97% (Exam 1 & 2) and zoom attendance was 3%. Always open to introducing current topics into lectures and keeps things interesting.

Very kind professor, I'm very glad I took his class. The grade is just one midterm and one final, and it's take home as the class was online. Pretty straight forward, if you want a good grade take the class.

Super nice guy, teaches a pretty simple class based on lectures and two exams to go with it. Each student has a small presentation as well. More of a history or international affairs class than economics, but that honestly makes it more interesting. He has a lot of expertise and experience in the regions he teaches on as well.

He is the nicest/sweetest old man alive. The class was interesting and easy-none of the concepts were very hard and exams are based on the review questions he posts beforehand. The Professor really cares about his students and tells funny jokes. Take him!

He is the best professor at UM. Literally the smartest man Ive ever met. Sounds corny but its an honor to be his student. Youll learn so much from him. Material is not very difficult and he makes the exams very straight forward with reviews to go with each one before hand. If you can, definitely take him. Hes the best!

Great Professor. One of the nicest at UM. I learned a lot from him. You have to have some background to be able follow the lectures though. Not a ton, but enough to ask meaningful questions etc.. He gives really good detailed answers. He also loves to help students and will always make an effort to help outside of class.

Nicest / sweetest professor I've ever had at UM, but his class was really unorganized and he is not a great teacher. You can take this class and get an easy B but the class is 100% test grades and you never know what will be on it even with study guide. He is helpful in office hours. SOO nice though

As part of the MAIA program I have never taken a finance class so I took this class blind folded. Since it is an online class it makes it difficult with the finance terminology, however he was more than willing to help. I overthought the questions but they were honestly extremely easy. This definitely a great way to get your foot in the door.

Maybe the easiest course I've ever taken.  A couple tests based mainly off the 4 problem review questions right before the test.  You won't learn much in the way of macroecon theory but for most people a solid choice.

Sometimes he rambles and class gets boring but class is a lot more entertaining when students ask questions, he is better at explaining and lecturing when you ask related questions because he knows a lot! Is quick with grading exams, and goes over a problem set that will help you do well on the upcoming exam.
Really nice guy, and very knowledgeable. I feel like a lot of people may not have the background to follow a lot of what he does, but if you do you will learn a lot from Professor Connolly

Dr. Connolly is probably the nicest old man ever. Coincidentally (or not) this was the easiest class ever. Still not sure how I got 100% in the course and an A not A+. I digress, three exams are your entire grade, so easy. Just don't take his night class if you can help it because his soothing voice will put you to sleep!

Did not learn anything from this class. Take it if you are looking to fulfill a requirement and want an easy B+/A-? Don't even go to class, you won't understand anything. Only formulas on powerpoints are used, a lot of extra info.

He's a nice guy but can't teach that save is life. Class is simply him rambling about the oddest things and then he asks questions on the test that we never talk about. On the positive he does allow open notes and open book on the tests.
Great professor.  Very knowledgeable. Funny! Talks a lot about his experience with the IMF.  Tests are fair; similar problems to practice test.
Had hime of international Monetary Economics.  His class was extremely boring but he was very nice and funny at times. Just study and you'll be fine

attendance not mandatory, but go for the (rare) notes. you learn the basics of macroecon, but he talks a lot about life in general and about his many travels. tests are easy (usually the same as the practice test but with different numbers). great guy that will take you to lunch at the rat a few times instead of class.

Booring. Took her for research, course code wasn't available. Lecture is just her reading off the ppts and then a guest speaker. Focus on the study guides she gives and know them by heart you'll do fine. She's petty with class attendance, but she gave extra credit for those did go. Research poster was not that bad to do, she's just super nitpicky.
Caring and professional, highly knowledgeable.
Has very disorganized powerpoints and it takes a lot of time to organize them in ways you can study and understand them.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I had this Professor for pharmacology and I can not say enough good things about her. Exams are straight from the ppts and lectures. She gives very specific SGs that will guarantee you a 90% on every exam, the extra points are from additional info on ppts. She will give you a SG for the HESI, and I would focus on that and HESI remediation quizlets.

I took her for Pharm. She's an excellent lecturer and gives anecdotes that will help you on exams and on ur HESI/NCLEX. My favorite was "cold and clammy need some candy". You need to come to class bc attendance is for a grade. Pharm is just hard bc there's so many meds you have to know and their mechanism of action, adverse effects, etc.

Love love love Dr. D! She is so caring and really wants her students to do well! She does give a quiz at the end of each lecture, so go to class! Also, do not come late! You are not allowed to take the quiz if you are more than 15 minutes late to class (which is at 8am)! She was super helpful in lecture and gave a lot of tips for the HESI!

He taught a very dense/abstract subject and broke it down to made it digestible. His quizzes were difficult but there wasn't anything that he didn't cover on them, and 99.5% of the quiz questions were on his study guides. I found that the quizzes got easier over time, put perhaps that's because I understood his testing style better.
I wish more professors were like this man!! He is GREATTTT! I don't know what half of the people on this board are talking about because he couldn't be more helpful and clear.... A+!!!
Great professor
He is amazing hilarious and a great professor makes you understand the material very easily!! Ignore those comments he is the best!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
THE WORST

The entire class did extremely poor on the first exam and it is 45% of our grade. Test was impossible, and i honestly feel like it was intentional. He said he wasn't going to curve but he would "adjust" the grades. Oh, anded he is making us wait an entire week for test review. Going to need to pray for second exam because its another 45% !
He has a weird sense of humor. It rubbed me the wrong way, however if you talk to him one on one he's pretty cool. Do his study guide and you'll do good in his class.

You might as well study the book and not go to his class. He needs to teach more about the nursing process and priorities of care and quit trying to be so funny and likeable in class. By the time you take the exam or the Hesi nothing makes sense.

At first, he seems like a fun, nice guy but by the end of the semester you realize that he might have a personality issue and is kind of a jerk. He curves his exams, but when you get to the Hesi, it has nothing he taught on it so the class is useless. Just read to book, lectures are just an excuse for him to talk.

Hmm...He's great one-on-one but during lecture he's incredibly rude and yells at us for asking questions. His exams aren't very true to his lectures, and his study guides weren't based on what he lectured. He curves pretty big though so it's definitely possible to get an A in the class. Attendance isn't mandatory but I would suggest it.

This was my favorite class. I enjoyed studying for it because it made me work hard. I spoke a lot during case studies and that showed him how much I enjoyed this course. The only people rating him low are people who don't love it. You just learn to love it and I loved it. The only bad part was minimal hw and easy tests. I wish he made it harder.

Most fair professor i've had at UM. Class is difficult, but the exams are exactly what is on the case study.  However, I do think that the case studies are pointless and the grading system doesn't make snese

Previous review has to be written by the Professor himself. Not a single student would be happy with a C, and this is definitely not the hardest class in terms of exams. It is only hard for the professor not to randomly select you for a low case study grade.

Great professor—clear lectures, organized slides, and genuinely cares about student success. Exams are fair and match what's taught. Only downside: one classmate, i believe named tony would routinley show up with a quite FOUL odor and distract the whole class. Otherwise, excellent course overall.

My problem today isn't with the professor, it's with a classmate. I found the class very interesting, but ran into issues during many classes regarding the body odor of another student. This large beast of a man (Tony i think his name is) would routinely make the class smell like a porta potty. I have to imagine this is why prof was mean. Nice guy.

People get mad because of grades, intermediate II is the hardest course in the accounting department, so its obviously not going to be easy. When I spoke to him in office hours he helped me understand the concepts and that helped my grade. Overall its just a difficult class and the grades aren't handed to students.

Professor Macciocchi opened my eyes to the world of accounting, mainly how bad the department is run here. I would recommend dropping anything to do with accounting as long as he and Medina are running shop.
AI deserves to take this guys job not ours. At least AI could grade the case studies in a way it could remeber who speaks and not just give you some BS. The worst

Nice guy, but definitely has favorites. If you enjoy listening to lectures instead of having to participate, do not take. Course is 4 midterms that make up 80% of the grade. The other 20% is case study participation which he still doesn't accurately grade even if you speak. No practice exams so you have only his lectures to base studying off of.
Take Werner at all costs. Utterly confused
Professor Macciocchi is a great guy, but is not a great teacher. I would take Werner if I did it again.

Expects heavy participation and will challenge/grill/question you on what you say. Tests are difficult without discussing them after. Good teacher, but definitely has his favorites and just an interesting teaching style.
Do not take this guy. Wait until Werner teaches 312 in the fall. Worth the wait to not suffer.

Great Professor! I came in this class nervous because of the many previous bad reviews about this professor but he is opposite of what those reviews said. He gives what is needed to pass each exam and is always open to help if your struggling with a topic. Studying is required but your well prepared by this professor to pass.
One of the best professors I had. I love the Harvard cases. Participation matters a lot, it's probably the most important thing to succeed in his class.

MY FAVORITE PROF! He truly cares about you and about your real-world understanding of accounting. He does this through case-studies, which you discuss in class (participation matters here) and his lectures that apply directly to what we do on our tests. This has been my favorite class this semester and I wish he taught more courses. Funny guy too
He is just amazing! Definitely my favorite class of the semester. I wish he taught more courses. MFC.

I never go do these but made the exception for this guy bc he is the goat. Everything he does is super organized and you actually learn stuff through his lectures and especially the case study discussions where you learn real life applications of what you are learning. Speak during those cases and make good points. Use study guides + class examples
Guy is genuinely a good dude. You will be fine if you come to class and participate in the four case studies. Probably the best accounting professor I've had.

Currently in his class but with enrollment coming up I gotta come on here and say the reviews below are false and probably came from one student that just had it out for him. His lectures definitely require full attention and effort, and I studied a lot for exam 1, but he's not a bad teacher at all and actually wants to see students do well
DO NOT TAKE THIS GUY! Unfortunately you are forced to as an accounting major. The worst.
Worst professor in the accounting department. Would not recommend taking him if you have other options.

The professor's grading system for participation is horrible. 20% of your attendance grade is based on showing up to class, the other 80% is split between whether or not he REMEMBERS if you spoke during the two in class discussion or not. Gave me a failing participation grade just because he can't recall. Bias and unfair system.
Guy is the worst
awful
incredibly pretentious and rude
once used an entire lecture to scream at all of his students that they did poorly on an exam...maybe teach better
not a nice person

Professor Macciocchi engaging teaching style made every class enjoyable. He is also incredibly approachable and always willing to go the extra mile. He is one of the best professors I have ever had at UM. Highly recommend his classes to anyone interested in accounting!

His Excel lectures and exercises don't translate well to his paper exams. The exams are 10-12 loaded questions with ~40 minutes to complete, and it ends up being tight for most people. He's not transparent about grading as he said he would curve a group assignment but didn't. He also says that certain concepts won't be on the exam, but they are

The class is tough (lots of notions and so many things to cover) but he's just an amazing prof. He made the material accessible even to non-accounting-major students. I would take any other of his classes

Professor Macciocchi has to be one of the best professors at UM. He does a great job simplifying the material in very easy lectures, while also showing where you can implement his teachings into the real world. He is the most approachable professor I have had, and he provides a good student to professor relationship.

Prof. Macciocchi makes understanding somewhat difficult topics much easier. He's fair for exams (allows front/back note sheet on exams) and group project is not too difficult. He likes to see a lot of participation in class but the participation grade is just from online reflective questions. 10/10 and very attainable to get an A. Such a chill guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor I learned a lot from his class and he was a great teacher. Easy to follow and very straightforward tests.

His exams are based on what is on his slides so if you study those you are in great shape. His participation is based on weekly discussions on pack back which were pretty easy and took about an hour-ish a week. His project wasn't too difficult but make sure you put effort into it. He is a great and reasonable professor, take him if you can.

One of my favorite professors at this school and easily one of the best accounting professors. Makes difficult topics seem very simple. Not really any homework, and the tests are just like the practice problems. Encourages questions and genuinely wants students to succeed. I am an accounting major and this has been my favorite accounting class.
Difficult class but amazing teacher, he wants to see everyone succeed. One of my favorite accounting teachers I have had so far at this school.
Super chill and would take him again! accepts late work and gives clear feedback
I genuinely don't know why there are any bad ratings on him. He is so easy and amazing. If you need a chill class, take him. He is one of my favorite professors at UM I have taken him twice now.

He is a good guy but a bit disorganized. You can see he care about his students and gives the material to succeed in his class. There was 6 speeches all somewhat 4-6 minutes. He's not a tough grader and gives valuable feedback if you're stuck on a speech. Overall easy class and good professor.
Easiest class ever. He doesn't really do anything, there were guest speakers every day and you just had to show up and listen. All quizzes are online and there is no final.
Amazing, so sweet. He accepts late work, and is funny. Def recommend

He didnt really teach much, he had guest lectures almost every class, who spoke on the most random stuff. you could read the slides and chapters and learn the info but he doesn't make much effort to help students learn. no tests or final, only quizzes with answers online and these 500-word "Micro-Reports" every week. Easy A but waste of time
Prof. Steinberg is great! It is a very easy class. You can get an "A" as long as you attend every class and complete the assignments, and they are all very easy. The quizzes are all online.
The TA's do everything for him. It's super easy to get an A in this class, just do the assignments on time (even if you dont you can submit months later and still be fine). Would 100% take again

he's pretty good and nice, however all of the graded things are done by the TAs and I don't think he even takes a look at them.. which makes it pretty hard bc you never know what they're looking for. no tests, about 12 essays, and easy online quizzes.

He takes forever to grade papers. You won't know your grade until the end of the semester. (As previously stated). He also shows interest in certain students and make it so obvious. He also lacks communication and does NOT give clear directions on what he expects.

I've had him before this and overall he's very easy going and helps you if you need it and doesn't really take attendance for upper level classes. He never grades anything until the end of the semester for some reason but he's a very lenient grader. I recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class was an easy A as long as you did all of the quizzes (which you can take as many times) and completed the writing journals. Professor Steinberg is a nice professor and grades easily. Attendance is mandatory as part of your grade is based upon participation. Honestly if you can't get an A in this class you can't get an A in any class.

He takes forever to grade papers. You won't know your grade until the end of the semester. He also shows interest in certain students (You have to be one of the students that talk alot because he talks alot) He doesn't give clear instructions on what he expect on papers
Textbook can be found online, not super important.

Took his class for less than 2 weeks, all I can say is that if ur seriously ill do not expect him to care. I got sick with Covid emailed him the paper work from Baptist Hospital, he ignored my first email when I send him a follow up email he replies "Ok". For a professor teaching communication I think that speaks volumes. Practice what u preach.
Prof Steinburg was nice, loved the guest lectures.  There are quizzes and papers but they're all easy because you can redo as many times as necessary.  Pretty easy class.

Dave was one of my favorite professors of all time! I took his class in 2014. It was one of my first classes in college. So you can see how much I enjoyed this class by the fact that I feel compelled to write a review almost 8 years later. Take him! He's the best. I had him for two classes and both were superb.
This was my first class in Miami and it was super enjoyable. Had great conversations and as long as you showed like you cared he wasn't serious about stuff. Wish I could take this class again.

Would 100% recommend Professor Steinberg for any class you can, and took nearly every class hes taught. Leans towards the easy side of grading and a bit scattered, so take for the professor more than the topic

If your looking for one of the best communication teachers, take Professor Steinberg. So chill, so nice and doesnt give that much work. There was no final and the quizzes are super easy (about the notes). He cares about his students and is very leniant with assignments. Makes everyone feel welcome, espiecally in big classes.

Interesting material but you won't know any of your grades until the end of the semester. He gives good feedback and allows you to make things up. Weekly quizzes and writing assignments that are annoying but not that bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Super chill and understanding! Take Davids class.
Dave is a great teacher and really laid back... If you do the work you will pass..... Very good class ....

Lectures can be a little long occasionally, but he is such a great man to know in the Communication school. He has so many connections and he is someone you should have at least once in college. He's the nicest professor I had this semester and is really straightforward about exams. He is really willing to help you out to get the grade you want.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Be prepared for longggg, boring classes with him. He talks nonstop and always tries to fill up the entire class period. He won't even be discussing things on your test most of the time because he goes off on so many tangents. Do the practice quizzes because 10 of 15 will be on your test exactly how they are on the practice.
Great professor! Knows the subject well. He just lectures a lot and sometimes the lectures are pretty irrelevant.

Professor Steinberg is really fair and committed to his students. Lectures were a bit long at times, but I think it was because this was an evening class that met once a week until 9:05 pm everyone was tired.

Dave is the man. Attendance mandatory, but the class is extremely laid back and tolerable. The assignments are interesting and he allows you to present about your own interests. Very useful in improving your public speaking skills, but be prepared for him to critique your speeches in front of the class.
He likes to teach. Old school professor.

This class is policy debate. Dave's been doing it since forever so he's a good source for info. The "class" really is a free 1 credit; all that Dave requires is A) you're part of the team (meaning you come to meetings) and B) put in effort (do a bit of research or go to 1 tournament). We travel all over the country for free as a perk =)

exams, very easy, with some questions ripped right from the textbook website (good to know!). lectures were a jumbled mess, he's just not cut out to teach...he basically reads from the book, stopping at the most inopportune times to say something unrelated and confusing. he dropped the homework assignments a month in, they werent difficult anyways

His class is boring but the tests can be easy if you study the flash card and do the practice tests on the textbook's internet. I did bad on the first exam because there were six chapters, he understood us and change every exam to three chapter and it was pretty easy in that way. He also drop the lowest score and he curves! he takes attendance!

very nice professor, BUT the class itself was a mess...it felt like a painful waste of time. It seemed as if we were just meeting twice a week to chat about random stuff. Not recommended very highly if you value your time and quality of class. TESTS are completely textbook based - b/c not much is covered in class discussion

Debate Team! Definitely recommend you joining. Travel for free across the country to different schools. Intense time commitment though (as in you'll spend entire weekends traveling and a lot of time during week preparing). Dave himself is pretty laid back, an old school debater. A lot of the work is up to you. Scholarships for those who need Free A

Boring, unclear, and teaches nothing in class. Read the book. And at some points I'm not even sure he even knows what he is talking about. He usually responds with "maybe", "could be", "I don't know".
took it in summer. lots of football players took it and we all had a good time. he likes to see you try. good summer class - i got an A
Very boring but easy. I slept through class but visited him during office hours. If he knows you are trying, you will get an A! Highly recommended.

No complaints on Dave. I certainly agree that he is a very down to earth fellow and genuinely wants you to succeed. He does go on tangents and has a very casual teaching style. If you pay attention in class, and actually do some reading at home (preferred deity forbid), you'll do just fine. He is very knowledgeable and equally helpful. Recommended.

He's a really nice guy, but his class is boring. Also, the tests don't reflect what is taught in class, but it is all in the book. He also focuses a lot on names and who did what. Focus on the book nothing really goes on in class. . .
Very nice & understanding teacher. Cares about students & their grades. Cool and down to earth. Take his class! :)

Too bad a couple of these people could not give coherent reasons for trashing this guy. He runs all over the country with the debate team and is a national leader. Sure, that's going to make him frazzled, but he knows his stuff, and puts people first.

Basically...he's a good guy at heart but he goes off on tangents very often. He's unorganized and usually going by his syllabus is pointless. THat being said i think its a great class to take if you want a good grade. When it comes down to it Dave is a very down to earth teacher who is understanding and wants people to succeed (unlike some professors). I recommend him to those that are takin a class to get a good grade not too learn much...LOL. (i've taken him two semesters in a row)
He sucked.
No Comments
No Comments
The class is kind of boring, but the test are easy. Almost all of the questions come from the practice test on the book's website.
He is one of the most incompetant professors I have ever had the misfortune to study under.
No Comments

By far the best math Professor at UM, really cares if students are doing well and will help you succeed. If you study, do the homework and pay attention you should be fine, definetly recomend taking Dr. Draghici again.

Genuinely feel like I didn't learn a thing.  Homework is extremely R heavy only for us to not be allowed to use it on exams.  The review guides for the exams don't really relate to what's actually on the content at all.  Her notes are very messy and she doesn't post them all the time.  Overall very hard to actually study outside the class.

Being honest, she is amazing. She deeply cares about students success and offers so much extra help. She explains something in many ways to ensure students understand it. She is also super kind and accommodating. If you need to take a class w/ the math department, then she is an excellent choice! If I can take another class w/ her, I 100% will :)

Make no mistake, this class is tough. First midterm was maybe the hardest exam of my life. No curve. She wants you to succeed, but she wants you to work for it. She is helpful during office hours and answers questions in lecture. If you want to do well, make sure you show it to her. Homeworks are time consuming. Study your butt off for exams.
the worst professor taken at this school. ABSOLUTELY AVOID taking her.

I am currently taking MTH 224 with her, and I have to say she is amazing. The math dept is p bad, so she is a strong choice. She deeply cares about your success and explains a concept using different methods to ensure students understand it. I cannot emphasize how much I love this professor. Her office hours are very helpful. She is just the best.

Exams are difficult while quizzes are easy. Does not complete all problems in class but will help outside of class if needed. Gave lots of extra credit on exams and for in participation. Needed outside help to understand material as class is fast. Not terrible option for miami math but not the best. Made me dread math as someone who used to love it

If she was a great teacher, I wouldn't have to constantly refer to my old AP calc notes. Her pacing is also incredibly slow and she tends to skip steps, so not a great combo. Tests and quizzes are decent and the reviews help. The math department isn't strong here, so if you had to pick someone, then she isn't a bad choice.

Calc 2 is hard no matter what, but she is great at explaining and the practice problems and homework help a lot for the exams. She is very sweet and funny, and she provides extra credit. Take her for calc 2!

Dr. Draghici was a great professor in PRISM who always came to class prepared. Her lectures are essential to passing the class, and her tests and quizzes are fair. They can be long, so be wary of time. She goes over lots of problems in class and is always willing to meet for her extensive amount of online office hours.

Very sweet lady who seemed to want for your to succeed. Definitely alot of content to learn so be ready to practice problems. Overall tests were definitely on the harder side, but she gave lots of partial credit and extra credit as well to boost your score. 3 exams + 1 final and your lowest exam grade replaces the final.

If you are not required to have her, don't! I took calculus in high school and understood the concepts well. She can not teach at all, is a harsh grader, and only wants things done her way. She does problems on her iPad and doesn't explain anything. If you never took calc, definitely don't take her class. I absolutely hated her class!!

The most organized I've ever seen honestly; she's nice and understanding; attendance is mandatory and she also posts zoom recordings of class to review; the notes+worksheets she makes are great; hw is tedious but I would take her again in a heartbeat. She gave a few chances to improve grade at the end.

Lectures are amazing and she always provide a summarized studying material for each chapter. However, there are 5 exams for each chapter and they are unnecessarily hard. Do not take her class if you are not good at math and stats.

Really great professor who explains everything thoroughly. Must go to class or watch recorded lectures or you'll be lost. Really great notes and worksheet examples that are similar to the quizzes and exams. Very interesting material and useful if you want to get into management careers.

Zohar is so chill and respectable. Course covers some complex topics and final is lengthy but pretty much if you attend classes review the material and REACH OUT TO HER FOR QUESTIONS/office hours/review sessions (because she is always always willing to help) you will do fine. Phenomenal prof and even better person.

This class is very rigorous, with lots of hw and studying needed to get a good grade. You need to attend the classes in order to learn the material. There is a quiz or exam every week and she does sometimes take points off for simple things. However, she is kind and tries to make class interesting.

Dr. Zohar is one of the best professors I've had. She is sweet and funny, you see her mom persona in class. She presents her content in a clear and concise way and tells you what to expect on quizzes and exams (she hosts reviews before each one too). She's a tough grader and throws in concepts that seem unimportant. Pay attention to everything!

Zohar is not an easy A. She is insanely organized in her teaching. She records every class. I wouldn't pay attention in class and just watch the lecture on my own time. I am a good student in general and felt that she for sure pushed me. Not impossible though. Her teachings is very easy to follow. 4 exams dropped lowest. 1 Final 8 quizzes.

there is a quiz every week and an exam around every 3 weeks. you have to pay attention, take notes, show up, and study outside of class but she tells you what examples to study for each quiz and exam. she is very very organized in her way of teaching which made it easy to follow. i loved her.

I had her last semester and I had to drop. I worked way more for this class than any other class and I was willing to put in the effort. But her tests are super hard and complicated. Her homeworks too. I'm an international student diagnosed with general anxiety (I had also homesickness), she was really bad at understanding my mental health issues.

Absolute waste of time. Unnecessarily hard and she gives me the creeps. Nice in person but the class is built around wasting your time. Exam every week, Quiz every week, Reading Responses every week, mandatory hw every week. Talk about having no life.
Exams and quizzes were difficult and fair amount of work but caring professor and willing to help

Makes the class much harder than it needs to be. Test or quiz every week, and a good amount of homework. Tests are 1000000000000x harder than the worksheets and quizzes and is a very strict grader like most professor in this school. Overall an OK professor/class.

Zohar is a great professor. She is a great teacher and teaches the material well. She makes the lectures interesting and not boring. Gives lots of opportunities to do well, she drops the lowest test grade and the lowest quizzes and keeps the best 5 quiz grades. The homework is annoying. The tests are hard- she likes to trick you!
Bait and switch quizzes and doesn't teach whats on those quizzes. avoid!!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor seems to not care about how her students do. The quizzes and exams are ten thousand times more difficult than the worksheets in class. Almost like she doesn't want you to do well. There are 4 midterms, 8 quizzes, and a bunch of homework. This class should not be as difficult it is.

She makes the class very very hard! It should not be that difficult! She is a hard grader, she leaves a lot of homework and there are quizzes every week. Do not take her! She is very very bad. Do not take her!!!

Such a hard grader and makes you feel dumb if you ask her a question. Takes off like 15 pts on an exam if you don't round the way she likes it,etc. Easy worksheets in class and way harder tests. 1-2 HW assignments weekly + weekly quizzes/tests. Makes class way harder than it needs to be. I would only take her if she was the last and only option

I love Professor Zohar. Her lectures are fun, and she is a genuinely nice and caring professor. She lets you make up a test and provides lots of other opportunities to improve your grade. She also does a lot of review sessions. The material in this class is not difficult, so as long as you come to class and pay attention you will do great!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I think Dr. Zohar did a good job explaining the material. I took calculus in high school, so I had some background going in which definitely helped. The tests that she wrote were fair and easy. However, the department final was not at all what I expected. Either way, I ended with an A, so I'm not mad.

She is one of the best professors I have ever had. She makes the lectures interesting and teaches the content well. The tests are pretty hard but if you just make sure you can do the worksheet examples you'll do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: if you can take any other professor, do it. she is the hardest grader and does not care about her students. she feeds you information from the notes and tests you on the notes +more that she has never talked about. she is the worst professor that I have ever had and definitely do not recommend her

Professor Zohar is a great professor. Make sure you attend every lecture or catch up if you can't make it to her class. She accurately prepares her students for her quizzes and exams. She is also very funny, which makes the class entertaining.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lots of tests and quizzes, but they are based off the notes. Pay attention and attend class and you will do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Amazing prof and makes you work for it.

Professor Zohar is very caring about her students. She goes over pre-printed notes and you do problems together in class. She is great at answering your questions. There is a quiz every week along with homework that can take a long time. Definitely pay attention in class and do the homework and you will be fine for the tests.

reviews.comment: Test or quiz every week and then doesn't grade them for a month. so much homework and other busy work unrelated to tests

reviews.comment: Unbelievable amount of work for a useless class. Constant exams, homework, quizzes, reading responses.
