reviews.comment: She is fine, but there are quizzes, homework, and tests every single week. She also takes forever to grade things.

She is super organized, you follow along with her during class while she is explaining she is also doing the exercises. One of the best methods of teaching I've had so far. You do have to study because she puts too many things on her tests and time is limited, but she is great! would take her again 100%

Not sure why so many people are complaining about Zohar. They either a) did not show up to class or b) expected exams to be exactly like the homework/notes. If you put in the work, you'll get out what you put in. Simple. She's extremely caring about her students and wants everyone to do well. If you understand the concepts, you'll be fine.

Zohar is pretty bad in person, but shes an absolute mess online. She has made online exams extremely difficult by not allowing students to see the next question on each exam until they submit the previous question. No way to pace oneself on exams like this. She also gives students extra credit for answering irrelevant Harry Potter questions.

I really appreciated Professor Zohar's class. She is really caring and pretty funny. She adapted to online teaching because of Corona well. Her class is not particularly easy and certainly gets harder as the semester goes on but I am not sure how much easier any professor could make this subject. I would definitely take her again.

In all honesty these earlier reviews threw me off. She tried using a new teaching method this semester and ill be the first to tell you its TERRIBLE. Her test questions are way different than the class examples and it really seems like shes going out of her way to trick you. Partial credit? yea ok haha. Overall she made the class harder.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Tough, unclear grading criteria. Impossible to calculate. Tests are hard af! Reminds me of Madam Dolores from Harry Potter. Wish she would give fewer quizzes and her tests where easier, or at least make the practice problems harder so we have a chance to do better than a B-. Hardest B to get, doesn't seem right.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Zohar is a good person, or at least she tries yet she can be quite double-sided, to say the least. I also never thought I would do so much math in a Management Class. The class is very tough with a lot of homework and quizzes, ALOT! Her tests are hard and she likes to trick you on purpose. Not very understanding either.

Prof. Zohar is clearly smart, but a horrible professor. There are weekly quizzes and the exams are long. The final was absurdly painful. She is also very pompous, thinks she's funny with her Harry Potter jokes (she's really not), and often calls out specific students unfairly in front of class. I would never recommend her, but if you must, beware.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professors grading is ridiculous. She will mark you harshly for small errors with zero explanation provided. Not only that, but she will make mistakes with grading, and only realize them after having half the class come up to her after receiving their test. When you get back your exams be ready to have to argue, or question the grade you received.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I have literally had more quizzes and exams in this class than all of my other classes combined. The material is completely irrelevant to any sort of work you will end up doing in real life. Everyone knows this class is a joke but for some reason Zohar takes it way to seriously and grades everything ridiculously hard.
The class is challenging, but zohar is very friendly and really cares about her students. She is really clear about her grading, and also on explaining the course material.

Professor Zahar is one of the best professors I've had at UM! She already has pre-printed notes for her students and goes in detail through every topic. There are a lot of quizzes that are easy to boost your grade and 4 exams. She is an amazing professor and super funny! I would definitely take her again!

She is probably one of the best professors I've ever had. She has pre-printed notes for the class, and walks through everything step-by-step. Her quizzes are insanely easy, although the tests were long and covered a lot of material. I'm horrible at math and still did well, I would definitely take her again!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She's a sweetheart and the class is super easy. She is VERY picky with her grading. She'll mark off for minuscule details, but once you know what she likes it should be easy to get an A. Pay attention in class and you should be good for the quizzes and exams. Her class is a bit boring because she does teach as if we were in grade school.

Prof Zohar is a great teacher. She goes through class notes which are pretty much the same as the tests. If you have taken calc before this will be easy but if you didn't you might have trouble. There are small quizzes pretty much every week but she tells you before hand as well as 3 exams and a final. Homework is due at the end of the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Super easy A if you understand basic formula use. She gives formula sheets for the exams and the quizzes are often which is annoying but super easy. Zohar teaches like the class is 3rd graders so it is very dumbed down. She is super nice and just wants everyone to do well. Minimal effort needed outside of just doing the homework to get an A.

really great professor! for each chapter you print out a set of notes and a worksheet packet and her lectures are her going through the notes and working through the problems in the packet. online hw not bad at all. 12-13 quizzes but only best 10 count. tests generally straightforward but can be long. if you put in decent effort you will be fine.

She's such a great math professor. She's really caring and makes the material more enjoyable. She's very available for help outside of class and is a fair grader. Exams are fair, there are long online homework assignments and several quizzes, and 3 exams.

Prof Zohar is the best math teacher I've had. Extremely thorough and easy to understand. Her notes are exactly like the 3 tests. You only have to do five homeworks the whole year and the rest are optional. Would definitely take her
I love Professor Zohar and took her for a bunch of other classes. MGT303 is really easy and super similar to MAS202. Some of the stuff being taught is kind of redundant but its an easy A.

This professor in particular lectures well in class although when you study for that exam nothing that you learned in lecture is it in the test rather much difficult questions are in the test you wouldnt know where she pulls the questions from. Will never take her again. Bad
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: She is an amazing teacher who is always availble in her office to help. Definitely reccomend taking her class.
The class requires you to retain a lot of information but Prof. is very clear and concise on what you need to know for the tests. Hard class but you will learn a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very boring professor/class to sit through. Do not sign up for a once a week class with her.
Dr. Zohar is great professor, she clearly explains the methods to solve the questions for home works and exams.  If you follow her notes you will do well.

Zohar is actually a really cool person and I like her a lot but if you did not take Calc in high school or the prerequisites this is a hard class. She goes really fast with the material and theres a quiz every week. Overall good teacher if you're willing to put the work in
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Great teacher. She gives a packet of notes to follow along in class. If you do all of the homework, the tests and quizzes will be fine. Quizzes are all homework problems. Shes always willing to help you during office hours or make accommodations to make up a test. Would definitely take her again.

I would take any class with her. She gives homework but once you've obtained all your homework points its optional. Lots of quizzes but she only takes your 10 highest so it really helps your grades. Toward the end of the semester the material got harder; she is an amazing teacher though--attend class and do your part and you won't have any problems

Dr. Zohar is the best professor I have had so far at UM. Her lectures are easy to understand and take notes and she is always willing to help students out during office hours. She is understanding and willing to help her students succeed. The people who wrote the bad reviews likely didn't attend class or put in any effort.
Great professor, go to class and you'll be fine. I took two courses with her and both required very little homework. Great professor, if I could take her for all my math courses I would.

this is probably one of the worst classes i have ever taken. You don't learn anything and Professor Zohar isn't capable of teaching this class. The only thing she is capable of is reading off a filled in packet. I also would say she is an extremely anal grader and if you go to her office hours you are wasting your time. DO NOT TAKE

Professor Zohar is probably one of the worst math teachers in the university of miami. She's not clear and basically reads off a page with filled in answers. You will be able to keep up with her if you practiced the material all summer if not expect a lot of extra studying. Expect a lot of bad jokes which you have to laugh at. not their on quiz day

THE BEST. Math is not my strong suit and she made it so easy. Printable notes that you fill in, put hw on board 5x a semester, mini quizzes but only counts your best 10. Problems from the hw and notes were almost identical to more than half of the test questions. As long as you study the hw and the notes its an easy A. Shes hilarious & approachable

This was my 2nd semester w her & shes literally the best! I took MAS 110 w her my freshman yr & got an A in the class. I'm actually sad that shes not teaching MAS 202. You take alot of mini quizzes throughout the semester but she only takes the best 10. She is flexible with her office hours and if you need to make up a test or quiz. TAKE HER!!

She's awesome. Super funny and makes learning super easy and casual. She gives a lot of 1-2 question quizzes and counts the highest 9 as your overall quiz grade. Participation is putting up a homework question on the board 5 times throughout the semester. Super nice and is always willing to make things more clear and will work with you.

She's very clear with her lecture but  GOD HERE TEST ARE TOUGH! If you do the homework and follow along and read her notes you'll do good. I did have some trouble because I've never taken Stats in my life so I had to catch-up on the basics plus what she taught us so that was tough. If you have taken stats before definitely take her! NEED BOOK!

Zohar rocks, she's super clear cut tells you everything she expects from you, holds review sessions in class the class before the test, and gives out study guides. Only 3 exams but a bunch of quizzes but is so so so nice. She will help you understand whatever you don't get and I 100% recommend taking her

Amazing professor! Her notes are very clear and she is more than willing to explain something over.  HW isn't mandatory  but it is very helpful. Test Reviews are not all-inclusive so it helps to use hw problems at practice and have good notes. Attendance is mandatory. 10 quizzes throughout the semester, 3 exams and final.

She acts like everything is not a big deal and is very casual during class. When it comes to tests you have to be extremely specific or else you won't get points. When you go to her office hours you have to pry answers out of her. Overall, not a very good professor I would avoid

Class hinges on tests. She takes attendance, but if you show up you have to try really hard to not do ok. Hw is quasi-mandatory. She doesn't check but you have to go to the board 10 times within the semester. Her notes and exam reviews are SO clear. If you know how to do them you have to get a B+ at the very very minimum.

I missed class almost once every week and Professor Zohar was great about letting me make up the quizzes. Her office hours are very helpful and she'll actually sit down and go over the material with you! She's a great teacher. I'm taking her again next semester.
I've taken 3 MAS classes, and Dr. Zohar is the best professor I've had so far. Her notes are really helpful, and she knows exactly what she's doing.
She's an extremely nice woman who is always willing to help out her students and explain the material better. Tests are a bit challenging but if you do the HW and go to class its pretty easy

She is extremely nice and quite funny. She loves participation. Her quizzes are easy and her test Q's come straight from the notes with different numbers (pretty much). For the final i just practiced the questions on the class notes she makes for you and got a 95. Also you are required to do at least 7 h.w and put them on the bored. I loved her!

She's a great professor! I personally went into the class with prior knowledge of calc. This is an applied math course for business so for Business School kids, I highly recommend it. She's funny, nice, and definitely cares about all of her students. Too bad I couldn't get into her MAS 201 class for next semester!

Dr. Zohar is a great teacher.  She explains everything really well, and the tests and quizzes are just homework problems with different numbers.  This class is a breeze if you've taken calculus before.

easy going professor but not funny as she thinks so..mandatory attendance, open notes quizzes, exams are not coming from another world..She also gives extra credit..easy but boring class. If you really love math and like challenges she's not the one you need. If all what you care about is an A then she's fine.
Best teacher I've had at the U, hands down.

Zohar is real clear and all quizzes are open note/from the hw. The tests are straightforward and similar to the review sheet. Closest thing to a high school class out there and it is to difficult to do well

Keep up with the notes and homework and this class is an A. Zohar is funny, nice, clear and teaches the material very well. Test corrections for extra points which also helps learn material. Definitely recommend her.

I think she is a good proffessor.She is nice and very funny. She is very clear and very helpful too. However, it is not really easy to get an A in this class since her tests are really long. Hopefully there are long but not hard and there are extra credits too. Overall I would recommend her.
Awesome professor, I ran out of time on the tests which brought my grade down, but she is really great at teaching this boring/confusing subject.
She assumes that everyone in the class has taken calc before. If you have not taken calc before you will not do well in her class.
great teacher, really helpful

Best math teacher i've ever had. I took IB math in high school and had some calc background. Quizzes are easy, she only counts your 5 highest scores (i got 100 in my 1st 5 and therefore didn't have to take any of the rest). I got an A in all my tests by studying the night before (doing all hw and review problems she gave us). Explains very well.

A very fair class, it's that simple. I took IB math before which had some calc elements. I went to class, never did hw, studied for tests by looking over my notes and doing the reviews, and I got an A w/o too much trouble. I'm no math wiz, but I don't struggle w/ it either. She's a nice lady and I've had wayyy more boring math classes in the past.
Total stud, watch out for sarcasm and Jewish jokes.  And remember, on a scale of 1 to 10, her kids are an 11 for cuteness
Loved her. Quizzes are simple, test aren't difficult if you know the material. Offers extra credit. Pick Her!
very hard class. NOT AN EASY A. She is a nice person, but her tests are extremely hard and the class average is usually around a C-. If you struggle with math...stay away

She explains things well but her tests are extremely long and can be difficult.  She loves to make you graph everything.  Zohar is also very sarcastic so watch out.  All the people who say she is easy have probably taken calc before...if this is your first time for calc the class will be challenging.  The final is cum.

Her class is boring but she is really nice             The mas105 class is the easiest class in the world. You have to be really stupid not to get an A (I studied the night before the test for each one)
No Comments

She's a very cool teacher. She made me undertstand everything so well. She is willing to help outside of class if you go to her office, usually 15 minutes before class, and after. Her test corrections and extra credit questions on tests really help! Do your homework and be prepared for a quiz anyday of the week! I got an A.
She loves to be sarcastic and make jokes, but knows how to teach.  Take this class if you want a high grade, she won't let you fail.
Very very boring if you've taken calculus before, but it's an easy A. She's a really nice person and easy teacher.

If a funny teacher keeps you somewhat interested in class than i suggest you take Zohar..shes a sweetheart and can actually teach math...she goes over every hw assignment at the beginning of class and no questions are ever ignored...plus the material on the tests always comes from either hw or notes so its not unexpected at all
She is a really good teacher and she is really helpful. If you do your hw and stay on top of things there is no reason you shouldn't get an A in her class
she makes test really long and hard

Beware of her sarcasm. Other than that Mrs. Zohar's pretty cool. Do the homework and you're covered for the tests (alot of the time she takes problems straight from the HW) She operates on a "If you don't care then I don't either" type of system. Oh and if you're wondering why she always wears a scarf on her head it's because she's Jewish.

I took her for two semesters. She is great and gives you a lot of chances to get an A in the class. She offers extra credit and test corrections which can be really helpful. A good teacher and a class where you will learn. Recommended. PS: Her new last name is Zohar
Everythings on tests and quizes based off of homework. do your homework and you will do fine.
She is best. she seems like she is getting some loving at home. Happy to be in her class.
Mrs. Sacks is awesome! She not only teaches but bonds with her students. She is very entertaining and gives a lot of extra credit. If you want to pass, you will pass!
No Comments
Avoid at all costs! Isn't available for office hours nor does he care about the success of his students.

AVOID AVOID AVOID.  He is the lowest rated professor in the UMiami evaluation system. I was assigned to this professor for MATH 108 in my first semester because he filled in for a professor out on leave.  I had no idea I would literally be thrown into a truly horrible situation with a truly horrendous professor.I feel UM duped me into this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I feel bad for Dare because he seemed like a nice enough guy. With that, never ever take him for any class. 50% of the stuff he lectured was incorrect and the students had to correct him. he was late to every lecture and most exams. so many mistakes on the exams. taught myself and my classmates more than he taught me. i hope he learned from it lol.

Never on time to class and was 20 mins late to the final. Homework often unrelated to exam content, or just content he neglected to teach. On exams he claimed he would give partial credit but a negative instead of a positive would result in a 2/10 on the problem. Not my first time with pre-calc and he made it more confusing than necessary.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you haven't taken pre-calc yet, good luck. I think the only reason that I've been able to make it through this class is due to my past knowledge. He writes on the board with little explanation and continuously does entire problems wrong. He's a nice guy but It's evident he's not well suited for teaching. ALSO the tests aren't like the review!

His teaching style is writing problems up on the whiteboard and solving them. This would be helpful if the problems had anything to do with the mass amounts of homework he assigns, but they don't at all. If you have not taken pre-calculus before I would not reccomend this class. He also has little to no office hours.

PAY ATTENTION IN CLASS. If you listen to her examples, and write down EVERYTHING she says you'll be good.  Studied for 2-4 hours night before quizzes to get As. Understand concepts more than memorize everything (but still memorize everything). Very smart teacher, wants you to succeed.  Participation is not free 100. Not easy but will learn a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is a great professor. BSL is a hard course, but she really explains it well and I really took a lot away from it. She'll go through all of the material in class, but be prepared to talk about cases.

This course is so hard be prepared to spend weeks studying for quizzes throughout the whole semester. Professor goes by so fast and uses jargon every sentence making it difficult to understand the lecture and subject. The final exam is cumulative and covers an extremely large amount of content I am sure no one can actually fully understand.

Honestly, my favorite class taken this semester. Quizzes are very straightforward, and the format is the same: two case questions, and you decide the winner, state the rule of law, and then apply it. She explains everything clearly and wants you to succeed; always around for office hours and lets you out of class early more often than not!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: BSL212 is tough, but she explains well and will repeat things if needed. There are 6 quizzes and a final. Each quiz covers 2 chapters, so study hard early. Final is easier if you prep for quizzes. Take notes on a laptop—no slides and she goes fast. Ask questions! For quizzes, read cases carefully so you don't miss key info.

Professor Del Riego is one of the most intelligent and caring teachers I have ever had. The course in its nature is very difficult, but she somehow found a way for it to be my favorite at UM. She truly does a very good job making everything interesting. No homework, but you have to study for the exams and you should do well.
This is the best professor I have had at UM, take her class! She explains very well and the tests are doable if u study. Take the class!!
If you do the work and dont turn in anything late you will be fine
Fun collaborative classes. No tests. Some of presentations are graded toughly but great feedback is given. Highly recommend.

Professor Del Riego is amazing! She might seem a little tough at the beginning but she is so nice and caring! She makes the subject interesting and engaging. Class itself requires a lot of memorization, you have to come to class otherwise you wont perform good. Also! Dont spell anything wrong !! TAKE HER for sure

Do NOT take this professor unless you are ready to learn on your own/or are okay with it. Del Riego speaks super fast about the chapters and rushes her classes. You will not be able to take down notes because every definition she says is different. Also marks you tardy if you're a minute late. What is this HS?

She is a nice professor but can not teach. Her definitions for everything are loose and she never has concrete toughts. She is the toughest grader I have ever had. You can study for hours but will still fail the quizes. Intresting material and I love the content but the quizzes such, not an easy A or B.

PHENOMENAL PROFESSOR. Professor Del Riego was undoubtedly my favorite Professor for my first semester at the U. The class itself isnt difficult, however, reading chapters and taking detailed lecture notes are a necessity. As long as you come ready to work you will do well. In addition she is highly personable and can talk sports for hours. 10/10
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Don't spell anything wrong on the tests.  Seriously.  Don't do it.   Other than the tough grading she's pretty good.

Conscientious professor who appreciates you sitting down and actually learn. Gave practical tips not only regarding the class but life in general. A true economist, Dr. Spigelman incentivised skills transferrable to today's market, from attendance to public speaking. Can do well even if one does not show up: do so at your own risk.
Only 3 exams but it is curved. Gives test questions in class. Entertaining listen at 8 am

Professor Spigelman is the best, and I was disappointed when I couldn't take his course next semester. He likes to go on unbiased political/economic tangents sometimes, but he's extremely knowledgeable about economics, and I believe everyone can learn from him.
