reviews.comment: Professor Spigelman is the best professor I've ever had at the University of Miami. You don't even need the book to get an easy A. If you pay attention to lectures the three exams will be extremely easy. I got an easy A in this class just by paying attention and going to lectures. Each test is around 20 multiple choice and can be finished in 20 min
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: I would recommend having 2-3 friends to help each other out with notes. Attend class because hell get grouchy if you dont. His lectures never runs the full time and not that boring. 2 exams and a final if you or your friends take good notes no need for book. Go to class he tells everything that will be covered on exams. Amazing professor!

He is very repetitive, which makes him a good teacher because he drills concepts into your brain. Lectures can get boring, but he doesn't use the book at all so must pay attention. Review sessions are a must before tests and are super clear. Hate that he isn't very clear on grading and doesn't put grades in blackboard. Major curve on tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Tests based off lectures and no material from the book. His lectures have no power points and is professed completely verbally. His lectures are all over the place and he skips over information. He often mumbles and is not clear with his words and when he draws graphs on paper they are not easily readable. The only positive is he curves heavily.
Best professor I have had in all of UM! I am taking him again next semester, truly amazing and learned a lot. 10/10!

He is a good professor. All you have to do is study the notes and you will do really well on the tests. If you don't pay attention in class you will definitely fall behind and have trouble. Don't bother buying the textbook. I haven't looked at it once and I have an A in his class. Just take good notes!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: His tests literally depend on his lecture instead of t the textbook, you better come to every class. However, he murmurs while giving the lecture, making people hard to understand. Also, he does not give any materials or slides, he gives all the important definitions orally and gives all the graphs by drawing on a piece of paper!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: terrible teacher. nothing relates to the book. his notes are all over the place and its impossible to study for his exams because of the lack of information he teaches you. skips the basics and moves too fast. only good thing is he curves.
Goes off topic A LOT and does not teach any material from the book. Would not recommend taking the class because he doesn't even explain the material properly.
I had him for BUS200 and he was great. Has a good sense of humor and is really clear about what he expects from you. It's more of a wide overview than deep coverage but I liked it

No homework and he likes when you ask questions, but if you don't understand what he says the first time, he'll just explain it the exact same way again but slower. Not a great teacher. Decent guy though.

Way to easy. Gives top half of class an A, and since there are many foreigners and people who don't care since its a gen ed, this class is a joke. You can study for 1-2 hours before the two exams and get an A. The group project requires about 1 hour of effort and can be done the night before, since its pass/fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Tests? Not many--LECTURE HEAVY--Would take again

reviews.comment: Dr. Spigelman was always early for class and ready to address all our concerns. He made the class interesting by teaching us material beyond the scope of the textbook. Attend the lectures for the mortgage crisis you will learn a lot of interesting facts about this period in the US economy.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--GROUP PROJECTS--Would take again

reviews.comment: Didn't really teach very much, every single thing we learned in this class I learned in high school, so the material was especially easy for me but it definitely should not be hard to get an A in this clas. Go to the 2 lectures before the exam and listen to every word he says and the A is yours
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: The class is big, so if you sit in the front and pay attention, you will get an A and won't need the textbook. If you don't care and watch Netflix and read the book, you'll get about a C. His tests are straight out of the lectures.
Need to attend lectures and reviews before exams. Exams based totally off class lectures. Not that difficult if you attend class.
Show up to lectures and reviews and you will be fine. The class is dry but he makes the test straight up from the notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Easy professor as long as you go to class. He does not follow the textbook, so all of his exams are based off of his lectures. He has several review classes before the exam and tells you exactly what you need to know.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The teacher for you if you dont care to learn that much but get an A.  He repeats the material often so you should be fine for tests if you go to the three classes before the exams.  Based solely off notes, not the textbook, so copy every graph he draws and youre good to go.  Not available for office hours the week of exams which is annoying!!!!!!

He's a really nice guy and has some funny stories (that you'll hear over and over again.) His lectures are kinda boring. The first half of the class was insanely easy but after the first test, it picked up and got pretty confusing out of nowhere. The group project (shark tank) is kind of annoying but it's pretty easy and is pass/fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Spigelman is probably the most boring professor I've ever had. He teaches a lot of things that aren't in the book, so you really need to attend class to know what's going on. His lectures are long and draining, and he mumbles more often than not. He's a nice guy, but not a professor to take if you're easily distracted.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Don't study homework problems for the test.  Go to class, write down every problem he does, and study those.  He reviews everything the week before exams, so if you miss a day it's okay.  Super easy class, nice guy, would recommend.  Not a business student, never went to office hours and still got an A. Sit in front so keep yourself focused.

Lectures are extremely long and at times pointless. He is not clear about the material and hardly teaches. Best recommendation is to sit in the front and force yourself to pay attention, attend every class, and do the homework. I would not highly recommend him but he's not the worse.

Very easy class. You can pretty much teach it to yourself. Barely attended class and still got an A. Spigelmann is a weird dude too but seems nice. My only issue with him was how he refused to have office hours during the week of the exam.

I missed a ton of class and just got the notes for the tests. Theres only 2 midterms and a final and they're short and easy. Theres a little homework for each chapter thats all due at the end of the semester.

Homework is not due until the end of the semester but don't wait until then to complete it. The homework is not relevant for tests though. Go to his office hours and talk to him after class because he loves to get to know his students. Also, let him know when you don't understand because he will help you out as much as he can.

Pretty easy class; lectures can be long but they are exactly what is on the exams. Final isn't cumulative. Homework is tedious but easy grade boost. Come to class (or the review sessions) and you should get an A.

Easy class, doesn't take attendance and you really do not need to show up to every class to do well. Review sessions are basically him regurgitating the test to us so its definitely a good idea to go to those. Not the most engaging class but if you put in a little effort you should be able to get an A. Doing the homework as you go along is a must.

His class is just very easy. Three tests, all multiple choice. Final is not cumulative. Most questions on the tests come from his review classes and review sessions. I went to class every day, but it wasn't necessary to do so to get a good grade. The online homework takes a while to do. Didn't think he was the nicest person, but it's an easy class.

Spigelman tells you exactly what is on each test. You can show up once a week and still get an A on the tests. There isn't any online homework either and only two tests outside of the final. If you want to learn causally about business in a general sense, this is the class for you.
Easy class If you show up to the review classes and then the review session there is no reason to not get an A

Very nice guy. Overall easy class, he literally reviews for tests like four times it's amazing. Just putting in a little bit of effort and going to class will get you an A. That said, I didn't really learn much.

So easy it's unbelievable. After the first test you'll quickly realize you don't have to go to class; everything you need to know is covered in the review session. Any reviews stating he is difficult must be ridiculously bad at economics, because this class is a joke. Having said that, he is a bad teacher. Doesn't explain things well, but easiest A

Great professor! He makes it very clear what to study for exams if you go to the review sessions, so GO TO REVIEW SESSIONS!! Makes a class that could be boring fairly interesting, and if you go to review sessions then you basically know what will be on exams. One project at the end of the year but simple if you follow the business plan format.
THE TEST ARE TRICKY AND HARD, WHOEVER SAID THEY WERE EASY LIED. I AM STILL TRYING TO GET A GOOD GRADE. NOT TOO MANY QUESTIONS IN THE TESTS BUT ITS TERRIBLE.

His class really doesn't take much. If you go to class there is no reason to not pass his tests. His tests are pretty simple and he gives a lot of review before. the only thing is his online homework which is all due at the end of the semester. but it really isn't too bad. he's not the nicest but he's not mean. easy a.
Easy but didn't learn a thing
Decent teacher for the class read the textbook
3 tests and online hw

Really easy, pretty boring. If you have any idea of basic business principles, you'll be fine in this class. He was such an easy grader. You could skip every class and still get a good grade. Way too easy. It's not even that he teaches well, because he just kinda talks and goes off on tangents, but the information is common sense.

Nice guy, but he should not teach. He cares about his students and really wants make a change in how they think. But he only glosses over concepts instead of showing the process behind things that happen.
lol go to the two classes before the exam and dont go to anything else
Pretty chill guy.
Nice guy, really cares and wants to help you if you need it. Tests are easy just show up to the review.

Mr. Spigelman is very passionate about economics, however instead of showing how certain processes work, he will simply show you how to do the problem and that's it. However, his tests are a joke and as long as you go to his review sessions you should be able to get an A. You could miss every class and just go to the reviews and still pass.

Don't that the class if you want to learn. If you want an easy grade then go for it, otherwise take a different class. Passion for a subject and enthusiasm doesn't make a good professor, it helps but isn't the only factor. He doesn't define things or explain concepts, he shows steps to solving problems but not why those processes work. nice guy tho

Not a good professors. Always goes off topic and whenever he's on topic (which is rarely), he is confusing. I've taken Micro before, and even though I knew everything, he phrased concepts in ways I couldn't understand. However, HIS TESTS ARE JOKES. A fifth grader can do them. The class is an easy A if you just show up. Bad professor, easy class.
Excellent professor. Period. You will learn a ton and he's easy.

A lot of times he doesn't make any sense and it seems like he doesn't know what he is talking about. His tests aren't hard but they are only 20-30 questions so even if you only get a few wrong you can still get a bad grade.

I loved his class, and I'm taking him again next semester! He really cares about his students and wants to have a positive impact on their learning.  I really don't see why he's getting so much bad press.  He goes over the test info, has office hours, and holds review sessions for extra help.  The book IS a great aid, though.  He's great!!

His class was probably one of the easiest econ classes just because he underweights your lowest test grade and gives you full credit on hw if you made effort. Get the book. He's kind of unclear when he explains things so the book will help alot. Also, just go to review seshs/classes for the tests and final.  And Go To Office Hours! It Helps!

He knows the information, but doesn't know how to teach. He only shows graphs, and makes statements about them that he doesn't explain. He pretty much ignores the textbook, so I couldn't learn what I needed to know from that, because all the info was in class. He is one of the worst teachers I have ever had. I had to get a tutor.

By far the best econ teacher at UM. Very easy class. I definitely learned a lot. Attendance is not mandatory but the tests are exactly what he discusses in class so it is very difficult to do well if you miss class. Also if you go to office hours he will tell you exactly what will be on the test. I highly recommend him!

His class is a sore but its pretty easy. He teaches very straightforward, and the 3 classes before the exam he takes the opportunity to review every concept that will be on the exam. He does curve the exam depending on the average grade in the class. If you're looking for an easy teacher, definitely take him

I took his eco 211. He is a very hard professor. He does not know how to explain the concepts and we learnt nothing in the class. The exams are not easy which we have to memorize all the concepts in the book. very hard to understand him. Do not take his class if you want to learn Eco and get an A
I would try and avoid if possible. Loves going off topic

Not the best teacher but you can definitely get an A as long as you go to class. The 2-3 days of review before tests are most important. Everything he goes over on those days you can guarantee will be exactly whats on the test. The book is useless.

I think he's a good guy, though I know others dont.  Teaches very straightforward with good examples and was always helpful in class.  His tests were pretty easy as long as you did the practice problems he put online.  He's BY FAR the best 302 teacher.  Also willing to talk about sports anytime.  TAKE HIM!

He is not a good teacher. I took his ECO 211, it is very hard to understand him. He is not good t explaining concept, I have to study by myself before the exams. The exams are difficult if you do not memorize every concept in the book.
Worry rate before, sorry ,guys, this professor doesn't have racial discrimmination, but his teaching is little bit borning. You had better learn things by yourself if your major is Economics.
The class will be very easy IF you took econ before. If you want to "learn" econ, I do not recommend him; you will be rather memorizing graphs and MR=MB all semester.
The class is really boring but incredibly easy. He pretty much tells you what will be on the test and as long as you memorize  how to do the graphs, you're fine.
Attendance not mandatory. Tells you what is on exams the week before, and homework is literally him just glancing over graphs. His lectures can be dull at times, but the class is an easy A.

It's an easy class, but if you really want to learn economics, i do not recommend him. He draws a graph and it is your job to interpret with "logistics" - if this is your first econ class, do not take him.
He is a nice easygoing guy. His class is the easiest I have ever taken. Almost no work. Class is optional. Not the most exciting lecturer but hey, it's eco 211, cut him some slack.
the class is tough.textbook is totally useless .boring class

solid professor. his textbook is definitely needed to study for the tests and is very easy to understand considering each chapter is like 5 pages TOPS. if anyone would like to get the textbook for $20 email me at shufizzel@gmail.com because thats how i got mine instead of paying the $80 or whatever he charges

Yeah he repeats his same boring stories and is kind of bizarre, but the class is super easy. Just read the book (very short) and know the few examples and you'll get an A. You could probably skip most of his classes as long as you know the stuff in the book (since he wrote it). Definitely take if you want an easy A

Very boring and a terrible teacher. Luckily, he is a nice guy and a lenient grader so it is possible to get an A. Also, he repeats the same things every class, such as his favorite book, how he went to Stanford, and how he wants you to succeed. Attendance is not mandatory
The tests are easy if you memorize how to do the problems in the book but he does not explain the material clearly and it gets frustrating

He is one of the worst teachers I have ever had. Spigelman just draws graphs on the board, but doesn't explain them at all. The only way to do well on the test is to memorize what is in his text book. You don't improve your understanding of economics and this class is a complete waste of time.

His lectures are completely useless. He goes from A to C without showing you how he got to B. He also repeats himself over and over again. Oh and trust me he will let you know that he went to Stanford. Did I mention that he went to Standford?

What a great professor! Keeps his class interesting and I always feel as if I am learning a lot! He is a very nice guy and will always go out of his way to help you out! You should without a doubt use any opportunity to take his class. It's fun and you'll learn a lot.

It's a huge advantage to have the book, but he rips you off on it. Getting an A wasn't as easy as everyone said it was. He's annoying when he repeats himself a lot. There's not a lot of work  involved and the more you put in the more youll get out

One of the worst professors I've ever had, and not because he doesn't try. You'll spend a third of the class listening to him tell you about how he's changing his life and telling everyone to stop whispering. He makes you buy his 'textbook' which is like some pdf he came up with in a week and sells to you for $70.
He is so annoying. I'm tired of hearing about his life -_- yawn.He repeats the same things over and over and you can tell he has a huge ego. Guess you gotta deal with it for the A.
Show up to class, take notes, and study them the night before. Tests are easy, curve may sometimes hurt you (90 is B), definitely do-able. No need for textbook
Super easy, attendance not mandatory. Easy A, I went to class maybe 5 times in the entirety of last semester in 212 and got an A in the class. 302 is turning out to be the same deal
Attendance not mandatory, but he notices who shows up for participation grade (10%), and he basically tells you what's going to be on the test. Makes the information interesting, highly recommend.
He is so easy! he tells you what's on the tests! he doesn't require attendance!

Pretty tough. Not helpful whatsoever. Honestly the worst FIN professor I've had, though many say they've had worse. Work load is light though. Is somewhat lenient on grades. IDK, I'd take Sanders if I were you.
Best economics class. helpful reviews .
3 tests and 3 homeworks, straight from the book. Big review sessions prior to test are extremely helpful. My laziness got me my C, not the class content nor difficulty.

u'll need the book cuz he assigns hw, attendance isnt mandatory but u should definitely go, he even lets u switch around his sections... i ave no interest in eco but i left the class knowing a lot... he gives awesome reviews and tells u pratically everything on the tests, he really wants u to learn and like the material and hes super helpful!
If you did not get an A in this class you should just quit school.  That said you still learn a lot and he is a good professor.

Awesome econ. professor.  I hated and sucked at economics before taking this class and now I'm doing an econ. minor.  He makes sure you understand everything and lets you know what will be on tests.  Makes class relevant to the real-world.  An A in the class is extremely do-able.
He is a really nice professor.  Take his class and u r definitely gonna learn a lot.
Nice guy, good teacher. Available to offer help. His tests can be a bit difficult but he does give partial credit and is a fair grader
nice guy, makes class easy, tests are pretty easy despite being on a lot of material, if you show effort and participate you should get an A
He's a nice guy and makes the class relatively easy. The tests are curved a lot, so if you pay attention you should get an easy A.

Wants you to understand what he is talking about, so all he does is make sure you learn it, no matter the grade you get on tests. He tells you whats on the tests everytime and grades you based on if you understand what he says
Take the class. Go to class. Learn a lot and get your A.

Great professor. Attendance not mandatory, but go, I didn't at first and regret it. If you go and absorb the material the tests aren't bad at all. Tells you exactly what you need to know. Uses real world examples. I'd recommend for anyone.
Probably the best professor in the department. She has amazing lectures, is so organized, and brings in soooo much real-world experience. Take her!!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is one of the most caring professors I have ever had. She teaches every new concept in an engaging way. We had multiple projects that made sure we used skills learned in class, so we could further develop our knowledge on them. It is very obvious that she knows the subject to its full extent. Just make sure you go to office hours for any help
Kindest and most dedicated PR professor. Absolutely an angel, and wants you to succeed.

This teacher is so dedicated and is always willing to take time out of her day to meet with you about anything even if it is not about the class. She has her own PR firm and shares all her knowledge with her students. Genuinely one of the best professors. I took her for social media messaging and strategy.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Not understanding at all. Too strict about attendance. Never had a professor be so strict with deadlines. If something was turned in a day late, half of your grade is knocked off. If you miss a certain amount of classes, your grade gets lowered. Not a hard professor but way too strict.
Professor Mayor is the best! I would recommend 100% taking this class with her!

Professor Mayor is my favorite professor so far at UM. She's a teacher who wants to see you succeed in the class and your career. The lectures are informative and give you the info you need. She is a resource & mentor to her students. TAKE HER CLASS! Also, you don't need the textbook. Just go to class and be engaged.

The best professor in the economics department! He is very caring and takes into consideration your struggles with grasping information, and makes time to evaluate gaps with you. If you are an economics major, definitely take him if you can!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Esteban is an incredible professor and a very caring guy. The class is very difficult but lectures are clear and the handouts are very helpful. Expect tough exams. But, the curve at the end of the semester was incredibly generous and he even bumped up past the curve (82 and up was an A, 78-81 was an A-). You will learn a lot in the class!

This class is tough, but Esteban is simply the best. He cares about his students and treats everyone with respect. He teaches very well and is an engaging lecturer. He encourages questions and goes out of his way to help students with office hours and review sessions. Tests are hard, but not unfair. You will be challenged but will learn a ton.

Petruzello's ECO 444 is definitely not a walk in the park, but if you choose to actually do the work - paying attention in class, reading the textbook, reviewing notes - you'll do fine. For those interested in economics, Petruzello offers a truly inspiring class; pushing students to apply their systematic thinking into the business world.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. P is absolutely amazing! This is by far the best Economics class I have taken. It is a balance between becoming passionate about the subject and truly understanding the material. While exams are kinda hard, curve is great. He is super passionate. Wish I could take him again!
super sweet guy! exams are quite difficult, but homework assignments are similar to the structure of the exams. curve is great too.

Best prof in the Econ department. Incredibly friendly, and clearly passionate about the subject and teaching. Courses can be challenging but he is always eager to help, show up to class and pay attention and you'll have no problem. Grades on a heavy curve. Great guy, even better professor. Take him if you can.
He has a beautiful personality and helped me find myself when I got lost in the equation of GDP. He has great hair and I like his hat

Esteban is an amazing professor! No other way of putting it. This class is tough though, and you definitely need to pay attention in class and read the book. He gives handouts for each lecture which serve as great study guides, and they help you through reading the textbook. Test scores are low but he curves VERY generously. Definitely recommend

I forgot to do my course eval so hopefully this can make it up. Seriously this guy is a great prof, he knows what he's talking about and does a great job of explaining hard concepts in a way that you can understand. Ive taken 10 eco classes at UM and hes the best professor i've had. His exams can be hard but if u study you will be fine.  Great Guy

Great guy, you can skip everyday and he won't care but if you care and always go to class you can extremely well in class. His exams are hard but he does a great job making content clear. Will answer nay question you ask and is very helpful if you need it. His exams are definitely hard but if you study you can do really well. All around great guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great class and a great professor (would also recommend ECO307 w/ him). You can tell he really enjoys the material he is teaching, which makes the classes more engaging. Loved the lecture format, easy to follow along, and notes line up to book readings and exams. You should go to class and pay attention if you want a good grade though.

This is my first time doing this but he deserves it. He is the best economics professor at UM hands down, i've had two classes with him and i loved it. Hes super caring, cares about students, exams are hard but its everything in the handouts he gives every lecture. I recommend him to friends that are not even econ majors lol
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: dont take this professor. Hes useless. Just boringly lecturers about the textbook, gives no study guide, then basically says good luck on the test, which are very hard. He is a professor that wants you to fail

Ive taken two courses with Prof Petruzzello. The first was 307. I enrolled because I was genuinely interested in pub econ. The second was ECO311. This time, I enrolled just so that I could take another course with him. By far the best prof at UM. Hes the exact person youd want guiding you through this material. Hey dean - hire more Petruzzellos!

Dr. Petruzzello is a fantastic professor. Out of all the ECO professors in UM I got the most enriching experience with him. He gives handouts for each class so note-taking is easy and you know what to focus on. You do have to know the material well for his exams as he examines each detail, but he covers everything, so no surprises. TIP: Do the HW!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Great Professor. Class is very organized and straightforward. Do not copy paste your homework or assignments. he will know. Be yourself and create your own work. You'll do great.

Great Professor. The class material can e hard but very straightforward. Make sure you answer Homework and exam question in your own words. He can tell if you have gotten your explanation from somewhere else, and you will loose points
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Best choice for Economics at UM. Exams mostly come from problem sets/practice problems, he doesn't try to trick you or anything. Lectures are very helpful but not mandatory. Very nice guy and accessible outside of class.
The greatest professor that I have ever learned from

Esteban is my favorite professor at UM. He gives handouts before each lecture and that is SO helpful. Although nobody likes to read the book, I highly recommend it. It is very very interesting and will help you immensely. He is very nice, smart, accessible. If you have questions he wants to help you answer them. I have taken his class twice!

He's amazing. His passion for what he does shines through. You can tell he works as hard as possible to be the best possible professor he could be, on all regards. If you pay attention in class you'll definitely learn, and he tells you exactly what to expect for each exam. Would've taken him for every Econ class if that was possible. Learnt so much

Esteban is an incredible professor, and I say this because he truly cares about his students and their performance. His tests are intricately worded, but he is always there to help you understand the wording so that it cannot mess students up on the exam.
Such an amazing professor . Cares, is kind , very helpful , not an easy grader but thorough and you learn a lot if you pay attention. Very smart, very passionate . AMAZING professor.
Great professor- gives handouts during class.

His lectures are fantastic because you can feel that he loves what he does. He doesn't lecture off power points, but gives you outlines to take notes on. I found it hard to study for his exams because there didn't seem to be clear themes or overarching points, but he is very accessible outside of class to help you. Pretty sure he curves at the end.

Best professor in the econ department hands down. took industrial and now health econ with him. attendance not mandatory but highly recommended bc he gives you handouts that you fill out during class as he goes through the lecture. if you study a reasonable amount before exams and follow along in class you should get an A-/A. such a great guy.

He is a really amazing teacher that really cares about his students. His lectures are well thought out and interesting, but it isn't mandatory to attend. Reading the textbook is useful if you want to get an A. Really great Econ professor that really knows what he's talking about.

Best professor ive had at UM. Take as many econ electives with him as you can. Learn a lot, not too difficult to get an A, clear grading criteria and super interesting classes. If you don't enjoy his class you shouldn't be an Econ major.
Best prof I've had at UM. Must take for Econ majors, and I've only taken health econ, plan to take industrial with him in the future.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: I've taken 3 classes with him at UM: Labor Econ, Industrial Econ, and Health Econ, and each class was better than the last. He has very clear grading criteria: three problem sets (drops lowest one) and three exams (final exam is partially cumulative which helps you learn the main topics long term). Take notes, read the book, and you'll do well
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He is a great professor! You should take one of his classes. He is always motivated and is really interested that the students learn something about the topic. I highly recommend him!

Dr. Petruzzello is awesome. His industrial economics class was phenomenal and I would highly recommend it. One of the ECO dept's bests, his lectures are interesting and easy to follow. Dr. P is happy all the time and extremely helpful. I loved having him and he his passion for the material made the class all the better. Tough exams but fair.

Esteban has been my favorite professor in UM's Econ department. He really cares about teaching and makes each student feel valued. Very fair grader and gives you every opportunity to earn a good grade. I've never had a professor that understands the student's perspective so well. Take him and you'll learn, earn a grade you deserve and have fun

Esteban is one of the better professors in the economics department. His lectures are clear and informational, he covers all you need to know and does a great job at teaching the material. Exams are fair if you go to class and take notes, reading the book is a must.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Esteban was my favorite professor so far at UM. Class is very straightforward with 2 midterms and a final, w/ additional 2 HW assignments. Attendance isn't mandatory, but I highly recommend it. Esteban gives handouts that you fill in throughout the lecture, so you don't miss anything. He's a very fair grader and makes time to help students.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Explains material very clearly. Very fair amount of work (15 homework problems, 2 exams + final) for the amount of material covered. Pretty funny. Very accessible outside of class. Relates incredibly well to students. Lectures are very interesting; attendance isn't mandatory but you'll really miss out on one UM's best professors.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Don't get spooked if your grade for the 1st midterm isn't great. He's a fair grader & by the end of the semester you understand way more than you ever though you would. Information itself may be hard but never felt like exams were made to trick me. Very approachable & lectures are interesting because he truly cares about the subject. 1000/10

Prof. Petruzzello is probably the best econ professor I've ever encountered. I can definitely say that I've learned a lot from his lectures. Even though attendance is not mandatory, I highly encourage you to come because the lectures are VERY helpful for the exams (unlike with some other professors). One of the most unbiased teachers at UM.

Esteban is the best economics professor at UM hands down. He genuinely cares about his students and is always more than willing to help you understand the material if need be. He's incredibly kind, intelligent, and also hilarious. I would definitely recommend taking his class.

Professor Petruzello really cares about his students.  He is extremely knowledgable, and does not make this class super easy.  It is challenging but it was worth taking.  If you pay attention and ask questions, you can easily get an A.  Top econ professor I've taken at UM

Dr. Petruzzello is an all-around great professor. He is energetic, loves to teach, and will do all that he can to make the material interesting. Exams are based solely on the material from lecture and thus you don't have to buy the book if you don't want to. Attendance is optional but useful, as he is a great lecturer and stresses exam material.

Esteban is a fantastic professor who is passionate about health economics. The course was one of the best I have taken in the economics department, and I would highly recommend the course to everyone, especially those interested in a healthcare career.

Dr. Petruzzello might be the best professor from the econ dept. His class is contextualized, he focuses more in the intuitive aspect rather than methods. He clearly loves teaching and he loves the content he is teaching. He will go above and beyond to help the students. Regardless of content, he will make the class as interesting as possible.

Esteban is the man. You can't just take a miss, if you go to all classes or get all the class notes you will do well. No surprises on tests, very straightforward as long as you have his class notes, opened book to do homework, nothing else.

Esteban is an awesome guy. The class wasn't too difficult, especially if you go to class. The tests can be a little challenging, but its not rocket science. I learned a lot in this course and this professor is a great dude.
Do not take calc with him, takes off points for every little thing and doesn't allow methods he doesn't teach in class even if you get the correct answer. Take anyone else

People say he takes points off for every little thing, its true. But he tells you exactly what not to do, and there are really only five or so rules to follow. Always right equals signs is an example. Lectures are excellent, posted online with notes afterwards too. Just pay attention. Lots of HW, thats the whole department mandated. Always Availabl

Great professor. You can tell he knows what he is talking about and is passionate about his work. He provides optional worksheets every week that are exactly like what is on the quizzes and exams. He can seem a little intimidating at first, but just stay off your phone for literally 50 minutes. Take him if you can; he's really good.
Don't take him. He docks off points for any and every little mistake. Avoid him if possible.
do not take math with this professor if you enjoy life.

One of the worst professors I have had in college. Enjoys degrading students and has a prideful attitude. Assigns a minimum of 60-80 homework questions a week, extremely hard grader, and only accepts perfection. If you want to succeed in calc, do not take him as a professor, even my own tutors said he was not well respected in the math department.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Shows bias to students on his good side. The strictest grader you will ever see takes off massive points for missing an equals sign. Kicks students out and sends them to the dean's office for minor infractions, like being on a phone for a second. DO NOT TAKE unless you're a teacher's pet. If you miss lectures, you will fail.
very cold professor and made calculus 1 very difficult. retook with different teacher and had a much easier time

Professor Wawerczyk creates a tense and uncomfortable classroom environment, often interrupting instruction to reprimand students over small issues. His focus seems to be more on strict control and criticism than on fostering a class that is engaging, helpful, and worth taking. I would strongly recommend avoiding his courses.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Handles delinquents effectively, no nonsense

He is exceptionally uncomfortable, and takes away from class time to yell at students for minor infractions. It is clear that his priorities as an educator lie in berating his students and maintaining a simulacrum of order rather than making his courses enjoyable, valuable, and meaningful. Do not take Prof. Wawerczyk.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you want to pass, do NOT take Professor Wawerczyk's class. He's very strict with attendance, tests every week, temperamental, and his grading system makes no sense; he'll look for ways to take points away from you. If you need a B to get into Business, you won't accomplish that with him. He's accessible outside of class, but I don't recommend!

Amazing teacher. Really takes time to make sure students understand the material and will answer any questions you have even if you ask the same one 10 times. Loves math and enjoys teaching it to students. Just don't mess around in class and pay attention and you will be good. Best math teacher I've had.

Very good lecture style, makes concepts easy to understand. You will learn the material well, but almost impossible to get a good grade in the class. Will genuinely look for any opportunity to take off points on exams and quizzes. You will drop multiple letter grades for small notation errors. Also jumps at the opportunity to ridicule students.

Dr. Wawerczyk is the best math teacher I've ever had (and I'm not good at math). His lectures are hilarious, and he answers every question asked no matter how many times people repeat themselves. He cares, office hours are super helpful, and he made Calc 2 digestible even though it's extremely difficult. Stay on his good side and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great professor. Really does care - don't get on his bad side he will yell at you in front of the class. However, if you actually want to learn math, you will.

Prof Wawerczyk did a great job teaching calc, just go to class & pay attention. The quizzes are super similar to the worksheets that he makes, so be sure to review those. He only takes top 5 quizzes, you get EC for completing HW early, and he offers EC at end of semester. He is better than these reviews make him seem, just study well for exams.

Great teacher, teaches in a way you'd understand. You do need to attend class as he takes attendance and he can be a tough grader at times but he does tell you the way he wants the work. Don't get on his bad side.

Eric was a great teacher. Attendance is mandatory and he can seem strict, but as long as you dont talk to other people obviously or get on your phone he will love you. He teaches the material clearly and helps you master the material. He is a quirky dude which makes the lectures much more entertaining and keeps you from falling asleep. He's great.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great prof. I learned so much in his class. He can be perceived as kinda scary at first but he's a funny guy. Show up to class. Review practice exams and you'll do fine. Best prof in math department.

Dr.Wawerczyk is an amazing math professor. He presents material in a clear manner while also providing some interesting historical background on mathematics; always available for help. When it comes to grading, he is very particular and takes of points for bad math grammar. Lectures are recorded, but don't miss 5 classes or you fail. W proffesor.

Professor Eric is very knowledgeable and teaches very well. Although he gives a lot of work he prepares you very well for exams! If you email him about more office hours he will do meet and help you with whatever you need. If you are willing to put in the work you will be able to get a high grade and actually learn.

Teaches incredibly well! He can be a bit strict, but for me, how well someone teaches matters most. He puts a lot of effort into lectures and makes students really understand the concepts easily. It is structured in a way that sets you up for success as long as you do what's asked. Genuinely the best math teacher I've had.

Wawerczyk is a very intelligent professor who teaches extremely well. If you are having trouble understanding something conceptually, you may ask him any question for good help. He may come off as condescending or passive-aggressive at times, but he doesn't mean it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I've taken multiple math teachers at UM and he is by far the best at explaining all the material. He is very straight forward and doesn't surprise you with extremely difficult problems. He tells you exactly what you need to know for quizzes and exams. Very efficient at teaching, definitely put a lot of effort into the class and study. TAKE HIM!

SOOOO incredibly rude and would jump at the chance to publicly humiliate students. kicked a kid out, yells at them, made a "no giggling" policy. decent at explaining material, but every class made me actively want to drop my major (math).

Lowk a scary guy, would kick kids out for electronics, fail you if you missed more than five classes, a little condescending. But he taught the math really well with plenty of examples. Gave study guides and hw that prepared you well for the tests. Quizzes every week but only top 5 counted. Take him if you're prepared to go to every lecture.

Wawerczyk, was the most efficient math teacher I have ever had. His personality was not super easy to get along with however his ability to explain mathematical concepts was exceptional. There was not one topic that I felt that he was not able to thoroughly explain to me. Tthere are some difficult concepts but Wawerczyk is the way to go 100%.

I love him. I took him for Calc 1 and 2. He is a very strict grader and will deduct points. However, he is a great lecturer and explains concepts very clearly. He is always willing to help and accessible. He provides study guides before exams and quizzes and you will never be surprised on a quiz. 5 absences results in a complete fail.

GOD. SEND. This man is the best math professor ive ever had, by far. 10+ office hours a week, always responds quickly to emails, and the classes are fun and informative. 5 absences and its an automatic fail, so dont be a doofus and show up. Can be a little passive-aggressive, but as far as gripes, thats it. Made calculus understandable

Some of these professors need to learn its not their job to fail students, this guy will fail you at 5 absences no questions asked, will give 0 credit for a correct answer without one notation, and overall a rude person

Do not take this class unless you naturally excel at calculus. His lectures do not align with the exams as they do the quizzes, so be prepared to study. The homework is unnecessary in that it does not match with the tested material either. Lectures are basically a waste of time since the material you need that he teaches is hardly mentioned.

The workload was unbelievable and he graded extremely hard. I was drowning in studying for quizzes and exams, all of which were extremely difficult. I found him very mean-spirited and condescending, pretty much a bully. You can master this material with much better teachers and avoid unnecessary abuse. I earned an A- but it was the toughest A ever
All quizzes are about lecture questions. Pretty easy if you participate and do homework. He seems like a cold person but is actually a nice guy.

His expectations are unreasonable. He had a baby so he canceled the next 2 classes. Then after that the next 2 were on Zoom, which is completely understandable… except for the fact he made us take a test the next day after not having had a lesson with him in person for a week. He's a tough grader. More than 4 absences is an automatic fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's very smart and clearly very passionate about math. Although, he is very annoying and complains about his other classes during class time. The homework is a lot harder than anything we could ever do in class and there is a lot of it every week.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: terrible. r

He is extremely smart when it comes to math and answers every single question thoroughly and makes sure you understand. However, a lot of unnecessary homework. Calls class out for low attendance rate even though attendance isn't mandatory. Tests are ok. Quiz for every discussion. Study questions he did during lecture.

HE IS THE BEST. All the bad reviews about him probably don't care about the class. He's passionate about what he teaches and wants everyone to excel. He gives you EVERYTHING you need to know for quizzes and exams and makes it clear if you don't do it a specific way, you'll get points off. He records lectures and posts his notes. TAKE HIM!

I didn't focus to the homeworks and studied only using the class notes and EXAM STUDY GUIDES and got an A on all 4 exams and an A in the class. Prof W will allude to his "favorite" problems in class and those are usually on the exams. Pay attention to how he formats his answers in class because he will take off points if you dont answer like that.

Just don't. I have always excelled in math, even AP calc, and yet I managed to do horribly in his class. He's mean, will humiliate you, and will call you out for missing one singular lecture even though his syllabus states that attendance is not mandatory. He tries to act like he cares about his students but he doesn't. Save yourselves.

Our class had an attendance problem and our prof would frequently reprimand us, even though I always went, so it was kind of annoying. Lectures can be boring with little/no class engagement. Other than those issues I thought he was great, clearly passionate about math, and ALWAYS ready to help outside of class/email

This professor is the absolute worst grader of all time. Multiple quizzes and exams I have gotten the correct answer, but points taken off because I missed a parathesis or my work wasn't his exact way. I have never hated a class and a teacher more in my entire life and I plan to bring this up with the math department, to save future students.

Great Lecturer and professor. Passionate about math and also passionate about having his students learn. Top 5 Quizes and Final replaces lowest test so relatively easy to pass if you do well enough on his tests.

I do not recommend professor Wawerczyk. The only positive thing I can say about him is that he is passionate about math. Otherwise, he is a mean natured person. He says he's willing to help you however, he does it in such a demeaning way. He uses his power over his students to his advantage. I think you'll be better off with a different professor.

Took for Calc1, harsh grader, takes off a ton of points. He is strict with phone policies and attendance but really is passionate about math and does his best to show it and teach well. Don't just google the homework, if you dedicate time to doing most of the problems you will be set for the quizzes and exams. Quiz weekly but only top 5 count.

Professor Wawerczyk is awesome. He spends alot of time lecturing about fundamental ideas so that students really grasp the concepts. He always posts his lectures, replies to emails quicky, and is accessible outside of class. Most people are stupid and lazy. Read the book, attend lecture, do the homeworks, and go to office hours and youll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Worst class and professor I have ever had in my life. He doesn't grade tests accurately and his lectures are all based on his level of knowledge on math. He is strict and very intense on his students, which isn't bad, but the way he teaches is boring. Most kids average a C, and he tells them that they are lazy and should drop his horrible class.

I've taken a lot of math at UM, and Wawerczyk is definitely one of my favorite math professors I've had. He made linear algebra, an inherently abstract and difficult subject, feel somewhat intuitive and easier to grasp. He assigns homework every week, but it's never a ridiculous amount and he prepares you well for it. Would definitely recommend.

I've taken a lot of math at UM and Wawerczyk is definitely one of my favorite math professors I've had. I took MTH210 (linear algebra) with him and never felt lost. He made it feel not too difficult to understand the subject, which is inherently abstract and difficult to grasp. Assigned no more than 1 worksheet a week. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: You can see this professor deeply cares about math, and in lectures he would often go way into detail of small things. He is always very open to questions and did a lot of examples during class.

He explains the concepts very well and is always open to questions. However, he has very strong opinions about random topics and will share them. He has a very strict no electronics policy, but does try to give as many points as possible. Seeing graded tests and quizzes online was really helpful! If you do not have to take calc 2 then take him.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: He was a very tough grader, and made me switch majors because of how much he made me despise math. That being said, he is very willing to help, and I think that if this class was my only class of the entire semester maybe it would've been fine. His exams are graded terribly, and there are much easier professors out there if that's what u want.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Took MTH 140 and 141 with him. Amazing professor, very knowledgable, and tries to make the class fun with Desmos demonstrations. Would definitely recommend!

Lectures can be very boring and repetitive, not a ton of student participation, but is always available to answer questions and go over topics. Lots of homework weekly and quizzes but you can drop most of them. Provides study guides for exams and review days. Final was pretty difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Wawerczyk is the best for calculus. He is very clear when explaining, always open to questions, and the problems we work through in class are very similar to the quizzes/tests. Always accessible outside of class and just a genuinely caring person! Just make sure to stay off your phone lol. Taking him again for 162.

No electronics allowed ever in class and would kick you out if even saw them. Scary guy and really confusing when lecturing, but would only count 5 quizzes for the entire semester. Not a fair grader and looks for reasons to take off points even if you get the answer right

Needs things to be done HIS way, is very dismissive and arrogant in teaching, excessively challenging examples of otherwise simple concepts, overall one of the least enjoyable classes of my adult life.

He's very good at explaining the concepts in depth. He's the only math teacher I've ever had that has made me understand why math works the way it does, not just how to do the problem itself. He seems harsh sometimes, but taking him for math is worth it.

Tough grader but fantastic professor. Heard he is the only great math professor and although his tests are hard, his students are the only kids at the end of the semester who are not lost at the end of the semester and do good on the final. Took him for all my math courses and he was great!

Best math professor I've ever had. Not only does he explain the concepts, but he explains why the concepts matter and proves why they are true. He records all his lectures so you can rewatch later if you feel a need to. He also takes notes for you during class about the topic itself. I worked my schedule around taking him again for MTH 141.

reviews.comment: Pretty average professor. If you have to take him just do it, it won't be the worst. He's pretty nice and neutral until he's not. He gets agitated randomly. Even if you feel dumb for asking questions just do it, u have the right

reviews.comment: Professor Wawerczyk, while very knowledgeable, is not the best nor the worst Math professor at UM. He is accessible out of class and provide weekly review sections. reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I love him!! Idk why is rating is so low he's such a great teacher. Math was by far my favorite course thanks to him. Sometimes he can be a little mean, but his teaching style is amazing and he describes the content so well! I will be taking him again next semester.

First few weeks he was so kind and really wanted to help students learn. Throughout the course, he got more and more aggravated during class. He encourages students to ask questions, but if you ask one he makes you feel very stupid about the question you asked. Overall not a bad teacher but crazy attitude.

BEST PROFESSOR!!! Math is hard, but Wawerczyk will always explain. He answers questions and help until he is sure students understand. Exams are VERY fair; he emphasizes exactly what will be on the test and chooses the most straightforward examples. Pay attention in class, take notes, and do the test review packets...you'll be fine.

INCREDIBLE professor! The best math teacher I've ever had. Grades SO fairly. Gives every opportunity to bring up your grade. Go to class, ask questions, do homework, and you'll do great. Truly cares about his students and makes class fun. Also very good at explaining concepts and posts all notes and lectures! 100% recommend for MTH 140+141.

Best calculus prof! I took Dr. Wawerczyk by chance for MTH140 and basically built my schedule around getting him again for 141 because he was so good! Don't listen to the harsh ratings - he truly wants to see you succeed and is by far one of the most patient professors I have ever had. Answers emails within minutes and is super helpful all around!

He’s a great Professor and is super caring. He’s really accessible outside of class and will respond to emails in minutes. While participation isn’t mandatory, attendance is taken everyday. He also records his lectures but I still recommend going as much as possible. Also he doesn’t tolerate phones in class fyi.

I really enjoyed this class. I have never once said that about a math class, but Dr. Wawerczyk was very patient in explaining concepts and answering questions. I feel like I have a way better calculus foundation now than before I took this class, and I took AP calculus in high school. Be present in class and listen and you will do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: SUPER NICE and accessible to students outside of class, in class, though, he can seem intimidating. His lectures go VERY fast, so watch the recordings right after, and if you skip a day you miss A LOT so go to class! He answers homework questions (basically telling you how to solve a problem) in a matter of minutes through email, so REACH OUT!!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof Wawerczyk clearly is passionate about math, sometimes he strays off topic and talks about concepts far beyond the course which can be confusing. If youve taken AP Calc his class will be much easier. He is very accessible outside of class; responds to emails, will schedule more individual office hours, etc. Cares about his students.
The best professor you can take for Calc 2. Hes funny so class is entertaining and his lectures are great. His reviews and in class problems reflect the exam exactly, take him if you can.

Good professor. He does care about his students and does want to make sure that you have an understanding of the lessons. If you haven't taken calc or trig before it can be kinda difficult and sometimes fast paced, but if you take notes, do exam reviews, and go to his weekly zoom office hrs, shouldn't be too hard. Taking him again for mth141.

I emailed him countless times with questions, did all the homewok, and studied on my won and got help from my friends. Still didn't pass although I showed so much effort and did everything he asked me to. Unfit to teach math for those who aren't STEM kids.

reviews.comment: He's a good professor. He always letting students in class know that he wants them to pass and wants to help them. TAKE PROF. W FOR MTH161!!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He's the most caring calc professor in uni. He makes sure everyone understands the material, you can email him anytime with any question and he'll explain it. Tests are mostly based on in-class material, so no surprises. Grading is very clear, gives some extra credit at the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: These reviews don't do Wawerczyk justice. He is so nice and wants to help his students. If you show up and pay attention, do the homework, and the reviews you should be fine. His exams are not too difficult, do the reviews and you should be fine. I definitely recommend having him. I loved his class and he made me feel like calc was easy.

Nice guy and I am a fan of his teaching style. He answers emails fast and answers any questions you have. My only complaint is that your grade is mostly dependent on the tests and he does not offer a lot of opportunities for other grades. There is HW and 2 extra credits but it does not help much. Also, he did not let us see our final exam grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The reviews below don't do this professor justice. He is a good professor and has a very straightforward approach. 4 exams + final, 4 quizzes and Cengage hw (about 4 assignments per week). The lecture may be a little boring but he teaches well and there are no surprises on the tests. Tests are graded fairly. Do the reviews and you'll pass the test.

Love Professor Wawercyzk! One of the best math professors by far. He is very attentive to the needs of his students and is always available. He will make sure to answer any question you have until you fully understand. For exams, study the review and you should be just fine. There is weekly webassign but it's not too challenging. Really great guy.

WOW HE IS AMAZING!!!! Take him if youre the type of person that gets confused a lot he will not make you feel dumb. he will answer your emails within minutes. whenever you need help he is always there. He tries to make a quite complicated subject as easy as possible and is an amazing grader! He is one of the best profs Ive had

I liked Professor Wawerczyk. Definitely a solid choice for a math professor. He really wanted everyone to do well. He understood that people in Math 101 weren't STEM people, & so explained concepts in a way that non-STEM students could understand. The homework was hard but helpful. Showing your work is really important. Overall great professor!!
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Wawerczyk is an amazing professor. His experience in the field shines through in his teachings, and despite being math, he made ways to make his class fun and engaging, whether it be with jokes or class interaction. I would highly recommend taking him! I would again if I could.

Dr. Wawerczyk is super nice and genuinely cares about his students. He's a true nerd for math and wants everyone to do well in it, and he's totally accessible outside of class and more than willing to answer any questions. Super chill and understanding about extensions and his class is pretty easy. Definitely taking him for MTH 141 next semester :)

He is not as bad as people make him out to be. His lectures are a bit fast-pace, and he expects students to know certain math concepts before he teaches. He gives about 4 homework assignments per week, and a quiz every 2-3 weeks. He always asks students to reach out with questions, and tries to be funny in class. Material on exams are on homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I'm terrible at math, but his class wasn't too hard. He actually cares about his students and wants them to succeed. He's a pretty good professor that answers any questions you might have. There is A LOT of homework and a quiz every week. Still, he never answers emails and is a harsh grader. This guy gets a bad rep for not caring about students and I couldnt disagree more. He gives a lot of review before tests and the homeworks really help go w stuff he teaches in class. Awful professor. All bias aside, he simply does not care for his students. No face cams or mics for zoom classes make an impersonal environment and he often just goes through the lectures without much concern. Easy A as long as you do the work but he dumps a lot of homework on MyMathLab without much care or regard.

Is Professor Wawerczyk the best Math professor at UM ... not even close. However, he's very accessible in his office hours and is always willing to help. There are no surprises on his test, if you do the review and go over his lecture notes you should be fine. The lectures are boring, but try not to skip class. Overall, he's an decent professor.
Horrible teacher. He gives extremely hard tests and is a tough grader.

His method of explanation is too mixed up. His approach to one question would change if he were to approach the same question. DO NOT TAKE HIM!!! IF YOU WANT TO GET A W ON YOUR TRANSCRIPT, BY ALL MEANS, TAKE HIM. HOMEWORK HAS MATERIAL THAT WAS NEVER TAUGHT IN CLASS!

This was the hardest thing I've ever done in my life. I took the two semester calc instead of the 1 semester calc because I thought it would be easier. I WAS WRONG. Goes way too fast for us to follow and expects us to pass. Such a ridiculously hard class.

Dr. Wawerczyk is a great person who is always willing to help, however his class is so hard! I had to work so hard to barely pass the class. My GPA went down because of this class. I would not take him unless you are willing to study math every hour of the day.
Tests are way harder than HW and class examples. Not an easy class if you're not a stem student.

Grade is based on exams but you know that from the beginning of the course. It helped taking AP calc beforehand in high school, but if you go to his office hours he is a lot of help before exams. He really cares about his students.

reviews.comment: Very clear and knows what he is talking about. Likes participation and wants to help you if you are confused. All of the grades are really just the exams and homework.

Tbh he's pretty chill. Not the most amazing prof but definitely not the worst. He knows what he's talking about and willing to help when you're confused. I think a lot of the reason I didn't do very well was because I wasn't studying as much as I needed to.
I had to work my tail off to get a B. If you fail a test you will not get a good grade.

I didn't learn much attending his classes but practicing the reviews and doing the homework are enough to prepare you for his exams. Wawerczyk is very helpful and accessible during his office hours. He gives extra credit points and super easy quizzes to boost your grade. Put in the effort and you'll get an A.

He literally grades the hardest out of every calc teacher, hood jokes arent funny and he thinks that is supposed to make us like him better, he doesnt teach he just writes on the board and says we do this then we do that With NO explanation of how he got there or what formula is used.

Awful.
His class was the worst I have ever taken at UM. I am very good at math, but this man made it impossible. Why did the school hire this man?!

Half of the answer key on his study guide was wrong! He is AWFUL. Please do not take him. I am warning all of you.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He makes math unnecessarily hard and he does not explain anything clearly. I am going to fail because his class is so hard. Take at your own risk.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Wawerczyk is very caring and passionate about math and does his best to engage the class. He is a very fair grader who gives lots of partial credit and he is very accessible as his office hours are very long and multiple times per week. Do your homework/practice tests and go to his office hours and you will succeed.

He is super nice and accommodating but his teaching methods are kind of questionable. The homework material was never the same as what was on the test which was frustrating. He is always willing to help but I did not really understand the material the way he teaches it. You definitely have to study on your own in order to pass.
Tough grader do not recommend
He really cares about his students and tries to make the class as engaging as possible.
Worst teacher I have ever had. Nothing on the homework is actually on the exam, he never explains anything clearly. You are so confused by the end of the class, and will understand nothing.
The worst math professor I have ever had in my life. The exams are nothing like the homework. I have never met a teacher that uses the most inconvenient way of solving problems.

A new professor. His best qualities are his patience and understanding. Rare qualities out of a math teacher and you can tell he is passionate about what he was doing. Creates an open environment in a math classroom that I have never seen before. Very sweet guy. Take him!

Super sweet, honestly surprised by the negative reviews. Exams aren't difficult and she allows 5 cheat sheets. If you pay attention to lectures you'll be fine. Projects weren't hard either, maybe instructions a little vague. hw are pretty representative of exam questions, and her reviews classes for exams basically tells you what will be on them.
Didn't learn a thing, it feels like shes right there learning it with us. No prep for exams, extremely boring class, and not responsive. I would do anything to have picked a different professor.

She's really sweet, but her lectures don't actually teach you anything. All exams are online, but with no partial credit. Her instructions for projects are vague and she takes off a lot of points because she wasn't specific enough. She does offer a lot of extra credit.

I'll come back to this but after her first two exams I can confidently say this fin302 with her isnt as bad as people are making it sound. super easy, she tells you whats on them, and the averages for the two were well into the 90s. Group project is annoying but shes a sweet person.

Truly an amazing person. She genuinely cares about her students and wants everyone to succeed. Welcoming environment where you feel comfortable asking questions. Keeps the class engaging, which makes a challenging course feel much more manageable. You can tell she's passionate about teaching and about her students
Do not take this professor, class time seems useful until it's not. Exams are hard and online so if you mess up even the smallest amount you're screwed. Don't take her save yourself
Failed due to homework and attendance despite getting good grades on tests and final project.

Took her for FIN302 then for FIN303. Her exams were initially open note, no lockdown browser but since everyone used ChatGPT, she used lockdown browser halfway through the semester. She's still navigating how to organize the course, and makes last minute changes. Overall lovely professor, she's easy to come to. She's not as bad as people here say.

The professor fails to give good instructions for group projects. Exams are short and on Pearson, so if decimals are slightly off the question is wrong. Professor gives a review that consists of her reading through slides, no example problems. The class lacks organization and instructions. Grades meticulously despite absence of directions/examples
This is the easiest class ever, she is just a mid and boring teacher. Make sure you do your homeworks.

Avoid her at all costs, she is unforgiving and rude. Homeworks are worth a ridiculous amount of your final grade and are challenging and based off accuracy. If you miss one or get a few questions wrong it changes your whole final grade. Also exams are impossible.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Horrible at teaching and does not show examples of how to do problems. Tests have way too many questions and are impossible to finish.

She is not the best teacher, didnt learn much in class. Exams are pretty much pearson homework just do the work in excel and you can use all notes in exam. Group proj is annoying there is not much guidance given. Overall easy A just study for exams on your own. lots of extra credit opportunity in the end and dropped lowest exam.
This class is not bad. She drops lowest exam. Gives you many chances to help your grade. Easy A if you somewhat try. Nice lady.

Awful professor exams are unfair as she teaches one way and the questions are presented different on exams. Does not matter if you study you will still perform badly. Praying she curves to save my gpa.
most teacher Ive ever had in my life. Worried for myself as a finance major as I learned nothing in her class. She does not teach and is so rude.
Can't teach. Drops the lowest. Not hard to do well if you try.
I can't fully express how dissatisfied I was with this professor without violating Rate My Professor guidelines.

Changed requirements for the group project about 50 times and was really vague. Does not teach at all, she just reads off the slides. She decided to drop lowest test grade because people did awful after she switched the format halfway through the semester. "No final" but will give an exam last day of class, but she does allow any size cheat sheet.

I feel like everyone's being a little dramatic. She isnt great at teaching and makes the content way more confusing than it needs to be, but she's not AWFUL. drops your lowest exam, responds to your emails within the hour, and tells you EXACTLY whats on the exam during reviews. shes fine its not as bad as ppl say shes just not good at explaining

If you DO NOT Care about your GPA, about your money invested in your tuition take this professor. In that case, it's a perfect fit. If not, continue searching and take another professor. She pushes students to a failing position and can't teach at all. Always snarky and vicious.

reviews.comment: She wants you to fail
