reviews.comment: just bad.
MEH pretty easy class ruined by a crummy professor.

You might be thrown off by the "hilarious" tag I put on this rating with her awful rating and 4 difficulty.  The reason I put hilarious is because it's funny that she is able to give lectures and be called a "professor" at this university. She is a joke, she can't even do her own problems and when she makes mistakes, she blames the student. Beware.

She has little to no teaching skills whatsoever. She has a horrible attitude, doesn't care about her students and provides no help outside of class or even inside of class for that matter. You will have to teach yourself all of the information if you want to do well and she will not guide you on what to do to prepare for the exams at all.

This professor is terrible. Seems like she doesn't actually know what she is teaching. She randomly adds content that you need to know for important group projects on a Friday night a few days before it's due. She doesn't help understand any material. Basically reads from a script.

One of the worst professors here. Doesn't know how to teach and her lectures are truly terrible. Not one person can understand what she's doing and always makes mistakes. She would often change what is needed on certain assignments right before they're due. Do not take her.

She's snarky, gives basically zero useful feedback, has insane criteria for group projects and submissions, is insanely inflexible when emergencies come up (she'll DEMAND proof or you get a 0 on whatever you missed). All the lectures are just slides from Pearson and her notes are chicken-scratch gibberish. She also won't prepare you for her tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: A few students were even discussing plans to change their major because of Professor Espinoza. She is a disgraceful teacher. There is no place for such a vicious professor at UM. Avoid this professor at all costs. MAKE FINANCE GREAT AGAIN!
This lady is probably the worst professor at the University of Miami Business School. Avoid at all costs. Mean attitude, really unhelpful feedback, lots of homework.

Not sure why she is always so tense and gives off a snarky attitude in class. Rarely answers questions and does not care to reexplain the material. Every class she convinces students that the next exam will be made much tougher and not many will do well on it. This lady isn't fit to be a professor and must work on handling her emotions at workplace

Easy class. attendance isn't mandatory, barely anyone shows up. I would rec. just staying ontop of hw, and study that for exams(basically the same thing). you get 2 front and back pages of cheat sheets per exam. our final wasn't communicative(other fins were). She is super sweet. Final project was long, but not too bad, 10 min group presentation

Very difficult class, but very kind and fair professor. Towards the end, she offered extra credit to everyone, since many of us were struggling a bit with the class. Thankfully, her homework is worth a huge chunk of the grade, which also helped me a lot. Finance is not easy, but she makes it possible to succeed.

She became much nicer towards the end of the class (maybe because of course evaluations), but I found her to be very frustrating. She doesn't seem to care about her work, as literally everything is made by the book (lectures, homework, and exams) and you will have to teach yourself everything, but it isn't extremely difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Espinoza is great but it is a tough class. Her exams are challenging but she helps in any way she can. She dropped our lowest exam grade and offered extra credit. Homework is a large portion of the grade and if you get a 100 on it she is more willing to work with you at the end if you need a little boost.

Her class is difficult, but that's not her fault. She will do her best to help you succeed. She is generous with extra credit opportunities for the class. Do not give up if you do not do so great on an exam.
She grades with compassion and understanding. You need to study and learn the material but doable. Homework is worth a lot so just do it. There is no reason to not get a 100 on homework.
She dropped our lowest exam grade at the end. You should take her if you want to actually learn the material and succeed. Even if you perform poorly in one test, her extra credits are generous.

I loved her class! She gives plenty of extra credit to help those students who did not do as well. Please ignore the negative reviews; there are false. She will do her best to help you and she is accessible outside of class time. She met with my group for our project, and gave us insight on our project, so we can do our best for the presentation.
Class is a disaster, exams are hard professor doesn't teach or help with final exam.

She is one of the nicest professors ever. Lectures were very helpful for understanding the basics of finance. Exams are exactly from the homework, and homework are easy and you are given lots of time to do them. Attendace is not mandatory. Only downside is the group project at end of semester since it is very vague and tedious. Very chill class

You can learn everything yourself there is no reason to come to class; Exams were easy; homework was worth a lot but the final project was vague and the grading seemed ridiculous with little to no explanation. She is a sweet lady but for an 8am just not a professor I'd take again.

Lectures are not engaging and she doesn't work out the problems. Thus, you kinda have to teach yourself, but it isn't too hard using Pearson. The exams aren't worth a lot of the grade so if you mess up on one you're fine, would've done better if she taught tho. Wouldn't recommend for a higher-level class since she can't teach well.
Very cool teacher. Tests are open note online. Final Project is confusing but overall if you want an A take her
Good professor except for the final project. Very vague instructions and people did not do well but otherwise a good class and would recommend
She is really caring and sweet. An easy A if you learn her system. Group project is kinda vague which led to not meeting her expectations but other than that I really recommend her.

This lady has absolutely no clue how to teach. I didn't learn anything by attending her lectures, so I just stopped showing up to class after week three. Looked up everything online to learn it for the exams and homework. Super easy though, so still ended up with a good grade.

Whole class is taught by the book. Teacher is very generous and gives you unlimited attempts at homework and 2 attempts for the quiz. Everything, including exams, are open-book. However, the expectations for the final project are very vague and you end up getting a bad grade even though you did everything stated on the rubric.

Jenna is very sweet but you are expected to be in the glass studios for a 8 hours a week. There is a mandatory 3 hour time slot that you are required to be at and you will get in trouble for leaving early. She believes that her class is the most important and should be prioritized.

Jenna is a one of a kind teacher. She is super hilarious, open, and caring, but also amazing at what she does. You'll really be learning from an expert and it is a good experience even if you aren't into art. Definitely a time commitment outside of class, but you schedule in a two hour time slot/week at the beginning. Grading is equal to effort.
Glassblowing is really hard and physically taxing- be warned. But Jenna is really nice and easygoing. She's and experienced and talented glassblower and a great teacher for beginners.

I took 205 with Dr. Eve, which is the orgo 1 lab. A lot of reading and watching videos before lab (which is expected), the quizzes were difficult, and the final was as bad as you could imagine. Mentally prepare.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: CHM 110 is a very manageable course, especially with Professor Eve. He genuinely cares about his students and makes sure he is available outside of class to review any tough concepts. He also makes his exams very straightforward and gives credit for corrections.
CHM 110 - Absolutely great professor, makes lectures so funny and interesting. Class is actually so easy and his tests are exactly as he says.

I got A's on *everything*, failed the final and ended with a B in lab... the final is unnecessarily hard; I wouldn't even study for it. He's gonna come in at the end of the semester and cake you up and fill your head with AIR- he says that over half of the 206 students get an A+, LIE! He just says the same speech every single chemistry lab

I believe this a great professor. I think that he is very caring because he bothers making videos for the students to be familiar with the content of the lab. I believe that even though there is a lot of work, no one said it was going to be easy. He is very efficient and does not like to waste time and he goes the extra mile for his students.
Everything about this course is fine except for the final and the insurmountable amount of lab reports. That exam was impossible, but most people have to take this, so brace yourselves.

Tegan Eve barely shows up but still defines you by a scantron. I got 100s on all lab reports and a 94 quiz avg, but one final exam ruined it. He's arrogant, dismissive, offers no support, and acts like he runs the place. TAs do better. Terrible person, terrible professor. If I could give negative stars, I would. He doesn't deserve to be a professor
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: got 100 of all the reports, which take forever, and 100 on all the quizzes just to end with an A- because of the most diabolical final exam. He does not curve this final and the average is typically a 57. So disappointing you can put so much effort into the class just for the one final exam to bring your entire grade down. not understanding either!

Professor Eve has a lot of negative reviews for courses containing labs. This course does not have one and he prepared us very well for each exam. He also gave multiple assignments to bring our grade up including one that brought up our exam 2 score by 10% just from completion. If you go to class you should be fine.

The chemistry department at UM is a complete joke. There is no reason for students to be getting high A's on lab reports and doing solid on quizzes just to be screwed over by an impossible and hyper specific final. This class will harm your GPA, because the one person you see twice a semester decides to write the hardest questions possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: The final exam was not that bad. There's a lot of stuff you won't know but if you read the manual and have a general idea of what you're doing in lab, the final is doable. The assignments are tedious, but if you do them well the first time, you will do well on the final. Dr. Eve will try to scare you but if you put in some effort, you'll be fine.

WTF WAS THAT FINAL. Did fine in lab. My TA was a little strict with grading but that final would have david goggins screaming "they know me son." there is no need for that final to be that difficult and theres literally no way to prepare for it. On top of that Dr. Eve does even teach labs his TAs do, youll probably see him 2 times all semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I performed exceptionally on my lab quizzes and reports just to get a B+ because of the most heinous final I've ever taken, which is harder than the lecture final. Besides that, your grade depends on whether or not your TA is chill. How to fix this? Make him teach the gen chem, orgo 1, and orgo 2 LECTURES. Trash the puka T.eve you're not cool.
Eve is a great professor if you hate good professors. Makes the final impossible for a course that he makes his TA's teach.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The entire lab is taught by TA's until the final where Dr. Eve writes an impossible exam based on super specific stuff that he put in the lab manual that he wrote.

This man was rude especially to me when he had to work with my absences halfway through the semester as I had to leave school for 2 weeks for medical reasons. Anyways, the majority of your grade and experience in the course depends on what TA you get. The final is VERY hard; so specific. The only way to buffer this is by doing well on all reports.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Tegan Eve is by far the worst I have encountered in my life. He's extremely rude and the final at the end is nearly impossible to pass with. It's a one credit class which doesn't make sense as to why there is so much work for a lab. He should be fired from the University of Miami for torturing students and stressing them out like this.

Dr. Eve is someone you will see once or twice all semester. His TAs run the lab and each TA is different with their quizzes and grading guidelines so you either get really lucky or the complete opposite. No structure for how his TAs give equal and fair quizzes across different sections leaving each quiz tough. Time consuming for a 1 credit orgo lab

The actual lab isn't that bad, it's a lot of work but it's manageable and depends on your TA. The issue is the final exam, it is almost impossible. It's probably the toughest exam you'll ever take at UM and it's only for a 1 credit class! The only unbearably hard part of this class is the part Dr. Eve directly writes...

Eve doesn't teach any labs, they are taught by TAs. All that he does is make an impossible final exam worth 20% of your grade that everyone fails. The exam focuses on minor, random details from his 2 lab manuals making it virtually impossible to prepare for unless you've memorized both of his books. One of the worst professors at this school.

Labs are extremely time consuming and some end up being 15+ pages long. This is frustrating, considering it's only a 1 credit class. I spent 6+ hours a week working on these reports. The experiments are complex and difficult to understand, event after reading the lab manual. The final was ridiculous. Disappointment with the structure of this class.

Simply chaotic from start to finish. The experiments often do not match what the manual instructs, some reports come out to over 15 pages, and the final is 40 hyper-specific questions you will only know by reading the manual cover to cover ten times. If he didn't have a monopoly on the chem labs, I'd take anyone else. But, we have no choice. Sad.

The amount of work necessary for this 1 credit course is ridiculous. The final exam is near impossible to do well on because the questions are so hard for no reason and aren't covered by any course material.
Zero empathy for students, bad instructions

It's a 1 credit class. 1 CREDIT. Why oh why did we need a final for a 1 credit class??? Especially a final that's so difficult and references things even the actual chemistry course doesn't cover? Plus, the classes are super uneven across sections, some TAs are super chill while others are extremely difficult.

Labs took a ridiculous amount of time for a class that is only worth 1 credit. TAs grade everything and you can't choose the TA you get so you might get a tough grader. If you get a tough grader not all hope is lost though because the class gets curved. Final lab exams are HORRIBLE and everyone always fails. Don't know why they have them.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: I hope the school reevaluates this professor. Take this course with a grain of salt because it is set up to make you fail the final while having quizzes and pages of lab reports due every week. It should not be worth 1 credit, if anything, 3 minimum. Regardless he is the only one in charge of chem labs, unfortunately.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Did not see this professor until the final exam. His labs are very hard to understand, and many of them are not even correct in the manual. In utter disgust and disbelief of this man. Doesn't show his face for the ENTIRE semester, until the last week when he hits everyone with the most impossible final exam they may EVER TAKE. If you value your mental health don't take this lab

reviews.comment: The class is completely unrelated to what you learn in lecture and is much more difficult than the lecture itself. If I could skip this class I would...

reviews.comment: No lab organization, never interacts with students, extremely difficult final for no reason, and took up more of my time than chem lecture despite being only one credit.

reviews.comment: Worst professor at UM hands down. So much work for 2 credits out of class and 6 hrs a week in class. Now in CHM206 he gives quizzes before every lab that are very difficult.

reviews.comment: You don't see him. It depends on your TA, mine was great. Eve provides videos of the experiment, watch those!! He does a good job with that, but READ the manual, your final grade depends on it. If you study every detail of the techniques used, you'll end up with at least an A in the class because the final exam is mainly techniques and post-labs.

The final exam is EXTREMELY HARD. Did not talk to one person who felt confident about the final exam. Class ran entirely by the TA, never once met Dr. Eve. My TA, Gili, was AMAZING. BEST TA. Really made sure we understood the labs and did her best to prepare us for the monstrosity of a fin al exam we were given.

Terrible, terrible professor. Tegan Eve appeared only once during the semester during the final. The final itself is ridiculously difficult (average was around an F) and I memorized the entire lab manual to no avail. I do not understand the point of such a difficult final but focus on the quizzes and reports and you should be set for a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Watch the videos that Eve posts on blackboard because the manual does not go into detail about the procedures for the lab, if you don't you're going to go to lab extremely confused. The final is hard but doable just know ALL the math that was in the pre-labs and experiments. There's also weekly quizzes so study the manual really well.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: soooo many lab reports. honestly depends on your ta of how easily you will be graded. we had difficult quizzes every class. the exam was terrible and you cant even study for it on top of all your other exams. i did well on reports cause i had a good ta but the exam was awful
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Forces students to buy his books. The questions he assigns in his book as homework are vague and brain-degrading when doing it. Taking his one credit class, if you want to excel, you will spend around 1 hour for pre-lab reading, 1-2 hours for complementary video instructions, 2-3 hours for post-lab questions and lab reports per week. Not worth it.

TAs under Tegan teach chem labs, but chem labs have 0 interaction with him.  My TA spent class time with me and gave me my grade, fair and square. Tegan changed it afterward. I tried to get it changed back but he refused and was a complete dick about it. The grade had little impact on my life. But you should know that he is difficult.

Only taught by TA, don't rely on them. There's a video where he explains the experiment for that week and he does a good job. If you don't watch those, then your experience is going to be like the majority of the people who wrote negative reviews. For this lab, you can't depend on anyone but those videos and yourself. It's as simple as that.

I hate the class with a burning passion. I don't recommend this professor. Nothing really makes sense, the TAs grade rather harshly, and it's way too much work with short time limits. I'm always curious about what inspires chemistry professors to provide the most mind-numbing work imaginable with absurd expectations.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Eve's chemistry labs are some of the worst classes you can take at UM. In the lab, you'll have no idea what you're doing most of the time, and a 7-10 page lab report is due every week. All the TAs grade reports and worksheets insanely hard as well. After this, a lab final at the end of the class is given which is virtually impossible to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
1. honestly depends on who ur TA is 
2. not easy to reach 

unfortunately have to take as STEM major, but avoid at all costs

this lab is unfortunately unavoidable if ur a STEM major but it's still awful. you won't know what you're doing 80% of the time, the time to complete worksheets and labs is short and very precise. honestly depends on your TA but most of them are psycho and the final is based on everything you've ever done, so start memorizing the manual now.

This was the WORST class I have taken here. He doesn't do anything whether it be for his TA or students. Talks down to us and tries to act better than everyone without doing or helping in any way. This course makes you write a 5-7 pg paper every week which is so much work then depending on your TA you can have an easy or tough grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr Eve himself was very chill and nice (others say not so much) But the course was taught solely by TA's. Nothing was graded until the day of the final and my TA def threw in random grades. Final was awful, it was on all the labs. ZERO feedback ZERO help and ZERO grades back, at that point you couldn't ask what to correct or anything. I would avoid
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He acts like the lab is our only class. I worked my ass off for only 2 credits  Two reports due each week that are 8-15 pages. The final is atrocious. The questions about each lab are so specific and you have to know how to do all the calculations you learned. Almost everyone fails. He curved a letter grade though (i.e. B+ to A-).

This teacher never provides any useful information, he will give you inexplicable deductions from your assignments but does not write down the exact reasons. He will only write a few points, but when you correct these places, there will be new places where he deducts points, and you never know where your next assignment will be deducted.

Dr. Eve makes it very hard to get an A . This year 91 was an A so curve wasn't as large as most stem classes. Finals are notoriously hard and easy to fail (I heard scores from 20s- low 80s, and 1 A), but if you focus on the theory behind every experiment as you write your lab reports it you'll do well. Final is 20%, so aim for 100 on the other 80%.

The class isn't bad, just very writing heavy. However, this professor is absolutely horrible. Doesn't care in the slightest about his students and makes that abundantly clear. Extremely disrespectful and condescending, really acts like he's too good to be talking to you, even when emailing him about serious issues. Not sure how he's a professor.

I missed a lab once because I got into a car accident and when I went to tell him that he all in all said "tough" so I didn't get a makeup lab and got an F on the quiz, the homework, and the next days prelab so that was fun and good

The amount of time that is required for this one credit class is absurd, but the ABSOLUTE worst part is the final. Many people have no idea how to study for it. The final is also 25% of your grade, and it's known for dropping people's overall grades from an A to a C. Dr. Eve's grading criteria for this course needs to be revised.

I went to Dr. Eve to discuss what would be on the final and would recommend others to do this too. The final is almost completely composed of calculation questions from various experiments. absolutely the worst professor not only in the department nor the whole school but since the history of professors the enlightenment era. Writes the final, which asks random questions from the entire lab manual. I would these labs somewhere else if possible.

This only refers to Eve's final exam- which is disproportionately difficult for a 1-credit lab. With 10 experiments, the questions are all multiple choice  and roundabout asking "which of the following is false"- things you could only know by just memorizing procedure. Likely the most terrible experience you'll here. "Teaches" orgo lab as well.

CHM labs are NOT taught by Tegan Eve, but rather by TAs.  I've had good experiences with mine.  You don't see Tegan Eve often, but when you do, he is very unapproachable.  I've never had a good experience with him, and he can be unreasonably mean.  For lab: put in good effort on pre/post labs and reports.  Final is awful but you'll survive 3
This guy seems to thrive on our unhappiness. His finals always destroy people's grades in the end. He is very unfriendly and unapproachable.
The kind of worthless final that will destroy your GPA. This class almost killed my 4.0 for a 1 credit lab

Terrible. Oversees all the chemistry labs, but they themselves are taught by TAs. Writes the final which is extremely difficult and specific. Not friendly at all. Would avoid if possible. In all, way too much work for a one credit class.

The class itself was easy and really interesting, because my TA was a sweetheart; however when it came time for the final, I studied all night and still only managed a C. When I emailed the professor (Tegan) about it, telling him how hard I'd worked, he was condescending and very unhelpful. But unfortunately you need this class if you're premed.
Difficulty of class depends entirely on your TA. Final is way harder than a one credit class final should be, take it seriously.

Labs honestly depend on your TA. I got lucky and got a pretty decent TA whose quizzes actually weren't impossible. Try to get as high of a grade as you can in the class before you take the final, because the final is DEATH. Eve doesn't curve the final, but he does curve the class grades. I ended up with an 87 in the class but it curved to an A-.

I have never met someone so disrespectful and uncaring about his students. It seems to be a challenge for him to answer even the simplest questions respectfully. Emailed him asking to make up a lab, gave me 800 words of university policy and an ambiguous response, all while managing to be so condescending that I wanted to hit my head against a wall

Honestly chem lab isn't that bad but it can also depend on your TA. Do your experiments carefully and know what you are doing. For the final, you should know how to do all the math, the reactions in the experiments, and potential errors. Study your pre-labs, quizzes and lab reports and you're golden for the final. Got a 90 on it and 95 in the class

All of the labs are taught by TAs. I was fortunate and had a pretty chill chemistry lab TA. Just study the lab manual for the quizzes and put effort into your lab reports and you're fine. I didn't think the final was that bad, but it was definitely a challenge. However, this class is a lot of effort for only one credit :/
Needs to change the course curriculum to something more related to what is actually taught in the CHM 201 lecture.

Dr. Eve is very caring about his students. The reason he is so harsh with grading and very hard (especially the final) is because he wants you to do well. People may say what they will but I STILL remember my labs from CHM 113 an CHM 114 because of him! Great help on the MCAT if you ask me!
Chem Lab is hard! It is taught by TA's and the final seems impossible. I got a C on the final, but I still got an A in the course because I tried very hard on the lab reports!
TERRIBLE. thats all.

Labs are taught by TAs. The final is hard !I read my manual 3 times and got a B+. The test is very tricky. You have to know EVERYTHING. Make sure you have a strong GPA throughout the semester, I ended up with an A in the class because of it. so don't slack off. But it is not impossible to get an A, just very difficult!

By far the worse professor at UM. I have never encountered a person that wants students to do so badly. Avoid him if you can, but if you have chem labs its pretty much impossible. His lab finals are impossible, and sadly he knows it.

Only meet with Dr Eve once and he seamed like a good professor. Class was taught by the TA. Main problem was that the CHM 151 class was not at the same pase as the labs so it made class a little difficult.

Chemistry labs are BAD. Eve and MOST of the TA's are the reason it is so bad. The labs arent usually that difficult to do, but the TA's take so many points off if it isnt written perfectly. And the final is so damn impossible because you need to memorize everything from the manual and the retarded "making the connections" book.(For only 1 credit to

Eve is an arrogant, rude, proud (you know what) he really shouldn't be teaching at UM. Seriously, take someone who'll respect you and teach you well. You can't ask him nothing!! he acts like he's doing you this great favoor.
Ridiculously hard for one credit. Have a high grade going into the final because most students grades go down after it.
I thought that Chem lab wasn't that bad. You need to study really hard for the final. However, it's college, isn't it? If you know everything back and forth you'll do fine. I got an A- in chem lab.
Not the TA, so thank god, because my TA was awesome. His final is freaking impossible. Try and get a different lab person.

He is not the lab teacher, but the person who writes the final for all chemistry labs which are very hard. You basically need to memorize everything...yeah everything. You need to know all procedures and results like the back of your hand. Just a heads up because there is no way to avoid it if you are going to take a chemistry lab.

Ok the ratings i just placed are for EVE, he is rude, doesnt help, and he has 1 mission in life, to hate kids and be a prick to them. however, i do have to say his TA's are amazing i had Chensung Wang and he was the best TA ive ever had, now your work during the year is graded by the TA, the Final Exam made by eve is hard and questions are retarded

first off...whoever put the chili pepper is an idiot cuz he's not hot. secondly, he can be a very rude and judgemental person, and sometimes really nice and helpful. the final is haaaard and almost impossible to pass.

He is SO SO SO RUDE! Think TWICE before even asking him a question. He will NOT hesitate to yell at you, ridicule you or embarrass you in front of others. Has NO sympathy
very rude, not helpful, tas unfair
Dr. Eve is one of my favorite professors ever. He is very helpful and fair. He is interested in his student's success and he has a great butt. ;) CLD
Not helpful!

Not a bad guy. He does coordinate the chemistry labs very well. His exams are on the tough side, but are do-able. Organic Labs are alot of work. However from what I hear other universities have it much worse than we do, so I am not complaining that much.
arrogant and loves the gators
This teacher is exceptional at creating an environment that feels supportive while also offering constructive feedback to improve your writing skills!

Do not recommend this course. For an elective, it was way too stressful and too serious. I definitely wish I took a different arts & humanities cognate. At the end of the semester, I found myself doing more work for this class than my other courses. Save yourself the hassle.

I loved her a lot, and she is an amazing teacher. She pushes you to improve and wants you to do well. reviews.comment: Don't take her she is terrible.

She's a difficult grader, but I strongly prefer that in a creative writing professor. She challenges you to write your best and not turn in half-done or mediocre stories. Gives great, extensive feedback and is an approachable, friendly lady. Would recommend to any student willing to put in the work to become a better writer.

She does have a patronizing air about her that is off-putting, and the workload is EXTREMELY intense. However, you will definitely learn a lot about writing and yourself as well. If I could go back, though, I'd take another professor.

If you want you college life to be loaded with work this is the way to go! The amount of work you are given for this level is ridiculous even if you are taking 15 credits like normal students. This sounds like an everyday rant but I have warned you never take this professor.

Like everyone else has said, she plays favorites and is extremely patronizing. She constantly insults you (not constructively criticizes, but insults you) and will smile while doing so-- think Prof Umbridge! Her comments are generally useless & too sparse/late to help. She is a nice person and cares a lot about her out of class programs she works with.  But that's just it.  She doesn't give you comments on your writing until there are only four weeks left in the semester and then expects you to brilliantly revise your work from super low and demoralizing shadow grades.  Not much room allowed for creativity either
Great course! Really improves your writing, BUT DO NOT MAKE HER YOUR THESIS ADVISER! She can turn from being the coolest professor ever to sabotaging you. Also a bit disorganized.

Sweet lady who wants everyone to succeed. I took her for business comm, which was a small class where pretty much everyone did well. shes a Frost professor so there is a lot of music references

I love Professor Alonso! She is so amazing and truly cares about her students. She is also very understanding and willing to help. Such a plus that she is also an advisor because she can answer any advising questions which is so helpful. SO hilarious and makes class SO engaging. Amazing professor, took for COS333 not COS 211

Professor Alonso is one of the best teachers I've taken at UM. She makes the class interesting, and she's hilarious. She provides great feedback on everything. I usually dread classes where the teacher just speaks, but I look forward to coming to this class every time.
BEST. LOVE HER. TAKE HER. There are about five speeches, but they are all easy to get done. She gives good feedback and it is a very interactive class.

Professor Alonso is amazing. Class consists of 3-4 speeches. She doesn't grade harshly at all, should be an easy A. She encourages creativity and gives great feedback on every speech. This class is so much fun, would definitely recommend taking public speaking with Professor Alonso.

Awesome teacher! Loved the class. Do not take public speaking with anyone!

Her tests were extremely difficult. She provided study guides for exams and allowed a cheat sheet. However, even with that and lots of studying, tests were nearly impossible. Do not recommend this class if needed for major. She took attendance randomly.

I am in this class right now and my problem with her is that on the tests, she gives study guides that supposedly have everything thats supposed to be covered and then deviates from that and adds random things that weren't supposed to be on there. Nice person but isn't very organized or clear.

reviews.comment: PSY 312 - She grades things quickly, but her exams are confusing because nothing is truly set or concrete. She explains things she herself, admittedly, doesn't understand, and often gets things wrong. Also, not flexible with attendance.

Professor Hurtado is a really sweet professor. Her classes are largely lecture based and can be a little boring but if you attend the lectures you should be fine. for her 200 level classes you get a page of notes and she offers a final cumulative exam to replace a test grade. the test are easy.

My second class with Dr. Hurtado (PSY 210), and cannot recommend her enough!! Classes are lectures but always interesting with lots of videos. This semester she has made attendance (takes at random 5-8 times a semester) part of your final grade instead of extra credit. Double sided cheat sheet for every exam, 3 exams + final is optional

If you hate really long multiple choice quizzes don't take her. I personally could not get above a B+ even though I studied very hard. Very lecture based and then study the power points for the exams. That's basically where your final grade comes from.
Final is optional and online and will replace your worst exam grade. Need to say any more? She's a G.
Her lectures were very interesting and easy to understand. Her class overall was pretty easy and she seems like a very caring person.

Super sweet, gives extra credit for attendance and has other extra credit. Cheat sheet for the exams as well as a study guide. Just pay attention and do the study guide and you should do really well in this class.

Incredibly knowledgeable and passionate professor. The course is all lectures, but they're interesting and she makes them fun/engaging a lot of the time. There was extra credit and the final was optional to replace a lower test score. I will totally take her classes again in the future

Super great professor i loved her. Attendance was given as extra credit and there were a few other small extra credit things too. She allows one sheet (front and back) of notes either handwritten or typed for each exam and the final was optional. The exams are 100% more the lecture than the book, the homework doesnt help much but her slides do.

Great professor. Easy class, super nice professor. Just pay attention every once in a while and you'll be fine. For tests, you're allowed to have a cheat sheet front and back unlike other psych professors.
very sweet. attendence every few weeks. class was super easy. can bring a cheat sheet to exams. lots of textbook, but you dont really have to read, just answer questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: she is literally my favorite professor. SO sweet and caring. gives cheat sheet for all 3 exams and optional final to replace lowest exam grade. tests are easy if you listen to lectures. genuinely cares so much about her students and is very accessible! 100% take her

everyone says this abt alot of profs but she's genuinely one of the best profs at UM. take her. you get a cheat sheet for exams and the lecture's are very entertaining. this class was rlly fun and i learned a lot

Social psych super cool topic. Attendance taken on random days but i believe it was sometimes extra credit or something? Large class, but she'd answer questions pretty honestly/thoroughly and be available after class. On time, prepared, and organized/knowledgeable about her topic. HW and exams all online MCQ asynchronous.

Professor Hurtado's lectures are super interesting and you learn a lot. Her tests cover a lot of material but it's open notes. You definitely should still study though. The final is optional and replaces your lowest test grade if you take it or won't count if you didn't do good on it. I'd for sure recommend her and this class.

Prof. Hurtado has great lectures and is very engaging. I feel like psych/sociology lectures can get boring and teachers just read off of slides, but she always incorporates videos, examples and tries to prove things by getting you to interact and be thoughtful. Four exams, with an optional final for extra credit. Great course and a great professor.

Super kind and thoughtful person. Amazing teacher and speaker. Love her lectures because the material is super interesting IMO. Allows cheat sheets in every exam. Homework and quizzes are online so it's not work overload. 10/10 recommend

She allows a page (front and back) with anything we want to use during exams. The tests are based on the lectures and slides, not the textbook. There are online assignments and quizzes with them due weekly, but they don't take long to do. If you go to class you will get an A. I highly recommend her!

Prof Hurtado is a great professor, but she does make you read the textbook + do McGraw Hill which takes a lot of time, especially since barely any of the textbook content is featured on the tests. The study guides are helpful but sometimes she doesn't give enough information about certain topics. Do the hw and go to class and you'll be fine.

She is such a nice teacher and you can tell she loves what she does. Her class is not too overwhelming and she covers interesting topics, she actually made me want to learn about psych. Easy at home quizzes, open notes tests, easy homework assignments due every other week. Take her !

3 big exams, really hard. A lot of solving super heavy materials and lectures. Homework every week, exams get harder and harder. Moved through material kind of fast and without solving step by step exercises in class which is confusing.

Easiest A+ ever. Weekly homework assignments and 3 major exams. The exams are all online, open note, and there is an optional final you can take which drops your lowest exam score. 

DEF choose Dr. Hurtado over any other PSY110 teacher.
Amazing! Attendance is not mandatory, and all the tests are online. She is also so nice. I highly recommend taking a class with her because it's an easy A+.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: PSY 110 was a very general but interesting course. Hurtado's lectures are really interesting but you don't need to go to class to do well on the exams. She gives one homework assignment a week and 3 tests a semester. This class is very manageable and I think she teaches really well.
The GOAT. Interesting and fun lectures, online open-note tests, 30 minutes hw per week, optional final. Very passionate about psychology and wants you to succeed. Take Dr. Hurtado for PSY110.

Professor Hurtado is the best. She explains things in a way that makes them very interesting, and is always up for deeper discussion into topics. She moves swiftly, but in a way that makes it easier to pay attention. The tests are challenging, but they are open note. The class itself has a lot of cool topics, and its been my favorite class at UM.

Definitely recommend Dr. Hurtado. Her lectures were easy to understand and she made them very interesting, so getting bored is not an issue. She gives extra credit and the HW is not hard. She gives study guides for all exams so you know what exactly is on each exam, and she lets you use notes. Very nice professor who genuinely cares for students.

Her lectures can be a bit slow sometimes, but if you pay attention, you will do well. She's sweet. Her exams are based on her lectures and power points. She will randomly take attendance, but it counts as extra credit. Homework is due every Sunday at midnight but can be finished in less than thirty minutes. You can find most of it online.
Hurtado is the psych department goat I can't lie.
Absolute beauty. Attendance isn't mandatory, just gotta do online homework every Sunday and tests are open note, nice woman.

She's like my second mom, i swear. She is the sweetest lady and cares about her students. Her lectures are very interesting, and she's super enthusiastic about psychology. I highly recommend her if you want an easy A in her class. She has an optional final! There are 3 exams, and if you decide to take the final, she will drop your lowest grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Hurtado is a great professor--she gives a practice exam for every exam in her class with the exact types of questions you will expect on the actual exam--this makes it very easy to pass her exams. At times, she may confuse herself during lectures with what she is talking about, but other than that she is very clear about what she is teaching.

Hurtado is such a good psych professor! She only takes attendance randomly and once in a while but classes are so interesting that you want to show up every time. She teaches in a way where the info really sticks but even if it doesn't, you're allowed to use your notes for the exams! Totally values comprehension over memorization. Loved this class!
The mother I never had
This professor is a great mother
She went through the course material really fast during lectures and pretty much just read off of the slides. The tests are online.

Class was lecture-based, with weekly online assignments + opps for xtra credit, & in person or online (lockdown browser) open-note tests. Go to class & take good notes and you will get a good grade. Lectures can be boring, but she is always willing to help. She gives study guides, if you fill them out with notes in prep for test, you will do well.
Hurtado is great! Her lectures are easy to process and closely related to material students are graded on. I would recommend taking 210 without a shadow of a doubt.

For a statistics class, I feel that she did not explain the material in a comprehensive way. She talks very fast and leaves little room to process. However, grading is not bad and tests are straightforward. She gives extra credit that can be applied to tests. It's hard to learn from her in class, I had to learn most material outside of class.
Does give a lot of homework and changed syllabus grading policy 3 times but tests have no camera and are very similar to the lectures. Pay attention to the videos in class and her lectures

She is awesome for visual and audio learners. She paints a picture for each subject she teaches. The only down fall is that she gives a lot of questions for exams and gives little time. You get a full cheat sheet back and forth for every exam. There are 3 exams and 1 optional exam to drop the lowest grade. Homework due every Sunday.
Dr. Hurtado is a great professor! Loved her lectures because she is super concise and to the point about the slideshow topics. Also super kind and helpful outside of class!

he's awsome. i hate math, like a lot of people have said, but he's made it truly enjoyable and my improvement is amazing. highly recommended!

Great teacher and overall nice guy. Tests are almost exactly like the review sheets and everything is presented in a way students can understand. He really wants you to do well and is pretty flexible when it comes to test dates. I highly recommend him!
The best! If you're not great at math and need a good teacher who actually cares about his students take Francois! He is the best teacher. He's really helpful and wants everyone to do well.

Overall, just a great guy. One of those professors who is really interested in his students' grades. He does everything he can to help you understand the material. He's funny, adorable, and has an all around great personality. Best Professor at UM!
I attend FIU and I come to U.M. to ask him all of my doubts in Math.  He is the best professor. He really wants his students to learn. He is awesome.

Absolutely the best. Extra credit off the wazoo for him being late, making a mistake, or just because. Don't let that or his accent fool you though, he makes sure everyone understands the material and will take the time to slow down for any questions. Extremely high recommendation

Doesn't try to stimulate interest, but explains concepts extremely well. Wants his students to all get A's, although tests and grades are all fair. Plenty of extra credit opportunities. The first math class in which I've done well, ever. He tells bad jokes too...this is my favorite class this semester.

Professor Francois is an excellent teacher. He is always willing to help if you are not understanding all the material. He is patient and really wants his students to do well. Take any of his classes if you need special help in math.
He made me love maths again!!!!! tienbe raid prof!!

An overall nice guy. Is very understanding and wants his students to do well. Tries to tell jokes, but usually fails. Gives extra credit on tests when he makes an error. Which he often does. Girls if you cry, you'll probably get an A.

he's such a good teacher!!!  he's really smart, and very nice.  he cares about all his students, and makes sure every single person in the class understands the topics.  he's also very funny, and tells a lot of jokes.

Professor, Francois is an excellent teacher.  He tries his best to make sure that his students understanding the materials. He nice, fair, and always willing to help.  He's great! watch for his jokes. He is also a former UM student...

Easy material that is 10x more complicated by her for no reason. Cares way too much about attendance but shows up late and unprepared every. single. class. Likes to pick on students and constantly has a passive aggressive attitude. Only take if you must, you will end with an A but at what cost.

Her lectures are not very organized, and she struggles to maintain a clear lecture. If you participate, show up to class, and put in the effort to build a relationship with her, you will be fine. Do the assignments and care about the work you do. Her class structure needs improvement, but it's not hard to succeed in her class IF you try.
DO NOT TAKE SAVE YOURSELF

I would take her if you have to, but if you don't, I wouldn't recommend it. She's really disorganized with grading and due dates, and she can come across as kind of passive-aggressive during lectures. She also isn't very flexible if you get sick, and her assignment instructions can be pretty confusing.

She is super funny because of how she acts lol. The class is not hard at all so I didn't really take it seriously with her. There is a group project semester long but it is easy. The tests are really easy to study for and get good grades on. Attendance not taken unless she says be in class that day. Overall easy to take and she is chill.

The sweetest prof ever! Care about her students so much and makes time to ensure everyone understands. All test were online, 2 oral exams. Very manageable and easy to pass. Take this class! U wont regret it
Super nice, if assignments are late, she will still, take them
Take her! It's a lot of work, however, that's just a foreign language class thing. She doesn't grade harshly either. Be prepared to write though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Honestly, she made this class so much harder than it needed to be, I never thought this would be my hardest class but it is. The workload is crazy, many exams including oral ones, so many quizzes as well. I don't get why attendance is so strict especially when you have personal matters or you are sick, I don't find her understanding at all.

ITA 102*** As someone who knows only English, this class was terrible for me. Most of the students in my class spoke another language and she definitely catered to them. She assumed we all understood the grammar and "taught" at a rapid pace. When someone in my class had a question, she told her they couldn't ask it unless it was in Italian.

She is the best. Very considerate over your situation and truly wants to see everyone do good in the class. Material is tougher than earlier Spanish classes but if you study and ask questions you will get it.  Would take her again in a heart beat.

Professor Korban is a solid teacher. While there is a lot of homework, it's assigned by the department and is given to all sections. While this class is a lot of work, none of it is very difficult, it's just busy work. Attendance is also mandatory. If you want to improve your Spanish, take Korban. If you want an easy A, probably not the best choice
Professor Korban is really one of the best. She is so kind and understanding no matter the situation. Would def take her again.

Profesora Fuentes Korban is such a kind and amazing Spanish professor. She takes attendance every class and you must participate during class. A lot of Cengage homework but if you do them you'll be prepared for the class, tests and compositions (short writings). She grades assignments fairly and ensures you learn Spanish. Would definitely recommend

Great professor. She is very sweet, very understanding, and passionate about teaching. She assigns a lot of work, but as long as you try your best and participate a lot you will be fine. Although the workload is quite heavy, she is a great teacher, very engaging, and will help you get a good grade. Overall a great professor and sweet person.
Very kind professor, just complete the work she assigns and pay attention/participate in class and you will do fine
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved this class. It was challenging, but everything we learned was meaningful. She makes the class environment engaging and welcoming, despite being mostly online during covid. She gives great feedback and is very supportive.

Dra. Fuentes Korban is incredible! She gives feedback on every single assignment and really wants to help you learn more than anything. Class structure is three short books plus a test and essay, and then a final essay.

Dr. Fuentes Korban is an AMAZING woman and professor. Extremely knowledgable and helpful, but expect a lot of material/assignments and to be held to a high standard on them. That's exactly what you need for learning a language, but you need to be determined to put work in, and she's there to help anytime you need it.

This prof is not good. She does not teach material in class and expects you to know everything on the exam meanwhile she does not go over it. Here exams are long and the only reason why I will have an A is because I knew Italian before going in to the class! Don't take her unless you actually know what your doing in italian.
The best teacher and most kind guy you'll ever meet. Take him
I never missed a lecture and still didn't know what was going on. TAs were generally unhelpful too.
He is so old and doesn't speak good English.  Nicest man ever, but you will learn nothing. Hard to study for tests because you don't know what you are learning.

3 exams, one dropped. First was very tough; class got a 23-pt curve and I still got a C. Remaining exams were open-note, final was open-note and group, so very easy. All MC, but only ~ 17 questions, so one mistake hurts. Some questions are oddly worded. Be strategic with studying/notes. Won't learn much micro, but not too hard to finish with an A.

Didn't learn a single thing all year.Tests make up of 4 MC, 20 question exams (one gets dropped). The third exam is open note, and final is an optional group exam. I first decided to take him because my friends told me his exams were take home - but he changed his rules. He clutched on the final and told the class all the answers!!

Okay here's the most honest review w no exaggeration because some people got mixed grades. 4 exams are your whole grade, 1 is dropped. 2 of the exams (last exam and final) are open note or group. No homework. Don't have to go to class. Cons? You will bomb every exam. You can't avoid it, trust that at least 2 of them get curved. You can get an A

Extremely all over the place. Beyond grateful (to my TA's) that I got an A. He is extremely reachable via text if you have any questions. All in all, very lost class and I'm not sure if I would take it again.
Take if you want an easy A, not if you want to learn about Microeconomics. You won't learn. Ever.

His tests are quite difficult and draw heavily from assigned readings and lecture material. The course is more challenging than I expected, compared to what I had heard previously. He is a nice person, but his teaching style may not work well for everyone.

YOURE SO COOKED!! Basically went into this class with an idea that he will be easy. He completely changed how he teaches. We have 3 major tests with an optional final. 2 of the exams were open note but the notes DID NOT HELP AT ALL. He tests on things that he doesn't speak about at all. My GPA is now cooked because of this class.
drops lowest exam grade. grade is based off of three exams and the final. tests are no longer online or take home theyre in person and open note. curves really good don't recommend.

People were saying that his class is a free A but it's not a case anymore. There are 3 test and an optional final exam. His exams are straight up impossible and even though he made 2 of them opened book it did not help at all. Questions on his exams have nothing to do with what he teaches. He is a really nice guy but a bad professor.
He is getting older and his teaching has declined. Very nice dude but you really learn nothing in his class.

will you learn a single thing? no. will you get an A? yes. hugo, my goat, has an incredibly thick accent paired with a very quiet hard-to-hear voice. he will not teach you. the first exam was near impossible even with a curve, but the rest of the exams were either collaborative or take home, and you can drop your lowest score. do w that what u will

Overall, Hugo is a good guy. He has a very strong accent that takes some time to get used to, but he drops a lot of questions on exams and curves heavily. By the end of the semester, our tests were take home and open note, and the final was optional. His lectures are a little all over the place, but if you go to class and participate, youll be fine
Really nice guy. Didn't learn that much - a little disappointing. Think he gave everyone As.

You won't learn, but its the easiest A you'll ever get. He's an older, Latino man, so his accent is a bit tough to get used to. Only graded on the 3 exams and the final is optional. First test was difficult, but got a huge curved. The next one was take home, and the last he literally just gave us the answers to. He's a really nice guy.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hugo is actually the nicest guy ever but not a great teacher. You will end with an A but probably will think you're going to fail after the first exam but he'll add a huge curve. It's all online or group quizzes and you never have to go to class. You won't learn anything but easy A.

Flesh-eating amoeba enter my brain every time this guy speaks. I'm wondering how he got this job big time!!!!!!!! So rude even though his class is easy, he made my life hell. Class average on the first exam was genuinely a 40%. Would rather be a citizen of Hiroshima in 1945 than take this class again.

Overall, his macro class wasn't great. He was extremely confusing and could rarely remember what he had already taught us. The content wasn't that hard, but the exam questions were poorly worded and difficult. Some exams were short, others were very long. Take notes in class and try to pay attention; if you can make him like you, it should help.
He's super kind, but very lecture heavy, you won't understand the tests but I promise it'll be okay. There are only 3 major tests

Professor Hugo is very kind. His class begins difficult but if you stick through it's not difficult at all. I would take him if you're looking for an easy class. Sitting through lectures can be boring but overall worth it.

DO NOT take prof hugo for any class. its true he's a great guy but at the end of the day, you need a teacher. this guy does not teach only mumbles through his lectures and you will not understand a word. our last exam was about articles about israeli politics, which had ABSOLUTELY NOTHING to do with microeconomics. DID NOT LEARN A SINGLE THING.

Im in his Macro and his Micro vs Macro classes were very different, Recently he switched to in class test for only Macro. You cant even hear this guy or understand him. He has no office hours and is so hard to reach. if you want to learn and get a good grade dont take him.

Hugo is a great guy but you will not learn a thing in his class, every exam you pray he curves. Try and get on his good side and you should be fine. Exams are very hard so prepare or pray he makes it a take home.

Hugo is a wholesome old man, but not really a very good teacher. Thankfully I took AP micro in high school, so I know the topic. But if you don't have previous experience, you won't learn much. The whole grade is composed of 4 exams including the final, and he will drop the lowest grade. Idk my grade yet, but I have a A+ so far.
Nice guy, confusing exams and likes to trick you. He's very nice and knows alot about Economics, but it's hard to learn much in this class. Even the smartest kids complain on exams.
Best teacher. Grade is based on 3 test and a final. tests are so one of them was take home. Best teacher!

Exams are no longer open book so beware. He's very sassy and snaps back at students for asking questions because he's horrible at explaining the material. I took AP Micro in high school but didn't take the exam and I'm confused about what hes saying, I can't imagine what it's like for the kids who didn't take it. I DO NOT RECCOMEND.
No structure, poor at explaining. Nice guy but Hugo needs to realize this puts a lot of stress on students.

Hugo is a nice dude, horrible terrible professor. His lectures have no structure, he literally canceled class one day and said learn the material and we'll review next class. 
Entire class is 3 tests, and even if you have all the notes (i printed every article and slideshow) you still will struggle on them. pick someone else if u really wanna learn

Professor Faria is a kind person but his class has no structure. No review days, or schedule for the tests. He canceled several classes, and his way of teaching is messy. Your final grade is based on 3 exams with very few questions. They are not online anymore, but they are open book, which doesn't help much though. I wouldn't take him again :(

reviews.comment: Such a sweet old man but absolutely clueless. He never comes with a plan for class and always forgets everything. Class average for tests was failing but he put big curves. No matter how many notes you bring the tests are still over nothing in the slides or documents. He's nice but if you could take someone else do it
Very kind Professor. Just like a father. Didn't learn much from his class. If you want free grade just take him. No work. Open book exams. Very easy.
There is completely no structure to this class. I am so lost and I go to every class. Tests are impossible to study for even with open notes. Nice teacher but can't teach.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: It's hard to understand him, and his way of teaching is a bit messy. He is a kind guy if you get to meet him tho.

Hugo has a very unique teaching style that takes a while to get used to but is very fun once you're with it. The class grade is entirely the 3 tests. The final test is optional, it is used to replace a previous test grade if you are not happy with it. He offers some extra credit. Sit in the front (no microphone) and take notes, you will do well.

Professor Faria is definitely nice and knowledgeable but doesn't get his point across very well. Sometimes it's just hard to understand him. He also brings up politics very often and our third exam was basically a political science exam. Additionally the exams aren't take home anymore and the questions aren't the best.
Hugo is a great professor, super thoughtful. Class isn't too bad.

Hugo is a god. He has the power to destroy you but shows mercy. He made this semester super tough, but in the end he saved us and everyone got 100 on the final. He's a great guy and I heard that he's even easier for micro.
HES THE BEST!!!! He is so sweet and caring. He wants everyone to do well and will always help you.
clueless

sweetest guy. attendance isn't mandatory, graded by only 3 take-home 25 multiple-choice tests. don't even have to pick up your test yourself, your friends can pick it up and drop it off for you. he gives extra credit and engages with people who go to class. take him he's the sweetest.

Hugo is a very funny professor! He is nice to students and loves when they participate. Participation will boost your grade in his class. The tests are not too difficult. There is a textbook for the class, but you can understand the material without using it. He also posts his lecture PowerPoints on his class page. He's quick with grading, too!

The lectures are boring, but attendance is not mandatory. Your grade is based on 3 take-home exams that are really easy, and you are not required to take the final. Hugo's a nice guy and accessible outside of class, but he inserts a lot of his opinions into lectures and goes on tangents. Overall, the class is boring but easy. Take it for an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very easygoing class. Hugo knows people don't take his class seriously but he doesn't care. No one goes to class, theres 3 take home exams. do NOT chegg them, those answers are all wrong. just spend the 1-2 hours looking thru his notes and you'll find almost every answer. Easy A, but no one takes the class seriously.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Hugo is a great professor who really wants his students to do well. The whole class is graded on 3 take home tests and the final is optional and only has to be taken if you want to replace one of your prior test grades. Attendance isn't mandatory. Hugo is a very nice and good professor who makes his class easy and simple.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Hugos class was the easiest class I think I have ever taken! Very funny guy that engages with the class during his lectures. The only grades are 3 open note exams that you have a week to complete and can work with other classmates on, plus he doesn't require a final exam. Very laid back and offers to bump grades if you participate enough in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He doesn't like to be called professor, he likes to be called Hugo. His lectures are rather disorganized, but he is accessible by text. He only gives 3 tests, which are tricky but doable. Very funny & likes talking about politics. Recommended for easy A.

Hugo is the GOAT. Class is never mandatory, you're graded on three exams that you get a week to finish, if you take all three exams and do well on them you don't have to take the final. You cannot fail his class the lowest grade he'll give you is a C.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hugo Faria is by far the most compassionate and caring professor. Sit in the front to ensure you can hear him and pay attention. Frequently makes funny jokes and admires those who participate. He is always available via text and appreciates those who do text him. Attendance isn't mandatory, but I have never missed because of how much I love him.

I took Hugo because I had heard good things. Do not take this professor. The take home exams are incredibly hard and somewhat arbitrary. The questions are on material that was never covered. Before this class I had a 3.9 gpa (one A-). There is no reason for me, a straight A student, to have gotten a B- in an intro level class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Unless you talk 15 to 20 times every SINGLE class you are not going to get an A. I do not recommend this class for people who do not like talking out loud in front of a class or participating in general.

Don't take this class if you want to learn. Attendance is not mandatory and lectures are very long, slow and boring. He is a nice, older guy. Three exams make up your entire grade for the semester (no final). Exams are take home and MC, but hard and answers are debatable.

Professor Faria is a nice guy, but the class is graded by 3 exams that consist of 20 vague questions since he lets you take the test home. Online resources will not help you and in-class lectures are incredibly boring. Take a different professor if you want to do well and learn anything at all.

So the tests are worth a lot and do not relate to slides or anything else really. They are take home but very debatable and on stuff you would go over on random days. No one comes to class. Very very boring lectures. If you go and ask a few questions you will get a boost. Super nice guy tho and he will help you if you need it.

Professor Faria is the most boring and monotone professor I have had a UM. Every time I went to this class I dreaded it because his accent is so thick I could barely understand him and thus the whole hour and 20 minutes of the class felt like I am watching grass grow.

Very nice guy but exams are not based on what he goes over in class, so it is very difficult to prepare, and a high probability you can get a bad grade even if you know the material. Very nice but got a poor grade despite preparing well and studying. Would not recommend

This was ECO 379- a very easy class. All you need to do is participate. However this class was a right wing echo-chamber with zero room to actually participate if you have any dissenting opinion. He made some very outrageous political claims and was extremely biased

reviews.comment: Man's class is super long and sometimes hard to get through but you will get an A. Take this class to boost your GPA

Professor Faria grades by three exams. Doesn't make you take a final, and he's a really nice guy. I would say that his way of teaching is kind of confusing, but its manageable if you pay attention and take notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: 10/10 my favorite professor at the U. Will take him for any class he teaches. Cares about students and genuinely wants them to learn.

I have never heard of a professor who was as loved by students as Hugo is. Every time I mention him to somebody they always have good things to say about him or his class. The class itself is fairly easy and if I had even put in the slightest bit more effort I couldve ended up with an A+. He is funny and always answers questions if you have any.

3.9??? WHAT? This guy deserves a freaking 10 out of 5. Easiest class ever. Take him if you want to get an easy A. I strongly recommend him, besides his easy class he is really accesible outside class, hes SO caring and make everyone laugh!! Has a strong accent but not hard to follow. TAKE HIM!!

Hugo is simply a king. He is very understanding and really tries to help out his students. Available pretty much all the time for office hours (whenever you call or text him). Very fair in grading. His class was hard, but very interesting. You kind of have to pay attention all the time but because of his hilarious personality, it is easy
Very nice and friendly guy. Hes pretty hard to understand and his lectures are very boring. His tests are also stupidly hard but theyre usually take-home.
Take his class. He wants you to learn and wont kill you on the tests. If you show up and care youre all set.

As simple as this, the only review you need to read (unless he changes it all up next semester bc there were cheating scandals and a snitch in my class) IF YOU WANT AN EASY A THEN TAKE THIS CLASS BUT IF YOU ACTUALLY WANT TO LEARN THEN TAKE A DIFF TEACHER.
Easy A class and he is really nice too

Easiest teacher at UM and its not even close. There's 3 tests for the whole year and you have a week to complete them. Classes are very boring and he's horrible at explaining things, but the only grades are the exams which are ridiculously easy. If you actually want to learn anything, I don't suggest Hugo. If you want an easy A, definitely.
Professor Faria is awesome!! Only put a little effort and get great score.
The course is based off of 3 tests all worth 33% of your grade. Attending the lectures help with tests so try not to skip but attendance is not mandatory.
Hugo is the best! Really cares about his students and is a great teacher. 3 tests make up the grade.

Faria is great! He will try to learn everyone's name, and if you sit in the front and participate he will be more lenient w you. He curves like 20% and he made 2/4 tests optional, including the final! I highly recommend recording his lectures because that's where he gets his test questions. Don't buy the books either it all comes from his lectures
He is funny and will try to learn everyone names. Also my man dropped 2 out of 4 tests for me and I didnt go to class. You also learn even though it is easy.

He is a really good professor. He cares about his students. You don't have to go to class since grades are based on the exams which are multiple-choice, 4 exams and he will only count the 2 highest grades. However, if you don't go to class you won't understand. He is always willing to help and explain things over and over again

Dr. Faria is a teacher you cannot miss class for. If you go to class and pay attention in class you will most likely do well. He is an extremely fair grader and cares more about you learning the concepts than the grade it's self.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Faria is the best economics professor! I wish I could take him for more sections. Go to class and pay attention to his lectures and you will pass with an easy A. He is understanding and gives extra credit. AMAZINGG PROFESSOR

Hugo is a great professor, this was my second semester taking his class and I don't regret it one bit. Attendance is optional but it's best if you go, he does his best to make sure everyone is successful in the class but of course you have to put in effort yourself. Final was a take-home quiz and optional for those with a 70 average or higher.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: he is very nice and caring and curves all of the tests, attendance isn't mandatory but it is important to show up because his tests are lecture heavy also he is funny and fun to listen to. he cares a lot about his students and if he notices you coming to class and not skipping a lot he will write down your name and raise your grade up a notch
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great teacher, give a lot of extra credit quizzes and is a really great person. Accent wasn't really a problem to deal with. Grade is based on 5 tests, all 20 question multiple choice - even the final exam. Study a lot for these tests and you will literally have to do nothing else. Tests are based on stuff he says in class. Test can he hardish tho

Lectures are all over the place and the tests are super confusing but he gives a ton of extra credit quizzes and his grading scale is super easy. Overall easy if you show up and pay attention. Dont need to get the book.

Possibly the easiest class I have ever had. Not only is Hugo a great guy, he's super lenient. We probably skipped half of all classes and studied a total of like 8 hours and still got B+'s. Just imagine how well you could do if you show up!

Hugo is so so sweet, but I did not learn much. His tests were worded very different than the material that was taught, making the exams a lot more difficult than they should have been. He also has a tendency to ramble which makes it hard to pay attention. He gives a ton of extra credit opportunities and curves pretty much everything.

Very nice guy. The class is easy if you just show up and pay attention. Tests come from lectures. Does not take attendance and gives plenty of extra credit quizzes. Grading scale is also very lenient (70s are a B)
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Faria is very kind. He takes time to establish connections with his students and he is accessible if you need help. You must pay attention in class because the tests are based off his lectures and not so much the book. The tests are multiple choice and are not too hard. This was my first Econ class and I was able to do well.

Hugo is a good guy. He takes the time to try and learn the names of the students. He's a little weird and funky, but in a good way. Very clear conservative bias, but does a good job explaining his views. A little unclear and unorganized, but if you pay attention in class you'll be fine. DO NOT BUY THE BOOK.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Faria was a fantastic professor. The material covered was pretty tough but he always explained it well. We had three group take home exams and they were all very tough and conceptual. However, he allows you to make corrections to try and boost your grade. HIGHLY recommend taking calc III and maybe even linear algebra before taking this course.

reviews.comment: must take at UM.. but you have to go to class and participate

ECO 499- Pov and Development (now 379) is a discussion based class where we read and discuss Why Nations Fail. Hugo is very accessible outside of class and tries to help students in any way he can. reviews.comment: Fun class. Great, interesting lectures that's all based on one book. The class has no exams or assignments, just attendance and participation. He's a climate change denier though, that's frustrating.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This class works better if you've already taken him for another course, like macro. He needs to know who you are so he calls on you to participate. The class is 100% participation- no tests or assignments.
The class has the opportunity to be easy, but he is very unclear. His tests are worded terribly, so it makes them hard. Only a few multiple choice tests and super easy projects.

I took Professor Faria for ECO 211 and now I have him for 212. He is the best, anyone who says otherwise probably didn't go to class. His tests are super easy (20 q, multiple choice) and are solely based on his lectures. Take good notes, don't buy the book. He really just wants you to learn and he likes to know his students by name. TAKE HIM!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: He makes the class very difficult. I never missed a class but I sadly learned nothing from this class besides his name.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: The class is composed of 4 tests, 1 group powerpoint (that you don't have to create--he provides it for you, all you have to do is present it) and 1 group paper that can do in 30 minutes while procrastinating. No homework. The tests are hard though--attend class, take good notes. The final is open textbook and notes.

I showed up, took good notes and still didn't learn a single thing. This class with any other teacher would be a breeze but he makes the material way more complicated than it needs to be and doesn't go by the book. This class was a total headache and class average was about a 65 on every test. Spare yourself and take someone else if you can

Doesn't take attendance but if he doesnt remember your face he will definitely call you out on it.
