reviews.comment: Dr. Hanna is an incredible professor who cares about his students and is passionate about biology. If you attend, participate, and put in some effort, you should earn an A+. The class is not challenging because Hanna wants students to focus on learning rather than grades. I learned so much and was never stressed! Take his course!

He is not a very good professor but the class is super easy. He just talks about random things every class and just writes on the whiteboard. The whole grade is based on 3 midterms, the final, and workshop. You won't learn anything and the exams are nothing like what he talks about in class, but there is a lot of extra credit.

Prof. Hanna is passionate about what he teaches and wants students to be excited about learning. Graded on four easy exams w/ lots of extra credit opportunities. Be in class to hear about them bc he will not repeat them! Explains some exam topics on the whiteboard. No grades up until last minute, but will show you scores after class upon request.

VERY disorganized. bro didnt post the syllabus until 2 months in and didn't even know when his own exams were. never replies to emails and is impossible to reach. his lectures are extremely boring and dont reflect whats on the exams at all. only upside is that he offers a lot of extra credit and hes truly a nice guy just not the best prof

does not teach what is actually on the exam. Does not post your grades until transcripts. Tests are true or false only. Never know what is going to be thrown at you on the exams and lectures arent even worth going to. gives extra credit but limits it to only a 5% boost.

Take Hanna if you want an Easy A while doing the least work - not to learn. I'm very interested in what he says, but attendance is not mandatory. He gives insane extra credit, especially on exams, and it is basically impossible to end with less than an A-. Final is optional if you get 85%+ on all exams. Loved this class!!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is a super caring professor who wants his students to excel in his class while also having you learn something in the class. I would 100% recommend this class if you're looking for an easy but interesting STEM cognate class. He has a ton of extra credit opportunities to make sure you get an A.

I really never understood when people would say that someone was the "best professor they'd taken", until I took Dr. Hanna's class. I have taken both 106 and 160 with him, and he is incredibly passionate about the material he teaches and wants you to genuinely learn about the field(s).

Easily one of the best professors that Umiami has to offer, you will never have another professor like hanna, He's a sweet guy that clearly cares about what he has to teach and is beyond passionate about his student and the topics he discusses, for both 106 and 160.

Prof. Hanna was disorganized, frequently didn't show up to office hours, and never responded to emails. Despite that, this is the easiest class at the university. His exams are elementary and he provides almost 2 letter grades of extra credit. He is worth taking if you want an A but don't expect to learn a whole lot.

This class was SO easy, just go to class and pay attention. The exams are very easy and are purposely made that way. Review sheets were given for each lecture that very much reflected what ended up being on the exams. He is a good professor and is very passionate about biology and wants to get to know all his students. He is disorganized though.
Great class, the professor genuinely cares about the class learning and is enthusiastic about what he's teaching.

If you attend the lectures and take some notes you are almost guaranteed an A on the exams. He also always adds extra credit questions on all exams. If you get a 90 or above on all 3 midterms you don't have to take the final. He also lets you write papers on things related to what we are learning to receive more extra credit in case you need it.

He is an amazing professor who cares for his students, he lets the class decide what is on the exams and provides study guides to his exams. Overall, he is super passionate and is very fair in grading.

Super nice professor, wants students to pass. Gives a bunch of extra credit opportunities and has a total of 4 exams. One is dropped and the other three make up for your full grade as well as the workshops. He gives extra credit on the exams as well. Also does review sessions before exams which are very helpful. Overall would def take him again!

Best teacher in my time here so far. Everyone ive spoken to loves him. has genuine passion for what he does and understands not everyone shares that so he explains things in a way that makes sense while still reflecting his love for what hes talking about. great funny guy will help you out!!

The 3 exams are the only thing contributing to your final grade, but they are questions pulled from or similar to the homeworks. Study the homework thoroughly for each exam and you'll be fine. Her office hours are pretty good and she's very accessible, but she'll tell you to figure it out on your own sometimes. Honors class so very proof heavy.

3 exams make up your final grade. Each exam is just like the homework for the covered materials so study that and you'll be fine. Pretty harsh grader but within reason, and it's an honors course so very proof heavy unlike the regular one. You are expected to figure things out but her office hours are good. It's a difficult but rewarding class.

Good professor that clearly cares. Does tell her students to figure it out on your own. Study the homeworks and proofs required and you will pass. 3 tests to decide your fate and sometimes a bit harsh on grading. Make sure to give it your all.
This professor is terrible, who else takes 3 weeks to grade a 5 question exam? Doesn't respond to emails, tells students to "figure it out" during lectures. Avoid if you can!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I found certain aspects of the course challenging that I believe could be improved upon. While Professor Michelle is undoubtedly knowledgeable, I sometimes felt the course material was presented in a way that could be more accessible. Additionally, the feedback on assignments was often delayed and, when received, lacked detailed insights.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you want to flunk your GPA take this class!!

Very good lecturer and explains concepts clearly, though I wish that they were slightly more interactive. Tests are very reasonable, though I wish that we were graded by more than just 3 tests. Make sure to do homeworks and attend class; if she is in good favor with you, she might bump up your grade!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Just 3 exams decide your grade, but they are very similar to the weekly homework she assigns. She is very caring and you can see she likes the topic she's teaching. Lectures were not very interactive and you had to memorize a lot of theorems, but I feel I really learned the reason behind a lot of concepts. Her office hours were also very useful.

One of the best math professors at UM. The material is not easy, the HW doesn't count toward the overall grade in most cases, so 3 exams deciding your grade is not favorable. She posts all her notes online, so if you go to class, read her notes, and maybe watch YT videos you should be okay. Definitely do the HWs and Additionals cus thats the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Galloway is an amazing math professor. She is very explicative in her lectures. She gives homework every week, yet it doesn't count towards the final grade. Although 3 exams determine the grade, she mirrors it on the homework. The honors section makes you memorize some theorems. The class is challenging in an entertaining way. Recommended
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Galloway is by far one of the best professors I have ever had. You need to attend class to get an A as all of the lectures and examples in class are reflected on the tests. Weekly homework assignments are given that are graded, however they do not actually affect the over all final grade and only are used in borderline cases.

ZERO review before exams. ZERO review problems. Too much information crammed into lecture (impossible to take notes and learn). 3 exams decide entire grade. Curve is hidden until final grade. Would not recommend if you've ever had trouble with a math class before. Attendance and Homework only affect curve. Prob good teacher for smart people.
Dr. Galloway did a tremendous job of teaching the course material.  The course challenged me in away that no other class has yet done.

Avoid unless you are good at self teaching. Her Schedule didn't have any roadmap or the grading scale, was totally in the dark. Checks your work like a mathematician, small mistake and you lose 5 marks. Only 3 exams which count, each exam has few problems so plenty of time but each problem is worth a lot, no chance of making mistakes. DANGER CLOSE!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Stay AWAY!

 Extremely anal about how things are written on exams. Deductions if she doesn't like the way a proof is written. No reviews, must study homework that was incorrectly marked by grader. 
Never pauses during lecture for you to digest material, you'll constantly be racing to copy form board. Lectures vary greatly from textbook teachings.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Galloway. Sometimes she's a little kooky in a good way, but she cares about the class and knows what she's doing. The needed material is in the lectures. Homework is representative of the tests, so do well there and you should be set. Slight curve.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: If you are a math major she breaks down the science of mathematics in one of the most eloquent ways possible. You will definitely learn a lot. But if you are there just to get by and get a good grade, definitely take another teacher. The class only has three tests...
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I had a great time in Honors Linear Algebra with Dr. Galloway. I ended up with an A in the class. All her exams were  tricky but do-able. Make sure to form a study group from the beginning of class, it will really help you out, especially when you reach Vector Spaces. Very kindhearted and accessible during office hours, I would 10/10 recommend her.

Dr. Galloway is an interesting choice to have for Linear Algebra.  I took her this semester because she is the only professor who teaches the Honors Section. The class itself isn't that difficult, but she does make you memorize the starred theorems. The class can be tedious at times, but luckily she has two exams and a final, all of which are easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Seems nice and very smart, but very scatter brained. Just does the proofs that are in the text book during class. Get ready to do a whole lot of proofs. Not very available outside of class. Tried contacting her a couple of times, either did not respond or just was not helpful at all.
Honors section. Harder than other sections but worth it. Basically theoretical lectures and applications on the homeworks. Tests are do-able and she is nice and willing to help  would take again
Honors Linear Algebra. I thought I loved math, beware of proofs in this class! Requires time and effort, but the professor is genuinely kind and wanting to help you!
This class is harder than other mth210 classes but it's worth it. She's a really good teacher. But you have to study if you want to do well.
Awesome teacher; she explains things very well, slowly and clearly.  I learned a  lot.
Dr. Galloway is an amazing Professor. She is very supportive and enthusiastic.  I will recommend her class to my friends.
She's really great! Always helpful when I have questions. She explains concepts clearly!    Favorite class this semester!

professor likes to have long lectures. Every day, about 3-4 pages of notes was taken. If you ask for help on homework, she gives "hints" which are usually of no use and just confuse the class even more.

I really enjoyed her class. She is a quirky professor and can seem out there but she really cares about the students and what we learn. She is a very fair grader and as long as you study for the tests they are doable. Take her class!

The class was a lot of fun, the teacher was good, the material was interesting, and the workload wasn't miserable. You do need to know how to prove theorems, but she is very good at explaining ideas and theorems that are confusing at first glance.
Loved this course. Dr. Galloway's lectures were clear.  If you want to learn how to prove theorems take this course.

I loved math until I took this class. The teacher was disorganized, hard to understand, bad at explaining what she meant, and overall just a bad teacher. The class isn't too difficult as long you keep up with homework. Tests require a lot of memorization because she assigns theorems that you must be able to prove.
Lots of homeworks, theorems, proofs.Two exams and final.She is willing to help before exams, like problem sessions if the class asks.

If you take honors MTH210 with Galloway, be prepared to do nothing but prove theorems.  A lot of homework and a lot of memorization.  However, she clearly has an understand of the subject and is relatively helpful to students who have questions.
No Comments
I enjoyed learning how to prove theorems in this class.
Honors professor, nice old woman, but LOTS of homework and lots of memorization.

Professor Garrigo is one of the best professor I have had at UM. Her lectures are engaging, dynamic, and connect deeply to current events.  The work was always interesting and felt intentional - it always served a purpose throughout the course. Amazing guest speakers as well!

Easily one of the best classes in the program. Silvia builds everything around relevant, real-world case studies, so the sustainability concepts actually stick. Engaging, approachable, and genuinely invested in her students. One of the professors I learned the most from. Take this class if you get the chance.

TAKE PROFESSOR GARRIGO. BUS 300 quickly became the class I looked forward to most every week. She genuinely cares about her students, is incredibly engaging, and gives presentation advice that I still use in both my classes and internship today. You will leave this class a better public speaker. Truly the best professors at Miami I have ever had.

Took Responsible Business at the graduate level. The class was discussion-based and focused heavily on case studies and current events, which made the material engaging and relevant. Professor Garrigo explained concepts in detail and brought practical examples into class. I learned a lot and would recommend the course!
Very easy class and super caring professor. Lectures can get a little boring but I would take her again.

You with out a doubt need to take her if you need to take Bus300. She is one of the best Professors i have taken here at UM. Super nice and caring, here assignments arent hard at all and she is not a tough grader as long as you include what she wants to see. She also doesnt give out homework. I am begging you to take her i promsie you wont regretit

She is a great professor and an easy grader! NO TESTS. 3 writing assignments and 3 oral presentations. It may seem scary to have to talk in front of the class, but she definitely helps you with tips and tricks to reduce anxiety. She gives great feedback!

Professor Garrigo really cares for her students and tries her best to make the class fun and interactive. Grade is fully based off 3 papers and 3 presentations (no tests, yay) and attendance/participation. You definitely have to go to class, but its not hard at all and honestly really helped my presentation skills.
Very great teacher, class is really straight forward! Didn't take the beginning half of the semester too seriously which messed up my final grade so just put in the work and you'll get an A.

If you fail this class what are you doing. I wish i realized this earlier but the review questions he gives before the test are the test he is very nice there is homework but you do it as you want and it is all due the last day of class, honestly just a grade booster. TAKE THIS CLASS.
AMAZING. I hate math and I genuinely enjoyed his class.

Professor Lorenzo was one of the best professors I've had. He is approachable, funny, and kind, which makes class enjoyable. Attendance isn't mandatory, but lectures are very helpful. His review sessions closely reflect exam content, so even if you miss class, make sure you attend the reviews.

Very efficient; you'll receive your test grade the moment you walk out of the room. Explains difficult concepts in simple terms, and make sure to show up on review days; he literally shows you how to pass the test. He also gives you half the semester to do the math hw, so there's no rush. Overall makes 101 very easy, take him if you love yourself
Great guy and explains the material really well. Just do your work and pay attention and you'll be just fine.

He's incredibly understanding and will help students despite the class's heavy reliance on test scores. He's more than willing to assist you if you reach out to him. Attending class is recommended but not mandatory , as he thoroughly covers the test material before the exam. He's the best professor for 101. Great person
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's genuinely a good teacher. The only competent math professor at UM. He wants you to pass the class. Works very hard to get students to pass exams. If you need to take MTH 101, take Lorenzo.
Best prof ever, super supportive. Study guides are mirrored to the exams, super straightforward exams. 100% would take him!!!!

Great professor; he's the best, and he helps you understand the math so well. Very good lectures, and he doesn't drag them. Attendance isn't mandatory, but I recommend it if you struggle with math. Review days are also extremely helpful; he always goes over what to expect, and if you have questions, he'll answer them. BEST PROFESSOR EVER :)

Professor Lorenzo was fantastic. Definitely cares about his students and is super understanding & fair. Always got out of class early, he would never drag on lectures. If you are to take this course, take it with him! Great guy all around.

Awesome guy. He actually taught me math for the first time since middle school. He makes the material so easy to digest and it also helps that he kept it real. Attendance is not mandatory because everything can be taught through HW, but if you are struggling with the source material, show up to class and he will teach it and probably dismiss early.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: KING. Take this class!! Attendance is not mandatory, but if you do go its an easy A. This is coming from a usually horrible math student.
I LOVE THIS MAN. I AM HORRIBLE AT MATH BUT HE MADE THIS CLASS SOOOO EASY!!! TAKE HIM ASAP.
I am terrible at Math and he made learning math easy, very straight foward, gives great test reviews, and was overall super nice and chill. Best math professor ever!

Great professor. His teaching was very straight to the point. I dislike math but he made it easy to understand. Attendance wasn't mandatory. He usually ended classes 20 mins early. He also reviewed before every exam and basically gave same questions but with different numbers. Passed the final with a B+.
This professor made math 101 simple and easier to learn. I'm not good at math and I was able to learn and understand the concepts we learned.

he is an amazing professor, easy to understand, and he reviews before every test making it clear what will be on the test and easy to study for. He gives you enough time to finish the assignments so this class was not stressful at all. Highly recommend you take his classes if you can!
He is the best teacher for Math 101. He gives partial credit on tests and makes learning the concepts simple. 100% recommend taking this course with him.
SO chill, attendance not mandatory, always got out 20 minutes early. Super effective at teaching and always taught the simplest way, nothing convoluted. Understood and sympathized with students.

Professor Lorenzo is the best MTH101 professor in the school. He tells you from day 1 what he really cares about. His reviews before exams tell you question by question what is gonna be on the test and he is an easy grader. Also posts your grades literally 5 minutes after you're done with tests. Does not care about attendance whatsoever. 5/5

Professor Lorenzo was absolutely incredible. Best professor in the department for a math class like this one. He helped prepare for exams by explaining exactly what you needed to know and did not waste your time with stuff that would not be asked for on the exams. His lectures were quick and to the point, allowing for time for questions.
Amazing teacher for MTH 101. Highly recommend you take him compared to other options at the school. The man cares.
Great prof super nice would take again; she cold calls on u tho

Dr. Tran is a good lecture not very engaging though. A lot of information to learn, reason why attendance is a must to be able to follow all the stories. Quizzes and tests are multiple choice but not easy. For a 100 level this was not an easy class but you definitely enrich your knowledge in Roman and Greek myth.

Please do not take this class. Her lectures are vague and unclear. You are required to know every miniscule detail WHICH SHE DOESN'T EVEN COVER. I have come up to her numerous times at the start of the semester asking what in particular I should have studied and she provided unclear answers and did not to help.

Her lectures are impossible to understand, and the exams are quite literally almost impossible. You are forced to know hundreds of discrete facts about Greek myth, as the exams are not on the overarching themes, but rather minutiae. DO NOT TAKE!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is a good professor but this was a lot of work for me, especially since I took it for a cognate requirement. 5 Quizzes (lowest dropped) + midterm + final. I had to study for each for a long time. It's a good class but not if you're looking for an easy cognate.
All you have to do is pay attention in class and take notes. Her exams are 100% straight from class content, and everything is interesting and digestible.

She's a good professor but her teaching was not super engaging. Only lectures and ppts in class. Prepare to be called for drills in class. There are weekly quizzes, a midterm, and final which are all online under lockdown browser. You can get the textbook but you don't need to since she posts it.
Very nice person and lectures were very interesting. Just be prepared to review for the biweekly quizzes. She posts image and ID lists before each quiz which are good review tools.

Prof. Tran expects you to know an insurmountable amount of information for any 101 course. If you are looking for an easy cognate, you can go find something else. All online quizzes and tests, but they are tricky and on lockdown.
She is a great professor and really wants her students to learn. She is very understanding, the class is straightforward, and I would highly recommend taking a class with her.
I love Dr. Tran! I have taken Latin 101,102, and 201 with her. She is a great teacher, and I have learned so much. She is very supportive and incredibly helpful if you have additional questions.
Very boring class but shes alright
One of my favorite classics profs I have ever had! Super caring + understanding. Would recommend!

This professor is a great lecturer, and she absolutely loves this subject. however, for a 101 class it's absolutely ridiculous the amount of material she gives. each test had about 150 characters of greek myth, and the exams are on lockdown so you can't use any cheat sheet. however, she's a good professor. but the amount of material is insane!
This class is very lecture heavy, but the professor makes them pretty interesting. She gives an outline for every exam, so as long as you study that the exams themselves are easy enough.

Professor Tran is truly a great lecturer. My only critique is that she jumps around stories and then comes back to what she was talking about originally. It is sometimes hard to follow the point she is trying to make. However, she is engaging and grades are fair. She puts a lot of emphasis on attendance.

I loved taking this class. If you study the material before the quizzes you will easily be able to get an A. For the 201 class there is only one essay at the end of the course which she gives you plenty of time to do and even meets with you before submitting it.

This is a review of the class, NOT the teaching. I'm a BME major so I took this class as an elective thinking it would be easy. However, this class has a lot of reading assignments and essays. You must write 6 essays summarizing/interpreting difficult sources which are about 15-20 pages long. This excludes work for midterm/final. easy grading tho.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I love the way that Dr. Tran teaches. She is very enthusiastic and tells the greek mythology tales in stories. She's got a sweet heart and answers all of your questions via email and in person. If you love greek mythology highly recommend!!! For CLA102 you have to do the quizzes and just write one paper :)

Such an interesting class. You don't even need to read the book she explains everything that happens and it actually makes sense. All exams are online, just pay attention to lecture, review notes, and you'll do good

I love professor Tran. Her lectures are actually interesting and she sets them up kind of like a story. Class goes by so fast and as long as you pay attention you will get an A on the quizzes. Take her!
Really good teacher and keeps it interesting, attendance is mandatory. Tests and quizzes if you do ID guide she gives and pay attention in class is easy

Took her for greek and roman mythology and it was honestly a very fun and chill class. You take quizzes online and at home with a lockdown browser, but they are pretty easy and her lectures are actually pretty interesting. Definitely recommend this class

One of my favorite classes. I highly recommend taking her CLA 101 class. She's a great professor, and her lectures are interesting if you enjoy mythology. She is super passionate about this course. The course is pretty easy, you just have to listen and take notes in class. Textbook is recommended, but if you listen well in class, you'll be fine.

Professor Tran is one of the best professors at UM. She is super passionate about Greek Mythology, and she makes the subject super captivating. She is so kind and accessible outside of class. I definitely recommend taking her class for an easy. A. All you need to do is show up to class and pay attention. All tests/quizzes are online. Amazing prof!

Two problems: she is quiet so it's hard to hear everything she says & there are a lot of names to memorize that it gets confusing. 5 bi-weekly exams but lowest grade gets dropped. Exams online with lockdown browser. Can be interesting at times, but boring at times too. Pay attention and you can pass tho. don't need the textbook but it can help you

Wow. Tran is amazing. She is super kind, sweet, and humble. She really cares about her students. She is very flexible on deadlines for assignments and is willing to make accommodations for her students if need be. Highly recommend.

1.) Quizzes asked really open-ended questions for multiple choice. 
2.) Lecture heavy and confusing. For example, she'll be in the middle of a myth and when a new character appears she'll switch from the myth she's talking about and talk about a myth which explains the new characters backstory and then continue along with the first myth

She provides study guides for every quiz and drops the lowest one at the end of the semester. As long as you show up, take good notes, and study a little bit before each test, you will do well. Occasionally her storytelling was hard to follow regarding which character she was referring to, but she is generally a good lecturer.

I am a Classics Major and took Dr. Han for CLA 101 this semester. Amazing lectures, clear grading criteria with biweekly quizzes (she will provide an ID and image list), and she is very passionate about the subject! She always goes the extra mile to make sure that we understand the content. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!! One of the best professors at UM!

All you have to do is pay attention to her lectures, take good notes and you will pass. If you understand the stories and who's who you will do good on every quiz and exam. Her accent can be hard to understand at first but you definitely get used to it. Very accessible as well. Easy arts and humanities cognate choice.

I loved having Professor Tran this year. Her Greek and Roman Mythology class is very engaging. Every lecture is a story with twists and turns that she executes wonderfully. There is a quiz every other week but you have a lot of time to take them and they are easy as long as you review the list that she provides. I definitely recommend this class!

I absolutely adore Dr. Tran! Her lectures are incredible; like an epic story. I had no idea what classics even was before taking her classes now I've taken so many with her I've taken on classics as one of my majors. Her instructions for assignments are clear and it's mostly essays and a midterm and final which are easy as long as you go to class.

I really loved her for Greek and Roman mythology. I like to think I am a good student and I paid attention so the class really was not hard for me. However, it is A LOT of memorization. I took the class because I thought it was going to be surface level. it was NOT but I still ended up really enjoying it. If you do not want to study do not take!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved taking her class. She has amazing and interesting lectures. The book is not really needed if you pay attention in class. Her exams are straightforward and everything on it is discussed in class. If you miss a lecture you will be a little lost since she gives a lot of information in every class. But in overall an amazing professor

Professor Tran makes Greek and Latin mythology really interesting to learn about, and all of the lectures are actually engaging and fun. It's a very easy course, you just have to make sure you remember what she covers in her presentations. Would 100% recommend to take her class, it's very easy to do well!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: An amazing teacher and story teller. Her classics classes are engaging and fun. Her Latin classes are straightforward and very well structured.

Professor Tran has been the best professor I have had at UM. If given the chance, I highly encourage you to take her courses. As long as you pay close attention in lectures, you should be able to pass with an A. She is such an incredible lecturer. Each time I have class, it seems like "story time". She makes everything so interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: The textbook was not needed in Cla219 .The class is enjoyable , the review sheet for exams very helpful.

Dr. Tran wants every student to get an A. She is very nice and is willing to help. Her class only has multiple quizzes, a midterm, and a final. She makes the material very easy. Same goes for 102, but the material just gets a little more difficult

Dr. Tran is a wonderful professor. She cares about her students and has a soothing voice. Quizzes, a midterm, and a final account for 90% of the grade, and attendance accounts for 10%. You are allowed 3 unexcused absences, but you will not want to miss because class is actually interesting

This was a very interesting class and Dr. Tran is one of my favorite professors at the university. She grades very generously and doesn't try to trick you on her quizzes. Also, she drops the lowest quiz grade. You do have to sign an attendance roster but you're given a few unexcused absences.

She is such a really lady, very passionate about what she teaches. Her lectures are a little boring but if you like the class you'll love it. The grade consists of only bi-weekly quizzes that are all multiple choice.
Latin is an extremely boring subject for me. But she makes it bearable and if you put in minimum of effort you will get an A. Super caring and understanding.

Amazing teacher!! Helped fuel my love for Latin. She keeps students on top of their work by giving weekly quizzes, not hard, and prepares you well for them. Forces students to participate which really is a good thing and everyone ends up doing well. I learned a lot from her, also how to strive in my other courses. HIGHLY recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She was honestly the most amazing teacher I have ever had. What a gem. She has a very soothing voice and makes it easy to go to morning classes. Her lectures are just so much more enlightening and easier to grasp than with other professors' lectures from the CLA department. Overall, an easy A if you take notes, read them, and use her exam reviews.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed parts of this class. However, there was not a clear grading scale and the readings were very odd. Using points from her lectures in your assignments are important. Some of the topics for assignments were impossible to find readings for and the prompts were vague.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS--Tests? Not many

reviews.comment: Dr. Han Tran is a goddess who walks upon the earth. An incredible storyteller who winds myth and art and history together; class is always interesting, so I never skipped a single 9:30am class. Han Tran makes my Tuesdays and Thursday worth looking forward to. An incredible course by an incredible professor.  11/10 taking classes with her next year

The book we used cost $6, and the text was really readable compared to some other translations. The lectures were easy to pay attention to and most of the material on the tests and quizzes is from the lecture, not necessarily the powerpoint or book. Dr. Tran is a great professor and the material presented during class was interesting!

reviews.comment: TAKE THIS CLASS!!! SUPER INTERESTING AND NOT TOO MUCH WORK! Prof. Tran is amazing!

reviews.comment: Prof. Tran is a very articulate lecturer and CLA220 is immensely interesting for those that enjoy mythology. My only critique is that she possesses the unique ability to relate every single Greek/Roman myth to the underlying theme of female sexuality/eros. I would suggest a title change: CLA220: Female Eros in Mythology.

I love Dr. Tran. One of the best professors at the University of Miami. Gives enough inspiration to pick up classics as a major or minor (unless you're lazy).  Very understanding with a soothing voice. Nice and is willing to listen! I think she should have a raise each semester. Usually I hate going to classes but she makes you feel like why not.

Professor Han Tran is the example of what a professor should be. She is always there to help you and she only worries about you getting an A . She is the reason for why I added Classics as a second major. BEST PROFESSOR if you want to take Latin or Greek no doubt about it. I have taken all my Latin with her and also my Greek classes. THE BEST!

Professor Han Tran is the example of what a professor should be. She is always there to help you and she only worries about you getting an A and understanding the material. She is the reason for why I added Classics as a second major. She knows the material and she is super nice. Great Professor

Professor Han Tran is the example of what a professor should be. She is always there to help you and she only worries about you getting an A and understanding the material. She is the reason for why I added Classics as a second major. If you do the work, if you go to class and show her that you care, she will help you so you ALWAYS. TAKE HER!!!
Most beautiful and amazing teacher i have had at UM. Class isn't hard if you show up and she will help you. She made me take my classics minor. Absolutely love her :)

Han Tran's voice is like a fairly tale, I could listen to it for hours! She is very helpful and cares a lot about her students. The class wasn't super easy but she made it enjoyable. Do your work and you should be fine.

Easiest language class I've ever taken. Attendance isn't mandatory but you'll be lost if you miss classes. If you can translate halfway decent you should be fine. I'm not good with grammar but i still got an A because of my translations. all the work is done in the books so you need them. Not hard,but not an easy A if you don't know what's going on

Great Professor! I had her for mythology class and really got to understand her style when in a smaller class, she's a great teacher and really knows her stuff! Also this class is super interesting, definitely recommend taking with her!

shes super nice and has the most soothing voice! it is like storytime every morning. i was never interested in mythology but i loved listening to the stories. attendance is taken every day, but if you show up for class and listen you dont need to read the book. quizzes are easy if you pay attention or read the power points.

Amazing woman and an Amazing class. You don't need the textbook per-say, but it is extremely helpful for studying. I got straight A's and i didn't read the book, but i did take plenty of notes (i had to buy two notebooks)All in all, show up do all assignments and fill out the study sheets and you'll get an A plus. I love this lady!
Tests and quizzes are easy if you can translate well, and she makes the setting really comfortable and engaging. She is  really nice and helps the class if they feel unprepared.

Attendance is mandatory. Your participation grade drops after 3 absences but you can just have someone sign you in cause she passes a sheet around. You have to take notes during her lecture to do well on the quizes and exams, theres some things in there that are not on her powerpoints or the book. Reading isn't necessary if you go to class.

She knows the myths, but she's quiet and always seems to bring things back to female sexuality.Her quizzes and tests are all multiple choice, so the class isn't hard, but if you don't think feminist thought is the end result of all stories, this class might irk you.

If you find Mythology interesting, this class is a breeze. If you DONT like mythology...its an easy A. She literally takes her quizzes straight from the powerpoints, which can be downloaded straight off blackboard. 15 minutes of studying and you get almost perfect scores...even on her midterms. It's a big lecture too, so you can just chill.

This class is ridiculously boring.  I love mythology, but it actually pains me to sit through this class.  She does know her stuff and she explains things, but she doesn't create any excitement for the course.  Her slides are mostly pictures (which are only Mac compatible), but you really have to take notes.  I still wouldn't recommend it, though.

She can be an awesome teacher if you like the topics she covers. She shows she knows the material by heart, and it's even funny sometimes. If you want an easy class, go somewhere else. If you like a little challenge, and interesting stories then I highly recommend it!

He is the best, knows a lot about the industry and has this gift of making you think and go beyond the average ideas for campaigns or anything creative. He really pushes you and the work comes out great.

This professor is all around amazing and a great person to learn from if you're looking to go into advertising. He gives great feedback and only wants to help students better their skills. 1000% take his classes.

One of my all time fave profs at UM! he's really nice, approachable, and understanding. most of the work you do is in class so make sure to show up. As long as you show up, try, and actually do the work, it's a pretty great class. 100% have/would take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: The class is all discussion based and he expects you to participate. Overall it is chill, but it really makes you think. The grading criteria is not very clear for the class though which can be annoying. Also he forces you to buy the book, but you never use it. He is super interesting though and makes class exciting.
The realest.

Amazing teacher. We did not read and write long papers, we actually created campaigns! Super interesting class, a lot of work but very useful. He gives good feedback, he is always there to help you and he is an easy grader. Definitely take him!

HUGHES IS THE BEST. 331 is the best class I've had here. We created about 10 campaigns, which was intense, and the focus was not on grades/textbooks, but actually about writing and creating campaigns. He gives feedback on the spot but is blunt/no bs, and shows you how to do it better.  If you are serious about your writing you need to take him!!

No teachin, just talks abt his feelings&asks students 2 talk abt theirs, then assigns group projctsCeatv class, gradin very subjctivTurn in same as classmt n get dif gradeBypasses adv mngmnt&marktin methdsconcepts & only looks 4 creatv he likes, yet campaign wud b complt failure bc no strategyTakes secret attend, takes 4ev to grade,few grades
Professor Hughes is fun and cool. We created 3+ campaigns during the semester and I am using 2 for my portfolio. They're the best conceptscampaigns I got to work on at UM.
Great and funny teacher for copywriting. Definitely take him for clear-cut writing assignments, but you'll have to write on your own if you want actual portfolio pieces.
Very sweet and actually cares that you do well.

He was a great teacher and covered a lot of material in class so we didn't have a lot of work outside class. There were quizzes every Friday which usually covered the previous week's material which helped keep the information fresh. Exams were not super difficult and we reviewed in class for at least one full class.

I was disappointed by the way he interacted with me outside of class. The class itself is not difficult, but he doesn't teach the material, just goes through problems. If you care about actually learning and not just memorization, I would NOT take this class.

does a pretty good job at keeping students engaged during his lectures, however the structure of the course is not good. The quizzes are majority your grade and they are always a 2-3 questions that you get only about 8 minutes to complete. if you mess up at all, your grade is tanked.

reviews.comment: Honestly, the best math professor I've had here. Truly cares for the students. Although it's a grind and a lots of homework, it was easier to manage because he teaches the content very well. Has review zoom meetings before every exam and the review guides are straight forward.

reviews.comment: really nice and super accessible outside of class hosting zoom sessions and recording our classes but the actual content is just hard. unless you were goated at pre calc in hs i wouldn't take this class. even so for me it was not like hs pre calc at all. if you have to take, he's a caring guy but i would beware of the class itself.

reviews.comment: awesome guy. he's very witty which makes his classes easy to sit through, while others would be painfully boring. you can tell he cares about his students and their success, there is homework but it's mostly light and preps you well for tests.
He moves extremely fast and does not teach it, he just does it and expects you to know how after he just works the problem. everyone on here is lying do not take him
He is genuinely one of the best teachers I have had at the University. He explains concepts very well and you can tell he cares for his students.

reviews.comment: Goated professor. Screwed around too much for the first half of the semester and banged my grade for the semester but when you put the effort in you really do learn from him. Legend.

The best professor I have taken at UM. You have to put in the work to learn and I used office hours HEAVILY. But so far, I have not made lower than a 94% on an exam. There is partial credit, homeworks to help. It is a heavy class but if you put in the work you will be fine. He is also super helpful and wants you to succeed.

Sergio is a great professor - he explains concepts clearly and makes the class engaging. Attendance is mandatory, but the recorded lectures are helpful if you need to review. Using unstuck ai along with the practice problems really helped me ace the exams.

he literally prepared me for college, super nice dont be afraid to go to office hours super helpful, do the homework every single night dont wait, go to review sessions and office hours everyday and guaranteed you'll pass. notes are good and more helpful on an ipad, if u understand HW you'll be okay. Just be honest with any trouble you have

reviews.comment: He's a great professor! it's clear that he loves teaching and that's what makes his class standout. If you feel unsure about your math skills, I highly recommend taking his class before calculus. I promise you will improve so much in his class!!

Prof Hernandez is amazing! Very helpful in class and during office hours, and really wants you to succeed in math. He understands math is not everyone's strong suit and does his best to teach the material clearly and so that you can really master the concepts. Takes attendance and gives weekly quizzes which reflect the exam content fairly well too.

2 semesters worth of math in 1 semester. Professor Hernandez interacts with the class and does all work on the board. It's easy to fall far behind in this class so do the homework and complete all the test practice problems and you will comprehend the material. Awesome professor and very important course for engineers who are behind in math.

DO NOT MISS A CLASS !!! OR you will struggle to get back on track. Being on top of your work is super important or you will get lost. Recorded classes, however sometimes unclear and very rushed lessons. Though, that is just the class. If you don't have to take the course DON'T TAKE IT! Other than that he is a good teacher, and can be helpful.
100000/10 TAKE HIS CLASS

I came in with a poor foundation of algebra and he fixed that in one semester. Exams are hard but if you do the review and the homework you'll be fine. Takes attendance but it's not for a grade and he records all the lectures. Can be sassy at times which some of my friends didn't like but i thought he was super funny and kept class entertaining.

reviews.comment: One of the few good math professors at Miami. Extremely clear in class and gives study guides for everything. He explains everything really well and will always answer questions
m

His class is tough in the sense that he covers a lot of material and sends a lot of hmw. He tries to help in any way he can with review sessions, study guides and lots of office hours. If I he taught other courses like calc 1 and 2 I would take them with him in a heartbeat, he is one of the best math teachers I've ever come across.

I think he is overrated.  He got easily annoyed with questions and rushed several lessons.  He consistently tried to scare students back to MTH101 even though most students in his class had already taken precalc and calc in high school.  He is fine but there is definitely better options.

Lots of math homework but only worth 60/1000 points, better to work on exam reviews to ace exams. Records all his lectures. Eager to teach. Fun personality. Exam reviews match exams in the way you solve them. I scored 62% on exam 1, 102% on exam 2, and 96% on midterm so far, improvement was due to exam review packets (lowest score replaced).

Prof Hernandez is a great professor, he is very clear and gives good explanations. He gives practice problems to practice for tests. His tests are hard, but he gives partial credit. This class is not easy, and you will have to spend time outside class studying and reviewing.

Professor Hernandez has been the best math teacher I have ever had. If you think logically, and do the homework, you wont have any issues with this class. He also posts his lectures to zoom, which is very useful to help with studying. If I could rate higher than a 5 stars, I would.

Sergio is an awesome professor. He cares about his students and provides great lectures. He also is readily available for office hours if you need him, and he makes the class engaging and fun. I also enjoy how he has a positive attitude for every class and he is definitely a professor I would take again!

Sergio is one of the best professors. He is funny, caring, and always ready to help. He had the challenging task of covering a lot of material, but he gave us great classes and very useful homework. There was a lot of work, but it was manageable to maintain a good practice rhythm. An excellent professor that I recommend to everyone.

Flipped classroom model was honestly terrible. I can tell he's a great guy and teacher but learning at home can be difficult to keep up. Even he wasn't happy with the flipped classroom style of teaching. If you're on top of it you'll do fine. Quizzes every week + about 8 exams + final. It was a lot to cover in the short period.

Sergio is the best math teacher I have ever had. The only negative part of my experience in his class was the fact that I was in MTH105 and it is inherently double paced which makes the workload too much for some people. Sergio himself is a great professor. He genuinely cares about his students and will explain any question.

Prof. Hernandez is an amazing professor, and I highly recommend him. I had him for MTH 140 & 141, and his lectures were easy to understand. Even though this is an early class, it was still fun & interesting. To pass, you still have to put in the work. Do all of the hw and extra credit. He really understands his students and wants them to succeed.

He's funny and entertaining, but I personally struggled with his style of teaching. He tended to under-explain, and routinely got irritated by the questions anyone in my class would ask him. We were an 8am so maybe that's why. I have Koppendrayer for 141--his lectures are much better explained and he grades more kindly than Hernandez.
Sergio is such a cool and genuine dude. He is a good teacher and definitely enjoys what he does. His class is not hard as long as you pay attention in class.

He is an amazing professor, and I am so glad I had him as my first math professor at college. The guided notes from each unit are so helpful, and definitely do the extra credit reviews for each test, it ends up helping so much in the end. If you put the effort in to understand the information, you will do great.

reviews.comment: Professor Hernandez is truly my favorite professor at the U. Having him my first semester of college was actually amazing. He is super helpful when you do not understand topics and hosts weekly review sessions for any questions you have. He offers extra credit every exam and honestly just overall one of the best professors I've had. Take his class.

He teaches fast and there isnt always a lot of time to ask many questions DURING class but he has office hours and he is super helpful if you go to them. He holds reviews weekly and before exams which are very helpful. Do the reviews, you get a bonus and are similar to the tests. Def recommend over all the other professors!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He did a really good job giving students extra credit and a lot of review opportunity before any exams. He's easy going and he made lectures interesting because he liked what he was teaching. The exams weren't bad as long as you pay attention during the lecture and do the reviews.

He is understanding for one test I asked to take a day late due to mental health problems and he easily allowed it. The class is just really hard, but it's MTH141 in general. I did well in 140 and struggled a lot of this class. He really enjoys math and teaching. He just moves really quickly and you need to teach yourself. Very accessible!

reviews.comment: I love him. Literally in his fan club. Take him if u can! Hes really chill and easy going, and he measured attendance by an attendance code given at the end of class. He grades fair enough and hes good at explaining. He can be kinda fast for some people but honestly just do the h/w and review and youll be golden

Calc isn't easy, class is extremely test heavy, he takes ages to grade exams but he's funny, nice, a bit snarky too. I get tutoring from him and Camner so I try and sometimes it shows in my grade. The hw online does not reflect exam Qs; feels like a waste. For exams he doesn't go over all review, only Qs u ask, not efficient at all. He tries tho?

reviews.comment: Professor Hernandez was an incredible calculus A teacher. Im taking him again for calculus B. You do have to purchase the online book to access the homework. He gives a 30 point extra credit assignment. He is always available outside of class and cares a lot about his students. Grades are off 4 tests (including final), homework, and 2-3 quizzes.

10/10 recommend for MTH 140. He will always make time for u, is very compassionate when you meet with him and actually wants to interact with you. If you pay attention during class and especially reviews, and print out and follow along to the class notes, you'll do well.
Hes really easy going! Def recommend!! 10/10

This class was extremely difficult, even though I took calculus in high school. I felt uncomfortable asking questions and felt like I was unlearning concepts I had previously mastered. The homework load is a LOT and sometimes doesn't even match test q's. AVOID this class I'm going for a different one next semester.

Professor Hernandez is great. He is very accessible every day of the week for office hours and also works the math lab. He is always there to help you and is always very patient with you while asking questions. Homework is much harder than exam, so it is great for prep. Very reasonable tests.

I received a D in his class after attending every single lecture. He has an extreme disconnect with his students and inability to teach calculus in a way even the brightest students can comprehend. Very condescending attitude.

He goes very fast in his lectures, and does not allocate proper time for you to comprehend what he is saying. His tests have almost absolutely nothing to do with the review. Ive attended every class, and am normally an excellent math student and I am struggling to get a C. He graded tests very tough.

Great dude, very helpful and makes sure you understand the material. Has lots of time set aside just for asking questions. He's very happy and awake for an 8am course. Would definitely take again if he didn't have his class at 8am.

I took MTH 107 and 108 with him. He is the only professor who helped me understand precal. The homework seems like a lot, but go to class & take good notes & you won't need to do all the problems. He makes himself available outside of class too if you need extra help. Passed all his exams with above 90%. The best! I wish he taught calculus :(
He was fine. He just yelled a lot. Not like mad yell... he just talked really loudly for no reason. He also wasn't the best at explaining things.
There is A LOT of homework, but he is super nice, funny and teaches really well!

I'm awful at math and somehow got a B. He gives a lot homework but lots of time to do it, plus it's good practice for tests. He's also funny, which makes math less painful.

Professor Hernandez assigns a lot of homework. If you do the homework you will do well on all the tests. He gives a good amount of tests that aren't that hard. He goes quickly through material but still very good at teaching. If you come to class you will get a good grade.

reviews.comment: I'm VERY bad at math but because of him, I made it through. I will definitely choose him to teach me math again given the opportunity. If you are not great at math I strongly recommend him. There is a lot of homework but just think of it as practice for the exams.

This is the math class/teacher for people who aren't very good at math but need the credit. He's good at explaining problems and makes it as interesting enough. There's a lot of homework, but if you do the homework you'll do good on the test, I missed a lot of class and just did homework and I got an A-. He gives partial credit on test questions
Class isn't mandatory, but you should go. Topics are easy but his lectures really help you understand the concept. 3-4 tests, with a final. Online homework but no textbook.

While attendance isn't necessarily mandatory, he will sometimes take it if there's a noticeable number of students absent. Easy homework on each section. I think he does a good job of explaining the problems and teaching the class. I'd definitely take him for any other math course.

He wants to make sure that the whole class gets what he is teaching. He is also hilarious while he is in class. Explains everything really well. Make sure you do all the homework on time

reviews.comment: Prof Hernandez is very sweet and helpful. Always announces office hours and opportunities for students who need extra help. The lectures are pretty routine and he jumps right into it. Sometimes it can be hard to keep up, so if you find yourself lost seek help before it's too late.

Super funny and energetic! he makes sure that the class understands what is going on at all times and if you have any questions, he'll be happy to answer all of them after class or during his office hours. overall great prof, but dont skip too many classes or you will not pass the tests. and take advantage of review days!
Omg he's awesome! The best math teacher I've had in my entire life! I am super bad at math but he definitely lets you know what he expects from you. Take him if you have the opportunity! :)
You can tell he genuinely wants his students to do well. He gives a lot of hints during class as to what will be on the exam and what won't.

Great professor, would 100% take him for all of my math classes. He is clear, has review sessions, and is always willing to help. Math is hard but totally makes it tolerable. Attendance is not required, but please go because if you are failing, he will help you out.
Speeds through lectures No patience

By far the best math teacher I've ever had. He takes his time with the material and explains everything clearly. His tests are mostly comprised of the problems solved in class. He gives extra credit on the tests. Expect a lot of homework, but if you do it consistently it's bearable. He sometimes takes attendance. Definitely recommend him.

Professor Hernandez since Day 1 emphasizes that if you ever need help to see him after class and not wait till finals are around the corner to see what extra credit you can do. He offers extra credit in all his exams and as long as you take notes "word for word" you will pass his class. He explains everything clearly. Best Math teacher I've had!!
Be prepared to do a LOT of homework, but this will be very helpful as he takes questions from the homework for the exams. Very helpful, funny, and good looking too. Take him!

Professor Hernandez is clear and efficient in teaching math. He is very organized and presents everything in a crystal clear manner. Though his tests were a bit tough, I would definitely take him again if given the chance!

Well he is a teacher that just writes straight out of the book and tells you that you don't need to read the book. He just write the problems down and explains it so fast that you have no time to write down and listen what is actually happening. Then when your are copying the work down he erases it once your almost finished. Won't recommend. TRUST.

I would have enjoyed more class participation or group projects rather than just lectures. Also, please stop using MyMathLab. It's horrible.

Awesome teacher, I hate math but with his really clear teaching you'll easily get at least a B. A lot of hw to do online which can be a pain but definitely helps you do well on the tests. Pretty funny in class also, keeps people really interested during his lectures.
More than willing to help, he's young (and very good looking) and is easy to connect with. Does a really good job of being realistic and teaching you what you need to know and that's all.
He is amazing. He does his best to explain the problems. He does care about teaching ! Take him, he is also hilarious !
Real fun/funny professor. Always holds review sessions the week of the test. Makes math easier to understand. Not an easy A, but definitely an easy B.

Highly recommend this professor. He gives you notes on the board that if you study them you will do well on the tests. Also you do NOT need a textbook but you'll need to buy an online code for homework. do the online quizzes not mandatory but will help you get an A!

Sergio is the best!! I found him very funny and very interesting. His teaching is clear and makes sure his class understands the content. He is also VERY helpful (sacrifices his time for review sessions for tests). For MTH105, it isnt recommended to skip classes because the course is 2 semesters of precalc in 1. So don't miss class for no reason!!

Good teacher, lectures were clear and homework was not graded. Tests were of inconsistent difficulty, however - one would be incredibly easy, with a large amount of the class acing it, and the next would be terribly difficult and too long.

Best math teacher. Explains everything simple and very clear. A lot of homework which is on the online website but it prepares you really well for the class. Take this guy. I struggle in math but between his HW and his teaching style (very clear) I got an A. Was prepared for every test. Guy is awesome.

I'm so glad I had him for MTH 101. He's a great teacher and gets that most people are in the class bc it's required. He really enjoys math and it's a fast class, but he does stop & ask if we all get it. Has good office hours and is very available. Wants his class to succeed! Take him!

He is an amazing teacher. I hate math and I actually looked forward to his class. He is helpful and will take time to explain things to you, whether it's during class or his office hours. I absolutely loved this professor, my favorite one this semester.
Very good professor. He makes math enjoyable and explains things in a simple way that's easy to understand. His tests are not difficult but homework is mandatory. Very helpful and funny. Take him!
Good teacher. Very smart and helpful. He prepares you well and is a nice guy.
Great teacher. helpful, clear, knows the subject. Funny and friendly as well, definitely recommend.

He is the best math teacher i've ever had in my life! I don't understand why he doesn't teach calc 1 !! !.. If you have to take this course take him! he explains very good, he sometimes goes fast but if you practice with the hw you'll get the information easily! Go to office hours and show interest and he'll be very helpful!
he is the best teacher ever. he explains everything so clear. he made me actually enjoy doing math. he is the greatest every student should take him
I hate math and I'm terrible at it, yet somehow I got an A+ in his class. I attribute every single aspect of that grade to his teaching abilities.
