She gives a fair amount of assignments to boost your grade if you don't do well on the essays (as long as you put a little effort in them you'll get 10/10s on them), but her essay grading is very confusing. Says she's looking for one thing in an essay but judges it on another. Solid professor, but there's better options.

Professor HM is a very kind and caring professor and one of the best English professors at UM. She really takes the time to get to know her students and makes class decently exciting. Assignments for this class are quite easy yet tedious, but she is quite accommodating and a relatively easy grader. Definitely take her course if given the chance.

YOU MUST PARTICIPATE
I was unsure about Professor HM at first but I ended up loving her. I have 100% learned how to become a better writer in her class. She is genuinely a caring person and likes to check up on her students. Sometimes she starts off the class with discussions outside of the material and I love it. Take her you will NOT regret it.

she's ok. There's def worse options. She grades the essays super tough. U better be a good writer in her class. There is HW due every period, but that's most English classes. She is super sweet during class tho and reviews a lot of concepts. I feel like my writting just stayed the same with her. She tries to keep it as interesting as possible.
Amazing class and great professor. So much fun!

I actually became a better writer in this class. Even though the topics were based on our lives (which made it more interesting) we still learned how to become more academic and interesting. Not bad at all! Super caring and organized too.

She is such a cute teacher! She's very very nice and makes class interesting and applicable to life. Journals are easy, and her rubrics for papers/projects are very clear. She also gives the opportunity to do extra credit during the semester. I don't like English/writing, but she made it interesting/easy to get into the topics. RECOMMEND!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The homework was always based on the readings assigned. There was only a total of 3 papers, and a final group project. Her grading was tough but with enough feedback you could continue to improve your essay grades. Attendance was graded as well as participation. She was a great teacher who was kind. Her explanation for everything was always clear!

Professor H-M is a really nice person, but not that great of a teacher. Attendance is mandatory, but classes are kind of pointless. Not an interesting class, but the structure of my essay's got a lot better. Made us still do a group project even though we were online. Lots of busywork. Don't take this class if you're looking for an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor HM was an amazing teacher. I learned so much from her class. I learned how to better analyze and think critically about different subjects. I would definitely take her class again.

Absolutely loved Prof HM! Took her 8 am bc it fit with my schedule. Her lectures can be boring, but she puts us in groups to do activities that take up time in class. She calls on you if you don't participate, but she's also understanding that it's an 8am class. Not too much hw, usually just some readings that we discuss in class. Easy grader!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I had a great experience with this professor. Shes available for help outside of class, and I would recommend her to friends. Would take again!

I thought Professor H-M was great. Fun personality. She gave good assignments and showed real-world examples which you can tell she gets genuinely excited about. She game me good advice during her office hours. I did all the assignments so it made things easy (as it always does).

She spends almost every class doing boring lectures where she drifts from the subject matter and just talks about herself. She clearly has favorite students, and holds grudges. I missed the first class of the semester and she seemed to hate me for the entire rest of the semester. She didn't grade by her rubrics either on essays.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hospital-Medina is a mediocre teacher. She adjusted to the virus not too well and she still assigned her project. She is also a tough grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Although she is a really nice lady, Profesor HM was a very disappointing teacher. Her lectures were incredibly dull, and she struggled to engage the class. She provided confusing feedback on papers and basically told me she couldn't help me when I tried to learn more after class once. She also didn't put a single grade in the whole year

Professor HM overall is a good teacher! She's a tough grader on the first essay, but just make sure to go to her office hours and she will tell you what she likes. Her class can get dry if no one participates.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: I probably wouldve done better if my high school English teachers were as good as professor H-M. Im glad I had this class.
Professor HM helped me out so much. She actually takes the time to give writing feedback. i enjoyed her classes and she's pretty innovative. She's super friendly and always willing to help.

Professor HM is okay. I didn't personally feel like I learned anything about writing, which is the point of the class. Her lectures were usually kinda boring. She gave grades based on how she felt, not a rubric, which was annoying because I didn't know how I could improve. She is a decent option for this class compared to the other options

The best English professor at UM. Is willing to work one on one in office hours and gives great feedback on essays. I believe that after taking her class that I am a much better writer. Attendance counts and do blog posts.
Great professor! This class is an easy A as long as you can write a decent paper. Show up to class, you only get 3 unexcused absences. You don't learn much actual material in the class though.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Gives good feedback on essays and actually reads every single essay (the whole thing) that everyone submits. Fair grading. However, class is extremely relaxed and laid back, and so is Professor Hospital-Medina. Lectures are usually just empty stuff to pass class time and I don't think she has ever stood up once from her chair. Didn't learn much.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Professor HM is awesome. If you take the time to learn more about her she is really cool, down to earth, and funny. The class isn't a ton of work, but attendance is mandatory and you do need to participate. She is kind of a tougher grader than you would expect from her in class persona, but if you go to office hours for help you will do well.

She's an awesome professor. Always making goofy jokes during class & keeping everyone engaged. Make sure to participate, because that's accounted for in your grade. She does grade papers a little more difficult than you'd expect based on class, but it's still super easy to do well. Really interesting class topic

She makes everything she can to makes the lectures interesting so we can enjoy and participate. Explains everything well. If you have any questions go to her office hours, she will definitely help you, but let her know before because she might not be there. Just do the work and you will be fine.
I feel way more prepared to write essays now and to sound more professional and creative. She makes activities interesting too.
You WILL learn to write and to write well. Makes the boring interesting. Fair grader. Good experience.

Prof. HM genuinely cares about her students. Her classes were always interesting. They left me thinking about stuff for the rest of the day. She is really innovative and encourages her students to think critically and write clearly. A lot of the lessons are actually fun. Fair grader. I def learned a lot. Would totally take her class again.

One of my favorite professors at UM and definitley one of the hottest, fair grader and gives great feedback. She really wants to help the students improve their writing. One of the best in the department!
Not the most friendly, and sometimes condescending but is decent. Class was boring and assigned 4 papers for the semester. Relatively hard grader. Wouldnt take again.

Pretty interesting topic but some of the reading material was questionable. Not often available for help and even when she is, she will tell you everything looks fine but then grade differently.  Classes go by pretty quickly and are interesting. Very unclear about how much each assignment is worth. Don't bother doing extra credit that she offers.
Good teacher. First english class I got an A in. Grades more harsh on first paper then gets easier.

There are a lot of really terrible english professors at UM, but this woman is great.  Her assignments are very clear and easy.  You have three papers, all of which are slightly different, but if you're a decent writer you'll get at least an A-.  Blog posts, participation, and the final group project help bring up your grade.  Take her if you can.

Great and relatable professor. If you participate and hand in quality work, you should get an A. Best of all: NO FINAL!!! Your grade is based on 3 papers, 1 group project at the end of the semester, a few blog posts, and participation. I would highly recommend this professor!
Online classes often, multiple choice exams (4), lots of memorization, career support outside of class, a few group presentations, highly recommend.
Loved her, amazing person and teacher. I recommend taking her 100%. All exams are straight forward and super easy. Make sure to do your projects in time as it can take a long time!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very easy class with 2-3 group projects that are easy and fun. Teacher is nice and understanding. Tests are exactly as the lectures.
Memorize the notes and you will get a 100 on every test. Probably one of the nicest prof I have had at this school. Group projects super easy.

Professor Raniero is one of the best professors I have ever had. She is organized, knowledgeable, and genuinely cares about her students. Her classes are clear, fair, and engaging, with great guest speakers. She is also very approachable and supportive, and even helped connect me with people for internship opportunities. 100% take her.

Professor Raniero cares a lot about her students and structures the class in a way that is very organized and easy to follow along. The long classes can be intimidating and long, but she never makes you stay the whole time and gives you valuable breaks. Her real-life experience shines through and the guest speakers are incredible

Professor Raniero, an exceptional professor, is both knowledgeable and caring. She is undoubtedly the best professor teaching Business Tech. With extensive experience in the field, she also invited numerous remarkable guest speakers to class, sharing valuable insights and knowledge that greatly benefited the business students.

Professor Raniero is an incredibly caring and engaging professor who truly wants her students to succeed! Her lectures align perfectly with group projects and exams, making the material better to understand. Exams are fair and based on class content, no suprises. This course sparked my interest in taking more bus tech classes. 100% take her class!!
Great teacher, well taught course. She understands how we want to spend our time and doesn't waste it. If she can end class early she will. Also has good guest speakers

Professor Raniero was a great teacher. She really cared about her topic and she made it very easy to understand what was going to be on the test. Not only does she care, she loves to interact with the students.
Professor illaria is an amazing professor that tries to give real professional advice and knowledge , I love her group projects and extra credit opportunities !

100% TAKE HER! Her class is comprised of three exams, two group projects, one hw, and attendance. The exams are super easy. Group projects too, just find some chill people to work with. She has a very cool background in IT and AI and has engaging lectures as well a guest speakers. Although I'm not majoring in IT I left her class interested in IT!

Professor Raniero's class was interesting and engaging. She is very caring for her students and is always there for any questions you might have. I enjoyed the 2 group projects we had and the tests weren't difficult either if you review the slides.

100% take her. Took the 3hr class. She gave breaks, taught interesting stuff, and was  kind. This is the only BTE class that you won't here complaints about busy work or bad tests. Tests (three mini ones) are super easy if you read her slides. She gives extra credit too and 2 projects is the only homework (she gives generous time to complete them).

Professor Raniero is an excellent instructor who makes Business Technology both engaging and manageable. The course is structured around three equally weighted exams and two group projects. Exams are very fair if you prepare, Overall, she creates a supportive, well-organized learning environment and is one of the best professors I've had

Professor Raniero is an excellent instructor who makes Business Technology both engaging and manageable. The course is structured around three equally weighted exams and two group projects. Exams are very fair if you prepare, Overall, she creates a supportive, well-organized learning environment and is one of the best professors I've had.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Raniero was amazing and very knowledgeable about her topic. I enjoyed her class so much and the group project she assigned wasn't too bad and fun. Would recommend

Very helpful in many ways. I took it as a 3 hr late night class, and she kept it light and entertaining. The exams are easy if you study a bit, and the group projects aren't pressured that much. I would recommend this professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment:
took it as a 3 hour night class and she often let us out early
exams were fairly easy
she also gave a lot of extra credit
She's an amazing professor and gives good career advice. She can help you with your career if you ask

Professor Ilaria Raniero was excellent. Covered all material well. Everything on tests was stated beforehand and was straightforward. Group Projects were very engaging. Overall great teacher and really cares for her students, I would highly recommend.

Prof. Raniero was my favorite professor last semester. She is new but extremely kind, receptive, and was as engaging as she could be given the boring curriculum. Her exams were incredibly easy and she gave clear directions on what to study beforehand. The project is a bit tedious, but I highly recommend her over other professors for this course.

I took this class at night and the Professor tried everything to make it as interesting and interactive as possible. We had guest speakers as well as small Kahoot questions during class time. She cares about her students successes. I would recommend taking her because she as an interesting and impressive background in the workforce.

Professor Ilaria wants nothing but the best for her students! She's extremely knowledgeable in her field and passionate about sharing her experience with students. She's always open to answering questions and is understanding and willing to work with students. She genuinely has made BTE210 my favorite class overall here at UM!
Genuinely amazing person. One of my favorite teachers I've had. Always kind and made class engaging and interactive.

I loved this class! The professor took the time to get to know us and she brought in entrepreneurs with hands on experience. She is a business executive and shared industry knowledge that we wouldn't get from the other professors. She was also available to help me with my career and personalized coaching. I definitely recommend Professor Raniero!

She is a good professor, the class itself is pretty easy. Except 2 group projects which are a lot of work and wish it wasnt so much of grade because group members dont do work. Just go to class and study quizlet for exams, not hard at all.
Professor does not understand the course material. Reads off a slideshow for the entire class period. The worst class that I have taken by far. Avoid this professor.

She is new to teaching and she is all over the place. She seems to be a nice person, but she is not knowledgeable about the subject matter at all often lost in the material. Me and many other regret taking this class with her when she was added last minute and we could not go to other section.
The exams are somewhat challenging at times but the practice exams and review are very helpful.
Orgo 2 is a hard class in general, very sweet and understanding man but not a great lecutuer but extreamly accessible out of class for explanations, read the textbook on my own for 90% of the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of the nicest chemistry professors here at UM. He really wants to help you and gives you his past exams to study from before yours. He isn't a great lecturer, moves super slowly, and expects you to learn a lot on your own. If you had Cesar for orgo 1, this is the biggest adjustment ever, but it is doable, just a lot of learning on your own.
One of the most caring chemistry professors in the school.

He is the sweetest professor ever; he will help you out during the exams if you participate, and he cares about what he is teaching. He gets all over the place and loses his point sometimes, but as long as you follow along, you will understand. Take 101 for an easy stem cognate.

He really cares about his students, but I found it so difficult to pay attention during his lectures because he goes off topic a lot into things you don't really need to know for the exams. There isn't a lot of homework, and it's easy to do well if you just do the practice problems in the textbook.

Professor Hilaire goes through material in a slow, organized and clear manner to ensure that students really UNDERSTAND the material. He helps students really learn, not memorize how to solve problems. His class is graded based on participation, 3 exams (1 is dropped) and a final. His exams are extremely similar to in-class problems and posted work

Dr. Hilaire is a great professor and very accessible during office hours to explain anything. The TA Karsten was absolutely amazing and was very helpful during office hours, and hosted review sessions before every exam that really saved me. Orgo I is difficult, but I definitely recommend taking it with him.
Tests weren't hard. I didn't go to class, but I felt prepared by workshops. The TA was really strange, though, and was unhelpful/did not know what he was doing. I recommend going to the workshop!!

Many students dislike St. Hilaire because he expects you to learn a lot of the material on your own. However, the expectations are clear even though the tests are difficult. He genuinely wants his students to succeed and will curve exams and the final grade to be fair. If you go to his office hours, you WILL succeed. Not an easy A, though.
sorry but take cesar even if it's at 8 AM

Easy material, do the practice exams and look at the study guides he posts and you will pass. Reach out to him if you think he made a mistake on your exams. Lectures are slow so it is likely best to learn with outside material. Overall easy course.
Not that hard of a grader but is very disorganized, listen in lab because he tells you instructions and doesn't give you a written copy.
He makes Chemistry less intimidating and will help you to succeed in the course. He actually cares about the students and will take the time to do zoom lessons. Just take him, you will learn.

Professor Hilaire is a good chem teacher however, he is a bit disorganized. Your grade is comprised of homework, 4 midterm exams (none of which he drops), and a cumulative final. He is nice and is willing to help you but be prepared to study a lot for his exams, especially the final.

Funny teacher, loves you if you participate. Accent can make him a little hard to understand but he is more than happy to repeat himself. Skips some of the intro stuff so if you have never taken chemistry before, be prepared to do some self teaching or get a tutor like I did!

He's not a terrible professor, but he does kind of sound like he's speaking nonsense sometimes during lecture. The good news is he does care about his students and is willing to meet with you. I would've rather taken the 8am class with Cesar instead because he actually explains material better. Overall not bad, but could find a better prof instead.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: St. Hilare is a chill guy and a nice professor. However, he does not teach during class and is extremely disorganized. Read the textbook to suceed and do past CHM 221 exams. Only come to office hours if you need help and do all the problems in the textbook. The class is self-taught. Not a great teacher. Would recommend taking Gonzalez.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: St. Hilaire is a nice professor. This class is difficult and is essentially self taught. I'm glad I took it with Hilaire because of his good vibes. If you actually want to learn the material: take the time to learn from the HW, go to as many workshops as you can, and form study groups. Don't rely on the curve it's a bad mindset.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Super easy material + great articulate teacher + little homework + pretty easy test

I recommend Prof Hilaire. The class was tough, but he tries to make it as manageable as possible. He gives out optional worksheets, study guides, and exam answers, so you have a lot of practice and know what you did wrong. He also gave a curve. His slides are a lot and he goes kind of slow, but do the work and you will pass.

Genuinely caring and very knowledgeable about chem. kind of disorganized which can be frustrating and exams sometimes have things that you wouldn't expect, but if you go to his office hours and study what he says to he's very lenient and you'll end with a good grade. His lectures were rly helpful for me and he's funny so fs attend!

honestly the most caring and understanding stem professor ive had. had a situation during the semester and he was so accomodating. gives barely any hw and his exams are straightforward so do his reviews. doesnt take attendance but i dont reccomend missing lectures. curves exams and lets you do corrections!! take him if you can!!!

Professor St. Hilaire is reasonable, funny, and accessible. He is the best professor in the department and would highly recommend him for any chem course. But get ready to study because the material is dense and tricky. Tests in his courses are very difficult but are just more complicated versions of the concept at hand.

He gives random iClicker quizzes. Really disorganized and easily distracted during lectures and forgets to cover all test material. His explanations are hard to understand but he provides study guides, practice exams, test reviews, and corrections. Watch examples on youtube. Better than other professors for CHM 110 but not great.
Bro gave lectures OVER SPRING BREAK. and class always went a few minutes long. These things were consistently annoying. Other than that not a bad teacher.

I wouldn't recommend St. Hilaire. He is unorganized and expects you to learn material he does not cover on your own. He held zooms during spring break to teach and spends too much time on one concept and tangents which don't let him cover all he needs to. Passing the class isn't that hard since you have test corrections.

This class was a ride. I would 100% take him out of all teachers due to super easy grading. He will teach the first 2-3 chapters, then become unorganized and lose track. From there he will heavily curve exam 2 and 3 and add 20 points if not more of EC on the final. Taught myself all the material, if you can do that you'll get an A, if not a B or C

He records every class and has an online option, but sometimes it can be hard to follow online. He offers 50% corrections on each test and as long as you complete the practice exams you'll be fine. The lectures can be very long, but if you pay attention and take notes. It is not the same content as 103, it is more like a mini orgo.

He's kind and understands if you need to reschedule an exam, etc. I mostly taught myself the material but he was a very fair grader. you can get 50% of your points back by doing test corrections on anything you got wrong and you can drop one exam.

Valentine was a great professor. He provided pratice exams and held review sessions before each exam. His exams had a CRAZY curve because he allowed revisions. If you could not go to lecture he held a zoom. Would 1000% take him again.

St. Hilaire is the best prof to have for Orgo 2. He teaches really well and wants his students to succeed and really makes an effort for us to understand the material. There are 3 exams & 1 final. He gives some extra credit and has test corrections, so we can get better grades. Take him! He is the best option and an amazing professor.

Although he is a little disorganized, overall hes a good teacher and attendance is not mandatory and you also have the option to join virtually. Tests are super easy and he drops the lowest at the end of the semester. One of the easiest science classes i have taken at UM

Prof. St.Hilaire is such a great person and an awesome professor! He is always willing to help and goes out and beyond for his students which is rare. He wants his students to really understand the material. I learned a lot in this class and have enjoyed it! Overall, I definitely recommend taking any chem class with him! You will for sure learn!
had him for HHMI lab with diresta and they were both helpful. No quizzes, presentations. And they helped us with our lab and gave feedback. Both are chill and would highly recommend them for HHMI
He has lots of office hours in person and online. Can over explain topics which sometimes confused me. He provided practice exams and rarely homework. I wish he taught 121!

If you have to take CHM 103 make sure it's with St. Hilaire!!! SUPER awesome guy, and actually understands that chem is hard for students. Exams are super straight forward, gives assignments multiple attempts so you actually understand, and will work with you if you struggle. (Don't waste money on the book though.)

He is easily the nicest professor I had this semester. His tests are not hard at all but even if you dont do well he offers corrections. For 110 he barely gave any HW too. Sometimes he goes into way too much detail on simple things but its in the best light. Def take him if you can

If available, TAKE HIM. Retook Orgo 2 with him and ended an A :) but overall this class was way easier than taken it online with 4 professor teaching one course in a disorganized fashion. I'd advise waiting to do orgo 2 just to take it with him. I promise you would NOT regret having this professor.

Professor Hilaire was the only reason I passed Orgo 2. Anytime I needed help with my test corrections or literally anything at all he was there. He wants his students to succeed but he's not oblivious to the fact that orgo 2 is probably the hardest undergrad class at UM. I'm grateful I even passed because I struggled the entire semester.

He is so sweet and does not want you to fail. Is very accommodating and is forgiving of mistakes. There is no doubt that he is one of the kindest professors I've had. But, lectures were disorganized and hard to follow, and orgo 2 is a hard subject to teach yourself. Spent more time out of class trying to learn the material rather than practice
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: 2nd time taking orgo 2. Wish I took it with him first.Many students failed exams and he allowed test corrections. He was ALWAYS accessible to discuss and talk outside of class. Truly an amazing individual. During lecture he can be very confusing but study the textbook.Curve at the end was good because we all failed the final. Written Response exams

It can seem like what he's saying is complicated, but ITS NOT. He takes forever to talk about one topic but only because he is very thorough, so don't get scared. Thats what makes his 110 class so simple. It's just basic math, all you need to do is practice practice practice. Very nice, accessible, and curves generously. TAKE HIM, he's great.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. St. Hilaire is an absolute KING. He was super caring and funny - always told us stories about his past jobs and things. Dr. Hilaire genuinely cared about us. He even offered to help me with my CHM 121 work if I needed it. I will definitely be taking him for CHM 222!

He can be a bit all over the place but he genuinely makes his class so easy for his students. You don't even have to show up to class, but make sure to always learn the material because the tests will be hard if you don't know anything. He provides study guides and always records his lectures on Blackboard.

had him for hhmi lab with diresta and they were the best professors for the lab. we did not see him that much because we saw diresta more but when we did he was very nice and was willing to help with our project when needed. super chill

St. Hilaire is a pretty good prof. I had him for HHMI Lab so I suspect he's a bit different in labs than lecture classes. He's pretty nice and can be funny at times (if your humor is broken) but if you don't already have some lab background, it can be hard to navigate the class because he expects you to have a general understanding.

This man is a legit legend. Super funny, you can talk to him so casually about anything. Absolutely amazing for HHMI, so much fun! He does a lot to help out with the HHMI projects. Ask him for a compound you need, and he'll stop what he's doing and will go grab it for you. St. Hilaire's care for his students is unmatched, he is truly the best!!!!!!
Awesome professor!!! Gives extra credit on exams. If you miss a class he records all the lectures. Will accommodate you if you cant make an exam.
St. Hilaire is the BEST!!! I had him for HHMI labs and he was the most uplifting and kind professor I have ever had. I would recommend him to everyone!

I did not take AP Chem in high school because it has never been my best subject, but I have actually learned a ton from this class. His lectures are very thorough and he cares that you really understand the topic more than just if you get a good grade. Definitely take him if you can and especially before CHM 121 if you haven't taken AP Chem.

Nice professor. He tries to use lectures to explain the topics until you understand, but sometimes it is repetitive. The topics are fairly easy to learn, and there are only about 5-6 chapters for whole course. As long as you follow along in some lectures and do the posted exam reviews, should be just fine.

The professor was nice and repeated topics so we can understand more. Few assignments and the rest are exams. He was too nice on his exams. Straightforward questions. No book needed. Youtube videos and attending lectures should get you a good grade.

Only orgo teacher at the school that doesn't actively try to trick you. His exams are straightforward and if you put in the work an A is actually possible, unlike with some of the other orgo teachers. Hes a cool guy, responds to emails, and was helpful in office hours. He should be your #1 choice for your orgo professor.
Not a difficult class, he breaks everything down to the basics. If you haven't taken AP Chem, recommend taking this before taking CHM121. Also he has a cool accent lol

This man is a very nice guy but do not take his class if you are not able to teach yourself all of the material. His lectures were SO unorganized that I was not able to follow anything he said during them. If you have to take him - make better use of your time and just self-study. He also has never answered a student email.

Good person and teacher. His lectures are basically him talking to himself through the ppt. He encourages participation but not graded. Tests are hard, but its to be expected, just be above the average and you'll be fine. He curves. His office hrs are NOT mandatory but are HEAVILY recommended, and almost a must if u want to get an A. I didnt tho.

Dr. St. Hilaire is a really great guy. I had a horrible chem background coming into here, but I aced every test! His class was definitely disorganized and a bit hard to follow, but I figured it out at the end of the day. He is always willing to help out a student and accommodate you!

Dr. St. Hilaire was often repetitive but only so that we could understand concepts better. He was also a bit disorganized and had a bit of a confusing grade book, but was otherwise caring about his students. If you took AP Chem in high school, the material will come easy to you but pay attention to the lectures anyway.

I took IB DP chem in high school and decided to take this as part of my STEM cognate. It was a really basic chem class, only covered 6 textbook chapters in the whole semester. Don't pay for ALEKS because it doesn't hurt your grade if you don't do it. He seems to really care about students learning the material, just super disorganized!!

This class was the most unorganized class that I've had all semester. He's never firm with any due dates and tells students different information about exams. I don't even know my grade because he's terrible with the grade book. I basically had to teach myself the lessons because his lectures are useless. He also never responds to emails.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Pretty good professor. Lectures are boring and he goes over the same material so many times but he really wants you to understand it. He's also very accessible outside of class. Tests are super easy.

I love this professor. The class was very hard, especially since I can barely do algebra... I had to memorize every word on his slides. If you are really bad at math and have bad reading comprehension then take this class before 121.
Amazing.

Great Teacher and actually cares about students. Study guides and problem sets are very helpful. CHM 222 is very difficult but manageable. Just make sure to go to class everyday and also get a tutor. He is the best professor for CHM 222.

This class is largely overrated. Prof. Scharf's material is completely unusable in the real world. reviews.comment: He is very lecture-heavy, but if you pay attention and take notes (he provides a digital outline for every class a few days beforehand) you will get a good grade. He is very strict about phones, but other than that he is a chill guy.
Best professor. Pay attention and you'll get an A.

One of my favorite professors at the university. Lectures are intense and very quick. Although he doesn't take attendance you still need to go to class to get notes. Cares about his students and cancels class often. Tests easy enough if you study notes and group projects at end of the year. Take him
interesting lectures that prepare you well for quizzes

Professor Scharf is an excellent teacher. I had him in the fall for MKT 201. His homeworks were easy, tests were 100% fair and he was super nice. The group project in my opinion was actually pretty interesting. I highly recommend professor Scharf.

Professor Scharf is PHENOMAL. He is a great teacher, is always willing to help you, and is incredibly clear about course material. His tests are not hard if you study the course outlines he gives you, however they often contain A LOT of info. Best teacher/professor I've ever had by far. So glad I took him for MKT 340 and MKT 201.

He is one of the nicest and most genuine teachers you will find at the University of Miami. Very straightforward in terms of the structure of the course is 3 exams and one group project, but as long as you attend the lectures, you will be more than prepared. Highly recommend any class he has!

I cant understate how much I loved having his class. He might be intimidating at first but he always very clear about what he wants from students. reviews.comment: Definitely one of the best professors I've had here. Really passionate about sales and cares for his student's success. This class isn't only good for sales but for other business ventures, making friends, and even with girls from Scharf's body language tips. Tips for success: Study the headings, write down everything, study an hour/day for 3-7 day

Professor Scharf is the best professor I've had in my three years of college. He really gets students interested in the lectures and engaged, and keeps class entertaining. Always available to explain grades to students and helpful with feedback. Very good sense of humor too, I wish I had more classes I would be able to take with him in the future.

Professor Scharf is the best. Attendance is said to be mandatory but not really. He clearly structures his classes and gives you the information you need to ace his class. He gives extra credit on all of his exams and will occasionally cancel class. He is just a nice guy who wants his students to do well. Definitely take his class!

Professor Scharf is a wonderful teacher. Although content heavy, his lectures are clear and concise. He is completely transparent about test materials which means that if you study hard, you will get good grades on tests. Sometimes the lectures are a little fast, however he is glad to repeat himself. TAKE SCHARF IF YOU CAN!!!!

I took his retailing class in Spring 2022. Fantastic teacher and very straight forward. Notes are super easy to take down and concise. Before every exam he tells you what in the textbook you should read and what parts/pages you can skip. His expectations are super clear. Zero complaints about the teacher. You will have group projects.

Great teacher, very straightforward, and all the notes are directly related to the tests. Offers lots of opportunities to get a better grade, such as optional classes to get extra points on the next test. 

I will say that some may not like his teaching style, as it's just copying notes down most of the class, but he's not a harsh grader.

Probably the most straightforward class you can take. Exams have a lot of content but everything is directly covered during his mostly simple lectures. If you show up and copy his notes you'll get an A.

I have never written a review but Scharf is my favorite professor at UM. He is engaging, cares about his students, and everything he talks about in class is on one of his 3 exams throughout the semester. He gives a lot of extra credit and the exams are straight from lecture notes. He is very organized and wants his classes to succeed.
By far my favorite teacher at UM, smart as can be and has a photographic memory, attendance is not mandatory but will know if you don't go. follow lectures and tests will not be super complicated

Best professor I've had. If you take great notes on his lectures and memorize them you will ace both exams. Lectures are engaging. He is a master of MKT. Partner project is doable and ask for his feedback/advice. Take Scharf for as many classes as possible - he is great.

The man has an unbelievable memory. He must have hundreds of students, along with the hundreds or thousands of people he interacts with for his other full-time job as a salesman, yet he will learn every student's first and last name within a week or two, even when we had masks on.
Sometimes a little annoying with class protocol but otherwise great prof

Would definitely recommend Professor Scharf. Really nice and good teacher. Class is reasonable on work however very consistent and straight forward. He's easy to reach outside of class and normally ends class relatively early.

Prof is an awesome guy and really knows his stuff. He's always willing to have a conversation and has a lot of valuable advice. 3 exams and one project so if you study for them you should be completely fine.

As a freshman, Scharf is the best professor I've had this semester. Very fair with grades in my opinion. Lectures are pretty fast paced but manageable. If you study on quizlet with all the vocab for the exams you'll do well.

Very good knowledgable professor. Positives- interesting lectures, really feel like you are learning important things. Negatives- prefers handwritten notes and he goes fairly fast, attendance super mandatory, phone use prohibited, short answer exams are more difficult.

He's so nice. And you can reach out to him whenever and he's super understanding of everything. Really easy and fast class. You learn a lot and at the same time class isn't hard, neither are the tests.

Ian Sharf is a great professor!! As a freshman it was great having him, very straightforward. Hands down the best professor at UM, there is no one like him. He is amazing at what he does. Prof. Scharf is one of the best. Pay attention to class and the exams will be easy.

Professor Scharf is amazing! His lectures are not long and boring, he throws in funny and worthwhile stories. There's no homework. There's 3 tests that are a piece of cake if you take notes. I definitely recommend taking him!

Scharf is a good professor. Personally I don't like his style of teaching. You have to memorize everything he says and spit it back out on exams. The content is not that useful in my opinion either. Great and smart guy though.

Scharf is a great professor who cares about his students' success. He's strict but very engaging, I learned a lot. You have to go to class and take extensive notes to pass, but it's worth it.

such an interesting guy definitely recommend!! so cool to listen to the classes were fun to hear and he is so helpful

reviews.comment: Amazing professor and person, the tests only require rote memorization.

he's not very friendly or understanding with personal problems but he is a good teacher. people love him because he's very straight forward and clear cut. exams are kind of difficult but as long as you study and do your work you're fine

Scharf is hands down the best professor ever, and his classes are a must take. Scharf has been one of my favorites though out my 3 years here and he is really funny. He is also great person to get a recommendation letter from..

Scharf is the man. He really knows his stuff. This was an amazing class and there is basically no homework. The tests are pretty hard though. You really need to know every single thing from the lectures. Regardless, we learned very important lessons and I would definitely recommend. BEST teacher, best class i've taken thus far... actually learned skills that will help in life. No textbook needed. Must go to class.. but thats how you learn. Test is exactly what he teaches on the outlines just make sure you take the time to study. NO cell phone in class but yu don't need it.. the class is 50 min and feels like 20. Greatest!!

This is my second time taking him; his exams are verbatim to class notes. Memorize his notes word for word--best marketing professor! TAKE HIM!

One of the best teachers I've had. Class is very straight forward and he makes the class enjoyable. The workload is very manageable and the tests are very straightforward. A really fun, easy class.

One of the best professors at UM. His class was very interesting and he gives really valuable tips for interviewing, and conducting yourself in the work place, in a fun and engaging way. This class is must take.. You will learn real tactics. Professor Scharf demands attention but time passes by quickly.  He is the Best professor in the MKT Department

He is very intelligent and down to earth.  He makes this class so interesting with his real life stories. He provides his student an outline.  Test will based on those outlines. A lot of memorizing and some videos. One final project (easy), one field trip, 3 exams... He is the Best!

The only professor who is worth the full price it costs to attend Miami.  The only class I look forward to, and I'm not a marketing major.  Disregard your grade, your major, and any other reservations. You will learn more than you could ever imagine with this guy. Simply amazing. Blows my mind every class.

Great professor!!!! LOVED taking him. Very clear straightforward lecture that he even provides a complete outline for. Notes are essential for getting an A in the class. Also provides opportunity for extra credit with marking labs. And follow his rules - don't dare take your cellphone out!!

Scharf is the man! His retailing class is very useful if you plan to someday own a retail store. Class is not hard at all, but you need to do every assignment and attend all his classes as well as the marketing lab in order to secure an A

Scharf is awesome! Retailing management is interesting, fun, and he is a great teacher. one of the best professors at UM. very knowledgeable about the subject. To A this Class MEMORIZE THE LISTS FROM THE OUTLINES and you'll be OK. Final project is easy and fun.

BEST PROFESSORS AT UM! BY FAR!

Very knowledgeable. He's seriously an amazing teacher--one of my favorites!

If you're somewhat interested in geography or culture you will be able to get through the class. The tests are SO specific and focus on small details and each test covers SO much information. You need to read the book and memorize maps. The classes get worse as you go on but some topics are interesting.

The course is super annoying to sit through but you have to attend be/c attendance counts towards the grade, the exams are way to specific although the professor says that it's going to be broad information. Def. study the maps and try to get those points for the exam be/c the rest is multiple choice. you have to study 100's of slides,ewwwwwwwww

Not a bad professor. Tests are multiple choice, need to know the maps. Tests based on lectures and on textbook. Quite biased towards Jews and Israel, but it's a small section of the course, so easy to deal with it. He tries to make it interesting, cracks some jokes, plays music. Easy requirement to get out the way.

He's not a bad teacher, I've had plenty worse. He's easy to understand, and his classes are semi-mandatory, he barely ever passes around an attendance sheet. Tries to make things interesting, cracks a couple jokes here and there. Very biased towards Middle East and Jews - works Jews into every topic

Why? Oh poor soul! did you take that class?But the teacher is horrible!! Seriously...he would be the annoying dork you stay away from in high school. He is completely biased, he basically imposes his opinions on you and expects you to agree with him. The class as a whole is ok,it's pretty easy and you can get a good grade.

If someone tells you that this class is HARD.... they're a moron. It's a very easy class. I didn't study, read the book or go to 1/4 of the classes... I have a high grade in it. He does tend to push his opinions on you, but it's nothing too bad.

Very good teacher, made everything extremely clear. His tests are hard, but fair. He expects you to read the book, and some information from the tests are from the book. Tries to make it funny, plays Abba before class. Good guy, good teacher. Interesting subject.
Extremely hard tests, do not take it with him. Goes way beyond what he is supposed to teach, Mostly teaches his own personal views rather than real facts! Extremely biased about a lot of issues!

Great guy, he tries to make the class as interesting as possible with jokes..but geography is BORING. attendance is part of the grade..PAY ATTENTION in class. There is alot of material on each test, and they are pretty difficult, even with studying I got C's. If you're taking it to fufill a requirement, take something easier like psych/sociology

classes are boring but he marks attendance 15 times so u gotta go cuz it affects ur grade..he basically reads off the slides and gives u a big load of info to study for the tests which are too hard..he requires u to know every single detail..too much for a 100 level class, nice person though but that won't give u an A so take another class :)

HARD tests... for the final i studied probably 30-40 hours... his powerpoints are WAY too detailed and even though he tells you the tests will be "broad information" they are VERY detailed... for example our first question was which language is not of slavic origins on exam #1... who cares?

Chill teacher. His tests are fair if you put forth the effort to study. The map questions are a cinch, just name the country or city that's numbered. All lectures include slideshows, it is very helpful if you bring your laptop and take notes on there or print out the PPS. Extra credit for attendance. Make sure you study the PPS and read the chapter
don't take it with him!!! his test are hard as others have already stated!

its true his text are difficult.. and his powerpoints contain alot of information.. and his class gets really boring..i would study for the test and i still would get C's on them!!!!! take this class with another teacher! trust me!
his powerpoints get a little too detailed, but he makes it very clear during class what you will be tested on. you just have to go to class.
Smart teacher but his class is boring and his tests are hard. Go elsewhere if you want to get a good grade. Getting A is nearly impossible unless you have LOTS of time too study.

Great teacher who knows a lot about his subject. His tests are a little difficult, but if you study you will have no problem passing them. Plus you get points just for showing up. He gives you a lot of interesting facts to think about. If you are looking for some extra knowledge take this class, but not if you are looking for an easy A.

Funny guy. Yes it is true the tests are harder than they should be in a class of this level, but they are not THAT impossible. Class is boring. However if you attend class (attendence is 75 points) and study the notes, you will be fine. The book is only useful for boldface terms. If you are expecting an easy A though, look elsewhere.
as mentioned above he expects people to know every detail of the book and lecture. It is extremly time consuming and the tests are really hard... dont take the class with him!!!
intersting class, taught well. aimed towards the non-major. It is easy and very informative. i recommend him!

As mentioned above this class is one of those alot of people take to satisfy a requirment.  It's hard to believe this guy thinks more time will be spent on his 100 level class than some 300 levels, but it's true.  Watch out for this guy he's a real piece of work--it's definately history + geography, which he makes grueling.

Many students are just trying to meet a social science requirement by taking this class and he makes it very difficult for those which are not pursuing a major in this area. He expects alot of time to be spent on his class. Unless you are willing to spend large amounts of time for this class, take someone else!!
Best professor ever!!!

Dr. Ironson is one of the best professors I've had throughout my entire undergrad experience. Her positive psychology course genuinely impacted the way that I see the world and engage with it. It's a reassuring class because it shows the science of happiness to improve your personal life. Take this class if you want power over your life!

I took this class because I was interested in positive psychology, however she totally ruined it for me. She makes the tests IMPOSSIBLE, genuinely wants you to fail. She is so unorganized as well, offers extra credit and then forgets she did. She is rude if you contradict her about exam Q's, and will offer extra credit only to hand picked students.

Wow never ever take her. I am a straight A student & every assignment she gave me low grades on even after asking specifically what she wants. ZERO knowledge of the internet and  makes it everyone's problem. Mean too. I have accommodations and she tried to embarrass me in front of the class after asking her to repeat herself. Misogynistic as well.

Dr. Ironson is incredibly experienced and has tons of publications. She doesn't need to teach but just does it because she wants to, which makes it a great opportunity to learn from someone so qualified. Tests are very difficult no matter how much you study but she curves them and gives extra credit.

Seniors, if you want a stress-free, happy semester, DO NOT take this class! Dr. Ironson is a genius in her field, very accomplished and genuine. However, her lectures are all over the place, her exams are HARD and TRICKY, and her classes are at times long. Her homeworks are helpful for personal growth but take time to do. Overall, not worth taking.

Dr. Ironson's class, without a doubt, has been the most invaluable & practically applied course throughout my PhD. She taught us specific skills to be effective clinical health psychologists in a medical setting. As soon as I got in a hospital setting, I was far ahead of peers, felt very comfortable & was perceived as an efficacious team member

I would definitely recommend taking this class if you have the chance, it is a lot of writing (4 HW assignments and one long paper) but they are extremely beneficial and fun to work on. The exams are pretty tricky and sometimes her powerpoints are hard to follow, but she is an extremely nice lady and I would take her again.

Dr. Ironson is one of the best professors I have ever had. She is so experienced and has great stories to tell. The material has made a positive impact on my life. The tests are quite tricky, but the homework and attendance count as two test grades. There is also so many opportunities to get up to 10 points extra credit on each exam. TAKE IT!

Dr. Ironson is an accomplished professor; however, I found her positive psychology course a bit lacking. The course material seems more geared towards self-discovery. This was not what I wanted out of the class. I disagree with any class that enforces an attendance policy. That is just a blatant representation of material's lack of rigor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Positive Psychology was an interesting subject that I personally enjoyed. The lectures were boring and professor Ironson doesn't use PowerPoint. Attendance is taken on a sign in sheet every day. Tests are multiple choice, but hard. The questions are fact driven and require lots of memorization. There are also papers of different lengths.
If you get to know her, she's an inspiration. You make the most out of her class. Look up her resume online. It's enough said.

She is an amazing professor with a huge amount of knowledge and experience under her belt. Her health psych and positive psych classes are useful for anyone going into the fields of psych or medicine. As for the difficulty of the class, if you know the material, you'll be fine. By far one of the best professors I've had at UM.

Can firmly say the best professor Ive had in all my college yrs. She has an MD & PhD and knows her material. A respectable & commendable background in her field of studies. Always willing to offer ex. credit to help augment a student's grade. Always makes time to answer questions in & out of class. Has an adorable and welcoming personality.

Can firmly say the best professor I've ever had in all my college yrs. She has an M.D. and PhD and knows her material. Very approachable & willing to make time for her students. Offers extra credit opportunities and will work with you in order to help boost your grade if need be. Very passionate about what she teaches and has an adorable character
Really good teacher and class. Especially if you are interested in medical school or health psychology. One of the few psych classes that I actually found useful.

I really dont understand why people think this woman is a good professor. She reads straight out of the textbook, makes you memorize an ABSURD amount of statistics, and each exam is 80 questions in an hour. She's incredibly smart, but completely condescending and inflexible with grades. By FAR hardest psych class ive ever taken. DO NOT TAKE HER.

I loved this class...it was Positive Psychology. It was kinda hard to remember some of the statistics she wanted us to know, but she seems to genuinely care about us learning and threw out bad questions from the tests and gave us interesting mini assignments and offers alot of extra credit opportunites. Love her!!

This lady is amazing. She's extremely knowledgeable, and is willing to work with you if for some reason you don't do well (which is hard). She is passionate, and has a lot of information useful for the future. Make sure you visit her during her office hours. :o)
took psychologica assesments in med settings - amazing class, you can tell why she's one of the top mind/body researchers in the country.
This women knows her stuff. She explains topics in a straight forward way. I would say to take her class if you can.

This class is hard. Average on midterm was a 46%, could revise for half of what was lost. Labeled as a beginner course, but soon after midterm became far too complex for even the best students. Professor can be nice but is blunt. Class style is odd, most content written by hand, minimal demonstration online. Homework 1.5+ hour each week. Can use AI

The course starts out fine enough, but pretty quickly delves into material too difficult for an introductory coding class. The professor is also not very helpful with questions, and "attendance" is more like a participation grade, so stay engaged. He also seems to hold different standards for some students, so stay on his good side if you can.

More difficult than I thought going in, students with prior coding experience excelled. That being said, he gives you a lot of material to read and ask questions over, and there are a ton of grades in the class, so a couple bombed assignments wont hurt you too much. Decent guy, but comes off as rude to some people

Ineffective teaching style, issues with tone when speaking with students, and does not respond to emails. Unless you're good at teaching yourself or you already have experience with Python, it's not worth the trouble.
avoid taking him at any cost.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: One of my favorite professors I've had, and probably the best prof for 303. Very sweet and caring, always willing to help with good feedback. Straightforward class with helpful assignments and good material to prep for tests. Take her if you can!

She is SUPER nice and caring towards students and it shows. Participation matters a lot as she will grade your exams more generously if you participate. Exams are a tough, but if you study the slides posted on blackboard and make your reference sheet, you'll be golden
Professor is very nice but boring. HW and tests are straight forward cause she posts exam reviews and all lectures

Very sweet professor! She may go a little bit fast in her lectures but truly cares about her students and wanting to improve to make class more engaging and interesting. Exams are straight-forward if you pay attention to the homework assignment and reviews. Would highly reccomend!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Best management teacher you can get. Tests are straightforward and simple, you get a note sheet for each one. Homework is once a week and is basically the same as what is on the test, so its great study material. 10/10 would reccomend

Messy professor. Rude in emails, zero coursework or lecture structure, blames students for poor personal leadership abilities. Lectures not engaging doesn't know any names, but gets upset when attendance is low.
Disorganized lectures, stopped paying attention a third of the way through the semester. Learned more from textbook and homework. Exams are online open note.

This guy was horrible. Mumbles through his lectures and scribbles useless hieroglyphics on his iPad for 75 minutes. I wasn't able to learn a single thing. Only learned from the textbook. DO NOT TAKE HIM IF YOU NEED TO LEARN STATS. All tests were online, though, and long homework assignments were once a week. Not impossible, but definitely useless.

Not gonna lie, the reason I took him is because of a one-star review that said "If you don't know Set Theory, Logic, and Boolean Algebra, DO NOT TAKE." and I'm a math nerd who was salty about having to take stats despite getting a 5 on AP Stats. If you like math, take him because he goes much deeper into the theory than a standard 224 class would.

Stopped going to class and just read the textbook and did homework on my own because I could not stay awake. He kinda just talks to himself and draws stuff on the board. All of the midterms/final were online. If you can take another professor I would. The class wasn't impossible like ppl say I was just too bored to actually try.

Dr. Grigorescu is an incredibly caring professor and wants you to learn the subject, and do well. If you show up to his class and pay attention, you will learn everything you need. I strongly encourage you to participate if you can. Sometimes the lectures may feel slightly unorganized, but he will answer any questions and make sure you understand

Took him for MTH162. The material is really something you will just have to struggle with on your own, however I avoiding him. The lectures were unclear and disorganized. He was very hard to follow and understand and he went off on random tangents very often.

His lectures are very boring and useless since he is very unorganized and starts going on a random tangent for a while. He says he teaches from the book but what ends up on the test is a random fact he mentioned one time. Also, it was very hard to take notes because he would write maybe like 3 or 4 words on the ipad and then immediately swipe up.

I took this guy for MTH 224 and it was horrible. I came in with lots of knowledge because I took AP Stats in high school and passed with a 5 so I thought this class would be easy. Some dude was snoring in my class. Unless you know Set Theory, Logic, and Boolean Algebra, DO NOT TAKE.

"Intro to Probability and Statistics" did not feel like an introductory course AT ALL. Treated the class like we all had Phd's in math like he does. Rambles about random theorems and says they're "common sense" and does not elaborate. Homework takes minimum 2 hours to do, is assigned often, and is graded really hard. AVOID AT ALL COSTS
