reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lots of long lectures and very harsh grader. Very difficult to communicate and work with. Would not recommend
Awful, too critical is fake nice to the students and is just rude plain and simple rude undoubtedly gets off on the little power he has, grades hard too worst of both worlds
Rude. Dumb. Bald. Worst prof at miami
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: If you want to learn and/or get a good grade, avoid this professor. He teaches to boost his own ego, not to help students learn. The course material isn't hard by any means, yet it's quite hard to get a good grade on anything. He wants to teach the class that nobody does well in, evidenced by exams graded largely on semantics not understanding.

Prof Korogodsky is overall a nice guy, but I would never recommend taking his classes. His lectures are all over the place, with random information that is just never talked about again or tested on. He clearly knows his IT stuff well, but as a teacher, I received absolutely no benefit from taking his class and only continued to struggle.
Very chill not too hard. There are activities every class for participation.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Just be active in the class, talk to him. He is chill and very active. You can text or email him anytime, and he gives fast replies. He smiles a lot. Please be active in the group projects. I had to clutch in the final project because none of my teammates contributed much.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: What a joke of an instructor. Would not recommend to any student at UM if you wish to be treated with an inch of respect and courtesy.
Not a tough grader, mainly completion. Group projects were easy and interesting. Would take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: an amazing professor
Super easy

Pretty funny and chill professor. The assignments are very easy and you can barely put in any effort to pass with flying colors, but you must still show up to class. You work with your classmates a lot for various assignments.

By far one of my favorite writing professors at UM! Class was super easy and clear to understand. He gives you great feedback and is easy to contact for help if needed. It consisted of two group projects and papers with clear guidelines and rubric. As someone who likes history I found it very interesting and fun.

This class was by far the easiest class that I have taken at UM. I want to be clear, I have no problem with the professor. However, the course itself taught me absolutely nothing. It focused on archival research which will never come in handy to me one day. It was a very very easy course and he grades most things based on completion.

$7000 to be taught nothing and I mean nothing
One of the more tolerable writing professors in a rough department.

This class has a small workload, with only a couple big papers and barely any homework. Much of the work is through in-class responses that are basically a participation grade. Although the classes can be a bit repetitive, I would still recommend taking it because the professor is great with feedback and the essays are graded relatively easy.

Great professor. The grade is based on in class assignments that are free 100s and two papers (one individual and one group) and he is very willing to help you with assignments, so getting an A is a very attainable goal. You can learn lots from him about the craft of writing.

Trust me, those reviews are not accurate. Right now he probably changed because he is a tough grader who does not take into consideration the work we did, he just cares about dates. If we are not submitting it on time it does not matter if it is a masterpiece. Truly a class I would not recommend to anyone.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: He was an awful teacher. I did not submit in time one homework and I explained my reasons. After that, he judged me and talked to me as if I was an inferior. I do not recommend anyone to take his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: This guys is great. So unserious and funny. Easy class and you should definitely take him.
He's a good professor, pretty okay class. He sticks heavily to his rubric and gives harsh-ish feedback.
Very nice guy and will tell you straight up what you need to fix. Not too easy of a grader but if you do what he is looking for he will give you a good grade

Professor Ly is concise and succinct, and the workload he gives is easily managed. He teaches a lot of new concepts in a very approachable way, and is chill with grading. He is so easily accessible, and always available to message. Sometimes he provides unclear instructions, but he will let you change/makeup grades you are not satisfied with.

Such a cool professor. There is a bit of homework but it is never too much / hard. It is usually just short readings. Do the classwork and write the essays using his feedback + the rubric and you should get a B at least! ATTENDANCE IS MANDATORY!

Ignore the other reviews, they might have been accurate in the past but not now. Nothing is ever good enough for Professor Ly, he will tell you to redo a project a day before it's due and not tell you why. He doesn't take into consideration a student's heavy workload, and never tells students about homework, he just expects them to know about dates
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: This professor cares about your learning. Attendance is important to pass the class, but class is engaging. He has a rubric for his projects and constantly reviews it so everyone understands how they are being graded. He is very accessible. He will always meet with you whenever you need it. Take him if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I had this professor for ENG 105 and ENG 106. He makes the class fun. The lectures are easy to follow if you read the textbook. The class mostly consists of group work. He responds to emails fast and provides good feedback on homework. Honestly, if you follow the rubric, you should get a good grade. Minimum homework and manageable assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment:
BEST PROFESSOR. TAKE HIM. SO EASY AND NICE 
LITERALLY SO PERSONABLE AND WANTS YOU TO DO WELL. HELL MEET WITH YOU ALWAYS. 
took him for eng 105 and 106

Professor Ly is a solid choice for ENG 105 like the others said he grades by a few homework assignments and group work we do together in class, which you all discuss at the end so you can't really get a bad grade on it unless you don't turn it in or don't write a good few sentences. 3 Essays which he even says don't do more than 5 pages.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Ly is really nice and easy to reach outside class. There are 3 projects in total each 4 pages long, he provides clear feedback and is not a hard graded. Ill definitely take him for 106. He gives a lot of hw though theres a reading and discussion each class, readings are pretty extensive, other than that amazing class and easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He's a cool teacher that gives some good feedback for the papers that you have to write (there's 3 of them that we did). There is a lot of work to do though. After every class, there's a reading for you to do and a lot of of the work done in class is with groups over the readings. You need to show up for class or else it impacts your grade as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: he gives three essays total and each is 4 pages. he does grade them pretty harshly even when he tells you that they are good to submit. there's a reading homework after every class and then group work based on the reading. he does answer emails very quickly. overall, not terrible, just grades harshly, so I wouldn't take again. attendance mandatory
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I liked this Prof, his class was pretty straightforward, if you show up and make an effort you will pass. His class is heavily based on group assignments done during class with peers, and with a few essays throughout the semester. He can be funny at times and is very easy to reach outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This class covers so much material but she simplifies the concepts/info for the quizzes and exams so they are not bad. There are so many opportunities for extra credit. This class is genuinely one of the most useful courses I have taken for MBE, so I definitely recommend. She is also helpful and wants you to succeed.

For this being such a difficult class, Dr. Merly makes sure her students have a clear understanding of the material. Always shoot for partial credit wherever possible on quizzes and exams, and don't skip over the extra credit!

For this being such a difficult class, Dr. Merly really makes sure her students have a good understanding of the material. Always shoot for partial credit wherever possible on quizzes and exams, and do the extra credit!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Great professor! For such a hard class, she makes it very digestible. Quizzes and exams are hard, but not impossible, study hard and shoot for partial credit wherever you can
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lowkey an extremely difficult class but very fun and Merly does a great job at making the infinite content fit into such a short course. Exams are difficult but if you remember to study, she makes the class more than passable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Merly is a good professor that cares, and is really good at answering questions inside and outside of classroom. Only thing is quizzes and exams are both free-response and multiple choice. However, she grades tougher on the free-response. But, overall, good professor.

I really liked Dr. Merly. However, my TA made this class much more difficult for no reason. She was a very tough grader for this being an introductory course. Your success in this course depends a lot on your TA. The lab reports were tedious and the instructions were often unclear.

I really liked Dr. Merly. She is so nice and very knowledgeable and accessible outside of class. She really wants each of her students to succeed. I will say though this class is much more difficult than I anticipated it being. I think that's because its graded by few things. Students with an A were exempt from the final exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Also took her for MBE 329, and she's great.

Dr. Merly is very passionate and knowledgeable about what she teaches. This course is similar to the pre-req and easy to follow. Weekly readings of scientific papers. The grade is made up of readings, participation, several quizzes, a mid-term, a final, and a group project. Students with an A in the course were exempt from the final.
Super easy class, I just forgot to submit one single lab report and got a B because of it :(

Awesome professor and awesome class. Sadly, it is sometimes hard to know how she is going to grade you, as several of my friends would put the same exact answers as I on tests and we would all get different answers.

Dr. Merly is extremely knowledgeable in all areas of this class, which makes understanding it easier but makes her grading tougher. The class is lecture-heavy, but if you're this far in, you are probably majoring in Marine Science so that shouldn't be a major issue. Tests are all short answer and partial credit is very common, but still study hard.

Dr. Merly is a great professor. If you are interested in marine biology and the content you will surely get a lot out of this class, however it requires a lot of reading. Although you can cram it out before the midterm/final its definitely best to spread it out. She is also a very tough grader and makes mistakes, but is available for help.

Merly was a good prof. She assigns A LOT of papers to read and will fs throw a question about one of said papers in the exams. Her exams are a lil difficult time wise, many students couldn't finish exams 1/2. But over all just pay attention, and stay on top of things and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The intro to marine bio course she teaches might catch you at unawares because it's not as easy as you might expect. There's scientific paper readings each week and quizzes that you actually have to study hard for. Sometimes the grading criteria was confusing, but she's always available for advice or help and clearly cares a lot about her students.

I liked Dr Merly a lot, and she clearly is knowledgeable about her students. The class is about a naturally interesting subject and so it is engaging. Sometimes, the lectures became tedious and boring. The exams were easy, but you are only graded by the two exams and the final paper, so they carry a lot of weight.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Merly is amazing! She's so knowledgable about marine science and her lectures are interesting and engaging. I loved this class because it gave me a solid base in the subject, as we got to learn a little bit about so many different species and topics. Definitely take her class!

Would not take again. This was a 100 lvl course and she acted like it was a marine bio senior seminar. Lectures were extremely boring and would be over 100 slides. Grades you on two tests that count for over 30% of your grade and a term paper that is minimum 8 pages long. This should not be a 100 level course. Tests are extremely specific.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is a really sweet woman. Very passionate about the topic and clearly knows what she is talking about. It's just a lot of in depth information. Only 3 tests and a group project make up your grade. Tests are hard, a mixture of multiple choice, T/F and short answer open ended. If you're looking for an easy cognate class I would look elsewhere.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Pretty great for a lab professor. Always happy to answer questions, gives really good feedback, but encourages TAs to grade reports pretty hard. Still, as long as you show improvement she usually curves to your advantage.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Very approachable content though it is a lot of content. The tests were a little hard to always do well because there was so much content and her questions were very specific. But shes such a good teacher, very sweet and really knows her stuff and can apply real life to the material. Top hat programwas a little hard to keep up with. Good class!
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Cute and nice

Presented the material well and made the class fun. She is a very nice and helpful person and I definitely recommend taking her for any class. The final is a practical final, where you go around different stations and answer questions (you get about 45 seconds per station). She does give a list of what to study before the final.

Dr. Merly is hugely knowledgeable about comparative immunology, very accessible and approachable, and an all-around good person. MSC 465 has three exams and a final presentation. She has high standards for the class, and her exams are all essay-based and require a lot of studying, but she's a great choice if you're willing to put in the work.

Dr. Merly is a very approachable and knowledgeable professor, and marine biomedicine is a great class.  Exams are pretty tough (they're all essays and short response) but fair. No textbook.  Three non-cumulative exams, one research paper, and a few group presentations throughout the semester.  I'd definitely recommend Merly and this class.
Great class but you definitely had to study a lot to do well. Merly is super fair though and willing to help.

I think we did need a book I just didn't buy it. Her class was easy just a lot of unnecessary work since I had classes more important that writing lol. She is kinda weird but super nice and considerate.

AMAZING TEACHER. Truly a fun class and great teacher who truly cares for her students. Its not a lot of work and the deadlines give you tons of time to complete the essays and projects. You will have to present in class but other than that amazing fun class. You will meet people too which is always great.

Had a later class in the day, but didn't even mind because she was great to be around! The class discussions felt inclusive and purposeful. I have also always received great feedback on my assignments, super helpful in regards to what I have to change/improve.
favorite teacher ever!! gives such good feedback, takes the time to do things to help that most teachers wouldnt normally. also kind and wants you to do well!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Overall, a really nice professor. Gives 3 papers over the semester and opportunities to revise and improve your grade on them. Very similar to AP Research, a lot of material was taught that didn't really need to be, but overall, not bad for a mandatory course.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: we have a really active class and we kinda all just mess around she's pretty funny and your bound to get a good grade because she lets you do lots of revisions which is nice.
Class was kind of boring (Intro writing class, not much she could have done), but she is very nice and is understanding if outside factors make getting work in on time difficult.

I took WRS 232 with her. Although we had a lot of writing that we had to do she was an easy grader, as long as you tried, you got a good grade. There were some presentations, a couple of journal responses, and 3 big essays. Overall, such a sweet and caring person, and I would definitely recommend taking her. She is always willing to work with you.
The class consists of three papers, homework, and then some other assignments. She is caring and wants you to succeed. I would take her!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Really nice professor! There is a good amount of work but she gives you enough time to do it!

Love her! Absolutely take her class. You will be challenged to write well, but it will not be an overwhelming amount of course work. Flexible with due dates and scheduling. Can't recommend her class enough!

Professor Reid is super nice and very caring. There are three major papers but she provides plenty of opportunities for feedback and review during the writing process. She assigns a lot of homework and small assignments which can get annoying, but overall she is chill and I would definitely take her again.
Professor Reid is awesome. Understanding and gives good feedback to allow room to improve. Take her if you can.

I wish she was my teacher for every class. She leaves very clear feedback, and is super flexible. I actually enjoy going to this class, but it is a lot of reading and writing. She is very passionate about improving writing, and wants you to do well!!!

Lisa is a great professor!! i would definately take her again. I took her for WRS232, and it was a fun class.
We did have small readings weekly but she went over it in class and explained more. 
She is available outside of class, is understanding, caring and you are guaranteed an A+ as long as you do your assignments and follow the rubric,

Lisa Reid is one of those professors that you truly never forget, in a good way. She helped me become a better writer and I learned so much in her class. There are 3 papers in total and very minimal work on the side. She is super flexible and easy to approach if you ever need help with an assignment or need an extension on a paper. TAKE HER!!

Sweetest professor I've ever had. I really recommend her! 3 essays, and she tells you exactly how to edit your drafts. Not strict on grading and is very broad with her prompts to allow you to have more freedom in your writing. As for people saying she changes things around too much, I found her very organized. She really cares about her students!

Professor Reid is very helpful and it's clear she is passionate about what she's doing! She is super flexible and as long as you participate she will be understanding about late work and revising your grade. Her class was always fun and chill.

Overall, I've had her for both 105 and 106. I chose to take her again bc of her personality. Prepare to be flexible, and try to communicate with her. Prompts for papers are broad, and you have to look at the criteria and things posted on blackboard. I've missed several classes, but she understands if you email her. Very few assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Reid is one of my favorite professors I've ever had at UM. She really cares about her students, loves class participation, is very lenient and understanding if you just communicate with her. Class is an awesome vibe and she's a great professor to talk to and to get help on with your writing. She really helps your writing improve as well.

My favorite teacher at the school so far. Cares about her students and supports a lively and connected class environment. Good grader and paper/essay rubrics are clear in understanding. Very personable and easy to reach out for help. Gives lots of time on assignments to ensure quality. Overall great professor and great class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I love professor reid, she does tend to change things around a lot but other comments make it sound like she does it without telling anyone. That's not the case at all, she usually would talk with the class abt any changes she wanted to make, she was very communicative and if she decided to change anything she'd send an email breaking it down.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Came into this class thinking I was about to have the hardest and most difficult time of my life only to realize Professor Reid is actually the GOAT. Yes, there is work and reading to do, this class had a lot of work. BUT, she is so fair on grading and really just wants to see you succeed. As long as you care in class you will be good. Loved her.

She is so helpful and will answer any questions you have. She wants you to get a good grade and always has you turn in a draft first so she can give feedback. Cares more about the content of your writing than grammar.

Professor Reid is an excellent choice; she's caring and fair and always will come to class open to any suggestions and ideas. She gives a normal amount of work; if you keep up with the assignments and their feedback, you'll get an easy A. I totally recommend her, I'm not the biggest fan of the class, but she makes it better.

Prof. Reid is really nice and takes student feedback into consideration for her lessons. She seems to still be figuring her class material out and therefore dosent have clear guidelines for some assignments just speak up when you have an issue. Her rubrics for essays are straightforward and she gives you plenty of time to complete each assignment.

Her first year writing class is easy and lets the students actual opinions shape her lesson plan. changes the nature of assignments to benefit her students and she's a fairly easy grader, grades based on effort/completion. She's so caring and super sweet if you don't like her then you have to be a difficult person to deal with in class.

Dr. Reid was a great professor. I would take her class again. She assigns homework assignments or articles to read before class. You can skim the articles to at least know what they're about so you never have to read the entire thing. Fine workload. She was not terrible at all, she is kind and understanding. Just do your work and you'll get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Reid is definitely my favorite Professor I've had so far at UM. best ACC profesor ever! explains very well and is very easy to understand. makes the subject easy and not boring. the only down side is that his exams are very long so you have to work fast but everything in the exam is covered in class.

If your looking for a 3 1/2 hour final and memorizing endless amounts of notes from every chapter testing to see how much you can cram in your brain for a week and forget shortly after then take his class. Very difficult class, good luck getting an A.

Perez is awesome, best professor at UM. Very nice and helpful, not afraid to have fun and joke around, but he still gets things done. Very organized and clear, classes usually end early. Exams are very long tho, time is your enemy. Not a lot of notes, textbook used for homework only. excel project is not very difficult and he will always help

Explains things well. Very organized and thorough. Laid back guy, but test can be rather challenging. But you really have to study hard and practice using examples that aren't just based on concept. Timing on tests are a problem too. Not an easy A, but who knows, you may do better than me. Not sure how much he curves (haven't received grade yet)

Definitely one of the best teachers I've had. He's incredibly organized, and he explains very clearly everything you need to know for the class. He's also very efficient- we always got out of class early!
Perez is definitely one of the best teachers at UM. He is very clear during his lectures and tells you exactly what will be on the test.  Just study your notes and you will get an A.
Awesome professor! he makes everything very easy to understand but keeps the class challenging. An A can be achieved with effort for sure

Professor Perez is great!  Although I feel that the first test that we had was too long, it is possible to do well in ACC211 if you put in the effort.  He teaches the material very clearly and effectively, and he is the perfect teacher for ACC211 since he knows that basically all of the material is new and unfamiliar.  He made me love accounting!
Best Teacher ive had at UM, take him for ACC211
One of the best teachers I've had at UM. Extremely nice, always lets you out early and is very clear with the material.

Took him for Financial Acct for Lawyers - Fall 2011. He's a top tier graduate level professor, period. He's not easy, but he's crystal clear about what you need to know for the exams, he's excellent at communicating the subject matter, and he'll help you as much as you need. Quirky sense of humor kept class moving along. Awesome guy.

Take Perez if possible! His tests are not easy, but he's a great professor. Always playful in class & doesn't take himself too seriously. He's passionate about Accounting & a very smart guy. Always willing to help students in need, & is lenient & understanding w/ his assignments. He's not out to get you

by far the best teacher at UM. everything he teaches is straight forward and clear. he let us out early everyday and is always available to help you. he sometimes gives an easy problem for homework but doesnt collect it. he always goes over what will be on the test question by question. good guy

One of the best professors at UM! He is very easy to understand and tries to make class more interesting and he always lets us out early.  Tests are not easy, but they really are not that hard.  He tells you exactly what will be on the test and how difficult the problems will be, so as long as you study 2 days before the test you will be fine.

Great teacher and a good guy. His lessons are very clear and he makes sure everyone understands. Don't underestimate the difficulty though; you need to read the book and do all the practice questions to earn an A - and of course go to class! But Professor Perez is always willing to help and is super patient if you need help.

Class is easy but the tests are LONG. No one ever finished on time (especially the second test). Dont use the book and when he assigns HW, he doesn't collect it like he says he will. Make sure to do the building blocks project through out the semester and not a week before it is due.

People say hes a great professor and to take him but DONT!!! hes very good at explaining the material but his exams are VERY long and very HARD. He builds you up to break you down. He may be a good teacher but his class is horrible. You will not get a good grade in this class unless if you study for about a week before the test.

Perez is the best teacher I've had in my life, and makes accounting interesting. His tests are easy, but time is an issue. I wish he taught more subjects, because it's impossible not to learn from him. Taking his morning classes is worth it, and he almost always lets out early. Take him no matter what, for 211 and 212.

Go out of your way to take him, even if that means an 8am class. He covers only what you need to know for tests and always let us out 20 minutes early (in a 50 minute class). His tests are extremely long and no one ever finished on time. They are not too difficult though. Don't need to use the workbook, barely used the book. Rarely gives homework

LOVE HIM! he is the most amazing professor i've had at UM. i took him at 8am m/w/f for 212 cause i loved his 211 class. attendance not mandatory, but hes so organized, helpful, makes complicated concepts super easy, and always lets class out early. you're dumb if you don't take him. makes you do the least work possible to actually know the material

ok heres the deal: He is an amazing teacher. Very CLEAR on the material, very engaging and lets you out early a lot of the times, plus basically no h.w. and hes funny! PROBLEM: his tests are VERY long. People in my class rarely finished, theyre not hard, but LONG, think: 100 multiple choice and 5 Short answers. You will feel very stressed on tests!

Professor Perez is a great teacher. Explains things in detail. If you do homework and attend class you should do well. I took 211 and now I am taking his 311 class in the summer.. He is a 10 as teacher and in good looks!   :)

Amazing teacher! He makes everything so easy to understand.Tests are easy if you study your notes. Class is mandatory but he doesn't take attendance. He always lets his classes out early.TAKE HIM!!!!!!!!

He is the best accounting teacher at UM! he is funny which is great cos sometimes the material could get boring. 3 tests and a final. very helpful and he's very hot! love his style! def recommend him!
Goes over everything that'll be on the test the class before. Notes are really helpful and make it so that you don't have to read the book much.. easy tests, I def. recommend!

He is by far the best accounting teacher in the business school.  He actually explains everything and tells you what to expect for the test.  The material is still difficult for Intermediate Accounting but having him as a teacher makes the class for more enjoyable.  Would definitely recommend.

Really clear and an awesome guy in general, his tests have a couple problems and then 30+mult choice. The tests combine the text and class notes so you need to go to both, but he tells you exactly what is on the test so you know what to study.

Awesome teacher! He explains the material very clearly and gives you practice problems that are very similar to the tests. Never takes up the entire class time. You don't really need the book except for the homework he assigns. Take him if you can!!!!

Take him. Even though he teaches early, worth getting up for. Best professor i've had at UM so far. He's nice and funny. Always lets out early. Tests are fair. Go to class and you will succeed. Don't take anyone else.
The best accounting teacher by far!

take him for acc 212. he knows how to teach. he is very clear and direct in his teaching; he doesn't lag or drag. this makes it even easier for his students to learn a lot. he usually finishes early and then uses the remainder of the time meeting with students that are confused or need help. his 3 exams are mc based on lectures and handouts.

Prof. Perez is one of the best teachers ever!  I have taken his ACC 212 and ACC 311 classes.  He is extremely efficient and clear.  Additionally, he is a nice guy.  Take any class that he teaches...it is well worth it.
Best teacher.  He gets straight to the point and doesn't take up much time. He tells you exactly what to expect for the tests and they aren't bad.

Professor Perez is one of the best professors that I have had at the University. He is extremely nice and efficient. His classes never takes up the whole class period, and you definitely learn the material. There is one large Cybertext project, and Prof. Perez divides it up and helps you. Take this class! Prof. Perez is the man!!!
Mario is the man.  He goes throughly and classes go by extremely fast and never last the entire period.  First effective teacher I've had in a while.
Good teacher, explains material well and is always willing to help. Tests are all multiple choice and pretty easy if you study the study guide he gives you.
Good Professor, cares about students and is always there to help. Gives study guides that help you study for every test. If you know the study guide, you know the test. Overall good professor!!!
Requires lots of in-class participation and painful amounts of group work. Was able to semi enjoy this class but its required so make the most of it! But, he is very easy to like and work with!

There are 3 exams, weekly journal entries, and 5 hw assignments. I felt like all the assignments and exams were very difficult but he is very generous with partial credit. Sometimes hard to understand his thought process in class.

I have never learned more from a professor that Dr. Myers. The content will stretch your mind, but he is there to challenge you and help you. He grades based on effort as long as you can explain your thinking. I respect him so much for personally getting to know every single BMB major. Truly an honor to learn from him.

I have been taking Dr. Myers' classes for 4 years and he is hands-down one of the best professors I've had. He has great lectures that teach information in an understandable and well-connected flow. His teaching style is such that he'll provide you with all the information that you need while posing interesting questions designed to make you think.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Myers is a really knowledgeable person. The class itself is very easy as long as you are committed to reading a research paper a week. Easy 1 credit A.

Ludicrously overrated. I used to look up to Dr. Myers, but I realized after graduating that he is a narcissistic and overwhelmingly arrogant professor. Rik possesses a keen sense of passive aggressiveness and condescension in his voice when speaking to you. His teaching style is ineffective, and I personally didn't learn much from the BMB courses.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: I have taken a Dr. Myers course every semester since I transferred to UM. At first I was overwhelmed even with a one credit class as my background knowledge was lacking a tad. But Dr. Myers is more than happy to meet to explain things even if it took 2 hours to do so. He also tries to get to know you past academics and is amazing in general.

Dr. Myers has an interesting philosophy about teaching. Starting with BMB411, every single class he teaches in BMB centers around learning material from reading papers. To truly understand challenging content, you really have to grapple with it and get your hands dirty. I've taken 4 courses with him (BMB411, BMB506, BMB509, BMB514) and he is great.
Way too much work for a 1 credit class. Myers is condescending.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I dont think this professor understands that this coarse is only one credit

Rik Myers is a fine lecturer, but I've noticed a recurring problem in the 500-level courses he teaches. They are inherently full of abstract material and Myers tries to emphasize reading numerous papers and posting on the discussion board. However, these classes are near-impossible to study for as there is too much material to digest all at once.
If you want to get smarter, start hanging out with Rik Myers. The best advisor and the best professor at UM hands down. Ive taken 5 classes with him and theyve all been amazing.

Taking this as a freshman with no background in biochem made it a challenge, but that's kind of the point of the class. He wants you to struggle thru the papers and get a semblance of understanding that you expand upon in the class. It's work heavy for a 1 credit class but I think it is worth it b/c it helps you read research papers and understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I don't really feel like I learned much Genetics in this course. His grading is somewhat arbitrary, very generous with partial credit. That being said, the exams are like "skill-testing puzzles" as he calls them. They really push you to expand on advanced concepts learned in class. Overall, I think the class was interesting but I didn't learn much.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--SO MANY PAPERS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He does an okay (and I'm being generous) job with the lectures since he assumes we know a lot of the material beforehand. This class is basically a theories course on molecular genetic labwork and if you're not somewhat familiar with genetics or the lab, good luck. Very lenient on partial credit and not super hard to get an A or B, but its a lot.

Dr. Myers is generally a good professor and lecturer but I definitely believe the way he structured his BMB514 course was somewhat arbitrary. While the grading is wholistic, I really feel like I don't know genetics as well as some of my peers who took BIL250. Ultimately if you want an easy A take this class, otherwise take BIL250 and learn genetics

Myers is definitely the master of Molecular Genetics. He knows the material inside and out, front and back, and is very lenient with partial credit on exams. That being said, the course does lack structure and he makes his exams way too challenging even for a 500 level course. I don't feel like I gained much out of this class, but Myers is the best
Best professor at UM

Better than TK Harris. Better than Arun Malhotra. WAY better than Amjad Farooq. Rik Myers is by far the most brilliant and charismatic professor at the University of Miami. He truly knows and understands the intricacies behind Biochemistry. He can explain complex concepts in a simplistic manner and does with nothing less than a touch of perfection!

I had the fortune of taking both BMB251 and BMB411 this semester. While both courses are one credit classes, I thoroughly enjoyed BMB411 a *lot* more than BMB251, It was leaps and bounds more interesting and thought-provoking and Rik teaches you to truly become a critical thinker. Biochemistry is all about understanding and he truly enforces this.

He truly knows his stuff. Super up to date on current research. Stays after for extended periods of time to talk to students beyond the daily course content. Replies to emails in depth and beyond what's expected. Has amazing stories and lab knowledge that motivates and drives thirst for knowledge.  10/10 recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Best professor at Miami, you have to work for it but he'll make sure you leave knowing your stuff and able to contribute in the future
Myers is the most charismatic, knowledgeable, humorous, eloquent, brilliant, and all-around inspirational professor at UM.  BMB 411 is a lot of work for one credit, but your mind will be blown.

Dr. Myers is one of the best -- if not the best -- of the professors at UM.  His material is challenging, but he will go out of his way to make it interesting and loves to help. I loved all of his classes.

Took class in Fall 2013.  He was by far one of the most enthusiastic professors at the University of Miami.  He is extremely encouraging and makes you believe you can do anything.  He encourages to think outside the box and understand the processes and the holes in our knowledge.  Best professor I've ever had.

I wouldn't have graduated if it weren't for Myers. Not only does he have a heart of gold but his logic and reasoning is so enlightening that everything, no matter how complex or confusing, makes sense with him. I owe a lot to him
Simply amazing.  Best professor I’ve had at UM –- Myers will blow your mind.

Dr. Myers is the best lecturer I've had at UM so far. He is incredibly enthusiastic about what he does, and he makes his portion of the course both interesting and digestible.He understands that understanding concepts is more important than memorizing details.

High recommend going to class, because his exam is the only one that is extremely concept based, and lectures really reinforce the concepts. If you understand the how's and what-if's, you'll do great. Super clear and enthusiastic when it comes to lectures.

Biochem at UM is taught by 3 profs.  Rik Myers teaches the last (and shortest) segment of genetics.  He is a wonderful lecturer and class was a joy, especially when compared to the first 2 lecturers. He encourages dialogue with his students and wants them to be interested in class.  Overall, I highly recommend him (not because I got an A).

Myers is by far the best of the 3 professor-biochem team.  Passionate about genetics, and teaching.  Test is tough but fair.  Even if you have take genetics, make sure you study hard for his section of the course.

One of the best teachers I have ever had at UM. His lectures redeemed the BMB401 class for me. His lectures are interesting. He meets with students after class at the food court, and discusses things in a discussion board on Blackboard. He really wants to help students LEARN. He is also an interesting person. His test wasn't that bad.
myers is the best of the 3, he is very clear and helpful. his tests are not bad either. COme to class, he gives out extra credit quizzes.

Dr. Ram is a very funny and sarcastic professor who is very knowledgeable about engineering. That said, the class workload is significantly heavier than expected for a 2 CREDIT class. He is very picky when it comes to grading cad/creo. using a radius instead of diameter, redo the whole thing! Missing an axis? redo! Try to keep up as much as you can

This man is the worst experience I have ever hat at UM. So rude and helped with absolutely nothing. He was my advisor and I ended up changing majors just to get rid of him and even when doing that he changed me to whatever major he wanted and enrolled me in whatever classes he wanted just to not help me look for others.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Ram was my former advisor in the CoE. He is extremely rude and impersonable. He is hard to contact and will rarely respond to your emails. And, he schedules you based on what HE wants you to take rather than what you want. If you're stuck with Ram as your advisor, be confident in what you want and don't let him control your decisions.

Dr. Ram was my advisor for the College of Engineering, he leaves things to the last minute and is extremely derogatory to female students. When asking to change advisors I was told by my FYF that this is impossible to do and that, I should just try to see him as little as possible. Completely ruined my excitement for UM before the semester began.
Concerned about every insignificant detail of your work and even if you clearly know how to do something like in the book if it isn't identical then he will take points away from the grade.
"in terms of the thing"

This man is the bane of this university's existence . He has ruined my engineering experience and truthfully makes me want to drop out. He is so unbelievably unreasonable, dunce, and inconsidetate. He is so unorganized and I am absolutely dumbfounded as to why he is still a professor. He makes this class so much harder than it needs to be. F u Ram!

DO NOT TAKE HIM I REPEAT DO NOT!  He is the most laziest professor I have ever met I don't know how he managed to become the dean. He doesn't respond to emails and if he does he is rude or gives one word responses. His lectures are boring, he has an accent so its hard to follow, and don't ask questions because they will not get answered. RUN!!!!

DO NOT TAKE THIS GUY IF YOU CAN HELP IT. HE DID NOT GRADE A SINGLE ASSIGNMENT/TEST THE ENTIRE SEMESTER AND A C SHOWED UP ON MY TRANSCRIPT. HE IS NOT RESPONSIVE ON EMAILS, HE IS RUDE, HE IS LAZY, AND HE DOES NOT CARE ABOUT YOUR GPA. PREPARE YOURSELF, HE IS THE WORST.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He can be very frustrating, and I found it difficult to ask question. He just wants to talk straight, without any interruptions, which I found to be largely not useful. The Creo portion is far more stimulating that his lectures about Engineering, which are extremely dull.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Ram was a great professor. I had him for AutoCAD and MATLAB section, which were both rather easy compared to the C++ section. His tests are straightforward, and simple. The only complaint I have was my frustration with my group design projects, and emailing him - he was not much help. He emails you one-word answers and is very blunt in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Ram is overall a good professor. I had him for the AutoCAD and MATLAB portions of the class. In both he showed us how to do things rather than teaching us. I found this to be fine as long as you pay attention. The PowerPoints are very useful. Reading the book isn't necessary, but it can help and problems are assigned from there. Allows redo HW.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dr Ram is EXTREMELY RUDE. he will definitely pick and choose on which students he wants to bully or make that student feel stupid. his lectures are pointless given the fact that they are all up on blackboard & he will not stop rambling about things off topic. he will repeatedly say that he does not care and will call you out if you missed anything.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: He heavily cares for and wants his students to succeed, however, he DOES really respect his job. DON'T miss or even be late to his classes and seek help from him in his office hours if you need it! Because of him I realized that Engineering was not for me, switched majors, and am now graduated from UM in a field that is my ultimate passion!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Ram is a good teacher I think, but he is not for the thin-skinned. He will call you out in class and make fun of students. The guy has no chill. There is a lot of homework but DO IT. There was one test and it was easy if you paid attention in class and followed the tutorials.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I'm alwayas fighting the urge to fall asleep. Attendance is mandatory. He can't even use AutoCAD properly. He's that one teacher who is a meme (not in a good way). reviews.comment: I LOVE DR RAM HE IS GREAT

reviews.comment: Give terrible feedback and is very harsh on students

Ram is a terrible teacher, and a pretty bad person. He gives the engineering program a bad rep, and is someone every engineering kid has to deal with. He will demean you given the chance, and is extremely harsh with everything. Just dont let him stop you from doing what you want to
Dr. Ram is alright, he gives a lot of work for AutoCad. It's kind of hard and lectures can be extremely boring.

His lectures are so boring and never very easy to follow in class. Unfortunately he is also a very strict grader and his homework can take a while. Luckily the test is not too hard which can help a lot of students

Dr. Ram is a nice guy but he tries to be funny and he kinda fails. I guess the attempt counts. For BME111 hes not the best teacher especially for matlab and he is very boring but its just an intro class and getting an A is not difficult at all. Im indifferent in recommending him, hes an okay teacher, better advisor.

Dr. Ram, though his lectures may be boring, is a really nice guy and just wants you to do well.  He gets off topic all of the time and he will get on your tail if he notices you missing class, but he's just looking out for you.
You may think he's a bad teacher until you get to the higher-level stuff, then you realize how great he actually is. Took attendance but doubt he actually checked it.

Dr. Ram's class is full of**** and i think he is a horrible professor. You can hardy understand anything him and his colleagues are talking about but they expect you to pay attention to the. If you are not a engineer major then don't explore and take this class because you will regret it. If you are an engineering major GOOD LUCK!!!
Dr. Ram just wants to challenge you. If you're MAE he's gonna be your advisor for the next 4 years so get used to him. If you get on his good side things can go well for you
Ram is hilarious. He gets off topic quite often, but how can you blame him? Even though it probably keeps us in the class for a lot longer, I find the discussions interesting sometimes.

Yes, he does like to humiliate people, don't take it personally, he's just bored. Make a good first impression by standing out so that he remembers you.  Tries to appear intimidating, but can be comical. Try to avoid asking questions out of class unless you want to feel dumb.  Good overall teacher, a lot of work but i liked him.

Dr. Ram is a great professor, though he tends to waste class time talking about random topics.  Still, I would definitely recommend him (you'll most likely have him at some point for Intro to Engineering anyway).

As far as a teacher Dr Ram is fine no complaints however he has been very arrogant and condescending towards me and treated me very poorly and/or has completely ignored me even when I am in his office my advice i guess is just not to deal with him outside of class if you can help it.
If you have him for the AutoCAD section you are in luck. He is the best teacher for AutoCAD. Work can be difficult but it's doable. Don't miss any classes and take good notes.

Dr. Ram is the man. I have him for Matlab and he always makes class interesting by connecting it to the real world. Great professor, and a really helpful guy. He may seem mean at times, especially when you first meet him, but he's really just trying to motivate you.
He is an awful professor. The worst of all is that he loves to humiliate people and make them feel worthless. 10% sure AVOID!!!!!!!!

Dr Ram is awesome if you just show up to class and do your work.  He doesn't like slackers, people being late, or turing in assignments late so don't do it.  He has very resonable and basic expectaions and is the funniest teacher I had last year, can't wait to have him again.

Everyone gets an A in Intro to Engineering classes.  Individual and group projects take time.  Lecture about engineering is boring... and one of Dr. Ram's favorite expressions is "than you can believe is possible"
Hes just... dr.ram, funny guy, but can be extremely ****y about absences and missed homework. No delays whatsoever. do your work and youll be fine

Dr. Ram is the man, by far one of the funniest and most helpfull teachers I have ever had. Tests are easy, easy A. Great jokes, even cracks on some of the kids but its all in good fun. Highly recommend.
DR RAM IS THE BEST!! AND HE'S MAD FUNNY!

I feel bad because a lot of our class really didn't gaf and it was clear, but she took her frustration out on the rest of us who were actually doing the work. She doesn't actually teach; in fact we only had class once a week and she'd just have us perform our songs that we wrote by listening to an assigned playlist of music in a specific style.

This was the easiest class I ever took at UM. Attendance is mandatory, and if you miss a class, your grade will be heavily impacted. All you have to do is show up to the class, and you will get a good grade, but if you don't, emailing won't really help. It won't require much time, and you get to listen to music all the time.

She is crazy but class is online no camera. Attendance is mandatory. Class is sooo easy, online exams with camera but it doesn't matter. She gives you all the test questions during lectures so write them down or honestly just look them up. She is more than fair, so easy take her!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class was the easiest class ever, but the professor was so rude. Even when you would email her for help or ask questions in class she would give passive aggressive answers and was unnecessarily rude. When emailing her she says I don't know what to tell you. Not the type of professor I want to take again
she's great. very easy A, online exams are open note and the questions are exactly the ones she says in class.

Took this class for a cognate and it was so easy. There were 3 exams and they are online/open note. Prof. Yarling gives you all of the exam answers during each lecture so as long as you pay attention, you will have all of the answers and be able to do well. Attendance is mandatory - she gives a question at the end of each class that you submit.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Yarling is the GOAT. This class is super easy and just requires you attend class. Everyone on here saying she has a "short fuse" or "gets worked up easily" are wrong, she just gets annoyed when people ask stupid questions they can easily figure out themselves. She is one of the nicest professors I've had in college!

Very easy A, just not that fond of her personally. Always seems lost, quick to anger and somewhat judgmental. For a class that's online, she has a lot of trouble adapting to her environment. Very easy class though.

This class is an easy A and I would take it again. She give many extra credit opportunities and all you have to do is show up to class and listen. She is readily available via email but you shouldn't really have any reasons to email her.

This was the easiest class I've ever taken. Just write down the test questions she gives you every class and you'll get an 100%. You don't need to take notes on anything else in the lectures because it won't be on the exams. However professor has an incredibly short fuse and gets worked up over little things/can be rude to students.

As everyone has said, she gives you the test questions word-for-word and you just write them down. Attendance is taken through an "attendance question" that you answer in Blackboard. You are graded only on attendance and three exams, with a chance for a concert review for extra credit. Easiest A+ of my life.

So so so easy. like seriously show up, write the test questions, and answer the exit question in the chat (always something simple like a name) and you get your A. Prof is also super funny and passionate.
Easy peasy class. She gives you the answers to the tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Nicole (and Marcus Grant) are very good teachers! Learned a lot from their course and they made it easier. In the words of Marcus: "We are handing it to you". Overall, you learn a lot in the course and be prepared to study and write. Homework question every class but you learn!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: BTE 210 is generally a difficult course, i was very worried before taking this class but the professor was very caring and kind and very clear about what we need to do, learned a lot, specially about ai and how to use it build a business.

I went to 3 classes in total this semester. Tests were online open note. The group project took a little time but was not challenging. Take this class if you want to get through BTE 210 without any work. It has been my easiest class at UM so far and I've heard that this could be one of the more challenging classes with another professor.
He is a kind professor and accommodated many of my requests. Classes are interesting and exams are easy.

The group project was fun and taught practical skills for starting a buisness. Choose good team members, as you need to work hard on it together.
