Very nice person, do the WebAssign homework and practice the review problems and you'll do fine.  Getting an A or B in MTH 151 with her is very doable.  She has a generous amount of office hours too.

Easily the worth math professor I've ever had. Her homework has nothing to do with what you learn in class, and the tests are much, much harder than the reviews she gives. She barely teaches the material, she just goes over a few examples, skips key steps, makes mistakes on the board, then moves on quickly and leaves you confused. DO NOT TAKE!

I liked Mrs. Rosenberg. She wasn't the most amazing teacher i've ever had but she was definitely not a bad teacher. She definitely knew how to engage with her students when teaching. Her homework is long and hard but her tests are easy so be smart with your hw drops. If you can do the hw you can definitely take her tests.

I actually enjoyed her class. She goes a little fast at times but is very helpful if you go to her office hours. She tries to answer questions you might have in class quickly so we don't lose class time but she still tries. Her tests are basically what she tells you to review and a lot of the in class examples we do, so pay attention to those.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Really hard, doesn't really teach anything or explain anything. Introduces new things, goes over examples once, and does not explain it. Does one example and moves on. If you ask her to do a homework problem, she doesn't solve it, she just explain the gist of how to do it which is never helpful. Tests are very hard and homework is never like tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Unless you've taken calculus before don't plan on doing well in this class. She doesn't actually teach you how to solve problems. She just goes over hw and practice problems that aren't like the test questions.

This professor very tough. The exams are very hard. She provide a lot of examples but in the exams the questions are completely different. The exams have harder questions than the ones she practiced in class and does not give extra credit. You can understand the material but she wants you to resolve the questions in her way. do not take her

No help at all. She does the problems her way and makes you feel stupid when you ask questions. Teaches way to fast for someone who hasn't already taken this course. A quiz every week which gets tough because she only gives you credit if you solve it her way.
No partial credit, tough tests.

She is a very tough grader and her exams do not reflect what she teaches. Her teaching is not easy to understand and comparable classes are easier. She does not care if the entire class does poorly and is not very helpful when approached after class with questions.

Not great at "teaching". Dropped her class after 2 days for a different calc2 because she was going over concepts that I already knew in such complex ways, that I knew I wouldn't have understood it if it were my first time seeing what she was explaining. She gives overly complex explanations and does 35% of the problem in her head.
The homework is too hard. Teaches through examples, but will always answer questions. Need to go to class
She's always in a good mood and has a teaching style that I really responded to.

I like the way she teaches. She goes over examples in class and has you work on them in class.  The homework is harder than the tests so you are prepared.  I am dyslexic and her teaching style is helpful for me.

Hw is so much harder than it needs to be and sooo frequent. Quiz every week. Tests way harder than the review and barely related. Cant explain or answer questions. Often messes up when writing a problem and students have to call her out and she wont redo it so students can see how it should be done. Also takes attendance.

She takes attendance which is a bummer because the last thing I wanted to do was listen to her. To be fair, she did know her concepts, however, relaying ideas- and teaching- is not her strong suit. Quiz almost every week, three tests. I hope you like physics because she also teaches 151 (for engineers) and you get a lot of applied physics problems.
Horrible Professor. Lots of unnecessary homework.
Very nice and willing to help. If you have taken AP calc this class is a breeze with her, if not you will have to put some work in as she moves pretty fast.

She works extremely fast in class and does not go back. Kids are afraid of asking questions because she makes you feel dumb. Do not take her if you have not taken calc 1 before. Very nice lady though. Get ready to utilize Khan Academy and the book.

Shes a good person, but can be a bad teacher at times. Willing to help, but is definitely harder in giving points than most. Try to establish a good rep and youll be good. She does help you learn the material, and thats what is important.
Teaches extremely fast, not responsive to questions. Makes you feel dumb. Excessive amount of Homework. Erases whiteboard while people are trying to copy. Run.
She is simply the best!

She is not a good teacher whatsoever. I had to get a tutor just to stay afloat. Tests are fair, but grades harshly. Class was basically a waste of time because she goes SO FAST when she teaches. I never learned anything. If you have the option, choose a different teacher. If not, good luck.
Awful professor! Expects u to have already taken calc and doesn't curve even though class fails tests. A lot of homework too. Get a different professor if possible

I've had this professor for 2 semesters, and although she goes quickly through her lectures, her tests are easy if you do all the homework. Also, she's more than happy to explain to you difficult concepts during office hours. For those who have her for Calc I, you do not need to have taken calc in the past, but pre-calc is strongly recommended.

Very difficult class, she skips steps and assumes you know how she did it. Does the problem herself and doesnt explain it. Nice lady but doesn't answer any questions. If you can find another teacher do it but its not impossible.
Favorite.
I enjoyed this class a lot more than math classes I've taken in the past. I'm a science major, so I'm decent at math but not a whiz. I found the Professor and the material to be very fair.

Ugh I hated this class! Don't recommend taking freshman year.  It is hard and she is not helpful AT ALL! Whenever you ask a question she tells you to look it up yourself. Tons of webassign hw and quizzes, and difficult tests. attendance mandatory to maintain a grade and understand class.  then again i always hated math.
A lot of work, but I enjoyed the challenge. She is an awesome teacher, provided one has interest.

Rosenberg is the most amazing teacher I've had she takes the time to explain everything, she gives alot of hw but its easy, there are many webassign quizes but she drops a lot of them. Take her, I know I will next semester becuase I got an A
She has been wonderful. I have no idea what everyone is talking about. One of my favorites.

Blatantly ignored emails I sent her about attendance and wouldn't answer my questions.  I liked her at the beginning of the year but found that incredibly frustrating.  Attendance is not required but if you have perfect attendance or close to perfect, she will bump you up if you're in between grades at the end of the year.
not easy, but you'll learn
She is the best teacher i've ever seen!!

Mrs. Rosenberg's class is a tough one, however she does take the time to work with you personally in her office hours. They aren't always helpful, but at least it shows that you care and then apparently she may throw you a bone here or there. This class is significantly easier if you have taken BC, but if you haven't...Brace yourself.

expects you to know through BC Calculus. spends little to no time reviewing. She teaches basic theorems and examples, and then expects you to solve the most abstract of problems. I don't go to class because I don't learn anything from her, I have been better off teaching myself the topics. Even the ARC tutors are stumped with her problems.

Do not take this class unless you have at least taken AP Calculus. Professor Rosenberg assumes that you know most of the material covered and does not spend much time explaining concepts. There is a lot of homework assigned and it's not worth that much, tests are a lot harder.

Prof. Rosenberg is awesome. She's one of the best teachers I've ever had. You will, however, have to work. If you don't want to work, you won't do well; but it won't be her fault. She's a sweet woman who is always very helpful... If you feel like learning, take her. If you want to coast, take someone else. And her French accent rocks!

Professor Rosenberg is a very intellectual woman. However, I don't think she knows how to apply all of that into her teaching. She means well, but with her French accent and assumptions that you already know a certain formula, she's very hard to understand. Tests are very hard and homework is online.

Tests are much harder then homework so you don't really know what to expect. However, she drops one test and a bunch of quizes which really helps. The only bad thing about this class was the difficulty of the tests.

Definitely need to have already taken calculus before to have a good chance at passing. The homework is easy but her tests are hard- you either get the problem right or you're completely wrong. Does NOT help explain things when you ask her to clarify. You have to teach yourself A LOT. She is a smart person but CANNOT teach.

not that bad of a teacher, she doesnt care if you come to class at all, very laid back and easy going. its your responsibility to learn the material. doesnt allow graphing calculators. tests arent too bad, but there is always that tricky problem that you will stumble on. do all the webassign homeworks and quizzes, study for tests.
Absolutely horrible teacher. If you're learning the material for the first time you will be completely lost.
Terrible professor. She doesn't care if you pass or fail, and tests are hard. You may not even finish in time. On one test she even grabbed the pencil out of my hand.

Here's my problem. I took IB Math Studies 1 in JUNIOR year of high school, then nothing in senior year, and somehow landed in calc 1. Everything was new, so the tests hit me really hard. Honestly, just get 100's on the webassign quizzes and do all the homework and extra credit and you'll be fine. But I really didn't understand anything she taught.

She was my favorite professor during the semester I had her. In fact, I chose her for a second semester. She does have an accent so that may be hard to follow at times. Just pay attention and ask questions whenever you need to. The work is not hard, just busywork so you practice and are prepared for the final exam.

If you can take another teacher for MTH140, I'd recommend it. She's nice, but assigns way to many webassigns and gives a lot of quizzes.. I was always a little confused in her class, if I hadn't taken AP calc in high school i would have been lost the entire semester. She drops one test grade which is nice. Extra credit at the end of the semester.

She doesn't tend to care much about students and how they are doing in her class. I formed a connection with her by going to office hours and getting extra help. I swear its the only reason I passed the class. Her class is really fast paced and sometimes hard to understand. She is really generous with points however! Giving a major EC opp at end.

My least fave prof. Rushes through material & breezes over questions. Hard to follow - she skips important steps in a prob. When asked to clarify, she blows it off & expecting us to have superior mental-math skills (rather than just writing down & explaining how the problem is solved).

Easy A. You have to work for it though. Uses webassign. One exam is dropped. You don't have to take her final if you get  a 90 or above on all the tests. She has an accent that's comprehensible, just annoying.
Super easy super helpful great person she always makes herself available to help.

She is not a bad teacher but she is a pushover. If you want to take a class that you will not be annoyed in dont take her. She favors the athletes, brings them jerseys to sign, gives them better grades and never makes them take the exams with the class, when they do she gives them the answers, she wont do that for anyone else. HORRIBLE and unfair!
you can get a B easily

Rosenberg is a decent teacher but the real good lies in the course design itself. Homework problems are input into a website which tells you if they are wrong and lets you correct them...good for actually knowing whether you're doing something right or wrong. A digital textbook can be used as well. Very good if you've taken Calculus in high school.

I took this class to finish my math requirement for the Comm school n I'm so glad I got her. She realizes most ppl in the class hate math n she makes it easy and painless. Gives EC. Drops multiple quizzes and a test. She loves athletes. Take her class if you want an easy A. Go to class though cause she gives test problems as "examples"

Great professor!!!! She is very fair and very helpful. Cal can be very difficult but she explains it well. The tests can be a bit tricky but if you go to class, do the homework, and ask questions, you'll be fine.
go to class and take notes when the tests come she lets you use a cheat sheet and if you get a 90 or better on the three tests you don't have to take the final
go to class and do the hw and its simple she lets you use a cheat sheet on tests and the tests are extremely easy if you get a 90 or better on the three test you get an A with no final

Unless you had a 4 for AP calc don't take her. She skips several steps at a time whilst presenting examples, loves root signs and negative fraction exponents (algebra is just thrown in to trip you up) and moves through the subject far too quickly. And the tests are hard, examples taken to extremes to only vaguely resemble what she taught.

She's awesome! She gives out printed notes from Blackboard that give perfect examples of what are on her exams, and she even drops one of them at the end. She doesn't ask for hw to be collected, but trust me, just do it-if you do, you'll fly through her exams and quizzes, and you can ask her questions in class on it.
one of the best calc teachers at UM take her!
great teacher great class

Loves Athletes. Has a french accent but is kind of pretty. Attendance is not mandatory but she gives you practice problems to do in class that are exactly like questions she asked on the test. Athletes don't show up for test yet they still pass. Good teacher.
Pretty easy, drops two outta 4 tests!. Tests and quizzes straightforward and fairly easy, no mandatory hw/attendance.

great teacher, had her for both calc 1 and 2. she is very understanding and works with students until they understand a concept. she really tries to help every student get and A or B. Show up to class and look at the homework and you'll be fine

you should go to class because if you do then you dont have to worry about studying, its very straight forward she's very nice and is you dont get something she wont move on to the next section till most of the class gets it

HW & attendance aren’t mandatory and she drops your lowest test and quiz grade. If you ask her for help on the quizzes she drops helpful hints until you get the problem right. Tests are straightforward as long as you’ve done the homework. She also gives an optional 4th test which is more like a quiz and gives a 50 pt extra credit assignment. Tends
Tests are challenging. Some exams questions come straight from the notes,HW also helps.

no, you can't "just show up"! Very good professor, flexible with quizzes, moves prior scheduled tests around physics ones (very helpful!), teaches methods with the consideration of how they'll be used (i.e. on physics tests). Would take a class with again no question. Do your work and you'll do great, just as is on her syllabus.

Monique is probably one of the better Calculus II teachers at the university. She is one of those professors who wants to see you succeed in her class. She passes out typed notes for each section. I thought she was a really good teacher and presented the material effectively. Very willing to meet with you after class for additional help.

I think shes really nice, and she does a handout for every lecture that she puts up on blackboard. The tests are a little tricky but a lot of the times she'll use the same examples from the notes! ^__^
good teacher, teaches at the students pace.
Not bad

I almost didnt take her because of the reviews on this site. I got stuck with her and I COULDNT be HAPPIER. She is a wonderful professor, clear and fair. Her tests are ridiculously straight forward and she is one of the most understanding professors ever. She is super willing to help you understand and takes time to make her class easy to ace.

Took her for pre-cal. Easy class, easy lectures. Tests are easy, just go over inclass notes which she prints out for you. Can be a bit sarcastic sometimes and likes to make fun of dumb people. So....if your dumb just dont open your mouth. Very good examples and very clear about everything. Spoon feeds all the info step by step.

Math is my worst subject but this class was very easy.  I did not use the book once and I didn't have to take the final because I got an A on pretty much everything.  It's not difficult at all and you don't have to be good at math to understand this class whatsoever.  Homework is not required either.  This class could not be any easier.

Lectures were clear but you needed to be in class everyday to understand. Very willing to tutor. If you study and do the homework, which is not required, you can get a good grade. Besides, she gives plenty of extra credit to boost grade and lets you drop some quizes and a test. I got an A and so did a few others who put in the time and effort.

the class is beyond easy. no homework checks. easy quizzes easy tests. very boring. the french accent makes it tough to understand sometimes. she prints out notes for each section. i did not use the book once.

SHe has an accent so it can be hard to understand sometimes, but trust me it works to your advantage.  She prints our every lecture and has notes ready for you every class.  She gives you plenty of time, she doesnt check homework.  You can not show up to her class and as long as you study ull pass with an A.  her quizes are easy and so are her test

The women is not a nice person. Would've done anything to be in another class. I had a SOLID foundation in math and it didnt help at all. She looks at you in disbelief as if you are the stupidist microbiota on earth. B*tch!
she is awful. she gave me a D and i got Bs on all of my tests. i hate her

If you have a decent math foundation, you will be able to get through the class.  Lots of people had a hard time with her teaching style, but it's not too bad.  She can be a ****, but this happens when people **** and cry to her.

Basically had to teach myself calculus.  Most cold hearted, evil, non-understanding, incomprehensible excuse for a professor. Oh wait, she's not even a professor.  During a test, she once laughed at a student and told them that she thought that it was sad that they weren't able to figure it out. FFF
This teacher really isnt as bad as everyone says - If you just pay attention and do homework/study you can get an A+ like i did (Unless your dumb, like most of the people in my class were!)

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!! She may be the worst teacher ive had in my life. The tests are stupid, filled with ridiculously complicated algebra. This class will make your life miserable, and I pray to god that this woman gets fired sometime soon
THE WORST EVER... AND NOW SHE TEACHES MTH 111 AND MTH 112!!! IS SHE EVER SUPERVISED? WHO THINKS SHE IS A GOOD TEACHER? SHE MUST BE CONNECTED... AVOID AT ALL COSTS

WORST TEACHER I'VE EVER HAD!  NEVER EVEN HAD HER OWN BOOK FOR THE CLASS. SHE EITHER HAD PAGES TORN OUT OR WOULD BORROW A STUDENT'S BOOK TO GIVE EXAMPLES IN CLASS.  ASSIGNED HOMEWORK THAT WAS IRRELEVANT TO HER EXAMS! NEVER TAKE HER! DROP IT NOW!

Avoid at all cost...pays excesive attention to insignificant math; tests are ridiculously long and hardl; misses class without excusing herself beforehand and is boooooooooooooring!!! An interesting and necessary class made boring and complicated by her.
STAY AWAY! She's crazy!
She actually said, "I'm not supposed to test you on the topics you know.  I'm supposed to test you on the topics you don't know."  Her test questions are stupid and involve difficult algebra.
No Comments
No Comments
No Comments

Addicted to Matthew Nelsen. He's so easy to learn from and always makes sure emphasize why we are learning every concept and its importance in political science and the real world so that you truly care about what you are learning. He is extremely willing to restructure his course or the work based on student needs and feedback. 100/10.
The best professor I've ever had. Genuinely changed my life. So kind and an incredible person. You will genuinely learn so much in this class.

Professor Nelson is a truly student oriented professor. His class aims to actually engage and educate students rather than just throw information at them. He is easily reachable outside of class hours for questions, and goes above and beyond providing resources to succeed.

Prof Nelsen is super approachable and open to discussion - I would really recommend any class he teaches. The class itself is straightforward and readings are easy to complete if you are interested in the topic. Attendance is graded harshly, but enjoyable lectures really make coming to this class easy. Would reccommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He starts class off with Kahoot to take attendance so definitely attend class. You are graded on participation (attendance), Harkness discussions, and the final. If you go to class and are prepared for the Harkness discussions, you should do well in the class. The final is take home and not difficult just do the readings and review his powerpoints.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I've had at UMiami. Starts off class with a Kahoot on current events which I enjoy, and assigns a decent amount of reading per week, but you can get by with skipping a few readings. Participation is required and weighs heavily since there are no exams, but very easy to speak in class. I definitely learned a lot.

HE IS THE BEST PROFESSOR I'VE EVER HAD. Take him, trust me. No exams but his class is amazing and I actually enjoyed talking during discussions because his questions are relatable and something you can actually think about, rather than trick questions. He is good about responding to emails, encourages students, and cares about everyone doing well.

Dr. Nelsen is one of UM's best professors. His POL 201 class was one of my favorite classes I have ever taken. His method of teaching is excellent and he cares very much about each of his students. 3 Harkness discussions worth 25 points each, participation (50), and a take-home online finale exam (100). If you put in the time, you will get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Prof. Nelsen is a great guy who cares a great deal about political science. I took this for a cognate but I'm very glad I did. He would do kahoots at the beginning of class for attendance. You're graded on attendance, a final exam, and group discussions. Nice guy definitely take for a good grade.

He is honestly one of the best political science teachers here at UM. He's super enthusiastic and easy to listen to. His class is easy to pass if you are present and participate. He does three group discussions that make up your grade, along with one final at the end of the semester, which is open note and open source.

Please take him if you are a poli sci major, he was the only reason I did not change majors. Awesome lectures, discussion matters a lot, light reading, everything is easy to understand. Genuinely the kindest professor ever.

I've taken two classes with Dr. Nelsen, and he is simply the best. He's intelligent, kind, caring, and extremely knowledgeable and passionate. Attendance is mandatory, but he always understands if something important comes up. He has been beyond understanding of my own mental health crises and always supportive. TAKE HIM! You will love him!

Professor Nelsen is a great lecturer because he is extremely passionate about the content he teaches. Although he makes his political affiliation extremely obvious, he welcomes students to question him and share differing opinions.  This class revolves a lot around conversation and there are few written assignments.

Prof Nelsen is the best!!! Seriously take him. He's so understanding and undoubtedly so knowledgeable about urban politics. I felt so comfortable in his class, and was always wanting to pay attention to his powerpoints and talk about the readings. But who he is as a person is equally as valuable as his class material. LOVE HIM YOU MUST TAKE HIM!!

Professor Nelsen is easily one of my favorite professors. He is so knowledgable about the topics he teaches. He cares so much about his students and prioritizes our mental health. If you have the chance to take him, definitely do! He is seriously so nice and just a great professor all around.

Shes an amazing professor. Whereas her class is strictly lecture based, the content is really interesting and her approach on teaching makes up for it. Attendance isnt mandatory, and there are only two exams for the semester which are really simple. While the attendance is mandatory i would suggest attending her lectures as they are interesting

Dr. Newell is a new professor, but she and the class are great! We talked about many unique and interesting topics that aren't normally discussed. You aren't allowed to use technology unless it's a tablet to write notes on.  Just do your reading, write your reflections (only 5), and do your papers. Her lectures are long but interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Great teacher. Professor Newell is very knowledgeable and always has interesting lectures. Throughout the entire semester there are only two assignments and 2 exams (midterm and final), so you're graded by little, but it's very easy to get an A. Just come to class and review the slides. She does assign readings but more as supplementary material.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Newell is very sweet and caring, but her class is very heavy lectures. not really interactive or fun. Its a whole hour of taking notes and hearing her speak. The class is interesting and attendance is not mandatory. We are also graded by a couple of things.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
I have taken two classes with Professor Newell, and both have been fantastic. She is very well organized, so you walk into class knowing the agenda and expectations. She's so sweet and incredibly knowledgeable. Brownie points if you see her outside of class -- she loves it! 10/10, would recommend. 

5 Short summaries, two essays, one group project!
Professor Newell is great! There is no exams, only 2 papers and a couple summaries based on the readings. She tries to make class fun and enjoyable. I definitely recommend her.
Amazing professor and so nice. Second time taking one of her courses and both classes have been organized and so well structured- no exams only 2 essays and 5 short summarys

Awesome prof! Really enjoyed my class with her, was bummed out I couldn't take again. Grade is a mix of papers and exams. The assigned readings aren't crazy important, but lecture is. Make sure to go to class and take notes. She also loves participation. You can tell she knows what she is talking about, really impressive class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: 2nd time having her course and love her! She's really caring and wants you to succeed. Super flexible with meeting her. Her class has lots lectures and really discussion based. 2 essays and 5 short summary assignments.

She's super nice and easy to get along with. She really made me enjoy religious studies and I'm probably going to minor in it b/c of this class. She does have a lot of long lectures with packed slides- sometimes hard to pay attention. Her exams are straightforward & easy, and she assigns 2 essays throughout the semester. Super easy and interesting!

Class was discussion-based and very enjoyable. She is helpful, willing to work with you, and is open to comments and suggestions. Class promotes critical thinking and open-mindedness. Highly recommend.

Really nice lady and great teacher. Gives just the right amount of assignments for students to have enough to be graded on but not feel overwhelmed. Genuinely cares about her students and is very flexible with meeting times and grading.

One of the hardest classes that I've taken at UM. Dr. Newell is very nice and clearly interested in the subject, but I was often left wondering how she was making connections between the topics and overall theme (spiritual, not religious) of the class. I've heard that she is awesome for other classes, but I would not suggest taking this one.

She is so sweet, smart, and helpful. Honestly the best lady. She assigns lots of papers with several drafts, but it's an English class so that's expected. Attendance and participation are also a large part of your grade, so make sure you wake up for class. No tests at all and quizzes are just for extra credit. P.S. Definitely DON'T buy the book.
She was my favorite teacher last semester. She was clear and concise and a fair grader. I absolutely loved her and I wish I had her for ENG 107. If you can, take her.
She is very helpful and clear. One of the most positive experiences I've had in Miami.
Professor Newell is a very concise and fair teacher.  She assigned us a total of just four papers all semester and graded them fairly easily.  Easy grade.  Nice teacher.
Fantastic way to teach art history, friendly person, and amazing teacher.

Professor Timpano is the best teacher I've ever had. His lectures are amazing. His passion for Art History is inspirational and contagious. He makes the class fun and extremely interesting. I've taken the majority of his classes and I would have taken more if available. You walk out of the class loving everything about it.

Dr Timpano lectures are amazing, learn so much! He's very engaging & his classes are inspirational, his passion for the subject matter is infectious. I've taken a lot of his classes -I'd take more if available. I appreciate how clearly he explained complex Art concepts and his interests in the student's understanding. His classes are fun as well.
Love!!! His expansive, fresh, unbiased view of the art world helps ground and connect the students with the vast materials explored in this class. I would take it again!

Walked into this class with minimal knowledge of art history; will walk out having declared an ARH minor. Intelligent, amicable, and perceivably accessible outside of class, but can, above all else, effectively convey course content and make it properly engaging. Can't really say a poor word about Nathan.

The class was 2 tests and 4 quizzes. The "final" wasn't cumulative and he just treated it as a unit 2 test. If you show up to class and just listen to him talk and take reasonably decent notes, you'll get an A. You don't have to go but it will save you work later if you do. The tests are 5 images and an essay he talks about in class. Hes great.

Best teacher I've had at UM. Wish I could take every single class he teaches. He's extremely funny and has a sense of humor that students can relate to, which explains why he's so liked. Loved his lectures. I even enjoyed writing the essays and studying for the tests because everything is so interesting. He made me fall in love with art.
Absolutely love his classes. He is incredibly knowledgable and very funny. I took him for his modern art lecture and 2 seminars and absolutely loved it. Be prepared to work though!

Nathan is very knowledgeable of his subject matter. Funny guy with a sarcastic sense of humor. I would definitely take any of his classes again. Material was fairly easy, readings just a bit difficult at times due to translation and such but he does a great job at explaining everything.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: I had him for freshman seminar in museum studies. I really liked him, although he does give out a lot of reading to do. He is a very smart person who is very passionate about art history. I enjoyed the seminar a lot and would recommend him. One of the best things about our  class was getting to see different museums in Miami, such as Viscaya!
One of the best teachers I've ever had. Made art history interesting and fun. I wish I had time to take all of his classes. Sooo worth taking him over anyone else!

I also had Timpano for a graduate level seminar class and arh409 (art & cinema). best teacher I had at UM by a long shot. makes art history interesting and relevant and teaches it how I always thought it should be taught. students love him and participate. he is down to earth but so smart and makes you think with out boring you/being too hard.
Timpano was the best prof I have had. He keeps you interested in his lectures and if you listen in class and take notes you will do well!
This class was mainly just project-based and very straightforward. There are no tests/quizzes. There are just two projects that you work on throughout the semester, and that's all :)

Dr. John is a great professor who explains assignments and projects very clearly. Exams are split between take-home and in-person, with the two averaged, which feels fair. He also offers extra credit built into homework, giving students opportunities to boost their grade. Overall, strong lectures and a well-structured systems programming course.

Dr. John is amazing.
Excellent
We love Papa John!
Great

Dr. John knows what he is talking about. Projects are incredibly useful.

reviews.comment: Not available for help after class. He hasn't answered my email that I sent on the first day of the semester... kinda awkward.

One of the best professors at the University of Miami hands down. Gives highly relevant coursework. The final was both engaging and challenging. Could be the worst professor I've ever had. He doesn't teach to the labs, which are almost all of your grade, and the whole class is unorganized. TA's were no help either.

He's a difficult teacher, but then again, the all of the courses he teaches are difficult topics. He's an incredibly nice person though, and will help you out, but you have to put in the work. His tests are really hard, but he curves generously. He's not out to get you.

Microprocessor was the hardest class I have taken at UM. He rambles in class and uses slides he did not prepare himself. For me, he is the best teacher in the computer engineering department. Very kind person. Surely,his subject is difficult. Fortunately he curves which gives you chance to pass
Horrible, horrible professor. His tests hardly reflect what little he teaches. He assigns the labs before you know how to do them. I would avoid all classes with Dr. John. Just horrendous.
He's really horrible at trying to explain/teach anything.

Confusing thought process. Can't take notes with this thought process.  It's nearly impossible. Doesn't answer questions about either the test or the labs.  Switch to Murrell if you can. Also doesn't curve even though the average test grade was a 52.

honestly an underrated professor. accent is not hard to understand, and he genuinely knows a lot about linear alg. true and false questions are hard, but the tests are the exact same as the practices he gives. he brought his dog once

Very organized lecture. Professor cares about students success. If you don't go to every lecture, you will fall behind. Quizzes and homework medium difficulty, tests are hard. Impossible true/false questions.

He is very, very passionate about linear algebra and does a really good job with his lectures. Do not take this professor if you want to fail. There is no big curve at the end of the semester, so it's not true. Even if you do the practice exams the material is still very hard. He treated this class like it was a 500 level class. I spent a significant amount of time preparing to fail. Nice guy but expectations on theory questions are unrealistic.

Very passionate professor of Mathematics. Sometimes his accent makes it a little difficult to understand his points but he's open to answering questions. He's not super accessible outside of class. I wish the grading criteria was clearer; there is no curve at all. Otherwise, he is fairly good at lecturing. He gives practice tests before actual tests, which are extremely helpful. The tests are still difficult, and he expects you to make really abstract connections that are not necessarily obvious. If there is no one better, take him.

Dr. Oliveira is one of the best math professors in the department. Not the easiest by far, his true or false questions are killer. But you will definitely learn a lot and his grading is favorable towards the students.

Oliveira's class was well structured and organized. It was easy to follow what topics you were doing and his lectures were good. You can also just read the textbook as well. The exams and quizzes weren't hard, but you definitely still have to study and make sure you understand everything.

He always answers any question you might have. His accent is very understandable. Sometimes the board may look really messy when he is done, but if you pay attention it flows in an understandable way.
I thought he was a very kind person and was very willing to help. would recommend you take his class.

Professor De Oliveira is one of the best professors! He is very respected. Passionate professor with a deep understanding of the subject. He has a bit of a thick accent but clear to understand nonetheless. Sweats profusely during lectures. 9/10

Writes on board in a disorganized way making the math hard to follow. Youtube is much better than the textbook. Although it may seem like he doesn't know what he is talking about in the lower level classes he teachers, like linear algebra, it mostly because of his terrible english. He has a very thick accent which at first is very hard to understand.  He goes off on tangents and is very loves unhelpful proofs. He's terrible at teaching and it seems like he barely even understands the information he's presenting. I've had three different tutors who all did not know how to do multiple sections of what we were being taught, because they said they've never used it once in their mathematical careers.

He is hard to understand, not only because of his accent. He tries really hard to make things clear even if he isn't very good at him. I wouldnt recommend his class, but if you are stuck with it he'll take the time and try to help you
Avoid his class if possible. IF you take it plan on getting a tutor and spending atleast 12 hours in the library before the test especially if you havent taken calc before.

Good class, and overall chill experience.

This is the best class ever! Imagine going to class and just watching movies all day...this is basically what the class is. It is offered during intercession and requires two papers, one individual and one as a group. You can request writing credit if you want it. The group project is easy if everyone does their part. Easy A!

Took during intercession, HE'S GREAT! Probably the best intercession class you could take. Saw cool movies & the few assignments were very doable. Small group project at the end is super easy. He really is a great professor &cares about you doing your best. TOTALLY RECOMMEND! Interesting, you learn a lot & get 3 credits out of the way super fast!

Nice guy! He tells you in advance when there will be a quiz (which isn't often) and he lets you email your essay(s) to him for comments before the final draft is due. Interesting and engaging class!
He's a really great professor. Very helpful and does justice to the material as he presents it. You really get a feeling that you are learning from someone in the field. Take his classes!

2 papers in the class which he grades fairly easily; as well as quizzes. He ultimately just wants to see that you understand the philosophical concepts discussed and are forming your own theories. Dr.Bueno makes his class extremely interesting & involves everyone. Grades fairly-there are 4 quizzes,1 paper & group presentation instead of final exam. Always willing to help outside class and is very approachable. Highly recommend him!

This professor doesn't provide a positive learning experience. She is late to class and doesnt respond to student work, which makes it really hard to get better at writing or thinking critically. She tries to coast along, but will never let you do the same.

Find another professor. It's not worth it.

I understand why some people don't like her but I genuinely think she pushes her students to be better writers. She always gave good feedback and tried to have meaningful class discussions. If you want an easy A this isn't the class for you, but if you're looking for a challenge then I'd say go for it. It took a few Bs to get to an A!

Saunders is probably the least desirable professor ever. Can't understand why she's employed. Most unfair prof i have taken.

Before you take her, know there is no thought or logic that goes into her assignments or grading. She is confusing and often contradicts herself on expectations. The absolute worst teacher or professor I have ever had. She is a terrible human being and is very unfair to her students. Grades unfairly with no satisfactory explanation. Unapproachable outside of class. She should be fired from the University as soon as possible.

One of my favorite Profs! She is wonderful.

Prof. Saunders is a great professor! She takes the time to go through the literature and films and is very understanding - very willing to help. Thoroughly enjoyed the course....I tried this class with another professor and it didn't work; I dropped in the 1st week

Really good professor. She knows her stuff and is very willing to help with papers.  She also explains everything you need to know about the books you're reading so all you have to do is write the papers based on your notes.  OH and she's from the Caribbean...so that helps!!! :)

one of the worst professors at UM. Very rude and abrupt in emails and unhelpful. Does not give off a feeling of wanting his students to succeed. Exams are nothing like the homeworks. You should definitely take Dr. Miao for Diff eq. Attendance is not mandatory, though it is helpful if you go to lecture. very good , and easy
Good Prof, make sure to attend class quizzes are online and exams are in person

He interacts with his students because you can tell he just wants to be social. Take this class.

He's not bad, but he's not good either? He is a funny guy when he gets to talking about the political state of the world. But, I learned very little economics. If you end up with him, don't worry you'll pass but you'll be kind of confused along the way.

It is not hard to get an A if you show up, pay attention, and review a little as needed.  A formula/notes sheet is allowed for tests (which are all multiple choice).

He is a funny guy, but when he's teaching it's unclear what he's trying to explain. Most of the classes was just him yapping with no clear understanding of what we were supposed to be learning. Really not that bad tho, just not the best professor. Not that much homework, just some problem sets (you can find the answers on studocu)
