reviews.comment: Vanessa Septien is without a doubt the best professor I have had at UM. Her classes are incredible and she truly cares about every single student.

Professor Septien is a world class instructor with a distinguished background in law, and an experiential teaching style aligned with that of the Ivies. Regardless of your career path, you will leave with a renewed confidence in public speaking, persuasive writing, and the ability to think strategically when tackling real-world challenges.
Vanessa Septien is highly versed in her area and is an exceptional professor. The classes are engaging and also very current. Highly recommend!!
The absolute nicest professor at the school. Made going to the 8am class time enjoyable. I can't recommend this professor enough. Definitely take her. She's the best

Expert in her field. She's always able to connect what you learn to a relevant experience in her career. This class was really interesting and very useful as a real world class. This class does have a lot of in class busy work. This class helped me improve both my professional writing and speaking skills. Prof Septien is great at feedback and is a very fair grader. She is a great professor to have.

Amazing Professor, who loves what she does, highly recommended! VC

One of the best teachers at University of Miami. I would definitely recommend this teacher to anyone.

Genuine great professor that cares about you learning and understanding the material. Minimal work, but be prepared to get over your fear of speaking in front of the class. Great learning environment, highly recommend!

He needs to retire ASAP, you receive more useful feedback by calling your mother than him. He talk way too much and gives little to no useful information. Nothing gets done with him and does not push you AT ALL. he is lowkey funny though.
I hate drawing, but I actually learned how to draw correctly and pretty well in this class. He's a very laid back guy, but really teaches you what you need to do in order to draw better.
Good learning, study and you will earn the grade. lot's of work but very interesting. Recommended , he is a cool guy.
Excellent professor and an amazing guy overall. Only issue is you will need to work hard to ensure that A. Otherwise, he's a great guy. Like probably the most fun professor I've had at UM.

Very good teacher with great hair.

super clear on what will be on the test and allows test corrections for 1/2 credit back. Also homeworks are extra credit.

Professor Stuetzle is extremely knowledgeable on the material he teaches and really shows it in lecture. He teaches and explains the material in a way that is very understandable and interesting. His class is definitely test heavy, but there are no surprises on the exams. They are very fair, and its easy to do well if you study and go to class.
This class sucks. It's a lot of work; too much work actually. The other professor is probably a better option. Very nice person though.

Stuetzle is a gem. This was my second class with him and he is extremely consistent as a professor. Will answer any question you have and is very helpful during office hours. Always gives a study guide with the material that will be on the test and the tests have no surprises. A lot of writing in the course, and he is detail-oriented when grading.

Lectures are boring but so is the content, he makes it as interesting as possible. Moderate amount of homework, lets you correct your tests to make half of the points back. Exams are super fair and only have stuff that's on the study guide. Nice and helpful/accomodating

Nice guy, grade is based on tests with no other work, the final is optional and replaces your lowest exam grade. Study guides are detailed and clear, and require some extra textbook reading but nothing on the test beyond what's on the study guide. Doesn't take attendance but offers EC opportunities in class only to those present.

Dr. Stuetzle was a great professor and was very knowledgeable. I actually enjoyed going to class. He makes the lectures interesting and he's super engaging. Honestly, I thought the class would be harder than it was. There are 3 exams and the final is optional. As long as you pay attention in class or read the book/slides you'll do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Highly recommend taking him for stats and/or research methods. Makes lectures interesting as possible, even when the subject is dry. Will tell you in class specifics that he will test on. Just do the homework and do his study guide and it's an easy A. Not a lot of work.
This class is awful. SO much work and very confusing material. Would recommend an easy courseload if you take this class. He is very nice and accessible though.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: This is an incredibly boring class and the way he teaches it makes it even worse. He explains things in a way that makes them more complicated. Best bet with him is reading the textbook and using those practice problems because otherwise the information you get probably won't be right all the time. He also grades things super slow.
He is an ok teacher but he never did examples during the class. The only way to do well is to really study the textbook a lot. He did give partial credit on exams and he was a fair grader.

He lectures alot, if you need visuals for the stats class he teaches do not expect from him, I personally don't think he's a good professor for a stats course. does not give extra credit, does not curve, and study guides do not help. Use this info to weigh in your decision to take this course. good luck

Dr. Stuetzle is a fun professor. this was my first stats class ever and I was nervous about it before we started but Dr. Stuetzle is a great teacher and takes his time explaining the topic. The grade is determined by 4 exams and any homework you do is for extra credit
Nicest professor but hardest class ever, and I am an A / B student. Worked really hard and struggled to earn a C-.

Show up, take good notes, devote a couple hours to each exam and youll get an A. The class is worth taking even if not for a grade tho, Dr. Stuetzle gives lectures that are incredibly for both psych and nonpsych majors. The content also gets more and more interesting as you go. 100% worth taking the class and 1000% worth getting to know the guy

Take him. Just do it. He's the best prof I've ever had. He explains everything in such an intriguing way. Tbh I learned a lot about life just by listening to his lectures, not only about psych. I only read like two paragraphs of the textbook bc he didn't get to it in class. Literally go to the lectures and the tests will be so easy. Great class!!
The lectures are very interesting. He'll teach you things about the human psyche that will give you an advantage in life.
If you study the powerpoints for each chapter he posts, you only need to go to class on exam days . No homework or projects. Grade is entirely made up of 4 multiple choice exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Stuetzle is a smart intellectual professor who really knows what he's talking about and makes the class so interesting. I found myself being excited to go to his class. A lot of people chose to skip his class since he doesn't take attendance, but his lectures are genuinely interesting and helpful for the exams that it's really worth going to.
Excellent professor. He has a rep of being a tough prof. To be honest, if you pay attention in class and read the book you will be fine.

Best psych professor ever. Class is not mandatory but honestly does help. He puts the slides on BB but it is more beneficial to hear his lectures vs take notes on your own. Do the reading to have an idea of what he's talking about. If you took psych in high school its SUPER EASY. Tests are MC, 4 per semester and the 4th is the final.

If you intend to LEARN, take a class with Prof. Stuetzle. He has extensive experience in psychological testing and is passionate about the topic. He shares interesting anecdotal details from years' worth of experience. He is an excellent lecturer; engaging, clear, caring. Makes you want to be interested in material. He will challenge your thinking.

You can tell Dr. Stuetzle really cares about his students. He's willing to adjust his schedule to meet with you. The class is hard for people who don't like stats but he is very good at explaining things and his lectures are usually funny and engaging. There are 4 tests that are pretty hard but homework is weighted as much as an exam.

Great stats professor, if you go to class and pay attention and take notes on the book the exams aren't hard. There are extra credit questions and he takes attendance and homework into account for your final grade. He is passionate about the subject and is good at explaining. If you see him outside of class he is super nice
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Honestly don't know how I got a good grade in this class. He would rush through explaining things and I would have to go in for office hours or get my friends/ the book to actually teach me because I could never grasp it in class. He can be harsh when it comes to putting + or - signs on work. He does give you a formula sheet and study guide though
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: He didn't make the class very exciting, but neither is the material. Class was super boring. If you can manage to show up, pay attention, take notes, and actually study then you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Stuetzle tries really hard to make this class difficult, but it's really not hard content-wise. Just read the book thoroughly and review your exams so you can understand how he thinks. He writes lots of bad questions which he ends up throwing out. You can explain why you chose a wrong answer and he'll hear you out.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Professor Stuetzle made statistics incredibly interesting. I was afraid going in because I had never taken a stats course before, but his classes were super fun to be in and he did a great job at breaking down the problems and concepts before teaching the math. Definitely recommend going to and paying attention in classes.

Stuetzle admits that he is a hard professor to take, but he genuinely seems to care about his classes and he knows what he's talking about. The class can get rather difficult and the lectures can get boring, but he does a very good job explaining everything and extremely good at communication with students. Be prepared to study a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Makes class harder than it has to be, questions on exam are tricky to say the least, graded only by 3 exams, in class examples aren't helpful, read the book. Study guides given a few days in advance, they're helpful but you need to dedicate time to build it then study it (7 pg). EC is a joke, 2 pts all semester. Subject is boring, not his fault.

Rick Stuetzle is a fantastic professor with unlimited compassion for his students. He WANTS you to do well, only if you put the effort in. I highly recommend going to his office hours and taking advantage of his comments. GO TO CLASS, attendance is required. His class is hard but for those going to grad school, he prepares you for future stats.

Professor Stuetzle is my favorite prof here so far. His lectures are cool and he knows how to keep the information interesting. The only grades are off 3 tests and the final. He gives study guides a few nights before the tests that directly reflect the material covered. If you know the material on the guide, you should get an A.

One of my favorite teachers. Makes the class interesting and straight forward. Always there to help his students and really cares and loves his job. He makes the exams straight forward and studying isn't too bad. The homework isn't overwhelming but really helps you keep up in class. 100% recommend and would take again

He cares about his students, and is very reasonable. The course itself can be difficult to understand, but his lectures and applications to the real world made it so much better. I would definitely recommend him! You do need to try in this course, he is willing to help you outside of class. Always answers any questions you may have.
Ehhh... Make sure you Read the book!! The tests were difficult even when I went to class and read the book.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: I've had Stuetzle for 290 and 390. I found his lectures boring, almost unbearably boring. He takes way too long to grade assignments and tests. BUT I do believe Stuetzle values his students. These psych stats classes should not be rigorous. You don't have to prove anything like a real mathematical statistics class, but it's just so mundane.

Not an easy teacher, but he knows what he is talking about. Fast pace teaching so pay attention, and you must read the textbook to pass the course. He can be pompous and stuck up but is nice when you meet with him one on one. Grade is only based on the tests. If he can be avoided, stay away. If not, good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Only grades are a few tests.  The final is optional.  He's lectures range from a little dry to actually interesting.  He is funny and attempts to make the subject fun.  His tests are all multiple choice, but they are rather hard unless you know someone that has already taken the tests in a previous semester.  Attendance is occasionally for EC.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Stuetzle is the best!  Lectures were actually interesting and I enjoyed going to class.  Treats his students with the respect and is really understanding if you missed a test and will usually let you make it up.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: The class is a lecture so it was very hard for me to stay focused. However, read the book and you'll be fine. I went to class around 4 times total and passed the class with a B.

Read the textbook! Keeping up with the readings is key. I wouldn't say that the material is ridiculously hard, most is fairly easy to understand and common sense. It's really easy to get lost in this class, happened to me so many times. I would go back in my notes and have no idea what I was talking about. Staying on top of the material helps.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Stuetzle does an amazing job at teaching this course, sometimes knows the answer before you ask the question. If you pay attention during lectures do all the homework and study the material you will be fine. The one thing I can say is that just knowing how to do the math will not cut it on the exams, you have to know the "why" and the explanations.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He's such a great lecturer. The material can be dry & boring, but some of it is interesting stuff. He tries to make it fun in lectures & uses really good examples as well. However, YOU MUST READ THE BOOK. If you don't, you can kiss your grade goodbye.

ATTNED OFFICE HOURS!! Dr. Stuetzle was very helpful during office hours and would go through the assignment step-by-step to make sure you understood what he wanted. The lectures are mandatory in order to understand the assignments. Just ask for help and he is MORE THAN WILLING to guide you through the assignments. Honestly such a nice professor.

Makes an effort to present the material in a clear way. We didn't get our homeworks back until late in the semester, so we couldn't really use his feedback until then, but really, that's the only complaint. If you have to take the class, he'll make it as painless as possible. He'll also read your ratemyprofessors comments :D
Gives study guides at the last minute before an exam. Makes the class harder than it should be.

If you can get past his arrogance, he's a good professor. He's super willing to help you and is flexible in scheduling office hours around your schedule. Reading the textbook really helps in your understanding of the material and he always throws in those "you read in your textbook that..." during lectures. Usually one homework per test period.
He's fun. Easy class. work a little and you'll be fine. Go to his office hours-- he's quite approachable.
I love Dr. Stuetzle! He's an excellent instructor, a personable individual, and would highly recommend him to other students.
Awesome teacher who cares about the material and his students.  Love him!

Even though he's funny and engaging in class, the bulk of this class will be about learning SPSS and writing an actual APA-style research paper. Make sure you stay focused on these things and pay attention to the close details.

Struetzle was an awesome professor. He relates the course content to the lives of his students in a way that makes what would normally be boring mundane info much more relevant and interesting. If it weren't for him I probably would have skipped the majority of the lectures.

Such a sweet genuine guy. Very intelligent and knowledgeable. Will answer your questions clearly and enthusiastically. His tests are straightforward and if you pay attention and read the book you'll get an A. Loved him!

Majority struggles for even a B+. Assigns a lot of hw, prepares you for the test, and he is very helpful. But his tests are very tricky and tedious. Must pay attention to every word he says in class. If you miss a class, you immediately fall behind. Maybe the difficulty level will prepare me for psy 390 with him but idk try another prof
Great professor. Very knowledgeable. Incredibly clear, yet interesting. Take his class. He makes stats easy. Totally willing to help students.

Dr. Stuetzle is an excellent professor. He doesn't use Powerpoint, which means he isn't standing reading off the slides like other professors. Stats can be confusing sometimes, but he answers questions and reviews practice problems a million times until everyone understands it, so if you study and practice there should be no problem.

Professor Stuetzle is amazing. He is extremely helpful and will explain things clearly. He doesn't use Powerpoint so class is actually dynamic and (somewhat) engaging. He seems to genuinely want everyone to succeed and want to help you get there. I can't wait to take another class with him.

Dr. Stuetzle was an AMAZING teacher.  His explanations and application of the concepts of statistics were on point. He helps one learn the material in a way that would not be possible without his class, so I highly recommend that you attend his lectures. Grading can be picky but he is fair. He makes himself available at all times if help is needed.

Dr. Stuetzle is a GREAT teacher of the material. His explanations and examples are very clear. Lecture is easy. The lab section of the course is tedious by design; grading can be picky. However, he is very available for office hours (going to him with questions about papers is a HUGE help). Would definitely reccommend him for others to take.

Professor Stuetzle is a great teacher because he actually wants students to learn the material. His lectures are very clear and helpful. He is also very helpful in answering questions and he has a lot of patients. This class is not easy but if you study and do what you are supposed to do, an A is very possible. Pretty much common sense

Stuetzle is nitpicky but good; he is so demanding because he wants you to learn how to do things correctly, not because he wants to make life difficult. If you put in effort and have problems, he will patiently help you out. He's not a warm person, but he cares about how you do, even if he doesn't show it that much.

The lecture section was very straightforward and getting an A on the exams was fairly easy as long as you read the book. Attendance was not mandatory. The lab section was definitely more work, but not impossible- just keep up with all the work and go to his office hours when you need help!Overall he's not as bad as people say.

For the lab section of 316, he isn't too bad. Uses his red pen a lot for corrections. Going to his office hours for writing your paper is very helpful. (hint hint). Grades kind of tough, but its manageable.

I don't know who thinks this guy is mean. He is always in a good mood while teaching, which makes the students more excited to be there. I personally have always hated Math and was avoiding taking this Stats course, but he made it not so bad. His tests are extremely fair, though he is picky. Play by his rules, and you'll do fine and learn a lot.

He is a tough & nit-picky professor, so you have to keep up. There is a test pretty much every other Monday so you can't procrastinate. He is willing to help you, though, and appreciates it if you show effort. Go to class, even though it's not mandatory, and read the book. It helps.

I did experimental psychology with Dr. Steutzle and now I am in my doctoral program. Thank God I had him as my professor. My dissertation would have been impossible if I did not have him. I hated his nit picking when I had him but now I know he knew what he was doing. If anyone out there plan on doing the PhD program, I would say, take Dr. Steutzle
I love this class. He jokes about having to maintain a "reputation for being mean" but he's one of the nicest professors I've had. This is not an easy class, but if you work hard, you'll do well.

If I didn't have to take this class so late during summer I would've completely LOVED it. The professor is extremely easy to understand and he goes above and beyond to help his students. Those who say otherwise obviously never set foot in his office. Go to his office hours, I cannot stress this enough! I loved this professor I highly recommend him!
this is a hard class! but, i did learn. if you want an easy A this isnt the class for you. if you want to learn and be challenged then this is your class.
Awesome professor! Awesome teacher! If you really want to learn statistics you should take him. Definitely take this class!

The way that the material is presented is a bit confusing. At times I felt that he tried to complicate the material more than necessary. It did not seem that this was done out of care for the students but more a sarcastic style of teaching. Along with this he is often condescending. An example of this is when he refers to IQ scores or uses large vo
He made me love stats and he is very sexy.... what more could you ask for?
pretty tough and picky but you learn so much! He's a really good professor but this wont be an easy A

I loved this guy! He's a bit cynical and kind of falls through sometimes on jokes, but he genuinely wants you to learn. His tests are difficult because he is a bit smug about tricking you, but he doesn't do it often and offers really easy extra credit! And most importantly, he teaches SO WELL!!!!

He's a very good teacher. He's very nice and very understanding and offers extra credit. Tests are difficult, just make sure you practice all problem types and you'll do well. If you don't understand something on the test he gives you hints. I recommend.

His tests are ridiculously hard! He loves trick answers and making it as difficult as possible for you to succeed. However, he does a great job teaching the information and isn't mean...until test day!

HIS LECTURE IS GOOD BUT TOO FAST PACED ESPECIALLY IN HIS 6 WEEK COURSE IN THE SUMMER. IF YOU HAVE A JOB IN THE SUMMER DONT TAKE HIS COURSE IN THE SUMMER. YOU HAVE TO STUDY A LOT AND THIS WILL TAKE MUCH TIME OFF YOUR HANDS.TO ADD HIS TEST ARE VERY TRICKY, WATCH OUT FOR HIS WORDING.
good teacher, interesting, the two hours go by fast. I recommend him!!!

One of the best professors I've had at UM so far. He may not be the easiest of the stats teachers but you'll definitely learn the most. Do all of the homework and read the chapters to study. Also, go to his office  hours; he's more than willing to help. An A is absolutely possible.

You have to go to class and pay attention. He is hard, but not impossible. Even though it may be difficult he is a really good teacher, you just have to make an effort and approach him the right way (not 10 min. before the test). Do the homework and pay attention in class and you'll do fine. Also, it isn;t as much math as people think.

I was nervous to take this class because I heard he was hard, but he is a good teacher and you'll learn a lot from him. He's not as hard as everyone makes him out to be. It's definitely possible to get an A, just make sure you go to class or you might get behind. His tests are hard but he gives some extra credit opportunities.
HORRIBLE, i do NOT recommend!!! his exams are extremely hard, & he's not very helpful!

i really liked him. i heard he was a very stubborn, tricky teacher. but he ended up being very nice. he was very tough on tests tho. i would not recommend this class if ur trying to get an easy A. i rele enjoyed having him as a teacher. he was extremly good at explaining difficult concepts and he always was nice i would definatly not skip this clas
His tests are not easy by any means, but he is a great teacher and very helful. One of my favorites thus far. Just watch to wording on the tests and you'll be fine.

he has the fame of being difficult, but truth is he is not that difficult, he is a very good teacher, you will learn a lot with him, and will definetly feel more comfortable with your writings after having him as a teacher, he is funny and his comment will really help you, just follow his directions and meet with him often, and u'll do good.

stuetzle is kinda weird. He teaches you well but his grading is tough. Make sure your grammar, spelling, etc is top notch or he'll dock you points for it. He is very meticulous in his grading so make sure u follow the guidelines exactly.

I was dreading this class because I read bad reviews about him, but it turns out he is NOT at all bad. He is a great teacher and he has a weird sense of humor that I enjoyed. His tests were really tricky though!! I took it in the summer so the material was crammed, and even then I really enjoyed this class. He also always had time to help!
Jerk. Hate him. Makes his exams hard on purpose and is not open to reconsidering grades. One of the worst professors that I had at UM. He tries to be funny and it's annoying. DO NOT TAKE HIM.
No Comments
Sexy and funny....when i made the comment about not all placebos work and my reasoning was birth control can't be placeboed he laughed really really hard. Fun and easy tests.
No Comments

I took him for Statistics, which was a class I was dreading.  However, he made everything very clear and surprisingly easy to understand.   He goes slow to make sure that everyone understands the material.  And, if you pay attention and take good notes, his exams are really not that difficult.

I don't doubt that Dr. Stuetzle knows that he is talking about. He is obviously extremely intelligent and his love of his craft is evident in his teaching. However, he is a difficult grader and his exams are very hard.
I truly don't think the class and professor could be any worse. Astoundingly bad.

Weekly quizzes which are open note. Final is worth 35%, but as long as you have a good grasp on the content you'll be fine. If you do poorly on the final though it does sort of cook you. Homework for each chapter section as well. Very understanding and kind prof, gave extensions when needed.
She is super nice and a good teacher. Be aware final is absolutely killer and hard kinda screws all your prior accomplishments in the class… 35%

she is kind, and the class work isn't hard but she doesn't prepare you well for the final. The final is worth 35%, she gives practice materials but they dont help you at all.The final is in a completely different format than the quizzes. Despite having good grades in everything else, the final kills you and she does not help you at all to prepare.

So nice and caring.  The class itself is hard but she really tries to make sure students do well she is a really good teacher and definitely the best across any "math" class requirement ive had to take in the business school.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Tian Yu is such a sweet prof. Her class is straight-forward, you learn in class, have weekly quizzes, 3 tests, 3 homeworks. Quizzes are online... Ngl the material is hard, if you're not locked in to class prepare to lock inn for tests especially the final. If you stay on top of it you should be able to get an A. also offers extra credit.
Tian Yu is awesome, class is really easy if you pay attention, take her if you can

genuinely wants her students to do well. Hard class but she makes it manageable. 9 quizzes but u can drop 3. 2 midterms and a final. first exam is easy and then the content gets harder.Only one part of the final is cumulative.

Professor Yu is super nice and her lectures are very clear. She takes attendance for extra credit sometimes but all assignments are online and straightforward. Exams are always extremely similar to her practice tests; I highly reccomend.

She is the only good professor in the stats department. Make her the department chair. Quizzes are open note, so all you need to do is match the quiz question to the homework questions and plug in the numbers, and she does the homework with you in class. Very flexible with rescheduling quizzes if you have a conflict.

Pay attention in class. You could get an A in this class, it's not that hard but you have to be dedicated. Go to every class for participation. HW is easy points cause she does it in class w you. Exams are same style as HW. She really sets her class up so that we can do well despite the heavy content. Quizzes every other week, 2 drops. HW 1 drop.

She is very nice when it comes to grading exams. This class has many quizzes but she drops the 2 lowest quizzes. There is Homework due after every chapter but she does it with you in class. She does random attendance checks and sometimes gives extra points for attendance. Lastly, the exams are VERY similar to the study guides she does in class.
The best.

Professor Yu is the best stats professor at Miami by a country mile. Her class could not be more straightforward, and you'll learn a ton of material without being overwhelmed. She is also underratedly hilarious, and if you stop by her office or talk to her individually it is always an awesome conversation. Wait to take her if she is unavailable!

Hands down the best statistics professor in the entire university. All tests and quizes are open note and she does the homework problems with you in class. If you can't take one of her sections, don't take statistics until you can she is that much better than every other professor.
This professor is one of the kindest and most caring professors I have had during my time at UM.
She is an amazing professor. her lectures are very clear and easy to follow, and she does the homework during class. exams aren't too tough, and both the exam and quizzes are open note.

I love Professor Yu. Such a great professor and teaches the course material well. Occasionally takes attendance, but she does the homeworks in class during the lectures and the quizzes aren't that hard. Midterm exams are identical to the classwork she goes over. Class lectures are recorded and posted on Blackboard

Professor Yu is awesome. Attendance is mandatory but quizzes and exams are open note and she prepares you well. The only negative is that if you are a slow test taker you may struggle with her exams because you have to work very quickly. She is super caring and understanding, my favorite math professor I've had at UM.

Quiz and Homework for every section but she does the homework with you in class. Everything is open note. She records all her lectures so you can go back to review, but attendance is mandatory. Definitely the BEST math teacher at UM.
BEST math teacher as UM coming from someone who has taken MAS three times and always dropped it

EASILY the best math teacher in the business school's notoriously horrible math dpt. She really cares about her students and makes everything so easy if you're willing to go to her when you need help. She is such a personable professor! I wish I could take her a million times.

Professor Yu is by far the best in the stats department of the B school.  She genuinely cares and whats all of her students to succeed. If you follow along in class while she does the required homework's with you study for a couple of hours before the exam, which are very similar to the practice exams, you will do fine.

The best statistics teacher I've ever had. She is so kind, caring, helpful, a clear lecturer, and goes above and beyond to help every student IF the student tries. Only advice is to study your a$$ off for the first exam because it's the hardest assignment all semester (avg was mid-70, no curve to my knowledge). From there, exam 2 and 3 much easier.
Very understanding and wants you to succeed. Lets you drop 2 out of the 7 quizzes and allows for a cheat sheet for the exams. I took her for MAS 201 and for MAS202. Highly recommend

She clearly cares for her students, and her grading system definitely works in your favor if you complete assignments. She gives partial credit when you show work on exams and quizzes were open book/note/everything. As someone that doesn't like math courses, she was a great professor to work with.

The stats department at Miami is horrible, so Professor Yu is a decent option. She was new to teaching the course however made it easy for students to do well. There is a lot of lectures that are pretty hard to understand, so you will have to teach yourself before the exams and quizzes. A difficult class but the best of the worst.

Professor Yu is new to teaching MAS202. She is very kind but can move quickly with the lectures and it can be hard to keep up. Quizzes are open note and one page of notes is allowed for exams. She gives hw assignments before every exam which are very helpful. Final is on coding which seemed irrelevant to the course but she explained it well.

Very nice professor who is new to UM. Class isn't easy but if you do the homework and study a little you will be well prepared for the exams. Not a ton of outside work but she takes attendance most days.
He's so funny and class is the best thing

At first I thought he was snarky but hes grown on me. The class is alot of weekly readings but no exams just do the readings. Weekly five question T/F quizzes on the readings (not hard) usually there always either all true or all false. Overall an interesting class but can be boring at times.

He is very approachable. Classwork was a decent amount of work outside of class. I learned a lot, especially writing skills. He is a very funny and interesting guy, and his lectures were very engaging. I would take him again!

Honestly the GOAT. Yes, he's a little weird and very opinionated - but he truly seeks to refine his student's intellectual sharpness throughout the class. Very open to disagreement and new information, a rarity in Poli Sci. Take his writing advice seriously. Pretty fun too and flexible on if you need extra time for an assignment.
Great overall and gets you super interested in the topic he teaches.

Professor Uscinski is one of the best I've had at UM. He is hilarious and cares about his students. The class is easy if you put in effort. We have heavy readings and reviews to write weekly. We write papers on movies watched in class. At first you will do poorly but he tells you what to fix weekly. Eventually, you do great! 100% would take again.

Three readings per week, becoming 3 small summaries. A few in-class movies with one-page summaries (2 weeks to do them after watching). Final paper.

Grading starts tough but improves with progress. Final grade relies on later work mainly, early grades do not represent your grade. Prof Uscinski makes lectures entertaining and engages with students.

Def improved writing, however, the readings were insane and time consuming. You read three difficult readings each week (20-30 pg each) and summarize them into 5-8 sentences not using the words "am, been, is, being, was, were, exists", FIVE one page summaries on "movies", and a final paper. Lectures were engaging tho, always simplified concepts.
