reviews.comment: He is genuinely the worst thing to happen to this college. Nothing is good enough for him because he masks the fact that he is a bad person under humor. Nothing can ever be good enough for him and he locks the class as soon as final papers are turned in so he can grade however, PLEASE save your GPA and do not take the class!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hes so funny but POL 401 is kinda hard. Its such a long class so I zone out a lot. The exams are kind of hard as well. When Uscinski is teaching for that day it makes it so much more enjoyable. Honestly dont take this class its pretty boring

Dude he is so awesome. I don't need to take anymore POL classes, but I'm seriously re-considering. He is the funniest, most engaging professor i have ever had. You do need to participate and show up to class, but he does not give quizes or tests, all he asks is for participation... just take the class u won't regret it.
assignments do not align with course content but helped my reading and writing tremendously! highly recommended for POL/Humanities majors. readings were difficult but lecture was only once a week

Really interesting class. There are a lot of readings that are difficult and long. Grades are based on reading summaries and a class reflection. He is super nice and approachable. I would recommend him
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: yeah he's a good prof, it is a writing class so get ready for all of that, classes are always super engaging and interesting; he is an amazing teacher in that sense but he picks favorites too often and classes get weird at points but he means well and he is super funny so take him just be. ready. to. read. & its not fun stuff it's long boring stuff
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--So many papers

reviews.comment: He's a great guy and a very entertaining lecturer. The reading summaries were very challenging though, as we had to summarize 70 page chapters at some points, so his class is very time consuming. However, if you put in the work, an A is pretty easy to attain. Learned a lot and had a good time in his class.

A pop quiz everyweek(25% all together) and three major tests throught the semester (25% each). All questions based on lectures and readings. So if you read each section assigned and attend the lectures you will pass easily. Great speaker and professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Has the best guests of any lecture. Really into his work so hes not as available but if you pay attention to the lecture, speakers and few notes you will get an A

I really couldn't pay attention in lecture no matter how hard I tried. Unfortunately, you need to listen and take good notes if you want to pass the class. Take it only if you're interested in conspiracy theories.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Usckinski is a very intelligent professor, however he isn't for everyone. If you like classes that are more lecture based than text book based, then take his class. The readings are hard though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Honestly one of the better professors Ive had at UM. Yea there is a lot of reading and few grades but what do you expect from a 300 level class. Perhaps the best part is how engaging the class is, he even brought in Roger Stone to speak! Better sign up quick though, even though his lectures are big they fill up fast,
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Get ready to read! Follow his instructions. No passive voice in the writings! (I.e. write like this.) He makes very funny and cynical jokes. Great to talk to and the class material teaches you a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Overall a pretty fun class, all you have to do is come to class and take notes and you'll get an A. The classes are interesting so it's not that hard to pay attention. You can tell the professors want to give you a good grade, you just have to put a bit of effort in. I also had Uscinski for a study abroad program and he's a pretty chill guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Honestly thought that Uscinski was a little unusual at first, and that this class would suck. Hes actually a tough grader but makes it clear how you can improve, and from what I gather, 99% of students end with an A. Weekly readings/summaries, but zero tests or quizzes. Cool guy with a good sense of humor, I would take a class with him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: By far my favorite professor. His lectures are very informal and he's hilarious. POL313 is a writing credit and basically every week all we had to do was read three articles then write a paragraph summary for each article. There are no tests, quizzes, or exams. Not too bad at all. I will definitely try to take more classes that he teaches.

Lots of reading and tough grader but you end up with a good grade if he sees you're trying your best. Make sure to participate if the class is small because he will notice if you don't and will call on you if he thinks you aren't paying attention. Overall, great Professor and interesting lectures. Would definitely take again!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I took him for the elections course and enjoyed his teaching style. As long as you did the readings and showed up to class and studied at all, you could get a B+ or A-. Interesting to hear what he has to say because he knows his stuff

Uscinski is my second favorite professor after Sylvia Thompson. He's extremely funny in a cynical and slightly snide way, but he makes you think. He's type of  professor that would be awesome to get high with. Don't take his classes if you're lazy, he will kick your ass. Lots of work, but it's worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Awesome professor who's very intelligent. Lots of reading but its worth it just make sure to participate in class. The grading seems weird at first but it all works out in the end . highly recommend if you like papers, discussions, and critical thinking instead of memorizing worthless facts for tests
Great teacher. Helpful if you go to office hours. Grading gets easier as semester goes on. Lots of dense readings

Uscinski is a fair professor. There are 3-4 articles (usually 20-40 pgs) to read every week for which you must write a paragraph on each article. These paragraphs are your grade. No tests/quizzes. Attend almost every class and do every assignment and you should have an A. The articles can be dense, if you don't want read this class is not for you.

Great Professor! His conspiracy class was awesome. A ton of reading to do every week along with short summaries but he is always available at office hours for help and my reading/writing greatly improved over the course of the semester. Taking another class with him in the fall.

Uscinski is the man. Go to the class. He keeps it interesting and keeps you laughing throughout the entire class. He's really helpful if you go to his office hours. Do what he says and you'll get the grade you want.

He is the czar of right, and we're all just swimming in a sea of wrong. He is the alpha and the omega. He is the great captain of this ship, named America. God forbid you use a passive verb in his presence. On a serious note, I picked up smoking again after YEARS of being smoke-free because of this class. I better get an A.

Terrible. Dont bother showing to class, he doesnt teach anything there, all you need to do is do summaries and extra credit. VERY hard grader for the summaries sarcastic for no reason. make sure you do ALL extra credit b/c thats the only thing that will get you a good grade. Never mind doing the actual work, all you need is extra credit to pass. :/

My favorite professor at UM. His classes are always completely full for a reason. He's nerdy and hilarious/sarcastic and will always work to accommodate you. The class is very informal and we don't use a textbook, but I think I've learned more in this class than any of my others combined!
The course is mainly comprised of simple projects and an article summary due each week. He is very knowledgable on the subject which the topic all the more interesting.
Hes cool.  He helps people write better.  He cares about students too.

Dr. Umhau is always willing to help even if she seems a bit intimidating at first. The beginning of the lab was a bit hard to follow, but once we started getting used to the way she taught, and more comfortable asking questions, it was great. The lab reports are annoying, but usually the TAs don't grade them too harshly as long as you try.

Took her for MSC101 and was a very interesting class. Dr Umhau is such a sweet person and great professor. 4 in person exams closed note, fairly lecture heavy but if you go to the lectures and take notes you should be fine.

this class is very light in regards of course work, each week's assignment is just one lab report based on the prior lab, just follow the provided instructions and you'll get a good grade, no final exam or anything just 11 lab reports
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She controlled the HW and exams for the spring semester. The HW was pretty pointless and didn't help recollect the material at all, but the exams were on par with previous semesters. She also lectures pretty quickly and is a little too thorough with the material (when she would lecture). She's pretty sweet but as a teacher, she's alright

Dr. Umhau is such a great professor. She is so kind and very knowledgable about the content learned in the marine science lab 112. The course grade is only comprised of 11 lab reports (they can be tedious) so it's important not to fall behind on those

Super passionate professor I loved his class! Very discussion heavy so just be open to share your thoughts on any movie/documentary we watch during class. There are also a few presentations and papers but he's a veery easy grader as long as you put effort in.

This teacher is so passionate about everything he teaches. Every class, we had a two-hour lecture and there was not a beat where he was not confident in what he was talking about. I loved this class so much that I'm taking another one of his classes next semester.

Jorge is an awesome professor, he is very knowledgable and passionate about anthropology, and his lectures are interesting. There are quite a few presentations and discussions, but they're always chill and not stressful.

Has good intentions but is not a good professor. Due dates are very unclear and everything is very unorganized. Homework and quizzes are fairly easy but you are better off to skip the zooms and teach yourself through the lectures from the textbook.  2 case projects that he seems to grade based off of completion. Exams were also very short.

The only thing I did after this class was to change my Finance major to a minor. Learned nothing from this course, literally nothing. Gives almost full on the 3 projects which shows that he doesn't check them since they are complex in mathematical calculations and nobody does them correctly lol. Don't take him unless you have no choice like me.

Nice guy, horrible professor. Most boring lectures I have witnessed in the entirety of college. Constantly contradicts himself and presents wrong information, and will not accept being corrected by students. He refused to show me my final exam, which was the only grade bringing me from an A+ to a B+.

You can decide whether you want to take his class: for me, his lecture is boring, but finance is hard to be interesting. He doesn't have attendance, and 3 projects are very easy to get 100 since it's hard for him to check calculations you did. He extends projects due date if some people asked him. His exam is ok, half concept and half math.

Good guy, bad professor. Lectures are long and boring. Very unorganized, does not give any math examples even though half of the test and projects include math calculations to be done. Not understanding.
very bad professor, doesnt give feedback, questions are unclear, not helpful. take my advice your better of learning from youtube this his class.

This guy is the worst professor I've taken at this school. Really arrogant, doesn't understand normal people, and makes his tests impossible. Just don't take this professor iEveryone I know got Cs and he did not curve just because one person got 100 He does not care about his students !

Do not take this professor! His exams are open book but extremely difficult. You have three projects and he does not give clear instructions. He does not care about his students. This semester I had a really bad problem and he was not understanding at all. He seems to be a really laid back teacher but in reality, he is not Worst proff at UM!

Very dry, rigid and obsolete teaching, 
I strongly don't recommend taking him.

This class is pretty difficult and there is no curve, but the grading is fairly lenient. I did learn a lot and Dr. Visser is a pretty interesting lecturer. The final was open note but very challenging and only one question was similar to our assignment questions. Read the textbook after each lecture it will help. Do not take for an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Obsolete content, very dry teaching. AI is at an exciting stage right now and the Prof. managed to make this exciting subject very dry and non-interesting. Highly recommend to study online instead of wasting time here. Also, very rude and non-flexible with dealing with students. I don't recommend it.

Very fun class, you definitely learn a lot about the basics of Game Programming, however, it is a lot of work, as your final presentation basically requires you to be an Indie Developer for a semester. All that said, however, it is also very fulfilling and rewarding once you have everything working in your game
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is definitely difficult, but it is a high level class so it is supposed to be. If you attend the lectures, study the material, and don't procrastinate the HW, you will be fine. Homework will take a long time, but he goes over it and you should definitely go to the TA hours if you are stuck. Final was medium difficulty and class is curved
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: 545 was a very difficult class, but I also expected it to be interesting.  WRONG!  This class was made so so boring from assignments to lectures you will learn nothing about AI that you're looking for in this class but keep all of the difficulty.  Lectures and homework's are directly out of the textbook, which he claims is optional, it's not.

I learned a lot and I have a project to show for it! Prof. Visser keeps up with new trends in technology and structures his class to be fun and engaging. There is a lot of work you have to do outside of class but it's worth it! Expectations are clear and manageable.
I was fond of the way the class was laid out. Great lectures fluid progression of topics.

This is the best class I have ever taken. Tons of material, not easy but really cool! I definitely recommend Dr. Visser, he is gentle, treats students with respect, and has excellent knowledge in this field.

Tries to make his classes more interesting. Explains thing well, even though parts of the material taught can be boring. Homeworks are pretty easy if you read the slides and are worth 70%, final is 30%.
Just go to class and do the homework and you'll be fine (70% HW, 30% final). Material is really dry but he's a nice guy.

This guy is the worst teacher in the Computer Science Dept. He lifts his slides right from the book and just reads off them in class. When you try and ask fro guidance he acts like he's busy or that your question is so intuitive that you shouldn't be wasting his time asking. I doubt he knows the material at all. he's researcher, not teacher.

open book final. Multiple choice was 56 questions that were mostly definitions that could easily be searched in your notes. Essay was 1000 word maximum and was extremely straight forward if you had even the most basic understanding of the material. Easiest A you will get in law school.

Prof. Urice is the kindest man. He uploads all the powerpoint which you can basically use as an outline. His book is amazing too. He is so down to earth and willing to speak with students. I always felt calm and happy in his classroom. 10/10!

Professor Urice is one of the most down to earth and brilliant professors you could have, especially in law school. He goes out of his way to make his material approachable and the takeaways practical. He can occasionally lecture too much, but his asides are almost always interesting and he maintains a solid structure to his thinking.
Worst Ever!!!! Do not do yourself a disservice. He makes you buy a textbook that he wrote which is full of errors, errors that can possibly result in malpractice.

Solid overall teacher. Only thing I could complain about is the final. 60 multiple choice questions to determine your entire grade in a 4 credit course isn't appropriate or fair. Also took him forever to get the grades back. Honestly all in all I probably wouldn't take the class again. Needs to be more chance to "show what you know."

Amazing professor who really knew the material. The professor encouraged the students to complete original research and provided wonderful guidance for class papers. Professor Urice inspired the class that was already motivated. The student presentations were excellent and covered a wide range of topics. The best class at Law School.

Prof. Urice may be the nicest, most easy going professor at UM Law. But be warned, anyone who tells you his class is easy is wrong. I fell for that one. The class was tough and his final bordered on brutal. You will not have enough time to complete the MC part unless you know the info from memory. If you want an easy grade, take another class.

LOVED THIS CLASS AND URICE! I did all the reading because I was so enthralled with the subject, and got an A. Definitely read and review. This is not a class you can skip the reading for, thinking you can do it all during the exam period. Exam was completely fair, but tricky, most questions required careful attention to what he said in class. TAKE!
No Comments
Absolute goat. Paper homework and his lectures take a somewhat challenging concept and made it accessible for the entire class. Highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Prakash was a great professor for this class! The material was understandable, and there were cool demonstrations in class. He made a challenging class easy to understand. Very accessible to his students!
Probably the best physics professor and he's a pretty good lecturer! Still hard because it's physics though lol and there's a lot of homework.

Dr.Prakash is a king and he loves teaching. He uses examples in class and tries to make the tests as easy as possible (but they are still hard because it's University Physics.) LOTS OF HOMEWORK so be ready and do it because there is alot and its an easy way to get a good amount of points. Great Prof, take him for 201 if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Extremely kind and knowledgeable Professor. Really cares about the students, and is a very respected researcher and scientist. Easily the best professor that I've had in the department.

Prof. Prakash is a great professor who really cared that we learned and did well in the class. The grading for the class was 60% exams and 40% participation, so *NOT* at all exam-heavy. I've never taken physics before and did well, just skim the readings before lecture and redo the worksheets and LC (hw too) for the exams (3 w/ 1 drop + a final).

I took Professor Prakash for PHY 201. He is a very nice professor and very knowledgeable. But I dont think hes great at teaching. The class is very exam heavy 60% and the rest of the material is mostly group based. I would recommend having some level of physics knowledge before taking this class or else youll be teaching yourself/ getting tutors
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Prakash is an amazing professor and I would recommend his course to anyone who asks. He is beyond understanding and helpful if a student needs it. I took PHY 101 and PHY 102 with him and he truly made physics enjoyable to learn.

My experience with Professor Prakash was great. He he was very friendly and easy to approach. His class is unique in that the lectures and labs are all during the same 2 hour session time, and also that majority of your work is done in groups. 40 % of his class is no exam or final based! I really recommend him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: Actually a bastion in his field. Super knowledgeable, approachable, and kind. Really makes you love the class and is a great connection/resource. The HMP department is one of the best at the U.

Dr. Ullmann is a great professor, he keeps the class engaged with his interesting stories that relate to the class content. Study his PowerPoints and you'll be fine for exams both midterm and final are easy.

Dr. Ullman is awesome. Super interesting class. He has so much knowledge and expertise to share. In Class exercises are part of the grade and attendance >80% req'd. There is a midterm, final, group project, and a few smaller grades - none of which are too difficult. He is a pleasure to talk to and learn from. Prob my favorite class this semester.

Dr. Ullmann has so much knowledge, it is insane! He has a story for everything and always had things to share related to the course which made the material very interesting. However, at times, the material presented felt a bit like a history class, the class itself was very enjoyable, and Dr. Ullmann was a very friendly person.

I can't deny that he is super sweet and has many connections but as someone who studied HOURSSSS. for his exams, they did nothing. The way he words questions on the exam literally sets you up for failure and they're worth so much that even tho I got 100s in everything else, they didn't matter.
Great prof. Tests make up most of your grade. Lectures get boring sometimes, but if you do good on the test you will end with a A in this class

As a student who always gets A's.... Ullmans class was terrible. Not only does this class bring you health anxiety, but also is very disorganized and is fear mongering. I left this class in tears several days and ended with the worst grade I have ever received. I get better grades in 400 level finance classes. Do not take him

Dr. Ullmann is a very kind professor, with many stories.  Group projects are a big part of the class. I would recommend his class. Although the exams are difficult, other assignments help cushion your overall grade.

Dr. Ullmann is amazing! He makes the material very interesting. The exams are not the easiest, but if you study hard you will do fine. Lots of group work, so make sure to attend class. I would 100% take this class again, and actually looked forward to going. He is very approachable and makes an effort to engage with the class.
Such a nice man and very knowledgeable on this subject. Tests were fair and prepared us well for them. Loved this class
He's the sweetest. Lectures aren't the most fun, but he's passionate about HMP, which makes it more interesting.

I really enjoyed taking this class with him. Although I did not do well on the first exam, I will get an A in the class. He is super understanding as long as you participate and are present in his classes. He is super understanding and caring. Lectures are sometimes boring but you will learn a lot if you pay attention.

Dr. Ullmann is an amazing professor. Even though his class was 4 hours he makes the class interesting. interesting and fun. Daily group projects so you need to be in attendance every class for the full duration. Also you need to pay attention to his lectures because it will show up on his tests; which are easy if youre paying attention
Great professor! He really cares about his students. He is extremely well educated and can answer basically every question. TAKE HIM IF YOU CAN! A lot of group projects.

BEST PROFESSOR I ever had. He is so caring with his students and really wants you to learn, gives a lot of examples and lecture is actually very interesting and engaging. Would definitely take him again.

Dr. Ullmann is the definition of an amazing teacher. He taught me so much in such a short time. If you get the chance to take HMP 270, take it! Everything is explained so clearly and he truly wants the best for every single student.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Amazing professor who is very knowledgable about the ever-complex world of healthcare economics. He is well-connected and highly respected, and there is so much to be learned from his lectures - which you should definitely pay full attention to! Great class for business, healthcare, and pre-med students alike. One of the best classes at UM.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I love Ullman. He's such a sweet man, and even though my class was over a hundred students, he was happy to get to know everyone individually. I give him credit for sparking my interest in health sector management, I even switched my major. HMP 270 is a great class for ANYONE considering a career path in healthcare.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Ullmann is a really great guy with lots of experience in his field, which helps to break down concepts and make his lectures more relevant to everyday life. He puts you into groups and occasionally has pop quizzes to count for attendance. Exams are very straightforward with pretty lax grading. Two major group projects at the end of the semester

Dr. Ullmann is such a knowledgeable person and he conveys his passion onto his students. You learn so much, and somehow, he makes it easy to understand. Healthcare is so complex, yet this introduction course is simple as long as you put in the work. Loved this class!

Dr. Ullmann's lectures are very interesting and he is very knowledgeable. Usually, he can answer any questions you have. Plus, he has years of experience and he still does consulting work to this day so he's very up-to-date on the current system. The only bump I had in this class was the group project at the end. Just prepare early for it!
slides. attendance. go to every class to get an easy 25%. you will learn a lot. there is a lot of info. take him. OG

Professor Ullmann is super qualified and knows everything there is to know about healthcare. This class really opened my eyes to the complexity of healthcare and I'm glad I had Ullmann to teach it to me. He's a very chill guy in class and isn't too demanding. Two exams, a project and a few in class activities.
Amazing professor, very informative class. You will learn a lot and gain a lot of insight into the field even though it's only an entry level class.
By far this has been the best professor I have had at UM. I would highly recommend him to any student. You will learn more in this class than any other class.
Tests are hard and grades the essays with no real deliberation. Lectures are boring.
Knows everything about the subject, too qualified to be teaching this class. The grading system is a little iffy but it's an amazing intro course. (makes you get the textbook, never uses it)

Great professor! He knows his stuff and does a great job teaching it. His class is made up of 2 exams, 1 project, and a few in class assignments. He is one of the best professors i have ever had. Definitely take him.
Dr. Ullman is one of the best professors at UM.
Dr. Ullmann is a great guy. Even though you only meet with him once a week, he runs a great class. He is very open to questions. He is also without a doubt the easiest MGT100 professor.

Extremely difficult and frustrating class. Assignments were unclear, lectures rarely helped, and grading was very harsh over tiny details. Spent countless hours confused and stressed trying to complete homework that felt unnecessarily complicated. The TAs were the real MVPs. I ended up withdrawing. Avoid this professor if possible!!!

This class is HARD with lots of tough material to go through. But the weekly HWs can get a pregrade, allowing you to fix them if you do them early. Weekly quizzes, tough midterm, and a fair final overall making the tests not too bad. Professor Milenkovic loves to crack jokes and references, and he was always smiling. Hard, but I would recommend :)

Yes, it is a hard class. The professor is very smart and does his best to keep lectures light, but the material is super heavy. You're going to have to work for your grade, but you'll definitely learn A LOT, which is very rewarding. He also really appreciates when students are genuinely interested, asking questions, and enjoying in the content!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Worst professor at UM by far.

Professor Milenkovic is a genius, If you want to be a strong CS student and learn a lot, I suggest you take his course. However, it is extremely challenging and you WILL spend long hours at your computer. This class is to see if you have what it takes.

The reason there are so many negative reviews is that CSC220 is naturally a weeder class for the major and students who just aren't cut out for CS take it out on him. There is a lot of homework, which is often complicated, but the tests he gives you are the tests he uses to grade. That being said, he's a great lecturer who you can learn a lot from.

He's a little hard to communicate with. You ask him a question and he goes on a tangent about completely different things. Not a helpful and test-heavy. A harsh grader spent hours on hours just to get a 0. expects you to know as much as he does.

Professor Milenkovic is a genius, don't get me wrong. Look him up on Google and check out his accomplishments. However, this class is unreasonably difficult, and the homework is poorly explained and takes hours. This class contains many interesting topics, and the TAs are amazing, but I recommend you take it with the other professor.

Horrible professor, if you can take literally anyone else do that. This guy gives templates of code for you to fill in with your own but the templates themselves have hidden bugs he doesn't tell you about. He also takes points off for having an updated system like using removeLast() instead of remove(size()-1). Hardest. final. ever.

Dr. Milenkovic is so passionate about graphics, and teaches it amazingly. The content of the class is very hard to understand at points, but his lectures are fantastic. He really wanted us to learn, and it was a great class. There are weekly quizzes, a midterm, and a final, which aren't super hard if you study. Take it with him, he is the goat!

Genuinely the worst experience I had with a professor. Expected everyone to be as smart and capable of grasping the concepts without actually teaching. He is extremely uncaring about his students. Had to withdraw from the course and now I am succeeding with another professor. THIS IS THE CLASS THAT MAKES YOU QUESTION COMPUTER SCIENCE!!!!

The class so hard for no reason. None of the concepts you learn are actually difficult he just makes them seem it. The TA Collin should have taught the whole class.The labs are fairly easy but then he assigns homework which is difficult. Every week they would have 3 help sessions to help with the homework where 30+ students would show up.

Professor Milenkovic is very knowledgeable, but my praise of him ends there. He is short, even rude with students, and quick to deduct a significant number of points for small discrepancies with his output, even when you have written the entire program. I've taken a lot of MTH/CSC classes and he assigns SIGNIFICANTLY more work than the rest. Beware

By normal standards, this class sucks. This is not a normal class, however. It is very hard. You will learn so much. If you are proactive-go to help sessions, ask questions, etc, you WILL be successful. This class will have you level up. Tips: Don't stress over the quizzes (only 10%) and collaborate with others when writing programs. Good luck!

The bad reviews on this professor are strictly because this is the first class most will take at UM that requires a lot of work. If you are in CS, this will prepare you for future classes, as well as work after college. He is a genius, he is preparing you for the real world with this class. Yes it is hard, but a class you need to get ready for life
He is horrible. He is too smart to explain things at a basic level for students. This is the hardest class I have ever  taken I am shocked I made it out with a B. Milenkovich? more like Milenkobich.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Very bad. Would recommend only if you are VERY passionate about computer science and willing to put in the long, isolated hours in-front of you computer. This course is not fun. It is not engaging. The lectures do a poor job at explaining concepts. Ruthless in grading. Do not take. (P.S. TA's are great).

Victor is the worst of all the CS classes I have had. I managed to get through it with an A- with way too many late nights. The constant work he gives out, along with how unclear it is, makes class miserable. Plus, the lectures are awful, and he's very unavailable. The TA's are fantastic and are the reason I got through it.
Ruthless in grading, not for the faint of heart. Avoid if your coding skills are not sharp.

Avoid if possible. Quizzes every week, unengaging lectures, and difficult and long labs and homework. Please ignore the reviews saying that bad reviews are from lazy students; I worked very hard and did reasonably well, it was just unnecessarily difficult. The expectation of skill for a 200 level class is just too much. The TAs are awesome though!

Dr. Milenkovic is an amazing professor, and he gets a bad rep by other reviews. There are weekly quizzes that have to do with the programs and lecture, and usually the homework is on the quiz although its not due yet. The midterm and final are just reused quiz questions. The material is very hard so you might have to memorize a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you want to change your major take this class.

There's a quiz and a program due every week. The programs are extremely difficult. and his instructions are incredibly confusing. Make sure to go to office hours and discuss with your peers so that you can finish the programs. The quizzes and exams are based on the programs so memorize how to write certain methods and classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Milenkovich is an difficult professor. Quizzes, exams, and labs are meant to challenge you, so be prepared to sink a lot of time into the course if you want to do well. That being said, you will definitely learn a lot, and if you participate and put in the effort, getting an A is not as difficult as you would imagine.

Victor Milenkovic is a great professor and adviser. I'd appreciate more real-world program examples. His teaching style feels old-school; I seek increased class engagement and clearer explanations, moving beyond reading from .txt files. While I like the lab structure, understanding steps in assignments can be challenging.
This class, with this professor, should be named "How to question your major 101"
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Milenkovic is a great professor who has a very well planned out course. His lectures can be confusing to follow at times but his labs and homework do a good job of walking you through the concepts. He can be a little hard to approach at certain times when asking questions. Be prepared to put in a lot of hours and hard work.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Avoid!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Not sure why Victor has so many poor reviews. There are quizzes every week but barely count toward your grade. The homeworks are continuations from the labs but you can get an extension by going to TA hours. The midterm/final are very hard but just study a lot for 2 weeks. Very tough class but just put the time in and you'll be fine.

Difficult class, but if you give a good effort and finish your projects, you will at least pass. Most of your grade is based on labs, homework, and a very hard final. Don't be afraid of help sessions, it exists for a reason. Lectures will not make sense. A CS major will eventually have to take a class with this professor, so get it over with.

This class had me on the verge of switching to business... I started growing grey hairs. He expects all of his students to be professional programmers when in reality most of us hadn't even been coding at all until 4 months prior. He makes you feel so bad about yourself when you go ask him a question. PLEASE take it with any other professor.

RUN. Im so serious omg. Okay for pretext, I actually love java and I did so well in 120. HOWEVER, this prof is the worst. Doesn't know how to teach, his homework and labs took atleast 15 hours every week and there's quizzes every single week. His final was so tough, and he would literally make you feel inferior and stupid for asking any question.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: This is a class that shows who the smart kids are and are in CS for the right reasons. Trust me, all the bad reviews are from kids that did terribly because they did not try. Victor is a Harvard professor. You can learn so so much from him. Use this opportunity! Literally just study and do your homework and you'll get an A. Also there was FAT curve
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: If you were looking for a sign not to take CSC 220 with Victor, READ NO FURTHER. He expects your brain to be a computer. I have lost all sanity through this course. The final is cumulative of the most obscure elements of the class. If you mess up one line of code on an assignment, expect a 0/100. I caution you, DO NOT even consider taking this.
Save yourself the headache and take this class with anyone else. Others have pointed out exactly why, I can confirm they're telling the truth. Seriously, run!

When it comes to grading the assignments, he tests your submission with his own coded tests. Then, whether your code passes or fails his tests, he grades you accordingly. This means that if you spend hours trying to get your code to work, and it doesn't by the deadline, you get a ZERO for the assignment. No partial credit, no regrades, no mercy.

I am in disbelief. I'd have a better time strung up in a medieval torture chamber than this horrendous class. This class requires an absurd amount of time and effort and I regret not looking at RMP before enrolling.

This is a hard class. The work is hard, but you come out knowing a lot more. He is doing a good job for teaching a class that weeds out students. Find someone older for Progs and Quizzes it will help you out alot. Also go to Prog Review sections since Comp sci tutors are $$ and they are there for free.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Milenkovic is so out of touch with reality please beware if you are a normal person. Even prior knowledge in the field won't help you here. Do not take this class.

If you ever wanted to question your existence or the major you chose then look no further. This guy is awful at teaching, worse than that is his vague instructions on the lab assignments/homework. I've asked him to clarify on specific things only to find myself more confused after he is done speaking. Avoid at all cost.
Makes me want to switch majors. He is very difficult to comprehend and cannot explain concepts in a clear and concise manner. Avoid taking him for 220.

I learned a lot in computer graphics. I sometimes make stupid mistakes in the progs, and Milenkovic was helpful to point them out when I post my bug on Blackboard. Don't be afraid to post on Blackboard and ask for help!

Computational geometry is by no means an easy subject conceptually, but Dr. Milenkovic makes the assignments easy enough to understand to be doable in a reasonable amount of time (some struggling required). Quiz, midterm, and final material are touched on particularly in depth during class, so pay attention and you should do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: A tremendous amount of work throughout the week and the progs require a lot of hours. If you get a couple of things wrong in the methods and he drops your grade 15 points. His lectures don't teach you how to code, for example, a linked list lecture is just full of definitions. If you're not well rehearsed in java than don't take him.

Milenkovic is a brilliant professor and knows the subject material extremely well. His ability to communicate this material, however, is difficult to understand if you're not a natural programmer. Put in the work, ace the projects and study for the quizzes from the lectures. Exams are difficult, make sure to look at his code as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Really unhelpful

This guy knows more than anyone else in the department. He's so smart, he has a hard time relating to us plebeians and how we could possible not understand something. His class is hard, because he gives a very difficult and in-depth homework every week.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Overall Victor is pretty cool but he is blunt and doesn't put up with dumb questions. The grades are mostly lab-based and there is plenty of help available outside of lecture when it comes to those assignments. This course is intended to be hard so as long as you put in the work you should be able to get through it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Tons of homework. People failed and waited for retake. All my friends switch major after taken his course.

Professor Milenkovic does not care at all about his students. His instructions are unclear and belittles you when you do not understand them. Comp Sci majors at UM, wait until fall to take CSC 220 with a different teacher! You will not regret it!

Dr. Milenkovic is a great instructor. Although CSC220 is a tough course, he makes it doable since he explains the concepts well in lectures. He is also super helpful and responsive to emails if you ask for help. Take this class. It will stretch you but in a good way.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: very hard
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: This man does not care at ALL if you need any real help. He just makes you feel worse for asking for any help. Seriously, this is a super tough class and I would strongly caution anyone against taking this. Labs take about 10 hours a week to complete. His teaching is mediocre but you NEED to have Java down by yourself. Toughest class ever.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: He lectures directly off his slides, but you can learn a lot. He can be pretty vague with his lab and homework directions and quiz questions. Pay attention and study past quizzes. You may want to avoid him if you're not a cs major.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: This guy is ridiculously hard. The projects are so difficult and he does not help at all. Worst teacher I've ever had! Seriously! Don't take him. He is not willing to go to your level to teach you.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Tough grader. He acts as though that's the only class in your schedule. Be prepared to spend tons of hours on your labs outside of the class. There's a huge gap between CSC120 and CSC220. He just expects students to be way more knowledgeable then we are. Can be a bit condescending when you ask question or for help? However, he's good at blackboard.

if you show up and really pay attention the course is not that tough, milenkovic is super responsive by email and also lets you collaborate with other students on blackboard. quizzes are hard but not worth a lot. exams take a lot of prep but he is a fair grader. good nonboring lecturer. lots of dad jokes
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Milenkovic teaches CSC220 in a consistent and predictable way. Lecture on Tuesday, lab on Wednesday, quiz on Thursday. The quizzes aren't too bad and the midterm/final are just long quizzes Dr. Milenkovic has slides prepared and available for lectures. They explain the concepts, but you learn the nitty-gritty stuff in the challenging projects.

CSC 220 is not for the faint of heart. The first few programs are easy, but the class gets exponentially more difficult. One bug in your output is a loss of 10 points on that program, so be careful. Then there's his daunting final, which covers everything in the course. But if you work hard, you'll learn a lot of computer science theory.

He was an incredibly confusing lecturer. He grades the labs incredibly harshly. Whenever a student asked a question, he would answer in an incredibly  condescending manner, as if the student should already completely understand the material before it's presented.

I believe Mr Milenkovic is an outstanding programmer but has no teaching skills. His classes are hard but will prepare you well. However, he has a terrible attitude and is very sassy. He probably thinks he is the smartest person in the classroom and will make sure you know it. He is not very clear in class, I had to teach myself with online courses

really didn't enjoy this class. he thinks he is so much smarter than everyone and makes you feel like an idiot when you ask a question. His grading is unfair and when approachedasked for a regrade he was not understanding. Really don't think he is meant to be a teacher

Never got bored in lecture -- always walked out thinking how cool CSC is! And I think he's gotten better about drawing things on the board for students. But he can come off as condescending sometimes. Weekly programs range from simple to tough -- be prepared to put in several hours of work a week.
You'll learn tons of things in this class. Very time consuming!! Not recommended if you are looking for an easy A or B. He's expecting some programming background students.
Good guy, difficult class. Praying I do well on the final in a few hours. He is not very organized, and it reflects in his presentation of concepts.
Amazing professor. Class is really, really difficult, but if you pay attention in class and ask for help when needed you will learn a lot and do fine.

Yes this class was fairly difficult, but that's partially because CSC120 was a breeze for me, so 220 seemed a lot harder. I love Dr. Milenkovic's use of the Blackboard discussion board - he answers questions promptly, and is very helpful if you ask. Just like 120, many of the concepts took a while to understand, but that's just how CS is.

This is the first time RMP's rating system has ever been wrong. He fails in all the categories, but his class was probably the one in which I have learned most at the university. His class is exceptionally hard - but it is because you are being challenged, not because you cant do it.

I enjoyed class with prof milenkovic.  He definitely assumes you have at least a bit of a background in CS, but I don't think any of his explanations were too difficult to understand.  I learned a bunch in this course and really appreciated his use of blackboard.  not many professors use it well or at all.

If you are good at programming, this won't be too hard.  It was challenging, and I did feel like I learned quite a bit.  That being said, he can seem condescending and starts to get on most people's nerves by the end of the semester.  Not great, but if you show up and can program a bit, should be an easy A or B.

He really knows what he's talking about - he just doesn't seem to know how to explain it very well. I struggled trying to understand just what he was asking of us. When someone did ask for help though, his responses via BlackBoard made things even less clear then before. Great guy, terrible teacher. Assumes you have an extensive background in CSC.

Really hard to understand his way of teaching. He is knowledgeable but he can't seem to explain his assignments on paper. If you like to be able to read your assignments then you are probably going to struggle in his class. Does calculations in his head.

Professor teaches as if you have had background for a programming class. Was supposed to be an intro into programming with java. Do not take unless you want a headache every Sunday trying to do the impossible homework. Would not take this class if I had to choose again.

OK this class sucks!!! if you are not a computer science major dont even bother taking the class!!! he assumes you know about basic programming, teaching is boring barely explain things, hws are hard, midterm is difficult..you spend tons of time in the hws.. TAs are somewhat helpful... if u need a Math elective.. dont even think of CSC 120!!!

Professor Milenkovic is a really nice teacher and is fair. However his class is really hard. If you do not have a basic understanding of Java or C++ the class will be difficult. He teaches as if you already know what he is talking about. His instructions are not clear at all. Take his class only if you already have an idea about the subject.

Mr. Milenkvic is a good teacher. However, you really need a strong logic background in order to be able to understand what he's talking about in class. I had 6 years of programming language expereicen and was taking the class for fun and it did the job, but he WAS suprisingly fast on lecture, assuming that all the students know alot.

I had difficulty learning with his teaching style. He basically sits at his laptop and types lines of code in class and explains what hes doing. He draws no pictures on the board to illustrate the data structures concepts behind the code. Visual learners beware. I will avoid this teacher in the future.

Milenkovic can get boring but his class is pretty straightforward. It consists of lectures with notes and programs and stuff up on the screen and then quizzes every once in a while, and then theres a couple tests based off of the quizzes and notes.

Dr. Van Dyken is hands down one of the best professors in the bio department. Tests are not difficult, he gives you clear instruction on what will be tested, and he's very animated during lectures. If he's an option to take, highly recommend
This guy is fantastic. He brings joy to my day and sunshine wherever he walks. He gives great feedback and makes things very easy to understand. This guy is an 11/10 teacher. Bravo

Took him for 150 and again for this course. You can tell he genuinely loves evolutionary biology, and really cares about inspiring future generations to care for the planet. His lectures are great, even with the no technology policy. The reading is a bit inconvenient for the workshops, however it is not that deep. Overall, W prof
waste of time

Awesome prof! Lectures are clear and accurately reflect exams without fail. A lot of HW questions also end up on the exams so make sure to look at those. The only downside of this class is that there are no electronics allowed, so for a class I took right after lunch I did find myself dozing off a lot but despite that, I still finished with an A!

I did not absolutely LOVE this guy like everyone else. I found his lectures difficult to follow since he did NOT allow technology in his class whatsoever. It was easy to become distracted/confused. The tests were difficult even if you studied alot. He's the type to teach a subject as if it's easy and common sense. Not the most approachable either.
BEST. EVER.

Im taking him again for 160 bc he's so efficient, funny and engaging. all lectures have slides, which are posted on blackboard, and are marked for what is tested material. the readings are recommended but not needed for this class. password attendance every morn, but you could js get a friend to send you the code.

Professor Van Dyken is the best professor I have had at the University of Miami so far. Rather than just going through his material, Professor Van Dyken makes an effort to connect the topics which he teaches while keeping his lectures entertaining.

Genuinely one of the best professors I had this semester, his class was engaging and genuinely interesting. He loves to teach and is passionate about each subject. He teaches in a way that bridges together every subject and makes it easy to learn.
no study guides for exams but the lowest of the 4 does get dropped. fair professor who does make lectures more fun, attend class and workshops and do the hw you'll be fine.

Such a funny and genuinely nice guy. Tries his hardest to make such dense content engaging and easy to understand. Easily the best BIL 150 prof! Gives EC for good attendance! As long as you go to class and workshops, do the homework, and study for tests farrrr in advance, you will do great in his class!

Van Dyken is a great professor for this class; it is easy to do well on the exams if you study the powerpoints a lot. Although there was a textbook you could use, I never did and found that you really don't need to use it. He gives extra credit for >80% attendance, and so make sure you do the homework and go to class as it adds a huge grade bump!

Amazing professor, so engaging. Class is generally very easy as long as you pay attention. He says exactly what will be on the exams and you just have to study a day or two before. Gives extra credit for 80% or more attendance.

Van Dyken is one of the best professors at UM. He is so funny, making lectures fly by, and a genuine guy. He can be a little intimidating at first, but he is truly amazing. Love his humor and wit, and his way of making complex topics more digestible. His tests are extremely easy if you go to lectures and pay attention. I recommend him for sure!!!
Van Dyken is literally the best professor for biology. His tests are super easy and the class is very manageable. His lectures are actually interesting and he's always available during office hours.

Lectures are engaging, covers content well. 50% attendance req'd. Drops one test, no make ups allowed for any reason, which is a bit ridiculous. Tests a bit difficult but easier than other profs. Not super helpful to talk to for help, and can be rude, not empathetic. Doesn't usually respond to emails.
Such a good professor, made lectures actually enjoyable and the tests were pretty easy for a college class. You can tell he also actually cares about his students and only wants you to learn.

Seriously an amazing guy. Tons of office hours. GO TO THEM for test review and to ask questions (and get to know him--he's hilarious)! He curves exams, drops your lowest, and the exams are already really easy. No technology in class, which was annoying at first but is honestly the reason I was more focused in his lectures than any other.
He makes his lectures so interesting! Great professor, easy tests, clear what is on the tests as well
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: super funny and engaging in class. lets you know everything on the test and is very transparent. tests are easy if you study! drops your lowest exam grade and the final is only worth 15% so it wont make or break you. super nice guy and wants you to do well!

Overall, he was a good professor. Sometimes, the fact that he was not tech in class was difficult, especially since the class was biology, and having an iPad was very useful. He was quite funny at times, but sometimes it felt like he was doing the bare minimum. It may have just been me, or since the class is full of content.

This was easily one of the best biology classes I have taken so far. His analogies are fun, he has a really random, funny and dry sense of humor. He is very chill. TAKE HIM, you'll be doing yourself a favor. The only caveat is that he is strict about not using phones which cmon guys it's not that hard to actually try and pay attention for 45 mins

Absolutely love this guy. Makes lecture so fun & is truly passionate about what he teaches and his students' success. Always available at office hrs or after class & explains content very well. Slides and reading exactly reflects exam content. 4 midterms (1 dropped) & final exam. Extra credit for good attendance. No electronics allowed.

Attendance taken, but only for extra credit. Gives you breaks halfway through class and makes the lectures as entertaining as possible. Posts all of his lectures and highlights what will be on the test. 4 midterms, 1 dropped, and a final. Tests are all MCQ and straightforward if you study. Doesn't answer emails, so ask questions in person.

This is one of the best teachers you will get for BIL 150. He is worth going to mandatory classes for. His lectures and teaching style is good for remembering conceptual things and as biology is heavy on concept learning, it will be a good thing for you to take his class. Good lectures, great sense of humor, and open to helping all students!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is the best biology teacher by far. He really cares about his students doing well and offers lots of extra help. His lecture are good and he is also funny. His tests can be a bit hard but overall a great class.

Love VD. Took him for 150 and again for 160. Hes so funny and makes lectures engaging. He posts all of his slides and even indicates which will be tested on so you know what to study. Nothing to worry about. Grade = 4 exams (one drop) and homework which is basically unlimited attempts. Gives EC for attendance. Very hard not to get an A, hence A+.

Oh boy where do I even begin. Professor Van Dyken is a very caring professor and makes the class pretty easy. Exams are easy and so is the homework. The final exam is literally just all the previous exams. My only issue with him is that he said Drake is washed and he's not
His only extra credit is attendance. If you go to his class every day then you'll get the full points. he only grades u for 3 tests... theres no such thing as curve btw!

One of the best professors I've taken at UM! His tests accurately reflect the exams, and he's a really good lecturer/teacher. He tries to be funny and make jokes, and we get a 5 minute break about halfway through class. Very caring professor who just wants his students to succeed. Take him!!!

Dr. Van Dyken is a great professor who really cares about his students. BIL 150 is a rigorous course; however, he's the best professor to take it with, as he ensures that students understand the material. His lectures are clear and engaging, and he presents the content in a way that can bring interest in Biology.

TAKE HIM. he is honestly the best professor I've had here at UM. he is funny and makes his lectures interesting by relating it to things people actually care about. attendance is extra credit. just go to the lectures and study well and you should get an A in this class. honestly such a good professor!!!!

Van Dyken was the most genuine and interesting professor to take for this class. He makes concepts easier to understand by drawing real-life comparisons and is so funny. The exams are usually identical to the slides, and the final was similar to all the past exams. He truly wants you to do well and learn a lot, so I highly recommend taking him!

Dont know how I got a B+ but its fine. Van dyken is a great professor. He makes his lectures engaging with some funny jokes and is a generally funny dude. He makes the tough material easy to understand and his tests arent too difficult if you study well for them. Go to the workshops they mark attendence and its part of the grade.100% recommend him

He tried to keep us focused by making many jokes and entertaining slide shows during lecture. My biggest complaint is that he does not answer any emails so if you have a question make sure to ask him during class. He is very funny and nice. Grading is very straightforward (scantron). There is not any extra credit.

This is my second time having Van Dyken as a professor and he's still amazing. Admittedly, I'm not as big of a fan of 150, but he still does a great job creating interest with his lectures. The tests aren't bad and homework is super easy. Definitely read the material and attend lectures, and you'll easily get an A.

Van Dyken the goat. Very flexible about the no electronics policy if you need it for accessibility or otherwise to take notes. SUPER engaging lectures and exam material that is actually covered in what he teaches. The accompanying reading in the discussion IS REQUIRED so make sure you get it AND READ IT or pirate the PDF.

Van Dyken is awesome! His lectures are really engaging and funny and he does well at explaining the concepts. He posts all ppts and lets you know what you need to know for tests by putting a marker on the slide. Grade is based on 4 exams (1 drop), homework, workshop, and final. If you study, you'll do well and won't have to worry about your grade.

He is super funny and the lectures are kinda interesting, but not interesting enough to make me go out of my way to go to class. The tests are pretty moderate, they definitely aren't too bad just study the slides. All the tests are multiple choice only.

The best lectures of all time. Average amount of hw, tests are hardish but manageable if you attend lecture- he makes it so much fun and interesting to attend class. The hard topics of biology he was able to explain in a very understandable way. He just radiates positivity and might be the funniest professor I've ever had. Take Dr. Van Dyken.

Professor Van Dyken is makes the topics we learn extremely engaging and interesting by making jokes and relating the topics to real life examples which helps understand the topic. The concepts were challenging, however professor he did an amazing job at throughly explaining them to where it can be easily digestible and completely understandable.

Dr. Van Dyken is absolutely amazing. I sat front row of his lecture at 9 am and he is just so energetic and funny! His tests are super simple and he will drop your lowest test grade. My best advice is to read the textbooks for help and take good notes in lectures. I will definitely miss him next semester. If you have the chance, take him!

Dr. Van Dyken is genuinely the best teacher I've ever had. TAKE HIS CLASS! I had a noticeably much better time this semester than my friends who took Dr.Gaines. His tests are reasonable (he puts yellow banners on certain lecture slides to detail it will be covered on the exam), his lectures are hilarious and super engaging, and he even gives breaks
Love Van Dyken. Definitely the best Bio 150 prof here. take him. Tests are manageable. He is funny in class if you go. You will definitely learn about bio.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Van Dyken is nice his lectures were easy to follow and funny. Attendance isn't mandatory + he drops your lowest exam grade. Homeworks & workshops are an easy 100% JUST DO THEM! His methods of studying weren't the best for me so don't get so caught up on how he wants you to study, but it was still really helpful : )

You have 7 workshop assignments, textbook assignments per each chapter, 4 exams and cumulative final. Incredible teacher and lectures are awesome and so engaging. Study harder than you think, its a lot of content, but you get to everything in the lectures. Do not miss any lectures, he will teach you everything very well.

His tests are extremely fair and staright to the point. As long as you attend the lectures and review the highlighted yellow slides you should be good for his class. He is super engaging and makes the class fun. Would def take this professor again if I could.
One of the best professors at UM. Is super caring and KNOWS HOW TO TEACHHH. As long as you pay attention in lectures and study notes you will do good on exams. If you can take VanDyken take VanDyken!

EASILY one of the best professors here. Attendance isn't mandatory, but I totally recommend going to lectures: he adds jokes and breaks, and overall makes the subjects so interesting to learn about. Homework is easy, workshops are easy, and exams aren't too bad either. He's also extremely caring and great to talk to outside of class. Def recommend!

Van Dyken is the BEST. He is such an engaging professor and makes the 75-min go by fast. Lectures are easy to follow, he includes videos, tells jokes, gives us a small break, and just fun to learn. Class has 4 midterms + final but lowest midterm is dropped, HW is easy/on quizlet, Workshops were easy, and attendance not mandatory. HIGHLY recommend!

LOVE Dr. Van Dyken. Had him for 150 and 160. His lectures are very entertaining and he cares about his students. Class is very easy if you attend lectures. Exams are all relatively easy. Do the homework and go to workshop (10% of grade is based on this so very important).
His lectures were actually engaging and super digestible. A lot of content for this course can be found on Quizlet. I definitely recommended taking him for BIL 160
He is a great professor. Engaging lectures and he's really funny. Tests are easy. 4 exams, lowest dropped. Highly recommend!
AMAZING TAKE HIM!!!
Van Dyken is the best professor that I have had at UM. His class is easy but not because of the material. He is just such a good lecturer that he makes difficult material really digestible.

Van Dyken is my favorite biology teachers! Extremely down to earth and is great at engaging you in long lectures. His tests are straightforward and using the textbook helps a lot. His homework isn't too bad and if you are struggling he will help if you reach out.

Van Dyken is wonderful, truly the best for BIL 150. He radiates great energy and his class is not that difficult. Lecture attendance is not required but highly recommended. This is a lecture dense class though so it's important that you remain on top of your work. Very minimal homework. He evidently wants his students to succeed. Take him!
