Great teacher. Easy and Fun. Tests and assignments very straightforward. Highly recommend

Very easy class.  She is very nice and laid back.  Usually assigns homework after each class, but nothing that takes more than 10 min.  A couple short papers during the semester and a final project (easy).
One of the best language teachers I've ever had. She is very nice and very much laid back. The only thing is she takes attendance... : (

Prof. Vazquez is one of the nicest professors at UM and a very good instructor.  The class is easy and she makes it fun.  She hardly ever keeps you the whole class time and all quizzes & exams are very straight-forward.  She is also very laid-back.  Totally recommend her.

he is such a sweet person and always tells cute stories, but his lectures didn't make much sense to me and i had to self teach a lot. his quizzes are also hard as they're poorly worded. he likes u way more when u participate, but gets kinda mad if u don't know the answers to his random questions. overall nice person but his class made me crash out

Took it as a stem credit as I'm really not stem driven, but he is a great professor. The class and exams are hard but if you read the textbook you will be fine. He is very nice and approachable and will help whenever/however he can.

Dr. Wang is very chill and shares funny stories. I took this for my science cognate, but found the quizzes and tests quite hard. He offers extra credit for over 10 points on test 1. Lectures can be confusing, and he sometimes rambles. Attendance is taken via iClicker. The material is challenging, especially for non-STEM majors.

I don't get the bad reviews. He's super sweet and passionate about teaching. Class is easy and interesting, 4 quizzes, some assignments, and case studies, all very doable. He uses PowerPoints and is understanding if you miss class. Just participate, keep your camera on, and you'll be fine!

i lost track of the amount of times i crashed out because of this class. there are 3 midterms and a final which make up the majority of your grade, and the lowest midterm gets dropped. he can be rude when someone doesnt know the answer to a question but otherwise he can be caring. quizlet is def the only reason i got an a. overall dont recommend

Very sweet guy who was always able to talk outside of class. Try and go to office hours to get to know him as he clearly favors you if he knows you. Tests not super reflective of lectures. Most kids get by from having access to past exams. He does give extra credit on final overall grade if the whole class does the course evaluation.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Wang has a star personality. He is funny, passionate, and will talk about anything genetics related. He goes on tangents (what a silly guy) and will kind of explain your question but more likely leave you laughing. Good luck on those exams though, I lowkey got a low C on both exams. Lol long live Dr. Wang
i love you professor wang.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Wang is one of the best professors in the biology department at UM. Not only is he incredibly nice and funny, but he is also very easily accessible outside of class for extra help. For his tests and quizzes, study his iClicker questions and lectures heavily and you'll do just fine. Also gives 2% points for extra credit for doing his course eval

He is very nice and obviously has a passion for the topic.  The course by nature is difficult but manageable.  Keep up with reading the textbook and adaptive quizzes as questions in those can appear on exams.  Gives 5% on the final if you show up to at least 80% of the classes and an additional 3% if at least 80% of the class does the course eval.

Professor flies through the information and all the material you need to learn on your own from the textbook. So much time is spent out of class learning the material but the professor is very very nice. The course is just challenging.

I don't recommend taking his class he seems nice but hes rude and doesnt help. Your grade is made up of 5 quizzes and 2 exams (midterm and final) , there's no homework and there's usually one extra credit assignment. The quizzes are suppose to be based on the slides but their not, the questions are poorly written and he doesn't allow questions.

He can be goofy here and there, but when it comes to his lecturing, he isn't very helpful. I took his class for my Cognate and I haven't really learned anything. He lectures off power points but always finds a way to get off topic. And the textbook isn't necessary at all. He's pretty average, but I wouldn't take him again.

(Summer session) Very hard class. He is difficult to understand and does not really help his students at times. That being said, quizzes are not too bad but are very short. Exams are pretty difficult and questions sometimes do not reflect learned material. Read the book because he skips lots of parts. Must study everyday to succeed! Quizlets HELP!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Also goes by Daniel Wang, his tests are impossible and I recommend avoiding the class if you can. Averages are high because some students have old test banks which skews the average to be high when most people are failing. He is rude and condescending and do not expect him to answer your questions in class, expect a pissy response.

absolute nightmare of a class, and there's no escape because he's the only one who teaches it. After getting a 45 on the first test, I asked him if there was any extra credit I could do considering that our final grade is only calculated by three tests. He literally told me to just try harder. Also, his tests are completely unrelated to the lecture
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: very nice professor he is understanding just took him last semester ! the class is easy if you keep up with the work
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: This class was awful! I have never gotten a bad grade at this school until I took this class. Exams are impossible and he does not prepare you for them. You are better off guessing. My best exam score was when I guessed the most.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Genetics lab was a cool class if you need a lab requirement! Our TA Anthony was amazing throughout the lab answering all our questions if we needed help and giving us a heads up on what to expect on our quiz. Final group presentation at end of the semester and lab reports due for every lab which wasn't bad. Overall good class, put effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He curves down 3% and have good attendance and will give you points on the final. The only way I passed was with quizlets, but other than that he's pretty funny especially how mandel violated pea plants.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Wang's class is definitely a hard one. Two semester exams and a cumulative final exam that covers around 20 chapters. He does offer some extra credit and the class grading scale is curved. Your best bet is listening to lecture and reviewing only the things he covers. Quizlets online have a lot of the material that he puts on exams verbatim.

Bad things: You'll have to teach yourself (become very acquainted with the textbook) and the final is cumulative. Good things: Do 80% of Clicker questions and get 5 points extra credit on the final and another 5 points extra credit on the final once 80% of the class did the evaluations. Quizzes had 2-5 points extra credit. Nice guy, cool stories.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He does nothing in class except discuss topics that are irrelevant to what he will later ask on exams. Is unnecessarily short with his students and refuses to provide extra credit opportunities. I am taking this class for a cognate and regret it majorly. Our grade is made up of two exams (midterm and final) and 8 ? quizzes. Don't take his classes.

Dr. Wang is a nice and caring person and a very straightforward professor. His exams focus on what he teaches in lecture so there's no need to read the entire chapter for each section. He's willing to help you get a good grade but you have to work for it if you want it. Exams are challenging but it's always stuff he's addressed in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Hated this class. Professor is nice but could not clarify any of the insanely difficult concepts. I don't recommend if you care about your GPA.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: SUPER easy class and great for non science people who need cognate credits. Class is mainly breakout rooms for discussion. In the rooms, you answer one of the discussion questions and present it at the end. Grade is the midterm, final and homework quizzes. Prepares you very well for the midterm. Taking his class in the summer because he is so good!
This was an awful class. Had to guess on almost all the quizzes and exams. He does not teach well at all. Do yourself a favor and take another professor.

I'm trying really hard to say nice things because he is a great guy, but this class was an absolute nightmare. Terrible lectures. Horrible textbook. Insanely hard quizzes. Impossible tests. Kids were desperate and stressed before taking his exams. I was better off guessing on every assessment. Take this class if you are a good guesser.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Wang is a good professor and he cares about his students. Make sure to go to class because attendance is mandatory and he checks attendance by giving iclicker questions. His tests were a little tricky, so make sure to read the books. Also, go to his office hours because he likes to get to know his students better who attend.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: If you receive less than an A in this class, college might not be for you lol. Easiest science class that I have taken. Wang is very detailed and even gives extra credit on the two exams. Take his class if you can!!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: His lectures are long, and he makes you participate regularly. You might think you learned something, but the test will show you otherwise. Tests include things that were barely mentioned during class, and he used strange metaphor questions. Grades purely rely on quizzes and tests. I'm usually an A/B student; this is my first C in university.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Easy lectures but difficult exams. He seems nice and answers any questions that we had, but did not assign us any homework not was there an opportunity for extra credit assignments. Our grades were purely based on tricky exams and 8 QUESTIONS-quizzes! It even seems as if he wants us to have a not so good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Wang really cares about his students but his test questions are hard so I recommend you read beforehand to have the core concepts in and then practice with his quiz questions. Personally, I learned better by the book than his explanations but he does care for your success and he will take your feedback and try to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Took him last semester and failed every test. Don't recommend at all if you care about your GPA.

This is a seminar class for 1 credit and Dr. Wang is a very good person does a really nice job running it. The course is one (70%) presentation on 1 chapter of a book he chooses, and the other (30%) is your attendance and judging those presentations. Dr. Wang creates very relatable conversation and is very down to earth. Just show up and pass!

It is up to the student to follow the syllabus. This includes completing all assignments/bulletin board posts, even though they are 0 credit. The quizzes are usually 5 questions each and they can be tricky. At the end of the course, the instructor will review all of your submitted assignments and your grade can improve by one letter grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Nice guy who really wants his students to succeed, but not really the greatest prof. Regularly has pop quizzes and puts a HEAVY extra credit skew on attendance so show up to more than 80% of his classes. Really understanding about makeup work.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Does not teach!! Easily one of the worst classes I have ever taken at the U. Only 2 exams the whole semester and he doesn't prepare you for them at all. His lectures are pointless and you have to rely on reading the textbook to pass. He expects you to just know what he is talking about when half of the class is lost
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Doesn't teach. Only reviews questions that he makes after expecting us to read a full chapter almost every night. He is absurdly defensive and it almost seems like he gets mad if you ask him a question he doesnt understand. Exams are hard because of the short answer.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He's very proud of his "flipped mode of learning" which quite frankly is not useful and a waste of time. Wang is an okay teacher, but doesn't really teach much in class. Most of class is spent on his dear Learning Catalytics where everyone answers online questions. You have to watch his video lectures outside of class and learn a lot on your own

People seem to try and avoid Wang, but I thought he was a great professor. Sure, the class was challenging, but I learned a lot. He really cares about students and is willing to meet to go over any questions. You certainly have to put work in, but if you read, go to class, and follow his suggestions it is very possible to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Grade comprised of mid term, final, and one extra credit opportunity.  It was an 8 am so no one showed up.  This was for non science majors only.

An unbelievable amount of homework for a 100-level class.  Graded mostly on the quizzes which didn't always seem to line up with the assigned reading.  Some questions on the quizzes and on the final, I thought, were also misleading or just downright confusing.  Unless you love biology, I would look to other professors.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: FINAL HAD NOTHING TO DO WITH HIS LECTURES. PULLS HIS QUESTIONS FROM RANDOM TEST BANKS. DO NOT TAKE HIM.  - A+ student who got B- in his class

Both a very easy and tough class. He has this way of teaching which basically lets him avoid teaching you, but his grading scale helps you a lot especially if you're just looking to pass. His pop quizzes are rare (like 5) but carry some weight, don't miss them. Lecture is a joke, you can learn better on your own, the book is your real teacher here

Interesting to listen to and clearly knows his stuff, however, for my BIL 104 class, he hardly "taught" anything that would be on the midterm or final so when I sat down to take these I was surprised by many things I didn't know I needed to know. Also is very unclear what chapters to read in textbook. Not sure you even need to bother buying one.

Best professor I've had yet at Miami. Really knows his stuff, and is always open to questions and discussions. Watch his video lectures before coming to class! His class is discussion based, so to get the most out of it you really need to prepare yourself. What you get out is determined by what you put in.
Yunqiu Wang, also found as Daniel Wang on ratemyprofessors, is not the best teacher. Most of the material I had to teach myself by reading the book and figuring it out.
Dr. Wang was very quick at answering questions and was very helpful. The classwork was a little too much for a summer course but with discipline I was able to complete it. Worth the hard work.
Great professor, very interesting class possible to get an A if you take good notes and listen in class. take him!
goated professor. Explains really well and quizzes and exams are very easy. Pick him for every CS course possible

The goat of CS department. Take any class that is offered with him. Simply the best, teaches well, always willing to elaborate, easy quizzes and exams. Barely any stress in the class but at the same time if you just listen you learn, that is how good he teaches. GOAT
GOAT CS professor. Take him he's also a chill dude.
Prof Wang is pretty good. The course was most difficult in the homeworks, but in turn the final and the midterm were quite easy.
Easy class. It is a good introduction to DSA. Wang is a good lecturer. The exams and quizzes are very easy. Study the slides and watch Neetcode and you will be fine.

He's a funny and very nice professor. Lectures are simple, often just reading from the PowerPoint but he is always available to help you on any topic. His accent may be difficult to understand at first but he is always ready to repeat himself or explain more if need be. The major tests are pretty easy. There's a weekly quiz that doesn't count much
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I had a spotty understanding of Java after 120, but Wang solidified it. He explains things very clearly and will insist you ask questions until you fully understand. He is happy to repeat and re-explain concepts that are tricky for us and really wants us to learn the material. 1 midterm, 1 final, weekly labs and quizzes but they helped me learn tbh
Great guy, great class

Not the most exciting topic in CS, so lectures can feel like an eternity. Still, the professor helps make it as manageable as possible. He is happy to answer questions. Tests are fair and are pretty reflective of homework. There were times where the homework problems were not provided as examples in class, so clarify those examples. I recommend.

His lectures were mostly spent copying text from the board that he was copying from the textbook, so you can get lost very easily. However, he is a very caring professor and would explain concepts the times it is necessary for you to understand. Definitely, his class is easier than other professors that teach it, so if you can, try to take him.

I would take any class with Prof. Wang! He is by far the best in the Computer Science Department. I am always excited to go to his class and learn. He is passionate, funny, and actually steps up to teach difficult topics in an understandable way. He makes sure that everyone understands the content and has reasonable expectations.

Average lecturer but tries to explain but also has an accent. You might need to self learn and read. He uploads last year's recordings which were useful if you don't attend classes but going do help a lot. No slides after first week so you need to get the notes. HWs are doable with a midterm and a final with only 10-15 MCQs including extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: How a university class should be! Work in = work out. Study and come to class and you will do great. He is energetic and passionate about computer science and really makes you want to learn. The content is difficult but that is the nature of the course and he explains it thoroughly. Always willing to take questions and make it even more clear.

One of the easiest CSC class! Weekly quiz from slides, 1 midterm & a final, all MCQs on lockdown browser! He reads the slides in class but attendance optional. Be prepared to learn the contents from YouTube tho. Labs are tricky so take TAs help unless you are good at programming. Offers 2.5% extra credit in both midterm and final. Study & easy A!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I learned so much this semester in Professor Wang's CSC 220 class! He made difficult material easy to understand. Assignments were manageable and perfect workload. I always felt challenged but engaged. His course is based on a point system and it is very fair. Would recommend.

Zheng Wang is one of the best teachers I had at the University of Miami. He took the most intimidating subject I knew of going into my major and made it understandable. He keeps his lectures interesting, and he is very nice to his students.
Not the best teacher for explaining questions. But definitely the least boring lectures I had.
If you simply pay attention during class, you will be completely fine. If you are not that good at coding, the labs may be difficult, but the TAs will help (if you actually show up to the labs).

Would not recommend ZW for 220. The man himself is nice, but his class was always confusing (kids all too frequently pointed out errors in his slides) and dull. Also, the class usually ended 30 mins early, leaving me to learn the material that *should* have been taught in my own time. Labs were awful; TAs only read instructions and did not help.
He is so sweet and really wants his students to do well.

He is one of the worst professors Ive had at UM, he can not explain concepts very well to the point that other students would have to step in and explain things for him. I did not learn anything in this class, and the lab assignments were also not clear in the instructions. Im not sure if the online format threw him off or if he is just this bad.
I would take him for anything possible lectures are fun. He makes it a point to have everyone laugh and learn.

Professor Zheng is awesome! My favorite professor at UM so far. He made a really boring subject fun to learn and I was never worried about my grade in his class because he overs extra credit. Would take him for the rest of my CS classes at UM if I could. Tests are very similar to homework problems.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Seriously, what can I tell you about Dr. Wang? Well, hes what every teacher wants to be. He took a subject that was hard as hell, and he made it easy to understand.  His class was enjoyable.  I have ADD and it was easy to pay attention in his class. TAKE HIM if you have the chance. Just go to class, do your homework, and youll do well.

Amazing teacher and super nice guy; he does his best to make a very boring class fun. His class was straight forward and easy as long as you go to class and pay attention. We had weekly assignments, a mid term, and a final. On both tests he offers extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Absolutely loved this class. I took it for my cognate. If you have never taken Chinese before, it can probably be hard and confusing, but if you have a little background in it, it is so easy and would def recommend as an easy class elective. And she's such a great teacher and so nice.

She is very good at what she does if you attend class and do the homework. She seems strict at first but is very kind and will be flexible if you need it. There is a lot of work involved, but nothing she assigns is useless.

Professor Zhang is a really great teacher and does her best to help every one of her students. If this class wasn't online I would've enjoyed it way more and gotten a better grade. Lots of homework but it's helpful and will help you learn more. Tests are reasonable.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Solid class, hard for me to learn because it was online but that's not the professor's fault. She's really nice, and really wants all of her students to learn as much as possible.
Great professor! Learned a lot, don't take any of these classes if you are not willing to learn. Go to lectures, watch recorded lectures, and do the homework and youll be fine
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Met only 1x a week and had independent studying 2x a week. Lectures were pre recorded and we met online to practice speaking and reading with classmates. She calls out people to talk. You have to study if youre not familiar with the language or you wont pass. HW was easy. Each chapter had quiz. 3 exams on several chapters. Study and take notes!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This class isn't for you if you're not willing to dedicate a decent chunk of your time to studying. You will learn so much in just one semester but you do have to work for it. Professor Zhang is great at teaching and is always there to help. Be prepared when coming to class because she calls on students to answer, no hand-raising.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Great teacher. Do your hw and study and you will be fine. Don't and you will have a problem.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This class is not for those who do not study. That is level of Chinese be prepared to spend at 1-2 hours studying EACH night. If you are from 101-201 pay attention and prepare a mater notes book. As a whole the curriculum moves fast, but Zhang laoshi is great.

Zhang Laoshi is honestly a really good professor. She knows how to teach the language effectively but she also expects you to make an effort and can seem intimidating. If you haven't previewed the vocabulary before class, you're not going to do well in terms of participation. She will call on everyone in class, there is no raising hands. Study.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Zhang laoshi is a great teacher, you will learn a lot of Chinese with her. Very insightful on the language. Beware of cold calls during class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Zhang Laoshi is my favorite professor. She really cares about her students and truly wants you to learn the language. The class is well structured and you always know what to expect on quizzes. I never thought I would have learned as much Chinese as I did in just one semester. Very good professor.

She is PHENOMENAL. I absolutely love her, such a wonderful teacher. She truly cares about the students and gets to know you personally. The class is very interesting and you learn so much from her. I took Chinese in High School and barely understood anything; with Zhang Lao Shi, everything is structured and nothing is a surprise. She's the best!

Zhang laoshi is an incredible professor. Yes, she comes across as very intimidating at first and definitely has a no-nonsense teaching style, but I've taken many language classes with many professors and I can say without a doubt that her class is by a long shot the most effective if you actually want to learn the material.

Professor Zhang is my favorite professor! Her teaching is so effective that I have learned so much Chinese for just one semester. Her class is very communicative. I find myself speaking Chinese most of the time in her class. She is very knowledgeable too. I think I learned the most from my Chinese class than any other classes.

Professor Zhang is an amazing class. You do need to come to class, participate, and do your homework. The amount of Chinese that you will learn in just one semester is absolutely stunning. She is clear, concise, and you can ask as many questions as you want. At first, she might seem intimidating, but she's written tons of rec. letters for me!

Very thorough teaching style: you can tell this teacher knows what she is doing. Work in the class, study ahead of time, and you'll be fine. Not an easy A, though. After my first semester I not only knew a lot more Chinese than I was expecting to have learned, but I also found it useful in conversation and reading. Very, Very good teacher.
Very good professor, lectures are somewhat easy to follow and aren't even mandatory, but helpful to go to. Online tests, basic homework assignments.

Attendance is not mandatory, I always go because almost no one shows up so I feel bad. I don't understand the way he explains things in class. BUT tests are the same as the review sessions but with different numbers. They are also take home exams so you can take them wherever as long as it is during your class time. I am terrified for MAS312.
Attendance not mandatory, tests online––too easy.
Goat. I am terrified of 312, but goat.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Most caring professor I've had so far! She adjusts grading for homework & future tests to make it easier for students. Very clear & explanatory in lectures and what will be covered on exams. Homework comprises the bulk of your grade. Attendance not required, but if you don't attend lectures, you MUST go through the textbook thoroughly.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Caring

reviews.comment: One of the best professors in the department. Super understanding and lectures are very educational. Very organized and posts all the notes which is really helpful. Take her if you can.

Xi Huo is one of the best math teachers I've taken. She is very clear when explaining the topics and always willing to answer questions. Her grading is fair, around 30% of your grade is homework from the book . She also curves if the class isn't doing too well. I recommend taking her for Differential equations you are going to love her.

I really liked Xi for ODEs. She was extremely clear during lectures and I enjoyed learning from her. There is a lot of homework and I did a lot of practice outside of class in order to maintain a high grade in the class. The tests were representative of what we learned (except for our first exam) and I thought that the grading was fair. Take her!!!

Easy to understand, and likable. The material for abstract math is difficult to grasp and some teachers make it impossible but Dr. Huo did a great job especially considering it was her first semester teaching this class. The grades are based off hw, two tests, a final and some discussion sessions that are test reviews. She really is Great!

Xi Huo is the best math professor I've had at UM. Her lectures are clear and easy to follow because she explains things very well. She is very nice and willing to help. Her tests are pretty straight forward, so if you know the material and study you should do well! I currently have an A+
Very nice guy but confusing lectures and all-over-the-place slideshows. Easy class, just have to know what you're doing with the equations. Open note exams and quizzes.
As long as you read the textbook and understand the homework, you will be fine. He isn't the best lecturer, so you must work harder than usual to understand the concepts.

He is very strict about font. Make sure it is times new roman for everything in your reports (even the graphs). There are 4 labs which are pretty elementary, he doesn't care about the numbers the class is more about how to write the papers. Follow the sample report carefully and you should get a good grade.

Can't understand him, class is poorly planned, he gets mad at you if you don't understand but his explanations are terrible, he gives you stuff straight from the book while managing to explain worse, he is good at what he does but he is a terrible teacher, avoid at all costs.
Amazing professor to independent study with.  Understanding and helpful.  He is much better than many others and actually willing to work with you.

You can tell he does know what he's talking about with material science but he is INCOMPREHENSIBLE-and this comes from some one used to deciphering engineering professors. My second of five labs(as an example of work load)was 58 pages long! ALL the lab equipment was broken so you have to rationalize the bogus data. No textbook, just his lectures!?

Dongqing Xu, is a lovely empathic professor. She is passionate about communication studies and it shows. She encourages participation and open discussions. She is well-studied yet remains humble and ready to be challenged. She looks out for her students and cares for them beyond the class.
Kind professor. There are a lot of assignments for STC 220, however DQ is kind and caring to her students.

I LOVED having her as a professor. She is really considerate of her students and formats the class based on feedback from students. Easy A since most of your grade is homework which she does in class. I liked how she created quiz questions based on students' interests. I teared up after our last class because of how sweet and caring she is. 11/10

This class was difficult, because it is very math-based. His grading criteria is clear. He's a fair grader and does his best to help you do well. I did better than I thought I was doing. He grades the tests by giving partial credit for work. He is kind and professional. Just do your best and you will do well. He's also very responsive to emails.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Truly an amazing professor. He teaches the material very well and also makes the slideshows easy to study on your own. He has homework due before the exams and then reviews with you to understand any mistakes you made. Then, for exams, he will grade based on if the process was correct, not the numbers. You also get a cheat sheet for each exam!

Xin is simply an amazing man. He comes to every class energetic and passionate. It's clear he puts in effort to make class interesting. His powerpoints are awesome, normally I can't self-teach from ppts but from his I can. Tests are pretty difficult, but he's such a good professor it's worth it. Put some effort into studying and you'll do well.

If you come to class, you will be fine. He gives really in depth descriptions with a lot of examples. Exams are hard but he grades really lightly so I did much better in the class than I felt like I was doing. If you ever need help on hw go to office hours and he'll walk u through it

classes are boring- he's not easy to listen to/follow. Easy to get in touch with. I'm the type of student who needs an A grade but has to do the work to achieve that (I have to work for an A); that said, he's an overall considerate professor, but his tests are harder than homework and there's no curve. His explanations to questions never suffice
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I never come on rate my professor to give a personal rating, but this professor was amazing. He genuinely cares about his students-I had a lot going on this semester and he completely understood. the class in general is not too difficult if you pay attention and his tests are NOT CUMULATIVE which is amazing. The grading is really fair too.

No textbook needed, just print his powerpoint before each class. He's not great at answering questions in class but if you go to his office he'll take time to explain. Exams are very similar to HW problems. If you're ok with math/stats, this class is no sweat. It didn't take up a lot of my time.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--Would take again

reviews.comment: Great professor. The course material is not very interesting but Geng does a great job presenting it in a way that students understand it. Fairly easy course and a fair amount of homework.
Makes the class very straightforward. You get a cheat sheet on each exam and the problems are exactly the same as practice problems/homework. Nice guy, take him if you want an A.
He'a a very solid professor. Very professional, posts everything on Blackboard, and answers questions. Thinks the students are a little dumber than they are, but that doesn't hurt!

My experience is that this professor is so good. 1 he does not record attendance. 2 his homework is very useful and less. It takes you 1 hour to finish once per 2 weeks. AND ALMOST THE QUESTION ON TEST IS THE SAME AS HW AND PROB SET HE GIVE ON BB!! Take him! Clear outline and easy grade will let you forget he is a Chinese professor. He's helpfultoo

His accent is nearly impossible to understand. Beyond frustrating. He doesn't require attendance, but then will actually use it to calculate your grade. Probably 1/4 of the class regularly attended. If you HAVE to take him, you'll need to work very hard on your own to master material because he is no help at all.

I took this class last year and wrote a review but I think it was removed! Writing again to help those signing up for classes! avoid avoid avoid! Very difficult to understand, lectures not helpful, passive aggressive. Youtube was my saving grace for this class! UM math department is seriously lacking...
Mr. Xu fumbles in his speech and struggle to explain the material even upon request of clarification from the students.
literally slayed

I don't even know why such a great school as UM holds such an incompetent professor. He argues with his students and is extremely disrespectful. Doesn't know how to teach whatsoever. DO NOT TAKE HIM! Even if you are a math genie, he will purposely dumb you down. He always comes 5 to 10 minutes after class starts. Doesn't treat his job seriously.

This professor is a total MISERY!! Do not take him. He will give you a ridiculously difficult time and he will make you regret every moment of his class with horrible lectures that nobody understands.
Don't take him.

Professor Xu is probably one of the easiest math professors at UM. He desires nothing but to help his students get a good grade in the class. Put a good effort and get an A, light effort will get you a B.
Attendance is not mandatory, but it's pretty easy to get a B if you do the homework and attend the class.

He tortures students with unbearable math questions and his lectures are a disgrace. There are no possible words to describe how detrimental this professor is to the GPA of students. University of Miami is a prestigious institution and this teacher drags the reputation of this outstanding school down.

This professor is the worst professor I ever came cross in school. He didn't teach an entire section of math that was on the final exam. He doesn't prepare students for the exam at all. He is busy arguing with students about grades and accusing them of things they never did. Avoid this professor at all costs!! Never take him!

Does not explain lectures well and doesn't care if his students fail. Promises to curve grades and give extra credit but does not. Camner center tutoring teaches you math more than he can. Not a nice person at all, he's rude and will laugh at your face. Avoid at all costs. Such a horrible experience.

BE AWARE!!! There is NO EXTRA CREDIT. He promises one thing and does another thing. Don't trust this professor. His extra credit brings your grade down, it's a gamble that is only 2 questions and included in the toughest exam! He can't even teach the subject properly and refers to numbers as "guys"!!! This is crazy and unbelievable.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Xu never calls students by names, this is extremely unpleasant. Nevertheless, he isn't a professor to look up to. There is no knowledge in this class that the students take away. Exams are very hard and nothing like his promises. Totally horrible professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very difficult professor to deal with. Laughs in class but that is only to mislead and trick the students to think they on a good journey with the math. He is stubborn and has a horrible attitude that is no pleasure to deal with.

Professor Xu is a good person. He cares about the students that put effort into the class, and help them in the exams. MTH107 is a very hard class and he is not the best at explaining the material, but will give you partial credit if you have the right process in the exams. Quite easy to pass the course but hard to get an A

It seems to me that the student tutors at tutoring center know the subject at a more advanced level and would be better of teaching the class then a professor with a degree. Horrendous teacher and he doesn't even care about his students.
His class is a scam and he doesn't even explain the lessons. He is very lazy
Never again would I take this professor he doesnt take his job seruiusly nor the students.

If you willing to fail, take him! He barely speaks english and doesn't explain when students address their questions. Students get no response, no explanation. His extra credits are a scam, he puts them as the hardest bonus question on the hardest exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Very easy to communicate with.
It's quite easy to pass but difficult to get an A.
Very talented professor! He is patient every time I turn to him for help and can always solve my problems using some smart techniques.
He's clearly a very intelligent person but conveying simple/complex concepts isn't his forte. I'd recommend going to every class but that's hardly a guarantee you'll do well. Practice regularly.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: If you finish and understand all the take-home quiz, you can solve most questions in the final easily.

Very smart professor but has no idea how to convey the material to a class. His lectures are very hard to follow and he does not answer questions well at all. NIce guy, means well, but if this is your first time taking calc, choose someone else. I took AP Calc AB in high school and did very well, and even I had to work to keep up in this class.

Made accounting as interesting as it can be. Super funny guy and explains material well. Exams aren't bad but important to listen to lectures. Lot of material in a short amount of time so don't fall behind. If you have a good understanding you'll do good on exams which are always mc. McGraw hill isn't too bad either. I loved him!
Very nice and fun professor! Hard class and a lot of topics get covered fast, but overall his exams are not that hard if you really know the material.

Very easy and I would recommend taking him for this accounting class. Study for tests and show up to class and you will be fine. They are multiple choice and online. Not much other work but there is a lengthy cyber text.

I have def had moments of wanting to leave class bc im falling asleep, but hes iconic. He is an amazing professor. He goes pretty slow, which can be annoying but is helpful for step by step instructions. Accounting is a detailed subject and he really puts in the time to make the lessons as understandable as possible for us. KING, take him.

This was the hardest accounting class I have taken at UM thus far. Exams are all MCQ and tend to be easier versions of the problems we do in class. Werner curves heavily, and besides the 3 exams theres no homework or cybertext for this course.
One of my favorite classes I've taken. Just need to study the homework and powerpoint to do well on the exams. He's passionate about the class, funny, and fair to students. Would take again!
This is an incredibly tough course. There is no homework or cybertext. Your grade is based on 3 exams and random attendance. Exams are all MCQ and he curves each exam and at the end of the course.
Worst class I've taken at um
He doesn't let you use technology, he doesn't post his notes, and his tests are nothing like what were doing in class.
Rounds A- to an A. Class is boring, but if you pay attention and put in the minimal work and effort required you will be fine.
Funniest teacher ever...All MC exams...the goat

Overall, great lecturer who is engaging and you can tell likes accounting. However, he doesn't respond to emails or post office hours so he's impossible to reach outside of class. Won't help with any issues no matter how small and is a pain if you have any problems or questions regarding the class or the content. Wouldn't recommend
Professor Werner is a funny guy. His lectures are super boring but the class, but he gives a lot of practice problems that are worked on in class. Tests are alright, if you study.

He's like your weird grandfather, but an expert in accounting. Also takes time in class to deeply address your questions, very nice, and funny. Loves to act out his lectures. Homework is easy and exams are multiple choice. Great guy overall.
Go to class! He says pop quiz all the time for ACC 311 but they are beyond easy using your notes or he'll give you the answer. He curves like crazy if you do bad.

He's great. If you go to class, pay attention to what he's saying, and take notes, you'll be fine. Doesn't go fast in his lectures and is very easy to follow. Does lots of in-class examples that help for tests. Tests are all MCQ, simple, straightforward. Lenient about deadlines. Very knowledgable and makes the class as interesting as it can be!

Nice guy, but gets off track every single class and not the best teacher. Also, good luck getting in touch with him outside of class it is basically impossible, will not answer an email to save his life.

Very nice guy but he goes off-topic all the time and tends to ramble pretty frequently. He seems like he knows what he's talking about, but he's so hard to follow sometimes and the test questions/answers are often misleading and confusing. Not a bad professor at all but I'd probably take somebody else if there are options

He's a great guy. He cares about us and slows down when the class doesn't understand it. He pushed back the hw and exam multiple times to make sure we really understood stuff. He also curved at the end.
All exams are MCQ and are pretty confusing. He goes off topic and tries to teach but never actually teaches.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do not take him. His exams are all multiple choice and so confusing, I find myself struggling and not even learning or having to teach myself. He provides little to no help on how exams are structured, and he constantly goes on rants about topics that have nothing to do with the class. I actually enjoy accounting, yet this class is my lowest grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His lectures can be a bit boring, but he records all of them for you to review or to attend class virtually. He also allows you to have one page of notes during exams, and provides a checklist of the topics you need to know about. Copy all (applicable) calculative exercises and notes, and you will do fine. He is also nice and wants you to succeed.

Weirdest Professor I had, he acts out a lot and usually goes way off topic. One time, he was acting out his mom in a factory. I got lazy and didn't show up to class half we through, but just watched Tony Bell on Youtube and he explained everything clearly. Ended with an A+, so we chillin.

Professor Werner is such an amazing person. Although his course is very tough, he wants to see all his students succeed. He cares about his students and appreciates when students participate in his class lessons. His tests are extremely difficult, but you will pass the class if you try your best and put all your effort in.

Easily a top 3 professor I've had at UM for my entire 4 years. That being said his ACC311 class is not easy. He does not give you study guides rather checklists and gives no other forms of test prep other than questions you can find in the textbook. His tests are difficult no access to exams after you take them so you won't know what you got wrong

Professor Werner is a great guy and a straightforward professor. His class is very lecture heavy. The tests are easy as long as you pay attention and take notes. Overall, I would recommend this class to anyone looking for a good professor for Accounting.

Nice man, but make sure you aren't fooled by his kind and relaxed demeanor. This class can be somewhat difficult if you don't study properly as I did. Make sure you meet with him and discuss what is on his exams. They were 34 MC questions and somewhat tricky.

Professor Werner is a great guy! Although his class is almost all lecture and can be a little boring at times, his personality makes attending class fun. Due dates for assignments are sometimes unclear, but he usually only cares that you finish the assignment at some point, not necessarily by the due date. I would definitely take this class again!

Very confusing semester, there was great confusion with what was actually due and when to do it. He is a very smart person, however I wish he was more organized. If you take this class create/join a groupchat for the large project, it's impossible to do alone. Also study quite more than you think for the tests.

Just show up to class and take notes, he will give you an A. A lot of people just don't go to this class b/c it's a core class for the business school, but you will get more out of it than you would think. He's a funny guy and wishes the best for all of his students.

Prof. Werner cares for his students and goes above and beyond. His lectures are relevant and important to exams but tries to keep them light and uses lots of examples. Would recommend for sure, one of my favorite profs

He is probably one of the funniest professors I've ever had and so his lectures are about as engaging as accounting can be. Unfortunately, there is a HW assignment online every week which takes 2-3 hours or more. Tests are multiple choice, luckily, and there's two very easy projects. I think he really does his best with a very boring subject.

Werner is a good choice for ACC211. I have never taken accounting before. He's an odd guy but makes lectures interesting. His exams are tough. Study and ask questions in class, do homework, and you'll be fine.

He's a little wacky, but if you look past the charade and think about the story he's trying to tell for the concept, he's a little genius. In class examples were literally on each exam. The last class before the exam, he tells you what you should touch up on from the textbook.

Majority of class he is talking about something non related to accounting and goes off on a tangent about it for literally half the class. I learned nothing from this class. Never knew what was going to be on the exams. The last class before the final he tried to teach two chapters that were on the final in the last 10 minutes of class. awful

He loves to make weird voices and tell jokes and strange stories that you are not sure if they are actually ever going to end or are applicable in any way to what he is teaching. He genuinely wants you to learn though and his examples from class are the exact write out problems on the test, just make sure you read the book for conceptial questions.
He is a little bit disorganized but that is fine. He wrote what you need to know. And follow him you would be fine. Extremely knowledgeable and caring.
Fantastic Professor. So into his job and wants his students to do great. Provides real life examples while maintaining a fun environment. He is the best accounting professor

This professor literally teaches nothing. the class is all messed up, sometimes he even don't know what he is talking about, he would just convulse and make boring jokes that no one understands. He is a tough grader and review everything that is not on the exam. don't take him unless you have to.

This professor has a great sense humor. Always tells jokes on the class. However, he is like Jon Snow to writing exams: Told us to focus on the certain materials while testing us on completely different stuff. Be careful if you wanna take his undergrad classes.
Best Accounting professor ever in UM, extremely knowledge and want you to learn. I would definitely take him again

He just rambles on and on and teaches for maybe 10 minutes per class, so he only goes through things once and then moves on. The guy cares but he is a terrible professor. Don't take him unless you have to

Do not take for 311 unless you have to. Very condescending and doesn't have office hours or answer emails. You'll probably get a B at worst with the curve, but he is very disorganized and it is not worth the stress. Have to read the book for MC questions on exams. Refused to take 312 with him
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I was a bit nervous taking my first accounting course, since I'm bad in math. I absolutely love how he makes the class not boring and how he focuses on providing the class with real life problems. I liked his passion for Accounting and how he tries his best to easily explain everything. Make sure to take note of everything he does. Helps with tests
He was a terrible lecturer; he would ramble on about nothing. I genuinely feel like I learned nothing this semester. Take Perez if you can.
He is very humorous. He doesn't cover every detail on the textbook but explain one big example from each chapter. If you understand that problem and you are able to do it yourself, the test is easy.

For his classes you absolutely must attend the lectures and the better notes you take the better you do on exams. He likes to tell personal stories but his lectures are not boring. Many people seem to realize that going to class is the way to do well his tests so it''s hard to get a really good grade if you don''t take good notes

Took 312 with him also. He is a little disorganized and always late to class, but he teaches you EXACTLY what you need to know for the test and you don't really have to read the book. He likes to act out examples with voices and everything. Best teacher to take for these classes IMO
Poor professor and person. Never is clear or takes the time to meet with students/answer emails. Extremely condescending with bad attempts at humor not helping anything.
Good comedian. Not the best teacher. Pretty disorganized and moves pretty fast. Doesn't make time to meet with students or answer emails.

Professor Werner is my favorite ACC teacher!  I also took ACC301 with him.  His classes definitely aren't easy, but he makes them great because he is so funny and an outstanding professor.  If you take good notes and study them, you'll be able to completely understand what the textbook explains, but you'll have to read the book too.

Goes off on tangents a lot and jumps around all the time during lectures. The examples from class are usually the short responses on exams, and Multiple Choice come from the book. You don't need the book though, I never used it and got through course fine.
Passionate teacher, really disorganized lectures though.  For the tests, just know how to do the examples from class and reading the book helps for the multiple choice

Fantastic Professor. So into his job and wants his students to do great. Provides real life examples while maintaining a fun environment. His tests are based off of his class. If he doesn't teach it, good chance not on exam. He wants his students to do well and goes over many examples in class. Highly recommend!

werners a pretty good guy but his lectures can get boring and confusing sometimes. his tests are usually pretty easy and are exactly what we learn in class, no tricks. just know how to do the examples from class and you'll get an easy A

He's a bit crazy when he pretends to be your angry future boss or his mother. But its all in good fun to help you understand the problems. I am generally a very good student, but for some reason I find his class very difficult. However, most semesters he is the only one who teaches 301 and 312, so you dont have any choice but to take him.
Great teacher, has real life experience.
HE IS THE BEST!!!!

For cost accounting he was good, not too sure about the 311 class. Really clear on what problems will be on the test. Have to go to class. Questions are from lecture. Honestly if you go to class and take good notes and end up with less than a B- you need to go to FSU

This professor is super boring. I think he should do something else rather than teaching. He does not prepare for classes. He just gives whatever examples he has in mind. Especially, he does not follow the textbook content, he thinks he know everything.Plus, his exams do not match with what he teaches. This guy makes me want accounting useless !

this guy is the worst accounting teacher I ever had. I wonder why should they let such a unorganized and confusing professor teach ACC courses. He like to make jokes but his jokes are not even funny.Unfortunately, he teaches so many courses! and there are not many good ACC professors

He is horrible at explaining concepts.  He tries to be funny but sometimes it makes things more confusing.  He made the tests really hard, especially the multiple choice.  One slip-up and your grade collapsed.  He really should stick to ACC 211 & 212, not upper level courses.

Im not sure why so many people think he was a good teacher.  He give you information in class that conflicts and is different from the textbook.  HE BASES EVERYTHING ON THE TESTS FROM THE NOTES.  You can not even read the book and still get an A.  He is very helpful though and will meet with you for hours if you need him to.  A very nice guy.

Two exams and a noncumulative final. He's pretty funny and keeps lectures interesting but the material can be tough. Lots of application rather than theory on the exams. He covers most of what will be on exams in class but you have to read for the multiple choice part of the exams. Doesn't take attendance but you need to go to class.

werner was a pretty good teacher. he is a funny guy who keeps his class usually interesting. He goes off on tangents sometimes but he knows what he's talking about. willing to help anyone thru phone/email/meetings. his tests are sometimes very difficult but if you keep up in class you can get a good grade.

Great guy, awesome teacher just go to class take notes pay attention and participate, make sure you ask questions so you get it all. there isn't anything in the book on the tests that he didn't go over in class first. Put in an honest effort on the projects and you'll get an easy 100%

One of the best accounting professors I've ever had. He's very funny which makes the class more enjoyable. Only 3 exams which are very straight forward. There is a lot of complex material in the course but he explains it all very well. Overall great professor!

FUNNY man!  Took his night class and was never tempted to fall asleep.  Extremely helpful and wants his students to do well.  If you go to class you will not need to use the book other than for reference.  No homework required (except Red Book and Learning Blocks).
Awesome teacher.  Really nice guy and funny.  He writes the book and basically tells you what is on the tests.  Highly Recommended

Great professor.  He makes jokes in class all the time to keep people interested in what would otherwise be a boring subject.  Tests are easy.  He writes the book for the class, so expect problems similar to it...
he teaches from his own book, which isnt bad. he knows his stuff and teaches very well his grading isnt bad either..hes one of the better accounting proffs!
Presents Material clearly and effectively, very knowledgeable and really does do the funny voice (annoying @ times though) Go to class, take notes and u should get an A
Werner is a really FUNNY teacher!!! If you study the notes and go to class you will do well on the exams! He makes accounting fun :)

Werner is a great teacher, I would definitely take him again!  It helps to go to class and listen to his lessons because he covers everything that will be on the exams; he's pretty funny too.  If you pay attention in class and study the night before, he makes it so that an A is very attainable.
very helpful
great teacher. uses a bunch of voices to convey the material (its actually pretty funny). go to class, take notes, do the textbook homeworks and you will get an A

Ok lecturer but class is boring (blame the material). Tests are reasonably difficult, mainly because of the huge disparity between the amount he prepares you and the amount you need to pass. Not too bad for accounting but expect to put in some serious legwork before the tests if you want an A.

Had him for 211 and 212. Really funny, class is so boring though. Since you have to take it though, I'd hands down take him. He doesn't require hmwk assignments and is really lenient with the syllabus dates. Tests are easier than other professors.
ACC 211 and 212 Definitely take him if you can! Super nice guy, really funny and tests aren't hard at all (and you actually learn).

This professor is the best accounting professor I have ever had: lectureing very clearly, writing on the board (no powerpoint) very neatly, and very funny guy. I feel so sorry that I left UM and cannot have his class anymore. But when I am reviewing for the CPA exam, I still can recall some sinarios that I had in his class.
With Burnett (Robinson is gone), the best accounting prof. at UM --period.
Also had him for ACC 301 and ACC 501.  Great examples and really goes into the material. Take notes and do homework problems. Tests simple and he has a more lenient grading scale than most.
If you go to class and take the notes you will do well on his tests. Very clear and helpful. Definitely take him if you can.

reallyy weird. not very clear...i ended up doing well, but only because i studied on my own. notes did help though. textbook kinda helped, but went more in depth than what he tested us on. i would recommend going everyday to at least have the notes. multiple choice can get a little tricky. all in all just have to work hard in the class..and ask q's
Excellent professor.  Wrote the textbook and gives exams the same as the problems he assigns.  Explains everything clearly.
Very funny and cool guy...for an accounting professor.  Exams are based almost all on lecture notes, so pay attention in class and you'll do good.

I would not recommend. She takes weeks to grade, doesn't really answer questions clearly, and she seems extremely uncomfortable teaching. She is dreadfully hard to follow and not engaging. Attendance is required, she gives hand written in class assignments and waits until the last 15 min of class to assign it. Overall, pretty bad experience.

Dr. Matsuda is very kind, but I wouldn't recommend her. She grades very slowly & whenever we'd ask her a question, she'd answer circularly, confusing our class even more. She's in a post-grad program as well, so I think she was busy with her own schoolwork to grade our things.

i really liked this professor! she was very caring and seemed like she cared about her students a lot. as long as you study her lectures, her tests are super easy and I got an A on all of them. highly recommend taking this course

She is truly so sweet and means well. She is taking classes right now so she understands how tough it is to be a student right now. She is very kind! There are 3 tests, which she provides a study guide for and as long as you know that material you'll be okay on the test. She is open to meeting with you and goes over exam grades as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Matsuda is so kind. She really wants the best for her students and does her best to have engaging and interactive lectures. The grade in the course is based on three exams and two PBL group assignments which are actually pretty fun. Definitely recommend!! Would love to take another course with her if I get the chance.

Dr.Matsuda is a very nice professor. She is super kind and sweet to everyone and when nobody would pay any attention, she would not get angry but talk to us and be like "HOW ARE Y'ALL?" I wish she had good ratings because she was trying so hard to make it interesting for us.

Group projects are 56% of the grade. The other percent is the 3 exams. Exams are easy as long as you study her power points. Group projects are graded well as long as you put in the effort. Easy A as long as you put in the work.

Not horrible, but if you can take someone else. Pointless lectures, so when it comes time for exams just read the book. Not flexible with students at all, almost the entire class had a huge anatomy midterm on the same day as hers and she told us to manage our time better. Attendance is important and she's a stickler about it too, overall 5/10.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The professor was great but he had a heavy accent that was difficult to understand, honestly hardly spoke English. Very passionate about teaching. The worst part of the class were the students who did not care, he tried really hard to engage students but it was almost always radio silence. If that does not bother you, this is a great choice.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very nice guy but he doesn't speak a lick of english. Easy A but didn't learn anything. This review is for his PHI343 course.

He does have a strong accent but he really enjoys teaching and wants you to learn.  If anything his accent is just more motivation to pay attention in class.  He is very straight forward with expectations and homework, and curves generously.  Attendance is essential to understanding the content.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Ziren is a very nice person and very passionate about his work. I know accents are very normal but his accent is hard to understand. But you can tell he really tries to do his work well and wants his students the best from. He is an easy grader and takes attendance. Would take him again.

Fred is a sweetheart but impossible to understand. Heaviest accent I've ever heard and he struggles to speak a lot. He tries really hard to teach the class and help us understand so that makes me respect him a lot. Sadly the material is extremely difficult so take somebody easier to understand if you want to learn. He is an easy grader and curves.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Basically just had to write 100-150 word response to a question every week based on what we learned in class. If you don't listen you will still do fine. He is really nice and tries to get students engaged. If he is an option definitely take him.

The lectures are mandatory and extremely boring. If you show up and do the work, you'll get at least a B+, even if you get a failing grade on the midterm which many do poorly on. The rest of the class is busy work, but graded easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lectures are mandatory and incredibly monotonous and hard to sit through with little class engagement. Weekly discussion posts (about 700 words), 2 essay assignments, final group project, and one test that is incredibly hard for no reason despite studying. As long as you do the work you will get a good grade.

feels like he gives you assignments just to have you do them. every topic is covered 5 times over the semester on a multitude of discussions and the final project / essays. Class is easy but professor has a TA who grades everything so lazy. midterm tanked by grade bc no one knew what it was on, hes the only professor for this class too
DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR WHATSOVER
Class is super easy if you know sports.Gave Most of the class 100's on the 2 essay's. If you hand in the discussions he will give you above a 90. No class on Friday's

Professor Shehadeh explained the material clearly and made the class easy to follow. The lectures were organized, and grading was fair. I would recommend taking this class if you want a professor who genuinely cares about student success.
Harsh grader but is caring
He is an excellent instructor who explains the material clearly and makes the class engaging. He is very supportive and always willing to help students succeed.
Great Glass and Excellent Professor

Although his lectures are very hard to follow, and he does not explain very well during them, he is of great help in office hours and really wants his students to do good. Tests are just like the homework and the book, so its best to just read from it. He is also very generous with his curves.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Not a good lecturer, BUT the exams are easy and reflect the mastering homework/textbook problems. There is also a HUGE curve! I don't go to lecture, but I take notes and do problems in the textbook & I've gotten an A on both exams so far. His accent and teaching is really hard to understand, but you can succeed by teaching yourself pretty easily.

Professor Torres is one of the best language professors at UM. She is very kind and supportive, provides a lot of helpful resources, and creates a positive learning environment. Grading is very fair, and expectations are clear. The only downside was the MindTap homework, which is part of the curriculum rather than her teaching. Highly recommend!

Professor Torres is the most caring professor I have had. She is super understanding and lenient with grading. You will have to do a ton of homework, but that is every spanish class. She will teach you a lot and is the best spanish professor at UM. Also gives you candy on halloween.
The best Spanish professor. Period!!
She is so nice and helpful and really wants her students to succeed. There is a lot of homework but that's just how the program is ran. She is also a very easy grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Love her! On the waitlist to take her for SPA102 rn. Super understanding. Veryy fair grader. Really just wants to see you succeed. Brought us halloween candy. I suck at spanish but she was so nice and helpful.
literally the best Spanish teacher ever. she's such a sweetheart and genuinely cares and will help you out with anything. I would retake her class in a heartbeat.
Best teacher. Took two semesters with her. Kind and concerned. Very accessible and easy to understand although there is a lot of homework.
Take her if you want to have fun with Spanish 101 and get an A in the end.

My favorite Spanish professor I have ever had! She is so caring and understanding of all students. make sure you participate in class, there is a good amount of homework but we go over it in class. Her study guides are VERY important for the test, if you use those you will do well!
Best professor ever. I really enjoyed the course and professor Torres

she is very caring. her study guides are amazing. very straight to the point. but there is a lot of work involved with quizzes and hw. buy the professor version of the textbook instead of the student one bc it explains everything better and it has the hw
I am currently taking this course. She is amazing. I highly recommend her.

Professor Torres is amazing. I took the class this semester because It is mandatory. The course is directed towards heritage students and I am loving it! The professor motivates me to learn more about my Hispanic ancestors.

I liked her very much. It was my first semester at the UM, and my first Spanish course ever. She is very helpful, patient and a very kind professor. Very clear in the classes and also in the directions for different activities and evaluations. Highly recommended teacher.

This was my second semester with Professor Torres and it was like the first time, a good experience. Although the course has a lot of homework, she explains the topics well in class, bringing examples and materials in addition to the book. Also, she is very understanding, always willing to help students. I would take Spanish course with her again.

Professor Torres is an excellent professor. At first I thought that the course would be very difficult but I gradually increased my interest. Although the texts are long, the topics made me identify much more with my Hispanic roots. I highly recommend this professor. She made me more interested in studying Spanish.

She's seriously the nicest most lenient person ever. Granted I took her class online, but she was so kind and understanding. Late on homework? She'll give you an extension. Can't make it to a mandatory class? Just meet with her and let her know. She's is so kind and just wants what's best for her students. Tbh love her
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Shes so sweet, the class was easy for me because Ive already learned all of the grammar but if you havent, reading the textbook might be helpful because she doesnt explain it that much in class, instead you mostly do activities to practice. As long as you have a basic understanding and learn the vocab you should be able to get an A

Professor Torres is a sweet lady. She is very accommodating and wants the best for all of her students. HW is online and tests are not too difficult (4 total) as long as you have a basic understanding of the material. Oral exams and compositions seem intimidating but she is very helpful, gives good feedback & truly just wants you to try your best.

Dr. Torres is really accommodating. All of the Spanish classes are designed the same way by the department but she wants her students to succeed. Spanish itself was harder then I expected but thats not on her. She is great at responding to emails and I really recommend her.
She is a great professor, and person.

she is the sweetest professor i have ever had at UM. this is the best spanish class i have ever taken since she made it so interesting and fun. quite an easy grader too. the exams are a little bit difficult but she has no control over it as the spanish dept is the one that puts together the exams. wish i could take another class with her again!!

Not a great teacher at all. Gives so much homework and barely ever knows what is going on in class. I wanted to minor in Spanish but after taking this class I don't think I can ever take another Spanish class again. The material doesn't seem bad but the tests are always impossible. I took six classes this semester and did the most for this one.

reviews.comment: Professor Torres is great! The class is pretty easy, even if you don't test well. There are plenty of assignments to boost your grade, but not too many. Definitely a solid choice.

This class is definitely difficult, but it could be handled very easily by attending class and reading the text. It is a very interesting class where you learn a lot about human physiology. Additionally, Professor Lu teaches exactly what you need to know. He made a review before each test covering all the test content. He is very accessible.
A very difficult class but he's accessible and is willing to help his students

This was definitely a difficult class, but it is manageable. Dr. Lu is extremely accessible and helpful. He does take attendance, but it doesn't count for much. The class is only based on three exams, there is an optional final that replaces your lowest exam grade.

this was truly the hardest class i've taken at UM so far. the prof. is very willing to help out and going to office hours helped, however the content & exams are challenging and class is very fast paced. do not take it unless it's required or you are actually interested and want to learn about neurobio.

He was helpful after class and always available to help but lectures are hard to understand and the content is difficult enough as it is. The book helps understand more. Tests are based only on lecture slides and theres a generous curve for your final grade which is based only on three exams. No extra credit or homework points, mandatory attendance

Lu is very passionate about what he teaches. Exams are based on lectures and during reviews he will tell you what is on the exam. Lots of concepts are confusing - read the book to better understand. Hardest part of the course is learning the different brain structures and pathways.

Don't listen to what other people here are saying. Bio 268 was by far the most interesting class I have ever taken and the prof. is one of the best at UM. Clear grading, says exactly what he expects you to know on the exams, and is SUPER passionate about the class. It's a lot of material but its not quite as bad as some other classes I have taken.

Please do not take this class unless absolutely necessary. This is actually the hardest class I have taken in my life, not to mention the professor is legitimately impossible to understand and mumbles the whole class. This class actually made me depressed. Do not take unless you are a neuroscience major or it is absolutely necessary.
Lectures are material heavy, read textbook for comprehensive info

My favorite class I've ever taken!!! Dr. Lu is awesome and really passionate about everything to do with the class. Apply yourself, read the book, ask questions, go to office hours and you'll do great.

reviews.comment: lectures were hard to follow, not very engaging but professor was accessible. class material was very heavy, no easy A

reviews.comment: Do not take unless absolutely necessary. Teaches the class with very little detail and answers questions vaguely. Three exams are the only thing that make up your grade. reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

He literally laughs when students don't understand things. Read the textbook, it helps a lot, office hours are useless. Your entire semester grade is just the average of 3 non-cumulative exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Easy A. Your grade depends solely on its relation to the class avrg. Bad teacher though. Brags and laughs about how people have done badly on tests. Disgusting human being tbh.
