reviews.comment: He's a great professor and an A is very doable if you study smart. Flashcards helped a lot and made the class easy.

Must go to lectures!! 3 Tests given, all of which come straight from lectures. Read chapters from textbook on what you're not solid on, but overall if you put in the effort, you will get an A or B. Professor is easy to reach out to and will gladly help during office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Awesome class -- not easy though. Must have the textbook - read before class and his lectures will fill in any gaps. Dr. Lu is one of the best neuro/bio professors I've had; truly enjoys teaching the class so the class is one you look forward to!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This is THE hardest course I've taken at UM. Do not take this course unless you are a pre-med neuroscience major. It is truly a medical school level class. The lectures are insanely boring and the amount of info is truly overwhelming. This is not an elective and not on par with other 200 level courses.

His class and material is tough, as there is a lot of it. I never really paid attention in class, mostly just went through the whole book and learned from it. The tests are tough as there are a lot of material, but he does care about you as a student, and the lectures are useful if you're able to pay attention. Definitely a class you'll work for.
Never listened in class, just used his powerpoints and textbooks to get an A. When I did listen, he is not a bad lecturer. The tests are difficult, and you must read the textbook to do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Ridiculous amount of material. Wouldn't take if you don't have to save your GPA...
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Lu has to be one of UM Bio's best professors. His lectures were interesting and, more importantly, loaded with good info.  His tests were fair (despite the second one being pretty tough), but if you take good notes and study hard, an A is very, very attainable.  He has a good sense of humor and gets along well with his students. Great professor

Dr. Lu has been one of my favorite professors at UM. His class isn't the easiest but it really isn't hard if you study properly. First exam is a breeze, second exam is tough (he even warns you), and third exam is not that bad. Very lecture based so definitely attend class and take notes but book is needed too. Interesting material and smart prof

This class is easy. Do not need textbook. Tests are based off lecture. You can study his ppts and pass with an A. This is one of the easier Bio classes I have taken. Those that complain probably didn't go to class. He does have an accent but he is VERY clear with the material.

This material of this class is interesting, but if you expect to learn by going to class, forget it. His accent is so strong that I can barely follow what he says, and his powerpoints aren't much help. You're gonna need to read the book. A lot. Oh, and his tests are so hard he laughs about it.

Very helpful in office hours. Powerpoints are a little vague but everything he says in class ends up on the exams. Lectures more important than textbook. Exams not as easy as it seems, requires critical thinking not pure memorization. But he is a nice guy.

Dr. Lu is one of the best teachers I've had at Miami. Not only is the course extremely interesting, but he also makes exams straightforward. Everything on the test will have been talked about during class, so attendance is very helpful. If you go to class, read the book and take notes, its not bad at all. Got an A+. Take Dr. Lu for sure.

Dr. lu is a great teacher! His tests only cover information that he covers in class so you have to be ready to take good notes. He is also very nice outside of class and is always willing to help. He is definately one of my favorite professors at UM

This class is very hard - don't be fooled by these ratings. All he does is read from the powerpoints and then the exams have nothing to do with what he lectured on. Don't take this class if you have other hard classes too. Don't recommend at all.

A+. How? Go to class, pay attention, study hard. If you already know the material or only read the book you will only do average (B+ is 80-85) because most test questions are based on lecture. There's 3, 100 point exams. Final is not cumulative. Lu is one of the better professors here. Book is very good too, you will use it a lot. Most get B+ or A-
Great professor! The course is very interesting and enjoyable. Attendance is a must to do well on exams.

Intro Neurobio takes a lot of studying and it's a good idea to go to class b/c his tests focus on the things he covers in lecture. He doesn't curve tests. If you're willing to put in the work, take this class. It's been my favorite bio class so far. Nice guy and interesting subject! A+ grade.

I actually thought his powerpoints were great for studying for the tests (provided you were in class and took notes). I got an 'A' in the class and basically didn't read the book, studying from my class notes only. Nice guy; grading can be tough because of no curve, but the semester I took it, he gave bonuses on the final to help boost the grades.

His lectures are useless. The powerpoints are almost pointless, but they do help as a guide for what to read in the book. His exams are very fair, not tricky at all. As long as you read the book and memorize, you should be able to get an A. He has a lenient grading scale even though he does not curve. A- is like an 85%

I liked this class.  Lu's a good guy and really likes what he teaches.  Tests aren't too bad, but he doesnt curve.  Go to class because he only tests what he covers, and sometimes he discusses things that arent in the the textbook.  Good medschool prep.

Lu is a good guy. he is very helpful, so if you have questions go to see him. His class is not hard, what makes it tough to get an A is the fact that the test is 50 questions and since an A is 90% u can only get five wrong.
a very chill professor. doesent expect a lot from you. all the exams are take home. take if you need an easy math class and dont care about how much you learn.

Zame did not have a syllabus, was impossible to contact outside of class, only named topics and didn't actually teach them, and always dismissed questions about grades. Tests are take-home and sometimes ask questions from the textbook, but you can find a pdf online. Only rule for tests is no collaboration. Great time to do work for other classes
what the ****

You don't have to show up you don't have to turn in anything you will receive a randomly selected grade or maybe an I for incomplete at the end of the semester depending on his unknown and mysterious grading strategy. Does not hand back work and there is no syllabus. This professor is like hitting the mystery box you can get a ray gun or a pistol.

This is the worst professor I have had at the University of Miami. He does not give a syllabus. He does not post grades. Every exam and assignment is take home, however he takes forever to grade them or does not give them back to you. You have no idea what your grade is throughout the entire semester and you will not know until the semester is over
Really boring and just not a great prof. No grading scale and I have no idea what I have in the class

For anyone thinking of taking him for any math class, fall or spring, PLEASE DO NOT EVER ENROLL IN THIS CLASS. EVEN IF YOU NEED THIS CLASS, DONT TAKE IT, TAKE IT WITH SOMEONE ELSE NEXT SEMESTER. His classes make no sense, and he does not have study material and anything for you to learn off of.

Absolutely worst prof i have had. absolutely should not be teaching. does not care about student success. did not give syllabus until half way thru sem when confronted head of math department. awful teacher, rambles and does not explain material, terrible at teaching. no grading scale, nothing of value in the class. not sure how he has a job.

reviews.comment: He is making my life a living hell. Absolutely inaccessible outside of class. Lectures are utterly useless. Goes on weird unrelated tangents. Hard to follow. He doesn't have a grading scale and if you ask him about it he'll give you a weird cryptic answer. Doesn't explain anything in class. Interrupts you when you ask questions. Horrible.

Lectures were not engaging at all. Professor Zame keeps repeating topics even though he already mentioned them several times. His lectures are also not well prepared and I had to teach myself everything. If you want to actually learn linear algebra, I suggest staying away from this professor.

Did not teach or explain well. Multiple tangents every class, very repetitive. DO NOT TAKE. No structure in class and very difficult to catch up. All exams are take home but have very confusing questions. Loses exams and misgrades so keep your exams for reference when he posts the grades at the end of the semester.

He isn't the worst. He does 1-2 exams and a final. All are taken home. If u express to him that u care ab the subject and take the initiative, it isn't the worst. He doesn't have a set syllabus, and lectures r unclear everywhere. U need to self-teach a bit to understand the info. HW is not graded. Wish he didn't give Qs that need online programs.
Avoid at all costs.

I love that I went into student debt to see live ASMR sessions. His voice was such an audio stimulus. If you want an occasional 10/10 nap session for a semester, this class is for you. If you want to learn MTH224, look somewhere else.

Horrible, easily one of the absolute worst professors ever. Grade is based entirely on the final, his lectures are more boring than watching rocks race, and the exams/hws were needlessly long and difficult. Zame had no structure or direction with his teaching. I did not learn one thing about Stats. His lectures are all over the place and incredibly mundane and repetitive. We had one exam before the final and it took him over a month to give back. Do not take him for any class.

DO NOT TAKE!!! We only had 1 exam and the final. We got the first exam back 1 week before the final. I am good at math but I did not learn a thing in this course. Grade was based on 1 homework assignment and 4 take home tests. Was the easiest professor for math 311, but I wouldn't recommend if you are actually trying to learn anything

Worst professor ever. Gave our class 1 homework assignment and 4 take home exams the entire semester and not one thing ever got graded. Lectures are confusing and all over the place. Goes off on tangents about information that is not relevant. Dont even bother showing up to class because you wont learn anything from his lectures.

He assigned 3-4 take home assignments for the entire grade. He never gave us a score or gave us back any of those. His lectures are illegible and directionless. Assigns letter grades with no basis because he does not grade your work throughout the year.

Only giving him one star cause we legit did nothing through the entire semester. He assigned two homeworks (which i never got back) and one test plus the take home final exam. This class is cake cause theres no work. Also, i never bought the book which was smart of me cause weve never even opened it. Looking for an easy class, this is it.

Pretty solid professor. I never showed up to class but managed to pull an A. If you go to his office hours and show that you're passionate about mathematics, he will be happy to help you out and promotes good and thought provoking discussion. Discussing key problems related to Analysis with him will earn your brownie points and get you an A, thanks

Extremely disorganized. First half of every lecture is repeating the back half of the previous lecture. EVERYONE GETS A B. It doesnt matter what you do, youll get a B. Very disorganized, none of the class is taught from any book its all information he finds interesting. 2 hw and 2 exams that he doesnt grade until last week of school. AWFUL.

reviews.comment: During the course there were 3 homework assignments and 1 midterm. The professor failed to grade any of the assignments until the final week of class.

He's what you think of when you imagine a stereotypical mathematician - smart but disorganized, sharing some ideas that he considers interesting (almost having "conversations" instead of classes). It's not impossible to follow him but you do need to stay on top of it. He tries to follow the textbook but gets off on tangents every now and then.

I'm convinced that it takes actual practice for him to be as horrible as he is. I think he has a bad professor training manual that he reads from everyday, and puts forth extreme effort in being terrible, in hopes of one day making it into the Guinnes  Book of World Records for worst professor who are maintaining employment.

You do not have to show up to class and even if you do the class is pointless he is very unclear on the material.  Good at math and ended up with a bad grade.  He is by far the worst professor I have ever had.

Do not take any of his classes. You will not be fairly evaluated. Every student receives a B, with no regard to merit. The tests are essentially optional, as they will not be factored into the final grade. Class is optional: a classmate showed up only a handful of times. Guess what he got as his grade: a B. Fair, right?  Undoubtedly the worst.
terrible teacher. goes off on tangents and not willing to listen to students.  asks questions just to shut you down

Rarely uses the board but will still expect you to understand proofs he covers in under two minutes.  Goes on random tangents and will not tell you exam dates util the week before.  Wears canadian tuxedos all the time (not sure why I added that haha)

I took Theory of numbers with him despite warnings from my friends.  He came into class with no notes and would just start talking about information, sometimes unrelated to each other.  The only assignment was a difficult take home final  that he was willing to help with.  He's very knowledgeable but you really have to like math to stay interested.
If you did not already learn calculus, please do not take this course.

I literally play bike race for 75 minutes a day because paying attention is useless. I'm horrible at math and he does not make it easier or more enjoyable. This is the first year he's made a syllabus but it is completely useless. Unbelievable how little structure there is in this class, which makes the assignments long and difficult.

Professor Zame is by far the worst professor I've ever had. He often goes off on Tangents that don't relate to the lecture, he's never in his office when you want to see him, and his affect and monotone voice doesn't make you want to learn. Avoid him if possible.
Worst Professor I've EVER had!!!b

This is the worst class I have ever taken.  It is almost impossible to get a good grade. I have no idea how I ended up passing the class when I was sure I was failing and would have to repeat it. His grading method has no sense.  Although he is willing to answer questions and try to help, the class itself is the worst thing I have ever experienced.

Honestly, don't bother. He is so unorganized, and cannot teach well at all. Didn't even give us a syllabus. Feel like he makes up class policies on the spot. Not professional. DO NOT TAKE HIM--there are much better MTH113 professors out there. Tests are generally 5-7 questions.
Don't even bother
the worst out there

This class was a joke. If you have any prior knowledge to discrete (or number theory), you'll breeze by this. He is quite boring, unorganized, and extremely repetitive, but it's very useful subject matter. He's smart, and I guess he forgets he's supposed to TEACH some topics instead of just reviewing them. But the class is very do-able.
Worst teacher I've ever had, bar none. No syllabus, completely unhelpful and incomprehensible.

Worst math teacher I ever had. Do not take this class with him, I have taken tons of math classes and I used to love math, this guy made me hate it. The material is suppoused to be easy and he makes it really hard because his exams are made up right before entering the class room, they are hand written,if you are lucky if not written on the board!

Absolutely Horrible! On the first day of class I asked for a syllabus, he said he would think about one; it never happened. There is no structure to the class. No use of any book. The class is taught as if we are supposed to already know the material. It does not matter whether you try hard in the class or not. Would definitely NOT recommend him!!!
worst teacher i've had at the University.  No syllabus or returned work.  I was bored to tears in class and lab.  I honestly believe he arbitarily decided our grades based on if he liked us.
horrible horrible horrible...had no class structure and a crappy sylabus. do not take this class with him.
No Comments

He's just too damn smart to teach at the 500 level.  Real Analysis is pretty tough material but he just skips around with no real strategy or direction.  Doesn't realise that what is obvious to him is damn near incomprehensible for others.  I was lucky to get out of there with a C.
This guy was all over the place in class. No syllabus, no semblance of course structure. Plus his advice on homework was cryptic at best, since he'd often say nothing more than "fiddle with it."
Has good lectures, solid teacher, imo best out of the other staff

Acevedo is a solid choice for orgo 2. Lectured very fast but that's how it has to be for this class. He provided very clear sets of notes for each chapter which was super helpful. Although attendance isn't mandatory he went over examples in class that made the notes make more sense. Hard class but I would recommend Acevedo if he is an option

I got a C in orgo 1 because of Agrios but Acevedo was a solid professor who clearly explained material and made very clear notes with pictures and examples copied straight from the textbook. You dont have to go to lecture as most ppl just learn orgo 2 by themselves but his exams were solid (tough but fair)

reviews.comment: Dr. Acevedo has one of the cleanest set of lecture notes that he provides us prior to the lecture to follow. His weekly quizzes were a little stressful but they were not that difficult and reflected the kind of questions we did in class. He always said yes to zoom meetings if you needed help. DO TEXTBOOK PROBLEMS FOR EXAM PRACTICE!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I was unprepared for this course and any chemistry class will be difficult, but Dr Acevedo is one of the best professors that I've ever had. He cares about his students grades and is always available for office hours. While his exams are extremely difficult he gives a generous curve at the end. Take him if you can.
2 semesters of chem in 1 is difficult but he made it better. So nice and wants you to succeed. Works out problems in class. DO BOOK PROBLEMS and practice exams. Requires alot of work to do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Acevedo is a great lecturer, does multiple practice problems during class, and sometimes spends entire classes reviewing for exams. You dont need to read the text, but need the book in order to do the practice problems, which are the best way to prepare for his exams. He even uses some of the same practice qs on the exam itself. Weekly quizzes
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Acevedo has become one of my favorite professors! Kind, eager to help, and really wants you to understand! No homework, but txtbook problems are ESSENTIAL for tests. If you take good notes, reread his lecture, and put in some elbow grease, it'll pay off! Awesome curve! AP Chem isn't needed (I didn't take it). Sad I won't have him next semester!

Dr. Acevedo is probably one of my favorite chemistry teachers. Lectures are very clear and organized. He actually gives you his chapter notes, with his own practice problems. However, the class is difficult; there's no homework but be prepared to do lots of textbook problems to study. Curves generously at the end of the course. Go to office hours!

Dr. Acevedo understands that chemistry is tough; does his best to help his students and to make the course fun. His lectures and teaching style are great, exams are very fair and weekly quizzes gets you studying early. Don't need AP Chem to pass this class, take great notes and DO THE PRACTICE PROBLEMS and you'll succeed. The best for PRISM!!

The best Chemistry Professor at the U. His lectures were so informative where I never felt as though I needed to read the textbook (and he made it very interesting). He always wanted everyone to do well and goes out of his way to get you help if you are struggling. The quizzes and tests are hard, but the practice problems he assigns prepare you.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Acevedo is a great professor. His lectures are amazing & he's easily accessible. I admit this is a not an easy course especially if you have not taken AP Chemistry before, but if you're willing to put in the work (and make the most out of your study of course) then not only will you get a decent grade, but you get a lot out of the course.

This course is difficult, but Dr. Acevedo is a great teacher. You have to study a lot and do practice problems to really understand the material, but he is accessible outside of class if needed and gives practice tests for every exam that are very similar to the actual ones. Sapling homework may seem annoying/long but it's great practice for tests!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Acevedo really cares about his students understanding material. You should go to his office hours if you need help understanding concepts. Chemistry is hard, especially at the U. You can pass with an A or a B if you put in the time. Requires 10 hours/week. After taking this course, I reviewed the Chm book of my MCAT review and knew a lot.

Chemistry always requires a lot of work and the homework and book problems he gives require a lot of time, but as long as you do and understand them you'll be fine. He uses a lot of the same problems on his tests too and gives the class a big curve at the end. Overall he is very helpful and wants students to do well in his class.

Dr. Acevedo is a perfectly fine teacher. My only complaint about him is that he lectures are very fast paced and they are essentially just him speed reading the textbook aloud with a a few practice problems thrown in. That being said, he really wants everyone to do well and will do everything he can to make sure you succeed (if you seek out help).

Rally nice guy, they call him "the unicorn" of the chem department. Lectures are pretty boring, he works out problems on the board for us. The online hw (Sapling) is super annoying. I'm grateful to have had him for Gen Chem 1, I heard he's easier than most. Sweet and funny.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: The notes that he posts and bases his lectures on are ok, but they're not great. His online home works are horrendously time-consuming. Workshops were helpful. Grade in class mainly based on performance on tests. He's nice and approachable. I struggled to get used to his class but textbook/practice problems helped me understand concepts.

Dr. Acevedo is one of the best professors I've ever had for chemistry. He truly cares about his students and is very fair on tests and assignments. He is willing to help and is also very understanding. The content requires studying but Dr. Acevedo does a great job outlining all the concepts and making sure you are prepared.

Dr. Acevedo is by far the most caring professor I've had at UM. He is very willing to meet with his students outside of class and is able to provide good explanations. Regardless of your prof, orgo is a class you're going to have to put a lot of work into, and Acevedo is more than willing to help along the way.
The best professor! Take him for an easy A!

His lectures aren't too useful but he's not a terrible professor. He is willing to give a better explanation on problems if necessary. He literally outlines every chapter so you don't need to read the book. This class is tough no matter what; you're gonna have to work for a high grade. It is possible to do well. I got over a 100 on the final!
My test average in his class was above a 100% and I have never taken chem in high school. Take Dr. Acevedo for this class enough said.

I had Dr. Acevedo for chem 221 and I thought he was a great professor. No the class is not easy but it will not be easy with whoever you take it with. I definitely recommend him to anyone who needs to take this class. I have not taken chem at this level before in any way and I was able to get an A+ in his organic chem class. Take him!

I don't understand all the bad comments, I found Dr. Acevedo a great porofessor who really cares about his students. The class itself is very hard no matter who you take but I believe he makes it as smooth as possible. He is also very kind when answering any questions. I would take him again.

Take Leslie Knecht if possible. There is no value in going to class as his lecture are essentially him reading the text allowed.  There is a significant average difference between his and Leslie's classes, even though he says otherwise. The exams are meant to trick you and get you to lose points. Please be careful if you decide to take this class.

He's really not that great of a teacher. His lectures are just basically him reading straight from his notes, which are straight from the book. Not even worth going to class. Tests aren't too bad, until the last one. Take Knecht if you can, if you have Acevedo its going to be mostly self taught from the book.

He is not an effective teacher.  He stands in front of the class and reads from his notes which are essentially copied and pasted from the textbook.  He offers no additional insight and is unable to provide helpful answers when asked a question.  His class notes are confusing since he picks and choices what to take from the textbook.   SELF-TEACH.

Nice guy, but unclear and boring lectures. He doesn't work out problems on the board--instead he just reads from an already worked out solution or slides. Not a great teacher for this class--take Knecht if possible.

Did not have a good experience in Dr. Acevedo's class. The class lectures were not beneficial at all, as all that was done was read powerpoints that came straight from the textbook. Not once were practice problems done on the board. All problems were just read orally and assumed we were to understand what was going on. Not helpful at all.
Not very difficult, but mandatory clicker questions for final grade are a pain. So no skipping class, and his class is pretty boring. Just him reading his notes and explaining them.  Wouldnt recomend

Mrs. d . . .  kept me in school when I would have left if she wasn't there.  I owe her so much for her teaching and support.  I love you Lady and I will always remember you.  Every time I claim it, you are there making me believe in myself.

Ms.D was the person who knew what she was talking about.  She knows opera, can act, direct, and makes it clear, so we finaly knew what we were doing.  She even brought her own clothes from home to wear for costumes. I said she was easy because she made something hard easy. fun too. Thank you. Thank you. you rock, lady.
The BEST.  Wish She hadn't retired.  Our loss.

I'm looking on my computer, hoping to find Prof de Acha, because I need a piece of music, found this site. I did my degree with this wonderful lady--the best teacher I've ever had--anywhere. I owe you so much Ms. D. Anybody saying bad things about you is a loser. Get a life.  You are talented, patient, fun, inspiring. I hope I can find you.

I graduated 10 years ago. I sing for a living.  Not a day goes by that I don't think of Professor De Acha and thank God I was assigned to her studio. She made me a singer.  She was the most knowledgeable person in music and theater.  We all loved her. She knows so much and really loves to share and teach. I'll always be grateful to have had her.

Horrible teacher. She spends all of the voice lesson time just talking about herself. She doesn't focus on her students nearly as much as on herself. I also had her for English Diction. She barely ever taught the class, and it was basically left up to us, the students, to read the entire book to study for her tests. I would not recommend her!
She knows so so much about voice and how to use it correctly. I look up to her so much. She knows what she's talkng about and explains it so that you really understand it.
No Comments

A phenomenal teacher who will bend over backwards for a student if they show interest. She is one of the most talented women I have ever seen. Not only opera trained but an amazing musical theatre actress/singer. My second mom.

Ms. DeAcha did not foster creativity in our musical theatre class. She actively stifled specific people and made the majority of us very unhappy. Also, her grading was unclear until we saw it at the end of the semester.
Super sweet professor! She is so lenient and nice. Her exams are all online, and her projects are super easy! Highly recommend taking her!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I've never rated a professor on here but I had to for her. TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!! She is so sweet and I actually enjoyed going to her lectures. Exams are open note take home and material is straight from the lecture. You have to go to lecture because there are some missing words on the slides that she will say during lecture but not bad at all.

Dr. Afkhami was truly one of the best biology professors I've taken so far. Her exams are online, 2 projects that do not take you more than 10-15 minutes and 1 group project that was so easy. Take her if you want to learn about ecology and actually boost your gpa.

Take her for bil330! Exams are online based off of her PowerPoint lectures which she does such a great job at. Notes r fill in the blank style and her lectures are the material for the exams. Fill them out by going to class ans u will be fine! She is super sweet too if you ever talk to her! Not a stressful lecture at all.

Sweetest professor on the planet! Dr. Afkhami is such an awesome professor for HHMI, the research project she had us run was super interesting and she was very helpful throughout the entire process, she is amazing!!!!
Great teacher. Lots of Extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She is a really nice professor. Straightforward class, no textbook needed. 3 exams drops 1 plus an easy final (all have E.C.). Everything you need to know is in her powerpoints. Plenty of quizlets online to study from. Has few additional extra credit. 3 projects that can be easily done in 30 minutes each. Put in the effort and it'll be an easy A.

kind and encouraging, and class is pretty easy! runs through powerpoints in lecture, but the info is straight from textbook; tests are straightforward and MC, but questions can be pretty specific. would suggest reading the chapters to get enough detail for exams!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Afton was one of the best TAs I've had. She is easily accessible outside of class and wants her students to understand the content and do well in her class. Would def recommend over the other TAs.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She is a really great TA- probably the best I ever had at UM. She is really great at explaining concepts and making sure you are prepared for any kind of assessment. She is very nice and wants to make sure you fully understand all concepts in class. She is a tough grader, but she is also very reasonable.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She's the best TA in the ex phys department at UM. Her class is hard but doable and shes a great person to be around. Afton is super smart and knows how to explain concepts well. Her grading is fair and the topic of her class is very interesting as well as hands on.

Dr. Zabowski is easily one of my favorite professors at UMiami. She cares so much about her students and really wants everyone to succeed. Fairly easy class with few assignments and barely any homework. I would absolutely take a class with her again!

If you can, take this professor!! She has a 5 on Rate my for a reason. She is one of the nicest people and would always bring food to class, often being homemade. You can tell she truly cares and remembers her students, often asking follow ups to previous conversations and interests. The class is easy but constructive and the pacing is very good.
Honestly the best professor in the world. Super sweet and understanding, if you show up and do your work its the easiest A. Could not recommend her enough. She also brings food everyday
My favorite professor ever! Best English course I've ever taken!!!

Snacks every class. Let us out early all the time. Cancelled class for us to work on assignments. When I tell you she's the best of the best, I mean it. She's so sweet and bakes treats for her students. She clearly cares about everyone's presentations. Do yourself a favor and take her class. Even if you're not an engineering student, try to get in.

The kindest and most caring professor! She takes time to get to know her students and knows everybody's name! She is truly the sweetest lady and even brings baked goods to every class. Please take her if you can she is the best! Her class is really not too hard, she cancels class a lot.

Best english professor and class you will ever have. Please take her and just enjoy the ride. Truly a sweetheart that cares about her students. As a professional 9 am class hater, I still loved her class. Also has baked goods for her students.

TAKE THIS CLASS IF YOU CAN!! She is the sweetest! You'll have a new assignment every week but they are so simple. She doesn't give a big workload because she know's all the other work we have in other classes. She brings yummy baked goods almost every class. Overall, she is the best and you should take this class with her!
Must take.

She is the best! Classes never take up the whole period, and the final is a portfolio of all your work through the semester. She provides great feedback and lectures are super entertaining. She allows you to cater your writings to your interests!

She was very funny and caring. I 100% recommend her and would prefer to have her as my professor again. I appreciate how she gave us lose deadlines so that we could put time into other classes as well. She bakes a lot of yummy food too. Sometime I wish she did not get political, but other than that I have no complaints.

Dr. Susan is the best! I really like her class. It's fun, and she genuinely cares about her students. The 9 a.m. class was totally worth it. She is very sweet and kind, and she makes it easy to get an A. I highly recommend her—she's the besttttt!

The SWEETEST professor ever. She is very understanding and laid back. There's a total of 8 assignments all semester and they are due the very last day after finals, so plenty of time to complete essays. The assignments are very straightforward and simple. Great class!!

honestly the sweetest professor ever. she cares a lot if you're struggling with something outside of school and gives you time to complete assignments. good lectures and always brings super yummy baked goods in the morning!
She's the sweetest professor I've ever had, I'm so lucky to have been lectured by her!
Lovely, lovely lady. She takes the time to get to know all of her students and brings snacks/baked goods every day for class. The only 9am I will never regret taking!
This review is her 37th 5 star review, just doing my part here, enough has been said

The most special professor I've had. Always has food waiting for her students and really cares about students' well being. Easy assignments to complete with a good selection of topics. Classes always ended early and professor Zabowski understood always understood the workload of engineering students and gave leadway with assignments and attendance
The best professor on campus. I'm not kidding. Take her
The class was easy and fun. I liked the assignments and the readings. She is so kind and always available. Take the class!
Professor Zabowski is the best! She is so caring and funny and even though she starts off saying she is a tough grader we literally did bare minimum in the class. ALWAYS HAS SNACKS FOR US!
Professor Zabowski is the best! She is so caring, is so funny, and always brings food. There are 5 assignments and 2 presentations, but they are not bad at all. Definitely recommend taking her.

Professor Zabowski is amazing! Great and accessible outside of class and so nice to talk to. She assigns a few projects throughout the semester but is flexible with deadlines. Would cancel class if we were ahead and always baked for us and brought us snacks! It was so nice having a teacher like her during my first semester of freshman year!

Omg. I could go on and on about Susan. She is truly one of the kindest most caring professors you will ever have. She always greets you with a smile and freshly baked cookies or other treats. No real assignments either! Take her if you can, she is the best!

I never got the pleasure of meeting Prof. Zabowski in person because my class was online, but she was a joy to connect with even virtually. The material in the class can be confusing, but Prof. Zabowski is there to help every step of the way. Could not recommend her more, you should feel lucky if you're in her class.
One of the Kindest and most understanding professors, I am taking another one of her courses again. Very lenient with deadlines and very caring for students.
She is amazing, understands engineering students have heavy course load. Class is fun lots of snacks and discussion, little work.

Professor Zabowski is the nicest professor i've ever had. She responds to emails quickly, is always available, and brings food to every class. I wish I could take her class again. We did about 5 papers which she let us redo for a better grade. Best professor at UM.

She is one of the funniest and kindest professors that I have had at UM. You will never leave her class without a smile on your face. As long as you follow her instructions, the course is pretty simple and she will give you good feedback. She bakes for her students every class and it is always so good. Take her if you get the chance!

Professor Zabowski is the best! She responds to emails and concerns, and tries to make her course as manageable as possible. She knows you by name, and is super kind and sweet. Just show up to class, show interest, and you'll get a good grade.
The nicest and most understanding professor ever. Very simple yet engaging assignments as she knows the engineers have enough to worry about. She brings baked treats every class as well!
Writing based class, she is also really good at responding to emails and wants you to do good. She is very helpful when you need her

One of the sweetest professors ever! I took her class asynchronously and I thought the material was very complex. However, she was there to help me understand the assignments clearly and she is a very easy grader! She hosted a couple of Zoom meetings to check in on us, so she really does care about her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Zabowski is amazing! She is the nicest professor I have ever had. She is one of those cool teachers you can come to about anything. I am a Bio Major and would highly recommend taking her class as a non-english major student. Easy A.

I never meet her because of the online COVID class, but this class was very easy. 2 essays, 1 final essay, and a few discussions. She will let you resubmit essays if you don't like your grade. I didn't learn anything from this class, but it will just boost your GPA. I recommend this class but just stay on top of deadlines.

Prof Zabowski is probably the best english professor you will ever have. Super nice, and caring. Just show up, say a few words and you'll get an A. Assignments are super easy and take 20 minutes to do. Final portfolio at the end is just a resubmission of your top 3 best assignments from the semester. Don't worry there are no real essays or papers.

I LOVE professor Zabowski. She is the sweetest woman and she will bake for you pretty much every class. She is very understanding and grading isn't hard, shell give you feedback to help for your final portfolio so don't stress. You have 5 papers (mine were no more than 2 pages) and pick 3 as your final grade. Definitely take this class.
Most loving, amazing woman ever. Really understands students. Always brings food to class.
Cutest teacher. So sweet. Bakes for you. Does not waste any time. LOVE HER SO MUCH.

To be completely honest you will not learn much in her classes but she actually makes the class enjoyable. She is the nicest and most caring professor I've ever had and so flexible. Will have to write a few papers but you will get an A in the class if you write the few papers. She always brings in food and will brighten you're mood no matter what.
I just love her!
Most incredible person ever must take she is amazing i love her

You'll never have a better professor.  Short, concise assignments that you are given feedback for.  2 page max on all papers.  The best 4 of 7 are taken into the final grade.  If you make the changes she says youll get an A.  Really sweet lady, makes cookies and cupcakes for us all the time.  ZABOWSKI YOU ROCK!
The easiest english class you will ever have. She loves her students as well. I highly suggest taking this class.
Best.English. Teacher.

very encouraging&positive. great break from physics and chemistry. discussion-type lectures. understood that students have other priorities. easily respected. short classes. no wasted time. very willing to help. great communication. assignments returned soon &answered emails asap. good office hours. always open&willing to help. GREAT BAKER!
she is the nicest professor EVER. she makes us cookies all the time! it was so great having her class as an engineering major because its the least stressful class. I LOVE HER
The greatest teacher ever to walk the face of the Earth!
This is by far the best and easiest professor you will ever have at UM (especially if you are a Engineering major). She is so sweet and she bakes for her students. SHE IS JUST AWSOME.

FABULOUS PROFESSOR! She makes you want to go to class and for an 8 AM, that's a lot to say. I loved going to class. She is so sweet and understanding and will always give you her undivided attention. Great class - I totally recommend it for a well-deserved EASY A :)

This is the complete truth about Prof Zabowski. She's one of the nicest professors I've ever had, the class is a breeze if you have half a brain, and she gives you food. However if you have any real aspirations of a career in a literary intense field this may not be the class to take, i learned absolutely nothing. Bottom line: EASY A for a reason.
AMAZING!

Mrs. Zabowski is very understanding! Attendance & Participation are necessary but you'll find yourself wanting to go to class on your own. She ends class early almost all the time. She feeds you (fruits, cookies, snacks)! No final exam--just a portfolio of writings done throughtout semester. No textbook. You learn something! EASY A :-)
Very easy class, easy grader, just participate and come to class and you'll get an A

reviews.comment: good luck. Come to class ready

reviews.comment: He seems nice at first but at the end of the semester he will turn his back on you if you miss one of his classes. He will report you to the student dean. If you can take another class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: his "grading of philosophy" relies on effort and showing up. very few things graded on actual content; he grades the process. made me very motivated to improve for myself rather than for a grade.

Caring professor with a great attitude! Papers are graded very fairly and mostly based on completion. Beware of 4 pop quizzes throughout the course however they are very easy and he gives 2 free points just by taking them. 5 free unexcused absences as well. Overall an amazing guy who loves what he teaches.

reviews.comment: Very easy grader, papers are graded on completion. Funny and caring, makes English a fun subject.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: The tests are kind of hard you just need to study a lot but besides those it is an easy course. Attendance is mandatory and you have to buy a platform called TopHat and there are pop questions that are graded so if you get them wrong or don't answer on time it affects your grade. There is a final project that has no rubric which was frustrating
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: This class was a lot of work for it to be a cognate. I do not recommend taking her!!! The exams don't match her review and she gives very little instruction on what to do for the final project. Attendance is mandatory and you have to pay attention the whole class as there will be random questions on tophat that only give you 20 seconds to answer.

This class was unexpectedly difficult. The first unit is hard, the second is harder, and the third is pointless and redundant. The final project was fine but she refuses to give a rubric and expects you to just know what to do. I studied a TON for the second exam but still struggled because her exam reviews are very different from the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This is supposed to be an easy cognate but she makes it so difficult. She turns the simplest concepts and turns then it into the most difficult to digest ideas. The tests are so complicated for no reason and the study guide for the test is useless. On top of everything she makes you buy another platform called Top Hat which is the same as Canva.

I am genuinely confused by all the good reviews. One of the most annoying professors I've had in my four years, knows that people take this course for a cognate so she intentionally tries to make it difficult (said this HERSELF). Seriously self-centered about the importance of this class, rude in emails, and condescending about not knowing content.

Dr. Brown was an amazing professor. She cares a lot about her students and is very passionate about the material. There is a end of year project that isnt too difficult and i actually use it to build my own exercise regimen (running x weightlift hybrid). Her test and the final werent too difficult and make sure you do the weekly assignments.

Dr. Brown's class was one of the better ones I've taken, and it's because she cares about the subject and makes it interesting. The ExRx project was fun and simple, and she is great at explaining concepts. She gives you opportunities for extra credit and is very reachable. Attendance is not technically mandatory, but she grades on participation.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Brown is super sweet and passionate about the subject. The first test is the hardest since there is a lot of biochem but she makes the lectures easy to digest. The ExRx project was interesting to do. She answers emails quickly. She also covers important info in class that isn't exactly on the slides but will be on the test.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I love professor Brown! She is so sweet her class is very straight forward. Going to class is important because of participation points and sometimes she says/describes things in more detail that aren't on the slides. Her tests can be a little tricky but overall not too bad. She gives a few easy extra credit points throughout the semester.

Dr. Brown makes her lectures very interesting and engaging. I took this class because of a cognate requirement but would take it even if that wasn't the case. Hws are really easy. Her tests can be a bit tricky, but as long as you pay attention in class and take good notes/study, you will be fine.

Dr. Brown is a great professor who really cares about the subject. She's kind with a sense of humor. She relates the class to you and your health which I enjoyed. Tests are easy if you pay attention and study.

Dr. Brown's course was very clear & straightforward. So were her assignments, tests, & in-class assignments/lecture material via TopHat. Not much you can screw up unless you miss deadlines. Although I took her class for credit, a lot of things I learned are very useful & I appreciate being able to properly address my fitness and health levels now.

Dr. Brown is clearly super passionate about the material and definitely cares about her students. The homeworks and final project are easy, but there is a lot of info on the test and I've found them to be difficult. If you are interested in the subject I'd say it's worth it but I wouldn't take it if you're just looking for an easy STEM cognate.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: You have to get this website TopHat for a cheap subscription. But, the class is very interesting and if you go to class and take notes you'll do well. The project she has at the end of the semester is fun and easy and the few exams aren't too bad. You get credit for showing up also

This is a great class especially if you are taking it for a cognate and this isn't your main area of study.  Professor Brown understands that many of her students are taking this class for their cognates and tries to make the class easy to understand, engaging, and not too difficult. Her passion for the subject really shows when lecturing.

Dr. Brown's KIN 155 class is actually what pushed me to minor in exercise physiology. She's a great professor and made learning the material that much more enjoyable. Tests weren't intimidating at all, if you complete the study guides she provides you'll do fine!

Professor Brown is AMAZING. The class is fairly easy and she makes it super interesting. If you go to class and pay attention to her you are almost guaranteed to do well. The workload is light and the final project is about writing yourself a workout plan which was super cool to do. 10/10 recommend her!

Professor Hauptfeld is genuinely a very good professor and also goes without saying a genuine nice guy. His class was easy to understand he gives instructions on the essays, the lectures for my course were pretty long but he made them as interesting as possible!

One of the best professors I have ever had, he engages with the class to ensure the lecture doesn't bore us, and always listens to what you have to say. All work is pretty straightforward where as long as you follow instructions you will be fine.

He is so boring, he lectures all class long, he's also super awkward. Has group activities which you need to turn in at the end of the course to get a grade on worth 30%. I didn't buy the book and still passed my online quizzes which are like 3 questions long, had one final paper worth 40% .... How I passed this class with an A is beyond me.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Really good guy. Clear teacher and clear grader. Also gives a lot of extra credit opportunities.

Hauptfeld is one of the best professors I've had at UM. His class fosters engaging, thought-provoking discussions with in-class activities that get you thinking about issues in ways that make you reconsider your view of the world. He's friendly, approachable, and willing to help + gives extra credit. Take him if you can!

He's an awesome instructor. He really shows the passion he has for teaching. Very knowledgeable about the course material and gives a great intro to the field of philosophy. Also really good to talk to outside of class about the material. There are reading responses every week and 2 papers but they're straightforward;Definitely recommend for PHI101
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: I took this class purely for writing credit. He is a cool guy and the topics are interesting, but I didn't like it because I just don't like philosophy. There were 2 essays and a few HW with clear grading criteria. He was a good prof with ideas that integrated the whole class
Great Professor. I took him for ethics and I do recommend him. He is every passionate about the subject and will answer all of your questions. He wants the best for his students.
Took Him at MDC Wolfson, Awesome teacher, really puts feeling in the class, great examples and overall educator

I took him at miami dade college and I really like him. He gives good feedback on your papers if you decide to write over the option of taking a test. He is super handsome and super friendly. I really like the way he lectures, he talks a lot but theres so much to say philosophy is very interesting. Take him if you like to participate in discussions

Professor Adam is a really good teacher. He gave the option to either take the exam or write a paper. Attendance wasn't mandatory which is good cause his lecture can drag on. He's really lenient on extra credit and due dates. He's a great professor and guy. Take him if you can!

Professor Hauptfeld is a helpful professor as well as a nice person! He is always there to give feedback for your essays, which, by the way, make your grade, so don't slack on them! Lectures can drag sometimes, but he does his best to make lectures as interesting as they can be.

While Dr. Meade was helpful during lectures, she was very hard to get a hold of this summer and this semester. I understand this pandemic has thrown a lot of us off balance and I'm sure she had other things to worry about outside of school, but there are many things I wanted to discuss. She was unavailable and unresponsive most of the time.
Adriana Meade is a very good counselor and is a good professor. I had her for a very basic class so it was very easy.

Unreliable and quite frankly shouldn't be advising and instead should strictly stick to teaching instead. Extremely hard to get a hold of and you will be bothered by the poorly trained student workers instead when it is her job to actually advise and teach. Don't take any of her courses or see her for advising unless it's mandatory.
Awesome!

She is a gem. I know its tough b/c you take this class early in your college life and its a bit tough but if you study, read and work hard its easy to get a decent grade. Shes very accessible and is excellent at teaching the material. Build a relationship w/ her b/c she is very helpful and writes great LORs. A kind, caring and incredible professor
Shes very nice, and a decent teacher. I think she grades a little tough, but fairly nonetheless. Id recommend her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr DuBois is a very smart, caring and patient professor. Go to class because she gives very useful details that are not included in the lectures. Her exams are more than fair, with 44 Qs + 2 or 3 bonus Qs. Little homework, & interesting workshop topics. Use the Pearson Homework to study, as well as the Dynamic Study Modules.

If you skip class, be ready to read the book. Professor Dubois is very passionate about her evolution and biodiversity. She narrows what you need to know for tests down in her lecture. Take good notes and memorize your phylogeny trees and you'll do fine.

She is a pretty straightforward choice for Comparative Physiology. Gives study guides with terms and concepts for every lecture which definitely help improve your exam scores. She is knowledgable but very boring. Exams are very fair in my opinion (Averages are usually a B- or B), but you have to study hard for them because they are the only grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Dubois is a kind and engaging professor. She only expects you to know what is covered in lecture, even if she runs out of time. I went to every lecture and never bought the textbook. Take good notes, look at the practice exams, and you will get an A. CAREFULLY read the test questions. Some of the lecture material is tested on the MCAT.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: DuBois class is fair. The exams are based mostly off of her lectures and not the textbook. Only use the textbook to fill in the information that you don't understand from lectures. If you study this class is fairly easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She makes you work for your grade but she makes herself accessible. Go to her office hours and go to the workshops (they are mandatory). She makes it easy for you to do well since there is extra credit (homework, workshop attendance, homeworks, etc).
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Tests are tough--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is a very sweet lady and it's obvious that she is passionate about biology. she grades a little bit tough on open-ended exam questions. She is also kind of boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: This was her first semester doing writing portions on the test and you would have to be very specific when answering the questions. She gave a lot of homework assignments, went really fast during the lectures, a lot of it is you reading and comprehending on your own. If you have a strong background and knowledge you may be OK.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Super nice and gives detailed lectures. She expects students to attend class and answer questions. There is a lot to memorize due to the nature of the course however the tests and quizzes are mainly fair. The lectures coincide with the book.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Not a great professor in the slightest. Puts very little effort in to helping students and exams are not fair. Take another professor if you can because the amount of information required for this course was absurd and does not give a good grade (no curve). Cares little about her students and the topic of her course in general. Do not recommend.

Descent professor. Lectures are heavy but helpful. Gives study guides for every quiz, test, and final. ANSWER ALL THE STUDY GUIDES! You need to study a lot for this class so take good notes and review in advance. Memorization is essential for this course. The final was pretty easy (part-cumulative) she repeats some questions from past exams
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Such a sweet woman. Animal communications with her has been my favorite class at UM. Super interesting subject, exams are super easy if you actually study a bit. Really fun class.  HOWEVER I also took her for BIL360 this semester and she was not nearly as good for that. Talked too fast and notes weren't terribly helpful. 3.5/5 difficulty for 360.

Terrible teacher. Lectures are not clear enough at all, and it seems like she rushes through material without teaching any application of it at all. Exams are very tricky and specific, and multiple answers could seem correct. Bad experience
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I do not recommend taking her. The only way to get As on her exams is either to study ridiculously hard to the point where your using all sources from lecture, book and mastering or you buy a $10 study guide from those kids that sell them. And I guarantee the only students who gets As on her exams are the one's who buy the study guide.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: awful! her study guides are not helpful whatsoever, her lectures are ok but rather skip every class and read the text book instead since just lecture is not enough... her exams are ridiculously tricky. do  not take (but if krempels is your only other choice, just take dubois)

She's a good professor. Clear and very helpful and really approachable. This is a reading intensive class so be prepared to put in some work. But it's not too complicated. There's a lot of chances to do well.

DuBois is a great teacher, very young and loves birds. She's very helpful if you are struggling and ask for help. Sometimes her lectures can be boring because she goes really in-depth in to examples. Overall would take her again.

Loved her class Very detailed lectures (study the diagrams HINT HINT) Great during office hours Outlines for each chapter AND exam + practices exams (so you understand the types of Qs she will ask) 6 units (so each exam is very narrow but deep in info) Easy final Extra cred for a feedback survey if % class completes it I read the book

She is such a great professor!  Always willing to help and gives very reasonable tests.  She wants the students to do well, unlike a lot of other professors.  Also took her for Animal Communications and she was great then too.  Very clear-cut in lecture and does a great job explaining the material.  Really increased my interest in her courses.

Dr. Dubois is a great professor! I learned a lot, and I always felt very prepared for all of the exams. Definitely not an easy A, but if you go to lectures and do the study guides, it's not hard to do very well.

Dr. Dubois was very helpful and managed to teach me things that had baffled me since gen bio. Her tests were NOT difficult if you went to class and if you gave the chapters and figures at least a cursory look-over. I would definitely recommend taking her 360 section, especially if you plan to take the MCAT soon.

Has obviously never taught let alone 120 students. quite strange, a person that you could see owning 20 cats. Her tests (each one) covered around 5 Ch's and within those 5 chapters there are a ton of figures. Her horribly worded and vague test question could be on any part of any figure within the chapter. AKA stupid class due to the teacher

Not sure what has happened to Adam since he left Miami but he is NOT nice. He tries to be nice but a snide/jerk remark is inevitable. His lecture style is ok. He literally lectures the textbook, brings little to no outside material to lecture unless it has to do with his research. Homework will cost you 140, is only worth 5%. Unpredictable exams

Definitely the best orgo professor at UM. His tests are very easy compared to that of Heller or Colonna because his exams resemble the end of chapter practice questions. His handwriting is horrible so make sure you don't get the arrow directions wrong. He is very helpful during office hours.
He gets confusing sometimes, but compared to other professors for Orgo he's fairly easy and you can definitely get by

He honestly made Orgo enjoyable somehow. He has a great sense of humor and makes the lectures fly by. He curves the class (it was about 80+ to get an A). He holds review sessions before tests and answers any questions. He has a homework section worth 5% (you have to buy the software), but it is helpful in learning the material. Definitely recommend
He makes Orgo enjoyable. Best chemistry professor ever.

Braunschweig is an amazing professor. His lectures are very clear, he knows what he is talking about, he is funny and makes you laugh. His tests are very fair, he is always willing to help you and definitely wants the best for you. The class is curved (a big curve). He goes slow and makes sure everyone is doing well! TAKE HIM!

Professor Braunschweig is easily the best teacher I've had here so far. His lectures are very clear and he goes slow so that it's easy to follow. The homework doesn't count for much in terms of grades but it is super helpful for preparing for the tests. Exams are fair and he always provides time for review sessions.

Braunschweig somehow makes orgo enjoyable. His lectures are very clear and he tells you exactly what you need to know for the tests. There are no trick questions. He has a good sense of humor as well and is always very positive and enjoyable. I would definitely take him again and recommend him to anyone.

Adam Braunschweig is possibly one of the best science teachers I've ever had. I was personally terrified of taking organic chemistry in college and he made the class so understandable and enjoyable. I actually enjoy orgo and it's definitely thanks to Braunschweig.

His first semester teaching (CHM 202) didn't go very well, so he took our class very slowly.  The only downside was that we didn't cover as much material as we were supposed to, but we had a better understanding of the material we did cover.
Not a good professor.  He ridicules those he doesn't like and those who ask questions.  Exams do not correlate with material whatsoever.  Makes mistakes frequently.  Just avoid

Very bad professor. She has no patience with students and she is very rude to them. She lives by the textbook and goes so quickly through problems that she doesn't take the time to explain anything, and she'll get annoyed when you try to ask her questions. LOTS OF HOMEWORK. If you have the choice, gamble with any other professor instead of her.
Will not let students leave to use restroom during class, calls out students during class time. Treats students like high school students, not as fellow adults.
She is the BEST!!! If you want an easy A & walk out the class knowing what to do, this is the professor!! She's very awesome!! Highly recommend her!!

She is very clear. Explains every thing and if you don't understand she explain it again. Class is easy to follow if you don't miss a single class. In addition you have my math lab which is helpful and have a lot of tutorial videos on each section. Take her. She is strict but very good professor.
She is extremely clear & very detailed with the procedures. She is always willing to help & so patient. But is very strict with cellphones.
A really kind and understanding professor. Easy to pass, not too many papers.
She is so incredibly understanding and sweet. Genuinely wants you to learn and understand the material and isn't harsh at grading. I would recommend her to anybody who is taking WRS 105.
Overwhelmed most of the time and a bit superficial. Means well but is trying to hide her lack of knowledge of science writing. She should teach something else, or not at all.

Literally the sweetest professor you will ever have. The way she formats her assignments creates so many opportunities for you to earn credit if you put in the work and stay on top of your papers you'll def get an easy A. She also gives ample class time to work on assignments though there was quite a bit of reading assigned. Highly recommend

she is an amazing professor, with every assignment she allows for corrections for a new grade, assignments are graded heavily on effort put into steps along the way as opposed to the whole grade depending on the final assignment, no tests just papers

This professor is absolutely amazing. She's very caring and gives you more time if you need it. The papers you write are interesting because you get to choose your topics for the most part. You will learn a lot on how to write better and she gives good feedback on your papers. You do write a lot of them, but you get lots of time.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Adina was my favorite professor this semester by far. She really cares about her students and is very understanding. The assignments we had were meaningful and helpful. I never felt like anything I was working on didn't have a purpose. There was great variety in the class format and I was always excited to come to class.

Professor Sanchez-Garcia is a true gem! She's a wonderful professor and she definitely helped improve my writing over the semester. She cares a lot about her students and works really hard to make the class as fun and entertaining as possible, even for the STEM students that dislike English. Super sweet and hoping to have a class with her again!

Get ready to read and write a lot. had to take this class -mandatory for BGS. Unfortunately requested an IC. I had missed couple of assignments -she reached out to me , no way I could catch up. Explained the situation and granted an IC. I remember the days when IC's were not granted. How things have changed. I would take a class from her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Participate in the class discussions it will matter , the professor is very sweet and understanding . Its an easy class if you keep up with the class work , I highly suggest getting the textbook . The professor is always available if you have any questions. Overall a great class to take and not hard at all

The worse had a summer class with her with 4 other people and yet she always told me she couldn't give me feedback because she was so busy. She graded differently depending on the student. She's a joke and if you're going to teach a class on how to write paper and you can't give feedback then you're just useless.

This class involves 3 papers so yes it is a lot of writing, but professor Sanchez-Garcia gives such great feedback on your work, grades fairly and offers opportunities to make any adjustments for a better grade. She is so nice and helpful. You will definitely see a positive difference in your writing after taking the course!
This class has a lot of assignments that include reading and writing. The professor gives excellent feedback, and she does so often. I learned a lot from this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Adina is the best professor I have had at UM so far. She is the most like my high school teachers and so sweet and kind. There are a few papers but the prompts are very interesting and not as boring as high school at all. She is very interactive, class is fun, not a lot of homework besides working on your projects. Take this class!!! She's the best
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: While there were a lot of papers with a smaller timeline than most semesters (thanks Irma), the coursework was relevant to the interests of each individual student. Adina cares about all of her students and tries to make the subject interesting, regardless of a student's major. She's also approachable and remembers students from previous semesters.

Adina truly cares about you if you care about the class. She encourages you to improve your writing skills and will grade fairly. The blog posts we wrote were one of my favorite activities that semester because of the creative expression that was allowed. It really helped me destress. Also the papers we wrote were interesting and major-related.

I took her class that was specifically for STEM majors. Adina is an amazing professor and really cares about her students. Assignments are a little vague, but that is only because she lets students do them based on what they are interested in. Always lets you revise papers and blogs for a better grade. No reason not to get an A. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: She gives you way more work than any other Eng107 teacher for engineers. The final is a long research paper that will suck up most of your time while you work on the assignments that build up to it throughout the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: I found Adina to be extremely helpful, great with feedback and she will give you any assistance at anytime. You can expect to get back what you put into the course. While is a tough grader, she is fair and again, if you need help, just ask, she responds!
Extremely difficult in comparison with other eng230 teachers. Avoid if you dont like busy work

Professor Sanchez-Garcia is one of the nicest teachers.  Even though I found her ENG230 class relatively easy, I found it to be super useful, especially when we were working with resumes.  It's important to participate in class, and she gives everyone plenty of opportunities to do so.  What you put into the class is what you get out of it!
Adina is a great teacher! She is not an easy grader, but she is helpful and makes you enjoy English class.

awesome teacher! i wasn't into the whole sci-fi thing prior to this class, but she made it really interesting. encourages students to think outside the box on assignments and is extremely helpful and caring about students. TAKE THIS CLASS!!!
Assigments are not clear !!! take very little effort in making things clear.
Her assignments are somewhat vague but I guess its the nature of science fiction texts. She is a fair grader and extremely helpful during office hours. She is also a hot mom for her age too lol
not helpful at all :(
she is one of the best teachers at UM! you do stuff in class that actually helps you in the future. she is really nice and clear about what she expects. def recommend! pretty too
Very nice! Not an easy grader and takes forever to return grades; however, she cares for her students a lot. I would recommend her!

She rambles on and on and on and does not listen to a word that the students say... it feels like classroom participation is impossible. I cannot take this class seriously and I really dont like it...
Really good teacher who helps out students alot, Very fair grader, as long as you turn up and do the necessary work (which is a lot) you will get a A or A-

you will always be doing an assignment, just do it, and follow directions. you will get an A. very very fair grader. and information learned in this class will be useful in the future. i got an A and did everything the day before any assignment was due, even the 10-15pg single spaces FINAL!
Assignments sound hard but she gives out A's like it's her job.
BAD Teacher! nobody understands her...very confusing, the final project is the worst project EVER! don't take her, did not learn a thing!
Really recommend taking this class. She is very nice and the class is interesting, you actually learn. It is very easy also.

Never hated an English class until this one.  Usually learn better from classroom interaction with other students but don't expect that in this class.  She constantly rambles and throroughly enjoys hearing herself talk.  English should not be a lecture class.  Do not take this unless you want to sit and be fed the "correct" info by her standards.

I am a senior and I have to say I took her as a freshman and is my favorite teacher to this day! I took her for both 105 and 106. I wasn't even interested in the topic for 106 but I just took it because I loved her. The sweetest lady in the world -- doesn't even belong at UM because she is too nice!

Adina is one of the best professors that I have had at the University!  I highly recommend that you take this class.  She is extremely nice and helpful!  There is one major business project at the end of the class, but it is fun.  The work in this class is very useful for business students.  I enjoyed this class, and I normally hate English!

Very sweet. Will help you out no matter what. Even if you're worng she'll tell you you're right. Pretty easy grader, will work with you to make it better. Just a sweetheart. Pretty easy. English is my least favorite subject and I managed really well. Talks a lot but is a complete sweetheart. Easy. Take her.

Absolultely lovely.  She's very sweet, and very open-minded.  What's fantastic about her is that her only agenda is to make sure your skills improve.  She's not the kind of professor who wants you to jump through hoops for the hell of it.  She tries to make each student's experience as personalized as possible.  Definitely take her.  She's amazing.
She's great!! and nice and makes really good coffee!

Took english with her freshman year and from what I can remember she was super nice, responsive to emails, willing to meet with students, and one time even busted out laughing in the middle of class for no apparent reason. I would love to take another class with her if I got the chance.

Very nice professor. She is very clear in her assignments and expectations.  the "big" project is not a lot of work if you actually follow her suggested method of completing the project. class discussions help pass the time.  must do one short presentation.
No Comments
She is super nice! I Liked her class alot.

Very nice teacher and a fun class. The discussions were almost always interesting, and she tried to keep them balanced and open.  To some, the grades are a blessing and others a curse, it all depends on your work style.
NO WORK IS GRADED UNTIL THE END OF THE SEMESTER!!!  Read that again. However, she is a very tough grader. I rate her a C+
very sweet understanding woman. good class,  helps your writing skills, not a LOT of work and she's lenient, no work is graded until the end of the semester. fun.
Professor Agatemor strived to make sure his students did well. He was very clear about what would be on tests and was very understanding about late work.

I have genuinely never had a better professor. He is the best in the chemistry department. He is the only professor that reviews for the exams the entire week. He genuinely wants his students to succeed and will do whatever it takes for them to pass. If you participate, go to office hours, and actually try he will give you extra credit.

You're going to have to study orgo on your own; that's just the deal with a subject that has this much content and requires this much practice. That being said, Dr. Agatemor did everything that a person could do to make the time spent outside of class easier: He's the boy. If I had to enroll in 221 again, I would add his course to my cart twice.

the BEST chem professor at UM. so helpful outside of class, just go to his office hours and be respectful in class he WILL help you pass the course. he is so kind and unlike the others does not want to see you fail
Professor Agatemor was certainly one of my best professors at UM. He prepares you for success and was always available to help.
