Challenging class with a difficult professor. Could be very condescending and mean to students at times and would be very unclear with his class materials.

Dr. Agatemor is a kind and helpful professor. He emphasized the importance of a calm headspace and was reassuring. His teaching methods were effective in teaching the material and reading the textbook is super helpful. The exams were partially made by Dr. Knecht making the questions difficult and different from his style of teaching but doable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Orgo is a very difficult subject but Agatemor was a great professor who does everything in his power to make the material as clear and understanding as possible. He is also very caring and helps his students do the best they can. My semester was a little harder because him and knecht didnt agree on most things test wise other than that great prof.

Organic Chemistry is a hard course no matter what. Dr. Agatemor was nice and understanding and cared about his student's success. By providing lots of reviews and practice problems he appropriately prepared students. He was available every day during office hours to answer any questions. He did not make exams my sem so that made it harder.

Great teacher. Professor Agatemor spent a good amount of time on each topic, doing many practice problems in class to reinforce the concepts we learned that week. He encourages participation from everyone. Organic chemistry is difficult, but he prepares you well. Do plenty of practice problems (he posts them for each module) and you will succeed.

Prof. Agatemor is a great professor and person overall! This class is undeniably hard. However, Prof. Agatemor seems to care about his students and wants them to succeed so definitely take advantage of his office hours!!  I would definitely take orgo 1 with him again!

This is a very difficult course, but he made it as understandable as he could. Always used examples in class. Made it so that homework would not be stressful and never pulled surprises on exams. Almost everything on the exams was taught in class which is very rare with these stem courses.

The HW is easy, which is nice but also bad because it doesn't prepare you for the exams. He tries really hard in his lectures and hands out cheat sheets, but the textbook is your best friend. Half the content you will probably need to teach yourself, even though he discourages going to outside help. Go to workshops and tutoring if you want an A!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Nice guy, he honestly wants us tom do well. Orgo is hard obvi but if you put in work there is no reason to fail. Exams are not just made by him so it depends who else is teaching it. Do old exams and you will be fine
Reminds me of Jimmy Butler the way he always believes till the end. Easy grader like DWade in the dunk contest.

Prof Agatemor truly cared about his student's success. He answers emails super fast and is willing to meet with you outside the classroom. I think he is a relatively more forgiving grader on exams compared to the other orgo teachers. He does review sessions before the exams and is very clear on what the exam materials are.

Professor Agatemor was easily one of my favorite professors Ive had at UM. TAKE HIM. Come to class as much as you can and try to teach yourself the material/do the homework for that chapter before class and you will understand everything he is teaching. meet with him after class, FIGHT FOR TEST POINTS, if you show you understand he may help you!

AGATEMOR IS KING
LOVE THIS MAN

Lectures are straight to the point. No beating around the bush, he tells you what you need to know.

Good professor to take organic chemistry with.Lectures every class, which are helpful, but the lecture on its own is not enough to do well on the tests. recommend reading the chapter. He does one or two review sessions before each exam which are super helpful- dont miss them. He also sends out study guides. Overall, he is a good professor.
He is nice and very supportive.

I took CHM 221 and failed before taking the course with Dr Agatemor. Dr Agatemor cares about our success in the course. He make sure we understand the basic concepts and vigorously prepare us for the exams. I strongly suggest you take his class if you want to do well in organic chemistry. Above all, he is accessible after class to help.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He makes sure we understand
He was very supportive outside class.
Great Professor

I had him for CHM110 and the class is so easy but his test is sometimes on stuff he didnt show us and he explains things in a complicated way for no reason and he has no mercy with iclicker he gave me like a 60% cuz my ipad glitched but i got a 100 on everything else cuz its so easy. He is really nice tho but still.

Professor Agatemor rlly does care about his students and their performance. The key thing in this class (and im sad that i didnt realize this earlier after one failed test) is to pay attention to the examples he does in class. He will make things make sense if you give him the chance. But organic chem is not easy so def expect to put in some work

He is a very nice professor who explains the topics very well. Gives a lot of examples before exams which helps in tests. Organic Chemistry is a challenging course in general. He makes it easy as long as you do your part of studying. Take him over other professors.

Christian is a nice guy but he has an expectation that every student will know exactly what he is talking about all the time and he gets upset when the class is confused, claiming that what he is saying is "simple". He is completely unforgiving when it comes to extensions and can be condescending when meeting one on one.
This professor is listed as an instructor for MIC301 but had no instructional time as one of the instructors, so I have nothing specific to say about them.

Nice guy but quizzes and tests are absurd. Open note, but he asks you to match about 20 terms/attributes with a handful of parasites. Grading unclear and puts nothing in Blackboard so you don't really know how you're doing in the class.

Honestly this class is not difficult, he has take home quizzes/tests and is a very nice professor. Actually, I really learned things in his class and not forcing you to take tests within a framed period makes you actually want to learn the material. Also, if online, try and participate a bit, he loves hearing from students

Parasitology is one of the easiest classes in the Microbiology Major and it is simply one of the most rewarding. Dr. Ager makes it extremely easy to make an A (x>80%). All of the exams are open notes and open computer, so as long as you know how to utilize your resources to the fullest, you will be absolutely fine and truly pass with flying colors!
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This CLASS IS IMPOSSIBLE. His exams are nothing like previous years. There are 2 exams a midterm and a final that are extremely difficult. His lectures do not help nor does his slides. DO NOT take this class, I found it harder than organic chemistry with collonna.

Your grade consists of 2 midterms, a final, and quizzes all worth 25% each. You get to drop 2 quiz grades. His midterms and final are take home BUT they are extremely difficult and take a long time. Typically an 85 average is an A, but it depends on the class average. You don't know what you have in the class until the end and then you are happy.

Depends on who you ask, I believe this was an easy class... you do not have to spend too much time on his midterms, however his quiz might take a few hours to get done. Amazing professor, one of the best at UM.

Ager loves parasitology, and does a good job with this class. He's a good lecturer and a nice guy. All assignments are take-home, which means that there's a lot of work but no studying.  If you're willing to put in the work, this is a fun MIC class to take.
He really knows his stuff, and loves to give useful info beyond the scope of the class.
He is the best

He's a very sweet old man who knows his field (Parasitology). The tests are very difficult and requires your notes to be extremely organized in order to get a good grade. He grades on a curve after the semester and there is a quiz every Monday and the final is not cumulative. Everything is open notes/book & some people even use their computers.

What an excellent class! He is an excellent teacher. His lectures are always interesting especially when he incorporates stories and traveling tips. His tests and quizzes are hard, but they are open book/open notes. Very nice person. This is probably my favorite MIC class.
No Comments
Open book, open notes how much more could you ask for?
Really strange teaching skills- you leave that class not knowing what the heck was taught!

actually a microbio major class. lectures make no sense. questions pulled out from God-knows where. tests are very hard and expect 60 percents even if you're a good student. not a class that you can logically study for.

Dr. Agrios was not prepared to teach here, he doesn't seem to know how to handle this large of a class since he used to teach at a different school. His lectures are very difficult to follow as well. On top of that, he's an extremely slow grader. He's a caring person but just isn't a great professor in my opinion.

His lectures style suck, so if you take him you're going to have to teach yourself the entire course. He also lied about what would be on our exams, and fell behind in teaching content that the other professor had taught and showed his own students, which then that material would be presented on our joint exams :) DON'T take him if possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Agrios is my favorite professor. He gives amazing lectures and is always there to help at office hours!
He is the best professor I have ever had. He makes a difficult topic easy to understand. He is super caring and accessible outside of class.

(CHM 222) Dr. Agrios is super slow in lecture and expects you to learn material on your own when the tests approach. The exams are departmentalized so I won't blame him for their difficulty, but I think he could have done better at preparing us for the exams. He also does not respond to emails. Single-handedly tanked my GPA.

Do not take this professor. He has no idea how to line up the lectures with the exams. He was so rude to me when I went to his office hours. The chemistry department needs to reconsider his position because it is just not working. Don't even try to email him he won't answer.
Ruined my gpa. Dont do it. Every other orgo 1 prof is better, i have never seen averages so low before

Agrios can be difficult to follow in lecture but if you read the book ahead of time and do all the practice problems as he recommends you can do well. He is typically behind on lectures but is very helpful during office hours
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Agrios is an extremely nice person but it is impossible to do well in his class. Some of his exam questions are barely mentioned in class and the structure of his exam makes it nearly impossible to succeed. He overwhelms the student with 9 options for multiple choice questions and the smallest of details will make or break you.Dont take

Was in CSC542 but not listed here. Prof Aguiar gives a reasonable amount of work and is fair in her grading criteria. She is always available after class, and is very approachable, friendly and helpful. The lectures were interesting and informative. I highly recommend taking her CSC classes if you get the chance.
Her lecture was fine, even sometimes interesting, but the grading is really a mess

I really liked professor Aguiar. This class has lots of work: a midterm and a final, 5 quizzes, 3 assignments, and a big project divided into 3 parts. However, she gave us many opportunities for extra credit to improve our grades. Not the easiest class but you will definitely learn something. I recommend reading the book.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This is my second class with professor Aguiar. She is very kind and willing to help students will anything. She is very open for office hours. One of the best teachers in the department. Class topics are hard but she makes it understandable.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Intro to Software Engineering with Dr. Aguiar-Pulido! The class grade was largely group project/presentation based, with lots of revision opportunities available to improve your work/grade. Additionally we got to provide peer feedback on projects as a class, which was actually really cool. I really enjoyed it! Would take again!

Class was ridiculously hard. Her teaching style is not effective and leaves many (if not all) students confused about the material. She's a little hard to understand, but doesn't make up for the fact that she seems confused at times too. Super tough grader with poor feedback. I wouldn't recommend her to anyone! Just not worth it... very stuck up
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class was an absolute mess. We had 4 quizzes, 4 assignments, a midterm, a non-cumulative final, and a project that counted for 35% of our grade which was completely unnecessary. The lectures, feedback about work, and due dates were never clear whatsoever. I would not recommend taking this prof at all! Wait another semester for a different prof
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Aguirre is one of the best professors I've taken at UM. He is hilarious, funny as well as helpful. He is even accessible after class and is understanding. The work was mainly done in class so no need to complete homework. Overall, great class and you will learn a lot.

Carlos is an amazing professor. He really makes the class interesting and shows you how typography can be used in ways you might not have originally thought. He won't grade you based on his personal opinions of your work but on the piece itself. He's very flexible and understanding. He's extremely talented and one of my all-time favorite professors

You forget Carlos is a professor because he acts more like a friend who just happens to be giving you assignments! He makes the class fun and incorporates great field trips. If you take any of his courses at UM, you won't be disappointed. You will learn and still have fun.
Every class Carlos teaches is fantastic. Honestly the nicest, most helpful, and caring individual in the art department. If you have the option, take any of his classes. Carlos is the man.
He is a very intelligent professor who has had experience in the field. He is open-minded and very approachable.
I love Carlos. Very patient and friendly and knowledgeable. He taught me more than any other professor I've had.
Have to read before the class. Very little teaching, more focused on class interaction.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The discussion structure of the class makes it so great to learn and she is a great professor. Read the chapters before class, know what you're reading, take notes, and be ready to discuss in class. She really wants her students to learn and has changed the way I think about marketing.

Love Amy. Very personable and outgoing. No quizzes OR tests, just a lot of creative projects throughout the semester. Pick a good group bc 2 of the big ones are group projects. A little on the harsher side of grading. Brings in guest speakers and frequently gives time to work on projects in class or ends early. Would take again.

Okay here's the thing. Let's start with the +. Amy is a great person and has great energy which I respect. She will make you create your own website and your own brand proposal which are helpful if you want to build something in the future. However, she will give you a bad grade with minimal feedback & she doesn't really guide the projects.

You read before class then come in and participate. She doesn't like the use of technology in the classroom and expects you to do the readings beforehand, where you then discuss the chapter in class. No homework but exams are important.

her class is taught in the way where you teach yourself the material and discuss it during class time. every chapter from the textbook is almost 30 pages long which she expects you to read in a day. apart from this the class discussions where good but her tests are hard and you really have to engage to retain the info. only ipads allowed in class

Excellent conversationalist with Harkness-style classes, but overshadowed by a large reading workload and memorization of hundreds of vocabulary terms. Class lectures are supplemental to your own learning, as you are expected to teach yourself. Project grades were hit or miss for groups, but ample time was given to work on them.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She is a very nice professor and gets to know each students. However, you teach yourself the material from the textbook since she does not lecture the material. Study vocab terms and case studies to do well on the exams. There are three exams and one group project broken up into an essay and presentation.

Makes you read the textbook, but does not actually teach. must read every word and does not say what will be on the exams. Tells you to refer to syllabus if you have a question. very little instruction and grades harshly.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: One of the nicest professors at the school, class is basically learning on your own from the textbook, though you don't really need it. three exams and one group project

I once had to ask her a question about grading and she has no clue how she graded it, I swear she probably just uses chat bc it was absolutely nonsensical. Didn't show up to meetings, ghosted me, cancelled classes and then made the material from them the majority of the exams. Exams qs there to trick, 2 good answers but 1 better. avoid at all costs
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easy class. She assigns dense chapter readings before every class, which lead her lectures/group conversations, but you don't learn much. I think I only read 2 chapters from the textbook and still did well on the exams. All you need to do for them is memorize the vocab and read the case studies, and you'll be fine. 2 easy group projects as well
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: It's a marketing class so it's easy but she doesn't grade on how well you do something or if you have an actual good idea but only by how many sparkles and cool animations you have in your power point. Kind of frustrating when you have the best idea and good substance on the presentation but it doesn't look as nice.
BEST professor at UM! MKT 385 was my favorite class. Super east and learned actual useful advice for life. Also did projects that will help in job interviews.

I totally recommend taking this class. You should come to class ready and read the chapter assigned. All the exams are vocab and major concepts. There are only three exams and a group project and presentation.

She does not lecture and instead you simply talk with her guidance, except what we discuss has absolutely nothing to do with the actual exam. Additionally, the grading criteria for exams and group projects is incredibly vague and she takes off seemingly random points everywhere. SUPER INACCESSIBLE. Doesn't seem to want to do her job. Nobody has A.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: THE GOAT. She purposely has vague grading criteria to prepare you for the real world. If you show you care she will give you very good feedback in a private setting so stay after to have her look over something before its due! Low ratings she gets from 201 aren't accurately showing her, she'll put you through the ringer but its so worth it imo

I absolutely love Professor Agramonte. She is so kind and funny, and really gets to know all the students in the class. The content is based on the textbook, which makes exams mostly memorization based which gets difficult, but still I would 100% recommend professor Agramonte. 3 exams and a group project that everyone foes well on. Love her!!
not clear, you don't learn anything, and i don't know anyone who got an A

Expect a lot of reading. Textbook chapter assigned every class. Classes are group discussions of each chapter which Professor Agramonte makes very enjoyable, and participation is part of your final grade. 3 tests (based on assigned chapters and case studies) and 2 group projects. Study and have a good understanding to get A's on the tests.

She's good and fun, but her class format is to read dense textbook chapters every night before class and discuss them, and for participation she expects students to write notes on the board about what they read. She makes for a good facilitator of discussion, but I can't say I learned much about marketing or its principles from her lecturing.

Nothing is clear in the course weather its the grading the tests or the structure of class everyday. There are no study guides, practice questions so the first time seeing what a test question looks like is in the first test. In order to be successful you need to study every term from the chapters from that unit and get above a 90 on every test.
Find any other marketing teacher. Tests are very hard and there is no curve.

Her difficulty rating is dangerously inaccurate; her class is VERY hard. You rarely go over what's actually going to be one the test in class, and half the time test questions cover something completely random from the book. 

Get ready to study over a week for tests; and there will not be a curve. Find another teacher if you want a decent grade.
You will get a much better grade with other professors. She doesn't curve. Tests make no sense. You don't learn a single thing the entire class

She is the most un-organized professor, the rubrics she gives for the projects and papers are complicated and vague and will often leave you extremely confused. The class set up is based on the textbook chapter you had to read the night before (30-50 pages) and focuses only on 3-5 questions/topics that WON'T be on the exam. Avoid if possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Extremely nice and respected, insanely successful too so this is just her side job. Shes a great recourse if you are trying to break into marketing. That being said her exams are very hard and justlike the textbook. I would read the textbook before everyclass as annoyign as it sounds it will help you do great in the class.

Amy is a great person, just not the best teacher. Discussions in class were great but none of that helped during her exams. Multiple-choice questions also had syntax/grammatical issues and were vague. Marketing in general is not an exact science, so you have to follow what the book says so recommend following it closely. In general, avoid.
Classes were engaging. HOWEVER, exams were not easy and class lectures were barely helpful when it came to exams. tough grader on final project.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This professor is amazing! She is engaging and very easy to connect with. I actually looked forward to her class. You have to do a lot of reading, because this is a discussion-based class where you talk about the material you read during the class. Other than that, not too much work. There is a big group project, but it's nothing bad. Great class!

Can't say enough good things about Amy. Knowledgeable, funny, interesting... but you don't learn a ton of marketing in her class. Although you'll go on a million tangents, if you put your head down and work a little on the days it counts, you'll get an easy (and fun) A. That said, if you wanna learn marketing... try elsewhere.

This class isn't too hard, she will tell you the mc questions on tests aren't just straight vocab but they are.  You are supposed to read the textbook before class but really you don't have to, just study the vocab and cases for exams, Prof Agramonte is super nice though and very accommodating, best marketing teacher imo

Amy is amazing!! Everyone should take her. You learn so much in her class and are actually able to apply the knowledge to the real world! No exams and 2 group projects. Attendance is mandatory but class is fun! Please take her, def the best marketing professor at UM!!!

Took this prof because of the great reviews here. Do not be fooled. You will not learn anything in class, and the tests are needlessly difficult. No guided review sessions, study guides, or anything to prepare. The classes themselves are jokes and completely unhelpful. Do not take if you want to learn and do well.

Professor Agramonte is my favorite professor at UM. She takes the time to get to know each student and for each student to know one another. She is very knowledgeable and has her own business, so is able to bring real world examples into the class. Best class at UM by far and even better professor.

She is the best! There are no exams in this course and as long as you go to class, participate, and try hard on the group and personal projects, you will succeed in this course. She brings in guest speakers and tries to make the class interesting. Projects can take a lot of time but they are fun and not very difficult. Would definitely recommend!

Prof. Agramonte has some amazing stories to tell, and could always find examples to connect with class discussion. I took the Harkness style of MKT 201, and really enjoyed class. However, there was a fair amount of reading required in order to do well on exams and be prepared for class. She is a fair grader, but doesn't give 100s.

Agramonte is such a joy to have as a professor. There are no exams, just group projects and branding projects (ex: personal website) and she is happy to give feedback along the way. All assignments are very manageable. I have never had a prof who cares about students as much as she does. If you need a MKT elective I highly recommend this class.

Probably the best professor I had in UM until now. Professor Agramonte is caring and very knowledgeable. This is a discussion-based class based on textbook's readings. There are tons of quizlets about her exams online, so tests shouldn't be a problem. Participation is worth 20% of the grade, so ask some questions in class and you should be fine.
chill teacher with a kind heart, grading can be kinda random but with demonstrated effort youre guaranteed a good grade

She's very successful and enjoy making her students feel engage and welcoming to class. Majority of the content that would be graded on would be from the book, which is barely discussed in class. Much more discussion-based class but a great portion of self-learning through the textbook readings. Hard to score 100 in anything harsh grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: I love Professor Agramonte. She is a queen. One of the most successful professors I have had yet. Seems like such a wonderful woman and is passionate about what she teaches. Tests are kind of arbitrary, though.

I did not like her at all. She made us clap for her whenever she announced that she doesn't give out exams, which was almost every class. She acted like if she was the queen or something, very annoying. Also, she never gives 100% on work. The class was very easy, but took so many points off for little mistakes.

By far the best professor I have ever had during my time at UM. Prof. A actually cares about her students and wants you to succeed not just in her class, but in the future too. She is a master in marketing hence why she has had such a successful career. She made going to an 8 AM exciting and motivational supplemented by cohesive lectures.THANK YOU!

Professor Agratamonte is so nice and so caring! Her lectures are not boring, class material is really cool but she wont give you 100% despite not having any criticism. Other than that pretty easy class if you get good group partners. Easy A. Some projects are kinda long and tedious but fun at the same time if you like digital marketing. Take her!!
Very kind and personable, you can really tell she loves teaching and I loved the class. Definitely take her if you can.

Professor Agramonte is really nice and her lectures arent bad. There are no exams, just a couple group and individual projects. You do have to put in the work for good grades in her class. Overall I recommend.

takes attendance for more than half the class, lectures are very general, could be better spent learning how to make a website - only cares about fluff even if your ideas or content aren't feasible, so just add anything and you'll get an A, did not learn a singular thing in this class, has potential but the curriculum is lacking

Professor Agramonte is a gem. One of the few teachers who doesn't care that they are there to be paid and actually cares about her students. She is one of the best professors you can ask for. No tests, but projects aren't a walk in the park, and you will still need to dedicate a significant amount of time and effort. Very well worth it. 10/10

Sometimes the number of points she takes off makes no sense. You may get no negative feedback on a project and then you might lose .51 of 1 point, so you'll end up with something like an 89.49/90. That being said she's very accessible and wants you to do well. Take the assignments seriously and it's an easy A. Would absolutely take her again.

This was by far maybe the most annoying professor i've ever had. She will never give 100 percent on anything. She will give no bad criticism but some how take off 5-10 points after she says you did perfect. I passed but still strived for perfection but never reached mastery.

Best Professor at UM she is so kind, caring, and understandable. She wants her students to do well in her class and it shows she's so knowledgeable and uses real world examples which makes class interesting. We did a semester long group project and she made it super fun & not stressful glad I took this class with professor Agramonte!
Amy is the best! She's so nice and knowledgeable about marketing. One group project is essentially your whole grade. She helps every group out and gives good advice. Cannot recommend enough.

Prof. Agramonte is super sweet & understanding. I have really enjoyed having her this semester. I do wish though that more of our classes were led by her instead of being led by the students (due to the harkness method). I felt as if we were teaching ourselves mostly out of the textbook, but every time she did chime in, it was always interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: I love her! She is a great professor that is extremely caring for her students. Her class is very easy and fun. Take her! You won't regret it!
She's a very nice lady and her class is about average in terms of difficulty

Amy is sooo chill. She really wants everyone to do well and if you pay attention in class, you will do well. She loves when people are outspoken and she bases a lot of her lectures off of real-world marketing examples. Make sure you go to class because she takes attendance.

Professor Agramonte is the best! Some of the best lectures ever. Keeps class engaged and relates textbook material to real life marketing concepts. Really awesome professor that anyone taking MKT 201 should take. 3 exams, 2 papers, 1 presentation and no final. Had a blast in her class. Really good choice for any Marketing class.

Professor Agramonte is a breath of fresh air for my UOnline program. She gives incredible feedback, is extremely caring, and clearly wants her students to learn and succeed. The discussions and projects have been interesting and relevant. Would love to have her again!
Take this professor NOW
Solid teacher within the marketing dept. Would take again.

Although Professor Agramonte was nice and she definitely has experience in the marketing field, her class was entirely lecture based with powerpoints straight out from the textbook company.  She grades the case studies very easily but her exams are difficult because she words the questions poorly, know all the terms in the book for all the tests.

Prof. Amy is amazing! She is super enthusiastic about teaching and I really enjoyed her class. Instead of the usual final project, we had the opportunity to work on a real life marketing problem and present it to a 'client' which made the project much more interesting and fun.  Take Prof. Amy's class, you won't regret it!

I truly loved this course and how passionate Dr. Ashu was about the topics. I also loved he incorporated the current events of the coronavirus into the class, and how the industry is reacting to it. Group projects on COVID-19 on a chip for different tissues was a good distraction during the lockdown.

This class is amazing and Dr. Agarwal is an incredible professor. The homework enforces the concepts taught in class and the exams build your critical thinking skills. The only complaint I have is that the powerpoints he uses to teach are picture heavy, and make it hard to review off if you don't write down every word he says in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Ashu made this class extremely interesting and I thoroughly enjoyed coming to each lecture, even for 8AM class!   The  lectures, article presentations, and project designs allowed the class to be very involved and it was great to be able to have such a collaborative and thought provoking course

Lectures are super interesting and current. No textbook, just crazy long powerpoints posted on blackboard. Weekly homeworks are long and force you to use critical thinking skills to apply the material. Tests are similar to homework. My class chose to do 2 exams (no final) &  a final group presentation about a topic from class. Loved this class!

Ashu makes class a lot more interesting by focusing on recent technologies. Tests ask you to think beyond just memorizing, but if you have a good grasp of the material (which isn't difficult if you have attended class), you should be fine. Do not walk in late with a coffee, but also do not yawn because he will tell you to go get a coffee.

My favorite class I've taken thus far - he's an incredibly intelligent guy and makes the class very interesting as he sticks with current trends in the field.  Expects a lot of critical thinking, but isn't hard if you genuinely care about the material you're learning.
Best class offered within the BME department

He truly wants his students to succeed, but expects you to put a great amount of effort into your work. Assignments and exams require critical thinking rather than simply regurgitating information. He gives great feedback on all classwork and the final project. I've learned more in this class than I have in any other engineering class thus far.

Dr. Agarwal is perhaps the rudest, most condescending professor I have ever had. If his first impression of you is BAD, you're basically screwed for the rest of the semester. EXTREMELY rude, and will go out of his way to embarrass you I front of your peers. Very unprofessional, and will give you false information if he does not like you. BEWARE

Her class is pretty easy. It's mostly literature, but there is some grammar. The homework is pretty easy, and if you turn it in late, she doesn't take points off. The tests aren't that hard, and you don't have to study much. She's really nice and tries to keep class interesting!

This professor was amazing. She is so nice and extremely helpful. She truly cares about her students and will give you every opportunity to succeed. There was a TON of homework, but she lets you turn it in late and won't dock any points. DO YOUR HOMEWORK and you will pass, guaranteed!
Awesome

Fantastic teacher.  Explains things very well and provides a ton of places to practice every topic.  Very understanding and fair grader (if you forget to turn in a paper on the due date, she'll give you a day to turn it in without losing points) and, most importantly, keeps class interesting and fun.  I highly recommend her!

Great professor who's passionate about the subject he teaches. If you just do all the things needed, you can get an A because he's not a harsh grader as long as you do what he asks and work on your mistakes.

Great professor who works with you and cares about the students. Engage in class, do the readings, and don't completely bs the assignments and it's an A. Try not to be late because sometimes the quizzes start exactly at the beginning of class. Just do your work and he'll do his part. assignments and timing can get a little complicated at the end
Dr.Hatrick was a great professor. His grading system was incredibly fair. There were a few reading quizzes, but nothing that was too difficult. Strongly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Under the circumstances of my class, Professor Hatrick did a great job of catching up and teaching us the class using another instructor's materials. I thought it was handled well, and I enjoyed taking his class. It was super chill and at times, fun!

Amazing professor, great guy. Easy class too. Your grade is mainly made up of 3 papers, all of which he gives direct feedback on during conferences. If you follow that feedback, you'll almost certainly get an A. Papers are 10 pages max. Gave a few short and easy reading quizzes. Class discussions were very fun, interesting, and engaging as well.

Dr. Hatrick is such a great professor—my whole class loved him! He's an easy grader and all you have to do is correct the notes he makes for you on your conference drafts of the essays and you'll easily get an A in his class. He's funny and the lectures are engaging. I always looked forward to this class!

Not sure why people are being rude, i thought he did an amazing job ( considering our particular class has some weird circumstances). Overall a great guy and easy to succeed if you do the BARE MINIMUM>

He took over for my old teacher for WRS 107 and was terrible. Made zero sense and every class there wasn't an agenda or anything to do but we HAD to show up and sit there listening to him, it was terrible. 107 itself is an annoying class as well so we had a lot of assignments to do and with him it was so much worse
Dr. Hatrick is an amazing professor. He is very kind and his class is not difficult. Everything is well organized and clear. I definitely recommend taking him.

he's on the shyer side but he is a nice guy who wants the best for his students. super accessible outside of class and I had some personal issues and he always worked with me instead of against me. class is very straightforward and generally easy. just a lot of writing but as to be expected.

Honestly, Dr. Hatrick was a good professor. Not a hard class at all. He sometimes takes class very seriously and gets offended quickly. Otherwise, he is a nice guy. 4 papers throughout the semester, some easy four question quizzes as well based on readings. I would take this class again, easy course.

I really liked Dr. Hatrick! Good professor even though the class material didn't really teach me anything new. He was super nice and understanding with assignments. Gives readings at least once a week and quizzes on them but nothing too serious. Grades on 4 essays, completion assignments, and quizzes. Takes class a bit too seriously though.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class genuinely felt useless. It wasn't difficult, just meaningless. His grading was not consistent either, and felt more biased than anything. He sometimes cares way too much about the class when it was just unnecessary to.
Dr. Hatrick is so sweet and truly cares about his students. He is an easy grader and if you do poorly he lets you revise your work.  I don't understand why he has so many negative reviews.

I don't understand why he has such bad reviews. I absolutely loved his class, his assignments were straightforward, the only HW we had was reading. We had to write 3 papers and he offers full support to ensure you get a good grade. He also cancels class for two-three days for workshops and offers detailed feedback during those days. Take him!

I believe Dr. Hatrick is a great professor. He clearly cares about what he does and his students, which you don't always get with professors. I believe his grading is incredibly fair and we only have 3 papers (2 were 3 page assignments, and the third was a three page paper branching off of one of the previous 2).
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He has awkward pauses during lectures (tism?) and he is unclear about what he wants us to do sometimes. A lot of confusion from students and most of his assignments are trial and error like he's figuring it out too which is unacceptable for how much I am paying to be here. Takes everything a little too seriously. Solid 6/10.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Hatrick was new to Miami this year, but overall, he is a really caring and solid professor. We had three papers total (2 that were 4-5 pg, 1 8-10) and small hw throughout. He responded to emails promptly and was generous with extensions. Don't listen to the other reviews, I swear class is not that difficult if you actually go and care at all.
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This guy might be the worst professor I've ever had. Everything about his class is a disaster. Take another professor and get an A. This class should not be as hard as he makes it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Hatrick is the worst professor. His classtime is uselss. His grading criteria is unclear and his feedback is unhelpful and not legible. Instead of learning which I was hoping to do in Dr. Hatricks class, he spends his time discouraging his students instead of trying to help them grow. Try and find a differnt 105 prof unless you want more stress
Awful professor
Worst feedback on every essay, writing is illegible, hardest 106 by far the worst assignments compared to other

Prof Hatrick is overall a decent professor and definitely isn't the hardest but his instructions are often somewhat unclear of what he wants from his essays. Additionally, he uses class time extremely poorly and it often feels like attendance should be optional because we don't really do anything useful in class. His grading scale is mostly fair.

Dr. Hatrick is fantastic! He cares about his students and is understanding. Three papers are written in total, for the last two you get to pick the topic. He offers extended office hours the week papers are due and gives detailed feedback. If you participate and ask for help when needed, you will succeed. Definitely recommend taking his class!
best prof at the U. definitely reccomned

seems to be one of the harder if not the hardest writing professors at the University. Instructions are not clear and the grades reflect that for the whole class. Very nice guy, just not clear with what he wants the class to do. Class time is not well used and sometimes feels like a waste of time.

Dr. Hatrick is one of my favorite instructors of all time. He is new to the university this semester, TAKE HIS COURSE ASAP to fill your writing credits! Lectures are engaging, and he is very charismatic. Plus, you spend 2/3 of the semester writing a topic of your choosing. Only 3 "big" (4/5 page) papers, and a few small assignments. He is the best!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Really nice & graded everything pretty fairly.  His lectures were very clear & easy to understand the concepts, but also boring. The subject is very repetitive though, which is why it may have been boring. He offered extra credit & writing assignments were easy. Very willing to meet outside of class & go over tests too. Overall good guy, meh class.

Professor Heller did an amazing job teaching this course and I would highly recommend his class and teaching to any student who asks. I am not a morning person but his course made me want to wake up at 8 am to learn all his class had to offer. There are 2 papers and 3 midterm exams that are very doable, it is important to understand all powerpoints

Dr. Heller made an 8AM class so fun. His whitty sense of humor and engaging lectures made class really entertaining. His exams can be a bit tricky but if you take good notes and study then you will be fine. He also offers extra credit which helps with your grade. He is a super understanding and caring professor who is passionate about this subject!

Never met a more accessible professor. Distilling the brain into language that non-neuroscience folks can understand is a true skill. He also incorporates artwork into his lectures, and is really knowledgeable about the pieces, making connections to the topic of the day. PLUS: the readings were fascinating. Thumbs up!
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He does not seem very passionate about his job. I bought the textbook (the old edition because the one he recommended was too expensive) but I never used it so that was a waste of money. I feel like he did not add too much to the lectures (all the power points were on blackboard). There was a chance of extra credit. Overall he is decent.

Professor Rozar is an exceptional teacher that will help many students learn the discipline of biology. He is not like the other entrenched lazy professors employed at Mt. SAC  His teaching style is fresh and it's easy to detect that he has a strong intention to effectively inculcate the students with the principles of biology.

Professor Rozar was probably one of the nicest professors I've ever had. He's extremely kind and understanding, but do be cautious of the incessant amount of group projects, as well as the hard work put into them to get a good grade, but overall a very rewarding course with a clear grading criteria. Attend, work hard, participate, and get an easy A
Nice guy. Great class
He is a cool guy. His class is layed back and his quizzes are easy.
Ron is a very easy and cool lab TA. He makes the class really easy, will edit lab reports for you, and in general, it is easy to get an A

This guy is the man! Very laid back person who doesnt have hard quizzes or tests. The only thing he is hard on is the lab reports, but there are only 2 and he doesn't make it worth that much. Extremely nice and smart guy.
Ron is the sweetest lab ta.  His lab is pretty easy and he just chills and lets you do whatever you want.
I LOVE the ponytail.  So hot.

I cannot hype this woman up enough I love her so much. She's THE BEST math professor. Her lectures were so informative but she has such a good personality that you actually wanted to learn math. She's a super fair grader and has so many office hours to help you, she wants you to succeed.

Best professor in the UM math department. Every single review here is accurate. If I could take all of my math courses with her I would. Lectures are fun and it makes you actually want to come to class. She's a generous grader. You must absolutely take her if you can.

I cannot hype this woman up enough. She is the best professor I have ever had. She has a good sense of humor which makes her lectures more fun while still teaching the material so well. She prepares you for all quizzes and exams, has great office hours, and wants you to succeed. If she hasn't retired yet, TAKE HER!!

Mrs. Agras was the sweetest teacher I think I've ever had. I swear she genuinely cares about her students and she's always in a great mood, which makes it easy to go to her class 4 days a week. She is great at simplifying things and is always there to help. Take her if she hasn't retired yet.
wonderful!
Nicest lady ever. Easy exams, small curves on each one too.
BEST TEACHER AT UM!!! She taught the material beautifully and made math interesting

Prof. Agras was a very nice woman. The class was perfectly explained and if you had questions or doubts, she was always available in her office. Do the Review Questions before the test and you will definitely get a good grade in the class.

Professor Agras was fantastic. She never overcomplicated anything, but at the same time she managed to teach calculus well and efficiently. Extremely nice woman! Tests are easier versions of the review guide. If you can do the entire review guide before each test, then you are very likely to get an A or A+ in this class. Very good experience

Agras is a great professor but I wouldn't categorize this class as an "Easy A". If you don't show up, you better should have taken Calc before because you probably won't do well. She gives fantastic lecture notes that are filled out during class and a fair amount of homework. Unfortunately, this was her last semester but she was a great professor!

Amazing Teacher!!! Not only does she make her lectures easy to understand, but she provides you with excellent lecture notes as well. While the online homework is sometimes a little tedious, I'm sure compared to other classes, its a breeze. She gives you a review for each test, study it and your golden. Loved her, took her for Calc II as well.

Professor Agras was amazing. She really cares about all of her students and wants every single one to understand the material fully. There is a decent amount of homework that needs to be done but what do expect out of Calc II. Wonderful person and an even better teacher.

If you have the chance to take Professor Agras, TAKE HER!!! She is the best math professor I've had in my life. She cares about every student, makes sure everyone in class understands the material, and is overall a very very very good person. I took her for MTH 161 and based my spring schedule around her 162 section. There are 3 tests and a final.

Could not have asked for a better experience. I loved her so much for Calc 1 that I took her again for Calc 2! Cares about her students, truly is invested in how we do, and does her best to make sure every one of us understands. Her pre-exam review packets are essentially the test! Cannot express how amazing she is. Absolutely, 10000%, TAKE HER.

By far the best teacher I've had in a long, long time. Not only does she provide almost all the notes you'll need, but she gives reviews that're almost identical to the tests. She truly cares about how you do and won't move on until she can see that every student understands. 10000% recommend, take her if you can!

Love this teacher, the best I have had so far at UM. Made Calc 2 understandable for me (even at the confusing parts). She is so helpful and truly wants everyone to do well. I just did all the review sheets before the test and studied that and I was golden!

Agras is an amazing Calc 1 teacher. She explains everything in a very clear manner, and is very receptive to questions in class and during her office hours. Before each of the 4 tests in the course, she gives review packets (and answers). If you can do the problems in the packets, you'll ace the tests. You don't need the book, and HW is webassign.

Take her!!! Best teacher I've ever had, Agras explains EVERYTHING and always makes sure no one is behind or confused. Her tests don't have curveballs, and the review hw is very helpful. She will always help her students and her work is never too difficult. Love her!

The best math teacher I've had at UM. She is so sweet and wants to make sure that all over students succeed. As long as you go to class and pay attention, the material is explained very well. An A is definitely possible.

Professor Agras is the absolute best math professor. If you have an opportunity to take one of her classes, you should. Three tests, lots of online homework that collectively counts as one test grade, and a final that counts as two tests but can replace your lowest test score. If you put in the effort, you will do well.

Absolutely the best teacher I have ever had at UM. She goes through every step slowly and refuses to move on until every one understands the material. Hw is weekly and short less than 1 hr/week. And she gives reviews before tests that tell you EVERYTHING you need to know for the test. Do the reviews & Hw and its hard not to get at least a B

Ms. Agras is the greatest math teacher ever! She is so sweet & really cares about her students. She wants her students to understand the topics & succeed! Class consists of 4 exams & a cumulative final. Homework is online (webassign) & she is relaxed on deadlines/extensions. Attend all classes or you will feel behind. TAKE HER CLASS

She is the SWEETEST teacher! Definitely take her. She explains the material very clearly and takes time to answer homework and review questions during class. Her tests were really easy if you pay attention to all the material. She also has review packets before each exam to help you out.

Dr. Agras is a true pleasure to learn from. She really cares that all of her students are comfortable with the material. She is entertaining and encouraging and explains things in a manner that is easy to understand. Agras will always take extra time after class to explain if need. She doesn't assign too much homework and is lenient on due dates.

Agras is wonderful. Even if you don't like math, she's entertaining and absolutely lovely to talk to. She stops often to make sure everyone understands what's going on, and she encourages questions and always gives helpful answers. I recommend going to class for her explanations, but if you know how to do the math, the tests are not hard at all.

Agras is THE nicest lady ever!! She's really helpful when you don't understand something. She made Calc I understandable.  She is also pretty funny :)  She gives out review packets before the exams which help out a lot too.

I hate math literally! But Mrs.Agras probably is the most helpful teacher I've ever met! She is funny and patient, if you have any question she would help without hesitate. Her explanation is clear and perfect! I just love her so much! I wish I could take hers MTH162 next semester that for sure will help me a lot!

This woman is by far the best teacher I have ever had in my life. A truly inspiring lady who honestly cares about her students. I have always hated math, but I found myself wanting to do well in it just to make her proud. Truly beautiful both inside and out.
My favorite teacher at UM. Made Calc an easy subject for me. TAKE HER if you can!
Best professor I've ever had... I actually liked math with her. Highly recommended !!
THE BEST TEACHER AT UM!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! SWEETEST LADY EVER AND LOVES BASEBALL! MAKES CALC SUPER EASY!!!! she is amazing!

I absolutely love Professor Agras! She's the sweetest woman ever, and absolutely loves to teach. A lot of people don't like math, but even Agras can get those people to love coming to class! Explains thoroughly, so that everyone in the class understands. Easy tests, online homework. Get her class!

Math is not my forte at all, but she explains the concepts so well and really stimulates interest in the subject. You don't need the book so don't buy it. Just take very good notes and come to class because she reviews homework problems and what's going to be on the test. If you do that, you'll get an A.

Absolutely loved this professor! She is great at teaching and will explain everything perfectly. If you are struggling she will go out of her way to make sure that you do well. Extremely nice and has a great personality.

Hands down, best math teacher I have ever had! She is incredibly nice and her lectures are very easy to understand, and she doesn't have an accent. She will pretty much do anything to help you succeed and will help you during her office hours too. This is the first math class in a long time where I actually am confident before the test.
Extremely helpful and is willing to do anything to improve the student's understanding.  Very nice, bright person.
Very VERY helpful, the best calculus teacher here. TAKE HER
She is a fun teacher. She is very helpful in class. Take her! If you study and go for the tests then you can get an A.

This teacher, in my opinion, was one of the worst math teachers I've ever had. She spends half the class answering people's dumb questions as opposed to teaching. Do not take this teacher! She doesn't command respect from the class and is a total pushover. Take Bibby instead, trust me!
This teacher is very passionate and it shows!

This woman is an absolute gem. She is the most helpful, sweet prof at this school. Math is not my best subject but I got an A+ in the class. The tests are hard, but she prepares you SO WELL for them that you dont even notice. She is always willing to help and will do everything she can to make it clear. best teacher at this school hands down.

Absolutely love this professor. She makes Calc 2 a breeze to understand and her tests are as straightforward as the example problems. No super hard application word problems like some professors give to see if you know the concepts. Just attend all the classes and takes notes and you should get an A.
it probably hurt when she fell from heaven because this woman is saving me from failure.

Norma Agras is one of the sweetest people alive on this planet. I got Mono my first semester Freshman year and she tried everything she could to make sure I was ok and keeping up with the rest of the class. I inevitably had to drop the class unfortunately, but even afterward she still smiled and told that she would miss me. A+ teacher all around

Prof. Agras is a great professor. She not only cares about her students and makes sure in class that everyone understands, but in her office hours, will do everything to make you understand what we're doing in class. She sometimes takes attendance but I don't think it makes a difference in your grade - but to pass, you have to go to class.

A FANTASTIC teacher. She's always willing to help and she made Trigonometry make sense to me, who failed the first two exams. If you're bad at math, she sympathizes and will explain everything to you from the ground up. She randomly takes attendance, but she's so nice and funny that you always find yourself wanting to go to her class!

Great teacher you are allowed to miss 3 classes, and she is always to give extra help and answers any questions in class until the person completely understands. Homework is mandatory but its very helpful since the tests and review packets are similar to the homework problems.

NICEST LADY EVER. Take her if possible, she's so helpful. Go to her review sessions, do your review stuff she gives you, you'll do fine. Two C's, a 100, two B's on the exams, did all the extra stuff then got a 79 on the final and got a A- in the class. She really cares about her students.

Wonderful professor. I had her last semester and purposefully took her class this semester. Welcomes every question and will explain a concept until everyone understands. Her reviews have questions right off of the exams, so be sure to do them, even though they are not mandatory. She really just wants to see you do well.
nice lady, take her if you need a lot of help with math her tests aren't easy easy but it's not that bad at all as long as you go to class do hw and go to her reviews
Professor Agras was amazing! The homework really helps you on the test and going to office hours is important if you want an A.  Its easy if you just do the work, you hardly have to study!

Possibly the nicest teacher you'll ever find. You can't NOT pass with class with at least a B if you put in even the slightest bit of effort. The homework assignments are long, but she gives you a ton of time to do them and will go over almost every question before they're due. The tests are pretty easy if you study. I definitely recommend her.

She is a great teacher. She really cares to make sure you understand what you are learning and always encourages questions. Tests are much easier than than reviews and homework. She helps you until you fully understand what you are learning. Good for partial credit too. Take her for calc II shes great!

Calc 1 was awesome with her! She has a really fun personality, and is great at explaining math.  She encourages you to ask questions and really cares about her students. She gives reviews and homework, which are much harder than the actual tests. A lot of times, examples from the board are the exact test question. TAKE HER IF YOU CAN! SHE'S GREAT!

She is really nice and constantly encourages you to ask questions. Always eager to explain something you dont understand. Her tests aren't too difficult and she gives partial credit for attempting the problem. Also, she gives you a review packet for every unit with everything that will be on that test. I deff recommend her!!!

Super sweet lady!. She tries to make the content as clear as possible. Teaches enough for you to know for the exam. Spends extra class time to make sure that everyone understands the material. The HW is harder than the test and the lab assignments are just like the tests. 4 tests and a final. Labs and homework is due on the day of each exam.

Ms. Agras is one of the best teachers you could have. Her friendly nature and desire to help you succeed makes this class extremely enjoyable. For those who don't like math, take her and you will. She's always willing to help and will not make you feel insignificant Love her!

She should be considered a saint!  She's so good, I never even had to read the book.   She teaches diff. from the book (but in a way that is easy).  Not an easy A bc it's precalc 2.  The trick is, don't miss a class and do your hw= guranteed A!  And the best part is, she speaks English unlike the rest of the math teachers at UM.

Best teacher I've ever had. She's nice, patient and explains the material like you've never taken it before. There is not much to say about her except that I loved her so much, if she ever needed an organ  I'd give it to her. I got A's and all 4 exams but didn't study for the final so I ended up with an A-. Highly recommend.

One of my best teachers of all time. Ms. Agras cares so much and will do absolutely everything she can to help her students. Tells you exactly what to study for the tests and makes homework extra credit. Rearrange your schedule if you must but take her!!

Hands down, best math teacher at UM. She is incredibly helpful and truly cares about the success of her students; often staying past her office hours and promptly answering emails on her off time. If you want a good teacher then you have to take her. I will adjust my schedule to take her for the rest of the math classes I have.
Awesome professor!! Super sweet and extremely helpful. Explains everything clearly and answers any question you may have. I would definitely take her again!!

This woman is probably the best math teacher I've ever had, no joke. She teaches like nobody in the class has ever seen the material before, which may or may not be the case. At times, it can get frustrating, but in the end it's worth it. The tests are so easy and she is a dorky, yet awesome person. Take her!!

had her for 111 and she was AMAZING! told EVERYONE to take her!...then i had her for 112. NOW IM DYING. last test, the class got scores of 24% to 14%. sad sad. i really dont like her anymore. shes covering more stuff than ANY of the other calc classes. I'm just not sure what happnd from last term to now.

One of the best teachers yet..very clear in teaching.you just need to keep up on homework..she is always willing to help a student in her free time..helped me get up on track since i had a horrible teacher for cal 1 now i feel as if i know everything in cal 1 and 2
Pretty easy class.  Just do the homework she posts online and stay ontop of your work.  Boring class but if you put in the work, you WILL get a good grade.
The BEST teacher I've had at UM. Very nice, makes sure that everyone understands as she goes along

Best math teacher I've had at UM. She went out of her way to make sure everyone understood what was going on and was a very fair teacher and grader. I would definately recommend taking her, she's excellent!!!
she is really helpfull. she makes herself available and the class is not that hard if you try
The best math teacher here. Very clear, goes out of her way to make sure everyone understands the material. Funny, is a big Miami fan. Definitely recommended considering the state of the math dept.

although a grad student, wilson can actually TEACH. even though i am personally really interested in philosophy, Wilson explains the material very very well. philosophy can be challenging but as long as you pay attention in class and do the reading, an A is definitely possible.

Super nice guy, explains the material well, and it's an interesting subject. Takes out the time on Sunday nights to do review sessions in the Ashe building for exams. Final was a take-at-home timed exam (through BB). Highly recommended.
Great class

Nice guy, grades a little hard on the reading responses.  there's 8 reading responses if you want a wiritng credit, do well on the final essays as they count for 40% of your and go to class and you'll fine.  super nice guy and very intelligent, can be a little wordy but good class nonetheless
He is really nice and helpful! /Definitely would recommend if you are going to take philosophy. Take it for the writing credit, it is much easier! 8 one page papers and 2 short final papers.

He's a grad student at UM that teaches the subject well.  He does a good job explaining the material, which in Philosophy can be ambiguous.  He assigns homework every so often, didn't take attendance, 3 exams and one final paper (he gives writing credit).  He is always willing to help and holds study sessions for the exams.

He's a really nice guy and wants to help his students out and see them do well. He gives a quiz every class which can be annoying, but no exams...for the final, you can take a written exam or do a 10-15 pg paper for writing credit

Be prepared to take quiz's every class. These quiz's are not too hard if you read all the material assigned. He lets you use a page of notes on the quiz's and final exam. Gives option to take final exam or write a lengthy paper. I found the class to be extremely boring, but if you are into philosophy you will probably like him.

Attendence mandatory, about 9 quizzes all together worth about a third of your grade.  Extremely nice and polite teacher, even took our class out to Starbucks one day.  Offers fair extra credit, and has one test for a final that is not really that hard.  class gets kind of boring, but material itself is not that exciting so it is not his fault for
Great Instructor! Stumbles over words sometimes, but is overall very clear, understanding, helpful, and a fair grader

He only really does 8ams so I was always dead coming to class but hes very knowledgable on the topic and he does try to be funny at times. Easy clear grade. If your process was right he does give credit for work done. Honestly thought I was going to fail at first but his reviews summed up the most important info.

Online tests and quizzes on BlackBoard without any lockdown browser which some people took advantage of, and honestly his quizzes and tests are unfair in content. In class examples/homework are much simpler than assessments, study the textbook and know material very well. He does give hints in class. Class mandatory, but he teaches theory well!

reviews.comment: If you consistently attend class and do the work, you'll do well and find the tests to be on par with the material presented. Professor is a nice guy and is happy to explain a concept again.
Doesn't know how to teach, makes topics overly complicated and grades insanely strict. Takes letter grades off for small mistakes on exams.

This class was just fine. You must pay extra attention during the class in order to do well. Some students had more trouble than others. If you understand the homework and pay attention to when he is explaining how to solve examples you will do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: The grading criteria is clear. There are many oppurtunities for extra credit. He does an extra credit problem each class. If you attend class the material becomes easy. Attendenace is mandatory and you lose a point each time you miss a class. Test are a little harder than homework but follow the same steps

Be careful in his ECE205 class. Very nice professor and gives occasional extra credit. But be cautious with every single thing that is graded because the number on blackboard corresponds with percentage on your final grade. It is very possible to do well on all the tests but miss a homework and lose 5% of your final grade, so be careful.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He is really a nice guy, his teaching is clear and helpful, he drop some quizzes and homework , the class will be easy if you studied well and show up. the attendance is mandatory.

This is by no means an easy class BUT once you understand the concepts and how to apply them, it'll be easier. I definitely would say there is a correlation between class attendance and grades. Make sure you turn in all assignments and study the practice problems in the book if you want to get an A.

He is one of the nicest professors I met. He is clear when he explains and wastes no time with theories. He repeats the first test if the class doesn't do well. He Drops 2 out of 5 quizzes and 2 out of 5 homeworks. He is generous with grades. The class was easy if you studied well. He is available to help if asked. I enjoyed his course.

This course was by no means an easy way, but that being said,  if  you attend the lectures & put in the time by studying and doing assignments, an A is definitely possible. Professor is super kind and accommodating. If you need help and reach out, he will make time for you and try to explain concepts in different ways.

Very hard. This class will possibly be the hardest class you take at UM. It was harder than physics for me. I don't recommend him. Good luck if you decide to take this.. you'll need it. The textbook is HORRIBLE by the way, it doesn't explain concepts at all. There are no outside resources for help.
Nice guy. But class was confusing and tests were hard. Avoid if you can.

PROFESSOR:The professor is very nice he will make several attempts to explain the concepts differently if you ask.  TEST: The test will cover the main topics in each chapter, so be sure to under how to apply each law and theory he lectures.  GRADES: He is very fair grading test, quiz and homework. So be sure to complete all assignments.

He is a nice guy, I understood all the concepts in class and have been failing all the exams. If you want to be an electrical engineer please take this class if not avoid at all costs. This isn't a reflection on him as a person it's just an extremely difficult class and if you can't visualize what's going on you will do poorly. AVOID IF YOU CAN!

He teaches an electrical principles class that's designed for non-electrical engineering majors.  The class is not easy and in fact it's frustrating sometimes but he doesn't give the most complicated problems on his quizes and exams.  Once you get the concept it'll be easy. Study all of the practice problems in the book if you wana get a good grade

Although her lectures were excruciatingly long, she's truly knowledgeable in her field. You have one midterm and one final on respondus and 2 easy "papers". Lectures are incredibly long and boring. She lacks engagement, mostly just reading off slides for the whole time at a slow pace. The course was graded on four items: midterm, final, critical thinking assignment, and participation.

reviews.comment: Lectures are incredibly long and boring. They lack any engagement mostly just reading off slides for the whole time and ur grade is severely hurt for not participating or attending an hour and a half lecture that you can simply just use the lecture slides posted to learn from.
This professor was so rude. She doesn't respond to emails and is not accommodating to students. Do not take her
Professor Reskin is not nice or caring at all. She literally is so rude and does not care about her students.

Professor Peskin is very nice but her lectures can be long and boring. There are 2 exams and a diagnostic and critical thinking paper. She's very hard to get in touch with and can take up to a week to answer emails.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Peskin is a very nice and caring person. However, her course is lecture heavy and at times can be super long. She talks the whole time, but answers any questions. She seems super knowledgeable in her field, but wish the class was more interesting. There are 2 exams & critical thinking & diagnosis assignment. Her tests are hard.

Prof. Peskin is a great professor. Her lectures are very interesting, and her slides are very thorough. There are only 2 exams (Midterm and Final) along with a critical thinking assignment due at the end of the semester. She really puts in so much effort and understands her students. All professors should be more like her.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I loved Prof. Abaka. He was really flexible with testing and projects. Lectures were a bit confusing due to the fact that they weren't fully chronological. Tests and final paper was easy-ish. Grades a lil slow. But I enjoyed his laidbackness and his love for the subject. He was welcoming and I got to make good friends because of the atmosphere.

Professor Abaka is a funny character. He is a great person but his actual teaching skills are poor. He loves to ask open-ended questions and is a bit of a scatter brain. Do not pay attention to the syllabus, it is never right. Be prepared for random, last-minute information and assignments. The test are usually short-answer questions or essays.

Rarely teaches, the course material that we learn in class is unrelated to assessments. Relies on power points and 50 page articles to teach the material. Very slow grader, you won't know your grade until after the semester. Doesn't answer my questions directly. Avoid the class at all costs, unnecessary headache.

Dr. Abaka loves what he teaches and it makes class enjoyable. He's quite a funny guy too. He's very fair in giving exam essay questions beforehand so you know what to prepare. My only complaint would be that it takes a while to get grades back. Ignore negative reviews, too many students skip class/hardly pay attention for their opinions to be valid
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: extremely disorganized and non-communicative regarding upcoming assignments and assessments. class content is intriguing, but is poorly conveyed with little sense of chronology. only major assessment was given long after the end of the end/drop period, making judging your performance in the class essentially impossible until semester's end. avoid.

reviews.comment: Nothing to like

Dr. Abaka is very passionate about the subject and he expects you to put effort into understanding the subject also. We had two map quizzes, one quiz, a midterm, and a final.
