reviews.comment: He knows the subject extremely well and it is interesting; however, he does expect all the additional reading to be done in order to keep up with the class information.

Abaka was absolutely amazing. He was very passionate about the subject. Lectures can sometimes get dull, but the majority are pretty cool. If you participate and show you care you'll get an A. The readings are also fascinating.

Classes are extremely boring. A lot of days are spent just watching pointless videos. He doesn't upload any notes to blackboard. His presentations are the least interesting things ever.  He had no office hours. . Very poor communicator. Never answers emails on time, honestly don't expect any help from him. You teach yourself everything. Just bad.
Dr. Abaka is a very smart and intelligent proffesor. i enjoyed his class and I learned alot. I am going to take another class with him. He is a good professor. He deserves five star rating.
He's such a pleasant teacher that you want to hug him. He is extremely knowledgeable about the history of Africa and its colonialism. The course was enriching!
Great professor! Very nice guy. A lot of reading, but I really enjoyed the class.

He is an awesome guy. The class is extremely interesting. The exams are easy, you just need to google the topics of the essays and you are set for it. You need to read all the books assigned but most are really short and easy to read.

He knows his stuff, that is not the problem. All of his tests are blue book and his T.A. grades the them. She is very picky about the topics. Thought that the class would be easy, it is intriguing but it takes more than a little effort.

obviously very knowledgable! has a lot to say and a lot can be learned from him. i think that he's a good prof. but i am not too happy with the set up of the course, coursewrok and grading. the syllabus seems irrelavant in this class.
very nice person, very understanding in cases of emergency

I thought this was a non-major entry level history course, yet I spent nearly all of my time and efforts on this class and the insane amount of writing assignments and did not receive the grade I thought I deserved. Though the class material was incredibly interesting and important, the workload was simply unacceptable and ridiculous.

easy class. i went to class most of the time, and he only takes attendance occasionally (and even so, you are allowed 6 absences). he gives you the topics that will be on the exams, so i just googled the topics instead of studied, and got an A on both tests. great guy.
Edmund is the man. Enough said.
Dr. Abaka is really fun and an all around great guy. His class was pretty stressful since you had to read a lot, but once you got the swing of things, it was a good time.
He is very helpful during office hours, and is always willing to clarify things.

He is a really great teacher.  He's very helpful, and really knows what he is talking about.  He also has a hint of sarcasm which makes him funny.  Although, class can be a bit boring sometimes, but other than that he's cool.
No Comments

Dr. Abaka is my favorite teacher. I recently went to Ghana with his study abroad program in 2004. What better person to teach african history than someone who is actually from a country in africa. He is from Ghana and is a knowledgable man. He's the BEST!
He's a great teacher, and very approachable~!!!!
No Comments
So easy! Really nice guy! Try to go on the Africa trip in the summer so much fun. Awesome teacher

Down to earth. Call him Joe, not Mr. Abbati. He has a wealth of knowledge, and doesn't talk down to his students. Has a tendency to go off on tangents, but the tangents are still filled with good information.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Took him earlier and liked having him, different experience this time. Difficult to follow lectures. Asks if anyone has any questions and gets pissed that you don't know the answers (happens with about 80% of questions asked). Overemphasizes technical knowledge unnecessary to actual desktop audio production (the name of the class).
Great guy and super helpful. If you put in the effort you'll do well.

This guy is absolutely the best. I learned so much in his class and he makes the whole course completely painless. I definitely lucked out by getting Dr. Amir. Tests are very easy if you pay attention in class and do the homework. Great lecturer and would definitely recommend him over any other teacher.

Some mechanics professors like to make a student suffering with their classes by giving them tough exams and make the passing grade from 70 . However, you will not see this things with professor Amir; he's a very nice guy and very clear . To be honest he made like this class . You will be fine if you take notes from the class and study the H.W, EX

Good lecturer. A bit dry at times but he made sure to cover all subjects well that would be covered on the exams. He did not personally grade homework, and the grader was extremely tough. Examples done every class. Extra credit opportunities available. Would take again.

She is fine until the exams. The class is interesting, and only 3 attendance checks when we have a speaker. She teaches you nothing to prepare even though its open note its no help. The exams are the most ridiculously hard exams i have ever taken with multiple student proctors. The most OD prof. Dont take it. also no way of cheating. AT ALL. 2/10.

She lectures all class. There are 5 attendance checks that she will randomly do. If you miss one, you're cooked. She will post the slides from class but will REDACT important/bolded/underlined things. I find this just rude. There are two open note tests that are pretty difficult. The class average was a C on the first one
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Ahn's class was a great intro advertising class. Graded from 2 group projects you will get 100% on if you follow the rubric, very easy, and two open-note exams. There are 7 random attendance checks and example slides that will be on the exams but won't be uploaded to Blackboard, so it is important to go. Small extra credit but it adds up.

Only two tests, which are all open note. 2 group projects, make sure you choose the right people. Ms. Ahn gives a lot of extra credit, so do them. She randomly takes attendance, so show up to class, since it will be part of your grade. Overall pay attention and study for the tests, and you'll be fine. She also brings in guest speakers, very fun.
Somehow she made advertising hard, the exams are way too difficult even with being open note.
Professor genuinely cares about her students. The class barely has homework except for 2 group projects and 2 exams that are open note. 100% recommend she is amazing.

Professor Ahn cares about her students and constantly encourages you to go up and talk to her if you need anything, whether it's help in class or about getting an internship. Attendance is random, so it's important to go to every class. As long as you listen to the lectures, which are really strong and interesting, you'll do great on the tests.

Professor Ahn is very organized with her slides — she posts them online but sometimes removes things we learn in class so you actually show up. There are attendance checks that ask about what was taught in class that day. 3 group assignments and 3 open book exams. Study for the final — it's closed book!

She is the sweetest person ever but her grading? Awful. you have 3 group assigments but if your group is not good you are dead. you also have 4 individual assigments that even if you ask her to review it, later on she will find a way to discount points. She is really nice but as a teacher, I'll pass. Also the class slides are very unorganized.
Annoying. Made every test online beside the final. Actually just annoying.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Ahn is one of the most helpful and insightful professors I have had at UM. She is always open to providing in-depth feedback and is extremely understanding and patient. Take her classes, she is awesome.

Class consists of lectures that are boring. Attendance is mandatory (2 skips). You need to do your assignments her way or you will get points off. Your group matters if you want to do well. Overall, shes nice but you have to meet with her to get a good grade. Not assignment heavy at all.

She's overall a very sweet professor but her lectures are pretty boring. I do enjoy how the exams are online and open notes and she is easy to access outside of class. Just boring lectures that's all.

Do not take this class. She is so unorganized and didn't grade anything until the last week of school. She isn't very friendly and it honestly seems like she doesn't want her students to do well. Take another class if possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Ahn seems nice at first, but does not care about her students and creates unnecessary challenges in the course. With the semester nearly over, she has yet to grade any assignments. Additionally, she often recaps previous lessons in class, which consumes a significant amount of time and suggests a lack of clarity in her teaching.

Super nice professor but her lectures are very boring and repetitive. All exams were open note and online EXCEPT for the final. She made the final in person, closed book/note, AND cumulative. I was shocked. However, she gives study guides for every exam, even the final and the final is 50 multiple-choice questions. Had to memorize 33 pages of info.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: takes attendance 6 random times a semester. all 3 tetsts are online and open book, but final is cumulative and in person. Lectures are lowkey boring as she reds of the slides, but no too bad (i wish it was more interactive). group assignments are fun! Easy class fs

Prof. Ahn is very nice but this class is extremely boring. There are 3 assignments + a group project at the end of the semester. Instructions for the assignments were very unclear so it was hard to understand what was expected for each assignment. Attendance is also mandatory - she takes it each day.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Gives lectures most of the time and 3 group projects done during class time. Attendance isn't mandatory except for those days. Exams are all online, open note and w/o a lockdown browser. Not too hard. Pretty interesting material. Prof is available to meet and replies fast to emails

Professor Ann is very nice but her class is not the most exciting. She just reads off of Powerpoint slides each class. Attendance is not mandatory and there are 3 in-class discussions but she gives you the topics ahead of time so you can prepare. There are 3 exams and 1 final - all are open note online (no lockdown browser).
She's nice but the class itself is just very boring. All tests are online and open book so thank god for that.
I loved taking this professor. I loved class and she gave a lot of good lectures with valuable information and she's super nice. Take her if you get the chance.

I could barely understand anything Professor Ahh ever said. She is a very nice person who seems to be very caring. Her tests are open book and there are a few individual assignments that aren't hardly graded upon.

Similar to what other posters said - follow the lectures, take notes and you'll be alright. It's not particularly exciting, but Professor Ahn provides students every resource they need to excel in the class and its up to them to utilize them or not. She's easily reachable and helpful outside of class if you get lost in the lectures. Good class.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She's really sweet but so boring. Just reads from slides usually and group projects are huge. She is giving us 1 week to write a report (15 PAGES), make a presentation, and we have a final that covers everything. Almost feels like she doesn't realize we take 4 other classes and have A LOT of other work to do...

I love this professor, I’m planning on taking her next semester as well. She is VERY organized and everything is very clear. Easy tests, interesting lectures, she engages the class. Very kind, caring, and passionate about the students success. There’s literally nothing negative to say about Professor Ahn or her course. Highly recommend

Professor Ahn is a really nice woman. Lecture slides were posted every day before class. I stopped showing up bc attendance wasn't mandatory. Tests were open book and easy to pass. Individual assignments are just graded on completion and following directions. Boring class if you're not passionate about advertising, but still easy enough to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Easiest A. Her lectures are boring but she tries hard to make it interactive, a couple group projects which are not hard, homework is easy . You have to have your camera on the whole time but tests are super easy, everything is in the PowerPoint. No need to read the text book
Tests are really easy, open book, read over the powerpoint before the exam and you'll be okay. Homework is simple, just do what she asks.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Your grade is pretty dependent on your group projects, so if you get a bad group, it will be tough for you. Regina is very kind. She requires your camera to be on and attendance is mandatory. You don't need to pay attention to pass, but you need to be present.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: had her for stc114 too and her teaching style is the same. open notes exams (kinda hard tho lowkey), group projects, attendance/participation counts toward your grade. unfortunately, if you get bad group members, you're stuck with them the whole semester and end up doing lots of work, which was my case, but ik other people really liked their groups

She replies to email so quickly and she includes many examples in her lectures to help you understand all the concepts. Lectures given by her are a little bit boring. There are nearly 5 exams the whole semester, and she also gives us some extra credits to improve our grade. Camera are not required to turned on during classes.
The class is so boring and has so many requirements. She only read the ppt in the class.

She tries really hard and definitely wants the best for her students. Shes so easy to meet with outside of class and I definitely recommend doing so because she is highly intelligent and so so sweet and will be happy to help you with anything really. Her classes can be a bit long and drag on and her teaching style is a bit different but shes great.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Regina is the nicest prof ever but the class was just her going through a powerpoint. There were a lot of students so there wasn't really one-on-one feedback, but for the group discussions, if you had questions she answered really fast. You only need to show up to a few classes to pass.

Lectures can get boring, but she tries her best to make it interactive. The group projects were easy (but annoying b/c of my unhelpful group members). She heavily recommends reading the textbook, but you don't need it because everything on the exams is on her lecture slides and the exams were open notes (at least this semester), so an easy A!

Professor Ahn is very kind and lenient. She's very knowledgeable about the material and genuinely wants you to do well. We had 4 exams, 3 out of 4 of them being open note which made the class easier. 5 group projects but she grades really easily. Lectures got kind of boring at times but she tried to make them as interactive as possible.

Professor Ahn is just meh. She speaks in fragments and the way she talks/phrases sentences makes no sense. The class was all online for fall. We did 5 group projects, but our grade was made up of exams, which were open note/book this semester. Overall a very easy class/professor, but she makes 0 sense. She is so sweet though. Take for easy A.
He's so sweet and kind! Don't worry he's great and tried his best. Yes he dis have an accent but just read the lab and ask questions if you need help.

Professor is very kind. Don't worry about the bad reviews. He's helpful and you can tell he cares and tries a lot, his accent really doesn't change the class performance if you just pay attention during the lecture period. It's very hard to fail this class.

He isn't a mean guy, but he made the lab very annoying. He starts class with a 15-50 minute long lecture covering content that is highly irrelevant to the course and boring. His accent is also very strong and half of the time did not understand questions asked by students. He also did not communicate well with TAs who were almost always lost.

Dr. Gebreil is an amazing professor for HHMI labs. Although he does have an accent, it does not affect the labs. He is very organized and helpful on everything we need to do. He gives a short lecture on what we will be doing every day in the lab and then demonstrates how to do different procedures (super helpful). Overall, amazing professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He is always willing to help and answer questions. He gives a demonstration/tutorial before you have to do it. Workload is light and he gives detailed instructions on what to write for research paper. You honestly have to try to fail this class. Accent is diffucult at first, but you get used it and it does really affect performance in class.
Super nice guy, but not a great professor. Heavy accent that is oftentimes difficult to understand. I was super confused during lab but it didn't really add to the difficulty at all.

This professor is absolutely horrible please do not take him as your HHMI instructor, consider dropping out of HHMI if you have to take it with him. Class isn't challenging it is just a waste of time and you will be frustrated with his disorder and bad instruction. This class has no schedule or order so be prepared to have no idea what you're doing

He's a nice guy, but his lectures at the beginning of class about what we would be doing that day were unorganized and extremely hard to understand. When lab work began, no one knew what to do because we lacked specific directions or even a paper with instructions. We had to figure out what to do for ourselves. Very unclear expectations.

He made lab really difficult. Heavy accent, starts with an hour lecture not pertaining to lab, does not respond to emails. I would avoid him for HHMI if you have the choice. Our final project is due in a week and we still do not have instructions.

I would avoid him if you are taking HHMI. He is really difficult to understand and does not give clear instructions on experiments. The TA's made it a little bit easier but it was hard to figure out his expectations and how to go about a lab you have no knowledge on.

First year at UM.He didn't know how HHMI labs were run.He gave us a quiz which is unheard of for HHMI. Has a very strong accent. He also doesn't give clear directions, and he changed our whole experiment once it switched to bio from chem. He lectures you at the beginning of every lab for 20-50 min before even starting, so it takes a while to finish
Doesn't know what's doing, don't have a command over the subject and is very unreliable communicator.

No real-world applications throughout course. Lectures were based on exercises and a simple "check-in" and then moving on. Must attend class though the university restricts that requirement.  Messages in group and one-on-one sessions were not honored in actions. Exam answers correct and clearly in writing were rejected in direct communications
x

I LOVE THIS PROFESSOR! She is animated and well articulated. She explains things well. I would take any class she teaches. The material itself has the potential to be difficult but she makes it so easily digestible.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She is a very nice teacher, helpful and clear.

Great professor with an eagerness to teach and loves to work with students and make sure they succeed. The material she teaches is hard, but she is really great at responding to e-mails and meeting with you to explain things.
Bad attitude and weak lecturing. Seems like going to school for sociology hasn't taught her manners

Attendance is pretty much required to do well because she does a lot of in class points toward a grade which you will get a zero on if you do not attend. She also just speaks what she thinks is important rather than lectures from a powerpoint, so you have to be there to get the notes. If you attend class it is so easy and she's an awesome prof.

Lectures were very informative and casual. Almost conversational. All the tests are open notes, and she teaches about material that is very relevant in current times. Very good choice for SOC101, but attendance is required.

Professor Bahraini is such a good professor. She is a recent graduate from UM so she understands the workload students have. Shes passionate about sociology and is so relatable. She gives only two exams which are open notes and online. She just wants you to learn, not stress about memorizing everything. Theres one final project but its easy.

Easy exams. Just memorize EVERYTHING on the slides (especially diagrams of mechanisms). Never dismiss small details or fine print as unimportant, because they'll probably be tested. Lectures are enjoyable, but you don't have to attend class at all to do well. There might've been extra credit for in-class questions in the past, but no more.

Worst professor ever, impossible to follow. Tests on the most obscure details. Definitely memorize every minute detail on the slide. If you can, just take 401 so you do not have to suffer through 2 semesters of him. I know he made me and several others drop the major.

Good curve A (80+), B (70-79), etc.  To get an A in the class, do NOT buy the text.  Buy Lippincotts Illustrated Review, study the slides carefully.  Very detail oriented.  If you memorize everything on the slides its easy.  Little critical thinking, if any.  Class is jointly taught, and Ahmad (worst of the 3) is often at odds w/ his students.

for ahmad: you need to study the notes and old tests. If u have time reading cant hurt. BMB has a lot of memorizing so be prepared. I would rank them as myers, ahmad, and then huijing. However ahmads tests are not bad at all and he has a nice curve.

During lecture Ahmad treats students like grade schoolers.  Don't talk or be late for his lectures.  His test questions aren't too tough though.  Know the slides and you'll be fine.  Huijing clears his throat every 2 seconds which is annoying.  Go to Myers lectures because they are actually enjoyable and you get extra credit for the in class ?'s.

This is just rating Ahmad. He knows his stuff, but seems more preoccupied on a few people talking in his class. Also asks questions and gets somewhat annoyed when people don't answer them. He doesn't talk very loud so you HAVE to sit in the front to be able to hear him. His test questions aren't horrible but you definately have to study. Nice curve

Tests are primarily on details and the overall picture rather than pathways and mechanisms. Curve and extra points/questions helps a lot (80 is an A). Ahmad has a thick accent; Hujing is easier to understand. Myers is interesting and easiest of the 3 teachers.
Really fun, but I learned a lot too!

Professor Tojino was an amazing professor. He takes the time to help every student and goes in depth with his reviews and critiques. His goal is to help you grow as a writer. His readings are very educational and he wants everyone to learn. He helps with publications and will be completely transparent about the process. I would take his class again

Professor Tojino, or "Aidan", is a terrific professor. Throughout the course, he manages to significantly improve the writing quality of each student without the class requiring a lot of work. The grading is based on a "labor contract"; if you do the work intentionally and show up to each class, you WILL receive an A. I recommend this course 100%!

Overall great teacher that really wants you to do well. Participation is very important and counts towards your grade. Tests and quizzes are straightforward and she usually gives a review the class before. If you go to her office hours, she is more than willing to help and will even understand if you submit an assignment late. Definitely recommend.
She is a fantastic Spanish teacher. She really cares about the students and wants them to do well in her class. Always come to class and be respectful to her and you will do fine.
She is a very nice teacher who will do her best to help you get an A as long as you respect her and her class--so go to class every day, do your homework, be nice.

Professor Nnamdi misinterpreted a sentence in my paper and graded it incomplete, even though it met all the requirements. When I questioned her, rather than admitting her misjudgment, she kept on coming up with new criticisms. When she ran out of arguments, she suspended my practicum, which was a total abuse of power and was eventually rescinded.

I never have had to write a review about a professor, but please at all costs AVOID this professor. She lies consistently, does not take accountability for anything, has a terrible work ethic, rude, and inconsiderate. I would give her a 0/5 if I could.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: WORST PROFESSOR I HAVE EVER HAD IN MY LIFE. She has terrible communication skills, constantly is late or cancelling class for "emergencies" but does not extend the same courtesy when someone misses something due to her poor communication. She is rude, unhelpful, and should NEVER be able to teach again. I am going off on the teacher evaluation.

One of the worst professors ever. She doesn't take accountability and constantly blames her students. She doesn't show up for class and talks badly about her students on zoom. Please don't take this class with this instructor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: She's bad. Blames her problems on anybody but herself. Just don't even think about choosing her.

reviews.comment: DON'T TAKE. She left her mic on and literally talked bad about all her students to her boss on the phone. She blames her problems on the students, and doesn't know how to work blackboard. She doesn't share power points and has rude attitude about everything. She never answers emails, and her excuse is because she's "busy". Please AVOID her!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: this class is incredibly confusing and she is no help at all. she gets mad when students ask questions, doesn't give any information on what will be on assessments, and is simply just rude. she cancels class without warning quite often so you're really on your own. avoid at all costs would not take again
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Awful awful awful do anything but take her class, Im convinced she hates her students, new professor made the mistake of taking her never again. Shes rude beyond belief argues with students everyday, incredibly confusing exams and doesnt give you anything to review, you have to learn everything for yourself avoid her all costs

Professor Ake is the kindest and most caring professor I've had while studying at UM. He's so enthusiastic about what he's teaching and you can tell he loves teaching and helping his students. Participation in class is important but it doesn't even feel like "class participation" because of how fun it is!

Dr Ake is a great guy who really loves to teach jazz. I wish that this class was in person this semester, interesting material but as a non-jazz person it did become difficult to pay attention in the online format. Ake is very fair and willing to help you, and the readings surprised me

Easy class. Grade is based off of attendance, three non-cumulative, open note tests, and four short discussion reports over the course of the semester. Jazz isn't really my thing, so the content wasn't my favorite but Ake is a really nice, fair guy.

Really good teacher and professor. He teaches class so we enjoy it AND so we learn. This was my favorite class this semester. Chill, fun vibe. My playlist is better after this class. 4 2 paragraph discussion reports, and 4 exams. Show up to class, take notes, do the readings and you should have no issues with this class. A true gem.

I could not say enough good things about him. he is super nice & chill. his classes are actually fun and interesting and he doesn't give boring lectures or busy work and wasteful assignments. super caring, approachable and flexible. very few yet easy assignments. he wants u to succeed and is like ur friend. take him if you have the chance! the best

Talk about just a great guy. Professor Ake is probably one of the nicest people I have ever met. He is so passionate about what he teaches. Even when classes were online, he would still show up every class with a smile on his face. If you don't take Ake, respectfully, I don't know what you're doing.
Professor Ake was amazing. He very much cares about his students and loves what he teaches. Very easy grade as long as you pay attention and do assignments.

This will probably be the easiest class of my college career! My camera was off the whole time, got 100 on every assignment. As long as you do the work, & turn in the attendance answer u will fly by. There were 3 exams, kind of hard but the assignments cushion ur grade. He's very nice, understanding & an amazing music player! Choose him if u can!

Easily the best professor at UM. He's really nice, makes class interesting, and really cares about the subject matter. The class is an easy A if you just pay attention in class, which isn't hard to do at all. I definitely plan on taking him again for another music cognate course.

Evolution of Jazz is a fun elective for non-Frost students. Dr. Ake has a great personality and makes the class really interesting! If you show up to class you'll do really well on the exams. Short reading and discussions in each class.
Best teacher at Frost!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Dr. Ake was definitely one of the best professors in the entire school. He shows up every class excited to teach and genuinely trying to inspire college kids to care about what they are learning. Absolutely a pleasure taking his course (as an elective), and I would suggest signing up for his courses if possible!

Dr. Chiba has a very heavy accent and sometimes has trouble teaching concepts, but he does teach biology in a much more simple way than other professors. Class is not a lot of work and hes a pretty easy grader and gives a good amount of bonus, but you probably wont learn as much detailed cell bio as previous courses. Impossible not to pass also.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Chiba is an EXTREMELY easy choice for a biology elective. The class is 4 exams (1 in class, 3 take home), 3 group presentations, and 1 point a day attendance. He is a very easy grader if you show originality in your thought and will also give bonus points if you participate in class. He's a very interesting guy and thinks about biology uniquely
Super Easy A class !!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Super easy course that is also very fun! I recommend it.
Extremely easy class. GPA booster

Chiba is literally the easiest professor on the entire planet. I could give my dog all the assignments to do and I would still pass with a 100%. However, he requires people to sign in every class period, but as long as you have friends that can sign you in, you'll be fine. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

Easiest class of my life.  You learn absolutely nothing, but it requires 0 work and you are basically guaranteed an A if you show up and turn in your "work."  The grades are only based on 1pt a day attendance, 3 presentations (you can straight read off notes), 1 in-class test (you have the ?'s before hand), 3 take-home tests, and 2-3 "homeworks"
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: You are honestly better off taking Mallery and DiResta, Chiba is nice but very confusing and will screw over your grade due to random grading. He says on thing and does another. If you are okay with a C take this class, if not DO NOT TAKE. this class may ruin your chances of going to medical school when it isn't even hard material!
Chiba is a very nice guy and a very good researcher but was too disorganized to be an effective teacher this semester.  He didn't demand much, but he didn't offer much, either.

Akin. although accomplished and smart, is an overwhelmingly ineffective teacher. she scoffs and is outwardly shocked if you do not know an answer to economics from previous levels. she is condescending and maintains a VERY negative environment in class inhibiting questions. she is also not thorough in explaining difficult concepts. dont.take.

I have no doubts that she cares about her students, and as such presents the material in a very digestible manner. However, she can be a somewhat difficult person to deal with, and has let her emotions take control of her in class.
WORST

I took this Dr. Akin's class in Spring 2010. I thought that she was wonderful. She was always helpful and courteous. Without any doubt, this was the class that made me choose ECON as my major. Thank you, Dr. Akin!
WORST TEACHER I HAVE EVER HAD. DONT TAKE HER.

Professor Akin is undoubtedly the best econ professor I've had at UM. I was so disappointed in the econ staff here before her. She knows her stuff. She cares about you KNOWING the material..not just passing an exam. She explains the intuition behind her math. And the math isn't hard. Hardly calc 1. If you think the class is hard,your just lazy
worst class at UM. Why is she so mean?
Doesn't teach anything that's in the book, makes you feel stupid. Homeworks are OBSCENELY long and don't have anything to do with the material in the notes. Horrible class, BEWARE!

She is a smug individual that cares only about proving that she is smarter than the students that take her class. Do not ask questions unless you want to be publicly humiliated for an undeserved reason. AVOID HER IF POSSIBLE!!!
ruined my semester. I am no longer interested in Macro...she often loses her temper in class. although she is very smart, but definitely not a good teacher

reviews.comment: This professor not only had aimless lectures that weren't worth attending but was sassy and rude in class in response to students' questions. His emails to communicate with us were confusing and he requested on multiple occasions in emails that we not reach out to him if we have questions as to not overwhelm him. STAY AWAY AT ALL COSTS

Prof. Aparicio was rude and inconsiderate. He made an introductory physics class unnecessarily difficult. One example that stood out was how in the first exam of the semester he entered the lecture hall and loudly started talking to the test proctor. His emails during COVID-19 were also hostile and unnecessary. Avoid if possible.

Have never dealt with a ruder professor. Does not answer emails-or answers them very rudely. In person class was useless, he just uses the projector/slides from the book. Once classes went online, he became even harder to reach telling students specifically to not email him and just read syllabus. Avoid at all costs- take physics at a diff school.

Honestly, he's a tough professor but physics is a hard subject. He does try to understand students struggle but I don't think anyone really understood the material in his classes. If you don't have a background in physics or prior experience, it would be better to take someone else.

Understanding the professor was very unclear due his accent. He starts new chapter and gives quiz while we are preparing for exam for previous topics. It was very confusing. He teaches as if we are already know the course, which is difficult enough while attending a live class. Other professors were much cooperative during COVID19.
The rudest professor at UM. He tells students not to email him and is rude in all mass emails. Not understanding at all of the circumstances.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor does not want students to succeed. During COVID crisis, repeatedly sent hostile, mass emails claiming he was not going to answer questions if we emailed and that it was totally up to us. Test questions were nothing like the textbook or questions from lecture.
In four years at UM I have never come across a more rude, unhelpful or incompetent professor as JAB. Take ANYONE but him. If no one else is available take physics later...
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Aparicio makes his test completely unlike the mastering assignments or the questions in the book. Even the discussion sessions seem pointless because they don't help you for his exams. His thick accent also makes it difficult to understand what he's saying, especially in a large lecture hall. Avoid him if possible.
Simply rude. Not great at. explaining concepts, not great at responding to questions in emails. Only positive is him allowing you to drop one of every assignment- homework, quiz, test.
He makes his test questions as hard as possible. The practice tests and masterings do not resemble the test at all. He is very rude and not understanding.

Professor Aparicio is a very great professor. Physics is an overall difficult class especially at UM however, despite having a big class and going through COVID, he has done everything possible to help us perform our best and answer any questions we may have. Great professor!
He's frankly a jerk. Totally not used to teaching a class of this size. Totally over his head. Thick accent makes it hard to understand anything. Tests are designed to trick you not test the material

He does a very poor job of explaining things and makes it very difficult despite being an intro level class. He gives practice tests but the practice tests nor the homework match what he puts on the exam. He's condescending and often puts the wrong answer and says it's correct, even on EXAMS. He even told a student he expects half the class to fail
Ridiculous

He is the best; you will learn a lot while having fun, he will make you love pharmacology.  He is an angel, the best of UM, he is always there for his students, you will love him, it is impossible not to love him.  Remember his birthday Nov. 9.  He deserves the best of your love.  His study guides will help you pass all of the exams.

Professor Apatov is funny, smart and very concerned about how his students are doing. His study guides are excellent and correlate with the tests perfectly. You learn and he's not hard. Awesome teacher!!!
Awesome guy.  Knows the material backwards and forwards, inside and out.  Is able to teach it in an understandable way.  Uses a lot of humor, and makes class fun to attend.
He kwows the subject back and foward. Awesome professor. Really helpful.
The BEST professor I have ever had.
No Comments

Honestly, the only reason he gets a 2 and not a 1 is because attendance was optional. At least then I wouldn't care if I missed a class due to the fact I knew I would not learn anything anyways. He rambles, thinks he is teaching, and everyone is on their computer playing Angry Birds or whatever game. It was pointless, and I expect more from UM!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Horrible!! UMiami, please do better, this is unfair to your students.

AVOID!

Did not learn one thing throughout this course. The professor rambles on about whatever while the whole class doesn't pay attention. Zero class engagement, class average was a 25 on the midterms, and everyone did poorly. If you actually want to learn something worth the tens of thousands in tuition paid then avoid at all cost!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Words can't explain how bad this class was. I must say, he's very very smart, but he can't engage the class if his life depended on it. I didn't learn a thing in class other than the FEW times he did excel breakdown on zoom. Avoid at all costs
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Heavy lecture professor that demonstrates passion and interest on teaching this subject. Do not miss class or you may fall behind! It could be challenging material so prepare to study ahead of time for the exams. Not the very best in answering questions but quick to reply through email.
AVOID!! I have not learned a thing from his lectures. Very painful.

Andrade makes the class unnecessarily hard. A lot of homework, difficult exams, and challenging projects. My friend had the same course with another teacher and said it was easy, very different from my experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Respectfully, his lectures are all over the place. Got mad at us when the class average was a 50%... Way too much "real-world" applicability with nothing relating to exams. The exams are like the homework quizzes, but still very hard to prepare for because the homework questions range so widely.

If you aren't wired to understand financial calculations, good luck. No help on anything question related, and he'll cancel your review on you 10 minutes before its meant to start and leave you without a proper review until less than 24 hrs prior to the exam. Even if you study a week straight, if you don't get the numbers there's no hope.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took Professor Sandro online and can say that even though online classes are harder to pay attention to and are often dismissed by students, this professor really does everything so you can understand the subject. He records every class and divides it. The subjects are extremely important and he explains them in detail and in a very concise way.

Great professor and is extremely knowledgeable about portfolio management. This is a great class to take even if you have an alternate career path or study. He provides a fundamental knowledge that can be beneficial anywhere in finance. The class isn't easy though, and the first is exam is the most difficult and the majority of the class fails it.

The professor is really knowledgeable about portfolio management. Our grades consist of exams, two group projects, and a book report. The main problem with the exam is time even though we are given two hours to take it. Nothing is a surprise though so as long as you show up to class and pay attention, you should do well.

Professor is a nice guy but he never seems to connect with students through his lectures. Its because he doesn't show you the process step-by-step. This course is extremely excel heavy with at least 30 questions on the exams. The first exam is the most difficult, it should be the second to boost the moral of the students. 90% fail the first exam
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is one of the best professors in UM. Class not mandatory, however you should go to every single class if you want to succeed in the class and in life. His lectures are extremely interesting, for the finance world and quantitative finance in general. Take notes (SOS), follow his exact instructions and do not study last minute and ull succeed.

Amazing professor. This graduate level advanced class in portfolio theory required knowledge of linear algebra and basic portfolio theory. He is great at explaining complex mathematical formulas and concepts.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took this class because of all the good reviews. He's a great guy but his lectures are boring and there is so much information that the class is impossible. I have never gotten a bad grade in finance before this class. He also did not grade our projects and the final is worth 40% of the grade so you are going into final with no clue about grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: TAKE THIS CLASS. I literally learned more about portfolio management and investing in this class than in all my other classes combined. It is not an easy class! but he is very good at explaining things clearly and making sure you understand them. Goes into detail on quantitative investing, AMAZING PROFESSOR, 100% RECOMMEND!!

FIN651 actually. Best professor I've had. Lectures very clear and he is always enthusiastic when teaching. Very accessible in office hours, always willing to help. Exam not hard almost all from hw. Attendance is not mandatory and he made it very clear that he respects different ways of learning, but they are so interesting! Take a course with him!!
Amazing, the best finance professor in the whole department. He defines how a great professor should act.

Professor Andrade is an amazing professor. His lecture material is very organized and understandable. He teaches a great course for those interested in quantitative investing with very clear explanations of how what he teaches applies to the real world. Most of all he is very nice, smart, and reasonable with grades as long as you put in the work.

If you are a finance major, take this class. All about the quantitative side of investing and he's a good teacher. You can tell he actually cares and wants you to learn which make it much more enjoyable. The project is hard, don't wait till the last minute.
This is by far the best finance class at the U. I learned more about investing in this class than in all other classes combined.

I really liked him as a professor for FIN320! He knows a lot and really knows what he is talking about using real examples from his past. He is easy to study for tests. The tests are really strait forward. If you study the problem sets and the power points you can get an easy A. I really Recomend him!
you will learn a lot of things from him.  he is my favorite professor in UM. Highly recommend him!!

best finance teacher I've had yet. makes his own power points and they are incredibly easy to understand. he does a good job explaining them as well. everything on the test is straight from the slides, and the 2 or 3 practice problems you do in class before the test (just different numbers). he's really a nice and smart guy overall
Good prof, interesting class. Most exam questions are from problem sets.
Class is difficult, but if you study the problem sets you should do ok.  He's a pretty good teacher, not great but not terrible either.  Probably a safe option for 320.
LOVE HIM!! exams are hard, T/F questions, one short answer, and 3 or 4 calculation problems. 93+ is a an A. If you are majoring in Finance, take him! You can learn a lot from him!!!
Very intelligent professor who is very knowledgeable regarding finance.  He gives very challenging tests, but if you are a finance major, I would def take him.
He knows his stuff, but expects WAY TOO MUCH of students. Not recommended if you want to minimize stress levels.

He is a very smart professor who knows finance very well and wants you to learn too~but the tests are really hard.You have to invest a lot of time studying his materials in order to do well in the test.
Exams are hell ... but I feel like I learned a great deal. Great class after all.
Andrade is a good professor and a nice guy. But it sucks to study endlessly and get a 75, even when the 75 is a B+ in his scale.

This guy is great. Nice, smart professor. He is really willing to work with students if they do not get the material. The tests are similar to the problem sets, just with some added complications. Andrade breaks down difficult finance principles and makes them easy to understand. You will learn finance from his class.

he is a hard teacher. if finance is your major and you want to learn, then i suggest taking him. if you dont care whether you learn or not then take someone else. be prepared for the tests they are hard, but if you do the problem sets you should do well. he is a very intelligent professor and really wants you to learn..

He is horrible. All he does is lecture on slides every single class, which end up having nothing to do with the tests. All he gives us to study for for the tests are problem sets, which he claims are identical to test.. I could do all the problem sets off the top of my head with ease and couldn't so a single problem on his impossible test.

THIS PROFESSOR FAILS TO UNDERSTAND THAT STUDENTS CANNOT DEDICATE THEIR ENTIRE LIVES TO HIS CLASS. EXAMS ARE UNREASONABLY HARD. THE BOOK IS ALREADY COMPLICATED AND HE ADDS MORE COMPLICATIONS TO THE COURSE (LIKE EXCEL). HE PRACTICALLY DOES NOT DO EXAMPLES IN CLASS.
Good professor. Though at times he seemed distracted, overall classes were interesting. his slides are helpful. let's see what the final will look like  ...

This is a challenging class. However, the professor provides plenty of opportunities for you to learn the material.  I wish I had realized the benefit of working the homework problems before the first exam, if I had I would have scored much better.  An A is attainable if you solve the homework problems - lots of them appear in the exams.

THis Professor was not that great, he gives really hard exams, he is not very organized, and for the most part i ended up teaching myself most of the material. he does try to help you though, just becareful because sometimes he might confuse you more.
Great class from a smart and energetic professor.  This class is much more difficult than the average class.

Really sad as a student who does not like using AI or anything, but she's genuinely impossible to actually learn from. Very very sweet but her lectures don't make any sense whatsoever. If you're just trying to get the credit, it's all open-book and attendance isn't mandatory. If you're trying to learn the material, however, take a different prof.

If you are looking for an easy class, take this. I learned absolutely nothing, and it felt like a waste of three hours every single week. She is extremely caring and loves math; however, that does not translate to being good at teaching it. Every HW and exam is open everything though

It's a total "credit-only" class. She is an expert on the field for sure, but her board work is impossible to track and the lectures just don't click. Because everything is online and open-resource, there's ZERO motivation to actually learn the content. It's an easy grade, but a pretty frustrating experience if you actually care about the subject.

Super easy class, I highly recommend if you want an easy A. Attendance is mandatory but all exams, including the midterm and final, are take home and without Lockdown browser, they are on Canvas. The exams are short and easy and she goes over each exam question in class before we take. Her lectures are confusing and fast but the materials easy.

Only went during the 1st week, and I got an A. If this is your last math, take her. If you have more math after this definitely do not take because you will not learn anything (maybe I would've if I actually went to class who knows). Everything is online with multiple attempts, including all participation and the final.

Bystrik is a super caring and intelligent teacher. That being said this was the easiest class I have ever taken. Everything is online no lockdown. Dont take this class if you want to learn, cause you wont. Take it for 3 free credits. You could not go to class once and get a 100 in the class

Really good professor if you want to do well in a mandatory math class. Super sweet person and gives lots of opportunities for grading. Not the best choice if you want to learn the material really well.

Dr.Bystrik is a nice professor; she is passionate about what she is teaching and provides plenty of examples. The course was simple and manageable. EASY class, but she might be difficult to understand.

The class was probably the easiest math course I have taken at UM. The professor cares a lot not only about the subject she teaches but the success of her students. She is very helpful if you ask a question and makes sure that students understand the material. Attend class throughout the semester even when attendance isn't mandatory.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easiest class i've taken at um only thing is that you do not learn. only take if you dont need further math.

Prof is the easiest for math req. She reviews and conducts open-note exams in class with help. No attendance required at first but later in the semester she required due to material difficulty. Super kind and understanding.

Dr. Bystrik is an incredible professor who clearly cares deeply about the subjects she teaches. She doesn't require attendance, but if you show up to every class, she will give you extra credit. If you have the option to take this course, take it.
If you need math credits definitely take 113 with her. Super chill and caring.

Easy A all around! Professor Bystrik makes this class a breeze - everything is online with unlimited attempts. I barely attended and still got an A+. The lectures are forgettable, but unstuck study helped me breeze through the quizzes.
Prof. Bystrik is an amazing individual! Her class is definitely manageable and one of the best professors I've had at UM!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: easiest class i've ever taken. attendance was not mandatory, which was reflected in the class numbers, but all of the exams were online with 3 attempts and no lockdown browser. she gives you resources to compute the problems online, and is clearly very passionate about what she teaches.

Tbh, easiest prof ever. U won't learn much, but u will get the grade. U don't need to goto class to get an A. Everything is online and she give sm time to do it. I am not the best at math and I ended with a 104%. If u need to fulfill a math requirement, take her. Very nice woman too.

Take her class! She wants students to do well and 113 is such an easy A with her - she walks you through all of the assignments and exams in class, but none of them require a lockdown browser so you can use outside resources to get the answers even if you don't go to class. She is so sweet I would 100% take her again.

Prof, Bystrik is a sweet lady who wants her students to do well. This class is an easy A. She puts quiz and test answers (including midterm and final) on the board during class and there is no hw. If you can hold off on taking math I would wait to take it with her. Highly recommend.

Incredibly easy class. If you want to learn about math, this isn't the best class, but if you want a free A, definitely take her. The class is incredibly easy and all the exams and assignments are common sense and don't require any outside work. Incredible class if you aren't a fan of math and just need a class for the requirement.

TAKE HER!! She is very sweet and caring and all assignments including tests and midterms are done online and you have several days to complete them. She often puts up answers on board in class so attending is beneficial but not necessary!

This class was incredibly easy. Graded on about 10 blackboard quizzes all with unlimited attempts (this includes the midterm and the final). Professor Bystrik loves teaching this class and genuinely cares about her students. As someone who hates math, I would absolutely take a class with Professor Bystrik again.

THE GOAT. I took this because the reviews said it was a free A and it really was. Ended with a 100.2%. Only showed up to class like 5 times and still got everything. 
DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS IF YOU NEED CALC 3!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
She just told some fun stories about calc and let us have 3 attempts and online graphing calculator on every assignments.

The 8am was worth it, and attendance isn't mandatory, but I went anyways because I felt bad only 5 people showed up every morning and she helped out on assignments if you went.  Would highly recommend her if you just need to pass calc 2 and don't need it for your major or another class.

I did not learn a single thing, so if learning is your objective, look elsewhere. That being said I didn't go to class for 2 months straight and ended with an A+. Everything is online and multiple attempts. She is super nice but somehow hasn't realized no one is learning a thing. Also her accent is very thick and hard to listen to.

All you need to pass this class is common sense. Don't take Bystrik to learn, but if you need an easy A, this may be the easiest you get. I attended maybe 4 classes throughout the semester. You get three tries on each test, which are already multiple choice. Sweet lady, but seems oblivious to the fact that her students do not put in any effort.

I absolutely adore Dr. Bystrik. Contrary to popular belief (took this class Fall 2023) the exams were in person. However, they were not challenging if you went to class and took the time to learn the material. Dr. Bystrik is extremely knowledgeable and willing to help students.

MTH 113 was the easiest class I have taken at UM. Dr. Bystrik is a super nice professor and will do everything in her power to help her students succeed. She is clearly passionate and loves to talk about the history of mathematics. She also gives students 3 tries to do assignments and there was no homework outside of class.

I HAVE NO IDEA WHAT SHE WAS TEACHING US IN FINITE MATH. she didnt try to teach it, she would just write the problems on the board BEFORE class and wouldn't actually tell u how to solve it. She also is impossible to understand with her thick accent. I haven't learned a thing.
TAKE HER!! unless you actually need to learn calc 2... but if you don't need to continue after definitely take her. Everything is taken online with no lockdown.

if you want to actually learn math, don't take this professor. But for everyone else who wants an easy 100, take her!! She does all "tests" with the whole class (as long as you have a group me, you literally just need one person to attend) and those are the only assignments. Even the midterm/final was done with the class.
Amazing professor all assignments are posted online and you have multiple tries. The final is also online no lockdown at all !!

Take this class!!!! All assignments are posted online, including the final exam. I showed up to class probably three times throughout the semester and I finished the class with an A+. The teacher is very understanding and for all of the assignments, you are given three tries to complete them. I would take this class again if I could.

I took MTH113 and I still have no idea what this class is BUT she does all assignments with you and she truly does care. Take her if you want an easy A. Oh yeah and she has a very thick Russian accent but don't worry you'll be fine.

She's great! She has a very thick accent and sometimes she was really hard to understand but all the lectures were online as well, homework and tests were done in class with her, and open for weeks online to do. And the final was even multiple choice and multiple attempts. I didn't even study lol I just brute forced the thing and got an A.
She's incredibly nice and understanding. Definitely best professor at math department.

Professor Bystrik has to be the best professor at UM by far. She is very nice and understanding about assignments and makes every assignment due at the end of the semester. If you do not need to take any more advanced math than defenitely take this class, it is a free A and attendance is not required. What is not to love about Professor Bystrik!
Very nice lady. Easy A class, but you wont really learn much. If you dont need anything past Calc 2 for your major then take this class. Attendance isn't mandatory.
Great math professor but you have to keep up with material yourself since there's no homework etc.
She is so sweet and gives you multiple attempts on multiple choice questions on exams including the final. (fall 2020)

I've only been to class 3 times all semester and I have a perfect grade in the class. If you're looking for an easy math class definitely take it with her. Best grade I've gotten in my entire college career.

Favorite math professor by far at UM. Minimal work, no exams (except the final), and attendance is not mandatory. If you want a really good understanding of the course material this is not for you, but if you want a stress free course Dr. Bystrik is perfect. So passionate about math and really wants to engage with students and share her knowledge.

This course was very easy to pass. If you actually care to learn about finite math then I suggest not to take this course with her. She goes over all assignments and quizzes in class so you are basically guaranteed a good grade if you show up. There is a final but she goes over the answers in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I can't even tell you what Mth 113 is about but I got an A+. Super easy to do well. Just homeworks, where you get the answers to during class and a final, where you get the answers to in class as well. She is the professor to take! Form a group me at the beginning of the semester and you will get an A

This class is so boring because of the material. prof Bystrik cares a lot and really enjoys teaching, but everyone is so lost in class because of the topics. Assignments and quizzes are done in class with her. There is one extra credit opportunity.

I have never gotten an A in a math class before until this one. Professor Bystrik did all the assignments with us in class, as well as the very few tests we had. The actual content of this class is very hard, but there is no need to worry if you take Dr. Bystrik. Her accent is a little hard to understand sometimes. She is so kind and so passionate.
Amazing didn't learn a single thing and barley showed up and got an A. My advice is make a groupme with the class to share answers.

Lol I did nothing in this class. She gave the test answers before the test so I never went to class. It seemed like she struggled with the online format and just gave everyone A's because of it. Very sweet lady though and I'm sure she's probably a better teacher under normal circumstances.

Dr. Bystrik is always available to help. It is pretty clear that virtual teaching is a bit rough for her and that she shines in person. With that being said, learning the material virtually was definitely not ideal and I had to google some things to make sure I understood them. She was always willing to help and gave tons of easy assignments.
Professor Bystrik is nice but she didn't teach me anything. Her tests were short and she gave you the answers before you took the exam. The class was pointless but an easy A. Not worth my time.

Dr. Bystrik is very knowledgable and interested in math and teaches everything we need to know for our tests. She is not the most organized lecturer when it comes to presenting the material and she has a thick accent but I enjoyed having her.

If you don't actually care about math and don't need to take any classes that build off this, take it. She gives you extra credit just for showing up to class sometimes and she either gives you the answers to the online assignments or you can look them up. She only gives two exams besides the final and you get cheat sheets on them all.

they are trying to make MTH 161 uniform which sucks. Bystrik is a really nice person and decent teacher, but this year they scaled grades down. I had an A+ and ended with an A- because the department was being annoyingly strict. Calc I is becoming the same for every teacher now so really doesn't matter who you take anymore
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Take her class if you can. I never went to class and still got an A. Great professor, really caring, gives TON of extra credit. Make sure you go to the class before the exam tho, cuz that's when she gives a review for the exam. take her class if you can.
She is a great professor but her exams are tough.
Extremely extremely lenient. Gives a lot of extra credit to assure you will pass. Actual material is very hard tho

Her classes are the EASIEST Calculus classes at UM! She permits you to utilize reference sheets on her exams, including the final! She offers SEVERAL extra credit opportunities. However, these reasons are why the Engineering Department dislikes her. I still achieved a "B" in the class having VERY LITTLE knowledge in Calculus and with a tutor!
She is such a sweet lady and cares about all of her students! She is not that good of a teacher, but with a little bit of effort, you can get an A+ in this class. She gives a lot of bonus points.

Honestly not quite as easy to get an A as others would say. I did all of the HWs and didnt get any extra points on them idk how. Still, I never went to class and got an A. I have no clue what Calc 2 is about.

Incredibly nice woman. Also insanely smart too, seems like she understands basically any math out there. Material is hard but gives you so much extra credit for insurance to keep your grade high. If you want to conserve your gpa, this professor is a good choice.

Extremely easy class to get an A in. Tests and quizzes are actually really tough but she allows group tests and occasionally she will let you take it home if nobody finishes on time. As lenient as it gets.

The class content and tests themselves are difficult but she gives numerous opportunities to get extra credit (about 1/3 of all the points I earned were EC) and she practically tells you the answers to test questions. The tests were in groups and you can use your notes and the internet. Show up and do the extra credit and you'll get and A for sure.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT--Would take again

reviews.comment: God bless Dr. Bystrik. Show up to class and she'll literally give you the answers to the tests and let you bring them to the test written on a cheat sheet. Computers allowed on all quizzes. The A is so easy. You won't actually learn a lick of math, though, so if its not your terminal math class probably don't take her class.
If you had her for Calc 1, it's the same exact thing. She really cares about her students! You just need 182 points to get an A. Her class really boosts up your GPA. TAKE HER!!
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: One of my fave professors at UM. She is so nice and wants all her students to get a really good grade. If you don't show up to lectures, you'll still get a good grade but if you do show up you'll get a good grade and actually learn. Also, she gives bonus points for literally everything. So easy to succeed in her class

If you want to actually learn calc 2, dont take Bystrik. just show up to the reviews and copy down verbatim what she writes on the board (no matter how sloppy her notes are), show up in the last five minutes of class to hand in hw, get work from your friends. you can use a comp on quizzes and two pages of notes on exams. super easy A

She has an accent, but you quickly get used to it. Do the HW /practice problems from class and her exam review! No surprises on exams - very similar to the problems she goes over in class. Quizzes are not hard and help out your grade. Also, she is very helpful during office hours! Take her class!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Bystrik is a great person. She genuinely wants everyone to pass her class. Her extra credit opportunities are amazing because you can walk into a final with no worry that you're still gonna get an A in the class. If you want an A TAKE HER, I MEAN IT.

If you need to take more math after calc 2, DON'T take her, it will be hard to learn. If this is your last math course you need, take her! Easy A! You won't learn much unless you teach yourself. Quizzes we get to use laptops & gr. calcs, on exams we get two pgs of cheat sheet & gr. calc. Reviews before quiz/exam which are the only classes I went to

Very Nice Professor.  Kind of tough to understand accent in the beginning of the semester.  She does not teach by interacting with the class.  She is not very organized with her thoughts and her written work is all over the place and messy.  She also goes very fast, as if she expects some knowledge of the subject.  Quiz and Test reviews are KEY!

Great professor when you want help at her office hours, during lecture can be pretty confusing and hard to get across your specific question in a big lecture. Exam Reviews are very similar to tests. Gives extra credit, lecture attendance not mandatory.

Prof. Bystrik is by far the easiest professor. Copy everything from her reviews and she only changes the numbers on the tests. Her accent is heavy but you get used to it after a while.
