Joseph is not ideal, but gets the job done. I had never taken Stats before this class and ended with an A. You will get used to her accent. She doesn't answer emails and gets mad when people ask questions she deems simple or obvious. Pay attention, write down everything, make a good cheat sheet, do some practice questions and you should be fine.
worst accent ever, impossible to understand and worst explainer... only good thing is she will let you have a cheat sheet, but exams a pretty tough

I can't stand this woman. If you're looking to pass, then you'll be fine, but this class is AWFUL. I can't understand her and I'm constantly looking at the clock for the class to be over. No homework, but it doesn't matter because she wouldn't even go over it anyways. You get cheat sheets for tests, which is good because without them I would fail.
She's hard to understand and makes things confusing. Overall, what you're going to study is easy. She goes crazy sometimes but it is funny.

I honestly have no idea why she does not have a 5 point rating. She is the best math teacher I've had at UM. Explains very clear everything and the exams are just  like the in class exercises. She lets you use a cheat sheet in which you can literally write whatever you want. Midterms are simple and the final is semi-hard but not impossible.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Worst teacher in UM, and Im saying this even though I got an A in the class. She literally decides not to answer any questions, and never actually explains the concept of what she's teaching, only teaches were to plug in what numbers without knowing what they mean. Grades test on what she thinks ant not on the actual answers. Take to waste money.

I don't understand how anyone cant get anything lower than a B+ in her class. You really have to try to get anything less than that. She is a good professor and willing to help students who seek it. Not that bad if you actually go to class and pay attention.

Her lectures can be a little irritating at times, however, if you go to class and take notes you'll be fine. The notes will help you with the tests. She's can be difficult sometimes  but she really is a nice lady who wants to help her students. I would recommend her. The people complaining on here are the ones who were on social media during class.

Want a question answered? Good luck  Want an email answered? Good luck She forgot to teach us a topic until my group asked about it Open note tests though, if you can figure out what she is saying and keep up
actually the worst professor i have EVER had. do not take her unless you want to be unbearably frustrated and annoyed the whole semester.

She is not the easiest to understand, but she writes everything on the board.  He tests are open note and open book so as look as you take good notes and are familiar with the book you will be fine.  She also gives reviews packets which are almost exactly like the tests.  She also gives extra credit if you score below an 80 on a test.
awful teacher, do not take her she will never answer your questions so there is no point in seeing her if you need help, DO NOT TAKE HER!!!! possibly the worst teacher at UM
BEST teacher ever! very funny!
WORST teacher ever.  Does not help students if they do not understand the material and is obnoxious...DO NOT TAKE

The material may seem overwhelming but in class notes are not what help. The book is really clear and the power point notes are helpful. Exam open book/open notes. This class is very easy to pass if you study from the book, prepare your book/notes before the exam. Quizzes are take home and HW is not collected. Attendance is not mandatory.

this class is open book open note tests, but dont let that fool you. if you dont have reallllly good clear notes you can still do bad on tests. i would not reccommend this professor, not very clear nor helpful

This is the most ridiculous teacher that I have ever taken.. she didnt even show up for the last day to review for our final.. the whole class got horrible grades. the book is useless. things were on the test that she didnt mention nor were in the book.. DO NOT TAKE HER!!! YOU WILL REGRET IT FOREVER!!!
Open note exams, but hard as hell to understand
Refuses to answer students questions.
Wow...if you can't pass her class, I'd say you have no business being at UM.
No Comments

really dont know how helpful or clear she is because I only went to 6 classes the whole semester 2 to take tests and the other to hand in her EASY take-home quizes. extrem. easy grader if you dont like going to class, she doesnt take attendance and aslong as you study the study guide, u got an A

Dr. Porter is a professor I cannot recommend enough. He's fun and engaging, and if you go to his lectures and pay attention, you're more than fine to do well in the class. A big portion of the grade is a semester-long group project, but the guidelines are clear, and you have ample time to complete everything.
Great professor. Energy is contagious. Definitely recommend.

Actually such an amazing professor. He is so engaging and entertaining. I genuinely loved going to his class he made it fun and easy to comprehend. He is so passionate about what he's teaching and I learned so much from him. If you can take a class with him DO IT. He's actually my favorite professor

Dr. Porter is THE BEST professor, absolutely amazing. I loved walking into his class everyday and learning something new! Always willing to help students and incredibly passionate about the content. TAKE BPH 301!

If you have the chance to take a class with Mr. Porter, DO IT. Porter is one of the few professors i had during my time at UM that genuinely cares about you as a person, and is truly rooting for your success. By the end of the course, (not to be corny)- I left with a sense of purpose and appreciation for healthcare. His drive is truly infectious.

Best professor at UM. If you can take a class with Dr. Porter, I strongly suggest it. He is genuinely interested in Public Health and wants his students to be engaged and succeed. His classes are very engaging and the work load is very manageable especially if you are interested in the topics. He is always willing to speak with his students.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Porter seems likable at first but he's so passive aggressive and holds grudges. He turns things so political and focuses on anything but public health. He can be funny at times but it gets old fast and he prioritizes participation way too much. Gives crazy statistics out of context that make no sense at times. Hated him by the end of the semester.

Really great professor who genuinely cares about his students doing well. Super easy to talk to and makes himself available almost all of the time. Quizzes are online and you are allowed to use your notes and textbook and there are no exams.

Good professor, pretty easy class. 4 open note quizzes, discussions about once a week, no exams, 1 group project. Porter was very engaging in class and expects frequent student participation. Not as writing heavy as some of the other public health classes which was nice. Always willing to help you if needed and easily accessible outside of class

Professor Porter has been the best I've had so far at UMiami. He evidently cares about his students and his class is so interesting. As long as you participate and complete all assignments on time you are guaranteed to do well. He is so passionate about public health and I plan on taking him again. Take Professor Porter!

The praise for this man needs to stop. If you aren't one of his favorites then he's an average professor at best. I'm really not leaving this class different than when I came. Just suffer through the lectures and show up, and do the assignments on time and you'll survive. You don't need the textbooks or his lectures to do the quizzes IMO.

Dr. Porter's global health class has been one of my favorite classes at UMiami. His passion for teaching is what makes it so great, so I know any other class I could take with him would be amazing. The material is interesting, and his method of teaching is interactive and sets everyone in the class up for optimal learning.

I took three courses with Dr. Porter, and each one was a favorite course of mine throughout my four years. His passionate and lively manner of teaching always made classes engaging and left you wanting to learn more. He truly cares about each student, and is always willing to help students in any way he can, inside and outside of the classroom.

Porter is a great professor who makes his lectures enjoyable and funny. He really has a passion for what he does and it shows. Never had a more caring professor than him. He only has a couple of take home quizzes during the semester.

Very passionate about public health and you can tell in his lectures. He cares for his students and is always happy to write letters of recommendation for them. Has strong beliefs in the work he does and he passes that passion and determination down to his students. Great professor and a great connection to have for post grad letters and work.

Dr. Porter is one of my favorite professors at UM! Participation is extremely important in his class, but you will never want to miss as his lectures are extremely interesting and engaging. Could not recommend enough.

Dr. Porter is so inspiring and so passionate about what he teaches. Classes are interesting and very engaging. Beyond the classroom, he is very accessible and easy to talk to. He is always there to offer guidance (academic or not) with his students' best interests in mind. If anyone ever gets the chance to take ANY class with him, they should.

Dr. Porter was one of the best professors I have had at UM. He is so passionate about what he teaches and makes each class so interesting and makes the material so engaging. Not only was this course intriguing, but he makes it very manageable with the amount of work he gives and loads of extra credit. TAKE THIS COURSE!

Dr. Porter is one of the best professors I have ever had. He is so genuine towards his students and cares about not only your education but health. He knows how to make class enjoyable and entertaining. I recommend everyone to take at least one class with him during your time at UM. You will have a new outlook and understanding on life.
Dr. Porter is THE BEST professor I have ever had!

Dr. Porter is such a great professor! He made class fun despite talking about such heavy topics. The set-up of the class is exactly what you would want. You learn a lot of great information and you get to develop your own data visualization, presentation, and research skills as the semester passes. Porter just understands his students and is caring

Andrew Porter is an amazing human, professor, professional, and supporter. He has true passion and drive for everything he teaches, and you will find yourself effortlessly thinking about the material outside of class, with family and friends, etc. Super fun and educational. Cannot say enough great things about him!!

Andrew Porter has got to be one of the best professors I've had at UM. He is so funny and makes our classes fly by. Participation in this class does matter but he makes the class inviting and non-judgmental. He is super accessible outside of class and is willing to help with anything you may need. Don't miss out on a chance of taking a class w/ him

Dr. Porter is one of the most memorable and exceptional teachers I have had. He made me want to work hard and learn and gave me more reasons to fall in love with my passion for public health. If you are passionate about the program his classes will be engaging and worthwhile for your educational journey.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Porter is one of the best professors I have had at UM. His classes are so interesting and you learn so much about public health. I've had many classes with him and would recommend his classes to anyone!

Porter is a professor who truly cares about his students and the quality of his teaching. He always makes sure the information is up to date and that students are not overwhelmed. Participate in class, communicate if you're having trouble, and you will succeed! Take his class. It will make you a better person and student.

Any course with Dr. Porter is a course I would recommend. Dr. Porter is very approachable and a great person overall. You do need to participate in class but the conversations are very engaging and very up to date. You will enjoy going to class and the discussions as well.

Dr. Porter was truly my favorite professor at UM. He is extremely passionate about what he teaches and every class was one I looked forward to. His classes are very interactive with discussions, group projects, and presentations and he makes sure that they are all interesting and relevant topics. If you put in the effort it will be noticed.

One of my most memorable classes at UM! Porter is extremely knowledgeable and makes his class fun. Pay attention in class and the skills you'll learn will last you a lifetime. Don't be afraid to ask questions and don't come late to class!! He creates a safe environment for his students and makes them feel valued. Be ready to learn and youll do fine
Absolute best professor and class I've ever take. Dr. Porter is one of a kind.

Porter is hands down the best professor I have ever had. He knows how to keep his students engaged and talks about topics/issues that are relevant. You have to participate and contribute to the class to get a good grade, but the workload is very manageable. Porter cares about his students -- I've grown a lot through his classes.

Dr. Porter is an awesome professor, and the way he teaches BPH 301 helps students both learn about the subject matter and become prepared for future work in public health and medicine. The lectures are really engaging and class participation is encouraged and important, and the exams were fair and accurately tested what we had learned in the class.

Andrew is easily one of the best professors on UM's campus. He is very knowledgeable about the subject and a great resource for students. His classes are straightforward: show up to class, complete the assignments and you'll be fine. He truly cares about his students in a way that other professors don't, which helps students succeed.

If you have the chance to take Dr. Porter, do it! He was truly one of the most influential professors I had during my time at Miami. He is really clear and outlines what he wants from students in a very manageable and accessible way, so it is never super difficult to do well in his class. I took every one of my Public Health classes I could w/ him!
One of the best professors at UM. Not only is he incredibly smart and respected, but he builds a connection with his class and engages you so no matter the topic class is not boring.

Dr. Porter (Andrew) is easily one of my favorite professors at UM. He's not only incredibly intelligent, but also extremely engaging and kind. From the first day of class, it is evident that he loves teaching and loves his students. If you show that you care and put effort into the class, you will do well. 100000/10 would recommend.

Dr. Porter is a great teacher! He also truly cares for his students, which is hard to come by. He doesn't just lecture at the class but encourages thoughtful and stimulating discussion. The class structure included a final project based on a country of your choice that you spend the semester researching. I highly recommend taking Dr. Porter
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: The best professor I have had at UM. He cares about his students and makes class hilarious and fun. TAKE HIM!

Professor Porter is one of the best professors I have ever had at UM. He makes class super interesting and is a very inspirational person. Going to his class was always a blast and I would always look forward to what hysterical thing he would say next! I took him twice for Intro to public health and his human Sexuality class (favorite class).

I am a senior and this is the first class and professor that I have loved. Porter makes every second of class interesting, engaging, heartwarming, fun, and funny. I never want his class to end. Someone needs to promote him. I'm pretty shy and he makes me want to participate, which is good because it is required. BEST PROFESSOR at UM.

Dr. Porter was one of the most laid back, easy going, yet INTERESTING AND FUN teachers I've had as a public health major. I took both BPH 490 and human sexuality with him. BPH 490 was a lot of work (just the nature of a senior capstone) but Porter made it fun. Human sexuality was super easy and intriguing . An A is definitely easily attainable!

Dr. Porter was the reason that I changed my major to public health. His lectures are engaging discussions, and his assignments are relevant and intentional. I enjoyed every aspect of class, and I never felt that I was doing busy work. As a public health graduate that took over 4 classes with Dr. Porter, I felt prepared for work in the field.

The absolute best. Took three of his classes and is one of the most accessible professors ever. You actually want to listen to him lecture. Only 4 quizzes and reflection papers. This was a 3-hour class and often times I did not realize the time going. Always open to talking after class or before. Wish I wasn't a senior so I could take him forever.

Porter is hands down one of, if not, the best professor I have had during undergrad. I had him for multiple classes, but BPH 310 was the first class I took with him. Level 4 difficulty since there is a lot of work, but it is not hard to get an A. For every class I've taken with him (total of 4), he never failed to inspire me in one way or another.

Porter is amazing. You have to talk in class, participation is a major part of the class and you won't get anything out of it if you don't participate. The textbook he gives is actually really interesting.

Dr. Porter is the absolute best professor at UM. The way he plans his Human Sexuality course is brilliant. I gained such a high insight into real world matters that ill carry with me forever. If youre looking for a meaningful letter of rec, hes your guy, Dr. Porter creates a personalized individual letter for each student.

One of the best teachers I have had in my life! He makes everything so interesting and engaging and I actually felt comfortable sharing thoughts during class discussion. I also love that his emphasis was more on appreciating and understanding the information rather than giving quizzes or test questions just to trick/ask irrelevant details.

Dr. Porter opened my eyes to the real world and legit is the most inspirational professor I have ever had. He opens the class up to discuss topics for 90% of the class period and makes it so easy to participate. I used to hate talking in class and he made it so easy to want to engage in conversation. If I could take his class every semester I would

Hands down the BEST professor I've had at UM. He makes learning fun and relatable. Easy grader with lots of opportunities to earn extra credit. I was actually sad when the semester ended because I loved this class so much. Won't regret taking him!!

People have been telling me to take a class with Dr. Porter for the last 3 years and after 1 week I totally understand why and why there is always a huge waitlist to get in. By the 2nd day of class he knew everyone's name, he's quirky and funny, the time flies by, you can tell he cares about both the subject and the students in the class. He makes

THE BEST MOST ENTERTAINING PROFESSOR I ever taken. I love this guy FYI he is gay. I woke up early mornings just to learn about stuff I care about and that is current with a side of comedy. The class is very interactive and informative, you will learn a variey of important topics that should be mandatory to know living in our current society!

Dr. Porter is easily the best professor at UM. I am a senior and wish I would have found him earlier. This is the only class I have ever looked forward to going to every day and was upset on the few days I had to miss for travel. If you come to class, participate, and turn in the assignments you are guaranteed to have a great semester. A++++ class!

Great Professor! Professor Porter is truly there to make sure you get the most out of his class & your educational experience as a whole. I would recommend him to absolutely any & everyone! Make sure you're there everyday & participate, do the assignments he gives & you should be just fine. Great class, great professor, great experience hands down.

BPH321 has been, by far, the most useful class I have taken as a Public Health student. Dr. Porter teaches you model-based intervention in order to change behaviors and gives you good insight into research while managing to make the class fun and engaging. MUST TAKE!!!

Dr. Porter is the best professor I've had by a far shot. He engages with his students and truly cares about the material of the class (as a sex researcher himself). The class has a lot of triggering materials but is overall super interesting and fun and should be mandatory for all Public Health students.

Dr. Porter is hands-down one of the best educators I've had, period. He truly does care about his work and his students, and that passion shines in his lectures.  In practice, his classes are fairly graded and interesting. I've taken four classes with him and he was a strong influence in my decision to pursue a career in public health.
I just came here to say that Dr Porter is everything you want in a teacher. He is funny, knowledgeable, caring, and keeps his classes interesting. He definitely wins the award for best dressed too.

Dr. Porter is basically the light of my life. Human Sexuality is one of the greatest classes I've ever taken. He's so funny and interesting, and really deeply cares about his subject matter, and will make you care about it, too. I'm just sad this is the last class for my minor, because I can't take another class with him.

Dr. Porter expects a lot from students in terms of participation. It's pretty easy though as his lectures are engaging. There are a lot of assignments but his criteria are very clear so if you actually put in effort you'll do fine. Definitely my favorite professor at UM so far.

The best teacher I've ever had! Dr. Porter is amazing and goes above and beyond his obligations as a teacher. There are very few courses at UM that I leave feeling like a better person  and Dr. Porter made that possible.  His teaching method is really engaging and makes it easy and fun to learn. If you can take his classes, you won't regret it.

Dr. Porter is an amazing professor, and by far one of the best I've had at Miami. He is very organized, he is a fair grader, and a very interesting lecturer. Attendance and participation are important, but he does give plenty of extra credit options throughout the semester. He is overall a great professor, and definitely take him if you can.
BEST. PROFESSOR. EVER.

I am a senior graduating in December and I can honestly say that after 5 years at UM Dr Porter is the best professor I've had. He expects a lot from you in terms of assignments and presentations but he wants to see you succeed and helps you get the grade you want.  Make sure you get him off topic, it is hilarious when he tells stories or rants!
Amazing & Worth taking!!
Dr. Porter never failed to make the lessons fun and engaging even with some of the course content being dry. Would take another class with him in a heartbeat.

I've had Dr Porter for several classes in public health, but this is by far the best. It should be a required course for every student at UM. Dr  Porter makes me want to come to class and I end up learning more than I do in any other class. Best professor at UM!

He is the best professor I have ever had throughout my 4 years in college! I made sure to always enroll in his class because he has an amazing way of teaching and broadening your perspective. I would definitely recommend him to everyone!
Dr Porter's class was my favorite of my last semester at UM. Best professor I ever had at UM.

Professor Porter is teaching my nursing health disparities class and it is the first time I've actually had to think. The course is easy in that he wants you to get a good grade and will work with you but hard because the material is challenging and he doesn't accept repeating back answers. He also requires attendance and participation.

I'm currently taking Dr Porters health promotion class and it is amazing. He takes dense and boring material and brings it to life with interesting examples and activities. I actually enjoy going to class and never miss a day. I love how he is willing to discuss any topic from multiple perspectives. He does require participation so if you don't tal

I just graduated and I am so glad I took Dr Porters class. I actually looked forward to going to class every day.  I have a new knowledge of Global Health and a different perspective on global issues. I learned a great deal in this class and consider it time very well spent. I would encourage other students to take this class.
Probably the best teacher I've had so far in college, it was different from my other classes but I had fun learning and actually looked forward to it. I would take anything he was teaching.

I just wanted to say that this class has been my favorite class throughout all my years of college. I am more than thankful to have had Dr Porter as a professor, you he is by far the best professor I have ever had.

Dr.Porter's class is great. It is the 1st class I've taken that makes me think. He doesn't just read from the powerpoint, he engages everyone and feels like its an open floor for discussion. (so refreshing) I only have great things to say about the class. I hope he stays at SONHS and teaches in all programs, because he has a talent for it.

Dr. Porter was my favorite undergraduate professor. He is so passionate about health promotion and it makes class fun! He doesn't waste your time with silly papers or big exams but when he does give an assignment, he expects excellence. He does have strong opinions so don't take this class if you get offended easily.

This was my favorite class this semester. Dr Porter made class interesting, relevant, and fun to learn. Watch out though, he is a hard grader but will give you chances to make up work you've messed up. I can say, I wish I would have taken more of my classes with him, I would have learned more and had more fun doing it.
Would take again!!

reviews.comment: I loved this professor! Not only was the class pretty easy, but I genuinely learned so much from his lectures, he's very engaging. There are quizzes every Friday and only two exams which he basically gives you a study guide with a couple questions and the exam will be directly from that. There's homework but it's very easy and quick to complete.

Quizzes every Friday - he cancels class ALOT. Every class is a lecture. Quizzes are easy but not based on questions he gives you in class. Study really hard for his exams because they are all free response and cover a lot of material. I love this professor, super engaging and conversational. Has a great classroom environment.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very nice, likable guy. Lectures are interesting, he doesn't just directly read off powerpoint. Every week there is a homework assignment and a quiz. So easy.

As a required class, he does way to much and is tooo strict on attendance. Its so clear he has his favorite students. He doesn't care about what you have going on outside of school. Get ready to be overwhelmed, be treated differently if you are not one of his favorites, and not enjoy this class. This is one of the few classes that I dread going to.

Professor Green assigned more homework than any of my core classes as a stem major. I was consistently drowning in work and it made it difficult to like the class. Honestly if he doesn't like you, you will not do well in the class. Additionally, he takes attendance and participation VERY serious.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Green genuinely improved my writing skills. The course includes three major essays and regular homework, so it requires consistent effort. If you stay on top of the work, the class is manageable and rewarding. Bad reviews are those who don't show that they care about the class

Assignments and essay prompts are always so confusing. You have to write down exactly what he says in person in order to have a CHANCE of doing the assignment correctly or knowing when it was due. The discussions in class are lowkey fun and easy but other than that his class is just confusing.

He is a bad teacher with lots of work, dropped out of his class within a week and best thing I have ever done. Lots of better professors who you will learn the same amount but it will be much easier. Tons of homework assignments that each took 2 plus hours.
he has very specific expectations on how he wants you to complete work. he favors certain students in the class and if you are not one of those you will not get the grade you want.
He assigned so much work. Like why was a first year writing class harder than my core classes. It's doable but I really recommend taking anyone else if you can
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: This man does not like to cut you any slack whenever you think differently or creatively in a way that is not his own. If you miss a class past the first month, chances are that you are gonna lost 10% of your grade on that paper because they all matter for one reason or another. Stay away from this class, it is literal torture to step into.

Professor Green is one of my favorite teachers I've ever had. However, there is a lot of homework and 3 essays that are graded tough, so it is a lot of work to succeed in it. You will learn how to be a great writer.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dude teaches like he has a gun pointed at his head. 0 leeway. I'd walk in every day and think to myself "here we go again" if he doesnt like you, you will not get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very condescending. If you don't think the way he expects you to, you get a bad grade. His lectures are very much “using big words to sound photosynthesis”. Take literally anyone else, because he will treat you like a 2 year old. He made me argue after class for my own paper in order to get an A because he didn't like my answer. RUN FAR AWAYYYYY!!!
Nice guy, but the homework is unnecessary and he makes us to give feedback on his students' papers for him.
Some policies are annoying and there is some work that feels unimportant but overall he's pretty decent. Just go to class do the work it's not that hard.
This guy is impatient and gives absolutely no leeway when it comes to asking for extensions. Kind of rude too. Petty.

For it being a required writing class he takes it very seriously. He assigns a lot of busy work and most of the time it's not graded. The bulk of the grade is from 3 papers. You also have to spend over $50 to buy movies/tv shows you need for the class. His writing process is lengthy and does not help.If you can put up nonsense you can get an A
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Literally the worst professor ever. He takes his job way too seriously and will not excuse late work or absence for anything. No matter if you are sick, dealing with personal or family issues, NOTHING. He grades so harshly even if you do the exact revisions he tells you to. The only English class I have ever gotten a B- on a paper. Do not recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: STAY AWAY AT ALL COSTS

You definitely need to put a lot of effort into writing the essays in this course. There are many short assignments so one bad grade won't hurt you. He gives very thorough feedback for your rough drafts and many classes are spent improving your writing ability. He is a very nice teacher who has a lot of interesting stories to tell.

This class is no walk in the park - expect a heavy workload of homework, readings, and weekly papers. While the content can be engaging, the professor's grading and feedback are often vague. Using Unstuck study alongside the textbook may help manage the workload.

His classes are definitely entertaining but he gives unnecessary amounts of work. Even though this is a freshman's course, he tries to turn it into an upper English class. If you want to keep your mental health in check, I would not recommend you take this class with this professor. P.S his feedback doesn't tend to be clear/helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: BE CAREFUL, expects you to be on time when he cant even get your grades on time. totally not patient, had a personal issue going on and he did not help me at all, almost failed my assignment (that was 1 third of the final grade). So if you struggle with mental health and have family issues that can lead you to miss class, please dont take him!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Nice and funny guy who knows what he's talking about but maybe not the best professor. takes the class too seriously for a freshmen year writing class, clearly has favorites and grades a bit harshly. Would not retake the class but not a hard one to pass. get all the assignments done on time and participate to get a good grade in the class

Treats a mandatory freshman year english course as if it is a masters course for prospective journalists or authors. Every other mandatory course has been taught by a chiller who let us know that it would be easy, but in this course you will have a 10-30 page reading every class with a mandatory response. All assignments due at 9pm day before class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Going into the class, I was nervous because of his reviews but as long as you put in the work, you will be fine. He can tell if you spent a lot of time on your papers and if you haven't so don't write them in one night. He gives thorough feedback on essays and is available to meet and discuss them.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He's a very nice and funny guy. The only issues I have are that he hands out so many unnecessary homework assignments and a lot of busy work and gives such small time windows to work on them. It's like he forgets we have other classes and a life. He also takes forever to grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Andrew Green is an amazing professor. I'm not sure why he has any bad ratings to begin with, but I am here to encourage you to take his class. At first, there were various annoying homework assignments, however, once you got those few over with, there were just 3 remaining papers for the semester. He is very nice and wants his students to succeed.

If you would like preserve your sanity please avoid taking this class. While classes can be  entertaining and mostly discussion based, we are given extensive amounts of homework and readings to complete in usually a short period of time. Coupled with the other engineering classes it becomes extremely overwhelming.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He sends so much hmw and papers, he takes an awful long time to grade anything, he expects us to behave like english majors even though everyone in the class is an engineering student. I would not recommend his course to anyone.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: The class is very participation heavy everyone has a voice in the class. This makes the classroom a lot less intimidating. Gives credit where credit is due and is flexible with deadlines always trying to encourage students to do what they feel will help them produce the best work. You will see improvement in your writing.

Very unhelpful professor. I was an international student and I took his class when it was my first semester as such. I told him that I might need a little extra explanation and help from you, and he said, I will not give extra help. Nobody told you to come study in the States. Not recommended for international students.

Don't get me wrong - Andrew green is a nice professor and is always available when you need him. But, when it comes to the actual class, he is a terrible grader. He grades as if we are grad students and gives TONS of homework. He also gets mad when things are late - but never grades things on time. DO NOT TAKE HIM IF POSSIBLE!

I graduated three years ago, I took his class in my first semester. I was just remembering the good and bad memories of my journey at the university.

I just remembered the worst class I have attended to was this
- You feel lost when you attend "Bored"
- No grading citirea 

I would never take his class again "NEVER" 
Just wanted to help :D
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Green should not be a professor, he does not care, he is not intelligent, or even accessible to provide help to his students. Avoid at any cost. Such a shame that the University of Miami has this clown teaching English.

Always out to get you if you were not his class pet. Sends too much homework. 5-10 hours a week. He thinks he is doing you a favor by sending movies for homework. Only class I ever did bad in. Do not take unless you are an english major.

I would say that I hated this class- but not because of Professor Green himself. He is a super nice guy and understanding and definitely keeps you engaged - but gives an ABSURD amount of work for an INTRO level class! I wouldn't recommend taking it as it was so time consuming and the stress isn't worth it.

Professor Green treats an intro english class like youre all english majors. Every single class has 1-3 hours of homework at least and there are huge papers every 1-2 weeks. If you take him be prepared to watch a lot of tv/movies and read a ton, as well as spend an hour + on focus questions for each text. Ridiculous amount of work for eng 106
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers

reviews.comment: Prof Green is a nice man. Although this is true, you will have to write 2 papers every week. I had class two times a week and got an assignment every class due for the next class. Not only do you have to write a lot, but you will have to watch long movies/TV shows and read long articles. Green being nice doesn't weigh out how much work you get.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: If you choose this course, work evry ngiht, paper every week, reading questions every week, please do not take his course!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: You know how the current, in-use American flag was created for a school project and the student who made it received a B-? That teacher was probably similar to Professor Green. If you go to him for feedback, you can expect a lot of vague advice. Met with him on essays multiple times outside of class to revise and still got C's on them. Do not take
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Green will definitely make you work for a good grade but his class is totally worth it. You will come out of the class a better writer for sure. Just put effort in on the homework (which is easy), participate in class once in a while, and don't put off the essays til the night before and you'll do great. Best prof I've had so far.

He really helps you improve your writing, meeting with him outside of class is really helpful. He really cares about his students' success and is willing to give you as much feedback as you need. He also values hardwork so try your best to exceed expectations. Also tries to make sure grade isn't based on big papers only, there are other assignments
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers

reviews.comment: Prof. Green is such a caring person and he genuinely wants to help you. Yes, there are a lot of assignments but theyre super interesting and thought provoking. His essays make you think a lot but the process makes you a better writer after the class. Definitely take him!

One of the best teachers I have ever had. He challenges you to think outside of the box and be better. Anyone who is on here complaining is truly just lazy. You may think that it is a time consuming class but when you actually finish the assignments it improves thinking and grows you as a person. And that's what college is supposed to be about.

This teacher will literally sit there, grade your paper on his scale that makes zero sense, and then LOWER your score because your paper wasn't as good as it "could have been". Newsflash, things are not worse because they aren't better, that's just now how things work.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Green is an amazing English teacher. If you've never been challenged in writing, you will now. You have to work for your grade and sometimes he has weird deadlines, but you will actually learn in his course. He grades tough, but also leaves a lot of room to prove your dedication to a paper and improve your grade. Don't wait till the last minute!

I honestly loved professor Green and his attitude toward teaching. This was the one class I looked forward to, and the class discussions were always engaging. He does grade essays quite hard, but you can tell he wants his students to succeed, so its important to email him or go to office hours if you're struggling with a paper.

This guy gives homework as if his students are english majors. AT LEAST 2 hours a day on studying!! The amount of time you need to spend on his work is out of this world. If you like writing about life for two hours a day take his ENG 106... if not, then DO NOT take this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He really is a good teacher just kind of gives boring assignments. You can tell he really loves English and his job... its just really hard. 11/10 for his attitude though! if you have the choice go for the nice old lady (I don't remember her name) for English for engineers

If you haven't gotten the idea from the other reviews, don't take this professor. ENG105 is taught by multiple professors and you can get someone who will give you the grade you deserve, not a grade much lower. Far too tough of a grader and doesn't give useful feedback at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: you have to be super engaged in class and do the readings, but he makes class really interesting and fun!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Andrew Green is a very interesting and passionate teacher. His class requires you to read short stories and watch movies that are in very good taste. Class discussions are very engaging. Essays are a lot of work and require you to think abstractly and outside the box. I learned a lot about my writing as well as philosophy from this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Professor Green is very friendly and approachable. Attendance is mandatory, but his class is interesting. His essay process was sometimes annoying because much of the grade goes into outlines/annotations/peer reviews and his comments could be vague. However, I do believe he grades fairly and he loves giving extra credit on blackboard assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: AVOID AVOID AVOID. DONT take his section of ENG106. You will do way more work than you will in any other ENG106 class. Not much of a complainer when it comes to work load, but this teacher just assigns so much unnecessary and time consuming crap. Only 50% essay grade is your final draft, the rest is intensive peer editing. Save yourself the trouble
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr Green uses a 3 step torture approach via 3 essays. Sir Green loves implications; any mention sends Professor Green into an "A+" frenzy. The Master Overlord of the Seas might be a little nearsighted and Vice Chancellor Green often confuses students, but don't blame it on His Excellency; Lord and Savior Green XI Jr. Sr. simply forgot his glasses.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Disappointed with the grade he gave. Did so much work and receive an unfair feedback.

The man has no idea what he is talking about. He tries to make points that are original, but doing so just ends up regurgitating thoughts and ideas that are very common. The only two words hell give you for feedback are superfluous and focus. Ive never had an English teacher with such a limited vocabulary. Kinda makes you feel bad for the man.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: took Mr green both semesters of freshman year and thought he was amazing! keeps lectures interesting and really cares about the students and remembers details about each.  wish he taught more classes so that I could take him again, gives good feedback and made me a stronger writer
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: If English isn't your major, don't take him. I worked hard and got nothing. He asks for something original, yet complains if you don't see what he sees. He gives vague feedback and doesn't help. I took all my essays to three professors who said they were "A material" before turning them in. He gave me a C on each one with no good reason to do so.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: not terrible but not great. I think his teaching style was just not a good match for me though.  My level of stress went up walking into class because he randomly calls on people and will make you look really dumb if you don't give a really good answer.  He never intentionally tried to make people look/feel  bad but sometimes it still felt like it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Just avoid this professor at all costs. Dude doesn't know what he is talking about. Honestly feel like he just needs someone to talk to. Green sees a fault in everything everyone writes but says that he wants to give everyone a good grade. Its not that he is a tough grader, I just feel like he doesn't know how to grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Green is a really good professor and the class taught me a lot about my own writing. But that being said, in order to get a good grade you definitely need to come to class, get your drafts done, participate especially during peer reviews, and use the peer reviews to your advantage.

I went to all his office hours and emailed him constantly. His feedback was useless. I've had an A in every English class I've ever taken until Green.  No matter how hard I tried I got a C on every assignment. I finally got a B and because I was at a funeral (I had proof I was really at a funeral) and missed a peer edit he gave me a C again. AWFUL!

Green is actually a very caring professor. He wants his students to succeed, but he also wants them to respect him. If you fail to come to class, do your work, or respect him/peers in class, you will not pass. Other than that, you do have to work hard to write a solid paper but he give great feedback during office hours and commends extra work.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: I've done each assignment that he gave us on time, and I never skipped a single class. Yet he gives me C just because I'm not a native American.

Professor Green was on the most part very welcoming and comforting the first few weeks of class. Even though I passed the class, I expected a higher grade  than I thought. Take advantage of the online peer reviews it helps a lot. He is a tough grader and his prompts for essays are quite confusing. Don't buy the book. Waste of money.

Overall, Andrew Green's class is fairly easy. However, he is not at all a good professor. He thinks he provides you with the best of feedback on your rough drafts when he in fact does not. Also, he is big on attendance meanwhile he says nothing useful in his lectures. Be prepared for him to go on and on about his short time spent at oxford.
Go to class and do your work on time. There are easier teachers

I was never a fan of English courses in high school but I still did fairly well - mainly B's. I really liked Greens class though, he made class as witty and interesting as he could and was always there to help you with your papers.
Amazing Professor, very helpful, assignments are clear, offers to guide you throughout your papers, gives great advice
He doesn't explain well what you did wrong on the papers, just vague answers. class is mandatory. For a english for engineers class its too hard and too much work.

Professor Green is one of my favorites at UM. Disregard any negative reviews. If you simply check over your work like you are supposed to and don't procrastinate, then you will do fine. The class is built for peer review and draft writing, and of course your going to get a bad grade if you don't put in any effort. TAKE HIM.

He grades very harshly for a class that is mainly for freshmen. I've only ever gotten As in previous English classes, but I got Bs on all my essays. People in other sections of English 105 have told me how easy it is to get an A, so if you're really concerned about your GPA take this from another professor.

I'll admit that some of his exercises were quite interesting and helpful. That being said, he is not a good professor. He is highly unfair and biased when it comes to grading. I've always been a good writer and I failed this class. I took it again afterwards with professor Johnson and got an A. I definitely don't recommend him.

Although it's been a bit of time since I took Andrew Green's class, I'll still say that he is a very unreasonable guy who expects way too much for a class that deals with freshmen. I got an A+ in a higher writing class I took after him, but a B- in his class, despite my work quality being around the same. If your GPA mattes to you, AVOID him.

Dr. Green is sarcastic and witty. He wants to give As to those who deserve it. To those of you who can write, his class is very easy. He is always willing to help. Keep up the participation and always do online postings. Showing up to class is a must.

Very helpful if you go to his office hours. He is a very committed person who honestly wants to give people an A if they deserve it. If you put yourself into the subject and really engage, you can get a good grade. His class discussions are actually very interesting and thought provoking. Hard class but I thoroughly enjoyed my experience. Great guy

Gotta say, one of the hardest teachers at UM. He expects far too much from his students, and his comments don't exactly help to bring you to his desired destination. His advice typically goes something like "vague," "abstract," or "could have done more with the quote." But most people got Cs. Do the best you can if your stuck with him.

Pretty easy to get along w/ in class & keeps the mood light. Very UNCLEAR with his feedback on essays. Simply says things like "you could've explored more by doing xyz." Always. He's def an ideologue & from time to time drops irrelevant political messages (it helps to just agree w/ the guy). In summation, AVOID if possible!

One of the worst english teachers I have ever had. He expects way too much of your writing and grades at at least a graduate level. I suggest not taking his class, because it's almost impossible to do well.

Professor Green makes the class fun, engaging, and helps the time pass quickly. He's a nice guy who seems to have a passion for this subject. However, the class does require a lot of work. Be ready to read a lot! Also, in my opinion, he expects a bit too much for the essays. You will learn a lot though.

Dont take his classes. The actual class is relatively laid back but he expects the world with his assignments. His comments are not helpful. You can write prolifically about a topic & his only comment will be along the lines of "you could have/should have done.." Also, he assigns a boatload of useless exercises that are a waste of time & irrelevant

Well, it's a mandatory class and Drew doesn't make it painless. Keys to know: allowed to miss 2 classes, after that takes half letter grade off. Horrible jokes. Overall not a bad guy I guess, you learn a decent amount, but it is a fairly difficult class. Avoid if you can, could be a bit worse, could be MUCH better.
Andrew Green is an absolutely awful professor. Don't. Take. Him.

You get what you put in. He's very willing to help students during office hours. I was almost never bored in his class. If you want an easy A don't take him. If you want a teacher that has a passion for what he does and are willing to be prepared for class discussions, then you'll enjoy this class.

Gives 1 bonus pt for perfect attendance. As long as you work hard on your essays and show him your effort and participate in class, you can get an A - he raises your grade depending on your effort.  He's a hard grader but he's extremely helpful if you ask for it.  You'll learn a lot from him.  Also for essays, you get a lot of peer review.

After taking 106 with him after 105, I firmly believe the Professor Green is one of the best professors at UM. He's incredibly helpful with regard to everything in class, and will spend a lot of time and effort working with you to improve your writing. And the best part is that he does it because he truly cares, not just because it's his job.

Difficult class mainly due to his very vague teaching and overall unhelpfulness.  In class he gives alot of BS exercises that do not teach anything towards writing.  He is obnoxious and almost nearly gave me a D not because of my work but because he messed up my grade on the grade calculator.

Ay Lord. Don't take. He thinks he's your friend & tries to give advice for your personal life. In grading and advice for Eng, utterly useless. His comments for rough drafts are horrible. Super unclear, a lot of boring work, not too hard, but doesnt provide enough help. Take Martha Otis! She's amazing.

I don't get all the comments.  I mean, yeah, he's difficult and yeah there is a lot of reading, but it's like no one expected to work or do anything when they came here.  It's kind of embarassing.  I mean he told me what to do when I got a bad grade and he told me how to do it again and I did better.  You learn a lot.

Green is a tough grader.  He has high expectations for final drafts.  If you miss more than 2 classes it hurts your grade.  Most of the essays you read are boring. Strict on deadlines. If you can find another english teacher, do so.

Even though English is my first language and I have been doing great since high school. Now I have completely lost my interest because of this bloody class. This professor needs to take a break. HIGHLY NOT RECOMMENDED!

Worst professor I've had so far. Extremely tough grader and very strict about deadlines. Also, he'll put your grade in his class entirely in the hands of one other student. He doesn't look over your rough drafts. He has other, untrained students do it. If you get a crappy student, good luck passing his class.
worst professor ever..

Overall terrible experience.  I got an A in ENG105 and now I dropped to a D-??  Very disrespectful with grades; he gave out at least 5 on our first paper in a 15 person class.  Judges your writing once and then if he thinks it is bad, it is impossible to improve.  Do not take this course

Awesome professor. If you want to learn, take him. He is extremely helpful, and will put out a little extra effort to help you if you ask nicely. You will need to work, and spend some time on your essays. Never leave your reading until the morning before class... Highly recommended.

English was my favorite subject throughout my high school and college life. After taking this class I would rather drop out of college than attend once more of his useless classes.You will absolutely hate this class. The man thinks he is next Hemingway so his grades are based on that BS. WORST CLASS EVER. I beg you not to take this class!

Green is a very tough grader when it comes to essays. His critiques on rough drafts can be very unclear and when you get to the final draft it shows in your grade. Although I do feel like I am a better writer from his class, it was not an easy road to get a good grade. Also, the class is quite boring and expect to listen to his corny jokes.

Andrew Green is helpful at times when at office hours or by appointment. However, his grading scheme is all over the place. He does not grade on the quality of the essay and thinks a C on a paper is good. The good part is there are only 3 papers but some of the minor assignments are useless. Movie nights are a waste of time. I do not recommend.
real bad.  don't take.

He is a very tough grader, take advantage of his office hours, he loves students who show concern for their essay's, and grade for the class. If you follow his criteria you should do fine, but his class is A LOT of work...but he helped me become a better writer in the end.

Tough grader.  Feedback is often ambiguous.  Essay topics are different but interesting.  Likes to make students mimic academic essays rather than be original.  Nice man who is willing to help.  Take advantage of his office hours. Recommended for decent writers-- you will do well.  If you consider yourself a poor writer, there is no hope of an a.

i personally like him as a person and he's a great teacher. I definitely grew a lot as a student from his class but I will say that it was ALOT of work. For every paper I went in to see him twice and went to the writing center. I would have at least a couple of drafts for every paper, so decide if its worth your time and effort.

You will either love him or hate him, but most people hate him.  I think it was really funny because our class united in disliking him, which made way for some interesting conversations.  As for grading, if you participate a lot in class (lots of discussion) and can write semi-well, you don't have to worry.  I got an A, but it was definitely tough.

WORST TEACHER EVER.  I never before got lower than an A in English including an A+ in english 105 and this dude goes off with comments like "this is good work, C+".  If only we could all write like he does.
he was one of my worst experience at UM. DO NOT TAKE HIM EVER
DO NOT TAKE!!!!! BY FAR THE WORST TEACHER AT UM. DOES NOT CARE ABOUT STUDENTS AND TAKES PLEASURE IN HANDING OUT BAD GRADES. TERRIBLE!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

He's a pretty hard grader, but the class can be interesting and funny. He's pretty understanding. Grade is based on 3 essays, class participation, and homework which is usually online postings about the works being studied. Dont take him if you want an A
He sucks,He is a waste of time.WORST PROFESSOR EVER.

It's only the middle of the term, and I wish I would have listened to what other people posted! Way to much work for a basic writing class. Plus Green is really annoying, he likes to pick on the people who he knows wont know the anwser.
Calls on people in class which is kinda annoying especially if you arent paying attention. Interesting class though as far as an English class goes. Three papers 4-5 pages each.

Professor Green can either be a teacher you really love or really hate. He comes off as a jerk sometimes, but he's really a good-hearted guy who wants you to work really hard and has some fun doing it. His classes are informal and you can say anything you want as long as you can back it up. If you life discussions and proving your point, he's great

This class was very helpful to my development of writing. He is very nice and class discussion are alot of fun.His class gave me the opportunity to make friends. Take advantage of his office hours. His class is based on 3 papers and there are three long readings. Never tells you one is wrong just looks for evidence.Writing topics are unique.

This guy is such a square. His class is too much work, not fun, and overall terrible! How can anyone give him a good score? I think he rated himself for some of these because NOBODY likes his class! Run away!!!
yeah he helps you develop good writing skills but hes not enjoyable by any means, if you're looking for a tough class, this is it..... also suggest don't do it

Great teacher, but don't expect an easy A. He focuses a lot on the process on writing and really helps you develop your skills as a writer. Only 3 big papers throughout the semester and not too much reading at all, but definitel challenges you to work on the writing process. I would reccomend him if you want to improve your skills as a writer, but

Andrew Green is a very pompous man.  He is willing to give extra help, but when I followed his suggestions I received little to no improvement in my grade.  He is very sarcastic and rude.  He made a comment saying vegetarians go against "God", as if anglo-saxon christian are the only students to attend UM.  Do not take his class.
TERRIBLE ATTITUDE

You will learn a ton in this class but there is a lot of work. He is very interested in your education and the class and expects the same of you, just for the class I hope. If you follow his recomendations and ask for extra help and follow it you will get an A in his class.
DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS! it is not an easy class and there is a lot of reading for homework. he is extremly sarcastic and in your face. to much work and not a good time... no no no dont do it

He's a horrible teacher, expecting massive amounts of work to be done in short time as if students dont have any other classes. He is extremely strict as far as absences go, only allowing 2 although he himself has missed more. The class overall is very boring in subject matter.

i liked green alot. the subject was boring as hell. and though he came off as being a strict teacher, he was very courteous and gave back alot of feedback which def helped my writing. overrall, good teacher

He's probably the best English teacher I've ever had. He's tough but not so much that you feel like you want to kill yourself. He's respectful of ideas and really encourages class discussion. He has no problem talking to students about papers and offers lots of help and if you take advantage of what he offers you should do great.

wow... this class was way intense. he gives you a lot of work, but if you take advantage of the help he will give you outside of class (which is limitless), and you attend class (HUGE, he does not mess around when it comes to absences), your writing will improve, you just have to be ready to work hard. he is a very hard grader.

Terrible. Most of us in this class are confused as to what he is asking for on the assignments (the standard response to our essays is "you can't just do ____, you have to do MORE.") Just a bad teacher, pure and simple. This class started out with 31 or so students, and has now dropped to 14. Refuses to give extra credit. A bad, bad, bad teacher.

He is a horrible teacher. A rude, arrogant ****. Makes you think he is bending over backwards for you, where in reality he is doing absolutely nothing to help you at all. He is stuck up, doesn't care about anything but himself, and he doesn't care if someone dies or you are in the hospital - bitter ****.
Not a bad teacher, though at times selfish and arrogant. Will do little to help students; definitely won't go out of his way to do so.
He's really nice and helpful.... cute butt.

He is an excellent teacher and a great guy. He does like to challenge you to write well, and he does have relatively high standards, but his class is very rewarding. His class is also very fun, and I sometimes even miss it. I would reccomend this class only if you are a decent writer to start with.

The class is challenging, you definitely cannot bs your way through it.  The grade is basically 3 essays.  Class discussions are fun, he never will just tell you your idea is wrong, he'll just ask for textual support.  I loved his class.  I went in hating literature, and by the end of the semester, I had a true appreciation for it.  I left a better writer as well, and the difficulty was worth it.  He was there to help academically, and with personal problems.  I highly reccomend his class!
No Comments

Very bad professor. Don't take this guy if you don't absolutely have to. The class is unnecessarily difficult, and the writing just doesn't seem very relevant. Green seems to favor girls. Avoid this class if you can.

He tries to be helpful.  He's available to meet with students, but tries to be an emotional support rather than an academic one at times.  Assignments often seem nothing but busy work, but the essays can be challenging for Freshmen.  Grading techniques are curious.  He seems very easily impressed by papers obviously written with a thesaurus in each hand masquerading as a strong vocabulary.
I felt that he was condescending and unclear in his grading techniques.

Professor Green is a nice guy, and I guarantee that if you take his class, you will be challenged and learn new techniques to become a better writer. This class inspired me to Minor in English and helped me realize my writing potential.

i've had him two semesters in a row and he can be quite pompous from time to time, but it's easy to pass the class. 3 papers and no final (for freshman english). his grading is weird and he's awkward, but he's clear about assignments and papers. the class goes by pretty fast so it's not too bad.
I thought that his lectures were boring and had very little effect on the assignments. The essays seemed as if they were just thought up by a chimp. They were ridiculously(sp) hard.

Green is a nice guy and for the most part, all the minor assignments in his class are easy.  There isn't that much work to do.  However, I don't think like how he grades the major assignments (70% of grade).  I hear other teachers are better than him.
No Comments
No Comments
Why is someone who thinks he is so smart, teaching freshman english?
No Comments
I wish I could give him lower than a 1. Just avoid. Read all the other reviews
Awful professor
AVOID!!!! LIKE SERIOUSLY AVOID.
He cold calls constantly and talks about politics every lecture. I would avoid he is not a good professor.

Avoid him pls. WORST professor I ever had. Nothing relate to the topic brand management. Nobody gets his terrible example at all. Too late to drop the class. Call people all the time. You have way better options you can choose for major.

what a waste of my time. one of the WORST marketing professors ive ever taken. calls on people non stop. MAKES THINGS SO COMPLICATED. doesnt talk about anything to do with brand content management. gives dumb examples and no one KNOWS what hes talking about.

I have loved having Professor Francois for JMM102. There was barely any homework, just a reading assignment every few weeks. Total of 4 exams and she gives a review powerpoint before each one. Great and very fair teacher. You will have tests somewhat frequently, but they are easy to manage and cover a fair amount of chapters at a time. Attendance is mandatory, so just show up and try your best. She is very understanding and a great resource.
Reads off PowerPoint slides.
Very easy course. Professor Francois is so kind and engaging, I recommend this as an easy elective.

Professor Francois is extremely nice and cares about her students. She tries to make her class engaging even though there is a lot of content. Class is not too difficult. There is 4 tests and participation is graded.

Prof Francois is so nice! The class is very easy, just four multiple-choice exams on content she sends out in a review powerpoint. Just make sure you review the slides and show up as attendance is a big part of your grade!

Professor Francois is one of my favorite professors! At the start of every class, we would debrief about things going on in the media. Prof. Francois is a lovely professor who really wants students to succeed. Attendance counts for a fifth of the grade so go to class! reviews.comment: Prof. Francois was the sweetest. Very straight forward class and she's always there to help if you don't understand something. The class was basically PowerPoint lecture slides and her reading off of them. If you take notes on the slides you will be fine. 4 tests and 20% of your grade is attendance so just go to class.

It's a very test heavy class but her tests are easy. She teaches the concepts very well and has great review sessions. She is a super nice professor, classes can be boring sometimes but I've learned a lot about the media industry from her. A great professor overall who always appreciates feedback from her students.

I'm a former student, currently overseeing LatAm distribution for a major US media company. Everything P. Francois taught has been incredibly instrumental to my growth. Her expertise is spot on. Her teaching style simplifies a complex industry, offering a valuable perspective that is otherwise inaccessible. I cannot recommend P. Francois enough.

Ana is a great professor, and she clearly cares about her students. There are only four tests throughout the semester, so you have to be ready to do well on them. Professor Francois is amazing! Her exams are easy if you study the review powerpoints. Although, her lectures can be very long and boring but the class is easy as long as you study for the exams. I definitely recommend her!

Professor Francois is the best! She is really sweet and does really take into consideration her student's opinions. Her class is lecture heavy, really interesting, and enjoyable, and she sometimes will show videos and bring guest speakers. Exams are not the worst but studying is necessary. I would 100% recommend taking professor Francois!
She takes attendance everyday and if you don't have medical excuses. Memorize the PPT's, the exams are exactly the same as the PPT's.

I had Professor Francois last Spring and I still think about her class. She is hands down the best professor at the SoC & I learned so much! Professor Francois is truly amazing. She gives great lectures and her tests are super easy. She doesn't give homework and only gives 4 exams. The final is non cumlative. She gives a study guide/cheat sheet for each exam which is exactly what is on the test. I HIGHLY recommend that you take her class. She is an amazing professor in many ways.

The grades are based on 3 tests and THAT IS IT. But the tests are very easy and straightforward. They are not meant to trick you so if you know the material and take notes in class you are fine. Ana is an ANGEL. She is so sweet and usually ends classes early so that students aren't overwhelmed with content. Love her!

Prof. Francois is a very kind person, but her lectures sometimes get very boring. She tries to joke and engage with the class, but a lot of the time it just gets awkward. Maybe it was my class environment. Follow the study guide, and it's an easy A. The class topics are also not very engaging.

Francois is a great professor and really knowledgeable on her field. She is very caring and wants her students to succeed. Her class sometimes feels very long because it's mainly lectures. Study for the tests with the review PowerPoint she gives. Tests are mainly memorization. Overall very easy class, just show up, and study for the tests.

Francois is amazing. Class is purely lectures, but they're not boring to follow along with. She really wants to see her students succeed, so ask questions and approach her if you need help. Graded on few things, four tests and attendance. The tests are purely memorization, and she does offer a few extra credit points for attending media events.
Class was lecture heavy but content is not difficult especially if you go to class, take notes, and study

Francois rocks. Lectures are really important and sometimes long but if you ever answer questions or come to her for help, she's the greatest. In my class she always had a ton of communications scholarships available to look at. Pretty easy class too, just 4 exams and some little assignments.

Professor Francois is a very nice Professor and provided lots of opportunities for her students. However, her tests are not the easiest and with so few grades in the grade book they matter a lot. reviews.comment: She clearly cares about her students and is very experienced in the industry. Always wants to help and had multiple extra credit opportunities. Francois is a fantastic professor. She does her best to make the lectures engaging, and you can tell she really cares about her students and their success. Francois is a great professor. She has plenty of experience in the industry and the class is very interesting if you care about the subject. VERY lecture heavy and sometimes they do feel long. Great professor. Very knowledgable. Grade is based on three exams and one group project.

I love Professor Francois!! I think she is very nice and the course material is interesting and she try's to engage you in her lectures but the lectures can get to be very long and boring. Prof Francois is such a good professor. she is very experienced and has a lot of knowledge that she is very eager to share. The class isn't an easy A, but as long as you pay attention and study you should be good.

I greatly enjoyed the lectures of Professor Francois. She was great and I definitely recommend her. She teaches from powerpoints, and all exams are open book. super nice prof, very very interesting lectures. 100% would take again. no hw, tests open book and 10 questions. easy but very educational. dont need textbook

Prof. Francois is absolutely amazing. Her lectures were extremely interesting and I enjoyed learning about the media with her. She really cares. TAKE HER CLASS!

Professor Francois is the absolute best! She genuinely cares about students and wants you to succeed in her class. Great Profesor! the class is made up of 4 tests and participation each thing is 20%. You have to go to class, tests are multiple-choice and short answer. She will test exactly what she tells to study so as long as you study you will be fine.

Absolutely loved taking her class. Lectures are incredible and she's very knowledgable about the business side of the media industry, well experienced. low stress class. very understanding and knows what she's talking about. AMAZING person

I loved JMM102 with Francois. She makes the class really interesting and there's never homework. The tests are based off of the Power Points and if you memorize those, you'll be fine for all of the tests. Overall, a great prof.

A lot of what people say about him is an over exaggeration. He really is a nice guy and just wants and cares about students learning. One of the best teachers I had at UM. He is extremely sarcastic but knows very well the material and he knows how to teach the material in a simple way. Dr Simon is undoubtedly the best professor I've had at UM so far. He's knowledgeable and very respectful and I couldn't be happier with the class and the guy teaching it.

This guys knows his stuff. He gives you insight into his political experience while teaching you interesting material about US politics.  He even gives you a clear study guide. An amazing professor that truly cares about his students and their education. He is a little hard to swallow at first with some pretty strong humor, but I truly came to love him and learned more than i ever imagined. I look forward to taking more classes with him !

This course is really helpful in your future research and study. Prof. Simon is knowledgeable and very responsible for students. His course is full of humor and with complete documents. He's a great guy and a very good teacher. He teaches the material very clearly and provides a unique perspective.
unnecessary information. I feel frustrated with these long and boring study guides. Why bothering doing them? Just say read the whole friking book !!!

a real snore. boring as heck, but very easy.

thinks everything happens by frikin spontaneus combustion...don't take himmmmmmmmm!

Professor Arango is one of the best, she's friendly and very understanding. Her lectures are interesting and the assignments are very clear.
