She always has a smile on her face and is very reasonable with the workload, exams, project, etc.

I love her! She always has a smile on her face and I enjoy starting my day with her class. The lectures are generally engaging. It's a project-based class so no tests which is nice. There are a good amount of assignments so just make sure you stay on top of them and you will do well! You can tell she cares and tries to help out in every way she can

I love Dr. Arwari. Such an amazing professor, and makes an already interesting topic even more fun. Even though the grades are based solely on exams, if you pay attention and go to class its an easy A. Highly recommend taking a class with him.
It's a tough class, but he does a great job of teaching it. Very engaging and gives lots of real world examples to help explain the concepts.
he teaches the material in a very easy to digest way.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of the only professors who knows what he's doing to the full extent. Work is all laid out for you, and his lectures are very interesting. 4 exams and the lowest one gets dropped.

Awesome professor! His class consists of only 4 tests and drops the lowest one. Tests are easy if you just pay attention in class and study the slides. His class is just listening to his lectures, which are very enjoyable to hear. His teaching is really fun to listen to. I wish he was my professor for all my classes!

Brian is an absolute Beast! He's a great person and will work with you when you need to miss an exam. literally no homework and class is light as long as you take notes during lecture and study the day before the exam.

Professor Arwari is passionate about what he teaches, while knowledgable. While graded by few and getting distracted at some point in the semester, he really does care about all of his students. If you take him, definitely do!

A very enjoyable class that makes you want to attend lecture. It's clear he is knowledgeable and interested in what he teaches. He cares about each of his students beyond the grade they receive and is very accessible outside of class. Go to lecture and study a bit, and you will ace the exams. I would recommend Dr. Arwari to anyone in a heartbeat.

Dr. Arwari is the best professor I have ever had. His class has four tests, and you can drop one of the first three. Thirty multiple-choice questions, no textbook, all in-class lecture with slides, study guides, and Quizlet posted. Dr. Arwari is incredibly knowledgeable about his subject and will help you in life as a whole. I beg you to take him.

Someone described Professor Arwari as a "national treasure" - that couldn't be more true. He's the whimsical, wise, and wonderfully friendly professor you dream of having. It felt like a high school class where everyone's friends with each other and with the teacher! 10/10, no notes. He is Miami's Finest.

Mr. Arwari has a good class structure. He uses presentations that are clear and concise. He has a sense of humor and is good at linking real world examples to material. Study from presentations and you'll pass easily!
excellent professor that actually cares. take his class if u can
He's such a great professor and cares about you as a person.

One of my favorite teachers ever—he's a national treasure. Explains things through stories and real-life examples that make the material stick. Super chill, funny, and always willing to help. I actually looked forward to class and even talked about what we learned with my family. He's smart, caring, and just a great teacher all around.

Best teacher I've had at Miami so far. His lectures are entertaining and while class is not mandatory, still go because it is a fun class. The only grades are four tests, and he drops the lowest grade.
he's the best teacher who genuinely cares for his students. easy A if you study his slides and quizlets. take him you won't regret it!

Arwari is the best!! Attendance isn't mandatory, but he makes the lectures super interesting. Powerpoints of the lectures are posted but you'll learn better if you go to class. Your grade is made up of only tests but they're super easy and I only needed to review a quizlet of terms for them. TAKE HIM HE IS AWESOME!

He was one of the best professors I have ever had! Super engaging and intelligent. We only have four graded assignments, so you have to do well on those to get a good grade. They are all multiple-choice tests that are based on the chapters learned in the class. It is quite a bit of memorization. You can also drop one of the tests at the end.
Absolutely the best professor on the campus, sparks interest in every lecture and makes every day interesting. 1000% would recommend

One of my all time favorite professors. Arwari is hilarious and had the class dying of laughter at least once during every lecture. Extremely smart and can tell he cares about the content. Exams are difficult but if you study you will pass the class easily.

A literal stand up comedian, I did not miss a single lecture because class is so much fun. However, exams can be a little tricky, more than you think, study hard for them but the lectures teach you very well - he goes very in depth on simple concepts and will make a joke that will make the content unforgettable. no homework, just 4 exams TOTAL.
Great guy. 10/10
Love this man
Amazing teacher, absolutely loved him if you have the chance take any of his classes. If I could I would wake up at anytime to attend his class.

Dr. Arwari is fantastic, one of the best professors I've ever had. His lectures are funny, thorough, and will cover everything on the 4 exams (lowest is dropped, 3 makes up entire grade for the class). You kind of need to go to class, or if you miss at least get the notes from a good note taker, but I always looked forward to attending this class.

Amazing professor. Really wants to see his students succeed and is willing to work with you for whatever you need. Class was not the hardest but can you can easily underestimate how much work you have to put in. Amazing professor and very interesting class.

Arwari is a FANTASTIC professor. He is always engaging in his lectures. With KIN212, if you come to class you will pass the class with flying colors. I learned a ton from this class and it has ignited an interest in psychology for me. 100% take this class, I would take it again in a heartbeat.

WHATEVER YOU DO, JUST TAKE DR. ARWARI! YOU WILL NOT REGRET IT, HE IS BY FAR THE BEST EX. PHYS PROFESSOR AT UMIAMI!! HAS MY ENDORSEMENT 100% YOU WILL NOT ONLY HAVE FUN AND BE ENTERTAINED, BUT YOU WILL WANT TO LEARN AND GO TO CLASS.

I really enjoyed this class and Professor Arwari. He knows students by name and is super respectful and funny. Although attendance isnt mandatory, I found that listening to him lecture made tests very easy, and I also just enjoyed the class enough to want to be there every morning. Definitely take him and this class.

as long as you attend class and pay attention/take notes on the real-life examples, everything is very easy to understand. 4 exams, 1 dropped, no final. very funny guy, makes lectures very entertaining and engaging, and always ties it back to the concept he's trying to teach.

Mr. Arwari was a great professor. He makes his material very easy to learn from the way he lectures. He applies everything to the bigger picture and never fails to tell a funny story too. Really a great guy in general and makes learning that much more enjoyable.

Prof Arwari deserves all the praise. He is a super caring guy that is knowledgeable about his subjects. Not only was he superb in class, as he used to live in Hecht, he would always have a conversation with me whenever I passed by. The course grade is three out of four exams (the lowest dropped). Absolutely recommend as long as you plan to show up.

An amazing profers and interesting lectures! Very lecture heavy and your grade is made up of 4 tests you take through the semester. Easy to reach outside of class, you can tell that he cares a lot for his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Despite the low grade I received in KIN212, Dr. Arwari is a great professor. The whole grade is made up of 3 tests. If you go to class and pay attention to the lectures and prepare for the exams, you will be fine, but if you do not attend class, you will be forced to cram before his tests and will struggle. However, he is a great professor overall

4 exams, you can drop one of them, that's all the grades. The exams aren't that hard if you go to class and attend review days. He's super funny and makes class very fun so you'll actually want to go. Best professor at this university.

I LOVE DR. ARWARI. This class is definitely an easy A if you take notes on the slides. Nonetheless, GO TO HIS CLASS. He explains everything with such ease and he adds a lot of humor. Only complaint is that our grade was solely based on 4 exams, because he never gives out homework (which can be good to some), so definitely study heavily for these!!

Dr. Arwari is the best!!! He is so kind and smart. You will have the most random but cool knowledge from this class. All you have to do is attend class. If you attend and take notes and study a day or so before the exam, you will easily not just pass, but likely get an A. I did not worry about this class at all. And it was really enjoyable.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Arwari is very chill. Attendance isn't required, but the tests are vocab heavy. The only grades are the tests, but he drops the lowest one. He is very accommodating and understands we are students and have other classes.
He's a great professor and would definitely take again. There's only 4 tests and the lowest gets dropped and he gives you study guides and would go through the whole thing the class before the test.

Professor Arwari makes this class relatively easy and fun. Your grade is determined by just a few quizzes, but he drops the lowest one so you have nothing to worry about. He also gives study guides which tell you almost exactly what is on the test. Just know the study guide and you can easily get an A in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Good choice for a teacher because there is no homework and the lectures are worth going to. He is quite accommodating if you have an issue, but I've found sometimes he means well but sometimes has negative tones in his responses. Anyways, the class is very interesting and tests are graded fairly.

In my KIN 212 course, we took 4 exams and were allowed to drop our lowest (except exam 4). Only graded on these exams. A very interesting and intelligent professor and makes the content easy to understand. Be ready to listen attentively, take notes, and review. Use the exam guides he provides because they cover the content that will be on the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Arwari is awesome. There are 4 exams and 1 is dropped. One problem is that the exams are a bit difficult than you would think. Each exam is 25 questions on lockdown browser so if you miss 1 question you are down to a 96. Overall, very nice person and good professor.

Great professor and great lectures. There's study guides for each test, take 4 but only grades 3. He allows make ups, no attendance required. All the tests are online but in class. The test were quite difficult, they can be tricky with the wording. So do not take the class as an easy A, because it's not if you don't at least review before a test.

Great professor! I only went to like two of his classes but man was I hooked. Doesn't take attendance, but you don't wanna miss his class bc he's literally so interesting! I heard his exams are hard sooooo make sure y'all study, but if I went to UM I'd definitely take a class with him! Probably my favorite professor!

Brian is a very good professor!!! No attendance required but he makes lectures so interesting so everyone goes to his classes. NO FINAL, he evaluates just 4 test and you can drop the worst one. Tests are all multiple choice, which makes it tricky and confusing. They are all based in his presentations but it also helps going to class. Hard to get A

Arwari is a great professor. There are four exams. He drops your lowest one of tests one to three. Test four is mandatory. Exams are easy if you study the notes which he posts on blackboard. You don't have to go to class but it is highly recommended you do so. Exams have so weirdly worded questions so take your time.

BEST PROFESSOR EVER! Although attendance is optional, the class is super engaging so many people do not skip. He is willing to help you if you are struggling. His exams are super straight forward if you review your notes and fill out the study guides. Your grade is based on 4 exams, but one of them gets dropped.
incredible professor, interesting class, tests are multiple choice and a little hard to get good grade
Great professor, take this class!!

Cheerful mood, laid back demeanor. Just enjoys talking about psychology and doesn't require you to participate at all if you don't want to. But if you do want to ask questions and be involved, he will respond well to that too. I took KIN 212, loved it.

Arwari is a great professor. Had him for KIN 212. He is hilarious and his lectures are very interesting. Class is really easy, you really don't have to show up but go anyway because his classes are pretty entertaining. He cares about his students success so if you need extra help he will be around. Tests are all based off his powerpoints
Great lecture, amazing teacher, you go into class thinking it will be boring... but you leave inspired. Definitely take this course with Prof. Arwari.
Great professor, helpful, cares about student success. Show up to class, his lectures are much more interesting than just reading powerpoints.

Lectures are very interesting and he gives lots of relatable examples. Only 4 tests and you get to drop lowest grade. You don't even need to showup to class to do well. Tests come directly from his power points and as long as you study the night before it's an easy A. definitely recommend this class, my favorite one i took this semester.

Amazing, super interesting lectures! It's an easy A as long as you review his slides a couple times. No textbook. 4 tests but he drops one. No final. He gives study guides for each test. Tests are all online (30 questions MC). He makes his lectures fun and straightforward. I recommend this class for anyone!! This class was a relief from my others!

Quite possibly the easiest class I've taken at Miami. 4 multiple choice exams and you get to drop one. They are super easy, I got A's on all of them and none of them took me longer than 20 minutes to complete. The questions are taken directly off the PowerPoints almost word-for-word. He is basically handing out A's. Take this class with Arwari!!!
Great professor. Tests are somewhat challenging but not too hard. He makes the lectures fun and engaging. Very knowledgeable. No book. No attendance. Tests are online in class

His lectures were really interesting. He counts 3 out of 4 tests and the test questions were not that hard if you read the power points and take okay notes. Really happy that he didn't make this class harder than it needed to be. Another bonus - if you ace the first three tests, you don't have to take take the last test or even go to class anymore.
He's a great professor with really interesting lectures and overall a really cool guy. One of my favorite professors at UM.
Great professor. Explained everything extremely well. Class consisted of 4 tests, and he drops the lowest one. Used power points for lectures. Overall pretty easy class if you study.

Dr arwari is probably one of the best teachers I have had at UM. His lectures are engaging, tests are easy and the information for this specific class was extremely interesting.  While the slides are posted online, you will want to go to class.

Professor Arwari's Sports Psych class was easy and I actually learned quite a bit. He's interesting - he has plenty of entertaining stories and anecdotes - grades easily - he even drops your lowest test grade - and all his tests are pretty simple as long as you look at his powerpoints which he posts on blackboard! Overall a knowledgeable professor!

this class was my favorite class ever. I looked forward to going to his class every day. He makes the material so easy to understand by using life examples with everything he says. even though his tests are a little tricky, he still drops ur lowest grade. overall, if i could take him again i would!! he's so chill. TAKE HIM!!!

Arwari is as great as everyone says. Interesting class that you will want to go to. The tests were surprisingly tricky though; easy to get caught up on long answers that sound the same. Don't think this class is a cakewalk, but do take it; Bri Arwari's the man.
awesome class, barely showed up, still got a good grade, easy. really cool guy i wish i could take him again

This class is really easy as long as you go over notes and power points (there isn't a textbook). He's a really cool guy and easy going. There are 4 tests 25% each and no surprises. Everything is clear and to the point. I HIGHLY recommend him. Plus, I didn't go to class much and still got an A

Great class and great professor! There were 4 mc exams (each worth 25% ). If you go to class, take notes, and memorize the power points/your notes you will definitely get an A.  I got an A in this class and I even missed a few of the classes. As long as you get the notes, you will be fine! He makes each lesson interesting and worth attending!
really cool guy and makes the class enjoyable

Relatable, down to earth guy from Italy. Class consists of four tests;each on four chapters. All study materials are on his powerpts. Tests are straightforwardfrom the study guide. you actually really need to read over the powerpts a million times in order to memorize them. Others say that this class is super easy; but it does require time tostudy.
Great teacher, incredibly smart but teaches very simply. Can talk on a level consistent with anybody. Highly recommended.

Great professor, no textbook required. All lectures are powerpoints, he posts on blackboard. 3 Exams, non-cumulative (final is the third exam, also non-cumulative). Highly recommended, extremely nice guy and always open to questions.

Awesome teacher! Most fun class I've taken at UM so far. Highly recommend him even if it does not pertain to your major. Attendance is optional, but he is so entertaining you will want to go. Tests are fairly easy and straight-forward.
Such a great professor.  He is intelligent and explains things very clearly through demonstrations and stories.  Going to class isn't necessary, but is helpful.
Amazing professor. One of the best at UM, def learn to juggle, watch out for his tricks hes a very smart guy. def recommend

Makes concepts and theories as easy as possible. He's really laid back and knows his stuff. 3 exams plus final. His study guides are not 100% accurate but not too bad. His exams are tricky but as long as you study for them. KNOW HOW TO JUGGLE if you want E.C.
Great at explaining concepts and providing examples. Interesting anecdotes as well.
I strongly recommend this professor. Teaches well and extremely helpful.
Great teacher!! highly recommended!

Really great teacher and a cool guy. Willing to help you out so long as you actually attend class. His stories are very entertaining and the concepts are fairly simple as long as you pay attention. Totally recommend him as a teacher.

He has a lot of stories to entertain the class but I hope you are a great test taker because that's all there is. Each test covers like 4 or 5 chapters. The book is not used in class but some of the questions on the test are straight from the book. Learn how to juggle, it will help you at the end of the semester.
Cool Guy, very nice, test are long but it could be worse....Get ready to study...
Easy class that is made to be to hard!
No Comments
Tough grading on some of the exams. Lots of dense lectures. Grading is done very slowly.

Malhotra is a kind professor. His class is somewhat similar to Harris' but the content is more intense. You don't learn too much in class, not because he isnt a good professor, but because the material is fundamentally challenging and specific. Study hard but overall the class is manageable and malhotra is pretty solid.

Dr Malhotra is nice and knowledgeable, but unorganized. He didn't grade anything until the very end, which made him a lenient grader. The class is for the ex phd program, most people have FT jobs, but the lecture is in the middle of the day twice a week. It's not mandatory, but Dr Malhotra asked that we attend. Hvy on HW the last 2 wks.

Took Malhotra & learned a lot, theres 2 presentations, 2 exams, a final 12 pg paper & a quiz every week but the quizzes are open notes & you can find the answers in the papers. He is a very lenient grader & a great teacher. Definitely take notes of his lectures because there tends to be exam questions on what he says. He is big on experiment ?'s
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers

reviews.comment: He teaches the class like everyone knows the basics already. If you've never taken stats before, start reading the textbook early or befriend someone who did, or you're screwed. Lectures are tough to follow, but the two exams are pretty easy. Final exam is optional, and a 90 gets you an A at least. Not a ton of HW, but they are pretty lengthy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Had not taught undergrad in several years so did not understand how to teach basics. Course included coding which most students did not understand how to use. Homeworks were math from the textbook but exams were mostly concept applications so the homework wasn't related to tests. A midterm (30%) and final (40%). Lectures were straight from the text

Whatever you do, do not take his class. Lectures make no sense and he treats it like a grad class (when this is an INTRO CLASS). The homework is graded harshly, the extra credit isn't easy, but hey, at least you get a cheat sheet on the two exams. He's a genius, but that doesn't make him a good teacher whatsoever. Just take a regular stats class.

Actually impossible class if you don't already have a coding background or stats background. Take a different professor :). Arthur is a great guy and super interesting and intelligent and I would take a class on like, his life as a scientist, but he teaches terribly and is bad at undergrad teaching.

He's a grad professor so he expects all of us to know what we're doing when this is many people's first stats class. Homework has pretty vague directions and it's graded harshly for no reason. Two exams (midterm and final) make up ~70%. Only saving grace is getting a cheat sheet for exams and some extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class wasn't engaging, and the teaching style didn't work for me or many others. Most of the time, we were just reading from the board. When we worked on problems, the instructor copied them from his computer without solving them with us, leaving little opportunity to fully understand the material.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you've never taken stats, do not take it with him. Lectures didn't help, but if you read the book you at least learn a little. Thankfully he is available outside of class via office hours, but in class he is not super helpful. Exams are conceptual and unrelated to the HW, and HW takes hours at a time to do. Avoid if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Not the best lecturer, homeworks do not help on the exams, but people on here are overdramatic. The exams are worth a lot, but there are opportunities for extra credit, like just showing up to class. He is an EXTREMELY lenient grader. Don't let these reviews scare you. The grading for the class is lax too. You can get an A- being in the low-mid 80s

Isn't the best at explaining concepts in class, but if you read the textbook sections for the lecture material you'll be fine. Offers a decent amount of extra credit, and the exams are not too difficult, but the homework assignments take a good amount of time, and the coding aspect isn't as easy as they make it seem.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The worst professor I've ever had. This was such a hard intro class for no reason. His lectures make no sense and goes off another professors class notes because he doesn't have any. I spent at least 9 hours a week on hw for this class. Your life will be stats and that's it. Take this class if you want to fail. I am hanging on by a thread.

He is bad at teaching. One of those people that is really smart, but an awful teacher. A lot of HW, and in the beginning its easy, but it gets so hard, and you're doing it all by hand. The exams are all conceptual basically. His lectures are boring and very confusing and hes very sassy, especially with questions and critiques. He is not helpful.

Teaches an intro class at the grad level. Grading is based on HW (30%), midterm (30%) and final (40%). HW can be very difficult and is graded harshly. Lectures make no sense, he just rambles. Exam was based on very conceptual material unrelated to HW. Please take anyone but him, this has been the worst class experience I have had at UM.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: i feel bad because he seems nice and is a huge figure in the oceanography scene so it's great opportunity to be taught by someone like him but it's nearly impossible to understand anything from his lectures. there's only 2 exams which are possible to do if you study an insane amount and you get a one page cheat sheet, but he's not easy by any means
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Took this course expecting environmental statistics to be more applicable than regular stats as a marine bio major, I was wrong. Not worth taking enviro stats with him when his lectures move extremely quick and we don't learn anything, he is too smart to be teaching a basic intro class. Tests were from other prof luckily &python required for all HW

reviews.comment: literally all you need to do is show up to class and complete the four easy assignments, lectures are fun and entertaining and she truly makes an effort to involve people and connect with her students, overall great professor
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: THE BEST PROF!! You can tell how passionate she is about anthropology through her lectures. Participation in class is a small grade, but not huge. Tests include projects and papers. Fair and easy grader, just gotta put in the effort and you'll be good. LOVED her. I would recommend this class.

Where do I start? This was by far the worst professor I've ever had at the University of Miami. SO stuck-up. As someone with a learning disability she forced me to disclose my disability and didn't care about any of my school accommodations. She is an extremely difficult and unclear grader. As an A student, I highly recommend to NOT take her class.

This class was really fascinating. I signed up on a whim, and ended up learning so much about the field. She also gives her own personal experiences as examples which was really cool. I felt like the quizzes were fair. Highly recommend taking one of her classes.

Dr. Ardren is great and this was a super fun class! This course was very discussion heavy and Dr. Ardren randomly takes attendance so I would recommend going to class. There were no exams and four assignments that were super easy and not super time consuming. Should be an easy A!

She is very sweet and cares about her students. She will reply to any questions you have. Her lectures are not the best and if you want an A you have to go to her lectures and study hard for the test.

Nothing remarkable. Class requires you to buy books and often shows interesting programs, but she is so nondescript in what she wants from her assignments. Some lectures seem to stall, and at the end of class, you feel like you're not really learning or doing much. Takes off points for the most minute details.

Great professor. Although lectures can be a little long, she will sometimes start talking about her own experiences in the field, which is so cool and amazing. I learned so much about Native American cultural heritage& preservation, which I appreciate even more now. Take good notes and study the vocab!

Great teacher, i nvever used the Archaeology book once and got an A.  All you need to do is to go to every class and take notes and you should come out fine.  tells great stories about the digs she's been on.
One of my favorite teachers at UM, got me interested in anthropology.
Traci Ardren rocks!
She is great, its hard to know what to study for, but focus on the vocabulary, give examples, exams are kinda hard, but the paper is easy, and the lab assignment is annoying but simple enough
It is not a hard class, but it is not inspiring. She is very friendly, but she makes fascinating subjects less then interesting. i would describe her class as....eeeeeeeh
Was a real fascinating and interesting teacher.  She really knows her stuff.  If you attend all classes and take good notes you do not need to buy the book for the class.
Extremely easy, very interesting.  Make sure to take the honors class when possible.. the final and midterm for honors section are take home essays as opposed to in class exam for the regular class.

Gives interesting lectures. No need to buy or read the book. She goes over everything that you need to know for the tests. Only problem was the lack of grades: one research paper, the midterm, a group assignment, and the final were the only assignments given. Supplemental movies made the class more fun. Good Teacher!

Knows her stuff so you will learn alot in the class. Lecture based with 2 tests, research paper, and lab assignment. tests are on very basic concepts she goes over. A good class for many as it is easy and you learn alot in it.
Great professor, knows her stuff, makes class interesting, never boring. Hard tests, but willing to help outside of class.
She is a wonderful professor!!!
No Comments
No Comments
Great class, fun, learned a lot.
No Comments

Hands down one of the best professors I have had here at UM. Her lectures are amazing, and she constantly asks questions and keeps everyone engaged and focused. She gives chances to revise writing assignments, and the two exams (midterm and final) are a choice of different essays. Hard not to do well if you show up to class. The best.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great prof! She chose the topic of objects in history, so it was more like an art history class. The only issue with the class was that she assigned at least 1-2 lengthy readings per week, usually due early on. But, usually, I could skim because we went over them in class. Super nice, and very accommodating.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Go to class/participate, take notes and you will do well. This class requires reading, not sure why kids taking a history class are surprised by that, but its not "hard". Professor White is one of the most knowledgeable, accessible, kind professors I've had. Her ability to tell thought-provoking lectures were unreal. Great professor, better person.
Dr. White is an amazing professor who gives great feedback and makes you a better writer. Take her course, you won't be sorry.

She is a very nice, caring, and respecting lady, but her class is boring unfortantley. No problem with Professor White herself but I came into college liking history and then she made it uninteresting. Hard to do assignments and read books when you aren't interested in the subject anymore. 4/10 don't recommend, very nice lady tho
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She and the TA share grading responsibility. Only grades are participation, 2 essays, a midterm, and a final. Be prepared to write a lot of notes in valuable lectures, and participating is a must. Shes a great person and you can get a good grade as long as you put in the effort. Show up, ask questions, and take advantage of 1 essay rewrite.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: good professor, really cares about her students and has a passion for the subject. Class is very hard- participation in class is very important, and your only graded work is two essays and two written exams. No textbook is required other than a few short books that are assigned, so attendance and excellent notes are absolutely mandatory to do well.

Very nice woman, very smart. BIG on participation which sometimes sucks because it causes students to contribute pointless things to the conversation. Very fair in grading. I got annoyed with her towards the end though, lots of reading, but it was worth it in the end because the class is so interesting.

Professor White is extremely passionate, knowledgeable and helpful.  I had taken her before for 362 and loved it, so decided to take her for a seminar.  It was stimulating and challenging, and I ended up learning a lot and doing well.  Be prepared to read-a LOT, but also know that she is very supportive and reachable!

Very interesting course material most of the time.  She does a tremendous job of following military campaigns without being a military historian, and a great job of completely turning the myths of the American Revolution around.  The only downside is the excessive focus on physical locations such as taverns and churches for gatherings
Professor White is an extremely humble and helpful person. She is very insightful and knows what she is talking about. Her lectures are interesting and her grading is fair.

Very energetic, you know she is very into the course material she is teaching, and makes an effort to get to know the students.  People say she is a hard grader, but most people I talk to get a B, with a good bit of work. Don't be scared off by the work unless you have a really hard courseload, her class is fun.  Discussions are a blast.

I took two of her classes, got an A- and a B+. She is a tough grader, but she is fair and willing to help you on papers. She is one of the best history teachers, never boring. She is really passionate about what she teaches and knows her stuff. Just make sure you go to class. You will learn alot, but if all you want is an easy A don't take her.
Very interesting course. Only work is two long papers, a midterm, and a final. Seems almost impossible to recieve an A. Very interesting course material.

Taking my second class wth her. Really tough grader, but fair. Got a B my first time through, and that's what I deserved. Her lectures are interestng, and she always likes to insert funny, yet surprisingly relevent, historical stories, just to liven he mood. No textbook per se, you have to read a few books though. 1 prob is that NO ONE gets a A

Very good teacher. She has a lot of passion and energy towards the subject which is helpful during lectures. She gives two papers and two exams, which she is a very hard grader. I was happy to get a B. Take her, you'll learn a lot.

Overall fascinating class that covers important details. Lots of reading on average a book every one to two weeks. Was very helpful and had entertaining teaching style. Anyone who does not like her does not like history.
sooo boring.. shes's really nice but not enough assignments and she grades really hard.. i loved history before.. but i DO NOT recommend her

Do not take her class if you value your GPA. She's nice and really helpful, but it doesn't matter what you do you will never get an A from her. you'll be lucky to get a B+. Do not take her class, she'll kill your GPA
she's very passionate about what she teaches. Dr. White is very helpful and she's real cool and funny. take her classes they're fun and interesting.

She knows history, especially colonial history and she has a passion for looking at it from the perspective of  minorities. Unfortunately she also doesn't like dissenting opinions too much. I have never had a teacher who made me feel so incompetent. Take this class if you love history but be warned that it is alot of work (3 essays, midterm and fin

I would recommend this class with her! Majority of your grade is made up of 4 group projects you do throughout the semester and some individual assignments. Attendance is mandatory and lectures get boring but overall a good class and not that hard. Plus she is very nice and caring and wants you to learn!!

I have taken three classes with Dr. Falcon at this point and I would gladly take more if I could.  She's super kind, understanding, knowledgable, and truly cares about her students. If you need more time on an assignment, she is so quick to give it to you. The biggest complaint I have is probably how she organizes her blackboard.
The professor doesn't know how to communicate well. Can't stick to there word overall an awful professor.

She was good, I wasn't super interested in this class tho and her monotone voice doesn't help. I thought this class was going to be the study of disease hence the name yet it was not that and more a lot of calculations. 2 exams, 2 research critiques, and some smaller assignments. Tests were manageable if you study, but she gives EC which helps.

She is fine. She comes off kinda monotone which makes me reluctant to go to her classes. She is very accessible by email and she gives a ton of extra credit which is nice. The tests are not a huge part of your grade so if you dont do well its not the end of the world, especially with the extra credit.

She is a nice professor and has extra credit after all the exams and is very responsive to emails her about anything. She wants her students to do well and for the most part people do. The wording of questions on the tests gets difficult, the jamovi software is confusing, and her lectures get boring after a couple weeks but overall its an ok class.

reviews.comment: Your grade is comprised of major assignments, exams, and professionalism/attendance. She is super proficient in the material she teaches however, she is not the most engaging. Her major assignments and exams are doable as she gives you the appropriate resources. Lots of extra credit!

Although the content was difficult, I am glad I chose to take Dr.Falcon. She genuinely cares about her students and is easily accessible outside of class. She gives opportunities for extra credit and her assignments allow 2 submissions(easy 100% hw grade.) If anyone rated her bad they probably didnt pay attention in class + attendance is graded
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class was super chill, participation matters and she was nice overall. Just show up, take notes and you'll be good. A really kind lady tbh

very nice professor, this class is really only interesting if you care about the environment and stuff like that. theres 4 group based PBL's and a final project that were easy enough i guess. I think she grades attendance if you miss more than 2 classes. a very non stressful class

I really didn't want to take her again but I had to. It's a chill class just show up and you'll pass. I really don't think the assignments aligned with what we were supposed to learn. I really can't blame her for this class bc I really think UM threw this into the PH major to make us take one more class. You literally don't learn anything tbh.

Tough class but falcon makes it fun and relatively easy to understand. Group project makes up a majority of the class, but a few individual assignments as well. These were very tedious but she was always there to help if needed. Gives a lot of class time to work on assignments but you still must spend a lot of time working outside of class
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Wonderful professor for this course. Very interesting lectures with lots of cool information being taught, which applied to different assignments and presentations throughout the course. Professor Falcon was really great!

Very nice and offers office hours but fast-paced. The whole class didn't know what was happening. All assignments, extra credits, and tests are  hard and you can't use any source besides the slideshow to help. The software is difficult to use. A tutor from the camner center is 100% needed and I found out about that too late and had to withdraw.

reviews.comment: Very good teacher, will make sure you get the grade you want and accessible outside of class. Tests are a little confusing so make sure you know the information well

She is a sweet person but this is the hardest class I have ever taken. Pick anybody else. Nobody in my class knows what is going on right now, and there is no time to stop to relearn things because it's at such a fast pace.

Dr. Falcon is an amazing professor. Her lectures pretty much reflect the exam, so there really is no need to read the book. She grades somewhat tough and is picky with certain things for group projects. Other than that, she made the class enjoyable and ensures that everyone understands the content, especially right before an exam.
Boring lectures, difficult-worded tests, and unclear instructions for what she is looking for on group assignments.
She was really understanding about situations and made me feel comfortable in this space
I've had Falcon multiple times throughout my time at UM. She is an incredible professor, super funny, extremely understanding, supportive, and helpful. You might wish she was your mom.

Dr. Falcon is kind and lays out the information you need to know in her ppts. Takes attendance in class when people stop showing up as much. Participation is 10%. Group projects are stressful, hopefully you don't get stuck in a group with students who do the bare minimum (or less than that). Interesting class material.

reviews.comment: I really appreciated how eye-opening this class was and how much I learnt about my own environment and all the health hazards that exist. The quizzes were relatively easy, they are take home and you get a few days to do it. The work isn't hard if you pay attention during lecture.

BPH465 is in the top 2 hardest classes I've taken for my major, but Dr. Falcon makes it doable. She is available if you need help, and she VERY understanding about qualms in groups. She is super creative, compassionate, and makes you feel like you have a voice. I left feeling inspired by the project in her class, and I wanted to make it happen.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I enjoyed Epidemiology with Dr. Falcon! Her lectures were not painful and she puts gifs in the lectures to keep our attention. She gives daily participation credit which you must be present to receive. The 2 exams (midterm & final) were definitely more difficult than her lectures, so really study the powerpoints! She curves and gives study guides!
Easy course but she has a bad attitude. Not a cool person but the class is manageable.
I love her

Dr. Oberoi is such a caring professor, she is very respected and detailed in her lectures with lots of examples. There is not a lot of homework, the tests are Multiple Choice. Attendance and participating is mandatory but if you really pay attention you would do it naturally.
Class is very boring but mandatory. You are forced to speak in class as it effects your grade. The tests are lecture heavy. Nice professor but the class sucks.

reviews.comment: Super tough grader - very detail-oriented. Lots of assignments - mostly related to a huge group project that you work on throughout the semester. Professor Oberoi makes her lectures interesting and easy to understand. It is obvious that she truly cares about her students, and ensures that they succeed in her class.

Professor Ashemimry was a really great teacher in retrospect. She is tough but fair and really makes sure you get your money's worth. Wish she would go over more problems rather than extremely long derivations. This is a very difficult class, but I would say her tests were very fair. She just really needs to work on learning how to give partial credit.

reviews.comment: Constantly berates students work and intelligence and actively tries to fail students and brags about it claiming its "not her problem". Avoid if possible
Gives formula sheets, goes over what's on the exam, genuinely the best professor in the finance dept imo. If you just show up to class and study you can succeed.

If you rated this professor less than a 3 you are actually not ready for a college course! She gives homework with multiple attempts, allows a formula sheet, and prepares you for the exams if you show up to class. Bad ratings are from students who fail to take notes or chat gbt all their homework. I didn't study at all for the final and got an A.

She is a very nice lady, willing to help and meet but the class is extremely hard for no reason. She puts too many question in the exams, and we run out of time. Exam 1 was easy, exam 2 and the final were very dififcult. She is a considerable person but I recommend taking with someone else as it might be easier.

So her lectures are boring but she's a REALLY NICE LADY. Her first two exams were very difficult but the final was easy (probably cause everyone was failing). She is a very nice lady and cares for her students, but the exams are way too difficult. Many of us are not finance majors, and it was too much info, and questions were far too difficult for people just trying to pass this class. 

If you are really good at finance then this class will be easy for you.
very very sweet professor but the tests are HARD. i studied and did the practice questions but it was not helpful for the exams

Professor Tsouderou is one of the kindest professors at the university, she always helps when one need, giving extensions for HWs and amazing office hours, and while homeworks and exams can be difficult, she lets you bring cheat sheets and even reschedules your exam if needed.

Professor. Tsouderou always has such a vibrant and bubbly personality every time she lectures. She evidently has a very profound career path in Finance. The tests can be hard, but she makes time to answer any questions you might have and there are exam reviews posted which are helpful. Don't expect to Ace this class without putting in the work!

reviews.comment: Professor Tsouderou is an amazing professor. She is so kind and understanding of every student's individual needs. She gave us all numerous opportunities to improve our grade and is always flexible about homework assignments.

Super knowledgeable, and it is evident she has a ton of experience in the topics she teaches. Also happens to be one of the nicest/kindest professors I've ever had. 

I've learned a ton about Finance in this class, and don't think I would have with any other teacher. If you come into the class wanting to learn - you'll do well. Simple as that.

Professor Tsouderou has the most productive office hours in the university. If you have trouble with homework or a test, she'll help your grade as much as she can. She gave me advice to read the textbook and my midterm 2 grade was drastically higher than the first one. Put the hours in and you will succeed.

Gives mandatory HW. Gives lots of optional practice problems that reflect the tests really well. She's super sweet and always interested in giving any supplemental help or talking about current events in finance. Definitely would recommend.
Great professor all around! Really nice and appreciative.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Attendance every day, homework every week but it's easy. All exams are multiple choice. Professor really cares and will give extensions. Awesome Professor. You can tell she's overqualified for the course. Exams are not easy, but she lets you use a cheat sheet and is always available to help if you need it. All the negative reviews have to be from lazy people who put in minimum effort and expect to get an A or were just not meant to be finance majors.

She's a really nice person. But im afraid thats about all. She doesn't know how to engage a class and actually teach to a class. She was never meant to be a professor, she'd thrive much more in an office setting, and not in front of a class

she makes fin302 WAY HARDER than it actually is. gives so much practice questions and reviews for exams that are ABSOLUTELY USELESS. lectures are boring and will not teach you anything. be prepared to teach yourself all of the material. she's very nice but way theres better prof to take. stay away if you can!!!

She's great and gives extension for HW if you forget or didn't understand. She'll go over the homework with you and practice problems. VERY lecture and powerpoint heavy, hard to understand the concepts at all. The tests are all multiple choice on lockdown. Just do the homework and REDO the practice and ALL HW questions and use to cheatsheet 4 a B.

The worst experience I ever had taking a class. If you don't work or have a strong background in his lecture topics, it will demand a ton of hours to start "understanding" what he is talking about. In the final exam, you must understand methods not explained in class.

reviews.comment: Dr. Wikramanayake is by far my favorite professor at UM. He cares about his students and makes sure you understand everything. He gives you practice exams so you can see the format of the actual exam.

Dr. W is one of the best professors in the biology department. Truly caring, and doesn't make you feel dumb for asking questions. This is the only biology class I've taken where the exams don't depend on memorization, but on understanding and critical thinking. As long as you go to class and take notes, you should do well.

reviews.comment: Loved the class!! He is really a great guy- ready to help out. He also makes the subject very interesting. Make sure you go to class, understand well the material. This is NOT a memorization class...it is more a concept-based class. If you understand the material, you will be able to think OUT of the box, which is what he wants.

Such a great guy! Wish I could take him for more classes, HHMI lab with him was awesome. He is so sweet and by the second day will have memorized everyones name. He is so sweet and funny and he never makes you feel stupid for asking silly questions (like many professors do) and he is always willing to work with you extra and help you out.

Attendance is practically mandatory since he gives surprise take home quizzes every so often. His test are Ridiculously hard. Do you ever look at someone and wonder, "what is going on inside their head"? Yeah, that's me every day with Atlas. He seems like a nice guy but I can't figure him out. The material is easy if you use your brain. It's easy to miss points for things like negative signs and whatnot so check your answers. Read instructions, you'll get extra points.
Might as well skip his lectures, you wont learn much. Take notes from the homework and you will be fine. Lots of homework you have to do, not always that bad though.

Atlas is a fine teacher. But, he is not very accessible outside of class, he is at the RSMAS campus so it makes it very tough to meet with him. Very Lengthy homework that can require you to get almost 100 questions right in groups of two. Tests were alright, if you study you should be above average but the average for the four test were wither a C or C+. Hard to get an A unless you do really well on the tests which is not easy. Nice guy but its not that easy of a class and its an 8am...
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Not a science major and got an A+ in the class. Not that hard, lots of extra credit, good guy.

Nice guy, he could not be more fair. Chemistry is not my forte whatsoever, I did have to put in the time. He's willing to help his students. The homework is the best way to study and do well on exams. Exams are fair, the final being cumulative is difficult. Your grade is the reflection of your effort.

He seems a bit disconnected from what he's teaching, but his class is pretty straightforward. Hey, wasn't the best class ever, but it wasn't the worst. Who really enjoys chem anyway.

Extremely painful class. Tests are very long and hard. Homeworks are 40 questions each once or twice per week. If you are not good at chemistry do not take, it is a difficult subject already and with this professor it get worst.

Very fair professor. Chem is a difficult subject as it is, so I think he did a pretty good job of teaching it. Attendance was not mandatory and he uploads all his powerpoint lectures online, which are basically outlines of the chapters. Good at explaining problems/questions you may have. Weekly homework assigned, same difficulty as the tests.

Professor Atlas is very nice, there are 3 exams and a final. There is Homework  due every week which i found it very helpful for the exams! As in any class (especially chemistry) you need to put in time, study and keep up with the lectures, as long as you do that you should be fine!

This is probably the worst professor I ever had in my life. Lectures are boring and absolutely useless. Tests are extremely long and hard (2-3hrs) and assigns around 40-50 HW exercises per week (one homework was around 100). CHEM for ENG shouldn't be easy I know, but this guy makes you regret you are taking the class all semester long. DO NOT TAKE!

If you can avoid taking chemistry with this professor do so AT ALL COSTS. His tests are extremely difficult and he is no help. Points at his power points and thinks its teaching. I had to teach myself everything. To pass his course do ALL examples in the back of the book and the ones he gives you online, thats the only way to pass.
Worst Professor I've ever had, only reads his power points which are available online, does not go over content accurate to content on tests.

Not the best professor. Attendance is not mandatory but at least if you go you have a better chance of understanding the material. Take home quizzes sounds great but they are VERY difficult. Tests are equally as hard and long.

I was in his honors section, and it was definitely a hard class. Not impossible, but hard. Quizzes are all take home, but EXTREMELY difficult. Not the best teacher I've had--his lectures are boring and he doesn't seem to go out of his way to help his students. Like I said, a hard class, coming from someone who took A.P. Chem. Not an easy A.

I've taken Professor Augustyn for APY 101 and 202 and they were basically the same class, but I enjoyed both of them a lot. Professor uses great videos and examples in class to supplement the book and powerpoints.

reviews.comment: Nice guy and chill class. Super passionate about the material and uses pretty engaging content and videos in class that keeps people engaged. Exams are online too which is a plus.

If you want an easy class and can attend every class, take this professor. He is very funny and the lectures are pretty entertaining so if you want to pay attention instead of doing other homework it is enjoyable.
APY101 is super boring class, but show up for the attendance and its the easiest A+ you will get.

I had never given a speech before this class, and I can say, without a doubt, that this was the most incredible and informative class. It is definitely possible to do well in the class without any previous experience of public speaking. Professor Shaffer does the best job making everyone feel comfortable and welcome!

she's literally the nicest professor i've ever had. all you have to do is do a few speeches and even if you're scared of public speaking she's an easy grader and wants you to do well. if you have to take public speaking do everything you can to take her. besides speeches you don't really have to show up to class especially if you give her an excuse

Professor Shaffer is such a great professor. Firstly, the class is pretty chill so you just need to show up and do your speeches. You do need to plan them though because even though she's pretty nice she will give you a bad grade. It was a fun class and our whole class bonded. Highly recommend with this course with HER
She is the goat. Love her so chill and nice. Makes an awkward class enjoyable. if you have to take this class you must take it with her!

Professor Shaffer was an amazing professor! Personally I was terrified of public speaking, but after taking her class I can say Im definitely more comfortable with presenting. She was very helpfulshe gave good feedback and would try to do her best to help you learn and improve! I strongly recommend taking her for public speaking

Professor Shaffer is the best! She is so nice, always smiling and makes everyone feel so comfortable. I never thought I would say I enjoyed public speaking but I did and I am so happy I took it with her.

Professor Shaffer took her time to be very patient with us and doesnt pit her students against one another. She encourages us to not compare ourselves to others but to compare ourselves to ourselves. She is by far one of the best professors I have ever had and she is the only person I would recommend anyone to take this course with!!! :)

Five speeches (Introduction, Special Occasion, Informative, Persuasive, and Narrative). All are done within a reasonable time frame (narrative during finals week/ also easiest speech less stress during finals). Each speech requires a self-evaluation (she gives good feedback), allows notecards, and also allows for class feedback. PRACTICE!!!

Professor Shaffer is by far my favorite professor. She is the sweetest woman, who genuinely wants you to succeed. Her class is so helpful and she keeps the overall feeling of the class light and fun. Would recommend 1000%!! If you take public speaking she is a MUST!!

Prof Shaffer is the juice. She's more chillin than nitrogen ice cream and you'll actually learn some valuable skills in her class. She makes 5 speeches feel like a breeze and gives helpful pointers, she's the bee's knees. Come to class and you'll make friend's, everyone in her class blends. I recommend... The end.

reviews.comment: Really amazing class! The prof is so nice and kind and love the way she teaches. Very interesting class with five speeches. The prof grades students nice and kind. Don't hesitate to take this class! Highly recommend! No any homeworks besides speeches. Textbook is not mandantory.

Professor Shaffer is one of the best teachers I've ever had! There is no confusion in this class. She tells you exactly what she expects for each assignment. Professor Shaffer is an AMAZING person and teacher! The class may seem scary at first, but it is very helpful. If you show up to class and do your best, you will do well. She's super funny and always willing to help with assignments. Don't save this class for your senior year! I would take it a thousand times over.
She was great. I use so many things that she taught me in everyday aspects. This is a must take for anyone. Wish she had more classes available
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The nicest teacher I've ever seen to international students. She is there for you, and you can talk to her about your problem whenever you want. Did not feel stress during class. But overall its a speech class, so ALWAYS prepared.

the sweetest and coolest proffessor i ever got to have, she's understanding and you can talk to her about anything. her class is easy and clear, take her!
Awesome professor

Her accent is very thick but you get used to it.

reviews.comment: She's super nice and super easy. You can tell she's super passionate about sociology. As long as you go to class and study some before exams, it's an easy A.

reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

Sweetest professor!

The entire class is just lecture and you have to get used to her thick french accent. She is nice but she's way harder than the other SOC professors, she puts 5 questions on each test from textbook reading. You would think sociology would be easy but her test questions aren't straight forward. strict on attendance, take soc101 with someone else

One of the best professors that I have had at UM. She really does care about her students, and her lectures were quite interesting. Grading is based on three exams, one paper, and participation. I enjoyed my introduction to sociology, and I would recommend this professor for this course.
Meh... She's ok. Her accent wasn't too distracting for me.  Incredibly easy A if you do all your work on time.  Never cracked the book once.

Literally the easiest teacher. Her heavy french accent takes a couple classes to get used to. Attendance mandatory, but she gives you 15 points EC if you only miss three classes. Very in depth powerpoints are given, but she leaves out some stuff to make sure you're paying attention. Overall though, my easiest A at UM.

Super nice and will let you argue your point on exam questions. Easy class if you show up and read the book. She awards extra credit for good attendance. A strong French accent makes the first day or so challenging to understand her but you will get used to it.
Didnt like her. hard to understand and quite boring....but still easy A
Amazing professor that cares about his students!

(BSL425), I cannot express how dope this dude is. By far the best professor I have had at the U as of now. Avery, is a chill dude, but expects you to read and ask questions, he doesnt spoon feed you material but will try his best to help you understand class concepts. Go to his office hours, they help a lot. He does not have an ego, he is the GOAT.

reviews.comment: Best. Prof. Ever. Holy i cannot explain how much I love him.
