Read the textbook + come into class knowing a background of the chapter ur learning that day and you will ace the class. KING ON THIS PLANET ILY JOE.

(BSL 425) Professor Avery is a very nice and chill professor. He doesn't take his lectures too seriously and listens to student feedback. There isn't much structure to his class, but he doesn't pretend that there is. You will learn a lot from him. There is a lot of reading outside of class, and he can get quite philosophical. Great professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is my FAV professor at UM! Such a cool professor and really cares about his students. If you don't understand something, go to his office hours and he will work with you. The class isn't easy but he really prepares you for the test, and teaches in a way that you really start understanding the subject and thinking outside the box. Test heavy tho
Professor Avery is the best! He's such a nice and caring person. If you attend class and participate, getting an A shouldn't be a problem. He's one of the best professors I've had at UM.

Professor Avery is the definition of a living legend! By far the greatest professor I've ever had. He's very personable and understands if you need anything. Don't be afraid to reach out for help, he'll be glad to work with you. Show up to class, participate, ask questions and you should get an A.

Professor Avery is without a doubt the best professor in the entire school. It is no question, you have to take him for Business Law. Any student who took law at the same time with a different teacher would tell you to take Avery. He is the GOAT. What a legend.

Professor Avery singlehandedly created the best classroom experience I've had at any level. I genuinely had fun attending his classes. You never know what is going to happen next. He's also super smart and a great resource in the industry. I wish he taught in the Spring so I could take him for another class.

He truly cares about his students and his lectures actually make you want to attend class. He is an amazing professor and is extremely personable. As long as you attend class and try to understand material outside of class, you will end up with an A. If I could take another class of his just to have him again I would.

One of the best professors I have ever had by far. Its a difficult class that can take time to get a grasp on but he wants you to succeed and helps you a lot. His lectures are awesome,he teaches the material in a very easy way to understand and gives good feedback on your quizzes. Be present and have a sense of humor and the class is very enjoyable

New to teaching and still one of if not the best teachers I've ever had. The exams are stressful at first but you really start to get the hang of them. He wants everyone to succeed. Take him if you can

BSL212 is a difficult class and Professor Avery is great to take for it. If you: take the feedback that he gives you on the first quiz, stay after class if you're confused, show up, and participate when you can --> then he will make sure that you do well. He focuses on making lectures engaging, just be sure to read the chapters he assigns.

TAKE PROFESSOR BRILLAT! She is so caring an so friendly! We had group discussions for every paper wee had and she would bring in coffee and snacks for us and the class environment was so much fun. If you have the chance to take her do it!

Wow Ava is literally the nicest professor Ive ever had. She is so patient with me even though I have no tech or science background. Super easy grader and patient with absences. I literally took an in person class online the whole semester. So sweet.

Please take this professor if you have the chance! I would look forward to her class and she is the most caring professor I've ever had. She is a very kind grader and really cares about her students. Her class is also very interesting and I learned a lot.

Professor Brillat is the best and most caring English professor I've ever had. I'm a math major, but I really enjoyed this class. She is really understanding if you have any issues with assignments and is always available to help. If you submit every essay on time and give it your best effort you will get an A. I highly recommend taking this class

This is by far the nicest, sweetest and most understanding professor Ive ever had. She is an easy grader and really takes the time out of her day to make sure you understand the assignment. I took the science english class as a business major because english classes were filled up and she made me feel so welcome and made sure I was never lost. TAKE

Prof Brillat turned a class I thought I was going to struggle in into one that was very manageable. There is a decent amount of reading to do, but she uploads pdfs so no need to buy any textbook. Also she goes over the readings in class so it's not a big deal if you don't do the reading. Follow instructions for papers and you'll be fine.

You really cannot describe Dr. Rush, you will never have a professor like him. He is very blunt in telling students whatever he wants. Honestly, you will not learn a single thing in class. However, if you go to class and if he knows your name you will get an A. The practice tests provide for like 50% of the questions on the actual test.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Extremely heavy accent. Does not teach accounting, rather gives terrible advice on  random technology. He makes his students feel crappy. A few students in my class teared up because he was so harsh on them. We thought he was the tech support guy - but no, apparently he was our  teacher. You can't take this guy seriously - at all.

Just do the practice tests, and that's it.  His final exam was the same practice test (with the same typos and everything).  You don't need to show up for class, though, if you do and he knows your name, you are guaranteed to get an A.  He will ask to see your homework.  Just turn in anything that looks like accounting homework and that's enough
don't take this class
Read the book, He isn't as mean as he comes across on the first day of class but attending class is pointless. Again Read the book and do the practice tests.

Professor "Rush" has teaching style that boarders on harassment-7 students walked out in 1 class.  He, in turn, insults, degrades, and demeans every student.  He requires you carry the book to class, even though he does not teach AT ALL.  In 4 weeks of classes, he taught 1 chapter, you will learn nothing.  This man is incompetent, avoid him.
this professor is god level, I have nothing to say. can you imagine in 3 week of the classes, he didn't teach any accouting and only teach us how to use blackboard.what a *!

If you aren't going to pursue a career in accounting and just want to get the class over with, TAKE HIS CLASS. You won't understand a lot of what he says, but tests are super easy. If you memorize the practice tests he posts, you will be sure to get an A. He is a very nice and funny guy once you get to know him.

If you take his class be prepared to teach yourself the material from your text.  Accounting is my major as my last professor was absolutely amazing and this guy is making me second guess that. I was the highest grade in the class and still only got an A- despite his "curve".  Out of 32 people originally, only 5 people remained by the second class.
Very boring class, wont learn anything about systems accoun ting but he loves to talk about quizzes and the "project". Juste get on his good side and do all of the project and you will do good.

So weird... He talks about making quizzes and tests and "AUDITING" all the time but you never learn anything about accounting. I never showed up for class and failed the tests and got an A-... Just make sure you do everything for your "project" and you'll be fine. Getting on his good side is a good thing too.

Prepare to be frustrated. assignemts and homeworks are confusing. the quizzes are easy. you can take them many times until you get 100%. The tests are impossible. don't bother to study for the tests. make sure to get on his good side by participating and going to class. do all his homeworks and have your folder ready and you will get and A.

Without a doubt, the worst professor ever!  He makes up assignments and quizzes that completely confuse the students.  You never know what to do.  The tests are impossible.  In order to get a good grade, get on his good side by attending and participating in class.  Once again, it is a terrible class!

I really don't know why he's teaching systems. He did a great job in cost. He is a bit demanding, but he has a big heart. His contribution and dedication to media and technology as a teaching tool is impressive. The man is no dummy, just read his articles. PhD from UT in accounting --the best school in the country for that.
Just show up and you'll get an A.  He is a horrible professor, but as long as you don't argue with him about how unclear he is, you'll get an A.
No Comments

I don't even know what to say. He has no business being a teacher. This is not even a real class. Be ready to be frustrated. He does not teach and he just makes up tons of assignments and you dont know which your actually supposed to do. HORRIBLE. But I hear he gives everyone an A. We shall see...

Seriously one of the craziest professors I have encountered in my college career. we were supposed to learn about accounting sysems, instead we talked about "homework" and "quizzes" that were supposedly due, but never picked up. I would literally sit in class and do something else and I got an A. Get on his good side and you got an A.

SO NICE! he is a great professor. A lot of time and effort are needed to do well. Homework assignments are hard and take a really long time but help you understand the material. Always willing to make time for extra help. Don't take this class if you aren't good at math or don't want to put in any effort.

Extremely nice and helpful professor. Some say 311 is a joke. They obviously didn't have Awad. This class is tough. The lecture notes are helpful, and if you understand the homework, then the exams aren't bad. If you want to learn something, take this class. If not, take Hullet and spend the semester calculating means and modes.

VERY HARD CLASS! Awad is the nicest prof ever and always willing to help but teaches in a complicated way so its hard to grasp. Super nice though. If you want an easy A take Hulett, if you actually want to learn MAS take Awad

Great teacher. Extremely smart. Ask questions, participate in class and do the assignments and you'll be fine. Class is technically optional but if you don't go you'll be lost (MAS is hard in general). Very helpful, always around for extra help if necessary.

Very intelligent and knowledgable about the subject. Sometimes difficult to follow so you have to pay close attention. He gives you all the notes which helps a lot. HW is challenging, exams are manageable but you do have to prepare well. Actually a very friendly and patient professor who'll help you with any problems!

Brilliant guy. He has a slight accent, and it takes a few classes to get used to his teaching style, but in the end, he provides an amazing foundation for Stats. Tests and homework sets are very challenging, although he provides plenty of Extra Credit. Go to his office, read his notes: they are the base for most homework&tests, and are EXTREMELY he

He is a great professor. It is a really difficult class though. He tries to help by having a lot of office hours and his grading system lets you make up for crappy test grades through hw and extra credit.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. Take it during the summer somewhere else. AWAD CANNOT TEACH. ANY QUESTIONS ARE ANSWERED WITH A DUCK AND DODGE.  I asked him once when to use a formula and he said "you use it when you need it".  Unless you already know what P(Y=i|C) means don't even bother looking at this class.

A little difficult to understand. Prior to each quiz he gives a couple homework assignments on blackboard and he picks one of them and may slightly change them for the quiz.  You are allowed a cheat sheet, so I would simply write out how to do the problems and got 100 on each quiz.  I barely paid attention or went to class and got a B.
No Comments

This class is extremely difficult! Dr. Awad is by far the most relaxed professor this year, and probably the best professor I've had at Miami. He is very helpful, and understanding...most of all...VERY PATIENT! If you ever have any questions, he is always available to help the students out.

This is hard course. I think the way he explain the materials make it little more difficult compare to my other statistic teacher. However, he is very nice man, care about students, listen to comments and make adjustments where neccessary. Tests are difficult as well, but extra credits help a lot. Overall, he's good professor.

This class is HARD. It takes time to understand what your notes really mean. But he is ALWAYS available. I chill w/ Awad many a afternoon. He's always appoligetic too when his tests are hard, he make adjustments if he feels something's not working.
He is a great teacher, and is always open to help you out! But the course is extremely hard and  you will need to put in HOURS and HOUrs of work to get a good grade...but overall he is a good teacher

I see a lot of reviews on his language barrier & personally think he does an amazing job. If you don't understand then ASK he will go over it again don't be ignorant and if you are a Spanish speaker have a little more compassion as we all come some way some how from a strong accent family. Dr. Ayub cares for for his students 42 students all passed.

Prof. Ayub is very knowledgeable professor  with excellent skill that help a lot to understand the entire Nursing Process. His ability to combine lecture topics  and clinical are exceptional and his "Nursing Student Grand Round" are incredible and amazing. If your are interesting to became a real professional nurse I recommended Prof. Ayub100 % .

Professor Ayub was my clinical instructor at UMH and he was wonderful. I learned a lot from him and he taught us many useful tips on how to be excellent effective and efficient nurses. Hes very knowledgeable and has a lot of experience. He is very kind and wants the best for his students. I recommend him as a clinical instructor.

While I was unable to experience my Adult Health II clinical rotation entirely in the hospital, Professor Ayub made the clinical experience in the hospital and online the very best that it could possibly be. We gained a lot of insight from his own knowledge and own experiences and his help navigating us through the hospital. Thank you Prof. Ayub!

Prof. Ayub was my clinical instructor at University of Miami/Jackson Memorial Hospital. He is a demanding, highly ethical, punctual and extremely dedicated to his students. He makes his clinical classes an excellent smooth transition from NUR304 to NUR308 where he helps his students to understand the new knowledge. Prof. Ayub is 100% Recommended.

Professor Ayub was my clinical instructor for NUR308 or Adult Health 2. He was really helpful. He gave the group games that incorporate clinical skills and knowledge about different subjects cover in class. Also, every single clinical day he will cover and teach tricks of been a good nurse. Highly recommend Prof. Ayub, wonderful instructor
Luis is a caring clinical instructor who makes it easy to get comfortable trying new skills
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: very caring instructor and there to help if needed!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Prof. Ayub was a great clinical instructor. He helped us get great clinical experiences and always encouraged us to try new clinical tasks. He always pushed us to do our best to succeed in the nursing field.

Professor Ayub is very caring, to all his students at the University of Miami/ Jackson Memorial Hospital. He makes clinical a very fun experience and allows students to be creative and think outside the box. I had my clincial in a Level 1 Trauma Ryder Center and it was amazing experience. I reccomend professor Ayub to all students!

You can notice that he cared and had a passion for his profession. He tells you what you need to know about the class; however, there is a lot of material covered in each exam. He also has two group projects, which can be difficult if you do not find a proper group. You will enjoy his lectures if he has stories included which are unique.
Take Professor Ash if you can. His stories are very entertaining and he really gives good life advice. His experience reflects in his teaching. Very good professor.

Professor Ash's teaching style either works for you or not. He reads form outlines every class, it's kind of heavy lecture based. If you're good at memorizing terms and definitions you'll be fine. Attendance is not mandatory. Also no homework. Be in class, listen to him and his stories, take notes and you'll do just well.

While I do think Professor Ash was knowledgeable about marketing, I don't think that his class was very beneficial for people that are generally interested in learning more about the subject. He reads word-for-word off lecture outlines, which in my opinion doesn't offer anything as I can do the same thing, but did give good real-life examples.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Cannot say enough nice things about him. If you can get past the first exam his class is very enjoyable, you'll hear about all kinds of real-life examples of what you're learning that seem too wack to be true. He also claims to scale the semester grades which didn't end up happening, but I liked him so much there's no hard feelings

Really nice guy but does not teach anything. Attendance is optional and nobody goes because all he does is read directly from the textbook the entire class. Tests are multiple choice and short answer. The short answer is listing terms out which sounds easy but listing 40 terms out off straight memorization can be tough.

Ben Ash is a great professor. He makes jokes throughout every lecture. He is happy to be there teaching and telling stories. He does one cold call per student and one case study which is super easy. Fun group project. His outlines are super helpful and he tells you what's going to be on tests. Memorize and study what he tells you to. Great guy.

He is a really nice guy. You do not really have to attend class. Grade is based off three test and two group papers (very easy). The test are difficult if you are not good at memorization. He tells you exactly what terms will be on the test and they are on the chapter outlines he provides. Easy A if you have the time to memorize a lot of material.

Great person. Class is solely lectures of him reading chapter outlines. Tests are long and require detailed memorization. Grade is composed of the final, 2 tests, 2 easy group projects, 50 points for your cold call and 50 points for your case study.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is a super nice guy and has a lot of real world experience with the topics that are discussed in class, so his stories are very fun to listen too. His tests are very difficult, but if you show up to class and participate it shouldn't be a problem. All he really does in class is read off of his outlines he lets you print. He's decent overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: his class is basically him reading off his powerpoints. You learn nothing from his class. He is very nice tho.

I really like Prof. Ash, he is extremely experienced and this shines through in his lectures. I felt the group project was enjoyable, though the exams I felt were a little too challenging, and requires strong memorization of points which were only briefly covered in class. Other than that, I would totally take his course again.

Professor Ash is a great professor, but on top of that, hes an awesome guy. He really cares about all of his students. The lecture material is straight out of the notes and powerpoints that he provides so its nothing too heavy. He also tells funny stories so even though attendance isnt mandatory, it can definitely be worth it. He is a gem.

If you pay attention in class and study for exams it's not bad. He is a really nice professor, really cares about his students, and makes lectures fun. He reads off outlines that you can print before class and has lots of stories to tell to go with the class material. 2 group projects and know your case for participation on the day you are assigned

There is a lot of material and the class can become a lot. His exams are manageable, but study throughout the weeks because all the material can become unbearable. His curve helps immensely and can bump you up a letter grade. The textbook is necessary for readings, and there are two group projects.

Professor Ash is a really nice guy. Nothing against him at all, but genuinely this class is a nuisance. Every class he just reads directly from the course notes (20-25 per class). It's just so boring. There isn't any variation in class and a lot of the material is the same. There are definitely better and more interesting Marketing classes to take.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The textbook lectures are boring, but his stories are hilarious. At first I found his class kinda boring, but as the class gets into stuff he is more passionate about it picks up. Hes a solid professor worth taking.

Professor Ash is a great, funny, and knowledgable teacher. His classes can get dull because he is just reading the outlines but the stories he tells are interesting and funny. Attendance is mandatory because of his cold calls which seriously impact your grade. There's no homework but the tests do have a lot of info on them. Great class!

Professor Ash is a solid professor to take. He has really cool insight because of his past job. However, his lectures are basically him reading off the class notes and can get pretty boring but attendance isn't mandatory. Tests cover a lot of material but are very doable if you study hard. Put in the effort and you can get an A. He's a great guy
Average class, be prepared for lectures in which he reads the outlines. He gives real-life examples which made the class interesting about TEXICO. Test are HEAVY and cover most of the final grade

Every single class is literally him reading the outlines verbatim. There is like no point in showing up to class when you could just read the outline at home but he does take attendance randomly. Overall likeable guy and boring but easy class.

Best class I have ever taken at UM! His lectures are engaging and inspirational. Not only is Professor Ash an outstanding lecturer, but he is also a kindhearted individual. He tries to get to know all of his students before, during, and after lectures. If you want an excellent professor that also truly cares about you, take his class.

Professor Ash has fantastic insights when it comes to marketing because of his work experience with Texaco. There are 3 exams, 2 projects, and a one time participation. The exams are straightforward because he tells you exactly what is on them. About half the class fails the first exam. Don't worry there is a final curve. Definitely take his class!

Professor Ash is the GOAT! He tells the coolest stories! He says exactly what terms are on the 3 exams (60% of grade). They are easy A's. There is NO FINAL. For the 2 projects (30%), he rarely gives B's on them. For participation (10%), you just have to talk about a case once at the end of class. It is very easy. I would HIGHLY recommend Ash!

Class was really boring & he would just read the outlines he posted to you VERBATIM. Only thing that was semi interesting were his stories. you still had to show up because each class he randomly selects people to ask questions & that's your participation grade. Kind of a harsh grader on the group projects. tests were also hard. curves at the end
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I've never rated a professor/teacher ever, but with Ash I couldn't resist. The guy is fantastic; he has real world experience that he uses in his lectures (not mandatory btw). His tests are hard, but he will make sure you perform well. I failed test 1 (like, failed) and was able to finish with a B+. 3 Exams, 2 group projects and a final. TAKE HIM!

First things first: Ash starting using a new textbook for MKT 301/201 in Spring '18, so don't rely on old comments. Literally reads chapter outlines. 4 textbook-based exams, 2 group papers and presentations (doesn't tell you what he expects from assignments until AFTER grading them). First exam class average was an F at 59%. Curve was a lifesaver.

Professor has interesting stories to share in class and clearly has a lot of experience in the marketing field however he is completely unapproachable outside of class, even in office hours. During his lectures he reads off of the chapter summaries he uploads to blackboard. Reading the book is necessary before the exams if you expect to do well.

Has a pretty huge ego. If you want to learn everything from MKT 201 again plus a little bit of advertising, listen to his stories about Texaco, and brag about all of his money and nice things, then go for it! He also likes to secretly dock your grade if you skip class, even though attendance "isn't mandatory".
Amazing and well-respected professor. Let's you know what is on the exam the class before the exam. There is a group assignment (two essays and two presentations).
Cool guy , tells you how it is. Straight forward on what you need to know for tests and also knows a lot about marketing. Great guy/ great class.

Professor Ash is awesome, and he's funny. He's a great guy and very straight forward with the material that you will need to know. As long as you put in effort this class isn't too hard. No homework, but there are group presentations, which are about 5 mins (1 min a person). Overall would take again for sure

Great lecturer, makes class interesting, and his examples make it easy to remember the material. He sets the course up so that you can pass it if you're willing to try. Lots of industry experience, cares about his students, and is easy to reach out to.

Advertising management wasn't the easiest class I've ever taken, but Professor Ash clearly laid out each and every topic at hand. He made it as interesting as he could, but lectures were sometimes long and boring. Tests are easy if you study for them, attendance isn't mandatory, and if you show interest in advertising, he's a great connection.

BE SURE TO GET A GOOD GROUP.  Choose the smart, hard-working types, because group projects are a HUGE chunk of your grade and you don't want to carry the team.  DO NOT procrastinate on group projects; we pulled all nighters about 5x and it sucked.  Ash is a great teacher and lots of fun, but his class requires a lot of work.

Ben Ash is hands down the most amazing professor I have had. His credentials are absurd and his back story is enlightening. He's the most tell-it-like-it-is guy that I've ever met. He'll tell you the truth to what you need to do/be to have success in the future. Admits that he hates grades and cares more about developing the individual. Must take.

His lectures can get repetitive because you do the same things everyday but he is really easy because he tells you exactly what you need to study for the test. He also gives a ton of personal stories so that you're able to relate what you're learning to the real world. Nice, funny, and easy.

Professor Ash is an awesome professor. He is passionate about the subject and although he tends to veer off into storyland he is excellent at giving the material and is always there for you. two group presentations, three exams ( which he gives you an extremely detailed study guide for ) and one in class assignment. great professor take him!!!
Easy going guy. Get ready to hear Texaco stories. Tells you what is going to be on the test from his notes. Definitely take him. Put in a little work and you'll get an A.
BEST TEACHER EVER! LOVE HIM AND HIS CLASS! TAKE HIM

Funny guy.. but his stories get old pretty quickly.. Though so much of his class is basically handed to you.. He tells you everything that will be on exam.. Easy class participation.. Group projects/presentations kind of suck but they aren't too difficult and that's really as bad as it gets in this class so.. I'd recommend.

Ash is ok. TAKE THIS CLASS WITH FRIENDS: 6 group papers. doesn't tell you what he expects on papers until after you hand them in which is annoyingunprofessional. Go to lecture right before the exam and you'll get an A if you study alot. Don't buy the book, take a picture of one of the cases and answer simple ?s in class once for 100% participation

He's funny and personable, but after hearing the same stories over and over again about his position in an oil company plus just how rich he really is, you get tired of it. We had six total papers this year (all done in a group by the way). Tells you exactly whats on the test right before the actual test which (just go to that lecture&you'll pass).

Ash makes going to an 8 am not the worst thing in the world.  He's funny, and he tries to engage his students.  Unfortunately, this class is almost exactly like CAD 114 except for a project and presentation that we had to do at the end.  It uses the same books, and the tests are extremely similar.

He's a funny guy but definitely not too much to learn from him. He has nothing but stories about him working at his beloved gas company. Completely a waste of time and lots of work for a entry level. Really useless. NOT recommending him at all.

He is the BEST teacher I have had at UM. I didnt mind waking up at 8 for his class.  He tells you EXACTLY what is on the exam during class and then again during the final review. The tests are straightforward and really easy if you study exactly what he told you. Really helpful and wants  you to succeed.

He is the BEST marketing professor in the whole departement. Teaches you real knowledge from his real experience. Very VERY interesting and charismatic professor. Test are not the easiest, but just go over class notes and you are fine. Btw he gives you ALL notes. Just take him. He is the best.

Great professor, has lots of fun stories to back up any topic covered in class. Very clear explanations, and really knows his stuff from working in the business. Tests are hard if you don't study, but if you pay attention in class and follow his study guides you'll do just fine in the class.
Best Marketing teacher at UM

Class now consists of 5 small group projs instead of one big one. Good luck getting higher than an 85 on those, he's looking for out of the box. The exams r easy bc he tells you what to study, the only reason the first one is hard is bc its longer and u dont know what to expect. MEMORIZE THE LISTS. Lots of stories, overall great guy and funny too.

The most interesting professor I've ever had. His whole class consists of his own personal marketing war stories. You don't have to attend, but you'll want to. His first test is tough, but the other 3 are easy. He grades the project tough but fairly. His test reviews tell you all the answers, and it's impossible to get less than a B in the class.

Interesting, knowledgeable, and fair teacher.  Awesome life stories he tells when relevant to the subject matter.  Class is not a breeze, but he tells you exactly what to study on the exams, so if you put in the effort you'll do fine.  My only complaint is his very tough grading on the final project- so make sure it's impeccable!

He is an amazing teacher. He has a story for all the topics we go over so if you go to class and pay attention, you'll remember the info. Gives reviews for the tests and there is a group project at the end. Take this teacher!!

Most overrated professor ever. Everyone loves him...but their is no substance behind it. He is not a good teacher at all and his tests don't test your knowledge but is just pure memorization of useless facts. He comes off as a good guy at the beginning but really is not.

AVOID! He got so strict this year trying to teach a class he has never taught before... He takes attendance, he asks us to read the book then quiz us, which is useless since that is not the way to teach advertisement! Got a B- and studied literally every week...

One of my favorite professors. He makes class interesting and easy. You don't really have to read the book because his notes and powerpoints tell it all. He gives reviews before tests that tell exactly whats going to be on them. Easy test and easy A.
a

Good teacher. Tests are pretty easy and he makes it easy to do well on tests because he tells you exactly what is on it the class before. You can skip class and not miss much, except for some funny stories. Take him.

Easily my best professor of the semseter. Great guy, and a decent teacher. Teaches with powerpoints right out of the book, so tests are straight out of the book. Tests involve A LOT of cramming, but probably the best intro marketing class. Good guy. Good stories. Can skip and not miss much
Great professor, very knowledgeable, clear, and open to answer question. Gives a great review for the exam. Pick him!

This guy is awesome.  He outlines the text book with powerpoints every class, and he connects it with his real world experience with Texaco.  His classes are hysterical and he has really funny expressions.  The test are made really easy by the reviews, make sure to study lists.
The only teacher who makes me work. He actual causes you to learn the material.

Tells good stories, but if you want to learn marketing, take someone else.  He gives outlines from the book, and quickly reads them word for word every class.  Tests are easy if you can memorize lists, don't require any actual thought.  Not recommended, unless youd rather hear off-topic stories than learn marketing youll need in future mkt classes.
Easy to get a good grade due to the professor's reviews before an exam!

Probably one of the most interesting professors in the whole school, he can tell you about his adventures in Europe and with Texaco. Prof. Ash is one of the best professors ever.  He is truly a nice guy, and his stories are priceless.  The class involves tests and 1 marketing project. The class I took was the most unpleasant of my semester. Her lectures are boring and the information in the class is mostly nonsense. The class is flipped so you basically learn the work at home then come to class to do harder questions with her. She is pretty nice and will help out if you need it. The class is not very hard but the tests are pretty heavily weighted and usually only have a handful of questions.

Professor Azadi is a great professor, she does flipped learning which can be annoying and there definitely is a lot of homework but it helps you actually learn the material (and helps that its a big part of your grade and balances out the tests). Its not the easiest class, but definitely would recommend her. She's super nice and will help you out!

Absolutely awful and does not care of the grade or wellbeing of the student. I am in her class right now, I warn you, do not take her. Her lectures are boring and she goes way too quickly. This class isn't supposed to be as hard as it is.

PLEASE avoid her.

I can see she cares and puts a lot of effort into the class but way to much work during and outside class. Too many quizzes, too much going on in the class for you to take in. She is very nice and professional but the class is a living headache.
She is nice enough but gives way too much HW. The test questions felt way harder than the homework too. I studied a lot and still struggled on exams
Too many exercises and homework in class and after class. The homework and exams are really difficult, which is not covered in her lectures. The lecture pace is very fast.

I actually took her for MGT 446, but that wasn't an option. This is the second time I have taken her and she is great. Really knowledgeable about supply chain strategy and very willing to help students. Graded on 3 homework assignments, exams, and group projects and presentations

Goes over lots of in-class examples so you know exactly what is on the tests. A very nice professor and has a clear structure for classes so you know what you're walking into each class. She makes the curriculum easy to understand and doesn't make the tests too hard. Would highly recommend.

Professor Azadi is a very good professor. She clearly explains the course material and puts all of her notes on blackboard. Theres a lot of homework, quizzes, and in class assignments, but if you show up and pay attention, it should be an easy A. I would recommend taking her.

Class starts off easy and gets hard very quick. Put in work and you'll be ok. She's a fine choice for the class.

She is organized, super understandable, and fun. This class is super interesting for the supply chain world, and in general very interesting for everyone. You do a lot of excel and read the powerpoints, if you are on top of it you can get an A. She is a very good person as well. Take this class and take her. Not an easy class.
She is a really good professor
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

really nice!!!!! I love her!!!! Pay attention to the class and ppt and get A

She is a really nice professor and since it was a distance learning class it was only discussion boards and quizzes based on the reading (short chapters). Professor Lopez is very engaging. Her lectures are very clear and interesting. She uses real life examples and thought provoking questions. Also she gives good feedback to papers. Ms Aze is SUCH A SWEET HEART. She's super encouraging and always wants to help. Sometimes the lectures get boring but that doesn't stop her from asking people to participate. Would totally take again.
Excellent teacher! She is always willing to help and provide feedbacks to your papers. Her assignments made me think out of the box and had a great impact in my life. I would def take her again.

Honestly, she is the best teacher that I have taken at the University of Miami.  Although the class material was super hard, she worked with me so much and every time I went to her office hours to work over past test, she would help out my grade. She is hands down the sweetest professor I have taken. Extremely compassionate and understanding. She is easy to approach and helps her students out in any way she can. She made the topics very easy to understand. She changed my life. I hope she reads this one day. If you put in some effort you will definitely pass! Take her, you will not regret it
Extremely nice and flexible about your problems and issues

Great teacher, gives helpful powerpoint, tests aren't too tough if you study and there's only 3 not counting the final which is not cumulative. She allows extra credit work to be handed in which helps raise your grade if you scored low on a test. Love her and would definitely take again!
AMAZING professor. so smart and approachable. very kind and truly cares about her students

Game theory can be tricky, especially if you don't have a stats background. With that said, Professor Kaya keeps her lectures engaging with interesting real life examples, and the homeworks (3) and exams (2+final) are very similar to the examples she presents in class.
Very straightforward class structure. Quizzes weekly, but if you attend the lectures you will be fine.

Lectures are long and boring. Difficult to stay engaged. Accessible outside of class but makes simple concepts very confusing. Midterm and Final are not cumulative and open note. Very good professor. People say her lectures are boring but I found them interesting.Take her if you can.

Professor Kaya is very knowledgeable but her class is so boring, she just talks the whole hour and a half, and it's hard to stay focused. I found it very hard to follow Professor Kaya's class. She explained things in the most complicated way possible. However, I still received a high grade because every test and quiz is open note, and she gave multiple extra credit opportunities. The class was very easy to get a good grade in, but I don't feel like I learned much.

I didn't like her at first but she gives A LOT of opportunities to improve your grade. Open note quizzes every week + homework of equal weight so make sure you do HW! 2 exams also open note. Curves at the end and gives extra credit. The only real issue is that her lectures are terribly boring but if you do the work you will be completely fine!

reviews.comment: Big class so she didnt really get to know anyone unless you actually go up to her. Quizzes everyweek but not hard if you do the homework. Everything is open note so re watch her top hat videos.

reviews.comment: Overall a good class. Lectures on Tuesday with a small lecture and a quiz on Thursday. Homework is due every Tuesday at 11:59p. This class is especially easy if you have taken economics prior to taking this class. Although her lectures are quite boring, they match up pretty well with the homework and exam content.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: As someone who never took Econ before I was really confused because she explains things odd; however, kids in my class who took Econ before said it was very easy. Although I ended with a good grade I do not understand Econ at all. Very long, hard to follow lectures. Weekly homework isn't bad but quizzes every week are annoying.

Gives weekly quizzes and homework that are worth most of your grade. No exams except for the final and everything is open notes. Lectures are kind of boring and she has an accent but the material is simple. The homework is usually exactly what is on the quizzes so as long as you do your homework you will be fine.

She's super nice and class is easy if you are good at ECO or look things up. But her lectures are super boring and she overcomplicates simple topics to the point where it doesn't make any sense. Lots of extra credit. Not terrible but not my favorite.

Each quiz and each homework are worth 3.5 points. Quiz every tuesday (open notes), homework due every monday. Homework is 7 easy questions. She has a very heavy accent so sometimes its hard to understand her but she is nice and understanding. Open book final.

I would not recommend taking this class to anyone. You will not be able to understand her thick accent and her sentence structure when she speaks. Furthermore, she makes many mistakes on the homework and quiz questions and answers. She is also a harsh grader. She has a thick accent so not the easiest to understand, but she gave a ton of extra credit. Changed her format so there is a short, easy quiz every week and no exams. She's very sweet, lectures can be a little dull but she is super helpful. She will help you when you need it and wants you to succeed. good choice for econ

One of the worst Professors I have ever had. could barely understand a word she was saying and was not helpful at all when asked questions. reviews.comment: She is the best teacher ever. To be honest, economics is not a easy subject and it has a lot of math involved. She is a very understandable people and really helped us with the final grades.

Professor Kaya is great, she really makes sure you understand. It's important to read the textbook chapters before class so you understand the material she talks about in class. the worst prof I have ever had. So hard to understand and is bad at explaining. The class averages are always so low and she never goes over it. She is the best microeconomics teacher in this school. She gives you all the tools and the resources to succeed in her class and her lectures are inspirational. Do not leave UM without taking Dr. Kaya's econ class!

Literally best teacher. Gives you so much material for the tests to study and drops a bunch of grades if you don't do well. Also extremely smart, very well qualified and always there for extra help. Wish every teacher was like her

Smart lady and pretty cute. Has a bit of an accent that can make you lose focus sometimes. She really knows her stuff and makes it easy to understand the material. Not trying to make anybody fail. Just pay attention to the lectures and read the book. It's not hard material.

This professor is the best math teacher I have ever had. She gives tests and tells you exactly what is on it. Assigns HW but it's not graded.
Super sweet prof. Her accent that people complain about isnt bad if youre from Miami :) her quizzes and test are to the point and easy. I recommend her to everyone
Good teacher. Quizzes are extra credit and tests are one page. You dont need to buy the textbook unless you really need to do extra practice problems

reviews.comment: Very nice person, but very hard to understand her as her English is not great. Homework counts as extra credit but she doesn't tell anyone that until well into the semester and there is no way to go back and see the assignments as they are posted on the board each day and then erased. 12 out of 23 students were FAILING this class when I withdrew.
reviews.rating_tags: Tests? Not many--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: The only things that are graded are your tests and then you have the ability to get a max of 15 extra points from the three quizzes she gives. reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: This entire class comes down to just doing the homework. She was always very clear about what would be on the quizzes and tests. Quizzes were are about 6 points each and counted as extra credit towards the tests. Good explanations and didn't give more work than was necessary.

She is a great professor, if you are not good at math take her. DO THE HOMEWORK! i cant emphasize that enough, the tests are based a lot off the homework. if you dont do the homework you wont do as well unless youre naturally good at math. show up to class because her examples are exactly like the quizzes&tests. dont let the easiness fool you,study

Great professor. She assigns short non-graded homework sometimes (on the weekend). As long as you understand the class and homework examples then you should get an A. Also, she provides extra credit quizzes for her Exams. Sometimes she doesn't go in depth with explanations but she's willing to explain after classduring office hrs. Take her!

Greatest Math profteacher I've ever had. Is very clear on the material and the tests are based exactly on the material she teaches in class. Gives extra credit quizzes before tests which are easy and a useful extra 5points for each test. Highly recommend her!!!

Professor Azofra is one of the best math teachers I have ever had. She will give you quizzes before a test for 5 points of extra credit so quizzes won't hurt you, just help you. She can be sometimes hard to understand because of her accent but overall, easy class if you go to class. Go to class, or you'll find it hard.

There are only three tests throughout the semester, not including the final. Each quiz is counted as 5-points of extra credit that will be added to your test grades. Take neat notes even though she will gives a thorough review of the material the class before the test.

One of the nicest teachers I have taken at UM. Very helpful when it comes to reviewing the material. She will teacher one thing the whole class if it's a difficult subject. She is always available to help after class. She even reviews the material 10 minutes before the tests. Easy A if you show up and pay a little attention.

Her exams are easy and she teaches you everything before. I don't go to many classes but i go to hers because they are so useful. You'd be an idiot not to take her class. Easy A as long as you can understand her English.

Explains everything step-by-step (sometimes unnecessarily)so you shouldn't have a hard time understanding the material. Easy quizzes are for 5 points extra credits towards tests (which are short). Good teacher. She is an extremely easy teacher though, and because she doesn't check homework or take attendance, it's easy to be tempted into skipping class and not review the material. Loved her. She is great, there are quizes for extra points and 3 tests and a final. Just review the material and you will get a good grade.

One of the best math teachers at UM. She teaches in a very simplistic way. Yes, she's got a heavy accent but its not as bad as people make it out to be. She always gives a review before tests. Tests are exactly like the review. Quizzes are bonus points. Love her!

Azofra is extremely clear in the way she explains things, and reinforces the concepts with many examples. If you attend class and do the homework, it's pretty hard to fail - even if you're like me and have trouble with math. 4 test with bonus quizzes. There are no surprises or curveballs, the tests are just like the homework.
such an easy class and i learned a lot. she's a great teacher, don't listen to what other people say. she's not that hard to understand.

Prof Azofra is helpful, but sometimes hard to understand. class is very easy to drift off to sleep in. Most people in class are only there for requirement, so interest level amongst students will be low. overall, okay class and teacher.

This class is verrryy easy. The tests never have tricks and the quizzes are extra credit added on to the quiz. Math is not my strong point and I've gotten a 99 and 100 on the tests so far. Definitely recommended.
ONE OF THE BEST PROFESSORS IN UM!!! She's such a sweetheart! very nice and helpful.. She is willing to help anytime in class... God bless her! TAKE HER!!! She's the best! love u mrs. azofra! U ROCK!

This class is an easy A. Homework is not mandatory, but recommended. She does not really teach by the book, instead applies other simpler methods to get to an answer. Her test are real easy. This class is pretty easy.  She gives 3 tests and 3 quizzes.  Quizzes count as extra credit and is added to the test for that chapter.  Cumulative exam at end of the semester.  She is very helpful and is a very nice professor.  I definitely reccomend her class.

She's always willing to slow down if you ask her. She will explain everything you ask her too. All quizzes are extra credit towards your exams. Only 4 exams and they're not too hard. Homework is optional, but you'll want to do it to keep up.

I have Azofra now and this class is almost too easy.  Go to class and you will be fine.  She goes very slowly and doesn't miss any steps when going over problems so students know exactly what to do.  The quizes are for extra credit and tests are SO easy. I definitely recommend her.
If math is not your string subject, do not take her and you like math then take her. Seemed as though a lot of times students were confused. Does not teach well in my opinion, moves too fast.

She is a very thorough, helpful teacher. Her 3 tests are extremely easy but you have to either go to class or do the homework to do well on the tests. Her quizzes are completely extra credit which adds points to your tests. She wants you to succeed and will go over problems until everyone understands them. I would definitely recommend her!

Always willing to help, she explains the problems that you don't understand. Her tests are relatively easy if you study, and you get extra points from the quizzes. You don't have to attend class, but it's beneficial if you do. Homework is assigned for practice, not for a grade. Overall very fair and a wonderful teacher.

She is a great teacher and very nice. She helps people when they need it and her quizzes are extra credit for the tests. Her tests are fair and not that long. She has a strong Cuban accent, but it is still very easy to understand.
She is very nice and willing to help with quetions.  She will go over and over the information until you understand it.  She wants you to suceed.

I did not like her at all. It seemed as if she shunned upon class participation, yet got annoyed when no one participated. She will correct a grade/problem is she sees she is at fault but she can't teach for crap -.-. worst 8am class of my life.

She's nice and willing to help, but unfortunately her class is boring and I dreaded going.  It's pretty easy especially if you did a lot of the same kind of math in high school, but if you are just learning the material she isn't very good at explaining.

Only gives 3 100-point test and the final. Some questions on the tests are weighted more than they should based on the concept/work involved. Go during office hours if you can, she is willing to explain anything you don't understand.

She's really nice and will take time to explain anything you don't understand.  Definitely buy the book because she assigns homework (she doesn't check it though).  There are 3, 100 point exams, and 3, 4 extra credit point quizzes along with a final.  The class isn't difficult, but just make sure you actually do some of the homework, it will help!
great teacher. love her

Class is ok. Assigns Homewoek but does not check it, so your only grade in the class are the tests and the extra credit quizzes.when I asked to see her during office hours she was more willing to see me then than to see me during her office hours, like she didnt want to come to her office hours.but will change grades if she sees shes at fault.

Professor Azofra is incredibly nice. She is willing to take the time and explain something if you do not get. She even asks in class if she needs to slow down. Her class is really easy to pass. She offers extra credit that goes towards your final exam. If you want an "A" take her class.
Worst professor ever. She doesnt care about you at all and will fail you as easy as 1 2 3. they should fire her

The sweetest, soft spoken teacher! She has an accent but it's not thick at all and can be very boring. She is soo thorough with her teaching. helps you WHENEVER you need it. Give's quizes (she warns you when they're coming)and they're extra credit. I'm horrible at math and I got a 104 on the first test! shes amazing!
She keeps the material clear and concise.
She was a very easy teacher. Everyone does bad on the second test, but she lets you drop it if you get above an 80 on the Final. Only hard part is understanding her strong accent.
Great teacher. Explains everything in detail and gives plenty of examples. I really enjoy her teaching methods. Her exams are fairly easy. I recommend this teacher!!
Really sweet, will go over concepts multiple times to make sure everyone understands. Homework is optional, and she gives quizzes for extra credit. Only bad thing is her strong accent.

Easy class if you understand the material. I had trouble, you are only graded on tests, so your grade has no cushion, sink or swim kinda thing. There are bonus quizzes, extra-credit points for your tests, don't do well on them, no worries. HW is given for your own benefit, it's not graded. Very, very tought spanish accent to understand.

I LOVER HER!! She is so nice! She goes over the notes a million times. I really only go to class once a week and if I know there is an extra credit quiz I that day and she explains everything that is going to be on right before. She is super easy!

Very nice teacher. Kind of hard to understand due to accent. Very helpful. Goes over notes a million times until everyone in the class understands what is going on. Take her class! If you pass the 3 exams w/a 90 or higher, you don't take the final!! :)
I took her MTH103 course.  Easiest math class ever.  Extra-credit quizzes, easy tests, optional final.

The material is easy but you have to really listen to understand this professor. Her handwriting is horrible at best and all the tests are handwritten. She also tends to write a different number than from what she is saying so you'll write 3 but she says 4 and you'd better rasise your hand to get her straight. I got an A in the class.

really easy math class really easy teacher. she was really sweet and made sure you understood everything. she had a weird accent and was hard to understand at times, but overall it was fine. good class if you want the easy way out.

Easiest math class ever, everyone but one student outta 22 didnt have to take the final based on an "a" going into the last week of class. Once you catch onto her "sino and cosino" accent, very easy and shes super nice as well
Really good teacher, good explanations if you pay attention.

Shes gotta strong accent, but overall her class is really easy.. It's so easy to pass her tests and she also has extra credit bonus quizzes. I recommend her for someone whose looking to get an easy A.
freshman year, the only math class i needed to graduate.  you could not understand a word this woman said she and she made no effort to help you.

She has a very strong accent, and this made her difficult to follow, but it's not impossible.  The material itself is very easy, and she makes it even easier by counting your grade out of the best of 3 tests.  This means if you do good on the first 3 tests, you don't even have to show up the last 3 weeks of class.  I recommend her, but not if you completely are horrible at math.

Easy material and teacher if you've taken it before.  She has a Latin accent, but being from miami, I'm used to it.  I took this class junior year of high school and I find it extremely simple, the accent might be a slight problem.
Very difficult to understand.
SHe's so nice

You can't even understand what she says, it's an okay class if you want to not show up and get the notes from someone else, but if you have never taken it, YOU WILL BE LOST. 4 tests, your whole grade is based on the best 3 of the 4. she has bonus quizzes, yet the class is SO boring it's hard to go
Hard to understand his lectures. His practice problems are not similar to the test. You have to know the math because it is so hard to understand his accent

I could barley understand him-his accent is so heavy. The quizzes were super easy, I got 100 on all of them. Imagine how confident I felt walking into the exam thinking this class was an easy A, right? Wrong. The final was impossible even with the allowed note sheet. I think I got a 0% on it genuinely. I am a straight. Do not take him-tanked my 4.0

reviews.comment: hes the goat

He has everything you need for the quizzes/exams on blackboard. Learn to use calculator bc its much faster, even if he doesn't require it. Just practice the questions he gives bc they are lit copy-pasted with different numbers. U have two-sided formula sheet, use it.

Tests and quizzes are open notes. Class is making good notes to bring to the test, and understanding everything in the notes you brought. All notes and lectures are online. He can be hard to understand at times, but he makes sense. I recommend going to class, as it helps to have someone talk you through the problems, but you can teach yourself too.

professor Vega is very nice and records the lectures prior to teaching them every morning. attendance is only taken when he remembers. there's a quiz every week or every other week but the material is pretty easy if you study 2-3 days in advance and do the practice problems he does in class. easy class if you know how to teach yourself.

Extremely thick accent. I wouldn't even bother trying to learn from him because you will spend most the time trying to understand what he just said. Does let students use a 2 sided reference sheet for every test so I recommend just copy and pasting all the homework questions onto the ref sheet and printing it for the test. No partial credit too.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I have nothing against this professor, he's a very nice guy. However, his teaching method is terrible, lectures are super difficult to understand so you have to teach yourself everything.

Do not take him. I'm not exaggerating when I say his accent is so thick you won't understand anything he says. I never went to class cuz there was no point. I had to teach myself everything. Have quizzes a lot, but not too hard, and drops the lowest 3, I think. Doesn't allow retakes on anything; if you miss a test, your final will weigh double.

Not that hard at all. Allows one page of notes for the quizzes and tests, so just put formulas on them and it'll be fine. Easy to teach yourself the subject since all the answers to the in-class material are available online for study. Attendance is taken at random points throughout the semester with two absences being dropped.

Loved his class! Grade is based on your best 4 of 7 quizzes and the final. Quizzes and final use class/homework material with different numbers. Formula sheet allowed for both. He goes fast in class, but that gives you time to ask questions, and he is super willing to help. Also, introduce yourself.

He is very good. He provides video recordings of every lesson, so it was easy to learn at home. His quizzes were short, they look exactly like the class and optional HW questions. You're allowed a formula sheet for quizzes and he only keeps the best 4 out of 7 grades. Just have a good cheat sheet and use a good calculator for algebra.

Is a good teacher if you learn well by yourself. His quizzes are straightforward if you go over the homework questions. There is 7 quizzes with 2 drops and 3 exams including but the final can replace one. No partial credit on quizzes either get the right answer or no credit. However they are not hard tests. Attendance is random.

This is a wonderful man. He wants everyone to get 100, providing everything needed to study, and answering any questions regrading the quiz or exam after. You're literally allowed a cheat sheet front and back, and the ti-nspire. That calculator does everything. Learn to use it.
So easy to learn by yourself, jsut watch the lessons.

Avoid. Not a good professor at any means. Doesn't speak clear English. Incorrect grammar with his spelling and pronunciation which can create confusion especially with using variables in math. Not generous at all with grading and every quiz feels like a curveball completely different from majority of the general material. Very disappointing

Awful teacher! Accent so thick you can't understand him. Tests have incorrect grammar which causes confusion for students. Test questions are made to trick you. Class is just a lecture where he goes over the same notes, which he does post meaning you don't actually need to go. Takes attendance 5 random times which counts for 5% of total grade.

Professor Bazan-Vega is great! He usually lets class out early, but that does mean the lectures can be a bit rushed. If you struggle to quickly pick up math, his lectures may not be your style. There are a lot of quizzes and exams, but there are no trick questions. He is a great professor who will listen to any questions and concerns students have!

If you are good at calculus, this class is very easy. Attendance isn't mandatory and he posts all of his lectures/notes online. 60% of grade is tests (he assigns 7 and drops the 3 lowest; they are easy and you can use a cheat sheet) and 40% is the final. He is not good at teaching and barely speaks English, so don't take if you aren't good at math.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Bazan teaches the material well, but quickly, hardly stopping for questions. He is difficult to reach outside of class. That being said, the class is very easy and attendance is not mandatory, so if you know what you're doing, the class is as easy as it gets.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Not the most engaging teacher, but good! He posted videos of every class lecture, so I didn't pay attention in class and watched the videos to go at my own pace. I taught myself and the concepts aren't difficult so it was fine. 7 quizzes and he drops 2 lowest grades. 2 exams + a final. You get a cheat sheet for all.

If I could give a 10, I would. You fail, you honestly didn't try. He is the best math professor at UM.  7 quizzes and drops 3 of your lowest. Open book/ cheat sheets for his quizzes and exams as well. Yes, he goes fast BUT makes sure everyone understands the material and has recordings from class. Attendance is not required but it is suggested.

he is great and gives 7 quizzes but only counts the top 4 quizzes. the other grade counted is our final exam. overall, he is great and tries his best to teach. he is super understanding and cares tremendously.

Attendance is not mandatory, all of his lectures are recorded and posted. Grade consists 7 or 8 quizzes, and he only takes 4 of them (drops 3 or 4), and the final exam. If you take good notes and do the practice problems, you can do well in this class.
Professor B-Z is the best teacher ever eh, he gives a whole page cheat sheet for every quiz and exam okay? Luis covers veryyyy important concepts eh.

It's very difficult to do well in a class when your professor speaks broken English. But that seems to be the running theme for Math professors here. He used to be online and isn't anymore. 7 quizzes drop the lowest two. Only showed up for attendance there is no way you'll understand a word this guy says. be ready to teach everything to yourself :(

Bazan-Vega has a lot of negative reviews and I can understand why but he isn't as awful as the reviews make him out to be. He can be difficult to understand and moves fast but none of the concepts are too difficult. All quizzes are identical to the homework and you get a cheat sheet for every quiz and test.

He goes so fast in the classes and you just can't understand him so its hard to learn. No extra credit opportunities, no retakes, straight by the schedule. If you have a serious reason for why you missed a test he does not care. Do not take him
Worst teacher at UM, seriously does not care about students or material. Averages are horrible, and he could not be less interested in the students or material.

He is terrible and doesn't care if his students succeed. The exam averages were LOW, with some people getting 20s or lower and he does nothing about it. He is so rude too when you meet with him during office hours. I had to go to the chair already. Screw him.

reviews.comment: Prof Bazan-Vega is funny. He kind of just does what he wants. The material is pretty black and white, and frankly he doesn't care too much if you don't get it. Figure it out. He is a cute old man. Accent is thick.
This guy is just amazing. Highly recommend taking this course!
goated if you re watch the lectures and understand everything he's saying. Lets you use cheat sheet and lets you out of class early. Also, no homework. Great guy!

Professor Bazan Vega was very hard to understand, and I did poorly in class. Attendance was mandatory, and he taught off on the textbook. I don't recommend taking MAS 201 with Professor Bazan Vega and I would suggest taking it with another professor.

This was the WORST teacher I have ever had at UM. The professor is VERY difficult to understand, gets angry at questions, explains nothing, and assigns quizzes every week. reviews.comment: AVOID AT ALL COSTS. His grading is the worst. You could get almost everything right and get one number wrong and he won't give you any credit. I went to office hours and he stood at the door while I asked questions about my exam and he had no answers. I am a good student, I have never cried so much over a class, only on test 2 and I'm gonna fail.

Professor Vega's lectures can be hard to follow but the exams are exactly like his notes. Exams are open-note and as long as you study beforehand you will be fine. He gives 7 quizzes and drops the 2 lowest ones. He ends class early almost every day. He does take attendance randomly throughout the semester so it is important to go to class.
Personality: Great Textbook: Don't get one Attendance: If you want to pass go to class otherwise you will be lost Quizzes and exams are open note

The professor is very nice and sometimes funny, however, he doesn't teach. In high school, I never took Calculus 1, so the content was a bit new. You are gonna have to study a lot for the final if you want to get a good grade. The Final was extremely hard which hurt my grade.

The class was pretty easy for the most part but if you have not taken calculus I would not recommend him. He doesn't teach rather just points to the board but everything was not bad up until the final which was insanely hard based off his other assessments and hurt my grade.

At first, I loved it. Although hes impossible to understand, I loved his humor and how every quiz was open notes. I flew by the semester with ease... until the final. What a complete scam. Saw questions/concepts he never taught. He couldnt care less about your previous grades or effort. Fail the final, fail the course. Awful. Do not take. Hate him.

reviews.comment: He does have a heavy accent but he's so funny just the way he teaches and the things he says. The whole class is so easy you can pass without studying, just take notes because every test/quiz is open notes.

If you can take a different professor do it.

reviews.comment: He has a VERY heavy accent and rushes through class. You basically have to learn the material on your own. He doesnt explain things and always ends class really early. I do not recommend taking him for this class you will have a very difficult time.

He was awesome for MAS201. I got an A+ in that class. For 202 everything is different he has a hard time explaining the material. The class gets so much harder. He is difficult to ask questions too. He does not give you your exam back so you have no idea what you did wrong. Not the worst prof, but not the best for MAS202.

Very caring professor, understanding and accommodating. Explains concepts really well and is very organized with his notes/teaching. Lets you know well in advance when you'll have a quiz or exam. Drops the 2 worst quizzes out of 7. Great Prof.

reviews.comment: He has a v e r y heavy accent and gives many pop quizzes. Class is straightforward, but felt like a waste of time. Each test only has 3-4 questions, which is very annoying if you miss a question. Pop quizzes about once a week. Try to find a different professor, but the stats department at U Miami is about the same.

He is very nice but you have to teach yourself everything after class because he is extremely difficult to understand and does not show you how he gets answers, he comes with everything prewritten to class and speeds through the material. Waste of time.
Good teacher by math standards. The reality is most math classes are the same, but he explains things well and what is on the Tests is the same as the material before

Took him for MAS110/MAS201/MAS202 and he's just the best! Super straight forward w/ his teaching, has his lectures all organized by numbers. One of my favorite professors at UM.

AVOID HIM AT ALL COSTS!!!! His class is extremely boring. He has a very thick accent that is very hard to understand. You will not get much from his class. Most students in his class have to learn all the materials outside of the class. His tests are usually 4-5 questions. Each question worth 25-30 points. If you miss two questions, you fail.

Caring professor and gives easy tests! There are 8 quizzes and only counts the best five. He tells you exactly what is going to be in the exam so that you don't have to study everything. He lets you bring a formula sheet and you can write anything on there.

He gives quizzes weekly but will drop half of the lowest grades. He can go pretty fast unless you ask questions and if you have any previous knowledge of calculus the class is not difficult at all. I would definitely recommend taking if you have calculus experience.

- Hes not a huge fan of partial credit - His accent can be difficult to understand sometimes - Hes organized and usually gives a quiz every week (but only counts the best 5/9) and you can replace your lowest test grade with the final - He also will tell you what concepts will be on the test and how many Qs which is nice - Hes rough sometime

Honestly the worst professor I have had throughout my schooling experience. He seems like a nice guy but I can never understand what the hell he is saying. reviews.comment: MAS202 with Bazan was pretty easy. He does examples on the board and they are almost identical to the questions on the exam. He posts notes on blackboard, but they are sometimes hard to figure out so you should try and go to class as often as possible.

Very good teacher and very easy to succeed in his class if you put in the effort. Yes, he is hard to understand because of his thick accent BUT once you get past that he is a fantastic teacher. Go to class and you will get an A! Great guy
Hard to understand, extremely boring

reviews.comment: Although his accent can be hard to understand sometimes and his lectures are a little boring, he teaches the material in a very straightforward manner and as long as you copy down the examples you are sure to get an A. You are allowed to have a sheet of notes on the exam and I literally copied down all of the examples from class and got a 100%.

He is an amazing teacher that explains things very thoroughly. He posts everything (including the homework) online. He has several "pop" quizzes that he tells you about in advance and you can use a cheat sheet on each one. Overall one of the best statistics teachers at Miami and if you go to class/ review online material you will pass no question.

Literally show up to class and you will get an A. Goes over 3 examples per class and shows step by step how to do it, and then assigns about 3 more of the exact same problems for homework which is not collected. He then takes 1 example from each class and puts it on the test. The questions are virtually the exact same.

MAS 201 sucks but unfortantely as a BUS major you must take it. Bazan has a tough to understand accent and it's hard to follow what he's saying but at least he lets you bring a cheat sheet to class on quiz and exam days. Under no circumstance take the 2.5 hour weekly lecture. It was the worst decision I've ever made.
Easy A - tests and quizzes are almost exactly like the HW and examples he does in class. Attendance is NOT mandatory, but you definitely wanna show up to get the examples
Really nice professor ! not too easy but still isnt that hard ! Nice personality ! TAKE HIM!

His quizzes are easy and announced (date and content of the material). He knows very well how to teach the material, gives very little hw that is NOT for a grade. If you fail its really your own fault. Easy grade.

Easy class. His accent is pretty thick and most of the time it's pretty hard to understand what he's talking about but the material is really straight forward so it doesn't really matter. I highly recommend taking him-if you want an easy experience.

Prof. Bazan is a nice professor and straight to the point. He will give quizzes exactly like your homework, and let you use 1 sheet of notes for the test and quizzes. Good professor, I would recommend highly taking the class with him
He is soooo nice....It's an easy A. His class it's knida boring but it's useful for beginingers. Take him!
DO NOT THINK TO TAKE IT :S

Useless. Doesn't teach you or help you understand anything. You will not be prepared for 202. Even if this class seems easy, it's not worth it in the long run. Don't be fooled by the reviews on here. Also, he gives hardly any partial credit and grades very strictly
Worst professor u can have don't take it

Professor Bazan-Vega is the best for this class!  I also took MAS201 with him.  He presents the material very clearly on the whiteboard.  Although there are pop quizzes, I didn't find the class to be stressful at all.  It's important to keep up with the class and do all of the homework assignments.  He is one of the nicest and fairest professors!

This class is ridiculously easy, I find it incomprehensible as to how anyone can fail this class. Two exams and the final were not at all challenging. However, the professor is not at all helpful as he is impertinent and unintelligible; probably because he doesn't take interest in his job.

the first two exams were simple and exactly the same as his example problems. however, the final was awful. It was nothing like the example problems and unbelievably difficult. You dont need to do anything or pay attention in class (cant really understand him anyway). He wont help you or care about the class. Also no partial credit whatsoever

LOVE him! Super organized, gives you all of the notes up front, gives a test review before the tests.  The tests are definitely trickier than the hw and class exercises but doable.  And he always lets you out early, like you're only there like 45 min tops!! I'm taking him next semester too, def recommend!

MY favorite prof at UM. I took him for MAS 201 and 202. Once you get used to his accent, everything is very straight forward. He teaches you only what you need to know for the exams and you get out early almost every class. He also lets you have a note sheet for every quiz and exam, so you don't have to memorize anything. Take him!!

Useless. Doesn't teach you or help you understand anything. You will not be prepared for 202. Even if this class seems easy, it's not worth it in the long run. Don't be fooled by the reviews on here.  Also, he gives hardly any partial credit and grades very strictly
Best stats teacher. Tells you what to expect on quiz and tests. Notes are posted on Blackboard usually less than a page.

Presents material very clearly and effectively! Realistic with the homework he assigns and will try to help students as much as possible with grades and understanding material. Always takes the time to ask after reviewing homework and learning a new concept if anyone has any questions.
Definitely the best professor for MAS202. Take him over the other professors.
Bazan Vega is the man! super easy. 8 quizzes and he drops the lowest 3 grades.  2 Midterm exams (non-cumulative) and 1 Final.  Lets you use a formula sheet. Really hard NOT to do well
Awesome teacher. He doesn't give partial credit so be very meticulous on his tests. I enjoyed his class. It takes barely any time out of class. Just make your cheat sheets and your ready to go!

envelope   He is a great teacher who explains things in a clear and organized manner, so going to class is very helpful.
