We usually get out early and he is stylish haha, definitely take Bazan!
Great professor! Makes things easy to understand. He's very clear and concise. Also really helpful and just a nice guy.

Good teacher. You do get over his accent fast. Willing to help his students as much as he can; especially if you do not understand. I am taking him again for the second section of stats. I surely recommend him.
BEST TEACHER EVER!! I have already had him for two classes, choose him!!
Really good teacher.. you get over his accent fast.. homework is not mandatory bc if he collects it, it goes toward extra credit, but you probably won't even need it

Honestly...if you dont get an A in this class is because you're an idiot! He gives you a review sheet before the exam in which he barely changes anything. Had better

Thick accent, goes over stuff ad infinitum, really boring but if you even sort of pay attention then you'll understand the lesson, so that's nice. Lots of mini quizzes but always with a formula sheet of whatever you want to put on there. Basically, an easy class.

reviews.comment: Prof. was GREAT! He was funny and nice. Class was difficult bc of the amount of info. I do not like the 3 tests averaged out  final grade. It doesnt seem fair and jeopardizes your grade if you do bad on a test. I would recommend as a professor but not the grading style is not in favor of the student. Blackboard grades tests, he doesnt grade.

Barry is a gem. A diamond in the rough. He's my favorite professor yet at UM. This man is so funny and always does a ton of interactive activities in class. Before each test he does a "Brain Bowl" gameshow to review the material. The coursework is hard but overlaps a lot with PSY110 and BIL150. Great class, super interesting!
Makes class interesting and has a great sense of humor. Genuinely cares for students but have to participate in class.

Best psych class I've taken so far. Get ready to study, but as long as you do, you'll do great; + opportunities for extra credit w/ optional 1-page papers and bonus questions on exams. Dr. Hurwitz is super kind and caring too, and his lectures are really fun. This is the class that made me decide to add psych as my second major!!!
Dr. Hurwitz is a very approachable and caring teacher. He makes a difficult subject very easy. Best teacher I've ever had at UM.

He is a nice man that is passionate about psychobiology. There is a lot of information for each exam but his questions are very straightforward and fair. He has dad humor but it lightens the mood of the class. Just study his powerpoints and you'll do fine.

Such a funny and chill professor. He really tries to make the material more enjoyable. Don't need the book, just learn his lectures well. Doesn't really play tricks on tests, and doesnt give homework. He even gives a 2% curve if you attend 80% of the classes.
By far the best professor I've had. He really cares about his students. No need to get the book, just print his lecture slides, write notes and you'll pass!
Not too tough. Very boring and his jokes definitely don't make the time pass faster., but he's a nice guy and a good teacher.

Easily the best class I've taken in my time at UM, you don't need the text book, just go to class and pay attention and you'll get an A.  Definitely show up to brain bowls.  The professor keeps the class engaging and the tests are straight off of his power-point slides.  Excellent professor, would take again.
The best psych teacher at UM!

This class is an easy A with interesting material! Pay attention to the lectures, review any material you don't get on your own and study for the review sessions as if you are studying for the actual exams. Three exams each 33% of your grade, plenty of extra credit on the exams and some even through attendance. I picked up the textbook like twice.

Very interesting class!! Exams are mainly based on the information in his lecture slides, but 2-3 questions come from book. The exams are not too difficult and he does an exam review. Attendance isn't mandatory but can boost your grade 2% if you attend 80% of classes. He does a great job at explaining and is one of my fav professors at UM so far!
He's a great guy! Really approachable and reasonable. This class is interesting and he makes it a lot of fun. Highly recommend it.
Love this professor. Take the class!

Everything you will ever need to know for his tests is on the lecture slides.  If you spend time cramming all of the chapters strictly from his slides you will not have to even crack open the book.  Exams are pretty straight forward, you just have to really know the stuff.  Easy A if you cram.

Class is horribly boring, he just reads off power points and shows videos, but you get extra credit if you go to more than 75% of the classes. Tests are a bit difficult if you don't go to class because he will talk about specific videos he only shows in class. Voice makes you sleepy

Dr. Hurwitz is a genuinely good professor - he'll answer any questions you might have on a subject. There is extra credit in the class if you happen to have over an 80% attendance rate for his random attendance sheets. The grade is 100% tests, but he does a review for them the class before - a big help. Would take again.

Had him for psychobiology. I wish I could record his voice, I'd fall asleep like a baby every night. Lectures can get pretty boring besides his small jokes. Overall, I learned that humans are much more mechanical than I expected. Would recommend if you're interested in the field and want to read the bookwithstand his lullaby of a voice.
Intelligent. Passionate. Helpful. Great professor with a goofy sense of humor. Read the book and you will get an A. One of the best teachers I have had during my time at UM.

Dr. H is definitely a goofy guy who loves what he teaches, and all of his students. His tests are pretty straight forward... as long as you pay attention in class, study for a few hours (maybe even not - especially if you're a science major), an A is really easy to get. Attendance is not mandatory, but extra credit. Overall a good experience!!

Barry is obviously very knowledgeable about psychobiology. He makes a lot of corny jokes, which I think are hilarious. His tests are based off of the reading and powerpoints, so no need really to take any notes (powerpoints are really full of info). Not an easy class but interesting.
Has a genuine interest in students' learning. He has a (major) stuttering problem which makes him somewhat difficult to follow.
Excellent professor, you'll have to do some studying if you plan to pass. But you'll get a good picture by just attending class. Professor, is helpful and you can tell he enjoys teaching the subject.
Really funny guy and he makes the subject matter fairly interesting. I have been to class 4 times and have a 92 average.

He is monotone, but he can also be funny in a sarcastic, nerdy way. He is not always great at answering questions, but he loves if you ask questions & joke around with him. His PowerPoints are pretty self-explanatory. He shows interesting videos in class & plays games w/ the class to review for exams. He doesn't take attendance, but it helps to go.

He is sooooo funny. Very interested in helping the student clearly understand what he is teaching. He has in-class activities that are fun and he uses lecture stuff on tests. If you pay attention, you'll definitely get an A.

I took Dr. B's MSJ-213 class. He is an amazing lecturer, inspirational, passionate, and has real-world experience with the people he is lecturing about. The class has 3 tests, the last one being a cumulative final. As long as you take notes during class and study for a few hours in the days leading up to the test, you will get an A.
Bergeron is funny and crazy passionate. Awesome class to take as long as you show up and take good notes. Listening log is super important.

Prof. does an extremely good job of presenting the material in an interesting way. However, you WILL have to study to get a good grade. Tests are fill-in-the-blank and memorization of notes/songs. It is fairly simple material, but it requires going to class and reviewing. Very enjoyable class, especially if you are interested in rock music.

Dont be fooled, this class is easy only if you have a bunch of free time. If you're a premed taking biochem or orgo your grade will suffer here. Tests are fill in the blanks and require LOTS of memorization. Teacher insults you everytime saying test will be easy, when he actually makes them difficult unless you spent 10 hours reviewing this stuff.
Easy if you attend class.  Sometimes gets annoyed when people dont show up and takes attendance on those days.
Awesome class. Don't blow off the tests, but they're very fair if you take notes and study them a bit. Writing credit available. Great professor. Really knowledgable and keeps it fun.
Bergeron is the man! Very easy class, he makes it pretty interesting as well. Definitely take him!

He is a great professor and incredibly passionate about this class. Attendance isn't technically mandatory, but if you don't go you will probably do poorly. His grading scale is a little bit harder but if you just put a little effort in, it'll be super easy to get an A. You can also get a writing credit for the mandatory concert review.

Bergeron is one of the best professors I've ever had.  He has such a great teaching method and he is really interesting.  Every time I hear a song that we studied in class I can identify it and the artist really quickly and I remember random facts.  Class isn't mandatory, but if you want to pass you need to go.  I definitely suggest this class.

easy class but know everything on the listening log because they're worth a lot more on the test. only need to know the artists name. go to class and take good notes and know every name covered in class

Awesome, clear, and friendly teacher. He explains the history of jazz like a story, keeping you entertained with jokes along the way. The class is kind of easy, but definitely don't blow it off. You need to go to every class and take good notes- he doesn't review for exams. Make sure you know every song on the listening log. Final is Cumulative.
Great professor. You really need to have all the notes & go to class. Memorize all the songs and it's an easy A.

One of the funnest classes i ever had at UM. Go to every class and take good notes. 2 exams and 1 paper. Make sure you concentrate on the listening log for the test. Know every song on  the log and you will get an A

easiest most entertaining class at UM. he really engages you and tells some fun stories that you remember long after you finish class. keeps you really entertained. one paper for an easy writing credit and three exams with fill in the blanks and a listening portion. everyone at UM should take this class!

Very good class and professor, makes it interesting and engaging. Pay attention and take good notes, exams aren't MC, and the listening portions aren't easy. 1 Paper-respond to a concert you attended (easy writing credit)
best teacher at UM, only class i have enjoyed... funny dude!

A! Mandatory attendance (1 pop quiz) because you need to get ALL of the notes and memorize them to get an A. A "B" is a 93 so don't screw up on exams! Also, make sure you can recognize all the songs on Variations for the listening portion, which is harder than the fill-in-the-blanks. Final is 90% audio. Bergeron is cool and funny, TAKE HIM!

Class is pretty easy. Exams are fill in the blank so take good notes. Attendance is a must because there is no book. Make sure you know the listening because they are worth more than the other questions. Easy A and writing credit.
Hes a raging cajun!! hes the mannn

Not a very good teacher, but it is an ok class. You really don't need to do anything outside of class except for studying for his two midterms. They aren't too difficult but sometimes they can be a pain. Study and you'll be fine. Make sure you go to class! Especially after the midterm, because he uses that to take attendance.

Really easy, just remember to blend in with the class and not stick out. Do not talk during class or ask questions that might appear obvious or you'll definately be called out. Tests are easy as long as you pay attention, and you'll definately learn. Again, stay out of his way and you'll love it. Just blend in and enjoy an easy A.
Professor Bergeron is the best.All you have to do is just to go to class take notes and listen to his music.Don't have to the textbook.He gets really mad when somebody cheats on his exam.

Easy A. Go to class, take notes and you'll do great. Under no circumstance should you speak during his lectures. The subject matter is incredibly important to him, so avoid side chatter for the duration of the period and you'll be golden. Tests are easy, music is great and so is the instructor as long as you refrain from talking in class.

great teacher. is very clear about what is on the tests. go to class and take notes and pay attention and you will get an A. doesn't even make you buy a textbook. cares very much about what he teaches and is very passionate about music. great teacher to have.

He got issues. However, I did really bad on the first test and he made me make it up by doing an additional paper for extra credit and everything worked out PERFECT at the end! So for that I am thankful.
Easiest professor. Gives you a writing credit if you write a paper so that was key for me.
Took rock and jazz with him. Awesome classes, awesome professor. Really knows his music history and makes the lectures interesting. Take these classes immediately.

easy class, but he has his OWN grading scale. if you want an A, you need to get above a 96. an 82 translates to a D. he'll write this on the board, too. he doesn't even hide it. take this class (or another one) with a prof who has a fair grading scale.

this is an great class if you love learning about music. he made it really interesting. he gives three easy exams based on the lectures and he gives a review before the exam. he doesn't take roll regularly, but if the class is half empty he will. wish he taught more classes

Let me tell you I was so disappointed by this class! He let you know from the start who he liked and who he didnt. He gave more Arethra Franklin and Otis Redding than he did Led Zeppelin or Pink Floyd. He gave 3 songs from Elvis, 1 Clapton, 2 Zeppelin and 1 Hendrix song yet he gave 25 Beatles songs! Stick to ROCK and spread the artists' out.
Evolution of Rock...best class of my life. Prof is funny, interesting, lectures without notes or anything, rarely keeps you the whole class period, easy tests. Can't go wrong, easy credits.
Its an easy class to go to because the music is great, he generates interest in the class. Just be sure you go, even though he doesnt sometimes.

Took him for 124 too, easiest class ever. however you must go to class otherwise he will lower your grade by one letter if you fail to pick up your tests when handed back out or the pop quizzes during substitues. you can get notes from previous students and the final consists of only listening to songs. this goes for JAZZ and ROCK....

Easy Class, nice/funny teacher. Go to class even if there is a substitue, he will give pop quizes and that makes or breaks your grade. 3 very easy tests. He only gives A, B, C, etc...no - or +'s. He tells you every single question (songs) on the final... you can't go wrong!
really, easy. go TO CLASS> gives pop quizzes. also picking up your tests when he hands them back counts as attendance
Best Class EVER. 2 tests and one RIDICULOUSLY EASY final. Guaranteed, sure-shot A. If you don't get an A in this class, leave UM.

easy class, actually learn something. took him for rock. 2 tests... easy, final is all listening and naming the artists. can't get any easier, if you don't leave with an A, you should drop out of college.
Chucky B is the man. Took rock class, really interesting and really easy. Always look forward to the class because you spend half of it just listening to classic rock.

Took his jazz and rock classes because they are so ridiculously easy. He will do ANYTHING to satisfy the crowd at his lectures (ie move tests back, end class early). You do have to deal with his random tirade about whatever is bothering him which gets annoying, but it's an overall interesting and stupid easy class, take it.

This guy is the man. He genuinely loves teaching people about jazz. I took this class as an elective because i had to, but looked forward to going to class every day because it was so relaxing and informative. He lectures half the class and plays music the rest. The music he plays is chosen well for our age group. I highly recommend this class.

Extremely easy class, I never wanted to take a class on Jazz but it actually wasn't bad at all.  I learned a lot more than I thought I would and the teacher was really funny and down to earth. He's cool in class but if you are absent on a day of a pop-quiz just for attendance purposes he will turn into an a - h o l e when you go to talk to him. Easy A

SO RUDE to students taking off class for the fall Jewish holidays. Won't announce when tests are because too lazy to take attendance. Makes extremely rude comments about "frat guys." An easy class, but not worth the headache, especially if you're Jewish.
Jazz class. The class was interesting. All lecture notes. I didnt particularly like the guy but will get an A. It was a fun class.
Chuck is THE man!
He's awesome.  He's interesting, and he makes you learn without realizing you're learning.  He's a great speaker, holds your attention, throws in a few anicdotes.  This is a great class.
Chuck is the man.  Enjoyed every class I had with him.
very interesting class. tests are based on his lectures only. he just wants people to learn and appreciate jazz music. great class, and you might actually learn something!

didn't know that i could ever like jazz music as much as i did after this class.  learned so much because there was no pressure to know SO much stuff.  would spoon-feed you what is on the test.  very interesting and definitely would recommend taking this class for a fine arts class over ANY other.
No Comments
This guy is the man! He doesn't take attendance but I attended every class.  His lectures are awsome, tests are clear and easy and he is an interesting dude.

Prof Recarey is literally the sweetest ever. He gives you an outline of all the concepts that will be on each test and you can fill it out while taking class notes. Sometimes he goes off topic during class. Also tests are challenging, but OK if you study. I would definitely take him again though and it helps so much to go to his office hours!!!

ppl only give him bad reviews bc he's an old man so he's just traditional and a little snappy. that doesn't bother me, i'm not sensitive lol. he's genuinely a really good lecturer bc he gives examples for everything which helps a lot. he's rlly good at making sure you understand the concepts thoroughly. exams aren't hard if you study

This class puts everyone to sleep. He cares more about attendance (he's so strict about it) than actually engaging with his students. He doesn't know anyone personally and literally just reads off the slides for 40 minutes. Material is super boring. Exams are difficult. Don't take
attendence and the exams are hard

Dr. Recarey is adorable and it feels like I'm just going to class to see my grandpa. The material is pretty easy and if you just review the study guide you should do well on tests. Attendance is mandatory. He can be a little condescending and rude sometimes. Overall he is good, I would take him again.

Professor Recarey is a great professor who loves what he does. I enjoy all of his classes and don't think they are too difficult. Just use the study guides he provides and you will be prepared. No phones in class but he is great and I would recommend to anyone.

All you really need to do well in this course is grind out the study guide (using active recall) prior to exams, and just show up to get attendance. Thats the cheat code, so don't worry about all of the other fluff.

The course itself isn't hard, and if you put in effort, you get grades not bad. However, he is extremely short-tempered, rude, and disrespectful to students. When he makes a mistake, he blames the students. If you upset him, he will say really hurtful things, like belittling your hard work and your grades is only because of his extra credit.
Very lecture heavy and he takes attendance before every class. Don't buy the textbook his exams are made up of what he goes over in class. Take in depth notes and you'll be fine.

If you want to take this class with Professor Recarey, don't. He is completely disrespectful when you go to his office hours (he tells you to go and he will help you - he doesn't). He also throws random concepts on the exam that he states won't be on it. Lastly, is just plain rude when you ask questions in class. Worst prof in marketing department.

Profesor Recarey is an amazing professor. Despite his iffy ratings, he is kind and offers a lot of help to students. You can tell he really cares. He makes his own tests and they are really straightforward if you come to class and pay attention (study).
Okay professor the class is mainly based on exams for your grade. The exams are pure memorization. Could be mean at times if your answer wasn't exactly like his then you were completely wrong.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The class is hard but manageable. Just stay ahead and make sure you understand the material during the lectures. Make sure you do the group project on time, it is very easy to procrastinate and it is a long project. The exams are straightforward forward and he gives you a study guide.

Recarey seems nice but can be rude, especially if you ask a question that he has gone over in class. The group project is pretty awful and boring. Every time you are late or absent it affects your TOTAL grade. I've found some of the content interesting, but Recarey himself is somewhat unlikeable and can make this class unenjoyable.

He is fine. A little boring but the course itself really isn't that exciting so he does the best he can. The tests are a bit difficult especially if you only rely on the study guides but he curves and there is extra credit. Go to class and don't be on your phone. Big group project so have a good team.

Three exams not cumulative but they are hard and cover a lot of material. He gives extensive outlines so as long as you study well in advance you'll be good. Group project throughout course. Lectures follow powerpoint but honestly you need to attend class because otherwise power points make no sense. Lectures can be boring.
awful, rude, and long lectures. Easy class but be ready for the longest hour of your life every day.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Recarey is an okay professor. His lectures for the most part do not relate to the exams but he does have study guides. He uses examples in his exams rather than direct questions. The exams are pretty hard. The group projects are okay and he grades them okay.

The lectures can be easy to stop paying attention to. However, as a person that doesn't like marketing and took this class, I did find the content itself interesting. He provides a study guide, but I recommend studying the CONCEPTS presented in that guide, not the questions themselves. They are not exactly the same, but they are similar.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Recarey is a great prof who is always available for his students during his office hours. This class is very much lecture-based and everything you need is on the slides. TO GET AN A in the class: Go to every class and fill out his pre-made study guides during his lectures. This is word for word what's on the exams. Overall, he is a very nice man.

I don't know why this professor has such low ratings. He doesn't use textbooks and what is going to be on the exam is on the lecture. When he says something is important it will be on the exam. He provides study guides that are almost like the exam. 2 group projects and 3 exams. Final is not commutative. I would take him again. Great professor.

Professor Recarey is a good person at heart and is always available for his students during his office hours. This class is definitely lecture-based and everything you need is on the slides. Key tip: Copy and paste all info required into Quizlet and burn your brain for an hour/day 3-5 days in advance to get an A on the exams.

attendance taken every class. tests are pretty much verbatim based off of his lectures. every class is a lecture. 2 small group projects, 3 tests, and you have to go to the marketing labs. do the study guide along with his lectures in class because he goes in order. lectures can get boring but the tests are not hard if you study, and he curves
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Outdated and deceiving

Professor Recarey was simply a snobby old man. He gives attitude for absolutely no reason and makes you feel dumb. The class consists of 3 tests, including the final and 2 group projects. I studied hard for the tests and didn't get the grade I thought I would. The class is curved though, thank god.

Can be rude sometimes, but a good professor. Lectures are very clear and exams are all multiple choice. You'll learn a lot. The other reviews focus too much on himself rather than his good ability to teach. Attend class to get all notes for the test -- they are exactly like what's taught in class. The class is curved. I'd take him again.

Professor Recarey is knowledgable & passionate about Marketing, which sums up the only good things I have to say about him. He is condescending and singles out individual students for no good reason. His behavior isn't appropriate for a professor. The tests are passable but tedious, and you aren't allowed to use laptops in class. Good luck tho!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Do yourself a favor and do even think about taking him. Unless of course, you want to deal with a rude and inappropriate professor for an entire semester. Actually in disbelief Miami continues to employ him, in the business school no less.
Very good professor. Study the powerpoint and the study guides in order to do well in the exams! Go to his office hours!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Overall, a very memorization heavy class. I did not learn, I memorized. Exams are small textbook details that are not helpful. Tip: memorize the textbook. I feel like this class has so much potential to be interesting, but it was dry and too memorization heavy. Also the group projects were useless. Please take someone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: Not a good teacher, tells you to buy the textbook but doesn't even use it. Puts stuff on the test that we have not gone over. Not the nicest guy. The class did not do well on the first test and did not care. The class asked if he would curve or give extra credit and he said he didn't care if we failed.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He is very sweet and knowledgeable, but this class was brutal. It was so boring, and it honestly has nothing to do with marketing. It was more of a history lecture and shipping lecture instead of learning about international marketing strategies. The exams were purposely tricky. I do not recommend taking this class, take another marketing class

Recarey is a really knowledgeable person. He knows everything about marketing and has extensive experience, you will see by his examples. You do not really need to read, just make sure you take notes in class because the examples and the things said in class will be on the test. You will learn a lot with him

Recarey is a nice professor. His lectures are easy to follow and he tells interesting stories. Print out his review guide and answer the questions as he lectures (he answers every question that way). Remember his examples for exams. No final and exams are not bad. Kind of an old style of teaching, but I don't mind it.

The class was very interesting except for his exporting & logistics section (which happens to be his favorite). Download his study guides & fill them out during class to be ready for tests. Attendance is essential. He's sassy but caring. His grading for the project put me off. He'll give different grades to groups who put exactly the same info.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Honestly I took Professor Recarey last semester in MKT 301 and thought he was great! This semester not so much. He reads off PowerPoint slides and the lectures are boring. You have 3 exams which includes the Final which is not cumulative. You can get an A if you put work into the class but overall it the class is boring.
Lectures are important. Attendance is mandatory. Exams are fairly tough. Big group project as well. Caring professor when you go to office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Recarey was great! He made my first marketing class very enjoyable. I would definitely take him again and you DO NOT NEED the textbook. Whenever he lectures you must copy down word for word what he says because what he says is on the exams. Just get ready for group projects though otherwise he is great!

Ehh.. I'm on the fence with Recarey. He is an okay professor, nothing extravagant. He does make himself available outside of class quite often. His test are solely based off of his lectures, so there's no point in buying the book, I never read the book at all this semester. If you don't go to class, you won't pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: its a hard class but he explains everything and he is very nice. pay attention to his exact words and examples because they will be on the test. 3 exams, 3 study cases and 2 group projects

Attendance is mandatory and it's important to take notes during lectures although he posts powerpoints. There are 3 exams and a term long group project which takes a lot of effort and time to complete. If you need help, he will definitely give you. Overall, he is a nice man but he is very specific with his grading.
TAKE NOTES IN CLASS AND PRINT OUT THE REVIEW SHEET EARLY. the material is not hard but he makes things extra long and unnecessary.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He is that kind of professor that knows a ton of stuff and he loves what he teaches. However, i took his class at night and it was hard to keep paying attention. you do have to study for tests and take notes. he is a tough grader. NOT an easy A. You should take group projects very seriously.

Bring the test review questions to class because his lectures revolve around them. Go to his office hours and talk to him because you'll get on his good side and he'll remember you and help you out if you need it. He tells a lot of stories as examples during his lectures and some of them show up on the test so don't disregard them. Nice guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Recarey is interesting; he can be really nice and helpful, but if you say something stupid or wrong he'll snap on you. Can be really mean, but as long as you keep things distant & show you care about the class, he's a good teacher. He tells you exactly what's on the test in class and you learn the material. The class is curved just stay above avrg.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Do not buy the text book. He lectures all class, but he presents the information very clearly, with great examples to help you understand. Prof Recarey is a very nice guy. I went to office hours a few times, and he was always extremely helpful. He genuinely cares for his students. Attendance is mandatory. We had 3 tests and he curves final grades.

You have to go to his class to know what you are going to get quizzed on, he goes over everything in class. He's kinda weird because he is like very nice sometimes but also extremely sassy and likes to make fun of students and make them feel uncomfortable. He is somewhat a tough grader with the exams, but he really isn't that bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Prof Recarey is the best. Took him last year for a beginning level marketing class, & decided to take him again this year. If you go to class, fill out the review packet as he lectures in class, & study before, the tests are very manageable. He is pretty helpful during office hours, & if you get on his good side he'll really help you out. 10/10
very arrogant and loves to hear himself speak.  All info is from lecture despite being asked to purchase a mandatory textbook.  Also pretty rude in office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Recarey is a man stuck in his ways. He is extremely disrespectful to his students, it appears that in his mind he is superior to the students from his experience in the ancient marketing world and justifies his treating students as below him. His ancient  experience and textbook readouts aren't very relevant in our modern tech marketing world.

He made me hate this class. Tests were long and hard that required a study guide of 4 pages typed 11 font MIN. An easy class that was made extremely difficult for no reason.  Take any other professor if you want an easy breezy A.

Prof. Recarey is a good guy, but he's a good guy stuck in the past. His lectures are boring and just not made professionally. He's super SUPER rude to students for no reason at all (if you're oriental expect a lot of comments being made in your direction). It's like he's an old man whose just too naive to realize the stupidity in his own logic.

If people don't like Professor Recarey is because he is very traditional. He gives good long lectures. He also has so many stories associated with every topics. He doesn't miss anything. He puts a lot of effort in his lectures. There is no need for textbook, you learn everything in his class. That why he is so great.

I love this professor, he gives the best examples. I consider him, one of the best professor I have ever had.  He has a lot of knowledge and explains everything so well. You have to go to class to get the notes but they are super straight forward. The tests aren't hard but you just have to study. Its pretty easy. He gives group projects that aren't so bad. He is a nice guy and he is helpful.

Recarey's lectures are really boring and long. And he is very COCKY. Tests are not hard but you need to pay attention to his lecture. All test questions come from his lecture. You don't need to buy textbook, waste money. Overall, avoid him.
LOVED his clas!! Tests are not that easy but if you study then you will do fine! He is amazing. For real. Take him

Recarey is the most condescending member of the MKT department faculty  If you do not answer his question exactly how he wants it during class, he will correct you publicly without acknowledging that you got part of the answer right. He is the cutest old man in the world. I thoroughly enjoyed all his lectures and was happy to come to class. He makes an effort to relate to his students.

AMAZING professor. He knows everything about the subject and relates it to current events and his own personal experiences. Horrible! I learned nothing, only came to class because he takes attendance. Tests are tricky and the projects are useless. I wasted so much time try to find information for those projects. If you don't need to take this class, then DO NOT TAKE

Horrible! Uses the same notes from years ago, find someone with the notes! So boring, but he takes attendance. Didn't learn anything of use. Tedious, long group project will be the bane of your existence. Don't take if not required!!!!

terrible professor! do not buy the textbook it is a waste of money. all test question are from class. he drones on and on and made me loose interest in the subject. he is EXTREMELY rude to students asking for help. he also made a very creepy comment towards me when i came to class from practice wearing spandex. do not take his class.

Terrible teacher, drones on and on and does not spark any interest in the topic. He has been teaching the class for too long and isnt helpful
great guy and teacher, but the class is incredibly BORING. lots of busy work.

I don't know how these reviews have been so positive-Recarey was extremely rude to students attempting to seek his help during office hours, he feigned knowledge of current international marketing (referring to his very much past experiences even though this generation differs greatly), and random test questions were intentionally misleading.

He is an amazing professor! He really teaches you the subject instead of reading straight from the book. No surprises on the test just study the guide provided for you. Sweet old man, loves what he teaches and makes it interesting.  Very easy to follow, easy exams straight from review sheets.  Big group project, but its not at all difficult, and somewhat enjoyable.  I learned a lot, without struggling to get an A, so highly recommended.

He's a great teacherand very clear. I never read the book and got A's and high B's on my tests. Professor Recarey is extremely nice as long as you turn off your cell phones. He is also a marathon runner. There are 3 noncumulative tests and an 80 page International Marketing Plan project. Old, funny and kind. Class sticks entirely to slides - book not needed! Gives review sheets before tests that cover test entirely - material not difficult and is interesting. 1 project, majority of grade, easy.

Betsy is really sweet and personable but did not follow the syllabus whatsoever. She also was a bit unorganized with the class flow and Canvas but overall was flexible and would help you if you had a problem. Wants students to succeed and is a great person.
Basically didn't want to hear anything but a comedy, no serious shows allowed.

She's so amazing, I wish I could take her for every class. She met with me outside of class to work on my own pilot script and help me network to find an internship. She also took our class to breakfast!

I've taken Professor Mateu for three courses. The discussions are engaging and if you need guidance in the film industry, she's your go-to. She remembers students who make an effort and will help you where needed. She helped me secure big studio internships (plural). Honestly, my college experience wouldn't have been as successful without her.
Betsy is the best. She's an excellent teacher who is always happy to meet outside of class. She cares about each one of her students and always tries to help.

Wish I could take her for literally every class...genuinely. Her feedback is sometimes not harsh enough but is well-intentioned. She is hilarious, inspiring, and caring. She is very informed on the TV industry. I recommend the TV writing track for anyone who wants to do anything in TV. Take her class. It's a real family feel.
Greatest to ever do it.

Easily my favorite professor that I have ever had. She is super engaging and caring. You have to work hard in this class to get a good grade, but there is minimal homework. Professor is very kind and wants best for her students but a little insensitive with feedback. You only have one script to write the whole semester and Professor grades vaguely. reviews.comment: AMAZING. If you want to break into the television business you should go out of your way to take a class with Betsy.

She is the best teacher i have ever had here. if you can take her class take it. she knows so much and just wants to teach shes not all about grades and papers. you have one writing assignment and its a fun assignment. love her would take her class if you are in the COM school no matter what your major is. so helpful &fun!!

Seriously, Betsy changed my life. I wish she taught more classes!! but she only teaches 1 class a semester, so it doesn't matter what she's teaching, she is a GOLDMINE of knowledge and advice for the real world. Whatever she is teaching, TAKE IT! It will be so worth, she's amazing.
best teacher ever. If you want an engaging class, where you'll get a few laughs, take this one!
Hella chill kinda weird but in a good way. Knows lots of random stuff and is a good writer.
Be prepared to write a good amount. he's definitely not your average professor and a little quirky. cares about his students.

He is the kindest professor at UM, truly cares about his students and class. Class is mandatory but all wrs classes are, his class isn't nearly as boring as the others as he tries to get everyone involved. Definitely take if you need writing
chiller and easy class but you still learn stuff. A little weird but definitely would take again

Genuinely one of my favorite classes. Every day we'd leave laughing and breaking down our negotiations, which made it way more engaging than most classes. Prof Katzen is such a gem. The class was out of my comfort zone but she created such a great learning environment. Really nice and considerate teacher, very helpful in giving feedback on assigmnets.

I highly recommend Professor Katzen's course! Initially, I was nervous about taking this course because of the emphasis on oral presentations. Professor Katzen genuinely cares about her students and provides the tools succeed in her class. She will always find time to meet outside of class and gets back to emails very quickly. reviews.comment: GREAT PROFESSOR. Professor Katzen not only cares to learn each student's name, but also to make sure students are comfortable with each other. I highly recommend Katzen to make your BUS300 experience a positive one.

Professor Katzen is outstanding and deeply committed to student success. The course covers critical elements of public speaking and formal writing, offering invaluable real-world preparation. Her support and availability is unmatched. This class is an unparalleled experience, simulating professional career. Thank you, Professor Katzen!

Looked forward to this class every week! Katzen is the BEST professor for BUS 300. She truly cares about her students and wants them to do well. It is not hard to do well in this class. Katzen is always open to meeting with you and she gives amazing feedback. I can truly say I have learned skills that will help me in and out of school!

This was my favorite class I have taken at the business school. Katzen is an extremely caring, respected, and intelligent professor who wants you to succeed. You're likely doomed with this professor. I agree with all the recent feedback peers wrote.

If she likes you'll get high grades but if not, low grades. Grading system makes no sense at all. Came in every day having no clue what we would be doing and it was rarely useful. She is a nice lady and the class is fun. However, the quizzes are very difficult and even if you read all the books and take notes, you are not guaranteed to end up with an A. Professor Katzen is amazing. She pushed me out of my comfort zone in the best way possible! If you have the opportunity to take her, do it. It is obvious that she really cares about her students and wants to help everyone succeed.

Truly phenomenal professor. Took this as a once-a-week 3hr class, and Katzen honestly made it something I looked forward to every week. I had her for BUS 300 as well. She really cares about the students who go out their way to learn, she can tell where there is an effort to improve. If you are interested in pursuing law school SHE IS A GREAT RESOURCE! I had a terrible fear of public speaking and she helped me become better (she really believes in her students). You will learn w her

Professor Katzen is amazing! She made getting up for an 8 am class worth it. The discussions we would have were interesting and relevant as well as the debates, they were fun. She pushes you to get out of your comfort zone in a great way. Definitely take her :)

Instead of learning critical thinking, this class is more likely to be a self-challenging class. Professor Katzen would not teach you what to do but discuss the cases in class. Professor Katzen is the best! If you want to build confidence in public speaking and business writing, take this class! Professor Katzen is one of the most accessible and caring professors at the school. reviews.comment: Took this class and loved every moment of it. Easy class if you participate and show up. Few HW assignments but all of them serve a real outside purpose. a lot of writing, okay class

Open-note policy on quizzes, can retake to improve scores.

class is one semester-long group project where you create and run a study, she is very caring and sweet and gives lots of detailed feedback. you will get a good grade as long as you fix what she asked you to and complete other assignments, none of which are very hard. if you want a research/science career this is a very valuable class

The class is very structured and what is expected of you is clearly stated. Dr. Simpson is very enthusiastic about teaching and approachable. However there is a lot of work and writing so expect that !

I LOVE BILLIE SO MUCH. GENUINELY PROBABLY ONE OF THE GREATEST PEOPLE I HAVE EVER MET. CARING. KIND. A GENIUS. I LOVE HER. truly a treasure to humanity. I LOVE BILLIE!!!!!!!!

Billieeeeeeee!!! Such a beautiful soul and so so so talented. She's opinionated, but I would trust her opinion with my life. So very understanding and truly loves getting to know her students. Definitely has her own way with words, but in a way that's impossible not to love.

Prof Blatt 's corporate tax course is no joke. It is extremely hard. Be ready to read and practice many problems every week until the last day of class. This class prepares one for tax law. Do not take if you are uncertain about tax law as profession. This course is heavy and requires a lot of all practice with material. Class is 95%-98% LL.M tax
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Single worst professor I had at UM law. Over ten years later and I still cringe when I hear his name. He is unfair, arbitrary and dull. I always dreaded going to his class. Caveat emptor.

most boring professor I've ever had. Brilliant man, lousy teacher.  Handwriting is illegible, so you can't follow what he's doing on the board.  Class seems to never end.  Final is the hardest exam you'll take in your life.

Very difficult class. He goes down the rows calling on people, asking questions. Be prepared to be called on daily! The entire grade is based on closed book final, which is very difficult! His handouts for every class only make sense after he goes over them.  Good luck with this course! But if you work hard, you will be fine.
Best professor at Miami. Very clear if you pay attention and do not rely on outlines. Hard work pays off, but do not take this class if you are a slacker. Learned a ton.

This Class is Tax Boot Camp.  Very socratic.  Closed Book Exam.  Focuses on the theoretical underpinnings of the Internal Revenue Code, in addition to solving tax problems.  He is very funny if you have a sophisticated sense of humor.  All-in-all the class was stressful, but a great foundation for future tax classes.

Loved the class. It challenged me more than any other class. I learned a ton. Be aware, this is not a class for those who "think" they like tax. This is a TAX class! Make sure you like tax before you enroll. Hard effing exam!
If you want to *learn* fed tax, take this class **pass fail** and get ready to work. One of the top 5 classes at UM Law.
One of the hardest classes at UM, but also one of the *BEST*. Outstanding prof for students who want to learn (you will learn a lot!). Not for slackers. Hard work will pay off in grade.
I think I may have failed the exam, LOTS of material, easy to coast along in class with lots of the old outlines but left scrambling and lost on the final.

I think the only good thing I can say about this class is that it is almost over.  His lectures are boring, he talks down to students, and if you don't have an accounting or highly knowledgeable tax background, forget it.  I came in eager to learn, but he made me feel incredibly stupid.  His lectures are all over the place.  Take ANYBODY else!

Took legislation as my 1L elective thinking it would be exciting - this class made me want to kill myself.  It was so awful and boring - no one has any idea what he's talking about and his questions don't make any sense.  Mandatory attendance policy (3 absences max).  Only good thing is "on-call" goes by rows.  DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!!

Class was so not what you thought law and religion would be...instead it was the biggest waste.  No discussion of what religion says about certain topics, but how to be a jewish lawyer or what a zen buddhist thinks like...guy is rude at times too...and gives confusing feeback...don't take this class
No Comments
Great guy--very straightforward with a dry sense of humor. Always willing to help students.
His questions are horrible because you never know what he's asking. But he will not pick on you if you are not on call. The exam isn't too bad, but you can't really study for it as much as others.
Very tough but fair. If you speak up and do your work he'll notice. Sometimes you have no idea what he is asking. Overall I would take him again.

Moody. One day he's cracking jokes, the next he's cracking the whip. Most days you have no idea what he is trying to get to say when called on. Exam was fair enough but subject matter can be obtuse at best. Hard class to study for but useful in term of statutory interpretation part. Be warned.
great prof, dry sense of humor, cares about students and very helpful, but can be very demanding.
This guy is tough, but good.

he's one of the best professors i've had, super understanding and genuinely cares. you can tell he's really passionate about politics and has a lot of insight and wisdom. he's also very responsive. Class consists of 2 quizzes which are 2 essay questions, and a take home essay for the midterm and final which are pretty simple. 10/10 love him

Best political science professor I have taken so far, he is clear and loves his subject, the tests are easy, and you learn slowly because he takes his time explaining carefully. He could get a bit monotone because of the way he talks, but he is so respectful and asks for questions and participation. He seems to never have a bad day.

Overall a great professor. The class is very lecture heavy which can get boring sometimes. Your grade is made up of 3 exams which are fairly easy and non-cumulative, and attendance. Lots of readings assigned, but you just need a generalized understanding for each on exams. Content itself is very interesting as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Whoever has anything negative to say about Professor Blankenship has no idea what they're talking about. Super cool guy, friendly grader, and easy to reach. Entire class is made up of 2 take home exams and 2 quizzes. If you have something negative to say about a guy with that work load, maybe it's more of a reflection of you than him. 10/10 class.

Prof blankenship was a great teacher. Very lecture heavy but if you just read the slides you'll be fine. He describes the readings in the slides so its okay if you don't read them all. He gives great test outlines (3 tests, lowest grade counts less) so just study the outlines and general concepts of readings and you'll get an A. attendance=kahoot
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is painfully boring. The professor is brilliant, but his engagement with the students is terrible. Although it's only a 75-minute class, it feels much longer because the class participation is minimal. He does 99.9% of the talking, and only 0.1% of the time does he ask for student feedback. It's a no for me :{
he is very knowledgeable but the 3 hours class is boring, attendance mandatory. But only 2 quizzes, very easy, just study the slides/readings and one paper, which there is plenty of time to do.

This Professor is one of if not the best Professor I have ever had and I am currently taking him and have for about 3 classes now. His lectures are very interesting and he is almost a history book and very interesting to learn from. He has helped me with my future plans and helped guide me throughout just the one year I have had him. Take his class

Very kind professor, lectures are a bit boring but straight to the point. All lectures include what is going to be on the test but he posts them online. Grade is just based on 3 exams that are no cumilative.

Prof Blankenship is incredibly knowledgeable about International Relations and is clear and concise with tests. Lectures themselves are boring, but slides are posted online with study guides that make test material very straightforward. However, must study a general idea of the pretty long readings he assigns as they do appear on tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is a really nice guy and very approachable. He is very smart I enjoy his lectures and he posts a lot of helpful content and outside resources that are very helpful! Best professor I've had.

Prof Blankenship is one of the best poli sci professors I've had. There is a lot of reading, though, so you have to be prepared for that. Class is based on attendance, two quizzes, and a take-home/open note midterm and final. Quizzes and exams are easy to ace if you take notes and pay attention. Extremely knowledgeable and wants students to do well

Although VERY lecture heavy, Blankenship is very knowledgeable about the subject which makes it interesting. Your grade is based on attendence and 3 essay responses (including the final) which he grades EXTREMELY fair, as long as you do what he says to do in the instructions. Hard not to get an A in the class! Also very thoughtful and understanding
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof. Blankenship is the best! Yes, his lectures are boring, but he is a walking history book with so much knowledge and understanding of the subject. Tests are super easy (and short) usually 18-20 MC questions, and all you need to do is study the slides and do the readings to be prepared. Your grade is based on 3 Exams including the final.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great professor. Course is on the easier side and lectures may be a bit boring, but very caring and a good class. Attendance matters. Would recommend

Not sure why this Prof doesn't have more positive reviews. He is very understanding and always answers emails very quickly. The class is based on organized and easy-to-understand Powerpoints. No exams, just four papers; but he's a very fair grader. As long as you read the PowerPoints, the essays are very easy. You really learn a lot too. Take him!!
Lectures may be boring, but not a tough class. Great professor and very understanding
Lectures put you to sleep. Never makes eye contacts or opens up lectures to questions. Quizzes and exams seem easy. Only one paper and no other homework.
He is good professor, the class based on lecture. He explained details about each section. As long as you listened the class you will get A

Professor Blankenship is a nice guy but his class will put you to sleep. His lectures are based off of PowerPoints that he posts online. I never paid attention and taught myself the material before the exam. Tests are pretty easy, 15 multiple choice questions and 5 short answer. Your grade depends on three tests including the final and attendance.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Mr. Black is an amazing professor! I took him for Introduction to Photography, and he was so caring and made things so easy to understand. My main tip of advice? Show up and just do the work on time and you will get an A no problem! I would take his class again easily!
The most easy A, all the points are very clear, really care about you

Sean is one of the best teachers that I have had. He is always eager to help in and out of class and even with things that do not pertain to class. If you enjoy photography, I highly recommend taking his class. You will learn a lot and some of his passion for photography will rub off on you.
He's the nicest professor ever. He will let you develop your own style in photography while learning the guidelines. It is a very enjoyable class. I would love to have another class with him.

Sean Black is the most passionate, helpful professor I have ever had. He goes all the way out to help a student. What I loved about his class was that he guided you with experimenting with your own style as a photographer. If you have an opportunity to have him as a professor do it! You would NOT regret it. Best class!
Sean is so nice and flexible! Easiest class ever!
Dr. Fowers class was sooo lecture heavy. He is a sweet guy but his tests are impossible to study for because his powerpoints have almost no words on them.

Dr. Fowers is so sweet. The lectures were a bit boring, but honestly, I just wasn't interested in the subject material. It's more of a philosophy class. A LOT of homework readings, weekly, untimed, open note quizzes (easy), 4 assignments (easy), & a final paper or project at the end. He was such a nice guy & I would take him again because of that!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He's really nice and caring. There were no finals for this class. Really easy if you listen in class and complete the assignments. The course is kind of difficult but if you listen it's ok

Amazing guy. The class can be difficult at times but if you study and read the assigned readings before the exams, you'll be fine. 4 assignments, 2 exams, and a paper/project (do the project). He's easy to talk to and cares about his students' success. The exams are curved and so is the class so put it in the work but no need to overly-stress.

She's sweet, but sweet doesn't matter when you're the only MIC 319 professor to not provide a study guide. The other two professors from the other sections both gave excellent study guides that prepared you for the test if you completed them.

Taught the extracellular bacteria section of MIC319. Easiest section for me because complement was the only major thing talked about. Didn't provide a study guide but marked things that would be on the exam in her PowerPoints. I found her lectures to be all over the place and hard to follow but tutoring helped. Accessible outside of class
this lady can't even use powerpoint. literally useless as a professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: So disorganized, lectures make no sense at all, shes rude to all students, she isnt accessible at all. Overall shes horrible.

Professor Blaney really cares about his students and helping them succeed in his class, it may not be the most challenging class and if you don't want to pay attention you will not get a lot out of the class, and probably still pass. However, if you are truly interested in theatre and pay attention he has so much to offer and you can learn a lot.
This was a great class! Dr. Blaney is a great professor who helps his students live up to their potential.

Queer Theater was probably the most mind-bending and challenging course I took at UM! There is a lot of reading in this course, but it is manageable and interesting. I learned so much about the history of LGBTQ theater. Great discussions, with a truly caring professor.

This was an enjoyable intro course, and I was surprised by how much I learned. Lots of reading, lectures, discussion, and a final group project where everyone gets to be involved in making an original piece of theater for the class.
This was a great course! Dr. Blaney demands a lot from his students, but he clearly wants to see all of them succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: A really easy class. If u show up, you will get A. Darren is really a wonderful professor. TAKE HIM.
Darren is an amazing theatre arts professor. I would absolutely take him again.
Awesome class, (even if you've never acted before in your life, which was a large part of my section) I'd definitely recommend it. Really fun class and a very caring professor.

Funny. Great personality. Take him for any THA  105 or 101 classes you will laugh a lot and get an A. Took this as an elective, perfect way to boost your GPA. You will only have to go to a theater show in school, and due a short one page paper at the end of the semester.

Really fun class, learned a lot. You start off with simple and fun activities and by the end of the semester he makes everyone feel comfortable performing a short scene in front of the class. Some readings and tons of extra credit opportunities, loved this class and would definitely recommend it!
The best acting teacher. He will help you become better. Just make sure the class is small because mine was 16 and you didn't get a lot of one on one time with him.
He is so nice
One of the best and most fun classes I've taken at UM. As a bio major, this class was much needed relief. Easy but super interesting. Darren is the BEST!!!

Very enjoyable and easy course. Darren enjoys theatre and wants his students to enjoy it as well. The class involved journal writing, reading/watching plays, and creation of an original scene for performance to the class. Guest lecturers came in to talk about their roles in UM's theatre department.

Best math teacher I've ever had, makes things so easy to understand and gives shortcuts to make everything more simple/take less time. Tests are exactly like the study guide, minimal homework problems. Can be kind of difficult if you're having an issue w grades but overall best person to take for such a hard class.

I really enjoyed Dr. Bibby for Calc 2. He makes things so straight forward and his tests are really similar to his reviews. There really are no surprises. He is kind and caring and probably the best choice for calc 2 at Miami. It is a shame he is retiring.

DR BIBBY ROCKS! he is a great teacher and stays true to his own exams, even lets you use a notecard so you don't have to memorize everything! Really refreshing to come across a professor that genuinely cares and makes the class attainable. Show up, put in the effort, and you'll do great
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I've ever had in any subject. Calculus scared me but he made the class not just doable but easily successful. He gives review sheets for every exam that actually help, he's great at explaining things, and gives many shortcuts for hard concepts. An A is very possible if you are willing to actually put in work! TAKE HIM!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Bibby is a sweet guy. Before taking his class this online semester, I was looking forward to it since he's really good at teaching calculus. I heard great reviews. However this semester, they decided to make this course departmental. Every single thing they made departmental. The tests were unbelievably difficult.
Take this class if yiu like baseball. So easy

I have waited to take Dr. Bibby's Calculus two class and it was worth every expectation I had. Today, one does not find too many Calc instructors like Dr. Bibby. He could even be unique. Advice: just get a seat in his class and don't second guess your decision.

Professor Bibby is probably one of the best professors I've ever had! Had him for both Pre-Calc and Calc 2. His tests are fair and based completely on the reviews. If you do the homework and work on your review couple times prior to the exam, you won't have any issue. Make sure to not skip class, his lectures are great and very helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Bibby is an awesome math professor. Whether you're good at calc or not, you will benefit from having him as your teacher. His lectures are super clear and helpful, and his tests are very very fair. If you can take his class, do!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great professor! Hes available for office hours and willing to help students. 6 quizzes and a final, the problems on the exams are very similar to the class problems so take detailed notes. I recommend!

Dr. Bibby is probably your best choice for Calc 2 if you want to be well prepared for future math courses. He skips most of the minute topics that other professors go over. Dr. Bibby makes the course manageable by allowing you to use index cards on the midterm examinations and the final exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He is an AWESOME professor! Takes class very slowly and thoroughly explains all material. He is a tough grader though so beware of losing easy points on the exam! He takes attendance every class so I would try to attend every lecture. The HW is online but there is a lot of it. He gives a review guide before every test that is helpful, DO THAT!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Super cool old dude that loves baseball. Class is easy if you show up at least once a week and do the study guide you should get an A. If you understand basic algebra, which you should then you will pass. Final is optional which is a plus. He takes attendance but it's not graded.

I just finished taking MTH 113 and he was always clear and provided the class with his exact expectations. No surprises and was really approachable. Also very knowledgeable and always provided feedback on tests really quickly, there's no grade for homework but doing it is a great help. Able to use an index card for formulas on tests. overall great!

reviews.comment: Lots of homework but only because of the department. Not the fairest grader. Does not seem like there is a systematic way of taking off points; just kinda does what he feels like. Teaches well but does not prepare students well for the final exam since the department is much harder than his midterm exams are.

Absolutely loved taking Prof. Bibby for MTH 113. It was a "special interest" class, so it was different from the other sections, and was all about saber metrics and baseball analytics which I loved. Incredible passion to teach baseball analytics at 9AM on 3 days per week, so would definitely recommend taking him for MTH 113. Also watched Moneyball!

First thing to know for mth 161 is it's department based. So he no longer allows note cards and the homework is excessive and out of his control. Nice guy accessible outside of class for help, but he teaches just like any other math prof. Example written on board, repeat. Repeat. Repeat

Dr. Bibby is by far the best math Professor I have had this far. His lectures are absolutely amazing and he makes Pre-Calculus and math in general so easy to understand! He also provides study guides for each of his exams which are super helpful and are formatted just like the tests and lets us use an index card "cheat sheet" for the tests.

I am taking Dr. Bibby for MTH 108 this semester and he has allowed me to understand Pre-Calc and the best way possible. His lectures are amazing and very well organized. The way he teaches his classes are so easy to understand and the reviews he gives us are formatted exactly like his exams. Just show up to class, pay attention, and you'll do good.

reviews.comment: Dr. Bibby was the most amazing math teacher I have ever had. I took Calc 2 with him this semester and I really enjoyed the class. He is willing to meet outside of class and he is super clear with his material. I would definitely take his class again and highly recommend him!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Respected--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Bibby is my favorite. He cares about his students and makes class fun. He is accessible outside of class and is willing to help you as much as you need. Take good notes!! He allows you to use a notecard on the test to write down as much as you can fit and it is a lifesaver. Study and do what he says and you will do well.

reviews.comment: Very easy professor. Allows you to have a notecard on every test, including the final. Tests are exactly like the problems he does in class. Has office hours like 4 times a week - very accessible. I've taken him 3 times - guaranteed A

reviews.comment: I love him. Took him twice for Calc II and III and I'd take him if I could.
So amazing. Best math prof at UM

Need online access code for homework. everything is clearly outlined in syllabus. allows index card for tests. gives very useful handouts. show up & take notes & do homework & you'll definitely pass. gives review problems for exams & goes over them. explains things in helpful way & uses some humor.

Hes amazing! His lectures can be kinda long but hes so funny it makes up for it. You get two quizzes dropped at the end. Tests are easy compared to the review he gives. Definitely take him if you can.

Dr. Bibby is a hilarious teacher and makes the class very entertaining. He explains things very well and if you listen and understand the material you WILL do well. Do not give up the chance to take Dr. Bibby, because he is very memorable. Also very nice and straightforward.
The absolute man
Great professor. It is very easy to get an A. The review sheets given out before test are basically the same as the test. Just study the review sheets .

One of the best you can find. Lectures are good and he teaches the material well. He gives you a review sheet and if you do all the questions on it you are guaranteed an A or A-. Also allows a cheat sheet in midterms and finals. Overall he is great.
He's a great professor. You're allowed to have a cheat note card for every test AND THE FINAL. He is very easy; I would definitely take again, which I am for MTH 309

Best math professor in um. He always make the lecture clear and interesting. Do the review questions and the test is gonna be fine, he just changes the numbers of those questions in test. Easy A if you don't skip class. Definitely take again.
I love this professor for his humor and clear lecture. He makes MTH162 easier to learn.

Really cool guy. Taking math 113, which he made into a baseball math class. He makes the class interesting and he clearly loves what he is doing.  I would recommend him 100%. Just show up to class and do your homework and study and you've got an A.

Dr. Bibby is the best!  If you put in the work, you are sure to get an A.  He made classes fun and hard material easy to understand. You come out of his class having actually learned something. He gives test reviews that are just like the test, a 4X6 index card is allowed on all tests and you may use a graphing calculator!
