reviews.comment: Dr. Bibby is the best! He made classes fun and hard material easy to understand. He is always available to help. If you put in the work, you are sure to get an A. He goes over homework with you during class, he gives test reviews that are just like the test, a 4X6 index card is allowed on all tests and you may use a graphing calculator!
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Bibby is the best math professor I've ever had. He makes calc 2 easy to understand. The lectures are very boring, but that is calc and you will get that with any calc class. There are 4 tests and a final, but he drops the lowest test grade and you get a notecard on every test. His study guides are basically harder versions of the tests.

Bibby is the man! He's funny af and is a great teacher. There are 26 online hw assignments due in the semester. He gives 4 tests and a final (no midterm & lowest test gets dropped). The review sheets are harder than the actual tests so if you perfect the review you will do great on the test. Overall he is one of the top 5 teachers I've ever had.
He's a great guy and a great teacher. Calc 2 is a tough class but he makes it doable. I would definitely take another class with him if given the opportunity.
very clear. if you go to class you will be fine. the tests are exactly like the review sheet. he is very nice and funny. best professor ever.

He allows you to have a note card on every test and the Final. Also allowed to use a calculator on every test. He gives you a review sheet and spends two days on it before the test. Able to see him during his office hours if you have questions. Very helpful if you have questions. If you want all the insights to the test go to class. Book won't help
Show up to class, pay attention, take good notes, and you're good for the test. The test review worksheets are super helpful.

For most, Calculus II is a difficult course. Professor Bibby made it easier and interesting with his jokes and 'tricks.' I was originally placed in a higher level math and had to drop down to Bibby's class; he made the transition easy and steady for me and was always there to help and answer my questions. Amazing teacher and person.
Great professor. Content can be difficult, but he explains it in the clearest way possible. Would take again if I could.
Fantastic professor! So caring, clear, and helpful. You get to use an index card and you have a drop. The review is very similar to the test. Very luck if you can take him !

He is a good etcher but his tests are somewhat difficult. On the tests he puts questions similar to his review but a slight difference that sometimes you don't catch and do it wrong. He is a really tough grader but you can use and index card for the test

One of my favorite professors at UM HANDS DOWN. Didn't open or need a textbook once, he's that good. He'll make you laugh and enjoy math. I planned my schedule around him just to have him. Even if you didn't get it in class, he was extremely helpful in office hours. Not one bad thing to say about Dr. Bibby!

No textbook necessary... Professor Bibby is a legend. Hilarious with a great sense of humor, Bibby will make you love, yes love, Calculus. I looked forward to his class every day because he actually made it enjoyable. If you can, register for his class as soon as it's open. You won't regret it

Bibby is a great Calc professor. You will not find another who explains everything as crystal clear as this man. He gives review questions before every test that accurately represent the difficulty of what's on the tests, albeit with a small wrinkle here and there. You can't go wrong with Professor Bibby.

Bibby is super easy and chill. He writes all the notes in class on the board so it is easy to follow along and understand. His tests are extremely easy, if you do the practice tests they are almost exactly the same just with different numbers. Attendance isn't mandatory but i recommend going because his notes really help and basically give you an A

Bibby teaches clearly with a touch of humor. I understand everything he teaches, and enjoy it too. He gives ample time to complete homeworks and allows the use of notecards and calculators on quizzes and tests. As long as you go to class and pay attention, you're good-to-go!!
Prof Bibs is a funny guy. Hes a stylish man and also teaches calculus very well. His office hours saved me before the calc final. Bibby is a boss.

Bibby gives review sheets before every exam. Do the review and you're guaranteed a B for each test. Study a little more and you have yourself an A. 5 tests (drops one...don't waste it on a doctor's appointment)homework (worth almost nothing), and a final. If you want to get a good grade AND learn math, take Bibby. Bibby > Rosenberg/Oneida/Beverly

He lets you use a large notecard and graphing calculator on exams.  Attendance is not mandatory, but you have to pass in homework usually the day before exams.  Pretty easy class as far as calculus goes.  But if you are in class, don't talk, or he will stop the class and yell at you.
Allows notecards on exams, as well as calculators. Very helpful, and just an awesome professor! Take him!

Taking a math course with Bibby for a 2nd time just reinforced how great a professor he is. Calc II, which is typically considered nightmarish, became extremely understandable. Tests are reasonable, though by all means make the notecard for memory's sake. Compute: The Great Bibsky/(****^2) = Math. Solve for The Great Bibsky
Take him. take him, take him, take him. He is fantastic. If you dont get an A in this class it is your own fault. Best math teacher at miami. Love him.

Bibby is by far the best professor I have ever had in my academic career.  He expects a lot from you, and for you to understand where everything comes from but he takes his time to explain everything.  If you do the homework and review sheets you will do fine.  Work hard and an A is definitely possible.

I have taken every single math class at UM with Dr. Bibby because he genuinely is a great professor. Very knowledgeable, available, willing to help. Exams are easy if you do his review. Class attendance is not mandatory, but highly recommended for an A in the class. Doesn't overload you with unnecessary material. Take him and Calc will seem trivial

Good, clear professor. 5-day week class moves FAST. You have 7 exams plus final (drops worst exam), test every other Friday with Thurs review. He allows 4x6 notecard with formulas & EXAMPLES. MAKE THE NOTECARD! IMPORTANT: If operation & answer are perfect but you miswrite answer in the answer space box, he'll deduct a point. Be careful.
simply the best math teacher ever. He is Crystal clear and his tests are east.. Bibby rocks !!
Awesome teacher! Makes class interesting and only teaches you the concepts; doesn't waste time with unimportant examples. Very good teacher, very funny old man.

Great teacher. One of the few English speaking calc teachers. Very helpful in office hours. Gives review sheets before every exam and they are exactly like the exam. He also lets you drop your lowest grade. If you go to class and do the homework (although it isn't required) you can get an A in the class.

excellent professor, lectures are very clear and tests come straight from class examples. Lets you use a flash card for each exam to write formulas/examples/anything you want. Homework not graded but helps tremendously on test day. Highly recommended for anyone taking MTH108.

This was pre-calc part 2. I can easily say he has been my best math teacher through out my entire educational career. He is very helpful and good at explaining things. As long you study and do your homework, the test are pretty easy. I highly recommend him.

really tough grader. He doesnt go through things more than once so unless you've taken calc 12 before its hard to keep up. There is no curve and he takes off a lot of points for little things. Hard to do well in his class even if you understand the main concepts.

Genuinely a great guy and a great instructor. MGT100 is super easy so it is basically impossible to not get an A if you attend the lectures and even do the bare minimum with the group project. Jeff is really helpful and friendly and makes the class feel less like a class and more like a hangout spot. Take his class its free and fun.

Half of the classes are working on a group project with your TA. Jeff tries his best to make the class as entertaining as possible, even though the content can be meh at times, he makes jokes to lighten the mood. Has funny stories if you get him talking in class, which I recommend doing. Tells you exactly what to take notes on and whats on the test
very nice, easy class, sometimes a little boring but overall great.
The best Management Professor at UM.
He is such a sweet teacher and really tries his best to keep the class engaged. Can't recommend enough!

Jeff is very entertaining and always fun to listen to and interact with. He's super down to earth and genuinely cares about each and every one of his students. Definitely the highlight class of my first semester as a freshman at UM.

Jeff's class was probably my favorite core class this semester. Even though the material can be uninteresting as a business prerequisite, he somehow finds a way to make the class fun and engaging. Also fairly easy, just 3 straightforward exams (none are cumulative), and 2 group presentations.

Absolutely love this guy. Take advantage of his extra credit opportunities- chances are youll make some friends as well as hear some cool UM visitors and learn something. Jeff has good values and is super personal with his students. Super interesting too since hes lived and taught practically everywhere.

LOVE JEFF!! He gets a bad wrap he's seriously the best. My 3 hour night class would be HORRIBLE if it weren't for Jeff being so engaged with students, genuinely hilarious/relatable. You need to take Jeff over someone old and boring ANYDAY, exams are exactly like his review sessions, gives extensive/kind feedback on work, go to class and your golden
Amazing teacher!!! Definitely take him he is very sweet and caring and the class is super easy!
Great dude

Jeff is hilarious. The only reason why I was able to survive the 3hr class was cause he made it entertaining. His personality is so personable and he's passionate about what he's teaching. The class is super easy, just show up and show effort and he'll respect that. No exams, just a few projects but they were straightforward and easy. Love him

Jeff is the best! Had him for both 304 and 100. This is a teacher that truly cares about his students and their success. Not a particularly difficult course; Professor Jeff highlights what you should actually learn, and he doesn't bombard you with a ton of terms and definitions that don't matter. Take his class and enjoy!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: If you think this class is hard idk how you got into UM. There's no work outside of class and the two tests we have; you memorize like 20 terms. He's honestly such a sweet guy and if you cant take joke then maybe he's not right for you. Class is mandatory for all business students and you don't learn much in it. I would totally recommend him.
Does not answer emails. Makes super weird and uncomfortable comments. He means well. The class is easy.
Jeff is amazing! Such a fun and engaging class.
Super fun professor!
for mgt 360. absolutely amazing, we all love jeff. wonderful professor, one of the best in the business school. made our night class genuinely fun to go to. thank you jeff :)
Easy and Great class
Great Professor!

Upperclassmen opinion: worst management professor. This class has no structure and you leave class learning absolutely nothing. He goes until the very last minute of every class (9:20pm) even if there's nothing to do. He gets mad and calls the class out for his own mistakes. Is nice but is a terrible teacher and not accessible outside of class.

Any bad review on here was probably the students fault. Jeff is actually the best and does the most for the already easy class (no shame to mgt100) to be easier. Take Jeff!! Hope to take more of his classes great and funny professor.

I didn't enjoy this class. Graded on a few things (3). A big group project throughout the semester, a poster presentation and participation/attendance. Class is all over the place and you don't really know what he is expecting and I was very confused. Participation grades aren't really what they are supposed to be. I made great friends in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Jeff was a great professor with clear expectations. If you show up to every class and pay attention to the lectures you will be fine. The tests are not hard if you spend an hour or two outside of class reviewing his slide and practice test. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great Prof, had him for MGT100 and MGT480, always enjoyed coming to class, was very fun, and loves to talk and make class fun.

Do not take him. He is the worst professor I have ever had in UM. He has so much resentment towards UM students and is constantly making accusations about "people like us". He is very judgemental and always has something negative to say, it is never enough. 

The class has absolutely NO structure. He NEVER answers emails, NEVER!!!!!!
he's nice try to go to class though it will help ur grade

He talked about his Rate My Professor ratings on the first day of class and said he would be considering them throughout this semester. I can see he improved because the reviews from before are completely different from the professor he is now! Such a kind professor. The material is also simple if you take notes and review them. Take him!!!!
Take him, take him, take him! Such a kind and funny person.

Great professor, very clear instructions on what he is looking for on assignments and projects. Tests are very straight forward and he alludes to what will be on them before hand. 100% recommend taking his class.

Specifically referenced rate my professor during the first week of class, and said has considered his past ratings when updating his class. Now specifically tells you which slides from his lectures or which videos assigned will be on the quizzes. He is also just a really nice and caring guy and I would definitely recommend him.

Jeff is the best! He is kind, hilarious, and genuinely cares about students. He also gives extra credit for volunteering and attending additional lectures. These reviews do not do him justice. Definitely take him!

Jeff is a fantastic professor! Super interesting guy. His lectures are very interesting and he jokes around a lot which keeps everyone engaged. He appreciates participation a lot but its never to answer difficult questions which is nice. Tells you exactly what will be on the quizzes from the slideshow. Fun class and great prof.

Great professor and learned a ton of skills. You meet once a week for a lecture and once a week for the group project. He can sometimes be a hard grader, but he is very honest and helpful. He is such a fun speaker, and everyone is always laughing. Two quizzes which are VERY manageable. Loved this class.

He is the best. My favorite professor; I would recommend choosing him if you can. He has an amazing personality, is hilarious, and very nice. He offers extra bonuses for volunteering and attending events. His tests aren't the easiest, but he provides all the material you need to study

He is a great and funny person! But you still have to work hard to get a good grade if you read the book and go to class you should be fine. He also offers a lot of extra credit opportunities to improve your grade. People that didn't do well in his class didn't put time and effort into the assignments and the group project.

Jeff is ok however, I barely learnt anything in the actual class and learned more in the semester long group project. The tests are mostly FITB and he never got a 100 on his own tests. He's funny but I thought I was going to actually learn something in the class.

New to UM & first impression was friendly, however that had quickly changed throughout the semester. Although I had put a great amount of effort into his class, it was never enough. He had a different grading system in comparison to other professors who were giving fair grades to their students. Very frustrating to deal with as a freshman. Avoid!
Made me laugh daily, strange activities to each us but i still passed so just read the textbook and study off that
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I literally don't understand this mans deal. He is such a harsh grader for no reason. Every other student I know who has a different prof ended this class with an A. If you have the chance to take another prof do it. He picks on students. Some of activity choices were questionable and highlighted the inequalities between student backgrounds. Not it

Friendly professor who says he cares, but can be rude and demeaning. Course had little to no structure, and was the only MGT teacher who gave a final quiz with fill-in-the-blank instead of all MCQ. Was his first semester, but far and away the most clueless prof I've had and he grades tougher than any of the other management 100 teachers.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Honestly, didn't learn anything for a whole semester. We did a ton of pointless activities, always started class late, and never knew what style the test was going to be (multiple choice, free response, etc). He never seemed to know what he was doing and the class felt like a joke. However, we never had homework and only saw him once a week

Jeff is a great professor and cares a lot about his students! If you do a decent job on assignments you will get an A. He will help you if you have questions on quizzes or other assignments. Anyone who said he is a tough grader either didn't study or didn't take the group project seriously enough. Lectures were interesting and activities were fun.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Don't be scared of these ratings Jeff is a great teacher and an awesome guy! He is very knowledgeable and will teach you a lot how to succeed as a young business professional. He will make you work for your grade but very fair and accessible outside of class.Everyone who rates him bad is just mad they didn't get an easy A. Take Professor Bourgeois!

Great guy but it is his first year at the University of Miami and he just seems genuinely lost. He also grades extremely harshly for no real reason and his blackboard page is confusing, His quizzes are all on material he never covered in class.
Jeff is gang fr but don't underestimate the quizzes and project cause they highkey tuff. He grades hard but the feedback makes it understanding.

From the first day of class, I knew that Jeff is a professor who genuinely cares about the well-being of his students. While he does grade a bit tougher than the other MGT100 teachers, being challenged is all part of growth. As long as you complete the work and show up to class, you'll get a good grade.

Jeff is awesome and I definitely recommend him. If you actually get involved in the class, participate, and put in some effort on the assignments you will get a good grade. He cares about his students so much, has tons of real world experience, and does cool activities instead of just lecturing all the time. I look forward to his class every time.

Jeff is an AMAZING teacher! He tries to make a connection with everyone in the class and it's obvious he loves teaching. His lectures are meaningful and you barely get homework. The activities in class give you new insight on the world. This was honestly my favorite class this semester!! I would definitely recommend taking his class!!
I like his dynamic classes sessions. He truly cares about his students. He does not deserves these ratings; however, he really is a tough grader.. I would definitely take his class again.

Jeff is a really funny laid back guy who seems to be knowledgeable. Despite this his class is all over the place and very hard to follow. He makes jokes half the class and makes it very difficult to get an A even though the material is not hard. He does not give full credit on anything and always takes off points no matter your quality of work.

Jeff is super nice and cares a lot about his students, but every assignment is out of 10 points or less and he constantly gives grades below 90%. Take a different professor if you want an A in management.

While I admit that Jeff is a tough grader, he definitely does not deserve these ratings. He cares a lot about his students, and even though he may show it differently, he wants you to succeed. He is also very chill and funny. Don't be scared to take this class based off his rating

It makes me sad to see all of these bad ratings... Jeff is so sweet and funny, and he really cares about his students. We do a lot of interesting activities in his class and I always look forward to going because there's always something new we're doing. He's a tough grader for no reason but get on his good side and you'll prob get a better grade.

AWFUL TEACHER. If you want to get a good grade in Management do not take this class. He is passive aggressive does not know what he is doing and will never give anyone a 100. Ruins what is supposed to be a really interesting class. He fails to teach and I wasted my money paying for class where we talked about oranges.

Do not take him at all. It was his first year teaching at this school and he was clueless. He will call on you randomly, he grades so harshly, and expects you to know everything even though he did not teach it.

Super friendly 1st year teacher that wants to be your friend... but the harshest grader of any management teachers. Jeff often has no idea what he is doing including around exam time leaving students stressed and confused, with him providing often completely false answers on test format etc. Can be really rude to his students and shows people up.

I think this is an excellent class overall. You truly leave it a stronger journalist than when you started. That said, the course is very intense — the workload is heavy and the professor will challenge you consistently. However, I see that as a positive, because it pushes students to grow, improve their skills, and reach a higher standard.
This is the hardest but also the best class I have taken at UM. I feel like I am more than ready to take on the real world with the skills I gained in this class.

This class is really good at making sure students have actually comprehended what they have learned over the last four years. It truly does nail down all the little tips/tricks we should know before heading into the real world. The class was basically an internship. It felt like we were getting experience working in a real broadcast setting.

She gives feedback that is unhelpful and honestly rude. She will mark you off multiple points for a simple mistake. She also believes everything is AI written, even when it is not and will mark you off on that as well. Be careful.

This class makes me wish I never chose a major in writing or journalism of any sort. I have never felt more discouraged in a classroom I have never tried so hard to please a professor just for them to dismiss any work presented. She has a my way or the high way approach without any reason and picks favorites. Has a lot to say and helps with nothing

Professor Treadwell is the best! This class was so helpful for me as a content creator and a producer and I have grown more in this class than in any other class throughout college. I would highly recommend to anybody that wants to get better at making packages.
Good but tough.

Prof. Treadwell is a really great professor who brings up necessary topics for us student journalists. Each class is a discussion, where we talk about writing, editing, filming to ethics in the industry. Prof. Treadwell has a very clear and honest view of what it's like to have a career in the business and prepares us for the real world.
I think Professor Treadwell was a great professor who taught the topic clearly and helped me learn a lot about the subject matter.
She was an amazing teacher and has so much passion for her job and it really helps create a great learning atmosphere!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof. Treadwell is very enlightened and gives great feedback on assignments. She pushed me so far out of my comfort zone to perform on camera and behind the scenes. She made me realize I might want to make a career as a reporter! Te work and feedback in her class also improved my writing and shooting, and made me hold myself to a higher standard.

Professor Treadwell is the best and most caring professor I've had at UM. She is tough on you, but that's because she wants to see you succeed and have all the skills you need when your graduate. She is willing to help at all hours of the day and will become your best resource. If you don't like her, you are in the wrong industry and major.

Treadwell cares so much about her students and their success. Lectures and discussions are great, this class is not for the faint of heart. Its hard, but has been the most rewarding class I've taken at UM. Info and skills learned are relevant and she provides great professional insight.

Treadwell is a tough professor, but if you genuinely want a career in broadcast, she is the professor to have. You need to get her on your side for sure. Put in work, turn in everything on time, show up early, be friendly and she will be on your team.

Treadwell seems very intimidating through her initial grading. STICK WITH IT, she eases up after one or two assignments. She really does mean well and is a wonderful teacher if you show you care about the class.

Whoever says this professor is easy and nice and all are lying. She grades waaayyy to unnecessarily harsh and she talks to me like I'm stupid in class as well as online. She won't hesitate to talk to you like you're dumb in front of the entire class either. I've received Fs on assignments other professors looked over and told me they wouldn't have.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I urge you all to avoid this woman at all costs. She is blatantly clear that she has "favorites" and if you're not one of them you will face a loss of points that you don't understand why you are receiving an 80 while others are earning more. Additionally - a nasty disposition and tone make it even harder to cope with the grading system.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Treadwell has experience in the real world when it comes to broadcasting, and she brings it into the classroom. With that comes high expectations for your work, but it will only result in you becoming a better storyteller! She also have a very clear breakdown of grading which is extremely helpful.

Professor Treadwell works with Professor Ed Julbe to teach this class and it is the second time I've taken a class with Professor Treadwell. She is an absolute gem and everytime I take her class I just learn more and more. There is a lot of work in the class but again, it is all worth it you will learn how to produce a live TV show!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Treadwell does work you hard for your grade but it is because she knows that it is what it will be like in the real world! She's had a lot of experience in the real world and knows more about broadcast writing than any other professor at UM!

Treadwell is the best professor in this department. She has years of experience at CNN and her lectures are very insightful. She also goes above and beyond to help her students and truly cares about their success. Be prepared to work hard but if you care about doing well in this field, you will take as many of her classes as you can.

If God is a woman, it's Professor Treadwell. She worked at CNN for 17 years, and she's the sweetest woman ever. The only people who write bad reviews are people who can't take ownership of their own stupidity.

Professor Treadwell is an incredibly smart and kind professor. She cares that her students actually learn about news. If you can't handle her class, you aren't trying. She is a fair grader and a loving person.

I would not recommend. She is not really interested in helping her students succeed. She will assure you that you will be okay and then does not offer much guidance as to how you can improve. She requires that you do a lot of work, like you are not taking any other classes and does not care about your physical or mental well being. Do not take her.
really hard class, do not take her class

You will do a lot of work in this class but you will also learn a lot. Prof. Treadwell drills broadcast writing through various exercises, homework, classwork, and labs. She's a tough grader - but she spent decades working at CNN so she knows the business well and she knows what you need to learn to succeed in broadcast. Take her, you'll learn tons

Good prof, but is extremely inaccessible outside class and you won't have any grades in the gradebook until prob the day before grades are due. Exams on LockDown, and straightforward if you study. In lectures, she just reads off the slides; no big deal if you miss a few classes. If you need a writing credit, this is a super easy way to get it.

Professor Bouza is very helpful. The course isn't super easy, but she does a good job of teaching it, and she gives many opportunities for extra credit. If you study and do the extra credit, it's hard to fail this class.

Great professor! Super nice, patient, and explains everything clearly. I learned a lot in her class. Exams are taken at home with LockDown Browser and are fair if you study. Highly recommend taking her

If you have the choice, do not take her!! She seemed like a sweet person but as a teacher she was terrible. all the tests had NOTHING to do with the material in class and they are super hard. She also took a very long time to open tests on test days and has taken up to half an hour to open tests. If you do take her be prepared and study the book.

She is not a good professor. Her lectures are boring and she spends too much time on simple concepts and breezes through the harder ones. The things that she spends the most time lecturing on do not appear on the exams which are much harder than the examples she provides in class. I'd wait until another semester if she was the only prof avalible

not good at all. got stuck taking her bc all the other sections were full. overexplains simple concepts in class that will not appear on exams. lectures are boring and she genuinely pulls exams from out of no where with purposfully tricky questions. incredibly difficult to work with and blames all her issues on canva. doesnt listen to students
She is such a nice person. I went to see her for office hours and she was so helpful. She is engaging when she teaches. Her lectures are a bit hard, but it's also just the topic.

Great professor who cares about her students. The class consisted of group projects, discussion boards, quizzes, and exams. She's willing to help students who are struggling in class and offers plenty of extra credit opportunities which was incredibly helpful.
Bouza's 230 section is wonderful, she is very approachable and knowledgeable about the content covered, I had no issues and would highly recommend her!

I don't know why people are saying her class is difficult; I genuinely loved her and her class and I feel like I learned a lot. I took her for stats as well, and while I am NOT a stats person, I still got an A. Her class is only difficult if you don't pay attention and don't try. I am hoping to take another class with her in the future.

Do not take her class. Her exams are impossible, poorly crafted and have nothing to do with the material covered. The questions were extremely vague, with typos and one has to guess the answers because they have nothing to do with the material. She is a nice person and gives extra credit but her exams are awful. AVOID AT ALL COSTS.

Easily the worst professor I've had at UM, nearly impossible to do well as her exams do not reflect her extremely simple and poor lectures. No wiggle room for grading either. Do not take at all costs.

Dr. Bouza is a very good professor who always responds fast to emails. However her exams are pretty difficult mainly because of all the select all that apply questions. I do believe her grading system is great and benefits the student greatly. You can get up to an entire letter grade of extra credit and she does not take attendance.

Professor Bouza is very knowledgeable and engaging during her lectures. She highly encourages discussion and takes her time to answer every question. Her assignments are mainly in the online textbook but they're very easy. She has 2 other assignments & extra credit that are all group work. Her exams are easy just pay very close attention in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She read off of the slides so it felt like showing up for class was a waste of time. I took the online Prenatal Development class and tests were easy if you spend a lot of time studying (theres only 3). I really did not like that her class didn't match the assignments that were put on syllabus. She gave us a group presentation a week in advance.

The exams are extremely confusing and do not align with the lectures/study guide. She makes the material seem easy in class but then the exams are complicated with multiple answers to select. She does not show up in office hours. She does not dive extra credit. She is not flexible with dates/deadlines at all.

Lectures were engaging however the tests did not correspond to lectures at all. There were multiple grammatical mistakes which made the exams even more difficult. Almost all the questions were multiple select and could be very misleading. She is very accessible and gives extra credit but if you do not NEED to take this course I wouldn't.

Exams wording was misleading, so many technical difficulties. In one exam two of the graphs showed up as a blank square. Asked if i could take the exams in person and on paper and she said no. She cancelled on our office hours on multiple occasion's. She would never respond to my emails asking for help. Nice person, but felt impossible to succeed.

Professor Johayra is passionate and cares about the class. But her exams are hard. About half of them are questions with more than one answer. Those options are confusing, making you worry about how many of them to pick. It is also online with lockdown browser. I personally prefer in-person tests. Taking them with the camera on adds to my anxiety.

Really tries to help students understand and encourages asking questions. Gives good practice questions in lecture powerpoints that are similar to exams. However, does not give exam prep questions (which are also similar to exams) back with answers but encourages collaboration to get to the right answers. Some pop quizzes on book chapter.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. B is a great professor and invested in the material for PHY230. She is knowledgeable about the subject and is super sweet and funny. Assignments don't make up much of your grade but go to class because assignments can only be done there. She takes long with grading, the exams aren't the easiest, but I loved her class and would 100% take again.
Literally the worst professor I've had in my life due to her horribly worded/misleading exams, not giving exams/exam prep assignments back, and lack of communication. Do not take her at all costs.

She is a nice professor and can definitely keep the class engaged during lectures, but the grading is pretty harsh. A majority of your grade is made up of exams and the class is only out of 100 points. There are extra credit opportunities, but these assignments often count for around 0.05 points, so it doesn't really make a difference.

She is an amazing professor. She genuinely cares for all her students, is open to feedback and overall want you to do well in her class. Her lectures are entertaining and engaging. Her tests are hard but she does everything to prepare you for the test. Easy to talk to and approachable. Would/ want to take another class with her.

This is a course in marketing.  You just happen to focus entirely on digital media marketing which is why this course is so great.  You learn how to look at media marketing in an entirely new way.  Professor Bolton is fun, he is engaging, and very fair.  He does a great job preparing you for the real world.  Highly recommended

Social media project for the entire semester so pick an easy idea and a good group. Kinda an absurd amount of work for a marketing elective. Many presentations, a journal, 10 linkedin posts, several homework assignments. A midterm and a final on longg lectures. Just fill out the study guide as he goes. He is not flexible AT ALL about missing class.

Bolton has to be my favorite prof at UM. He's so incredibly kind, he takes notes on everyone and knows everyones name. I will say some cons are lots of hw and a huge group project u work on all sem. Midterm+Final. Not too hard but def a lot of time required to be put into the class. I highly recommend him he's the best and i learned so much!!

This class is way harder than it needs to be. Many people who studied for hours and days got low B's and  C's on the exam. This class is an easy concept but it seems like the professor wants to make it challenging and difficult.
My FAVORITE PROFESSOR!! He cares about his students, while also teaching about Digital Marketing. There are two exams and a few projects, but all are very manageable and easy to complete.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Truly the best professor I've had at this school so far. He is so passionate and makes each lecture engaging and entertaining. Cares about his students and teaches a lot about the real world.

He rambles a lot but he does put a lot of care into his lectures and tests are open note. He is nice but a little weird and will do random call outs. The project for a social media is not explained clearly and he gets too into it. Overall nice guy easy grader and provides a lot of feedback

Professor Bolton is nice but I DON'T recommend this class. All the material is dated and not about Digital Marketing Analytics. His tests are open note open book and he gives you two "study guides" one for the textbook (which he never mentions in class) and the other for lectures, he says his tests are based on them but they aren't. DON'T TAKE!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Bolton is an entertainer. He definitely has the skills to present to his fellow students, and know how to get his message across. Although the projects are a bit time consuming, it is definitely doable if you take the time to really focus on it. There are only two exams throughout the entire semester which is not awful either.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: There is a lot of work in this class and also his tests are really hard and heavy. not a lot of assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He cold calls which is stressful, however I learned so much and took a lot away from this course. There are 2 exams which are both open note. Definitely meet with him one on one if you have the chance.

I think Professor Bolton is a great guy. He loves marketing and loves teach us about it. Some of the work was a lot and there was a lot of it, including a big group project (and you don't get to pick your groups). Some of it felt like busy work but there were some assignments that really helped me learn the material. Make sure you take notes!

One of the best professors I have ever had. Very patient and knowledgeable about the subject. Had lots of real-world experience that he would bring up in class. You can learn a lot of applicable marketing skills from this class. As long as you keep up with the work, you should be able to get an A.

Professor Bolton is great and a cool dude. He does like to nitpick his students which is kind of hard especially when you are confused about what is being taught. Make sure if you take the class to read the textbook on your own because you do not go over anything from it during class. Also, fill in the lecture study guides during class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Bolton is very knowledgeable in this course. His material is very interesting and you will definitely learn a lot. He gives a lot of work and you have to dedicate time to this class in order to succeed! Overall, very good class!
I liked the class but I thought it his assignment schedule was a bit confusing.
cares about his students! can be a lot of work but a useful marketing course

Initially, I didn't know if I'd love the class, but professor Bolton is extremely knowledgeable in everything he teaches and teaches it very well. The class is a lot of work (really a lot of assignments), but he makes himself readily available for any help you may need. Group project is a huge part of the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Bolton is a great guy and very knowledgable, but I did not like this class at all. It's extremely project based and he is very vague about his expectations and direction. I did not learn anything useful in this class and dreaded attending it. I would recommend any other marketing choice other than this course.

Professor Bolton did a great job of making the lecture engaging and interesting. I would definitely recommend him! You do need to read textbook to do well on the exams. Very thoughtful and caring teacher!!!!

Professor Bolton is such a nice guy. You can tell he really wants his students to succeed. This is probably the most real-world applicable class I've taken in college. I really really enjoyed it. Professor Bolton will support you and prepare you for the real world.

Great professor, group project throughout the semester that is a lot of work if you don't have a good team, and he picks the teams so pray you get lucky. Tests are open notes but still challenging for some reason.

Group project is probably the most annoying part about the class, but other than that you learn a lot in terms of marketing and getting into the minds of consumers.

Professor Bolton is amazing!! He really cares about his students and always makes himself accessible outside of class. The majority of the class is one group social media project. Midterms are hard but usually open book and if you study you'll be fine. He also gives a ton of extra credit opportunities to boost your grade.

Great professor with a visionary view on current digital development and marketing. Inspirational lectures to connect your knowledge with you real life. Pay attention in class and you will get good grade.

Professor Bolton is amazing!! This class is extremely useful and engaging as he teaches us real life information. His lectures are very interesting and he makes it very clear on how to get an A in the class. If you have the chance to take this class it will definitely increase your knowledge of digital marketing!

Great guy. Makes it very clear how to get an A. Lectures are very entertaining.

reviews.comment: Professor Bolton is such a great professor. He gives interesting lectures and projects. He could be a tough grader, but it is definitely a class you should take!
Professor Bolton is extremely engaging and uses relevant content within his lectures to encourage class participation.
He is a good teacher, accesible and caring.

It is an interesting class, if you listen to the class carefully, and read the book. You definitely will get A for this class. And you also have an opportunity to operate social media. The professor is so nice and helpful.
Great class!
He genuinely wants you to do well. Is very specific about assignments and gives you detailed instructions. A lot of chances to make up lost points and overall, a very interesting and fun course.

reviews.comment: He is a great teacher! Extremely respectful and fair grader!
Great Professor and really cares about his students, he wants you to meet with him and discuss your future plans so he can give you advice. great class

Dr. Britton is awesome. He is such an understanding and helpful guy. I thoroughly enjoyed his class and writing about something I loved. He genuinely cares about his students and understands that sometimes we need extensions. I loved how interested he was in everyone's end of the year project, and how painless he made this course.

so sweet and perfect and kind. i was always late unintentionally and as long as you show engagement w his class, he forgives attendance. gives fast and concise feedback. easy grader. so understanding and will give you extensions.

Very understanding professor and very easy class. It was mainly graded on Three research papers (you choose the topic) and reading checks + a few other assignments. He gives enough time to complete everything and is pretty lenient and understandable with late work/deadlines. Easy grader and always responds to emails.

Professor Britton was genuinely the best writing professor I've ever had. He cared about both his students' well-being and improving their writing skills. He's hilarious, and I have literally recommended him to everyone I know looking for a 107 professor. Take him. He's the best.

Britton is the goat. He assigns 3 major papers throughout the year that sequentially flow into each other and you get to pick your topic. Cares about each students progress a lot and is very understanding. I have always hated taking writing/english classes, but I really enjoyed his class.

He talks A LOT. Spends more than half the class time talking and then doing tedious little assignments. Really great person tho, cares about his students and wants to see everyone succeed. Accepts late work with no penalty and never used a single book in this class. Takes attendance everyday.
Amazing professor. Secret - I never got the textbook and I was fine. Clearly explains assignments, encourages questions, and brought snacks on the last day of school.

Boring class a great guy. I learned how to properly read and write STEM papers efficiently. The downside is that he makes you buy a notebook and textbook you won't use, and he has some unnecessary assignments. Half the assignments are poorly explained; however, he leaves good feedback and genuinely enjoys teaching. Do the work and participate!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Britton was fantastic. he was very caring and aware that most students have more demanding classes. he was flexible and clearly laid out every assignment, which was mostly a few blog posts and 3 papers. he walks you through every assignment in class and gives ample time to complete. would def recommend, super nice guy. he brought pastries once

this prof is amazing. he really wants you to learn the material, and this class has helped me so much when it comes to science communication and research. def take if you are a STEM major, you won't regret it.

Professor is great however the class is super boring. He gives good feedback on essays and isn't too harsh of a grade and almost always gives extensions if you ask for them. He takes attendance every class. Downsides are that we were required to buy a textbook we barely used and sometimes he lectures the entire class which can be quite boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Britton is an extremely kind, caring, and intelligent professor. He allows for any extension, gives true feedback, and is interested in all you have to write. reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Tough grader at times. Assignments will really start to pile up towards the end of the semester, but provides a lot of opportunities to raise your grade. Very nice guy and very approachable.

Professor Britton is such a great English professor who is extremely accessible in/out of class. He will respond to any emails pretty quickly and is always willing to help. I would not say he is the easiest grader, but he does give many opportunities to resubmit assignments towards the end of the semester. Great teacher!!

Mr. Britton took his time for every student and put plenty of effort into everything. He would be willing to extend assignments if you asked. He always responded to emails quickly. Every assignment was graded with useful comments.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: By far the best English class Ive taken. Most classes are lectures where he goes over the specifics of assignments or analyses a reading to teach. Gets a bit harder at end of semester with lots of assignments at once, but manageable. Easy grader and has really helped me improve as a writer.

If you have to take ENG 107 take Professor Britton! He is an easy grader, but he does tend to over explain things. There are a good amount of papers, but plenty of time to work on each of them. He is super nice and always allows for extensions!

He is by far the best English teacher I have ever had. Although there are blog posts and some papers due, he really pushes his students to be better. I have been struggling with the new STEM concepts and not only has he met with me multiple times but he wants to see his students do well. If you have the opportunity to take this class I recommend.

The most incredible English professor I've had! He is so understanding with deadline and just wants to see that you want to learn in his course. I had to work very hard in his class but I have learned so much. Highly recommend this course to those of you who actually want to learn more about science writing.

Dr. Britton is one of the best teachers I've ever had. Very considerate to his students, you can tell he really cares about us. Hard to get a super low grade but you definitely have to put in work to get high A's. I 10/10 recommend taking a class with him if you get a chance.
Professor Britton is really nice and flexible. In the beginning, some of the required readings were a little annoying, but they weren't that bad. I recommend taking his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: A very nice guy who is also surprisingly funny. He really cares about you and wants you to write to the best of your abilities. There are pre-class readings that arent too bad and class can get slightly boring but overall hes a very chill professor.

Such a nice guy who really cares about his students' success. He does not give that many assignments compared to other ENG105 teachers. He is a fair grader and loves when students come to office hours. The readings he assigns are also pretty interesting.

My favorite class as a freshman at the U BY FAR. I love Professor Britton, he is funny and just a good guy in general. Hearing things about other teachers, I have never been happier about taking a course. He grades easily, very understanding with late work, and truly wants you to do well.

Britton is a cool guy but the class itself because it's so basic is pretty dry. He gives great feedback and the syllabus and dates are solidified early in the semester. Easy class as long as you do the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Britton is a pretty good teacher. Hes available outside of class and is quite flexible. reviews.comment: Very nice teacher and gives good feedback. There are quite a few essays to write but nothing to crazy. Just turn in everything on time and follow his directions. He's also very flexible and if you need extra help he's very willing.
Very Nice Guy. Only 3 papers in the semester and he gives a B every time as long as you do them.

I don't think he will give out anything higher than an A-. Going to class is not necessary. His lectures are very broad and hard to apply to your own writing. He is always willing to meet with you to talk about your papers. Only three papers assigned. Very minimal reading.

Professor Britton is the NICEST teacher. His discussions are really helpful - if you pay attention and take notes the papers aren't too bad. Gives lots of feedback, super approachable, always there to help you. Highly recommend him.

Professor Britton is a really, really nice guy. I took a science fiction english class which I thought was going to be awful and it ended up being one of my favorites. He gives good feedback on the papers, and there aren't many assignments. He honestly wants everyone to do well, definitely recommend his class.

This is the nicest man ever. Took him for 105 and 106. These are extremely simple classes. He likes the whole idea of human identity and its boring but interesting. Easy teacher who isnt hard on due dates. Does not give a lot of assignments either.

Britton's a great professor! He's easy to follow in class, utilizes the board for notes, and is super clear about assignments and information. He's also a really nice guy--lenient with assignments if you're responsible and demonstrate an effort. He's a fair grader, but he's not an easy A.
Great professor, but he could be a bit stingy when grading papers. Ask him for help on your paper and you should do fine.

if you want a solid A, avoid this professor. he is really interesting, helpful made me actually like english! however he gives out B+ on papers A LOT and only with revisions and doing all the assignments will it bring your grade up to an A-. if you want an interesting but kind of challenging class choose britton.
Loved this professor. Very nice, understanding, and available for help. Highly recommend him!

Took a Sci-Fi themed Eng course & did very well. Britton is clear & helpful. He provides plenty of time to do assignments & anyone w/ average skills can do well if they listen to his critiques. Must read the short stories & they are discussed in class. Unbiased guy (unlike other ideologically driven professors). Highly reccomended!

Professor britton is really helpful. I would definitely recommend his course. Hes really knowledgeable and his class is easy as long as you keep up with your writing and you dont leave it to the last minute. Definitely take his class over any other english teacher
Easily my favorite professor this semester

He is a good professor and means well, but he never likes to give out A's on any paper when he knows they are good enough for an A. As long as you do the essays like he says then everyone gets pretty much a B

He is so nice. If you ask him for help he will gladly help you, even meeting out of class. There is 4 papers you do, and you get a couple weeks to do them, then you can also revise them for another grade! it's a fun and easy class. the papers are mostly your opinion or experience and analysis. I love the class and highly recommend him.

You do pretty much nothing for the whole year. Read a couple essays that are extremely long and write a couple essays. He is a tough grader on the essays in the sense that not many poeple get A's unless your paper was amazing. This class you can get a B easily in if you do all the essays and the hw.

Tough grader.  Gives you numerous chances to edit papers.  He gave out a lot of A-/B+'s when they should be A's, but I am not complaining.  Take it if you don't mind sitting through boring classes and typing generic essays

Lets you rewrite your papers at the end for extra credit/to bring up the grade on those particular papers
I really recommend this professor. He is really helpful and fair. He lets you rewrite your papers at the end of the semester for a higher grade and he loves working in groups.
a really nice guy. he will help you as much as you want.  papers are pretty easy to write. if you do the papers its pretty hard not to get atleast a B+

Really nice professor. Very willing to help students out. He could be more enthusiastic about the class.

During Fall '05, he adjusted the schedule due to the storms, and it is true-- He did cancel class a few times withoutprior notice. Great person and professor

Easy class. Teacher is a nice guy and really willing to help students out. You can rewrite every paper(only 4) and your grade is based on final portfolio( basically if you make it look great w/your binder/labels/etc and you have a basic grasp on the english language, you are set)!! Boring though
No Comments

i love this class. there is a lot of reading involved, and you have to actually work for your A, but it is still a great class.  he really knows his stuff and makes an effort to work around his students.  after the storm, he dropped a paper and extended the due date of another. you have to attend, but it's worth it.  the tests mirror the lectures.

If you want to have a life, don't take this class. This guy is inconsiderate and so far at UM he's the worst professor i've ever had and i'm a junior. He cancels his 8 am classes without an email. He's the absolute worst. Do yourself a favor and take another english class.You'll have on avg 100 pages of reading due for each class..some days 200.
Ugh, worst class of my life. I hate this guy. He thinks that his class is your ONLY class. DO NOT TAKE HIM. This class runs my life and i prefer organic chemistry to it.
a lot of work. helpful with special circumstances at end of semester
he's the man

Easy class if you know how to write already. The classes are useless but you have to come anyway since he gives writing assignments. Only 4 big papers to write, and he comments on them heavily, in the end you only have to turn in 2 or 3 of them. He has no useful input about how to write, though.

classes are a bore, almost useless judging by the fact the only 2 tests (final and midterm) are easily passed as long as you read the material. attendance is mandatory though. . . overall easy class if you can manage to attend class
Nice teacher, easy class

Worse class I have taken at the University of Miami, I don't understand why we pay so much money to this school. So bad.

I think it depends on the class you take. I had her for Adolescence and she was amazing. It was a discussion class so not too much homework. She leaves 2 articles for every class which you have to write a discussion post about but it's honestly not bad at all.

Dr. Britton did a great job at teaching research methods even though the subject is just overall boring. She has many quizzes which are all so hard and so many assignments. As long as you are good at time management you should be good with her assignments

Very harsh grader and pretends that she wants you to succeed but when I go into her office hours she is condescending and doesn't help me with the quizzes nor understand what I need to do for the homework. About a month and a half into Dr. Britton's class and the lectures are pointless, as she will spend a minute on a topic, convey the material poorly, then move on. I have never been to a class where I have been so frustrated and irritated with the teacher. The lectures are so unnecessary, but we are still required to go. I'm only a month into her class and I am already so irritated I am here writing this review. She makes the class harder than it should be and puts hard questions on the test that are difficult to answer. Book is way more helpful than going to her lectures. She grades the journal assignment very harshly and will take off points for things she told you to do.

This is the worst class I have ever taken. I love research and learning and this class was MISERABLE. She gives no grading criteria and then fails you. Content for the exam is easy but she overcomplicates simple conceptS so much that her own TA cant help us when we are confused. Coming from somebody who has A in the class, DONT TAKE IT!

Avoid at all costs. Solely getting an A because of reading the book in depth. Don't bother going to office hours for the journal assignments because she takes points off for things she tells you to write.

reviews.comment: Ok well for one this class was supposed to be an Easy A. The textbook she used was not the one that the other classes used at all. She made this class so much harder than it had to be and expected us to prioritize it over classes such as Orgo. Dont take her.

reviews.comment: If I could recommend any teacher at this school it would be professor McGuinn. He is one of the most kindest professors I have ever met. Everyone I've ever spoken to that has taken his class loves him.

Professor McGuinn is the best teacher in the Political Science department. I've taken four classes with him and I recommend everyone does. It's three essays for all your grades and he always accepts extensions. He is really caring.
Dr. McGuinn is an engaging lecturer, thoughtful grader, and incredible professor.

reviews.comment: Dr. McGuinn is the best professor in the poli sci department. Students are afforded the chance to learn about complex topics with little stress. In addition, Dr. McGuinn is incredibly kind and clearly cares about his students. You will learn in the best environment.

Is extremely access bile, will always respond to your emails in less than a day. Really cares about his students and give great feebacks for the class' three essay. If you go to class and reach out to him for feedback then you are set. Definitely one of my favorite professor I have taken at the U. Would 100% recommend.

I never write ratings, but Professor McGiunn is genuinely one of the best professors I've had. He gives great feedback on papers and cares about his students. Very understanding and clearly very knowledgeable and passionate about his work. 10/10 would take another class of his
What an amazing professor! Dr. McGuinn is incredibly knowledgeable, kind, and hands-down the best professor in the political science department. His insights and feedback are so helpful.

reviews.comment: Professor McGuinn is incredible! His lectures are super interesting and he's so passionate about his job. He's super understanding and kind too. Anyone who needs a POL class credit take him!

Bradford is an exceptional professor, he is very fair and understanding of his students. If you're not into writing papers, this class might not be for you since he mainly assigns writing assignments and there are about 2-3 major writing assignments that make up your entire grade.

Extremely intelligent and knowledgeable. Engaging lectures (though attendance is optional). No exams. Graded on 3 papers. My advice is to on them START EARLY. He lets you send him unlimited drafts and will give thorough feedback, but don't think you'll be able to write them in a weekend. Great guy. Very understanding. Take him.

reviews.comment: I have taken Dr. McGuinn a bunch of times. He is one of the most knowledgeable professors I have ever had. Three essays, occasional attendance. Super approachable outside of class and very reliable for source material. Best POL professor by far!

reviews.comment: McGuinn is my favorite POL prof at UM. He is very passionate and well-versed on middle east politics and US military and history. He really cares about you learning the material. He leaves very meaningful feedback on papers. The class is graded on 3 essays and attendance. His lectures can get boring, but when you focus, you can really learn alot.

Professor McGuinn is the best. He handles difficult issues relating to terrorism and international relations with care. He really reads your papers and gives in depth feedback. He also offers unlimited feedback on rough drafts. At times, his lectures aren't super engaging, but if you listen you'll learn lots. Couldn't recommend him more.

reviews.comment: lectures could be boring at times.. graded by basically just three papers and attendance was 10% but he took it maybe 5x in the whole year like four days back to back and then just stopped

reviews.comment: My second class taken with him, and all I have to say is that McGuinn is the best professor in the poli sci department. Lectures are fascinating, papers are fun to write since you pick the topic, and McGuinn gives the most thoughtful, detailed feedback which is super helpful when writing your papers (only 3 of them too!) the absolute best.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Nothing I say can truly express how amazing Dr. McGuinn really is. I took six classes with him. His lectures can be a bit boring but attendance is not necessary if you can do good research for the papers. He is always happy to meet and give feedback on your draft to ensure you get a perfect paper grade. Take as many classes of his as you can.
He is such a caring and helpful professor, this is my second year taking a course with him and I highly recommend his lectures. He is the best!

Amazing Professor. He is so caring and passionate. Grades are based on three papers. He reads draft before submission, and gives back very long and detailed feedback with your grade. You also can choose the topics of your papers, and the guidelines are so helpful for improving your writing. Lectures were interesting. Take him!

Professor McGuinn is so beyond professional. Will help you improve your writing a lot. Doing 3 papers is annoying ngl but if you organize your time properly you shouldn't have a problem. Also, he lets you send your paper beforehand and he legit gives you so many corrections, so no excuse for getting a bad grade. You can skip a class here and there
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor McGuinn is the best professor I've had at UM. He is incredibly knowledgeable on international studies, particularly on the Middle East . Many professors do not empathize with the many stresses a college student may endure, but he truly understands and tries to work with students based on their situations. Be prepared to write!

One of the most knowledgeable professors I know. His lectures are a bit boring, but his essay assignments are really interesting. Having such free range made me learn so much about stuff I was actually interested in. He is so caring, and makes time for his students. I've learned a lot, especially without feeling terribly stressed about his class.

McGuinn is the man. Incredibly intelligent and caring, and he obviously knows what he's talking about. The papers are easy if you devote enough time to them and he provides in-depth, genuinely helpful feedback. He is extremely understanding of how hard school can be on students and is more than accomodating. My favorite professor at UM by far.

He's incredibly understanding. I've turned in a few assignments late and he was lenient with me. He graded my work based on its quality, basically. I got a B+, but if I was on time with some of my work, I would've gotten an A. The lectures were informative and the structure of the class was amazing.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This was my third class I've taken with Dr. McGuinn! He is so knowledgable and his lectures are very interesting. Although there aren't many grades, he is always willing to read drafts of your essay, and his feedback helps a lot! His exams aren't difficult in the slightest as long as you've gone to class and paid attention.

In 4 years he's honestly one of the best professors I've had at UM. Bradford is very caring and wants you to do well. Meeting with him before the papers and submitting a draft, then using his comments basically guarantees you an A. It's 2 papers and 1 final. Course material is interesting and he wants to keep you engaged. Highly recommend him

Took him for POL203 and now taking his 392 int. terrorism course. Dr. McGuinn is definitely the best of the best, and listening to his lectures is like listening to someone tell a fantastic story. He's a very fair grader and gives great input/feedback. If you get the chance to have him as a professor, definitely don't pass up the opportunity.

Very caring guy. Was going through a lot this semester and he is very considerate. His lectures helped me develop a new refined way of thinking in Foreign Policy. Yes lectures can be difficult it's US Relations with Middle East. It's a topic most do not understand or master completely in one semester. But you will write better, clear instructions.

Don't take his Middle Eastern politics class. Lectures are confusing, severely boring and useless towards your grade bc the majority of it is based on two unrelated 10-page papers. It's been 3 months since we turned in the first paper; he STILL hasn't graded it so it is April now and no one knows their grade. Ridiculous. He takes attendance.

McGuinn is the man. This is the second class Ive taken with him, and I would take another in the future. Super caring and accessible 24/7. The papers were a lot of work but hes a good grader & gives specific and helpful feedback. His lectures can get severely boring, but hes a great guy and very intelligent.

Graded by a paper, mid-term, and final. Incredibly knowledgeable professor. He talks and chooses his words eloquently, which make him fascinating to listen to but hard sometimes to get his message for notetaking. Lectures tend to be on the tiring side, but in part that's because of the thought it takes to listen to him than material.
I would take professor McGuinn over any other professor. Very knowledgable about his field of teaching and interesting person!! WOW amazing

Such a great professor! Only a midterm, final, and a paper. His tests are easy as long as you do the readings and sudy from the book. He gives feedback for the paper as long as you ask. Attendance is a sign-in sheet but its not given every class. If you actually do the work, you can get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Really caring teacher, you have to write an 8-10 page paper for this class, but he lets you send drafts to him beforehand and gives really clear feedback. His tests are easy as long as you do the readings from the book (which I consider very necessary for this course). Attendance is 10% of the grade but honestly, it's just a sign-in sheet.

reviews.comment: class consists of two approx 9 page essays and a final. he asks for you to send the essay as you write it, and he gives feedback. he wants you to get an A. he rarely takes attendance but if you go and take notes, then you are basically guaranteed a good grade. he is very knowledgeable and caring. i keep taking his classes

I've done a year-long study abroad program for Political Science at the London School of Economics which has some the most highly accredited professors in the world. However, none of them come close to UM's Professor Mcguinn. He is the most eloquent, well spoken professor I've ever taken. His language pulls you into the subject. Highly recommended!

his lectures are fairly boring, but if you listen, you will learn a lot. very smart and has a lot of experience. 2 essays and a final, so not that much work. he is willing to work with you on all of the essays and is very responsive to emails/questions. great intro course

Professor McGuinn is probably the most intelligent professor I've ever come across and still manages to be extremely helpful, kind, and approachable. His classes are generally graded by two papers and a final and he's genuinely willing to help on any questions you have. His papers require work and effort but he's a fair grader. Would 100% recommend
I have taken 5 classes with McGuinn and will be doing senior thesis research under him. Very Knowledgeable and easy to talk to. You need to take notes!! Very clear expectations.
