reviews.comment: McGuinn might be one of the most crushed on professors at UM. He is very handsome and eloquent. Great professor, I learned a lot in both of the classes that I took with him and I also learned a lot on my own while writing the papers for his classes. Check out his twitter fanpage, it'll definitely make you laugh if you've taken a class with him

McGuinn is a god. If you can write a couple papers decently well, then it will be easy for you. He barely takes attendance, but I went to class just to hear his eloquent voice talk. For the final, if you just take notes on the political ideologists that he praises, then you will be fine. So magical.

Incredibly smart and best spoken professor at UM. Be sure to show up for his classes. Random attendance days. Lectures are long but interesting. 2 long essays and a cumulative final but not too bad. Very knowledgable about current events. Helpful in office hours and always responds to emails. Will help with essays as well.

McGuinn is the only professor I've had at UM who truly cares about his students.  He always responds to emails (if he doesnt send it again and he will reply).  Very knowledgeable on his subject especially the Middle East.  Pretty easy class a lot of notes though. By far the best professor Ive had at UM and a refreshing change from the usual UM prof

Dr. McGuinn is an amazing professor. He is the most elegant speaker, and gives brilliant commentary in response to students' work and input. He is highly respected by students, and while he has high expectations, they are not overwhelming. Definitely recommend McGuinn. He is always willing to help, and his lectures are interesting and informative.
Great Professor. I had almost lost hope in the University of Miami's Arts and Sciences before I took McGuinn. Really changed my worldview, and I was only in an introductory class!

You really learn a lot in his courses. I have taken two of McGuinn's classes and would take more. The only issue is that if you're taking a course of his with no text book, you really have to stay on top of yourself when it comes to the readings and note takings because he doesn't provide a study guide for exams.

Good teacher and generally liked by his students. I personally found his lectures to be a little dry and somewhat tedious so I stopped showing up to class until our papers were due. If you email himshow up to his office hours, he's ready to help and he's actually pretty cool to talk to.
Amazing teacher, very inspirational.
Most eloquent speaker on campus. Lenient grader, always there to help you with any problems you have. Greatest teacher I've ever had.

Dr. McGuinn is an exceptionally smart man and extremely dedicated to making sure you grasp everything he talks about. His feedback on paper drafts is absolutely magnificent and he's probably one of the best professors I've ever had.

Dr. McGuinn is very knowledgeable about all thing Middle Eastern. He listens carefully to students' opinions and doesn't shoot them down. He adds them into the conversation. He is also incredibly helpful with papers and questions. I emailed 4 drafts of my paper and he had great input every time. Do not hesitate to take his classes. Great experience

Most amazing professor at UM. So knowledgeable on every topic, but particularly enthusiastic about those concerning the Middle East. I've taken 4 courses with him and all were invaluable experiences. He also cares about his students, which seems to be rare among professors. Take him or you're making a huge mistake!

McGuinn is a charismatic speaker and deeply knowledgeable about the field, and he does a good job responding to questions and emails. This class has two big papers, along with a finals assignment based on the readings (of which there are a lot) from throughout the semester.  Recommended, especially if you're really into the subject.

Extremely engaging, interested in your success, and perhaps most importantly, able to keep your attention every class! Seriously though, highly recommended if you are interested in Middle Eastern Politics.

Amazing prof and even better looking. He is thorough, extremely helpful in and out of class, and will generally keep your interest the whole semester. Highly recommend him to anyone interested in Middle Eastern politics.

He is a very charismatic professor and extremely passionate about International Relations. His lectures can be tedious but if you do the readings, you will be golden. (tip: know the articles and examples for each topic for the test to get an A) Overall, a good professor if you like lecture halls and are committed to reading.
Best professor in the entire UM. I enjoyed every moment of his class.

Professor McGuinn is the best Political science teacher that I have taken thus far. The lectures were a little boring, but professor Mcguinn is very knowledgeable about whatever subject that he teaches. Don't worry if you need clarity on anything he's very helpful and approachable!!!! Take him if you can!!!!!
Best EVER!,

He is the best professor in all departments, in all schools, ever. Period. Helps you with EVERYTHING you need, always reachable through e-mail, office hours, etc. If you need help with an essay, talk to him and he will guide you, recommend you readings, etc. Class is very interesting, knows the subject like the back of his hand. TAKE THIS CLASS.

McGuinn is the most influential professor I've ever encountered. I have taken 3 courses with him and I am registered for a 4th. Incredibly elegant speaker with a ridiculously vast vocabulary. Infinite knowledge on the Middle East. Extremely approachable. Exhibits great concern for students. So much more can be learned from him beyond the syllabus.

the man should run for president. he speaks so eloquently, captures you. really nice and understanding professor. i didn't buy the book and got an A. make sure you have a LOT of works cited on your essay. grade is made up of two 8pg papers and a final written exam. easy professor and entertaining, definitely take him
McGuinn is the man.

Guy is an absolute class act. Truly embodies what it means to be a "professor" in the college atmosphere. Always extremely prepared and upfront about the point of the class. Easy A and probably the best professor you'll take while you're at UM. I would highly recommend him to anyone.
the best professor in the entire world! seriously. How can there be such a nice professor?? I will never forget him :)
No Professor nicer or more interesting then Professor McGuinn, everyone of his classes are really interesting and an easy A.
Professor McGuinn was always available for my questions and always motivated me with encouragement. Thanks for a smooth, productive semester!

EXCELLENT!!! Teacher knows everything about everything about everything about politics, and what seems to be going on currently in the world. Only does two essays and a test at the end. I recommend him to anyone and everyone. Extremely helpful with essays. Class not mandatory. Classes can get kind of long. But it is worth it in the end.

McGuinn is incredible. His lectures are engaging and very informative. But beyond that, he genuinely cares about each of his students. He will remember your dreams for after college and set you up with people who can help get you where you want to be. The ideal professor. More teachers should be like him.

McGuinn is amazing. i will only take polisci with him now.  you don't need to buy the book, barely need to go to class, 2 term papers and a final.  i got A's on both papers.  He's so friendly and smart and yes he is definitely a super hero.
Chiseled, regal features; presidential hair; witty and erudite; helpful and magnanimous; a gentleman and a scholar.

Professor McGuinn is definately one of the best professors I have ever had in my life! He is one of the few who strives to be close to his students, listen to them and comprehend. This is a challenging class. It requires a paper (about 30 pages). But still it is worth it. He helps a lot with writing the paper!!!

Brad is the best!!!! THE GREATEST PROFESSOR YOU WILL EVER HAVE!!! :) he's a total savage when it comes to his lectures. He makes his lectures like stories and that's what makes everything he says so interesting. -balto

Dr. McGuinn is an incredible lecturer and is engaging and insightful. He was always readily available during office hours and very helpful in matters inside and outside of class. He cares about his students very much and wants them to get the most out of his course and their undergraduate experience. Highly recommended!
By far the best professor at UM!  He is supportive, helpful, and knows the area very well!

Brad used to be my step dad. He is dedicated and he is such a FANTASTIC person. I LOVE HIM! He knows so much about everything!!! I would recommend him to anyone with my eyes closed. Not only is he understanding, but he is very helpful in all aspects. Take his class. He is so funny! SAVAGE!
HE IS THE MAN!! Most interesting professor I've ever had at UM.  Great topic... seems to know everything about South Asia, and he is great at pulling in current events.   HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!

McGuinn is by far the most interesting professor I've ever had.  His lectures are very enjoyable, almost like an informative show.  There is also very little stress in the class, which I appreciate.  You can just focus on showing up and learning.  He could organize some lessons better, but overall, he's amazing.

The very best teacher I've had in UM thus far! He's an expert in the Middle East and a very helpful professor! I defenitely recommend you take any of his classes, you'll learn far more than you can ever imagine :)

Great professor, very articulate and charming. It seems like he knows everything there is to know on Israel and the Middle East. His lectures have interesting material but can get boring after an hour or so. Not only do I think he works for the USA, i think he's secretly Batman. He is Bruce Wayne with salt and pepper hair. Hes also SUPER HOT

He is one of the best professors I have ever had. He is extremely knowledgeable on Middle Eastern affairs and makes the class very interesting. He had us do a report on a topic of our choosing and this really helped me understand the subject matter. He is understanding and easy to contact via email. I would like to take him again in the future.

Prof McGuinn is the BEST professor at UM! You genuinely learn in every class. He's not only very intelligent, but also a great guy. He cares about his students and does he's best to make sure you get a good grade. Take his class if you can get in!

Take him if you already have a background knowlege of his class...i didnt and had to learn extra since he lectures assuming we know the history of the place. other than that hes a great guy and i also suspect he works for the CIA. lol

Professor McGuinn is incredible. He is definitely someone who has been there, done that, and he knows everything...I swear he works for the CIA or something. His lectures focus a lot on current events, so if that's your thing, this is the class for you. His lecture can been a bit unstructured, but his study guides help. He's an easy grader.

He is a very intelligent professor who designs his class for advanced poli sci students. I , myself, was a beginner and found the class to be very difficult. He has no structure to his course and he's hard to follow. However, the plus side is that he is a really easy grader.

My favorite professor in UM. I know everyone has said this, but it is the truth. he is so nice to his students, genuinely wants them to suceed, i just feel so inspired everytime i listen to his lectures. He is extremely eloquent and so intelligent (and handsome).  All his classes are 1 term paper, and 2 tests. TAKE HIM!

I absolutely adore this man. He really doesn't teach to the book, rather he gives you a current perspective to what's going on in the world today relative to the subjects of the book. Can be a little strange to get used to, but then you'll realize how practical it is. I would recommend him to anyone, and I want to marry the man!

One of my favorite teachers. He's got a good sense of humor. A great presense. Extremely eloquent and unbelievably intelligent, sometimes a bit over my head, but a very generous grader. He keeps his presentations extremely up to date and he's very well-versed in current events all around the world.

Best professor I have had at UM! He is helpful with everything, and his lectures are interesting. His class is a midterm, a final and a paper, and if you go to class you will have no problem. I HIGHLY recommend his class!!
Absolutely amazing! He is one of the best professors I've ever had. Extremely intelligent, and always willing to help!

Best Professor I've had so far at UM. Format of class is  midterm, 1 paper, final. His lectures are super interesting and hes very sarcastic and funny. Great guy who really helps in his office hours. Highly recommended!
I have had this Prof. for 2 classes at the University of miami and I still maintain, he is the best out of all the poli-sci professors at UM.
The best professor I have had at the University of Miami to date..
funny guy who is mad nice and is always willing to help you.

Professor McGuinn is the best professor I have had since being at UM.  Not only is his class incredibly interesting, but he cares about each and every student and truly wants them to succeed.  Mind you, you should read, come to class, and work hard just to get the most you can from the class.  I learned so much and truly enjoyed the course!
good professor. very straight forward and intelligent. looks at all sides, unlike many of the other pol. sci professors. not bad to look at either.

Really great professor.  He's really easy to understand and no suprises in his tests at all.  He really wants to help the students and will make every effort to work around your schedule for office hours.  All his classes have a midterm, a final, and one paper - that's it.  He's pretty funny too and cracks a lot of jokes in class.
DO NOT TAKE THE CLASS

reviews.comment: Swanson is a good professor. Though I wish the class was more engaged. Also, he does a good job, but don't expect to see him much outside of class.
easiest class at um and his lectures are pretty interesting if you want to pay attention. if not its still an easy a

MCY121 is supposed to be a GPA booster. However the professor gives F's. I got one. This class has too much busy work. I have 400 level classes with fewer assignments. Attendance is mandatory, "quiz" every class. 4 or 5 easy exams, but why so many?  AND 4 reflections/essays that must be on time, no mercy. Late is heavily penalized, no exceptions.
Loved this class. Knows a lot about the origins of hip-hop. Highly recommend. Only drawback is that you must come to class. If you don't, you will fail.

Lectures are very slow and monotonous, leading students to hold back from participation. Majority of the grade depends on how much you talk in class, even if you do very well in the remainder of the areas (projects, reading, etc.). Also acts as he knows more about cultures covered in class than he really does, teaching wrong things during lectures.

reviews.comment: Very lazy and unenthusiastic.

Swanson is a nice guy, but my god does he make this class boring. Super dull lecture style with uninspiring course content. Either of the other MCY professors is the easily better option, in my opinion.
Swanson is extremely well-educated and interesting! Sometimes doesn't warn you about due dates so stay up to date on Blackboard
Great class and great professor. If you do the work required (which is not much) and show up to class, you will get an A+. It's that simple.
Simply a lazy man
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is so easy and everything is online. I had an A, until I didn't. Yes I only went to class once, but I was passing the tests and assignments easily. I was gaslit into thinking I passed until I didn't. Beware. Take this class, it's easy, but do not miss more than 6 classes, Brent Swanson will fail you, like he did me and half my class.

Swanson may be the laziest prof I have ever seen. He cancels class sometimes because he feels like it; however, if you miss 6 lectures, you fail the course. It's painfully easy, but be careful, he does not accept late or missing work, and it could hurt you.

Seems like a cool guy but goes through powerpoints very quickly and doesn't post them so good luck taking notes. Tests are online and on zoom (you have to keep your camera on) and assignments aren't too bad. He does spend more time talking about political/social issues rather than the musical techniques, so if you like that take this class.
such a great guy, 3 exams and a few assignments, quizzes for attendance at the end of class that he gives you the answers to. not really lenient with late or incorrect assignments. TAKE HIM!!!

TA grades all of your papers, didn't pay attention in class and still got an A+, he's a rly nice and funny professor. All tests are taken at home via zoom (so you can assume how ppl got good grades) participation quizzes at the end of every class, white guy teaching abt the history of hip hop so take that as you will.

I would have LOVED to know not to pick Mark Lammano's class. If you are reading this trying to sign up for a section of MCY140 if Melvin Butler's section is full take this one. It's the same course work, very easy very low maintenance. If Mark Lammano had a profile on here I would give him an awful rating. Spare yourself and take this one.
Chillest professor. Very easy to listen to and learn from.
Really great class! You have to take participation quizzes each class, but otherwise it's an easy A.

Took him for a cognate so it should be an easy A, it's music. But it felt like he makes the exams annoyingly hard. Test questions seemed to be conflicting information, where one question could really have 2 answers. Don't recommend unless you have time to grind a little, and like forced participation for an ONLINE Cognate class.

Swanson is chill but don't expect to talk to him directly unless it's after class, as his TA does most of the grading. His lectures are recorded in case you miss them and the participation quizzes stay up till the end of the class day. Those same questions are used directly for the test. Make sure to participate in breakout rooms.

reviews.comment: Get ready for the midterm. I liked this professor until he assigned this. 5 essays to write in 5 days. Absolutely ridiculous.

reviews.comment: Professor Swanson is a really chill professor and an easy grader.  The tests are very easy and always have extra credit.  He isn't a tough grader on essays and you learn some interesting stuff about hip-hop.

Swanson is a little problematic. It must be difficult for a white man to teach the history of Black American and Latin Music but he's just a little racially insensitive and obtuse. The readings literally don't matter, don't waste your time. Super easy, show up and do it. It's an easy credit and good material. He also never learned my name.

He is a very knowledgable professor and an all-around good guy, and I learned a lot about early hip-hop and genres I didn't know existed. The online format is convenient, but need more interaction from students. Sometimes he would put us into groups and no one would say anything. Otherwise, a great class!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great class. Wish he covered more recent stuff, but I had a good time in his class. Easy tests and quizzes. Papers too. Easy A and learned some cool stuff about hip-hop I didn't know.

Best class I've taken so far. He's the sweetest and funniest professor, and he clearly knows a lot about music. If you're one of those annoying fans who think all rock music is supposed to sound like the beatles, this isn't the class for you. Don't get mad when he talks about gospel, disco, etc. because they did impact rock. Tests are a breeze..
Best class Ive taken at the U. Really down to earth and cares about students. I appreciated focusing on other bands than the Beatles like Alt rock of the 90s.
He's ok but talks way more about social issues than actual music.

reviews.comment: Great professor! Caring and down to earth. The assigned readings and listening are gone over in lecture so if you miss something he will fill you in. The projects are very self interpretive, lots of creative freedom. 100% would recommend.
Really great. Fun teacher!
he is not good. he forgets to post the quizzes and he is just terrible at teaching none of his students care either.
He tries to be engaging, but it's just boring most of the time. Sometimes unorganized and most of the time just leaves the students wondering what he even covered in the lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: ok so Swanson is not a bad teacher, he's a really fair teacher. I signed up for a history of rock class. we learned about so much music that had nothing to do with rock It made me sick, and It made me not want t

Great professor for an intro level course. Clearly works hard to develop a good course curriculum and give an in depth analysis of music. Often discusses topics that are not easy to talk about with a large group of people but are vital in developing a mature and intelligent survey of music history.

One of my favorite classes I have ever taken. The quizzes are super easy and there are only two real homework assignments in the semester. The three listening exams are the only thing that you need to study for and require you to actually pay attention in class The final is also easy with the multiple choice questions are straight from the quizzes.

reviews.comment: Cool class. Wish we had covered more of the bands in detail, but I learned a lot I didnt expect. TopHat points are helpful. Coursework was average and the tests are straightforward. Hes a very engaging professor.

reviews.comment: condescending, know-it-all, often speaks down to students.

He's very knowledgable and facilitates conversations very well. Be sure to participate, it will help him know you have been reading. Also, try to read the content. If it's too long of an article, you can usually get away with skimming, but if it's less than 4 pages, read all of it.

Tests are based on songs which is awesome. Only hard part was a 2500 word concert review but everyone does it and survives. Anyone who likes music should take this. He is somewhat funny also and you get to use laptops entire class.

Great Class. Evolution of Rock is a fun course to take. Grading on the concert review is random and not taken seriously. The professor does not seem to care much for the students, not easily accessible, and seems too busy to deal with the students in the class.

I really enjoyed evolution of rock with him, I learned a lot about the music industry and listened to a low of new music. You absolutely need to go to class, if you don't you won't do well. I personally didn't use the textbook.
Awesome class. Must take!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Really great class. Prof. Swanson was really understanding when I struggled in the class early on. He told me what I needed to do to get an A, and I did. TopHat saved my grade!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Cool class. Took it as a cognate. Definitely worth taking.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor and material was great. It's a fairly straightforward class if you do the work. Not an easy A  because you have to work, but it's not a difficult course. I learned a lot about the music industry and cool stuff about music I never thought of. Downside is that it's in a lecture hall and many of the students could care less about the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This class is easy but there is a 2500 word concert review mandatory at the end of the semester.  Having to write that much about a concert sucks.  The class is easy and you get bonus points for answering questions through TopHat online but he also take attendance using an online attendance code at the beginning of class.

Really liked this class, but wish it wasn't in a large classroom. Professor does his best to keep students engaged, but most of them seem to not care. Otherwise, Dr. Swanson presents the material in an entertaining fashion and I learned a lot about the social aspects of rock as much as I did about the music. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Brent Swanson is really one of the worst teachers I've ever had. Maybe this is because of my class being a large lecture hall, but he is really mean. He will pick you out of the entire class if youre talking and make you leave. He is not accesible either. I have emailed him three times this week for help on a paper and he doesnt answer.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Great teacher. Make sure you do the reading and come to class. TopHat points pay off!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This was one of the easiest A's that I've gotten at the U. That said, it is VERY VERY important that you always go to class and answer the tophat questions. If you get 60% right it's worth 7.5% of your final grade as extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Amazing professor. Very stimulating and I learned so much about racism and sexism in the music industry. But this is definitely not an easy A. You can't blow off this class at all. I noticed a lot of students were struggling and freaking out, but it's because they blew it off. So if you are going to take the class, make sure you prepare to work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Cool class. Lot's of material, but worth taking. Likes to discuss issues of race and gender, so it was different than I expected. Make sure you study and show up to class. It's not an easy A, but I got an A by showing up and answering Top Hat questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Such a great professor. Really changed how I understand rock music. Filled with lots of cool anecdotes as well. Top Hat extra credit points really helped me (gave me 5 points on my overall grade)  Lectures are more important than the reading for the exams, but need the reading for the quizzes. Definitely recommend if you don't mind doing some work.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: You need to read the chapters before every class to be able to answer the questions right on TopHat (counts for a grade). He's knowledgeable, but it doesn't translate for non-majors who are just taking the class to complete a cognate (not an easy grade booster). Long, detailed tests and a concert review. (Dropped because it was not worth it).
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Swanson is absolutely my favorite professor at the U! Adore him! He often will warm up the class with insight on current events, funny stories and even asking us about our own lives before beginning his lectures. Which are phenomenal. He doesn't use powerpoint, all aural, which I personally enjoy. Attendance is pretty necessary, readings aren't.

Very cool class. I took it as a cognate and even though it was more work than I expected, I learned a lot. Two papers, two exams, and some online quizzes. You have to come to class, but you get a bunch of extra-credit for answering questions in class. Definitely worth taking.

I loved this class. I took this class as a cognate and it was really easy. Only two papers, two tests, and some online quizzes. You have to study the listening excerpts quite a bit or you won't pass the tests. Aside from that, the class required relatively minimal work. If you go to class most of the time, your extra credit will save your grade.
Cool class. Can be time consuming, but worth taking for sure. Studying is a must!
Great class. Professor was engaging. I had to work, but the extra-credit iclicker points gave me an easy A.

Great professor and makes the material interesting. It's a lot of Classical music, but I actually learned more about European and American art and philosophy through studying the music than I anticipated. It's a lot of information, but as long as you follow the study guide, the tests are fairly easy. But you can't just blow it off and cram.

Cool class. Liked the more contemporary music, but the professor made it interesting. Really engaging prof. Just make sure you study because it catches up with you. It's about the same amount of work as any other class, but the music terminology was foreign to me, so it seemed a bit more difficult.

Dr. Swanson is a cool and engaging professor (and funny too). He really changed the way I listen to music (in a good and bad way because now I analyze music more than I ever did). The workload isn't that bad, but you won't do well if you don't study and go to class. He gives a study guide which is also helpful.

Do not take this class with him. For a 100 level course, it is a ridiculous amount of work and memorization. This class is more geared for music minors than if you are just taking it as a gen ed or cognate. He expects way too much out of the students. Definitely not an easy class for a GPA booster.

Professor was very funny, but also very informative. Tests were a little hard if you don't study, but he gives a study guide.  A lot of students don't show up for class so he gives out information that isn't on the power points, which makes class attendance kind of mandatory even though he doesn't take it.
Great teacher!  Funny at times.  Class was relatively easy if you followed instructions.
Really cool, charming, interesting dude. Class could be kinda dull sometimes but it was the material, not him. He did his best.

Can be very very funny in class. Likes to have discussion about socio-political background of music. I guess this will interest certain people but not all. Spends a lot of class time on discussion. Fairly competent.
Great class!

Dr. Butler is amazing. Every lecture was engaging and his passion for what he does is infectious. The final project, though long, was enjoyable and rewarding, and never felt tedious. The weekly youtube shorts are fun, but easy to forget about, so stay on top of them. Overall, awesome professor.

Really funny and kind guy. Get the required Perusals and YT shorts done early so you don't lost track of them. I honestly didn't pay a lot of attention in class and was fine. Mini projects weren't my favorite but put in even the slightest bit of effort and you'll be fine. Choose a final project topic you're interested in because it's lots of work!

His light-hearted personality really helped me at a time where things were rough. His classwork was confusing to me as the guidelines were slightly vague, but he's willing to communicate and reach out to you. Honestly, a great man to strive to be.

Dr. Butler makes a required Gen Ed Music course amazing! He brought in guest speakers and kept convos relevant to current music + media. He genuinely cares what the class has to say and is super funny + caring. Super charismatic person. Grading is clear and the work is light. A 45-second video ten times and a few mini projects. Easy and enjoyable.

he's fine and the topics are cool but the class gets really monotonous really fast. i eventually skipped the readings/videos because they were completely unnecessary and not graded. if your video discussion is good you'll get a good grade. depending on your opinion the mini-projects are unique or annoying, but i found them pretty interesting.

Get ready to learn a lot in a little time.  I learned more finance in this class than in several finance classes together taken at the School of Management.  Dr. Buitrago is knowledgeable, approachable, and he delivers his lectures perfectly.  It's a lot of material, but it all makes sense once he explains it.  Best course I have taken at UM.

Prof. Buitrago is the best! I learned in this course more than in my entire Bachelor's at IE.  His lectures are crystal clear, he makes sure you understand. He demands a lot from you, but he explains what he wants and gives you examples before he assigns exercises or homework.  Best professor I have ever had in my life. I will take all his classes.

Dr. Buitrago is the best professor at UM.  I have taken courses in different schools and departments and he is the best I ever had.  His explanations are clear, he masters the material, has a lot of experience.  He is a great mentor and an inspiration to become an engineer.  Dr. Buitrago is accessible and caring.  I will take all his classes.
Amazing professor, a lot of in class work

I am not an engineering major and I took this course at the advice of others in my major who took it with the same professor.  Prof. Buitrago is the best, I was able to learn and understand advanced engineering concepts with ease. He makes the topics look easy, he is a great educator. I wish I had discovered him before,I would take all his classes.

Doctor Buitrago is an amazing lecturer. His classes are full of actual cases and examples, he is very good at synthesizing the most important topics.  His slides are the best textbook, they highlight the important points.  He is the best professor I have had.  He is approachable and respected by everyone. He is never boring, very interesting always

Doctor Buitrago's class is the most useful class I have taken at UM. He gives great lectures and practical exercises. The workload is constant throughout the semester, but all of it necessary.  He is very punctual and demands the same, very demanding in the course load, but I enjoyed it tremendously. He is the best professor at UM.

Professor Buitrago is a beacon of inspiration and intelligence, igniting curiosity in every student fortunate enough to learn from him. His wisdom and passion are an invaluable gift to academia. I learned more from him than all my other professors at UM combined.  He is the best at UM and beyond.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Buitrago is an exceptional educator who has left an indelible mark on countless students. His passion for engineering, engaging teaching style, and support for student success have inspired all his students. His dedication to fostering critical thinking and intellectual growth is truly remarkable. Professor Buitrago is a true asset to UM

I loved the course with Dr. Buitrago. He has a lot of experience and he completely knows the material.  He explains every detail very well, gives handouts that help us do in class exercises.  He teaches at a professional level and transmits all his knowledge in his lectures.  Great slides, handouts, homework, and group projects as well. Awesome!

I am a senior and have taken all the ISE classes. Prof. Buitrago's classes are the best I have taken. He inspired me to study harder and become an Industrial Engineer.  He knows about everything, technical, financial, management.  His mix is very important in the classes he teaches.  I would like to study a master's degree and take all his classes.

Professor Buitrago is the best instructor at UM, that's it.  I wish all my classes were taught by him.  He is demanding but he explains everything so well that you have no trouble doing any work.  He gives great professional advice, and he inspires his students.  After taking his classes I know why I want to be an engineer.  Best, best, best.

Best class ever! Professor Buitrago is very knowledgeable and experienced.  He explains every method thoroughly and makes sure everyone understands before proceeding.  His lectures are fantastic, no one misses any.  I would take any class he teaches, best professor at UM without question.  His grading is fair, lots of homework and in class work

Without question, the best professor at UM.  He is interesting, his lectures are thorough and full of real world examples.  He is very knowledgeable and speaks clearly. Expectations are clear and group work is encouraged.  I will take any course that he teaches.  Doctor Buitrago is the most respected professor in the College of Engineering.

Dr. Buitrago is the best professor I had at the College of Engineering in four years.He is well respected and has a great reputation as an intelligent and knowledgeable professional.He teaches using MIT, Harvard and Stanford material.Everyone loves him, and his lectures show you why you studied engineering in the first place.He is very handsome.

Professor Buitrago is the best professor at UM.  He is very knowledgeable and respected.  When he speaks you hear someone with great intellect and experience.  His lectures are motivating and thorough.  Great slides, he knows so much math.  He makes difficult concepts understandable.  He is very practical and doesn't care so much for grades.

Dr. Buitrago is the best professor I had at University of Miami.  He is very experienced and his lectures are fantastic.  He is very knowledgeable, and his courses are different and more complete than any other.  The course material is excellent, I keep all my handouts, slides, homework, etc.  I wish I had him for many more courses during my time.

Doctor Buitrago is the best professor at University of Miami.  I have taken many courses at UM and his is the best.  After I took his class, I enrolled for all his classes the next semester.  Follow my advice: pick the professor, not the course.  He gives great lectures, practical and clear.  He is caring and approachable. Great professor!!

Doctor Buitrago is a sensational lecturer.  His classes are interesting and full of important facts and examples.  He prepares his classes well, and his slides are complete, available, and great reference to keep.  Hi shows great respect for his students.  He is demanding, but fair.  I will take all the classes that he teaches.

Professor Buitrago is a great teacher. His lectures are inspirational, he is very knowledgeable and has lots of experience in the industry. His lectures are loved by his students, we stay glued until the end of the class.Great PowerPoints. Grades are fair and clear. He is the best professor in the College of Engineering.

Best professor and course in IEN at University of Miami. He teaches real work cases and how to solve them. Every class there are two cases, one graded, and one homework. He is very knowledgeable of the material and is a pleasure to attend his lectures.

He legit never showed up to class, or if he did it would be like 30 minutes later. He does NOT teach at all if you are in the class to learn. But easy grade cause he never shows up so neither do you have to.

Prof wasn't always organized and would be late to class sometimes. Pretty simple class. mostly theater exercises then we have to perform one monologue and one scene. Doesn't reply to emails and he often doesn't show up to the meetings he sets up w/ students to work on material after class.

Acting classes are very participation based and are pretty fun.  Although you can tell this professor has a lot of knowledge in the field, he is extremely disorganized and sometimes will not show up to class without saying anything.  The acting exercises are enjoyable, but classes often consist of him talking about himself for a long time too.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Bush is the best professor ever! He is so passionate about his job and being a theater director. He is very inspirational, if you are thinking of taking his course, DO IT and thank me later!
Professor Bush is super funny, respected, and loves what he does. His class is super interesting and if you love theater you should join!!

I love him and his class, its so chill. no papers/quizzes/tests. you just go in and learn about acting and preform a scene every once in a while. theres a short 3 sentence reflection you write at the end of every class but thats about it. one thing is, he doesnt put in grades into the end but as long as you participate you get an A.
unstructured class

Burt is not a bad guy and curves heavily, but this class was not a good experience. Lectures were complete nonsense and unhelpful, zero lesson planning, no availability for help from TAs (no in-person hours) or the professor, and lectures had nothing to do with the homework which had nothing to do with the exams. Zero transparency for the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very difficult to follow in lecture. Illegible handwriting and what is written on the board is not worth putting in your notes anyways (it is scribbles). Two exams that each have 4 questions make up 60% of your grade and a majority of students fail. He curves but you don't see the curve or really know your grade at all until final grades come out.

Do not take Burt. Lectures are unorganized and difficult to follow. I have never met a less accessible professor outside of class, as he literally sprints out at the end of every lecture. Homework is doable but exams are extremely difficult. Our midterm average was a 47 and extremely unclear on the content that will be on the final.

He's a nice person, but not very good professor. Would definitely recommend watching YouTube channels such as Neso Academy if you decide to take him. The average on the midterm was less than a 40, so be prepared.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's the guy you wanna have philosophical and abstract discussions, not do a lecture. His teaching style is abstract and doesn't go much into examples and problem solving. Lectures nothing to do with weekly HW which were tough. A reasonable midterm and replaced final exam for a project which was a blessing. Big curve. DON'T TAKE UNLESS YOU HAVE TO!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Burt is a great guy and his lectures are fantastic if you're willing to pay attention. Projects are challenging but relevant and rewarding. Tough grader but always gives a huge curve at the end of the semester.

Avoid Burt at all costs. Class lectures have nothing to do with the hw, and the hws have nothing to do with the midterm/final. Even though he curves nicely, you're anxious all semester with worries that you're going to fail the course. Never available 4office hours. You have to teach yourself everything. Projs are extremely difficult. Hardest class
No exams. Only projects, which are fun and challenging. If you want to profit as much as possible, read the recommended book before class.
No exams. Only projects, which are fun and challenging.
Never update the recordings on time. Never explain the homework assignment or mention the codes. But gives very difficult homework questions which has nothing to do with the lectures. Awfull!

Professor Rosenburg is a pretty bad teacher. He doesn't answer emails or office hours. His projects are ridiculously hard. He uses abstract examples during class, which have nothing to do with the projects. Never gives any indication of tests, and I don't think he even understands his own projects. Do not take unless absolutely mandatory.

I took Computer Networks with him. It is definitely a hard class, but I learnt a lot. He's a tough grader, and a bit rigid. He gives out hard projects, but is nice about it, and is willing to move the deadline further for us to complete them. Overall, enjoyed studying with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Tough grader

reviews.comment: A professor who truly doesn't care about response from students. He never gives examples and prefers to work in the abstract which makes his classes particularly difficult. Any proof he may perform is usually outside the scope of the class and feels like more of an exercise to see if he remembers how to do the problem rather than to teach us.

I agree this was one of the hardest classes I took for ME. Great person, who shows passion while teaching, but exams are brutal and it will make this class your priority for the semester. He only grades by exams, and expects you to know the material very well. Be sure to be at lectures and take board pictures, material on exam comes from board.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Only grades were exam grades, but exams were based on what was covered in lecture. He is excited by chemistry and it shows in the lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is easily the hardest course I've taken during my mechanical engineering track. Exams will be 100% of your grade and they're extremely difficult; however, they were heavily curved. Do all homework assignments (which aren't graded), use organic chem tutor on YT, and do the past exams he gives to have pass this class. Good luck, it wont be easy.

Will never respond to an email. Unprofessional and moves extremely fast through material, better off taking pictures rather than taking actual notes. Extremely test heavy as you only have 3 exams plus the final. Average of the first exam was a 45%.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor is good and knows his stuff. Unfortunately you must study a lot in his class. Tests are extremely hard. In a class of 85 or more students only 2 got A's on the first exam. He always have to curve because the test scores are so low. Studying 4 hours a day at least is a must if you want to pass his class.

Dr. Captain is the best professor I have ever had. He is such a wonderful teacher and you can tell he cares deeply about his students. That being said, he makes you work HARD for you grade. His tests are quite difficult, but he will spend HOURS outside of class working with you until you understand the material. Wish I could take his class again.

Had him bc of PRISM. He's caring and respectable, treats his students like adults, but honestly, I feel like he's too smart to be teaching this level class. He teaches like you've learned that whole topic right before. Tests are super rough, he does curve but it aint enough. Loves what he does and wants you to come to office hours. The book sucks.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I got an A but this was the hardest class I have ever taken in my life. His brutality knows no bounds, but that's okay, because Burjor is THE Man. Transcending the human race into the epitome of perfection that is Burjor Captain, this man, no sorry, god, will teach you the meaning of true savagery. Prepare yourself for him and make sure to study!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Great teacher, but very difficult class. Final grade is 3 tests, final, hw and a presentation. Need to study a lot, would reccomend if your good with numbers.  Curves the class so an 80% is an A, but only about 1/3rd of the glass gets it.  NEVER attempt any extra credit he gives, seeing as he makes it impossible.

I had a very poor Chem 111 teacher, so I was really worried when I heard that Captain was difficult. While the class is more difficult, he is such an incredible teacher. He gives you all the keys to do well. I read the book, went to class and did his homework assignments multiple times (they're optional) and got an A in the class. Highly recommend.
His tests were EXTREMELY hard. You need to study a lot for them, but he has a lot of short response questions, so you'll get partial credit.

I was in his honors CHM 111 class.  While it's a very difficult class with an expected prior knowledge of chemistry (AP chem completed, I'd say), he is very helpful and wants students to take advantage of his office hours as much as possible.  The homeworks are long but only once a week max.  Only two tests and one final.

Great teacher. Really understandable and clear. Class demands lots of practice and studying. Read book, go to class, do all homework's again and again. Study some ahead of time, and you'll be fine. Some Homework questions are like test questions. Do not be lazy. I liked him a lot; but studied a lot to get an A... Really made me enjoy chem though

Although he does a pretty decent job of teaching, the tests are just ridiculous.  He gives a plethora of practice problems, then leaves you out in the cold during the exams...its not like there is an alternative here
Unless you've taken AP or IB chem, it's extremely difficult to do well in the class.

Captain is the best professor i've had, his lectures are clear, examples are fully demonstrated, and he is very enthusiastic. HIGHLY RECOMMEND! The tests are pretty tough, but are very similar to the homework.
It's not that hard, until you get to the final. He said he would repeat test questions from previous exams, but I didn't see any. Do your homework because homework questions always show up on tests.

Prof. Byrnes is a funny and enjoyable professor. The class moved slowly at the beginning for me, but if you pay attention to grammatical principles when completing assignments you'll be just fine. Tests are straightforward, just study what he tells you. A little PR heavy at times — guest speakers didn't feel entirely relevant to the class.

Prof. Byrnes is super nice and friendly but is a strict grader. Be sure to follow directions or else you will struggle. The tests are very easy and he is not out to trick you. 

JMM108 is a writing course, but as a PR pro, Byrnes talks quite a bit about PR. 

He brought in 3 marketing pro guest speakers who were not exactly my cup of tea.

Professor Byrnes is the BEST professor I have ever taken here. He has real experience and connections to the world of communications outside the university. He also frequently brought in awesome guest speakers who worked with Apple, PR firms, and non-profits. I learned so much in this class and thoroughly enjoyed it. I 100% recommend.

Professor Brynes is the best Communications professor I have taken here at the University of Miami. He has real connections to the world of communications and brings in AMAZING guest speakers. He is also an experienced journalist and owns his own PR firm. There is one big project due at the end of the semester and he gives great feedback.

Professor Byrnes is a great teacher and super chill. The class is a bit work-heavy but not bad compared to other professors. The class consists of 1 or 2 weekly assignments(usually 1), a final project, and two exams. Professor Byrnes gives great feedback and is accessible out of class. Take him if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The nicest professor ever!! Totally recommend taking her for Survey of Motion Pictures, the classes are so so fun, and she is clearly passionate about film. Please participate tho! It makes the classes so much more interesting. Tests are super easy, and the other assignments are very chill. 10/10.

TAKE THIS CLASS! She's the best, one of my favorite professors. Her passion for film is clear and she's incredibly sweet and funny. If you're interested in film, she's great at giving you the info you need. If you just need an easy elective, this class is great for that too - no homework, attendance not mandatory, exams are open note.
Nicest Professor. Class is not mandatory but was so fun. You watch a movie and talk about it in class what's not to like.
Amazing class, amazing proffesor. One of the best in this school. She is very caring. You show up, do your work, you will get a good grade.

This was a very easy class especially if you go. I did not go much and you basically just learn film terms and talk about movies. The homework is to watch movies. Teacher is super chill and if you really want to participate and learn she is great at answering questions. If not, she is not going to call you out or anything.
Highly recommended!!
great professor and truly wants to help you but he is neat picky.

dr. cantos is honestly amazing, he really does care about his students and is so easy to talk to. he goes over things before the midterm and finals to ensure that everything is clear. willing to work with you also! kinda hard to access through email so just go see him irl tbh. the course is hard but if you study you'll be ok.
Great professor, great sense of humor, helps students A LOT, very flexible. I had to study hard but I also learned a lot. Super recommended!!!

I had a good experience in this class, the material was clear, quizzes and exams are not hard, he acts tough, but he helps students like no other, he spent an extra 45 mins breaking down the digestive system for 3 of us during office hours.
Dr. C is very knowledgeable and genuinely cares about your learning, highly recommended!
Great class, great lectures, professor Cantos answers questions after class and after lab. Highly recommended!

If there is another professor go with them. His course is very test heavy and you don't know which of the smallest details will be on the test. Not all test content is from lecture, so make sure you're actually reading the textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

Extremely unapproachable, not supportive learning environment. Material taught at level above reasonable for the course, no effort to explain concepts in an accessible way. I really enjoyed her class. Grading was very straight forward; If you did all of you work, on time, and attended class on a regular basis, you got an A. I feel like my writing skills genuinely improved as a result of taking her class.

reviews.comment: She knows what shes talking about, offers help on the essays which arent that hard, also lets you revise them and clearly shows what you should fix. She is the sweetest professor ever. She is sooooo wise and I genuinely learned so much about writing. You are able to write about really anything and she gives great feedback.
She seems nice and caring but then becomes passive aggressive as the semester goes on. i dont think my writing improved, i just learned to write how she likes to get it done.

reviews.comment: If you do your work and show up to class its not too bad. My biggest issue was how she incorporated political views into class and in 2 specific instances, in grading my work.

reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Melissa is amazing. She really love mental health and cares about students' mental well-being. She appreciates participation and effort. It's a very relaxed class work is easy and she ungrades

I loved this class! The topic of Love is really fun and engaging. I chose to take Burley both semesters this year which helped me learn a lot from her feedback. Make sure to be on time for class! All in all great Professor.

Absolutely love her, so sweet and cares about students. The class is a lot of work and you will have to revise your essays but if you do the assignments and show up to class it is almost impossible to not get an A. She wants everyone to succeed and is willing to help you do so. 100% recommend her, very understanding as well.

reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Show up to class. Cannot be late or absent more than 3 times, or else you wont get an A in the class. She gives many chances to revise your essay and she is always available to help and jump start your brain if you have writers block. She is very helpful, and she actually made learning fun!

One of the best professors I had this semester. Entire class is ungraded, and graded on completion and effort. In order to get an A, you must complete an extra 4 1-2 page papers (really easy trust). 3 papers throughout semester. 1 focused on discourse communities, 2 on art. She brings cookies to class sometimes!

As long as you put in the effort (come to class, participate, and write your papers), you will be fine. have to do 3 extra papers to get an A, but papers aren't that difficult. She gives you rewrites, but she does try to bring her political ideas into class. She is not the worst but not the best. If you have a better option, don't take her.

If you have the choice, don't take her. She gives so much homework its uanessacry. She also toys to push her political values on her and it's so annoying. Just dropped her class. I understand having expectations but I don't pay to go here for a professor to be vindictive.

This class was fairly easy. Melissa teaches everyone how to be a better writer and offers unlimited attempts to revise your paper to get credit. I didn't love how she tried to bring her own political and personal views to the class, but other than that I really enjoyed the class.

Melissa was a really great professor making me a better writer by far. She gives unlimited attempts for rewrites for papers, and grades the paper on credit or no credit, no letter grades are given. Everyone has to do revisions even if you get credit. And she's very specific on papers and assignments so just make sure you listen to the directions.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Great Professor! Even though she does try to bring her political views in the class, she does truly try to bring the best writing in students. She's very understanding of any medical or emergency situations if you turn in work late.
Definitely take her, she cares about your mental health. She is very understanding if you tell her before hand. Attendance is mandatory but her class is never boring.

She taught me so much about my writing and how to write so much better. She's the best writing professor at the U. She loves when people participate in her class and give their opinion on the topics. She cares a lot about her students and want them to succeed in their writing.

Melissa is the best writing teacher I've ever had at UM! I took her in WRS 105 and I am taking her again for 106. Her grades are based on points and you can redo any assignment to get a better grade, so it is really easy to get an A in the class. The extra credit opportunities are really easy. We talk about fun topics and meditate. She's the best.

Professor Burley has an easy class but she always expresses her political concerns and is very "gender-inclusive". She did help my writing though. I just recommend taking another professor if you can because my friends told me that their English professors were very nice and their classes were easy. It isn't bad but I wouldn't take it again.

Meh. She's really passive aggressive especially to students she isn't fond of which made me scared of her. She lets you revise your papers which is nice though. Not the worst but definitely not the best.
You are guaranteed an A if you do the work. She is actually nice.

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE SHE IS SO RUDE! she is condescending and disrespectful towards students. She frequently looses her temper and yells. As a meditation teacher, they could have not picked a worse person.

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed her class; she is a little strict on certain things, such as being on time and always attending class; participation really matters. reviews.comment: I had Melissa Burley as a teacher and she truly was not the kindest. I wish I read these reviews and didn't take her course. She is rude, mean, and overall has a negative energy. Melissa is the worst possible English professor you could ever get. She has zero empathy and only cares her own opinions. She has a very condescending tone of voice and she makes the average student seem less intelligent than they really are.

reviews.comment: For a meditation teacher, she sure isnt patient. Looses her cool frequently and yells at the students. This is just a seminar course and she takes it more seriously than my main lectures. Just dont take it.

reviews.comment: Before taking this class I was so excited to never take an English class but after having Burley I am actually sad to be done with her class. She cares about her students and what she's teaching.

This Professor is one of the worst English teachers I have ever had. No matter how strong of a writer you are - she will never give you an A. She also tends to seem very bias and favorite certain students. She makes it difficult to enjoy writing, even if you have always liked writing and been a strong writer. WOULD NOT TAKE AGAIN.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: LOVED Melissa and her class. She has 3 main essay's and as long as you pay attention and are on top of your work you will pass. She also has very weird things she wants about papers and she sometimes yells at student
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Really nice woman and excellent teacher. You do have to work for your grade but she lets you re-do almost all assignments to get an A or above.

reviews.comment: She is TRULY an AWESOME Creative Writing professor! She writes what you need to do better on your papers very clearly for you to utilize to not make the same mistakes on your future assignments for her! She was one of the very few individuals I have met in my life who honored and ALWAYS encouraged me to follow my passion! VERY caring as well!

Although her assignments can be a bit tough, she truly cares about her students and gives many opportunities to receive help and revisions. She can be a great advocate for students who respect her and get to know her.
too difficult and strict for paper

She can be nice at times, but I would not recommend her. You will question the fact that your actually in an English class. 3 main essays, makes you go to writing center, and you can't even include "to be" verbs in the essays. She is very picky with her writing, assigns lots of homework, and you only can miss up to 3 classes. Avoid her if you can!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: There's good and bad with this professor. She does her best to engage the class and make it interesting, and she succeeds for the most part. She is tougher than the usual english teacher and has a weird grading style however she allows  students to do revisions and is very helpful with helping you meet her expectations.
