reviews.comment: Very vague

Melissa Burley is a tough grader, but she really pushes your writing. You have to work for the A, and she is very picky in what she wants. If you ask questions and visit her during her office hours she helps you out a lot. You just have to show an interest, and she will do the same for you.

Literally the worst professor I have ever had. I missed four classes because I had mono and she informed me halfway through the semester that she had been taking percentage points off of my grade for every class I missed. Avoid this woman like your life depends on it.

I really enjoyed her class and  I took her ENG106 class the following semester. There is a good amount of busy work during class but it's not that bad. For essays, she does peer review the whole week before it's due and if you get below a C she allows a rewrite.  She is looking for specific ideas in the essays, but if you talk to her she's helpful.

She is biased. Her grades don't make sense, she'll give an F on a perfectly good paper then give an A on the rewrite. She is unprofessional. The only reason I got such a high grade in her class is because I took the time to talk to her and be friendly with her. I definitely don't recommend though.

Professor Burley is great. She is engaging and is dry fun to talk to.  Try to make sure that you have some kind of relationship with her or just chat with her, and she will love you.  The more she likes you the easier her class is.  You don't have to be good at English, she is very easy to ask for help if you need it and will give extensions.
She is one of the hardest English professors at UM! She wants you to write her way and it's absolutely ridiculous. She grades very harshly and very unfair in my opinion. Don't take her!

honestly, WORST and most UNPROFESSIONAL college professor I've had so far (fine, i haven't had many but still..) If you are like those kids that will do anything to get on professors' good side then good for you.. if not, RUN! she takes everything too personal and holds grudges against students (talk from personal experience).

AMAZING teacher--she made the class actually interesting and engaging. We peer-reviewed our papers in class which was very helpful. I'm not a great writer by any means but I got an A on every paper. If you get a C or lower, she allows you to rewrite it for a better grade. Overall, she's an amazing teacher! Take her
Ill keep this short and simple, she is horrible, disrespectful, rude and inconsiderate. Piece of advice, you would rather postpone taking English than taking it with her.

I liked the class...lots of poems & short stories and we have to share them outloud or with a group but it's helpful! The class becomes close because we are always sharing. She gives feedback and lets you rewrite poems & stories that aren't A material. The class is actually fun and interactive! Good class...I'd recommend her teaching style! Take.
Not a fair grader in my opinion. Doesnt really tell you want she wants but ends up grading based on what she expects. Not helpful.

She was a very nice professor. Gives a lot of readings and gives extra points for participating in class. Only three essays and some extra assignments, but those are short and easy. Liked the class, and if you participate in class and put effort in your writing its an easy A.

Very sweet. Grades your paper and leaves room for corrections in order to receive a higher grade. A fun, entertaining class. Lots of work but nothing out of this world, and not too difficult either. Go to class, do your homework, and write your papers.. you'll be fine. She's awesome, definitely recommend her class.
Best english teacher I have had in a while! Very nice and not a difficult class! Does require work a bit of work, but overall fun! papers are not difficult at all!
Best english teacher I have had in while! The class requires you to think and take time, but it's overall a very fun class! Papers are not difficult and not a hard grader!

Gave virtually no direction in assignments but graded very harshly.  If you have more than two absences, even excused, she lowers your grade.  Very disrespectful one-on-one.  Would not recommend or take a class from again.

She's one of those professors who favors the suck ups of the class. So if you're not one of them, well, good luck. She wasn't helpful at all to me, and I didn't appreciate how disrespectful she could be one on one.

Such a wonderful teacher and my entire class loved her. She is always willing to help, open to class discussions, and will let you have fun in between work. Fair grader and appreciates when you put in the effort. Worth taking

Never in my life have I despised English more. Completely unprofessional, totally ridiculous! No "to-be" verbs allowed. 3 Papers + a final, all of which are graded extremely harsh! Only 3 people in the class got A/Bs. Does not help when asked and the class is so small and boring. If you have to take this class I suggest finding a better professor!

Definitely a fun class. My writing got so much better because of practice and her advice. Class isn't too hard, but one thing that annoyed me is she expects you to write HER way--I had to totally revamp my writing style to fit her preferences. She also plays favorites. Like I said though, my writing improved a lot, so I feel like it was worth it.

This lady doesn't know how to separate Art from English. This was a pre-requisite I was forced to take, but I would've never taken it by choice. Although she grades fairly well, she is also very bias so stay on her good side. The entire term was spent reading about art & paintings/people's perceptions on them. One hw was to make our own "Mona Lisa"

I think she's calmed down on the "to be" verb pet peeve; she only doesn't like it when the use of it can be avoided. She doesn't do a portfolio so you're not crunched for time at the end of the semester. Interesting topics...small class so you become acquainted with her and classmates easily. Not a bad class at all.

Great professor and she's really nice. Below a lot of people may say that she's vague, but I think that's the point of the class. She wants you to make the prompts your own. I thought the freedom of writing what I want to write with a few guidelines was quite refreshing compared to AP english in high school. Not boring and not strict at all.

Terrible professor. Very unclear and doesn't try to help you when you ask for help. She has pet peeves with writing and if you do one of them she'll mark down your paper a lot. eng 106 was a very pointless class.
A very average professor.

Absolutely the worst teacher I've ever had! I am not kidding DO NOT TAKE HER! In high school I loved english and got a 4 on the aplit exam but this class made me never want to take english again. She is so vague on what she wants in papers. her class is so pointless I learned nothing. she is THE WORST teacher ever if you take her you will regret it

VAGUE, not clear at ALL as to what she wants to see in a paper, not even in her corrections. I took 2 AP English courses in High school and got 4s, but i still had to take this ridiculous class. Her "to-be" verbs theory would be practical if she didn't demand it 100% of the time. Not a very good class, whatsoever.

I had her for ENG 106 too. I loved her! She's a great teacher and I learned a lot from her. The class is small so you get to know your classmates and her very well. Her grading is straight forward and easy to get extra credit. She elevated my writing style by emphasizing the "to be" verbs and taking them out when I could. She's great!

It's a shame that so many negative people get onto these websites... my experience with her has been fantastic. She's interesting and makes class engaging. You get graded on your final portfolio which you spend the semester building. Take Creative Writing with her; it's her favorite class to teach, and it definitely shows.
Do not take this teacher. You will regret it.

Stay away from her class!!! I got an A in it, but she is nuts. Her grading system is unpredictable and she is never clear on what she wants. Also her to be verb thing is ridiculous. They cannot always be eliminated, she seems to think they can but fails to tell you how when you ask her. Some of the readings were ok, but classes were boring.
Ridiculously Boring Class. Says "To Be" verbs are unprofessional. I guess Shakespeare's Hamlet was unprofessional then.

she was the worst teacher ever... completely bipolar grading.. she wants you to be an outstanding writer and yet doesn't tell you how to get there she just sends you to the writing center.. i hated the fact that all of my friends were getting easy a's in her class and i was struggling to pass her papers
bad teacher
She has no idea of what she wants from a student. She tells you one thing (that doesn't help) and does another.
seriously...keep away!

This teacher is not the nicest English teacher around- she is sarcastic and disrespectful and has an obsession with "to be" verbs. I am an A student and received a B in her class and even went to the writing center with all my papers. I learned nothing new in her class..seriously!

I thought Burley was great. She was always encouraging and made class fun with her "sarcastic remarks". The texts that she has you read are very interesting. I would recommend this class to anyone. To all those who complained about the grades on their papers...SHE LET'S YOU RE-WRITE THEM!!!!!
Burley is extremely opinionated, and she doesn't respect your opinion. If you write well, you'll do fine. However, her class is not enjoyable nor is she very respectful of her students.
She sucks.  She is mean, she doesn't listen or respect your opinion, she doesn't teach. and to make it all worse she expects you to write papers without to be verbs. dont take this teacher.

She's opinionated, likes to pick on students in sarcastic kind of way, and looking for sophisticated writing. If you know how to write WELL, youll do fine. If you write like you just got out of high school, youre screwed. No tests, just papers and in class writing assignments.

Her class is awful and hard to sit through. Shes not very respectful and talks over you/interupts you when you try to give an opinion. She grades really randomly...I put 100% effort into a paper and she gave me a 40 and made me redo it - for another paper i fudged it the night before, didnt try, and got a 90 with a "Great Paper!"
No Comments
No Comments
For anyone considering an intersting course, take Burley. She makes the topic so interesting that the time seems to fly when you're in class. Her assignments actually help you become a better writer.
The calss is alright, she doesnt really do much to improve your writing though, but overall its pretty easy if you do all the assigments.

Dr. Judd is an uninteresting teacher. She requires attendance, though her lectures are rarely relevant to the content she claims to be discussing. Half of the time, the lectures she gives are inaccurate or present information that is plainly false. Do not take this class if you enjoy literature; you will be disappointed.

Great class to take for writing credit! Interesting writing about movies, but like a writing class, lots of writing. Try on the papers, hit the criteria, and you'll get 100 on all. 

Very easy with good feedback on each assignment. Take take take this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Judd's class consists of watching a movie once a week then having a paper due every two weeks and a casual response in between papers. As long as you try on the papers you get a 100. Would definitely recommend for an easy A and writing credit.

The most boring class I have every taken. Sure, it's really easy, and all assignments are basically pass/fail, but attendance is mandatory and the lectures made me wish I was deaf. She teaches nothing but surface level analysis of boring movies and her voice sounds like she's always on the verge of tears, it's so off-putting and weird.

Very kind professor. Class consists of discussion and at the end typically lecturing with a PowerPoint about the film of the week. Weekly assignments but definitely manageable. Interesting class and she is very knowledgeable about the films she teaches.
I am soo surprised by the bad reviews. Professor Judd is so sweet, caring and passionate. The class is so fun and not hard, completely based on movies. Lectures were interesting to listen to.
Love this professor! Take her for any class you can she is so sweet and classes are based off films. Lots of discussions. Keeps things fun and interesting!

So confusing when it came to communication and following the syllabus. She doesn't email back. She only gave 1 grade back the entire semester so I had no clue if I was doing well or not. Lectures are BORING and POINTLESS except to find out the assignments.

Really nice professor. She is respectful to all of her students, including international. She always came well prepared for lecture. And she taught us the material together in class which takes out the frustration of learning lit.
She is such a nice Professor. Super helpful and understands students.  Learned allot in her class too

I have never met anyone more dull in my life. She shows up late almost always, and only takes attendance sometimes, but if you  miss it affects your grade. The class is ridiculously easy, always giving us "group work" and encourages us to do it outside, which means you pretty much always leave early. Her lectures are ridiculously boring though.

Dr. Judd's class was a waste. This was a 400-level class and felt that she did not give the class any of her time or treat it like an upper level course. She showed up late, gave us stupid summary assignments that she didn't grade but were mandatory and NEVER responded to emails. She acted completely uninterested. Take someone else!

She showed up late, excused us early, rarely lectured, and was unavailable for discussing the term paper. She wasn't there during office hours and didn't respond to emails re: term paper. Grades arbitrarily- myself and everyone I know got an A-, which brought down my GPA sadly. Not recommended, especially if you are trying to keep an "A" average.

I agree with the previous comment.Half the time we split up in groups and "discuss" the novels while she leaves.Did not even give paper topic to write on.Only 1 paper + attendance determines grade for this course.She is NEVER available (even during her office hours).Emailed her 3 times in the past week and she has not replied once.
Dr. Judd is very informative and helpful. She tries to get everyone to participate in class discussion, and she's always available to talk outside of class. I recommend her.

I don't know what these other comments were, Judd is ridiculously easy, ridiculously nice. If you want an easy A without working at all take her class. You have to go to every class, but she cancels about a third of her classes...TAKE HER!!!
Literature seminar. She's a bit ditzy and always late for class. seemed to give everyone a B regardless of how good your paper was.

She usually neglects to talk about the text and just gives background information on history or genres of the novel. Or, she just asks the students to come up with talking points. Boring, wish it was more focused, and that I was learning more about the text. She's frequently late and cancels alot. Take someone else if you can, but easy class.

She is a horrible teacher, we had three papers and a final paper and she gave everyone the same grade on the first two papers that she gave back even with the same comments. It was clear she didn't even read them. She is definitely not a fair grader and I would suggest not to take this class with her! Incompetent, bad teacher!
Interesting class-Great teacher!

OK. How about the papers are 2 pages - pass/fail. She's always late, never gets to everything she wants you to read, we watch movies half the semester, never lectures, you don't even really have to read the novels. It's the easiest class ever. Period. Awesome when she brings her little son - he's hilarious! Also, most boring class this semester.

Dr. Judd is pretty cool.  She's really flaky and usually late but the work for the class is not very demanding.  You can get away with reading sparknotes if you're crunched for time.  Not the best if you're an english major as far as offering new insites but for any other discipline it's a simple lit class that will expose you to some new stuff.
No Comments

This class was easy to do well in, but was torture to attend.  Half of the readings were things I already read in high school.  As an English major, I was disappointed to get no new insights into this material from this professor.  She was also consistently late and seemingly unprepared for class.  Avoid if you care about literature.

He was the chief of HR at 3 Fortune 500 companies. For entrepreneurs this is probably the most important class you can take. I left pretty much having a blueprint for hiring, selecting talent, succession planning, leading employees, how to successfully lead the organization when the company has to pivot, and so much more. Best class I have taken

This professor is truly one of the best experiences I have had. This is what we pay our money for. Super engaging and cool guy. He is very good at what he does and the lectures are super easy to follow and enjoyable. Take him 100%

If you are engaged and participate, you will get an A. He makes the lectures engaging and fun, so it is not difficult to participate. He's honestly just a cool guy who cares about his students and is so passionate about HR (which i feel like is rare). The final is a little challenging, but he gives you the opportunity to explain yourself. Take him!

The best professor I've ever had. Fully deserves this 5/5 on here. Genuinely cares about students, seeks feedback. Inspirational, full of life, and so talented. Never seen someone able to connect with every person in the room and made us all comfortable in a participation-based class. So much life experience and uses it in the classroom. 100/10.

Out of the 14 years I've been a student, Dr. C was by far the best I have ever had in my life. So full of passion and desire to pass his knowledge on to future generations (us). My class loved him; he always wanted to keep making sure we were engaged and wanted to receive feedback from us to become better. We need more professors like Dr. C.
Very engaging classes, gets you to think outside the box.

Professor Cerrone was one of the most engaging teachers I have ever had. Readings are all based off of current events and he does a great job relating them to the class. He has so much working experience in HR and tells stories about all of his jobs and gives examples of things he came across as the manager. Highly recommend taking him if you can!

One of the best professors at UM. Exciting material, talks about current events happening and implements them into class. Great structure. Some readings, some pop quizzes, one group presentation, one mid term and one final exam. Learned a lot, also about my career and life. Exams are not easy but take him and don't miss out. Participation matters.

favorite professor I've had, he makes the material exciting and unique with current events and interesting case studies. understanding and cares that you succeed in careers & life. passionate about HR and successful in the field so has some really interesting outlooks. exams are kind of opinion-based, not very hard, overall class is very valuable

Take him. He is the best educator I have had in my entire life. He has so much knowledge and expertise and is truly a good guy and only wants you to succeed. He sets up a 10 minute zoom call at the beginning of the semester to get to know every single student on a personal level. Who does that? A phenomenal professor. Take him, you won't regret it.

Incredible Professor. I think this has been my favorite class I have taken at UM he is so engaging, knowledgable, and entertaining. I genuinely wanted to go to this class everyday. If you have the opportunity to take him please do! Truly a special educator.

Dr. Cerrone is awesome. Out of all MBA professors so far you can tell he is the most qualified business executive outside of the classroom. Don't think because its HR its an easy lay up class. If you can keep up with Dr. Cerrone you are in for a real treat. Each class you are being taught by a world class fortune 100 CHRO level mind and talent.

One time I was sick with Covid and was upset that I was unable to go to class. That is how much I enjoyed his class. Take this course or others with him if you have the chance. You will learn about yourself as well as the general topics that the course is about.

Prof Cerrone is the best! His class is unlike anything I took before. It's pretty much all participation but he makes it super engaging. I learned so much because he related everything to things we were seeing in the news at that moment. He is so caring and wants everyone to leave the class having learned something.

Best profesor I have ever had. If I could I would take all my clases with him. If you have the chance TALE HIM! There is a project and a final which he gives all the questions before. I learned a lot and in a fun way. His clases are based on discussions really interesting

Dr. Cerrone is one of the best professors I have ever had! Even though we had a late-night, long class, he made it super engaging and fun. He is very experienced and his knowledge was a great feature of our course. I was apprehensive to take an HR course before, but now I hope I can work another one into my course plan so I can take Dr Cerrone!

This is a great class if you are willing to learn. The professor is the nicest and he is always available for questions. But the topics of this class are really hard to understand so make sure to hear up for some studying. The professor is fair and has standards. He won't tone down the topic because it is easier. Def recommend.

Do not miss his lectures and take notes of everything. Probably the worst class I have taken yet. The professor is approachable and does want you to succeed, but fails to teach the class in a effective way.

This professor's poor communication is unacceptable. Just 15 hours before the MAE 341 final, we were told the 'review slides' on Blackboard were irrelevant, after spending days studying them. This last-minute clarification wasted valuable time and caused unnecessary stress. Avoid if you value clear guidance and organization.

You will learn a lot from him, although this is not an easy class at all, but i think it is because of the topics... The professor is always available, and a good grade is possible if you study regularly with his notes. He seems like he truly cares for students to understand, and do questions on their own. He is not a type to pamper students...

His two exams are TERRIBLE. Avg was about a 60, I got a 38 haha. Quizzes and homework are very lenient, but annoying nonetheless. Be sure to pace yourself for project, he tries to give good grades on them. Tries to scare you that you will fail, but most everyone got a B to A- in his class. I thought I got a C- but I got a B.

If you've never walked through a forest in complete darkness, you will now. Exam content is gatekept and some questions are the most obscure fact from a random slide in a PowerPoint. In addition, there's a group project and tons of homework including solid works, which is never actually taught during class. Overall, VERY difficult class

Very hard class. He goes through material really quickly in lectures. He goes based off a powerpoint slide and sometimes just talks through problems instead of doing them on the board. His tests are very hard and he gives a lot of homework. There are 2 projects and they take up a lot of time so dont wait til the last minute.

She is the BEST OF THE BEST. She should possibly teach the other professors in the College about how teaching should be. Very quick, smart, and engaging too. She lets you use your tablets and laptops in the class for models and note-taking; but trust me, you will not have a moment to go surf.  Absolutely recommending!
Amazing professor, very smart who also explains well. Would take it again in a heart beat. Very useful class too.
One of my favorite teachers i've ever had here at UM, show up to class alot and show interest and getting a good grade is attainable. She's also very easy to talk to and funny.

Tough, but fair professor. She responds well to students who attend class. Her tests are based on the powerpoints she presents in class. When she says to put 5 stars next to something in notes, it'll most likely be on the test. If you study the slides and show up to class, a good grade is within reach!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: She is very sweet and kind and gives amazing feedback for your drawings. Attendance takes a huge toll on your grade and you only get 3 unexcused absences. There is also a lot of projects you will have to complete in her class if you decide to take Monday and Wednesday classes with her. You can redo assignments however to boost your grade.
new teacher at csulb and shes so nice !! i would appreciate more specific instructions and feedback but overall it was a pleasure to be her student ^^

Talia is such a sweetheart. She is very understanding, and obviously knows a lot about drawing from observation. Her explanations of projects were a bit iffy, but I'm sure they will get better the more classes she teaches. She is very forgiving about absences from class due to COVID restrictions. Take her if you can!

Rocco Ceo is by far the most knowledgeable and most skilled professor that I have met so far in the program. He seems to have an entire library in his mind on how to represent and render things through hand drawing. if you slack, his level of critiques will vary. so always try and show that your there to learn. literally the best.

Rocco is a very demanding professor but as long as you show interest in the course he is always willing to help and give feedback. He was always willing to come in outside of class hours if anyone needed any extra help and overall is a very knowledgeable architect. As a first year student, this was a great introduction to the major.

Professor Ceo is an exceptional studio professor. He helps students one on one and gives them great insight on their projects. He genuinely cares about his students and is very understanding. He has a great eye for landscaping and pushes students to work hard. Great professor.

The class was pretty chill. The exams were very similar to the study guide questions, so they were straightforward. The grading scale was adjusted so getting a good grade was easily attainable. The only downside is that 90% of the grade is finals and exams with 10% being the homework. No quizzes.

reviews.comment: Cai is an amazing professor, any student who has given a bad review is either very lazy or not committed to doing well in this class.  Yes, the homework can be long but you can expect to find that in a 300-level class. He is an extremely nice and down-to-earth guy who is very available and wants to see his students succeed. Exams are easy.

reviews.comment: I really liked the lectures! Very clear and made learning the material more enjoyable.

reviews.comment: Good teacher.
Plain and simple. Not a good professor. Also rude sometimes.

I loved this course. Struggled with the material, but was always available for office hours. Great professor, and moves at the perfect pace. He does assign  graded homework, but nothing that is unmanageable. I would recommend. Very nice as a person, as well.
Good professor!
He is nice.  Although he give a lot of HW,  you do them and understand them, you almost can have a good grade. the exam is almost like the review sheet he gives.
Possibly the worst teacher I have ever had. Does not go into explicit detail with really anything, and expects you to learn a lot of the course on your own through the textbook.
The class itself is a joke and his tests were doable.

Gives very abstruse and overly complex lectures. Isn't specific about what is on tests. Puts material that was never mentioned or discussed on tests.  Is a very very tough grader, rarely gives partial credit.
nice guy
He is one of the worst human beings I have ever met. Demeaning, condescending, rude etc. This was the worst class I have ever taken in my life. Avoid at all costs if you value your sanity or your GPA

DO NOT TAKE HIM! He makes class unnecessarily difficult. He even jokes around that "by doing the test review, sample textbook problems and homework, you will score at least a D on the test". very boring class

Will not help you in office hours. Boring class, and gives questions on test he never went over. seems nice on the surface, but extraordinarily condescending and makes you feel stupid when you ask a question. will never take with him again

Dr. Cai was my differential geometry teacher.  He did a really good job of presenting things both through equations and visually.  A few times he brought in some play-doh and a globe to help him model some things in 3D so we could better understand it. Very cool guy!
Very nice and funny guy. Make you love math truly. Lectures are very clear and fun. Definitely the best professor!
If you already enjoy math, you will like this guy. He makes the most complicated problems look really easy. If you don't, he's still pretty good, although he may be somewhat difficult to understand.
The best Professor in my life.
good teacher really calm and nice.
Was difficult to understand his words and methods in class.  Make sure to do a lot of studying on your own.

Cai is a nice guy .. he doesn't explain very clear but once you read the notes you will find it easy .. his grading scale is awesome .. he give rwview sheet and sample test .. easy A take it with him  .. P.S he never say good morning

had a hard time getting through his class. nice guy, but not very clear when lecturing. class is structured, so if you work hard you can do well. ended up with an A. final grading scale is very generous. 85 is an A. i never took calc before, so it he doesn't convey the info that well. not the best teacher, but is ok.
Really hard to understand, but his tests are very easy. Easy A!

He is incoherent, but his notes are cool, and his tests are super easy and straight out of the examples in the book (he doesn't even bother changing the numbers). He might not challenge you as much as you'd like from your DiffEq class, but take him if you're looking for an easy A.
this guy is really good. his tests come straight from the HW and the book examples. he's easier than the other diff eq teachers
A little confusing, but nice nonetheless.

Ming is awesome.... he teaches calculus like nobody's business.  i <3 ming and he's a great professor...he's about as fair as they get, hes really cute and always wears his belt buckle all the way to the side
Great teacher.  Loved the grading scale.  Drops some homeworks and math labs (you are required to go to math lab).  Gives a review sheet with a practice exam before every test.  So helpful.
pretty cool guy, knows what he is talking about, published some amazing things, decent teacher for small classes

I took his calculus class and it was horrible.  I could not understand a word he was saying and he made all the material much more complicated than it needed to be.  His tests were straight from the study guide though, which made it easy to study.

Great math teacher. A very ideal teacher if you never had Calculus in highschool. He teaches slowly, and spoonfeeds you every info, repeating little things to make you remember. His grading scale (85 A  75 B...) is very fair. If you want a fair chance at an A, take this person.
I would 100% reccomend!

Easy class, but hes unorganized and he is nice but he just skips steps and when he explains things he's unorganized and he grades kind of hard I think. everyone complains about him but I don't think he's that bad because its easy.

MTH 113 is easy, he's a light grader and will curve tests and give extra credit if the class is doing bad. attendance is not mandatory and all class secessions are recorded and powerpoints are uploaded. workload is very light for a math course and the final grade is pretty much the tests and final.

I had failed this class last semester with a 34% so I knew absolutely nothing . I ended up with a B- and I understood what I was being taught. I am so happy I retook it with Celano. He explained everything simply and made it pretty easy to then figure out similar problems. I have no idea why his reviews are so low, I kinda feel bad. Def take him

Professor Celano seems like a nice guy but his classes were not. Only 3 tests, but weekly quizzes and multiple homework assignments a week. Celano is a good guy, but online, he is a terrible teacher. He often talks to himself, makes mistakes that are corrected by students, and makes substitutions for numbers when doing examples but does not say when or explain. I started taking his class very worried bc of his terrible reviews. I dont understand why he has such bad reviews! Im not good at math but he made it all very smooth & easy to understand. Won't talk to you. Very hard to understand what he's talking about. Does engage with the students. Talks to himself a lot of the time. Homework on MyMathLab is very very hard. Test are not even on what he talked about.
Good person but not a good professor. He is not clear and concise when it comes to explaining problems. When studying for exams, online homework assignments help you a lot more than his lectures.

W o r s t

DO. NOT. TAKE. Professor more like writes the notes on the board and cannot explain questions asked by students. Students are confused 24/7. 10/10 would not recommend. Avoid unless youre in the mood to teach yourself all semester. Notes and study guides have errors every single time.

Terrible professor. Understands the material well but cannot teach it at all. He expects the students to understand the material by just copying the notes. When asked a question hes does not know how to respond and just uses whats written on the board. Do not recommend at all.

It's obvious he's smart, but can't explain anything. Writes stuff on the board and... that's the entire class. He writes, you write and he expects you to learn. Although Mr. Celano knows the material he is not good at teaching it. I taught myself the whole time. He is not good at explaining and grades harshly. Just started teaching

BEST PHOTO PROFESSOR EVER! Claudio is super engaged with his students and is always there to help. The course is pretty lecture and project-heavy, you have to work independently a lot. He gives time in class to work, but most of it is done on your own.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Claudio is an amazing professor! His lectures are fun and interactive. His personality is amazing as well. He has helped me so much with my photography skills and creativity. reviews.comment: She is genuinely so sweet and a very smart woman! She loves what she teaches and is very passionate. She's an understanding professor and her class is not hard at all. Read and take notes on the chapters for discussions, study for the quizzes. Final was online at home. 10/10 class.

Dr. Porter is absolutely amazing! She does give a lot of readings and assignments but all of it is extremely relevant to the courses and she makes them interesting. She really prepared us before we went into the field school and helped strengthen my interest in pursuing a career in cultural anthropology.

reviews.comment: Prof. Porter is a knowledgeable and respectable professor. The only thing I did not like was that she is very disorganized on blackboard and has things from other classes in there that may confuse you. It is also very reading heavy so don't fall behind she will literally ask you about articles by Author's names on exams.

Gives MANY extra credit opportunities just for showing up to events she sends through emails. Lecture heavy, you must read the readings before each class because she will ask you about them. Exams are a little difficult especially with her wording but she is so sweet and kind. You will love her! 4 exams, 2-4 discussions and few group assignments.

I enjoyed GSS 201 a lot except the readings. There were so many readings each week so don't get behind otherwise you wont catch up. Exams were challenging but they were outside of class so I did it other students. Make sure to study and actually read the articles bc they will be on the tests. One final paper on any topic related to the class.

reviews.comment: Dr. Porter is one of my favorite professors. She's so sweet and kind and is always trying to give the students the best education possible without being a heavy course load. She gives tests which are open notes and encourages you to work in groups to do it to discuss with your classmates the right answers. She does have some reading but its not bad

Loved her!  Super engaging, loved going to class because the content and discussions were very interesting.  Very accessible.  There is a hefty paper at the end, but if you need help she is super helpful.

HIGHLY RECOMMEND TAKING THIS. Dr. Porter is super disorganized, but other than that she's great and makes the class very engaging. there's readings you have to do before every class (sometimes 20 page reports), but most of them are really insightful, and it's clear that she crafts her curriculum with intention.

I have never loved going to class as much as I did going to hers. It is so interesting and discussions are very valuable. 
Be ready to write a research paper on whatever you want at the end. I loved writing it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr Porter is awesome! GSS201 is so interesting and relevant to society, everyone should take it. She's so kind & welcoming to everyone which makes it an open space to talk about personal opinions/experiences.  Lots of reading which is what exam is focused on, but they're online open note so nbd. 10 page paper & cumulative exam final. RECOMMEND!!

Dr. Porter is an incredible professor. The class was discussion-based and she kept the content interesting. She is understanding of any extenuating circumstances that could impact turning work in on time. There are a lot of readings but considering the only other work was one paper, two exams, and some discussion boards, it is very reasonable.
Very passionate teacher, care about everyone, perfect job assignment

She is a super understanding professor, meaning if you fall behind, miss a class or do bad on the exam she will help you out. She offers a lot of extra credit, which I recommend you do because usually is going to an event and writing about it, super easy.

reviews.comment: Dr. Porter is truly an amazing professor. Besides the heavy reading load she assigns, I can say that not only was I never bored in her class but I also genuinely learned so much from it. Warning, her tests can be hard but she lets kids explain why their answer is also correct and fixes it. She's super understanding, caring, and literally brilliant.

I loved getting to take Professor Porter's class. She is extremely engaging and cares about the material she is teaching. She is also very accessible and willing to meet with students and give them her feedback/ time. I would highly recommend to a friend. One of the best Professors I have had at UM.

reviews.comment: Literally the BEST professor I took this semester. He genuinely wants everyone to do well, I highly doubt anyone got lower than a B in this class. Not cause it's easy, but because he actually keeps us engaged and everyone wants to participate. His PhD was on GenZ behavior, so it's no surprise that he understands us all and knows what's best for us.
Ive never met a profferer nicer. This guy cares about every student and might just be the greatest professor ever.
Nicest professor I've ever met. He really cares about the class and after the first week, can really tell he genuinely wants everyone to do well. Great professor 100% recommend

Professor Clarke is awesome. I didn't want to take a 3 hr but he made the time go by so fast. (Also gave breaks) Class is very straight forward - you have every opportunity to get an A. We did some classes over zoom, but when we were in person, he has brought in snacks & ordered us pizza. He also sets up networking opportunities. Great person.
Easily the best teacher at UM. Beast. Absolute animal. Best class of all time easy, even if it is a 3 hour.
Goat. Unreal teacher

Amazing teacher, if you actually engage with the lessons. She picks interesting pieces for readings and has very, VERY, clear rubrics for assignments. If you don't enjoy writing, or thinking, then this is not the class for you and none of the WRS classes will be. Some people think she's 'woke', but she actually just encourages critical thinking.

Dr. Hoffmann is very kind and she cares about her students' well being and success. Classes can be boring sometimes as she will talk about topics that I probably learned in middle school. She is very flexible with deadlines and will 10/10 give extensions for everything. TAKE HER.

Professor Hoffman is such a caring and down to earth person. Her assignments are quite individualized, meaning you definitely have to do the work yourself, but she is incredibly understanding if you need help or an extension. I would take her again in a heartbeat.

She was a very kind and caring teacher who was always willing to work with you when something came up. The class is lecture heavy and they're pretty boring but the assignments that she has you do are applicable to real life. She does take attendance. If you go to class though, participate, and do the work (it's easy), the class is an easy A.

Professor Hoffmann is wonderful. Her class is a lot of busy work however, it is super manageable. She is so caring and empathetic towards her students. She puts herself in her students shoes and is willing to help you whenever you need it.

She is so so sweet. Attendance is mandatory, but she is very understanding if you miss. She gives so many extensions and does not take off a lot of points for late work as she wants to help you succeed. Sometimes the assignments aren't clear, but she tries to help as much as she can. I wish she was teaching 106 because I would def take her again.

Prof. Hoffmann is one of the best English professors I have ever had! She is caring and understanding. She doesn't mind if you pass the deadline as long as you show interest in her class. Her feedback on papers is also amazing. I would take every English class with her if I could!

Prof Hoffmann is the most understanding professor I've taken. She is easy to reach and understands that life outside of class is a real thing. The material isn't the most interesting, but she does a good job at making it engaging. This class is practical for real world applications and not just a grade. I highly recommend taking it.

This review is for WRS 106. Dr. Hoffmann is a great professor with great lectures. The only thing I had trouble with was reaching the word count in her essays but 1000+ is the norm in college courses. She is very lenient with grades.

I had Dr. Hoffmann for WRS-230 and loved it! She's super friendly, makes class fun, and is always willing to offer help/be flexible with deadlines. I feel like her projects were very applicable to real life. Dr. Hoffmann was definitely my favorite teacher I've had and I highly recommend taking one of her courses!

Dr. Hoffmann helped me so much with professional writing. Although it's not the most interesting subject, she really wants you to do well in her class, as well as in future jobs. Her mock interviews and professional email exercises made me so much more confident when applying to jobs/internships. Again, not the most exciting class, but very useful.

Very caring professor. Genuinely wants her students to do well and understand material. The class itself is useful as it is applicable to all professional environments. Decent amount of groupwork/discussions but really not difficult and actually interesting. Not a tough grader, understands people have different writing skills. Definitely recommend!
Dr. Hoffmann is a very sweet lady and really wants you to do well. Sometimes the material is boring, but the assignments and class activities are helpful. Take ENG230 with her if you can!

Very nice and understanding prof but didn't get grades on papers until semester was over. Accommodating to extensions, etc but class is often dry and non engaging. Strong emphasis on Native American media, African film in class. Easy grader just not the most interesting class.

Very caring teacher. Very sweet and doesnt judge your writing. She just wants to make sure you can clearly and effectively get your point across. Clear grading criteria. Idk if shes gonna do this for all her classes but the final project was able to be a 2 min video instead of being a paper which was a huge help, hopefully she continues that.

This is the easiest class I've ever taken. It was in person once a week, and asynchronous the other day. He would give one assignment that takes literally 5 minutes. His lecture is interesting if your in the mood to listen. Take this it's so light especially for a cognate.

100% take this class if you have the chance. Easiest class I had this semester. Very interesting lectures if you're into the media and the internet. No deadlines for homework and projects and he's very clear with his grading which made the class a lot easier. Extremely nice professor and cares for his students. I would take this class again.

Attendance or participation isn't mandatory which is nice. You have the entire semester to do all of the assignments because he grades on a point system. The amount you complete=the amount of points you get=your grade for the class. So you can give yourself an A if you want. very pointless class but you get 3 credit for not doing anything serious

She gives a lot of pointless assignments on videos from 2010. She also takes points off for the smallest things. Makes us do a bunch of nonsense outside of class and random group work during "lecture". She never actually teaches in class. The class is not bad or really that hard but it is pointless and she is honestly annoying.
I liked the project we had to do. She wasn't bad. Not an easy course for a 200 level class but it wasn't insane either.
if theres one thing Mrs. Delgado does. its make the class much more difficult then needed

Delgado isn't a good professor. The class is run like a high school class yet she grades so hard for no reason. The virtual child is annoying and the final project is so much work.The assignments have nothing to do with the lectures and the class is a waste of time. I seriously would not recommend her, not sure why there are so many good reviews.

Dr. Delgado is a great professor. The class is a flipped class, you meet once a week, plus have a whole week to complete a written homework assignment, which is very easy. If you answer all the parts, they're super easy points. There are only 2 exams, no final, and a final project. The class is very easy and would recommend taking her class.

She made my Child Psych course. Our only homework through the semester was raising a virtual child using materials learned in class. There were three tests and no final, the tests mashed readings and lectures together. The lectures were clear and organized and correlated with readings. She made classtime enjoyable and the class experience was great
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I loved this professor. She always tried to make sure everyone got a good grade in the class, including discussing why you got a grade on a test. She said this was the first year she didn't mandate attendance. Make sure you read the textbook though, she's ready to explain in class but a lot of the test was based on the textbook. Also STUDY!!!
tedious smaller assignments and one big project full of papers on a topic you choose on the first day. easy class if you do the work
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This class was extremely enjoyable and Professor Delgado truly did an excellent job explaining and going over all course material. This class is mainly done on your own time but then there is a review / one class meeting a week to go over the material. I recommend this class and professor very highly to anyone who asks.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: I have never written a review but I felt like I had to for this class. Dr. Delgado was a fantastic professor. She clearly is very passionate about prenatal development and it made me want to attend every class. You will learn so much in this course and I would recommend it to anyone looking for a 400 level psychology class!! You will not regret it

Dr. Delgado made PSY230 engaging through remote learning which I really appreciated. She's flexible as she offers extensions for certain assignments through a token system which helped me. All exams are written response so it's critical to read the weekly required readings. Take the My Virtual Child program seriously, it's needed for all her exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: DON'T MISS CLASS. She gives you a grade for attendance/participation for every day of class and it can make or break your grade. You have to pay attention in class or you won't hear the instructions for the papers and you won't do well. Little consideration for special circumstances but super nice if you go to her outside of class for help.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Quizzes two times a week. Journals due every SATURDAY night. Projects, conflicting with assignments, conflicting with exams. She's not accommodating, whatsoever. Material was interesting, yeah. Prenatal Development. But she was intolerable, 10/10 would not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Takes attendance every class so you can't really skip. Doesn't allow laptops for notes so you have to take them by hand, but lectures aren't bad. If you put in time studying, the tests are fair and reasonable. Made some really snarky comments to students but for the most part was nice and helpful.

She knows her stuff and you won't want to miss her class because of it. She makes the class interesting with all of the extras(during class & on blackboard)and you will know what I mean WHEN you make the right decision and take her class. Show up (don't miss more than 5 classes),pay attention, scan the text or read depending on what grade you want.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Great professor. Highly recommend.

don't take her if you need an easy A cognate. Her tests arent easy unless you read the whole book and go to every lecture because her test questions also come out of lectures.  You may think the MVC project will be easy but shes a hard grader so devote a lot of effort into those.  Extra credit helps.... got a B instead of B- bc of it
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: I loved her child development class! The virtual child project was so fun! Definitely do the extra credit, they're free points that can help bump your grade up! I think the tests are pretty easy if you read the book chapters the night before and listen during lectures, which is pretty easy because they're super interesting and she's very engaging!

The class is lecture based, but she opens some topics up for discussion and breaks up heavy materials with funny/interesting videos. The tests are very specific and you will need to read the textbook thoroughly. The virtual child project is easy, just don't procrastinate  and make sure your analysis is very detailed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Overall she is a great professor. She knows her stuff & I really enjoyed listening to her during lecture. Attendance is not mandatory, but it is extra credit. But you're gonna wanna go cause a lot of stuff in class is not in the textbook. GO TO CLASS AND READING THE BOOK IS A MUST!!!

Alright. I love this professor. She is a nice and kind lady. You must show up for the lectures and you must read the book. Her exams contain lectures and textbooks. You need to remember everything that she said in the lecture and you need to pay attention to the bold definition in textbooks. She will take attendance randomly. 2 essays. 5 exams.

Overall she is great professor. She tells you what she expects and what you should do to pass the class. Don't procrastinate. You need her power points to pass, and the textbook you need to read it is a must. She Gives you 4 Exams and the lowest grade is dropped. There is like 2 Papers, and you have to raise a virtual child but its easy peasy.

take her. GO TO CLASS! i can't stress that enough, she gives extra credit randomly for attendance and at the end, it DEFINITELY helps. her tests are basically from the book, but she includes a lot of questions from her lectures and if you miss class that day, you miss the question on the exam. all in all, pretty straight forward teacher. recommend.

Only two assignments that are based on your Virtual Child Assignment and are due late in the semester and about 2-3 weeks apart. Each assignment is about 3 pages double spaced, nothing big. Four tests and a final, but one gets dropped. Puts up grades IMMEDIATELY. Tests come mostly from book but specific examples from lecture. A LOT of extra credit

Easy, extremely interesting. She takes too many questions, which significantly slows down the class and the questions are irrelevant, however she knows the material inside and out and makes the class fun. Attendance is randomly taken for extra credit, in addition to an extra credit question on each exam. Material on tests is from class and text

Great Professor, she will help you. The test are easy as long as you read what she assigns and assist class. You get to opt out your lowest testing grade, and her final is relatively easy if you do well over all, she does put things about the lecture in the test, so coming to class is a must

Dr. Delgado is an awesome professor and very approachable. You need to work hard and read the book to pass her class. Her lectures are very interesting and she is very knowledgable. Not an easy class, but fun.

Dr. Delgado is an excellent teacher and child psychologist! She is a fair grader and expects for everyone to study from the book and power points. Come to class for extra credit and make sure to read. You'll do fine.

4 tests and if you're happy with your grade at the end of the semester you don't have to take the final. You raise a virtual child from birth to age 18 and based on your parenting choices, you can see how your child would grow up- it's very cool! 2 papers on your child and the 4 tests and final are the only grades. Go to class for extra credit!!!

it's not hard to get an A if u r willing to spend hours and hours on studying before the exams. she expects you to know everything from the ppts and a 500-page book. the virtual child assignments take forever to finish. She is nice and pretty overall. avoid her if u can

Really interesting class. Good teacher. Very helpful especially if you go to her office hours. She always keeps class fun with her open discussions. You MUST read the book along with remembering her in class comments  on her power points. Test covers both lectures and book. It is not a cakewalk, you need to work for an A in her class.

Professor Delgado is the best! She's so nice and her lectures are engaging, also her tests are fair. Sorry but if you don't study you won't do well! Go to class, read the book, and study and you'll do fine.

Dr. Delgado is not only a hottie, but really smart, and knowledgeable. She is a great professor. She makes the course content interesting and lively. The only knock on her is the amount of workload. She gives way too much work for the class. I will say this though, she is a fair grader. Do the assigned readings before class!

She's the best psychology professor I've had at UM so far. Unlike most teachers, she doesn't just read off the powerpoint, and actually has the class discuss the material. She's extremely knowledeable in her field and is able to make the material very interesting. Go to each class, as she'll give bonus points for going on random days.
She is the best prof i've ever come across!!! had a lot of writing assignments.. but its worth it.. you learn so much!

I am a senior this year and without a doubt can say she is the best professor I have ever had. She provides detailed slides with additional information and is very passaionate about her subject. That being said the class does require some additional reading of the book. It is however manageable and she gives many extra credit opportunities!

A very enthusiastic professor! Although she used slides she did not read off of them; she was extremely detailed in her lectures and provided videos and examples that really made the material come alive. Serious about getting everyone to learn, and not too hard if you simply study. Definitely take!

In order to get an A on the class, you must attend to every class, 75% is on the class material and 75% on the book  you must study from both to get a full 100%. If you attend to all of the classes you will get 7 extra points. The my virtual child questions must be done carefully in order to get an A
Did not make class material interesting at all.  Tests are absolutely ridiculous.  Not willing to meet for extra help during office hours.  Ineffective teaching style.

Really nice lady. Her exams are fairly easy. By going to class you will do better in the exam because she makes test questions for those who come to class, about movies and lectures. You need to read the book to get an A. You can drop an exam so try to do good on the first 4 so you dont have to take the cumulative final

Professor expects you to work hard for a 400 level course. There were 10 assignments that were time consuming. 2 tests, both very hard. The class itself is interesting, but the assignments feel like a drag so it ends up taking away from the class instead of adding to it like she wanted. She's really nice and knowledgeable though. Be sure to work

Professor is very nice and teaches very well. Her powerpoints provide a good outline, but you have to attend class to do well on the tests. 10 or so questions come from the textbook, and if she notices people are missing a lot, she uses more exa's from class on the test... so show up! 4 tests, final is optional to replace a bad grade.

Did not make the subject matter interesting at all. Tests are a little redic. They cover both lecture and book material...and some of the book material includes broad topics that she doesn't even touch upon in class. Also, the examples  she gives on the tests are terrible. Not recommended.
Not my favorite teacher but she is good at what she does. I am not fond of her  because for the written questions shes a very anal grader.

I took her class on pre-natal development, which if you've taken PSY 203 with her is an indepth study of the first part of 203 with some added stuff. I really enjoyed the class. There were 3 assignments and 3 extra credit opportunities and 4 tests (Final is optional). This will probably be my favorite class at UM. Textbooks aren't required.

Good class to take as an elective. Requires reading of the textbook and class attendance, but tests are easy and material is not hard to grasp. She relates most of her lectures to parenting. Good if you plan to have kids. She's also quite good looking.

As with other psych. classes you will need to memorize a generous amount of terms for exams. Exams are fairly easy if you've been to class and taken notes and at least reviewed the material. She gives plenty of opportunity to earn up to 8 extra credit points(towards final grade). Excellent class, highly recommended for anyone taking PSY203.
Great professor!!! I learned alot she gives real life examples and explains topics as many times as needed for students to understand! Also she gives lots of extra credit!!

first time i saw a student cry during an exam... BEWARE OF THIS PROF.!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! SERIOUSLY, YOU WILL BE STRESSED OUT AND FEELING MISERABLE THROUGHOUT THE ENTIRE SEMESTER. IF YOU VALUE YOUR GPA, BE CAREFUL... HAND WRITTEN TEST, NOT MULTIPLE CHOICE, SHE CAN DEDUCT POINTS FOR WHATEVER REASON SHE DECIDES!!

Prof not helpful, mandatory to give class presentation and attend student lectures or you'll lose 1 point, grading scale is unusual, each test scored out of 35pt, so you would think a 27 gives you a B, think again! The tests are not multiple choice, hand written. Overall, worst professor ever taken. Dont let the smiles fool you.

great lectures and interesting course. tests are easy as long as you take notes in class. offers several extra credit assignments and the final is optional if you do well on the other tests. she is very personable and willing to help!

If you like Psychology, you have to take her. Makes class interesting.  She's SUPER nice, her classes are fun, test are not tricky (but gotta study), gives tons of extra credit. It's a MUST to take. She's my favortite professor @ UM.
shes my favorite teacher ive had so far at UM. i learned alot in her class and actually enjoyed going. she was my first A+ i got in college, woo.
This was one of easiest class i've taken at UM so far. i got an A+ in her class... although did I take alot of notes in class and read the book.. she was so very nice
My FAVORITE teacher ever!!! don't think twice about taking ANY of her classes... inorder to ace the test you must go to class, your going to wanna go anyway- shes great
Very nice teacher, pretty easy class. She's so sweet! Take ANY class with her!
She is one of the best professors I've had at UM.  Her tests cover a lot of material but if you go to class, you'll be fine.  She is interesting and eager to help.

Actually worse class I have ever taken. Way to hard for an entry level class, makes you not want to be political science major. I would study so much, leave the test thinking I got an A and then get a C-. If you don't say exactly what she expects you to say on the FRQs she will mark you off. Ended with a B- (worse grade i've even gotten in a class)
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Wouldn't recommend her, she was extremely difficult for an entry level course. Extra credit barely gives you anything and we only got 3 exams to get graded on the whole semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I really liked her class, I'm not sure why so many people hated it. Just show up and take notes and you'll be fine. I had an A all semester until final exam which did drop my grade so definitely prepare for that. All you have to do is listen and occasionally do the readings. If you want a good grade I'd recommend going to her office hours too.

It's definitely not an easy class, don't take this if you think it'll be an easy intro, ITS NOT. BUT she is an extremely sweet and fair professor. If you show up to her lectures, listen, take notes, and study YOU WILL BE FINE. Yes exams are on the harder side, but it is not meant to fail you—you have to put in effort. Be prepared to learn.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Looking at her RMP ratings, people think she's way worse than she actually is. She was one of the best professors I've had, I learned SO MUCH in her class, a semester later and I remember it too. I use that knowledge in my classes now, and everyday convos; she's awesome and smart and engaging. Everyone hating cause they can't keep up.

It's an EXTREMELY difficult class for an intro level, and was easily my most time consuming class. She's also a tough grader. However, she was helpful in office hours and the lectures were similar to the exams.

I did various tutoring, dedicated hours of studying, went to her office hours, and still got a C in her class Her tests are 50% multiple choice (hard wording), 25% short answer (she looks for the most specific wording even though other answers are correct), and 25% long answer (nothing you write will ever be enough).

Your entire grade consists of 3 strenuous exams. Out of the 18+ credits I took last semester, I studied more for this class than all classes combined, yet, I still got a low grade. She doesn't work with her students when it comes to grades and the one form of extra credit barely gives you anything.
This was hell for an intro class. Tests are way too difficult and lengthy to finish in time. She also doesn't teach the material very well. Avoid.
Hardest intro class in the entire department.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Seriously don't take this class. I should've backed out while I could, I had A+'s in every class and this class was my one B. The tests are absolutely ridiculous, and the time crunch is worse. Avoid. Avoid. Avoid.
I'd rather take orgo again.

She is brand new to UM and I do not for the life of me understand why they hired her. She is elitist, and looks down on students. She expects way too much for an introductory course, especially when many students are not majors. All she talks about is Brown Brown Brown, where she was before coming here. Yeah, we get it, so why are you here? Avoid.
Just no, don't take her.

reviews.comment: Tests are mid, BUT the way she grades is absolutely ridiculous. They're made up of long answer sections and she is SO PICKY. Takes off points for every little thing. I'd have A's on every test if this weren't the case. Stares me in the face and can't give me a real reason why I got them wrong. Will give back maybe half a point for showing up. AVOID
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Do not take this professor. She is an intelligent person, but teaching is not her thing. Test is made of MCQs, ID questions, and essay questions all in an hour

reviews.comment: booooo tomato tomato tomato. pls respect the bad reviews over the good... not everyone is a genius. I put in 20 + hours of studying for both exams and got in the 70's. Very disappointing and ego crushing. I would take 201 or 203 over this if she is the only professor option. If you have to take it, GOOD LUCK!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Good professor but doesn't understand what to expect from students. Assigns mountains of reading each week for an intro class, then makes tests extremely long and confusing without ample time. 35 multiple choice, 5 short answer, 3 long long answer all in an hour meaning that your biggest struggle is time rather than the actual material.

For an intro class her class structure and difficulty level are ridiculous. Studied an excessive amount and still did not perform that well. Says she has office hours and is available but it takes SCHEDULING an appointment a month in advance as her office hours are always 'full'. Is sarcastic and snarky... would not take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Chriswell is very nice and knowledgeable. You have to read a lot for each class and there are three papers but you can choose when to do them throughout the semester as well as a final paper. The papers are graded harshly, but she gives a lot of feedback for improvement. The class is hard but I would recommend.

Some people were MADE TO TEACH. She's very smart, and engages students SO WELL. Answers questions thoroughly, even follows up w/ you if she thought her answer wasn't sufficient. She's awesome, lectures in a comprehensible way, PAY ATTENTION THOUGH, slides alone not sufficient. Dedicates sm time to her office hours&students. Up to 3% in Extra Credit

She wasn't terrible, but I wouldn't take her again. I thought the exams were easy but it was more so because of prior knowledge rather than the actual class. No homework in this class either. She does attendance quizzes though. Overall mid she's not as bad as people make her out to be but it wasn't the greatest experience either.

DO NOT TAKE HER. I studied for Exam 1 for full 2 days and got in the 70s. Exam 2 I started studying two weeks in advance and still got in the 70s. Since exams make up majority of our grade, having a C in the class despite putting in a lot of effort and trying to really understand the topics for the exam is deflating.

Professor came from Brown (first semester teaching at UM). Has really high expectations for an introductory POL class. The class does not align with POL policies from other courses. Tests are awfully long and are timed. Professor often is sarcastic with her responses in respect to the class's low performance on exams. Do not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: My favorite POL professor so far. She is so knowledgable and her lectures are very informative (if you actually pay attention). You need to study a lot and effectively in order to do well but she outlines exactly how to get an A in the class and is quite helpful in office hours. Material from the assigned readings and textbook is also on the exams.

One of the smartest people I've met & probably will meet. Very knowledgeable about topics and her lectures are to the point of what will be on the exam. If you use AI to study/make material make more sense to you that's fine - the exams will use her slides AND LECTURES make sure you pay attention in class. Will answer any questions and EXTRA CREDIT
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Her lectures are informative and organized. The test material comes from the lectures or the textbook/outside readings, but you don't need to fully read these for the exam. I've gotten high As on both exams literally just by studying and attending class.

If you actually put in effort (and don't shop in class), this course won't be difficult.

reviews.comment: She's very knowledgeable about the subject, but is just super uptight and too strict for an intro class. reviews.comment: I wish I could give a 0.
I agree POL202 was impossible for an intro class, beyond awful.

reviews.comment: Wouldn't take her. She's brand new from Brown. Intro class was way too hard. Tests were impossible. 32 MC's, 5 short answer, and 3 extended response in an hour and 15 mins. MC's were impossible as well. Studied for 20 plus hours for one exam, was well prepared and got a 70. Test averages are mid 70's. AVOID. Intro class IMPOSSIBLE.

reviews.comment: Very difficult to understanding and pretty boring lectures, however, he is very caring and understanding. I would not choose to take on of his classes again, but for being major required it was not the worst thing ever. The readings are very long and theoreticak making this a difficult introductory class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very intelligent on the material and knows what he's talking about. However, he can go on and on about a subject for a long time which can be very boring. The lecture slides are very confusing and you don't rely on them for exams. There are only two grades in this class the midterm and final. He does curve well and the kahoots make up a big part.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: he's a super sweet guy, really knowledgeable, and has great connections. class is lecture heavy so it can get a bit boring and hard to stay focused, and attendance is mandatory but it's manageable. exams are pretty tough, but he curves and offers extra credit so if you put in some effort you'll be fine it's not bad at all.

He is a really nice and caring professor, his lectures can be long and boring, however , if you take notes in class and study using his study guide you will have no problem in this class. He also likes to give extra credit whenever he can.

While the material may be slightly more difficult, Pischedda takes the time to thoroughly explain it should you ask in class. His classes definitely require students to ask questions and actively participate, but its political science, if you cant do that pick a different major lol. He is also very personable, and enjoys speaking with students.

Lectures are long and boring, making it hard to keep up with what he's talking about. Kahoot quizzes at the beginning of every class to take attendance. Participation MATTERS! He is nice and knowledgeable, but classes lack engagement and are hard to stay interested in. 2 in-class essays (midterm & final). Long readings for homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Honestly he is the most knowledgeable professor at UM I have ever had. I learned so much with him, if you are invested in the topic and pay attention, this is an amazing class. It could be more challenging then other courses but that it what makes this class more valuable to actually learn something.Highly recommend for motivated students

Avoid if you can! Test aren't too hard but he doesn't give good feedback and doesn't have a clear grading criteria. Classes are boring and attendance is mandatory. He has a very thick accent and rambles a lot. You are also graded by kahoots which are used for attendance, and if answered wrong he doesn't count the kahoot.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Passionate about the topic however, does not know how to teach, especially to a large lecture class. Not engaging at all and is difficult to understand. He goes on long tangents about small details which makes the lectures very hard to follow since the topics are honestly not that interesting. He grades super harsh and gives poor reviews.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was terrible. The grade consists of two exams and attendance. He grades the exams so harshly and expects so much from just an intro-level class. Attendance is taken by a Kahoot, and if you get the question wrong it counts as an absence. He seems like a nice person, but the lectures were boring and long. Do not recommend.

Easily the worst class I have taken at UM.  Every essay I wrote, I worked really hard for and got really bad grades because I wasn't "exhaustive" enough in my response, even though I most definitely was.  Do not take this class ever.  Not a nice teacher, boring lectures, difficult to understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor, really knowledgeable about the topics, wants you to learn!

His lecture was so boring it made it impossible to go to class but attendance is part of your grade. The tests were easy you just had to memorize definitions. There were no assignments but there is a quiz at the end of every lecture that also counts as attendance. He doesn't know how to teach that well. u don't need to read anything he assigns.

Graded by attendance/participation and two tests.  His lectures were so incredibly boring that it was impossible to pay attention, but you have to go because at the end of each class he asks a question about the lecture and if you get it wrong, it counts as if you were absent.  Sweet guy but so boring.  He was also so random when grading the exams.

Professor Pischedda is clearly very passionate about what he teaches, however, does not know how to actually teach the information. His tests are hard and he is picky with how he grades. There is no clear rubric and it is hard to review the slides as he doesn't put all the information on there.
