reviews.comment: Chill guy and really understandable. The class is tough however, theres only 2 tests and attendance plus the final.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Tough grader. Missing assignments back. Yeah. Not the vibe.

Essentially reads off his Powerpoints. He'll often overexplain topics, drawing them out far longer than necessary. That being said, his lectures are informative and as long as you take good notes you'll pass.

He means well and is a nice person but his lectures are very boring so it is hard to make yourself go to class. The quizzes are based on the lectures so you should try to go to class every time. I studied really hard for the quizzes and final and ended up doing well but I wouldn't recommend taking his class if you want an easy A.

I never did the reading for this class. I sat in the front and said hi to him every day and never went to office hours. Thick accent, sweet guy, very nice and means well. I thought he had a knowledge but the worst way of presenting that to students. Go to class and skip the readings and study hard and do extra credit if there is any.

Lectures where just a regurgitation of the power-points so in a way pointless to attend because nothing else was taught beyond the slides during "lectures". On the positive side the WiFi was above average in the room.

Honestly loved this class. The material is interesting and if you pay attention and understand the concepts in class it's not that difficult. He also hosts review sessions before the exam that are nice to make sure you understand the material.

I love political science, but this class was so boring I couldn't take it. His lectures are terrible, but attendance is mandatory so you have to sit through them. He assigns like 80 pages of reading each night, and they're always extremely confusing so nobody does them. Your grade is based on attendance, 2 quizzes, a midterm & a final. Avoid
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Really good professor if you're engaged with the material and interested in the topic. Textbook is not used in this class because you read the academic journals/articles of the theorists (Better in my opinion). About 80-110 pages of reading a week, but material covered in lecture. Amount of reading difficult, but tests fair if you put the work in.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Extremely boring class. I love politics but this class really put me to sleep. only class I've ever skipped willingly. tests and quizzes are pretty easy but you need to study for sure. 3 MCQ online quizzes and 2 essay tests. thats all. HOWEVER, always willing to help and reexplain. very knowledgeable but just sorta over everybody's heads
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: His lectures are very long. But he covers exactly what you need to know for the tests. The tests are very fair and there are 3 online quizzes. He is very approachable and over all a very good teacher. I would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Tests? Not many--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Teaches a very interesting subject but manages to put everybody asleep during his lectures. He manages to take a 3 minute topic and explain it to death for 20 minutes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Solid class
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Really interesting class. About 100 pages of reading per week. He teaches from slides but going to class helps a lot. Generally easy if you do the readings and go to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Horrible teacher. Thick accent and his inability to stay focused on a lecture makes it impossible to follow his rants or learn anything. Also teaches exactly what he wants, and in the end you learn nothing about the actual course. Assigns 90 pages of reading a week, all of which are extremely complex and difficult to read. All class is powerpoints.
her grading criteria was unclear, and despite doing well on exams and assignments, my grade suffered due to unclear presentation and participation expectations. Just unclear in general.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She's the most fair professor I have had at UM. If you put in the work and try your best you will succeed in her class. Her tests are detail oriented, but they are not hard if you try and study. Super accessible outside of class, and will give a lot of hints and help in review sessions for how to prepare for exams.
Good professor and good TA choice as well. She is very interested in the information and is not a tough grader, since the TA does the grading. Overall, would def take her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Costa is kind and very knowledgeable. Participation is important during group projects. The 2 exams can be tough, mostly written answer and a math portion. Do homework, similar questions on exams. Ask questions, she wants you to understand. Definitely easier than other genetics courses offered at the university from what I have observed.

Although the only work in Dr. Costa's class was answering discussion questions about papers and online quizzes, she grades everything extremely harshly. I did not find this class challenging but my grade does not reflect that as she took points off for every little thing. Nice person but not a morning person. Tuesday lecture, Thursday discussion.

Dr. Costa is a great professor. Grades are based on weekly discussions where participation is mandatory, 2 exams, quizzes, and a group presentation. Her grading criteria are very clear and tests aren't particularly difficult as long as you take notes and read discussion papers.
Really well-structured class with clear expectations and meaningful content. She's passionate about the class and wants students to succeed. Attendance and participating in discussions is important!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: great professor and helpful in terms of exams and lectures. some classes she does do paper discussions which if you skip WILL reflect on your grade, so show up for those. exams are also slightly based on those papers so make sure to actually read them. overall love her

Professor Cohen is a great professor. He's more direct and blunt than some other professors you may have, but he genuinely puts effort into making sure his students retain the material. He accepts late work throughout the semester and is fantastic during office hours. If you need help, GO. He's very passionate about his classes and it shows.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I have taken Professor Cohen's Hebrew courses from 101 until 202. This course will not only teach you Hebrew but will teach you how to be a better man (or woman). On a serious note, this course has been THE highlight of my UM career. It's also not hard if you put in minimal effort. If you try at all you will probably get an A.
Disorganized, unclear, and unresponsive to students. I would strongly advise avoiding this professor.

EXTRA CREDIT! Most people did really well because he allows for the opportunity for lots of extra credit work. 2 written exams, 1 oral exam, 1 regular exam, 1 final, and 1 presentation. some dumb assignments, some hw. can sometimes be dismissive when you ask a question or need help, overall pretty good!

Loved Professor Shai! I took Hebrew 101 with him. I joined knowing some basic Hebrew. He is funny but harsh when you don't understand. He assigns a lot of homework, but if you get something wrong, you can resubmit until you get a 100. He gives many extra credit opportunities. Automatic F if you miss more than 8 classes, excused or unexcused.

really funny
cant explain a lot of things- he says "just life" like ok..
he is really smart- speaks a lot of languages
most heavy work ton i have
but he is a easy grader but a lot of work lots and lots
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Passed his initial placement test, but he didn't think I was proficient enough and told me to consider dropping. Days later he sent an email forcing me to drop, despite me telling him I needed this class to graduate. I had also just gotten off a semester in Galapagos where I lived with a family that only spoke Spanish, for three months.

Very unclear with what he wants. Will not give clear instructions and then will take off points for not doing what he would have done. Did not leave the class with more knowledge than I came in with, which was sad considering I was very excited to take the class. He's a nice man, but not a very good professor in my opinion.

Taking Hebrew 201 with Professor Cohen was a terrible experience. He was unnecessarily harsh and dismissive, making it clear that he had no interest in actually helping me learn. Whenever I asked a question, instead of offering guidance, he made me feel embarrassed for not understanding. His attitude was unprofessional and discouraging.

An amazing teacher! Strict when it comes to the language, but truly wants you to succeed. He tests our proficiency and uses fun, creative ways to practice. His dedication and passion for teaching Hebrew make him one of the best. Love him! UM got a good one. he's the GOAT

Cares so much about students, and genuinely effective teacher. Class is based around clockwise cold calls which people may not like initially but I think people get used to it over time and end up actually participating in the class. Hopefully writes strong LOR too!

Prof. Cohen was not the easiest prof, but that honestly helped me learn more in his class. He encourages you to speak and creates a safe space even if you get an answer wrong. It was easy to get him to like you as long as you showed up on time and acted somewhat interested. He was always really nice.

I really enjoyed both the French internship and class. Course's mix of real life experience and lectures really prepare you for the work environment. Presentations allow you to gain useful skills, specifically when interviewing for jobs. Additionally better & gained lots of confidence in my target language. Loved the class & highly recommend.

I didn't like this class. He seemed more focused on showing off how much he knew than actually helping us learn. Whenever someone asked a question, he'd often brush it off or respond in a way that made you feel stupid for even asking. I wouldn't recommend taking his class if you're looking for a supportive and encouraging learning environment.

Shai led the internship course very well and provided many useful resources for a successful cross-cultural internship. I was able to apply my spanish language skills to professional environments to improve skills like communication, critical thinking, and even gain experience working in a cross-cultural environment. I highly recommend this course!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Took HEB102 with Professor Cohen. He is a great guy overall, creates a great class atmosphere, cares about his students, and provides personal attention to students (especially to those outside of class in office hours who need extra help).

This is the first Spanish class that I have taken with Shai but he has been the best Spanish professor that I have had so far. He is very kind and will push you to reach your potential and improve. He is very easy to get in contact with and will work with every student. He sees when people are trying and will do his best to help every student.

The class is SO much work but that's how it is with any Spanish class at UMiami. Shai met with students outside of class, gave many extra credit opportunities, and quiz corrections. It's not an easy A but once you get to know Shai the class won't seem so intimidating because trust me at first it will be.

I took SPA202 with Shai this semester and having him as a professor made the class 100x better than it could've been. There was a lot of class work and assignments, however Shai is very understanding and cares about each student. He is so funny and makes class fun. I highly recommend taking 202 with Shai!
Very good teacher! Cares about his students and really wants them to improve their Spanish. The class is a lot of work but he works with you.

I took Spanish 202 w/Shai. He is a very caring professor and wants the best for his students. He provides a lot of feedback on essays and written work, offers opportunities to make corrections and learn from your mistakes, and is always willing to meet. The workload may seem heavy but its from the department so its out of Shai's control. Take him!
Weird guy. Constantly complains about the "US school system". patronizes students for not being as good as his european ones. Very hot and cold, can never know what to expect
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I have only good things to say about Shai. Definitely can seem a bit intimidating for the first couple weeks, but eases up quickly. You can tell he cares only about his class learning Spanish and does not grade harsh at all. I will never take Spanish with anyone else.

This course requires a lot of writing, but Professor Cohen gives helpful feedback on each assignment and is a fair grader. He offers extra credit and is always willing to meet outside of class. He really makes an effort to help his students improve and I enjoyed taking his class. It is easy to do well in his class if you stay on top of the work.

I had him for Hebrew and safe to say he is awful. He was so mean for NO REASON and did NOT want to teach me. I ended up having to drop the class and take a W. On top of that, I reported him for being mean, ignorant, and making me cry. Also, when we were in class and I would ask a question because I was lost, he would make me feel bad about it.
Awful teacher!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Shai is the best professor I've had here. He makes learning fun and interesting, while he still teaches well and prepares us for exams. There are many extra credit opportunities, easy points for homework, and he is willing to meet outside of class. It is clear that he cares about his students and wants them to succeed. Take Spanish with Shai!! :)

Shai is a great guy and a great Spanish professor. I really enjoy taking his class. The grading materials and assignments are the same in every section of 201 regardless of instructor, so although there was Mindtap homework every night it was out of his control. He provides good feedback and makes the time in the classroom enjoyable. Take him!

Shai is the best professor ive ever taken for spanish. hes really smart, funny, and caring. theres a lot of in class participation but he is patient, doesnt get frustrated, and doesnt put pressure on you. hes helpful, lenient, and encouraging. ive never been more motivated to learn spanish and his class is the only one i am excited for every time.

This professor is nothing but the best! I'm walking away from the class with more Spanish under my belt than my four years in high school. The homework is very manageable and he has amazing lectures. He tries unique teaching methods for every style of learning, but he keeps students engaged and cares more about their success than anything else.

Shai is the best! I've learned more in this one semester than the four years of spanish I took in high school. He uses multiple teaching strategies like reading from the texbook, partner activities, games, and powerpoints. The homework load is very manageable and he prepares you well for exams. He's funny, caring, and wants his students to succeed!
Very nice and wants the best for his students. Grades very easily and is more concerned with you learning the things that matter, will allow you to succeed.

Professor Cohen is the best spanish teacher ever! Get the textbook, read through it, take notes, do the homework on time, participate in class, and you will succeed. He is very understanding and doesnt get mad if someone doesn't understand what he is talking about. He is always available for office hours and is an overall easy grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This professor was great! Super helpful and made the class fun! There is a lot of homework, but it helps your grade in the end.

took him last semester. Attendance isn't mandatory. be prepared to learn all of the material on your own. Quiz or test every week, which is nice if you do bad on one. However if you think you know calculus from highschool, this class will make you think otherwise. i got a 46 on the final but all my exam grades were high 90s

one of the better options for calc teachers. Quizzes/exams are straightforward + he lets you have a cheat sheet on all assessments (front + back). Final exam is cooks tho so get ready to study like never before for that.  This class requires lots of studying on your own time. I had to teach myself most of the material. I recommend him
Okay I'm taking him this fall 2025 semester and honestly he isn't a great teacher but none of the math teachers are great. Doesn't take attendance and quizzes and tests are pretty straightforward.
Don't. Just Don't. Coomes can't even solve our own homework problems. Save yourself and take somebody else.

LISTEN TO MY WORDS NOW. I am about to give you the warning I never received. Coomes doesn't give practice problems of ANY kind. Spends the entire class going over questions about HW from what we "learned" last time. but wastes the entire class doing this and doesn't teach it. If you haven't taken a calc class before this, you are in the mud.

Professor Coomes has a very relaxed way of teaching his courses, lectures will be near impossible to follow but he is very knowledgeable as a Professor so any questions you ask will be answered in depth. The course is project based, consisting of a midterm and final project. Do not recommend if you're not in the realm of Computational Math.

This is the worst professor in terms of teaching the material. I stopped going to class halfway through the semester because I learned the material better on my own. He would spend the majority of the class figuring out how to show a computer model of what he was talking about, which had nothing to do with the test material.

I wish I could rate him a 0/5. Worst teacher in UM (3rd-year student speaking). He does not know how to do his job. We were 1 day away from the grade submission date, and no one had received a grade from Exam 2, 3, or the Final. Tips: do NOT go to class, and teach yourself through Prof Leonard on YouTube. Do NOT go to office hrs. Cheat if u can. GL

Do not take him if you have a choice. Spends most of the time writing out the code to equations than solving actual problems. Doesn't respond to emails, phone calls or text messages. His only saving grace is that he is lenient with hw extensions and exams are just repeats of hw questions. Nice man, terrible professor. Avoid at all costs.

Took Dif Eq with him fall 2018. Had a lot of homework but only graded on completion. When it comes to test making, he's lazy. Every test question was directly from the homework copy paste. He allows a full page cheat sheet each class. It was very common to guess which questions he would pick and have the exact problem solved on the sheet.

Ahh yes, Dr. Coomes. What a terrible professor. It's a good thing Nate and the rest of my squad in Multi cheated on every single exam. He would walk out of the room and we would use our phones and cheat on every single exam. It's a really great wonder how he's even still allowed to teach at UM, bur regardless, his classes are boring but so trivial.

My impression of Dr. Coomes is that he is a very intelligent man; however, he is lacking in the "teaching" department. His lectures are dry and focus too much on theory. When he gives examples (if he does), they pale in comparison to the rigor of hmwrk problems. That said, many of his test questions come from the homework.

Smart man but cannot explain concepts clearly so students understand. Very boring and goes into way too much detail without explaining much. If you have questions you can ask but sometimes his answers are not very helpful. Had to study concepts on my own mostly, which is not the easiest topic to do (Calc 2)

HORRIBLE! He obviously didn't have a lesson plan for this class. He knows what he's doing but isn't good at explaining that knowledge. I had to teach myself from the book. He is slow about grading tests. He allows a cheat sheet so that definitely helps. It is a passable class but you have to teach yourself because he is USELESS!

This professor is brilliant at calculus and clearly has  firm knowledge in math but in my opinion he had a hard time effectively teaching the material to the class. He allows a note sheet for the 3 exams and 2 sheets for the final. Took forever to grade exams. I honestly depended on the texbook for this class.

Pretty good teacher and super nice and genial.  Is really smart but sometimes he can lose his train of thought a little bit during a problem.  Lets you use a note sheet for the three tests and two for the final.  Puts a curve on the test scores if he feels lot of people didn't do well.  I got an A in it and worked hard.  I recommend him.
prof. is not a good teacher, his exams are easy...a cheat sheet is allowable

The material itself is a joke.  Coomes will spend the whole class time explaining homework to the whole class if someone doesn't understand-which can be a double edged sword if you are doing fine and get it.  He takes weeks to grade ANYTHING so be ready for that. Take this all in perspective though cause I skipped class for weeks at a time. . .
Can get scatterbrained at times, REALLY nice (will go over the homework even if it takes a whole class period, etc.) Let us use note sheets for tests

Not the greatest teacher, but he's a SUPER nice guy. He'll spend the whole hour doing homework problems if he has to. The tests aren't bad if you study enough. However, be ready to wait a couple of weeks for stuff to be graded. Definitely ask him to let you use a notesheet on the test!

Came to class LATE every day. Came to our final 30 minutes late. He always seems rushed.  Lectures are boring derivations that confuse him and that nobody needs. You must bother him to grade your tests. The tests are like the homework problems, except sometimes he throws in hard questions out of nowhere. Lets you use notesheets on some tests.

Decent Teacher, but he confuses himself.  He doesn't make the majority of the test very hard, but will toss on some pretty hard questions once and awhile.  ALWAYS SHOWS UP LATE, keeps you late, and turns tests and homework back late.  Won't change tests for you, but overall nice guy.  Homework for him sucks, he assigns alot and hard problems
Not bad for teaching hellish curriculum. Will spend entire classes answering homework. Tests get annoying, no notes in 112.

Dr. Coomes is passionate about calculus and loves when students are interested.  For this reason it is easy to get him off on tangents, which can sometimes take 20 minutes.  Besides that, I think he is a good professor, though he grades the homework for accuracy, and he checks to make sure all the work is right, not just the answer.

He is a nice guy but he is so smart that he confuses himself. The tests were horrible and he collects the homework before the tests. Attendance is not mandatory but you better keep up. I am lucky I got what i did!
No Comments
very good teacher, as he explains fundamentals and principles very well and goes out of his way to help the student understand.  Also very helpful in office hours.
Nice guy, not the best teacher.  Not the worst, by far, but I would not recommend him.
comical guy..human homework answering mchine..dont expect to learn 4m him but his tests are a gift,,tells u exactly wat to study and lets u use note sheets for tests
works mostly in theory and can be very confusing.  in his favor he will go over the homework as much as you like.  A very boring class made more complicated than it needs to be by him.

Took him for MTH 211: 3 exams (20% each) + final (40%) so entire grade rests on those but exams are identical to his sample exams. Hard to follow lectures sometimes and doesn't give many examples to prepare you for homework but if you study hard you'll do fine. Most people never came to class but I'd take a bullet for this man he is so sweet
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: 3 midterms worth 20% and one final worth 40%. Attendance is optional. Reviews are exactly like the midterms. He's a nice guy that's a fair grader. Do the reviews, understand the material, and you WILL DO WELL!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Genuine great guy, very caring, he's the GOAT.

If you are going to take this class, definitely pick him. His class notes can be a little confusing, but the Midterm (and final) he tells you exactly whats going to be on them. Just study how to do the questions and you will be fine.

Best math teacher ever! Homework is optional but you better do it. Predictable tests, no surprises ever. He is very open to meeting outside of class and will always help you with anything you need. Attendance is not recorded ever. He is very knowledgeable about his subject, GOAT

Professor Cosner is a true gem of the Math Department at UM. Only three exams. All homework is optional and from the textbook. The exams are take-home projects that you get to do for three weeks and are basically just questions from the text. Really easy A if you take notes in class and do even half of the homework. TAKE HIM IF YOU CAN!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Cosner is by far the most brilliant and understanding professor in the Mathematics Department. He is truly a master of Analysis and Calculus, and his knowledge shows when he teaches challenging courses like Partial Differential Equations. He makes his classes accessible yet easy to understand, and Dr. Cosner makes everything take home - easy A.
Very solid choice he knows his stuff.

Dr Cosner was one of the best math professor's I've had at UM. He teaches the material very effectively. The test is only graded on 3 exams but if you do some of the exercises he suggests, it's a super easy A. Overall Dr Cosner is very nice and kind, he gets very excited about math, and he's an absolutely brilliant person as well.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Cosner is the greatest! He really knows the material and doesn't mind taking extra time to go over difficult concepts. He is very helpful and gives excellent feedback on tests. If you do even a third of the optional hw, the tests will be a breeze. Anyone who doesn't like him just wants to be spoonfed information. Easy A in my opinion.

I am an Engineer and in no way unfamiliar with putting a lot of work into classes, but his lectures are SO unhelpful (confusing, long, scattered) and the textbook was also incredibly unclear. I taught myself everything for this class (MTH 311) and had to put in and intense volume of work to do so. If you aren't prepared to do this, don't take him.

His tests are just like the less challenging parts of homework. Based well off book. Lectures are pretty boring. Can be learned straight out of the book if you skip class often. Tests always seem just a little too long for the time period you have.
GREATEST OF ALL..

Great professor, kind and well spoken. Classes are not mandatory, spends 20 mins going over a HW problem. Try and get old exams, they are a lifesaver. The final was tricky, but its manageable. He says at the beginning of the semester that practice is key, and he's right practice practice practice and you will be fine.

Nice guy and really wants you to pass. You shouldnt have a problem with it if you study. Try and get the previous tests from someone that has taken it, it will make your life alot easier. Watch out for the final, its much harder than his regular tests

Easy class, as long as you can memorize formulas.  He really doesn't teach that much, spends a lot of time deriving formulas, but he will easily spend 20 minutes on a homework question if needed, so don't be shy! And you definitely do not have to go to class to do well.

Cosner is a cute grandpa.He really wants everyone to pass.You have to read the sectio before going to class to understand what hes saying but other than that, his tests are super easy.almost identical to examples in book.HW not mandatory,Labs easy,No quizzes.Your grade is only the tests, that can be good or bad.I rarely go to class I have an A tho!
He is an awesome teacher.  He teachers the material well and is always willing to help you out.  He is a very lenient grader.  He wants you to get as many points possible on his tests.

Best math prof at UM. He will always give you the benefit of the doubt, and is amazing with partial credit. For someone who is only mediocre in math, he explains things in a way that anyone can understand. He gives you formula sheets and will usually help you out a lot on tests if you get stuck. i got all Cs in math before and now have an A/B.
He's the man!
the best one to have 311 wih, try to find old tests and u will get an A, a good grader too...alot of partial

Extremely helpful and nice. Does not make the class difficult that it needs to be. I highly recommend you take him if you need to take this course. If you rather not go to class, just read the textbook and do examples and you should do fine. Homework definitely helps and keeps you in practice. This class is mostly practice.
One of the best professors I've ever had in college.  Made math interesting.  Thorough in his explanations and analysis.
No Comments
Nice guy, always helpful, usually available, and very thorough.  Customs his teaching to the needs of the class.
Great teacher and always willing to help any student one on one.
THis guy is probably one of the best math teachers I have ever had.  Makes some problems look so easy.  Beats the process into your head.  Nice guy!
He's tests are easy and he is not strict about attendance. he is very easygoing and flexible. There is no required homework.
Great teacher and will go above and beyond what a regualr teacher would do.  He often agrees to meet with me and help  me with any problems I have one on one.
HE's very robotic, but he's a nice guy that shows signs of being human with a sense of humor every once in a while.  I recommend taking his class if you have to choose one.
Also teaches MTH112, and differential equations.

He isn't the best at explaining things but if you ask questions he's helpful. He is sometimes boring but can be very funny. You can have an index card on the tests which is really helpful. Also exams are really similar to the quizzes and iClicker questions. I would take him again.
Not even worth it to attend the lectures because he goes too fast and makes them too confusing. Not generous at all when it comes to regrading or giving extra credit. Do not take

A very friendly guy, but not a great class. I found it very boring and difficult to focus as a result. Claims he isn't trying to trick you with questions but he is. The materials you are given to study are not very helpful. Lots of all of the above and none of the above on quizzes and exams. Does have a decent amount of extra credit sprinkled in.

Prof Collins is a really nice guy and definitely available outside of class. My best advice is to go over exams with him after and he will teach you how to think through the problem so you are prepared for the final. Lectures are too fast and hard to comprehend. Read before if you decide to attend. Know the content in and out, tests are not easy
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: FOR BIL 250. Is Dr. Collins the best professor I've had? No, but the class was not the hardest thing I've ever taken (although this is coming from an upperclassman who has taken higher-level science classes before). The biggest annoyance was not being able to drop exam 4 like exams 1-3.

FOR BIL 250.  I'm not sure where the other reviews are coming from, Collins was a great genetics professor. He was super passionate about the subject and was helpful in answering questions. It's a hard class, but it's easy to study for, so if you want a good grade you can definitely get one.

BIL 250. Terrible professor. Confused himself during lectures when he was asked questions. Not understanding towards students in the slightest and rarely even responds to emails. Exams are so much harder than the lecture material. I did better when I didn't go to class and just read the textbook. DO NOT take him unless absolutely necessary.

FOR BIL 250. This was his first semester teaching it and for your sake hopefully his last. He had no idea what he was talking about and read off the slides. The only reason I did okay in the end is because he gives easy homework points. DO NOT TAKE GENETICS WITH THIS MAN. He was kind but doesn't help you understand the material at all.

BIL 250 Genetics: Prof Collins' class was difficult but manageable, the classes are extremely lecture heavy, but the course is graded fairly easily, with a decent amount of extra credit available. A LOT of information, but limited notes are aloud during tests, study hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class was a great experience & I wish all professors taught w/ his level of detail & enthusiasm. Class is hard but only bc the material, by its own nature, is difficult to comprehend. Dr. Collins however, isn't a hard professor by any means and makes such complicated material so much easier to grasp. Don't listen to bad reviews, take his class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I have not finished the class yet but I am in his neural development class and I was curious to see what others said about him cause I have really enjoyed the class so far. But I was surprised the 3 reviews he had were all negative. It was probably the same person doing the 3 because they didn't do well. He is the GOAT. Would recommend.

Dr. Collins was by far one of the most passive-aggressive and rudest people I have ever had the displeasure of being around. He was always making smart remarks, and treating others in a very demeaning and insulting manner when a question was asked, confusion arose, etc.  Do not take a class with him if you can help it.

FOR BIL153. Professor Collins was really passive-agressive and disrespectful at times. Expected too much of us while not giving clear directions or instructions to achieve what he wanted. Is a really tough grader and takes off a ridiculous amount of points for the smallest things. Overall not a caring professor and would reccomend you to avoid.

Uncalled-for passive aggression; most written criticism/replies have an air (strong gust) of smug arrogance. If asked to look over a project, he won't have face-to-face criticism, will then deduct pts without explanation. 44pts off  A. Half point off here and two points off there adds up. Each unexcused absence lowers grade from A to A-, etc.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Takahashi sensei is fantastic! She loves teaching and that is clearly shown by the passion she brings to every class. I looked forward to every class and I learned a ton over the semester. I highly recommend for any interested in learning Japanese.

Takahashi-Sensei is, put simply, the best professor I have ever had. She is truly motivational and cares for the success of all of her students. She takes the time to get to know us, and is beyond kind! The homework takes time, but it is very helpful as it provides constant immersion in the language. Awesome one credit upper level BIL credit with Mallery! Easy A and he is very friendly and caring, you can see it from the way he speaks and interacts with the class. Very precious and kind professor who also clearly has a love for the university too.

there was no homework but he is by far THE WORST BIOLOGY PROFESSOR. lectures are super boring and he talks about nothing. his hyperlinks are super confusing and not helpful. most test answers can be found online.
Really nice guy, but lectures are quite difficult to understand. Exams are quite long and use a lockdown browser.

Mallery is a very boring professor. He teaches from an ancient website he made. He gives so many extra credit points if you attend his lectures (because most people skip). Not an entertaining teacher, does not really give much help (no review sessions, office hours etc.) You can pass if you listen and take notes but you will not have a fun time.

I don't get how anyone passes this class without cheating. There's too much material, no practice, and the tests have random questions that studying doesn't even help with. The setup makes you wanna give up and take shortcuts because learning anything feels impossible. It's messed up that all this class teaches is how to get around doing the work

Lectures are super boring, covering too many topics. Tests focus on obscure details, and his old website doesn't help at all. No homework means no practice, and while he's kind, his teaching discourages any interest in bio and makes success feel impossible. Avoid if you want to enjoy bio, this class could make you hate science altogether.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures can be messy and hard to follow, but using study tools like unstuckstudy alongside other resources helps manage the heavy workload and test difficulty. Attendance is mandatory, so best to engage with the material.

very boring class, he just rants about stuff instead of actually teaching. it's hard to pay attention. he told us not to read the textbook cause he doesnt ask questions from it on the tests. he doesn't even use powerpoints, he uses a very old website that is hard to navigate. he's an adorable and sweet guy but i would never take him again for class
Entire class is his powerpoints which are messy and have a ton of stuff on them. Gives out quizzes like once a week or so which are a few questions but not too hard. Pretty boring professor ngl
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do not take this class he is very lecture heavy and it is impossible to keep up with him. he bombards you with a ton of material and his tests are so so hard. if you have to take this class quizlet and chatgpt will be you're best friend.

Teaching requires the instructor to convey things in a way that a non-expert can actually digest, which this prof is horrible at. Lectures, question types - basically everything - is complicated, structured poorly, and incomprehensible. He uses complex terms to explain basic topics. You can get an A by asking around, but you will not truly learn.
avoid this guy at all costs. nice dude, not so good professor.
Very long lectures, however, it pays off to pay attention as the tests are extremely lecture heavy. Proctors walk around and lock down browser is used so beware. Website is very important.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Class was easy to pass if you know people and have connections to find answers. If you want to learn about bio do not take his class since most of the test is questions on things he never talked about in class. I went to all lectures, but attendance isn't mandatory and isn't needed to pass his class.

Great professor if cheating taught someone anything. Terrible professor if looking to enjoy learning biology. Will not pass without looking at past tests posted by previous students or making 4 hours a day for study. Whole class WILL cheat on exams by looking at answers of the people in front of them, making the test average SO STUPIDLY INFLATED.

Boring lectures that don't help at all on exams. Uses an old website instead of PowerPoints like a normal professor. Exams ask the most obscure, random things. Genuinely confused on how people pass his class. Nice man, he gave us candy on halloween for our exam, but terrible teacher. Quizzes are take-home, and no hw.
Lectures are extremely difficult to follow, tests ask about oddly specific concepts that one would not cover when studying, overall a very frustrating and confusing class.

Nice man, but a boring professor. Lectures were long and sometimes off-topic, and oftentimes studying for his exams (4 plus a final, lowest of the four gets dropped) was extremely difficult as there was no textbook, but rather a website of his which he used instead. No homework (which was a con, as there was no way to practice or review material).

INSANE amount of material for each test. Impossible to know what's on each exam. Used his website maybe twice and got an A by relying on quizlets. Entire grade is 4 tests (one is dropped) and final exam which was hard. Extra credit for showing up to class but it's a waste of time to go bc he rambles. Take home quizzes. Wholesome old man though

Class was boring. Intense amounts of material covered in one class. Attendance isn't graded but he gives quizzes & he gives the password out during class. If you want to preserve your GPA, you are going to have to study a lot. Do not leave studying to the night before. Take any opportunity for points and don't rely solely on quizlets found online.

literally the sweetest old man. would i want Charles as my grandfather? yes. would i ever take this class again even if the life of my first born child hung in the balance? no. i hated this class with my entire being. please do not take his class.

Uses a janky website to lecture. A major cheating issue in his class, that even when reported Mallery turned a blind eye because his ego couldn't handle it. Tests do not align with actual biological content. Rude when students reach out for help and/or advice. No office hours. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. SAVE YOURSELF.

He is super nice and wholesome, and he makes jokes in class but the lectures are so monotonous and uninteresting it is difficult to retain information. Quizzes are super easy since they're usually take home, exams aren't as easy but you can find most answers on Quizlet. His slides are super confusing to navigate because he made them in html.

I think Mallory is one of the better Bio Profs. Attendance to workshops is mandatory, but lectures are not.  He does do Pop quizzes occasionally but they're not bad. Some exam Qs on exams don't make sense, or have multiple "right" answers. Ask people who have taken him before if they have any study tips and you'll do just fine.
He is the best! Sometimes he gets side tracked during the lectures but he is still an amazing teacher. His power points are super important!
Extremely boring lectures and reads off out-dated slides from his website created centuries ago. I don't recommend taking him if you actually want to learn something or actually interested in bio.

Lectures are so boring. All his notes and tests center on his website that looks like it was made before the creation of the internet btw. Mallery isn't personable, so don't expect to form any type of relationship with him. There are tips and tricks to get a good grade in his class. Just ask around.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He teaches half the course and it's all memorization. Lectures are a drag and tests are random questions unrelated to biological comprehension from his website
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Mallery was not hard, however his tests are lecture heavy. He has a quiz every class and the exams are pretty straight forward from lecture, so you basically have to go to class in order to actually make a good grade in his class. Overall, his class was not hard and I only needed to study over his powerpoints.

Mallery is nice, but the course can feel overbearing at times. There is a lot of information covered, and sometimes they are introduced with complicated vocab, he assumes you have heard of this before. Daily 5 questions Blackboard, open-note quizzes but you do most of the learning on your own with his website which can be very long at times.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very messy notes, does not use PowerPoints and instead uses a website and expects students to click on many links which are labeled as important. It is unclear what needs to be studied to succeed. Quizzes nearly every class but are easier than in the second half. Exam questions more memory based and easier to read than in second half.

this class is just Mallery lecturing his site every day with quizzes at the end of each class (with answers online) and an exam once a month. exams and quizzes are mc which I appreciated and made the class easier. the website could be more condensed but I found it to be a helpful tool rather than a textbook. he's such a wholesome old man can't lie

Professor Mallery was fine. Your entire grade depends on the daily quizzes and 4 cumulative exams. His lectures can be boring and he can be pretty rude if you ask him questions. His tests are based on his lecture slides (which include LOTS of random links and are so confusing), but at least there's no homework and he doesn't track attendance.

Mallery is a lecture only type of professor. He goes through his intricate website and the course itself contains a lot of information. If youre the type of student who will put a lot of work to go out of your way and learn on your own after taking notes in class than you'll do fine. His tests and quizzes are also found on quizlet.

Mallery's website is okay, but I feel like there is a lot of clutter/unnecessary info he could remove from it. It makes it almost impossible to know exactly what's on the exam. His lectures were actually pretty interesting. Quizzes almost every class and exams are 50+ Qs w/bonus. Exams are reasonable, and I honestly prefer his exams over DiResta's.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: 1st, don't buy the textbook, you won't crack it open once, doesn't align with what he teaches. As much as he is a sweetheart, Dr Mallery is a hard professor to understand if you didn't take AP Bio. He speaks in a way that he understands, but leaves the class confused. Gives daily quizzes to boost your grade and extra credit on random days.

Uses a very outdated website that features spelling errors and confusing flow of information. Not an effective way to learn at all. Requires you to memorize very specific information that has no correlation. Take someone else if you can. There are 4 exams and a final and he drops your lowest exam. Previous knowledge of Bio is recommend to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Mallory should not be teaching this class. I don't think I learned a thing given how fast he tackles the information. I would opt for someone else as you don't need to use a terribly designed website which is required to succeed in the course. Workshops are required but huge waste of time (no one knows the answers) and people cheat hard on tests.

This class is a joke. He uses a completely outdated website that contains irrelevant information and an insane amount of spelling errors. He fails to even proofread his tests, which barely make any sense. In the end, you're not learning a single thing. He expects you to memorize his entire website, which for some chapters is an insane amount.

Paying attention in his lectures is basically useless but you have to go to class because of the daily quizzes. The tests are hard but all of the information is on the slides which are weirdly specific. Sit with a group of friends to do the quizzes together and you should always get an 100. His class is super boring but anything is better than gain
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hes a very knowledgeable guy but his lectures get really boring. He does give a lot of free extra credit though. Rewatch his lectures and go through his website and you should be fine

His websites has way too much material on it and he knows the DiResta has the more preferred teaching methods of the students to which he will not submit to. Load of bs and his exam was extremely difficult unless you did AP Biology in high school or something, avoid avoid AVOID.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Best teacher for bio, easy if you took AP Bio. There's a 5 question quiz at the end of each lecture (you can use the internet). His test material comes straight from his website, so just memorize it and you'll be fine. There's some rlly good Quizlets out there. Also, he'll give you 2 points extra credit just for coming to class sometimes.

Attend every class because a lot of the time hell give extra credit which adds up. When people say learn the website, LEARN THE WEBSITE!! Especially watch the hyperlinks, animations, and videos because theyre on the test. Get help from the TA if youre struggling, mine helped me pass. Go to the workshops and take every opportunity to get points.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Lecture attendance are not mandatory but try to go to every one of them! Sometimes he gives out extra credit for attending the lecture which really helps at the end! Daily quizzes which are based on the previous lecture; 4 Unit Exams and he will let you drop your lowest exam score. Very respected professor! AP Bio experience STRONGLY recommended.
Super kind man but the whole class is based off his website. Lectures are very long and slow so can become uninterested. Lockdown is used for tests. No homework and every day quizzes
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is the best out of all the options but he isn't great. His lectures are very mundane and boring. However, he does have a nice website with concise lecture notes and explanations. There are quizzes every class but they will help your grade since the tests are astronomically hard. The exams are almost impossible but he lets you drop one of them.

reviews.comment: If you can master memorizing a ton of hyperspecific facts that you think are irrelevant, go for it. His half of the BIL255 course is eh, as long as you memorize, you'll be fine. Make sure to click all hyperlinks since he likes taking random information from his website. Outdated way of lecturing. Always had a hard time liking the material.

All of the reviews say to take Mallery and you should because he's the best bil 150 teacher. This does not mean he is a good teacher. He only reads from slides and there is a quiz every class. Be prepared to teach yourself the material!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Be prepared to work hard. Please take AP Bio before - had to drop even tho I am a Stamps Scholar bc I had no prior knowledge. Prof Mallery does not care about his students - I sat in the front for a month and a half & couldn't recognize me out of class. Very impersonal. DO NOT BUY THE BOOK! Not used whatsoever, just his website (memorize it). No hw

Prof Mallory is a really nice guy but this class is difficult. He gives extra credit on random days for coming to class. You get to drop the lowest exam grade so your grade is of 3 tests, the final, workshop, and quizzes. However he will let you work with your peers on the quizzes. I would say he is probably the best 150 teacher at UM!

reviews.comment: Goes fast & covers a lot in lectures so you can't get behind. If you interrupt the lecture to ask a question he'll be kinda rude about it but if you stay after class he's nice & explains well. Tests are exactly what's in the lecture. (also anyone is better than gaines)
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Very long boring lecture... I hardly remembered anything from his speaking. Tests were based on his website information which is very uncomfortable to read and memorize. If you like to sit hours in front of computer and memories million abbreviations and facts without understanding, that you can take this course. He has no connection with student.

If you want the easiest option for BIL150, this is it. If you actually want to learn,,, maybe not. I honestly do not think I learned one thing this semester. Dr. Mallery is so nice and a great guy, but his teaching method with his website was so confusing. It just felt like unbelievable amounts of useless information.

Everything is from his website. There are daily quizzes but they help your grade. The weekly workshops were indeed useless and way too long. I skipped class a lot towards the end cause his website has everything you need. He is so sweet and nice. Overall, tests are really hard as well make sure you study but read the website and you'll be fine.

If you're thinking about taking this course as part of your STEM cognate, don't do it (it's no where near 'basic principles of science'). His lectures are from his website with a million and one hyperlinks. The workshops were not helpful at all- basically just hours of my life that I will never get back.

He teaches all of his material from his class website that he wrote in the early 2000s and hasnt been updated since. If you memorize his website, youll be fine but lectures are pointless as he rambles off topic and then rushes through material once he realizes hes behind. Overall, if you actually want to enjoy bio, do not take him.

Charles is very rude and condescending. However, Di Resta is super nice and understanding. Charles section of the class was the hardest but they do recycle some of their exam questions which you can find online.

reviews.comment: His tests are filled with tiny and random facts from his outdated website. Furthermore, he teaches concepts that directly contradict what is widely accepted in the scientific community; for example, the teaches (and asks on tests!) that all living organisms are constantly moving away from equilibrium. Very confusing! Do not take!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Mallery is a nice man but he lectures from a confusing, outdated website. There are useful videos and animations on it, but you have to dig deep to find them. The curve doesnt exist if youre going for an A, but he passes nearly everyone. Remember, the course is difficult by nature, but Mallery is known to be the easiest BIL150 professor.

Although Professor Mallery is really respected in his field, and probably the best BIL150 teacher, his lectures are really boring and his tests are extremely difficult. He gives out extra credit if you go to class and sometimes he has pop quizzes in class, so just go to class and not do anything!

His lectures are so boring because he is just reading off of his website, it's hard to pay attention. However, if you do zone out all the information will be online which is helpful. He gives extra credit points for attendance sometimes as well as pop quizzes that are worth extra credit. Out of the Biology 150 professors, he's probably the easiest.

reviews.comment: Probably the better of the intro bio teachers at UM. His tests are hard and he doesn't really know how to help you if you don't do well on his tests. But he does curve a lot at the end.

This class is based entirely off of his website which is extremely long and includes many unnecessary hyperlinks. His class is definitely passable if you study ahead of time, however, his test questions can come from even the most minuscule bit of information on the website. 4 tests and a final with one drop test
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He is honestly a really nice guy who really cares about what he teachers. The problem is that the lectures are very boring and you can pretty much teach everything to yourself because he reads off of his website. All his tests are weirdly specific, so you have to read the lectures very thoroughly. Workshops are grade saving. Take this class for A.

Your grade is determined only by the tests you take. Both Mallery and Diresta give pop quizzes, so you have to show up because the pop quizzes add up to an entire test grade. Tests are nearly impossible even if you read his entire website and read the book. Its mandatory for a biology major, so good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I sit in class every single day confused out of my mind. Don't even get me started with his horrible website that has infinite amounts of hyperlinks. I studied weeks in advance for this class and went to every lecture and I am still lost. He just rambles on for over an hour and expects the 130 person class to understand every single random thing.

Decent professor, class isn't easy but still doable. Lectures are hard to follow and his website is impossible to navigate. Test questions include the randomest details from the website, so you have to study everything, but he also curves well.

Hes fine. His website may be the worst and most frustrating thing. I literally still don't understand why he uses it bc it is so confusing and follows no curriculum so the textbook is a waste of money. He curves tho and I heard better than the other bio profs.

Only grades from this class were 2 tests and 1 final along with workshop attendance. No homework or quizzes. One of the easier BIL150 profs at UM. Attendance of lectures is optional. All material can be found on his website that he created for the class. Nature of the course requires lots of studying.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Mallery is not a bad professor by any means, but his teaching abilities are mediocre at best (uses his website).
