Even though attendance isn't mandatory, don't skip!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Pretty much just write a paper and submit it to him by the end of the semester and you'll get an A. Only met the professor once. It was a one credit bio course, but still an easy A and GPA booster. Def recommend
Best bio teacher by far. Grades based on 2 exams and the midterm. Gives so much extra credit so it is important to go to class even if you just chill and don't pay attention.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This class isnt that bad, I scored in the 90s on tests. Watch animations if something isnt clear, study a week in advance and youll get your A. You will have to study but that is every pre-med class. I didnt like his website though so I mostly resorted to animations (esp the ones on his website which are good). Probably went to lecture twice lol
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: This class is really easy as long as you follow and read his website. I would definitely recommend him.

I never ever go to class, go during test and once after to hear him speak about the test and I study his website and purely memorize it and I have found the tests somewhat difficult but have gotten As on the first two. honestly take him bc its such a low maintenance class until the tests come up!
want a good grade? want to understand biology? don't take him! really bad teacher, with a really bad website.

He does not use the textbook AT ALL, highly recommends that you use lecture notes and his website. Website is a little heavy with info, what really helps is using old test banks. I used old tests and there was atleast 20+ same questions. Questions on test are straight forward. TAKE HIM, he curves A LOT!!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Although he is a decent individual, he is not understanding of accommodating his teaching style for his students. His website is ridiculously difficult to follow. If you can memorize every single detail click by click, then you may get an A.

I would not recommend taking Dr. Mallery. His tests were always outrageously specific when he told us that they would be broad. He is completely inaccessible, and when you do ask him a question he just tells you to figure it out. The good things about him are that he gives extra credit if you go to class, and he puts really big curves on his tests
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Not the best bio professor but he curves every test plus the final grade. Sometimes he gives extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Overall, Dr. Mallery is a decent human being but when it comes down to the nitty gritty he is just not one of the best professors. He does not teach out of the textbook like other biology teachers, and instead he has his own website chalk-full of hyperlinks that are impossible to follow. I wish I took a different professor who actually taught.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Mallery is a very kind man who has a long reputation with the university. Truly the best and easiest of the BIL 150 profs, teaches Cell Molec and researches. No set office hours but tests are straightforward and curve is generous. Any committed student will do very well. Extra credit when class is empty!

Does not care about his students and if presented with a correction or a problem he is unapproachable and takes an aggressive stance against the student. His lectures are boring and hard to follow due to his weird website. The information covered in class is too broad of a spectrum and most of the information covered is not on the tests.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Known for his website that he bases all of his lectures and tests on, and this makes his tests difficult. His lectures are incredibly boring and you wont learn a thing, but he does give random extra credit. His curve is the most generous you will ever have, and is your best option for BIL 150 if you care more about your grade than learning.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Worst professor ever, and super boring class. The website that he teaches from is horrible and makes it so difficult to understand what is going on. You won't learn anything at all, but he curves the tests so you will probably do fine in the class. He randomly gives extra credit to people who show up which is nice.

Easiest of the BIL150 professors. Based of his website which he reads off of during class. Gives extra credit for those who show up to class and curves most exams. Do well on his tests because there are no quizzes or homework other than a small workshop grade to boost your final grade.

This class was very easy basically just a vocab test. And he curves so much at the end. He's very boring but I just did other work while he was teaching because he gives extra credit when there's not many people. Definitely the easiest bio teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Everything in the class is based around his online website. The textbook is not needed at all. The class doesn't seem too hard while he's lecturing, but his tests can be challenging because he expects you to know minute details and there is alot of information on the tests. Not the best teacher. Gives extra credit sometimes in class if you're there

If you dont want to show up to a single class ever, take Mallery. You really wont learn from the lectures, just read over his website and memorize every random detail. He gives extra credit sporadically, so either show up and dont do anything or have a friend let you know. tests were very hard b/c details and b/c thats all there is to grade
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Mallory is a cool man. His lectures can occasionally get boring however its crucial to go to class because he gives a lot of extra credit. The test questions can be a bit specific however his curves are super generous and reading the chapters helps you a lot. Paying attention in class and reading will help you greatly. Final grades are curved.

This guy is simply not a good teacher at all. Going to his lectures are a total waste of time. Tests are EXTREMELY specific and sometimes unfair. Very generous curve if you have an F or D, however pretty much impossible to get an A unless you study the past tests days in advance for hours a day. Didn't go to 1 lecture and I got a B (easy C or B).
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: You have to memorize his website lectures in order to do well on tests. The tests are also very specific so it's very difficult to do well if you don't have test banks from upperclassmen or premed411. He's really nice just an awful professor. You only need to go to class for the clicker quizzes because everything needed is online. Would NOT rec.

Compared to the other BIL 150 professors, Mallery doesn't give as much work but his class is still terrible. His lectures come straight from his website, which is links within links within links. His exams (only 2) focus on minute details that don't matter in the long run. Almost impossible to get an A. I'd say about 60-70% got Cs only due to curve

Oh man, what to say about this man. Don't take him if you can. He taught the first half of BIL 255, and both his exams I got a D. His exams are stupid and don't make sense, he teaches from his website he wrote himself but I swear it's just a bunch of random words on a website page that don't form coherent sentences. I enjoyed having Diresta better.

Dr. Malley teaches the first part of BIL 255. He was overall a good professor and I found his lectures interesting. Although his exams are not "easy," they are straightforward-- just know all the power points and go to class. Gives random clicker quizzes so class is mandatory.

Compared to the other two bio professors, you won't have to do as much work, however Mallery is horrible. He only has two tests and the final so if you don't do well on them you're screwed. He pulls very specific and random questions from his website that only consists of links. If you actually want to understand GENERAL bio, don't take him.
His website is freaking terrible. Links within links within links. You have to know it all. Yeah sure he curves but not much and the amount of studying to do well is outrageous.

This class is extremely boring and confusing. There are only 2 tests and a final and that basically makes up your entire grade. Barely anyone goes to class because he just reads directly off his website (which is the book for the class). You can get extra credit on random days for attendance, but not very often. The class is a waste of time tbh.

I despised him after the first test. He can preach to you for hours about complex concepts and then test you on the smallest details. Sometimes even if you did study for hours on end, you might just get bad luck and get tested on insignificant things. The only thing that makes the class worth taking is the insane curves he gives to each test.

Loved class with him! Yes, you have to work for your grade, unless you're cool with getting curved to a C-, which he always does. Tests are tough, but come straight from the powerpoints. It's a little hard to gauge your understanding of the topics with no homework or quizzes. :/ Just go to class and do the iclicker "quizzes"- you'll be fine

If you go to class, you know what to study and Mallery gives extra credit. Diresta's PPT's are clearer. You cant get everything from Premed411 tests but it does help. If you use the textbook to clarify the in class lectures, you can get an A. Lectures are long and its super easy to zone out so if you're going to do that, just don't go.

He is incredibly smart, but very very boring. Gives extra credit for people who show up to class when no one else does. Tests are hard, but come straight from his website. Problem is, the website lectures are long and have so many links it is hard to study it all.

As a biology major, I believe him and Diresta are the worse professors for biology I have ever taken. The test are extremely difficult and not related to the textbook and barely related to the powerpoints in class. Going to class is completely useless and boring, don't go. Highly disliked this course and the only Biology course where I got a B.

He's a nice guy, kinda funny in a dorky way, but like most Biology professors, he's not very interesting. Lectures are read right off the online notes (which are incredibly confusing in and of itself) and the exams are nigh impossible unless you have a really strong background in Biology. You won't get high scores unless you devote a lot of time.

I took Mallery over the summer, most likely received a B+ or A- (just because of crunch time, if you take him over the regular semester, you'll be fine.) The key is to read the material and do the workshops as he takes a lot of questions from there. Show up to class because he gives extra credit.  Super nice and always there to help. Take him!

He presents from a website so I never had to take any notes for the class. He tests from the website so I just memorized the website lectures. The tests for this class in general are ridiculously hard and specific. I took it with Mallery and Diresta and both of them lied about what will be on the test, like not testing on history or specific aminos

Great teacher, however some people get confused with the online notes but if you go to class you know what to study. Test are not to difficult, basically memorize what was said in lectures you should do fine. Doesn't have set office hours, but can schedule an appointments and he is very willing to help. Gives out extra credit so go to class.

If you go to class you get extra credit which is extremely helpful if you mess up on one of the three exams.  You don't really have to go to class if you took AP bio in high school, but you should make sure someone gives you the extra credit code if you don't go.  Better than Gaines but still not good.  Memorize everything on his website.

His lectures are all on his website, although the website is a little annoying and it could get confusing on what you actually need to read. The class itself is long and boring, but he will give extra credit for attendance if not many people show up. Tests are worded poorly, but overall if you study and go to class they should be easy. AP Bio helps
Gives extra credit for attendance

DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. I've never struggled more in a class in my whole life. His website (that he created for the class) is the most disorganized thing -- and if you ever come to him and ask for clarification on something, he will just redirect you to the website!! Seriously, don't do it.

The website is insanely annoying. I tried to pay attention and take notes at the beginning but ended up making my own copies of the slides and memorizing those.  All I learned from the class was how to cram.  I managed high B's on the first 2 tests and still got a 46 on the final because I didn't remember anything. Extra credit but very hard class.

If you took AP bio, this class will be really easy for you. I ended with a B- and I skipped most of the classes. You get extra credit for going to class sometimes. He is the easiest of the Bio 150 professors at UM

Taking his tests is like answering trivia questions. Everything on his tests are from a website that is impossible to understand since it's hideously disorganized. He does curve his tests and the class, but that's the only positive thing I have to say about him. If you can manage to memorize his entire website, you're golden.
Incredibly boring and hard to follow. Need to teach yourself everything. Website is so unorganized and impossible to study from.

Didn't enjoy his lectures, quite boring and not interactive - just reading off the website. I hear he used to be the greatest asset to the bio department, but now it seems like he's lost some of that zeal that could of made this class more interesting and fun.

Very ineffective teacher that uses a disorganized and impossible-to-manage website. He will asterisk full wikipedia articles. He doesn't expect you to know all of the material from those links but that makes it confusing to know what to study. Ineffective and a disappointing class-I expect better teaching methods from UM.

If you want to learn, I don't recommend taking this professor. He just reads off of his powerpoint slides and isn't very helpful. If you're fine with skipping class and cramming the powerpoint slides in before the test, you're fine. He asks very random detailed questions from his power points and deviated from premed411 last semester.
Boring, Everyone gets a C. Nice & easier than other biology teachers.

Mallery is a very kind professor, but is boring as hell. Not only that he's exam are extremely hard. I do recommend him over every other bio teacher. Everyone passes with a C, not a lot of B's and definitely not a lot of A's.

Dr. Mallery knows his stuff when it comes to Biology. His class is EXTREMELY easy if you make the time to READ all his online notes.His tests are based solely on his notes online. It helps if you go to class for extra credit points but it really isn't mandatory.

I hear at one point he was literally the best professor at UM. Though I think since then, he's lost a lot of his zeal and just does it now to make a living. Understandably, he's an older gentleman and he does know his biology, but I feel as though he's not very approachable & tends to ignore questions. Which can be very discouraging to attend class

Mallery is not a good professor. This class is SO difficult if you have no foundation of Biology. This is because HE DOESN'T TEACH. He reads definitions off his website (which is the worst thing you could imagine) and his tests are unpredictable and unreasonably tricky and difficult. Unless you're a genius in bio, don't expect to enjoy this class.
he says excetera 60 to 100 times   a class, often when it isn't appropriate. such as the bases in DNA are A, T, G, C ect. but he's so much better than glasser so enjoy him while you have him.

No point in going to class, he basically reads off of his website. Memorize everything on the website, go to all of the workshops and have a friend inform you about the occasional extra credit he gives out and you're guaranteed at least a B. He puts me to sleep, but he's a nice guy.

His tests are actually easy because they come straight from his slides -- and premed411 helps a lot. He's very knowledgeable and his gives extra credit just for showing up; but he there isn't much engagement in the classroom. Sometimes it's difficult to get his attention when you have a question during lecture.

Dr. Mallery is a very smart professor. I really enjoyed his class. MEMORIZE HIS WEBSITE SLIDES!!!! It's a lot of information but if you put in the effort you'll get an A. Also, go to class!! He gives a lot of extra credit, and go to the biology workshops! They count for 50 points of your total grade. He also takes test questions from the workshop materials. His Final is HARD!! Study and you'll do fine because he's a great professor.

Compared to other Biology 150 professors (Wilson and Gaines) he is the easiest professor. His lectures are very boring, attendance is not mandatory, but when there are very few students in class he gives the extra credit so you have to be on the look out for the extra credit. I would also recommend the textbook just to get some background info.

No textbook required. All information is on his website. Even though others say that you do not need to go to class to get an A, going to class helps some..and he gives extra credit every so often if not a lot of people show to the lecture. His curve in the class is incredible! If you really want to learn bio, I'd take gaines; but mallery is easy A

For Mallery's section, the class website has everything you will need to know for the test. You can read the textbook, but this is not needed if you understand the content of the website. Go to class for his extra credit "pop"-quizzes, and study some for the test. Curves are usually pretty generous. Got an A. Definitely easier than Skromne.

All bio classes are a ton of reading and studying if you want to do well. His class is the same. Compared to other teachers(like Kremples), test questions are much clearer.If you don't care to do well and just want to get by, grades on a nice bell curve.Hard to fail, but most likely you'll get a C. Lectures are able to be followed.Prob best choice.

For the Mallery portion of this course: Read his notes before hand, use the book to further your understanding of concepts, attend class to really understand how he wants you to remember things. He gives you all of the tools needed to get an A, you just need to care enough.

Very boring professor.  No reason to attend class bc all the notes are on powerpoint.  However, he gives points for attending class and the whole class is graded on a curve so attendance is recommended.

Not an easy class. Glaser's material is so boring just try to study all of his old tests. Mallery's section is doable, study his website as much as you can, along with the old tests. A lot of memorization in this class

Great professor. Tests are extremely fair, and curves are given if the class does poorly. Dr. Mallery really knows what he is talking about and has great lectures. Attendance is not mandatory and the book is optional, but going to class is recommended because he gives out a lot of extra credit. Great guy, great class; take Mallery!

All the notes are online and attendance is not mandatory - but I highly recommend going. He sometimes gives extra credit for showing up and the material is a lot easier to understand when you hear him explain it. No book needed, waste of money. He's a really sweet guy. Tests aren't too bad, just study with premed411. He reuses some old questions.

His class is not that bad. You will need to study hardcore before his tests though considering there is only three. I usually study a week before. I am currently taking him. I got an A on the first test and a B on the second. He is really generous with his curves. Go to class even though it's not mandatory, he gives extra credit out a lot!

I have never had a professor deliberately try to trick a class before. He knows all about premed411 now, so studying old exams doesn't at all help. His notes are very unorganized and don't help with studying either. The only reason to come to class is for the extra pop clicker quizzes.

AWESOME class. I totally loved him! All of his material comes from his online lectures so the book isn't really needed. He's adorable and cares a lot for his students. Makes really good curves. Got an A in his class. Take him for bio!
must work hard to get good grade.  big curve
Lectures were boring, rarely ever went. I made simpler notes from his complicated, colorful online notes and that helped me learned the material better. What saves you is the curve...

B O R I N G. I NEVER went to class, barely EVER studied and got a C. Curve is amazing. Everything is online, don't waste your money on the book. He definitely knows his stuff but damn is that class boring. I wouldn't recommend taking this class w/ him but then again it was a piece of cake to pass haha.

really really boring class. you dont have to go or study and youll pass. minimum effort for a c. Hes a really nice guy if you ever talk to him. He is very responsive to questions outide of class and really wants to help his students. knowledgeable, but boring.

A lot of material for each test! His tests were based off his website and old tests that are on PREMED411. Go to class because he gives a lot of extra credit. Huge curves on each test. Questions on the tests are super specific. He knows his stuff for sure, but the class is super boring to sit through
Just read the website. Very easy class.

Smart man. Knows what he's talking. No need to buy the book, everything is from an online website. I crammed and barely studied and got a C, if you study you should get an A. His grading scale is ridiculously soft, curve is awesome. A LOT of material to study though.

The lectures are very boring. Usually I brought with other homework to do during the class. I attended because once in a while he will give you extra credit just for coming. I found that reading the textbook was very helpful when I didn't understand what he was talking about. ALL the test material is out of his online lectures. ALL OF IT.

His lectures are so boring. You dont have to go to class, but it does help becuase he throws around extra credit every once in a while. He wants you to pretty much memorize his entire website for the test, so the tests are pretty hard but he puts a curve so that almost evreyone passes with atleast a C-
hard class but doable
Horrible. Torturous.

He teaches the 1st half of BIL 255 (Glaser the 2nd half). His half is much easier than Glaser's. Go to class to hear his explanations & what he emphasizes from his site. He'll also mention things you don't have to learn & give extra credit. Everything from his test is found on the website. If you understand the concepts from the site, test is easy.

class is ok. a little confusing the way he teaches with the computer program and everything but tests aren't that bad wish he had more than two tests during the semester though. attendance isnt mandatory but going to class does help,but the lectures are really boring!
I really liked him. He explains things really well and wants his students to do well in his class.

honestly, his favorite word is et cetera; he rambles on about stuff, he knows what he's talking about and is good at it, but he is just so boring and monotoned.  tests are easy, multiple choice; i dont ever go to class, if you study his website, your well off.

The class is very boring. His website has everything he goes over in class, so you don't have to go to get notes. The tests are very difficult and cover EVERYTHING on his website. Copies of old tests are on premed411.com, but not many of the questions are reused. Avoid his class if you can, unless you want to spend weeks studying for every test.

Boring, not worth going to class, yet gives extremely difficult tests that there is no clear way to study for. no study guides or specific guidelines given as to what to study, expects every detail to be known. do anything you can not to take cell molec with him.
Boring lectures, difficult tests because of it...

BEST BIO TEACHER EVER.  Gives you a packet with all of his notes and powerpoints.  All of his lectures are from these packets and notes online.  Just study his notes online hardcore and you will get a good grade.  test questions are easy. nice guy.

he is a great guy and knows his stuff. he says you dont need the book and he is right. his test questions come straight from the packet he gives you the first day.  he tests are hard and require a lot of thought and studying. lectures seem difficult but all the stuff he talks about is not on the exam.

Usually there are 200 kids in your class. So no 1 on 1. He's ok except that his lectures are so random and he goes on way too fast. You can go to the lectures...but it probably won't help you much. PS: Even when he says not to really study for the test off the book...don't listen! The book is a better teacher.
Took him a while ago, but basically no use of textbook (dont buy it, esp if you take prince for 160) read the powerpoint... thats basically it

This professor only appears to know what he is talking about. This website based class is not an adequate way to learn the course material.  The website is not user friendly and it is hard to navigate what material you are responsible for. I attend another university and after taking this summer course, I will never take another class at UM
Very well spoken and logical Professor. Exams are based off the powerpoint presentations and book, they are very detailed and quite difficult. Good class, you just have to work for the grade.

A little boring but very clear.  Tests come straight from powerpoints.  Try to do well on his tests because they are easier than Glaser's who teaches the second half of the course.  If you go to him with questions sometimes he's nice, other times he's very dismissive.
not so clear and kinda boring, but he knows his stuff. it was fairly easy to get a good grade.

I actually think Mallery is the easiest for 150. His tests ae straightforward off his slides, you dont even need to use the textbook which is 3490348 pages long. He might be boring durign lectures but i think it pays off to take him. His curve is also very good, but the C range is huge.
class was useless if you want to learn from the teacher about biology. Intense reading and tutoring required if you actually want to understand what the hell this man is talking about during class!
Class is team taught between Mallery and another. Tests are hard and require a lot of studying although most of it you can learn on your own and dont need to go to class.

I loved this class with Dr. Mallery.  He teaches from his own website, so you don't have to read the book.  All of the material on his tests is found on the website, which is pretty straightforward.  While the material isn't always easy, he explains it well, so if you go to class and review the notes the tests are very do-able.

He is a very knowledgeable professor,but lectures may not always be interesting.He is really good in explaining protein.He has very interesting links on his web page.I still use it todayeven though i left this class three years ago

This class was extremely boring. I could not help but skip this class (which was ok, since attendance was not taken). I am normally interested in Biology, however Mallery's lectures were uninsightful. I disliked the class either because of the monotony of his voice or his lack of enthusiasm when presenting material. Tests were easy however.

Lectures are very long, boring, and confusing, but his tests are very manageable if you study.  You don't really have to go to his lectures, but he says that he may throw in a pop quiz from time to time (which never happened).  Dont have to read the book because he posts his notes online and his tests follow the notes, but it does help to read it.

Overall, Dr. Mallery is a good professor. He really wants his students to succeed. The class is tought by Mallery 1/3 of the term, and by Glaser 2/3 of the term. Dr. Glaser's tests are extremely difficult, but the class is graded on a curve. Bring a pillow to Dr. Glasers lectures; regardless, they are both great people!

Dr. Mallery is a really cool guy but lectures are pretty boring. All of the tests are from his online notes and studying old tests is very helpful but they are difficult and studying is necesscary. Definitely the easiest of the three BIL 150 teachers though.
Class is boring, tests are kind of difficult but If you study well and review old tests you will do fine. Only 3 tests total with the final so dont mess up a test.
Mallery's lectures are usually very difficult to follow in class. But do not get discouraged becasue his tests are not hard. He is definetly the teacher you should take for BIO 150.

Difficult class if you have no prior knowledge in biology. Lecture are not clear but his he gives alot of extra credit. His notes are all you need for his exams, test are not too difficult just read over his notest. Huge curves but not helpful if your already in the C range.

I took Mallery for summer term 1. The timing sucked since classes were at 8:30am. I didn't use the textbook at all! he never uses it so just study his slides and turn up to class. he gives a lot of extra points for being in class if no one turns up and he curves the exams! i hardly studied but turned up to class everyday and got an A-

I took him for summer ad he is amazing. Dont buy the book unless ur taking 160. He goes completely off his slides and workshops for his tests. Availble at his office most of the time and keeps the class interesting.
Pretty good teacher whose test material is solely from the class slides.  Kinda funny and has his unique way of keeping your attention.  A few "announced" pop-quizzes with bonus points.

He posts all his notes online on his website. He gives you a packet at the begining of the semester with all the notes for the whole semester. Hes super nice and hes a great teacher. The subject is a bit tedious but he tries to make it as fun as possible. Hes the best science professor I've had at the U so far.

Excellent Professor! Dr. Mallery is very knowledgeable. Unlike many of the science professors here at UM, Mallery KNOWS HOW TO TEACH. He is an extremely fair grader, and wants his students to actually learn! I definitely recommend him, What a great guy!
Kinda boring in lecture, knows his stuff, lame jokes, tests are very detailed but the curve was HUGE, i def recommend him
he's a cool guy...notes are posted online...tests are difficult but he curves alot so you won't do too bad..but overall the class was hard.

Hardest bio class I ever took. He gives pop quizzes sometimes so you have to go to class now even though he doesn't take attendance. He is hard to pay attention to because he is so boring. He does put a lot of curve though on the tests. If you're willing to study a lot I'd say take him.

mallery was very easy. u didnt have to go to lectures. everything u wud be tested on was on his website. if u basically studied the online notes u were fine. and he also gives tremendous curves which def help. i got Bs on the first two tests until his curve boosted me up to 2 Bs. he also seems really nice.

First off the guy below is clearly an idiot. His tests are not that difficult and usually cover 6 chapters at the most. I miss quite a few lectures, I study a couple nights before the test, first test was a C+, second was an A. Tests are worded a little weird sometimes but overall Mallery is a great professor.

HORRIBLE.......his tests are on like 11 chapters...you never know what to study since there is a million things to know....he curves but it doesn't do anything.....half the class fails the other half gets C's and theres like 10 A's and B's the genius's who will be doctors kinda thing

Although he is funny, and friendly I would not recommend Mallery if you have never taken a Biology class before or have taken one very recently.  When he explains things he jumps straight to the conclusion, and never mentions on how you got there.  This poses a serious problem for students who have no formal background.
awesome teacher
No Comments
Very straightforward class. His notes are clear and easy to understand. Tests are based on notes with no tricks or anything. He is surprisingly approachable to ask questions to.
Awful class boring learned nothing

Easy teacher. All his notes are online so you really don't need to go to class. Old tests are online too. As long as you study the old tests and go over notes online you should be fine. Going to class can sometimes help though cause he does hint at times for what questions he will put on the exams.

Pros: All notes online (tests from notes= don't need book). q's get harder, but most recycled from old exams found online, etc. curved grades Cons: tons of notes to read through, takes a while to print Tip: 1 page test Q's from online interactive test q's. diagrams fr workshops

She has her own research that she shares about that is very interesting. She's welcoming in the classroom and encourages discussion. She reads a slideshow each class and the tests were online. She will help you with understanding things if you go to her. She was very clear about how she wanted projects to be done. Overall good experience.
Lebron is an amazing professor. She is truly passionate about her work and it shows through her lectures. Fairly easy class to end with an A if you attend lecture and take notes. Loved her.

Super passionate about public health but exams were extremely tough and no study guides were ever posted. You have over 200 slides per unit to study and while the content isnt that bad, its harder than it needs to be for an intro class
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took this class for a cognate and it was not too hard. The slides are posted on blackboard and the tests are online. Attendance is not mandatory but make sure you have a good group of the semester long group project that is worth 55% of your grade.

Lectures are boring. Tests are on respondus lockdown but are pretty easy if you just review your slides/notes. Your grade consists a lot on a semester-long group project with many parts to it so choose your group wisely. She is a caring person though and always willing to help. Easy course if you put in the necessary work and turn it in on time.

Light class and Prof. Lebron is very nice. Attendance wasn't mandatory and she usually just read off the slides and told some stories in between. There was one group project that was easy. All tests were online at home on Respondus and were easy enough if you read the slides.

Dr. Lebron was a good prof. The lectures are boring when she isn't talking about something she is passionate in. The work is pretty straightforward, but the group work is what's going to hurt your grade. The exams aren't too bad just go over the lectures.

Dr. Lebron is an amazing professor. She is extremely kind and caring and is truly passionate about her career. She presents her lectures in a way that is easy to understand. There is a semester-long group project that is worth a large percentage of your grade so choose your groups wisely. I would re-take this class in a heartbeat!

Dr. Lebron clearly cares about her job and public health. She has interesting lectures and explains things well. Tests aren't hard if you pay attention and study. Group project is a big part of your grade, so try to get a group that will actually work hard as some things are graded for the group. I recommend taking her class

Literally the goat, super nice, very helpful, easy to understand lectures and material. Discussions are always open and informative. Group projects are very manageable if everyone does their work. Tests are extremely easy if you pay attention during class. Would take again, 10/10.

Very kind professor. You can tell Lebron cares about her students, and she is passionate about the content she teaches. Exams are very straightforward- she tells you what will be on them. Most of the class is based on a group project but she walks you through each assignment. Very clear grader, do what she asks and you will get an A.

Professor Lebron was a really great professor! Lectures were engaging and tests were easy. Two tests during the semester and a take home final that was open note. The main part of this class is the semester long group project. She's a really easy grader and shows a lot of interest in her students. Very laid back and respects her students' work

Basic class, a little annoyed that she ignored my email about helping my bad exam grade, students would never know if we were learning or doing group projects, you've got to study very hard for the exams since they are NOT straightforward, and nobody ever paid attention during class, honestly made no difference if this class was online overall.
Really great professor. Gets right to the point and provides relatable experiences to explain new topics. She gives you all the resources to get an A. Would def take again. 10/10

She is AMAZING! She really interacts with the class every lecture. You are graded solely by 3 exams and one huge project, that's super fun and easy. Her tests are also really easy if you pay attention in class.

My favorite professor this semester, and my favorite class. Super funny, kind, caring, and knowledgable. Class is fairly easy, two "exams" called quizzes which are directly from the powerpoints and multiple choice and the final exam was cumulative and short answers. Would take her again no question, I really enjoyed the semester.

Professor Lebron is very kind, funny and her lectures are engaging and interesting. Has 2 exams which she calls quizzes but are not tricky, just study the powerpoints and youll get a good grade. The final exam is open note and it is cumulative. She has ONE group project but with many assignments throughout the semester. I would take her again

Professor Cordes is honest although she is subjective in her grading. Trick questions pop up in the tests. There are a lot of assignments for this class but she provides you with the needed information to get a good grade. You need to go to class to get participation points because she ALWAYS takes attendance. Study hard and you'll be rewarded.

I've taken her for 302 and 307, and I don't understand the negative reviews. Her material is clear and organized. She gives you study guides so you know exactly what topics are going to be asked on the tests. She has a sarcastic sense of humor, but she'll like you if you just do what you're supposed to do.
She is very helpful and really cares about her students. Ask for help and you will get it, don't and you won't.
Dr. Cordes is such a good professor. She really knows a lot of the HR field. She is a tough grader but she is probably the best professor for this class. Take her you will not regret it.

She is a terrible teacher she just discusses all day how women are undervalued, underused and under-appreciated. Huge feminist.. If your a male you already start -10 points. Her solution to the worlds problems is put women in charge of everything. Her class is useless and makes everything harder than it needs to be. Overall embarrassment to PhD's
Horrible.

Probably the worst teachers I've ever had at UM. She is extremely subjective in her grading, and grades are not assigned on the quality of work but rather on her model of an 'ideal student.'  Take any other mgt professor and DEFINITELY DONT TAKE THE HONORS SECTION!! She has office hours but going in to talk to her probably won't do anything but low

She was the worst teacher I have ever had! She's very bland and not helpful and gets off by making fun of students in the class. If you are a happy person, don't show it in class. She's not personable and if you so much as smile, she will not like you. Major personality clashes. Won't give writing credit for the tons of papers either.

She is extremely subjective in her grading and if she likes you, you'll do well.  If she doesn't, you're screwed.  The class doesn't teach anything and she doesn't listen to student's concerns about grades.  She assigns grades not based on the quality of your work as teachers are supposed to do but whether you follow her model of an 'ideal student'

GREAT Teacher! You will have to study for tests, 10 page group paper at the end, she grades fair, a lot of little assignments that help bring your grade up, strict on attendance, you will learn a lot! Can be a little boring at times, but its not hard to get an A if you study for tests

If you do your work and study you will get an A. There is a 10 page group paper, which she makes you do an outline, rough draft, and final draft, must be submitted via safe assignment. She gives you study guides for the exams, make sure to READ the questions twice before you answer the exam as they can be tricky...

made class way harder than it had to be. very tricky tests that are confusing and can trip you up. did not really instill interest at all. i feel as though my class experience would have been better with another teacher because the material was at least somewhat interesting.

Her tests are extremely hard and its as if she studies how to trick you. She takes 2 attendances during the 3 hour class and accepts nothing late. This class is an easy class but not with her. HOwever she is a great professor who knows how to capture your attention. But its a class you have to work hard in or else its very easy to fall behind.

Mrs. Cordes is so awesome! If you take her 3 hour class expect to stay the whole time every time, but she is so much more fun that any other teacher!!!! Her tests can be hard, lot of studying but she is def a great teacher

She's difficult, but if you do your work and study you will get an A. There is a 10 page group paper, which she makes you do an outline, rough draft, and final draft. There are extra credit opportunities. No review for exam, but she gives you study guides that are very helpful.

Anyone rating this class 5 star difficulty is genuinely cooked for the rest of their degree. Don't let them scare u. Great professor, PLENTY of extra credit questions on exams (up to 15pts) and makes learning about the human body interesting and simple. Note: he calls on people randomly to answer questions so study ahead if you're on the shy side.

Anatomy is a hard class, you will have to put in effort to receive a good grade. Everything you need to know is in the lectures/slides. He's thorough in his explanations and accessible outside of class. Be ready to study, most of your grade is comprised of two exams but if you put in the work you'll be just fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class is VERY difficult, each test is roughly 400 terms. BUT, thats just how this course goes. You need to study a lot and be prepared every lecture to take rigorous notes. Serravite and his TAs are such good teachers, just make sure to never miss office hours. Do not take this course with other difficult stem courses, too much to memorize
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's incredibly accessible outside of class. Will drop anything to meet with you and make sure you understand the class. Your success in the course, though, really does depend on you. You have to be ready to memorize many terms and functions, so its 80% teach yourself, but thats just the nature of the course.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Silveira is a good lecturer and the quizzes and exams were fair, just make sure to read the textbook and pay attention in lecture. Attendance is not mandatory but I recommend attending lectures as I thought they were helpful. The class itself just covers difficult material so you have to study but we did have group quizzes which was great.

This class was hard to study because the tests can be either very broad or very specific. The lectures don't provide much information. Extremely reliant on the textbook, but even then, that won't help.
Quizzes are easier since you can use your peers. The only thing that saved me in this class was the grading style and the final exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I wouldn't recommend taking this class unless you learn strictly from the textbook. I attended all lectures and they did not help me. For the most part, her exam questions are easy/simple, but sometimes some make absolutely no sense and was not even a topic in the textbook or lecture. So just know the content well and you will do fine.

nothing she says in lecture is on exams so honestly read the textbook. most exam questions are copy paste from mastering hw so rly do the crap out of the mastering. most of grade is from hw and workshop so dont miss those. didnt go to lectures more than three times and still got an A. not a great teacher so if u dk how to study its hard to get an A

Very easy teacher and does online no lockdown tests but don't learn anything and she isn't the best at teaching but is a nice lady

This class was simply a joke. All the exams were online and she dropped the lowest of three midterm exams. Silveira is a scientist not a professor! She doesn't know how to teach material so you can understand it. You will be teaching yourself all of the material. However, she is said to be the easiest BIL150 professor. Good luck.

Silveira is probably one of the best Bio professors at UM if you want an easy A. Her quizzes/exams are online with no lockdown so take what you will with that info. She was the easiest professor for this class. She really cares but I found her lectures were all over the place and not organized great. Would recommend tho!

Best choice for BIL150. Weekly quizzes and 4 exams, all of which are online outside of class (except for final). Mastering bio is time consuming but easy and a good study source for exams. Shes a very nice lady. I feel like she is one of the easier bio profs compared to the others. Make sure to do all the mastering biology hw and show up to all the workshops. Super easy because all exams are online, except the final so beware. super knowledgable but not the best teacher but its ok cause she cares so much about her students you can always go to office hours but don't bother emailing her

Silveira is probably the best your gonna get here for bio. Avoid if at all possible. Constantly changing expectations for projects and assignments (it's hard as a student to hit a moving target), talks down to students, and just generally rude. Doesn't actually know very much about sustainability and the environment either. Would not recommend.

The class could get confusing because he would tend to contradict himself and the book. There are a lot of assignments that were easy to do but hard to keep track of. Professor Hicks was confusing, mostly because when I had him it was his first semester as a professor. However, the people complaining about this class are being ridiculous. The homework was so quick. He gives you an A on the quizes as long as you score an 80 or above. Overall, it was a very  easy class and he was so experienced in the field.

Professor Hicks left me confused about everything. He directly contradicts the textbook and stuff I have previously learned in other classes. Expect homework and quizzes almost every class. Prof. Hicks takes time to talk to every student about their papers, and knows the subject matter. Lots of homework but it's not that difficult. Professor Hicks is a hot mess and he contradicts himself all the time. He assigns homework from the textbook almost every class and there are quizzes on the material in the textbook in class. really passionate about what she teaches, hard class but holds office hours and study review sessions before exams. grade consists of two exams and the final and then 10% attendance. you just have to study and you'll be fine gives us slideshows so you dont really need to read the textbook.
