Do the reading, or the very least study her slides/lectures, and there's no reason you shouldn't do well. Her exams are extremely straightforward and she never uses difficult wording/phrasing in her questions to try and trick you
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Respected

reviews.comment: she's amazing, tests are easy to pass if you just study the slides. final isn't cumulative.

Great professor and very caring person. There are only 2 exams and the final but the exams are pretty straight forward. Easily accessible outside of class and even offers review sessions before each exam.

Such a great teacher. Actively cares about her students, makes her lectures fun, and makes her tests pretty easy. Most of the class is based on 3 tests you take throughout the year, and if you spend a couple hours the night before looking at her lecture slides, you will get an A. Attendance is graded by quizzes but its curved at the end of the year

Davidson is very nice. Attendance was not mandatory and you can still do fine on the tests if you don't go. She posts the slides, and all of the info on the tests is also on the slides. The textbook did not help much. She only gives three tests and two other small grades which makes the class hard because they cover so much material.
This class could be easy. The exams are very hard for no reason and she doesn't prepare you well for tests.

Although she is very lecture heavy she is very passionate about her job. There is 3 tests for the class which counts for 80% of your grade, 3 current event papers worth 3% each and a final project on the country she assigns you worth 11%. If you show up take notes and pay attention the tests will be manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: As hard as this class was, Professor Davidson-Schmich makes it easy. If you're not a fan of reading, this is not the class for you. Professor Schmich takes the time to genuinely explain what she assigns and answers any concerns students may have. She is always rooting for her students and cares about them.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Loved this class! Midterm & final exams were difficult and required studying; the term paper was graded very tough, but the pre-paper assignments timed throughout the semester helped to break up the work in preparation. Active participation goes a long way. She's very opinionated, enthusiastic about electoral systems, and has dry humor in lectures.

I have taken two of Professor Davidson-Schmichs classes, and would definitely recommend her. Although she is a tough grader and attendance/participation matter, she is also very understanding if you have to miss class. Reading is necessary. In summary: you will need to apply yourself, but she will provide all of the necessary tools to do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I genuinely enjoyed this class as hard as it was. It was one of those classes you dont mind putting work in. she's the cutest little thingy and was alwasy so helpful for office hours. I loved to participate even if you're wrong in your answer she validates you. I genuinely learned in this class. Put in work and show true effort and you will love it
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--So many papers

reviews.comment: If you have absolutely NO IDEA about women's issues/have been living under a rock, maybe take this class. But if you do know the basics, you won't learn anything new. 1 research paper+midterm paper+final paper about 30 pgs- and a presentation. Tough grader if you cant write. Rational if it's your thing. MUST actually READ and PARTICIPATE in class
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: You will learn a lot in her class, although your grade might not reflect it. She is a pretty tough grader and there are very few things graded. This class is not an automatic A, be prepared to work for it. She doesn't put in grade, so if you are one of those people constantly checking your grade pick another Professor.
Great professor! You definitely have to put some work in but she makes the class interesting and not tough! Her exams are very straight forward! over all I would recommenced taking her class

She is an amazing professor, you have to put some effort in but she puts the effort in to. If you come prepared to class having done the readings you will get a lot more out of class. She really likes to get the class engaged by asking questions, do the reading and speak in class and you will benefit. I'd recommend having her for an 300+ lvl class

Take the same class with another professor. Very unclear on what she wants. Contradicts herself. Do not take if you need it for a requirement. Other professors are better! Despite all the negativity, she is very knowledgable on she attempts to get across.
Very devoted professor! Take her only if you are ready to WORK HARD! But if you do, you can consider that you are really learning!

Once you get past the silly classroom etiquette stuff she's a great professor, really clear in her lectures, if you take tons of notes there is no need to read the books.attendance is mandatory, can't be tardy. available to help, i suggest going to her office hours she takes it into consideration. all in all good professor & pretty easy to get an A

Great professor, but really tough. Class only has 3 grades: midterm, final, and thought paper. GO TO EVERY CLASS!! and take notes because what she says is a lot easy and less dense than the textbook. it's a lot of information but she makes it pretty easy even funny at times. would definitely recommend

Don't enroll in this class if you don't want to come to every class and take notes. However, if you are willing to do, so it is a great class! She is very clear, has her funny moments, and manages to allow considerable discussion for a 100 person lecture hall class.

Great Professor. You have to come to class regularly because her exams come from her lecture notes, but her lectures are easy to follow and pretty interesting. Don't really need to do the readings for 381.

So i read alot of the comments on her prior to taking her class, and in addition to the interest i already had for the subject, i was excited. Well that excitement was short lived to say the least. I personally believed that her tests were ridiculous, they were paragraph long multiple choice ?s and she took off outrageous points for her essays :(

Compared to other polisci proffs i've taken she is by far the most straight forward. Lectures are well explained in a simplified way, and you don't really have alot of reading to do to pass this class. Take advantage of her office hours as she will help you. Essays are a bit tough but multiple choice is exactly the study guide so study it to the T.

Boring class with very strict classroom policies (no computer use, bathroom use looked down upon exc...) However, her lectures are very clear and well laid out and not a lot of reading assigned. Gives study guide detailing what she will ask on each test so multiple choice portion is easy, but she is a very severe grader on the essays.

knows her stuff. strict classroom policy to stow your cellphones. also, no tardies are allowed. classroom etiquette aside, Dr. Davidson-Schmich captivates her audience with her lectures. worth your money.

A bit of a pain since she doesn't allow electronics in class, have to take notes by hand. But her lectures are really clear and always answers questions thoroughly. She NEVER awards 100%. Always thinks there is room for improvement, but all in all pretty good professor and its pretty easy to get an A- at least.

This class is so boring. She has banned computers-so good luck taking notes because her powerpoints are useless(when she can get the computer to work) and she never can get the microphone to work. Everything you need to know is in the textbook, the lectures add nothing.
I really liked her and the way she taught. She really knwos the topic and make it interesting. Shes always awesome about office hours and extremely nice. I definitely would take her again.

Good teacher, do the readings to do well on quizes  She tells you the test questions before the test so theres no reason not to do well... Her lectures can seem long sometimes but her antidotes do keep it interesting and give another way to remember the information.
This professor is really nice and extremly helpful. She explains everything so well that you almost don´t need to study for the final if you have read the book. I learned a lot.

BEST TEACHER! Her lectures are super clear and easy to follow. As long as you go to class, take good notes, and read the book a little bit, you should be fine. Overall a great person though. Only two tests, all multiple choice and an interesting 5 page paper that is fun to write.
so far my favorite professor! so helpful . so clearly...

Easy course there are 3 midterms worth 40% of your grade where one gets dropped. 20% cumulative final but not hard. The rest is a group project, HW and participation but up to 5% of extra credit for your two midterms so if you do well you can have over a 100% average going into the final. Tests are made up of HW questions so if you study it is easy

Lectures aren't very interesting to follow.  Best thing to do is just study the homework but even then exams are pretty hard, although you get a cheat sheet.  Makes you get a bunch of subscriptions like for Top Hat, and makes you do a very tedious CFA course as part of the grade.  Class isn't particularly difficult.

Prof. Dolores is a great teacher. Shes understanding and kind and honestly, the course just isn't that hard the way she teaches it. She records herself doing practice problems on zoom and uploads it which helps you create a study guide for the midterms. Then take the study guide and practice with the Pearson questions. This is at least a B
Nice lady but if you take this class late at night you are cooked

I had her for FIN 302 and FIN 320. The classes are designed to be challenging, so people saying "ugh its so hard" well duh, that is a college course. she lets u have a cheat sheet and is eager to meet with students who need more help outside of class. She has reviews before exams that are recorded on zoom and are exactly what will be on the exam.

A very nice motherly person, but horrible at teaching. Exams are very difficult and lectures are very hard to follow. Had to learn the material by myself through her powerpoints and hw. I Don't recommend.

Really good person. Class was basically graded on HWs (which u get sm time to do), 2 midterms (50% total, and the curve blessed), and a group project. Was really interesting to talk to about financial markets, if you're into that stuff. Goated. Would take again.

Very nice and pleasant, but the class is rough. The class is a bit unorganized and exams are harder than necessary because the lectures aren't always clear and don't always match the content of the HW/review. She does make an effort to help though, which is nice.

VERY VERY nice lady but her class is extremely boring if you don't care about finance. She lectures the whole class. 4 midterms and on tophat with lockdown browser and you can take a cheat sheet. One is dropped. I thought her exams were hard. She also has homework due on the exam day.
do not know what is going on, tests were harder than needed to be, very unorganized, kind woman tho and cares for her students

Very sweet woman, however, she is disorganized and I never know what we are talking about. Exams are way harder than needed, but she gives a decent amount of points back. Need to buy Pearson & TopHat which is like another BB that you have to pay for each month. Ridiculous. Group project, shes letting it be a video this semester. Final is cumulative

She is SUPER nice BUT class is harder than it needs to be. Also, unneccessary amount of work in last part of semester. There's a third midterm, a very annoying final project and presentation, and a cumulative final. No study guide before tests which sucked because there was never really anything clear about test content.

Dolores is not a very good teacher. She is extremely disorganized, forces students to purchase expensive study sets & programs, dosen't give study guide for tests despite her lackluster teaching,& offers very little value to her students education. Would regularly flash attendance code for mere seconds offering no chance for student to input code.
There is not better professor for 320. She is one of the nicest people I have ever met. Do not hesitate to go to office hours as she is really helpful.
GOAT, she's the best. Learned a ton in the class. Everything is straight forward. She's super flexible and understanding. Two midterms, three quizzes, final project instead of a final exam.
The most CARING professor ever!! Some of the class seems confusing at first (the bond stuff) but she's super nice and will do whatever it takes to help you understand.

Prof Goytisolo is great. She is super sweet. Despite it being a lecture heavy class, it isn't all too boring and she teaches the material in an easy to digest way, granted the class itself is still pretty tuff. She genuinely wants to help you learn and will walk you through anything. The tests are very similar to the homework... keep that in mind.

Dolores is the nicest and most caring teacher I've ever had in my entire life. Super helpful with all material, wants to see all students succeed, and once again the most genuine prof ever. 10000000% recommend taking her. I never write reviews but had to because of how amazing she was. THANK YOU PROFESSOR!!!!!

[Took her class in the beginning of the year until I switched out, wish I didn't] Heard she's a great professor, here's the rundown for the class: 3 exams, HWs (that prepare you for the exams), Group Project (pick a good group), CFA Ethics Exam (will help you for the CFA Charter), and Participation/Attendance. Probably your best option for FIN320.

Professor Goytisolo is awesome. She truly cares for her students and will do anything she can to help them succeed. Her grading is very fair and she does all she can to give partial credit on exams. She has real work experience in the industry and knows Finance well. One of the nicest professors I've had at Miami. Definitely take her if you can.
Amazing professor don't listen to other comments very easy to do well if you follow the syllabus.  Very smart and nice guy Stanford professor and Dartmouth grad. Great guy to learn from.

Dhabhar was very nice! Easy to get an A (I got an A+). He has long rants and class itself is already long with cams required. It can easily get boring. He doesn't use blackboard for grading so you're kinda left in the dark but he isnt a hard grader. You need to set reminders for assignments and follow syllabus to a T to do well!! He will call u out

Talks about a whole lot of nothing. NEVER lets you out early from the 3 hour class and gives 5 minutes total to use bathroom. Camera has to be on. HAS NOT PUT A SINGLE GRADE IN THE GRADE BOOK THE WHOLE SEMESTER (will find out how you did on the project, presentation, weekly assignments, etc. ONLY when the final grades come out)

I was excited about taking this class, but it turned out to be a terrible decision. He always goes on random tangents about unrelated matters and wastes everyone's time. He is incredibly unclear in his instructions and every time you ask he repeats the nonsense in his syllabus. He has severe OCD and a class that should be fun becomes a headache.

Just be prepared for him to speak, a. lot. He goes off on tangents very easily and elaborates every response beyond necessary. He says everything is in the syllabus but students always had questions about things that were not there. He does not answer questions clearly, but finds a way to still go on a tangent about it.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: favorite professor at UM

One of the most disappointing professors at UM. Completely useless lectures that teach no one, and your grade is largely based on a final exam where the class average is an F, so he has to curve everyone in the end. Learned basically nothing in his class. Waste of time and completely unhelpful professor.

This professor’s method of “teaching” forced students to resort to collaborating on a final exam that was meant to be individual work, and forced the very few who did understand something to work on group projects for other students who knew nothing and contributed nothing but benefited from a highly curved grade.

I have never experienced such carelessness, lack of organization, or direction from one professor in many years of study. I can admit that this is the first time I had nightmares in the days leading up to the final exam because I did not learn anything sufficient to pass.

The only thing I slightly remember from 6 weeks of lectures is calculating a “burden rate.” The professor also refuses to discuss group case/homework assignments, something I find unbelievable; it is a professor’s job to teach and assist students, not to disregard them, especially with a difficult course as this one.

The professor does not use a textbook and teaches solely on cases. By attempting to teach only through cases, the professor did not teach concepts or formulas to then apply to cases; he basically spoke endlessly about the solution without providing fundamentals as to how to solve the cases.

I would highly recommend avoiding this professor; unfortunately as of now he is the only one teaching this required course for the MBA program. The course material itself is critical for an MBA student to learn, but with this professor’s method of teaching it is nearly impossible for one to learn anything.
Very smart and engaging. Class is not easy but very interesting and challenging. One learns much. Great professor.

He is a decent lecturer. My issue with the course is using a purely cased based method to teach a course as challenging as managerial accounting. I wish that he would have either used a textbook or teach concepts and then cases. Test is challenging, but he gives a previous test to help.

He is really challenging and demands a lot out of students, which is fair.  There was mandatory group hw every night which is really annoying.  If you want a good grade, you have to put in the effort. Test averages are low but everything is curved.  This was the hardest class I have taken at Miami, but it the class I learned the most in as well.

He isn't a bad a guy as some of the reviews would make him seem.  Some of his classes are just unbearable while others are really interesting.  Test averages are low but he curves and 40% of your grade is from stuff like Homework and participation, which if you have a pulse are really easy to nail.

Absolutely awful class. The tests were nothing like the homework. You think you know the answers, but the test grades come back and you were nowhere close. Test grade averages at about 50 or less. Teacher is nice and makes class interesting enough, but NOT good at his job. AVOID AT ALL COSTS.
The class was not that difficult, I feel like the lack of understanding was more an issue with the students initiative and work ethic. It is severely lacking at UM in the business school.

Horrible professor!! I think that when the class average is almost a failin grade, it speaks volumes of the professor. He won't tell you how he'll curve until the end. He knows his stuff but does a poor job at teaching it all. Overall, avoid his class if you can---more stress than what is needed.

He is not  clear on  the material given out in class. He needs to be more precise. He need to be more informative and clear on each topic matter covered in each chapter. He focuses tooo tooo much on case studies when he needs to elaborate on the basic material and then teach on the case studies. I have to give it to him; He knows his stuff.
His class is soooo hard.. and the test impossible the average of our first exam was 41 out of 100, it seems like one understands the class but when the hw and tests came it was chinese!!

I am midway through the semester and I already feel like I've lost half of my braincells. 

On the other note: His lectures aren't very helpful so read the textbook/lecture notes), or find YouTube videos, or anything. Keep on track of all the quiz dates, and Please PLEASE go to the TAs, they are so much better in explaining the material. Good luck!

Unclear lectures. Great syllabus. Use sections from the textbook to study for quizzes and you'll pass with an A almost guaranteed. Grade is decided by class average so just focus on being above average.
Never seen a professor write so many factually incorrect statements.

Honestly skip the lectures, read the book thoroughly, ask the TAs what will be on the quizzes and you will do just fine. If you get a bad grade on the quiz, most of the time you can go to his office hours to argue with him and get some extra points. He also curves the class so as long as you are above the average, you end with an A.
structured syllabus and quiz content is known beforehand, so you can just go by the textbook. Lectures confuse you more than they help. You do better if you just skip and show for quizzes .

Many complaints about this course come from students who skip lectures and cram. If you show up, take notes, and keep up, the material is tough but manageable. Don't expect an easy A the night before the exam. The professor can be blunt, but his office hours are genuinely helpful. You'll be fine if above the average. Only hw and quizzes.

Avoid this professor at all costs. He makes an easy class difficult and is very critical. The curve was almost 20%. It's hard to hear him, and he won't answer questions directly, instead asking if you did the reading. If you take the class, meet with him to review quizzes, but expect to be berated if below 90.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Teaches in a way that will make you confused about everything and confident about nothing. My grade went up when I stopped going to lectures and exclusively read the textbook. The book is the way
Enjoys making the class more difficult than needed.

I would like to warn those who need to take this class to be prepared for the semester to come. He will make you feel like you do not know the material no matter how hard you try, the averages on his quizzes are in the 40s. He will say one thing in class, but grade your quiz differently. It is ROUGH to say the least.

This guy made me depressed, seriously. I HAD to take him for two classes, which were the worst experiences of my academic career. He does not teach well at all, and he will tell you that, sure, your answer is correct, but he did not like your way of stating it. If you do not understand him, he will make you feel bad for asking questions. AVOID!!!

His accent makes him very hard to understand and he is condescending when answering questions (if he even answers). His quizzes make no sense and we're stuck guessing what will be on them. Our class consistently scored very low on his quizzes and he blamed us every time. He grades the homework very late and very tough. Actually awful experience.

Gave a quiz the day after the fall break ended, so I will automatically give a 1. Besides that, really hard to understand accent, is very rude, and makes almost no effort in teaching the class. This professor is a nightmare, and makes a class that is not that difficult almost impossible. Avoid.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Sarkar gets a horrible rep because he's a very tough grader. He can come across as rude sometimes when you speak to him, but I felt like he really wanted us to learn and he was honestly a great lecturer if you pay attention. I was afraid to take him due to other reviews, but he wasn't so bad. The class material is very difficult, so be prepared
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The most trivial class you will take in CS probably. As long as you have the slightest clue about computers, you need not read the textbook or go to class. Take this for a free A.

horrible. directions are never clear. He grades homeworks horrible in a way that makes no sense and the whole class was complaining allll semester. He says all students should learn and if u ask why u got a certain grade he says dont worry about it. He also is rude to students and not nice at all. he makes no sense and class is not fair.

Worst professor at UM. Speeds thru slides, and you need to FIND the slides online cus he doesn't give them to you but you need them to pass the quiz. Impossible to understand accent, going to class is meaningless. Not hard material, but he makes it hard. Wouldn't recommend this professor to anyone I know. Avoid if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment:
I've read reviews that say "avoid at all costs". None have been truer than the reviews that say that about Dilip. Truly a difficult person to work with, and a class that is nearly irrelevant. 

Seriously, wait a semester and take this class with the other prof.

Grade is based on six quizzes and 10 hw's. Quizzes get progressively harder. 

Hard to understand at times and he confuses himself while explaining on the board.

It's not hard to get an A but you will have to study by yourself before a quiz. The material isn't even hard, he just makes it confusing to understand. Good luck lol
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor tells you one thing and then the TA takes points off for it. There is no way to prepare for the quizzes besides reading the textbook. You won't learn anything in this class that is relevant for a computer science major. Outdated course, outdated professor.

Worst professor I have taken at UM. Homeworks are pointless and so are the quizzes. His accent is to strong to even understand, he makes you email or go to the TA of the class if you have a question. He will take points off if you don't write exactly what he wants in his exact words. Worst professor ever

This class was very interesting. If you take it with with Sarkar, you will learn a lot. He is difficult, but the material is not. If you show up to class, go to his office hours, and ask questions, he will help you out. He may flip, but he will never flop.

Useless quizzes and HW; He chooses one topic to put on the quiz that is close to impossible to solve. Professor is condescending and is never available for office hours. An embarrassment for the university.
Horrible professor
Avoid if you can!! That's all I have to say. No explanation needed, trust me!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment:
Not hard to get good grades. I got C because I didn't hand out the final project. Homework every week, and frequent quizzes. Homework & quizzes contain the same types of questions.
The slides on black board are often incomplete or not up to date. Write down everything he says in class.
Teacher is arrogant and not helpful but overall an easy class.

Worst professor I've ever had. Avoid taking this class as if your life depends on it. Unclear & unfair policies, harsh grader, condescending, accent is impossible to understand. Language barrier results in terrible explanations; one is forced to rely on the textbook for the entirety of course material. PLS don't take this prof!! Save yourself!!!

This was one of the worst classes I've ever taken at UM. I was so excited to learn about this but he's truly made it a miserable experience. Extremely rude when you ask questions, grades extremely unfairly with no clear instructions or helpful feedback, and delivers material in the most boring and confusing way ever. DON'T TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: One of the worst professor's ive ever had. Gives assignments before he teaches the material. Thick accent so he's impossible to understand, and participation is 10% of your grade even though the material he teaches has nothing to do with the homework

Easiest A of my entire life. I thought I accidentally enrolled in Algorithms (Tutorial mode version) it was that EZ. All of the homeworks and exams are trivial. Real computer scientists need not worry about this class. ��

His lectures are confusing and he's terrible at answering questions. Definitely the worst professor I've had in the comp sci department. That being said it's easy to get a good grade if you show up and do your homework, you probably won't learn much though.

He's a good teacher, his lectures are just very lengthy. Even though homework is due every week and quizzes are twice a week, they are VERY easy. I don't even need to show up to class most of the time because he puts all the power-points online which helped me study. He has a very strong accent but its not so bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Surprise quizzes, difficult tests, and arbitrary grading. Get ready to read the textbook, take lots of notes, and do long homework assignments. Dr. Sarkar is definitely one of the hardest professors in the CS department.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Worst experience as a professor I have ever had. I don't mind a hard teacher but at least be able to teach. He can be condescending towards students will make you feel like you don't know anything. Has a difficult time explaining what he means and when he gets confused which happens often, will make something up to accommodate his mistakes.
He is the worst professor I have ever met. He could not explain a single thing, but the worst part is that his test was something he did not cover in class.

You have to go to class and do extra exercises. This class is hard and you will get whooped. Dr. Sarkar's best (and worst) trait is how much he respects the class: you are expected to, heaven or hell, push yourself farther than before, but you *will* learn a lot from him. Bad grades are used to motivate, so know your strengths before taking him.
Awful teacher.  Impossible to understand.  If I did not have to take his classes to graduate I would never think twice about going.  BY FAR the worst and least caring teacher at the U.

Everyone really, really, hates this guy.  I heard terrible things coming in, and most of my class complained all the time.  That being said, I got an A.  I thought it was a pretty easy A.  During class he'll lecture about all sorts of stuff.  You have to be able to pick out what is relevant.  Do the homework.  That's the tests.  Pretty simple.
Horrible teacher, only he knows what he is talking about. Even worse when he gets confused himself in the middle of a problem. Avoid him at all cost.

Very kind and inspirational professor. Always engaged the class in discussions and gave us many opportunities outside of the classroom to apply course material in the real world. Very easy grader and only uses projects and attendance for course grade. She lets student be creative in their work and wants everyone to be successful in the class.
This class was a VERY easy elective. My main complaint is she didn't put in ANY grades all semester. If you want an easy cognate class this class is a good one to take.

She's a phenomenal professor and she's very nice. The class is a perfect elective because its not hard at all and all lead to one final project presented at the end of semester. If you need an easy elective for your school, take her, you won't regret it!

This class in an easy A, even though the course is very light you still learn a lot and she definitely cares about what she teaches. she is very kind and very accessible, would take her again in a heartbeat.

AMAZING!! THE BEST EVER!! There is a one page reflection due every Tuesday, but you only need to do 9/14. The final exam is a group project that encompasses a geopolitical simulation. She does her best to make the class interesting by bringing guest speakers. All that she asks is that you show up to class. She is so intelligent and passionate.

Overall one of my favorite's at UM. Gives a very basic framework for INS so is good to decide if you enjoy the subject. Be prepared to work in a group. The class isn't difficult but it is informative and if you participate, can be very stimulating.

Amazing professor! Very passionate and knows a lot about her field. Lectures can be a little boring but the class is easy so it's okay. No tests only group simulation projects. Highly recommend taking her if you want to jumpstart your international relations career!

Festival of busy-work. No textbook, lots of articles. Easy grader (everything feels graded for completion). She likes calling on people to answer questions about readings (instead of having people volunteer to be called on). She's a very nice lady, and very understanding, but it doesn't change that it's a lot of unnecessary work.

Very straightforward class. Studying for the tests is very straightforward. She has a very relaxed attendance policy which is nice. You can tell she is really passionate and brings in many guest lecturers. Many group assignments so if you're really not into that I don't suggest this. Great prof!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She really cares about all of her students & tries her best to bring in guest speakers (such as Ambassador Ayalde) to let students hear topics from different povs. She made sure to always ask open-ended questions for students to speak up & start a discussion instead of just listening to lectures for an hour long. Wish she taught more classes!

This professor is so incredibly passionate about the class and her students. I really appreciated her constantly asking critical thinking questions to the class and applying the theoretical framework to relevant international events. She worked hard to get very interesting guest speakers and even had a model UN diplomacy debate as her final.

Never given a rating before, but Prof. Derouselle truly deserves it. BSL 212 is a challenging course as it is, yet he consistently goes above and beyond and prepares you for the final from day one. If you show up to class and focus on learning the rules from each chapter, u will be fine. He has great hypothetical's also. 10/10.
Professor D is engaging and so funny. His lectures are very informative so make sure to write down notes and utilise the handouts. Loved his class.
He is genuinely my favorite professor on this campus. His lectures are always super engaging and he makes an effort to check up on students.

One of my favorite teachers at UM. Really cares about his students, is hilarious, and I am genuinely sad this class is ending. If I could take him for every class I would. Material is difficult but if you study you will do well. If you have to take bus law, Derouselle is the best.

HE IS AMAZING!!!!!! I highly reccomend taking him for any law class. His lectures are very entertaining and he just knows how to keep students engaged and want to learn. He honestly made me love business law and enjoy the material. Do remember to study and keep up with the material and you will be fine!

Prof DeRouselle is great! He truly cares about students and wants them to succeed. BSL212 is difficult no matter what teacher you have, but take him if you can! He makes concepts easier to understand by using scenarios.
Derouselle is great, you come to like him more and more as the year goes on. 202/212 is hard regardless unfortunately.

He's the best,TAKE HIM. Attendance wasn't mandatory, but if you dont go u wont get notes, and you NEED good notes. this class is based on around 5 'quizzes' which r actually actually just exams. this class has soooo much memorization snd application of material. Probably one of the hardest classes I've taken. I prob studied a SOLID 40 hrs for final

Professor Derouselle teaches the material in a way that is easily digestible, but you shouldn't rely completely on in course material you have to learn outside of class through textbooks. Great professor, very kind and empathetic, and you'll learn a lot through him.

Professor DeRouselle is amazing. He really cares for his students beyond just their coursework and makes an effort to check in with everyone. BSL 212 is a difficult class regardless of professor, but he was great at explaining the material and did what he could to help everyone succeed. He's also really funny. Highly recommend taking him.
Professor Derouselle is awesome. Would definitely take him again. Business law is tough across the board. It's lots of memorization but he wants his students to do well.

Prof DeRouselle is one of the best professors at UM. The delivery of this course by him is excellent, however, his tests are somewhat difficult. Luckily, his lectures are engaging. As long as you put in the effort throughout the semester, you will be fine. Make sure you know when you are on call as well. He is genuinely caring! TAKE HIM!

I just can't say enough about Professor Derouselle. He's funny and cares about what he teaches, and he takes the time to learn your name and even dedicates entire days to mental check-ins every once in a while. Yes, you'll have to put in work to prepare for quizzes every now and then, but it is totally worth it. Take him if you can.

Professor Derouselle is such a great guy. He truly cares about his students, and takes the time to know everyone's names. But be ready to work in his class, you have to completely memorize the material in order to do well on quizzes. As long as you are willing to put in some time and effort, you will be fine and should definitely take him!

Out of all the professors Ive had at UM, this is the first Ive ever written a review about. I genuienly feel as though Professor DeRouselle cares about his students well being. He takes the time out of his day to learn all of his students names and while the class is difficult, he covers the material in a way that is engaging.

Not his fault but the class is way too difficult as a core business class if you aren't majoring in legal studies. Derouselle is a great guy--tells great stories and has a great personality. However, he teaches too fast and it's hard to keep up with him--it's easy to miss things. Quizzes have "trick" questions which is ridiculous for a hard class.

He makes difficult concepts easily comprehendible by providing examples. He always answers emails and questions without judgment; he is also readily available for office hours. Grade is composed of quizzes, paper, student made quiz, and the final. Class itself is a lot of memorizing and application. If you're willing to put in work, you'll do well.

This teacher is the reason I wake up on Mondays Wednesday and Friday's at 5am. He is easily one of the best teachers I have ever had, and his way of teaching should be taught to all teachers at this trash school. Mr. D, if I become a lawyer, it was because of you. I absolutely recommend taking this professor, he has sparked a new interest for me.
My favorite professor Ive ever had at UM. Took him for both intro to bus law and law for entrepreneurs. The only reason why Im doing a business law minor is cause of this man! Hes the best!!

I never had any interest for law at all, until I took Professor DeRouselle's class. His lectures are super engaging, so make sure you participate or else you will lose points. The final was incredibly difficult and dropped me from a B+ to a B-, but overall if you read the textbook and listen to his feedback, you will be successful in this class.

Professor Derouselle was an amazing professor to have my first semester. Business Law itself can be a challenging class, but he was able to make it very comfortable and smooth-sailing. He is always there for his students and is overall an amazing man. If I could take any class again with Professor Derouselle I am for sure taking it!!!

The most incredible professor I have ever had. Empathic towards his students/cares about your mental health. The material is difficult/intimidating, but his stories and lectures make it so easy to understand. His quizzes are also based off of your analysis of the chapter and not who you stated wins the case (room for error). Always answers email.

Professor Derouselle is by far one of the best teachers Ive had. He gets you involved and his examples are really clear and easy to understand. He genuinely cares about his students lives both in and out of the classroom. His course is really hard and makes you work for a grade, but he is always reachable and an A is achievable if you work for it
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor DeRouselle is one of the best, most caring professors that I have had at UM. His class is hard, probably the hardest comparatively with other BSL 212 sections, but it was completely worth it. He makes the material interesting and fun, I always enjoyed coming to his class. Take good notes from his lectures and you'll be good!

reviews.comment: Professor Derouselle is hilarious and great! He makes Business Law so entertaining! There are 6 quizzes, a final exam, student written quiz, and a paper. I recommend taking him!

Professor Derouselle is a great professor. Very down to earth and cares about his students. The class is pretty hard and you either study and pay attention or you fail, but it is a rewarding class if you try.

reviews.comment: an amazing professor who cares more about his students than their work. he's super understanding about everything and wants to make sure that youre genuinley okay. teaches the material in a way that relates to you. would 10000% take again
my favorite professor at miami so far, take him!! its hard work but he is the sweetest

reviews.comment: Professor Derouselle is an amazing guy. Although he may be harder than other professors who teach this class, specifically from a grading standpoint, you will really learn and retain the information. The class is curved also and if you work hard you can do well.

reviews.comment: DeRouselle is literally the best. He genuinely cares for his students and is a hilarious professor. I absolutely love him. reviews.comment: Professor Derouselle is one of the most intelligent professors I have had. He wants to see his students succeed and is available to meet outside of class.

Definitely one of the best professors I have had at this school. He is awesome and class is so fun to go to. I had him at 8 am every MWF and I still woke up every day to go to class. He is understanding and extremely intelligent. Definitely take him if possible.

The man takes every opportunity he gets to give some larger than life ideological and politically liberal point or story with now business law implication. He's very pretentious, despite lacking any legitimate success in the real world. Nothing personal, he's just very passive aggressive and self-righteous.

Unbelievable professor highly recommend. Super easy to talk to and such a great guy. Makes the lectures exciting and you will remember the material for the tests. His lectures mirror the textbook so outlining the chapter before class helps a lot. The tests are all short answer so they require a lot of studying but by the final you are prepared.

reviews.comment: Overall a fantastic teacher. He explains the content really well, clarifies content really well, and has a great personality. Everyone in class seemed to like him a lot. I would recommend taking his class for BSL 212. You will definitely want to read the textbook and come to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great teacher. Really cares about his students and make the class very interesting. BSL 212 is a difficult course but he really teaches it well and wants you to succeed. Every student should try to take him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: His class is the highlight of my day. He interacts with students in the class by using them in his examples, and makes even the most complex concepts easy to understand. Also, he's HILARIOUS. Didn't even mind taking him at 9AM. He expects you to read a lot and his tests are challenging, but you'll get a good grade if you put in the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: My favorite professor my entire freshman year. Dense readings, but he clarifies well with funny examples in class involving everyone. I would 100% take him again. Quiz grading policy is difficult but over time you get the hang of it. He's super helpful and nice during office hours. TAKE HIM!
The man. He will make you put the work in to earn a good grade, but definitely worth it.

Don't listen to the people that gave him bad comments. He is an amazing professor. The grading policy that he uses is required by the Business Department, thus your grade depends on the average of the class. You have to study to explain the material better than the rest of your classmates to be above the median. You will learn a lot.

Quizzes are tough, and you will have to put in work.  Professor is great though. Chill and gives good career advice. I didn't expect it, but I actually didn't mind going to class early morning. Would recommend without a doubt.

Well Shannon is one of those prof that kinda come with a little bit of an anger from somewhere in life and the way that he get revenge is by forcing the students know even more than he knew when he was a student. I am an A student and end with a B. I feel like I only got that grade because we did not have a connection and it reflected in my grade.
I REALLY enjoyed this class! You have to be willing to put work in but it's possible to get an A if you try. Prof is SO helpful and super nice. TAKE HIM!!
I thought I would hate Business Law.  Professor Derouselle made it interesting.  Cares a lot about students.  Take any class he teaches!

Dr Derouselle gave clear and interesting lectures. His grading style is tough but fair, if you actually study you will do well. I took his MBA class and found him to be one of the best professors in the program. He has a great sense of humor and played chill music incw in a while.
really clear lectures and gave specific examples to help you understand. However, quiz are not that easy. A is achievable

I never thought I would enjoy going to a law class, but I actually liked his class. Don't get me wrong, sometimes the topics were difficult and not the most exciting. However Professor DeRouselle's approach definitely made this class much better. Funny and really cares about students!

Good professor but when it comes to the grading he is very hard. Tries to get you confused on what to study and what not study. Thats just his personality.   There are others prof. that I should had taken but gave this guy a try.   This is just me. I am just talking about myself.
He is ok. Class is not very hard but you really need to read the book very carefully. His quiz and exams are highly germane to the textbook. Learnt a lot from him and got an A.

I've take Professor Derouselle for two separate classes.  He is awesome, and I would recommend without a doubt.  Bad comments coming from one student who is angry and needs an outlet.  Stop lying, this professor is one of the best!

Shannon is a awesome prof. But his grading method sucks. He will give the grade he thinks you deserve since the quizzes are essay questions. If you are not good at explaining the issue as he expects it then you will get a poor grade and not that is wrong just that is not what he has in his head. Take him, just know exactly what he is looking for.

I learned a lot in this class - more than I expected. Professor is great -- he's clear, funny, and makes the subject way more interesting than it is. Don't understand bad ratings.  Sounds like someone is disgruntled about not getting a good grade :-(  Highly recommend!

Explains very clear and everyone seems to understand the class. After doing his quizzes and thinking we all did well he will always find something you could had mention. Basically, finding something to not give you the full credit. I loved the class. Its just his grading method. He says that if the majority get an A is his fault for making it easy.

If english is not your fist language dont take him. He expects for students to write like lawyers. I ended up with a B because the majority of the student in the class were better writers then me and he does some weird curve grading that he compares your test with your classmates. I got 91 in all my quizes but for him 91 was the class average B

This professor is very nice. He studied at well known universities so he is knowledgeable. He is good at explaining the material, funny,etc. But, there are 8 quizzes and this is where he looses all the points. You have two questions in each quiz and you must answer with a paragraph. He will expect you to know even more then he does. Cruel grader.

Really nice guy. Taught 8 AMs, and he would play music in the morning when we walked in. Great sense of humor. Made class really enjoyable and I honestly looked forward to class (even at 8 AM). Very clear explanations, so much so that I didn't even use the textbook the second half of the semester. If you study and write well, you'll do fine.
Great professor. Clear in his lectures and straight to the point. It's a pretty tough class and you definitely need to work hard; however it will pay off and you will definitely learn a lot.

I had him for 8 am and although it was hard to wake up for the class some mornings, I was actually never bored or tired once I got to class.  He makes the material interesting. Take notes and read the chapters before class. He's really into playing music whenever there's a free minute.  Awesome teacher.

Dr. Derouselle is a great professor. Had him at 8 AM and he was perfect for an early class. Very chill & mellow, but not at all boring. Also a very knowledgeable & funny guy. Book is essential, and the material is not very easy, but he gives great examples and is very clear. Definitely recommend him. Favorite professor of the semester. Take him!
this class in hard because of the material, but he is awesome professor, he makes the class very enjoyable and you will learn a lot. Take him if you want to learn great staff

I recommend this Professor. His class is interesting, cool, and he teaches very well. Class is hard and final is cumulative, you have to study hard. Also, attendance is mandatory and you have to read the book. If you go to class and study hard, he is an excellent professor!

She's the most personable professor in the political science department, very down-to-earth and caring. It's always a genuine conversation with her, not a one-sided lecture. If you need to hit your 21 political science credits, I highly recommend taking as many of her classes as possible.

reviews.comment: POL 202 is an incredibly boring class regardless of what prof you take, but Prof Hekimci's lecturing style really did not help. She is incredibly knowledgeable about content but expects the class to know random facts about world systems as well when that is barely discussed in class. However, class is easy to get an A in and I would take again.

Good class, the lectures can just get a little boring. Professor Hekimci is very knowledgeable. I learned a lot and enjoyed doing the discussion boards. You do have to read quite a bit each week but its not too bad.

Amazing professor! Dr. Hekimci does an excellent job of conveying the information in this course, keeping lectures interesting even at 9:45 in the morning. The discussion posts are a really good way to keep everyone engaged and aware of the topics being discussed in class. There are 3  multiple-choice tests that you can take at home with open notes

reviews.comment: She is an amazing lecturer! The lectures were extremely thought-provoking, and I was able to connect the concepts learned in class to other areas of my major. I really enjoyed the UNSC simulation and the final project presentations.

Professor Hekimci is great! Her lectures are clear and engaging. She shows documentaries and movies that really bring the topics to life. The NSC simulations were a highlight giving us hands-on experience with real-world scenarios. She is also very approachable. Take her if you can!

The semester has officially ended and all but a single assignment has been graded. There was no ability to review feedback on assignments including exams, papers, and smaller group projects. I have no clue what my real grade in the class is.
I've taken two classes so far with her and she's great!! The class is interesting and you will always know exactly what she expects from your assignments and tests. Definitely take her!

reviews.comment: Dr. Hekimci is knowledgeable, approachable, and genuinely invested in her students' learning. If you have a chance to take a class with her, do it! You'll learn a lot and have a great time doing it. Her lectures are a mix of real-life examples, documentary and weekly discussion board on BB. She is always ready to help!

Professor Hekimci is awesome! She really knows her stuff and makes class fun. She is super approachable and always there to help with questions. Plus, she encourages us to think critically and have open discussions. I highly recommend taking their class - it's a great learning experience!

This populism class was real interesting. Dr. H is super passionate & truly cares about students. She's young and relates to us and motivates us to do well. reviews.comment: I had her for US in the world - super down to earth easy grader
Literally the best spanish professor here, I would go out of my way to take a class with her. Super engaging lectures and very understanding, I 100% recommend her

Super sweet and understanding prof who creates a great space for language learning. I had prior Spanish experience so it felt easy, but she's supportive even if you're new. Online homework due daily, but manageable. Super welcoming—good class to build confidence!

This class was great, would definitely recommend. The assignments and tests were super easy and required very little prep, if any. A lot of homework that I often times was not on top of is the reason I didn't get an A, so do the homework and its an easy A or A+.

Gregorio is my favorite Spanish teacher at UM! She is super knowledgable, has engaging class discussions, and is kind, understanding, and funny. You def. have to study for the exams and put in work, but I was muchless overwhelmed in this class with Gregorio than other Spanish classes I've taken here. Just do the readings/show up and you'll be fine.

Di Gregoria was very sweet and understanding. The class consisted of lots of homework (they were easy from the textbook), 5 quizzes, 3 exams, and 2 essays. reviews.comment: She is a sweetie pie. Such a kind individual. My class was small and we all became friends and laughed throughout the entire semester. I enjoyed this class.

Professor Gregorio was so amazing! All the Spanish courses at UM demand a lot of work, but Professor Gregorio made the course really fun! Very kind and understanding too. She's a pretty lenient grader so if you put in effort, participate, and get the work done you'll do great in her class.
SPA105 with Di Gregorio was a very rewarding and relaxed class. It's great to jog your memory on spanish, but don't expect to get by without doing homework or participating in class.

I took her for a DaVinci program class and her lectures were very fun and interesting. She taught about art and Caravaggio, and coming from someone who didn't used to have a huge appreciation for art, she really taught a lot and passed her passion onto me. She is also an easy grader if you show effort.

Took her for Italian 101 and really enjoyed her class. Aside from it being easy to pass, she actually cares about her students learning the material and the class was super fun. Definitely recommend her for a beginner italian class

Literally the most wonderful and understanding woman ever. Our class was only 9 girls and 1 dude so we all vibed all the time. Straightforward assignments all up on the syllabus, no surprises, exams and quizzes are very doable if you pay attention. HW heavy but manageable. She's super reasonable and class w/ her is very enjoyable, actually learned!

Lorella is wonderful! She's very nice and has super clear class expectations. Most reasonable workload I've ever had in a Spanish class, and it's very interactive so you learn a lot. Three exams and only one final essay. Definitely would recommend her.

Very knowledgable. Class consists of weekly discussion posts, two exams, one final paper. This class is relatively easy if you speak spanish, do the readings and discussion posts on time. She is an easy grader and likes when students participate in class. If you are looking for an interesting class and good professor take her.

Very nice and smart professor. Not too difficult but the class mostly covers culture instead of the actual language but thats a departmental thing, not hers. Very very generous grader and caring of her students. Very easy going. I would love to take her again.

I really enjoyed this class. Despite it being an online hybrid class, everyone got very involved in the zoom meetings. There was a lot of homework but it's helpful. The tests were super easy and never took me more than an hour to take. Super straight forward. Class was fun. Truly really enjoyed this class.

She is an amazing lady who really cares for her students. I had to WORK for my grade but if you put in the effort you will be rewarded. Tests were over lectures & HW, she's very accessible outside of class, and is willing to help in any way she can. One of my favorite Spanish professors I've had.

Dr. Di Gregorio was a very nice lady. She was easily accessible outside of class and was an easy grader on most things. The Spanish curriculum pretty much is decided for her so the tests were hard but it wasnt her fault. One thing is though she talks the entire class only in Spanish so be ready for that cause I definitely wasnt.

reviews.comment: Dr. Di Gregorio is very caring and wants each student to learn. There were a lot of assignments, 6 quizzes and 3 exams. The class took place on zoom.

Lorella is a great professor. Although there is a decent amount of homework, if you do it well you will barely have to study for the midterms. I only ever studied for one day before each midterm and got As. Do your work, show up to class, and you will do just fine.
Lorella is simply wonderful.

She is a very caring teacher. She wants all of her students to succeed. There is a lot of extra credit in her class. She shapes her class around what topics the class wants to study. Class is fun, it's not mandatory, but we go through a lot during class and the class is fun so it's a relief going to class. She does take attendance

If you have the opportunity to take Deleon, please do NOT. Although the work in his class is cut out for you, as a pre med who has harder classes to worry about, it is an insane amount of work for a 1 credit course. We had 19 chapters of hw with at least 7 assignments in each. He's horrible at responding to emails, but when he did he was SO rude.

writing this because there arent many reviews for HCS217, very easy class. don't worry about it. there are about 4 quizzes that have questions straight from Pearson which is where we do our homework, no lockdown. Homework is unlimited attempts and is very easy; all open from start of sem. so you can complete them early (a lot but can be done quick)

Honestly, I hope nobody has to meet him in person. I took an online class with him and even that was difficult. God forbid you ever miss an assignment for a myriad of reasons. I was sick in the hospital and he was mad I didnt complete an assignment and gave me a zero. he is bad at responding to emails and extremely rude avoid him at all costs!

a lot of people don't like him; i get it. the exams are on quizlet just study them and you are guaranteed an A. he tries his best, but he really is a busy guy. takes attendance, just not mandatory. i think he is the better option compared to the new guy

reviews.comment: Professor Deleon's class is tough, but manageable with the right approach. While his lectures can be dry, reading the textbook and using tools like Unstuck AI for study prep really helped me stay on top of the content. Overall, a challenging but rewarding class.

This was the worst Professor I have ever had since starting college! He is incredibly vague when it comes to his lectures. He has zero care for his students and clearly doesn't enjoy his job. He has a nasty attitude and truly has it out for some students. He was incredibly rude to me when I asked him questions regarding our homework assignments!

Professor Deleon is very rude and his lectures are largely unhelpful. That being said, still go to them, especially the class before a test because he will give pop quizzes for extra points. If you have a question, ask him after class because he will not respond to your emails. Read the textbook if you actually want to understand anatomy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Deleon is super knowledgeable, but you definitely have to do a lot of independent learning. He's not the friendliest, never rly answers emails, and he's not very available outside of class, but if you come to class, study hard, are respectful, and try to go with the flow (he's very disorganized), then you should be fine. Avoid if possible tho lol
His lectures are all over the place, and it does not help that he is very passive-aggressive because he just expects you to understand the material right away.

He gets a lot of unnecessary hate. Both anatomy and physiology are tough classes, but Deleon gives students ample opportunity to succeed with a lot of extra credit. He also takes all his questions from test banks that can be found on Quizlet and has take-home quizzes and exams. May not seem the nicest, but he's funny and really does care deep down.

Dr. Deleon is hilarious and an enjoyable professor to get to know. He is passionate about what he teaches and loves to lead the SONHS study abroad trips in the summer. Totally recommend, easy class with minimal assignments and an enjoyable experience altogether. Get to know him and talk with him and you will see how he really is friendly and kind.

Dr. De Leon is a great professor. The material can be difficult but if you're listening to the lectures and reading the book, it's pretty easy to get a good grade. He gives extra credit questions on tests. Yes, he is bad at responding to emails. Blame UM more than him - they have him teaching way too many important classes, some with 100+ students.
This guy is the worst. Do not recommend at all

Professor Deleon is extremely egotistical with his position as a professor. He is not understanding whatsoever and is the most disorganized professor I have ever had. We were so behind in material and then he just sped through so much at the very end so he could put it on the final. Rough and boring lectures at 8 am. No extra credit opportunites.

This course was completely online. We had quizzes on Blackboard every other week and assignments in Pearson. The Pearson assignments can be time-consuming. Other than a few emails, I never heard from him, but all the information you need for this course can be found on Blackboard.

Does whatever he wants. no extra credit. no sympathy. NOT CLEAR grading criteria. NOT CLEAR about what content is on the test. NO FEEDBACK. DO NOT take this professor if you have the choice. He is the only one for nursing health sciences but if you have the choice DO NOT.Lecture heavy.NOTaccessible outside of class. NOT accessible over email.

He is very boring, people do not show up to class. Very disorganized and will completely change the course syllabus. He does not seem to be very helpful after class. He is the only professor that teaches this class and Physiology. What is great about this class is that there is a lot of outside sources and research that can really help.

most disorganized professor I've ever had. Grades everything last minute and even changes weight of assignments so a 10 point quiz ends up being 100 points. Dropped my grade significantly on the last day of the semester. No way of knowing grade until the final grade is posted. Don't even try to contact him by email. Was pretty funny in class tho

Dr. Deleon gets lots of deserved hate but in reality, he is a nice guy and does care about his students. If you have a question about anything (HW, Tests, Quizzes) ASK HIM IN PERSON. Quizzes are given online over the weekends and they are very easy to do well on. Exams are hard but he does allow cheat sheets for his students. Not hard to do well.

Personally, I did fine in the class, but I give no credit to him. I had to watch so many youtube videos to understand concepts. His test/quiz questions often don't make sense/are incorrect and if you ask him any question he will refuse to answer. He never responded to any of my or my friends emails, so you are kinda on you own in the class

I had to take him for anatomy because he's the only professor available so you can't even take anyone but 4 words. HE IS THE WORST! He claims he cares about his students but he never responds to emails and his very disorganized. His lectures are probably the most boring thing ever because he just rambles. Just read the textbook bc he will not help.

Deleon is a good prof, his lectures are interesting, but he does not answer emails and is very disorganized with grading. Had us write two papers and never gave any feedback, only graded them on the last day of the semester (idek if he read them). Exams are a little challenging but with EC and the curve you can easily do good.

Do not buy the $20 app that he recommends on the first day of class. It's not very helpful and you are farrrr better off using the Pearson Study Area (that you HAVE to buy to complete the homework) to study for lecture and lab. The lab focuses on more straight anatomy while lecture talks about more physiology.

Syllabus won't be followed. Read the textbook and complete all of the available chapter quizzes and tests that are available through the Pearson study area (he pulls a lot of inspo from these questions). Always be a step ahead of him! He's super disorganized and unresponsive (teaching too many courses alone). Study hard and you'll be okay.

He's such a difficult person, but his course is doable.Get ready to READ the textbook bc his questions come right from there and he has 3/10 lectures.If u have a problem it sucks to be u, bc I've sent five emails and never got a response back.Told us if we have questions during quizzes to figure it out. Just read the book and show up for attendance
very entertaining professor, low ratings are from people who don't care to read the textbook. Exams are straight forward.

Honestly I found him to be pretty entertaining at times and sometimes he was funny too.  He's pretty bad at responding to emails but he will answer your question if you go up and ask him after class.  The mastering is a big part of your grade so that's an easy grade boost and I would recommend reading the textbook.  Sometimes he is disorganized.

Cool professor, wish I could give him a better rating.
No communication skills with students, count on your email getting an answer days after you need it (if he decides to answer)
Lectures are too fast for anyone to catch up
3 Extra credit quizzes and one taken home exam
Count on the textbook, thats it

Graded by tests, mastering, and quizzes which makes grades easy to keep up even if bad test taker. Is really bad at lecturing but if you study the textbook you'll be fine. Gets behind in lecture easily and feels disorganized at times.

I emailed him documentation on why I missed class (extra credit) one day since I had strep throat and he said  nothing that I can do about that. Overall rudest professor I had to take in my health science undergrad. Oh yea he doesn't read emails either since I emailed him 3 TIMES for the beginning project and never responded to the strep too...

reviews.comment: i knew that anatomy was going to be challenging but it wasnt the material that challenged me, it was his lack of communication and accessibility that hurt everyone in the class. we were always confused on what is going on and sometimes the exams covered chapters we havent gone over yet :( my advice is to read the book IN DEPTH and youll do great

reviews.comment:
I was nervous when I first read his ratings, but then I had him for 352. 
Deleon teaches you how to look at things differently, emphasizes respect, and taught me that it is okay to have opinions as long as you can back them up. His class is lecture-heavy with a lot of discussions. One of the best professors here at UM.

Took during Spring2020 so this review is him PRIOR TO ONLINE: you really need to read the chapter then come to class to understand everything he is lecturing on. Book/reading/time outside of class is essential to passing. He seems like a tough prof, but if you get him in office hours he is really nice and willing to help out or explain concepts.

The worst class that I have ever taken. I don't why that he is still in our nursing school. As a nursing student, you really have no choice. Nursing students have to take his class. reviews.comment: Follow the syllabus. Attendance does matter and the tests come straight from the chapters in the book. He is a really good professor but not the friendliest. Study really far in advance for the exams and you will do fine.

reviews.comment: Possibly the worst professor I have had. Lectures are mandatory but useless, and he is overall not a pleasant guy at all. Read the textbook and ignore what ever pointless and sometimes rude things he has to say during lectures, and you will do fine.

No homework ever, just 4 tests and a take home test all equally weighted. Currently writing this while retaking it.

I don't like this professor. His course is so hard and no extra credit. Don' t take this professor's course if you can find another professor.

reviews.comment: If you do all the mastering assignments and go to class and do all the practicals you will do well in this lab.

Awful. Disorganized and unprofessional. Does not have office hours and makes you schedule an appointment and cancels the appointment most of the time because he forgets. His tests are focused on the most insignificant of details and he makes a bunch of grammar mistakes and blames it on the TA that he doesn't have. Worst professor and class.

I have to be honest, I am one of those students who has to study a lot in order for me to even pull out a B in a class. Having said this, Professor Deleon is a good teacher, he really is. However, during exams I don't know what it is but he becomes a slightly different person; refusing to answer any questions you have and need clarification for.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed the class, but I also really seem to like physiology. The class was one of the hardest ones I've ever taken- you'd better read the textbook and be ready to study if you want an A! There is a take home exam to help boost your grade as well as attendance, so be sure to show up (before 8:15 or else you're marked absent!)
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Grading is very fair. Take the homework seriously because it counts as 15% and can seriously boost your final grade. You can drop an exam and one of them is a take-home. Go to class even though its at 8 am. It really helps your final grade as well! Sign up for office hours and get to know him. He really wants to help in any way he can!
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This class is not the class you wanna cram the night before the exam. the class is hard as hell but he is a fair grader. he lectures plus he posts recorded lectures in class. READ if you dont you read you are doomed. Attendance is 5% of the grade so thats cool. He gives a take-home exam that replaces your lowest grade, plus  extra credit pop quizes
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: SO his class is hard, but if you are trying to breeze through it won't happen. He is actually very fair.
