reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: In Physiology, you must memorize the text book. Failed the first two tests, but the third take home test replaced one of those grades. His questions are extremely specific over chapters that are hundreds of pages longs. Beware to give yourself enough time to read the chapters and listen to the audio he posts. Do not take if given chance
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Honestly this is the worst teacher I have ever had. He brags in class about how majority of students fail the first exam. He is not approachable at all and he refuses to answer any questions during exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: All of the lab is done online, and you can finish fairly quickly. I almost never stayed past an hour, but the quizzes are HARD! Really make sure you know the models! Take pictures if you have to! There's also open lab once a week, it's really helpful to go just to be able to spend more time with the models. The Mastering homework is easy but long.

THIS WAS A VERY HARD CLASS, BUT HE WAS SUPER FAIR IN GRADING. YOU DO HAVE TO READ THAT BOOK. I CANNOT SAY I ENJOYED IT BECAUSE IT WAS AT 8:00 AM 3 TIMES A WEEK, BUT I DEFINITELY LEARNED A LOT OF STUFF. ATTENDANCE IS MANDATORY.

Attendance is worth 5% and it will be your saving grace, so don't skip class. Tests are worth 80% and Mastering A&P homework is worth 15%. He gives one extra credit opportunity (5 points on a test) that you should take. Lectures are useless since he just reads from the Powerpoint slides. His test questions are very detailed so study hard. Got an A-

Physiology lab isn't required, but if you need an easy science elective this is it. Of all of the classes I have had with Deleon (I have had him 4 times), this one is the easiest. The lab activities are very straightforward and you just have to put in some effort for a 100. You have 4 to 5 quizzes, and if you read the lab handouts it's an easy A.

The lab is done through Mastering A&P, and you have online assignments that you complete during the lab period. They're really easy and you finish in like 20 minutes. His quizzes are either online or on 3D models. They're pretty tough so you better study if you want a good grade.

If you want an A in the class, you better be prepared to READ. His tests are super detailed, and he basically told us that to do well you "can just memorize everything and regurgitate it on the test." There are 4 tests and 1 take home exam, and attendance is mandatory. Lectures are pretty boring and unhelpful, but it's whatever.

The first couple of weeks I went to class only to study and do terribly on the first two tests. For us the third test was online and it was easy 100%. Then for the next two I studied really hard and got two high A's. Ended with a B+. Never went to class the last half. Not very helpful but you definitely learn the material. NEED THE BOOK.

Deleon is an okay teacher. He is rather boring (especially at 8am), but you can't really expect much. His tests are TRICKY - you need to know your stuff to the point where I think almost nobody gets a 100, ever. Lots of info in very little time, so you have to be dedicated in order to do well. Think I'll get a B+ or A- and I work relatively hard.

I really don't know why people are so immature and whiney. I am currently in Deleon's class, and yeah it is hard, but he knows his material, yes there is a lot of material, but it is ANATOMY, not history or english. Study and you will get a good grade. THIS IS NOT A CLASS FOR LAZY PEOPLE, so quit whining and hit the books.

It's human anatomy, you can't expect it to be easy. Read the book and actually dedicate time to this class. He is a nice guy if he sees that you put effort. He knows who is doing the real hard work and who is not. Only take the class is you love anatomy if not there is not point. Got an A.

Deleon is probably the worst professor I have had here at UM. Not only is he hypocritical; he forces students to "teach themselves" the lessons. The few lessons he does lecture on are off topic and unhelpful. The only upside is his laziness - his refusal to put any effort into teaching results in exam questions straight from online test banks.

This is one of those classes where you get out what you put in. Textbook reading is one of the easiest ways to understand what the heck is going on in his class. Talking with him outside of class he is actually such a nice guy!! Loved having him!

Dr. Deleon is not very helpful. His classes are "mandatory". He passes a sign in sheet, but it does not affect your grade. His tests are from the book. Study DIRECTLY FROM THE BOOK, and review his slides to get an A. He also has pictures on the test& he gives you the pictures before the test to study from.

He has his good days and bad days, but if you get to know him he's actually a very nice person. He's willing to help you. He does not curve, but gives labeling images that will be on exam ahead of time. Exams can be tricky so a lot of studying is required. It's not an easy class but if you study hard you'll do fine. This class isnt for lazy people

Deleon has his flaws, like his office hours can be a hassle and he gets annoyed easily when he has to repeat himself. But overall, he always tries to help out with grades by dropping a test or by assigning a take home test. If you want an A read the book and slides. If you want to just get by, read the slides and you'll do fine.

He is the worst professor ever. He reads straight from the powerpoints in class, making attending pretty pointless except for random extra credit quizzes. Sends excessive emails & uses terrible grammar. However, the class is easy and straightforward, but I would suggest just reading the book and studying on your own instead of wasting time in class

Great teacher, passionate about making you understand. Shows concern when you don't understand. Best health science teacher at UM. And he's not mean at all. He's actually funny and nice. Whoever said he was mean probably doesn't know him.

Any one who rates this professor poorly doesn't study very well. Questions aren't tricky and they are straight from the book or powerpoints. His lectures are also straight from the book! No surprises. Paying attention in class helps a lot. If you think Deleon is hard...try taking Grayson!
He's alright and you will do fine if you put in more effort than cramming before tests. Not the hardest class I've taken, but not the easiest either.

he's nice & will try to help you but don't email him, he hates it. tests are ridiculous, study a week in advance & you'll pull a B or higher on every exam. lectures get boring, its straight from the power point. MUST read the book, he puts things on test from only there

Worst ! Cant stand his extremely difficult tests...if you said ok he teaches the material well then ok I would be prepared. I believe he could modify his teaching. Also extremely too much material to be covered.

Not the best professor. He is a nice guy but needs to get stuff straight regarding his class. His exams are 4-5 PP but vary immensely with material covered in book. He should provide study guides at least covering a % as Phy is not that easy. His take home tech is helpful but his questions are horrible even while using the book. The only tea! :-(

This was one of my favorite classes at UM. Dr. Deleon is a very dynamic, fun professor who really likes what he teaches.  There are 5 tests, including 1 take-home. They aren't easy but he will throw out bad questions and he curved 1 test. I got an A by attending every lecture and reading the book. I definitely recommend him!

two tests into the semester and i have a 94 and a 98.5 on the first two exams. take him if you are debating this or grayson and just want a background in anatomy and not to end your social life and have lab practicals on saturday as grayson has. nice teacher and means well, gave study guide as well as curved both exams to this point. read the book!
Terrible teacher. There were exam questions that were neither from lecture nor the textbook. Also, don't disagree with him, he thinks he's above being incorrect.

Not a very good professor. Unwilling to help his students, makes a million mistakes and doesn't take responsibility for them. He doesn't give back the test and makes you jump through hoops to see your exams at office hours. His unwillingness to award you points that he marked incorrectly undermines your hard work. Its a shame he's the only professo

He is really unorganized, doesnt post the power points on time, and always messes up the numbering on lab quizzes. but overall he is not that difficult. as long as you know the diagrams (which he posts before the exam) and study a little, you're fine

nice professor, very knowledgable and makes lectures interesting. he takes attendance but it doesnt count for a grade. his powerpoints usually aren't on the test, but THE BOOK IS. read the book, memorize body parts. it takes a lot of studying to do well. the tests are straight forward and he sometimes gives extra points for coming to class

great, fun and interesting class. I recomend it to anyone who is willing to study and attend class. He makes everything very interesting and unique. Test are ok if you study. He curves and drops the lowest grade out of 4 test... Great professor!!!

this class is really easy for anatomy.. going to class is kind of helpful and you take notes from his powerpoint but in the end the tests are literally straight from the book so the powerpoints arent that helpful.. they just reinforce the informations but i got an A in the class and didnt work too too hard just a lot of memorization

Dr.Deleon is annonying in that he's SUPER unorganized, always late for class, and never posts stuff online.  If you gang up on him and beg for slides he finally gets around to asking his secretary to put them up.  If u study and pick up on the stuff he says in class its not that hard.
Dr. Deleon is never prepared for his class and puts on a huge act of being a jerk but is really nice if you speak to him one on one. Also, his copier is always "broken"
Hot! Hot! Hot!  Hottest professor at UM.  Very intelligent and responsible.  The best professor around. Knowledgeable and interesting. Will

people often complain about dr. deleon, but in terms of the class it is not going to be an easy A no matter who teaches it. for nursing you want the material covered well,and he does a great job at that. as long as you study you'll be fine. he really is a great professor.

This man is a genius!  People love to complain.  He is hard working, good-looking and dedicated as a physician and professor.  Grouchy in the mornings but most people are. I'd be grouchy too if I had to deal with my fellow students. Always available for students to help understand material.  (his eyebrows rule!)

He is a horrible professor. Very unorganized and often has many mistakes on his exams. If you take his class you need to be sure to meet with him after each exam, because my grade nearly improved a letter grade everytime due to answers he marked wrong that were actually correct. I mean you can get by, but I don't recomend him at all.
he was a chill teacher who is very intelligent
This teacher did provide study guides b/c we kept asking for them. Besides the study guides, he wasn't much help.

Well, this man is all over the place! very unorganized but is very helpful. He is ALWAYS in his office and willing to speak to students but sometimes even when you speak to him you dont know what to expect. I suggest just reading the book because someetimes his study guides never helped.

Usually people that complain are the dumb ones. i think he is a good teacher, I learned a lot in pharmacology. he is always available to help. yes it is a lot of material, but we are in college not in elementary school, you need to read. It's sad that a lot my peers have to be spoon fed. please grow up.He is a good teacher.

I am only rating him as hard, because he does not teach effectively. He is all over the place and unorganized.  The material in class has nothing to do with the exam content.  I have not learned one thing in pharmacology and if you don't believe me ask the other 95 students in his class.
AWESOME TEACHER!!! exams are exactly what we've been taught. study hard and you'll get a good grade! Dr. D is a great teacher!! can't wait to have him again for physiology!!

Dr. D is super cool, and his class is not REDiculously easy, and he's always willing to help. I don't blame him for being late, which btw he never is anymore, or cranky in the morning b/c I'm just as pissed to be there that early too. I have yet to open the book and am doing really well in the class so that shows that he's a good teacher.

Duh!!!!! anyone that is nice has the ability of also being rude or nasty, that all depends on how a person is treated. Dr.D is usually pretty cool, sometimes in the morning he is a bit grouchy but who isn't when u have to wake up at 6 AM, other than that he isusually a sweet person. Take his class, treat him with respect and he'll do the same
No Comments

HE IS A REAL SWEET GUY, HE IS VERY ACCOMODATING, YES HE IS NEW AT TEACHING BUT HE DOES KNOW HIS SUBJECT, PEOPLE JUST LOVE TO COMPLAIN, USUALLY IS THE LOOSERS THAT COMPLAIN AND WHINE ABOUT EVERYTHING. I DO RECOMEND DR.D
No Comments

I think he is inexperienced, but he is very knowledgeable. No one seems to remember that we lost a week of class during the hurricane false alarm. He has been late a few times but so has everyone in the class. He is a very cool guy and will do a lot to make sure everyone passes....there are always ****s in a class

Normally the only students that complain are the dumb ones. A students never complain. The sad thing is they complain about this professor yet they take another class with him. This is lack of self respect because if I thought a professor was bad i wouldn't take a class with him.

People shouldn't complain he's not bad at all. If he's behind it means less exams, if he's late it means less class time! If you're in a small lab(mondayz lab only has 8 ppl) he's a great guy! he's funny and slapstick sarcastic. For students who don't know him he may seem rude but exams are easy and he's a very nice guy!! get in a small lab..

He is the rudest professor I've ever had. He's completely inexperienced but the class the class is very easy. He gets very behind because he doesn't teach what he's supposed to in the class, which would be Anatomy, not Physiology or Pathophysiology which he seems to spend about more than 10 minutes a class talking about.

He is a very easy teacher, but he is a very inexperienced professor.  This is his first semester teaching and really does not know what he is doing.  I figure it could be worse, but I'm doing pretty well in the class so I won't complain.  His test come directly from the book, so its not hard and most people should be able to do well.

Rediculous teacher. He's really easy, exam questions are right from the book, but he absolutely has no idea what he is talking about. He's new, so he's extremely unexperienced. He's got an attitude problem as well and he's not very nice. He came late to class 98% of the time. I'm only taking him again next semester because he's easy.

When I took his class, he ended up in the hospital right after the first test. The rest of the class was taught by subs and each of them would write different exams. It was tough, and I still don't know how I passed it. Diresta seemed accommodating though, and seemed like a nice guy for the month he taught.

Exams are impossible and tough to study for. Maybe I am wrong about this but my 2 friends, one of whom was studying way more than me did somehow worse than me. I got saved by an huge curve (for a bio class) at the end, and got a solid grade, but lectures did not help whatsoever.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Going to class was a waste of time because DiResta continually got off topic or just paused for minutes on end. You are better off reading the slides and book at home and then studying the past exams for practice. Exams are somewhat difficult but usually repeat questions.

Dr. DiResta was great until he had to leave for medical reasons. His lectures were way faster in PRISM than any other general biology, placing us 8 chapters ahead by the middle of the year! This class was tough to keep up but the Dynamic Study Modules, Practice Ebook Tests, and Easy Notecards were very helpful in passing the class.
He's lowkey high most of class but he'll give alright lectures. Ask lots of questions because his tests are very conceptual based and you have to understand everything that is going on

Very challenging exams compared to first half as questions are application based, leaving you mentally exhausted a bit into the exam. Also very book heavy. Lecture PowerPoints have very few words on them so you need to pay attention or just rely on the book. Definitely not recommended if taking another challenging class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DiResta was great to have for the INT labs. he was so nice and really didn't care what you were doing as long as you went every day and did some experiment by the end of the semester. let us leave within 30 mins to 1 hr almost every time. barely any assignments and he just gave everyone an a if they went to class and submitted the work.
Had Diresta for the HHMI lab and it was a chill lab. No quizzes but we had to do presentations. He would help guide and assist our group when we needed help with our experiments.

DiResta is a good and nice professor. His slides are just pictures from the TB, and he has some thinking questions with long responses. He also rushes through the slides. Almost every class there is a quiz, so always review. Practice exams are not like the actual ones. Exams (50 questions + bonus) are full of long questions and random graphs.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's a very nice professor but you will need to study. I personally did not attend many of the lectures in person and still performed well. HIS EXAMS ARE EASY NOTECARD HEAVY. The final exam was very hard and didn't relate to prior tests or the practice tests so you really need to understand the lecture content. overall an understanding professor.

I personally did bad on all the exams and still ended with a B. Super chill, wants everyone to do well. Uses alot of questions from easy notecard, which I didnt know. Not alot of work at all, only easy hw, easy workshop, and exams. Exams multiple choice and a couple short answer.

Dr. DiResta is an amazing person and genuinely cares about his students. However, his lectures do not accurately reflect the content that will be asked on the multiple choice section of his exams. DO pay attention to his lectures on case studies and other real world applications as he often asked those as short answer qs. Be ready to read the book!
Very nice professor and WAY better than Mallery and he knows it. Exams were so hard due to quizlet and other than that I just watched netflix in class 24/7.

Dr. DiResta is the best biology professor you will ever have. His lectures tend to be dense but he really tries to make the content interesting and applicable to real-life (case studies, examples, etc). Exams are not bad, extra credit on all of them, but just be prepared to read the textbook to study. Overall a really chill, and caring professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: had him for hhmi lab and he was the best. super nice and caring and always gave feedback on our project. he was extremely chill and honestly just left us to do our own thing for the most part.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: He is an okay professor, but the class is challenging. You should pass if you do all the assignments

Dr. DiResta is one of the best professors at the U. Lectures are interesting and the exams are straightforward. He gives extra credit on the exams to help your grade, and he's always willing to meet outside of class. Take good notes in lectures, and do some reading yourself and you'll get an A. Highly recommend to all students especially for PRISM!

He is an amazing professor. His lectures were all super informative and interesting. However, his tests dont reflect the lectures all that well; be prepared to read the textbook and study outside of class. Other than that, there is so many nice things to say about him. Amazing professor and person, I would highly recommend him!

Super kind but very lecture heavy, talk super slow and class can get boring. Hard class in general so you have to study to pass. No homework but quizzes are a must after every class. Tests are very long and use Lockdown.

Dr. DiResta is kind and funny, but he underestimates how his students feel. Several times students felt like the class was extremely hard without a curve, and his questions on tests are concept-application based. Hard material to like, he tries to engage students though. Class goes way too fast.

I loved Dr. DiResta! He's so kind and cares about his students. I found his lectures fascinating as he is very knowledgeable and led students to critically think of concepts. It's important to read the textbook beforehand or have some prior knowledge such as from AP Biology as his lectures are more applicative and talk about the general picture.

I had Dr. DiResta for PRISM BIL 150. Be prepared before coming to class by reading the chapters beforehand since his lectures don't cover the concepts as in depth; he teaches about a lot of real-world applications of the concepts you learn. He is very caring, and makes himself available to help you, just reach out to him! Overall great professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: He's a great teacher, and he's always available outside of class if needed. His tests are mostly straightforward with a handful of application questions. He uses easynotecards and other test banks, so those are great practice and review. He also gives practice tests and repeats those questions. All his tests have extra credit questions!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He was very chill and tried to make his class easy, especially once everything shifted online. There were extra credit opportunities for every exam. However, because of how easy the class became, I was less motivated to learn the material. But overall I would say he's one of the more lenient and easygoing BIL150 professors.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He is a good guy and cares about the information. Def one of the better Bio teachers
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Such a great professor, and really helpful. Sooo lenient with hw deadlines. Was really great through the transition to online class. No group project final.

I had him for both BIL255 and BIL150. I would highly recommend getting access to previous exams for both these classes, he uses similar questions and the previous/practice exams are the best representation of what his exams will look like. Powerpoints are very thorough, and you can tell he is knowledgable & wants everyone to succeed in the class.

I took him for BIL255 and it was the biggest mistake I have made. His power-points are not helpful, his tests are very heavy and don't cover what we learned. You are pretty much on your own for his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: The test questions were tricky and really specific and mostly based off of the textbook, although he sometimes threw in a few questions from what he directly asked the class in lecture. PP slides were useless. Make sure to read/outline the textbook chapters and do the problems at the end of each chapter. I got an A, but I had to really work for it.
Good prof, exams are complex and questions are long. Some qº are taken directly from in-class questions. However, his lecture format and test questions are WAY clearer and fairer than Dr Mallery's.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: The class covers a lot of information but as long as you put in the time to read and understand the textbook, you will do fine. All of his exams have extra credit on them and aren't too difficult. The final is a lot more difficult but as long as you do well on the other tests and really read and understand the textbook, you'll be fine.
It's a bio class so prepare to read. Not that hard if you are dedicated to thoroughly learning the material. Expect late nights and a few tears for an A and up.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Diresta is an interesting teacher, go to most of the lectures as he explains the material well. Grade is based on 4 tests, the tests aren't too difficult as the questions are more general, just study the lecture notes and skim read the textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Extremely unclear syllabus which changed continuously throughout the semester. He had no clear grading scheme for his lab abstracts so you were never able to know what your grade is until the end of the semester. He was terrible at responding to emails and returned abstracts very late. Not very caring. Good lab but he's not a good professor for it.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Bio 150 is an extremely hard class no matter who you take. This is the best teacher for it however (if you go to class, which most people don't). Your whole grade is dependent on 4 exams and a final, which are all extremely specific and very hard. He gets his exam questions from easynotecards though, so definitely take advantage of that.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. DiResta is a great teacher. He relates what he's teaching about the body to things we can relate to, which makes his lectures interesting. I suggest going to every class so you don't have to struggle with reading as much, though you probably will have to before the test. Really interesting class and he treats all of his students like adults.
gets all questions from textbook. good teacher who wants you to do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Wow, I have never had to work harder or read more for a class. You have to read so much, try not to wait till the weekend before the exam to read. Attendance is not mandatory, I never went, and I received an A-. Tests are straight from easy-notecards for the most part. Difficult class for sure, but I hear he is the best BIO 150 prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Such an amazing professor. Way better than Gaines, he doesnt speed through lectures and his exams are straight from easy notecards. Beat professor. Mastering biology homework is required but doable

I took this class through PRISM. His tests had a built in curve and consisted of around 40 MC questions and 5 FRQ (which were usually applications of class examples). He moves quickly, so read ahead a chapter prior to class. He is a nice teacher, and very knowlegeable. His MC questions tend to be more application (not as straight forward).
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Great teacher!

The only reason I did okay in this class was because of test banks honestly. You NEED to outline the textbook in order to understand the material. His powerpoint aren't really that helpful because they are just pictures straight from the book. The only reason I went to class was because of the clicker quizzes.

I had the misfortune of having Dr. DiResta this past semester as part of the PRISM program. I can safely say I did not learn a thing from his class. He spends the whole time lecturing on a potpourri of information, yet he tests you on much more specific ideas. Do yourself a favor, ready Easy Notecards for Campbell Bio, you'll learn a hell lot more.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: very nice guy but average lecturer and with no fault to it. biology is a hard subject and it is content heavy so he goes over the most important stuff in class but it is responsibility of people to read the chapters, if not you will not do good on the tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Was awesome! Would take again. Dont have to show up to class, and his tests are almost all multiple choice. Gives EC, and 1000 times better then Gaines. If going to UM, take this BIL150 instead of Gaines, no matter what you have to do.

Best Bio 150 teacher out there.  Bio 150 is just a lot of work in itself.  You have to read the textbook like CRAZY.  Lots of tests and each one is over like six chapters.  Gives extra credit on the tests, and if you put in the time you will definitely get an A

Nice guy but very boring lectures. Tests are just as specific as Mallery. He presents from power points and he has a few thinking questions in the slides but DOESN'T PUT THEM IN THE POWER POINTS ON BLACKBOARD, even though he said he will. He only shows the answers in class so if you want to review later, tough luck.

Great professor, and is helpful if you schedule an office hour appointment. Test questions are tough, so the curve will be your friend. Make sure to go to class since some questions are directly from lectures. Recommends reading textbook, but should do fine without it if you attend lectures.

The pace of the course is way too fast and the lectures are extremely unhelpful. You are better off reading the text instead of goin to class. 25% of your grade is "free points" and he curves 5% on top of that. Compared to the other 150 profs, he is by far the best. Take him!

To be honest he's probably one of the easiest bio 150 profs out there. The problem is that there is too much content in the class. You are expected to literally memorize 20 pages worth of intense material every other day. He pulls his tests off the test bank and his 4 free response questions can't really be studied for in advance.
Great Person. There to help.
Honestly, you don't really need to attend class. You're better off reading the textbook instead. His lectures don't help. Also, his tests are really specific and tough.

He taught the second half of BIL255. He really challenges you to think critically on his tests, so get ready to study hard and make sure you understand everything. I didn't really go to class, but in hindsight going to class would have been helpful even though his lectures were boring. His tests are TOUGH but he's helpful if you ask questions.

This class is much easier than the other Bio sections. He teaches PRISM so basically the class goes faster but his tests are relatively easy. Extra credit on every test and free 200 points out of 800 by homework and easy online assignments. You really don't need to show up to class but it helps. Without a textbook, you'll fail. Very helpful person!

DAN IS THE MAN! A really helpful professor.  A little boring/awkward in class, but at review he'll tell you everything you need to know.  Tests are tricky but he usually gives bonus.  He bumped me up from an A- to an A because i went to class often(most kids dont) and he knew me well.  If you have him, dont worry about it!

Tests are confusing, very unclear. Topic itself is confusing and uninteresting to me, so that doesn't help much. Read the book and know the powerpoints. Covers some topics in class that will be on the test, so if you don't go at all, you may miss some topics. Otherwise, a really nice guy, willing to help.

Probably the nicest professor at Um extremely helpful and made class super fun. Does not go off book goes of power point and his own life experience. Took him over the summer and had a blast also you get to go on field trips.
He's an excellent teacher, he knows his subject well, is clear, and interesting. The class is not hard at all as long as you show up and pay attention.
One of the nicest guys you will ever meet...really sparks your interest in the class. I would definitely recommend him.
A little strange at first. But an awesome awesome guy. Ask for help with anything, or just have chat.
Hes a great teacher but i wish he would slow down with the power points. i mean, i take notes on my comp and he goes through them like nothing. otherwise hes awesome and a pretty cool professor :-)
great

This is a lab class.  He thoroughly goes over everything beforehands during lab meetings, and expects one to understand the biological mechanisms when they actually perform the task.  Great guy with a great personality.  Allows for everything to be revised (more than once, if needed).  Highly recommended.  Writing cred.

Amazing guy. He's the type of teacher who will help you out and lead you all the way to the answer, but make you find it for yourself. He also teaches BIL 151 (HHMI), giving you some experience bleaching coral. Be prepared to think.
Cool guy who made the class interesting for a non-science major.  Definitely recommended.
No Comments
The classes are really boring because they read straight from the powerpoint.  The tests are pretty easy if you study the class notes and the book.
No Comments
good extra credit and powerpoint presentations on website
No Comments

This is truly a special professor. He and genuinely cares about his students. I definitely recommend meeting with him and attending office hours. When I struggled with one of the projects, he built a custom ChatGPT to guide me through the steps. I've never had a professor do something like that before, and it was incredibly helpful.

Worst professor in the Business Law department, and it is not even close. I think he somehow prides himself on making the topic far more confusing than it needs to be. If you ask a question, there is maybe a 25% chance that he will actually answer it. Avoid.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Donelson is one of the best professors at Miami I have had. If you can take BUS 300 with him I would not hesitate to do so I learned so much for the course that's applicable to everyday life/business. Def an eccentric dude but good advice none the less
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Donelson is an outstanding instructor—knowledgeable, inspiring, and crystal clear. He connects concepts to real-world examples, keeps discussions lively, and gives actionable feedback. I left the class more confident and genuinely excited each week.
Saturday classes are usually rough, but Professor Donelson made this class fun and time flew by. He emphasizes learning by doing and teaches you a lot of very practical skills.
I look forward to attending this four hour class on Saturdays because I have left every single class session with practical, real world lessons/tools that I will begin applying at work on Monday.

One of the best classes at UM. I loved the topic. He uses very recent cases some even currently happening. Only con is its a large class (like 50 students). lots of people went the entire semester without ever participating and it was probably a boring class for them. Going to office hours is clutch and if you do he will go the extra mile for you.

Really just a terrible experience. He is a very very disorganized guy. Barely lectures and there are no notes or powerpoints on blackboard. He just stands in front of the class asking random questions that no one can answer. The final exam is also worth 50% of the grade. I would take literally any other BSL professor if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I learned a lot in BUS 300 but it was because of the types of projects Donnelson assigned rather than what we learned. He is very smart and will guide you along the way if you go to him however very challenging and at times it feels like the class as a whole could be all over the place. Most kids get an A if they put in the work.

Never in my life have I experienced a professor this disorganized. No materials during lectures. He refuses to teach us the info he tests on. He skirts questions without giving any answers, leaving us to guess the material. Worst professor I've had bar none. Do not take this class, or this professor. (got an A, not complaining about a bad grade)

I was extremely disappointed by this class & professor. White Collar Crime is such an interesting topic, and one that has so much potential. Business law is my passion & I have never been so bored and unenthused by a class. Professor Donelson teaches in a disorganized & lifeless manner, leaving everyone confused and disengaged.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was the most disorganized class I've taken. I was so confused during class even though I think this topic is very interesting. You are given 20-40 page readings that you barely talk about. There is one midterm and one final worth 50% of your grade. I was disappointed that he was the professor for this class.

If you want a teacher with great stories and that keeps you on your feet, take this guy. While he's spontaneous, which can be stressful, he's just awesome. If you can take him in a 3-hour once a week format for BUS 300, I'd suggest that. He also fosters communication, and everyone in the class knew each other at the end of it.

Creative, hilarious, but spontaneous professor. Sometimes lectures seem pointless, but assignments and projects really captures your capabilities. He will stop to both praise and critique you. I suggest writing those little critiques down. He is kind and helpful, will give you an A as long as you prove your effort.

Don is a great guy, incredible smart and hilarious. I don't know why but this semester he changed the way this class is taught. It was a really interesting class but the lack of organization and communication was a real struggle throughout the semester. Almost 90% of the classes we entered the classroom without any clue what was waiting for us
I really liked having him, he's got a sharp wit that always made class very interesting. The materials sometimes felt bland, but I thought he was a great teacher, not an easy class however.

Goated business law professor. If you want a chill teacher that'll make law interesting go for this guy. First, quiz everyone bombs but it's the same for all the other BL teachers too. Afterward, it gets easier. He takes attendance and a textbook isn't mandatory but is highly recommended for practice and study. Btw no homework.
An absolute beauty. I love this man even though the miami heat are bad. Gives a quiz every week or two but study the night before and you'll be good. Absolutely take don donelson hes the goat.

Gives you exactly what is going to be on each test. One of the funnier and most genuine teachers I've had. Will curse and make jokes to keep the class lively. Big Sports fan also. Blaw is hard but he makes it as easy as possible. Curves class also!

Professor stresses real world skills. Public speaking, body language, and critical thinking are the three main points of his class. The setting in class seems that he is off the cuff or unstructured which can be unfavorable to some. But none can deny that he brings energy and engages the audience. Only downside is his lack of timely communication.

Amazing professor overall. His lectures are engaging and interesting. My only grievance is that he is hard to reach. You may have to email him multiple times to get an answer. Also he is not clear about grading or the scale. He seems to never give anyone a 100% on an assignment but he does curve in the end.

Donelson is a good guy but kind of an odd professor. His class felt like a huge waste of time, and we rarely talked about substantial, relevant material. That being said, his lectures were interesting, and he is incredibly smart and a super cool guy to talk to. He will destroy you on your first writing assignment, but everything after that easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: GREAT professor. Definitely the best you could take for BUS300 if youre trying to actually get something from this class. He teaches in graduate school as well so you can tell he knows his stuff. He doesnt just hand out A's you need to work for them. He will indeed help you get one if you go to office hours and get feedback. Hilarious letctures

The guy is a lawyer. He teaches you to think like one, but more importantly, to get right to the point when writing and speaking. This class was part of a a Masters in Leadership program. Lot's of impromptu speeches and last minute explanations on presentations. But you will become a better writer, speaker and presenter. You will have to work.

BUS 300 with Donelson was among the most interesting (& useful classes) I took at UM. He truly challenges students to think outside the box & be able to effectively communicate those thoughts. He provides tough critiques of class projects (presentations/papers), but this enhances the critical thinking process. Great professor, 11/10.

The class is all about teaching you to become a business professional both orally and through your writing. Donelson teaches you a lot of great techniques to use throughout your business career. He is very tough and thorough grader, but his feedback is great. Not a very organized professor though and sometimes fails to respond to emails.
Good class that is rly interesting. Usually lets us go a little early instead of taking a break.

I had Don Donelson as part of a summer camp and he is the best teacher I've ever had. He earns the respect of his students, but to do well in his class isn't easy. You have to participate and care about the course work.
This class was way more interesting than it should have been.
Very good class! Easy if you follow instructions and work hard
He's a boss, 'nuff said.

Donelson is amazing! Best teacher at UM. You will learn a lot by just attending class. The class emphasizes participation, so you are expected to contribute to the conversation. Your writing will improve by taking his class.

Donelson is awesome !!! He makes what should be a boring class into something that is interesting and useful almost every single day. He's also one of the smartest professors I've had. Group project kind of sucked but that's only complaint I have.

Mr. Donelson is one of the few teachers at UM that you must take a class with. Not easy, but you will learn a lot. This guy is incredibly smart, well-spoken, and good at teaching you practical things you can use when out in the business world. This class specifically was the only one at UM that really helped me become a better speaker and writer.

Donlelson is an extremely intelligent dude. The material that he teaches is on a dull subject that he makes interesting and very useful. Grades logically and always has great feedback. Be participative, put in some effort, and you'll do well. When he does crack a joke on occasion, it's usually hilarious.

Great professor! Did not look forward to take it but he made it not only tolerable but interesting and fun as well. Read the book, pay attention and do as he says on the quiz and you're good. The quizzes are lengthy and require a lot of detail for full credit but are doable. He's young, smart, and funny. I'd recommend him.
Extremely useful stuff.
This class was hard. Especially since he goes really fast, is disorganized, and a really tough grader. Quizzes almost every week which are tricky and hard.
He is very good at telling you exactly what you need to know. He helps you all along the way and is very clear and descriptive. Great teacher and he wears the coolest stuff.

One of the best professors I have had at UM. I was encouraged and challenged to think outside of the box in his class, and it was truly an eye-opening experience. He aims to teach you life-long critical-thinking,writing, and presenting skills that are absolutely crucial in the business world. Plus, his sass game is on point and he's a cutie

My favorite professor out of my entire freshman year! Business Law is a challenging class regardless of who your professor is, but if you take Donelson you get to have someone who is hilariously sarcastic, into sports, and is overall entertaining.
It's a hard class. I happen to be interested in law so I have a much easier time showing up. He's a great professor, and works very hard to make this an interesting class. This is my favorite class!
Legit.

Could not keep up with his class! It was extremey difficult, boring, tedious! And not to mention harsh grader! Not organized in the slightest. He is the hardest BSL teacher! He even admits so and likes to brag about how hard he is. I took another one later, and he was much better and easier.
Pretty cool guy. Classroom presence is phenomenal.
Good prof overall. Some work was tedious, I questioned the university for hiring someone so young to teach graduate courses, but it wasn't really an issue at the end of the day.
Good teacher

Great teacher, let's put it this way, I was previously very curious and interested in taking his class. Now that I'm out of it, BSL is my major. Need to go to class take good notes study and write a lot for his tests but they aren't that hard and he keeps that class interesting and fun so nothing to complain about.

Straight forward. Humorous anecdotes but when it comes to tests, wants you to really get into the material and apply it to the case study given. Lectures are awesome and if you study them well, don't need to read that much from the book (just as an overview). Otherwise, have to read. Definitely recommend as an intro to bsl law and law in general.
Good prof. I would reccomend him. He is young and REALLY funny.
good prof

Great professor. He is hard, but I think he is hard because he respects us and believes in our abilities. I feel like he truly wants us to leave his class as better people who have learned a lot about the material and ourselves. Quizzes seem harder than the other BSL profs, but the grades end up fair.
he has the best tie and oxford shirt combinations...although sometimes he combines patterns and stripes which can be weird.

Knows what hes talking about and is willing to help you, but he expects a lot more of his students than the other BSL professors so his class is a little harder. You really do learn a lot though and its really interesting. I dont think class is boring either, not all the time at least

Youngest professor in the department. Boring and long classes. Nice guy. Quizzes almost every week based on chapters of the book. Questions can be tricky but you just need to memorize the summary of the chapter at the end (almost always like 2 pages) and write them down on the quizzes. He's helpful I would recommend him. Attendance is mandatory.
He is very fair in his grading, as others have mentioned, but you do need to study consistently to do well. I especially appreciated the real-world applications discussed throughout the course.

You actually need to study for this class. My friend in the other class have a group final with open book. Here is closed everything and much tougher. But I learned a lot and he is very fair with the grades. Also he gives partial credit and meets with you during office hours.

Dont take him. He doesn't care about students only grades he won't meet with you outside of class he recommends going to ta office hours only also only two exams if you fail those u fail the class and he wont care to help you at all. Attendance is mandatory

I'm pretty sure some of the ratings he makes himself  (the ones with 5 rating, 5 difficulty, only would take again: yes, and some basic sentence) Don't be fooled by the 4.5 difficulty. :)

If you pay attention to his lectures and attend his office hours or the TA's office hours, you should be able to pass this class. Professor Donna is clear and very organized, he gives you what will be on the exams, and if you study, you will do fine. Great knowledgeable professor.
Curves everything. You have to study but he is extremely geneorus with grades. Take a different profe if you dont want to study.
Inspiring class. I had to study but got an A so far. We have our last class tomorrow and he sent us a poem by email to everyone. It made my day!
Best professor in UM. He is the only research professor teaching principles!
Very clear and fair with the grades. He solves everything in board.
Learned a ton. Extremely supportive during office hours even when packed of people
You have study, but he is very fair.

Only good ratings because of curve, teaches very different material from most microeconomics classes.

great class if you want to lear micro. do not take it if you just want to pass

he is a very bad teacher. do not take him ever. he does not know how to teach. he teaches as if the whole class knows everything already. he never directly answers question and speaks very fast. he takes his job too seriously and it is not a fun environment to be in. it will by far be your most stressful class with the most work if you take him.

This professor is very good. The only research professor teaching principles at UM. It says a lot. Take advantage of it!

This is the best UM professor. Constant encouragement of participation and the breakout rooms are amazing. Really helped enhance understanding of the topics. I learned a lot. But be prepared to study.
Very engaging lectures that allowed to cover lots of complex topics in an easy way.
Structured very well class with clear guidelines and practice exams
He is great at explaining complicated topics to students and is a very nice guy. He is always open to answering questions and is very vivid with his exam criteria.
Great pace for the class, particularly for the discussion or review of key concepts that reinforce the material even further.

Great intro class with substantial work and help from the professor.

best professor!!! Teaches modules well. Tests are curved, so that helps a lot.
Best class but your should get ready to study. I liked the real world cases and problem sets. He is always available after class for help!
Hard but best class ever. Love Javier's style.

Professor Donna is knowledgeable about what he is teaching. He is very available outside of class and very kind and understanding.
