reviews.comment: So much harder than other classes. You can do well, but it is NOT easy to. He tries but the lectures are pretty boring. The textbook is so hard to follow, use the slides and go to lectures! Know the case studies and math problems for tests. Review with him before exams. But I would avoid him all together if you can help it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: If you want a stress-free class, think twice. The professor is smart but not the best teacher. Lectures r concept heavy, while exams are very hard. You'll need to teach yourself a lot. I still don't know my grade... which adds stress. If you're good at self-studying, you'll survive, but don't expect much from the lectures, its just a LOT

We have 2 weeks to do problem sets (the only HW given) leading up to exams (13-20 questions), and during those 2 weeks we have two classes where we go over specific questions from the problem sets. 100% of the time those questions we went over were on the exams. Professor Donna is really good at what he does, he might even be overqualified.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Clear grading criteria, with 30% of the exam being questions he has explicitly done in class. Problem sets aren't graded on accuracy. You have two weeks to complete ~15 questions, with no penalty for being wrong. His office hours are very helpful, he is very intelligent and patient. Grade gets double curved at end.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class is graded based in 3 exams, attendance, participation, and 3 homework assigments. He doesn't dedicate anytime to explain the concepts he is teaching which overall makes the class ridiculously challenging to understand. He gives off the vibe that he doesn't really care. This is a common feeling amongst people who are doing poorly and good.

UM has the WORST math department, but Alvio is the exception. Yeah, Calc 2 is hard, but he tries to help everyone understand. There were 4 midterms, all very similar to the review done in class and posted review questions. His exams are designed in a way that you should know what to do in each question. If you study, you will be fine.
After test 1 I thought I was going to fail but 2 and 3 were alot easier. He is very smart and helpful definitely take him.

Truly one of the best Professors I have ever had. His lectures were well organized and he explained new concepts in such a way that made me understand why it works and not just how it works. He is very knowledgable about math and every lecture was fascinating. His exams are very straightforward if you pay attention.

Chronic mumbler and nonchalant during office hours final boss. Pick your seat wisely because he'll block half the blackboard the entire lecture and will move 30 seconds before erasing everything. 3 non cumulative exams (including the final), online HW with 2 attempts. Study and you'll be fine, but I didn't care for his teaching style at all.

Very good lecturer, prob learned the most i will out of calculus i would expect from myself. In my opinion the midterms should be more weighted and the final should be a little less but the grading system is fine as well.

The university should do a study of Prof Dominguez's teaching techniques, and apply it to all other math courses. They are engaging, well paced, and quite interesting. Prof Dominguez is a rare professor who has immense knowledge of his field who is also passionate about spreading that knowledge to his students.

Really great professor, explained the topics really well. I always felt like I knew what was going on and the exams felt easier than the homeworks. If you're good at basic math and pay attention in class, you'll get an A. I don't think I studied much at all outside of just homeworks and I was fine.
He da GOAT

I heard so many horror stories from students in other Calc 2 classes..
I thank Prof. Dominguez every day for sheltering me from the horrors of the UM math dept.

(Great professor, loved his class and would take it again.)
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Dominguez is a very good professor, probably the best in the math department. If you do the study guides that he gives for the exams, you should be good. The study guides sometimes are similar to the exams or he just uses the same questions and changes the numbers. There are 4 exams and the final exam which is 30% of your final grade.

Professor Dominguez is probably the best math teacher I have had in the past twenty years. He doesn't just teach calculus; he also changed the way I used to think about problems, giving me an entirely different perspective on the subject. He is passionate about teaching and can tell he cares deeply about his students and wants everyone to succeed.

One of the best professors in the math department for sure- if you do the study guides and understand them they are almost the exact same as the tests. He makes hard concepts easy to understand and goes through a lot of examples in class
one of the best professors in the math department

Dominguez is (in my opinion) the best calc 2 prof @ miami. Sit in the front, pay attention, and DO THE STUDY GUIDES (they are almost identical to tests). He is at times hard to keep up with, but just keep going and ask questions and you'll be fine. A great teacher in a terrible math department

He was the best math instructor I've ever had. He made the concepts understandable and there was a lot of examples practiced in class. He responds to emails very quickly and genuinely wants his students to do well and understand the concepts. I would take any math level class if he was the professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Dominguez is the BEST calc 2 prof. He makes the subjects very understandable and is passionate about getting you to understand what he is teaching. His lectures are easy to follow and the practice exams are very similar to the actual exam. If you have any questions, he is big on communication and answers emails fast.

He is so sweet and caring! I 100% suggest taking his class if you struggle with maths. He starts every class with a small summary of the previous one and he makes sure that everyone understands. He loves what he does and he makes sure you sort of like it too. I failed many maths classes before him and in his calc2 class I got A!!

Tests are basically the study guides, just keep doing the study guide a few times over and you'll be good. He makes it easy to make up work if you missed it but show up to class because he will go over test questions in there. Best teacher and grader for Calc 2

Professor Dominguez is a must-take for Calc 2, a hard subject that he makes doing well so achievable. He stopped attendance after the first exam, but you MUST go to class to succeed. There're practically no online resources and you'll be relying on his in-class notes. Nonetheless, he is amazing. Do not underestimate the material and study,.

Best calc 2 professor at the uni! He has a bit of an accent which can throw you off the first lecture but be sure that you will learn a lot! He explains things very well, answers all questions, exams are straight forward and the final was the easiest exam by far! He is not a fair grader... he is a very gracious grader!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He explains things very clearly and is friendly.  His review packets for the exams are very similar to the exams themselves.  If you understand the review questions you should ace the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He is AWESOME!!! Super nice and funny guy and a really good teacher. Tests are pretty fair and based off of the posted reviews. There is not too much homework and it also helps with the exams. The final can replace the lowest test score and there are 4 exams + the final. He's definitely a good professor for calc 2 and wants students to do well.

I love math, but even I admit that calc II is hard. he is definitely the best professor to take for calc II, he is not only caring and funny, he is a fabulous teacher and the most fair professor I have had at UM. your grade is based solely on tests, but he does a week of review which is very helpful.

Best professor ever,TAKE FOR CALC 2! I've always been pretty good at math, but was nervous to take calc 2 in college. He makes it so easy. The class may seem confusing but then he uses 2 days to review and goes over the exact problems that will be on the test, and also provides a study guide with answers. super sweet guy and guaranteed to do well

Just watch his lectures and do the homework and do the review if you had time, exams were problems from class/homework/review, if not they were very similar. Sometimes hard to understand because he speaks so fast. I took this class in high school so it definitely came easier to me, but still Professor Dominguez is a solid choice for this class

I like math and really enjoyed the class. If you are good a math, I recommend not buying the homework access code since I felt like the reviews were sufficient for the tests. Your grade is based on 6 exams and an optional final (which replaces the lowest exam). Sometimes I felt confused about what he was teaching, but I always figured it out.

Dominguez made Calc 2 actually manageable. I took the course fully online and despite the format, his lecturing style is very clear, and he gives really concise examples and explanations of the problems he wants you to understand/know for the test. The homework was optional and ungraded, and 6 total exams, with an optional final. Def take him!!
Great option if you don't want to learn anything. He does not even grades exams, just gives arbitrary scores and then A's and B-s.

Easily the best math professor I've had. Explains topics really well and always reviews them the next class. His tests are almost the exact same as the study guides so if you can do those, you will pass the class. You do have to attend as he takes attendance everyday. I highly suggest taking him especially if you aren't the best at math.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great guy-- I didn't have the braincells to pay attention for more than 10 minutes at a time, but he teaches in a clear and concise manner. His practice exams are almost exact to the tests and he does an amazing job explaining any problems.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Take him for precalc hands down. Best math professor here at UM for precalc. Homework is OPTIONAL! If you have taken precalc in high school it is so easy. Tests are multiple choice and closely reflect the study guide. Yeah he makes you a full detailed study guide. Heavy accent but not difficult to understand. Very funny!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The best math teacher Ive ever had. The subject matter that he teaches is difficult, but because of him I have a good grasp. I never thought I would enjoy math but he makes it philosophical and understandable. He will take the time in class to answer all your questions exactly. The way he explains math is genius and I get the concepts right away.

great professor, explains everything clearly and does not complicate things. exams are basically like homework problems, so if you do the homework and pay attention you should get As (and its multiple choice..). Attendance is non mandatory but he does give points on attending lecture. does not grade homework. drops lowest grade.
Really nice guy, accent is kind of heavy but he makes everything pretty straight forward. Homework is optional. Tests are multiple choice and he curves all of them and drops your lowest test score.

He took attendance in my class but definitely an easy A. He doesn't actually grade the homework so you don't have to do it. Exams are multiple choice so if you show up to class and study the material a bit you should make an A.
Easy tests, all multiple choice along with a very generous curve. Definitely take Alvio

Very good teacher. Made calc 2 as simple as it could be. Not too much homework, multiple choice tests and they are curved pretty well. 6 exams, drops your lowest score and if you end with an A, you don't need to take the final. Take him if possible

Dominguez is, hands down, the best professor for MTH 162.  All of his tests are multiple choice.  Attendance isn't mandatory but you need to go to class if you want to do well.  He is frequently available beyond class hours and is very responsive to emails.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: He's a good calc 2 teacher, one of the better ones. His class is probably one of the easier calc 2 classes at the school. Your only grades are 6 tests, which are all multiple choice. Alot of the test is what he reviewed in class. He teaches the concepts good as well. Final is optional and can replace test grade. Would highly recommend.

Incredible teacher. He truly does a great job teaching a subject that has a bad stigma (Calc 2). I read his reviews on here and decided to take him - best decision I've ever made. Curves tests significantly, you don't need to take the final if you don't want to, and above all he makes a hard subject easy and fun to learn.  Wish he taught physics...
tests are multiple choice but are pretty hard.  luckily, there is a pretty nice curve on the tests.  class isn't required but its highly suggested.  drops lowest exam or no final, your choice.
Very nice teacher who wants you to do well. Can speak very fast at times but he actually knows everything there is to know about Calc

Very helpful teacher, great explanations of the course material, great sense of humor, willing to help you after class. Lets you drop the lowest test or just not take the final. No quizzes and tests are fair.

Alvio has cracked the code for calculus- he completely understands calculus in a way that a neuroscientists knows the brain. He truly has a passion for math (I never knew someone could) and explains things more thoroughly than any math teacher i've ever had. He is a very kind man and gives multiple choice tests and lets you drop the lowest one.

Literally the nicest, most helpful math professor I've ever had. He understands the topic and explains it VERY well. He'll answer every question and if you need more help he'll meet you anytime. As long as you put forth an effort and pay attention in class, you'll do well on the tests. He wants you to succeed.

Why doesn't dr francis have reviews even though shes been teaching for decades? Its because she does so little teaching. Her course structure is extremely haphazard and she comes to class un prepared but expecting students to have done the reading. Grading is random. Unnecessary stress and self-teaching taking her class.
Prof. Francis puts so little effort into her teaching that it's laughable. She issues grades randomly.

Class was boring and a joke. I only went to class because she took attendance. The professor had no idea what she was doing. But the class work was pretty easy as long as you tried a bit on your writings.
2 exams, 3 quizzes (drops 1) and a final group project. She is the sweetest lady ever and is always willing to help outside of class. Her lectures can be boring but overall not a bad class.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof Goytisolo is a very very sweet lady. She is very knowledgeable as well. Exams were difficult but she wants to see her students succeed. She offered us a little extra credit after one exam. There was no final, instead a group project which was not bad. 3 Exams and about 3 quizzes as well

She is so professional and caring. You can tell she is very knowledgeable in her subject. She helped me be confident in this difficult course, despite not performing too well on exams. She gives me hope on succeeding and understanding and helps me stay motivated despite my poor exam score. She is very motivational! Best teacher I have ever had.

Prof Goytisolo is great. She is super sweet. Despite it being a lecture heavy class, it isn't all too boring and she teaches the material in an easy to digest way, granted the class itself is still pretty tuff. She genuinely wants to help you learn and will walk you through anything. The tests are very similar to the homework... keep that in mind.

The only professor at this school that I feel like I created a real relationship with. AMAZING professor and is so intelligent. She cares a lot about her students and understands that we have a life outside of school. The tests were not hard, extremely similar to the homework. I sat with her for so many office hours and she was so patient. TAKE HER

Dr. Downs is a very knowlegable professor. He KNOWS what he is talking about. He is approachable with questions and wants you to succed as long as you show you want to succeed too. 

His quizzes were difficult due to extreme application questions but if you know the material you will do fine.

The worst professor i have ever dealt with. His exam reviews are just the questions projected with the correct answer and does not go over the rationale, and he gets rude and fussy when you ask him to explain. He does not care about you. Whatever you do, DONT sign up for his class, and if he's the only one teaching it, withdraw from the program!

Downs is a great person. BUT He goes above and beyond to make things difficult, and there is no one on one help. SO many people have failed his course by /2 points. He is extremely tough and while he's knowledgable, his class is borderline impossible. Most people barely pass with the avg grade of exams being in the 70's after he curves...

I honestly love Dr. Downs, I would recommend him over anyone else and wouldn't think about it twice, all i recommend =p+is going to class asking questions FOCUS during his lectures record him and I know they say you don't need an ipad but it helps so much  
GOOD LUCK

This class actually consumed my entire life. He does explain anything on his slides and you have to frantically scribble what he is saying. You actually use the information he is teaching you though in other classes and in life so I guess you are not stressed out for nothing.

He thinks this is the only course you are taking and he's extremely disrespectful to students when they ask questions in class. His exams are extremely difficult and not based off his lectures or his powerpoints either. Also has a history of academic misconduct.. and falsifying data... Go to "retraction watch" and search his name.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Downs is awesome. He is easy going and does not try and make things difficult just for the sake of being difficult like so many others do. The material is not easy, but you won't be asked unfair questions that you haven't gone over. You need to write literally every thing he says down. What he says is more important than what is on the slides.

Dr. Downs is such a great professor. He truly cares about his students and wants each to pass. No textbook needed, all based on his lectures and ppts. There were only 3 exams, no final. There is an in-class quiz and only 4 case studies due during the whole semester. I wish he was teaching other courses to take him again.

Drennan is awesome. He could talk to you abt MSC for hours. He's always willing to help you understand something, and genuinely cares about his students. I would recommend going to lectures bc a lot of the content in class is on the exam. Also make sure you study for the exams because they're straightforward, but there are lots of FRQs.

Dr. Drennan is a great professor who cares about his students and wants to help you learn the material. He will meet with you outside of his regular office hours if you need, and he is funny and great to talk with. I would 100% take another class with him. Go to his office hours and study sessions before the exams and you will be perfectly fine!

Actually the nicest guy ever! Not great at responding to emails and moves really quickly through content - approaching him before/after class or in office hours is the best way to get a hold of him. Very very kind and tries to be flexible and understanding when he can. Review sessions before every exam! Takes sometimes up to 6 weeks to grade exams
Him and Popendorf are an amazing teaching duo for MSC111. Makes the lectures engaging, very personable, and loves to help out when needed. Class is lots of fun.

Dr. Drennan is such a good professor. Environmental Stats is a really hard class but I actually feel like I understood most of the material because of him. He only teaches stats in the spring so I recommend taking stats in the spring if you can. Hes awesome!

As somebody who typically struggles in math, Dr. Drennan was incredibly helpful outside of class. He is super willing to have office hours for any student that needs it. Additionally, he clearly shows interest in students personally, which is meaningful. He wants you to succeed!

Dr. Drennan is a great professor. He's very smart and very humble about it, and he makes classes enjoyable. He co-taught this class with two other professors and it was by far my favorite course of the semester. He's also very caring, it's not hard to talk to him, which is a good idea given that he opens up a lot of doors for marine science majors.

If you have a background in math from either high school or other university courses, you should have no problems handling the math in this course. Most of the actual math is simple arithmetic, and the only new stuff is learning how and when to apply statistical tests. Exams are pretty easy, but it's easy to lose points on stupid mistakes.
Drennan is a great stats professor and really wants everyone to do well in the course. A super easy grader and very willing to meet with students in office hours.
Fantastic intro course. tests are super easy as long as you're willing to review the material and pay attention in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Drennan co-taught my section of MSC 111 with two other professors, and was easily the most enjoyable of the three. He gives good, thorough explanations of topics that are immediately relevant to the exam material. Not a tough grader at all. Read the book and pay attention in class and you should do fine.

I took a stats class and then climate science with Dr. Drennan. He's an amazing person. In stats, he was kind of confusing but overall helpful. 10/10 he's a nice person, great to talk to, and oh so Canadian. I would definitely recommend taking any of his classes just because of how cool he is. Also, he wears Birkenstocks every day.

doesnt take attendance but if youve never taken stats you will need to go to class. gives an assignment every few weeks that takes a few hours but nothing too bad. only other grades are midterm and a final

He's a very approachable nice guy. the thing is, this class is definitely a lot of work for a 100 level. the tests are not entirely tied into the assignments/lectures, you'll have to work a little harder around exam time. he's very understanding and drops the lowest test and assignment. the final is optional if ur happy with ur grade. too much work

At times his lectures can be really boring, but in general he's a good teacher. He's a fair grader. He gives 4 tests (including 1 final) and he drops the lowest one. There are 6 HW assignments and he drops the lowest one. It is not necessary to go to class, but he takes attendance randomly.

Dr. Drennan has to be one of the best science teachers I have had the pleasure of meeting! He is very knowledgeable in the subject and it shows through his lectures. He is very lenient with the grading as he takes the best 3 of 4 tests and gives a lot of opportunities for extra credit. The course is challenging, but he is very willing to help you!

He's a very nice and helpful professor, and the class is interesting-if this is your major. DON'T take it as an elective! It's a LOT of work. Exams are tricky, lots of writing papers, projects, etc. If you have a full load of classes, you'll struggle all semester. You've been warned.

Dr. Driscoll is an incredible professor. You can tell that he is very passionate about what he is teaching. He keeps class very entertaining with his sense of humor and makes it easy to pay attention to his lectures. His class is very test heavy and it is very important that you make use of his long office hours if you don't do well. But great prof

I love Professor Driscoll. He clearly knows a lot about the subject. very caring, and kind. In terms of difficulty, this is the "hardest" comm class you'll have to take because of the amount of material (court cases) and "ethics" part of it. It is a pre-law class, but listen, take notes, and the tests won't be hard for you.

Hardest class ive taken in the Comms school by far. the lectures are BORING but the material is interesting. there are 3 exams and 3 assignments with a few extra credit points available. first exam is the hardest, but the final is non-cumulative. average on the first exam was like a 60 so most of the class dropped/stopped showing up
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Get ready to study. The course relies on 3 tests and 3 assignments. The professor is very goofy, but his lectures can get boring sometimes; he also passes around an attendance sheet during the lecture. The final is actually the easiest out of the 3 tests if you study and pay attention. Work hard, and you'll probably pass (communication law course)
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Every single class is a lecture, and the material is difficult. Tests are over 200 slides. Test uses hard language to the point where you sometimes don't even understand what the question is. Every test the mean score is 50. There are only 20/130 people showing up cause everyone drops.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is a really nice guy however the tests are too hard. We had 3 exams covering so much material, half of which was from the textbook. Lectures were hard to follow because he forgets to post the slides so I stopped going to class because I felt I wasn't learning anything and ended up doing better on the exams, but he also randomly takes attendance.

5/5 Professor - He truly cares about his students success inside and outside of class. I had a last minute job interview and he was very flexible and understanding. He also is very passionate about his lectures which makes them very interesting. Great person and super funny. Take him!!

Driscoll is a great guy who gives you all the resources you need to do well in the class. But you have to be willing to work, tests are worth most of your final grade and require a lot of memorization, definitely read the textbook. He passes around an attendance sheet every class but I'm pretty sure it's not graded.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Driscoll was pretty good. He's funny but lectures pretty much the whole sem. We have 3 tests that aren't cumulative. So many court cases and facts to remember so be ready to study. I would recommend at least skimming textbook chapters to better understand. One essay due in the class towards the end

Com 250 only has 2 tests each worth 42.5% & its so hard bc they cover so much material impossible to study. The mean score was 68 after the first one so he gave us 2 papers worth 15% to help our grade but not enough assignments overall. he is funny/nice but the class was all over the place & attendance was random only taken 10x the whole semester
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: test are bizarrely hard. review only given out one week in advance, and the only things ur graded on are two tests and like two assignments. the tests are crazy hard. the reviews have like 100 questions on it. but he's the only professor for this course :( takes attendance randomly so important to be there. i would not take him again
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: A HORRIBLE teacher. There were only 3 things he graded: 2 exams & attendance. Each exam was worth 43.5% each so theres no room for error. He didn't stick with the review guides for each exam. He uploaded class material the day before an exam to study. Didn't give us enough time to take the test and NO EXTRA CREDIT. Theres more to say. Dont take him
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Kind of scattered, but a really good guy. He also is a big deal in the Com school so having him like you couldn't hurt.
The class was supposed to be discussion based, but we spent approximately .01% of the time actually discussing.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I had the pleasure of taking Dr. Driscoll both as a freshman and junior. His classes aren't easy A's, but if you put in the work and listen, you'll be fine. He's always willing to help, and he's actually really funny.   I'm glad to see he's still got his pepper!
Professor Driscoll is so attentive and helpful! He really wants you to learn and will guide you through out the process.
Dr. Driscoll is a gem, and a real expert on communications law.
Learned a lot from this class,  I just read the book and studied the power points and I was fine on the tests. I also did the extra credit for insurance. Overall good class.

Great and interesting guy. Tests aren't a joke so to do well you need to show up and read the textbook. However, he gives a very useful study guide the class period before the test so go to that for sure.
Tests are tough, not going to lie. You have to work hard in this class and it is a lot of memorization.

Driscoll is AWESOME. Just go to class, pay attention and study the Powerpoints and you'll do fine (do not even need to take notes).  He does a great job stimulating interest in the material. If you need help with anything just go to his office hours and he is more than happy to help you.

He is a harsh grader. He sends around secretive attendance sheets during class so if you're late you won't be able to sign in. Doesn't work with students who are close to the B range he will just give you a C. Just be on time to class and study the Powerpoints, you should be fine. Him as a teacher he sucks in my opinion.

Driscoll is the man. Honestly, lecture is so interesting so I really suggest going to each class. He's funny. I'm writing this review mainly because he asked me to give him a chili pepper on rmp.com so there Professor Driscoll...your chili pepper has been granted.

he isn't a bad person, but his tests are IMPOSSIBLE and cover around 10 chapters, 10 readings, and 6 powerpoints for each test. and there is a huge research paper at the end. he also doesn't give study guides so you have to memorize everything for what ends up being a 20 question test. i wouldn't recommend him. so hard.

Dr. Driscoll is a great professor, very professional. His class consist in 4 tests all of them 25%. You need to study the textbook and the power points really hard. His test are really hard, but honestly i learned a lot. He gives a lot of extra credits.

Very good professor. He co-wrote the textbook and thus knows a lot of information and he can interpret the text really well (obviously). His lectures may get boring, but he will tell you what will be on exams periodically so it's advised to go to each lecture. His class is awesome! Highly recommended.

Very helpful teacher, funny, works well, and posts the powerpoints online for you to download. Notes were directly from the powerpoints, and he would post lengthy, detailed review guides for each test, which if you did would guarantee you at least a C.
Very good class. Lectures are great and are off powerpoints which he puts online for u to download. Reviews for the tests are also giving. Great teacher
Very good professor. Makes class interesting and is very down to earth. Any crap you give him, he gives it right back, making things more fun.

Professor Driscoll was an extremely interesting teacher. You can tell that he knows the ins and outs of the subject. He'll tease you, and if you say something stupid... well dont do it. lol. but he's awesome. I learned alot. READ THE TEXT. READ THE TEXT. oh! and READ THE TEXT. its really important. He's a brilliant man who makes you think. awesome.
He asked me for a chili pepper :) ... driscoll is awesome! most of the things he says you think "wow...did he actually say that?!" GOOD HONORS CLASS
He's awesome... blunt... but awesome.

Most people in the comm school have to take him sooner or later, so at least he's a decent teacher. His tests could be really tough but as long as you put time (more than I did) into studying, you'll probably escape with no lower than a B. He's somewhat interesting and accomodating, but sometimes he can blowup over dumb things.

Great professor. Makes light of what is usually rather bland material. Unless you're interested in the legal ins and outs of free speech, it might seem ponderous to you. Nonetheless, if you have even the slightest of interest in the subject matter, it's not so bad. Remember the cases and you'll be fine. One of the school's better professors.
Great radio class, glad I could take it with him. Great guy, knowledgeable, sense of humor, easy going. Recommended for any class he teaches.

Driscoll was a horrible teacher. His test expand farther then the actual material covered. I guess he expects you to be a psychic. His lectures are very dull and boring. He has the most annoying monotone and his tests have like 10 questions. If you miss 1, you already have a "B". He is not a professor that I would recommend.

Good Professor.

Well I have to admit his class lecture is very confusing and all over the place. You have to organize it yourself and read the text book in addition to his lecture notes. I will take him again because he allows as many pages formula sheet as you want to bring into the exams.
Nice guy but not a great professor. Lectures were confusing and all over the place.

Very spacy, rambling professor. Would oftentimes need to be reminded where we were in the course, and seemed to forget what he had already taught us.

AMAZING Professor! So nice and incredibly helpful. Will answer all questions you have thoroughly. Spent three class periods of review before each exam. Exams are practically identical to the review sheet.  Explains statistics very logically and in an applied sense, making it easy to understand. You will get lost if you don't pay attention in class.
I would say he is a really nice guy... however, his class is extremely hard to understand... No logic at all....   I would recommend other professor if you are a starter in MAS field.
He is a terrible teacher you will learn nothing all year.  Hard to understand and takes forever to respond to emails.

I took the night class that meets once a week, attendance is not mandatory but if you miss class u will get lost. He is very helpful in his office hours and the tests weren't bad if you are not lazy and actually to do the hw and the review he gives us
Absolutely do NOT take this professor. He is the worst professor I have ever had and I literally have not learned one thing this semester. Everything about this class is an awful blur.

I struggled through the class by having youtube teach me what I needed to know, but it was often not the same as what I actually needed.

Donno is by no means a good teacher. His lectures are impossible to follow as he'll just stand there and ramble on about the same concept for 40 minutes. Don't expect him to do examples or anything helpful. The "notes" on blackboard are just a list of illegible equations without explanations. Textbook is useless. This is truly a terrible course.

Awful course. Awful teacher. It's difficult to pay attention to what he's saying since he just rambles on the entire class and writes formulas on the board. The course material is complex, but he dumbs down the exams so much that you might be able to get an A without actually understanding anything you're expected to know. Overall- a waste of time.

Great professor! He's very nice and is more than willing to help if he sees that you care about your grade and just the class in general. Always willing to meet for office hours and explain material. Not an easy class, but it is definitely better with him. He doesn't make you do calculus that's not necessary!

Gret professor with straight forward expectations. He's always there to explain anything you don't understand. He understands the plight of international students and will help you when the wording gets tricky!
Amazing. Class not mandatory, open note tests, explains very well. You learn a lot and get a good grade

Prof Donno is really nice and cares a lot about his class. He's italian and has a pretty thick accent but is understandable. He is also not the best teacher and can go on rants about topics. The tests are open notes and he's a really easy grader so its not hard to get an A. Boring teacher/class but take him for the easy A!
GREAT PROF! He is super helpful and his lectures are straight forward. His tests are incredibly easy cause he gives old exams to study from, and they're open note. Definitely take Donno if you can!
Not an easy class, but open notes tests and an easy grader. Boring but statistics will never be fun

Tests are open note open book, just study the example handouts he gives you in class and you'll get an A. He's hard to understand but if you ask questions he's really helpful. Definitely recommend over other 303 professors. He's the only open note one
i really enjoyed this class if you pay attention and bring ur notes and his notes to the tests ull get an a i thought this class was really easy and i learned a LOT

I personally think he is awesome!! Yeah he has an accent but he is so funny and doesn't get offended if you just ask him to repeat it....plus the exams are open note!  go to him with questions and he is so helpful...yeah its boring but every stats class is!! definitely take donna he is the man
You can probably get an A without doing much work but you wont enjoy it or learn anything because he's boring, confusing, and has a thick accent. I will say that he's a really nice guy.

After taking this class I will say he's really not that bad. He gives practice exams, lets you use as many notes as you want on the test and is willing to go step by step with you on the project. Do the practice test until you get everything right and take that and your notes to the test. I don't understand people who don't get an A in this class.

I learned a lot in this class!! However this class is very very very boring, and the professor explains in a very confusing way!!! and exams are easy, the final is optional!!!(he does not let u know until is the day of the final exam!!!)

Very easy; Tests/Quizzes are open-notes. If you do better on the final, he replaces your lowest test grade.  Class can be boring and he is sometimes hard to follow; but if you go  and try to pay attention, its a very easy class. If you really want to LEARN and retain the info once the class is over; you should avoid him. If you want an A, take him.

attendance sheet, get a friend to sign. tests are open book, however you will not understand him, and you will always ask yourself why you are in class. 3 tests 33.3% each of 100% grade. you'll never know what is going on till the end of semester.

terrible teacher.  I got something wrong and asked him to explain to to me.. he gave me the answer key and told me to copy it..his tests are worded very poorly.. if you try and point out his mistakes.. he gets very defensive and doesnt give you your points even if he is in the wrong

The class is boring but Donno is an awesome job. He has actual real world experience in corporate America and does a good job teaching if you just pay attention. The class is much more statistics based than the other MGT 303 classes so keep that in mind when selecting.
He said this class would be boring and was right. Avoid at all costs if you want to stay awake and actually learn something.
class is difficult but he makes it easier. required attendance but doesnt always take it. 3 tests for your grade that are noncumulative. hard to understand sometimes but helpful if you ask him.
His tests aren't too tough. Sometimes he throws major curveballs. You should be able to at least get a B though.

easy class open notes. just study, he gives you practise quizes and exams which are similar to the exams you will take. i would take him again. You really do not need the text, he assigns hw but doenst collect it you can just borrow the hw from someone, he gives you all the notes you need printed out.

this guy is hilarious. not the best teacher but his accent and anectdotes are great.  tests and quiz structure is very easy. if you are good at teaching yourself things with the book this is an easy A. i would take him again for sure
Great Guy, exams could get a bit challenging, but its open books and open notes.  Take him, probably the best Stats Prof. ever.

He doesn't present the class material well, so I used the book to help me understand the lessons, but he assigns homework that he doesn't check and his exams are really easy!  He only gives two quizzes and two exams and a final that isn't culmative!  It is really hard not to get an A or a B in the class.
Lets you use notes on quizes and tests and also lets you use the quizes on the tests so its really easy to do well on the tests. doesnt grade hw or take attendance.
practice test similar to real exams...3 tests..no ec..no hw..take notes..impossible to fail...hes very nice and wants his students to get a's..take him

if you really want to learn the material, you will have to do it yourself. Class is easy b/c tests are identical to notes/practice tests! everything open book and he lets you do corrections to improve your grade. Cool guy w/ lots of experience.

Luca!!!!  I love this man!  You have no idea what this man is talking about in class but he gives you practice test that are identical to the real thing AND lets you use your notes, plus, he's a really nice guy.  Gotta love the Italian accent.

Best Professor ever.... makes u understand the material which is hard, but if u come to class and pay attention u'll learn and get an easy A cuz test are open notes. He's is very nice, he makes u understand the class giving lots of examples, he is very concerned about students  getting the material.
He is a great person. Really, help alot to his students. His fair graiding. Take you notes to class and you will be fine. Take him! Great man!
test are easy, especially since you can use the notes. doesnt collect homework. class is very boring but easy
Confusing information, but tests are simple because he lets us use notes and book. Hard material, but easy class and grade.

never went to class... got an A

Dr. Armstrong is an amazing lecturer and professor. Every lesson was engaging and interesting, I thought multi would be difficult but Dr. Armstrong made the course very enjoyable. GOAT Professor. Makes multivariable calculus extremely interesting and fun. Homework's are challenging and thought provoking and exams are fair. You will learn so much in his class, you should absolutely attend.

Armstrong is good MTH224. The class is boring but he is fair and makes an effort to teach to his notes The homework is super hard, but he is willing to help and discuss any questions you have. He is very clear about test and homework material. If you have the option to take him, DO IT you will not regret it.

Probably the best mathematics professor I have ever had, Dr. Armstrong is a truly gifted mathematician. Indeed, Dr. Armstrong is very well-versed in the subject!

Dr. Armstrong is the an amazing professor! He is quite frankly inspirational. The class itself as hard and I didn't have the best background but it has probably been my favorite class at UM. An elective math class taught me more math than all other math classes combined! No final as well usually.

If you love math, take him! He motivates you simultaneously which is GOOD. HWs EXAMs are not so easy but doable.

This was my favorite math professor at UM. He's young (read as relatable), and very good at teaching Linear Algebra.  He encouraged outside learning like MIT OCW but it wasn't neccessary.  Great to go in for office hours and just talk about math.  Excellent teacher would recommend for any and every math class.
This class makes all of your other classes seem less cool. And if you actually do what Professor Armstrong asks you to do, you're going to learn a lot. If you like math you should take this class.

I loved this class and Professor Duran. Yes, you have to go to class and participate if you want to get a good grade. Professor Duran has so much knowledge in the advertising field and I learned a lot.

If you want to maintain your GPA, just don't take her. ~ P_2 ~ Class is NOT interactive. Be prepared to be brutally bored and fight for attendance/participation points. Any chance to take points off, she WILL.
