reviews.comment: Police and Community. His class isn't that interesting, 2 tests (hard) 8 long response questions and a group project. Attendance is mandatory
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Dunham is the best! I took a criminology class with him. He is SUPER clear, very sweet and will answer all of your questions. He provides good preparation for all his test and wants students to do good. Don't skip class!! Class lecture is much more important than outside reading

Took him for police and community. He's such a sweet man and if you ask for help he will definitely give it to you but his tests are tough and your entire grade is a mid term, final, and pop quizzes. The tests are 8 essay questions and you have to be very specific. However, he must curve the grades because I expected a C- and got a B+

Professor Dunham is the nicest guy, and will go out of his way to help his students ! I love him so much and will take every class he teaches. Attendance is not mandatory, which is good because it is sometimes boring, and also interesting like movies on how to deal with cops, cheating is very easy to do and and most of the class matter is logic
The subject matter in this class was awesome! The book was a little dull and the lectures were dry as well, but the research project assigned makes the class enjoyable.

Dr. Dunham is a sweetheart! His lectures/teaching style are Ivy League quality. This class in particular was very interesting, and he always uses personal stories as examples to help students identify with the material. Only 3 exams, and they do cover a lot of material, but it isn't too difficult. Just keep up with the material and you'll do fine.

Sweet professor! Lectures are very informative & interesting (even though I admit falling asleep couple times) He gives the all the poss Qs (~ 30) so u kno wat to expect on exam, then picks 8. Grade is midterm, final& popquiz. quizzes at the end of each theory so u know when it's coming & more or less what to expect. i take good notes & have an A.

Excellent professor, although classes are boring. Attendance mandatory, and all tests are in essay format. But he provides great reviews before the test and the material is easy to grasp if copy powerpoints down (not on Blackboard, you need to show up for class). Textbook only necessary for 1 or 2 questions on test (out of 8)
CLASS WAS OKAY BUT PROF DUNHAM WAS HOT SO THAT MADE IT WORTH MY TIME.

Don't buy book. Tests are from lecture. Class is a test in memorization more than application. But I will say that he knows his stuff and he is a very nice guy. High pressure (a lot of material) midterm worth 1/3 than another high pressure final worth 1/3 and then section pop quizes worth 1/3. He tells you what is on each test..but it's just alot.
super awesome.

He is an excellent professor. He explains everything in class. His exams are essays. You can write as much as you know about the subject. He'll tell the class what the test will consist of. Take him, no doubt.

His tests are free response full essay. You must demonstrate full knowledge of each topic, which in his mind means you need to memorize the book as well as his lectures. He is a wonderful person and is an expert in his field, but is impossible as an undergrad professor. He should stick to grad level work.

I took him for a Criminology class and it was extremely boring!! All theories covered mentioned most of the same exact characteristics therefore it was easy to get them confused.  One 15 plus paper due at the end plus a final exam.  His grading is difficult.  You should ask what grading rubric he is using?? Don't take this course unless you have to

Unnecessarily hard. A lot of material to absorb and convey to him that you know all aspects of a certain theory. Taking him as an undergraduate I find his courses are just flat out ridiculous (I took his policing course prior to coming to this site)

I took a summer course but I still learned a lot.  He was a great professor.  He is very straight forward and taking notes is easy.  Basically all I had to do was show up to class and review my notes and/or book before the exams.  Definitely top-notch quality.

Grades consist of two exams and pop quizes that are 1/3 your grade (1/3 midterm and 1/3 final). His tests free response, but must demonstrate complete knowledge of the topic to get full credit. He posses a lot of knowledge and if you can pay attention its worth keeping criminology as your major...b/c you'll most likely take him again...

NEVER IN MY LIFE HAVE I HAD SUCH A WONDERFUL AND NURTURING PROFESSOR.  I HAVE HAD SUCH LENGHTY TALKS ABOUT THE STUDIES OF SOCIOLOGY AND POLICE USE OF FORCE.  HE SHOULD INVITE OFF. HUDAK TO CLASS MORE OFTEN.
No Comments
lots of theory and stats, very focused on sociology as a science, ivy league quality and demeanor, easy to take notes.
No Comments
No Comments
Dr. Dunham is a caring, helpful teacher.
Dr. Dunham is a great person who helps his students learn.  He always has time for us even though he publishes in good journals and Pinapple Press.

Very nice professor, easy A, but he cancels over half the classes just because he doesn't feel like showing up. He's a good teacher when he does teach, but I took this class to learn, and it feels pretty irresponsible to skip that much when there are students who actually care.

Easiest class I've taken at UM. Classes are infrequent and attendance is not mandatory. Only like 2-3 speeches all semester and these are the only assignments. If you want to get better at public speaking, he will give you good feedback and information in lectures.

Take this class! He canceled class often and didn't care if you showed up or not. The actual class was informative, so it's worth it to show up if you want to improve your public speaking. He basically guarantees an A. No exam, homework, or assignments other than two very short speeches that he doesn't even grade.

I dreaded taking public speaking but his class was the best. He is extremely nice and wants all of his students to succeed. We had to give 2 short speeches and he is very clear on what is expected of you for each. If you hate public speaking, take his class!
TAKE HIS CLASS. Do not take public speaking with anyone else.
TAKE HIM. Awesome, funny, and knowledgeable. Seriously. TAKE. HIM. Easy A and class was always extremely enjoyable.
Probably the best class/teacher to take in the entire university.  Really nice guy, extremely fun and easy class.
the only professor worth having for COS211...he's the man
coolest most laid back professor you'll ever meet. take him take him take him
Great Class
the man
No Comments

Dr Durocher is the sweetest! Child psychopathology is great with her. She doesn't do tests, she does case studies which are a million times better. You get to really apply the material with and diagnose made up children. There is a lot of writing involved, but nothing crazy. Would 100% recommend this class!
I cannot say enough good things about her. She is the best and makes sure to know each student in the class. You have to show up and do the work but she makes it so interesting.

Really good teacher, however there is alot of writting in this class! She is very accesible outside of class and will meet with you if you are confused or just need help! No eximas, but like i mentioned lots of writting! lectures are very interesting but knows alot about material!

My favorite professor on campus! She's very understanding that you have other classes with work and will commonly ask the class when we want assignments due. The class is based on 3 essays, two written tests at home, and one group project, all given multiple weeks to complete. She's also a really easy grader and will commonly give points back.
Great person, but defiantly a very very tough grader. Grades through every sentence of a paper/exam. Every word counts.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Although this was not the most captivating course, Dr. D is one of the only professors that truly cares about her students. She understands we have other assignments and revises due dates and makes the midterm and final take home! Awesome person and you want to do well because she is such a kind person - no textbook and one essay that you revise

Dr. D is absolutely amazing. She is incredibly knowledgeable and cares about her students. There are two take home exams, a presentation and papers. She is a tough grader on the exams but she challenges you to meet your potential. Her class changed my academic career and inspired me to seek a graduate degree in behavior analysis. Take her!

Her extensive knowledge in the field of autism are a superb tool. She is a sweet lady, and is ALWAYS willing to help/work with you. The class format is perfect for the topic. She posts posts great readings on BB. If autism is your field, you will be CRAZY not to take a class with this lady. She's a bit of a tough grader though...

so sweet, loved her so much. her class was challenging, but incredibly interesting. the tests were a little tricky and had multiple choice and short answer essays. i got an a going to classes and listening. she is the most adorable lady!
She was nice but soooo boring!!!
She just reads the slides! Great class if you don't want to go to class all the time, gives extra credit, but the tests can be tricky.

Tough course, reading textbook(s) is essential to pass. Focus on workshop problems when studying for exams. Flexible with HW deadlines, prefers quality over quantity. Helpful office hours, posts exam hints on the course twitter page. No attendance. Grade is HW + Workshop + 2 midterm + final

Take if you want to understand Algebra, not for an easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Class by itself is already extremely hard.  The textbook is not very easy to read / understand and he doesn't really help too much with explaining the concepts.  All lectures are done with a chalkboard so there's no way to catch up if you miss class unless you ask for notes from someone else.

Overall, good experience. The content is not the easiest but doable. The professor is not a harsh grader, reviews any questions. During lectures may be going too fast though, make sure to stop him by asking questions. Homework is completion grade. Quizzes and tests are straightforward and professor usually tells about their content in advance.

Took his class twice for 210 and 309. The quizzes aren't too hard and the exams are repeats of the quiz questions. Fairly generous grader. His lectures are hard to follow and likes to talk about proofs and complex applications rather than give example problems that will be on the quizzes. has a strong accent

This was a very difficult class, and I had to teach myself most of it. His lectures are extremely boring and he does not cover many examples. He assigns lots of homework and workshops so you are not just graded on tests. He knows this stuff is hard and does not want to fail anyone, so everything is curved at the end, but you still need to work hard

His accent was quite hard to understand at first. Bizarre textbook with weird examples that makes the class harder than it should be.  Test & quiz questions are extremely similar if not the same to the book homework assigned. Just copy down what he writes and then try to understand it later, he doesn't make much sense when he explains things.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: The professor skips some steps so you if have a question, ask him. Go to lecture, make sure to do the homework, and go to his office hours for help. Discrete Math is challenging and takes time but Dvorsky talks about interesting applications, such as cryptography and combinatorix. Learn to accept that you will get confused at times.

Few tests, unclear lectures (partly due to his heavy accent), bad office hours, and unorganized and unhelpful review sessions. Book was confusing and didn't provide helpful proofs, examples did not explain methods clearly, and explanation of formulas were lacking.  TLDR: Horrible Professor, avoid at all costs and wait for a better professor.
ABSTRACT ALGEBRA IS HARD BUT HE'S DEFINITELY TOO SMART FOR A 500-LEVEL COURSE. THICK ACCENT...

The class was the hardest class I've ever taken, because of the material. But Dvorsky was a clear lecturer and helpful during office hours. And the textbook was very good. The tests were hard but manageable if you studied the homework and workshop problems; those were a pretty good indication of the material and level of difficulty of the exam.

His class is kind of difficult. I am a math major. I can get all A's in my math classes but I still need to spend a lot of time on this class. In fact, this class is a difficult one for undergrad students.
WORST PROFESSOR EVER ! HE IS VERY HARD TO FOLLOW ! AND HAS VERY HARD EXAMS

He can be somewhat hard to follow at times since he goes extremely fast. He tends not explain why he is doing something until he is finished doing it, which makes the class pretty useless unless you read first. He does give interesting examples of how the math is actually used in the real world though

Teaches really fast and covers a lot of material. Cool accent and has a good sense of humor.  He is VERY helpful if you are willing to go to his office hours. NOT AN EASY A. Be prepared to read the text. The tests are pretty hard, but he grades on a curve. Lots of homework and in-class workshops are there to make sure that no-one fails the course.

READ THE TEXT TO PREPARE FOR THE LECTURES, OR YOU WILL BE LOST. DO THE HOMEWORK, TO DO WELL IN TESTS. EXAMS ARE HARDER THAN EXPECTED, SO ITS NOT EASY TO GET  AN A. VERY HELPFUL IN ANSWERING QUESTIONS DURING OFFICE HOURS.

I had a very hard time understanding and hearing him. He was sometimes funny in class, and I often felt like I was following along ok but then when the tests came they were more difficult then anticipated. I got a D in his class and had to repeat it. My advice is take it from Pestien, waay better teacher.

Bad teacher. He returned the first test (only grade so far) the day after the last drop date.  Half the class failed and when I went to go talk to him, he said "If you don't know it all by now, I can't help you. Drop the class."  He said he wouldn't help me and instructed me on how to do a late drop.

I got by his accent rather quickly - only took one or two classes to get past it. Either way, he is great at giving examples and explaining the material. A pleasant surprise considering my adviser knew nothing of him when I signed up for the course. I've recommended him to others already and I'm not hesitating to do so now.

His accent is hard to understand. It is difficult to get good explanations to questions in class because he doesn't try to translate the math terms to layman's terms. Does a lot of examples at a high pace. We were WAY ahead of the other MTH309 section. He does a lot of calculations in his head, so if you are a visual learner, he might not be best.

He's difficult to read, whether he's annoyed or amused.  He's very helpfull though and really knows the subject.  He's Fun in an odd way.   I overheard him say this to a student turning in late work once: *heavy russian accent* "I hev a huge pile of complaints outside my office, just stick it somewhere in between"

Great professor, challenging content. I was on the verge of tears doing problem sets earlier on. But that was my fault for leaving class without fully understanding the material. Ask for help if you find yourself lost in class. He's super helpful in and outside the class. He's really rooting for his students to do well.

Dr. Dykstra is one of the most kindest prof I have met so far. The class covers statistics topics some may find difficult to comprehend, but he makes himself available for help if you are stuck, and he does provide it. His problem sets are graded on participation/effort, and the exams are pretty much what are on the lectures.

Literally only 3 tests the entire semester and a group final project. Everything was graded out of 10 points so it was very hard to score well. He's the worst lecturer I've ever had and I had to teach myself everything.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Good professor. Entertaining lectures with famous paintings interspersed that reflect an idea or era in history. Quizzes are very easy, the exams are medium-difficulty. Hard grader on the essay assignments -- spend a lot of time on them and proofread if you want an A!

Good guy, makes some funny jokes in class, approachable if you need help, the lecture is really boring and is the same as the book. I didnt take any note an was able to do well on the test. Just do the reading and you will succeed.. Essays are really tough
He is not a bad professor, I personally didn't like some of his book selections and I absolutely hated the writing assignments. But the exam is easier than the papers.
Very, very funny, and very very knowledgeable on this frequently overlooked topic.  Very approachable class for a 300 level; 1 review, 1 term paper, quizzes, final. I'd recommend.

He is very caring with students and funny. Lectures and exams are hard but if you study enough you'll be able to pass. No multiple-choice, only blank spaces to write sentences/words/paragraphs on exams, at least that's how it was on JMM435.

I've taken three classes with Professor Dupagne over the years, and while I didn't like him at all at first, he's grown on me significantly. The classes are hard, you need to pay attention and take notes, but when you do show up, listen, and study said notes, you will no doubt get an A on the exams. He's so funny (not on purpose) and an amazing guy

i absolutely love michel dupagne! hes the funniest professor in the world and i love him as a person. his class is hard but the material itself is tough so its understandable. very easy to reach outside of class and the absolute king of the comm school. the negative reviews are not accurate! take him if you want to laugh. he cares about students.

He's a really nice guy, just not a fan of how he teaches. He WILL cold call the entire 3 hr class and make you feel dumb if you don't know the answer. Tests are hard bc you don't know what to expect and a tough grader. Content is interesting but it's hard to enjoy the class because he drags out stories and includes pointless info and too much math.

He explains things much more complicated than they actually are but he cares about his students. Ask a lot of questions and meet with him for office hours. Tough grader but offers extra credit. He makes a lot of jokes that only he thinks are funny.

The class and the content itself are really interesting, it's just he makes it so hard to like the course. His exams are difficult and you don't really know where to start studying considering that he just lectures to you and doesn't exactly point out what's going to be on them.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dupagne is probably my favorite Communication teacher at the U. Definitely my favorite media management professor. He does his very best to make topics interesting and fun, and I think he succeeds. He's a bit eccentric, but a great professor! His classes have presentations and papers, but he's not too tough of a grader on those.
Great professor. You might complain that his tests are hard, but you will learn a lot and he gives you all the material will be on the test. Also, he's from Belgium.

Professor Dupagne's class was not easy nor was it the most interesting BUT he was very helpful and was genuinely concerned about us learning the material. He enjoys teaching and at times added his own off-beat humor. Definitely an unsung professor but he is darn good and I would take a class of his again.

Professor Dupagne is a great guy. When I first took CEM301 i thought it was incredibly hard but with hard work i pulled through. Now Im taking CEM435 and its not all bad. Mr. Dupagne actually cares SO much about his students. I was so stunned by his kindness and help in giving me direction. He really cares and will be there for you if you need him.
Dupagne is extremely difficult to understand. He is a VERY hard grader. I do not recommend this professor. It ruined my GPA.
Hard grader. Sometimes difficult to understand. I would not recommend this professor.
I would not recommend anyone to ever take this class. This has to be among the hardest classes that I have ever taken in college.
All of his test are just basically memorization, but there is so much material that is covered.

He is really not that bad. His study guides have everything that will be on the tests and all the info comes directly form the power points...which he prints out everyday for you. Just write down everything you know on the tests and you'll get an A. More is better. The project is busywork but easier than it seems. Grades easier than you think
Dr. Dupagne is extremely intelligent and is very forward looking when it comes to the technology behind broadcast.

I took COM250 first semester Freshman year because it was the only section open, apparently because most students hate Dupagne. However, I'm glad I took him because he taught me that college isn't easy. His grading is tough and his tests are long, but I became genuinely interested in the subject matter despite my struggles throughout the semester.

Most useless professor ever. I don't understand how he's still at UM. If you don't have to take his class don't! He doesn't grade fairly, he's extremely rude to his students and pretty much tells everyone that they won't pass his class with a grade higher than a C.

Dupagne was cold and useless. He has no interest in his students. He is the worst teacher and this was the worst class. Just dont take his course. wait for mcdowell in the summer. That course is supposed to be a lot better.

Shouldve trusted all the comments here before I took him.Most insensitive & inconsiderate professor I've ever had.Tests are all essay, expectations are so unrealistic and hes a RIDIC. picky grader.Expects you to memorize case decisions verbatim and has a "sucks for you" attitude if you don't know it. If you want to save your gpa, RUN from Dupagne.

Terrible teacher. His tests are essay format and the questions he asks are broad and opinionated. He expects you to use details from the text to back up your opinion, but if he doesn't agree with you, the entire question is wrong no matter how many court cases you cited or how well you obviously know the subject. AVOID THIS PROFESSOR AT ALL COSTS

I took him for Communication Theory back in 1999. WORST PROFESSOR I'VE EVER HAD! His expectations are unrealistic and I nearly didn't get my M.A. degreee because of him.  He is a classic example of "those who can do, those who can't teach."  His class was a complete waste of time. I have not used anything he taught me in the professional world.

Michele, where do I start. I have had this cat twice and worked my tail off both times in 105&301. You do have to work harder than you do in most classes, but it's not unreasonable work that's rocket science- all memorization, literally.  The main problem that I had with him is his persona, he is mean and not very understanding.

This is  the worst teacher I have EVER had. the tests are just absolutely ridiculous. He expects you to memorize CLAUSES WORD FOR WORD and spit them out on the test! He can teach but his expectations are unrealistic

i got into this class as a freshman in the business school cause i didnt knonw any better.. his tests are unreal you need to know the most minor details. and he takes attendance in a lecture hall. and he is hard to undertsand. although if he was good for one thing it was teaching me how to study well.

He has a logical mind. He could make everything clear and understandable. I feel awful when I was in his class. But after I finished the class. I found everything I remember last semester is from his class. I would like to take his class again, although I hate tons of reading he gave us.
Professor Dupagne is a great Professor! He is tough, but I enjoyed the challenge. I would definitely take him again.
Students on the Dean's List don't get a whole lot of C's but I did in his class. He was a terrible teacher and his tests and projects are unfairly graded. His expectations are unrealistic.

Pros: Very helpful, always available to see his students. Wants things to be clear and understandable. Cons: Uninteresting class, things might not always be clear despite his help, very rigid professor. Grading is tough, takes points off for minute things, and wants you to be able to memorize like an encyclopedia and write test answers verbatim.
He expects you to recite 8 pages word-for-word definitions for his tests and then takes off points for unfair reasons.  His expectations of his students are VERY unreasonable.

This professor sat on my comps and really thought I must of had only him to worry about.  He assigned tons of books to read and felt that I would passw/flying colors. WRONG! Never took a class w/him but I can only imagine.  Really difficult...and that's an understatement!
Do not take this professor unless absolutely necessary. Powerpoint lectures were boring, his accent is distracting, and he grades tests really hard. Thought our classes average of a C+ was "great"
FUN IF YOU WANT TO GO AND HAVE A GOOD LAUGH. HARD TESTS. ALL ESSAY!
No Comments

THE WORST TEACHER I HAVE EVER HAD IN MY LIFE!!!  I attended lectures (which were boring as heck) and still performed poorly on the tests.  His questions have nothing to do with the lectures or the content of the textbook.  I asked him for help, and he basically laughed in my face.  He's awful.
No Comments
The fact that the lectures and exams were boring and tedious was overshadowed by the fact that sometimes the guy frankly had no idea what he was talking about and was totally unwilling to admit it.
I suspect these people are just bitter. He's tough, but a nice guy, and willing to help. Besides he works his ass off. Cut the guy some slack.

If saying he is tenured doesn't offer enough of an explanation, I will continue by saying that he is at UM because his PHD is supposed to legitamize the school. He tests your memorization of theory but also his academia peer group and their life history. This class and this professor offer no return on your academic investment.

This guy is a total tool. His lectures put me to sleep and the subject matter is a total ****ing bore. Unfortunately we are required to take this class. He basically lectures on the most useless information known to man and then expects a damn miracle on the test. Be very afraid when you get Dupagne. Very Afraid.

Tests are essay and short answer. There is barely enough time to finish test even if you know material. Very picky when grading. Questions are broad, but you have to include the specific details he's looking for, without knowing what they are. He also takes attendance.
Big jerk. Rude to students, not the least bit helpful.

He is certainly tough, but he is also willing to meet with students. He has a European perspective,  European high standards, and an encyclopedic memory. He is an an entertaining lecturer who is always well prepared but gives detailed, demanding tests.
can be very disrespectful to students (makes fun of some in front of the whole class), and does not test on important concepts in broadcasting, but rather on random & insignificant facts.

professor Erwin is my least favorite professor Ive ever taken. He is extremely hard to follow in class because he only talks about his own work and his own books. He is super rude to students who try to ask questions but wonders why no one wants to discuss in class. exams are impossible to pass, first exam the highest grade was an 80% (1 student)

ERWIN is scatter brained, he goes from one topic to the next and rarely discusses the information that is going to be on the test, he is usually not available during his office hours and spends most of the time during the lecture talking about his book.
Really good professor.

Yes his tests are hard. Yes there are only two. But Erwin is very intelligent and passionate about his subject and he will take all the time necessary to explain every article and argument to you until it makes sense, in or after class or by email. Not having weekly reading quizes allowed me to read to understand, not memorize, and I learned a ton.

This is a class where if you want to learn, and pay attention, it will be extremely rewarding. I was always interested in philosophy, but after this class I find myself thinking about philosophy and life lot. Erwin encourages class discussion, explains concepts clearly, and will answer and elaborate on any questions you may have. Great class!

Dr. Erwin is an amazing professor. If you really want to learn in that class and discuss important debates, he allows it, even discourages it. The readings from the book are important for the test and relatively hard, so give yourself time to read them for the midterm/final. Also, participate I that class and you get major brownie points!

No clear grading scale or concept of grades. Go to class, read the material, pretend to be interested, and add to the discussion as much as possible, easy A. He is incredibly smart and very interesting to listen to. If you care, you'll learn a lot in any of his courses.

lot of reading, but you dont really need to read if you take good notes in class. no powerpoints so lectures get long and confusing and the tests are very tough, but curved. if you do the extra credit then its an easy B

Honors class. If you're a pre-med worried about your GPA, don't take this class. 2 tests (20-25 MC) each. Questions are NOT recall style quest., they require higher-level analysis and most have a "none of the above" option. A good amount of reading required. Don't take for easy Honors credit. I got an A, but too much work + stress required.

He is a nice guy who is really sharp and funny - the obstacle is keeping up with what he is saying. If you are not into philosophy, it is easy to zone out in class, which is bad because the readings often don't help. For his honors section, we had two tests and an extra credit paper. The tests are hard, but the paper should bring up your grade.

Erwin is the best! His class is very interesting and he is very knowledgeable and enthusiastic about the subject. Very nice and absolutely brilliant guy who gives many opportunities to bring up one's grade. I didn't know I was interested in Philosophy until I took his class. Definitely recommend him.

Not a very thought provoking or engaging class (how philo should be). Only 2 tests and an optional paper, lots of reading though. There are definitely better (and worse) professors out there. This is not a class you'll remember from your time at UM. Yet Erwin is pretty accomplished... so I guess that's something.

Only a midterm and final which are multiple choice and grades on a curve. 2 optional papers, each about 5 pgs(1 for extra credit and if you do the 2nd one you get writing credit)Not a hard class but a lot of reading for the articles which are sometimes boring. Gives extra credit for participation so make sure to ask questions.

Conceptually great. He has his own theories and viewpoints that he'll give you but he really gets into the subject matter and you'll enjoy it if you like philo in general. Tests are multiple choice. Optional essay (if you need it for extra credit). For an honors class, relatively easy as long as you come to class. Kinda boring sometimes though.

Class is totally boring. Only lectures and he's so brilliant that only he understands the material. One term paper and a final. He grades extremely easy- he just wants to see that you're thinking about the topic, even if you're wrong. Final was open book. Definitely worth it to take him for your epistomology requirements!

Dr. Erwin is certainly one of the most accomplished philosophers at the University of Miami, and therefore taking any of his classes is a privilege to say the least. Those who think his lectures are boring should not be taking any philosophy courses. He is a great professor and his books are also extremely interesting and useful.
horrible teacher. gives out free a- to anyone who shows up. not helpful at all. dismisses student questions constantly.

He's a good guy, really wants students to learn.  You can miss many classes.  Just go to the reviews before the tests and you should get at least a B.  Extra Credit assignments are given, most people can get an A without much effort.
Ed Erwin is an excellent lecturer.  Every class is like a dramatic reading.  He entertained my questions and comments after class for hours.  He's also a sharp philosopher who really gets it.
The class is somewhat interesting, but it's hard to study for it. The tests are tricky, but there is some opportunity to raise your grade with a 4-page paper or panel discussion.
Ed could care less if you learn or not. He is more interested in his own projects than teaching his students. Had to learn about lighting on my own for example.
Great professor!  He knows what he is talking about and he cares about his students.  He is a good contact to have.
Great!  He really cares for the students and knows his stuff.
Ed is awesome. He really knows his stuff and he really cares about it. The only down side is that he's very hard to track down outside of class time. But he wants you to learn and is super nice.
No Comments

Amazing professor! Her lectures are fun, very hands on, and super easy to understand. The group project is honestly super easy and the TLs help a lot with it. If you get her for this class you are set up to get an A

Literally the sweetest professor i had this semester. So kind and understanding, participate and show demonstrate interest in the class and you will be fine. Hoping to be able to take her other course next. Most of the class is common sense and basic knowledge, light studying and you will be great. She is super nice and good at guiding you.

It's easy to tell Emery knows his stuff but he's not so good at teaching it to students. I also had to mostly learn the stuff on my own. Only two exams and a project but the exams are curved pretty well. Not the hardest class ever but I'd pick a professor who spends more time working on actual problems than theory since exams are mostly problems.

Not an easy class, but doable. I did more learning on my own than in class. Emery is nice and has fun stories to tell in class to help relate the material to real life. He likes to have his stories appear on tests, so it's best to attend. New corporation simulation project was awful since nobody knew how it worked, including Emery.
Very Inconsistent and rude..think he is god!!

Excellent professor that gives you plenty of opportunities to pass.  You are given a syllabus with the layout of the course.  Professor is always available after hours and more than willing to help out with any questions and or concerns.
DO NOT TAKE HIM! Projects are based on content that is barely learned in class. Does not help students and expects them to know about excel without going over it in depth. Worst professor!
Very hard to well and doesnt even think about changing a grade regardless of what you think should be changed. You will learn nothing from him but have to go to every class. Dont take if you can.
I worked my butt off in this class and I'm getting a B. The average in the class is a C+. 3 group projects, 2 exams, 6 pop quiz, 6 excercises. Harder than any of my other class.

He is impossible to understand, he is not at all clear on what needs to be studied, his PowerPoints and lectures are a mess, his study guides are useless. The only good thing about him was he only taught 1/4 parts of the class. His exam was the only one I didn't get an A on in this class.

His powerpoints are extremely disorganized, with either too many words on the slide or just a diagram with a page's worth of footnotes. He is not clear at all in explaining his lectures, and his exams require critical thinking AND memorization. I had him for a portion of virology as well as for a block for MIC319. I got an A but it was hard work.

Dr. Mesri taught ~1/4 of the virology lectures for MIC 436.  He's a good instructor and a smart guy, but his exam questions require critical thinking, not just memorization, so be sure to really understand the concepts and mechanisms from his lectures.
Horrible teacher, attended all classes. Doesn't teach at all, all he does is read out of the book. Doesn't prep for any tests/exams.
Awesome teacher, although his classes are boring. The tests are fairly easy, they're examples from the textbook or ones you did in class. Attendance is mandatory.
Worst spanish teacher ever. Doesn't do anything in class except activities from the book. Doesn't prepare you for any of the tests or any of the other assignments. Very unhelpful.

Easy grader and nice lady but many group activities that are sometimes annoying, but it will help you meet a lot of people in the class which is good. She knows what she is talking about and the quizes are easy.

I really enjoyed her lectures and liked how she related content to movie clips, it allowed me to follow along super easily. The exams were super easy if you just study the vocab on a quizlet. You get so much time in class to work on the group projects, and she is super willing to assist in anything to do with them.

In terms of MGT 304 her class was a bit harder than others. The group projects are confusing at times. The tests are on a wide range of things so it's hard to study it all.  Her lectures were a bit long and did not require much attention but attendance was mandatory.  Overall a good professor and you can definitely get an A with a little work.

She's a standard MGT professor. A lot of group activities and participation is important. Their lectures are more than enough to do well on the exams. She's very caring and easygoing and gives you many extra credit points for exams and for the end of the semester. For those MGT major you have to take her but you won't stress about this class

Very boring class. She reads off the slides with the exception of a video or two to keep you sane. Also have to write a two page "survey" if you miss a single class?? Guidelines for tests/projects are 10+ pages and say a whole lot of nothing. Tests are all MC. Easy class but not worth the hassle.

Great professor. I am a 2nd semester senior enrolled in Adv. Org Behavior and she does a great job of teaching it. Kids who give poor ratings either did not go to class or did not pay attention in class. This class gives you back what you put in, so go to class and speak up during discussions. Gives a lot of opportunities to be involved in class.

mind numbingly boring class. She uses the entire class period even if there isn't material to cover and just waffles. Attendance is mandatory, but you could easily get an A without even once going to class. Gets mad at students for being on their computer, but spends the entire class period reading off slides. Overall a huge waste of time.

Some people dislike this class because they aren't interested in the concepts overall, but I think that she does a lot to keep you engaged and teaches the material in the variety of formats. Only two exams, a take-home final, and some assignments. Try to listen and you may like the material more! Otherwise, a simple class with a nice professor.

Class is VERY boring. Just study her powerpoints and textbook to get an A on the tests. Make sure you pick a good group for your project because it's a lot of work. Offers a lot of extra credit with the bonus quizzes which makes it easy to get an A. Prof. is nice enough but can be passive aggressive at times. Attendance is mandatory.
Easy A if you pay attention and study.
Sweetest woman ever. Would take her again if I could

Honestly, I don't get why some people are dissing about her. She's actually a caring person who genuinely wants her students to do well. If you wanna ace her class, just make sure you show up to every lectures, complete all the assignments. Also ask for feedback on group projects. With her guidance, you can crush it and reach your desired grade.

Professor Koufteres made a 3 hour lecture feel faster than my hour long classes because of her focus on interesting topics, fun activities, and more. She was always positive and very kind and caring to me and my classmates. Dont listen to the haters, she is amazing!

She makes everything so much harder than it has to be and also pretty nice, but she isn't kind so don't be a fool. Also will call you out if you look one second away from the lecture. Case studies and textbook are very expensive. Study guide content will NOT help you on the exams, she even points out that none of the content will be on it the exam.

Such an annoying attendance stickler. Class material is redundant and basically an over complication of simple stuff. She will literally give you a horrible grade in blackboard with simply no explanation. She's "nice" but not kind. Snarky and truly just a bother. The group work sucks too. Take with someone more tolerable. Group log.. Seriously?
Best teacher I've had at UM. If you have the chance to take her, do it.
Loved her! She gives really good feedback on the essays and keeps the workload very minimal.

She is the best English teacher I have ever had! Gives feedback on rough drafts of precisely what she wants you to fix to get an A. You write about art and real-world events, so it is non-fiction writing if you are good at that. I enjoy history, so I enjoyed writing some of the essays. She is an easy grader if you follow her feedback.

I absolutely love her she is so nice and will act like every thing you comment about is like the most amazing thing ever. There were only 2 essays that are easy A's and a participation response journal. Watch movies and look at art in class. Absolutely take her for a writing credit, she is awesome!

Have taken her class twice and it has been great both times. Professor Oldman makes learning super fun while also making it very easy to do well in her class. Should be your first choice for any English class.
Three major essays with draft feedback. Long deadlines. Response journals graded on completion. Fair grader. Easy A if you do the work. Recommend.

Professor Oldman was the best professor I could have chosen to begin my first semester at UM. ENG 318 "Science, Medicine, and Magic" covered many niche topics which she presented in engaging ways. Her expertise, and passion really shone everyday. No midterms, nor final. Just two essays. Feedback on essays were great. For sure taking her for ENG 210

I loved Dr Oldman! Easiest class ever, three short essays and some journal responses. Watched movies, read interesting material, and analyzed art. She will give you feedback on essays if you email them to her. Easy grader. Very talkative. Take her for ENG106!

I had her for ENG 106. One of the best prof. at UM. You will get As on your papers as long as u hand them in on time. If you email her a draft she gives so much feedback but it's mostly positive. Attendance isn't mandatory and we often spent class watching films. She's super sweet but is definitely on some zaza at all times. Take her for english!!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: very enthusiastic and engaging lecturer, so fun to talk with, always willing to help. paper assignments are clear and well-explained. thoroughly enjoyed this class!

She is the best. I have gone to class maybe 5 times this whole semester. There are 2 big papers and journals that are due all by the end of the semester so you could do them all last minute. She is definitely high all the time. If you don't take this class with her that would just be dumb it's soooo easy

Dr Oldman is really a great professor. She really knows her stuff. I mean she could talk your ear off about Renaissance literature and I love that. She's super funny and engaging. It doesn't feel like class, more like a conversation. She's really awesome and I recommend everyone take her!

BEST ENGLISH PROFESSOR AT UM. Dr Oldman is an amazing professor who really loves what she does. You can submit your essay early for feedback and she will tell you how you should fix it to make it better before the due date. She is also super funny
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She is an amazing professor. She is funny, clear, fair and very approachable. I would definitely recommend taking her class.
I LOVE Professor Oldman. Definitely take her class if you can. She is super entertaining and keeps the class engaged. The work load is light.

i aint done with her class yet 
shes chill but shawty smokes sooooo much weed

Professor Oldman was such a kind, caring, funny, and engaging professor. ENG 201 was an extremely easy class that lasted for only 5 weeks, contained 2 essays, and 1 assignment. Her grading is very clear and she's very accessible outside of class to ask for editing advice. I would 100000% take another class with her
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Oldman is genuinely so kind! She cares so much about her students and their wellbeing. The course grade is based on essays and response journals, which are all graded really generously. Definitely take her class.

She is very passionate about the topic she teaches. She is also very understanding and helps a lot when it comes to essay drafts or essay ideas. Follow the lectures in class and make notes of important aspects she discusses and this class will be a breeze. It's even better when you're interested in the topic she is teaching.

The class was very easy, but also interesting and good to take for Polisci majors. Grade is based on two short papers and one response journal. The Professor reads rough drafts and gives suggestions for final ones. She is also very sweet, fun, and passionate.

ENG210 was a great class to take when you have a heavy/busy course load. Grade is made up of a few assignments - 2 essays and journal responses. Professor Oldman is very kind and does not take attendance. Send your rough drafts in before the due date for corrections and you will get an A!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Oldman is the best! She tries her best not to stress her students out and truly just wants you to enjoy literature. She is very knowledgable and a true sweetheart! All professors should take a page out of her book! She is also a very easy grader so as long as you submit the work you should have a guaranteed A.
She the goat

She makes reading books interesting, in every class she clearly explains what you read previously so students understand. Grades based on 2 essays and a response journal, she is super helpful always giving feedback on essays. Love her, have taken her 2 semesters in a row and will definitely take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Oldman does a fantastic job teaching each course I have taken with her. ENG 211 has been one of the most interesting classes, and it has been quite easy. Two essays and a "response journal" which she does not even grade. She grades very fairly and you can reach out to her with your rough draft. No way you should not make an A in this course.

By far the most welcoming and interesting professor I have ever had. She genuinely shows interest in students and wants you to succeed. Dr. Oldman was by far the most influential factor in my decision to minor in English.

Her class is so interesting. Its not solely reading but also analyzing art that ties in with whatever is being studied. Relatively few assignments: just two essays (easy grader) and journals graded by completion. Shes really chill and her class atmosphere is really comforting. Very low pressure environment, great to take during hard semesters
Super sweet professor. Class work was not difficult. You can tell she cares about her students and wants to make class enjoyable.

I've taken multiple classes with Professor Oldman, and not only is she an amazing teacher who knows her stuff and can both lecture and steer productive discussions, she is also just really nice and cares a lot about her students. You will learn a lot.

Dr. Oldman is amazing! She is really passionate about the topic, and it shows. The class is great because it's not just analyzing written texts but you look at artwork too. She is super understanding of special circumstances, and cares about her students. The work isn't too much, just some super easy response journals (for completion) and 2 papers.
Only gave 2 papers, no final, and 5 journal responses that were all due at the end of the semester.

One of the easiest teachers I've ever had. You don't have to show up and you can still pass with good grade. Only 2 short essays for the whole semester, and she grades easy. Her lectures were interesting and she cared about what she taught.

Very clear on what she expects and what will be graded the whole semester. Will constantly help anytime with papers so you can get a good grade. Always answers emails and is very accessible, such a sweet lady. Best class, best professor, taking again next semester
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: add her to your shopping cart rn. She is the sweetest person and SO passionate about what she teaches! She loves when people participate and is not judgmental in the slightest, we have great class discussions because of this. She gives minimal papers and homework, & we frequently discuss art and movies in class (as it pertains to the material)

You will not regret taking professor Oldman. She's super caring and passionate about what she teaches. She brings the most amazing level of enthusiasm to class each day. We had 2 papers which weren't that difficult, and 6 informal journals which you just get credit for completing. The course load isn't heavy, and the class is genuinely enjoyable.

Take Dr. Oldman!! She is awesome, probably the best and most fun English teacher I've ever had. Her class is interesting and she loves hearing everyone's ideas. She's also very chill, so it can be a nice break from the rest of your course load.

Amazing and extremely caring professor. She chose to remain online during COVID, so the class was based off participation, two papers, and a response journal. She is super understanding, and you can tell she wants her students to do well. I loved having a class where the professor is genuinely excited about what they teach.

reviews.comment: the best teacher i ever had. you have 2 papers and 2 test. super easy grader. you dont even have to read the book you can just use google. took her twice
Two thumbs up

reviews.comment: Pretty Awesome. 2 exams and 2 papers, and both arent difficult. Also very relaxing for a class, just talk about random books and paintings, so its a good break from stressful college life
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Oldman is amazing. She's such a sweet person and she's really into the material. She really lights up when you contribute in class, it's great. Essays and in-class quizzes are fair and completely reasonable.

Professor Oldman is really an amazing professor. She is kind and caring and truly cares about the topics she teaches. Her themes are super interesting and engaging. two essays and two midterms which are very easy. Not a tough grader at all, but still gives great feedback on essays. Loved this class and her teaching style. Would highly recommend!

Elizabeth Oldan is a great professor. She tries to make the class more discussion based which makes the class that more interesting. I enjoyed the types of literature we read. She connects the reading to art and film which deepens your understanding of the material. Easy, enjoyable class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Oldman is unbelievably supportive, smart, and funny. She's challenging but will always go above and beyond for students who need help with writing. I signed up for her 211 in the spring

Dr. Oldman is so kind, funny, and relatable.  She grades based on two papers and two tests in each of the classes I have taken with her.  The tests are straight forward, quote identification so if you read and pay attention, you will be fine.  Papers are interesting and not too long.  Great class and amazing woman.

She's such a wonderful lady. I wish people participated more because her discussions are awesome and she would never think anything you say is wrong. She grades well, the midterm and final were a little hard, but I adore her. Honestly you should take advantage of her office hours, she could help a lot. and her papers are so reasonable! only 4 pages
LOVE LOVE LOVE HER!! TAKE THIS CLASS!

Best professor I have ever had. She is so quirky and hilarious but absolutely brilliant and caring. I love listening to her lectures and I always walked away feeling like I had learned something. She is really there for her students outside of class and it is obvious that she wants you to succeed. Can't recommend her enough!
Awesome professor, really passionate about what she teaches and very clear and helpful with assigned papers. Loved her

Amazing prof, probably the best in the English department here. Will email each weekend reminding you about readings and such, which to me showed she genuinely cared about her job. Very helpful and overall great; class was never boring. Will take her again!
She's great. Can be slightly odd sometimes, but a great person overall, kind and a generous grader. Just read and come to class and an A is guaranteed.
prof oldman is knowledgeable, friendly, and fun.  she genuinely cares about her students. awesome outside class, as well. she really pushes you to improve your writing and reading skills.

I loved this teacher!! She was such a kind and friendly person, and she always showed interest and enthusiasm for students' comments. She also knew the material well. Apart from that, the class was incredibly easy. All you needed to do for the exams was identify 10 out of 12 quotes, usually ones that were emphasized in class.

Such a nice teacher! She really knows her material.  Don't be afraid to raise your hand in class and say anything; she accepts any answers and finds them all interesting.  Her paper topics are very interesting, and the reading material is great. Such a great teacher!

I LOVE THIS WOMAN. She is so inspiring and so helpful. I go to her office hours all the time just to talk. She will work with you to help you write about what interests you most in the class. Seriously take her if you can. She is brilliant!!!!!
The best english teacher I have ever taken at um. I really enjoyed her class, she is very nice and very helpful. Take her!!
Prof Oldman's class always made my day. She really knows what she's talking about, and teaches very well. Funny and cares about her students. Awesome.
Professor Oldman is really down to earth. She grades with leniency and never gave a quiz even though the syllabus said she would. We had two papers and one final exam. Take her if you can.

Professor Oldman is great! Her class is interesting and her lecture style makes you very well prepared for her tests. I've never had a better english class and I would take another one with her if I had the opportunity.
Professor Oldman is brilliant. She's extremely well-spoken and makes all the books interesting. I've never met anyone so knowledgeable and so enthusiastic about sharing her knowledge with a class.

She is awesome! Very laid back and chill. Makes class fun to go to. VERY fair grader on the papers, gives great comments and feedback to help you write even better. Final exam is very easy and she prepares you well for it. One of the best classes I have taken. Very easy to get an A as well!
A lot of reading and writing exercises, plus regular essays. Worth it though, my writing improved.
Super hot (a nice start to every morning), gives everyone an A, says attendance is required but IT IS NOT REQUIRED BY ANY MEANS. Books are optional, but recommended.
took her Shakespeare class last summer--lots of reading but loved it. a lot of discussion. really knows her stuff.

ive taken her twice so far for different english classes and she is awesome. she welcomes everyones different opinions and stimulates class discussions really skillfully. she genuinely enjoys the topics and books she teaches and cares about her students. one of the most genuine professors i have ever had at UM, and to top it off an easy A!
I ABSOLUTELY LOVED HER!!!! I am an English major and she is one of the BEST i've had at the U. Take her! She's fun and veryy smart!

Best PROF EVER. We had so many readings and i crammed in everything at the last minute and still got an A-. Honestly if your searching for a laid chill prof this is her. Shes so enthusiastic too she makes you love the class more take HER !
She called the introduction to the course "pre-gaming for the semester"... needless to say it was awesome
Lots of reading but it was worth it. Great lectures and discussions, she's highly knowledgeable and makes class really interesting.

She is hands-down the best English teacher I've had here. She's young so she can relate to her students, she describes the works in incredible detail (I didn't even really read them and I got an A), and she really knows her stuff. Highly recommended.

Knows what she is talking about, YALE educated, laid-back, and approachable. Her class discussions are very interesting and she knows how to engage her students while lecturing. Incorporates art and films which make you think on an analytical level BEYOND the surface of the required readings, therefore not at all dull. A+ professor.
very enthusiastic. really knows her stuff  one of my favorite classes this semestr
Phenomenal. Great at inspiring interesting and thought-provoking discussion, very good at anticipating students' thoughts and intent, and has a widely-read background of texts and theory.

Nice, and the class is pretty easy, but she kind of seems like she's high all the time. She gets way too into the subject, so if you arent an english or creative writing major it gets kind of annoying. Easy grading and she doesnt really pay attention to if you are there or not.
Incredibly knowledgeable and easy on the eyes
Very good at explaining things and a funny and interesting person. She is extremely helpful with assignments.

She is very caring and overall a great professor. This is definitely a course with a lot of content so you need to study, but it's all memorization. If you come to class prepared and participate a lot, it is not difficult to get an A. She is strict, but I felt very prepared for 102 after taking this class.

Class isn't too hard, I'd give it like a 2.5. If you just show up to all of the classes and keep up with the connect homework, you'll be fine. She marks super generously and is strict but in a good way. Super caring as well and understanding. I actually made a lot of progress in this class.

For the first time, I feel like I have made progress in French. This professor is amazing, and she makes class very entertaining. She has a great sense of humor and, in my opinion, is a very fair grader. I would not say her class is inherently difficult, but it is not the easiest either; I'd rate it a 2.5. As long as you study, you'll do fine.
Very fair grader. Some may not like her sarcastic style but I do and think it's funny. She helps out when you ask and is very nice and down to earth.

Tbh the worst teacher I've taken at UM. I would not recommend her to anyone, if you're bilingual or know French beforehand you'll be fine but otherwise you're going to be in for a journey no kidding. Her humor consists of literally making teasing the class and being sarcastic. You can't ask her questions otherwise she'll call you out in front
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Unbelievably rude. I asked for help on my essays because I received poor marks on them. I was told that I "know what I did wrong" and when I said I didn't she basically shrugged and said "oh well." Essays are nebulous at best, and support is nonexistent. That said, her exams are manageable, although you do need to study to pass. They make sense.

Profesora Llaveria is amazing. Her humor consists of sarcasm, and she made my class very fun. My best class all semester. She genuinely wants the best for her students. SPA201 is a lot of work, especially considering your background in Spanish, but she teaches it well. I would highly recommend taking her and coming to class prepared.

reviews.comment: Amazing, highly recommend. Lots of homework so be ready to spend quiet sometime.WOULD TAKE AGAIN!

reviews.comment: Prof. Llaveria is a great lecturer, but the Spanish curriculum at UM is inherently difficult. Gives you the benefit of the doubt if you show that you are trying. Doesn't quite matter who you take, it's gonna be hard.

She is a really good professor and is very knowledgeable. The class is not the hard. There is a lot of homework but it is pretty easy. She is very funny and cares a lot about her students and you will come out of the class having learned a lot.

Most engaging professor I have had. We discussed interesting topics and it felt more like a conversation than a strict lecture. She made french an interesting language to learn along with facts about french culture. She gives extra credit and wants you to do well. It may be best that you don't join the class if you can't handle french humor.

Professor Llaveria is honestly one of the best professors I've had at UM. I don't know how she could have bad ratings. She's hilarious and really nice, she's just a sarcastic French lady so if you're sensitive don't take her. I took her for FRE 101 and 102. However, don't take her if you want an easy grade. It's easy if you actually study.

Probably the worst French teacher at UMiami. Her grammar is terrible. When you're confused or ask questions about her errors, she becomes passive aggressive/rude. She doesn't teach French, just reads the textbook & expects you to follow along solely from that. She didn't even teach my class the FRE alphabet b/c she expected us to already know it...
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: ridiculously rude

If you are not bilingual and do not react to teasing well, do not take Llaveria-Powell. She will ask you if you grew up in a multi-cultural household, and if you say no, she will look at you as uncultured. I'm not saying that she's discriminatory, as she's pretty rude to everyone, but she will definitely like you more if you are bilingual.

I took Professor Llaveria-Powell for French. She discusses a lot of politics in class and most of our assignments due were never announced in class and difficult to find on Bboard. Make sure to be early to class and have extensively done all your homework. I thought her grading was easy, especially for listening, but theres lots of work required.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: A truly great professor, but not an easy one. She will help you if you let her. Improved my french drastically during the course.

Great Professor but do not take her if you lack a sense of humor. She is always willing to help and is available during her office hours. Go to her with questions, and she is very helpful when it comes to writing the second draft for your papers. Ask questions during tests, she will always try to help you out. You will improve your french and laugh

One of the rudest people I've ever met. She thinks she's funny, but she's just rude and out of line. Good luck if you mess up a problem on the hw, she'll scream at you & give you a zero. She gets angry when anyone asks a question. She's not a bad prof, but the class is hard and she's so rude and loud. Also good luck if you're ever late. AVOID.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I took her for SPA 201 and she's tough and sassy but honestly really amazing.  If you do the homework and study you'll pass no problem.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: If she's teaching Spanish, by all means take her ... she speaks absolutely pathetic French though and always ends up confused between the two languages ... for example, she will say "Je vais à lire" instead of "Je vais lire" or use "tenir" for "to have" instead of "avoir" ... she gets extremely annoyed if you correct her, plus her accent is Spanish

Hated her initially, but slowly she got better, can be rude at times but really wants all her students to pass, gives A's on cultural projects even when no one deserved it, tests are hard but she helps you on them if you ask questions. You have to go to class everyday even though it will suck. You'll definitely learn from her.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I had Sra. Llaveria-Powell for SPA 201 and I loved her. If people think she's mean it's because they either (a) never came to class prepared or (b) are way too soft. Her humor is sarcastic and she likes to tease, but she has the best of intentions for the class and cares for all of her students. She stresses in class that hard work  help from her.

reviews.comment: I loved this class..... She's awesome. Not an easy class but she's a great teacher

Señora makes class very enjoyable - I was always laughing. I looked forward to coming to class. Although she can be moody sometimes (and she takes it out on the students) and she is VERY strict regarding following the syllabus, the overall experience was fun and I learned a thing or two. If you put in the effort, she is willing to help you.
She is not clear and indecisive with her grading, if you take this class do your best not to become her scapegoat, because she will have one. do not take her if you don't have to.

This teacher is amazing! Would recommend to anyone! She makes the class extremely interesting and she is very funny (if you enjoy sarcasm and french humor)! Attendance is important, and studying/homework is ESSENTIAL! If you have questions or problems, she is always willing to help! I hope to take another class with her in the future!

She is a very, very good teacher. I would strongly recommend her if you are planning on taking French 105. She has a somewhat dry, French sense of humor, that makes her class very enjoyable and interesting. She will go out of her way to help you, as long as you show you're interested in learning. IF you study, you will do fine! :)

She's hilarious! She can have bad days, but overall her sarcasm really made class interesting and fun. Follow all her directions and she'll never yell at you. She can be a bit picky, but I learned a lot from her. Towards the end of the year she gets easier too. The workload is standardized so it stays the same for every professor.

Very intimidating at first, but is overall a very good teacher. Has a good sense of humor which makes the class interesting. Class has a lot of busy work, but that's to be expected from a foreign language class.

Sra Llaveria Powell is hilarious! Anyone leaving negative comments must not know how to take a joke. It may seem like she gives a lot of homework, but it is the standard load for all 211 classes, so that won't change based on professor. She grades fairly easily, and prepares you well for exams. She keeps early morning class light and fun! TAKE!!

Because the Spanish dept is so huge here, the tests are standardized. Take a different professor if you can.

HORRIBLE. She's so sarcastic and will put you down in a heartbeat, has no problem hurting your feelings. Doesn't prepare us well for exams. I don't recommend this class with her at all, I worked hard for a C+. Take it with someone else. D

lighten up, her sense of humor and sarcasm make her a bit crazy, but would you prefer a professor to just sit there and teach you monotonously? she's a great professor who makes the class a lot of fun. very understanding and makes the class easy as well. "don't have diarrhea over it, it's just spanish!" lol love her
She's mean for no reason but for the fact, as she says, for being French. You have her as a teacher? Switch to another one.

The best spanish professor at UM. She is HILARIOUS and makes the class fun. Very sarcastic and always has a witty response. Highly recommend her, I'll definitely be taking her for 211!

Very dynamic and fun teacher! Every spanish class at UM has a set rubric chock full of homework, online workbook assignments, compositions, recordings and presentations...which all takes forever and is annoying. But Llaveria makes class fun and worth your time. Definitely recommend her!
She is my favorite spanish teacher I'ver ever had! She's hilarious and nice and wants her students to do well. She's very helpful and grades pretty easy.
i learned a lot with her, fun class, and easy exams which she prepares you really well for. having class at 9 am wasn't such a drag with this prof., she made it pretty entertaining!

she was the best spanish teacher that i have ever had.  she is very helpful and does give a lot of work but her class if fun and she jokes around a lot.  She does have mood swings sometimes but for the majority of the year, she was pleasant and funny.  she over-prepares you for her tests, so you really have nothing to worry about.

She's very sarcastic but I think that's the best part of her. She's very funny and if you get in her good side from the very beginning by joking with her and making her day, you'll be set. She loved our class and we all had a great time! I recommend her if you want to have a fun french experience... I would love to take her again!

while she may seem hard and kind of mean, she's actually pretty cool. she does have her days, but i figured out that if you just make her laugh in the morning before class then she would be allright. i had alot of fun in this class, and still try to go by her office and chill every once in a while.
She's usually pretty nice, but she has moody days and will get very mean. but if you do your work and get on her good side early, you can breeze through.  Class really isn't hard

At the start of the semester our entire class thought she was completely insane. At the end, we knew she was completely insane. However, that's not a bad thing. She does try to scare some off at the start - she IS French, too - but she does make the class fun and her tests/quizzes aren't that bad. Our entire class had fun that semester. Good prof.
can be very bi****  but also can be very funny. tests are pretty hard, but other stuff like orals and hw help make up for it. i would take someone else if possible.

Very funny and very helpful, but when shes in a bad mood, watch out.
Excellent teacher!
she is a good professor. She may seem hard at first but stick w/ it the end result is good.
she is a great professor. makes the class fun and you'll learn a lot. Her tests were'nt that hard either

Cool guy with interesting and funny lectures. A decent amount of homework and tests are essay format.

There is a lot of reading, I gave up and skimmed

Professor Elena is a truly great professor. His class on the history of consumerism was very thought provoking, and I found myself deeply immersed in the content throughout the whole semester. Elena is incredible - evidently very intelligent and his class on consumerism is fascinating. The lectures are super engaging ... lots of video/documentary clips and group discussion. reviews.comment: Fabulous professor who teaches really interesting stuff. Three tests that are open note and relatively easy as long as you pay attention in the class. 100% recommend.

He is so sweet & explains topics well. Classes are basically just all lectures & you should take notes on your computer b/c he talks fast & you need most of the info. reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

Shes honeslty one of the best professors ive had. I had the best time in her class. make sure to participate and speak up and she will love you. shes very accessible and just wants students to learn. shes the best

Professor Skordilis is a nice guy. But that is about all he is. His lectures in class are nothing more than reading off slides that he does not explain. Wish he gave study guides, but he was opposed to them, even though the other section received them. I also wish we had more of a buffer in terms of grading. Most of my class likes his lectures...

He's pretty amazing! The class is heavy, but you learn a lot. His exams are fair—a mix of what's on the PowerPoints and what he says in class, so pay close attention and re-listen to the recorded lectures. He really prepares you for the HESI. Overall, a great professor who wants you to succeed!

Long lectures where he goes on talking for what seems like forever and he reads off the slides but for the most part he was agreeable and easy to talk to. 

tests were manageable but does not give a good idea of what will and wont be on it. study everything

just dont take him

The class was very straightforward and I learned a lot. The tests aren't too bad if you study.

Professor Rumbaut teaches the language in a simple way and makes it easy to understand. There is a lot of homework but it helps solidify the concepts, also exams draw from concepts on the homework.
