When asking for aid she tells you to "read the instructions" or gives you the runaround.

Nothing good to say about Erin. She is an awful communicator and is extremely hard to reach out of class. She knows her code but DOES NOT KNOW HOW TO TEACH STUDENTS. She doesn't teach other ways to do things but expects you to know them. However, when you know shortcuts she doesn't accept them. Everything I've learned I taught myself.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Brown was by far the worst professor I have ever had.  She strictly adheres to original methods for coding and is not open minded about new shortcuts.  Not only was she extremely unhelpful, but she was also just plain rude.  If you ever asked a question, she would simply respond "read the instructions"... even when the instructions weren't clear!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She read her teaching reviews this summer and changed the way she teaches accordingly. Lots of opportunities to code and get a hands-on experience with HTML and CSS. Her notes are very clear and instructions are literally step-by-step outlines for assignments. She's very willing to help you if you show a passion for web design.
tough grader. no room for leniency.

I am currently taking her for web design and she is stressful. The thing is she says "ask if you need help," but when we ask for help she ends up getting really annoyed. She also teaches confusingly. I have to teach myself most of the material to be honest. She makes it harder than it needs to be but nonetheless she knows her code. Just a bad prof.

Professor Brown makes very difficult things understandable. If you are still struggling she will always take the time to help you out. As long as you are trying 100% she will give you 100% Do all the exercises she gives you and even when they are done do them again.  You will be amazed at what you can accomplish after taking her classes!

She is very willing to help. But her teaching style is a bit confusing--sometimes even if you went to the lectures, you still don't know how to code. Fortunately, she does give some exercises to help you practice and get the code clear. Her grading is not bad, but tends to deduct huge points on code-unrelated mistakes like submission errors.
He is nice and supportive. I would like to take his course again.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Expects you to understand math without doing examples calculations and just by talking about the problems and showing power points. Its all over the place and is super hard to understand
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: doesnt say what he wants and expects you to deliver everything perfectly. he talks so much and always interrupts

This professor thinks his class is the only class. his tests are so hard and hes so devious and a harsh grader. he likes it when students dont solve his problems. he gives you good information but hes not a good professor because he doesnt solve examples of calculation in class whatsoever. homeworks take days to do! hate this class
His son Oren is hot. He was a great TA! Made this class worth it!
Difficult  but very informative in general
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Awesome
Horrible professor
good professor, has real world experience. Highly recommended
Good professor. If you prepare for the speeches and follow the instructions for the writing assignments, you can do well. Attendance is required, and writing assignments are graded harshly.

Espinosa is awesome. Try hard on your assignments and pay attention/participate in class and he will love you. 3 papers and 3 presentations are the same across all BUS300 classes. He gives good feedback and is very knowledgable and passionate about business in general. Would definitely recommend.
worst prof in um
very hard to get an A almost impossible, more a current events class he is very liberal, liked the assignments and he is a very nice guy easy and fun to talk to
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: One of the most engaging passionate professors I have had at UM. Cares about his students and gives good feedback. Fun class to go to and have discussions. If you put in the effort you can get a good grade.
Great Professor yet very tough grader. Very fun class overall.
His class is soooo boring. And he is a tough grade fro sure.
As others have mentioned he is definitely a very hard grader. But, his class is one of the only classes I have enjoyed coming to everyday and he really cares about students and gives good feedback.
he's dope

I saw people give Prof. Espinosa a low grading because he is a tough grader, which is unfair to him. Prof. Espinosa's lecture is vivid and interesting. This is one of the most valuable classes which you can get in UM. If you work hard, then A. This class is not hard for me, an international student. Don't blame others if you got a B without efforts

ESPINOSA IS A GREAT LECTURER BUT AS A PROTEGE OF FELLOW BUSINESS LAW PROFESSOR SHAPIRO HE DOES NOT ALLOW EXTRA CREDIT AND IS AN EXTREMELY TOUGH GRADER. IF YOU FIND A BUSINESS LAW PROFESSOR TEACHING A COURSE OTHER THAN LAW, STAY AWAY! THERE ARE PLENTY OF OTHER PROFESSORS WHO WILL WORK WITH YOU TO GET AN A+ INSTEAD OF B+. REAL EASY COURSE MADE TOUGH

Prof Espinosa takes a hard and potentially boring course and makes it really interesting. If you go to class and participate you'll do well. There are 3 writing assignments and 3 public speaking assignments, but he gives lots of in-class practice before any graded assignments. He's really funny and makes you WANT to be in class.
Tough grader

This class is 100% based on your effort, so people who skip or text are obvs going to struggle. Pay attention to his lectures, they may not seem important because there aren't exams, but this stuff is extremely useful. He is so inspiring and cares more than any other professor at UM if u show u care too. Brilliant, charismatic & heart of gold
this guy can be annoying. sorry. hes nice and young which makes the class kinda fun but his grading is too hard. first day of class says I dont give out A's. avoid him

This class was a challenge because you have two individual oral presentations, writing assignments, and a final group project. He is a really good professor but is a hard grader. This class is not an easy A and you must work hard to get a good grade.
Professor McAdam is very helpful English is not my first language but he was very professional and I learned a lot from him I got a fair grade.

One of the best classes, I have taken at UM so far. If you cover the required material, you will learn A LOT from this class. Professor is challenging, but all in all is fair in his grading. Highly recommend!
Not approachable, boring, and hard to please...go with another teacher if at all possible.
STAY AWAY FROM MACADAM - DO NOT TAKE ANY OF HIS CLASSES. HE'S SO BORING; HE GRADES SO HARD ON PAPERS AND IS REALLY PICKY. IT'S IMPOSSIBLE TO GET AN A. DON'T TAKE HIM!!!

I really love English and he completely makes the course uninteresting and unneccessarily difficult. His comments are never helpful and extremely unclear and it's difficult to write a paper that he will love. He is stubborn and the lectures seem to be pretty pointless. The final isn't too hard but I really really do NOT recommend him.
Thanks to him I learned that there were 120 ceiling tiles in our classroom. He is not very helpful and is not very accomodating. I am lucky i did as well as I did.

Very hard grader with standards not appropriate for a 201 class. Argues against everything in your papers = low grades. Papers must be written exactly his way, so you must think like him. Boring, useless lecture because students must guess what his thoughts are. Not open to other opinions. A's are rare. Do NOT take his class!
Not that bad of a class. There are very few grades and just do what he asks on the papers. I got a 3.3 without much trouble.
Super boring. Being in his class made death seem fun. Topics and books were incredibly weird. Not lenient in grading, attendance or tardiness. I do not recommend him at all!!!
He will get annoyed when the class is lagging on work and not doing the readings. Don't try to BS him, he'll know.  Just pay attention and go with the flow.
Horrible

in my opinion he's a really hard grader...basically you have to write the papers exactly the way he wants them written...so it's really hard to have an individual voice/style. and you have very few grades in the class, so don't mess up. and you read about one book a week, so be prepared...

As said elsewhere, tough grader, but he knows his stuff.  Also, watch out for dates.  He did a student led discussion, and when he forgot to remind my partner and I the week before(as he had done for everyone else)and forgot the day of and I had the wrong date, docked me a letter grade.  Keep up with readings, it helps to participate in class some.
Very boring, knows the information well, but he is obsessed, a little condescending and very unapproachable. 2 papers and an exam, relatively tough grader. I do not reccomend him.
No Comments

He knows the literature really well. He really likes class participation. If you take the class, be sure to do the readings. Your grade is based mostly on two essays and a final. A small percentage is from reading quizzes. He only gave 3 in my class and he dropped the lowest two. If your class doesn't participate though, he could give more.

Vague with grading and takes off several points for not following her formats exactly, so your grade can drop for no real reason. She even changes grades days later. Her accent also made it difficult to watch her online lectures. Avoid this class.
Has a heavy accent and strictly enforces specific formatting which defeats the whole "learning" experience.
She had a very strong accent
Worst professor ever grades super hard for no reason, do not take her
Very tough grader and takes points off for the smallest mistakes. Take another professor if possible.

Definitely take him for this course. good amount of work goes into it, but easy grader. assignments are interesting and class is only once a week so not a big life. Never fills the full time and is good with moving speech dates around.
Take him, easy class. Just show up and present, easy A
Amazing public speaking professor - everyone should take his class!
chiller fun class easy grade. Just do the work and you'll be fine it isn't anything to much

Dr. Pons is the best public speaking professor by far. The class is about five speeches, a super-easy group midterm, and an asynchronous online final. The speeches are purely effort-based, and if you show up and try, you will get a 100. Also, he is an exciting and funny professor. PLEASE take Dr. Pons!
The absolute BEST PROFESSOR at UM! Had the best time in this class and had such an amazing experience getting taught by him. Take him for any class he teaches!!

Great Professor! Class met once a week so we had 3 hours per class but he never took up all of that time - usually out in 90 min. Lectures were interesting and homework was easy, just a little time consuming. No textbook needed. Work was split evenly between individual and group work. Would 100% take one of his classes again.

One of the nicest, most understanding and lenient professors I've ever had. Due to COVID my class was fully online, but we had a space to connect to once a week to ask him questions or anything we needed. Allows for late work to be turned in. He is the only reason I even got an account to rate a professor at all. Amazing!

Take this class with professor Pons was the best decision I did. I was coming and going Miami due an Internship I was doing and his class was perfect for me, I learned and he helped me all the times for any problem I had with Black board... Great person and excelent professor.

Prof pons is quite possibly the easiest teacher at the university of miami. HE IS SO HOT TOO. He makes public speaking so easy; no real rules, he gives you the time cue, and your powerpoints can be just about as inappropriate as you want. hes super nice, super fun, super easy, and of course, super hot!

Great class!!!  Great professor and subject matter.  Don't bother buying the book because he has PowerPoints that are very helpful! You get a writing credit for taking this class which you will enjoy! The information you take away is useful for everyday life!

This class is a breeze! Really dont need the book cause he gives you powerpoints. Gives you quiz reviews. Every engaging, Fun and a easy grader. I recommending taking this teacher cause he is not out to fail you and will work with you.
Great professor! He presents the material effectively and provides assistance when needed.
Nice guy. Had weekly quizzes but he literally e-mailed the questions before so you can find the answers. Never stayed the entire class period.
Best professor I ever had! Very good sense of humor, knowledgable and super cute. I highly recommend him.

Such a funny guy and I learned so much from him in a way I've never got from a Spanish class before. Love him but be aware he's not afraid to cold call on you so be ready to participate. Very straightforward exams and pretty chill grader. Definitely take him if you can!
He is so funny I love him. I would def take him again, his tests are pretty easy and he's old so you can get away with a lot. If you can def take him
Professor Angulo is an older guy, so he doesn't put grades on Blackboard and often needs help with technology during class, but he is hilarious and makes learning fun.

Professor Angulo is an outstanding professor if you care about learning Spanish and want to apply it to the outside world. Oftentimes, he makes class very entertaining, though grading is sometimes tough.

Dr. Angulo is a kind man who cares about their students and that they learn in his class. Everyone participate and talk to each other. Lenient with extensions and has a good sense of humor in class. I learned a lot from him.

Dr Angulo is an excellent professor. He's an extremely engaging guy (you will have to participate) and is very accommodating. He's good at explaining the content and the classwork/homework highly reflect the exams, making them pretty easy. The compositions are tough, but I guess my exams made up for it (not sure though since grades weren't posted).

He truly is the best Spanish professor I've ever had. His class is so interesting because he always brings up funny examples to relate to the class material. He's an easy grader because unless you do a terrible job, you're going to get a B at the very least. He does require attendance but it is because of the Spanish Department and their rules.

whole semester not a single grade posted on BB, still no grades and school is over. will lose one of your homeworks, tests, or compositions. very disorganized and has no idea how to use a computer. the class work isn't insane but he will make you feel drained at the end of every class. he doesn't care about any students.
If you took Spanish at Miami before you should be set. Otherwise though, he was rude and doesn't seem to care about student success. A hardass to be sure

Even though I got a B- I still liked Prof Angulo. I slacked on the online homework, which is 20% of your grade, so as long as you do those on time you'll be fine. As long as you put a decent amount of effort in the class you'll pull through with a B+ or above. He makes class funny, and he is a stickler for attendance and participation.

I've had Prof. Angulo for two semesters now and I've enjoyed his class a lot. The class itself is not hard at all, many of the assignments are easy and help boost your grade if you're not a good test taker. Exams are light and have no surprises. Has a few simple extra credit opportunities that I actually enjoyed and learned from. Highly recommend!
Great professor! Participation and attendance are very much required for the course, but it definitely improves your Spanish skills.

I took Prof. Angulo's SPA105 class and honestly thought it was going to be a struggle. However, Prof. Angulo is a very relaxed teacher. Homework is easy and there is tons of extra credit opportunities that actually help you learn. Homework will carry your grade!! The class is for people who just want to get work done with no surprises. Great class!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Do not waste your time if you actually want to learn anything.

Dr. Angulo is a great Spanish professor for anyone taking Spanish at any level. It goes without saying that ANY language class will require some paying attention and focus. His tests and quizzes are really easy and based off of the textbooks entirely, and depending on the class one of your assignments will be to watch a movie. Honestly just show up
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Angulo is a funny teacher who really cares about all of his students, especially if you are in a small class. You have homework to complete throughout the semester, along with several exams, oral interviews, and a project. If you pay attention and study for the assignments while studying, you will get an A. I highly recommend!

He is really nice and explains Spanish in a way so that you actually learn something. He makes sure you are prepared for every exam. There is a lot of homework on Mindtap though that is due every week.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Hes an alright professor, the class is very interactive and you will have to actively participate along with working with a person next to you, so make a friend in the class. As far as grading hes pretty fair for the most part up until you question why you got a certain grade. I did that once and he was unable to tell me why I received the grade.
Professor Angulo helped me become semi-fluent and more confident speaking Spanish. He seems intimidating at first but is actually a great professor.

AMAZING PROF. 201 definitely moves fast and you have to review a lot on your own. Be prepared for him to call on you randomly and often. Many assignments but as long as you work hard they aren't too difficult. Makes the class fun and isn't a harsh grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Prof Angulo is the man. We didn't start off on the right foot, but once I showed him that I took the class seriously, he had no problem going out of his way to help me out with assignments (re-submissions, feedback, deadline extensions). He's also funny and the jokes help w/ the material. Exams come directly from book, he will hint what to focus on

I was extremely intimidated by Angulo at first and I think a lot of people feel this way. However with time he warms up to everyone and really makes class enjoyable. He doesn't always have the most orthodox teaching methods but they can be funny and memorable. Participation is key and you'll get used to it. A lot of work but definitely doable.

The class that I had the most homework in. Homework out of the textbook, online, essays, group oral presentations, writing assignments on movies, and recordings. Easy to balance, but it will take time out of your schedule. Prof. Angulo is a great man who teaches in a peculiar style, but the material is pretty easy.

He is an amazing professor. He only expects you to do your homework and come to class. he goes over the material before the test. he gives you a lot of hints on whats coming on the exam and prepares you well for it. he seem to be very strict but deep down he is not t all. his class is very entertaining just pay attention and youll pass easily.

At times hard to understand but I feel like after taking the class I have a much better understanding of Spanish. He takes attendance and only checks homework at random. His accent is at times hard to understand. The assignments are small and manageable, although at times his grading standards are odd. Tests are relatively easy if you study

Amazing professor and very knowledgeable.  Do your assignments and it's not hard to get a good grade.  He's very anal so pay close attention to what he tells you he expects from you whenever you have an assignment because he means it! Tests/quizzes always reflect what's been covered and he will tell you what to expect on them. Highly recommend him.

DO NOT LIE JUST TO GET INTO THIS CLASS. You will have a very difficult time if you do that. The class is not easy; you write A LOT in Spanish and have a steady flow of homework. The exams are hard and the quizzes are pretty easy and straightforward. If you study and do your assignments, you'll be fine. He's strict but an extremely good professor.

He's a really nice guy but homestly it's way too hard for a 101 class. If you came into college never having any prior experience in spanish, do not take his class. He keeps things funny and interesting, but I work hard in his class and still feel like i'm constantly behind
The professor is good. He keeps it interesting and makes you laugh. I would take another class with him and recommend to friends.
I found the class to be easy. The professor kept it interesting and funny. I would recommend taking his class.
Good Professor, but very intense. Puts you on the spot a lot in class, but only because he's really trying to get you to learn the language.

I think he's great! He's much clearer than most Spanish professors and he's very helpful. He's also pretty funny too, so listen carefully! This class is hard for people who haven't had much Spanish, because it goes fast. If you've taken Spanish before and need a refresher, this class is great. I highly reccommend him.

He is a really good spanish teacher. Class is very funny and you learn about the about the culture. Uhmm he does give a ton of work and all at once. He does only speak in spanish which you never really get used to. Overall he is a great teacher.

When I first started this class I was very intimidated by Angulo, but as the semester has progressed he has become on of my favorite teachers. He can be really funny and entertaining. He speaks only in spanish and expects you to come to class and do you work, so dont take him if you are lazy or hate spanish.

eekk beware! If you're not good in spanish you will need to WORK! He only talks in spanish. Like others said, he's stern, no joking, down to business 100%. You need your book in class everyday b/c you read from it EVERYDAY. But like every other spanish classes... he simply follow the curriculum given to him by the spanish dept.

He is a very professional and stern guy, but knows a lot about the material and grades fairly. The class was fairly easy, and if you do the assignmenst, it's not hard to get an A. I enjoyed the lectures and his explanations...Good teacher.

He's a good guy. I had him for 101 so there were a lot of people who seemed like they were there for no reason; these people are the ones complaining and saying they hate the guy. I enjoyed the class. Seemed like he was trying to make it interesting as the curriculum is determined by the SPA Dept. I disagree with how class is run, but he did well.

He is awesome.  He doesn't follow the syllabus exactly, because it's used by the entire spanish program.  He tries to make it as easy as possible.  He has funny jokes sometimes, and is very lenient on teh oral exams.  Teh course is a lot of work, but it is the same for all the spa 105s.  Spa 105 is for those who have had at least 3 years of spanish
He never follows the syllabus. Always has excuses. Expects you to know what he hasn't taught. Rarely speaks english in a 101 class.

Talks very fast. Very nice and lenient. When my partner and I got a situation we didn't like, he let us choose the one we wanted. Has pop quizzes on vocab and conjugating verbs. I liked his class. Only problem is his quick speech. Take him!
He is so fun and entertaining if you get him to open up. I learned a lot about more than just the language- he taught culture and history and more. I really enjoyed the class
Can be very entertaining and humorous. The class has a lot of work and there is little to no review for tests. Easy to pass if you attend.
Is smarter then he lets on. Do not come to class under the influence.
Fair teacher, speaks almost entirely in Spanish during class but once you get used to it he's easy to understand. Do the homework and study for the tests and you'll be fine.
He has some fun moments, but for the most part he flies through the material and is really anal about things. Not a total death sentence, but avoid if possible.
The worst most mean teacher I have ever had, anal about punctuality, not caring, not flexible. Too much material. When you ask him for help he says go study. Avoid Avoid AvoidTake someone Else!!!

Good professor. Teaches well and is helpful. However, I was not pleased with the program structure: two days before each exam a long sheet of test material  is handed out: I thought the purpose of a class is to learn instead of  not being allowed enough time to study the material - this is a way to set even the good student up for failure.
No Comments
Class was fairly easy if you know some spanish. he isnt very clear all the time and class is pretty pointless but i would go anyway.
He is memorable! The class had a lot of theater students in it, so going through the plays was fun. Like his take on Romeo and Juliet.
Goat. Please take professors classes. I took his Shakespeare course, and it was my favorite course at UM. He is a genius, exceedingly kind, and is super vibey

I could go on for hours about how amazing this man is. I took him for 2 classes and wish I could take more. If you go to class and take notes, it will be the easiest A you have ever gotten. His lectures are far from boring and he makes you want to be involved. All essays (take-home and in-class) are open-note and he gives you a chance to redo them.
Everyone loves his classes. He is a sweet man who tells you everything you need to know in class. I never read for his class and got an A easily because he read in class. He is the best.

Professor Clasby is one of the most genuine professors I have ever had. He truly cares about each and every single one of his students, always willing to talk to us after class. I've never seen someone so passionate about Shakespeare. Truly a great asset to the university. TAKE HIM.
Grading criteria is kind of all over the place. He is kind of self-absorbed and not interesting at all. You write the same quality paper and he'll give you a good grade on one and a bad on the other.
The sweetest elderly man you can meet. So easy going and makes students get passionate about subject.

He's are really nice, inspirational guy, but don't take this class if you actually want to learn Shakespeare. The class is structured poorly, he doesn't assign readings and just makes people read certain passages in class and explains what they mean and provides kind of obvious interpretations. Easy A, but I learnt less than I did in high school

Prof. Clasby is one of my favorite English professors at UM. I've taken him for two classes, and you can truly see how passionate he is about the material and how much he cares about students. He goes over important themes in class so if you show up, papers are not difficult at all. He also gives lots of great life lessons! Definitely recommend!

Clasby is the best! he goes over anything you need to know in class, so dont stress about reading. 3 papers throughout the semester and theyre only allowed to be 3 pages. very little work and you can revise the paper for extra credit. super cute & sweet guy
10/10 would recommend

The best professor you will ever have the the University.  Not only is he a brilliant man, but he is one of the kindest and most inspirational I have ever met.  Having taken three of his classes, I have undoubtedly learned so much about life (it seems like he has all the answers). Highly recommend attending class, but you'll want to anyway.

He's literally the cutest old man and explains literally everything. His classes are enjoyable because he makes things really funny. He loves to share stories about his life which is awesome because he has a lot to tell. He's always willing to help with papers and roots for his students.

Amazing class and teacher. Don't bother buying textbook. Go to the library and check out individual plays. Loved his lectures. Interesting class. Easy A if you write what his concepts of the plays are in class. 2 essays. 2 tests. Revisions available for all.
Gotta love Dr. Clasby! After all these years, he still has a passion for educating and the material he presents. It exudes from his lectures. You can't go wrong sitting for one of his classes.

this class grades you on how well you can tie the themes clasby explains in class to shakespeare's works. so, if you pay attention in class to what examples he gives that backs up those themes, you know what to write for the 2-3 essays you're graded on and you can get an A. One criticism: would have liked WAY more feedback on how to improve writing

He is such a wise man, that is both friendly and intelligent. Interested in hearing what you have to say. And he has a lot of great stories to tell. It's hard to not do well. But he's such a great professor that it makes you want to listen as he spits knowledge...

Excellent professor. You have to really try to do badly in this class. It's very easy to get an A if you come to class and take notes. Papers are usually only 2 pages, and in class exams are essays where you can use your notes and the book. He lets you revise papers for a higher grade. Very nice professor, highly recommend.

Great professor, very patient, kind and warmhearted. He wants his students to succeed. Open book exams, 2 page papers with no intro/conclusion, all he asks is that you come to class and participate. Extremely fair grader, and allows re-writes of papers and exams for a higher grade. Take him!

such a great professor! he makes all the material relatable, even middle english love lyric poetry, the most random thing ever but yet he still made it funny and interesting. VERY fair grader, open book in-class exams, 2pg papers w no intro or conclusion, and allows you to revise everything. Easy A but thought-provoking professor nonetheless

A really interesting lecturer and fair grader. In class essays are open book and note, take home essays are 2 pages long, and it's impossible to fail. He understands that most people aren't English majors and is really really flexible with due dates.
Amazing professor!  Literally just reads stories to you all class and doesn't want papers longer than 2 pages.  AMAZING
Fair grader. Open-book essay tests. Very funny, makes the class enjoyable (you'll actually WANT to go to class)

Very easy class, spoon feeds all the information.  Rewrites are allowed for tests and papers and grading is pretty easy. Attendance is not mandatory but it is much easier to do well on the papers if  you go to class.

I had Professor Clasby for the Creative and Reflective Thought Course.  Take it!  You will not be sorry.  The workload is completely doable and Professor Clasby is adorable!!  He is a fountain of knowledge and always extremely helpful.  He genuinely cares about his students!
Clasby had a reputation for being really easy, but he's also a pretty good teacher. He's really nice and genuinely cares about his students. You do actually come out of classes learning something.

He's a really nice man and has a good sense of humour, but not as amazing a professor as a lot of the ratings seem to indicate.  He is very picky about the way you write, and in a way you have to dumb down your writing.  If you write exactly what he says in class, more or less, and keep it simple but intelligent, it's not hard to do well.

I got screwed by this class. People who took it before me told me that it was an easy A but it definetly was alot of work. I asked him why he made the class so difficult and he said it was due to stricter standards imposed by the university or something of that nature.

This is the 4th class (yes, 4th) I have taken with him. Prof Clasby is the best teacher I have taken at UM. He made everything (Shakespeare, Chaucer, etc) extremely interesting and explains it in a way you will get it right away! Tests are open book/notes and straight from what he says in class. TAKE AT LEAST ONE CLASS WITH HIM, TRUST ME!
THE BEST TEACHER I EVER HAD. TAKE HIM...YOU WILL LEARN MORE FROM HIM IN ONE CLASS THEN YOU DID IN YOUR FOUR YEARS AT COLLEGE

This is my 3rd semester with Clasby. so you can already tell he's good. he pretty much tells you what u need to write for ur tests/essays and then repeats it many many many times over. you will want to take any class with this guy. im minoring in english bc of him. No reading or prep outside of class. Allows revisions to increase 1/3 letter grade.

BEST TEACHER I EVER HAD!!!!!!!!!!!!!! SOOO HELPFUL!! tells you the best stories ever, not only about english but about life lessons and stuff like that. i learned so much from him ( and he is easy) but i dont like him for that! hes just the best
if you listen to what he says, he basically tells you exactly what he wants you to write on your papers and exams. super easy
All essays and single question essay tests, but he gives so much info and makes everything so clear that you end up with more than enough knowledge to do perfectly

Eugene Clasby is one of the best professors at the University of Miami, hands down. He even managed to make Shakespeare interesting and fun to my husband, who is mostly interested in computers and sports. If you get into his class, consider yourself lucky.
He was an awesome professor.  He kept me interested in a subject that I would not have normally enjoyed..definatley take a class with him if you can.

The nices man in the world. He makes Shakespeare come alive with his zeal for the text and love of life. He is so helpful and willing to work with students, just make sure to go to class because the exam questions come right from there.
Ecclectic rennaisance person. Most helpful. Excellent listener. Supportive mentor. Take one of his courses before you graduate!!!

If you have any interest in the subject material, don't take the class...because you won't learn it. The class should be called: Dr. P's Life, how he's amazing, how he lives in Virginia and how hot his wife is. Because that's all he talks about. Most boring class EVER. pretty boring class. the syllabus says that monday wednesday it will be lecture & friday will be a discussion however participation is very rare. you mostly listen to him talk about himself. almost your entire grade is based off of the last 2 weeks of class. fairly easy though and nice guy.lots of reading toward the beginning of the semester though
LOVEE DR P!!
I loved his class, easy A and reaaly nice guy!

Discussions seemed to be agenda driven, promoting a liberal view on life. He loved to talk, especially about himself and all that he has accomplished. It's interesting to see that 20 years after my taking TAL 101 w/Dr. Provenzo, not much has changed. The course was fairly easy then, just as it seems to be today. Everything here is pretty accurate. His class is pretty easy as long as you read his powerpoints and do the projects which are easy. It isn't hard to get a good grade, not alot of work, just alot of reading in the beginning.

Pretty easy class. Don't contest him on the discussions or he won't like you.  Loves his cat and house in Virginia. Doesnt lecture much but expects you to know his notes for quizes. Projects are easy.
He barely lectures because he spends the WHOLE time talking about himself and his house in Virginia. The quizzes and assignments are easy, but you have to agree with him in class discussions.
He is an adorible man. He rides to school on a bike! He is really nice. He does talk about him self but some of the discussions are good. At the end you do a live text project and it's so easy!

All he does is talk about himself, never really teaches anything. He aggrivated me most of the time and has a "holier than thou" way about things. Easy class, likes discussion, just be ready to agree with him.

*STAY AWAY FROM THIS CLASS IF YOU ARE BLACK* At first I thought this professor was nice and funny but when it came to one on ones I saw the disgust in his face but I never thought anything of it until he marked down one of my reports which had the same content as my white colleague. Stay away! Teaches like he is in charge of a second grade class, strays off topic, tests on material that nobody cares about... basically he sucks. He is extremely rude and arrogant! Although this class should be a piece of cake it took a lot of work to get an A and was really only possible bc he had a great TA.

He is a great teacher who is very interesting! He doesn't take attendance. He went to have the surgery in the middle of the semester and he's TA taught us after. You need to write three music reports for the semester but it's easy, only 200 words each!

He's a pretty nice guy who tries to get the class just as enthused about music as he is. It's a good thing too, especially for someone like me who doesn't know a lot about the subject. His tests are pretty straightforward and he reminds me of Santa for some reason.

Great professor loves his work and what he teaches and it shows in how he teaches the class. Opens your mind to new things with music. Do not just read from book or PowerPoint he gives own ideas and real life experience. Great professor recommend him for anybody.

really easy.

he's annoying...dont take him

Class is absolutely BORING and attendance is mandatory..don't bother taking notes, the tests (2) are only vocab definitions (he gives a list) and listening to recordings..the listening test questions are HARD! overall, pretty easy class if you need an arts credit
DON't like Greco as he is somewhat rude and thinks he's the King of musicology.  but the class is easy if you can stay awake.  Just make sure to study the CD recordings once or twice
Easy class. Interesting material and Greco is a great guy. Attendance is 40% of the grade and the exams are just definitions and song recognition.

Classes are boring, pointless, and he is inflexible about attendance (a doctor's appointment is not an excused absence). Write down EVERYTHING he says about the listening pieces (the listening is about 60% of the exam). His definitions dont match the ones in the book so try and find old exams.

He may be not be flexible with attendance but he knows so much about what he teaches and makes class very entertaining.  He's great.  Stop complaning.

Attendance is most of the grade, you have to write 3 critiques which are annoying but not worth much of your grade. Tests are multiple choice. attendance is half of the grade, critiques are a pain in the ass and tests are reaaaally easy- multiple choice and listening.

myc131 was the easiest class. very relaxing and stress relieving. easy A.

easy a, but he was an ****. he was so rude, told a few **** jokes, made the t.a. do everything, spoke to us as if we were 8 years old, and lied about an extra credit opportunity. he is one of the rudest, self-centered, most pompous and arrogant teachers. he does not care about his students. if he does, i sure can't tell. j

Dr. Arva is so helpful and genuinely cares about his students. I loved his class--we read some great literature, and he always makes you think outside of the box. Dr. Arva is THE most helpful and dedicated professor I have ever had. He loves what he does and says "Thank you, guys" after every class, as if teaching us is a privilege. He may be a tough grader, but he cares about his students enough to meet with them about any concerns.

Dr. Arva is THE most helpful and dedicated professor I have ever had. He loves what he does and says "Thank you, guys" after every class, as if teaching us is a privilege. dude, this guy is painstaking, he is the toughest grader I have ever had. This class bring tears to my eyes. He lets people ramble on and on about nothing. Not enjoyable, very hard!

If you make an effort to participate with meanginful comments in class that have examples from the text, you will have a great semester. Very hard-headed; if you don't write his ideas in your papers/say them or agree with them in class, good luck. Oh my goodness! The most boring, terribly formatted class I have ever taken. Attendance is mandatory and he goes over allotted time more often than not. i would rather jump into a pile of cactuses than take this guy!

reviews.comment: I love Dr. Dauer! He is so kind. You go into this thinking what even is a scanning electron microscope? and at the end, you're an expert! He tries his best to make the class not stressful. One exam (study guide) and 3 projects that you can do in class with his and the TA's help. He is amazing and helpful for premeds. Attendance not always mandatory

He is the best and truly wants to help his students. This class is fun and super laid back. 1 test just so you know how to use the machinery. Then its just projects which he is always around to help you for. Hes also on the admissions team for med school and makes it known that he wants to help everyone. Def take him hes amazing

Dr. Dauer is the best!! He wants you to have a fun, easy class without any stress while learning a great technical skill. He is an exceptional person with incredible experiences to share with his classes. He is dedicated to the short- and long-term success of his students. I cannot recommend him enough. Please take him!!!!

Dr.Dauer wants his class to be enjoyable and easy. He is passionate about his job and cares deeply for his students. He is a very funny guy and will spend class telling stories. You don't have to come to class if you are busy but its good to just go and get your projects done quickly. The TA grades everything and they're all very nice.
Really great class to learn a technical skill liked by employers, plus Dr. Dauer is a great professor and the class does not have a heavy workload at all.
Good class, doesn't want students to stress. Attendance is optional except on presentation days.
He is very nice and easy going
Though Prof. Dauer can seem a bit disorganized, their engaging stories and commitment to student success make their class worthwhile. Use unstuckstudy AI alongside the textbook to excel.
He gives a very in depth review for exams, but you still have to put in the time to study. His stories mid-lecture are entertaining. Would recommend taking his class.

I had the privilege of taking Dr. Dauer's course. Their exceptional teaching skills, clarity in explanations, and dedication to student success made the learning experience enriching. They fostered an inclusive environment, encouraging participation and providing valuable insights. I highly recommend Dr. Dauer for an outstanding academic experience
Clear about what you need to know for the test.
This professor is perfect. Just actually study and you'll be absolutely fine.

reviews.comment: As long as you pay attention to lectures (he will often point out things that are most likely to be on exams) and his reviews before exams, I don't see a reason as to why you should do bad in the course.

Great Professor, fair grader, very good lecturer. Can feel a little disorganized with syllabus changes and vague grading criteria for projects, but very accommodating and happy to answer any questions
Great professor.

Dr. Dauer is one of the most passionate professor you'll ever meet. He makes lecture very interesting and not boring at all. Tests are very straightforward and easy. One of the most engaging class I ever took. 10/10 --- completely recommend.
Super passionate professor!! One of the best Physci electives you can take at UCLA. He's great!

Professor Dauer is passionate about this topic and it really shows. He works hard to make sure his lectures are interesting and engaging. reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very intriguing and knowledgeable man! One of the best physci elective I have taken here at UCLA. Highly recommend!!

Even though, I am not planning on studying this material more in the future it was a super interesting and stress-free class. Lots of funny stories and cool pictures. All test materials are clearly specified in class.

reviews.comment: The class was really interesting and informative. I think that some of the explanations were a little rushed and could be clearer. Great class!

reviews.comment: This class is one of the more interesting PhySci courses at UCLA. He wants everyone to do well and he is almost always available to meet up outside of class.

Dr. Dauer is an absolutely awesome professor. His classes are always catered to the students and he makes sure above all else that students leave the class smarter than when they entered. Dr. D is always around in his lab to answer questions or just chat. He's brilliant and humble.
Dr. Dauer is an excellent professor, and has an impressive resume. He's going to be one of your favorite professors at UM, and really cares about his lectures.

Take this class if you can!  The material is very interesting if you're interested in medicine or biomedical engineering, but the best part is Dr. Dauer. He is so kind and very supportive of all his students. Thanks Dr. Dauer!

Class for non-engineering majors, super interesting for pre-meds as you get to learn about all the medical equipment! Also the class is a sort of physiology overview. I suggest taking Ximena Vial (she gives take home tests) unless you are going to Med School.

Read through his slides, and understand it. All questions are multiple choice, fill in the blanks and true false type. Few essay questions which he tells you a week before test when he does the test review. And three midterms. Get A on average in first two, and you are done. Fairly easy if you follow his review. A small project on the last day.

Dr. Dauer is the best professor I've had! His lectures were fun and interesting. He also gave some lectures on how to get into medical school and other interesting topics that the class was curious about. And he lets students shadow at his diagnostic radiology center. Overall amazing professor and mentor!
Really interesting professor who is passionate about teaching and enjoys helping his students.

Professor Dauer goes above and beyond to make lectures engaging, relevant to real world topics, and being available to helping students outside of class. I highly recommend Professor Dauer to take any

I took a PhySci 122 with Dr. Dauer and I wish he was a permanent professor at UCLA.  I not only learned so much about the Biomedical technology out there but I learned about so many other career opportunities out there. I am 27 years old, PhD student. I have already taken BSc MSc from another country. I have been in lots of classes with lots of professors, but believe me "BEST CLASS, BEST PROFESSOR EVER"!!!!! I have nothing else to tell

Both the course and professor are very interesting. Dr. D. provides alot of information for his students if they are interested in depth learning. I highly recommend this class to other UCLA students.

Great professor and mentor at UCLA! Dedicated to teaching and his students. He definitely wants his students to do well. He is very approachable. Topics of the course were very interesting and fun! We learned how to read ECG's as undergrads, it was awesome!
Awesome teacher and great class. I hope he comes back next year for other students. great for Pre-meds too!  He is really clear and wants all students to do well!  Major Props for Dr. Dauer!

Awesome teacher!  He is really concerned with the students knowing and truly understanding the material. He tries to know everyone's name and love what he does.  This makes a big difference in the way classes are taught. I hope he comes back to teach more! Awesome for Pre-meds too!

Easily one of the more interesting physiological science courses at UCLA. He wants students to do well and is very accessible to meet up outside of class. Definitely one of the nicer professors out there. They need to invite him to teach this course at UCLA again next year!

love the topic but class his class is very difficult to get an A in. Definite GPA dropper which is not good for medical. I wish he would understand this can ruin some peoples dreams. Overall nice guy but I wished he cared for our future a little more.

This class is definitely plain and simple. He says everything you need to know. Reviews are definitely helpful. Don't overthink the tests and you are fine

Great class taught by a great professor.  Definitely recommend to take this class.

Dr. Dauer is one of the best professors I've had. He really is an interesting guy and it seems like he really loves to teach this class. Take his class!

Great professor, genuinely wants you to do well and get good grades. Always lets out early and throws in interesting random things into his powerpoints.
Very good professor. Keeps students interested and is very helpful.

Straightforward class.
Impossible to do well in this class. I can't stop getting distracted every lecture by his extreme aesthetics.

Lectures could definitely use more focus... lots of getting sidetracked.  Many people seem to do well in the course, but I personally found the tests tricky.  Seems manageable for sure though! And he does everything he can to make sure you do well.

Highly recommended class for pre-med students as well as BME majors. Enjoyable class. Not mandatory attendance, but it does help with knowing what's on the test and also just for learning about human physiology for your personal knowledge.

Boss teacher. Funny as heck and not hard at all.

Great class, as always.

knows his stuff

Such a sweet lady. The online homework is easy, and the tests are very fair. As long as you show up and participate a little bit, you'll do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Very nice professor - goes through the material at an understandable pace and will always be willing to help you or give you extra credit opportunities.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Del Fabbro is the sweetest, kindest, and most caring professor I have ever taken at the University of Miami. I truly enjoyed her course and would highly recommend her class to anyone who asks. I took her for ITA101 and ITA201 and enjoyed her teaching style the whole time. There is a lot of homework but it is not challenging.

Took the three of my Italian classes for the A&H cognate with her, THE BEST ITALIAN PROFESSOR EVER!! She's super sweet and caring and will do everything to help you. She also gives a lot of extra credit if you are struggling. TAKE HER!!!!
LOVE HER, TAKE HER

Del Fabbro is a great professor for Italian. If you are taking her for the first time, a fair warning: she might seem fast paced at fist and hard to read. However, she is one of the best professors and is a really easy grader and pushes deadlines back if you ask for it. She gives a lot of extra credit too.

Del Fabbro is a great Italian professor! At first, I thought she was too fast-paced for me and I didn't understand her or her humor... But she is an easy grader and actually pretty nice! She gives extra credit which is always a plus! TAKE HER
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--Would take again

reviews.comment: Super easy and nice! If you actually do all online homework and go to class most of the time, you will do great.

Most amazing Italian teacher at UM! She is so sweet and very understanding when it comes to deadlines. Professor del Fabbro is also a fantastic teacher and she will make sure you really do learn Italian. Highly recommend her!

She is very sweet. Pushes back deadlines if class thinks they don't have enough time. There are assignments due almost every class online and attendance counts. Her tests are not hard and she is a generous grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Very good professor, manages the class well by focusing on Italian but using english to make sure you grasp important things (like when there is a test or quiz). As far as the class goes, she makes it enjoyable. 10/10 would recommend her.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Ms. Del Fabbro has a great personality and sense of humor- very sarcastic! If you participate in the Italian Theatre extra credit assignment, you earn an extra 5 points towards your final grade in the class. It is a very enjoyable class. The textbook is mandatory for the online HW assigned. Easy HW with unlimited attempts, but expect a heavy load.

She has a great personality, is always there whenever you need help and most importantly, is very patient with all students learning Italian for the first time. Would definitely like to take her class again.

Excellent teacher, she only speaks in italian but explains very well. She's leniant with absences but will deduct points after a certain amount of them. Easy to get an A in if you understand languages well and she responds to emails quickly. Homework can be bulky but its not shoved down your throat. Definitely take this class!

I took her for 101 and while she is a nice person she gives excessive hw to drown you in. She will give you between 10-40 assignments due in one day and it's not like she gives you much time to do it either. She also only speaks in Italian. While I got a A- thinking could do the same in 102 I couldn't. 102 is more comprehension and I am struggling.

good teacher, be ready for a shock though, it is supposed to be o ne of the fiirst classes in learning italian, but she doesnt speack one word of english, the entire class is taught in italian, everything she says, ever, is in italian, good luck

He's very accommodating when you can reach him. There isn't a lot of work, grades mainly consist of three exams and a group final. While attendance isn't mandatory, I highly recommend it if you want a good grade, as he doesn't teach from a textbook. Overall, definitely one of my easier and more enjoyable classes, would recommend him.

Really enjoyed his class. He might not be the best explainer when you are unsure about something, but the content is very understandable if you pay attention, his exams are on the most basic content learned in the chapter, and we were allowed cheat sheets. Attendance is not mandatory, but if you want a good grade, you have to go to class.
Rafael is a bright professor, I loved his lectures he teaches really well and he cares a lot about his students. He will always make sure you understand and he is a great professor overall.

Such a nice guy, wants all his students to pass and he genuinely cares about you and your grade. If you study, go to class and pay attention you will pass this class with an A. Also very fun to talk to and interesting, best math professor i"ve ever had and he"s definitely not hard to reach outside of class, has office hours and navigate tutoring

Nice guy but you can't reach him outside the classroom. 3-4 closed-book tests and a group project; grading takes forever but is accommodating if you can get a hold of him. Attendance wasn't mandatory but I recommend going as the tests are pretty much carbon copies of the examples he does for the class.

Impossible to get a hold of outside of class but he is super nice and understanding when you can. The class is super easy and he gives you a lot of opportunities to do well. Optional take home final is at the end and all the tests were open note. There is 3 HW assignments all graded on completion.
Very good at explaining complex problems. He is always available during office hours, always goes the extra mile to help his students understand the material. Funny and charismatic. Take him!!

He explains problems very clearly during lectures. He goes into great detail on every step of a problem and makes sure everyone understands. He cares a lot about what he teaches and is always accessible outside of class for questions. 10/10 professor, definitely recommend.

very disorganized. i never knew what chapter we were on, and i attended every class. he was a mess and wanted to prove every theory with confusing examples. also did very few practices per topic. and jumped around too much.

I don't even know where to start. I genuinely don't know how I got an F if I did not miss her class more than 3 times, I read the material, I talked to her after class sometimes, I almost every hypo she assigned (which were NOTHING like the test). Almost half of our section got below a b- which says something about the class...
She is a caring professor and lecturer.
Compared to the level of the class, she was a good grader.
Avoid at all cost. Treaches the wrong law.

She genuinely doesn't know anything. She taught us the wrong law. Never bothered to read the book and would actually make up her own rules. Taught us to analyze using the gentle hands doctrine -- which doesn't exist. Told us a baby lion is like a house cat and not to use strict liability -- to name a few. Studying for the bar now and screwed.

She is the worst professor. Does not know what she is talking about. She actively did not teach the law. I cannot believe she is employed as a professor. Avoid. She actually said she grades based on her mood and doesn't have a grading rubric.

She is the worst professor I've ever had. Did not even had a grade rubric. Told the class multiple times she grades based on her mood. She never brought her book to class, not even once. I can handle someone being rude to me and purposefully trying to embarrass me in class but I would expect that person to know the law. She does not know the law.

While I do think she's a caring person, avoid voluntarily taking any of her classes. She required multiple group projects & court visits on your own time. Despite me showing up to 98% of classes, doing all projects and being prepared for the final, I got a B. She fails to appreciate students' genuine efforts & is often unprepared for class

Hands down worst educator I have ever had. She actively degrades specific students in class, has not read up on Tort Law in ages, and never seems like she wants to be there. Avoid at all costs if you can. The one thing I'll say is that her exam and grading was fair, but I'd take a harder exam if it meant having ANY other professor.
Does not know what she's talking about half the time. Contradicts herself constantly and truly does not teach well.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I hope she knows what she is talking about next time
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: The absolute worst professor at UM, hands down. She barely knows what she is lecturing about, and her final exam was exceptionally difficult. I haven't heard of anyone having a positive experience.

Most of the time, she doesn't know what she's talking about. She assigns pages from the old version of the book but makes us buy the new version, so she asks questions about cases that aren't in the book anymore. She's unprepared and spends more time talking about her dog than teaching. The worst I had at UM. She grades totally randomly.
All that you really need to do for class is read the facts of the cases, because if no on volunteers she will cold call. She is very funny and wants us all to learn the information.

I do not believe she has read the cases she assigns in a very long time. She barely knew any of the facts or holdings and would allow students to say anything without correcting them. One embarrassing moment was when a student gave the facts of the wrong case and she was oblivious and told them great job and moved on to another case.

Prof Fenton is funny but you will not learn torts. She has her own definitions for torts and you are expected to use the exact definition on her final exam. Class is reviewing cases with false details, sometimes she talks about the tort. I need to take Torts II but am afraid I will fail because I didn't learn anything in her class.

Most of your grade is her final test. She's very particular but not clear on the particularity. Relies heavily on the dean's fellow to fill in the class so go to those sessions. Her office hours are not super helpful because she talks about her personal business. Will lower your grade if you format your test incorrectly.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She didn't teach much and rarely answered questions, instead deferred the question by telling the class we didn't need to know that information. She also told our class that her grading was influenced by her mood. Combine that with the little feedback you get all semester, hard to know if you'll make a decent grade or not.

Professor Fentons lectures can carry on too long sometimes. That being said, I think she is knowledgeable in her craft and certainly provides answers to any questions you ask. Go to her office hours, they are very helpful for understanding what she expects from you on the exam. Overall, one of my favorite classes!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Boring old school lectures More focused on insignificant details of cases than on doctrine Speaks largely about herself, not related to topics Makes you comply with Dean Fellow (optional for rest of courses) homework but does not give any feedback Zoom lecture classes (blended course)with heavy lecture teaching and cold call Not recommended at all
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I'm a 3L choosing courses and happened to see that Prof. Fenton had iffy reviews, so I'm here to set the record straight. Like every law professor, she is tough but absolutely fair. She will tell you exactly how she wants you to analyze each problem--so just do that. If you feel unsure, meet with her. She is a straightforward, funny professor.

Professor Fenton expects you to have read the cases. In class she will ask for the details but she really wants you to understand why the cases came out how they did. DO THE PRACTICE HYPOS. If you do not understand something, go to her before the end of the semester. Hilarious professor and she LOVES Halloween & April Fools day.

I wanted to like Fenton but she was just so unprepared for class, it was painful to watch. She went off her memory of the cases, shuffled through her notes, & said things like "I don't even remember." She encourages you not to rely on commercial outlines yet spends like 2 seconds on the doctrine. She is usually giving her opinions on the case.

FAMLAW. LOVE Fenton. Participate in class by volunteering; it goes a long way (will help your grade). There is reading but ir's doable. If you don't read for the day, go over briefs to know the basics of what's going on. Commercial outlines aren't necessary (or helpful). You want to go to class & take notes. Use them on the final & you'll be fine.
She's awesome.  Very smart, very nice.  The haters on this board obviously expect to be spoon fed.  This is law school.  The process is the point.  Would take a course with her again in a heartbeat.

IMO Professor Fenton is incompetent to be teaching constitutional law.  She misstated holdings on a regular basis--some of them corrected by students, some not. Class discussion proceeded on a "say what you feel" basis which was often completely unrelated to any coherent legal analysis. And yes I am bitter b/c I did poorly in her "class."

Unorganized and she is guaranteed to fall way behind the syllabus. Biggest reason is because she cannot run a class. Lets students talk and talk and talk and share whatever opinions they want, whether its on point or not. Gives off an air of superiority/arrogance. Not helpful explaining things at all.

Fenton is underrated.  At times she is hard to understand in class, however if you have a question she is very available for office hours appts.  You must learn the material in her style to do well--do not use commercial outlines.  Her practice exams are extremely helpful and have questions that are very similar to those on the exam.

She does not care about her  profession. From the first day of class she spoke in a low monotone voice.  She gave a graded midterm. She is proof and point that law schools don't screen law professors. She went to HARVARD. Thats great. She should working in a library.

Prof Fenton is awesome! Cares more about her students than anyone who I ever had before.  Readily availible to speak with during office hours and pretty much makes you aware of what her exam will look like. Def. recommend

Professor Fenton is a wonderful Professor!! There is a lot of case reading for each class and she will call on students, but its doable. Most importantly, she is very maternal and encouraging and not out to "get anyone" like many law professors using the Socratic Method are. She cares a lot about policy and class discussion reflects this. A+!

Classes are very well organized and she encourages class discussion in a positive way.  She is respectful towards students and their viewpoints.  Reading can be somewhat excessive but the class environment makes it worth the trouble.

She is a very fair professor and willing to explain things to you without being a jerk.  One of the only professor's I felt comfortable asking questions both in class and outside of class.  Exams are tough but fair.
Her exams are so not what she teaches!!
Very good professor. Very clear, understandable, specific and easy to follow.  Would take her again and again... If only they were all as straightforward...

Although SOC 210 is not a very interesting class, Prof Theune did a great job at making the research go easy. All work is done in class and she gives really good feedback. If following directions, should be an easy A.
She is amazing.  Take her if you want an easy A and a good connection.

She was super sweet!  The class is split into two parts.  The first half of the semester is lectures, but honestly about common knowledge things.  The second half is in class assignments that are very well explained and very easy.  She is a great professor and great person in general.

Professor Theune is a great prof. She is passionate about what she does and very straight forward. The lectures are long but essentially exactly what's on the test. She gives extra credit for attendance and has a review day before each test where she tells you what the questions are. If you go to class and take notes, it is an easy class.

Dr. Theune was a very nice teacher, you could tell she cares about her students. Every week there's a writing assignment, but it is not too bad. She also does reviews before every exam, but I would just recommend going to class as sometimes she gives extra points for getting there early. Great teacher and one of the easiest classes I took.

Very caring and straightforward teacher. Skipped a couple of classes towards the end of the semester and still did fine. She does a review class before the exam day which covers everything on the exam.

loved her!! she was super sweet. i had her for soc101 online and she made the class super easy. her lectures were super easy to follow and she always did reviews before each test which basically were the tests. definitely take her!
Very caring for students, providing a rewritten and reviewed, enjoyable experience

Dr Theune is one of my favorite professors in UM. She is so kind and cares about your assignments for each week. If you email her about fine-tuning your work, shed love to do this for you. Dont miss this professor if you have choices.

This professor is amazing. She cares about students learning and not just the grade. She is always available for help and if you do all the work an A is easy. Gives extra credit for being early for lectures.
Dr. Theune is an amazing professor. There's a midterm, a final exam, a final paper, and four 500 word essays. The tests are exactly the same as the study guides she provides. Attendance is mandatory.

He's a great guy and honestly was a good professor as well. Very interesting lectures, especially considering so much of it requires memorization. Uses videos and fun analogies a lot. Not a tough grader at all just wants you to learn from the class and not stress about it.

If you can, take him. This class is so easy to get an A. All exams and quizzes are open note and online. Attendance is technically not mandatory, but there are in-classes quizzes almost every lecture, so it would be smart to go. The in-class quizzes are 11% of your grade.

Takes his job a little too seriously in the sense that he will digress to tell you to get off your phones a million times but will never actually do anything about it. All exams are TAKE HOME and OPEN NOTE with no lockdown browser. 
Free A+, no excuse to get anything lower, easiest class I've taken at this school thus far. 
100% recommend.
Love him and his videos. Exams usually open note
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor, he really knows what he's talking about, and it is clear he cares about ecology. The tests are all open note, which is helpful, and the quizzes in class are easy. It is very lecture-heavy but he does show some interesting videos.

honestly if you complain about this class youre extremely lazy and should just drop out of college, it does not get better than dr. feeley. he gives really interesting and insightful lectures, and what is there to complain about with open note no lockdown exams.

He is annoying and tweaks about people god forbid making a noise in class. He is also very strict about his in class quizzes, and with the bad wifi at this school it is hard to submit them in time. But his tests are online no lockdown browser so idk where bro is getting all this anger from, idk prob miserable. Take him though for an easy class.
He is fine. His class is easy and tests are online. Id take him again but he gets mad about people talking and phones being out and he can sound repetitive.

Dr. Feeley was good for BIL160. Online exams take home no lockdown browser, but lots of questions to get through in the time given per exam which makes it a bit tough. Lots of pop quizzes during class which are for a lot of points, so attending class and listening during lecture is important to keep your grade up with the quizzes. Overall good prof
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Take Feeley, his exams are online, no lock down. They are difficult, lots of questions. In-class and hmwk quizzes do contribute a lot to your grade, don't forget about them. Ended up being the difference between a B and an A for some people. He is very passionate about the Galapagos, if you're interested in studying abroad there, take his class.

Professor Feeley's class was relatively easy. He made the lectures very straight forward and exams were online and open note. However, even though they are online, it is still a good idea to pay attention. I messed up by being lazy, but his class is easy. Just go to class and pay attention and it's a breeze.

Feeley is a good professor. He knows what he's talking about, his expectations are pretty clear, but he can be a tough grader. Most classes are lectures with lots of guest lecturers. Lots of little assignments so keep track of them. Participate more than you think you should for the participation grade.
Very ineffective teaching methods, exams are poorly written with lots of errors. I would not recommend this instructor if you would like to learn about ecology.

I took BIL 160 with Feeley. It was an excellent semester and I highly recommend. The lecture structure makes class easy to comprehend and follows nicely with the textbook. Tests were online which made the 170 person lecture hall much easier. Very fluid, clear speaker, would recommend if taking the BIL 160 or any course at UM!

Open notes, online exams. No lockdown browser, take exams with friends even though he says not to. Great professor, interesting class. Thanos references. Can't go wrong by taking Feeley. Highly recommend taking BIL150 before instead of using AP Bio to get credit for BIL150.

Great professor that tries to keep the class engaged with interesting videos and examples of topics. Never thought I would be as entertained as I was in a Biodiversity/Ecology class. Grade is based on 3 midterms, short quizzes during class, and the final. Overall a very fair grading scale/material, definitely one of the best introductory profs.

Literally such an amazing teacher and probably the best option for BIL 160. All the tests are open note and online, so they are not too difficult at all. He also shows so much passion for what he teaches and he ALWAYS plays the funniest educational videos. I definitely plan on taking him for Ecology!

Professor Feeley is a nice, reasonable professor. He is very funny in class and occasionally plays videos which are hilarious. Grades are based on participation pop quizzes during lecture which are usually not difficult, workshop attendance, and on exams which are open book. He is clearly interested in and passionate about what he teaches.

Dr. Feeley is literally the greatest professor in the entire biology department. His lectures are absolutely hilarious and makes the exams crazy easy. I have friends in the other BIL160 sections who come to my lectures just because they're so fun.
Love professor Feeley, if you get the chance to take him you definitely should. Interesting lectures, easy tests, and a fun/light personality.
Lectures are pretty interesting so class is not a chore to attend, but there are some quizzes during the lectures for attendance/quiz grades. All of the exams are online and open web/note.
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Feeley is really great!! He makes this class extremely interesting through use of funny and entertaining videos throughout the class to break up the lectures. Just go to class and read over the textbook, and you will do fine on the tests. No homework. Doesn't check for participation but he does have pop quizzes that are pretty straightfoward.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Super enthusiastic professor! Very understanding and passionate about material!
I loved Prof. Feeley.
The tests are really simple if you pay attention during lectures and there isn't much homework. He's a really sweet guy and cares about his students!

Overall great professor. His lectures kept you interested, he always showed videos to help students understand the subject (the videos were hilarious). His tests were straight to the point. The grade is based on 4 open book tests and quizzes in almost every class, along with workshops. Very easy to do well, so amazing.

Literally the best bio 160 teacher, he plays the funniest videos during class and really keeps everyone engaged in lecture. If you ever need to take a chill class with a funny teacher Feeley is the way to go.

Very knowledgeable, gives helpful feedback. Can sometimes get carried away w/ specific project details that aren't relevant to the overall project focus (can be nitpicky abt these details), but its worth listening to bc it makes you focus on details you may have overlooked. Project instructions can sometimes be a bit unclear tho. Would recommend!

Took him for ARC 294 and absolutely loved it (actually thinking about switching my major)! Such a fun and inspiring course with on-site tours that teach you the importance of architecture within society. For anyone who enjoys architecture/looking for an intro class to take, TAKE THIS ONE! :) 

I wish I could retake this course!!!!
Great Professor
Great Studio Coordinator.  The project was based in Brasilia.  He is an expert and gave great direction and lectures.

I had Prof. Fett for an upper level studio. He was a great source of references and also drew a lot. We worked through design ideas in that way. He pushed me to work hard, but it was for a better project result.
Respectful and open-minded.  Tried to find out what my interests were and pushed me to have a nice project.

Chances are he will try to sell you to go on one of his study abroad trips.  Claims to care, but really has his own agendas in mind.  Is not open to ideas outside of traditional architecture and favors students that do.
Great young professor
Good professor.  Can relate to students well.  Would like to have him again sometime.
Smartest prof. in the school.  He makes class so interesting.  More work than others, but If you do the work, and you'll get a good grade.
this dude slays. hes the man. take him.
Cool guy as a person, but terrible as a professor. Would just chat and go off on tangents for all 3 hours. Waste of a semester, and his grading criteria is completely unpredictable.

He is very helpful and tries to see every student in studio...if you are confused with a part of your drawing or design he'll sit down with you and help until you're on the right track again. He knows what he's doing when it comes to Arch! He's also very laid back and isn't scared to joke around with his students. I wish I could have him again!
Dreamy and Super good.
Fett is the best architectural studio teacher.  He is still young so he is easy to relate to and he makes the 3 hours fly by.
She is condescending and rude. The class is easy though, she just is unorganized and just reads off slides for you to take notes, feels like anyone could teach the class. Just rude.

I took her for PSY 240. Although she is very knowledgeable as a child psychologist that specializes in complex trauma, she struggles with content that she is not familiar with. Lectures are boring and not very organized. Overall she was fine, and the class was not that hard.
no no no, worst class, so unorganized, inconsistent grading
She new so she has no idea what she's doing. She's a nice person, but she's still learning how she wants to teach and im not a guinea pig, so it's a no from me.
She seems nice. But the class is literally all common sense. She talks for over an hour each class but says nothing I don't already know
Extremely boring. Every class she just reads off of slides. She also claims to post recordings of each class but has only posted 3 recordings out of however many classes we have had so far.

His classes are manageable and meaningful. He values quality over quantity and rewards critical thinking, not just regurgitating info. If you actually try to learn and engage with the material, you'll get an A+, easy.

I've taken MMC 4200 & 3303 with him, and I genuinely got a lot out of both courses. I'd take another class with him in a heartbeat
