Honestly never had a professor like this and I wouldnt want to AGAIN! He doesnt teach, nor does he even grade the assignments. He has no clue whats going on in class because his TA's are the ones grading everything, and on top of that they take forever to grade your assignments. No quizzes. 4 parts to capstone. 4 discussions. 2 writing activities.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Ferreira is a nice person. Very knowledgable. However, he is not a fair grader and tends to go off topic very frequently, making his lectures difficult to follow.

He has a tendency to go off on tangents during class. His voice will speed up and it can be difficult to understand him. However, Dr. Ferreira is very knowledgeable on law (having been a lawyer and everything). He makes the topic interesting and expects participation. Tests are half-essay so they require a considerable amount of studying.

This is the most boring class i've ever taken in my life, but is mandatory for the com school. Professor Ferreira is a very good teacher. The material might be boring but he's good. Take him, he's the best teacher for this class. And you need to participate, the participation grade equals the same as a test.
I absolutely loved this guy! It's not an easy class by any means, but it's worth going to. He is extremely passionate on the subject. You must participate though.

awful teacher.  only cares about attendance and participation.  he shows favoritism to students and grades based on whether he likes you. lectures are off topic and irrelevant to tests and you have to read the most boring textbook ever a lot to make sense of his lectures.  avoid at all costs.

Definitely passionate about the subject; but difficult to understand and follow sometimes (has a tendency to go off on a tangent). Seems to have favorites in class, but is generally helpful and accessible and always appears with a cheerful attituded.

I thought the class material was interesting. Ferreira and the TA meant well, but most times their points didnt come across clearly. His class gets extremely boring and off topic. He does not take attendance, and you probably dont have to show up to get a passing grade.  I don't recommend this class at all if you are taking COM 101!
Not bad.  Tests are multiple choice.  Some real random questions on the test though that were not part of his powerpoints.

Kind of rambles and goes off on tangents that have little to no relevance. Well meaning, and definitely passionate about the subject, but has a hard time holding the attention of the class. Most people just end up facebooking the entire time. The tests are easy as long as you skim through the book and read over the powerpoint presentations.

Nice guy, but very disorganized. He needs to work on developing lectures and perhaps even study guides. He does tell you what's on the exam but that's about it. Then you need read the book and figure out, use wikipedia, etc. You must participate and make sure he knows your name. I think there were three tests and a participation grade.
PARTICIPATE!!!!!!!!! i got A's on 2 tests yet received a final grade of "B". He is huge on participation, altohugh it is hard because he talks throughout the whole class. Nice guy though.

Tests come straight from lectures, a bit from the book, but he doesn't always stay on topic so you don't know when to take notes. Big chunk of your grade is participation, but half the time his lectures run so long there's no time for discussion, so there goes participation. Very disorganized method of teaching.

Not only was the class boring as mentioned in the last post, but then he wants you to participate ALOT for points.  Who wants to participate in such as boring class with a boring professor?  I would not recommend this professor.

Funny how bad comments appear after we got our grades. The class in itself is boring, but he and his assistent are awesome. Participation is important, but overall a good experience. No sour grapes here.

This guy is arrogant and the class is a waste.  He is just some professor hiding out at University of Miami because he can't face the real world.  He doesn't even teach the class, his T.A. does and that guy was clueless too.  DO NOT TAKE THIS COURSE
This class was a joke. He talks for the entire 2hrs. Says participation is important but spends most of the class talking stuff thats in the book.
He's a good teacher, but doesn't teach, leaves the class to his TA, you can tell he knows the material but if possible take someone else.
He's a cool guy.  Read the book and go to class, you'll do fine.  Get out of the class if Luis the TA is teaching.  You don't want to encounter him.

LOVED HIM!!! He is extremely intelligent and keeps your mind just thinking throughout the whole class. He is very passionate about law and history of communication. The readings are easy and his exams are too if you study. He is a must have professor.
first reviewer got it right... super passionate, made me want to pay attentino. feel free to voice opinions and debate... seriously, ANY opinion he loves it

He is an amazing professor. He very passionate and pushes you to think in different ways. The downside: he only gives 3 exams total. There aren't very many questions and a lot of the questions he gives you are about little details. Know the cases and whatever he writes on the board or talks about from the book.

What a great speaker! He is such a passionate professor and knows his law stuff very, very well. However, at times, it's hard to keep up with him running around class. Overall, he really cares deeply for his students. You have to show up, speak up, and even if you suck in the test, he'll pass you if you show him you're TRYING REALLY HARD!
Took him for Media Law and others, and he actually made me understood (and remember it).  Not sure I'd have been able to do the same with other professors!

HE IS VERY KNOWLEDGABLE AND WILLING TO HELP - JUST PARTICIPATE AND TAKE GOOD NOTES. THE EXAMS ARE FAIRLY EASY AS LONG AS YOU READ THE TEXT BOOK. HE IS VERY INTERESTING. WOULD RECOMMEND THIS PROFESSOR.

Granted, this is a required course for mgrad students. But I found myself enjoying the theories Ferreira discussed in class. He's not difficult if you pay attention, participate (he LOVES students who participate, and besides, you should particiate anyway). Tests aren't THAT hard if you keep the theories straight and pay attention. Plus, he's a goo
He grades hard on participation, but come on now...if you have problems speaking in a BROADCASTING class, maybe you should change your major...LOL
Grades heavy on participation. Watch out for that. The first reviewer hit the nail on the head.
Very comprehensive course content; professor is very knowledgable in the field and he is helpful and available to his students

His tests are really easy, but he's extremely hard with participation.  You could have the highest grade in the class, but still get a B in the class solely because he failed you in participation.  If you're a good talker in class, by all means go for it.
He is a nice man, but his lectures go off on a lot of tangents, which makes it hard to pay attention to him.  His exams come mostly from the book, not from his lectures.

Doesn't explain directions clearly. Textbook sucks. He's a really good guy but he expects a lot more than he should. Attendance is a must, when it shouldn't be. He has crazy high expectations of students, probably because he's super smart but still, they're way too high. He's a good professor, just be prepared to learn the info on your own.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: May be the worst teacher Ive had so far. He doesnt explain much just gives you equations and does some practice problems.

Made us do three long and useless group projects all while expecting us to turn in homework and study for tests. His lectures were very boring and I could've easily skipped class and just read the book instead but, as it turns out, attendance was mandatory! Would never want to take another class with this guy again.
no comment
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dr. Fittipaldi tells us exactly what we need to do to pass his class. He gives his lectures during class and we have group projects. The exams are what you would expect from previous homework assignments. He is always available if you need help or have any questions! One of the best professors I have had at UM! Highly recommend for dynamics!

Dr. Fittipaldi just basically copied the textbook onto the board in class. The projects we did weren't really related to the course and it was just unnecessary work. You can tell he's a smart guy, but that doesn't translate well to teaching; he loses the interest of the class in lecture.

A lot of students don't like her, but it is because they are unwilling to do what she says in order to do well in the class. Tax is not an easy subject no matter who teaches it, and students like to rag on her for that but if you actually take notes and do the assignments and study how she tells you to you'll do great in the course.

Professor Fida is definitely amongst the best professors in terms of being a human being at University of Miami. Her course is honestly impossible but if you stop by her office hours frequently, she will help with any questions. My best suggestion would be to read the chapters and take notes before the class as well as drill the assigned problems.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The accounting majors at UM are just not really used to getting any homework in their classes or outside reading. That's the reason for most of the complaints on here. I though Professor Fida was fair and more than accommodating for office hours. The class does take work, but then again you are in college.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Like other reviews say, she is a nice woman, but she did a lot to make the material more difficult than it needed to be. Every test was multiple choice and required a solid amount of studying. Not the end of the world if you take her, but I've heard there are better professors to teach this class.

Professor Fida is a very nice woman, but a terrible professor. All we do in class is go over homework, and there's a lot of it, so if you don't complete by class time you're better off not going at all. She expects students to read the textbook and learn independently, so you don't learn much in class. I'd take any other prof. available if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: She does not know how to teach. The textbook is requested, but not useful. She left questions after each chapter as homework, and use the whole semester talk about them. Did not answer questions after class, when you came to her office hour and asked something you don't understand, she will tell you to review your note and ask your classmates.

She is definitely new to teaching. Knowledge, you can tell she is good, but she doesn't know how to teach. She doesn't understand what your question is. When you ask her question, she doesn't get what you don't understand or what your question is. She will lose patience if you ask too many questions...

Everyone who didn't do as well as they think they deserved, just don't know how to apply themselves. This teacher is awesome because she is more than happy to help her students learn the material, even outside of class.

Half of the material is based on math, but the book and teacher teach 90% definitions. Class time is like listening to a $10/hr tutor read the textbook. The hw is difficult because the math was not taught, and accessing her is not much of a consistent solution. She is a first-year tho, so that shows the importance of experience in teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Prof. Fida is alright. He lectures can get confusing and she moves really fast at times. She is new to teaching and accounting is not exactly an easy class to teach, but her tests are not that hard and she understands how hard of a subject this can be. Attendance is a part of the grade so show up. She is also helpful during office hours and cares
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I took her first Spa 203 podcasting class and it was very interesting. A ton of work but cotrina is super nice and super willing to work with you. No exams only podcast projects. She gives excellent feedback. She can be disorganized at times but overall great prof.
pretty easy you watch movies and read stuff and then write a few papers

Such a great professor! A little bit unorganized at times, but I'm so blessed to have taken her class. She's so kind and really cares about her students and the material. I recommend everyone to take her. If you put in effort and participate you'll be fine. I was very worried with my Spanish skills but I've learned so much, she's insanely helpful.

Prof. Cotrina is really sweet, however she is a little disorganized and gets off track from the syllabus sometimes. There is a lot of homework in this class but that is the case with any Spanish/foreign language class. She is funny, helpful, and willing to answer any questions you may have. She also understands if you are bad at Spanish.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Would take again

reviews.comment: Spanish classes always have so much homework, but I was able to get away with not reading most of it, and I still survived. I would say this is the course where writing papers in Spanish becomes more intensive. Cotrina is the best Spanish professora I have ever had. There may be a lot of work, but she is super lenient on grading.
Super unclear, not super nice, but reasonable and accommodating and willing to work with you

Professor Cotrina was alright. It was kind of confusing what she wanted from us at times and many of the activities were unnecessary but it was easy to get an A as long as you did the work and clarified any of the confusion she brought on.

Professor Cotrina was my favorite language professor at UM. She often strays away from the syllabus which can be confusing, but it often means that she is not assigning as much work. But this also means that it is important to go to class! She is a very easy grader. Take her!
She is a feminist and hates men.  All you read in the class is how men are horrible to women.  If you are a man do not take this class.

She was good. When you've taken other spanish classes, you can truly appreciate that she isn't strict at all. She's very chill and approachable. You DO have to study, but for a language class it's pretty easy.
She is really nice and extremely knowledgable.  I did not think her tests were very hard as long as you went to class and took notes. You need to participate in class so be prepared.

Young professor who speaks w/ clarity. Not a native speaker nor great at spanish, but I was able to understand her. Class is tough (like all spa classes) but she will help u through it. Many extra credit opportunities & great reviews before exams/essays. Attendance mandatory but it's necessary. Easier than the past 4 prof. I had) Def. recommended!

She is a great teacher who has a passion for the material and has insightful things to say. As per any spanish class there is a decent amount of homework but nothing too overwhemling. You may not like this class though if you don't like to speak in class. Otherwise definitely a good option for Spanish, just be prepared to think analytically.
DO NOT TAKE HER. She is not helpful. She seems nice but she is NOOOT...

She was a good teacher but a hard grader. Things could have been clearer though because most of the time half the class would not know the homework that needed to be done since she was constantly changing it.
Don't take her. My first language is spanish and all my papers she graded I got a 85 not greater than that. A lot of work. Not easy grader.
Great Professor,but this class is a lot of work.

She is young and relatable, and you can tell she is interested in her subject. She is a fair grader who will return your essays with a lot of constructive comments. Try not to come to class late or skip too much. Almost all the readings are put up on Blackboard for you to print out, so that saves you money since you don't have to buy an anthology.
Hard tests and she is a horrible teacher-do not take!

This was the hardest 101 class I have EVER taken. It was very difficult. There were 3 tests multiple choice 25 questions, and a group project. It's possible to pass, but STUDY HARD. Her lectures are boring and you have to write EVERYTHING. That's all you do the whole class. Don't skip. You can take pictures of the slides.
I'm a finance major and this was the class I had to study and work the hardest for just to be able to PASS-I think that's enough said
not the hardest class like everyone says but she is a truly awful teacher and doesn't seem to care at all if everyone does poorly. I wouldn't take her if I were you

She clearly knows a lot about marine science but is a very bad teacher and knows that the majority of the students taking her class are not MSC majors so she purposely makes the class very difficult just to prove a point. Exams are super hard and attendance is mandatory as well as participation-a terrible choice for an elective course

I had to drop this class after the 2nd exam and so did a bunch of other students which looks pretty pathetic on her part as a teacher considering this is an intro science class. If your taking her next semester just realize itll prolly be your hardest class

she is a really bad and useless professor, tests are super hard, last exam average was like a 60 and she doesn't care at all if you do bad and is mean with her students. worst class I have ever taken at UM and I am a junior
STAY AWAY! unless you want one of the worst class experiences ever

one of the worst teachers at UM. she's never willing to help you out and gives you attitude whenever you ask questions, her lectures are also extremely boring and long and won't learn squat. this is supposed to be an introduction class and she makes it extremely hard-DO NOT TAKE HER!

she's a nice lady but an awful teacher. its impossible to pay attention because she goes extremely fast and doesn't put her lecture slides on blackbird so you have to copy everything down. the tests aren't too bad but don't expect to learn anything in this joke of a class

horrible teacher, goes at her own pace expecting the students to understand literally everything she says and makes the class excessively boring-you also have to copy exactly what she puts up on the slides during class but barely gives you any time to copy it down-tests however aren't that bad-you do tho need to study

This is a very easy science class, she's not kidding when she says you don't need any prior knowledge. While her tests may have been somewhat difficult, there was a significant curve at the end of the semester. Attendance and participation count so you have to show up, but you don't have to buy the textbook. She's really sweet and always helpful.

She teaches the class as if you are in elementary school and then you get the tests and are blown away by what is on them and how hard they are. Grades you on 3 25Q MC exams and one final group project/presentation. Says she will curve at the end and doesn't end up doing so. try to avoid if youre taking bc of a requirement. too hard for intro level

Awesome professor.  Will teach you how to express your stories cinematically.  The criticism is what you pay for, so be open to it.  It's not personal, it's for the purpose of improving your writing and story.  If you can't take critical feedback in an academic setting, it will only get rougher in the biz.  Incredible writing teacher!
cool teacher, funny not arrogant AT ALL, knows what hes talking about and will make you think, thats for sure. Highly reccomended
He is blunt, but a great teacher don't be discouraged if he rips apart your script because it will really help you develop a great story. and he does it to everyone. Know the formatting!!

By far, one of my favorite teachers at UM. He KNOWS WHAT HE'S TALKING ABOUT and is very helpful in developing your script and storyline by pointing out things you probably never would have thought of! He is somewhat critical and enjoys a good dose of sarcasm, but its all in good fun. I thoroughly enjoyed his class. Highly recommended.

Fink, is a nice guy who unfortunately never made it in the industry. Therefore he takes this frustration out on his students. The class was a major waste of my time, and was more focused on structure than creativity. There is no room for artistic expression in Fink's class. Format correctly and you'll be fine, but don't try and get too creative. Fi
No Comments
Abrasive, arrogant and with little to no insight. Those who can't do, teach and those who can't teach or do are Morris Fink.
He only cares about himself and his own scripts at home. He treats his students as inferiors. I asked him to read a script on 3 different occasions and he said he was "too busy" Disrespectful

I love this guy. If you want to know what the real world is like...take his screenwriting class. He gives you a ton of criticism...but once you get used to it, you're as good as gold. He's also pretty hilarious.
Simply amazing.
Awesome.
My favorite class and teacher.  I woul take anything he taught, there is fair amount of work, but it is fun to do!
Idk why there are bad reveiws, He is a super chill + kind teacher that wants you to succeed and get a good grade.  It is a lot of writing but he is a super lenient grader and wants you to do well.
Take this class for a easy and chill course

Unless you own an Airbnb business, your parents have a manufacturing company in Honduras, or you have your own food brand, you will struggle when he cold calls on you. I would dread going to this class because I could never figure out how to answer him. Graded on a midterm and final essay each which I wrote 22 pages for.

A discussion-based class with no busy work, a midterm and final set of essay papers are the biggest parts of your grade, which involve lots of writing, but he gives you a week to finish. Genuinely a cool guy who has a lot of knowledge to offer. GOAT

100% the best professor I have ever had. She's really passionate about teaching and educating the next generation of architects and let's you explore different styles YOU are interested in. A lot of creative freedom and a lot of helpful guidance and feedback. She can get caught up with her own projects from time, but she is always there to help!

She arrives late to class and leaves early. When she finally does get to class she floats around the room and does not distribute time equally for desk crits. When giving feedback to students she can go overboard and be  condescending. She's talented as an architect herself but lacks the ability to teach students about architecture and visual rep.
She was amazing, very happy all the time and extremely helpful. She is very motivational as well.

Dr. Finn's class was a good class overall in my opinion. The syllabus outlined the semester very clearly and there were no surprises. Make sure to do the homework, which is all online and graded on completion (worth 20% of your grade), and participate in class (10% of your grade). He also offers up to 3% of extra credit during the semester.

He's a nice guy and really wants you to succeed in learning French! Very passionate about what he does. IMPORTANT ⬇️

Homework. You MUST do it before every class. 20% of your grade.

Big assignments. Do not badly mess up or you're cooked as they are worth 10% each.

Participation. You will be called upon 1-3 times/class and attendance is mandatory.

Dr. Finn is really nice and he does not make you feel bad for asking questions. There are a ton of assignments and they are usually back to back. HW is very short and easy completion. Attendence is completely mandatory, he is extremely strict on it like you have to get a doctor's note when you are sick to be excused. Overall, better than others.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I will miss this man only because he was so caring and genuine. HOWEVER, prepare to teach yourself everything as his lectures don't exist. Take advantage of the extra credit, the oral exams, the quizzes, and the cultural project at the end of the semester. Put in the effort and you should end with a fine grade.

Dr. Finn was a very knowledgeable and helpful professor. He is very encouraging, especially if you are not feeling comfortable in a subject. He appreciates participation and will call on people to try to get the whole class involved in material. He expects you to do the homework before coming to class, so be careful about falling behind.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The professor is great and very knowledgeable, but this is mostly a self-taught class. You will need to read the textbook and practice your French outside the class to keep up and do good on the tests. Attendance is mandatory, but the lectures are mostly just to practice conversing. Easy homework. Exams aren't too bad but strict grading.

He is a very nice guy but his lectures are nonexistent. You are expected to teach yourself the material before coming to class which can be a nuisance. He is very patient with students and does not judge at all which is nice. Participation and attendance matter! He is also very easy to reach outside of class.
Nice person but the course was pretty tough. V harsh grader and attendance is MANDATORY.

A tough grader, but a great professor who cares about the content he teaches. Willing to review in-class if any questions are asked. Most of the course is self-taught from the textbook, and all exams are online or through Zoom using Respondus. It's important to review before taking this class, so brush up on your French. Will miss this man!

I just wanted my language requirement complete. God, was it a strenuous task. Very little lecture; you teach yourself the material through online textbooks activities and then answer questions as a class to prove mastery. He's a good professor as well and will work with you during and after class if you need extra assistance.
Great person honestly. I liked his class. I had not taken French since 10 grd and jumped into 201. Lots of testing. Works with you. No textbook.

Professor Finn is genuinely a very nice person who wants you to learn the language. He assigns a lot of work/quizzes/tests/orals/compositions, but everything is layed with deadlines on the first day so there is no unexpected assignments or assessments.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Hes a good teacher but he just sucks at actually teaching you what you're supposed to know. Maybe because it's online but every night you have homework and you don't know how to do it at all and have to self-teach yourself. Then during class, we just go on a google doc and he questions you like everyone already knows everything.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He is really patient and won't embarrass you in front of the class. He will explain things to his best and won't get mad if you need it explained in English. The course plan is available ahead of the class time, so you can prepare for what's to come that day. He does a lot of group exercises. We did 2 big essays and 2 oral exams. Fair grader.

Very kind prof & cares about students. He's just bit of tough grader cause when writing papers, you might say something that's not technically wrong but he would take off points anyway just because you didnt say it how he would want you to. Lots of assignments: connect hw, composition papers, quiz/exams, projects, etc. But definitely doable

Dr. Finn is a great processor. My confidence in speaking French has improved so much because of him. I like his teaching style because its group activity based and conversations rather than heavy lectures. Very nice and caring professor. Would absolutely take him again!
Amazing prof, tough but patient. Will help you out and is always encouraging you to do your best.

often it would be a slow week followed by an assignment-heavy week. explains expectations clearly. you'll need the textbook. definitely improves your speaking abilities in french since it's a must to speak in french all class.

My FAVORITE class at UM! Professor Finn is super caring and a wonderful professor. He is so sweet, always has a smile on his face, and always greets everyone with a smile. If you are good at French/enjoy French, it is very doable to receive an A as long as you come to every class and participate. I love this class and highly recommend it.

One of my favorite professors. Dr. Finn is incredibly kind and really wants all of his students to do well, which is why he is strict on attendance. You will do very well in his class if you show up, speak in French, and show interest and solid work. He assigns homework often but it is really simple and quick. Amazing prof if you want to improve.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Honestly pick someone else. If you don't do well and try to retake it with someone else he'll get mad and try to visit that class/convince you not to. Rather strange. I wouldn't take my chances. Could be a bad/strange experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Finn is a nice guy but his class is hard. There is a lot of homework and participation is crucial. Make sure to only speak in french. He gets more lenient towards the end of the semester so make sure to try harder in the beginning. Overall, not a bad class but not one I would take again.

Great teacher, TOUGH GRADER! Make sure to get on his good side and you will be fine. Still, that doesn't mean he will be easy on grading your essays! Make sure you participate and do everything in good timing as he will make you speak in class. Despite his harsh grading, he is awesome and will give second chances if you ddnt turn in the hw.

Kevin Finn is a great professor. Hes nice and hes there for you if you interested on his class. Attendance and participation is a must and you have to do all the homework. I learned so much French in his class. Id recommend him for sure! Thanks Mr. Finn!

This was a pretty tough class for me and I've been taking French since the 6th grade. Professor Finn is fond of pop-quizzeshomework, attendance is mandatory, participation is a must, and he's a tough grader. If you're looking for an easy french class, this isn't it. But you'll definitely learn what you need to advance your french studies!
I like this professor very much. He is always willing to help you. You need to work hard in order to get an A.

Truly a great professor. Although it may seem like you get a lot of assignments, I always felt like they helped me in some way to improve my grammar. Participation is a must in this class, but if he sees you trying to speak French, he will definitely be there to help you out. I would recommend this professor to anyone!

If you like to be entertained take his class. He is extremely smart and funny. On top of that, he has an ENCYCLOPEDIA in his brain. If you want to LEARN french take his class. I assure you that he will TEACH you. He will give you a good grade even if you fail but try your best. Just be on time an. I would ONLY wake up for his 10 am class ;)
Way too much work but he is an incredibly sweet and nice guy! Loved his class! Take him if you are willing to work and learn a lot!
Soy Josefino, and I want to say that this class has too much work. However, K.Finn is nice and his accent is entertaining. The End.
Need to go to class, tons of pop quizzes and hw. It felt like I was always working on something for this class

Really good professor and an organized straightforward course. During class there's only french speaking and a lot of participation. His quizzes are vocab straight from textbook. Easy class if you show up and participate.

Very organized class. Easy to follow. Keep up with the textbook vocab. A lot of busy work for someone not interested. For not being able to carry a conversation well in French, I did fine. He's very nice and will help you if you want to improve. Must attend class. Loves pop quizzes on vocab.

He is prob one of my favorite teachers. He is super kind and although he makes you participate he is clear and easy to talk to. Still, it is difficult to skip this class and if your class does not study the vocabulary assigned for homework, he will give out pop quizzes on it for every class. Your french will definetely improve if you follow along!
He is really nice and helpful. Class is fun-you do have to participate but it is not embarrassing. He is easily accessible through email and will work with you if you need help. Great class!

Professor Finn is a good teacher. He's not overly entertaining, but he makes you talk and participate in class. He will learn your name quickly. His assignments are not hard, and he gives you ample time to work on them. You might have some difficulty with his accent at first, but then you get used to it. He uses a lot of videos in class.

Prof. Finn was a good teacher. He makes sure you speak only French (which really helps conversation skills) and most of the class is discussion based. He's very picky about grammar on the essays, but it's helpful and revisions are required. He speaks clearly, albeit with an accent, and instructions aren't always clear. Overall, I enjoyed the class.

Prof. Finn is awesome. He's such a nice guy, but if you get on his bad side, watch out. However, I learned a lot from his class and I improved my conversation skills a lot. I recommend this class if you want to learn a lot about French!
HATED THIS TEACHER! You  must attend class to pass. Not sympathetic. Do not take him unless you have too!
Great teacher, very ticky tack when it comes to grammar.  Just follow instructions and do the Quia and you'll be fine
Very good teacher, very helpful. Reccomend him strongly.

Awesome teacher, really takes the time out to make things clear. You have to be ready for class participation as you'll regularly be called to speak in class (in French). The typical lang department setup: journals (10), portfolios (2), oral exams (2). Lots of opportunity for extra credit. Very friendly and approachable, staying to answer questions

Prof. Finn is a great teacher. He is a very fair grader, has a really nice accent for not being french and he is very helpful and understanding. If u need to take french, or just want to take it for fun, take it with him!

He speaks only in French so you should have good background French experience to take this class. He is extremely nice and understanding. Gives a mixture of work such as two quizzes, 2 oral presentations, journals etc. so it is well balanced. Just make sure you keep up with the syllabus and online journal he doesnt always remind you.

Good professor. Just make sure that you read the syllabus and keep up on all the online work. There is a good deal of homework involved but if you do that then you should be fine. Prof. Finn is very helpful so do take advantage of that. He's a pretty nice guy.
Tough grader, there are easier teachers out there... Stay away unless you absolutely must take his class

Great professor! It was a bit hard to understand in the beginning because the course is taught in all french but he does what he can to help. Very easy class but lots of homework. Journals almost every week (paragraph or two), 3 portfolios (brochure/ad), 3-4 quizzes, online workbooks for every chapter, 2 oral exams, a mid-term and final. Easy A!
only speaks french in class but its not so bad..comprehensible..tests are easy but grades hard..recommended..u will learn in his class!! :)
RECOMMENDED. Is a tough grader, but is willing to help. He makes it easy to converse in class, which helps so much for french. The gramar review is great.
Tough grader, very nitpicky when it comes to essays. Stay away unless you absolutely love the french language and truly want to learn.

Fleysher comes from the real world. She uses the classroom to prepare you for it. If you don't want to get involved,  stay away.  I have a feeling the advice and encouragement she gave me will be ringing in my ears for the next 10 years.
reviews.rating_tags: Inspirational--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Possibly the most important prof of any I had. Incredible career advice. Life saving. She is the real deal and cares about you. Warning: stay away if you are looking for a slide. You have to work here. I hope Prof. Fleysher will mentor me for years to come.

She started a competitive NY summer intern program that is amazing. She helps you get there. She not only knows a lot about the business but she knows people in the business. If you work hard, she goes to the mat for you. If you're a slacker, look out.
There were several times during the semester where I seriously believed she was the Devil incarnate.  That's all you need to know.
She challenges you, but for good reason. She has A LOT of real life experience and knows a lot of people in the broadcasting world to help you out.

One of the worst professors I have ever the displeasure of working with.  She is very nasty, very rude, and does not do a good job at all of teaching the course material.  She made several students in our class cry on various occassions.  She made us hate the program.  She made us want to quit. She made us hate life.  Seriously, do not take her.
She's brilliant.  I've never met a professor more dedicated to her students.  She really goes above and beyond.

Fleysher is very experienced as a producer/reporter. She has some trouble translating that into teaching. She has great stories. Needs to focus on teaching writing/ keeping with planned syllabus. I recommend the class. You will do weekly writing assignments related to current events or TV news programs. Get to know her. She can help you in the biz

she claims for her tests to not be tricky, but in my opinion, they are. a lot of the times, more than one of the multiple choice options isnt correct, and she'll ask questions about something NEVER talked about in class (bc i never skipped) it also seems like she makes her tests in a rush bc there are ALWAYS mistakes.
Didn't really go to class because she reads off the powerpoint. Exams are easy. Not much else to say.

Dr. Uy is an AMAZING BIL150 professor. She is very straightforward and her powerpoint slides are very helpful and easy to understand. She has pictures with summaries on all of the slides. All of her test questions come straight from her power point slides and you can also find a lot of them on quizlet. I definitely recommend her for BIL150.

She's very approachable and easy to talk to. Her teaching style is easy to understand and she's very funny. Her tests are very straightforward, you only need to study the powerpoints. An easy A for a biology class.

Even though her slides are straight from the book, the information is all over the place and hard to follow. The book helps in clarifying however. She makes a lot of typos on her tests, that are essentially straight from the practices she gives you. Easy class, but bad teacher.

Dr. Uy is a great professor, she is one of the best professors I've had at UM. She explains very well her lectures and she tells you what she expects you to know for the tests. Read the power points and take notes in class and you will get an A.
not a good teacher, not a bad teacher
tough prof for non-science major
Awesome teacher, very lenient. Very personable, makes classes easy to deal with. Offers writing credit

Her tests are only 20 questions so just 3 wrong and you already lost the A. Also, her test questions are extremely vague and confusing. She is not very accommodating to student feedback and opinion. Would recommend another professor.
Dr. Mora is such a cool professor. Her tests are really easy and as long as you show up to class and listen to her you'll pass. She cares about her students and she always wants you to understand.

This is the best teacher I had this semester! attendance isn't mandatory, and all the powerpoint content she uses, she uploads it on black board. exams are very easy and all the content is based on the ppt! easy A!

Dr. Mora-Kepfer is an amazing, passionate, and caring professor who genuinely cares about seeing her students succeed and learn. The class serves somewhat of an intro to the endocrine system, but focuses more on the behavior element. Her tests are a little tricky, but overall she is an amazing professor! Definitely would recommend!
Loved the class! There were so many different and cool things we talked about in Hormones and Behavior. Tests can be a slightly tricky but not too bad. Definitely worth taking!
This teacher is freaking awesome, she is SO helpful and caring with the students. Class has a lot of material but you actually LEARN! She teaches awesomely, 100% TAKE this class with her :)
Easiest class ever. Gives test material class before exam. only have to go to class 3 times
He is the goat. Low risk high reward class. Lectures are interesting and short. You will get an A
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very easy class and caring professor. Attendance optional, and gives test material. Highly recommend.

Most chill class ever. Lectures every class, but always lets you out after about 30-45 minutes. Before every test goes over exactly what is on the exam so even if you don't go to lecture you can still do well in class, but I would still recommend going so it's easier to have a grasp on the knowledge. Easy A and the class is decently interesting

This class is very lecture heavy, but you don't have to attend or take notes. The class before the exam, he goes over everything that will be on the exam and will show you the corresponding slides. Its a quick turnaround for studying, but its not too bad and his exams are not bad if you study.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is super nice and a great teacher. His lectures make sense and are not boring. Also the class before every test he looks at the test he made and goes over the vocab you need. As long as you get notes and go to those you have no reason to have any trouble.

Amazing professor! Take this class if you get the chance, he knows what hes talking about. Very passionate about the subject, and often ended class early. Test are very easy, no excuse to get less than an A+ in this class

I never thought I would enjoy a course so much. While this course was not for my major, I feel like I learned so much. He gives you the exact questions that will be on the exam, which is a class before. If you do badly in his course, that is 100% your fault. He is an amazing professor who cares a lot about the subject that he teaches.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He's the man! He gives four exams 10 questions each and tells you what questions are going to be on it the class before so you have time to research. The rest of your grade is based off a presentation at the end of the semester. Aside from that his class was really interesting and I ended up learning a lot while getting a 100!
Really great professor--extremely knowledgable and approachable! Wish I could take again

Professor Flothmann is an amazing math teacher with great passion for calculus. I had her for Math 151 and 162 and found her lectures to be very straight forward. The exams are often very similar to the in class worksheets as well as the review guides she prepares before exams. If you want to actually learn this material take this professor.
Go to her office hours they really help. She wants you to understand the material. Work is not easy but its understandable. Great professor!

She offers lots of opportunities for extra credit and her tests are very fair. There are 3 exams and the final and it is very easy to do well on. She is a little bit hard to understand, but her worksheets are very helpful and after a while you'll be able to understand her accent. She's honestly the best math teacher, you should definitely take her.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Solid choice for a math prof. Her test have no surprises and she genuinely wants you to learn. Study the worksheets and you should do well. She also gives a lot of bonus points which is super helpful. Class can get boring but try your best to focus. She also makes an effort to learn everyone's name which made me more comfortable asking for help.

To many Homeworks. She graphs every problems even if she not supposed to. Her quizzes are harder that her exams. Do not underestimate her worksheets question. I will never take her classes ever again, and I will not make my friends take her classes to.

She is professor who genuinely cares. She might go fast on the easy topics but if you ask her questions she most definitely will answer them. If she sees that the class is doing bad on the quizzes then she will give opportunity for extra credit. Absolutely loved her. Her worksheets have notes and example questions which come in the exams!

She is always happy to answer any questions you have at the start of class or any other questions during the lesson. Gives a reasonable amount of homework. Tests are very similar to worksheets given in class and she gives lots of partial credit on them. Cracks a joke every once in a while to lighten the mood.

Prof. Flothmann is a great mth 162 teacher. The class can be a bit boring but she generally explains the concepts well. Lots of webassign hw but at least its easy to get 100 on those. Tests and quizzes require a lot of studying. Tests can be quite long so you have to work quick.  You can replace a test grade if you do better on your final

I had taken calculus in the past, but the way she teaches the material made it so much more difficult than it needed to be. Shes not particularly very nice either, you get scolded for not making her class your #1 priority and if you ask a question she just says you figure it out. If I knew the answer I wouldnt be asking for help:/
Worst professor should not be teaching!
The class was hard. A lot of people either failed or did poorly. I normally never do bad in math and got the worst grade Ive ever gotten. The Professor was rude to students and did not seem to care.

Flothmann is a bad teacher. The content itself is not hard, but the way she goes about teaching students makes it very easy to not do well. She does not care if you pass or not, and is not here for your best interest. I don't even have enough characters to go into the little ways in which she trips up her students preventing them from succeeding
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Terrible. She gives you so much homework and doesn't teach in class. When you ask a question in class she belittles you and says things like "we already learned that were you paying attention". She is such a tough grader. She doesn't give partial credit on the exams and grades very harshly.
Make sure you've done some Calculus before taking Dr. Flothmann.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I am usually very considerate when it comes to rating teachers but not now. She is probably the worst professor at the University of Miami. She is a very rude and mean person and she made my life miserable! Everyone else says the same thing about her.! She should be fired immediately! Please do not take this class unless you want to fail!

Do NOT take Dr. Flothmann's class. Not only did I have a difficult time understanding her teaching, but I have never dealt with a teacher or professor who was so inconsiderate and cared so little for her students. Moreover, she was so hard to get in touch with the entire semester. The struggles I had because of her were unbelievable.

I loved having professor flothman. she really cares, and is always available to discuss math things, no matter the topic, after class. when the semester ended, she got in touch with me and encouraged keep on going, and was thoughtful enough to send me an email with my final exam grade the day she graded it. I really hope i get to have her again.

I LITERALLY HAVE NEVER DONE A RATE MY PROFESSOR BEFORE BUT PLEASE don't take her I have never gotten below a B in any class in my entire life including high school and I just took the final and if I end with a C- i will be SURPRISED. Please don't take her. I literally taught myself but then the test has nothing to do with the homework/notes. DONT
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved Professor Flothman. She goes through all the steps really well, making it clear what she is doing, but doesn't waste time doing all the stupid steps and wasting time. I really hope I can take another class with her again!

If you get her as your teacher do whatever you can to get out. Very inconsiderate when it comes to grading, will fail you on little things such as submitting an assignment slightly incorrect. Do whatever you can to avoid her!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Worst professor ever, she got angry in her lectures and she was impossible to work with during office hours. Her tests were so much harder than what we practiced. DO NOT TAKE HER.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She really wants you to understand the material. She gives considerable help outside of class, and will walk you through problems in office hours. She is a tough grader and will take off points on test and assignments for small errors so make sure to double check your work

Do Not take this class she is a very inconsiderate person. She's very unclear at times with her instructions and expects you to know everything she's doing. Does not give any homework on the bright side.

She was alright. I had a very difficult pre-calculus teacher in high-school so most of what we did in class I already knew how to do. She teaches quickly so I suggest really practicing with the homework. If you are not good at math, don't take her because you will struggle because she doesn't really explain very well. She isn't a bad person though.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof Flothmann provided helpful handouts which went along with the concepts she taught in-class. Overall, she described things clearly and as long as you pay attention in class and do the homework you can do well

Tests are solely based on notes taken in class, so if you have poor attendance do not take Flothmann. She is a smart and nice lady if you ask for help or go to office hours. Overall a good teacher, but she will make you work for a good grade.

Dr. Flothmann is by far the best teacher I have ever had in the subject of math. Her unique approach to teaching calculus relies heavily on her illustrations allowing for clarity when introducing different concepts on the infinite scale. If you actually want to LEARN math, take her. If you want to just easily pass, don't waste yours or her time.

Dr. Flothmann was truly a gem to have as a teacher. She's very sweet and truly cares about her students doing well. Labs tended to be on the difficult side, but her tests/quizzes were average/easy in difficulty as long as you pay attention in class and prepare with some practice Q's. Most questions resemble questions done in class/from other tests.

Marta seems like such a sweetheart and if you actually come to class and participate you'll do well... unlike me. she's a total hardo when it comes to grading or if you go to her about your grade. This class is great if you're a really hard worker and like going to class

Marta Flothmann does an excellent job teaching Calc 2. While the subject can be difficult she really makes it very clear during lecture, doing out examples write before you. Its important to pay attention to these examples because they teach you everything you need to know for the tests. She is also extremely helpful during office hours.
super easy-- practically no homework!!! she's so good about explaining things and taking questions!

She is a really nice person. However, if you are not familiar with calculus or havent taken pre calc. Avoid her at all cost, there are other professors available. Def not a first option. Lectures where made in a class for 80 people. Thick accent and HARD EXAMS
If you pay attention, you will get an A

It can be difficult to pay attention in the Whitten lecture halls, but Professor Flothmann posts all her slides and usually provides a practice test that resembles the actual test. If you go to her office hours, she will show you how to do the problems. Very helpful but won't hand you an A.

She really means well, but has a very heavy accent. I rarely went to this class, learned mainly from the homework checks and helps, and luckily had a background in high school AP calculus. She is nice with extra credit and answering questions though. Definitely requires some teaching yourself, but wasn't horrible.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She's great! She cares about her students and wants everyone to pass- but you have to put the work in! Use her office hours! Exam can be hard, definitely do all the practice work she assigns as you never know exactly which questions she's going to use on the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Flothmann has infinite office hours AFAIK, but I've never been. The lectures are useless but mandatory. Do the WebAssign and worksheets and you'll ace the tests. If you're looking for challenging tests, this isn't for you. Remember H for I'Hospital or points off. I was dismayed to learn that she was from Hungary bc I thought she was Iranian.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This class was not an easy A, but the class was so worth it. Her teaching is crystal clear. Flothmann has office hours everyday except on Friday. She doesnt mind, she actually even loves it when you show up to Office Hours. There really are no surprises on exams. Primarily study what she goes over in class, but of course go over other things.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Flothmann is so accessible out of the classroom. She has office hours almost every day of the week, and even when she didn't, she would make herself available. Very difficult material and the lectures can be hard to understand but she clears everything up during office hours. Just a really amazing, respectable professor.

Dr. Flothmann was overall a good professor. If you have any questions, she will explain the concept again. I found her explanations very clear and helpful. I did not have to study much because I already had covered this material in high school, but I recommend getting help immediately if you are struggling because there is no curve. Overall, solid.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Though grader and tough tests. But gives decent lectures.

It's honestly not an easy class. The webassigns take forever and sometimes she rushes. But she is very helpful in class and outside if you have any questions and is overall a good teacher. This class is not an easy A though so if you want to do well you have to go to class, do the webassigns, and try to understand every concept she goes over.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: If you understand the concepts of calc before-hand, then you likely won't fail but you will still need to study. She tells you exactly what types of problems will be on the test but then gives difficult numbers. She is incredibly caring and understanding of her students; If you are having a problem, communicate with her. Be prepared to work hard.
Ms. Flothmann has a wonderful way of teaching. Her antiderivatives were on poiont, and her mic never worked. Shoutout to integral of x (cosx)^2 dx
Ms. Flothmann's lectures were great with a lot of nice graphs projected on the screen to explain concepts. The tests were not easy but ok if one understands the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Marta is a real gem! All you have to do is go to every class, pay attention in class, complete all her webassigns, go over the worksheets she does every class and you're guaranteed to pass. I got an A+ in this class, but i had to work hard. She gives extra credit for going to class and discussion and for our final she gave us all 18 extra points.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Here is the thing, I LOVE math but somehow she managed to make me dread it. Attending class became a task and I had to teach myself most of the content as she is too quiet to be understood. Though she does give out worksheets she basically does them for you allowing no room to learn. Her webassign homework does not provide any help for the tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: There's terrible teachers, and then below them is Flothmann. I have put so much time and effort into studying for this class, but no matter what I still cannot get good grades on the tests. And it's not just me... everyone I talk to is failing or barely passing. She has no sympathy for students, the tests are overcomplicated, and she goes too fast
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Are you taking MTH161? Yes? The read on. Dr. Flothmann is the toughest MTH161 professor there is. If you have taken calculus before and are naturally a mathematician, then why are you even here? BUT if you did OK in high school calc, then you'll get a B or a C in this class. Guaranteed. Tests are hard hard. TOUGH grader!! (she is nice tho)
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Most people are failing the class, cannot teach a class of such a large size. Over half the class dropped the class. Test questions are much harder than the ones she assigns.

Homeworks are optional so if you won't do them like me just attend class and make sure you know how to do the classwork. Tests are easy ONLY IF YOU STUDY. She explains everything really well and she's very helpful outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great professor. Homework is optional and really just practice problems for tests/quizzes. You will know exactly what will be on each test or quiz. She is readily available outside the classroom. She wants you to succeed.

DONT TAKE HER!!! She goes way to fast and does not explain anything really well and then her tests are the hardest thing ever, she throws random  questions you have never seen before and expects you to know them.
Extremely hard tests and exams! Horrible at explaining, skips through things very quickly. No sympathy for students. Everything is trigonometry. Does not curve.

Flothmann is easily one of the best math professors I've ever had.  For each class she has a lecture outline that she fills in with us in class.  She then posts the completed outlines online.  The class is by no means easy (because calculus is super hard), but she gives you the tools to succeed.

She is an ok teacher. Took AP in high school so the class was relatively easy. But if it's your first time taking calc she might not be the best teacher. Exams and Quizzes are mostly fair. Not the best explainer and sometimes can skip over things.

There is no homework, which is good and bad. I found myself out of practice and doing poorly on problems that were easy to me back in high school calculus. If you can pass out of this class with AP credit, I would recommend it.

She's heartless. Terrible class, extremely hard exams. Not even worth your time or effort taking this class with this terrible math professor. If I could give her a rating of 0, I would but I simply can't on this website.

Her exams are extremely difficult and in depth. HW is not graded, and your grade is mostly just tests and quizzes. The quizzes are usually less than 5 questions so if you get one wrong, you get a low grade. You'll come out knowing a lot of calculus, but be prepared to work hard.

I really enjoyed this class. She was always willing to help explain concepts and even helped on a few take home tests. Great personality and truly knew her subject. She is more old school and you don't need a calculator for the most part. Paper, pencil, and worksheets were all you needed to learn Calc 2
One of the best teachers i have ever had. Really helpful and there for you. Her tests are just really really hard, but she's great.
Really hard tests and exams

Goes through material very quickly and doesn't explain things well. She assumes much more than you do. Tells you which chapters are on the tests but once you open the textbook you see concepts that were never covered or even mentioned in class. My friend had a different professor for the same class and learned different and easier topics.

Incredible teacher, she's the best, took her for cal 1 and 2. Problems solved in class are exactly the same in the exams. She explains everything very clear and goes step by step in every problem.  Homework not mandatory, just study the problems done in class for the exams and you'll get a 90.

She's an amazing teacher and really helpful. I'd say one of the best in the University. Her office hours are really useful especially to know what to study for tests. She grades really hard and never curves. Study hard and see her in her office and you'll get a good grade.

Dr. Flothmann is one of the best teachers Ive had. Her lecturing is interesting and engaging, her grading fair and consistent. Attendance wasnt mandatory, but every minute was well worth it.  If you have any hesitations, let them go and enroll in her class. You wont be disappointed.

Marta Flothmann was a fantastic teacher of Calc 2. While it's not the easiest class out there, she does an excellent job teaching, and is always available during office hours to explain concepts. Wouldn't call it an easy A, but definitely possible to get an A as long as you put in some effort. Also, she doesn't assign hw, and drops lowest quiz+test
Fantastic teacher. Working to get her for MTH161.

A true instructor- truly understands the math and actually able to help her students understand. Though the pace might be a little quick, if you're fearless and ask the questions you need answered or go to her office hours this class should be fine. Don't speak-up and you'll quickly fall behind. Helpful handouts and plenty of examples in class.
Great teacher, will make you work for a grade. Also very harsh when grading, will rip your paper to shreds if you didn't pay attention. Otherwise wonderful and approachable professor.

Her classes are easy. Very thorough in explanation, and is there for you if you need more clarification. Show up to class and do the review problems and you can ace every test and quiz. No homework is assigned, so its up to you to practice as you will.

AMAZING PROFESSOR! She has a way of making calculus seem beautiful and elegant. She is also incredibly sweet and extremely helpful. The class itself might seem difficult but i think if you put in the effort, you will truly understand what you are doing and actually enjoy it.

The class itself is tough, but the professor is incredibly sweet and truly cares for the students. She moves quickly but is there if you have any questions along the way. Would definitely take her again.

Super helpful in office hours. I have no idea how she juggles all of her classes she teaches, she is amazing and brilliant! HW is worth half of the points, and exams the other half, which is a nice buffer. Unfortunately, the exams are nearly impossible and far too long. She gives extra credit though, which is nice!

One of the best math teachers I've ever had. Homework is not mandatory, but many questions on her exams are similar to those problems. She's very kind and extremely approachable. If you're having difficulty with anything at all, go to her office hours because she's always more than willing to help. Highly recommend taking her.
Worst professor!! beware

AMAZING teacher. She is so clear and everything makes sense during lecture. Homework wasn't graded, but it was necessary to do it to do well. 5 quizzes and 5 tests, all very fair and consistent with the homework and material taught in class. There is no one I know that didn't like her as a teacher, even though the class wasn't the easiest.
Nice lady, but didn't exactly love her as a teacher.  Pretty hard, but if you put the work in you can succeed.  Drops one test and quiz also.

Dr. Flothmann is not only CRYSTAL clear about everything you need to know for the exams, but she helps you SOOOO MUCH. She takes every little step very slowly. If you do your hw and approach her about any issues, she will help you. She basically retaught me algebra and trig during her office hours. She wants everyone to do well.
I had to put A LOT of time into this class to get an A. It's definitely do able I would say I just wasted way too much time on it. Go to office hours before the tests and she is very helpful
Very helpful if you need help or have questions. Friendly and understanding. Not the easiest, but if you put some effort to learn you'll do fine

Best math professor at UM, hands down. She is so helpful and crystal clear in her presentation of the material. Whatever you review in class is what will be on the quiz/exam. She never places any trick questions or questions you haven't gone ever and homework isn't mandatory. So amazing she's worth waking up at 8 AM for.

Very nice professor. Calculus 2 isn't a very easy course and if you want to learn and have to take upper level math courses definitely take her. No curve but every math class i know has no curve. Her office hours turn into lecture. VERY HELPFUL! Put in the effort it will pay off

Best math teacher at UM! She always asks if you need help and she explains things in detail so you really understand them. You do have to pay attention in class though. It's calculus. If you're not good at math then it won't just be easy.
Run away! She goes too fast! Nice lady though.
Excellent Excellent Excellent. Extremely reasonable, always flexible to move tests as long as you provide a good argument. Wants you to understand and get a good grade.

Excellent professor, knows exactly what she is talking about and is great at explaining everything. Only problem is she goes very fast during class, so keep up. Do the homework, ask questions, and if necessary, go to office hours and you'll be fine.

Professor Flothmann is the most amazing teacher I have ever had!!, she makes everything crystal clear, and she is very helpful. Not only does she know the Math, but she knows how to make learning insane amounts of math,in a very short time, quite fun.

Flothman is an amazing professor.  She balances teaching the material with fun / games and letting you out early on Fridays.  Quizzes and tests alternate every week; the lowest one of each is dropped.  She moves quickly, but is extremely willing to stay after to explain something differently or just to talk.
She goes too fast but knows everything!
BEST CALCULUS TEACHER!!!!! Pay attention in class, do your homework and you will do very well!
i love martha so much. she is the best math teacher i have ever had and she rocks miami green everyday.
Great teacher. Class is hard but if you pay attention you will get by. Doing homework is optional but encouraged.

I had her for Calc 1 and decided to take her 8 AM class this semester for Calc 2...and I hate waking up early. That's saying something. She's always willing to help and will answer any questions you may have. I recommend her for Calc 1 & 2

She is one of the best math teachers I have ever had.  Even though attendance is necessary, it was worth taking the 8 AM. She is always willing to help you if you have trouble, and homework is an easy A (even though WebAssign is a pain) since she is willing to answer questions in class.  If you do the work, the tests are as easy as the homework.

She is a great teacher for a hard subject. Professor Flothman is extremely helpful when it comes to going over homework problems you don't get or test questions. Take advantage of her office hours. Her test are a lot like the review but sometimes she throws in a couple of curve balls. Webassign sucks but ask for help is you need it.
She's very helpful and she makes sure that you understand the material. She made everything easy and she is always willing to stay behind and help you with questions.

She is so helpful and wants everyone to get an A. If you attend class and show some interest she will help you get an A through extra credit or something else. Unfortunately they put her at 8am often, but it is so worth taking her. She goes through concepts slowly and makes sure everyone understands them.
Really awesome teacher, pretty easy to get an A.

Professor Flothman was a great teacher! She was so nice and always willing to explain if we were confused - which wasn't often because she does a very good job communicating the material. Sadly she had to leave halfway through the semester. Professor, if you read this: we all miss you very much and hope/pray you are doing alright!

Prof. Flothmann is an EXCELLENT math teacher, one of the best I've had.  She clearly has a good understanding of the subject and is very helpful and friendly.   I would definitely recommend taking any math class with Prof. Flothmann.
THE BEST MATH TEACHER I HAVE HAD IN A LONG TIME!!! HIGHLY SUGGEST HER!

awesome teacher, gives partial credit and extra credit, drops lowest quiz and midterm grades. SUPER  HELPFUL... email or go to her office anytime and shell help... not super easy, but an A is definitely possible and you'll learn a lot... she's a great professor
I loved her and I hate math, that should say it all

I had professor Flothmann for MTH 110 and MTH 112. She was an awesome teacher!!!!! All you need to do is go over the in-class examples and know how to do the homework and you can get an A. She gives lots of partial credit and thoroughly explains the material. I got an A- in both classes. She drops a lot of grades and gives tons of extra credit!!!
She is very caring and overall entertaining. Often got side tracked by trivial questions and therefore sacrificed time for review. Not enough review for tests and tests were very difficult.

She is the best math teacher ive had in years, Great explaining all the concepts and the problems you have problems on.She is super strict on the calculator usage, and on how you show your work. Her tests are not hard if you study the material but they are semi-long and require critical thinking. If you have a choice on taking her i say DO IT

Great teacher, very clear explanations. Very helpful, you can e-mail her with any questions. Not enough review before the final. She gives alot of extra credit so make sure you do the problems. She gives alot of points during the test for how you work out the problems so they are not that hard as long as you understand the processes.
Ah yes, Flothman rocks. The exams and quizzes/tests are somewhat difficult, but she is a very easy grader. She explains things well and is also kind of funny... Had her for calc 2
Very good teacher, and easy grader.  If you pay attention during class and do the homework (which is not required btw) it is easy to do well.

Thick accent, very quick paced. Seems as the class is difficult in the beginning because of the speed, but she is VERY helpful. You can see her anytime and she explains everything. Be sure to do all the homework and practice exams, and she gives ALOT of extra credit at the end
She helps you out incredibly. I was doing pretty well at the beginning but then began to slack. Don't stop working. The practice exams help and you can always ask her for help.

She moves fast but is more than willing to help you.  On tests she looks for the right process more than the right answer, so you can get wrong answers AND an A.  Very nice overall, offers extra credit when it's needed.

No required homework, but suggested you do it.  Great teacher who loves her students, gives occasional extra credit, and tests are always well prepared and practice tests are given.  Best math teacher i've had here

I love Professor Flothman! She is the best math teacher I have had at UM so far. She is kind, fair, and very understanding. She really wants her students to do well, and if you take her class, you will do well! I hadn't gotten an A in math since 7th grade until I took her class!!!
She is incredible!!! I seriously love her.  She is so fair and truly cares how you do as a student.  Honestly, you couldn't ask for more in a teacher.

i absolutely loved her. i thought she was a great teacher who cares about her students and whether or not they learn. her exams aren't hard- just do the practice tests and you'll be fine. when i found out i had her again for MTH112 i literally threw a party! she's a really awesome teacher. =o)

great teacher.. if she sees you trying she will help you.  go to her for help if struggling and you will do well. test are straightforward. if she gives u practice tests DO THEM, KNOW THEM. Great teacher.
You are one long runon sentence

VERY nice and helpful teacher.  Best math teacher at UM.  I felt like I didn't have to struggle to learn the material, was able to do well and still walked away with a strong knowledge of the subject.  I definately recommend Flothman!

Flothmann is the best math teacher the department has.Very clear and to the point. Writes notes on the board very clearly, tests are identical to practice tests.  She wants you to do well!  I tried 3 different Calc I teachers(Goodman-horrible, Osfora-okay, and Dong-good). waiting for her to teach it
Pretty easy, the practice exams are just like the real exams. I highly recommend her.
Really nice teacher
No Comments

Loved the class, Dr. Andreopoulos stimulates thought and debate in class, which is quite more than most professors do in theoretical classes such as this. He assigns lots of research throughout the semester, if you don't like the material, you'll have a rough time, but if you do, you'll learn about the vanguard technology and treatments in BME
Prof Andreopoulos is a great teacher. He is able to distill a great amount of material and theoretical knowledge into his lectures. He has high standards for his students but is also very reasonable.

Dr. Andreopoulos is a very personable guy and is extremely knowledgeable. He speaks rather quickly, which makes his class difficult to follow at times. However, he's very approachable and loves what he does. Loved this class

really knows what hes talking about, nice/personable guy and wont kill you with grades. he's a good teacher but his accent can be a little difficult to understand at times.. buuut hes greek so the accent's more hot than frustrating... really good looking and obvi such a pro outside school. take his class.

Hes the absolute best!!! He does an excellent job of simplifying text book material and gives great notes that help on the quiz and final. Attendance is important but class is fun and interesting. I love his sense of humor and his real world experience

Prof. Fornaris was exactly the law professor I wanted for my first business law course at UM. An extremely well prepared and organized person, he is truly the embodiment of perfection. He knows his stuff, and justifies his grades that he gives on the quizzes and the final exam. The course requires effort but he breaks it down perfectly. Take him!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Fornaris is top notch. He works meticulously to break down the material very well,  all while providing many real world examples from personal experience. It is his practicality, humor, and enthusiasm towards the subject matter along with his expertise that makes course both comprehensible and interesting. Would take again!

Best professor I've had at UM. He actually has experience outside of the textbook as he is only a part time teacher and full time lawyer. Bring real life material into the course. Always supportive and positive and his quizzes are very reasonable. Learned a ton.

I took AP statistics which really helped me. He is an ok-lecturer, but is not very good at technology and lost some peoples exams.  His study guides are VERY accurate to exams. He occasionally gave freebie exam answers in class. Attend class because he is better at explaining the material than the textbook.

He wasn't great at explaining things and no on ever knew what was going on. He didn't follow the syllabus and then said to look at it when we asked while we got so far behind. Very nice person, but only got an A because I went to his office hours a lot.4 exams and the final was optional and a retake of your lowest of the 4 exams.

He was very disorganized telling us we would have HW or a test 2 days in advance when the HW takes hours. He did not go through the problems very well in class and I basically used the textbook to teach me the information. On top of all of this, he was all over the place with grading tests, sometimes he would take points off and I had no idea why.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Horrible professor. Wasted so much class time, 20 minuets late everyday, never followed the syllabus leaving us guessing when the next exam was. He would be extremely behind on lectures, cramming information last minute before the test. Inconsiderate and harsh grader, picks and chooses from who to take points off of, for no reason.

If i hadn't taken a stats course before, I would be ending this one with a failing grade. Shows up 20 min late, grades identical tests 20 points apart and if you ask why he says he was "in a bad mood". doesn't know answers to his own questions and tells us his wife thinks we're failures? horrible teacher.
