When students ask questions, instead of explaining he asks other students to try and explain it, but nobody ever knows what's going on because he doesn't teach. He grades the tests very inconsistently and will take off a huge amount of points and if you ask why he will simply say "must've just been in a bad mood". He also makes inappropriate jokes.

Please do not take this professor. He clearly doesn't understand how to teach in the modern day and is frequently late to his own lectures. His power-points and explanations were always confusing and he would fail to answer questions asked about the material in class. He asks others about how to answer a question and takes random points off tests.

Easy class, but do not ask this guy for a recommendation letter. He'll say he'll do it and months will pass and he will never get back to you or submit it. He is beyond inconsiderate, unprofessional, and lacks empathy. I am shocked he has any sort of respect in his field.
Take him! Lecture can be boring sometimes but if you attend and solve the HW you will be fine. He curves the exams by a lot!

I don't understand how this was a cognate class it was stupidly difficult. He was very disorganized, the TA misguided our exams multiple times, no one ever knew what was going on or their grade. He is nice but racist on occasion and not really funny.Stopped going to class and just did the homework and went for the exams.Take 292 instead of this

There was often too much unnecessary information given during class, steering away from the important things. Test questions were either too subjective or too vague. He never responds to emails and is a dull and disappointing teacher overall. (Also lost a bunch of people's tests worth 20% of the grade and refused to take accountability.)

This was one of the most difficult classes I've taken. I had to reteach myself a lot of the material but he tried his best to teach the material. I did like how he graded though. The homework was extra credit to the corresponding test and the final was to optionally retake a test. Just make sure you study for this class, if you don't, you'll fail.
he doesn't know whats going on in his own class, his syllabus isn't updated, he is hilarious though= but ig the class itself is funny alone. his grading are three journals and three tests.

Aside from never answering emails, Foote is a pretty great teacher. Makes the class intriguing and tries to be funny to make the class bearable. If you go to class and read the chapters you'll have an easy A. Most of his test questions come from lecture material. Journal assignments are easy, but some of the questions can get pretty personal.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Honestly, great professor. Keeps you engaged, barely gives homework, no quizzes, just 3 exams and the final. The exams are a bit difficult, with a mix of extremely simple questions and hard trick questions. As long as you study the powerpoints and do the textbook readings you'll be fine. Keep in mind he's pretty old, and NEVER answers emails.

The course is fun, the tests aren't hard, but this dude messed up our entire class's grades. I got A's and B's in all my exams and full marks in the journal questions he provided but got a B- because of HIS OWN miscalculations on blackboard. He did this with EVERYONE in the class and we are all attempting to get a grade appeal right now.

I don't know who hired professor Foote. He is disorganized and incompetent. A message via a pigeon would get to him faster than email. He DOES NOT respond to emails EVER. Save yourself the headache and do not take this class.
Professor Foote is incompetent and does not respond to emails. He is extremely unprofessional. I would not recommend taking any courses with him ever.

He is very nice and class is manageable. An A is reasonable if you read his lectures and do the online homework (which isn't a lot). Negative- is he is very difficult to reach out of class, won't email back even if the subject line told him he was the lotto. Bonus- study guides are very similar to exams

You definitely either have to go to class or read the textbook to do well. It is one of the harder classes I have taken and I have had foote for other psychology classes and I liked him but def not for stats. I recommend taking someone else for this class but he is not that bad. Only grades are tests pretty much. Final is optional and can drop test

Professor Foote is extremely kind and funny. This class is not challenging but it is crucial to study for the exams. There are 3 papers throughout the semester that are long but easy to write. He is helpful but he also hardly ever answers emails. I would highly recommend this course with professor Foote.

An extremely tough grader. Homework is extra credit towards tests, but I highly suggest completing them all since he is such a difficult grader. Additionally, homework assignments are very long and take an extensive amount of time to complete. So prepare to set a significant portion of time aside for this class every week.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The lectures are interesting and he is very knowledgable about the subject. He always includes little anecdotes about his experience as a marriage and sex counselor, which is interesting in itself. It was a pretty easy class. Just showing up and listening to lectures and reviewing a bit before the test was enough to succeed. Would recommend.

Dr. Foote is an amazing professor. Read the chapters, go to lectures and study the review sheets and you should get an A. He is a great person and relieves some stress since you do not have to worry about his class. He is very organized. He presents his slides in the same order as the textbook. I cannot stress enough, take Dr. Foote!!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Foote is a straight up king. I took his PSY292 course last semester and I enjoyed this one even more. Fair grader and the work load is fine. Course graded on 3 journals and 3 tests. He is SO funny and makes the class enjoyable regardless of content. Gives study guides and if the material isn't on the study guide it isn't on the test.

Dr. Foote's level of disorganization is beyond frustrating, it's juvenile. He knowingly neglects students' concerns and is extremely petty when addressing issues. Additionally, he doesn't follow the syllabus and leaves students scrambling to study for exams or write journals. I left more annoyed than educated.

Took this class for social psychology. Honestly barely showed up all I had to do was read the chapters that corresponded with each test and passed with an A. The tests are exactly the material covered in the book so if you read the chapters assigned for each test you'll definitely pass with an A.

DO NOT take Dr. Foote. He is extremely disorganized and does not follow his syllabus test dates (randomly lets students know when exams are with < 48 hours notice), and knowingly doesn't cover all the lecture material prior. He is also very disorganized, and doesn't finish lectures before jumping to the next one. Save yourself the headache.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: abnormal psych is SUPER interesting. he did a great job teaching. all powerpoints are on BB so def review those before tests. no homework, but do the extra credit. test was online and not hard; all multiple choice. 100% would take again

IF YOU ARE TAKING AN ONLINE CLASS WITH HIM.... beware he does NOT , I repeat DOES NOT, respond via technology. The grading was pretty fair, class was super interesting, but if you have questions it is nearly impossible to get a hold of him. I would only recommend if you are going to be able to see him in person. You barely need the book also.

Dr. Foote is a good professor. I have taken one of his classes before, so I decided to take this one too. The material is interesting, and lectures are engaging. He's a very nice guy, and very forgiving when it comes to late assignments. My only problem this time around is that he is really bad at responding to emails! Like he won't respond at all.

This class was distance learning so it was hard to reach out to him, especially since he's not very tech-wise but he is literally so nice and sweet. I was able to go to office hours and ask questions. 50% of the final grade is the average of 3 exams and then the other 50% is the discussion board.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Nice caring guy. five tests, due to online module had over 24 hours for each one. Easy class if you pay attention.

Professor Foote is a nice guy but you will not learn statistics through class-time. You need to be in class to get his specific definitions that are on the exams, but you will only learn how to do the problems through the textbook. Very easy to get an A but only if you are willing to work hard on your own time!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Foote is a cool person, but very sarcastic. If you have thin skin, you might want to skip out on him as a professor. The powerpoints he posts to Blackboard are full of blanks where important information should go, so you need to be in class to hear the answers. There's homework for every chapter but it's all extra credit & gets applied to quizzes
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This class was based on lots of memorization. Each test is multiple choice that is very straight forward so memorize as much as you can. Dr. Foote gives about 10pts in extra credit before each examine. They're long response and sometimes can be a lot but the answers are online and he hasn't changed them in like 10years.

I went to class a total of six times throughout the semester, so I'll take the B+. Foote likes to ramble during his class and his sense of humor didn't reach me. He didn't really seem like he knew what he was doing, but the material is very interesting.
A lot of extra credit! Funny man. Would recommend 10/10
Gives a lot of extra credit. On the last test he offers up to 10 extra credit points. Boring lectures, but he's a cute old man. Don't have to show up to class. Tests are pretty easy.

Dr. Foote is so nice and caring about his students. He gives so much extra credit for class and it helps so much for your grade. His lectures are long and sometimes boring but are important. He also does reviews before every exam which helped a lot. Definitely recommend!

Statistics is very difficult t teach, but if someone can do it, its him. Gave us 6 multiple choice tests and the last one was optional if you felt good with your grade, if not he would drop your lowest grade. The homework is extra credit for your test grade and if you don't understand something just ask him. It might feel overwhelming but its good.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Fav professor 100% and my favorite class. He makes the lectures easy to understand by making it fun, which makes you want to attend class. 3 journals are really required and big part of grade. Need to be VERY SPECIFIC. EVERY DETAIL COUNTS so don't hold back. Tests are multiple choice, so as long as you read and attend lectures you will be good.

TAKE THIS CLASS! You will learn so much for your own life. It was so interesting and fun, made even better by Dr. Foote's personal experience as a couple's counselor and sex therapist. He is amazing. The study guide is exactly the test but you need to spend some time on the journal questions

Only had three tests that he provides extremely specific study guides for.  He is an absolutely funny old man.  He uses so many real life examples in his lectures, which are just as interesting.  He seriously cracked me up so many times and he is so passionate about the university.  I seriously hope to do research with him before I graduate.

do the homework because it counts towards extra credit for the test.  He gives a study guide that is very similar to the test. Do it three times and you will get an A in the class. He answers your questions so ASK if you don't understand. If you still don't get it, read the book, it's very helpful. Homeworks are from the book so you have to buy it.

This class was so interesting. You will learn things that will pertain to your actual life. You have to be comfortable talking about sex, especially in your own sex journals. There are 3 sets of journals and they are not an easy A. Study hard for the tests and put in the time for the journals and you can get an A. Utilize Foote's office hours!

Difficult class involving many papers, tests, group projects, and optional extra credit. However, with a lot of effort, you can do well.  Go to office hours!  If you're willing to go to EVERY class and lose sleep over studying and papers, it is 100% possible to get an amazing grade.  He is very particular but very knowledgable.

The class is interesting, unfortunately you don't know your grades until final grade is posted. Semester ended with only 2 out of 8 modules graded. Emailed 4x & none were answered (email was correct). Other students experienced this as well. The tests are unfair. 50 quest. 65 min. long questions & long multiple choice options. Not enough time.

He gives an insane amount of extra credit. Homework assignments are LONG (aka don't do at last minute), but they are extra credit. Exams are EXACTLY like the study guides, however you do need to study them if you want an A since they're long & detailed. It's easy to get an A in this class, you just have to put the work in.

Wouldn't recommend. He was quite frustrating to me at times. He's very particular and peculiar. I hated going to class. However, that said, the class itself was not at all difficult. The tests are literally the study guides that he gives you, with just the numbers changed. If you always fill out and study the study guides, you should get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: never take this class. it was beyond boring and foote was terrible.
Took Human Sexuality with him. He's hilarious! Would recommend ten out of ten.

Ive taken two classes with Foote- Bio stats and now Human Sexuality I would say over all he is great professor and you're going to learn a lot but his classes are not a walk in the park- VERY passable with an A but you have to work for it- if you are thinking about taking human sexuality with him be prepared to write A LOT- OVERALL WOULD RECOMMEND

This class with Dr. Foote was super easy and interesting.  There are only 3 tests, and he doesn't count attendance.  I only went to class about half the time and got an A.  He also offers extra credit, so as long as you do that and study hard for the classes, it isn't hard to pass.

Dr. Foote is hands down the best professor I have had in all of my years at the U. He is literally one of a kind in every way. He is an excellent professor, and I would take him a thousand times over if I could. It's rare to find a professor who cares, is actually good at teaching his subject , and spends the whole class making you laugh. 1010.
Get ready to write!! You're given 3 journals through out the semester and these save your grade. Do the study guides-they're identical to the tests! He's funny and it's an interesting class!

The class should be called "How to get an A in PSY291" because you learn a minimal and shallow amount of actual statistics.  If you don't mind that then the class is literal perfection for an easy A+, seeing that he literally gives you the test before you take it.  Just don't expect to walk away with useful skills. (PAINFULLY long homeworks)

Do your homework! Look at his study guides that he gives you before the exam, because those are pretty much the exams! He's the easiest stat professor, and makes everything clear and easy to understand. You do need to study. If you get an A+ he writes you a letter of rec!

His lectures are very straightforward and entertaining; he has a pretty good sense of humor. Class attendance isn't mandatory, but he definitely notices those who consistently attend class. If you take good notes and read the book, it's a fairly easy A. Grades are based off of 3 exams and 3 EC assignments; definitely not a time-consuming course.

Dr. Foote is totally quirky and super funny. His lectures are definitely engaging for the most part and when they do get dull he throws in a bad joke or two to wake up the class. I seriously enjoyed having him as a professor. The class itself was meh, but he made me want to go.

It's not the easiest psychology class but if you study the book you can get a good grade, he also gives extra credit for each test. Sometimes he can be funny but it takes a while to get used to his humor
Super boring material and he made it even worse.Never use emails and you need to go to his office hour or call him. 6 projects, 3 exams and 3 essays, heavy workload.

Awesome class, you learn very useful information. He's a a great professor, funny and helpful. Don't underestimate the exams just because it's a sex class, they're challenging and he asks very specific questions. Textbook isn't really necessary, but go to class because you need lecture notes to do well on exams. Go to office hours, he's awesome!!

Very funny and interesting professor. Very into abnormal psychology. Makes you be very interested in the class. A bit sarcastic and condescending with students, but that's rarely the case. He's always happy and he makes you smile instantly. Teaches material really well and prepares you for the 3 exams well

Hilarious professor but grades harder than other psychology professors I've taken at UM and it's my major. Take him if you're interested in the class. I enjoyed it but thought the exams were a little harder than they should have been.
Class material is really boring...but he tries to make it as interesting as possible. Tests aren't hard if you study. I definitely recommend this professor.

Prof Foote is a quirky guy, but he can be a lot of fun. Class grade consists of group projects, at least 4, and 3 exams, which are half take home essay, half in class MC. Class content can vary from interesting to boring, kind of hit or miss.

For psych majors who are terrible at math, don't expect to learn stats without putting forth a lot of work in this class. Dr. Foote is an amazing teacher, but the lectures are a bit tedious and tough to learn from. He does give you a lot of time to study and his exams come straight from the study guide. He is also very willing to help if needed.

Dr. Foote is really nice. His exams are not hard if you have class notes, and if you do the study guides, which are VERY helpful. Lecture is a little boring, but he brings treats sometimes, and he is happy to help during office hours or after class. Great class!

GREAT CLASS! Really interesting material and really easy as long as you put in a little bit of effort. Going to class is important but so is reading the text book. Use Foote's study guides as well. He is a really fun professor as well as a really good teacher!

He's a good teacher. However, he's a VERY meticulous grader on the homework and tests, so make sure everything's perfect. Reading the textbook before the lectures really helps and take good notes. He gives you a study guide for each test, and it's a replica of the test so study it religiously.

Strongly recommend this course especially if you know nothing about sex and relationships! Professor makes it entertaining and is brutally honest about sex etc. DO THE PAPERS, take notes and study for the exam = easy A. I guarantee you WILL learn something about sex etc. in this class you didn't know before!

Do not take this class if you are at all interested in learning about psychology. It is a glorified sex-ed class. He is an easy tester- exams are exactly what is on his study guide. But not worth the snoozefest that are his lectures...

Great teacher. Take him for whatever you can. His tests may be hard but he gives study guides saying exactly what information you have to find a learn for the test and if you can't find something you can go to his office and ask him. Overall fantastic teacher, also very entertaining in class, he is very eccentric and will keep you awake in class.

Dr. Foote is great. Don't mind the people who criticize him for this long HW and the points he takes off. The truth is you learn A LOT and he expects you to know your stuff. His tests are easy as long as you go through his study guides. His study guides are almost exactly what will be on the test. You won't regret taking him! He rocks!

AMAZING TEACHER!! His class isn't the most interesting but he is entertaining to listen to. He is extremely helpful if you go to him for help during his office hours. His tests are exactly like his study guides. He gives you a study guide before each test and if you know everything on them you are good.

This professor is good to a certain extent. He marks off many points on your test because you did not explain properly: I used likely instead of probably (-3 points!). He's not at all good at teaching. His homeworks take about 6 hours to complete...some up to 10 hours 20 pages long. Don't recommend. Waste of money. Take a real math course.
May be the easiest class a UMiami. Just study the review sheets and you will be fine. Can opt out of the final if you have a 98 test average. Lots of homework. Really nice guy, loves what he does

Professor is very energetic and fun, and he truly knows what he's teaching about. He gives reviews for test that truly helps, though be sure to still study some of your notes for background info. Powerpoints are just outlines, so show up for class!

One of the easiest classes I've taken. He gives a review to every exam and all the exams are EXACTLY like the review sheet.  Plus he gives u the answers to the review sheet so once u study/memorize that your good. U really have to work hard to fail this class; which means u didn't try at all. U could study the night before or morning of an exam and still get an A (i did). All u have to do is: STUDY THE REVIEW SHEETS!!

Funny, energetic, charismatic - the person you need to take at least once (but try for more than that) as a Psych major at UM. I'm terrible at math, but he carried me like an infant to a B+ in stats (so, so helpful). Under the occasional sarcastic remark, he really cares about his students and how they fare in his classes. Couldn't recommend more.
lots of homework
He assigns A LOT of homework

all of his powerpoints miss slides and information so even thought attendance isn't mandatory you still need to go to get the class notes!  tests aren't too hard and you learn a lot.  Foote is a very nice guy, i recommend him

This class was really easy and SO INTERESTING. Just 1 nite of cramming before the exam got me an A. Grades also based on 3 question sets that took me about 4 hours to complete. Rly easy though - just questions about ur analysis of diff sexual behavior topics. He gives an optional extra credit paper too for writing credit. This class was awesome

I cannot stress how much you need to stay away from this professor. Seems like a nice guy at first, but is the TOUGHEST grader I've ever had. He even puts multiple correct choices on his multiple choice tests, and you have to choose the one HE thinks is the MOST right. He NEVER responds to any e-mails and has half-empty PowerPoints.
Wow, I haven't had a professor this bad in years.

I thought this class was going to be easy. It started out alright, but as the semester goes on, he gets tougher. I have an B, and I cannot tell you how hard it is to maintain that. He is a VERY tough grader. His PowerPoints are always missing slides, and missing information, so they're useless. He is generally a nice guy, but avoid him if you can.

I waited 3 semesters to get into his statistics class and it was worth it! He is a fantastic prof . Very clear and nice and will remember you. Later on I took his Human Sexlty course bc I knew it was bound to be good. Little awkward at times, since he's got the kind fatherly thing going on. Get to know him if you plan to need LORs for grad school.

He looks like a creepy santa claus.  Gives way too much hw.  The tests are pretty straight-forward... after doing 50 hrs of hw/week plus.  If you're a girl he'll basically give you the answers b/c like I said he's creepy (every1 who rated a 5 is prob a girl).  If you bring a drink to class make sure it has a cap or he'll prob slip something into it

Great professor, he's interesting and funny, a lil creepy though..but the class is early soo if you can't wake up, dont take it since the exams are pretty much based on his lectures. really interesting class..when you go to it.

Best "math" class I've had in a long time. He loves to help students and he even let me do his exam review in his office so he could help me whenever I needed. He knows so much about his field and he really loves to teach. He def pays attn to students' needs and time constraints. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!
He is an extremely good teacher and provides reviews before the exams. the reviews are almost the same as the exams, and as long as you do them and study them you should definitely get an A!

Interesting class (the name should have told you that much). Dont need to go to class, but do the reviews... go to his office hours before the test (sometimes the answers to his review questions arent as obvious as they seem)

Dr. Foote is nice, but it's kind of awkward to listen to a 60 year old man talk about sex. I only went to class twice other than the exams- he doesn't take attendance. The exams are multiple choice and are easy as long as you go over his review and make sure you know everything. Buy the book or make friends with someone who has it. Overall good.

Had him a long time ago. Found him to be very accessivble and interested in his students. Some thought he was difficult and gave too much work, but I reallly learned a lot. Seek him out. He's worthwhile.
Five exams and a final.  Homework can get long.  Good lecturer, but boring subject.  He's available at any time...he even provides his home number!  Highly recommended:)
Easy if you try. He can be very monotone and boring but part is because the students don't show much interest in the material.

Hes not great. I would Not really recommend taking his class. He has three test, thats it. The study guides...yea, I had around 6 pages from the review. OH and you cant just know the def. of a word, he ask you how it applies. Sure, there is extra credit..I did the writing e.c, waste of my time..28 pages(did get w.c). The book, doesnt use in class a

He's not the boring one, the material is.  Besides that, he gives study guides.  They contain massives amount of info, however it's as bad as people say it is.  Three tests and some extra credit opportunites.

Alright. Gives out review sheets containing all info. needed for the tests but it contains massive amounts of information. He is very helpful during his office hours and will answer any questions. If you are interested in the class it is pretty good. Easiness - it does require a good amount of work for the tests, but nothing ridiculous.
Grading is unfair and teaching unclear....

GREAT teacher! Worth the wait since the class fills up quick. You have to study hard but he gives study guides that tell you exactly what to study. It is a long class! He explains all the material very effectively. I really recommend him...
easy a, cool ass man!

yay psychology

Great teacher! learned about 18th century fantasy. She really knows her stuff and her interest spills over into us. it is what it is. Required to take this class and I legit got a 50% on exam 1 after studying for weeks. He's not the best at explaining and the systems are out of date. I would recommend just learning every single detail and handout.
Test is hard, me no understand. no take

Mr Friedman is the best. Super kind, always lets you resubmit for full credit, super nice during office hours. Shows up with a smile on his face and will always help you. Tough class but it is very very manageable.

Professor Friedman is an old guy but he's alright. ACC 406 has a lot of project,s homework, quizzes it was so confusing to keep track of due dates, but he was pretty fair and if you turned some stuff in late he was accepting. Throughout the course, there was a noticeable absence of feedback on assignments.

Maybe the worst professor I have ever had. Please avoid taking his classes at all costs.

reviews.comment: Never took his actual class but I know him and still remember him from professional meetings at UM where he served as an accountant. He is extremely professional, reliable, and thorough at what he does. A rare gem. If I were an accounting student I would want to take him.
Really good professor!!!!

I don't know what people are talking about- this class is tedious but very easy and he's is a great teacher. Will be there to help you whenever and always willing to let you resubmit assignments to get better grades if you don't do well the first time. A ton of resources (vids, manuals, & class) are provided & he also lets you redo everything for a few points off. Ultimately he does his job and doesnt worry about pleasing you, just teaching you (as he should).

I am not judging this professor as a person, because I do feel he may be a kind human. However, as a professor, this is the worst I've ever had. No consideration for his students taking other course/having a life. Miss 2 seconds of lecture and you're 30 steps behind. Difficult assignments due daily. Tough grader. Avoid him for accelerated courses!

Professor Friedman is the worst Professor Ive ever taken. He assigns a ridiculous amount of assignments that take HOURS to do. Stay away from this horrible man!!

Friedman is a nice guy. He is pretty tough as a grader but for our class he allowed us to resubmit most of our assignments to be regraded. He will literally stop the whole class to help individual students which is cool. The in class tests are tough.
Terrible.

This is by far the worst accounting professor at UM!!! Avoid at all cost. He is extremely mean and condescending, If other professors  are trying to light up you, then friedman is definitely trying to shut the lights. He is full of BS. WORST PROFESSOR EVER

This is the worst accounting class I've ever taken. I am not learning anything. He does not teach and is purposely trying to fail people. Something has to be done about this. I am basically teaching myself, groping in the dark. There needs to be an audit of the class. I feel like I paid $5000 to torture myself.

Good Professor. Grade consists of quizzes, exams and projects. The quizzes are based off reading material and are very tedious (memorization). This guy is slightly self-righteous, but a decent teacher. You do all practical work in class, which is what you are tested on. But your WEEKLY quizes are on book material, which is all theory. To be frank, i have never had such an impossible teacher before. This guy should just retire.  His lectures (if you can call them lectures) are difficult to follow.  He is rude to students, and thinks we're all CPAs.  His project is useless. Great teacher. Not all exams are multiple choice, so one really needs to know the material well. If one understands the homeworks, handout problems and quizzes, you can do very well on exams. He is also very nice.

Excellent professor! He does examples in detail using the computer during class, which is very helpful. He is the best professor ever. So helpful and so friendly! He's great! His class is pretty straight forward and when you need help he'll give it to you.
Professor Fridman is awesome! She is very kind, and assigns a very manageable workload. I wish all my classes were similar to this.

very kind and easygoing the course material was very interesting and she kept us engaged. class is not the entire semester which feels perfect for the amount of content and the final assignments. only wish the final assignments had been organized better but were not to difficult and felt like a fair amount of work.
Great teacher, very flexible and helps a lot with office hours. Would definetly take if you want a fun but not too challenging class.

There's only one paper, 5 quizzes and a final exam in this class. I had her for three hours straight but I actually looked forward to her class and she somehow made every topic/lecture enjoyable. Very easy as long as you show up to class and participate. If you study for 20 minutes before a quiz you'll be fine. One of the best professors I've had!

Literally the sweetest southern older man who genuinely is passionate about teaching!!! Gives great feedback and lectures are super interesting (if you're an ENG major/minor). Must go to class, but is a pretty easy grader as well.

reviews.comment: The sweetest professor, genuinely such a sweet guy. I wish I could take more classes with him, only 2 essays throughout the semester but readings every class which we talk about. I enjoyed this class.

Really nice professor, not a hard class. The books we read are interesting and you just need to take a little time each week reading some sections. Overall really nice class, very discussion based but the environment is supportive so it's not a problem.

Take him! Very kind. awesome feedback on essays, makes class a breeze. The reading we do is actually really interesting, and participating in discussions is fun and non-judgemental. This class was my safe haven as a pre med

Professor Stringfellow is literally a teddy bear. I just want to give him a hug. He is so kind and extremely understanding. All we do is read books (usually two chapters are assigned for hw) and discuss them in class. There are two five pg papers and five one pg journal entries. The class is interesting and I learned a lot about the plays we read.

Dr. Stringfellow is an amazing professor. He is very passionate about the works we read and also extremely knowledgeable. He's accessible outside of class. The class is discussion based, and he expects people to participate. You should though, because he always considers everyone's point of view. Really recommend him. Super sweet prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: At first I was very bored by Stringfellow, but I later realized that he genuinely appreciates students' input and is willing to listen to what you have to say. He does not grade too difficultly, and appreciates effort. Even if you don't do the reading, you can still participate in the many discussions he conducts. I'd recommend him.

He is very  passionate about English and literature. Every class was the same, we read a lot for homework and discussed it in detail. It is hard to do well in the class without reading the readings or at least skimming it pretty well. The class was a lot of work and the books were very ancient, I thought it would be  recent writings relating to law

Professor Stringfellow is an amazing teacher. He genuinely wants you to learn the material he covers and he is always available and eager to help a student with a paper one on one. Great professor, genuinely interested and invested in the subject he teaches. Great at conducting discussion, wants you to do well, very straightforward grader. You do need to put some work in (there's a lot of reading), but most definitely worth. Highly recommended! :)

Provokes easy class discussion by making the class sit in a huge circle, which I loved. Very friendly, spreads warmth in his classroom, and is very passionate about literature. He is very kind, so do not be intimidated.
amazing teacher who truly understands how to facilitate a great class conversation.  He is a fair grader and is always willing to meet with students.

I dont recommend to take this class if you are not interested in English. I remember a lot of class discussions about material that I was not interested in which made it difficult for me. Great professor and class mediator. He gets everyone to participate in stimulating discussion. He is also very passionate about the literature he teaches. I recommend him!

Prof. Stringfellow is an AWESOME teacher...he is so easy to talk to and really goes out of his way to help you out with the papers...the class discussions were usually very interesting. One of my faves!

Condescending and awful as studio professor. Zero time management and zero help. Good for the lecture classes (you won't learn anything, though).

was my studio teacher. didnt help at all, the assistant professor was much better. always late, wastes time, has no sense of time management. several times he spent the whole 3 hour class time with one student.

Professor Funchion gives great feedback on essays and his lectures are easy to follow. He is very caring if you don't like participating in class and does his best to make sure everyone gets an equal chance to speak. His readings can be heavy and confusing but clarifies the material.

reviews.comment: Prof Funchion is so nice and caring! Participation matters, but there are extra credit opportunities to make up full points if you're shy. The structure of the class drags a bit, and for an Edgar Allan Poe class, there isn't much of Poe. Regardless, this class is easy to get an A in, and he's incredibly approachable!

Prof Funchion is very sweet and lovable, but sometimes the structure of the class is a little repetitive. Overall the material was very cool though and he incorporated a lot of fun classes. We got to play a mystery board game and watched episodes of some Netflix shows in class. The Egdar Allen Poe class is not a lot of Poe, however.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This is my second time taking Professor Funchion and he is the best English professor at UM. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I have ever had. Makes class so interesting by supplementing Poe with other authors and psychology. Wants his students to learn and do well, very knowledgable, and super caring. Participation matters, but gives bonus journal options for credit if you don't. The best ever, take him!!

Hands down one of the best professors at UM, and the Con artist class is fascinating! Funchion makes class engaging and interesting, and assigns fun readings and movies for homework. His class is all discussion-based. You only have to participate once a week to get full participation credit. Easy but also sooo much reading and the class is graded by only a few essays.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

Funchion's Con Artist class is so interesting. Second time taking this professor, and so glad I did. Starts with some technical material (with some films threaded in), then a series of great novels. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Funchion's Edgar Allan Poe class is amazing. Short stories, novels, and TV eps. Not easiest grader for papers. Really makes you think critically about each work and draws amazing parallels between Poe and modern literary works+entertainment. He's such an interesting guy; very knowledgable and passionate about what he teaches. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Funchion is such a nice guy and incredibly passionate about the subject, which carried into his lectures and made the topic significantly more interesting for me. Dr. Funchion was very helpful and approachable. His lectures were interesting and he presented innovative material in order to make the assignments more exciting. Very engaging and gives good feedback on papers.

Worth the tuition. Easily one of, if not, the best English professors in the department. Weaves in contemporary topics of TV shows, etc to contextualize. Incredibly smart -- amazing knowledge of history.

He is a wonderful professor and I greatly enjoyed taking his class. He is extremely clear and engaging and if you are open to learning, he will make your semester a very interesting and inspiring one. Be ready to take notes and enjoy - his lectures are wonderfully organized and intellectually stimulating.
He stimulates great class discussions. Everyone participates so be ready to talk, but the subject matter is so interesting that you won't mind.
Dr. F is really nice and knows his stuff!  He is approachable and helpful and I would take a class with him again.

He's an awful teacher, very boring, does not know what he wants in a paper and gives vague topics.  He tends to also run over class time.
He's an amazing teacher. The topic he taught was really interesting. He's new, young and actually wants to teach, so that makes him very engaging and into what we are discussing.

Awesome guy who is very passionate about finance. I found his class to be structured very well. There's practice problems for each chapter, you get a note sheet, and an exam outline. What more could you ask for?

reviews.comment: Love this professor! He is really knowledgeable about the topic and is really passionate about it. He keeps the information very current and teaches it in a really accessible way. Tests pretty much come from lectures so I would attend class but it's not mandatory.

Professor Fuerst has such a passion for the topic - his lectures and tests are so straight forward and you can tell he loves his job. I would 100% recommend him and would love to take his class again!

Taking him for FIN330. He lectures all class and he goes pretty quick. You really have to just hold on. But he is incredibly passionate and always uses interesting real world examples which made it much more engaging. Tests are open note and online (COVID). Smart guy. Not a great lecturer. Available after class to ask him questions. From the options available for fin303 he is the best compared with others. If you're looking for a finance elective, take Fuerst's 330 class. He's a great guy and very smart. I agree with other reviews that this class is lecture heavy and a bit boring, but let's be honest- how exciting can finance really be? Fuerst makes it as good as it can be. Hard material, but he's always willing to help. He takes attendance.

Professor Fuerst is a really smart professor! However, his teaching style is not good at all. He has heavy lectures that are super boring. There is so much information and he is not clear what will be on the exams. It is just a lot and overwhelming. Overall, there were 3 exams in this course and attendance is mandatory! Do not take him!
If you go to class and put effort in you will do fine. He wants people to do well. It is a lecture heavy course but is less boring than other finance courses I have taken in the past.

SUPER SMART GUY who cares about his students and gives interesting and useful real world examples to help you understand the course material. attendance is not mandatory and the tests are EXACTLY what he tells you to study. cannot recommend this guy enough for finance. with a LITTLE effort and a decent amount of attendance you'll get an A.
Attendance not mandatory. Lectures are him reading the slides. Read the slides and do the HW before each test and you will be fine. Mediocre class.
don't need to go to class - tests were take home

Great guy! The classes are a little boring but definitely worth going because he does homework problems during the class that will be on the test (just worded a little differently). LONG LECTURES... AND VERY BORING! GOOD PROFESSOR BUT EXAMS ARE NOT WHAT YOU EXPECT! TOO MUCH COMBINATION BETWEEN PROBLEMS AND MULTIPLE CHOICE.

Great teacher - take this class if you want to have a fin choice that is interesting!  He is really good at teaching too - he will do all the problems in class to make sure you get them.  Read through all the notes and you are in good standing!

As you can tell, if you are not really a serious student and you barely got a B in 302 this is not the class for you.  If you can handle an actual workload and are sane then you will love this class.  A little bit of work, but tests are VERY straightforward. If its not in the notes, its not on the test.  He is a good guy too - take this!
DO NOT TAKE IT! This class is insanely hard and he is not clear at all. He just reads the slides and expects you to know everything, you will have to work you ass off to get a decent grade.
Great Professor! If you do the homework problems, and read the book, you should be fine. He really prepares you for the midterms and finals. Exams are relatively easy, in case you study well.

SOOOOO BORING! He literally just lectures off of hundreds of slides, and nobody pays attention. Its like he talks to himself the whole time. Not the easiest class either but if you read through the hundreds of slides and do the problems you should be fine.
Reads off PPT all class. Have to study literally hundreds of slides beforehand, and tests are impossible. Unreasonable teacher do not take
He just reads off the powerpoints. You can get an A by studying the problems and reading through the powerpoints the day before the exams.
A very boring class and professor. I never went to class, studied the powerpoints and HW problems and was able to get an A. Don't take if you don't have to

All he does is read slides! very borring class! Exams are supper hard, but he curves alot!

Great professor, the best in the finance department. Took with him Fin 303 and 330. Exams are fair based on the notes. Cool Professor
the final exam is so ridiculous hard.  the worst teacher i ever had!!!!DO NOT TAKE HIM,OR U WILL REGRET IT

Very good professor

reviews.comment: AVOID IF YOU WANT TO LEARN ANYTHING. He does not provide any insight in the cases you look at in class. He speaks in generalities that a 5 year old could come up with. No professor gives homework and he requires 3 hours of reading a week. All you do in class is get quizzed on the reading homework by calling students out randomly.

Take literally anybody else for MGT401. Assigns about 3 hours of homework per week when other profs assign none. Will cold call you in class and be upset if you don't share his opinion. His accent is very thick and you can't tell what he's saying when he paces, and he literally says in his syllabus that he refuses to repeat questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I have had in 3 years at UM. Being an international biz course, the class is very diverse/international (including myself).  Ganitsky has great and relevant experience. Not a hard course to get an A in, just do the readings and participate, which is easy since he is very approachable the course is very interesting.

Too cute of a professor. He is very kind and really cares about his students. His class is attendance mandatory and participation is always encouraged for class discussions. He really gives you the opportunity to work with a company and meet with a representative to create a plan to to optimize it. Very valuable class for me.

This class is really boring. You read a case for every class and then just talk about it during class. I wanted to learn something but didn't really learn anything, as all I did was read. Two of these case discussions are written and graded. One group project that's super long. Participation matters a lot. Take a different class if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Case study lazy teaching. No real application of his lessons. No teaching or discussion of concepts and applications in the real world.  After years in the business world in a very senior position, I still remember how I disliked this professor, his style and how it was a waste of my tuition. I dropped his course until another professor taught it.

He is my favorite professor! This is a discussion-based class, therefore it is why he calls on students to participate. As long as you read the textbook cases before the class, you will be fine. He is so sweet, understanding, and respected. He cares about all his students, and will help in any way he can.

If you like learning about business operations this is an interesting class. Also, Professor Ganitsky is really nice and will go out of his way to help his students do well. Tips: Say 1-2 things every class, show up 1x to office hours, and manage your time well. Don't procrastinate and make sure to be thorough for the final project.
There is nothing to take away from this course. 2 hour lectures of cases that have no real implications.

reviews.comment: Worst professor I had at all of UM. avoid at all costs. This guy is the reason colleges are failing. Tenured and extremely biased. One of the worst experiences I've had in years.

This class doesn't have exams, however you have to read a case before EVERY class. He calls on random students to participate so you have to be prepared in case he asks you something. There is 2 writing assignments but beware because he is a tough grader. One project at the end of the semester. And participation counts towards your grade!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Ganitsky needs to change his teaching style immediately. He spends the entire class period calling out specific students and makes them feel extremely uncomfortable if they don't have the same opinion as him or the same answer. Do not take his class if you don't appreciate being roasted the whole class period.

The class is mostly open discussion and barely lecture based at all. You will be forced to participate and you will have to read a lot. Take this class if you want to leave having actually learned something. Appreciate his efforts and make an effort yourself and you will do well.

reviews.comment: Professor Ganitsky was wonderful.  Very informative and encouraging. Excellent Guest Speakers.  Criticism was always constructive and explained thoroughly.  Great class!
Great professor.

There are cases to read for every class, even when he has guests speakers. So be prepared He will NEVER let you leave class early. He calls on people randomly regarding cases assigned and talks until the end of class and usually over 15 minutes over time. He deducts points if he catches you on your cell phone or laptop.

Nice guy, approachable, means well. But this class is incredibly boring. My biggest qualm with his class is that he tries to make it interactive, but he makes you feel stupid if you don't say exactly what was in his mind.. its as if he goes around the room for an hour trying to ask students to be mind-readers.. In 4 years, never been so frustrated

Excellent professor that actually cares deeply about students. Anyone that actually wants to have a decent, mind challenging education should take his classes. His personal stories of Columbia teaches you many core values in not just Business, but in life. I would recommend this professor to anyone truly interested in business. Sharp.
This guy is great! He cares about his students, Just Read the weekly cases and one end of the semester project

My favorite professor throughout my entire college years, I have taken two courses with him. He has clear PowerPoint presentations, explicit assignment requirements, and fair grading criteria. He is very dedicated, responding to emails and revising papers very quickly. He is approachable and would talk to me about travel and food in emails.

He was a very good professor. If you love traveling, this is a class you will really enjoy and he will share a lot of his own travel experiences in class, which is fun. There are no exams in this class, and there are a total of 4 writing assignments for the semester, most of which you can write about your own travel experiences.

Martin is his first name but he goes by his middle name Bruce, you can find many reviews under Bruce Garrison. Prof. Garrison is so nice. As a student you will write an assignment every week, which can range from 300-750 words. Easy class to pass as he allows for revisions of each assignment. Boring lectures though. Take him for the easy class.

The LeBron James of UM's Spanish department. Seriously though, he is an amazing professor and genuinely cares about his students and wants the best for everyone. You will learn while also having a ton of fun with the fellow students. And no need to worry about your grade, trust.

Genuinely one of the nicest people I've ever met. He does a great job at teaching as well as making you feel like he cares about you. Super easy and nice grader, its hard to do bad with him. I couldn't recommend him enough, super funny, engaging, nice, and actually good teacher. I wish I could take him again, pls take!!!

this man is an absolute GOAT. He is defenitely the best professor in Spanish department. Tests and projects are super easy. This is a really easily class, but you actually end up learning a lot which is really nice. He cares a lot about his students and wants everybody to do well. TAKE HIM!
I love love loveddd Gancedo so much you can submit the work super late and still get full credit plus he's so nice my class wasn't real
Lots of group projects and chances to raise grades. Pretty easy grader.

She's not that bad, don't freak out if you have to take. Homework is annoying but manageable. Exams are tricky, vague instructions, will NOT answer ANY questions during exams. However, she does give practice exams which are similar to actual exams. Gives recording of classes on canvas. Just do the work and you'll be fine. Final is a group project.
AVOID THIS CLASS. ROLLS HER EYES WHEN YOU ASK QUESTIONS. IS SUPER ANTI MAC WHEN U ASK HER A QUESTION AND YOU HAVE A MAC SHE WONT HELP YOU. FOR UR SAKE AVOID HER
Rate my professor doesn't even let me write what I want too avoid her pls I beg you

Avoid this class if possible. The professor moves extremely fast, doesn't explain concepts clearly, and it feels uncomfortable to ask questions because the responses aren't helpful. Loved this class and Prof. Perez! She taught the material at a great pace. I would recommend watching the video lectures before class so that you're just reviewing material in class. Do the homework and practice in order to succeed!!
If you take this class you are cooked. Good luck
Moves way to quickly to understand and is always mad about something. Not bad at teaching though if you can keep up with the speed. Really just depends on her mood that day.

She's pretty hard to understand but honestly the work isn't that hard. If you study for the exams and practice a lot to understand the directions then you're going to do fine. The project at the end is basically a grad boost and there's no final.

She is a great professor and an even cooler person with a lot of life experience.  She goes through modules very quickly during some classes, and it can be hard to keep up.  However, everything you need to do/know is posted in Canvas, and it is not hard to get an A as long as you review the material.  She is very caring and accessible for help.

Professor Gery Perez is passionate and knowledgable. Going into the class with a prior knowledge of Excel definitely gave me a leg up and made her like me more as well. Make sure to show up and pay attention, if you do, she will take care of you during hard times.

Pretty good professor. Sometimes she can come off strongly, which some people may not like. But if you read and follow the directions, you'll be fine. Also, GO TO HER OFFICE HOURS; she's very helpful and kind there. Don't do things last-minute in this class, and pay attention in lectures. Also, watch (or do) the modules ahead of class, so helpful!

reviews.comment: Very easy class with many opportunities to raise the grade. Not a lot of reading and only three big assignments.
Professor Gautam is really nice, tries to make the class at least a bit fun even tho its writing and its just boring. If you do everything he tells you to do, you will get and A its chill class

reviews.comment: There is a very solid amount of writing and reading you're gonna do. It's totally manageable and not too much at all, he's a sweet guy but sometimes with his accent he can be a little hard to understand. Most of his classes could've just been an email though... takes attendance

It's kinda hard to understand him and what the assignments are because of his accent. Literally my favorite professor. This class is so easy and he will give you unlimited amounts of revisions. He cares so much about his students and if you have a bad grade, he will go out of his way to make easy assignments to boost your grade. As long as you show you care, he will give you a good grade.

He is really really really nice. love him would take him again but...
his accent is a little strong but dont worry about him
tons of papers i feel like
and his feedback is shallow like you dont know what to fix really

Okay, he really does have a strong accent but it does'nt really matter, I can say I understood half the things he said in class but all his instructions were on google drive. Professor Gautam is the nicest, most caring, and helpful professor I've ever had. I absolutely love his class! I've taken him for two semesters and have always had a positive experience. I'm not the strongest writer, but with his guidance, I did really well. As long as you go to class, do the homework, and do the essays, you'll be fine.

He is an okay teacher, pretty funny and very passionate. Kind of a weird grader and definetly didn't learn anything but not a bad class. Group quizzes 4 major essays + peer review+ revision. no final which is also nice, he can be a bit boring at times but honestly not his fault its just a boring class by default

reviews.comment: He is such a good teacher. Attendance is mandatory but If you are there and do the work you will get an A. There are 4 Major Assignments which are mainly your grade it is the average of your peer review and final draft, but honestly it just helps your grade. He is very funny and nice. I would definitely take again

the goat. idk why he has any bad ratings. he is the funniest little guy I have ever met and he basically only grades you on the guidelines and format of your paper (not the actual content). just show up for class and you'll be chill
Literally my favorite professor. He is so passionate about what he talks about and genuinely cares about his students. I'm taking him again this semester!!! Love Professor Gautam.

Professor Gautam really cares about his students. He is always there to help students and will always be available for questions. If you show up to class, put in effort and ask questions you will do great. You can tell he is very passionate about what he teaches. I loved his class so much. I recommend taking his class!

He can be hard to understand but his class is not hard at all. He is nice and funny and if you understand writing the essays are pretty easy and he is not a hard grader. There are 4 major assignments which he lets you revise and then some short assignments, group quizzes, and mini presentations. I was worried bc of the reviews but he is the BEST.
Very caring professor. Class is mainly essays with a very clear grading criteria. Best professor at UM!!
Super nice and caring! His class was fun to go to. He means well and cares about his students. Definitely take him!!

He is not the most harsh grader but on the more difficult side, provides an absurd amount of busy work, personally I would try to find a better professor because you cannot really understand him either

reviews.comment: DON'T BELIEVE THE NEGATIVE REVIEWS! If you understand writing, then you will find his class VERY easy and laid back. reviews.comment: Although his accent makes it difficult to understand him, his class is not hard at all. There are in class quizzes which he lets you take as a group. Take Devi!

OBSESSED with MLA format and if one thing is our of place he will lower your grade. This was supposed to be an easy stress-free class and it was not.

He is an easy grader just make sure you have the papers done with correct MLA guidelines. The quizzes are all group quizzes.

While he offers valuable feedback, it's tailored to his unique preferences. He's nice and funny, but his accent is very strong. Good luck if you need to take him, many better options

Allows revisions on most big assignments, but comments are so frustrating and often illegible. Expect to print a lot.

Gautaum is an interesting guy to say the least. If you listen to his instructions you should easily get the A, he is very nit-picky with certain things. 4 essays and several smaller assignments. Not as bad as everyone is saying to be honest. Lowkey funny.

Professor Gautam offers a lot of resources to make your paper good. Strictly follow his guidelines and nothing else and you will get a good grade. He is accessible outside of class and he answers emails pretty quickly. I wouldn't say this class makes you a better writer at all. Just do what he says to get a good grade.

Good professor. Can be confusing when giving instructions for assignments/papers but very willing to work and help his students. If you go to class and make the suggested changes to your papers, he will give you a good grade.
This guy is hilarious, and he roast the students. Show up and make changes off of his suggestions gets you a easy A

Devi is jolly man and an awesome professor. At times it is hard to understand him due to his accent but he is still a very caring professor. His assignments are very straight forward. Follow his checklist and show up to class and you will do well take him.

Take his class!! Anyone that gave a bad review was just looking for an easy A class where they did not have to attend class. Let's be real: we are in college now. Professor Gautam is the best professor I have had at UM. I've learned so much about writing. He makes class very fun because he is so engaged and loves what he does. Best teacher.

excellent guide, purely understanding
