Fast paced class so keep up, if you miss something, she has a video for you prior to the beginning of class.

Basically only two professors for this class and from what I have heard she is the better option. If you have a basic/intermediate understanding of excel this class is a piece of cake if not GO TO EVERY CLASS and practice as weird as it sounds. Shes fast but posts video that explain better which help. For exams just do the practice over and over.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: makes you feel stupid for asking questions in class, refuses to slow down

This professor is mean and dismissive, refusing to slow down during lectures even when students struggle to keep up. Asking questions often leads to condescending responses that make you feel stupid for seeking help. The lack of patience and support makes the class unnecessarily stressful.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor is not a nice person and often comes across as snappy and impatient. She seems to grade Spanish-speaking students much easier, which feels unfair to others. Her favoritism creates an uncomfortable and biased learning environment. Would not recommend her class.

This professor was inconsiderate and made non-Spanish-speaking students feel unwelcome. She seemed to favor Spanish-speaking students, often engaging with them more and showing little patience with others. If you don't speak Spanish, expect limited support and an uncomfortable classroom experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The professor was often rude and dismissive, creating an unwelcoming environment. Favoritism was clear, as Latina female students received more praise and attention, while others felt overlooked. This lack of fairness hindered the learning experience. I recommend seeking a more impartial instructor.

She goes very fast and gets impatient but she's actually super funny and a great professor. If you skip a class you'll probably fall way behind because she rarely ever has any sympathy but she's a fair grader and very helpful if you put in effort.

Professor Perez truly cares about her students. I had never used Excel before this course and ended up learning so much. She posts modules that I recommend watching before class This makes it much easier to follow along during class without feeling overwhelmed. The practice exams are not the exact exams but do use all the functions you need to know
awful professor with 0 integrity and professionalism

If you have never used Excel before you really need to pay attention from the jump or you will get lost. She's tough but honestly wants kids to succeed. Go to office hours for help on HW. There are a lot of resources make sure you use them bc Excel isn't hard it just requires practice. No final just group project which was easy

Professor Perez is very direct and does not play around in class but she is very understanding. She gives many examples in class to help understand the different concepts. If you use the study guides provided in class you should be more than prepared for the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: BUS150 is a class that moves at a fast pace, but is easy to understand if you pay attention and don't skip classes. Perez is a great teacher and explains the material very well. She's fair, but also doesn't put up with people being distractions or not putting in effort. Put in the effort and you'll do well. She's 100% the best teacher for BUS150.

You either love her or you hate her. Entire class is her sharing her screen teaching you excel. She goes quick, and if you ask her to do something again, she's lowkey rude or will make an example out of you. However, she's pretty clear about what you have to do and tests aren't too difficult if you study. Easy class if you are decent w/ computers.

She's snarky and rude, but that's lowkey part of her charm. A lot of the reviews say she's mean, but honestly I would be too if I had to answer all the stupid questions she gets asked per class. She'll do all the assignments with you in class and people just don't pay attention and get lost, yet she explains anyways. She's fine. Sassy but fine.

Maybe because my class was online, but this was my worst class so far. I know Excel. Somehow I consistently got high B's on the exams. She's rude in class. Hard grader. If you need help with something I was often left more confused. Take any other BUS150 class. As a JUNIOR this was my hardest class.

Idk why she has such a high rating. Took BUS150 online, and she was quite rude. If you know Excel its not terrible, but I know Excel and I got a B on the first exam. The instructions were terrible. I would not recommend. Especially do not take online.

Professor Perez makes everyone in her class to really understand and grasp Excel and Tableau. She re-explain topics if needed, and the class flows in an easy to understand manner. The final project with Tableau can be challenging, but she is always ready to give you recommendations if needed.

Perez is a great professor, she has a strong attitude in class bc she wants you to learn but she is really nice and cares for her students. Tests are not hard if you study for them with the material she gives you. 2 tests and a final project. If you don't go to class you won't do well in her class. Would definitely take her again!
Difficult class but great prof. She cares a lot about her students and you will do well in the class if you attend, put in the effort, and go to her office hours if you need help. Learned a ton.

Perez has easily been my favorite professor this semester. She gets a bad rep because the class itself is hard, not because she is a bad professor. She moves pretty quickly but if you put in the effort the class is very manageable. If you go to office hours you will see how nice she actually is. Easily best professor for Bus 150.
If you pay attention in class you will do fine. She has a lot of extra practice to help you with the exams. She is very knowledgeable and willing to help if you ask her. Definitely recommend!!

She talks way to fast, and that is really the only way to learn the information. The online modules are a little easier to follow, but you can't ask for clarification from a video. She also is very judgy and spazzes out regularly.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She comes off as scary and rude but if you put any effort into the class and talk to her shes so nice and willing ti help you with anything. Warning: Asking dumb questions and she'll make fun of you in a very nice way.

1 semester isn't enough for the amount of material you learn. Prof Perez is very capable and smart. She teaches very fast but you need to grow a pair and stop her by asking questions. She can be mean and belittle you but everyone in class will thank you for asking questions. Highly suggest going to tutoring to understand the language of questions

To the whole class she is rude and cold, especially at first. If you talk to her 1 on 1, she is super nice and always willing to help. I didn't find her or the class really difficult, she always gave good study guides and made grading criteria clear. Probably the best prof for BUS150

Pretty difficult class and very fast-paced. She's very knowledgeable but her exams are very confusing and not like the review. However, I've actually learned quite a bit so that's a plus. One of the harder pre-reqs but definitely the best option for BUS150.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class was good as you learned a lot. She would just grade mainly on two exams (30% each) and a final group project (20%). Make sure you do well on the first exam as if you do not take it seriously then it will come back to bite your final grade at the end of the semester. Super helpful if you bring questions to her office hours!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Avoid taking this class at all costs if you want to learn.

She was rude to students the first few weeks, but she warmed up as the semester progressed. She can get sassy for no reason. She can come of as intimidating at first, but you learn it's because she cares about you learning the material. She is extremely passionate about the course. Easy class if you put in the work. She's prob the best option.

One of the best professors at UM. Not gonna lie, she goes pretty quick during lectures and gets annoyed when someone asks a stupid question. If you are having trouble or are a little confused, GO TO HER OFFICE HOURS. She is very helpful when it's one on one. Exams are easy and straightforward. First group project very easy, second kinda confusing.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Don't recommend her at all.

She is often very blunt and can come off as rude, but she warms up to students as they get to know her. She has very little patience sometimes but her tests are generally easy. All her lectures are recorded but you should go to class for attendance points. Overall a good teacher.
She gets upset when you ask her questions and moves quickly through the content. The tests cover a huge amount of the content but you can figure most of it out if you keep trying.
If you ask a question, she gets mad. However, if you talk to her alone she's nice. Tests are hard.

Prof Perez is nice but she goes way too fast. During Lectures if you fall behind just 1 step then you're stuck. She doesn't stop and if you ask others for help you'll fall even more behind. Exams are nothing like the practice exams she gives out. Also do not miss class. She does quickly and also does role call so you can't have friend give the code
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is very intimidating, but she really wants her students to learn. It's a hard class, but I recommend watching the prerecorded lectures before class. It makes her class so much easier if you already have an idea of what is going on, and she likes to ask pop questions in the middle of class. If you are lost and 4 steps behind she'll get irritated

She can be a little intimidating, but nonetheless, shes an excellent professor. Shes super organized and explains things clearly. She wants everyone to succeed and towards the end of the semester she curved everyones grade because she noticed how hard her students worked! Just put in the effort. She offers a lot of help outside of class too.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: If you don't show up to class, you won't pass. That being said, the class may come off as a lot but if you just pay attention to the lectures and do the practices she uploads before exams, you'll be fine. She is also very nice when you talk to her and ask questions. The final project is confusing so ask for help if you need it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Perez may seem tough in how she teaches but it's really just to push you. Make sure to pay attention during lecture because you don't want to ask a questions about something she already said. She also records lectures and separate videos from class that you can review for exams.

Class is pretty easy until you get to Module 8, then you have to pay attention in order to pass the class. Final project isn't explained very well but if you ask her she will help you out for everything you need.

She is a very smart and helpful professor. She lectures a lot and her tests are MC based off her lectures. They can be very challenging. She requires participation and attendance so as long as you show up and pay attention, the class should be fine.

Overall this class really isnt that hard and theres not much you have to do in general. In my opinion though this class could be a YouTube tutorial video... Do not take this Professor though! She is very rude and sighs whenever students ask simple/important questions . Also, she works very fast and is quite disorganized. I wouldnt recommend her

She is sometimes rude to her students but at the same time she cares about them. She records everything and posts them. There are two projects that you must present to the class but are quite easy. Take her but if you find someone with a better rating take them. But all in all shes a pretty good professor

Professor Perez is more likely than any teacher to take her time with you to help you succeed. This course does require you to pay attention and participate, but the overall knowledge you learn is useful in the workplace. What professor perez taught me is what I used at my interview to get hired.

Perez isn't always in a great mood and can get easily frustrated with the class. However, she can also be very funny and helpful if you put the time in. If you study a lot for the tests you can do very well and she will help you during her office hours.

She is a very hard, strict, and good professor. You actually learn a lot in her class. Do not miss a single class otherwise you'll fail. Exams are hard. The presentations are fun. Super interesting class for everyone. Take her only if you are serious about it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She became our professor mid-semester. She taught insanely fast even though learning online made it harder to keep up. I asked her to repeat something one day and she audibly groaned gave me lip in her condescending tone in response. The final exam was IMPOSSIBLE to complete in the given time. Ridiculous.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: AVOID AT ALL COTS!!!!!!! Actually think she could be one of the rudest professors EVER!!! she gave us the most unfair final ever and when students voiced concerns about the final not being fair she responded with well why are you talking to me when you could be taking the test. Awful Professor.

Prof. Perez is a great professor. Make sure to study the power points because that's where the test comes from. There's a group project at the end of the semester, it's a lot of work so just make sure to start early and don't procrastinate.
If you're not a techie, you probably wouldn't do as well as people that enjoy computers and such. If you study enough and do well on the final project you should be fine.

I took professor perez for BUS150 & loved her so took her again for BTE210. Honestly probably my favorite teacher at the school. Shes always available to meet outside of class & genuinely wants her to students to do well & learn. She tries to make lectures entertaining even if the topic can be dry. Very kind & knows both of these subjects v well.

This is my second class I'm taking with Prof. Perez. Previously I had taken BUS150 and jumped at the chance to enroll in BTE210 when I saw that she was teaching. She teaches in a manner that is both thought provoking and easy to follow. She also applies theory to a real world which helped me greatly with my job interview. I highly recommend her.

She is a really nice professor. The material in general is hard so you do have to put a lot of work into the course. She is willing to meet outside of class times. If you have questions on tests, she will meet with you and go through each question you got wrong.

One of my favorite professors, Professor Perez has more enthusiasm about teaching than just about any other professor which goes a long way. A large portion of your grade comes from an end of year project but it's not bad if you work hard in class and are productive when you meet outside of class

She's all over the place. Flies through the material and then gives you a project on Tableau, a completely new software that no one knows how to use. There was one test where the instructions were so difficult that not a single person in the class was able to finish an exam, and then she didn't even curve it. Save yourself
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: good prof, I got an A from dis class.

take it from me, prof sanchez will reveal writing abilities in you u had no idea were there! lots of difficult theoretical/cultural reading + comprehension homework, but it all helps tremendously for the cumulative final essay. IMMENSELY detailed feedback!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: amazing professor! love her class. what she teaches is really valuable and you'll learn a lot in her course. participation matters and you'll have to write essays but the work is very manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Respected

reviews.comment: My favorite professor ever. She makes class fun and interactive. Participation matters, and there's a lot of reading, but it's worth it. She is incredibly welcoming, knowledgeable, and caring. She also makes sure to incorporate gender neutral pronouns into her Spanish, which is amazing. There is no other professor like her in the entire school!!
Professor Gema is the best Spanish professor at UM. I would take her for any class. She's amazing. A lot of homework but you'll do fine. Definitely recommended, she's amazeballs.

She is THE BEST spanish teacher at UM (along with Omar). She gives a lot of essays that are a huge part of your grade (like 4-5 per semester) but gives SO much time to do them, and then a chance to fix it with a lot of feedback. Tests are easy and she makes it VERY clear what is going to be on them. Attendance counts, need the book.

Gema is amazing! I took her for both 212 and 310. She really cares about her students and you learn so much in her classes. Best professor I've had at UM. Don't take a class with her if you aren't willing to put in the work. 212 is a time consuming class. 310 was honestly life-changing. Can't wait for the opportunity to take another class with her!
Awesome professor! Waiting to take a class again with her!
One of the best professores I have ever had.  Take her for sure!
Great teacher,if you ever take a Spanish literature class at UM, take her.
Awesome professor! For sure take her!
No Comments
Class is a free A

Good introduction to philosophy. He was sometimes a little bit confusing or not the most organized; however, he was always open to any ideas or thoughts that students had. The readings were always short or simplified versions of the real nice thing. Lots of little group work, I didn't participate much in the class, but still did fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Really long lectures, super confusing material, and you have to partcipate in the discussions. However, if you are looking for an easy A 100% take this class. There is only one homework assignment a week- typically takes me about an hour. There is no quizzes or tests. Just show up to class and do you're homework and you will get a good grade.

very extensive writing assignments, very engaging professor who prioritzes conversaiton + participation, and while I liked his positive nature, the calss is organized pretty poorly for an introductory course (these hefty topics could be more simplified)

This professor is very assumptive that you understand what he means even when what he is saying makes no sense to anyone but him. Definitely much more work than expected when doing an entry level class for a Cognate. Every assignment is subjective in itself and grades are not consistent based on the work you do.

He was one of my first professors at the university and I thought he was amazing. Very clear and helpful if you just pay attention. class content can be difficult but if u ask questions he'll clear it up for you. interactive and not difficult tests or grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Not a hard class but really boring. Class participation is a part of the grade so you have to talk. Wittow is a confusing professor - he would ask a question and explain how there are no wrong answers but then wait for the answer he wanted. He is just kinda in his own world.

322 is a class where the majority of learning is done through assignments & projects. lectures are geoff reading his notes and reviewing code. he puts exam style questions at the bottom of his notes which are what he uses on his exams. if you complete the labtasks without brainlessly dumping them into gpt, the midterm (no final) ends up being easy
For me personally I found this class very boring. Geoff would stay seated in lecture the whole time and read off of a long page of notes. He's a nice guy but I found the class hard to get through.

I really liked taking Geoff for this course, a lot of his lectures were just listening to what he was saying and looking at his screen without a lot of interactivity, but you did learn by being there. Grading is based on projects and midterms but no final. The midterms were tricky but the professor gave some extra credit to make up for it.
I would take again, lectures are not mandatory, they are recorded. If you do the zybook and understand them, you'll be fine.
Good professor. Not too hard just ask the TA's if you need help. Lectures are funny. I would take it again.

Grade is mostly 2 projects and 2 exams. Exams are open everything (including chatGPT) Weekly labs are useful for practicing content learned the week prior. Amazing lectures that explain complicated CS topics easily & visually. Super accesible outside of class & responds to emails quickly. Geoff wants you to learn. Very doable if you put in effort.

Dr. Sutcliffe was a very easy professor for CSC 120. Grading was simple and lots of chances to make up points and do well. The class consisted of weekly labs, two projects, a midterm, and a final. The midterm and final are open note (you can use google), lab tasks and projects were simple enough and you had lots of time and help for them.

Geoff's THE GUY. He's goofy and always cheers up the class. He teaches UNIX and C well and you can always go up to him for help. Weekly lab HW, 2 open book midterms on BB and 2 projects. He covers a lot of topic so each lecture can be quite dense and he might go too fast at times. Take him if you really want to learn and enjoy lectures.
he does not wear shoes

Geoff is the GOAT, hands down best CS professor at this school. He's hilarious and really wants students to succeed. Android programming is a bit tricky at first but if you keep up in class and do assignments regularly you're guaranteed to get a 100 in the class. About 20 mini-apps total (given weekly), and three projects. 10/10 would retake.

Hands down the best professor CS department has to offer. He is as good as a professor can get. Always jovial who is very accessible outside class too. The contents get difficult in the last two months so you always have to keep up with it so beware. Didn't have any prior programming experience so had to work super hard. Projects and exams tricky.

Overall a great professor, He is very nice and I would take him again. He is always cracking dad jokes and puts care into his students. He loves computer science and will explain everything perfectly and thoroughly..

Overall a great professor, He is very nice and I would take him again. He is always cracking dad jokes and puts care into his students. He loves computer science and will explain everything perfectly and thoroughly.

Geoff is the goat! Couldn't recommend him enough. He made programming fun, engaging, and relatively easy. Prior to this class I had no knowledge of programming whatsoever, but Geoff made the topic fun and interesting to learn. This class even encouraged me to switch my major to comp sci. Take him if you can!

Really funny professor. He doesn't care if you show up. He is just there to have fun. He teaches well and you will succeed if you pay attention in class. I think anyone above an 85 receives an A. He also curves tests.

CSC 120 is a difficult class, however he makes it really interesting and fun. He gives all the notes, and the exams are open book. As a professor he is absolutely amazing. However it does feel like the projects sometimes are necessarily difficult, but the lab assistants are easy graders. He will make learning computer science fun

Fantastic professor - although cs can traditionally be a dull subject he keeps it light, funny and interesting. Notes and pptx are all uploaded to his site for easy reference. Zybook, the interactive textbook is great for the first 2/3 of class. Don't procrastinate the projects! Exams are extremely difficult but luckily not woth much.

Geoff is a legend. The class is challenging, but do all the homework and you will be fine. He uses Zybook, which is an online interactive textbook that shows you all of your assignments ahead of time. Lectures are long but Geoff makes them interesting by giving away CDs and ditching his shoes. Labs are easy. He grades fairly, but no extra credit.

Professor Sutcliffe's lectures were very enjoyable and necessary for passing the class. I've had some experience with other programming languages, so I thought this class would be easy - but unfortunately it was not. The first few weeks go by very slowly, but after he covers the basics, the material gets very hard so pay attention!!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Knew some programming already, even so this class was extremely difficult. Labs were interesting but exams were no joke. Some advice: Dont skip class, sit near the front, and focus. Take pictures of his drawings. Study hard and be ready to memorize tons of concepts. Teacher is funny/goofy but dont be fooled, he is TOUGH!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: He's a great professor, but it's a hard class. I came into the class knowing nothing about coding and it quickly became one of the hardest classes I've ever taken. The tests were very difficult; I failed the midterm and the final but managed to secure a C+ through labs and projects. There are hundreds of students so it's hard to get one on one time

I took this class wanting to develop my coding skills and learn more about coding in general. It was the worst mistake I've made. The class is filled with hundreds of students and is not intimate at all. I did my work but ended up doing poorly in the class due to his extremely harsh grading where basically half the class failed the final.

AMAZING TEACHER! Teaches to students who don't have a coding background and is great at giving another view of programming to people who do. Hilarious and walks around with no shoes, made me feel enjoy the class way more. Would totally recommend all the time.
His lab tasks are interesting and with a lot of background story! Make you feel you are solving a real problem by programming!

This class is so valuable if you are ever going to be doing any programming in the future. Yes, Geoff's class can be difficult, but if you do the work, you will learn. Computer logic isn't easy but I feel like I can use any language after this. He is a super fair grader and the labs can be fun

Geoff is one of the best professors I've had at UM! He is very funny and explains the materials very well! He is always available to talk and help you out! I found the class very challenging and the material was hard at times but taking good notes, completing all the lab tasks and doing the exam style questions were very helpful.
Geoff is #1

Yes the course material can be confusing, but that's because it's computer programming, and even CS majors find it difficult at first. It can take a while to understand some of the material, but Dr. Sutcliffe is the clearest (and funniest) professor I've had at UM. We were well prepared by test time, & he adjusts scores by reducing the denominator.

Dr Sutcliffe's class may seem easy because of his easygoing personality, but be no fool, his lectures are very hard to understand! Some of the teacher assistants have no patience. They react to your questions as if you are dumb, creating a tense environment not proper for learning. Go to the teacher directly, he explains the material crystal clear.

Very engaging lecturer, makes lots of jokes and has a hilarious Australian accent. Part of the class is terribly confusing, he tries to explain object oriented programming through visual diagrams, then makes you draw out the diagrams on the tests. Final did not seem difficult but was graded harshly.

Geoff is very passionate about programming and teaching. He takes a boring lecture class and keeps it entertaining/interesting with his sense of humor and creativity. Take this class if you want to learn object oriented programming.

Really cool guy, walks around class with no shoes on. Projects are hard but fun. Sometimes things are unclear with such a big lecture group. Pretty understanding(like givig us another week to submit a project) and generous with his grading system.

My favorite teacher in UM.I took his intro to programming class, C and Unix class and also Android Development class. This guy is a legend. He can make super boring and anal subjects of CS funny and interesting. He knows the subjects in and out. His classes aren't easy but he is very clear on what he expects from every project/homework. P

Amazing class! I had some interest in computer programming before this class, but after having Geoff for my intro to programming, I ended up minoring in CS. This wouldn't have happened without the great (and fun) foundation Geoff gives!

Geoff was my favorite teacher while I was at UM. Makes learning JAVA interesting and is able to clarify any problems that you may have. Aussie who walks around with no shoes on and cracks jokes the entire class, he is the man.

Geoffe is an amazing teacher.  I had no computer science background and he made the material really easy to learn.  Actually, I was placed in a different section but decided to attend his class.  It was the best decision I have ever made.  If you do the lab tasks, pay attention, and ask questions if you need help you will get an A.
He's very funny and a good teacher. He explains tough concepts in a way that you can understand. The class is still lots of work, and the material is complex... I'm just warning you ahead of time.

Geoff is a gifted instructor. Funny as heck, explains the material at students' level (which is amazing considering how much he knows and the level his thinking is at), and really does makes hard stuff seem like its no big deal. He is super generous with his time, and fair. I wish 25% of my profs and classes could be this good and fun. I love Java!

Geoff is one of the best teachers you will have. He's always willing to help you and deeply knows what he is talking about. Lots of work, but his notes should help you a lot. Tests are fair, and make sure you do your labtasks

Dr. Sutcliffe's class is very very hard and lots of work! During project weeks I spend hours in the lab daily. Would not recommend this class if you are taking a science major and could take psych stats instead!

Dr. Sutcliffe is a very good teacher. He uses helpful illustrations and is in his office all the time and always willing to meet with students. Hes one of my favorite teachers in the department and makes difficult subjects accessable.

Dr. Sutcliffe is a fantastic teacher. Makes a difficult subject incredibly easy and easy to understand. Is very helpful outside of class. The course work is tough, but he makes it feel like its no big deal. I definately recommend him.
He's cool

geoff is one of the best professors i've ever had. he's humorous and an awesome guy all around. really understands how students think and how to answer questions to make us understand. lectures are as clear as can be with colorful illustrations so you can get a good picture of things. material is hard but there's no one better to take this class wi
The class itself is hard, but he's a good teacher and will go through step by step if you ask him to.  He's funny too, I don't know if I could have survived in this class with a different teacher.
easy at the beginning, harder as he goes along, DOESNT OWN A PAIR OF SHOES. hes a hoot

Nice professor and all but the dude is extremely far left. I'm a moderate myself but this dude takes it to a whole other level. Only 3 assignments, but you need his book to complete it - which I had to pay for. Lectures are just him talking about his political views, which are borderline communistic. Not the worst experience but steer clear.

I dropped this class after 1 day. He spent the entire first class ranting about his own political opinions and did not talk about factual information or the course material. I'm a liberal, but he is so radically far left that the lecture was insufferable. He is borderline anti-semetic and only cares about sharing his radical opinions.

I consider myself pretty far left but he has gone off the deep end. Also the ridiculous cost of his own books that he teaches on. Basically, if you write essays how he does in his books (like a crazy "intellect" who is just rambling for entire pages) you will get an A. Never went to lectures. Also he won't engage with any points other than his own.

I do not understand the low rating at all. POL 316 is so easy. Yeah, his lectures can get a bit boring but if you decide to engage in convo during the lecture it's actually interesting. Attendance is not mandatory at all and the midterms were so easy to write. People who are complaining are prob triggered by his political views lol

Highly recommend Professor Gonzalez. He is every Knowledgeable and has many years of experience in public government, this class is easy as long as you do all your assignments and show up to class. his lectures were engaging and informational.
DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. He spends the whole class ranting about how Putin is good and he also is so far left, its infuriating, and I'm a democrat.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Gonzalez is clearly passionate about the topics he discusses but his lectures are super long and boring. The class is all based on papers which are about his own book. Not a crazy hard class but I don't feel like I learned anything. Easy A if you like writing.

Do yourself a solid, and don't put yourself through this class. I was so stoked to take this course but was severely disappointed. Theres a reason his class sizes are so small and no one shows up: his teaching is wack. Hes an easy grader but the assignments are way too dense. He talks AT you for 3 hours.
