If you're not good at public speaking don't worry you get graded on the written part to so you can still get a good grade and you can do extra credit.I wish I could take another class with her. 10/10

Giroux is my favorite professor I have had in college! I am about to take my third class with her and every class Ive had with her has been really enjoyable! She is super understanding and not a tough grader at all. Being polite and showing interest in the class will get you a long way with her!
OMG!! I am on my 3rd class with Dr. Giroux. She is the BEST, kindest, funniest professor ever!! I would take ANY class with her!!

If you show up you will be fine, of course a public speaking class can be intimidating. However follow her instructors, show her your speech before class so she can check it and practice practice practice. Its not an easy A but its a very doable A if you put in the work. I strongly recommend her.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: This class is an easy A if you show up, do the readings, journals, and take the tests. She gives four extra credit opportunities where you will be able to get four additional points on your final grade which is a real plus. Additionally, her lectures are straight from the book and the tests are based on the book so if you just read you will pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Tests? Not many--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Giroux's public speaking class is a great class as she provides clear instructions and great feedback. If you show up to class and do the assignments following her guidelines you will get an A.
I took this class during the summer and it was really fun. We had to do 4/5 speeches throughout the 6-weeks. I saw myself progress from Day 1 till the last day in Week 6.
Prof Giroux is an ineffective instructor. I am never sure what is going to be on the tests. What is  on the test is oftentimes never mentioned in class. As a result, I'm currently doing very poorly.

A very bad instructor here at UM. I was sick with the stomach flu (had a note from the doctor) and she accused me of lying and fabrication. As a result, she said that I would be losing a percentage point off my final grade every day that I was absent. In addition to being very unpleasant and mean to students she is a very harsh grader!
I heard from friends that she was good but after being in her class I really regret the decision.
avoid this professor if you are able to! Terrible, terrible class and professor.
mean and nasty teacher. gives pop quizzes and asks questions intended to trick and confuse students.

I never submit reviews but I have to when a professor is this bad. Whoever said it was like being in elementary school totally nailed it. She would always talk down to students and belittle their comments. Oh, and a super tough grader.

She is unnecessarily hard and it feels as if she wants you to do poorly, as opposed to wanting to see you succeed and be happy. Her teaching style is bad, in that her lectures are confusing and she expects you to teach yourself the material.

I'm a senior, and professor Giroux was the single worst professor I've ever had. She was incredibly rude to me and made me feel like I was in elementary school again. I left every class feeling completely disrespected and insulted.
Really disliked the course and the professor. Not sure why everyone used to like her. I thought  she Was unpleasant and graded harshly.
what a miserable experience

Took class based on many earlier recommendations. Attendance is absolutely mandatory (only allowed to miss one class without losing points), and you must read textbook to do well. Even still, you won't learn much and this professor is incredibly rude to students. Almost made me consider switching majors. AVOID AT ALL COSTS
Would avoid this class if you like to do any of the following: learn, do well, and enjoy class.

I took two classes with her: Interpersonal communications and Small group communications. The former was enjoyable and easy enough if you put work into it. Ever since that class she became obsessed with being seen as a mean and tough teacher. Most of your grade in her small group class depends on a MASSIVE group project that she'll grade harshly.

A kind person, and love to communicate with her students.  YET definitely she is not a good instructor. Everything seems pointless and waste time. Also her grading system is kind of strange. Exams are not tough but you have to remember everything. A lot of writing. Attendance is mandatory. Buy text books btw.
Dr. Giroux is very committed to her students and makes the class interesting and fun while learning a lot.

this teacher is so nice and funny. Sometimes her class is boring and some things that we work on are pointless but the class is entertaining. All the tests come from the book and she is always willing to help you. Not a hard class, i got 100 on almost everything

She is a lot of fun and seems really easy because she is so spacey. But make sure that you really do prepare for your speeches because especially towards the end of the semester she grades more strictly. A really fun class though and she makes it funny. Dont buy the book- I never opened it!
Really easy and extremely nice.  Definitely recommend.  not that hard.

Very nice lady.  Not a lot of work, but her grading is kind of random.  Stick to her formats even thought they dont make the most sense.  Overall the class is pretty easy, but sometimes I was frustrated at how pointless some of the stuff we had to do was.

She's a very sweet woman. Small Group Com is unbelievably easy. Even though you are working in a group for the entire semester, you wind up doing little to no work. The final is a group essay where 5 people sit around talking about the semester and then only one essay is turned in. Quizzes are common sense. Don't bother reading the book. Easy A. =)
Engaging and thoughtful, Professor Giroux is an excellent instructor in the art of public speaking. She is tough on grades, but that can only mean that you have to get better.

She is terrible - she focuses on the wrong things and misses the bigger picture as it relates to public speaking. Her formats are needlessly complicated and pointless to adhere to. She is a terrible public speaker herself, and her grading is arbitrary and capricious.
She is the BEST!  So sweet and helpful.  Makes you feel comfortable and confident in public speaking.  Really gets to know her students.

Not the best at teaching content for graduate level classes. Material does not stick. Very vague with her reply and exam content. Read the textbook on your own instead of expecting her to guide you on what to focus on or explaining a relatable story to help students remember material.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Advanced Health Assessment. Nice lady, however, shouldn't be teaching Health Assessment. Unable to convey material accurately, often late and rushed through lecture. Test were poorly written, often confusing questions. Exams covered anything in 600 pgs of material. Final 1200 pgs of material. No need for in depth studying, doesn't help on test.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: if you have the opportunity to take her class I highly encourage it. She gives great lectures and her exams reflect what she taught. I learned a lot in her class and it actually made me like peds when I was dreading that rotation before. 10/10 would recommend her as an instructor. She is also great outside of lecture to get career/life advice.

I have mixed feelings about the course. They were an entertaining lecturer when it came to subjects outside of the material we were supposed to be learning in class. Left feeling like I did not learn anything that would assist me in their following course or my future career. I feel they would be a nice person outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He says he'll give all of his students an A but don't be fooled, that's not truth. At least 5 people I know of got in the B range. He's rude and thinks he's being funny but he is just plain inappropriate. If you're international don't bother saying your name because he'll yell at you for not being able to say your name because he says it different
Excellent professor! Really knows his stuff- He is always willing to help you learn. His class presentations are very well organized and cracks! a joke every now and then. Loved him

Best Professor I ever had. His real world examples were unique and fun and really helped explain the material. Extremely fair - allowed students to redo work as much as possible until the last day of class to help with learning. It was amazing how many students did not take him up on this and ended up with low grades. Bes Professor I've ever had!
Awesome professor. Great energy and very funny and still taught alot of material effectively.
Excellent in the classroom.  His patented stories make the classes extremely entertaining and his knowledge on the subject matter is extraordinary.

This was my first time having Professor Marcia for 346. She's really funny, and has an amazing personality. Attendance is mandatory, which was tough since her class was at 8 AM. This class is definitely assignment-heavy, and honestly some of the work felt unnecessary at times. Be prepared for AP Style assignments and multiple AP Style quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment:
One of the greatest professors, very personable and truly cares to see her students succeed. 

Don't hesitate to take her course.

Professor Gomez is THE BEST! She has a great personality and her lectures are interesting. There are a lot of assignments but she gives you so much time to complete them and they are all short. You are graded off many things which is nice. Beware of AP style but she teaches it to you. I love her and I really enjoyed this class. Take her!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She is an amazing professor. Lectures are pretty interesting, you cover topic in social media. All you're working on pretty much during the semester is the social media simulation, and it's pretty easy. Engaging class, funny and she has great energy. Very accessible outside of class. Attendance mandatory.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: One of my favorite professors from the school. Prof. Gomez is amazing, teaches you actually useful things. Crazy engaging, very funny and overall a very happy individual. It is fun to have class with her. I've taken her 3 semesters for different classes.

I took STC 232 with her; she is a great professor. She is usually packed with things so if you need to talk to her don't wait till the last minute. Put effort into your drafts so you actually get good feedback. Brace yourself for AP Style. She is nice, caring and funny.

The lectures are a lot to listen to but the only thing you will really be working on in the class is the 12-round simulation. It is not hard as long as you finish it on time and try. She grades fairly. It was an easy class, even at 8 AM. (She also took attendance at the end of class just to make sure even the late students got their names down)

I took STC 346 and there were lots of writing assignments and printing and overlapping due dates, but she was very flexible, fun and down to earth. Super sweet and understanding the assignments could get overwhelming at times. Definitely take her if you have the chance though
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Great at explaining and super nice. The tests are easy to get an A on if you study, they are based exactly on the powerpoints. She does mark attendance, but is very understanding.

Gomez isn't bad, but the class is just too much work and she's kinda judgey about your style. Not everybody is a Miami entertainment writer and she seems to prefer people from her PR realm. All excessive amount of assignments & hard quizzes!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: I love this woman so much!  She is the absolute sweetest.  I strongly recommend taking her class.  Everything is very organized and thorough.  One of my easiest classes at the U.

Take this class! As long as you show up (sometimes), do the in class assignments, and take the tests, you'll get an A. The exams are super easy and there's only 2 plus a presentation. She's also super nice and helpful if you need her.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor is not clear about guidelines and how students are graded. She is accessible outside of class and willing to give feedback though. Class included about 8-10 writing assignments. The rough drafts were ungraded so this gave you the opportunity to get feedback to know what she wanted for the final draft. She's a nice person.
Professor Gomez was the best. Highly recommend taking any class she teaches. Shes a great teacher and really wants her students to succeed

STC334 was a very interesting class and Marcia Gomez is the best! One group project that has different parts and 1 individual presentation. Not very difficult but you do have to do your work. Highly suggest her
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She is actually the sweetest woman ever. You can tell she is such a happy person and is so passionate about the the stuff she is teaching. Attendance isn't required but something she randomly does assignments in class that you need to be there for to get credit for. You do have to study for the test but if you study, you will do well.
most lovely woman ever and the class is way easier than it should be if you just pay attention

Dr. Murphy explains material clearly and treats this as a true introductory course. The class includes three assignments, three exams, and a final journal project. She provides study guides and extra credit opportunities, which help students prepare. Overall, the course is well organized and approachable.

Dr. Goes is the sweetest professor I've ever had. She clearly cares about her students' wellbeing, and is passionate about meteorology. She is understanding, gives great feedback, and her homework, assignments, and exams are fair. If you study and pay attention, you should do very well. Definitely recommend!

Lisa is so kind and really cares about her students. Her lectures are interesting and she makes sure to try to make them relatebale while going over the materiel as many times as you need. I wish I cared more about this class because it is sad to see people on their laptops the whole time/not showing up, but shes genuinely great.

She is the BEST professor at UM. So sweet and reasonable, I highly recommend this course. Classes are mostly lectures but all slides are online. Attendance isn't mandatory but go anyway because she's the nicest person on the planet and very knowledgable on the subject.

Dr. Goes was a wonderful professor and very knowledgeable. She is very caring and really wants her students to succeed. Dr. Goes explains the material very well and she gives a lot of extra credit and partial credit on the written part of exams. She also had a final project rather than a final exam and for the last exam, she brought us all donuts:)

Actual sweetest person on the planet. She is the best professor at this school. I had her for two courses this semester and she brightened my day everytime I saw her. Never say a bad thing about professor goes because she has never hurt a fly. She makes her classes easy to get an A while being interesting and fun at the same time. I love her!!!!!!

Nicest lady on the planet. Super willing to help students and truly wants everyone to do well. The material is not super difficult; it is okay if you study. The labs can sometimes be difficult, but it depends on your TA.

Prof. Goes is a great professor. She is caring, understanding, and really cares about her students. Her class is pretty lecture-heavy and can get boring at times but her use of examples makes it much more bearable. Tests were easy, lots of multiple-choice but memorization is key. Take her.

Lisa wants to help you succeed, you just need to work for it! Lots of material, solely lectures with a midterm and final (plus some homework). This was her first time teaching the class so our TA helped provide some clarification at times, but she's a great professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Goes is the nicest prof on campus. She's super caring, patient, and always in a good mood. She breaks down hard concepts in an easy way to understand. Gives a lot of extra credit. Tests are a lot of material, but basic and just based off the ppts. Can be scary if you're not an environmental major, but she helps out a lot!! highly recommend

Lisa Goes is a really great teacher. She is super nice and caring and wants everyone to succeed. She prepares us well for success with her lecture powerpoints. Coming from a music major taking this course as part of my cognate, she made me very interested in the material. She is great!! Highly recommend!
The BEST! She is so adorable and an amazing professor. She is so nice, clear, and well organized.
Lisa is the BEST!!!!!

She was a great professor, I had already taken Pre-calc so I loved her teaching, lots of practice problems and provides a lot of resources for exam and quiz prep. The second exam was the hardest and the average was low so she offered 15 points of extra credit if you fixed your mistakes. Wish i could've taken her for calc 1!

She is a very kind person, especially if you ask for help during office hours. She lectures to make sure you understand the material and is very good with examples. However, tests are very difficult but there are weekly quizzes that can help your grade. Make sure to stay on top of studying and you should be fine.

DO NOT TAKE HER FOR 108 IF YOU STRUGGLE IN MATH! She is a nice person, but she is not meant to teach intro courses; if you are not the best/strongest at math...NO! Her tests and quizzes are MUCH harder than what we go over in class...SAVE YOURSELF THE DEPRESSION AND STRESS  AND CHOOSE SOMEONE ELSE!!!!!

She's the best professor to take for MTH 151. I didn't take calc in high school, so lectures were a bit hard to follow, BUT, they were recorded and available to rewatch throughout the semester, making sure you could go back and watch how she solved the problems in class. She's pretty funny and cares about her students. Just put in the effort.

The class definitely wasn't easy, but I'm not sure why people are surprised that it was hard when it's a calc class. Compared to my high school calc class, she was very clear in her lectures and doing the homework was enough preparation for the quizzes and exams. I do recommend having some prior knowledge on calc 2 before taking the class though.

While her lectures are easy to follow, tests are nothing like them and 10x harder. Tough grader, one small mistake can lead to 10 point off. Homework did not help, tests were nothing like it. After attending 12+ hours of tutoring and going to her office hours weekly it proved no help due to her overly difficult exams and weekly quizzes. Nice lady.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: After taking calculus in high school, I expected not to feel engaged in this class when taking it again. However, her lectures were organized and neat, and she would crack funny jokes. I found myself paying attention much more than I thought I would, and liking going to math class. However, sometimes the grading was inconsistent and/or incorrect.

The most ridiculous professor i've had at UM. Insane amount of HW that has topics not covered in class and that wont appear on exams. Exams are way harder than concepts covered in class, and she makes a point to put the hardest question for every topic on. Plays favorites, watched her erase a students work and write something in on an exam.
can't solve her own problems, makes problems extremely difficult to solve past the actual concept thats being tested, then deducts points for skills not included in course description.

I can't say I love her but I really like her. Tough grader and I found it unfair at times but she's caring and explains really well. Very easy to talk to and really helpful if you need it. Challenging class but as someone who struggles with math in general I found her great. Sad she's not teaching Calc 1 next semester

She can't solve her own problems half the time, and her explanations are so confusing that nobody understands what is happening. You will be learning on your own. I had previously taken Calc 2 in high school and received a 100 in the class, but she has me confused about things I've been doing since high school which is absurd.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Every student in my class was failing and it was all blamed on the students. The punishment of not doing well was adding more quizzes. Do not take her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I ended up dropping the class after she deducted points from two separate multiple-choice quizzes where I had earned a 100%. The deductions were based on criteria that were not included in the questions. For an online summer course, this kind of grading approach was too unpredictable and not something I could afford.

Dr. G is kind and willing to answer any questions about the material. However, the course is quite challenging, and she doesn't always acknowledge that. You can't take this class lightly, especially since expectations can be unclear at times. I still recommend her, as she's approachable and helpful during office hours.

She was good but she always tended to give the hardest possible questions for quizzes. She does end up dropping two at the end of the semester though. Exams 1 and 3 are fairly easy but for exam 2 the average was low like 50/60. Final replaces lowest exam grade so make sure to do good on that. Gives some EC.

Only having 3 exams was scary. Make sure to do very well on the first exam because all of that carries over to all of the other exams. STUDY for the final - it will make up for your final grade and your lowest regular exam grades. Do all of the extra credit, this is how I ended with an A.

Class is tough and requires effort outside of class to do well on exams and quizzes, but she's a fantastic teacher and cares about her students. Lectures are engaging and she explains things well. Very accessible outside of class for questions as well. Offers extra credit opportunities.

Great professor! Never understood anyone who had a problem with her. She covers all the material you need, no surprises. It's important to show up to class but as long as you do, it's not overwhelming to grasp the material. I would definitely take her for another course.

I LOVED HER, i am so supprised that she only has a 4.0. Yes the class is not easy, but she explains everything SOOOOO WELLLL. I love her so much and her review and homework is EXACTLY what the exam and quizziz are. So if your not doing well it is your fault because everything is as she gives it to you.
Very sweet person and tests/quizzes weren't too hard if you studied. Just go to class, do the homework and reviews.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Aleksandra is a very sweet professor, she teaches the content in a very thorough manner and cares deeply about her students' success. The exams were fair, they were definitely a bit too long because I almost ran out of time on each test. She is definitely one of the better math professors at UM, and I would recommend taking her.

This class is unnecessarily difficult, and as someone who isn't good at math to begin with this class was a struggle. Even after taking advantage of tutoring and other resources, and putting in way more effort than my other classes, the tests, quizzes, and final were still very difficult.

this professor is NOT good but seems like every1 in the math dpt is. she doesn't reply to emails and even after seeing literally everyone in class fail an exam, she didnt change her teaching style at all. she gives review packets but the solutions are wrong and they dont look like the actual exam at all so no preparation. ive always gotten a's

Professor Gorzycka did a good job teaching the material and was always clear in doing so. She also records lectures. There is a lot of web-assign homework, you take 7 quizzes (3 drops), and 4 exams (including the final). Class wasn't super hard but you need to put in work/study for tests. The second exam is the hardest and timing on tests is fast.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Good Professor does good job teaching the material and answers questions. Class moves at a good pace, hard to fall behind. Exams definetly do require a couple hours of review and studying.

She picks favorites for her class. She starts grading harshly as soon as you introduce yourself and try to show her you make an effort. Thought she would be better than she is according to reviews. As for her exams, she tries to make them harder than what you do in class or the review.

She gives seven quizzes a semester, takes the top five grades, and then drops the rest. She doesn't drop an exam, but you can replace it with your final exam grade. As for the difficulty of the tests and quizzes, there isn't enough time to take the exam she gives us. To do well in this class, you need to work for it.
You have to work really hard for this one :) She knows her stuff but makes it complicated.

Coming from someone who has taken plenty of math courses at UM, Professor Gorzycka is by far the best professor I've had. She takes time to answer questions, responds to her emails quickly, and gives extra credit for participation. Review in class problems for tests. Pay attention in lecture as she will often give hints as to whats on the exam.

Super nice professor who makes time to help students and is accesible outside of class. You will need to read the entire textbook and do not miss any class or you will struggle. Also take good notes. As long as you read the full textbook and attend the class you will perform well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor G is great! She teaches math, so obviously some people will find ways to dislike her, but as long as you ASK QUESTIONS, and participate when asked, you'll do well. She drops multiple grades at the end of the semester and gives extra credit opportunities. no complaints

She may just be my least favorite teacher of all time. I don't want to make my review of her purely emotional but from the beginning of the course, for some reason, she took an instant dislike to me and berated me with questions in front of the class, especially when I'd answer wrong. Was spiteful and unhelpful outside of class as well. Accent bad.
She is extremely nice and helpful, definitely recommend taking her
If you are taking any math class definitely take Professor Gorzycka! She records every class and attendance isn't mandatory. She clearly explains each topic and is always available for questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She's super kind and helpful with things students don't understand. She also hold a lot of review days before tests and the final which is super nice.

Prof Gorzycka is the best math prof I've had here. She is super knowledgeable and makes sure her students understand. She's super organized and makes her own notes worksheets for her students. There is a lot of Webassign homework and frequent quizzes, but they help you learn the material better. If you can, definitely take Prof Gorzycka.

Aleksandra is one of the best professors I have ever had. She explains material super well and there are no surprises on any of her quizzes or exams. My favorite feature of this class was that she recorded her lectures. I work 12 hour Sundays and was able to attend my Monday morning class online if I needed to. Wonderful professor and person!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Prof. Gorzycka is amazing, and I'm so sad that she isn't teaching MTH 162 next semester. Lots of hw and gives so many opportunities for EC. If you put in enough effort, you'll definitely pass. Her class was fun and interesting. She really wants her students to do well. Take her class if you can.

Nice lady, but I worked so hard in this class and just didn't get the results. Quizzes are easy, tests are hard and get progressively harder thru semester. Such a heavy grader. If you mess up one thing algebraically in the beginning, you will most likely get the entire 10+ point question wrong. If you want a more lax professor, look somewhere else.

One of the better professors in the math dept. Class was really hard for a precalc class, but I'm sure it's more of the material than the prof. She's really nice to students in class and makes it clear what she wants to see. Helpful during office hours too. Recommend her for MTH 108
Definitely the best math professor on campus. She is such a nice person, and her class is very straight forward. Usually 6-7 quizzes through the semester and 3 exams. The final was brutal
She is quite possibly the nicest professor Ive ever had. She is top tier, however the whole class and mth 161 got destroyed by the final.

If you could take any math teacher at UM take her!! she is the NICEST teacher I have had for any of my subject thus far. She takes into consideration what you would prefer to see on quizzes and always ask for feedback. she will tell you what you should expect to see on exams. she is super nice and lets you leave class a couple minutes early.

The only good professor out of the math department! I would only take her if I had the chance. She cares about you so much and tries to make the math as easily understandable as possible. For tests she means what she says that the questions are student friendly. Show up to class to show your interested and she will notice and reward it.

She is such a sweet women. She offers a ton of extra credit because of how many people fail the exams. She teaches alright but its Calc 2 so its not that easy in general. She's the nicest math professor I've encountered at UM but the class was tough. A few A's every test but not many. Lots of practice and sleepless nights didn't help me but oh well
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Gorzycka is gem in the math department! She genuinely cares for her students and offers extra credit at the end of the semester. Her class consists of weekly homework on WebAssign, biweekly quizzes on 2-3 sections, 3 exams, and final. Always happy to answer any questions and walk through homework problems. HIGHLY recommend taking Dr. Gorzycka!

Terrible professor. She overcomplicates every lesson, is not understanding at all, her quizzes are fairly simple but her exams are almost impossible to pass. She gives a quiz almost every week and if not a quiz, an exam. She dumps a load of homework every week as well.
Exams are hard and she overcomplicates her explanations, so prepare to teach yourself. Lots of homework too

I took AP calc BC in high school and found it really difficult but when I took calc 1 here I finally understood everything. She cares about her students and is a really good teacher. Her class was also just so enjoyable, I didn't need to take calc 2 but I almost did just so I could have her again. If you are taking calc def try to get her

Shes great! Super kind and sweet teacher. Im taking another class of hers next semester. In calc 2 she allowed us to have a cheat sheet on all tests with formulas & common derivatives. She gives partial credit on everything. All homework/quizzes are on WebAssign and easy to find. Its easy to schedule a time to meet with her as well. 100% rec!

Best professor! Made calculus super easy to understand. There was a quiz every week and homework for every section covered, but I liked the workload. It makes you learn. She's super sweet and accessible outside of class. I am taking her again for Calc 2

Don't listen to the negative comments! Dr. Gorzycka is the best math professor I ever had! Calc 2 is challenging in general, but she is very clear in her lectures and the homework and quizzes prepare you very well for the exams. If you perform well on homework and quizzes and put effort into studying days in advance, you will do well in the class.

Im not sure why people are saying she was hard, she was a great teacher and extremely clear on what we had to know. There were no surprises ever. She always told us exactly what we had to know. There was lots of homework and quizzes every week but thats how most of the math classes roll. I highly recommend her, just don't fall behind
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Her lectures are good and she really makes sure you understand it before you move on but she doesn't put in grades right away so I didn't know what I actually had in the class it was just the total but don't miss lectures or else you will be lost.

Aleksandra is a gem in the Math department. I took her for MTH 161 and now for 224 and I'm looking to take her again. She is really caring, gives extensions and responses to emails really quickly. She always provides a review before the exams and reviews her review and answers questions the class before the exam. TAKE HER IF YOU CAN!

she's an amazing professor that actually cares about her class and students. I think its hard for many since they don't put in the time or do extra work or practice outside of what's given, and I mean its calc so its hard. put in the work and show that you care about her class and you'll get an A. she's amazing!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great teacher but doesn't offer extra credit like most other professors do for Calc 1. Makes things difficult since everything is standardized through the department, especially when she takes off 5-10 points on every quiz even if you get a 100, for the slightest notation error in your work. Wouldn't take her again bc that really hurt my grade.

It's extremely rough for Intro to stats class. She grades very heavy on her exams. NO make up quizzes/exams AT ALL (No exceptions including health issues). Get ready to learn how to use a different program called R studio. Imagine trying to learn stats plus a math coding program. Her office hours with app are rushed. Worst class at UM!

I think that Dr. Gorzycka would be a great teacher in person. Having her online though was a disaster. She never goes over homework problems or study guides and simply does some practice problems for you for each lecture. I already struggle with math so having a teacher that does not actually take the time to TEACH made this class impossible.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She will take off 10 points for the smallest mistakes and rushes through lectures. She seems like a very kind and caring person but the problem is she doesn't actually teach. Instead, she shows you 2 or 3 examples for each section and moves on to the next topic. The tests and quizzes are also much harder than anything covered in lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: By far the best math professor I had. She makes the material seem very easy and simple. She is very caring and willing to work with you. If you follow her lectures the class should be straight forward. Her tests are somewhat easy but they are very similar to the lectures.

SHE'S THE BEST math professor I've ever had. She's super sweet and caring and teaches you all the right material you will need to succeed. Definitely show up to class because she goes over ever possible question which is super helpful. She also gave extra credit at the end of the semester and tests are so fair!! You do need a code for online hw
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I loved having professor Alecksandra. She's by far one of the best calculus professor. She gives partial credit, explains really well. Shows you the rules and works through a variety of problems for you that may ask you to use these rules. Her exams are fair and on what is taught so go to class. She's kind and willing to help and answer questions.

Professor Gorzycka is by far the best math professor I've ever had. She is very organized, explains everything clearly, and is always willing to help with questions a student may have. She gives lots of partial credit and sometimes extra credit to boost test grades. HER TESTS ARE NOT DIFFICULT, THEY ARE NORMAL MATH TESTS.

She's a great professor, but the tests given were very difficult. I would go to her office hours frequently to get to know her and don't underestimate the amount of time you need to spend studying for this class. I would still take this class again though.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She's fine but sometimes doesn't explain super clearly and gives difficult tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Instant L, dont take her.

i took SOC 211 w her, which is all stats and she is not a math prof. It's a 'flipped' classroom but that just means you have to teach yourself everything and have to correct her in class bc she's often wrong w/ formulas and calculations. Very sweet but has no idea what she's doing.

Was asynchronous and she "posted" lectures but they just made things more confusing. It's just homework but she asks for work and even an uploaded youtube video of you explaining which is so extra. Also takes points off if technical issues. Then she says the answer is incorrect and to meet but shes never there. Just teach this class to yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor doesn't give too many instructions in class. I recommend meeting with her outside of class to for her to clarify what she expects you to do. She shows different types of media to help you understand the lesson. Unfortunately, her lectures aren't the best to understand the material and her lectures do your reading. Good luck :) !

She is always late for class & not organized nor specific with the instructions of the assignments. Everyone is always lost with her instructions. beginning of the semester she will make you do a participant observation & every other assignment and homework for the rest of the semester will be based off of this project. I don't recommend her class.

She's extremely average. If you do all the work and study a lot for exams, you'll get an A. Her lectures are incredibly boring, as was the class. Tons of assignments, and directions were not straight forward so it was hard to know what she expected. I didn't hate her, but wasn't an amazing professor either. Gives extra credit which was bomb

Terrific professor, one of the best I have ever had. Is clear about all material and only quizzes on what he talks about in class. Textbook can be used to reinforce material learned in class. A lot of extra credit. Highly recommend taking him. Do the work and understand the material and you will get an A.
By far the best professor at UM. He is so helpful and makes the material actually enjoyable.

I know it's an 8am, but trust me, take this class. Best BSL teacher by far, you will have less work, a more enjoyable lecture, and be better prepared for the exam than any other class. Getting up sucks but the class is great, he is a genuine, smart, down-to-earth guy. It's not possible for me to recommend someone more than I'm recommending him.

Easily one of the best professors I have ever had. When people tell you to never take 8 am's you should definitely listen besides this class. He is so engaging to where you won't fall asleep and if you study what you learned in class you should walk out with an A.

You won't find a better professor than him to teach business law! He makes the class easy to understand and entertaining to sit through which helps because the textbook rambles a lot. Plus he offers plenty of extra credit to boost your grade up and always makes himself available if you have questions or your circumstances change.

Professor Waldman is, hands down, by far, the greatest professor at the University of Miami. He wants to get to know his students and have people laugh at his jokes. In fact, he probably wishes he was a student himself. Using relatable examples, like situations his kids and their college friends have been in, helps put the course in perspective.

Genuine guy who cares about his students. Extra credit is easy to get if you need it. The lectures are basic explanations of the textbook, which helps a lot because the text might seem a bit dense and wordy at times. Only one group project and one essay, which are both easy As. He uses lots of examples based on his experience. Worth the 8:00 A.M.

He truly cares about whether or not you actually understand the material rather than the terms. He also goes over all exams with you and only assigns one writing assignment which is extremely easy. Even though it is 8 AM take this class if you want to learn and get a good grade.
Awesome teacher. He is a practitioner that knows his stuff well. His class is interesting and easier compared to other professors' class. Gives lots of extra credits and he is willing to help you.

He gets everyone involved in class and really cares about his students. He owns his own firm so he's a busy guy buts makes time for his students. He really wants everyone to understand the concepts and not so much the terms except the most needed ones but the final is department administered so you should study terms for the final.

One of the best professors I have ever had at UM.  He truly cares about his students and is willing to work with you on deadlines and makes sure you understand the material.  He makes somewhat boring material interesting and classes are entertaining. Don't let the 8am class stop you from taking him - he's amazing!

One of my favorite classes. He truly cares about students learning and doesn't try to trick you. I took this class at 8 AM and I didn't miss one class. Really recommend this teacher if you are interested in BSL and want to learn.

The best professor I've had at UM by far. He is a lawyer and an adjunct prof, so his lectures are relevant to current topics in the legal community.  He also has great stories.  I highly recommend him.  He is well worth the 8 a.m. you'll have.  Class is probably optional, but I recommend going more often than not.  Prof Waldman is the man.

I took his class on a whim (at 8 a.m.) because there weren't many classes open. This guy is funny, intelligent, and I was eager to go to his class every day. He is a very big lawyer in the Miami area and brings so much knowledge and real-world experience in a class that can easily be boring memorization of laws. He knows each of his students.

He is an amazing professor. He is an actual lawyer that teaches for his own pleasure. His lectures are amazing and super interesting. He teaches his class giving examples of actual cases he works with and makes them super easy to understand. He gives tons of extra credit on the quizzes so I assure you you won't do bad in his class. TAKE HIM!!!

This professor is amazing! Although the coursework is hard itself, he makes it enjoyable. He relates everything so you could understand, and he gives you extra credit on test, but will tell you exactly what it is about to help out your grade. His lectures are basically what you need. Use the textbook for nitty-gritty details, if you wish.

He is a man with so much experience in the field so do not expect a shortage of stories. He really knows his stuff so he will go in specific (but interesting) details about marine processes. Tests were pretty tough but it was quite an experience being in his class.
I honestly don't see where some of his exam and quiz questions came from. I thought they were unreasonably difficult.

Dr. Glynn is extremely knowledgeable and responsive  and makes class truly fun with wonderful anecdotes from his career as a marine scientist. His quizzes/exams are pretty tough, and you need to really understand EVERYTHING from his lectures/slides to do well, but he's a great choice for those willing to work hard to learn from the best.

Dr. Glynn's class was the highlight of my day every day I had it.  The quizzes and tests are difficult, but if you do some hard core studying you'll be fine (he also curves a bit).  The man has truly lived an amazing life as a marine scientist and has numerous stories (some hilarious) that were, quite honestly, inspiring.

Dr. Glynn is awesome. He has years of experience in his field, that yield intelligent lectures and amazing stories. He will make you work however. BUT, if you really study (like actually settle down in the library and legit study) for his quizzes, midterm, and final, you should do well. Go to class, and pay attention. It's not easy, but its amazing

His stories will blow your mind! But the class is very difficult, and his quizzes and tests will ask very specific questions. Designate time to study!!! But its a class that will teach you a lot ... definitely one of my favorites!

The man, the myth, the legend! If you are lucky enough to take a class with Dr. Glynn, count yourself among the fortunate. This class is hard, but he pushes you for your own good. Go to class, sit up front, and ask for help when you need it! He's an incredible man so get to  know him! (Note: if you're looking for an easy elective, look elsewhere!)

I loved this class! I looked forward to hearing Dr. Glynn's lectures and stories. Quizzes and tests are really hard, so study A LOT. Love the material, love the class--definitely take it, but be prepared for a lot of studying. It's so worth it.

I have taken three classes with the man and he is a good teacher with high expectations.  Teaches both big picture and details.  A great person who is very helpful and accommodating.  If you like the subject you will love the class; otherwise it is too much work.  Highly recommended.

A really interesting lecturer! The tests and quizzes are really hard, but this is because he just really wants people to learn and find an interest in the subject. His curve seems really fair and he's really funny in lecture. Just be sure to take really detailed notes in order to succeed!

This is an incredible class and Dr. Glynn is inspirational. It's a lot of work (definitely not for those looking for easy science credit) but MSC majors and BIL majors should love it. Extremely interesting, great stories! Sit up front and get to know him! Work hard and you'll do fine.

The class is amazing! But tough. I don't recommend it if you aren't a marine science major (premeds looking for an easy bio elective, stay away as this course will kick your ass). He's very specific on tests and don't believe it when he says something won't be on the test-it's all fair game. He's very helpful if you approach him and ask questions.

Dr. Glynn is a fantastic professor; very student oriented.  His exams are extremely difficult and very specific.  Prepare to study.  If you are looking for an easy grade, this is not your guy.  If you are looking to actually learn something, this is the professor for you.

Tests are extremely specific and require a lot of study time. Literally need to memorize every bullet point off 100 slides per test/quiz. Xtremely boring. Nice guy, hard to hate him, but then you get destroyed on tests.. so you do... Studying right now for the final and want to die, literally. Jumping off roof of pearson after this.

awesome guy, and famous for his coral research, but a terrible teacher, test are horrible... he stresses certain topics in class, and then literally the only thing on his tests is the stuff he did not stress .... do not take this class unless you have to ... if you do have to , you might end up taking it twice...

I do not recommend him, especially if you are not a marine science major, I took him to fulfill some BIL credits, and it was a big mistake. The material is interesting, but his questions are very specific and some questions are fill in. This is an into class but it did not feel like one :(
Not the best teacher. Tests you on very specific facts and things that weren't stressed during lecture. However, he is a great person and his stories are funny.
No Comments

He is a horrible teacher.  He says you don't need to memorize charts and numbers he puts up on the board and then he tests you on them.  Sweet guy but that shouldnt be why he gets a good rating as a teacher.  His stories are honestly never funny to me.

In my experience as an undergraduate and graduate student, he is one of the best professors I have known. Very student-oriented and stimulating. He has high standards, necessary for being a quality scientist.
The only reason students attended the class was for his stories.
He's a bad teacher....but a really sweet guy.
He's a world renound researcher, but a bad teacher.
Awesome professor and very supportive. Defiantly the hardest professor out of the three who teach this class but if you pay attention and take notes this will be an easy A.

reviews.comment: Great professor! Lots of reading! He is great.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He's a good professor, he lectures the whole class but tries to keep it interactive with iClicker. There's one essay that was very very simple. The tests aren't hard if you just pay attention slightly.
I agree with the majority of reviews but he does try to reach out to students so I'll give him that!
I would try to avoid if possible
Nice guy but I wouldn't take again

Koger is at best a "good" professor. He is quite partisan but overall I learned a lot from that class. You do actually have to show up which can be annoying because of what time the class is it. TA was great and was the reason most kids got an A in this course. You will get an A just become friends with the TA!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He has none of the qualities you look for when choosing a professor that will help you in your academic journey.
DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCES!!
Easy class, but he's just such a terrible guy. I honestly don't know how he sleeps at night.
Genuinely a creepy guy who cares more about people's personalities than their coursework. Don't take this class if you value your education.

He is very well articulated but incredibly obsessed with students cheating to a concerning degree. He is occasionally very rude and displays aggressive partisanship. Very intelligent man with almost no social skills, and he can make students very uncomfortable.

Koger is great. You will do the thing you came to college to do (hopefully): learn. "Old-school" professor for sure but you will actually learn important things from an "insider" in American politics. Brings his gov experience to class which is really cool. Hard exams but he will give a heavy curve. Show up and pay attention and you got an A
If you enjoy rude professors he is for you. Has very obvious favorites. Teaching aside just not a nice person.

Not sure what the review below is about but yeah Koger is a pretty tough professor. He cold calls and you def have be prepared for class. The notion below is very strange and someone might just be very unhappy with their grade. Exams are pretty tough but I went to his office hours twice and he was helpful. Recommend if you want to learn
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I thoroughly enjoyed this class and getting to know Dr. Koger. This was by no means an easy class, but an A was also very accessible. He applies all the concepts we learn about to today's politics and current events do show up on tests. Negative reviews come from students who did not participate or take good notes to review before exams. Great Prof
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Complaints below about Dr. Koger come from screen-glued zombies who never raised a hand. He keeps politics current and real and tests real thinking—not copy-paste trivia. Put the laptop down, study a bit, speak up, and the A practically hands itself over. Skim the news, review his slides, and show up—you're golden. Want lazy credits? Go elsewhere.

He's a nice person, but was SO unhelpful when preparing for tests. 2 tests count for most of the grade, and when asked questions about them, he didn't know because he hadn't written them yet. Never gave study guides and expected us to know minor details from the entire course. Lots of readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Don't take him if you don't have to. He is not helpful when it comes to test prep (no guidance about what's on the tests), but then was shocked when the class average of the midterm was in the 70s.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Absolutely do not take Professor Koger if you don't have to. He does not tell you anything that will be on tests and thinks it's funny that he hasn't even made the test just a few days before. Hard grader and terrible attitude. Hated this class so much. He wants his students to fail. Couldn't stand to listen to him. Just don't take him

absolutely horrible, avoid at all costs. there are no study guides and he won't tell you what's on the test. the tests (2) are based on readings, slides, and current news stories, so there's way too much content to even study and the questions are too specific. if you're insane i would recommend this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: To be honest, I woke up every day wishing this class was canceled, only to be disappointed. He makes the toughest exams with so much content and no guidance on what could be on it, and he was shocked when the average of the first exam was in the 70s. These 5s are false, DO NOT TAKE HIM.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: isn't very helpful when it comes to what is going to be on his test. class is hard and tests are written although he says they aren't. they are literally in a blue book. the final was cumulative and hard and they whole class was the 2 quizzes and the final and one paper. he also expects everyone to be congressional know it alls.

Does not give a lot of insight as to what will be on the quizzes/ final. I struggled in this class and did not feel very assisted or supported. Does not respond to emails and is definitely a tough grader.

Class graded only on two quizzes, paper, and final. Very tough grader. Does not give lots of notes/ resources to study and barely what to prepare for exams. He is accessible outside of class and willing to help but the guidance is not the best and he really just tells you answers rather than explains them so its hard to truly grasp the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Super hard class but Gregory Koger is funny and nice.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: A cool guy to talk to. Course was def on harder side bc tests were worth 70% of overall grade, so you could get caught slipping. During lecture we would discuss whats going in American politics at that moment, which was really interesting. Overall, I'd recommend b/c its interesting, but it is by no means an "easy A".

The class is lecture-heavy because of the amount of people. Professor Koger gives clear lectures and has a good sense of humor. The class was extremely repetitive, and the exams were long and multiple-choice. The guest speaker we had was interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I recommend him if you want to actually learn and sit through lectures. Grades were based on attendance, one paper, cumulative homework score, and three exams.

Professor Koger is very passionate about what he does, but his lectures can be hard to follow. The tests are content heavy and require a lot of review. Attendance is mandatory and the one paper is a large chunk of your grade. Class requires a lot of time, but if you go to class, take notes, and study, it is not as bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Koger is brilliant and gives good lectures for people who want an in-depth introduction to American Politics. If you are not interested in this subject, this class will feel intense as an intro course. His grading system is confusing, and you cannot really figure out your grade unless you email him.

Changes huge paper requirements like the wind changes directions, constantly and without good reason other than deciding he doesnt like his own assignments. Assumes his class is the only thing on your plate

Dr. Koger is clearly very experienced in the political field, and has very interesting lectures. I found the tests a bit challenging; you should definitely read the textbook and take good notes. He also cold-calls, so be prepared for that. Very informative and is happy to help you if you have questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Koger gave a speech at the beginning of the semester assuring everyone that he cared about their wellbeing and grade but it is clear that he had no regard for either. Not sure what this man was smoking when he gave 200 question exams and an essay where he deducted 5 points for every unnecessary word. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!

Do not be fooled by the good reviews, DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. Professor Koger claims to care about students but makes his class way harder than it needs to be considering it is a 201 Introduction course. Especially during a pandemic, he has lacked empathy for students by making tests 100 questions, the final is 200 questions in 150 minutes.

I loved Prof. Koger and this class. The tests are very long and wordy so be prepared for that, but he genuinely is a sweet person and gives soo many opportunities for required activity points etc. He genuinely wants you to succeed great and he's not boring at all

I would definitely recommend taking Professor Koger to anyone who is looking for a good polisci professor. Definitely one of the "easiest" and fairest you can find out of the polisci department. Just be prepared to get cold called.

TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. I'm taking 599 with Koger now and it is definitely the hardest class I have taken at UM, but he is THE BEST PROFESSOR. He is the absolute kindest, smartest, most patient, understanding professor, and I don't know how to explain him, other than to say he is not on a high horse at all. He wants kids to learn huge respect for him

LISTEN HERE. Dr. Koger is a funny guy, and this class is an absolute joke to him. He gives online quizzes before each test, and these quizzes compiled together are the test. WORD FOR WORD. The final is all of the quizzes online combined. I wish I knew this before. No need to read the textbook or pay attention. He's a great guy, would take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Tests are totally based off the homework if you study the homework you will do good on the tests. I only needed textbook for first test other than that I used the quizzes (homework) and lectures to study. He's a very nice guy and lectures are fun. He is liberal, though, so just be weary of that if you are conservative.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Koger was a great professor! Always discussed current events and tests based off of what he taught in class. few questions from readings but nice professor, great at teaching material and fair grader!

Prof Koger is a nice buy but boring lectures. Very easy class. 3 tests and attendance and the tests are super easy. Lectures are super boring and he posts the presentations that cover everything online, so you literally only have to go for the attendance. Boring, didn't learn too much, but easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Tests? Not many--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: This class was one of the better ones I've taken at UM. Dr. Koger tries to make lectures interesting, even though they are often long. He also gave us reading quizzes before each test to prepare and the questions from all the quizzes were the same questions on the test. Overall not a hard class to do well in if you do the readings/take notes

Dr. Koger is a great professor! His lectures are very detailed and I learned a lot in this class. The only complaint I have is I wish his lectures overlapped with the book a little more, but if you read the chapters and take the quizzes, you'll be in good shape. I highly recommend taking his class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Koger's a cool guy. Very willing to help at office hours. Lectures are pretty long, but he jokes to make it go by. You HAVE to read to do well on the online quizzes and exams; if you do it is an easy A. There was a paper, fairly simple. Final exam was similar to first two, so just read the text and study and you'll be fine. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Koger is awesome!!! Really makes you think and he challenges you, but he cares about his students. Reading material seemed boring when I read it, but it ended up being really useful for other classes. Go to his study sessions, he's great to talk to. and he's cute :)
You have to work for your A in this class, but it's not impossible! Dr. Koger is a cool guy, but there are only 3 tests (fairly difficult), including the final, so there are a lot of long lectures.

Professor Koger is a nice man if you form a personal relationship with him, otherwise he seems uncaring. The tests are incredibly hard and there are no study guides, final is cumulative. He will curve a little, but not a lot. The lectures are very boring and do not have the same material as the text. I do not recommend this class.
Good teacher, boring repetitive class.

Civil Rights. Essentially based entirely off of two books that we all individually presented on chapter by chapter. A midterm paper and a final paper. Attendance is mandatory. He teaches with a lot of anecdotes and quirky humor; if you take steps to know him better (visit him in his office, stay behind, etc.), he also will write awesome recs.

Taken Koger for 4 semesters in a row. All As. Tips for his classes: attendance is important (if the class has quizes, questions and essay will come from class notes; if the class is all papers, important info and analysis in class notes). Finals - he always wants your own independent research. Outside of class - always willing to help. Jenkins 312D
Readings every week, 3 papers, and a final. Great class and professor! Definitely take him. He really cares about his students and is always willing to help!

The best Poly Sci teacher at UM! What he teaches he puts on the test. Go to class and you'll get an A. He has review sessions for the midterm and final. All of those who say his class is hard don't actually go to class. He's always available to help! Midterm, Final, and Paper. Simple. Definitely take him!

Ok so I was a Poli Sci major when I went in this class after I wanted to drop out of school. Buddy has super hard tests that he just does not prepare you for he's a bad teacher and just an overall a hole. Outside of class he ain't bad, unfortunately that don't count for sh*t.
Koger was wonderful! His class was interesting and the current news was always discussed. Only a midterm and a final with a paper. The paper isn't too bad. Definitely take him!
Test are extremely difficult. Does not use textbook, instead makes you read 100+ pages per week. No multiple choice questions the entire semester. An extremely difficult grader

So if you're into politics, this is an easy class. Classes revolve around what's currently going on in the U.S. Need to study for tests, entirely based off the lectures (can read the articles for review) Paper thats worth 30-40% of the grade (around 7-8 pages). Always willing to talk with people during office hours. Quirky sense of humor.
Professor Koger made me want to come to class. He is my favorite teacher now! His class was not difficult and his lectures were very interesting.
Makes politics interesting. Which is difficult to do. Funny lectures. He has genuine interest in teaching the course.

Koger was the absolute best. His lectures were fun, interactive, and above all, interesting. His is a very funny guy and is extremely nice. His class is definitely not easy, but it's not impossible either. (somewhere in between) Pay attention to his lectures, take good notes, and read the chapters from the book. It's a wonderful class.
One of the best in the POL department.  Funny, clear and a genuinely nice guy.

Trevor is the freaking man. Wants students to produce good work and is always available outside of class to help you or give you notes. He genuinely cares about all his students and is always open to new ideas. If you can take him then take him

Professor Green is an outstanding teacher. Very smart, knows his field very well and easy to communicate with. Generous with his time as well. If you are going to study anything related to Communications at UM, make sure to meet him and learn from him.
Professor T is amazing! He motivates students and is truly here to help! One of the greatest!!!
Professor Green is the man. He cares about his students, and takes ample time to give students thoughtful feedback. He really cares about the development of his students. 10/10.

Trevor is the best broadcasting teacher to take at UM!!! He's almost like a Dad, he cares so much for everyone and takes so much time giving good feedback. No tests, exams, essays, quizzes. All group project related. He has a great sense of humor too! Highly recommend.

Professor means well and is very nice in person, but the grading criteria is somewhat blurry. When grading the tests, he follows the exact verbiage of the answers on his answer key (created by another professor) and some of the questions can be poorly-worded. If you are okay getting a B in the class then sign up, but most likely wont exceed that.

Nice guy. Fun environment for a lab, despite that it's almost 3 hours long. You'll have to do a lot of learning on your own, whether it's regarding shooting an interview, editing, or studying; very time consuming class. You'll actually learn a lot. Taught as if we've had another production/editing class before. Gives FABULOUS feedback! Fair grader.
he only talks about politics. made me hate psych. dont take

Everyone saying this class is "so hard" just doesn't go to class. If you go to class, write down what he says and study, it is easy. Attendance isn't mandatory and at least half the class never comes, i'm sure those are the people writing about how hard these test are. He also has extra credit quizzes online which bring you up a whole letter grade.
Sucks. Dont take. No one has an A because his tests are so impossible.

talks about politics all class. TA doesn't respond to emails. Tests are extremely difficult and only 1/4 of a typical 200+ class receives some sort of A on his tests. should've retired a while ago.
Sad he's retiring, AMAZING professor who made psych really interesting. Going to every class and studying hard for each of the 4 tests is CRUCIAL for getting a good grade. It's completely doable tho.

You can tell how passionate he is about his work. I liked him alot, but he gets off topic way too much. (3+ times per day) and it is always about trump. i agree with everything dr. gillis is saying but we are here to learn more than debate politics

I took his class online, therefore, it was a bit different, he was allot tougher on his online students, however, his lectures were very interesting but they were very lengthy and sometimes could get boring. You can tell he cares about his students success.

Gillis brings a fun, engaging vibe to his lectures, but don't be fooled - the exams are no joke. Stay on top of attendance and take detailed notes to do well. unstuckstudy ai was a lifesaver for preparing.

Professor Gillis is so funny! If you have the chance to take a class with him do it! The course had four multiple choice tests throughout the semester, as long as you take detailed notes on what he says in class you'll do fine. I will miss him when he retires!
Excellent professor. Class is super easy. Take detailed lecture notes and attend class. Study notes before tests and you should do fine. Really nice professor!

As a professor, I enjoyed class and thought it was well taught and he is approachable.

Dr. Gillis was easily one of my favorite professors at UMiami. I took him for PSY110 and PSY210 and he was great in both. If you go to class and pay attention, you'll do great

Dr. Gillis is a phenomenal professor. The tests are almost entirely lecture based so attending his classes is important for good grades. That said, his lectures are very interesting and he is very personable. If you pay attention, take notes, and follow the study guide, the class is fairly easy.
Textbook not necessary except for EXTRA credit, but, monotone voice and you should create a study group and you'll be fine.

Professor Gillis was an amazing professor and is extremely knowledgeable. His lectures are rly interesting but you do have to show up to class & take notes to do good on his tests. That being said, he gives out a study guide of the topics to study for the test. He also has quizzes where you can get extra credit if you score higher than 75%

Class is easy enough and tests are based on lecture slides. Gilis wants his students to like him, so he likes to make jokes. Sometimes in class he will point out things that will be on exam or explain a more important topic.

Dr Gillis is a really great professor. Attendance isn't technically mandatory, but everything on the test is based on lecture, specifically what he says. The little extra credit quizzes are not worth buying the whole textbook, unless you just want to buy the textbook to study. Overall, he's very funny and says silly things from time to time
Really good professor, textbook isn't really required but is necessary for extra credit.

If you do not come to class, you will fail this class. Super amazing teacher and the lectures were entertaining. 6 quizzes, and each counts as extra credit as long as you get above 75%. Tests were hard and you need to study to do good on them. As ling as you take notes during his lectures and study those notes closely, you will pass.

Great, cool professor. Lectures were fun and easy to understand. If you go to lectures you never have to read and can easily get an A. Very passionate and understanding. Curves and extra credit are great. Has a lot of mercy. Inspired me to change my major to psychology. Great feedback on tests just make sure to attend class or catch up on notes.

Professor Gillis is a great professor however, if you are not proficient in memorization you will not do well in his class. Your grade is comprised of 3 exams and the final therefore if you do bad on those, consequently your grade will be bad as well. You need to attend his lectures to do well on the exams as he pulls questions from what he says.

Gillis is a great professor who gives clear lectures. Everything from the lecture is on the tests and you need a near-perfect memory to do well. During office hours he is condescending and unhelpful but overall his class is easy so don't fret!

His lectures are so fun and he is a funny guy. BUT!!! The tests are HARD and I would never take another psych class with him cuz YOU HAVE TO come to lecture. If you study, you will do fine on the tests.  Your grade is heavily based on the tests so unless you got majority A's on the tests you probably won't receive an A in the class.  Great Professor though but definitely need to go to class and work for your grade.
go to class = good grade

Dr. Gillis is hands down the best PSY110 prof. Overall, you're graded on 4 exams, last one being a non-cumulative "final". love this guy.

Gillis is by far my favorite professor at UM. He cares about his students and is passionate about every subject he teaches. He knows how to keep the class engaged and is clear about exams. I'm not a psych major/minor, but if I were, I'd take every psych class he teaches.

reviews.comment: His tests can definitely be hard, but if you study you will do fine. I definitely recommend him as he makes his lectures very fun and interesting, got me really passionate about psychology.

Gillis basically has bullet points for each topic on the slides and then explains each bullet point/topic in depth. Try not to miss any classes or you will feel behind. Gives extra credit through super easy not mandatory quizzes. Wish I could take him again.

Best professor I've ever had and I'm a junior now. I was only taking this class for my cognate and I still loved this class. The lectures were great and he gives you perfect examples to understand the material. You can tell he actually cares about his students. I wish I could take another class with him.

Really great class and really great professor. Very lecture heavy so take lots of notes. I loved Prof. Gillis. I wish I had done better in his class, but I honestly didn't study for his tests at all. All of his tests are lecture bases, so you have to go to his class. you have to go to the lectures if you don't want to fail. the only source of information you have to study are the words he says during lectures so you NEED TO listen and take notes every single class. if you just study your notes exams will be super easy. all mc exams with xc quizzes that add basically a full 10 points to each exam.
great teacher

He gives no homework and is just an amazing teacher for psychology. Take him !! He gives real-life examples and his tests follow his lectures. The only effort you have to put in is listening to his lectures and taking notes to help you remember things he says. Looking over those notes a night or two before the test will guarantee you an A

Gillis is great for intro psych. If you go to class and take notes you can get an A easily, but part of the class is completing 6 research credits (which he dropped to 4 at the end of the semester) so you have to do like 4 hours of participating in psych research on campus.

Professor Gillis does great at describing content in his lectures. Attendance is not mandatory, but it is necessary. The content on the exams come directly from his lectures. 2nd time taking Gillis because he makes the class fun with jokes here and there and is a sweet guy. Optional quizzes are easy (answers online) and provide a boost to your grade

This class is very manageable. The class grade comprises of 4 exams. But there are also 6 optional credit quizzes that only boost your grade. Showing up to lecture is very important to do good on the exams, but the exams themselves are not too hard. I would take him again if I could.

I took this class asynchronous. grade compromised of 4 exams online, and there were 5 extra credit quizzes. His exams were much harder than the powerpoint lecture and powerpoints provided. this class takes up alot of time, and was not an easy 4.0 class

TAKE Dr. GILLIS!!!! He is probably the BEST psych teacher at UM! He will make his classes easy to sit through and really want you to learn psych. I would take his class again if I could- you could tell that he is very passionate.

He is such a great professor. Lectures are so interesting. His tests are word for word what he says in his lectures so take notes. Super easy class. Adorable professor. Take him, you will not regret it.

One of those professors that makes you want to get up in the morning and actually learn new things. Loved his lectures and used incredible examples that always helped you learn. Gillis is a really cool teacher who makes his lectures interesting and fun to listen to. Very hard class for social psych. I highly recommend not taking him everything is based off of what he says. And if you do not have photogenic memory you are screwed. Take another social psych professor.

Prof Gillis is a good professor, but he doesn't take attendance so it's up to you to go to class or watch the recorded lectures and take notes. Homework quizzes are extra credit which helps and his exams are word for word what he says in his lectures.

he a gem
