Highly recommend! :)

HE IS VERY PASSIONATE ABOUT PSYCHOLOGY, but its clear he is old school and is not too crazy about online class.  He is a Tough Grader, Doesnt permit EXTRA CREDIT, LECTURE HEAVY, A lot of Reading, and Sarcastic

HIS LECTURES ARE ABSOLUTELY AMAZING. HE IS VERY PASSIONATE ABOUT PSYCHOLOGY AND MAKES IT CLEAR CUT UNDERSTANDABLE FOR STUDENTS. ABSOLUTELY THE BEST AND I AM LUCKY TO HAVE HAD HIM TWICE FOR PSYCH CLASSES. THE BEST IN THE GAME, no doubt.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This class was very intriguing, however it is not an easy A. I regret not studying as much as I could have, but I still took away a lot from this class and it made me consider a minor in Psych. Very wise man to talk to. The class makes you think. No homework, but study. Quizzes are online, tests are multiple choice during lecture.
He's a cool and funny guy, lectures are interesting. Tests are pretty straight forward as well. The syllabus will tell you which chapters are on the test, Just read those and you will be fine.

Just take a look at the "Professor Note" on rate my professor left by this teacher for a kind of experience you'll get in class. Apparently an entire section of his class was "slow", and the ones who graded him harshly merely had "low self esteem" OR more logically, they just didn't like the professor they had.

While I realize I sit in the role of student and this professor sits in the role of well - professor...I also feel the need to say I've always felt respect is a two way street. Gillis - although maybe he means well - also gives off the vibe that it's his thoughts or no thoughts at all. No respect for other opinions, even if they're from a textbook.

This teacher is rude, opinionated, not helpful, etc.  I took Psych because it fit my schedule and it was interesting to me; I take GREAT notes, and like most college kids I can't make it to every class; that said, I read the book,studied my more than thorough notes, and discovered his tests are based on random stuff he says, not facts.

Professor Gillis is amazing and this is my favorite class I have taken at UM.  He is super funny and his lectures are clear.  SHOW UP TO CLASS and take notes on what he says and you should get an A.  He gives hints to questions on the exams during lecture.
he goes over so much in one lecture and often tells you what to expect on the exma

Imagine the cutest old man in your head and that is Dr. Gillis. He's a great professor too. The exams are easy if you go to class and take notes. I will take him for every psych class I take at this school if I can. I highly recommend you do the same because I heard Dr. Carver's PSY 110 class is much more difficult.

Great professor, very passionate about the subject. He's funny and tells great stories and gives examples which make the material easier to remember. Attendance is not mandatory but the tests are lecture-based and you should pay attention and take notes if you want to do well. He gives 5 extra credit quizzes, which can raise your grade a lot.

He is a great professor, definitely knows what he talks about. He helps you if you show you are willing to work. Attendance is not mandatory but you should go to every lecture. Class is hard especially if you don't like memorizing bunch of stuff. If you need to take psych take him, otherwise don't take psych because its definitely not easy.

He's entertaining and straight forward with his tests. Attendance not mandatory but should go and must pay attention if you want an A because he asks questions based on lecture. Consistent with lectures from previous years. Has 5 points extra credit if you do quizzes (based on book). Need to buy book for course code but can get by w/o reading it.

His lectures are confusing and he  goes through the material quickly. There are no power points. Prepare to teach  yourself from the textbook! He even offended two students for asking him to clarify specific concepts. He is not approachable when it comes to asking questions or help for that matter. The tests are hard & he is a tough grader.

Love Gillis!!! I took AP Psych last year (got a 3, wish I had studied) so at first the class was boring because it was info I already knew and didn't care to re-learn. The course definitely picked up and Gillis really knows how to keep you interested. Although it's still a review for me, I want to go to class because of how fun he makes it.

Just go to as many lectures as you can and you are guaranteed an A in the class.  His test questions come directly from lecture, so you will miss some even if you read everything in the book.  Barely used my textbook.  Make sure you do all of the extra credit quizzes he talks about.  Lectures are super clear.  He prepares you for higher levels well

Gillis is the man! His lectures are very interesting and he tells great stories! Pay attention to the stories because they will show up on your test. His extra point online quizzes are a great grade booster, but if you go to every class and study your notes you won't need to rely on the quizes! Wish I could take this class again.
Gives great extra credit opportunities. Just pay attention in class and you'll do well. Great professor!
Favorite teacher at UM. You have to go to lecture to pass though, a lot of what is on tests are things mentioned in class and not at all in the textbook.
Awesome good, funny, makes class interesting.  Tests are 100% of the grade which sucks.  Don't have to go to class but suggested.  Tests are not too hard but definitely require studying

Show up to his class, take notes on the concepts emphasizes, and read those notes for 4 hours the night before tests and you can get an A. His lectures are funny and clear (especially the comments on Freud).
Amazing teacher! Loved going to his class. i never missed a lecture. makes material fun and exciting. very fair and approachable teacher. definitely recommend

Really good lecturer, and is very clear about what he wants. But A's are difficult to get. Grades on his own system that's a bit confusing at first, but you'll get used to it. Overall, for an introductory course, I really liked this course.

Dr Gillis is a great teacher but he would be better teaching a 400 or 500 level class. He is way too smart for an entry level course. He moves very quickly and expects his students to follow along. If you didn't take AP Stats in high school, this class is going to be very very challenging.

Gillis was one of the first professors I had at UM and I decided to major in psychology after his intro class. He's a really smart and funny guy and wants his students to do well. Most of the exams was based on the lectures so I wouldn't recommend skipping class even though attendance is not mandatory. Also he really hates astrology

It's hard to review him: he's *technically* a good professor, but his personality really prevented me from enjoying this class. I couldn't relate to him, and so his lectures were better spent reading the book or doing other work instead. Basically, most people will like him, but a few will find his personality (or ego) a large obstacle to overcome.

Rod Gillis is the man. He is extremely clear on what you have to do to do well in his class. He's a funny guy, and keeps class interesting. If you don't show up to class, you won't do well. however, because most of his tests are based off things he says in class.
Great teacher, incredibly funny, and always keeps his lectures interesting.
Took his freshman psych class and assured me in my choice to declare a psych major. Absolutely loved him and laughed all the time in his class. Great teacher!

Great professor, classes are funny and interesting. I didn't got very good grades on test but I still love his teaching style, it was like a old grandpa telling stories. But you have to study for it for sure.
Great professor, though I didn't got very good grade at tests but still I love his teaching style. He makes me feel like a old grandpa telling stories.

BEST TEACHER I HAVE EVER HAD!! seriously i randomly signed up for this class to fill my schedule and i'm so glad i did!!! He isn't boring at all and explains everything very well. I have recommended his class to so many of my friends and wish i could take more classes with him!

One of my favorite professors ever! Test questions come straight from the lecture notes, so be sure to attend the lectures, even though it's not mandatory. He's hilarious and does a really great job of keeping the entire class engaged in his lectures.

Lectures are kinda funny and interesting, some questions are based on lecture.  Others are on the readings.  Lectures were posted online.  So pretty much an easy class if you stay on top of everything.  Test were MC

Dr. Gillis is a great professor! His lectures are interesting and can be funny. He class consists of 3 exams and a final, all MC. In order to get a good grade in his class, attend all the lectures, do the extra credit online quizzes, and memorize your lecture notes (his tests are based off them). This class can be considered an easy A. Take Gillis!
Take him and you won't regret. He can come off as sassy sometimes, but in reality he's a very smart guy and he knows how to make the class laugh. P.S. He hates astrology and stupid people XD
Great professor!He makes the class so interesting that you don't want to miss any of his classes. The test won't be that hard if you go to his lecture.
Easily my favorite professor this semester. Attendance is not mandatory but if you go to class the tests will be a breeze. He makes psychology interesting and easy to learn.

I was only relatively interested in psychology, but after taking his class I absolutely fell in love with it. It is evident that he is very interested in what he teaches and always does his best to make sure you understand everything. Very funny professor, very engaging, and gives great examples that let you remember the material. Take his class!

Gillis is one of those rare professors who is both rigorous and entertaining. If you take good notes in class, you'll be fine for quizzes/exams.  As long as you don't love astrology (you'll see why if you take his class), Gillis is a great choice.

This guy is awesome, he makes the class. He explained everything clearly and was very willing to help students. He was also very entertaining and funny. And his tests are super  easy (or at least they felt easy because of his teaching). This was the only class I looked forward to every day this semester.

LOVE THIS TEACHER. He explains everything very well and in an organized matter. All you have to do is read the side notes in the textbook readings he assigns. Take him! He is such an entertaining, funny, and cute old man :) This is probably the only class in my life that i actually enjoy going to.

My favorite professor by far! He's great and he keeps things so interesting, always telling jokes and making even the dry topics seem entertaining. I can't come up with one bad thing to say about him, highly recommend! Do your work and go to class and you'll do well
Attendance not required, lot of random memorization.  Pretty easy class overall.

He's GREAT! I didn't care much for Psych, but after taking his class I decided to make it one of my two majors. He's funny, he's sincere and I couldn't wait to go to his class. Don't take his class if you're not planning on showing up. Almost everything comes from his lectures. Take good notes!!!

I had class with him last semester. I wasnt fairing well and so I went in to talk with him. I told him my story (im a junior, I switched in as a soph) and asked what I could do. He suggested that I look smart, maybe it was in the way I was studying, or maybe UM is just too hard for me. Im a senior now with a 3.4 GPA.. Not saying im mad but hurt...

Even though I had trouble with this class, I respect Gillis. He tells stories of his own life and funny things to explain the material. The class can get boring though, it is a lecture course. Take notes and read the book because the tests are hard. There are 4 of them including the final, but he does a weird grading system so a 60 is like a C.

great prof! attendance not mandatory but go cuz he makes questions based on things he says in class. hes very clear and keeps it interesting. funny guy. easy A even without the curve if you read over lectures and very involved with his students. wants the best for us. GO GILLIS!

Literally the BEST professor I have ever had! I have never had a teacher who explained things so clearly and in multiple ways so that all students would understand it. Not only that, he takes a genuine interest in his tests and whether or not they are good and how the students perform. Absolutely wonderful, take him!
great prof. recommended. just show up to class and memorize his notes that he hands you on a silver platter

Take if you're good at memorization. I didnt do as well as I would've liked, bc I was unable to memorize everything.  Gillis drops hints as to whats on his tests you just gotta pay attention. Everything is multiple choice.  Very funny and smart.  Take him if possible

Such a nice teacher who's easy to listen to. He's funny, smart, and really accessible. His tests aren't too difficult, as long as you come to class and take notes for the tests, you'll have a great and easy time!

I LOVED this professor. After his introductory class I decided to take a psychology minor. His lectures are very-very interesting. ANd if you don't miss any, you easily get A or B on tests. He is really great.

Did not like this class at all all the professor does is make jokes instead of going over the material ! you basically have to just teach yourself ! even though he doesn't test on everything in a book.
Fantastic professor. Show up and pay attention and you'll be fine. He makes lectures really interesting and he is a really funny guy. He knows how to make good tests too.
BEST PROFESSOR AT THE UNIVERSITY OF MIAMI! Take him! he makes the class extremely interesting! Thanks to him i changed my major to psychology!

If you're taking Psych, you want to have Gillis. He is the ideal professor. He covers everything in lecture, he's funny, and his tests are a guaranteed A if you read over his outlines and attend class. A+ if you read the book also, which he wrote. Loved this class! He curves the tests, and for our final he gave a huge curve just to be nice. Take hi

He is an awesome professor! Even if you aren't interested in psychology, you will find this class very interesting. I walked in thinking I would hate the class, but I ended up loving it and switched my major to psych! It's an easy A if you attend class, take good notes, and read the book. He has a great sense of humor and cares about his students.

Either you love him or hate him. I thought he was hilarious up until he decided to be extremely unfair and not at all understanding when I had to miss a test for a personal reason and refused to allow me to take it early. Overall though, the class is not very difficult, even though he acts like it is and takes everything way too seriously.

Dr. Gillis was definitely the best professor I had during my first semester. He's interesting and hilarious during lecture. He makes psychology really fun and easy to understand. He was very kind and helpful when I asked for a recommendation letter, and he definitely wants his students to do well. Definitely take him, he is one of the best!

He is hilarious and influenced me in declaring psychology as my major. Awesome teacher. Just make sure you take awesome notes in class and read from the text for the few test questions that arent from the lecture. he is awesome

Dr. Gillis is a wonderful professor with an excellent sense of humor. He makes it easy to understand and remember psychological terms and concepts through his interesting stories and examples and practical style of teaching. I highly recommend him.

He is the best professor I have had at UM. Switched my major to Psychology because of his class. Make sure to go to every lecture and take good notes and it is an easy A. I studied for exams the night before and did extremely well. 3 exams and then a final, all multiple choice. He is also very funny and sarcastic. Going to the class is enjoyable!

His class is probably one of the reasons I switched my second major from creative writing to psychology. Funny and engaging, and yeah - a little bit sarcastic  (but honestly, if you can't handle it - drop the class). If you study enough for the tests you'll do better than fine. I did: kept up with the readings, went to every class, got the A.

Funny guy, gives you an outline for the notes and expects you to fill in the blanks... I liked the class until the second test... very difficult questions and he explained it was going to be that way THE DAY OF THE TEST!!! not cool making it so hard :(. he did curve it but it didnt matter the curve barely affected my F. ill keep the class though :(

He is extremely funny and tries to tie in the lectures to everyday life or crazy jokes...that way it's kept interesting. He is very offensive to those that believe in Astrology though, so if you have any pro-astrology views, he will make you cry. you should definately come to class and read the current chapters though. very friendly teacher.
He is not nice, he is offensive, and tries to find ways to take credit away from students.
Great guy. Easy class. Ive missed 12 classes and i dont study and I have a B+. He keeps it interesting too. He also has a tendency to be slightly offensive without caring. It's great :)Love him.

Great professor super interesting super funny I just didn't do well because he ain't easy you have to actually study going to class isn't enough you need to read the book and your notes very throughly or you will not do well on the tests.

Very interesting class, the best I've taken at UM. He is an excellent lecturer, and his lecture outlines make it crystal clear. His tests are very, very easy if you study and go to class every day. I did not miss a class, but that's because it was so interesting I wanted to go! He's funny and has great stories to tell. Definitely take Dr. Gillis.

Great professor!!!!! i know a lot from him! i decide to take psy as my second major after taking his class. he doesn't require attendance but i strongly encourage you to attend his class b/c its so useful!!!
Great teacher, interesting class! Take notes because the tests are mostly based off them. There are a few questions from the practice book, but he'll tell you before the test if he put them on there.

His lectures are crystal clear and always interesting. Take thorough notes and you can study from them for the tests, without using the textbook, and still manage an A. He clarifies any questions that you may have after class. Do not talk during lectures because he will become annoyed. Overall, I highly recommend anyone to take this class.

You would have to work hard to not get an A in this class. You don't need to be good at math or psychology to do well because he dumbs it down for you. Follow his class examples, study the quizzes, learn the different statistical tests and you're set for an A, maybe A+. He seems a little angry or frustrated sometimes which is the only drawback.

This class is a joke. I took AP Psychology in high school and got a 5 on the test. Since I loved AP Psych so much I decided to take it again. I started failing his tests. Tests based on what he says, not actual text. Pick a different teacher.

Probably one of the best professors I've had at UM. He is very helpful, and gives many examples from his personal life to clarify concepts learned class. This class is not easy, but as long as you go to class you shouldn't have trouble getting a B at least. Tests are all multiple choice.

Great stats teacher.  Cares about students and them actually learning! Tests are fair, never asks questions on anything he never said in class.  engaging to listen to, makes a dry subject interesting. If you want to learn anything about stats take him.

Dr.Gillis is an amazing professor here at UM. He cares about his students and is extremely funny in class. He has the funniest jokes. The book is strongly recommended and it is not an easy A but if you pay attention and take notes you would probably do well. Attendance is recommended due to he explains important topics in each  class that will be o
I took his PSY 110 class and PSY 204 class and he's great and really easy compared to other professors. And he's most certainly not a misogynist! lol

Best teacher I've had at UM. His lectures are interesting and worth going to, and as long as you listen in class you will get an A. I didn't even take notes and I was able to get an A easily, HIGHLY recommended teacher.
The test are fair. To get an A you need to go to class, take notes and read the book. Prof. Gillis makes class interesting and its easy to understand what he says. Highly recommended!!
Good guy. Makes the class pretty interesting and worthwhile going to. His exams are a bit difficult. Overall a  good professor to take
I love Rod Gillis, he is smart, funny, and tells jokes during class. His exams are easy as long as you pay attention to the examples in lecture.

Overall, the class is very easily, but for you to get and A, you have to go to class and take good notes.  Gillis tends to make stupid comments about the class, but just simply ignore them, cause he teaches pretty good.

I think Gillis is a great professor. His lectures are interesting and as long as you go to class and take good notes, you should be fine on the tests. It wasn't a difficult class at all. I would definitely recommend that you take it with him.

He taught what he was going to test on which is refreshing !! He's a little corny and talks about his mom and dog a lot but overall good class .. take him .. u can pass it ! ((make sure to take notes.. most of the tests are from the lecture))

He grades fair and teaches effectively. However, he constantly complains about how our generation sucks which takes up valuable class time. He lets his own personal problems intefer with teaching. For ex, calling us "stupid" one time because no one could answer his question and he was frustrated that someone took down his Obama sign.

i took gillis fall 08 and every time i went to class i left upset and offended. he called our class "retarded" twice, and laughed that our section is no longer the honors class - we were just "regular." one morning, no one answered a question and he called us "slow" and asked if we did qualudes before class. i got an a- but take foote instead.

To get a B, go to class and take good notes and study them...for the A you will have to read the book as well. As with other psychology classes, the material is not difficult, but it does take time to study because its alot of information. After this class, I made psych my mionor. TAKE w/GILLIS!!

he is awesome! makes jokes related to the topic, you understand everything he says, he doesnt take attendance, but the tests are 95% on his lectures, i wasnt interested in psychology before, but now it seems like its so easy to understand because of him. if you need to take psy 110, take gillis, you wont regret it at all.
Best Psy teacher EVER!

Alright, so although attendance isn't mandatory, it is. He doesn't take attendance, but basically all test questions come from lectures. There are few questions on the tests that are derived solely from the book. It's interesting, he's funny, and it's a good way to spend 50 minutes. Take him.

Fun guy, makes a lot of jokes throughout the class and makes his lectures fun and easy to understand. he puts his outlines online but you need to go to class to fill them in. great class, one of my favorites

I took PSY 110 with Professor Gillis last semester, and after transferring to Smith College, I'm taking Abnormal Psychology, Psychology of Adolescence, and Intro to Research Methods. Most of what I'm learning this semester is review because of how unbelievably comprehensive Professor Gillis's course is.

Gillis is a really good professor.  I highly recommend taking his class.  He is interesting, engaging, and funny.  His tests are pretty straightforward.  You need to attend the lectures if you expect to do well in the class.  The book is very helpful, so read the chapters, although you can probably manage to do well without it.
Great teacher, really funny. Tests are based mainly on lecture notes and a little bit from the book. Lecture notes posted on blackboard

Gillis was a prety interesting prof for an intro class. Overall, the clas wasn't too hard but the tests were a bit tricky. Definitely go to class; you get a lot out of his lectures. The only problem I had with him is that he had a lot of opinions I disagreed with, but he was a good teacher. I def recommend him if you don't mind scathing comments.
His tests are not very hard. You just need to go to class. He is interesting to listen to but he has a lot of views that I do not agree with.
Had him for statistics...he's pretty good at explaining everything and keeping your interest, but kind of a jerk if you ask stupid questions.  Overall a good choice if you're forced to take stat.

He is a REAL jerk! I don't know hoow he got so many positive ratings. He is very condescending and is anti-female. I got an A in his class but I had to work my butt off for it and I have a 4.0. He is VERY unwilling to help students and makes snarky comments when you attempt to ask for help.
I just took this class for Summer 1 and I was stressed out because it went so fast which I love/hate about summer classes. He is a great teacher though and pretty funny.

Great speaker, can easily keep your attention for the most part...taking notes via laptop is your best bet and write down AS MUCH AS POSSIBLE. Study the notes well and read and an A is definitely do-able.

I love Dr Gillis! He is my fav professor hands down! He is such a great professor.  I literally looked forward to his lectures.  He is extremely funny and intelligent, and he has a great sense of humor.  He makes the class fun with little stories.  I got an A in all 3 classes.  Take VERY detailed notes and study them word by word!
Gillis is the best ever

a few tests and that's about it. Each test is about 60 questions long, all are multiple choice. Most information comes from his lectures, which he makes very interesting. Most of the time, his examples are hilarious. I recommend a laptop in class. His outlines are online and it's easy to just type up the answers during class time in the outline.

1 of the coolest teachers at UM..makes the class interesting and provides examples that u will remember..just attend class and pay attention and the info will stick in ur head for the test..funny guy and curves the grades too..highly recommended! :)

Very smart/funny guy. He has the kind of personality that's allways entertaining. VERY good lecturer, he engages the students, makes interesting anecdotes, and at the same time he wastes no time getting through the material.    I HONESTLY THINK DR. GILLIS SHOULD GIVE A SEMINAR TO MANY OF THE PROFESSORS HERE ON HOW TO PROPERLY DO A GREAT LECTURE.

I absolutely love Dr. Gillis! I found him to be very interesting and entertaining and always looked forward to his class. I would definitely recommend him if you want to learn a lot and enjoy psychology.
Great class, very interesting. Just take notes in class and then study them and you will get an A or at least a B. Not a hard class and not boring.
The best professor i have ever had!! very funny guy!!

The class isnt that bad, but the professor is very opinionated, which is very ironic considering that he is a psychology professor.  He makes it known on the first few classes that he HATES accupuncture!

Dr. Gillis has a sense of humor and has an understandable way of teaching.  I suggest you make a few friends in the class to study with.  And ask questions (he likes it when students are involved).  Dr. Gillis also gave HW which were extra credit [18 points].  Great professor!
The trick is to take down notes. The anecdotes he uses to explain something usually appear on the test, so write them down.

His class was easy if you did the following: went to class with a laptop and voice recorder. He's a really good, funny, professor who knows what he's talking about and makes the time go by without too much pain.  If you take notes and listen to the lectures, you'll get a B. If you do those two, and read the book, you'll get an A no problem.
he teaches stats very well and his tests and quizes are fair. if you study you can definitely get an A in his class.
Dr. Gillis is not a very difficult prof.  Just go to every class.  Get all the notes.  More helpful to read the book as well.  I found it very enjoyable and was able to really grasp the concepts.
I took this class. I studied. It did not go well for me. We all took really good notes and shared them.
Excellent at lectures and always amusing

Gillis takes some getting used to. At first, his lecturing techniques completely confused me, but I took my labtop with me and was able to get almost every word he said down...then the tests were a little better. The tests are touch if you don't go to class...so go! He's funny and entertaining and super sarcastic. In the end, I loved his class.
Who the heck is Rodney Pitcher? All this guy talks about is Rodney Pitcher, and it's sooo annoying!

Easy class. C'mon, people. Little effort is required - show up to class, write down everything the guy says, and study that for the tests. If you can't get a respectable grade in Dr. Gillis' class, then you need to brush up on your study habits and motivation.

At first I rarely went to class so I couldn't complain. But then I started going and the class still sucked. I thought the tests were very hard despite my really thorough notes and the notes of some classmates.
Great teacher! Interesting lectures with funny stories to keep your attention. As long as you take good notes and study, the tests are easy. I loved him!
This guy brings his problems into class and vents about them claiming that they're examples of psyche...
One of my favorite teachers ever. Had no interrest in Psych before, and am now considerring more classes. He's a hilarious man, and really loves teaching. I love Rod Gillis.
Great guy..i love this class, he's awesome.
Presents the information clearly and it's obvious he actually wants his students to learn and understand the material
His class is great! He makes his lectures interest by adding anecdotes and helping you remember the content. Possibly the best faculty input I had on choosing my major (psychology).
No Comments
The lectures are actually interesting!
I aced his class, but he was a total moron.  And boring as all hell.

Fascinating lecturer, clear, and concise.  He trims things down to a manageable level and gets right to the point.  He also provides very funny anicdotes to help you remember the lessons.  He's a great prof.  And he's a good hypnotist, too.
i had him for psy 204 and psy 444.. awesome teacher got an a in both... im now in grad skool n taking his classes has helped a lot
Awesome class, tests are a little bit difficult though. :)
No Comments
Awful!
Learned Alot! Got an A
Relatively easy class, and he's easy to pay attention to.
No Comments
He's the man!
He's great for the lower level classes, but YOU DO NOT WANT TO TAKE AN UPPER DIVISION COURSE WITH HIM.

Dr. Gillis is hilarious!  He makes lectures interesting, informative, and entertaining.  His tests are fair and can be aced with sufficient studying.  My advice would be to disregard the uninformed review below.
Tests are difficult... basically only from lectures and picks the most specific little thing for most of his questions.. he was boring and i acutally liked psycholgy before and hated it after hin!!!

GREAT teacher-The tests are not easy at all, but I learned so much from that class and truly enjoyed his lectures. This man definitely knows what he's talking about, has great speaking skills, and is willing to help out in any way. Tests are mostly based on lectures, so show up to class!
best teacher at this university... actually everyone in the psych dept is wonderful (except durel)
Dr. Gillis makes even non-Psych enthusiasts interested, as he is an intriguing lecturer. However, his tests are NOT fun.

I had him for 204.  Really works with you. Talk to him 1-on-1 if you can - really interesting guy. Everything is from the lecture, although reading the book before class prevents you from getting lost. He stresses a lot on concepts and theory, so don't expect too many easy-plug-&-chug problems.
Fast talker... can not hold your attention for very long... very sarcastic... tells a lot of jokes but overall not a very good teacher
No Comments

He is a very good teacher, very entertaining. You have to go to class because the tests are based primarily on his lectures with a few things on the book. Very interesting class with an amazing teacher.

He is a great teacher. he tells a lot of stories as examples for the concepts so they are all easily understood.  for the tests, if you know your lecture notes well, you'll do fine.  a few questions from the book, most all are from the lectures. come to class to take good notes!

Best teacher I have had so far at UM. Very talented lecturer, and outstanding teacher. In case you were wondering his tests come straight from the lectures with only a few questions from the book. By far my favorite lecturer, he is a natural at speaking.

Best teacher I have had so far at UM. Very talented lecturer, and outstanding teacher. In case you were wondering his tests come straight from the lectures with only a few questions from the book. By far my favorite lecturer, he is a natural at speaking.

Dr. Gillis is a good teacher, who makes statistics about as interesting as it can be.  His tests are not too hard, and he gives extra credit. It's funny to watch him be sarcastic to people who complain
