reviews.comment: This professor acts like he cares by offering to answer any questions but REFUSES to answer anything that is related to exams. Hyper-fixates on one or two concepts on the exam, throws curveballs regarding particular experiments, and weighs each question to be 5 points out of 20. If you study until your eyeballs collapse on you, you'll get a C+ max
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Literally the kindest, most passionate prof at UM. He is so intelligent and so good at teaching. His class is also very easy and fair. It's all multiple choice, open book exams. Take his class, learn a lot, and have fun. Also: take as many classes as you can with him. He is so great you'll learn a lot about topics you didn't even know you'd love.

This class is made up of 4 grades: 3 exams and the final. You can do great on 3 exams and still end with below an A. He does not curve anything and he will not give you your exam back to see what you got wrong. All the exams are open note but you have to submit each question individually. His lectures are slow & boring & attendance isn't mandatory.

Don't take. Tests are 20 qs/final is 40. U miss a few-lose hella points. Doesn't drop/curve. Gives bs extra credit. Seems easy but qs are ridiculous. He's always apologizing/saying he cares but its bs. He doesn't let u see your tests so you can't improve. btw, I got all EC points and read everything. Naïvely didn't play the game, should've tho.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The workshops for his class are literally all extra credit, so go to them! Dr. Groff is so personal and kind, even in an online class of 150 students. Take notes on what he questions you, they will show up as test questions. I honestly barely studied for this class, just read the textbook and attended lectures. Grade is based on only tests though

Great professor and incredibly nice. Always willing to help students and you can tell he cares so much about his classes. Material isn't easy but read book, take notes, and go to class and you'll do fine

Groff made botany very interesting. Its obvious how much he loves it. Participation isnt mandatory but I went and barely studied because he repeatedly asks questions to the class that are almost identical to those on exams. Botany is more technical than I presumed itd be, but fairly easy to grasp. Got an A+. (Open note exams for online)

This has to be the best professor Ive ever taken in my life. Caring, passionate, accessible, and knows how to teach. For students looking to take him, the material isnt necessarily easy but he does an amazing job of teaching it which makes it easy. Attendance isnt mandatory, however it is EXTREMELY beneficial to your grade. Amazing prof, 1000/10

Dr. Groff is hands down the most caring and passionate professor I have ever met. The class is inherently difficult, but if you listen to his suggestions about studying you will do well. Hes also super accessible and will go out of his way to help you. Hes a great lecturer but can be a bit redundant. Still, definitely a top prof in the bio dept.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Execellent teacher. Awesome assigned readings. You'll learn in a lot in his class and it's not difficult either. Show up, read the assigned readings, and you'll be good.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Really great professor. You could pass by just showing up to class and taking notes on the lectures, he does a really good job of specifying what exactly will show up on the test. However, if you want a really good grade and understanding of the material, you should read the text book. Also, GO TO THE WORKSHOPS, they're extra credit and attendance.

Groff is quite decent as a lecturer, but be aware that he doesn't usually finish going through the slides, but important concepts are marked. Lots of textbook reading, and you have mandatory workshops as well. I struggled with the class as a Bio major who did well in other Bio courses, because I found his exam questions difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Groff is the best. Also note that even though it might not be listed, ask him and you can receive a writing credit. He is so kind, caring and extremely passionate. You would be missing out by not taking him, especially if you are interested in botany at all.

Dr. Groff is a great professor and really cares about being fair. The class is an easy premed course but is a lot of memorization. If you at least read the textbook and takes notes on his PowerPoints you should have no problem getting an A, but def study for exams bc you do need to know the material. And the extra credit from workshops helps a ton!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: When I first enrolled in Groff's class I was nervous, but I LOVED him and this class. Groff cares so much about his students and is so incredibly passionate about Biology, which makes the material really fun to learn. You will have to work for this grade, but if you go to class, take his advice, write detailed notes, read the textbook, easy A or B.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Get ready to study the book throughly. Go to class! If you miss class you most likely won't do well on the tests. Really emphasizes what's on the test during class as well as highlighting things in red on the powerpoint that are most important, so study that!
Just be prepared to read the book thoroughly. As long as you do that and read the PPT slides, you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Groff is alright. He is a very nice guy and is committed to learning each student's name by the end of the semester which is a really nice gesture. Lectures are straightforward usually and he tells you exactly what you need to know for the exam but need to read. Only bad thing is he didn't give us final grades by the P/F deadline so we had to guess
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Groff is a nice guy who is clearly smart, but his lectures are so boring and the book work is insurmountable. The class overall is super boring and I Highly recommend not taking his class unless there are no other options.

This class is pretty easy overall if you are willing to do the required reading. Lectures can get boring, but the information you need to know is marked on the powerpoints. If you have questions, just email him rather than asking during lectures because it throws him off. The final grade is based on 4 exams and 24 extra credit points from workshop.

He is overall a nice person but in his lectures he usually goes off on tangents and does not go through material needed for the tests and still assess you on it even if we're not near it. You are able to reach him out of class but his own policies cause major problems including reviewing tests and so on. Overall nice guy but wouldn't retake.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Groff is kind. He really cares for his students. He teaches many courses and students so his time is limited but he'll try his best to accommodate you. His exams can be VERY specific, read the textbook, take notes from it, focus on the red highlighted things on powerpoints. See what he focuses on in lecture. READ THE TEXT, trust me. READ.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Groff is amazing! Ive never had a prof that is more passionate about their subject! Lecture slides are always online so if you miss class its not a huge deal but youll miss out on his actual lecture which is more in depth. A lot of memorization but he is very clear about what he wants you to memorize.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He's honestly, so annoying. Not very considerate under challenging circumstances. His eliteness jumps out :/ I had to take this class for a cognate and he acts like you're majoring in this. I hated the class so much.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Groff is an amazing professor. He tells you exactly what he expects and makes it easy to accomplish that with a little bit of effort. Very passionate and loves plants which is so interesting actually. I would definitely take, just make a relationship with him and dont be afraid to ask questions. Will give LOR if you get to know him!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Not the best professor. very disappointing class as the concepts were not made clear and he skipped over important things

I highly recommend taking Dr. Groff! Read the textbook & pay attention during lecture & you will do well. Go to his office hours & send him emails when you have questions (He usually answers within minutes!!)He's nice, genuine, and passionate! He really cares for his students. His exams are multiple choice and are graded fairly.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Groff is one of my favorite professors at UM without a doubt! He is always willing to make time for his students and go the extra mile because he actually cares about the material and his students' learning. Use the textbook and notice what he focuses on in class, and you will do well. Helped me so much in future classes
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Honestly I did not enjoy his class at all. He gives some pointers for the exams sometimes in class but going is not that helpful. He puts a lot of the diagrams he says you have to memorize on the test itself so don't stress too much about the diagrams. You do have to study a lot to do well on the tests, though. LOTS of memorization.

Groff is a good lecturer but he was kinda repetitive with some stuff and that caused him to get behind and not cover all the material before the test. I read the book, but I'm not sure how much it really helped. Just know the stuff in red on his powerpoints and if he points it out in class know it. If you study its easy, if you don't its hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: very by the book. mostly focuses on what he goes over in class. Taking notes from the book as he recommends helps. tries to be helpful but it doesn't always resonate with students. Exams are weirdly specific about what he goes over in class, but final was really easy. gives EC for coming to workshops which is only helpful if you get a nice leader
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Omg, i hated him. his lectures were useless, he expects you to know minutae from the textbook and lectures, and he is not clear at all. the few times i spoke to him, he has been so patronizing. honestly, just take another professor if you can. but, if youre stuck with him, he does label on his powerpoints stuff in red that you should know.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Where to even begin. This class was the most torturous thing I have ever had to do. Groff's lectures are all over the place and he literally expects you to know the entire textbook. Unfortunately, for people that actually take other classes and have a life that is not possible. I'd rather retake organic chem then deal with this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Best choice for BIL160. Do what he tells you to which is read ahead for the assigned chapters and go to lecture. His lectures are okay but in them he makes it very clear what you need to know by putting "KNOW!" on certain slides and giving study guides out before the tests. Lots of memorization and very little in-depth concept questions on tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: His class is mad easy, but you also learn a lot. Only good person in the bio department from what I've experienced.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr Groff is caring and respectful of his students. His class taught me a lot about plants and he was very knowledgeable in the subject. I liked that the class was seminar style, and that it could also be taken as a writing credit. I def recommend !

Don't understand the negative reviews- one of the nicest most genuine profs. Tries to schedule every single student to individually reviews exams. Not a hard science class at all. EVERYTHING is on the slides, come to class and read the book for clarity.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Groff is so caring of his students and really works with you to do well. He is understanding and gives great lectures. His class is very interesting and engaging. We went on field trips which were very fun as well!

Definitely talked up by many, but not nearly as bad a choice as recent comments suggest. Gives good study tips during lectures and has no surprises AT ALL on exams which is a blessing. Always smiling and legitimately trying to lecture as he is paid to do, but 100% willing to open additional Office hour slots and thank you for your hard work.

Paul Groff was not a good teacher for this class. He was clearly stressed out and overwhelmed by the big lecture hall. He never answered questions outside of class besides saying "I said that in lecture." He is extremely passive aggressive towards the class and wastes tons of class time by being so. I definitely don't recommend.

Groff teaches you everything that will be on your exam. First study everything in bold, red or KNOW! on his ppts. THATS WHAT HE WILL TEST ON. Yes, there is a lot of memorization, but that is what biodiversity and evolution material requires anyway!! He is the BEST BIL 160 teacher at UM. His exams are easy. If you don't know something, thats ON YOU!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Okay so to the person that says people that give Groff bad ratings are those who don't go to class and do poorly on his tests... I went to EVERY class and got an A and still think he's a terrible prof who doesn't teach in class but still expects you to self learn everything in ridiculous detail. Future 160 students... you have been warned

Heres the deal- if you read the book and memorize every chart ( theres a lot ) youll pass. Lectures werent great and he just says STUDY and his meetings are pointless. He expects you to study 30-40 hours a week. Workshop is a breeze though.
The 5 most recent 1's he received on ratemyprofessor are from people that don't go to class and do badly on his tests. Don 't listen to them, he is a great professor and an awesome teacher.

One of the worst professors here. Expects you to learn all the material yourself. His class is a waste of time and his office hours are limited to be 5 minutes. Belittles you every time you ask a question. Honestly a piece of trash. I don't understand why students would have to pay tuition to take his class. Do not take him at all.

Honestly, don't take him. He spends over half the lecture lecturing us about the right way or studying, and how we should not ask him what to study because we should know everything. He insists students ask him questions, but then refuses to properly answer them. He belittles you in class, and expects too much for a Bio 2 freshman class.

Dr. Groff's lectures are pretty pointless. You barely learn anything, I don't understand all of the great reviews he's been given. Sure he's nice and wants his students to do well but you have to teach yourself everything! His study guides are pointless and his exams are all memorizing stupid charts and figures. 10/10 Would not recommend!

Don't get me wrong, Groff is a really nice and caring guy... With that said, unless you enjoy teaching yourself 80% of the material on the exam then DO NOT TAKE HIM! I got an A in his class so I'm not bashing him cause I did poorly. He is just a bad professor who spends 30 min of class saying how he wants you to do well and only 25 min teaching you

I truly enjoyed Dr. Groff's botany class. He is a very energetic and caring individual. I would absolutely take his class again, one of my all time favorites at UM without a doubt. Always smiling, always willing to help.

Paul Groff is a classical example of "empty vessels make the most noise." While he purports to put in so much effort, in reality he does nothing for the class or for his students. Office hours are limited to ten minutes. Grade is based solely on exams. And his lectures are always many chapters behind where you need to be for the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Groff is really caring and sweet. He tries his hardest to make the material interesting and relevant to your life, even in a non-majors course. His tests were very fair as he believes in "throwing balls that you can hit." The specific course I took (BIL109) was extremely easy if you learned literally anything in high school biology

Dr. Groff is really nice and yeah he knows everyone's names but is annoying in the fact he is super vague about some exams. First two were easy but third was literally so specific. No critical thinking at all just straight memorizing. And if the class doesn't know an answer he says we should have read and doesn't answer the question. Annoying to me
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: I took this class for one of my STEM cognates and because I remembered anatomy from high school well I didn't struggle. He presents a reasonable amount of material  for a non-majors course and is very helpful and thorough during lectures. Attendance is not mandatory but he stresses that you attend lectures to learn. I'd take him again.

Dr. Groff is an amazing professor. You can tell he wants each and every student to succeed, and even remembers everyones' name! He's straightforward with what he expects. If you put in the work, you'll do well.

Dr. Groff is hands down the greatest professor that I have had in my experience as an undergrad. He deeply cares about every student, which is evident. He even learns and remembers many of the students names in large classes, which I have never had any professor do. He is very passionate about the material and his lectures are amazing.  TAKE HIM!

Being a workshop leader with Dr. Groff was great. He cares about his interactions with his workshop leaders much more than the average biology professor. His workshops are also much less boring and repetitive than other professors as well since he does not recycle the same ones for years like they do. His passion will make you work harder

Dr. Groff is an amazing professor. Unlike other professors he cares a great deal about the success of his students and makes an effort to make his class as encompassing of the material as possible. Rather than recycling the same course and materials that have been used for years he is innovative. Any serious student who takes his class will do well

My experience in Dr. Groff's class was exceptional. If you attend lectures and put in the work that is asked, then this class will be your best friend. If you don't put in the work, then you'll be scratching your head once grades are released. Dr. Groff goes out of his way to clue you in in what to focus on. He also opens additional hours to meet.

He is honestly not a good lecturer. He talks in circles and then falls behind in class so you end up having to teach yourself two or three chapters at the very last minute. The 3rd exam is stupidly hard so pay attention to details. and beware, you dont actually have to know everything he says "know!" on his lectures.

Groff loves his job and really wants his students to succeed. If you go to class he basically tells you questions that will be on the test. The class does require a lot of memorizing and reading, but the tests are fairly easy. Definitely recommend taking this course with Groff!

Probably the best professor in the bio department. He is passionate and plants and the role they play in this planet. His knowledge about plants is endless and he could literally point to any plant and blow your mind with its history. His hand writes all his exams to reflect the concepts learnt and does not test on minute, unnecessary jargon.

Dr. Groff is not just a good professor (highly knowledgeable, organized, responsive, respectful, etc.) -- he's a remarkably eloquent and inspirational advocate for why biodiversity and conservation matter.   Dr. Groff is particularly strong in small group discussions, and I'd highly recommend any of his seminars.

Dr. Groff is a respectful, knowledgeable, and passionate professors. He truly cares about his students and wants them to do well.  His seminar consists of reading two books and discussing assigned readings.  I genuinely loved coming to this seminar, and learned so much at the same time.  A privilege to have and a must take.

Dr. Groff is the greatest professor I have had at UM! He is so friendly and inspirational. He is super passionate about what he does, and will remember your name! There are 4 exams including the final. You will need to study, but it is so worth it ! TAKE HIM!

One of the best profs at UM. Unlike most of biology faculty, he values your opinion, even if it contradicts his as long as you substantiate it. He expects high standards from his students but at same time makes class enjoyable. Groff's seminars give you an opportunity to read current research and broaden your thinking on topics like extinction.

I disliked BIL 160. The subject matter is not very interesting and Groff's lectures were completely pointless. His attitude could be strong at times. The benefits are that he gives a study guide for each test and that workshop is optional and an extra 40 points to your overall grade. I would not recommend this professor.

Really a great guy who cares about his students enough that he tried to learn the names of everyone in his 230 person lecture class.  Takes cheating, honor, and respect very seriously.  If you put the work in, you'll get an A.  Would definitely recommend reading the book and going to lecture most of the time.  Overall a great class.

AMAZING! Definitely one of the best science professors at UM. He truly cares about each of his students and his or her success in the course. I would recommend taking him over any professor hands down. Lectures are interesting and tests are fair. You will definitely have to read and work for your grade. The amount of work you put in will show.

Groff is the man. Nicest professor I've had so far. Most people with his intelligence are too smart to teach an  intro bio class but he did his best to put the material in simple terms. This was his first semester teach this class so expect the exams to be a lot harder than the ratings say they are. He genuinely wants his students to do well though

He definitely a guy that cares about his students. He will help you with anything that you need. The material and his test is hard, but if you take good notes, study and memorize everything with time, youll get an A. A LOT of memorization.  His test are about 40 to 50 questions that are really straight forward, about probably from 4 to 8 chapters.

He does not give any clarity on what to study for tests. Will tell you to know 20 or more figures or more for one test, then will not ask you about any of them. Will tell you to know 5-9 chapters for one 4050 question test. Very unreasonable class to take with other classes.

Read the chapters, study the diagrams and go to lecture and you will get an A. Bio professors at UM are tough and don't care about their students but Dr Groff is kind and considerate. I had him for a seminar last semester and when I saw he was teaching this course, I planned my schedule around him. Great professor and very knowledgeable.

There's going to be a lot of reviews saying he is an easy teacher. All I can say is that you have to learn how to study when it comes to this class. If you accomplish that, then you will definitely get an A. You need to read the assigned chapters BEFORE you get to class and then take notes on them. Start making mnemonics in order to memorize charts

SO easy at first, but after the first test, things get a lot harder. Hardly anyone shows up to class, not a big deal. Very big talker, and EXTREMELY repetitive. But, if you read ahead of class, theres no reason why you wouldnt get at least a high B on the tests. Very annoying though, and ALOT of material. His tests are EXTREMELY SPECIFIC

Probably the best bio prof at UM. He is passionate about what he teaches and he inspires his students. His tests are moderate (A-B range) and people get decent grades because his lectures are always full (people want to learn), unlike the other bio classes where no one shows up. Gives 10% free extra credit for workshops.

Very friendly guy, enthusiastic about his class. If you're interested in botany let him know and he will do anything to help you learn more. A lot of people did not show up to class, but if you want to get on his good side, show up and participate a bit. Tests are easy, and there is a final project which you will get an A on if you do it right.

Have you ever fell in love with a professor? Because I dd this semester with Paul Groff. The sweetest, most influential, open-minded, relaxed and accomplished professor whom I've ever had. Take this class if you want a refreshing personality, and a teacher who actually DOES want you to get an A in a biology course all while learning.

Dr. Groff was tremendously enthusiastic about the  material, very responsive to questions, and good at explaining big ideas in a simple way.  He also went out of his way to give students the benefit of the doubt and was very "easy." I'd recommend him, especially if you're looking for an interesting biology elective that won't take too much time.
Very knowledge botany professor. The class is structured like a fun, ideal science class (field trips, etc). If you do your part, you should succeed in this class.
Very enthusiastic about helping students learn the material and getting as much as possible out of class.  Very knowledgeable about subject matter and creative in presenting difficult ideas.
Great professor.. Needed it for graduation and he helped big time.. Nice guy and his test are replicas nearly of the exam.. Solid and cool individual

Took him as a senior. For ecology.  Mandatory I pass for graduation and he was a big time help.. Gives you a study guide and the test is the study guide for the most part.. Very helpful and understanding. Nice guy

Groff is the poster child for botanists. The class is really easy. He'll tell you that you NEED to know a TON of stuff but when the exam comes around, there's like 15 true/false and a few multiple choice about a diagram that he provides and doesn't even white anything out from. Half of the answers you can find on the exam itself. Super nice guy
Do not take him. He seems nice but his lectures and his tests DO NOT coincide. He's one of those teachers that makes the exam 10x harder then it actually is. Not worth it.

Groff thinks he knows everything and gets really mad when people are talking when he is. I mean REALLY mad. His class is pretty easy though. You just have to do evrythign yourself and he doesn't help with anything. And he just talks froever about pointless stuff.
If you are looking for a easy science class, take this one!  easy A and professor Groff is a really nice guy who really cares about science.  Even got me excited about science!

Paul Groff has been the worst professor I've had at UM by a long shot.  He wastes so much time and treats everyone like they're ten.  His class is easy, but I would rather have a hard class than one where I was wasting my time.

Professor Guzzi makes the law of financial transactions interesting. She is a very engaging professor who really cares about her students. Her lectures are funny and informative. This was my favorite class this semester. She is a tough but fair grader. I wish she taught more classes because I would take her again. Take her!!!

Most amazing professor I've taken so far and taking this class made me decide to add Legal Studies as a second major.  She makes the content super interesting with great real world examples, not to mention she has a great sense of humor.  Gives clear expectations on exams.  Although exams are long, if you know the material you will do well.

WOW Guzzi is great. You will learn many concepts to apply to your everyday life. Test are not bad if you study, get a study group and go over material. Guzzi is great with office hours as well. If she taught other classes I would take them. Make sure you participate in class too! Class is doable because the concepts are taught very well.
I looked forward to this class every day. Never a dull moment with Guzzi. She is a great resource for law school if you are interested in that as well.
Only class where I don't feel like I'm losing brain cells

I love this woman. She makes class interesting and teaches in a way that you'll remember the content. The tests require you to give yourself a lot of time to study but if you do you'll be fine. You have to have to go to class. Trust, the Friday class is worth it.

Best professor at UM. The tests are difficult but Guzzi is amazing and worth taking if you have the chance. If you study the material, you will get a good grade. She is so engaging during class and is always there to help if you have any misunderstandings. I just wish she taught more courses so I could take her again.

She was an amazing professor and you learn a lot in this class. She gets to know all of her students and cares for everyone. She is also very funny and tries to make the class enjoyable. Exams can be very difficult as there is a lot of material and they are weighted heavily. Go to office hours for help and questions.

I am currently taking this woman, and I LOVE her. I want her to adopt me. She is a very intelligent woman and clearly passionate. She radiates great energy and cares about her students on another level. My queen.

Best professor I've had just because of the fact that she cares about her students so much. I saw her out of class for something totally unrelated and she was more than happy to help me even though she really didn't have to. But be sure to work hard in class. She is willing to help everyone but the more you put in the more you get out.

Guzzi is THE BEST teacher ive had at umiami. i took her for both business law and law of financial transacations and shes the sole reason I want to go to law school. Hard grader but shes so funny and I always look forward to going to her class.

Professor Guzzi is hilarious and really knows her stuff. The lectures go fast, so be prepared to take a LOT of notes. The exams are open-note but challenging because you have to know the concepts well in order to answer. Great class, be ready to really understand the material.

She has no filter and is a total jokester. She will call you out if you aren't prepared, but she makes a not so interesting subject soo much fun and does a lot of interactive days in order to get extra credit or use the material in a practical way. TAKE HER IF YOU HAVE THE CHANCE. She's a queen and really supportive of her students' futures.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Unreal teacher that made a difficult course a whole lot easier. You have to go to pretty much every class and can't use laptops but she's super engaging and class goes by very fast. Tests get easier as the semester goes on, be prepared to write and explain on her tests but unbelievable teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I'm being 100% honest when I say she is the worlds greatest professor. Extremely engaging lectures that really help you understand the information. She's sarcastic but incredibly caring. She's tough but you definitely WILL NOT regret having Guzzi as your professor. If you work hard you will get the grade you want and deserve! Hands down the best
Great professor, somewhat difficult class. Pay attention during lecture.
Best teacher I have ever had in my life.

Guzzi makes this class much more interesting and entertaining than it would otherwise be. Very personable and brings a sense of community to class that I have not seen in other college courses. You have to work for an A, not difficult to achieve if you are active in class and put forth effort. Bar none, one of the most impactful teachers I've had.

Class is interesting but tough. Guzzi is funny and can provide a great atmosphere. Sometimes condescending. Don't be fooled by how "chill" she can seem in class, tests are hard and the material can be heavy

Best professor at UM. She is so nice and really cares about the students. She explains the material and provide good examples in the class, so the material won't be difficult to understand. My favorite class this semester.
If you dont like professor Guzzi or her teaching style you embody everything wrong with the 21st century. My favorite professor at UM

She is one of the best teachers in the business school. The class is not always easy, but that's the nature of the material. She presents it very well, is very knowledgeable and cares a lot about her students.

Awesome professor. She is always helpful and she likes to joke around and is a lot of fun, but she still gets to the task at hand. Curses a lot, which I think is great. Not afraid to make fun of students, or herself (in a joking manner, of course). Exams are kind of tricky, so make sure you study. Chapters are lengthy, but they will help lots.

I don't review teachers on her often, But I felt compelled in Guzzi's case. She is easily the best teacher I've ever had. She explains things clearly, is very knowledgeable, and is very in to what she is teaching. She is willing to help with any problems and will go out of her way to do so. I strongly suggest taking her class.

Dr. Guzzi is a great professor, and she makes BSL301 so interesting!  She actually is helpful and patient during office hours, unlike many professors.  BSL301 definitely is a difficult class, but Dr. Guzzi teaches the material very well in her lectures.

she's really nice, funny, friendly, and smart but the class is actually relatively hard. a lot of memorization but she does make it as easy as possible. if your ever confused during a test, go and ask her a question and she practically gives you the answer. she's an easy grader on the tests but not when calculating your final grade

I loved Ms Guzzi,  she tries to keep you interested in her class. And she s very helpful and clear explaining. BSL is pretty hard but she makes it so easy that you barely work that hard. Just study week by week and you will be ready for the final exam!!!

BEST TEACHER EVER! Very motivating, helpful, caring... She told us at the beginning of the semester that:" You guys are gonna be terrific at this subject." It turns out to be very true! JUST TAKE HER. PERIOD.

Great teacher! She knows SO MUCH! Sweet, funny lady. Business law is going to be challenging no matter who teaches it, so you might as well have a witty, bubbly professor! Only downside is being in class from 625 to 9. She usually lets out at like 830 though
Great professor!! Shes so sweet and funny. She really cares about her students. Makes boring material interesting. TAKE HER!

Absolutely, THE best teacher in UM. She genuinely cares about her students. The material is difficult but she makes sure you understand. Super caring, she is the perfect example of what a teacher should be like. Great role model as well!
She is very nice, helpful, and a great teacher! Her notes are clear and there is not much homework until it comes to test time. She keeps class fun and creates a great atmosphere to learn.

She is definitely one of the best teachers I've had at UM. I had no interest whatsoever before going to her class, and was dreading going to it seeing as the class is almost 3 hours long. Guzzi was able to make the class interesting and entertaining the whole time, plus she gives a break half-way through class. TAKE HER FOR BSL!  you wont regret it

Dr. Guzzi is by far the best professor at UM. She is extremely intelligent and really cares about her students. She uses a lot of personal stories to help explain the dense material which makes the class pretty humorous at times. I dreaded missing class and wish that she taught other courses as well so that I could take her again!
Best teacher ever!  Take her!  She acts just like Reese Witherspoon in Legally Blonde.  The class is pretty tough but doable with Guzzi!  Thank GOD she teaches this class!

By far the best teacher I've ever had. Sure, the class and cases are challenging but once you get the hang of it you'll do fine.  She's super helpful and actually CARES about her students. Take her over other BSL teachers for sure
Great teacher. She makes the class interesting and fun. The material isnt hard but a lot to memorize, but she makes it that much easier.

BEST TEACHER I HAVE HAD AT UM. Guzzi is amazing. She took a difficult class and made it fun and very funny. She knows what she is talking about and is extremely helpful. She speaks Italian, Spanish, French, and has a great understanding of the world. TAKE HER CLASS!

Actual practicing lawyer who is also a great teacher :).  Makes a fairly boring subject at interesting with a humorous spin.  Fair grader, cares about students... if you apply yourself and attend class, you will find her to be one of the best teachers around.  DEF TAKE HER!

Awesome...made a 3 hr night class relatively exciting...Fair alot of studying though, But she is very very very helpful.  She overrode new business school policy so I could take the final a semester late after I had knee surgery.
Great teacher, highly recommended and super nice.

Great teacher.  The class isn't easy, but if you study, it's not hard.  She is a very fair grader, which is important because the tests are all short answer.  I definitely recommend her, she is a great person and is pretty hot as well.  I've heard there are easier teachers in the BSL department, but she's great.

Best professor in the school of business because she cares  a lot about her students. If you don't understand the material she will stay after class with you in order to clarify anything that doesn't make sense. The material is very hard, but she makes it fun and her examples are very clear to understand. She makes the class interesting and besides
Great Professor, not the easiest but the class is clear and she'll try to see how your answers would would apply, even if there wrong, and she'll give you credit.

Really smart woman who knows how to carry herself.  She is a lawyer so make sure you show respect or she will put you in your place.  Show up to every class and you will do fine.  Take copious notes.  Be prepared to work and learn.  You will be ready for the final.  Great teacher
Awsome lady, very respectable, she still remembers everyone's name in my class! Very helpful and nice!  Great for Law Majors!!
Professor is amazing. She explains everything in great detail an goes over the material with you during office hours if you need it. Makes class entertaining and fun. Highly recommend.
Very dedicated teacher.  She came to class with pneumonia once.  She's very helpful and straight-forward with the course material.  She's also a very reasonable person.  Highly recommended.
Study hard for the class. She grades fairly but you need to learn the material. Beware of the little exceptions though.

Really clear teacher. teaches you everything important in class and you dont need to read unless you have to brief cases, which happens 1x/3wks. Shes a really cool, personable teacher who made the class, which is ALOT of writing, as enjoyable as possible.

easy class, need to study for quizzes which there are only 8, and then 1 final towards the end. very fair grader, never really studied and avg'd a 85 on quizzes. will learn law by the end of the semester
real nice teacher

Bsl 301 is probably the toughest class in the business law department, however, professor guzzi is makes it easy with her examples. My advice is study for all her quizes cause they arent easy. By the way, she is freakin hot and i would have familiar relation with her if she wasnt married.
Quizzes are a little rough but doable, study and you will be fine.  However for a teacher she is hott.  Good to stare at.

awesome teacher, quizes are pretty easy, and the final was a breeze.  guzzi makes the class very interesting and fun.  just study a lot for those law quizes and pay attention in class when she gives examples.
awsome teacher. has a sense of humor and has no problem joking around with her students. stays after class for those that need help. quizzes are pretty easy.
Its a hard course.  Ive heard that Turner is better at BSL 212.  Shes hot though

One of the best teachers I've had.  She makes a boring class interesting, and her quizes are pretty easy if you do some work.  She knows everyones name and class is very interactive.  She genuinly cares for her students and it shows.  If you have to take this boring class, take it with guzzi and it won't be half bad.
No Comments

Quizzes were corrected arbitrarily. Did not specify number of points taken off for each correction. Teacher (not Doctor, since she has no PhD) often lectures by dictation, which can become quite boring. Overall, I would stay away from her course and take it with someone with greater experience.

Awsome teacher for a tough course. She's young and funny and there if you need help. For class you really need to do all the reading or else you will be completley lost like me. Went to BC Law school and knows her material well. Always there after class if you need help.

Great teacher!  Professor Gwydir presents the material in a way that is straight forward.  She presents the course material on powerpoints that you can print out and bring to class and expand on which helps you learn instead of having to copy everything down and get confused.  Tests and exams reflect what you learn in class.

She's an extremely nice lady, she just can be confusing or annoying with her constant chatter. She sometimes will say stuff during tests disrupting your focus. However, she does give extra credit throughout the year & hardly asks for homework to be turned in. All the powerpoints she uses in class are posted on Blackboard as well as answers homework

I got through the class with an A because i am a good student but she SUCKS shes not clear, she goes way to fast for you to comprehend. idk WHY she has positive comments. she makes u feel stupid when u ask questions and doesnt answer them clearly, shes very unorganized and her teaching is all over the place. if u miss one class u can miss a pop qui
good teacher, ALOT of homework!!! The load of HW seems to never end but it does help prepare you for the exams, so its good i guess.  She's nice and good

GREAT teacher, she always looks for ways  to help you out and help you understand the material.  keeps class light and interesting, so i actually looked forward to going to a MATH class. thats impressive.  easy A if you can keep up with the material and do your work as you go along

First math teacher I had that realizes most people hate math, accepts it, and teaches based off that fact.  She tries to find way to keep the class light, and generally interesting.  Not too hard a class either, if you pay attention, you'll get an A.
she explains it really well, she gives extra credit quizzes on math xl and in class, homework is manditory, the class is a breeze if you do the homework on math xl. she helps if you ask
pretty easy class.. too bad she's a HORRIBLE teacher and will do NOTHING to help you get extra credit.

This class was an absolute breeze, and a lot of it was due to the teaching.  Professor Gwydir had crystal clear explanations most of the time, and even though I already knew most of the material and found the class somewhat boring, she definitely knows what she is talking about.  Great Prof!!

She is pretty nice and helpful, but sometimes rushes or does not answer your questions any different to how the material was told in the first place. Tests are really easy if you know all the material. She assigns a few problems a night and they are not mandatory, but attendance is. She can be boring but stay on the material and you'll be fine.

I was really intimidated by her at first, but she's a super sweet lady who really cares about her students. She is VERY specific about how her papers should be written, but as long as you follow her guidelines and ask her for help if you need it, you should be fine. The class was pretty much all discussion based, so come ready to talk about thebook
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Gwilliam is an amazing professor. She has a lot of personality and charm that is delivered through the literary discussions we had in class. She is an expert in her field of literature, and it was really a privilege to have her as a professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I wasnt very thrilled with this professor, and I started out really intimidated to participate. However, her teaching and grading methods were effective in making me a better reader and writer. By the final paper, it showed tremendously how much my skills improved. She truly cares about her students and wants you to get the most out of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Such a great professor. Never a moment of silence in her classes. Everyone is made comfortable and motivated to participate in her discussions. She really cares about her students and is flexible when it comes to due dates. One of my favorite professors with great personality and humor. I think she is a fair grader!

Dr. Gwilliam's Jane Austen class was always thought-provoking and engaging. The class was discussion based which motivated you to come to class prepared. She cares deeply about her students, is flexible with her office hours, and had a wonderful sense of humor. She is a tough grader, but it will make you a better writer. Highly recommend.

It's a good class overall. The discussions were great, the only down side is the grading. She is very very very specific about the way things should be done. One of the most specific professors I've had. Very tough to know what she wants for an A+ paper. I would take it but be prepared to work for your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Prof. Gwilliam was awesome! She creates a wonderful environment (she had us sit our desks in a circle) and is incredibly funny. She really gets to know her students and offers great feedback/help when necessary! Although she is very specific with what she wants on papers, she offers lots of help if you need it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This is a discussion based class and she is honestly one of the best teachers I've had in leading discussions and teaching literature. There are only 4 papers with the option to rewrite, but she has a very high standard for grading writing. I started off as a B- writer and ended with an A on my final paper because she was so helpful
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Gwilliam's Austen class is incredible, one of the best I've ever taken! Heavy reading (novels/criticism), short papers, avg. paper, then a long final research paper. Really makes you think critically. If you put in the effort, it's a fun challenge and so worthwhile. She really helps improve your writing, allows revisions. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Loved the Jane Austen class, she's amazing! Really good discussion and actually makes you think. Lots of homework and readings but they're actually helpful and she gives great feedback. Would definitely recommend if you're up for the challenge.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Challenging class, but in a good way. Short essays, a research paper, a regular paper, pop quizzes, and a written final. Don't slack on the final! Watch the movies, understand the plots, be prepared. You sit in a circle every class to discuss the book and talk about assignments. I enjoyed this class. Keep up with the reading!

Excellent class. Be prepared for heavy reading commitment (long novels) and weekly writing assignments and a seminar paper. But worth the trouble in the end because a good class and excellent instructor who opens up the 18th Century for students
She is tough but fair. Go to her office and ask her anything you are having trouble with.

As an english lit major I've had at least 7 different english teachers, and professor Gwilliam is hands down my favorite. I thought she was such a fun teacher, and very passionate about the subject, and eager to work with the students. Plenty of reading but not an overwhelming amount, and an easy to average difficulty grader and essay load.

Lots of in-class writing assignments. 2 short, 2 long papers. I found her somewhat abrasive in class, she isn't very open to hearing your opinion if it's not consistent with her interpretation. I'm a very capable writer so I found her assignments very easy, others may not have the same experience. Overall, she's OK.

An excellent instructor. I don't know where some get the idea that guys are uncomfortable to speak in her class. I'm a guy...I didn't have any trouble and neither did the others. She's interesting, supportive, and a lot more open than a few have given her credit for. They probably just didn't read for class :/... And yes, that's a must for her.

The first half of Literature and Medicine was definitely more engaging than the last half (read: modern literature over 18th century) but Gwilliam can definitely helm a discussion. Good critiques and is very helpful if you meet up with her outside of class to go over a paper or proposal.

Took Medicine and Literature with Prof. Gwilliam. The class was fantastic! She had us read a wide variety of texts (including Tolstoy and the more modern Atul Gawande) and really opened up the texts in an interesting way. Fairly difficult grader, but comments on papers are super helpful. All in all, she is definitely worth taking!

If you're a good writer, this course is not very demanding. Her lectures are comprehensive, and she does a good job of stimulating class discussion. Not sure why others have given her a bad wrap, but I assume it has to do with their own shortcomings as students, not any failings on the part of Gwilliam.

This professor's name is "Gwilliam" not "Gwillian" - perhaps the unhappy parties have larger problems to worry about than whether this professor is the right fit for them. I think quite highly of her, as my comments (found with her correctly spelled name) illustrate. Took her class Spring 2005.

Took her class Spring 05 (my Jr yr) and she WILL challenge you but her class is very rewarding. She's an excellent professor and her passion for literature is infectious. I remember meeting with her about a paper and leaving her office very impressed by the caliber of her professionalism and expertise.(PS - we read dark/kinky 1800's lit so fun HW!)

I will admit she is intimidating. But she is a great professor and makes the material interesting, which is not easy considering some of the required reading. She's funny, too, if you can get past being scared of her... No tolerance for laziness, not an easy A. This class will probably be my first A- at UM.
Interesting readings, her paper maximums are more like minimums and she takes daily attendance, but she keeps it interesting and I've really enjoyed her class.
No Comments
He's the best professor I have ever had. I admire him, and he is such an awesome person. He really changed my perspective at this school and was the first class I ever got excited to go to.

Professor Haywood is the GOAT. I would take his class again and again if I could. One of the smartest people Ive met. If you can take his class TAKE IT. You learn so much from him. Even if attendance wasn't mandatory you don't want to miss his lectures they are the best. - Nicole R
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: If you're looking to grow both personally and academically, this is a professor and classroom environment you want to experience. Your ability to perform quality research, develop and defend understandings, and receive criticism will be tested. Lectures are engaging, authentic, and personally relatable.

Best class I've taken. You're genuinely engaged and want to learn, but you must put in the work. Attendance and participation are crucial. Lectures are authentic, interesting, and funny. It can feel intimidating and most don't do great on the first exam, but if you try and stay committed, it pays off.

Professor Haywood is by far the BEST teacher I have ever had. ever! He has a super big personality and will try and scare off people in the first class, but do not drop this class. His lectures are so engaging and interesting. He is very caring, and if you participate, he will like you and praise you. Don't be scared to kiss up to him.

This was the first time I ever took a class and the professor was able to connect it to the real world and how it personally affects me. He pushes students to be better academically but also to be better human beings and to some it may come off as harsh. Negative reviews are 100% from lazy kids that never been expected to do anything in their life.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: My favorite professor at this whole University. You must earn his respect before reaching that cool side of him so make sure you dedicate time to this course, buy a big notebook, and come ready to class to brief some tough cases.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Get ready to work and learn the law. If you are passionate about law, then he's the guy. I would recommend that you take him. If you have a good work ethic, you will be fine. I also recommend that you build some tough skin because he's gonna tell you what he thinks, whether you like it or not.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof Haywood is the BEST prof I've had and made bsl my favorite class so far! If you can I would 100% take him! I sat in on a class before deciding on Miami and he is the reason I came here. The class is hard but if you put effort in and participate you'll do well. I got off the waitlist a week in and still did fine even tho I felt behind at first.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great class, you will learn a lot. That being said, you will learn a lot because Haywood will not let you slide by without knowing your stuff. His ego is huge and will make it known to you everyday that he is better than you. Do your work and stay determined you will learn a lot and be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: The BEST professor I have had at this school so far. Professor Haywood has a deep passion for the law and and even deeper passion of teaching. It is so clear he has an immense knowledge of the law and the subject matter. If you are prepared, participate at a high level, and listen to his advice, the only outcome is success with him.

When you're taking this course, your mentality 95% of the time will be hating to love him, and loving to hate him. If you have other rough obligations this semester don't take him. Going through with P. Haywood will make you want to add a pre law. Switching into his class was my best decision.

Great teacher better man. I took Haywood for BSL212 last semester. I struggled in his class all year but he holds effort, attendance, and class participation very highly. I didn't do As well as I would've hoped but his class convinced me to add a Business Law Minor.

If you truly want to learn in BSL take Haywood. Quite literally the best professor I've ever had. He GENUINELY cares for his students. Love the environment he creates in class. If you're willing to learn and challenge yourself he'll appreciate you very much. Put the work in!! Learned so many life lessons by taking his class.

My favorite class taken in college. Haywood is awesome TRULY cares about his students, quickly learns everyone's name and has a gift for creating a vibrant environment. Really touched my heart when he told me how smart I was and that I needed to believe in myself more. I've changed as a student for the better, and genuinely learned so so much.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: An acquired taste but a very knowledgable/caring professor. He's the smartest person in the room and makes sure everyone knows it, + isn't afraid to call out students & let them know that it's his way or the highway. A class that you have to fully buy into and you'll learn a lot. Recommend for students interested in BSL and looking for a challenge
4.8! Highly recommend
My goat, would take him 10/10 times.

Professor Haywood has been my favorite professor at UM so far. He can come off as intimidating at first but he genuinely cares about his students and is great at teaching the material. The class is engaging and Professor Haywood is funny and entertaining. Work hard and keep up with the homework and you will do fine. Read the textbook.

Best professor I've ever had. After bombing first test, I told him I was dropping, and his response (can't legally say) reached my heart and proved he cared. *STUDY AS A CLASS* memorize + spin cases. Don't be scared of the difficulty, you'll be a significantly better student after. Buy into it early. Don't get scared off. Good luck, legal scholars.

Professor Haywood was an amazing professor who truly cared about his students carrying engaging classes. Just be prepared for intense coursework, however, if you stay on top of your assignments you will be able to succeed. Practice and Effort are all you need professor will make sure to help you with the rest as long as you go to class.

Hands down my favorite professor. He strongly emphasizes preparedness, professionalism, and work ethic. Anything less than your best will most definitely be called out so prepare for some tough love. Overall, Professor Haywood is an incredible guy and truly helped me become a better man and a better student this semester.

Professor Haywood is the best teacher I have ever had in my academic life time. He truly cares about each of his students and the subject he is teaching. This class is not easy and it will require you to read the book to understand each of the topics. If you show respect he will reciprocate. Do not take this class if you are looking for an easy A.

At first Professor Haywood may seem intimidating, but all along he has his students best interest at heart. I have never had a professor genuinely care about each of his students the way Haywood does. Test/work is fair. I urge you to take him, he prepares you very well for the final as well as the world after college. My favorite professor yet!
great professor. definitely a hard class, but such a great teacher who truly cares about each individual student.

After getting a 50 on test 1 I was ready to drop BSL. Prof Haywood was certainly tough on us, but he also never gave up on us. Instead of dropping, I was motivated to prove him wrong in a way. I ended up finishing tests 2-6 with an 89 average. If you can't handle hard work you will not succeed. If u want to learn law and enjoy it take him.

This is Professor Haywood's first semester at UM and he undoubtedly left such a strong impression. He is an amazing professor who is incredibly passionate about his teaching. Take his feedback with a grain of salt because he truly cares about all his students and wants you to succeed. Read what he assigns and you are sure to do great.

Literally love this guy and this class. My best professor and one of my fav classes I have had at UM. Got super close with the students in my class and we all crack up with laughter at least 2 times every class. He creates a vibrant yet challenging environment - I wish every class had this vibe

Professor Haywood is a great professor. He genuinely cares about teaching his students, and keeping them engaged. His class does require work and is not an easy A. His classes are entertaining. He knows each one of his students name, and cares about them (he asked me if I had been going to the gym because I'm looking bigger).

Prof. Haywood is very engaging and is very funny. I am never bored in class and it is never a strain to attend. But, he is a tough grader. MUST READ THE TEXTBOOK. Treat the textbook like the bible you will do well in his class. MUST attend class, you will miss topics/case briefs and fail (literally). If you actually want to learn, take him!
He is chill like that.

Han Li is just great. His lectures are so engaging. It's a pretty small class, so we are all able to share our beliefs freely and he knows how to keep the discussions interesting. Clear grading criteria, not too many assignments, easy grading. One of the most engaging classes I've taken at UM. He's the best fr

Oh how I regret taking taking this class. It was for my cognate bc I thought it would be interesting but there was an exam, multiple long essays and lectures are so boring and repetitive. He allows his strong political views to dominate the lecture many times. He also grades harsh. Overall worst class I have taken at this school
Professor Li himself is a good guy and the coursework is not graded very intensely. However, the class can definitely get boring very quickly.

He was very slow. The class was incredibly boring and was practically like a bedtime story. It was unnecessarily long and he talked very slow and softly, making things much worse. The course content was actually pretty interesting though.
Overdoes it but you will learn some basic tort law in the class. Lecture style is punitive. Professor Halpert is not above being condescending towards students. Strange fellow.

Belittles students in class as a way to scare 1Ls. Goes off on tangents about his personal life which is completely uncalled for given the cost of tuition. Decent exam but you have to study basic torts coupled with Florida med mal on your own. Nothing to be scared of just know Halpert's game and stay on top of material.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is honestly hilarious and a solid 1L Torts Professor. As long as you go to class, read, and take notes of his hypos and the Florida statutes you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Stephen is great. Classic law professor if that's what you want. He's brilliant, makes you think, is very funny. Might drop a comment that shocks people every now and then, but those people are soft. Take Halpert if you can. Every time he brings up a hypothetical, write it down! And know yout FL statutes!

Professor Halpert is a great guy and professor, Insurance law is a dry topic and can be difficult to grasp, but he made it possible to understand. Id recommend taking his class as insurance defense is a very common field for new grads to go into after school. Although the class and subject material is dense, Halpert is not a harsh grader at all.
He is actually a decent professor. Pay attention to his hypos in class, they will be on the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Halpert's lectures were a series of incoherent rambling, dispersed thoughts, and often condescending comments. Students would line up for coffee before his class b/c staying awake was difficult otherwise. His cold-calls were ruthless and added zero pedagogical value. Overall, not an encouraging experience for 1Ls. The final was hard but fair.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Halpert is a funny, dry-humored, sarcastic, double Harvard grad who REALLY knows his stuff! This dude is basically a genius and his brain is a giant vault with endless information. He sometimes made "inappropriate" jokes that were a little outside of general political correctness, but it was nice to have a prof that wasn't afraid to be real.

Funny and has a sense of humor. That said, he is not clear at all with what he wants from us and goes off tangents during class. Also, if you have a "dumb" question he will more likely than not to be very sarcastic . Either way, an okay professor, just study and be on top of the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Halpert has a reputation as a tough grader. His final exam was pretty difficult, especially under the time conditions. I didn't feel too prepared for it compared to other courses since there's not much feedback. He's really funny and I love him as a person. He knows the material well, but his lectures are boring and hard to understand.

I took Insurance Law. The lectures were very structured and clear, and the class environment was pleasant.  Considering that insurance touches virtually everyone (especially attorneys), this is a class that one should strongly consider taking.

What I like about Professor Halpert is that he you can tell that he's passionate about the law. His demeanor makes you want to be engaged. He doesn't just talk at you, either- he'll ask the class a variety hypos after every case to make sure that you understand how to apply what you're learning.
Expert level

He was absolutely infuriated that he had to teach 1L Torts, and he let us know it.  Constantly insulting students and ignoring the reading just to ramble on about economics.  Exam was basically a test on intentional torts.  I have no doubt that he's great when he's teaching something he likes, but PLEASE don't let him teach torts again.

Expert knowledge. He studies the cases in such detail that he even knows background not published. An academic, old school professor that is ironic when appropriate but very helpful and willing to convey everything he knows. Just grader. You shoul know textbook and all problems at the end of each chapter.    Get Gilbert to understand better.

Great professor, focus on the text book and make sure to know the specific provisions of the Bankrtupcy code that he emphasizes in class. If you pay attention in class, the final will be a lot easier than if not paying attention. Examples and explenations does an amazing job of clarifying the casebook and the code.
Knows his stuff, but it's still boring as hell.  Strict attendance policy, but you're allowed a bunch of misses.  Hard final, hard grader.  Did no reading, got a C+ by using nutshell during final.
He's a good guy.  It was a workshop, so the reading and work weren't as bad as a regular class.  I'd recommend him for this.

Professor Carr is so sweet! Absolutely adored her class and look forward to taking another class this fall. There was a lot of work, but it was all pretty easy and was very helpful in preparing us for real world situations. 10/10 :)
Shell let you pay material fee and its unnecessary. She never knows what is she tehaching. Very unorganized. You will be confused

Professor Carr is amazing. She genuinely cares about what she teaches and is passionate about the journalism/public relations field. I enjoy going to her classes and learning from her. She always has a great topic to share and brings in experienced guest from the media world to share their experiences. Professor Carr always has a great story!

Prof. Carr is amazing. I took her many times and plan to take much more. She's very lenient on grades so people confuse her for a professor that isn't good, but if you pay attention and go to office hours you will learn SO FREAKING MUCH about writing and PR. She's great and really caring!

Carr is great!  She worked for the Herald before teaching at UM and really knows that she's talking about. She a little disorganized so you have to stay on top of your assignments. Her AP style quizzes are the hardest part about the class. Other than that, I learned a lot and would recommend.
Professor Carr is very sweet and cares about her students very much. If you attend class, review your AP Grammar book and follow the guidelines for your assignment, then it will be an easy A!

Professor Carr is great. Learned a lot about the basics of writing for PR in this class. She's very relaxed with students and is more than willing to help if you go to her. Not a fan of Professor Carr, many people believe she is easy because there is not a hard workload, but she is very unorganized. With less than a month left in the semester, no one knows what their grades are. She sometimes speaks to students as if they are incompetent and often gets distracted while teaching

Professor Carr is amazing! She is extremely knowledgeable about pr and gives you a lot of good advice. Also, she's super sweet and approachable. I enjoyed her class so much this semester. Definitely take her class if you can!

Heidi Carr is a great professor. She is sweet and helpful in any way she can. She is always available to meet with students, always returns your e-mails quickly, and gives you plenty of feedback.  She loves her work though, so she gives A LOT of assignments. She also gives a lot of quizzes  in an effort to help students get better grades.

Carr is great! When I took her, she only taught an 8 a.m., but now I believe she teaches more sections with more variety regarding times. I didn't like the grammar tests she gave us, but they are open book, and the great thing about her class is that she gives you actual stuff to put in your portfolio, AND she's nice! Take her!

She is the absolute sweetest person. As easy as the class was, I'm not a huge fan of how it was run. Other than 3/4 assignments, she gives you virtually NO direction for your end of semester project. Three weeks before presenting to Miami Herald editors, we still weren't sure what exactly she expected from us.

Really helpful. She's such a positive person. She will critique your work fairly but will never say anything negative, just constructive. Assignments are fun, lots of guest speakers and great contacts. This was my first 8 am and I'm not a morning person. I took it just for her, and don't regret it.
Such a great teacher! Loved this class and would take any other one she teaches! Easy work load and very helpful and just such a nice person. Highly recommend her.

This guy is the best professor ever. There are few readings you have to do for class sometimes but they're pretty easy. Online class and camera not required to be on altough he recommends it. Take home quizzes and final exam.

I took this class in the fall with a different teacher and dropped after 3 classes—she was awful and I cried every time. In the spring, I took it with Alex Heria. At first, he seemed intimidating, but he's the complete opposite. He's amazing, the work is easy, he helps with everything, and he truly cares. I wish I could take it again. Easy A.
I cannot stand this man. Genuinely so rude and plays it off as humor. Assigned multiple home works at the beginning of the year and never put it in the gradebook. Only had 3 grades total.

Hes a really good professor, would recommend for beginners in graphic design. He is harsh with his feedback but its tough love, his toughness helps you get good grades. It is a MUST to take professor Hixon for whatever class he is going to be teaching in the future. Plus most of the work is going to be a group work, and his feedback is insanely beneficial.

YOU NEED TO TAKE PROFESSOR HIXON!!! He is by far the best professor I've had at University of Miami. Attendance is mandatory, but he makes the class worth going to. So easy to pass, the only kind of annoying part are the video assignments he gives at the beginning but after that super chill. Doesnt post grades only emails you

reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: LEARNED SO MUCH! I had never used Adobe before and now I consider I can use all the programs very well. Projects are easy and fun to do. He gives you lots of feedback. Sometimes you only have class once a week. Lectures are recorded and he has everything organized so you can find everything easily. Great person, super nice and caring. TAKE HIM!

Professor Henriquez was good, but not great. He is a harsh grader and is constantly giving projects and papers, there is no break. I still ended with an A but I worked hard for it.

He is a great professor who really cares about teaching you graphic design.  The projects are fun to do and he gives you lots of creative freedom.  Really fun class if you want to learn to use photoshop, illustrator, etc.

reviews.comment: If you didn't know anything about Photoshop, this class won't be an easy A. However, the professor is so nice, and you will definitely learn from him.

Gives you a lot of content to review in case you are lost and allows for redos on every project. As long as you put in the effort that he's looking for, you will end up with an A. Such a good professor.
Hiram is the homie! 10/10 recommend. Its def a good amount of work but you learn a lot. His first time teaching online and he was very good at it.

reviews.comment: Your grade is based off of 3 projects, a few homework assignments and one quiz. the 3 projects you work on in class and he gives you plenty of time. the homework assignments you also do in class. the quiz is extremely easy and takes 10 minutes max. He is very friendly and easy-going and understanding, but you do have to go to class

Hiram is a good teacher. He shows you everything you need to know and doesnt mind repeating himself a million times. It's a hard class at first but once you familiarize yourself with the programs it gets easier and easier.

The class is challenging because the material being taught is difficult but if you struggle at all, go to his office hours! I cannot repeat this more! reviews.comment: I thoroughly enjoyed this class and would suggest it to anybody. If you have to take 106, take it with him. He allows you a "redo" on every one of the three main assignment and is very helpful in class. You can ask him whatever you want and he will tell you almost exactly what to do (and even makes some changes for you ).

Hiram's class was one of my favorites this semester. The class is mainly based off of 3 projects and you get the majority of class time to work on them. He grades tough, he will catch the small mistakes. However, he is really clear in his grading and tells you how you can improve your work. All projects have a "redo" opportunity which is great.

Not a hard class, but you have to put a good amount of effort for an A.  The grade youll get is mainly based off three projects.  He grades them toughly, but allows you to redo them for more credit after.  I had basically no experience with photoshop, indesign, or illustrator before I took this class and ended up getting a B with minimal effort.
only one quiz. 3 big projects. expects you to know how to use the programs

He's vague about what he wants and deducts points subjectively. If you don't have an artistic eye or prior design experience, you'd be lucky to get a B even if you try hard.

I definitely wouldnt take this class again if I could go back. It wasnt the worst thing in the world but as the semester progresses he gets more irritated with you if you ask questions. Kind of intimidating to ask a question because you dont want to get yelled at. if you study youll be fine. go to class and be on his good side
