High expectations but he also works hard to help you reach those expectations. I recommend to take him as early in the day as you can

Gives lots of extra credit on exam. Makes lighthearted jokes and tries to inspire everyone a lot. Pay a lot of attention to detail (sometimes too much though, especially about punctuality). High energy, slightly loud, may cut you off sometimes. As long as you don't take it personal it should be fine.

Has a bit of an accent but not too bad.

Actually worst professor in my entire UM career. Had him at 8am on Mondays and it would ruin my week. He gets increasingly frustrated as class goes on, and refuses to accept that you don't understand coding. Called us dumb many times outright, would clap/snap at us for our attention, and doesn't like when you are even one line ahead or behind.

Actually my favorite professor at UM, all he cares about is being fair. If you come to class, try to participate and do your work (which is not complicated just may take a little bit of time) you will get a good grade. A lot of students in my class would agree this class is useful for CS majors. Class sounds scary but he makes the class fun.
One of the best classes I have taken at UM. Very fun class, a lot of real-world examples, easy quizzes.

As many other reviews have professed, Professor Nguyen tends to get a bad rep for the way he tries to help with messy code [usually in a stricter fashion]. However, he meant well and trying to help students better their theory and syntax. Honestly, if you get to know him a little better, he's just a chill dude who likes to program a lil'.

Gets a bad rep but is honestly a super caring and dedicated professor! Tends to yell or raise his voice during lab but don't take it personally. If you take anything from this it's to go to his student hours because he is really helpful will be more likely to help you in the overall course if you show that you care about his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Hien is a super nice guy. I think a lot of people get intimidated by him in lab because he does tend to raise his voice at students but it's rarely meant in a mean or rude way he is just very passionate about what he teaches. If you care about coding and develop a connection with him, he is a great professor who cares and wants to see you succeed.
Super caring professor. Learned our names and made an effort to make sure you got the grade you wanted. Would take again and I'm grateful I had him my first semester!

You can tell professor Nguyen is passionate about the subject he teaches. His course wasn't difficult, but labs were important to understanding the overall concepts. He genuinely just wants his students to succeed and his reviews don't do him justice. There is a cultural difference, but he is a kind professor who cares about his students.

I enjoyed taking his class. Although you may not understand him at first, Professor Nguyen does a good job at explaining everything in great detail and will make sure that you understand (RADAR.) Focus in the labs!!! That is where you will truly learn since the lectures are honestly not the most informative. Code his way or you will face penalties.

Professor Nguyen is a very kind and caring guy. He is always available to help you and wants to see you succeed. He wants you to have a strong foundation for computer science and works hard to make sure everyone understands. His labs are extremely helpful and he is a very passionate teacher. I really enjoyed taking this class.

I thoroughly enjoyed taking this class, Professor Nguyen is eager to see his students succeed and will go to great lengths to ensure this. He is very passionate about what he teaches, and it's part of what helped me succeed in the class. I would highly recommend taking him for this class!

All I have to say is never ask him a question. He is beyond rude and it is not a language barrier. Stick up for yourself if he becomes too outwardly rude, the way he embarrasses students is mind boggling. Listen to what he has to say ab the labs, ask the TA for help if you need, and you'll be fine!

He yaps and yells whenever you ask questions If you implement something advanced, he rejects it, even if it works. I knew everything he taught but didn't have credits (self-learned in HS) My school didn't have a credit system (international) Worst class experience ever. He wants the code his way and criticizes you for going beyond what he taught

Pretty standard and easy intro coding course. Clearly he must've read all of the negative reviews online because if he ever raises his voice these days he tries to explain that he isn't screaming and it's just a cultural difference. Overall, a great guy who hasn't yelled at any of us yet. I feel bad since his reviews do not reflect him as a person.

Honestly do not understand why he has such low rating. He cares about his students and wants them to succeed. He makes lots of jokes and tries to get everyone involved. People who say that he yells probably do not understand the cultural difference. I was concerned he would be yelling at me too, but he is a sweet man who wants you to succeed.

I love this dude, the ratings don't give him enough credit. Maybe he has changed, but as i've read, I was concerned he would be a tough professor who is hard on his students. He actually connected with us, and gave us enough work to properly learn the material and do well for the exam.

For an entry level coding course, it neverrrrr had to be that complicated. Do NOT ask questions during labs unless you want to feel embarrassed or ashamed infront of your peers. He would yell and call students code ugly. I can tell he is a genuine person and wants students to learn, but his delivery is poor. WOA: MAKE FRIENDS !!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Worst teacher I've ever had. Humiliates everyone and screams in the lab. You also can't understand one word he says. All he does is waste your time, as office hours are composed of him just yelling at you for asking any questions. Save yourself, and do NOT take his class.

Prof. Hien was all in all a great professor. Although at times he might be tough, if you take advantage of his office hours it isn't hard to do well in his class. Just be prepared to get shouted at if you code a different way than he does.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: If you want to succeed in computer science I highly recommend not taking professor Hien. Hien has got some serious anger management issues, he often comes to class in a bad mood and proceeds to take it out on the students by shouting slamming desks and chairs. He continuously puts down students making his classroom a hostile work environment.

He is extremely helpful if you are struggling dont get me wrong. However, he yells at his students when they make the slightest mistake. Also, everything needs to be done his way, if not even if its right but not his way he will mark it wrong. The final project is also super hard. I honestly would not recommend taking this class unless you have to.

He was caring and willing to help you. If you are struggling, go to the office hours. IT IS VERY HELPFUL. The only thing I disliked was that he yelled during the labs. He can be reactive when you don't follow his instructions. It isn't out of ill intention, just a little rough. Going to the labs did give me anxiety tho but overall, I enjoyed him.

He comes off as sweet and tried to make lots of jokes but he takes a lot of time overexplaing. He also gets very upset if you make a mistake in your code and will probably yell at you, but to me it just seemed like a cultural difference and just wants you to understand. The class isn't unbearable because of him but don't step on his toes.

He was my lab professor for CSC 120. He wants things to be done exactly the same as he does and any small deviation would lead to him shouting at you. When you don't understand something he would repeat the same things until eventually just giving you the answer. He has a heavy accent and that also made it very difficult to understand him at times.

He was actually my lab professor for CSC120, the guy would constantly start shouting at kids for making the slightest changes to his code. He just shouts all lab long and gaslights you into thinking this is making you a real programmer. You'd ask him for help and he was often wrong, and when you told him that he'd shout at you and then walk away.

I personally love Professor Nguyen. However, those who are not tech-savvy should beware. Professor Nguyen expects you to be caught up on readings and be able to maintain his speed. He comes off aggressive but it is never intentional and he always tries to help. If you want to succeed in this class do all the readings and attend office hours often.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He makes the entry level cs class unnecessarily complicated. Labs are disasters, instructions are always not clear. He will teach the class with mood because the previous section's people didn't do the task well. Disseminating negative energy and lots of yelling. take him carefully if you don't know anything about programming.

What a great professor. His priority is your learning! He will find any way possible to help you understand the lesson we're going over, he makes the lectures FUN, he has a very interactive teaching style. He sends out polls for you to ask him questions so he can answer them in class, in case you're nervous of asking in a room full of people.

Terrible professor. Extremely easy class. If you already have knowledge in programming, you will not get much out of this class. It is very difficult to understand him and he made grammatical errors on his exams (LOL). 

His lectures are useless too and are full of rants and digressions.

Professer Hien is new to the University of Miami and I really enjoyed taking his course. He is extremely caring towards students and goes above and beyond to help them outside of class. Can be a little aggressive while explaining difficult concepts if youre a newbie but dont take it personally. He is always willing to help and wants you to learn

Dr. Nguyen cares for his students and will answer any questions you have. This class was enjoyable. There are weekly assignments, weekly lab homework, and a midterm and final project. If you enjoy the material being taught, you will have no problem getting a high grade in this class; if you do not "enjoy" the material, it is still fun.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Caring

reviews.comment: It was a great class for an introduction to computer programming. He was always available to help with questions. If you do the homework/labs you will do fine. Go to the labs if you need help. Great class, definitely take him!
Very nice guy, kinda hard to understand. Easy class if you do the homework, and if you do fine on the labs you don't really need to go to class.

If you have to take Chemical Oceanography, take it with Dr.Close! She knows her stuff (as it is her research focus) and she makes it as easy as possible. It's a hard and niche subject, its very easy to get lost. But she gives test questions beforehand so we know exactly what to study. The class is just difficult since Chem and Physics are.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr Close was an amazing professor. Although lecture heavy, she is very fair and is great at explaining the material. I enjoyed the way the class was structured, as she gives you all the quiz and test questions ahead of time.

Most people agree that Close is the best professor to take for MSC 215. You get the questions for all tests and quizzes ahead of time which makes the class less stressful. Although the lectures can sometimes feel long, Close is passionate about her work and she's a good professor to take!

Dr. Close is an expert in the fields she teaches. Also, the grading criteria is structured so that if you prepare sufficiently you will do great! For chemical oceanography, you have access to all of the exam questions beforehand so it's on you to go to office hours and learn the material expected of you. She makes great powerpoints and teaches well
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Class setup was trivially easy with 100% of exam questions being provided prior to the exam and a short final paper. Dr. Close was not good at grading exam or quiz questions consistently and would often take points away for not including information that was not directly relevant to answering the question posed (though may have been related).
boring lectures; weird exam but easily graded
Horrible. Stay away from her.
Outstanding professor. Brilliant. Teaches how to read intelligently a SCOTUS case.

God help you if you end up in her Corporate Tax course. You'll hear everything about her cats, her first husband, her current husband's "useless" children, feminist rants, and generally how everyone (except her, of course) is unintelligent and awful. When she does get around to teaching Corp., it is fairly incomprehensible and a lot of reading.

She was extremely difficult to follow during class lecture. She doesn't fully explain herself, and goes on very random tangents. This make complex material even more confusing. Her exam was as terrible as everyone had told us. Avoid her as a professor if possible.
Dangerous teacher. If you get on her bad side, watch out.

Great teacher.  Her tangents are hilarious "commercial breaks" during 2 hours of con law.  There are not a lot of cases, and she really teaches you to analyze the policy behind justices and cases.  Her exam was incredibly hard, but she is a very lenient grader.  Just try to answer every question.  I thought I failed, and ended up with a B+.

Extremely vindictive, it shows in the grading. Better to say nothing in class than anything at all. Exam was really intense but not impossible, but grading is definately erratic. Many top students were sorely disappointed.
This lady was great!  She does go off on tangents, but they are funny, and somehow, you still end up learning con law.
She talks about everything BUT con law - watch out for stories about her cat fluffy, her first ex-husband, and why she never had kids.
No Comments
Probably best to avoid this teacher if possible.
I don't know what these other idiots are whining about, she's a good teacher and explains things very well.
I concur with all other postings.  The best way to describe this professor:  Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde.  She enjoys putting students down and even other faculties and professionals.  WATCH OUT!

This professor is terrible. She trats her students like crap and is extremely unconcerned with your success in your carreer. Despite the fact that 80% of her students are practicing attornies, she beleives you are beneath her. BEWARE

Very oppressive professor. Goes on tirades about how unpreprated the class is. Constantly talks down to students. Engages in alot of male bashing. Agree with other reviewer - would be very careful about getting on her bad side.
She is corrupt & unfair. Expect to be blackballed & given a bad grade if you don't kiss her butt. She is a decent professor & explains things well, but is morally bankrupt. Be very careful with her!

If you are looking for a cognate, do NOT take this class. She gives an unreasonable amount of homework for a 101-level class. Way too many assignments, and is not lenient at all. No exceptions. I do not recommend.

What an awful professor. She relies on the textbook for all the quizzes and tests in the class. The entire class failed the first test and she didn't care to help any of the students in her class succeed. On a personal level she denied a religious exemption and wouldn't accommodate me because we had a test in the class that day.

The class material was easy but the professor is unbearable, I never wanted to go to class because she was so annoying. Missing a class will bring down a letter grade. She makes this class more stressful than it actually is in every way possible. If you can choose someone else, do it.

do not take if you're taking for cognate. this woman is too dedicated for people who could care less about theater. can be rude if you ask a question about your grade, I think she gets intimidated by students. her syllabus guidelines don't aline with her. turned in a paper a month late, should've been a F... got an 92, with a super fake excuse.

Shea is fantastic. She shows clear interest for the subject and her students. Her lectures are a bit wordy and long but thats the nature of the class and she does her best to make it interesting. 10/10 would recommend.

reviews.comment: Just as a warning, DO NOT TAKE

Could recommend not taking her enough. She isn't even at Miami and has to teach it from across the country on zoom. You learn nothing, her TA is the worst grader ever, you don't get a chance to learn because they give you an assignment, give you a horrible grade, and move on. Waste of a class, do not take, take Rick instead. Unfair as heck.

My highest grades in the class were only when I copied and pasted stuff from the PPT word-for-word and changed the numbers around using the SPSS output from the HW. You don't actually learn how to write, you're just told to follow directions like you're in grade school. Also you need a 94% minimum to get an A.... Don't take this professor.

Great professor! Extremely transparent about what will/won't be covered on exams & for instructions. Listen carefully during the mandatory lectures. She uses a textbook, but you can honestly get by w/ just the PowerPoints. Pop quizzes are for extra credit only. If you listen to what she says and take cursory glances at the slides, you'll pass.

reviews.comment: THIS IS STATS 101. Took PSY292 in Spring 2025, she does not grade any homework. The only grades are the exams which are EXTREMELY DIFFICULT. She does not prepare you well for the exams.  She has high expectations for students for an online class. She is clear with her teaching but It is very difficult. NOT AN EASY CLASS.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: You're only graded by four exams and a few pop quizzes. You have to read the textbook before every class because she might have a pop quiz on it. I didn't like exam questions. She does provide study guides. She can be a little ruthless but she's very direct with her teaching and you know for the most part what to expect on a test.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Hoffman is extremely clear and direct with this course. Her lectures are all directed toward what will be on the exams and she gives exam reviews detailing what she wants the students to know. Her class is made up of 4 exam grades (25% each) with up to 2 points of extra credit from bonus quizzes. Overall, would definitely recommend

took AP stats in highschool & it helps a lot for this class. 4 online exams, 2 points extra credit via pop quizzes, rounds your final grade up. exams are really similar to exam reviews so attend review sessions. she's willing to clarify any concepts i don't understand. overall i recommend taking her class!
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I don't even know how her ratings are so high. Her class was impossible. Asking a question is scary. She thinks she knows everything. I happily dropped the class in a heart beat
Her expectations for assignments are very clear and easy to follow. She explains herself well regarding SPSS and writing assignments. Her exam reviews are almost a direct copy of the test you take

Second time taking her because she explains things so well. Her slides and reviews make it easy to understand concepts and what to focus on for exams. She wants the students to succeed. Decent amount of writing work but would be with any teacher for this course.

Her lectures were easy to understand and she cares about her students actually learning. She organizes reviews and is easy to contact. Attend the reviews to know exactly what is on the exam to study for.

Professor Hoffman clearly cares about her students doing well. However, she can be very condescending at times, there is a lot of reading, and optional hw. Do it. Pop quizzes on chapter readings for extra cred. Worst part is that questions on test are designed to trip you up(they will talk about something related but not the focus of the question).
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I have taken Hoffman a few times now and I absolutely love her courses! The statistics can get a little difficult but she is very thorough with SPSS and goes through each step to ensure you can do the HW.Learning about the details of APA is super tedious but the class gets more interesting if you like biobehavioral stats.The study guides are great!

I like Hoffman a lot. She is such a good teacher and is very thorough. The homework is not graded but if you want to do well you have to do it!! She also gives you the solutions to the HW so you can check your work just dont fall behind. Go to the optional exam reviews and ask questions if something confuses you. I would totally recommend her!!!

Easy class. Show up, pay attention, go to the exam reviews, and do the homework (even though it is not graded, it helps you better understand the material). You always know what to expect on exams. The exam reviews are super helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Everyone told me this class would be easy, but it is not! She is so hard. I took AP stats in high school and did so well. This was completely new material. Definitely not an easy A. I think most people get Bs in this class.

Clearest professor ever. The tests are made up of only stuff we learned in class/on the homework. There are no tricks at all. Just show up to class/the review sessions and you WILL do well. It's hard to do badly in this intro to stats class with this prof. There's also a lot of extra credit quizzes. Highly recommend, super stress free.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Hoffman made this class interesting. It's your basic stats class. Go to class and review sessions-she goes over exactly what will be on the exam. There are pop quizzes, but she'll maybe emphasize or send a reminder to read a certain chapter before class-I usually just read the summary at the end. You just did't try if you had a bad experience w her
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: The class is graded only by exams, the professor is not understanding or supportive, exams are mostly conceptual, the homework problems do not help. Professor makes it intimidating to ask for help. Read the book and that'll help with exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This teacher gave 4 pop quizzes total. She made really difficult tests and we were not allowed a calculator or scratch paper. She gives you a study guide and holds a review session which helps, but the tests are usually conceptual based which isn't made apparent until test day.
Only graded on the tests but she adjusted them to make them easier when she saw my class was struggling. Super nice and funny. Would love to take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Easy class but she explains material really well and is so clear on what you need to know for exams. Go to class and do the optional homework and you'll be fine. She's very funny and nice

Dr. Hoffman is the BEST for PSY291! She tells you exactly what you need to know to do well and provides a study guide, and then goes over the study guide during an optional (but I encourage to attend) study session, where she makes it super clear what you do and don't need to know- not to mention she's super funny and very accessible!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: She was really a great teacher. This was my second class with her and she is so clear about what she is looking for. Most straightforward teacher I have ever had. There is a good amount of assignments and you need to take notes. But I would def recommend. Lots of extra credit
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The best teacher I ever had at UM. Great lecture with clear definitions and nice examples, easy to understand. Choose her without hesitation!!

Great professor. Always choose her when it comes to stats and research methods. She is EXTREMELY clear with her criteria, which makes it easy for us. Tests are also straightforward since if its not on the study guide it WON'T be on the test.

Dr. Hoffman was my favorite professor of the semester. She is super straight forward with what she expects, no surprises. Attendance is mandatory because there are quizzes each class on the reading but not something to worry about. Highly recommend this teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I'm really the worst at math and went into this course expecting to hate it and fail. Professor Hoffman completely changed my perspective and this has been one of my favorite courses in college. She's super clear about what you need to know and explains difficult concepts slowly and so clearly. Uses a lot of real world examples. Great teacher!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. Hoffman is one of the best professors I've had in the psych department. She's really an expert at teaching statistics & getting students to understand the material. Attendance is important since she explains how to do the homework in class. Some of her assignments have first & final drafts so you can fix your mistakes. Def take Hoffman if u can
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Loved this professor. She doesn't waste your time in class and always lets you go early. Never stayed later than 50 min for an hour and 15 min class. She tells you exactly what you need to know for exams and will help you in office hours if you're not getting something. She seems intimidating at first but is the best.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: One of my favorite professors at UM. Her study guide is exactly like the exam. Her quizzes are super easy and a great grade booster. Definitely take her for stats.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great professor. Assigns reading and homework every night (doesn't check it, has solutions up online). Short quiz on reading before every lecture, but reading the key terms and chapter summary is sufficient. Gives a review sheet for every exam with EVERYTHING you need to know for exam. Overall great teacher, straightforward and fair. TAKE!

Dr. Hoffman knows her material and is great at breaking down the main points. She's funny and tells you exactly what she expects from you on tests and assignments. She tries to give many real world examples. Its helpful to go to class to get credit for the easy daily quizzes and to find out what you need to study.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: If you have a choice, definitely take 390 with Hoffman. She will let you redo HW assignments to fix your mistakes, and tells you EXACTLY what will be on the exams. We usually get out of class early too. The readings are required and there are daily homework assignments, but everything is manageable and she has a great sense of humor/makes class fun
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Great professor! Her class is very structured - daily quiz, optional homework problems, and a review before every exam. Her exams are straightforward and fair, just keep up with your work (don't fall behind!) and ask her questions anytime you're confused. Really enjoyed her teaching style and she made Stats exciting and used interesting examples

Take her if you need a stats class! She tells you exactly what you need to know for exams. The material is presented really well; easy daily quizzes keep you on track so you never feel behind. If you simply read the chapter, you'll get As on the quizzes. Tests are exactly like hw problems. Got out of class early a lot. One of the best profs at UM!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: 10/10 would recommend

There are 4 tests worth different percentages and quizzes almost every class covering the reading assignment given the day before. Reading the chapter summaries will be sufficient for the quizzes.  Go to the optional class before the tests because she gives hints on what's on the exam. Easy class if you take notes in class and do the study guides.

Her class is so boring, she turns off the lights and puts a powerpoint presentation. Attendance is mandatory, there are easy 5 questions quizzes every class. She's a tough grader but her tests are doable. Each one is worth a certain percentage which makes you study more for others. She's okay, she dresses very nice.

She is not as easy as many people say. She makes you work hard to get an A. Quizzes every class about the chapter she is going to cover that day. Her text are exactly like the review she gives but she takes point off for non-relevant mistakes (such as you did not write the answer as she wanted). No homework. 3 exams and a final. She is not easy.

Dr. Hoffman is a great professor. She teaches well. She is very willing to help. There are quizzes in each class but all you need to know is what the chapter covers to get all questions right on quiz. Tests reflect what is seen in class and she gives out a review sheet so you can know what to study. HW not mandatory but very very helpful for tests.

Theres a quiz every lecture, but they're extremely easy but require you to read the chapter if you want a 100. The tests are pretty difficult, make sure you do well on the first one because its the easiest. Currently I am on the borderline of a grade and sent her an email and she seems willing to work with you which is a huge plus.

Gives absolutely no partial credit. If you miss one minor detail, be prepared to get full points off. Isn't helpful in her office hours. And gives a quiz every class. Granted the quiz is an easy 100 if you glance the "key terms" for the chapter assigned. But its still a nuisance.

Favorite teacher ever! Although there are quizzes every class, they are simple (only 4 questions). Her tests are VERY straight forward. She has a review class before every one and tells you EXACTLY what will be on it. She really wants her students to do well. She gives you all the needed formulas on tests so there is nothing to memorize! TAKE HER!

This class is intense, with a quiz almost every class. The quizzes are about 4 questions and the questions are very general just to check that you read the chapter. Her exams do require studying, but she gives you a study guide that is very helpful while preparing for exams.

ugh this was a hard class. She gives quizzes so often that you have to study literally EVERY SINGLE DAY for her class. If you're not taking hard classes, it's probably better, but this is a VERY intense class. I recommend taking it with Foote he's much easier. Take it during a semester where you have no hard classes. This will take up a lot of time

Very dynamic and fun instructor. She makes sure that every student understands what she is teaching and doesn't move too fast. Almost every class there is a short quiz based on the 20-30 page chapters in the book. Studying is a must for exams and doing the homework prepares you for all of her tests. Her final is partially cumulative.
I dont know why everyone says she is easy, I worked really hard and got a B. Nice teacher though, definitely recommend.
easiest A i've got for a 4 credit course. DO NOT MISS A CLASS. overall very good experience. made me like statistics
Dr. Hoffman was great. The class was SO easy but she knows that, she just wants students to get a basic understanding of statistics... which we did. I would recommend her to anyone.
easiest A+ possible

She is a really good teacher, she gives you what is going to be on the test...but that does not mean you can slack off, practice the study guide alot and you should be fine **she states when something in her notes is important(for a test)..you NEED to go to class(doesnt take attendance) to a) get the hw and b) take quizzes...good class
awesome professor!!!
Two Words...Take Her!!!  You do have to read the chapters for some simple "Quizzes", but well worth it.

She is an excellent professor. She gives review sheets before each exam and tells you exactly what to expect so you know exactly WHAT to study. Also gives formulas on the test so you don't have to memorize it! Do the h.w. and read chapters before coming to class and this will be the easiest A you've ever gotten for a 4 credit course.

She is a wonderful teacher and gives reviews and paper reviews before every test. The quizzes on the chapters ensure you read and the class is really geared to help even the worst students get an A. Wonderful Class

Very good teacher..knows how to teach and make student understand..keeps you busy but it helps you understand what you are doing gives you a review before the exam so u can be prepared...anyone can pass this class with an A...its not that she is easy and u won't learn ...she just makes it fun and makes it easier to learn!!!
Very nice! Made a possibly painful class into a pleasant experience!

10/10 recommend, absolutely take his class if you have the opportunity. He is one of the most welcoming, nicest people I have met. His positivity is inspirational. He loves his students and his work. There are 3 exams and a few assignments. The exams do not contain trick questions. If you attend the lectures, the exams are easy. Will miss his class

Cool and young professor. He even rapped for us lmao. The material was normal. The professor reads off the slides so don't ask him for help because he doesn't even know. Not an impossible class to pass

100% TAKE A CLASS WITH THIS MAN!!! He is AMAZING. Super caring, knows and cares a lot about the subject , and he gives a ton of opportunities for extra credit. He makes each lecture so interesting and fun. He even uses class volunteers to showcase a certain psychological concept. If you ever see a PSY class with his name on it, don't even hesitate!

Professor Howard is one of the newer professors at the university but man he is the best professor I had this semester! He is so down to earth and really makes PSY210 so interesting. He gives you a lot of chances to get good grades, his tests are based on what we go over in class...  Anyways he's a 10/10 go ahead and take him

Best prof I've ever had. He's so funny and makes each class so unique and fun. Interesting content and I learned a lot. No exams, just projects and weekly assignments. Loved being in class, he treats his students like equals and has fun w them, will apply class material to current & relevant events. Highly reccommend you take anything he teaches!!
Best professor I've ever had. Definitely take!

I LOVE DR HOWARD. Genuinely one of the funniest and most engaging professors I've had. He's young so he's relatable with his students and is super chill in class. Most of the classes were lecture based but still pretty fun. Course is interesting too. We had two group projects, one paper, and two exams plus the final. I would HIGHLY recommend!
He is very smart and rigorous. Be ready to study hard. He also talks a lot about current economic policy. Good guy too.

Nice guy but the worst class I've ever taken. Left that class, having learned nothing. My only saving grace is that 50% of ur grade is attendance and a group project. His exams are so confusing and way too many answer options. Smart guy, but can't really teach. Long winded lectures and not very easy content. Would've loved it if he taught better
He was ight

There were no ratings in a long time, so I kind of took a risk with this class. The class is very exam heavy, most of the grade is from exams, so make sure to study a lot. He's an amazing professor, his lectures cover what's on the test so make sure to pay attention to each detail, he offers a good amount of extra credit for one of the exams also
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The professor is clearly very smart and interested in what he teaches. His lectures are very organized. The material is a bit tough, but he is a very generous grader. One of the 2 midterms is dropped and he gives 2 bonus questions on all exams. Show up to class! He gives a lot of extra points on the exams if you show up.
He is a good guy, he gave a lot of extra credits when the class did the exam terribly

The lectures went back and forth between moving too fast and too slow. He was very approachable outside of class though.   Do yourself a favor and go to class. He gives extra credit attendance quizzes that can give you 10% extra credit on each test just for showing up.

He's a smart guy and you can tell he is very enthusiastic about the material and wants all his students to do well. Its impossible to follow along with him tho, he goes extremely fast and doesn't explain things clearly. Tests aren't that hard but be prepared to teach yourself the material. Attendance isn't mandatory but he gives extra credit.
Enthusiastic professor, real world application. Take this class if you actually want to learn about economics. Not to mention, he isn't bad to look at.
Hard

Great guy, really cares about student's understanding the material.  Would highly recommend.  Pretty hard to not do well in the class as long as you give some sort of effort.  Probably one of the best econ professors you will ever have if you want to learn non classroom stuff.  Pretty easy as well, curves up a bunch at the end.

Learned alot, Class is not a breeze but you will definetely learn a bunch. Go to class, its not mandatory but alot of the questions on test come from class and he gives extra credit. Second class taking him, both times A+

One of the least focused professors I've ever had. We missed the last 4 chapters because he rambled answering  questions. 2 test are 90% of the grade, but they are not too hard. He does everything to help you pass, even giving 7 of the 10 questions are repeats. Power points cover all the material.  Randomly does extra credit for attendance
Starts and ends class late. Does not answer questions.

Worst math teacher I have ever had. Taught by doing example problems, never explained work to the class, and was constantly talked over. He is a nice guy but cannot take control of the classroom and you have to learn the material completely on your own if you don't already know it.

AVOID if possible, he is not a good teacher. He messes up constantly on the lecture board and moves assignments and dates constantly. Goes over very limited content that's on the test. The exams are graded very harshly and there is no curve. He is hard to reach outside of class and hard to understand at times. Don't take for precalc 2.

Always late. Attending is useless bc he is incapable of effectively teaching. Gave back our exams to correct our mistakes for a higher grade, then decided AFTER finals not to count our corrections bc it would make our grades "higher than expected." No extra credit/curve even when the whole class couldn't decipher his poorly worded exam questions.

Shows up late to class
Can not properly convey his teaching material
Gives 7 question quizzes on something completely different than what he taught

Prof. Hsu is maybe the single worst professor I have ever had in college. I gave him an extra point only because he is a nice dude I guess. He never explains what he is doing, he very frequently makes major mistakes with basic math, and he assigns way too much homework. If you don't force him to explain his examples, you will learn nothing.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He makes many mistakes when going over material in class and can be very hard to follow. Unless you already have taken a class that went over the material of Calculus 1 in high school, I don't recommend having him as a professor because you may become lost very quickly.

So as far as I can tell the math department here's a joke, but Professor Hsu makes it super easy. The tests and quizzes are SUPER straight forward. I just don't show up and then I look at his lecture notes the day before the quiz/test to study since the same type of problems will be on there and I ace most quizzes/tests. Ting-Hao is the man.

A good professor if you pay attention during lectures. Tons of homework, usually about 3 web assigns a week, all due Sunday night. Thick accent but still understandable. He teaches some concepts in a very roundabout way.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Just a super cool professor, definitely take him. There's homework every week but it's just videos and pretty straightforward.
If you somehow fail this course, you are not passing a single other course at UM

Such a chill professor. Grading is so easy, attendance counts towards your grade (so basically free points for showing up), midterm and final are take home, and the major presentation is just to submit a powerpoint, no voiceover or anything. Never really paid attention, and still ended with an A+.
Sweetest Professor. Lectures are engaging. Attendance is mandatory, but lowkey its not. Definitely take this class if you can!!!

BEST PROFESSOR!!! Although attendance was mandatory, you can go in and just listen and get your homework done. He is so nice and caring. We had weekly homework's but they were easy and only a midterm and final that were online. Take him.
Attendance is mandatory but it's a question asking if you attended class. Three tests that are take home and very easy. Homework every week but it's easy to get 100 on.

Tests are online and easy. Great guy but the only knock I have is that he just makes quick political comments that arent really necessary. However, a great option for a cognate or elective and a good dude.
He's the cutest man ever. So sweet and class was fun and easy

If you need a good but easy art elective, take this class now! He has attendance pop quizzes that just ask if you attended lecture today, video discussions due every Sunday but each video is less than 5 minutes, 3 online exams, and 1 powerpoint project. He is an easy grader and also gives great feedback. I definitely recommend taking him!

Dr Hollander is a really great professor, he really knows his stuff. His lectures are engaging and the content is really quite interesting. He's very funny and knowledgeable, you can tell how passionate he is about art history.
Kindest professor at Umiami! Super sweet and adorable man who cares for his students. Class is pretty easy and tests are open note. TAKE HIM IF YOU CAN!

super nice guy, lectures were long but interesting and he made a great effort to include a diverse variety of artists from each era. workload was manageable and interesting, lots of material but easy quizzes. will definitely be taking arh131 soon. great if you need an easy cognate/elective credit, and a very helpful course to take as an arch major.

This class was completely asynchronous so I didn't have any communication with the professor, but it was a good class you just have to keep up with it like you do any online class. Grades are based on a midterm & final (SO easy), a project, & weekly reflection assignments. I actually did learn a lot & he does explain concepts well.

Hollander is an excellent professor and a great person. If you go to class and do the weekly homework, you will get an A. The project is easy but takes some time so start it early. The two exams are way more difficult than I expected but are online at home without lockdown browser. He is very easy on grading and will round you.
Hollander is one of the sweetest professors at UM. If you're looking for an easy class with little to no homework, this is for you.

Professor Hollander is extremely kind and passionate about art. I knew nothing about art and was nervous for this class, but it's impossible not to get an A if you do the homework. Although it's an easy class, the content is genuinely interesting and he's a great lecturer! Don't buy the textbook you actually will never use it ever!! Open note tests

A mid-term and Final exams are required that are open book, but still very challenging. A PowerPoint presentation is also due at the end of the semester.

Cares about what he is teaching and only requires effort in return. Only negative would be trying to communicate with him through email, non-existent.

Awesome class and highly recommend!
Great professor. All of the tests are open note.

Very nice man. Very lenient. He went out of his way to help students perform well in class. Exams are challenging if you don't have background in Art History. Lectures are a bit boring. He is a nice instructor overall. I would recommend this professor.

Professor Hollander is the nicest person ever. He is passionate about art which makes class so much better. He was caring and will help you if you fall behind in class. I look forward to taking more of his classes.

Absolute favorite professor ever. He is so nice, his lectures are so fun because he's so passionate about art history. He wants you to do well so he's a super easy grader and makes the class easy for you. The material isn't hard to grasp at all. There is a textbook but you really don't need it. Project is super easy. Take professor Hollander!
He's amazing. I would take every ARH class with him if I could. He actually cares about his students learning about art.
Professor Hollander is here to help and always patient with his students.  Very knowledgeable and passionate about the world of Art history.  I would definitely take his class again!
Super sweet and chill professor, will definitely help strengthen your love for Art History :)

One of the most understanding and passionate professors. He truly cares that his students learn about the material, and not about irrelevant dates and stuff. His lectures are clear and understandable, and you really learn a lot from the class in a positive way. I wish I could take more of his classes because he made me find my love for art history!

This is the second time I've taken Professor Hollander by choice. He is excellent. The lectures are clear and easy for everyone to understand. He makes the class/subject very interesting. Exams are open note and homework is minimal. Memorization is not required because he just really wants you to enjoy the art he is speaking about. 10/10, take him.

The class consists of 3 online tests that are open book, a powerpoint project, and weekly discussion posts about 2-3 videos. The class was overall interesting and discusses art from many different time periods. Overall, I found the class easy.
Love him, easy work has interesting content

He lectures from powerpoint slides. Weekly video reflections. A midterm and a Final. Very knowledgeable and caring. You can easily contact him outside of class through gmail. If you are thinking about taking this class choose him as your professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Hollander is amazing. The class is simple: every Sunday there are between 2 and 4 one-paragraph reflections due about different art pieces . There is only a midterm and final, in addition to one small project. The midterm and final are tough, so pay attention and take notes. He takes attendance and it goes toward points for your grade.

I took this class online last semester and it was great! Tests are multiple choice but a bit long. The professor requires you to do art critiques on different pieces he provides you (all online) but it's great because you really start to engage with the art. He is very nice and understanding!
Love him!! Really nice and explains very well.
I learned so much about art history in this course. I really enjoyed it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Simply the best. You get out of the class what you put in. If you are taking this as your cognate and are just trying to knock out the credit, you can do well pretty easily. If you are interested in Art History, definitely take him. His passion for it is infectious and makes you wish there was time in the semester to go into more depth.
Hes amazing! Hes so nice and flexible. Hes there for you and tries to make the class very interesting for us students

Professor Hollander is the GOAT. He is the nicest, most understanding professor. If you stay on top of your work and try you are guaranteed a good grade. He is very accessible outside of class and is always willing to work with students to help them succeed.
chill dude

Had him Summer I 2016 for Survey of Western Art II! He is a professor who cares so much for his students and is very understanding and accommodating! His exams are take home and competed online! He also grades you off of a couple of essays, but he does not grade hard on those at all! I even missed a few classes and STILL ended up with a "B"!
Great lectures! Highly knowledgeable, caring and passionate.
The absolute GOAT

Great professor. Would take again. 3 take home tests and one paper. online quizzes based on revel ebook. pop quizzes that are counted as attendance grades. He will work with you just show up and listen, he understands that most of us take the course for a cognate and that we don't actually know anything about art lmao.

He is a nice professor. However, lectures can be very boring. He teaches off of powerpoints that have information on it but beware that the powerpoints posted on blackboard don't contain the information just pictures. All 3 tests are take home. He wants you to be able to point out artistic techniques not just memorize dates and facts about the art.

Amazing course and an amazing professor. I learned a ton. Very happy I took this course. It was just for a cognate but it was my favorite course of the semester without a doubt. He is very knowledgeable about art and also very approachable.
Pretty easy class. The exams are all online and they are all questions based on his lecture material. Really nice guy and really easy A.

Took this 6 week course during the summer. INTENSE with an avg of 8-12 assignments per week inclusive of video discussions, ques, and 2 quizzes. I recommend the e-book (easier to search through). There is a midterm paper & final essay. Quizzes can be tricky, search carefully in book chapters. Don't slack! Prof. is simple grader. Sunday 12a deadline
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great guy , chill class. Learned a lot last semester. Highly recommend.
If you need this credit, look no further. This class is the perfect class. Clear ABC. Do the HW Do your test you'll pass A+. BUY BOOK
He's a nice guy and knows a lot about art, and is definitely extremely enthusiastic about it, but this class is supposed to be easy and the tests and visual analysis paper are not at all easy
Online tests. Not too hard. Everything is from the lectures. No attendance but a biweekly discussion board- not hard at all.
He's very helpful and is always willing to assist you with anything. Easy A

The lectures can get really long, but if you like art history or anything related, you'd find it really easy. The tests are online so make sure you do it properly since there is a time limit. Hollander is very nice, helpful and knowledgeable. Come to class to take notes since not everything is on the PPT. If you take good notes, easy A.
Tests are online which helps. Tests are basically straight from the lectures except for some questions where he asks about things said in class. Pretty straightforward.

Great class.  I have a new found appreciation for art.  Easy and approachable teacher.  Tests are online so you can use notes.  However, I would recommend coming to class because some test questions aren't in the notes, but you can still get by without going. Easy A.

He is my absolute favorite teacher at UM! He is nice, passionate about the material, and very helpful. There are online exams that are challenging if you dont go to class- he lectures off of powerpoint. Take him and you will learn a lot about art history- if you take notes, pay attention, and do the assignments it is an EASY A! Best teacher ever!

Professor Hollander is great. I truly recommend him. He is extremely helpful and approachable. I learned a ton in his class without having any remote interest beforehand. If you follow his study guide you should do ok.

Great teacher! he's unbelievably nice, knowledgable, and posts his lectures online. He gives you plenty of opportunities to earn points with online discussions, a paper, and 4 tests. He is probably the nicest, most accommodating teacher on campus. I had some family issues come up during the semester and he made sure I was taken care of.

Professor Hollander is one of the nicest teachers.  He makes going to class a pleasant experience, and I actually ended up enjoying learning about art history.  If you pay attention in class and know the art pieces that he tells you to know, you can do very well.  This is a great class to take even if your major is not related to art history.

Easy class if you go to classes and take notes. Attendance counts as part of your grade. Three online exams, one visual analysis paper, and three online postings. If you miss classes and do not take notes, most likely you are gonna end up with terrible grades. BUT, piece of cake if you go to classes and learn.
Great Professor! Made content clear. He is accessible and prepared. No BS!!! You do have to be there to learn but he makes it worth coming class. GREAT Prof!!!

Super easy class if you do your part. Memorize the slides. He tells you which ones to study. Come to class. He takes attendance. There are two exams and two papers. The essay questions on the exam are based on the lectures. Don't bother getting the book. He is super cool. Fair grader. Gives you every chance to do great. The papers are 5 pages long on a piece of work at the Lowe art museum. He is super cool, laid back, and approachable. Take his class!
Professor Hollander was very understanding and helpful. I would tell my friends to take his class.

he is a nice guy who likes to crack jokes. he is very knowledgeable. however for the tests, you have to study 60-75 images and also be able to write an essay about 2 or 3 of them for the essay portion of the test. the last test will kill you, with 4 essays. he does not give many hints as to what to study for the essay. but learn the study images.

a very interesting course because it focuses on a great time frame. hollander is an incredibly nice professor. three tests that involve memorization and easy essays, plus one 5-7 page paper that's graded very liberally. go to class because he's a great lecturer.

Hollander is amazing!!!!!! Nicest teacher, really cares about his students and what he's teaching. The class isn't difficult if you study the review he gives you.  He takes roll by passing around a piece of paper & the power points are online. You'll enjoy going, recommend it!
Fantastic professor! Easy grading, great teaching, non-mandatory attendance. Take it!
I ABSOLUTELY LOVE PROF HOLLANDER.. HE'S EXTREMELY HELPFUL AND UNDERSTANDING. THE CLASS ITSELF IS EASY. EVERYTHING NEEDED IS POSTED ON BLACKBOARD. TEST REVIEWS AND IN CLASS POWER POINTS AND OTHER INFO

Seems like a nice guy, although he says things that seem a bit strange at times. His religious & historical knowledge is a bit off as well. It is easy to skip his class because he doesn't take attendance & his powerpoints are pretty self-explanatory. The book is not necessary. The class is easy; the hardest part is memorizing artwork.

do NOT buy the text book, he puts all the images on the pwpt. the class is so easy, you don't have to pay attention. the 3 tests are 3 short essays, 25 slide ID.  A 5 page paper, even for the honors section.  I'm on rate my professor right now and i have a 99.. enough said.

I don't know how anyone could have anything bad to say about Hollander or his class. He makes the material very easy to understand and doesn't go over it too quickly which is great. He does assign a lot of slides for the tests but they're not difficult at all! If you go to class, don't bother buying the book though... you wont need it.

His teaching methods need to change! He assigns way too much material for each test and not to mention that you have to memorize it all..especially the artwork since you only have 1 minute to identify each. He's a nice guy but he could make the class a bit more engaging and maybe work something out with the material he presents.

What a snoozer!  Seems to say the same thing every class and the class attendance reflects that... no paper in a 300 level humanities class (wtf?)... I don't get why people like him; his comments on the artwork really don't do anything for me at all
Hollander is an excellent professor. He really knows his stuff, and he's so funny! I didn't think I'd like Art History, but he made it interesting. Plus, he's cute, so going to class is worth it.

professor Hollander was great, he had a calming almost "buddha" like quality to his teaching methods. He went slow enough for students to really know the material, encouraged students to question the artworks, and the tests were fairly easy although you have to know the artwork well.. so study! and there was one paper due but it was short and sweet
He is an awesome professor. He takes his time to make sure students understand the material, also his presentations of the course material is very helpful when reviewing for tests......
So kind and knowledgable. Would take him again in a heartbeat.
Great professor. Would recommend this class to anyone. Professor is amazing and the course material is great.
Absolutely a great professor and couldn't recommend enough. Very knowledgable about the topics discusses and very caring.

Professor Husayn is one of the most knowledgeable professors you will have access to at UM. He makes his classes engaging while also creating an environment where everyone can succeed. I would highly recommend him to anyone looking to take a religion class as an elective.

At first I was scared to take this course, no electronics, no more than 10 minutes late to class, quiz on lockdown every 2 weeks, Homework was 10 sentence reflection for a film or article.The discussions were amazing during class and everyone sharing their opinions. The films were quite interesting. Overall, I enjoyed this class don't regret it all
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very well spoken. Grading criteria is clear. Takes attendance every couple classes. One homework assignment each week that was ~20 pages of reading and then writing a summary on the reading. 1 pretty easy quiz every 2 weeks.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Participation is important in this discussion based class. Lots of short writing work to earn easy points and final is just a reflection on the semester. Great professor and an incredible class

Great professor and a very informative class. Its writing course, so there will be a lot of writing and reading. However, its very easy. Do all assignments on time and you will have an A. Class was very inspiring. Take him for sure.

Dr. Husayn is a kind and well spoken man. He makes class engaging and interactive. He is straightforward in what he expects from class, and is very clear about grading. If you put in the effort for the class, youll gain a lot out of it.
Super smart and nice guy. He assigns 8 blog posts throughout the semester, but they only have to be 10 sentences. Lots of reading, but very informative.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He is super helpful and friendly. Lots of reading and homework but not a super tough grader. Quizzes and papers are very straighforward. Keeps class interesting and allows for discussion. Somewhat strict about electronics but super understanding. Brought in snacks for the last class.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: be prepared for discussion, be familiar with the readings, and participate when you can. it's very easy to do well in the class if you're prepared and it's very interesting!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: 2 quizzes, one exam, 6 response papers (3 from media/ 3 from text on BB), and a final paper. Lots of reading. Accessible outside class and is always available for discussion. Helped me a lot understand intro to Islam
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: He talks SO much about random stuff (heavy politics), ur probably gonna hate him at first, but I learned a lot from his class. The whole class is presentations, literally every week, but they are SO easy. Easy easy class, just put up with him for an hour and u don't even need to pay attention at all. READ THE SYLLABUS he does a pop quiz 1st week!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Strong emphasis on political topics that have no correlation to the course. Forces students to respond publicly on their options on hot button political issues. Very left leaning.

Walter Hutchens is the GOAT. His class is very participation heavy (there are a lot of discussions on current events and presentations). Honestly, I learned more in this class than any other class during the semester, and the material was interesting and fun. At first I didn't like him, but he grows on you. Funny and smart guy! take him!

I'll say this: Your Blackboard grade will be misleading. Even if you don't do wonderfully on the news quizzes, you'll probably be okay if he sees you're trying and you turn in assignments on time. Really smart and experienced in the field but I didn't feel I gained much from the course.

If you are studying journalism, I highly recommend taking a class with Professor Hughes.He has years of experience and is eager to teach students.There are always guest speakers, which allow you to hear first-hand experience. Prof Hughes makes the class very fun and engaging. You will learn a lot from him, and he wants to see his students succeed.

Prof Hughes is very experienced in his field, but he isn't the best professor. There are lots of guest speakers and not a lot of work & the work you have is not graded. Current events quizzes at random, & he asks the most obscure questions. Quick tip, watch his broadcast because he usually asks a question about something he covered.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Great professor. As long as you attend class, complete assignments on time, and participate occasionally, you should be able to get an A. It's not too hard to do well in participation, but it is important since it makes up 25% of the grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor. Make sure to attend class and finish assignments on time, and it's pretty much a free A. Participate here and there to make sure you do well in that section, since it's 25% of your grade.

It was an easy the Philosophy and Ethics of AI and Computing. Sorta interesting, I genuinely enjoyed a couple lectures, and I would say the course is mostly philosophy and only one third about AI and Computing. He was not a very tough grader for the written assignments, asking questions helps but is not necesary.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Hwan is super awesome as a professor and I loved this class just get ready to write a lot of short essays and speak in class

Professor Ryu is genuinely kind and approachable, both in and out of class. He's easy to talk to, laid-back, and creates a classroom environment where students feel comfortable sharing their perspectives. He actively encourages discussion and makes you feel like your voice matters. His workload is manageable and fair. Highly recommend!
Very chill and nice guy

goated professor for PHI115, who loves the subject he teaches and is always open to discussion both inside and outside the class. The grade was only based on 4 easy writing assignments, group project, and attendance
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class was probably one of the most boring classes ever but it was so incredibly easy Hwan is pretty funny so sometimes he kept it entertaining. You can go on your phone and he doesn't care at all as long as you participate every now and then you will get the participation credit.

Such a nice and caring guy. I feel bad nobody really listens to his lectures, not because they're not interesting, but just because they don't care. Super interesting topics with a lot of class/group discussions on various topics. Super fun class, easy work-- 4 essays and participation/attendance grade.

He is a caring and genuine professor. Took him for PHI115. Unfortunately though many people do not listen but he still tries to engage and make lectures interesting. Class is not hard, no finals, a few papers and 1 group presentation. Attendance is mandatory but most people just sit on their phones anyways. Take him for an easy grade

PHD kid who is nice, caring, and understanding. Hybrid, just a reading or 2 per week and a small response answering a few questions due Monday, which were graded by participation. Final is 1,500 word essay graded loosely. Lectures are basically just to understand & explain the reading. A little hard to understand since he doesnt know English 100%.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great professor and very easy to reach out to out of class. But the class grade is mostly based off of 3 difficult tests. You dont do well on two of them and your out of luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Honestly barely showed up to class and just pounded the slides he gave us and got an A+. I'm not smart so I know most kids could replicate this success if they tried.
Easy!!! And he gives extra credit. Take him.

I really liked Professor Hwang, but this class is definitely not mandatory. I went to all of the lectures which was good for me, but it is easy to get distracted during them so you have to make sure you focus during the class or you won't retain any of the material. However,he does post all of the lectures online so you can look at them there
you will get an easy A, if you keep pace with the professor

He is a bit difficult to understand, but does a really good job of explaining the principles of micro in the most simple way so anyone can understand. He is very accessible after class and LOVES class participation. Easy A.

Hwang is fine. His lectures are straight from powerpoints, don't have to go to class, just study before exams and you'll be fine. Homework is due weekly and is annoying but easy. Exams are from notes and in class handouts. Not too bad but not my favorite.

His exams are tough but he is such a caring professor and is always willing to help you. Super accesible on his office hours. Material can be hard but he'll answer every doubt you have. 10/10 would recommend. One hw per week and drops your lowest exam grade.

Loved this professor!!!!! Homeworks are due every Sunday and are super easy and helpful. He bases all the quizzes on them (literally uses exact wording or just changes numbers in problems). Drops your lowest exam and homework score and weights your highest grades more heavily take him!!!
It's not very hard to get A if you can study after class. The professor is caring and patient. One homework per week, and three exams in total.

It was his first semester as a professor so hopefully he knows what to improve on in the fall. He's very caring and made sure you understood the material when you visited him at office hours. He also gives a lot of extra credit. However, he did make make me question whether or not I wanted to continue majoring in economics.

His class might not be super exciting but the content is clear and his powerpoints include most of the information you'll need to know, so there's no need to read the textbook. There's homework every week but you can get it done in about 1.5 hours. It's a pretty chill class

lectures are so boring and horrible no one goes to class. Everyone shows up for the 3 exams and calls it a semester. If your chill with not goin to class and learning it by yourself then take it, if not then have fun finding a professor that will. Homework once a week online and thats it. Not a labor intensive class he just isnt good
He has terrible lectures, I've never been so bored before in a class.
good class good professor

As this is an introductory class, Ian is excellent and sets you on the right path for broadcasting. I took his class last semester, and he is helpful with teaching new technology, such as Premier, and using the camera. You need the camera for projects, but directions are straightforward. Very personable guy that is great to know and talk to!

Highly recommend! Ian has been one of my favorite professors so far. Very responsive and caring. Gives very clear feedback on drafts. 3 big video projects, student spotlight assignment, and one straightforward midterm exam.
Just come to class and do the work. You are given about 3 video projects and he provides great feedback. Student spotlight is really fun and he is a great guy with a lot of experience
May he rest in peace

Super boring lectures. Lecture material and blackboard are extremely disorganized and unhelpful. The course grade is 85% exam based: exams which he does not help you prepare for and that cover things that weren't taught/spent time on in class.
Egregiously boring lectures. Outrageously disorganized slides and materials. Would take a harder class for my chem minor if I get to pick again.

Do not take his class. He is a very nice professor but has NO office hours and doesn't respond to most emails. He also put stuff on the exams that we never learned so a majority of the class got a 50 on the last one. There aren't any projects or extra credit so the class is 75% test based. Attendance is super important to get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Accommodating when he needs to be, never answered emails though. Other than that, it was hard to follow his lectures but he's a nice guy. Use his PPTs for the homework which are needed to do well on his exams. Good luck.

Good lecture and interesting materials though. Rarely respond to emails. Get mad when students ask questions. Hard to get an office hour. Writing questions are basically from homework, but he never graded it and does not allow taking photos of those long answers. No one can write down all the answers. Grading scale was given very late.

I personally have a bad experience with him. He seems to get annoyed with me when I ask questions in class yet gets mad when I don't ask for help. He got mad at me for failing a test. He doesn't respond to emails. I had to go into quarantine, and I emailed him about it and he never responded. I had to miss two classes because of it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Participation and attendance are important to get a good grade in the class. The hws are not that bad and the exams are fine if you study the hws and go to class.

Hynes is a great prof, passionate and clear about the material. Easy A if you memorize the homework he gives you. He encourages students to meet with him outside of class if they aren't sure about anything. You do have to show up to class as he takes attendance. All in all a solid class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Hynes was great, he basically goes through his slides and gives good examples and makes sure everyone is keeping up. He gives test questions during class, so attendance is always helpful. I used the book to make sure I understood different terms as his tests are very direct with definition. He is very nice if you just respect him and pay attention.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Worst professor! And on top of that very aggressive and disrespectful. Avoid at all cost!!!

One of the best professors I've had at Miami so far, he really appreciates and helps the students that try very hard and go to class and office hours. It's a good amount of work but it's do-able and can make for a very enjoyable 9 AM class (most 9 AM's aren't)
DOPE
Pretty easy class as long as you pay attention and try to understand what is going on. Asking questions definitely helps for the tests.
Worst professor ever.  Extremely hard to understand and very unclear in class.  Doesnt understand students questions when theyre asked, also extremely hard tests.

Difficult class, he's helpful, but he'll still fail you. You need a very strong prior chemistry background. You'll have three tests all semester, but should constantly work to stay ahead. Unless you have something to prove, or are really good, this class is something to reconsider carefully. That being said, he's still a nice guy.

Took the class for an easy science credit. it was manageable, but you def. have to read the chapter and study before exams. Lots of questions from the exams are from clicker questions he asks in class or from the homework. He's a good teacher, very willing to help you out.
Class was EXTREMELY BORING, but he's a nice guy. Says "ummm" a lot. I didn't purchase the book...just studied the powerpoints, homeworks and in-class questions for each exam. Moderately easy A.

He is THE WORST teacher I have ever had. I use to LOVE chemistry, and after his class I HATED it. He doesn't test the material, just random facts to make sure you've read the book. He is horrible, and unwilling to help you. He is very stubborn. Avoid taking him if its possible. He ALWAYS gets confused when you ask questions, meaning he doesn't know

Professor Hynes is a tough teacher, but he is so willing to help you that an A is definitely feasible.  Go to class, read the text book, and do your homework.  Also, let him know when you are confused and he'll spend as much time as you need, even hours clarifying.
Great Teacher.  Definitely recommend him.
He asks random formulas on tests, not difficult conceptually. Tests are MUCH easier than homework

Extremely hard teacher. Only Midterm and Final. Homework is VERY little percentage of grade. Must read textbook or you will FAIL as in F! Tests are a combo of multiple choice and short answer. Short answer is worth more than MC. Good luck! (This is for real, no joke)

The professor's lectures are hard to follow. Don't expect any of the problems you learn to match any quiz or exam. I felt like I was purely guessing on the work even after studying and when you email her for help she will say one word answers.
i taught myself the whole class. its hard to pay attention during her lectures but maybe thats just me. kind person, took her for 312 and 311. 312 is harder since there isn't as much of a curve.
She's nice but not a great teacher who's very hard to follow. Her tests are hard and class averages for the first 2 exams were below 80. You'll need to learn most of the material yourself.
This professor does not speak English. She is incredibly hard to understand. Do not take her unless you want to teach yourself

Lectures are quite boring and you should just learn the material outside of class. Not objectively hard content but she just doesn't explain. She records the lectures. People who say her accent is bad are just being dramatic.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Hulett is very nice. Although she's nice it's extremely hard to understand some of what she says. There is no homework, only quizzes and exams which makes studding hard. Theres also no text book. The only information are the slides and excel which can be hard to understand.

She is really sweet and you can tell she cares about you succeeding. There are 3 quizzes and 3 exams. I had a hard time understanding the material in class, so i just went over the notes and examples a couple of days before exams and did great. we also have labs on R Studio but they are the same as the in class examples. no homework.
The professor doesn't make anything clear and the quizzes are nothing like the homework. Don't take her
Good professor. Very nice and available outside of class. Always responds to emails fast. Definitely recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: You can't understand her. She's nice but impossible to learn from.

Overall, Professor Hulett was a good teacher.  She does have an accent which may be hard to understand at first, but you can tell she really cares if you put in the work. I'd definitely take her again if I had the choice.

She is super nice and always helpful. The class was pretty easy in itself so it's not hard to get a decent grade. Drops the three lowest quiz grades but final is weighed heavily. Sometimes her lectures are a little hard to follow but what's in them is always super similar to whats on the quizzes.
Ngl didn't pay attention at all and learned material on my own before tests but she's very nice
7 quizzes and she drops two she tells you exactly what's on each quiz and exam beforehand. Offers extra points of exams if you get the bonus question right. Very easy to access outside of class

I liked Professor Hulett, but her thick Hispanic accent makes the lectures EXTREMELY difficult to follow. Yeah, the material isn't that hard, but locking in on what she's saying is an entirely different story.
