She is super sweet and very nice, however she doesn't do a great job of lecturing and her accent is so thick it makes it impossible to understand what she is saying sometimes. Material is somewhat hard. Study on your own and learn the ti-84 calculator shortcuts because she won't teach them.

sweetest professor, always down to answer questions. however, definitely self study -- she has a tendency to make things a bit overly complicated when lecturing. you'll be confused in class, but have no issue on the homework. worst 3 quizzes get dropped. overall so sweet!

The class is hard, her accent is really thick, sometimes she will tell us one thing is on the weekly quiz and then something completely unrelated or 10x harder is on it. Got upset at all of us because we failed the first exam, as if that isn't a reflection on her. Hard to avoid the class because of the BSBA requirement so good luck if its her.
Terrible course. Can't understand her at all, moves too fast and is all over the place. Do not take.

The way she explains topics are difficult for no reason. She explains very poorly saying "this that this", which makes it hard to follow especially when many numbers are involved. On top of that her accent is thick. She moves way too fast which makes me have to self study in the end.

This professor makes this class way harder than it should be. There are surprises on the quizzes that were not on the homework's or practice problems. She a very nice person but her accent is thick and hard to understand. She also moves very very fast in class. Overall I wouldn't recommend
She doesn't speak English well. Goes too fast in class. Surprises on the quizzes that were not on the homework or practice problems. Overall a disaster of a class. Take someone else

She moves too fast in class. Her accent is very think and hard to understand. The syllabus is clear and she's a very nice person just hard for me to understand especially when she moves so quickly. I'd take a different professor.

Professor Hulett is a very kind professor. She comes into lectures with a lot of energy and enjoys speaking with students. If you are confused, she will help you. She does a good job simplifying her lectures to make them easy to understand no matter your familiarity with stats. Test questions can be a little tricky, but overall, they are fine.

The labs are easy but can at times be vague and lack instruction on how to complete them.  3 quizzes and 3 exams overall not to hard but studying necessary.  Post all notes but makes attendance mandatory.  Accent can make it hard to understand but not a terrible prof.  Overall not a bad class just study for quizzes and exams and you will be fine.

I taught myself everything in this class the day before the exams, with the help of her zoom recordings. She cares a lot about you learning, but sometimes the class is inherently just a little dull because of the material. Take her for this class though because she is very sweet and a safe choice of professor.

Professor Hulett is one of the best professors at the University of Miami. I was struggling in statistics, and I do not think that I could have made it through the class without her help. She cares deeply about her students, and wants them to succeed. Her lectures are great, and she explains the material in an understandable way. Take her classes!
If you don't know a lot of stats beforehand I wouldn't take. She can be hard to understand and moves fast. Probably would find someone else.
Nice lady but sometimes hard to understand. If you're not good in stats you'll do fine but will need a little extra effort, I basically self-taught this class.

Maria is an excellent professor. She's so caring and really easy to understand. She has more evaluations than other MAS 202 instructors but it's worth it because each exam/quiz consists of 1/2 chapters. If you are good at stats/math you'll think she's so easy if not you'll do great either way because helps any student understand the material.

Professor Hulett is an amazing professor. She genuinely cares for her students and wants to see them succeed. She is very accessible outside of class and is very accommodating if you need to take a quiz or an exam on a different day. I took her for both 201 and 202 and could not recommend more. If you have the opportunity to take her you should.

The best math professor I have ever had. Much better than the rest of the MAS teachers. People say her accent makes it hard to understand her but I disagree. There are quite a few quizzes and 3 exams but she gives you ample time to prepare and the quizzes are open notes. She goes above and beyond to make sure the students understand the material.
Very organized and prepares you well for exams/quizzes. Drops 2 lowest quizzes.

Professor Hulett was my favorite professor this semester by far. She is very personable and caring. She took the time to get to know all of our names. The quizzes and exams are basically the homework. If you have the chance to take her for Stats, definitely do.

If you go to class and pay attention, you will get an A. Quizzes are extremely similar to the examples she does in class. Love that. She is nice and will answer any questions you have. Kinda annoyed that we had a final project because we had a final test too. Overall very easy. If you are decent at math, even easier. I would take her again.

Professor Hulett was the best mathematics-related professor I've had at the U until now. While stats are hard, especially for a business course, professor Hulett gives great lectures, re-explaining the topics if needed. You can bring a sheet with notes to exams which does make them easier. Highly recommend.

She is good, I recommend. I find stats confusing and not straight forward. but once it clicks it's not bad at all. If u dont get it, get tutoring! u can quickly fall behind. Attendance is like 5%, but she def checks every class. Exams r straight forward, she is a good trustworthy teacher and she wants u to do well
Super nice and caring professor. Her exams and quizzes are not difficult if you may attention in class and complete online homework. Would recommend!
Very tough grader. Studied for hours and hours weeks before exams, still failed.

great professor! def go to class, attendance counts. Make sure you pay attention and study before test but you are allowed 4 pages of notes for every test. Quiz are open note but study a bit. Homework is easy. Use youtube it will be easier to understand what she teaches. Its an easy A if you try and also use her as a resource, she will guide well
Harsh grading and sometimes unclear guidelines for assignments.

She really is a great professor who cares a lot about her students and is willing to go out of her way to help them succeed. Tests/quizzes are similar to in-class examples and she gives partial credit. Very fair grader. Super helpful during office hours  and responsive to emails too. Definitely take her if you have the chance.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof Hulett is a great professor compared to some of the terrible math professors we have at this school. She really cares about her students and if you make a small effort in her class you'll do well. Amazing prof though.
Professor Hulett is actually the nicest teacher ever. If you pay attention during lectures you'll be fine.

Difficult class. She is a good lecturer and is very willing and able to help you outside of class. Definitely take notes in class and do the practice problems. Very little room for error in your grades.

Awful lectures, terribly set up assignments and in-class activities. Get by because you can memorize which problems she will copy and paste to exams with different numbers.... but good luck actually understanding a thing.
Simply the best. Goated

As someone who didn't take stats until college, I wish I took Professor Hulett for MAS 311 as well. Grades are based on 3 quizzes + tests, 4 labs, and attendance. Very lecture-heavy, makes notes/examples accessible to us for exam prep, and wants to see her students do well. 

Advice: use the exam review to help understand the content.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Hulett is the kindest/most caring teacher I've had at university thus far. She goes above and beyond to help students succeed & makes all class notes accessible. You are permitted to consult your notes throughout weekly quizzes. Complaints about difficult exams simply means you weren't paying attention because she 100% teaches all material.
Amazing professor, very caring. tests can have curveballs but she is very fair and engaging. One of my favorite professors ever

Absolute worst teacher. Take her if you want to ruin your GPA. I studied for over 20 hours for each of her exams and still got bad grades because of how difficult she makes them. The exams look almost nothing like the problems she explained in class or gave for practice. The entire course also has only 3 tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Hulett is great. If you put the work into the class, it will work out well. She is an understanding professor, and will make sure the class understands the material. Also, she highly values participation.

Dont listen to everyone on here. If you pay attention and take notes on the steps of everything, you will be able to use your notes for the quizzes and then transfer them onto a double sided cheat sheet for the exams. Absolutely take her
Shes very hard to understand. The most difficult part of her class is not the math itself, attempting to figure out which formula or methods shes like you to use.

I've taken her two classes. MAS312 and MAS547. She literally does everything that she could to take points off, even for minor mistakes. And somehow, she looks annoyed when I go to the office hour and ask questions. Not patient at all. But the simulation class is interesting and useful. Anyway, try to avoid her if you can!!!

Go for it if you truly want to learn Stats. For an easy A, go somewhere else. She goes the extra mile to give opportunities to improve. In office hours she'll take the time to address any doubts. No issues understanding her English and class slides are available. If you are a low performer and lazy things are going to be tough for sure .

I liked Prof. Hulett at the start of the semester, since she always brings a positive attitude to class, but my opinion decreased as the year went on. Math is not my strong suit so I can't entirely blame the difficulty on her, but she doesn't do much to help. Her emails are totally unhelpful and incoherent. Don't even bother emailing her for help.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: First off AVOID. Her accent is so heavy its hard to understand her. She gives weekly quizzes and she makes sure to take off stupid points just so you don't do well on them. Its hard to get a good grade in this class honestly
Good Professor, tough to understand at times though she is very helpful and understanding outside of the classroom.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Avoid at all costs. She's difficult to understand and is very rude. Useless during office hours and gets mad when you ask her for help.

Professor Hulett is a great professor! She makes the material easy to understand. There are 3 Exams, a group project, and a cumulative Final. The material is easy in the beginning but gets a little bit harder at the end. Overall, she was great and I am happy I took her for Statistics.

She's very difficult to understand. She also moves very fast - good luck taking notes. I went to her office hours for help and she just seemed annoyed. I would say avoid this professor, but she's about as great as the rest of the MAS department.... good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very nice prof. If you have a background with statistics from earlier classes or HS, this class only expands on those concepts a little bit. She gives you all the resources you need. Attendance was mandatory and no computers allowed so class was a little boring with redundant material. Overall, pretty good.

She teaches very well and very clearly in class if you pay attention. She can be reached during office hours pretty easily and is helpful if you seek help. Grading criteria is very clear, and even though attendance is mandatory, the grades mostly come from exams, quizzes, and R Labs.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very nice professor. She cares about her students. Lectures are walking through ppts and you have to go to class and take notes. She has hw but it's not graded. If you pay attention to her class you don't even need to do the hw and easily get "A" on her quizzes and exams. The questions are totally the same as the examples she said in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: I love Professor Hulett! Her grading style is the same as all other Business School Math classes; very straightforward lessons + posts all ppts, homeworks, HW solutions online, very helpful if you ask for it. She has an attendance sheet every class, and it helps to go for notes. About 12 quizzes - just do the HW. She's great and I loved her class!
Avoid at all costs.

Sucks. Please avoid. Barely speaks english. Mispronounces words. Gives quizzes that are not on the level of her teaching. Quiz every week;open notes but trust me, she will do whatever it takes so you don't get a full grade on that quiz. Always looking busy and unhelpful during her office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Hulett is an amazing professor! Her lectures are easy to follow, and the exams mirror the numerous examples in class. Homework is optional. She dedicates a whole class to review for the exam. Definitely recommend her!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She wants to help you however she doesn't speak great english, show up to class you should be alright, take notes because you can use them on quizzes,

Very doable class. Lectures are clear with lots of examples. She goes slowly and explains thoroughly which is great. She's always helpful if you have any questions. Tests are exactly like examples and you get a cheat sheet. Put some effort into the cheat sheet and you'll get an A. Barely used the textbook. Would definitely take her again

She is so sweet and always willing to help! I was dreading stats 2 but she teaches off of her power points (not the book) and gives SO many examples that you'll know exactly what to expect on tests and quizzes. Quizzes are open notes and tests allow one cheat sheet. Study her examples and you'll get an A.
Explains really well and slow. Quizes every week. loved her!

Dr. Hulett is great. She is very nice, always willing to help and clear about what you should know for exams. While it may be hard to understand her at times (English isn't her first language), she walks you through slides and practice questions very clearly so you know exactly what you're doing. Don't waste money on the textbook.

At first, Dr. Hulett's accent was a little hard to understand, but after about a week, I got used to it. Compared to other 202 professors, I've heard she's the best. She's really nice and really helpful if you ask her questions. If you pay attention and study, you'll be fine.

Exams were annoying. They were usually only 6 questions long, 5 of which were just copy/pasted from class examples. There was always one question, though, that required you to actually *gasp* UNDERSTAND the material. Basically, you could do nothing and get a B or spend several hours studying to prepare for that one question. I chose the former.

She was a very nice woman who put every effort into helping the class, but she is not easy to learn from. I got over her accent quickly but sill barely understood what she was saying. I managed to scrape by with an A by memorizing how to to do the class/HW problems. I didn't understood the logic behind anything, though...

She's an okay teacher. I took her 201 class too, and I did well because I took stats beforehand. Honestly, I would only take her if you have a stats background or if you don't mind teaching yourself. On the bright side, she's very helpful, and you can use a formula sheet. Her honors class has a lot of quizzes and projects! Her accent is strong too!
She is helpful and nice, her tests are not very hard. she just has a terrible accent, but I mean terrible. In contrast she is beautiful and always happy. take her, specially if you speak spanish

She is extremely nice and really wants to help you but her accent is terrible. Sometimes it's hard to understand her so you don't really get what she's saying. Overall, if you can get over the accent then take her because she knows what she's doing and will try to help as much as possible.

Professor Hulett is a very nice woman who is willing to help and greets everyone with a smile, however she is a very difficult teacher to learn from. She is unclear and she is very difficult to understand. I would avoid this class as it makes a difficult subject (CALC) even harder.

Statistics is a hard subject both to teach and learn.  Prof Hulet made every effort to make it possible. I did not have any issues understanding her.  But, you better pay attention and go to class from day one. Otherwise you'll be lost. Testing and grading was fair.  She is indeed strict with due dates . Overall a good experience given the subject
Her accent is bad, but tests are super easy. She is willing to help anytime. As long as you study before the test and do your homework - easy A.

You will not have any problems as long as you do your homework and put hours into it. Yes, she has a strong accent but will also spend as much time as you need during office hours to make sure that you do understand the material. Exam's content is fare and she sticks to the book's material. Grading is extremely fare.

She does not teach from the book but rather puts up Powerpoints that students have to read from. Also, there are 4 projects that require knowledge from the book that she does not even mention. She doesn't allow extra credit on tests and will not allow makeups on any missed quizzes or homework assignments. Also, she has a very thick accent.

nice lady and helpful if you need it. her teaching isnt as clear as it could be but she is a really easy grader. if you write just about anything as an answer or show some trace amount of work she'll do her best to give you credit even if its completely wrong. no homework and she allows you to bring your own formula sheets for the exams

She is so nice and is very caring! If you ever need flexibility with assignments or further instructions she is so helpful. Her class is pretty easy if you try in your writing although it gets boring at times.
Super sweet and understanding. I'd highly recommend, I wish I could have her as my professor for WRS 106 next semester. Just try and you'll do great in the class.

Professor Jung is such a sweet woman and is very caring and considerate when it comes to classwork and assignments. The three major essays she assigns throughout the semester are fairly simple and she gives good feedback to help make them even easier. I'd say the only downside is that she has a hard time getting the class involved sometimes.

Professor Jung is a nice woman who will give a lot of feedback on your work. She grades based on three major essays but she provides a lot of feedback as well as class time to improve your writing before submitting it. The only downside is that she forces you to go to the writing center and classes can be a bit boring, especially 3 times a week.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very inconsiderate for your grade and has no intention of helping you when struggling. Just sits and writes on his ipad and talks in a very low and hard to understand tone. The class is so boring I recall students doing anything other than following along. Makes an unnecessary fuss when there is a minor mistake within your work. Take someone else.

This teacher will not hesitate to give you an F in your transcript. Has no care of how the class direction is going, and will continue to squeeze the life out of his students even if they are struggling academically with his class. Has consideration over student disabilities either. This guy is a scam, spend credits for other professors.

20% Weekly Online HW which runs even during break and exams week!, 10% Paper HW every 2 weeks, 2 x 20% exams and a cumulative 30% final. Exams were a time crunch and he checks strictly. Exams are 65% same as practice exam but not for finals, he picks from Problem set. Lecture notes are directly taken from book and explanations are ok. Approachable
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I would avoid, lots of work. Tough grader, do an entire problem correctly make a small mistake in formatting the answer and you will lose more than 50% of the credit. Often feel that he grades vindictively, if he doesn't like you it will be harder for you. In depth quizzes every week are hard to keep up with. not enough time on exams or quiz.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Tough grader

reviews.comment: World class lecturer. Theory heavy. Best teacher I have had and the most organized you will find. This is his passion, not just a job. I wanted to pass this class for him as much as for myself. When a professor gives the effort he did, they deserve to see "A's" reflected back. He took 30 min off the Final which hurt those who struggle. Work fast!

He was a good professor. His lectures were fast paced where you would just be copying down what he was doing and then learning it on your own later. The homework is easy, and the test material is fair. Just know that his tests were usually a time crunch; you finish the test but with no time to check your work.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Jang is an amazing professor. His tests are manageable and its easy to do well if you pay attention in class and stay on top of your homework.

Professor Jang is hands down the best Professor I have had at UM so far. He is caring and approachable, and is clearly passionate about the subject he teaches. I found the content a little confusing at times but he was always an email away, and he is available even outside office hours if you need to clarify anything.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Gives good feedback--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Jang for Linear algebra. The class is easy if you show up, do the online homework, and pay attention to the lectures. The tests are very similar to the reviews and are even easier if you work on the online homework diligently. He is also super nice and approachable. Overall, I would totally recommend him.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He gives you a study guide before the midterms and final, which, if you study, are at an extremely reasonable hardness. He also gives homework quizes worth 15% of your grade taken straight out of the hw. Extremely easy to ace!

HORRIBLE Professor! I've never had to get a W before until his class! Calculus truly isnt that hard, and he even makes you believe that as well. Until his tests that consist of 5 questions and workth 20 questions a piece. If you cant finish one problem perfectly, you're already at a B. Gives no chance for students. DO NOT TAKE!!!!!!

Terrible terrible professor. By far the worst I have had in my 3 years at UM. He made tests entirely too difficult and treated it as a review of calculus as opposed to an intro to calc course. This gave the students who didn't take calc in high school no chance at all. He said there would be a big curve at the end but it was only two points.

The class was so boring! I never had calc in high school so for me; he moved to fast. Another problem could've been that I joined the class late so I had an unfair disadvantage. Even though I got a C the tests weren't too hard, but it was a lot of work for me to keep up...

I had Hyatt for Calc 1. Decent class, as I had already taken AP AB in high school. The tests are not tricky at all. They test what we should know in the chapters discussed. Class is all notetaking from what he puts on the board. Review sessions were nice.

I LOVE Dr. Kamenkovich! Hes really smart and cares a lot about his students. This class is super interesting and he makes it very straightforward (since its both a major and cognate class). I would 100% take him for this course if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Kamenkovich is one of the most wholesome professors; he genuinely wants every student to succeed. He is available outside of class and always makes time when you have a question. He is super passionate about what he does, and his lectures are very well done; not boring but not overwhelming. Definitely take him if you can.

Great professor. The accent can be difficult at first but you get used to it. Super caring and easy to talk to. Easy homework assignments once a week, usually just a summary of the seminars. The class itself is super interesting and he allows us to come up with topics that we want to learn about. Easy one-credit class and I would highly recommend.

Such a wholesome guy. Asks tophat questions during lectures so go to class!!! Also gives occasional quiz. Tests are a combo of multiple choice and short answer. Grading for short answer questions are fair and he always gives you points just for attempting an answer even if its completely wrong.

You can tell that professor Kamenkovich is a little awkward with the class and presenting, but I promise he is the nicest and one of the most caring professors out there. We had the best TA (shout out to Rebecca) which maybe was why I enjoyed the class so much but it wasn't really that hard if you had background of marine science and meteorology.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The class was called People, Plagues, and Pandemics. It was an interesting topic and Professor Moise definitely has a lot of expertise in the field. She brings in a lot of guest speakers from various parts of the public health field that give a very good overview of what it is like to work in public health.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Moise is passionate about what she is teaching, and is easily accessible by email. She does a good job integrating her connections through her career into the classroom. However, she can sometimes be all over the place when it comes to assignments or grading. Don't worry though, she is not a tough grader and is very understanding!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: There were no exams for this class. Her class is pretty straight forward, it was mostly research and writing papers, which I personally prefer over taking a test. She always has a TA to read over the papers and then she grades the final paper. Overall, I would take her again since it was mostly lecture and then writing papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Disorganized. Rude. I have no idea how she became the head of a department. Do not take.

Dr. Moise is an incredible woman and has a lot to offer as a mentor/advisor, however, she should not be a professor. She changes her syllabus constantly, has extremely unclear grading expectations, and is condescending. Also you won't know your grade until it is already finalized, making it impossible to gauge your progress in the class.

She's extremely nice and passionate but she doesn't follow her own syllabus which led to stress and drama. Grading criteria was never followed and due dates were changed with no notice. Beware of her grading. She is a lovely woman though.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: If you don't know GIS, you will struggle! The labs are broken down but steps are missed and you must assume things on your own. Grading expectations are not clear and student favoritism is EXTREMELY bad allowing for due date exceptions. Feedback on labs comes across as rude and isn't particularly helpful. Guest speakers serve no purpose to class.

Had her for Geography Capstone Research Seminar! A TRULY SWEET woman who THROUGLY cares for ALL of her students! She is VERY flexible about due dates and even let me turn in my Capstone Project Essay late due to me taking four other classes at the same time that semester! Make sure though that you use ALL of your time WISELY to get an "A"!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: VERY EASY FINAL EXAM
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: stefania wrote the midterms and exams for the course which i found very fair if you studied the manual and your labs. Writing the labs however were the trickiest part as every TA has different expectations
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Her lab was fairly demanding, the midterm and final are easy if you studied. Easy A, and im not even a good grader!

I'm pretty sure she is now the lab coordinator for orgo II at uottawa. If so, she was really good, the midterm and the exam were very fair if not boarding on easy. The labs themselves aren't bad either, but it can be time consuming to have to write a report every week.

Does anyone know if this amazing TA will teach CHM106 next semester? I took CHM105 with her last year and I was so impressed by her. She's great teacher, knows chemistry, she's funny and sweet. She cares about students and wants them to do well.
Best TA ever

Stefania is great. She really knows her stuff and she's always very helpful. She should teach the class rather than the lab! Quiz are fair, but she wants you to think about what you are doing. She's always ready with handouts, keys and notes she writes. I learned some chemistry with her. Chose her class if you take 105 or 106

She's so random. Sometimes she acts like she wants to help you, and other times she doesn't want to. DO NOT take this class if you're just trying to get an A because she wants you to, and I quote, "kill yourself studying" for her FRESHMEN ECONOMICS CLASS.  I was a junior taking 19 credits. I didn't have time for that.

DO NOT TAKE HER! I literally hate this class.  Hard to understand, can't read her notes, so you have to really pay attention all of class to get anything out of it. And did I mention attendance is mandatory?  Literally a terrible class. I hate it

Not an easy class.  Tests are challenging, attendance is mandatory, and does NOT count if you are more than 5 minutes late. only allowed 3 absences before you begin losing points. goes through each chapter, gives online quiz at the end, then the midterms pull questions similar to those on the quizzes.  econ was easy for me until this class happened
3 50 question multiple choice tests and a quiz at the end of each chapter. Get the textbook and you're set.

Almost impossible to do poorly in her class. She gives a huge grading curve.  If you read the book and take class notes you will recieve a good grade.  She does have a thick accent though and sometimes it is hard to understand her.
excellent professor. but she does not allowing chewing gum in class!

very nice lady! she really drills the material into your head if you can manage to go to class & pay attention. she goes quite fast but is good at conveying the material in an intuitive manner. take her!

The exams are straight out of the textbook so if you study that you will do well, but in regards of the professor she is useless.  Her very strong accent makes it difficult to focus during class.  Attendance isn't mandatory though.
Highly recommended. Teaches right out of the textbook, and gives a quiz that is online at the end of every chapter. Her final is NOT cumulative and the tests are very doable.

So nice! She really wants students to be involved in class and gets genuinely upset when no one is interested. Her tests are very doable and with the curve an A is in reach for almost anyone who puts a little effort. Homework is annoying but not too hard and she gives a week to do it. She has an accent but its not too bad. Definitely recommend!

She's very interested in helping her students. Her tests are a little hard, but not unmanageable. She curves every test so the class average is an 88; it's pretty much impossible not to do well in her class. She really likes when you participate in class, but she does have an accent. It not impossible to understand though.

DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. She is nice and means well, but is incapable of teaching the material and is very hard to understand. On several occasions she proved incapable of getting correct answers on her own tests (during a in-office review).

Most caring engineering professor. Super nice with good lectures. Gives lots of practice problems for exams. If you do and understand those problems, you will get a good grade on the test. No curve balls just like Shes had you practice. Reminds me of my mom, definitely take her classes (measurements, dynamics and thermo)

amazing notes, lets u do test corrections, expects u to read the textbook, very similar to physics, i got a C- in physics and somehow understood this, its a LOT  of practice problems but if u do them all and kind of memorize your good, the final took everyone out idk y it was so much more hard. attendance mandatory! no quizzes, one formula per exam

Absolutely amazing professor, I didn't do well on the exams and went to see her and got a bunch of points back and was very flexible with helping me find room to bump my grade up. Super caring and wants to see you do well
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Had her for Dynamics and Measurements Lab, generally very nice and understanding, but is all over the place which can make taking her classes a bit frustrating. I personally don't get much from her lectures. Never got below a B for her classes, tries to help you. She does take attendance which can be inconvenient.

Dr. Basalo is one of my favorite professors at UM, especially in the engineering department. The material is effectively taught, she cares a lot about her student's success, and makes everything clear from the beginning and is consistent through the duration of the semester. 10/10 would recommend to anyone who has her class as an option.

Dr. Basalo is one of the best professors you'll come across. Her grading is fair and you can tell she really enjoys teaching and the content of her courses. She's also big on class involvement so attendance and "Fun" quizzes make up some portion of the grade...those quizzes by the way are marked on completion.
Overall 10/10 would recommend

Basalo is the best professor in the engineering department. She is very organized and takes clear notes on the board during lectures. In class you will do a lot of examples which helps for the exams. The exams are not bad as long as you do the study problems before hand. She is very caring and wants to help her students.

Basalo is by far the best professor I've met in the department. She doesn't throw questions at you on tests that aren't like class examples or study problems--if you do at least a couple of the study problems, you're good to go. She's also very understanding of student circumstances and needs, so you can be comfortable being open with her. 100/10!

Dr. Basalo is the best teacher in the engineering department. Her tests are much easier than her class examples so as long as you understand the class examples the tests will be cake. Attendance is mandatory for all her classes. She is not a tough grader, she gives lots of partials. She is always available to help outside of class.

Dr. Basalo is definitely one of the best professors I have ever had. I would give her a 6 if it were possible. She truly cares about you. Not just your grade, but you as a person. She's like a mother figure. Her office hours change regularly because of her schedule, but she will do her best to help you succeed regardless. She teaches very well.

Basalo is without a doubt the best engineering professor I've ever had at UM. She's extremely understanding and will move tests around if you have a other one. She even let me move a test so I could celebrate my birthday. Clearest notes and lectures and no homework, only recommended practice problems. Take this professor!
Best Professor I have taken at Miami. By no means is her class easy but if you put the work in you will be amazed at how much you learn
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof. Iglesias does not cold call but frequently asks questions and loves when you try to answer them. She puts a checkmark next to your photo whenever you answer a question in class, so make what you want out of this. She is highly intelligent and passionate. My best tip is READ THE ASSIGNED CASES if you want to succeed on the final.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Iglesias was amazing! She is a little difficult to follow in class but if you watch her lectures at 2x speed, you will understand that she is brilliant and makes wonderful points about the Constitution and the many perspectives that interpreted it. I would take a class with her again. Participate and read!

I had to teach myself an entire semester of con law in 1 week before the final. She just rambles in class and is impossible to follow. She also does not know how to talk about race and instead gets defensive and takes critiques of the law as an attack against her.

Iglesias LOVES this course. Truly passionate about teaching it to her students. She really encourages class participation and the lectures will go by much smoother if your section is willing to participate. Make sure you write your exam to her viewpoints. I am vehemently against her many of her viewpoints that she expressed, and I still did well.

To say she was a disappointment is an understatement. I took her for Con Law and to have a socialist teaching you is not the most enjoyable thing in the world. She's unbelievably spacey in her lectures and if you don't write to her view point you won't do well.

Great professor! This Constitutional Law (first year course) is a gem. This is probably the most important class in law school. Professor Iglesias is brilliant, delivering master-class level lectures every class meeting. The final exam was a fascinating, ripped from the headlines memo-style three questions. Totally fair and good exam.

She really cares about her students. She is respectful and very clear about what she wants. She gives flexibility and will listen to engaging conversation. Her test was exactly what she said it was. She goes straight from the book, so she is easy to follow and appreciates participation. If you want to learn Conlaw, she will teach you. Great prof.

Extremely passionate about the subject matter-- Gitmo and denial of habeas review, etc. Her expressed views were, at times, radical but her knowledge runs deep. The class had great practical application to what is going on in the world & proved very informative. The reading was exhausting, but she did teach us how to PROPERLY brief a 100+ pg case!

took her for international criminal law in the Fall of 2009. A few things: 1. don't go to class.  2. dont read.  3. get an A. Never have I done less work.  She is the easiest grader at the law school. Just get through the class by either not showing up at all or showing up just to surf the net. Write your own communist manifesto as your exam answer
One of the worst professors. High curve but probably not worth it.

Do NOT take her for anything. Especially Crim Pro. I'm a hardcore liberal, didn't mind her slant, AND STILL abhorred her teaching (or lack thereof). She teaches international law/immigration law and not criminal procedure. Her exam was NOTHING relating to the topic/lecture. STAY AWAY!

She may just be the worst teacher in the law school. Although it was a Criminal Procedure class, she tested us on things like the Torture Victim Protection Act and 5th amendment rights for aliens. Her lectures were also of little to no intellectual or academic value unless you enjoy hearing how police and prosecutors are evil.
Outlandish professor; left of Marx.  Palpable bias in class and readings.

I really liked her - I heard horror stories before I took her and couldn't understand why after I had been in her class.  She is very helpful.  Whether you agreed with her views or not, she encouraged debate and thinking.  I thoughit was fun and got an A.  For exams, I would look at her old exams before outlining to see how she tests.
HATED HER!!  By far the WORST law school professor I've ever had!!!
She nuts. Left-wing nuts. And I'm left wing from Cali. Hard to follow. Basically always answer against Scalia and the cops are evil and you will do well.
i really liked this class, but then, it was a really small seminar and i am also a "left-wing nut" so we got along well. of course, if you're a right-wing fascist, you might just want to steer clear.

horrible horrible professor.  screwed the entire class by mixing up exams, everyone had to choose between a pass/fail and an actual grade (w/o knowing what the actual grade was).  in the classroom she is a left wing nut, rambles forever.  beware.
No Comments
No Comments

She gives SO much work! We have had a quiz every single week (short answer responses) with reading chapters that are 60+ pages for every quiz, writing 2 research papers, do homework almost every single class, emailing her answers to questions she asks in class, and MUCH MORE. In all honestly, the class is just too much work for a BIL 107 course.

While I haven't received a final grade yet, if you have any background in biology (high school bio, AP Bio, etc.), it should be a relatively easy class. You need to attend class as attendance is mandatory & she often gives quizzes. However, she does a good job making class dynamic rather than only lecturing. She is also very nice.

The in-class format is clear and consistent when it comes to the ppt slides and case-study assignments. However, when it comes to the weekly quizzes on the textbook (take note), it is hard to get a sense of what she is going to ask. Even though she could write clearer test questions or use a less confusing textbook, she is nice and helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: During the semester, She'd make us read 40 pages of a chapter and quiz us on random portions in 5 questions. She gave us the midterm study guide LATE and it still didn't help me pass. She is not that good of a professor, maybe she doesn't have time like she said in the beginning. Her preparations for quizzes and tests are unreliable.

I did not enjoy taking class with Professor Irmak. First of all, he lectures the whole class and it gets very boring. He is a very harsh grader and if you don't answer quizzes/exam questions the way he wants he will take lots of points off. There are better professors.

I honestly tried really hard to like him but didn't. He drags his lectures on and is the most confusing and harsh grader. I went to him multiple times because I spent so much time studying and was getting poor grades and he's incapable of explaining himself. I wouldn't recommend there's much better MKT professors like Scharf, it's not worth it.

Loved Professor Irmak's course. He does a really good job incorporating things his students like in his lectures and there very interesting. 2 presentations, a few quizzes on case studies and 2 exams. He's really nice and makes sure you're prepared.

Professor Irmak's lectures are pretty interesting because he ties the material to real-world scenarios. You must attend class and pay attention/take notes because some examples that he says in class are not on the powerpoint but will be on the test. Tests can be somewhat difficult but if you study/pay attention it's not bad. 2 easy group projects.

Overall MKT 310 is interesting and Professor Irmak is a good teacher, but this class is definitely a lot of work with multiple group projects, assignments, and case study writeups throughout the semester. He is a pretty easy grader though so as long as you put in an average amount of effort you should be fine

I enjoyed this class. Professor Irmak cares about his students and is passionate about marketing. As long as you go to class, participate, and study you will be fine. The quizzes can be difficult sometimes but they are not worth a lot. Exams are exactly like the notes/study guides and there is no final exam. Wish he taught other classes.

the class consists entirely of dense, detailed lectures. the exams are poorly worded. attendance is worth 150 points of your grade so do not miss class. there are definitely better marketing classes available and i would not recommend this class. i got an A but had to work way harder than i should have for a marketing class.
Professor Irmak is very smart and interesting and gives great lectures. There is not a lot of homework for this class just a few group projects and two tests with no final exam.
Best professor in UM! He is amazing. This is a class not only for credit but also really helpful. Short assignments project, able to do them in group. 2 open book exam. No FINAL
He is really nice and his class isn't bad. For the assignments he lets you work alone or in groups which is helpful. His tests are short/long response questions but they're open book.

Prof Irmak is a really nice and caring guy who values participation from his students. He gives real-world cases and examples to encourage everyone to give their opinions. We did a lot of group work, which I don't love, but overall a really cool class and good teacher.

Professor Irmak is a nice guy who seems to genuinely enjoy teaching his class. The material isn't challenging - but make sure to go to class to take notes. He only posts basic information on powerpoints in Blackboard & leaves out class examples and information that is vital for tests. A little lecture heavy but doable.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Olivero is the kindest teacher I have ever had. Very understanding of students tight schedules and classes are generally just discussions with an occasional one or two question quiz on the material in the middle of the lecture. By far my favorite teacher and very highly recommended.
Sweet, patient prof. Maybe not the best lecturer (a little scattered) but to be fair, she is not lecturing in her first language! Loves participation and discussion from students.

Professor Olivero is very passionate about this class and to give students an opportunities to discuss controversial topics in a medicine. It gives students a chance to discuss topics constructively as everyone has different views of certain subjects. I love professor Olivero and she has a constant smile on her face and is really approachable.
Irene is the most adorable Professor I ever had. If you care about Philosophy or any kind of Moral Issues, you will understand why you have the opinions that you do in this class.

Very nice young prof. Seems to understand that most students are overwhelmed with their other courses so she tries to make her class as easy as possible. Very passionate and presents the material in an interesting way! I loved her lectures! Dont know if she will be back in UM next semester, but if u have the option definitely take her
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: This professor is horrible. She has an antiquated style of teaching. Learn your accents. You will pass or fail because of them. She has a no electronic device usage policy. You are only allowed to speak in Spanish in the class. Bring a translator if you get stuck. She will not allow you to finish your thought in English under any circumstances.

She is a really nice professor and always trying to help. There are a lot of works to do in her class, but all Spanish classes have many works which you should know already. Sometimes she makes you do more than others since she cares about details, but her grading is always nice. TAKE her if you are not too busy, you will definietly  learn a lot .

Really Funny Teacher. Loves helping and is always available. At times a bit confusing but always takes questions. A lot of work but it's expected for a Foreign Language Course. Easy grader and if you try easy to get an A. One of the easier Spanish Professors, and she makes learning the subject fun. Cannot go wrong!

She's really nice, likes to establish a good relationship with her class. She sometimes disorganized, but she did her best to make sure our grades didn't suffer because of her. Her teaching method is a little to the left, so if you're already pretty clueless about the language then find an easier professor

She is so sweet. The work load isn't too heavy but she is sometimes unorganized. She is always helpful though and always makes sure that your grades don't suffer for her disorganization. She made me want to take the next level of spanish even though it's not required.

Professora Beibe is amazing! She keeps the lectures very interesting. She also really cares about her students and will go out of her way to help you. (She helped set me up with a LGBT minor before the program even started) Their is alot of work in the class but that is set by the department and not her. If you have to take spanish try to get her!

This teacher gives a decent amount of work but the work is easy and helpful. She really cares about your grade and does what she can to help that. I did not mind her class at all and am definitely going to have her as a teacher in 211 next semester.

one of the best professors i've ever had.  she is always willing to help you. if you study what she tells you to and go to class then you will get an A. not a mean teacher at alll, cares about her students' success a lot.

She is the WORST. I have never had a professor I disliked more! Like a few other people in my class, she made me cry. I got a decent grade but my other grades suffered because I had some much work for her class. She caused me to drop my spanish minor because she was the only prof taking the last class I needed to finish it.

Wonderful Professor! Honestly, if you try your best and do all your homework and assignments you should be able to get a very decent grade. She is always available to help her students ! I took her and she was always with a positive attitude in class.

she's a good teacher in the sense that you will learn the material and is extremely helpful when you meet with her.  Having said that, I never cry. I can count how many times i've cried in my life and I can assure she's responsible for 2 of those times.

Great Teacher! Prof. Beibe is very helpful and is always available if you need her. The homework is easy and so are the tests, and if you don't do a homework or if you don't do so well on it, she lets you redo them to boost your grade. Easy A!

she seems like a good teacher at first, but don't be fooled like i was.  get out while you can.  she will make your life a living hell.  I had more homework in this class than my four other classes and this isn't even my major (i'm premed).

SHE MADE SO MANY PEOPLE IN MY CLASS CRY. She is very degrading and her answer is always right.  There is no point in arguing and unlike other Spanish professors at this school she is OBSESSED with homework grades and making sure that you get points taken off in one way or another.  don't take her if you dont want to work.

Beware of the free response sections in the online homework, she's usually pretty tough on grading them. Makes you do a few compositions throughout the semester, and the oral exams can be tough because its all random, so you have to study all situations she gives to you. Stickler for attendance. Participate in class and study and you should be ok.

If you study hard you should be fine. You write 3-4 papers and then she corrects then and makes you explain each mistake. Its tedious, but if yo do it well she grades you fairly. She lets you do that with tests sometime soon. It's a bit of work, but it was all things that really did help me.
although she is very nice, the only right answer is the one she decides is correct.
No Comments
amazing.  weekly quizzes, but they are not too hard.  fun discussions.
REL 409 changed my life!  Take her seminar--you will not regret it.
Truly no political motives here. But not the most interesting class, and she is hard, expects you to have perfect spelling in another language...
She didn't teach REL 101 this year.  171 was a really good, interesting class.
She makes no sense when she talks. When you ask her a question she'll answer something else. Useless.
The most boring teacher I have ever had.
Oh ....my god, she is so boring i can't sit through these lectures
Interesting class and interesting professor.  the people who rate her badly are politically motivated.
No Comments

Really nice professor. Willing to help and really appreciates participation. I wasn't interested at all going into class but liked it a lot. Really easy tests, quizzes not bad either. Attendance not mandatory but takes a couple pop quizzes. Is a tiny bit difficult to understand because of accent and scattered thoughts

Easy Class. Attendance is not mandatory, but he does give a few pop quizzes. No need to read the textbook b/c everything assigned is summarized the next day in class. He tends to repeat himself a lot and has a quite mumbly voice. But he is not hard to understand and is always there to answer questions and provide extra help. Definitely worth taking

He's from Turkey and has an accent so its a but hard to understand him making it more confusing for me b/c i dont lik phi. however there isnt much hw. he's helpful lik before a test, he'll give u a mini review sheet which is helpful or you can ask if he can make one. his exams arent too difficult. 3 exams n one paper

You need to go to class or your will fail. Her midterm is super hard the highest grade was a B but it only counts for 10% of the grade. The homework counts for most of your grade and she always lets you rewrite it for a better grade which is awesome. She is super friendly and very smart.

Professor Oroza is a great professor with great knowledge within her field. She previously worked for The Miami Herald and expects a lot from you. A lot of people say she's a tough grader but it prepares you for real world experience. Does give you some guidance but doesn't hold your hand through the process. Great professor, no tests.

She's a really great professor. Every assignment is clear and her grading rubric is always the same. She teaches the information really well and is able to help if you need it. The best part is that you can re-do every assignment for a higher grade. It is a lot of writing, but the practice really helps you improve. I would definitely take her again

Anyone who said this woman gives hard exam is the laziest person on earth. All you have to do is read the pp she puts online the night before the exam and you are good to go. She goes into details in class. People who said she is boring, I don't know what they expect her to talk about in class apart from what she has to teach. I love her.

She's nice but she's all over the place. She can be mean sometimes. She's very knowledgable about the field but she crams assignments at the end of the semester. A lot of her work is extensive, she makes you do a lot for a little grade. Also, she never gives out A's. Max grade is a B.

Class is taught by powerpoints she puts on blackboard. She is knowledgeable about the field but the class is boring. I passed by studying the pp's and reading the chapters the week prior to testing. Only 3 exams make up your grade. Easy class if you like to study. If not, not the class for you. She is helpful to answer any q's, no ex credit.
Dont take COM101 with this teacher, its ridiculously hard. Most people get a C or below on the test. A GPA killer

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS WITH HER!!! most boring class I have ever taken. It's so hard to pay attention because she goes on and on about things that do not even matter as much. we don't use the text book and her grading is very harsh. you dont have a study guide therefore you don't know what to expect on the test!

I had heard bad things about her going into class but she wasn't that bad. She wasn't great but if you go to her office hours and get to know her, she'll favor you when grading. She offered an easy extra credit and her tests are based on powerpoints which she puts online. Don't both buying the book. It doesn't help. I'd take her again, though.
Tests are way too hard. Extra Credit Essay is graded too hard. All in all, not a respectful woman. If you can take someone else, DO IT.

Way too hard for com 101. Tests are very hard. Average in the class is around a c, which she thinks is good! Offers extra credit research paper, which she grades too hard. Allowed four absences. Very nice lady. No study guides, so you have no idea what to expect on the test.
COM101....so why were the tests so hard. Boring lectures, confusing tests with no study guides or slight direction given at all. Take this with another teacher if you can. Struggled to get a low B...

I had her for CNJ 111 too.  Experienced in the field, very friendly.  Participate, and put an honest effort into assignments.  CNJ 216 requires travel for assignments which is annoying, but the class isn't overly difficult.  Small classroom, so attendance mandatory.  Definitely recommend.
She is such an easy teacher. All the work you submit can be revised for a better grade. She is really nice. I would take her again.
too hard for an intro class
Possibly the worst professor at UM. Avoid at all costs. She can ruin your GPA; I want to say the class average must have been a 70.... for COM101!

She?s kind and helpful, sure. She does let you re-do the articles assigned & theres no textbook,which is great but i do not like her teaching style. Class was boring and I had a small class under 10-she would use powerpoints instead of actually getting hands on with us. I didnt learn anything new and was disappointed in this class ultimately.

This class is very difficult to get an A in. Her tests are completely open ended so you basically have to memorize every word she says for half the semester to get a good grade. Content-wise it isn't that bad, her grading system is just awful.

Professor Oroza is a very experienced professor, who I also had in a 100-level class.  The class can be a bit dull at times, but Oroza is a VERY VERY fair professor.  Very willing to meet with students. Definitely recommend.

She is such a great educator. I will def. recommend her. Yes, her lectures can be boring but she gives you a great deal of important and useful information. Overall her class is not hard if you keep up with the readings and her powerpoints you will be fine. The class consists of a midterm and a final and a group presentation.

Class was very boring, because I wasn't particularly interested in the subject. But she is nice and approachable. She also tells you what you need to study for the exams, so as long as you study and retain the material, you'll be fine. Exams are open response. Also, a group presentation. Easy A.

Oroza is awesome!  By far my favorite teacher thus far in the communication school.  As long as you come to class and show an interest, you're golden.  She lets you re-write stuff and her comments really, really help.  She's funny, normal, and very helpful.  Loved the class because of her.

At first I wasnt so sure about her because while speaking, she sometimes pauses and its not clear that she's trying to remember things, but she is actually very creative about explaining things. She says a lot of useful information and definitely prepares you for the tests. They are short answer, so you have to be able to explain specific cases.

She is the sweetest person in the world. She really cares about her students and their success. She is not disorganized, just extremely passionate and struggles to remember things. Her tests are short answer so you have to memorize A LOT of information, but they are very straightforward. I highly recommend her.

She is very excited about news writing. She really knows what she talks about though and she really cares about her students and their career success. It is a lot of work, but everything that is graded you can rewrite and bring your grade up.

She expects you to act as if journalism is your job and your story needs to be the most important thing in your life.  Sorry, we're actually college students with other classes and jobs.  She does give good grades on articles, but she expects way too much and uses powerpoints in a tiny class. extremely boring. do not recommend.

She expects too much from you, she doesn't care that you have other classes, she wants her work done her way. i took my articles to herald writers and they said they were good, she said they were terrible. gives a lot of assignments and always makes you read the newspaper.

I had her for my intro course. I got Bs on assignments through the entire semester but she gave me an A. We kept in touch all through college and when I was a senior she nominated me for all kinds of awards. Stay on her good side! If she vouches for you, it means a lot in the journalism industry!
She used Indesign a part of the course, but she really wasn't much help.  She did not give enough time for exams.  She seemed a bit disorganized.  I was not impressed.
My favorite teacher at UM, for many reasons. Really loves teaching and is an intelligent person.

Great professor! Definitely recommend her for the news media writing class. She's extremely helpful with any questions you might have on assignments and she allows you to re-write all graded assignments so you can improve on them. Very knowledgeable about the journalism field because she used to work for the Herald.
no comment

She is actually really nice and super helpful. She is not an easy A but if you work hard it's not impossible. There's a lot of work but in the end it's very useful. Most people that don't like her are freshmen students who want easier classes and love to complain. Don't listen, she's really helpful and understanding! :)

I have never in my life experienced such a terrible professor. she does not teach and she pretends that you teach yourself for a semester. If you need to take French, DO NOT take it with her. She puts tons of homework and gets mad at the students when they do not understand. Students don't understand because she doesn't explain! simple!

If you haven't taken French before DO NOT TAKE IT WITH IRENE. Trust me or you will be extremely stressed all semester. For those that have be prepared to work your butt off. Also be aware Irene has lots of mood swings and might go off on you randomly. On her good days she is very nice and understanding, but on her bad ones stay clear of her wrath.

She thinks she's teaching a high level french class. If you're a beginner do not take this teacher. She only speaks in French and if you don't have at least 2 years of French experience you will struggled through every lecture and homework assignment.

She is very nice, and you should take use of office hours or at least show an interest. The class can be fun, and sometimes group activities aren't the most helpful. And there is a lot of work but it helps you learn if you put the effort into it.

Worst Teach at the U!!Who allowed her to teach? I hope teaching is not what she is trying to pursue after she graduates.She is a waste of time. Pleas do urself a favor and avoid her!! Run the other way..and warn ur friends and family about her.
If you want to learn french... you are better off buying a program online. this women is completely useless!!! all you do is online assignments that mark every missing accents wrong and so forth.....

RUN AS FAST AS YOU CAN.... DONT WASTE YOUR TIME. SHE IS A TA( TEACHER ASSISTANT). WHY PAY TOP DOLLARS TO HAVE A STUDENT TEACH ANOTHER STUDENT. SHE IS NOT CLEAR WITH DIRECTIONS AND ASSIGNS ENDLESS AMOUNT OF USELESS WORK. SHE EXPECTS YOU TO WRITE A FULL  ESSAY IN FRENCH ON THE FIRST WEEK OF CLASS...

Ivan is an awesome professor. He may come off as intimidating, but he cares a lot about his students, and is super fun when you get to know him. He is willing to put in the time to work with individuals to help them achieve their goals, so my advice is to speak up, ask questions, show interest, and don't just try to get by with the bare minimum.

Really caring and great professor. I wasn't sure what the class was going to be like but it turned out to be my favorite class I've ever taken. I learned so much and loved wheel throwing. Ivan gives great feedback on how to improve your pieces and is really knowledgeable about ceramics.

You have to put in time to work outside of class hours, but ceramics doesn't have homework/tests so this is fair. He seems tough but if you work hard & participate, he is very helpful and encouraging. He takes notice of the students who are actually trying to develop their skills. Has ended up being one of my favorite art teachers.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He can come off as very intimidating at first but he's actually a great professor and very approachable. He is very honest about your work which I appreciated. If you show interest in the class he will like you and help you with whatever you need (ideas, technique, etc.). You won't know your grade standing until the day of the final.

Ivan is cool and knowledgeable underneath his tough exterior. I met Ivan in my free time. I was using a tool so it could damage materials, without knowing, and he got upset. Once he saw that I dedicated time and effort a relationship grew. Put in time, make him show you new skills, ask questions until he takes notice. Don't be another face to him.

If you are not an Art major, this class is way more time consuming than necessary for just an art credit. He gives very strict guidelines for projects and expects too much from students for an intro class. He is also pretty rude and annoying if he sees that you aren't very familiar with the subject matter.

4-5 projects the whole semester. Does NOT give you feedback on what you need to improve, until the final critique right before he grades you. Gave me an A- because he disagreed with my art style, which is pretty unprofessional I thought. He is easy on Intro to Ceramics but Intermediate, not many A's
Really cool guy.  All his assignments may seem overwhelming at first, but they are a lot of fun and really open your eyes to a bunch of new ideas and techniques.  If you love ceramics take him!

May at first seem strict, but very helpful and encouraging.  Has a strict schedule, which I found to be helpful.  Very detailed and expectations are clear.  Projects are open for imagination as long as they fit the parameters.  Very good class!
No Comments

Literally never went to class because all the lectures were recorded and all she does is read off the powerpoint. If you read the textbook, you will do well on the tests. She also offers lots of extra credit.
Wouldn't rely on the study guide to be a clear indication of what is going to be on the tests. Basically just reads PowerPoint slides to you so class attendance isn't necessary.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very easy class online. She gives easy and many extra credit assignments. Her tests are straightforward and done online. Take her!

I really liked Dr. Calles-Ramirez. She is sweet & a good professor. I am not a STEM person at all; I took this class as a requirement & still did well. The class is half homework, half tests, & lots of extra credit. She teaches pretty fast. Tests were all concept-based, so no calculations which was great. I recommend her if you don't like math.

Most profs understand what they teach but the textbook knows more than she does about the material. Some undergrads teach better. She makes it easy to get an A though! Grade is half hw, half tests, and lots of EC. Class isn't worth going except for review sessions, you can be prepared for exams by reading the slides and knowing stuff on the review.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Very sweet, caring woman. Took away all exams this semester and replaced them with these LONG (but easy) homework assignments. Took a while, but if you did them it was a guaranteed A. Showed videos and stuff during lectures to make them more interesting, always accessible if you needed her.
She is such a good professor! I learned a lot and the homework boosts your grade.
Amazing professor and very fair grader. I loved this class and it was very doable if you do the homework.
She is definitely the best psych prof at UM!

Professor Calles was amazing! She is a great person and a great professor. Her PowerPoints were very clear and clarified various concepts of the textbook (the textbook is very dense and boring). I don't know what the review below is saying; that person probably didn't go to class.

Very sweet person; wanted to like her as a prof but just couldn't. The way she explained things made no sense half the timebut I understood the topics once I taught them to myself with the textbook so I know it wasn't just me. Very understanding, let me take an exam late when my power went out etc., but I just did NOT vibe with her teaching style.
This class is so hard but she is very nice. Make sure you read the textbook every day.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Super hard class but she is nice.
She's a great person but her class is extremely hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Calles is the best PSY110 teacher at UM. Your grade is based on 3 tests, a non-cumulative final, and engaging extra-credit assignments. If you are genuinely interested in taking an introductory psychology college course, then take this class.

PROF SPANGLER IS THE BEST PROFESSOR AT UMIAMI. I absolutely love her. She makes you think of reading/writing through a different lens. Super clear expectations/feedback from her. Not a hard class but she makes you enjoy what you are writing about. She is super passionate and always positive. Class goes by so quick! SHE IS THE BEST EVER TAKE HER!!!

Such a cutie! She was super caring and genuinely passionate about writing. If you try and show effort, you'll get an A. The only annoying thing was the mandatory attendance. If you can keep up with a lot of assignments (which are easy) then you'll be good. Overall, if you need a writing credit and easy A, take this class with her.

She's really nice and caring, and easy to reach out to! The class had a laid-back, discussion-based atmosphere that made it really easy to be vulnerable when sharing our poems. There were four poems due across the semester and various poems due to be read outside of class. This class was really easy, regardless of your experience with poetry!

Honors class is kinda hard but his lectures r interesting/rly clear. he's so nice, always around to answer q's and is funny too. made religion rly interesting to me. papers in honors are analyzing books, not on the lectures, so they're kinda hard. but he's so helpful, really smart, and great guy. 100% recommended!
I loved this class. It was so interesting, and Petrella's lectures were crystal clear. If you study from your notes, you can pass with an A; you don't really use the textbook. I highly recommend it.
Great teacher. Highly recomended.Very helpfull. Exams are very clear to the point.He knows the material and explains it very well. Make sure to take good notes.
Dr. Petrella was a great professor.  Learned so much from him.  Never wanted to miss a class....very appealing to the eyes!
He kind of rambles, but he writes the key points on the board and tells you which things will be on the test.  Plus, apparently he's hot.

GREAT professor! Recommend highly! Very helpful and always willing to help answer your questions. He even gives his students his personal phone number in case they have any last minute questions before an exam.
I love him!!! soooo hot
Professor Ivan Petrella is an excellent professional, he is very helful and always willing to help their students
Great Professor. Really cute too!

Great professor and lecturer that knows how to keep up the interest level of his students. Class is usually just him lecturing. There is assigned reading and three 4-page papers based on the books. His enthusiasm for the subject makes the class enjoyable.
This guy is awesome, definitely take him.  Very interesting, cool guy.  Sometimes holds class outside on the grass.  No homework except 3 papers.  Best class ever.
Good teacher, recommended. His lectures have no visual or media aids but he is very active and makes you understand what he is saying without making you bored

just from reading comments about his other classes, i suggest getting credit from the 101 class because it's really not difficult at all. he only teaches for several sessions which is a shame because he really gets you interested in the topic. and he has awesome hair. just study your lecture notes (take really good notes) and you'll do fine.
Great guy, but he does expect a lot from you... Hard grader. The class is interesting, but unless philosophy is your life, and you can think abstractly i would stay away from this class

I loved this class overall, but Dr. Petrella was one of my favorite professors for the class. Go to the lectures & take good notes, b/c he doesn't use powerpoint or anything. Go to his office hours b/c he loves to talk about this stuff & explain it. Tests are easy. Doesn't hurt that he is very attractive, distinguished, and athletic... and single.

SOO hott! Good teacher, really smart. Went to Harvard. Has great stories too to go along with his lectures. Very organized lectures, doesn't use powerpoints though. Lectures are interesting, and his looks and accent will make you WANT to go to class.

Expects alot from undergrads who are likely only taking the class for honors credit. You can learn alot from him and overall he's a nice guy (and good looking) but i felt sometimes that his standards were way too high. ALOT of reading involved-some not so interesting either.
He is an amazing professor, but he has very high standards. Tough grader.
One of the better professors in the class even though the test questions were pretty difficult.

Great guy, pretty good and interesting teacher, somewhat difficult test questions.  He explains the material in class well and gives funny stories to go along with it which helps remember some of the stuff.  I would take him again if I had to.  Not as good as Sapp though...
he is soooo hott
His material was really interesting, and the course was great...but he has very high standards.  Don't take his classes unless you are a serious student.
TALKS FAST!  but he stops and asks for questions. he actually makes it a class and not just a lecture which is amazing considering the size of theroom.  Gotta admit though, he is hot.
No Comments
Loved interpreters, Pet is awesome!
Not only is this man intelligent and humorous, he's also a major hottie.

Dr. Petrella does have an entertaining sense of humor.  However, he speaks fast.  Tests are not as easy as they SHOULD be for a rel101 class but definitely manageable.  As a Harvard graduate he knows his stuff (not all do) but perhaps you can say he is plagued with an inflamed ego?!
Hilarious guy! Overall an easy going and cool guy. Always makes sure everyone understands what he says. The whole REL 101 crew is stellar. The tests are VERY easy.
Dr. Petrella is an ok professor. He will help you with whatever you want, but you have to study for his tests in order to pass. He is hot!!!

Isaac now works at FAU, and has been an awesome edition to the economics department. I was in one of the first classes he taught here, and he was a caring professor but a bit unorganized in his lectures; we often jumped around chapters without notice to read beforehand, but explained the concepts thoroughly and made sure students understood.

Super relatable, hes young and fun, incredibly smart, and manages to make economics funny. He uses real life examples. This is the HARDEST course ive taken in the econ major yet I was so inspired and intrigued that I got a 98% (not with out HOURS of studying), I am a B- average student
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: One of the best professors extremely caring funny and makes his lectures fun
as simple as this: is you want to pass take him; if you want to learn, do not take him

Took this as an 8am. Never went to class(missed like a month and a half of class), but did all group work by myself and turned it in. Somehow aced the homework and thought I was in for a easy A. Failed the midterm, final and the class. Took this class again with a different professor and never went to class. Passed with a B.  Take at your own risk.
Hardest ECON class in the major. Test are very difficult, but the homework is worth a lot so work in a group and try to get a 100 on all of them.

Professor isaac inspired me to change my major to economics. He presents the material very well and knows how to connect with students. Explains complex concepts in a manner that is easy to understand. The lectures are the most important part of his class. Best teacher at UM by far.

This Professor is a really nice guy. He helps you out if he sees you put effort into the course. It's not an easy course at all and I actually love economics. You should read the book prior to lectures.

Great professor that makes you want to learn.  He will miss some days but he will catch you up.  The book is needed but the online part of this book is not so save your money!  Great class!  Problem sets are 45% of grade but the tests are very challenging, just go to class and study and you'll be fine.
