Coolest Professor on campus. You will actually want to go to class! Which is a good thing, because you really need to go to class to understand the material. He expects you to read, and then teaches you what he will actually test you on. In his words, this is the hardest Eco class in the department, but if you study hard, its very doable.

love is class! he is very funny and friendly and makes the lectures enjoyable. even though he explains very well his notes can be a little bit messy. the exams are multiple choice and are very easy if you pay attention in class
Good teacher and easy class but his handwriting is horrid and he does not respond to any emails.
Please take this guy if you want to learn about the weed economy.
Class material is difficult and Isaac has alot to get through so he teaches pretty fast, however, he is a really nice guy and tries his best to make a boring class entertaining.

This was class was a lot of fun. He's a friendly guy who really enjoys teaching, and it shows. He does go off topic from time to time, but he's a pretty good teacher overall. Reading the textbook goes a long way.

Although, Issac's class may not be as challenging as others, and he may be nicer, I do have have to admit that he is extremely disorganised especially when it comes to grading problem sets/ exams, as it will take an entire month to grade a problem set. He is rarely in his office, and does not respond to any E-MAILS. Take him at your own risk.

Funny and nice! Attendance is not mandatory but dont miss the quizes and you never know when he feels like giving one. For the exams just read the text book and you will get 100% but if you go to class he makes everything very clear.

He is honestly the man.  I'm doing very average in the class but everyone seems to be doing well instead of me.  He is extremely funny, interested in the students, and definitely my favorite teacher this semester.  Highly recommend.

He is HILARIOUS and gets off topic a lot but he writes notes on the board and answers your questions. In order to do well on his tests you need to read the textbook. His tests weren't that hard but getting 10 wrong out of 50 puts you at a B already.
Funny and chill, makes the lectures bearable. Must read the book for the tests if you want to do well. Im glad I took his class.

He was always really nice and funny but his tests are really hard. He's very clear and easy to understand in class but in order to get an A you have to read the textbook chapters. If you like Econ, then you should take him

He focuses on making sure you know the fundamentals so you only learn half of the book but the rest is an easy read if you're interested. The class isnt hard if you pay attention and he has interesting lectures.
Funny guy, but his test are pretty hard compared to many other Econ professors. But if you wanna be entertained, take him!
One of the best professors I've had. He's super nice and approachable and makes a boring subject bearable. His tests are very challenging but he's a great teacher.

He is very cool !! He makes macro be nice and fun. The  contents are easy but the problem set not that much. The exam is multiple chioces and it is not that easy to get a high score. He follows the text book but during the clase he just write in the board (horrible handwritting). Is worth to take a class with him !!! He is awasome !!!!

Although Issac is an excellent teacher, his tests are tricky and slightly difficult. You will learn a ton from him and he has to be one of my favorite teachers at UM...but the tests are awful. he will do everything possible to help you with your grade though.
All the exams are multiple choices,some questions are strange.He doesn't use PPT. His hand writing is terrible.If you want to learn eco clear and pass the exam easier, try to avoid him

completely unorganized class/teacher. while hes not dependable or professional, he is very chill and laid back. exam reviews are very helpful (thats when all the material came together for me). he doesnt do a good job of connecting the theory we learn to the HW/test problems. if you can grasp the concepts on your own & practice a lot its an easy A.

Isaac is seriously one of the best professors I have had at UM. He can relate economic concepts to our everyday lives to make understanding the material so much easier. Really cool dude and his tests are based mainly on his lectures. Definitely recommended as he is always available to assist students. Take him if you plan on taking 211 or 302

His hilariousness and creative examples made economics as interesting as possible. Nobody is ever bored in his class. He is extremely laid back and good-natured with so few rules. My only complaint is his flakiness- he doesn't always respond to e-mails, doesn't always show up to class, and forgets to bring papers sometimes. Great guy though.
isaac is the man. take good notes and u wont even need the textbook. guys funny and entertaining so it not terrible being there. tests are really easy if u just read over ur notes a few times

I wasn't looking forward to taking this class but he's a really nice guy that has fun with the class.There are quizzes which is unfortunate and they are dictated which is annoying.There are also 3 tests which aren't too bad.Attendance is not mandatory but if you want to do well you should go to the lectures. Very willing to help his students.

If you are very serious about economics, you will be bored with this class because he teaches at a very basic level, but as an intro course, he's great. He usually has car problems or forgets his briefcase, so he'll cancel class or let you out early. He's so easy going and funny. He really made me interested in economics.

If you are very serious about economics, this class may bore you, but as an intro class he is great! He's funny, keeps you awake, and is so nice to explain every question that someone may have. He always has car problems or leaves his suitcase, so he cancels class or lets you get out early. Quizzes are easy if you at least pay attntion is class.

PROFESSOR PETIT-FRERE SPARKED MY INTEREST IN ECONOMICS WITH HIS INNOVATIVE STYLE FOR TEACHING. A YOUNG PROFESSOR YET VERY KNOWLEDGEABLE, WILL HAVE YOU AT THE TIP OF YOUR FEET EVERY LECTURE. EXAMS ARE FAIR. EXCELLENT CLASS. RECOMMEND BLINDLY.

my favorite teacher in UM! hes easy, easygoing, teaches well, very clear and funny. makes class interesting. super understanding. i loved him! also, tests are directly from the material, doest try to trick you!

great teacher. young guy. makes the class fun. make sure you go to class,altho attendance is not taken, he does give pop quizzes ( great way to raise your grade, you want these quizzes!) tests are easy, gives goos notes, tho sometimes gives wrong information

This teacher, although passionate about his subject, is extremely unprepared! He came to our final late after having a few drinks at the Rat! A young teacher, he tries to create a bond with a couple of his students, but if he doesn't recognize your name, don't expect your emails to be answered. An easy A, if you read the book though!
great teacher, gives good examples and quizzes are really easy

He really doesn't seem to know what he is talking about. Pretty unprepared for class and you don't learn very much. If you are serious about economics take a different professor. However, it is an easy A.

He's an awesome professor. He really makes you understand the concepts and he tries his best to not make the class boring. I learned a lot in his class. He writes notes on the board that are amazing, so go to class for them and read the book and you'll be fine. He drops quizzes and one test if you take the final. Great professor!!!
he is really nice and a good teacher. if you go to every class and listen to his lecture you will understand economics:).

He is a great professor! he really makes an effort to make sure the class understands the material. Writes outlines on the board for every chapter. He has "pop quizzes" but they're really easy..if you pay attention during class they should help boost your grade. He's funny too...
No Comments

He is such a nice professor, always willing to help and encourages class discussions. Don't expect an easy ride but you will learn the subject thoroughly, he uses great analogies to facilitate the understanding of the subject. Test are fair, if you study his notes you'll be fine. Overall he's an asset to the department
Very knowledgeable in languages, full of experience. If you want to study a foreign language, especially Arabic, take him he is the best.

He is all over the place. Unorganized. Speaks every language except English in class. Neither him nor the book are clear or translate any Arabic into English. He assumes everyone has a basic understanding of Arabic grammar, tenses and words so he doesn't bother explaining. As a person he is a very nice man.

Istifan is very approachable. Like the guy above me said, it's up to you to do well because he wont be on your back about anything, really. Tests are definitely harder than assignments etc, and you should study for those the most. He's fun and wacky, keeps things interesting. Very managable to get an A if you keep up throughout the year.

This teacher is wacky, but he still teaches you this incredibly hard language well. He knows what he's talking about, but you need to put in a lot of effort in order to really get the language. Not an easy A, but definitely possible. Also, he's loose with deadlines and attendance. In this class it's up to you to do well.

There is a decent amount of work (reading and blog posts), but nothing that takes an obnoxious amount of time. Gives the option to rewrite papers for higher grade. She encourages a lot of discussion. Always willing to meet and review papers. She has a kind of sarcastic sense of humor... I don't know, I haven't figured it out, but I liked her. =]

I loved Ms. Zieba! In the beginning she seemed like she would be really hard, but she turned out to be easier than expected. Really if you just do all of your work and participate in class you should get an A. I'm not a great English student, although I did improve with this class, and ended with an A-.
She is a really nice teacher when you act good( do your homework, show up in class etc). itll be really easy to get an A if you do all that. She is really pretty and hot too.

Zieba is not a bad teacher.  Although she definitely comes off as passive-aggressive at first, she is really pretty helpful and does not actually make the class as difficult as it sounds in the beginning.  Just show up to class, do you r work honestly, and with a little bit of effort you should not have trouble getting an A.

this teacher literally has a ton of work and we always have homework and blog posts due the day before classes.  make sure to turn in your work or she will make you do bull assignments that take hours. DO NOT TAKE HER

He's a great professor. He's  a very clear and effective lecturer. Take advantage of office hours to get concepts clarified. He really cares about his studentsand wants them to succeed... read the textbook cover to cover and do NOT skip  the how we know panels. His tests are hard, but grading is fair. Hardest most rewarding class you'll ever take.

Good teacher although sometimes lectures are boring but cell and molecular biology is hard to make very fun. He is a very fair grader and will often give people questions on a test if the question was confusing. It's a hard subject and a lot of reading is required
Best teacher ever
He's a good guy and professor, just expect to have to go pretty in depth for the material in order to pass the tests. You'll definitely know your stuff by the end.

He is very knowledgeable, and very helpful when asked. His office hours are only once a week for an hour though, so if you can't make it you'll have to ask to schedule another time. The tests are EXTREMELY difficult, and you have to know every inch of the chapters covered. But if you start studying well in advance for the tests, you can do well.

Skromne is overall a great guy. His lectures give you a good perspective of the topics discussed in the chapters, however, do not rely on your class notes when studying for his test. Read the textbook front to back and everything in between. Even the diagrams are important and you will be tested on them! If you need help, he is very receptive.

Prof. Skromne is a great professor. His power points are very clear, and he his very helpful during office hours. He truly wants his students to do well and pass his class. Test are tough and confusing, expect to work.

This class was very difficult, all I can say is studying daily is your best bet. Professor Skromne does the best job he can making a very large amount of material as clear as possible. He is much more approachable during office hours, and is willing to help those who ask for it.
His tests are confusing and hard. You may think you're ready for the test, but you're not.

Work is required for this class, but don't let other reviews discourage you. Dr. Skromne is an excellent teacher and always willing to help. His tests are very difficult but if you put the time in, you can get an A. He is always willing to help.

The material itself is complicated and can't really be explained without you trying to read and understand it yourself. He writes his own exams which are VERY tricky because of the wording. He's approachable and knows his material. Read everything in the book, even if he says you don't have to know it. Not my favorite.

One of the best professors I have ever had, but his class is no joke. You will suffer if you don't attend his lectures. He is really nice and not boring. His tests are by far the hardest exams I have taken. 33 questions for 6 chapters, and his questions are mostly critical thinking questions. If you study really hard you can get an A/B though.
He is extremely helpful. You do have to work very hard in this class and read the textbook before class and highlight. You can take good notes from his powerpoints though.

Skrome is definitely not one of the first teachers you'd like to take, but if you're stuck in the class with no other option, like I was, there is a way to master his class. You should attend his lectures because he teaches a lot. Also, READ the textbook from front to back. Past exams! Study for 1 wk or more for each test. He is approachable!!!

Very hard class.  The tests are tough, but you're allowed to drop your lowest test grade.  Skromne is a very helpful professor, and he genuinely wants his students to succeed.  Definitely read the textbook chapters before lectures-- this will really help on the tests!

tests are EXTREMELY hard and just as tricky. study a lot and youll get a mediocre grade. little curve on individual tests if any overall curve is also tight. drops one test. hes really nice/helpful but even if you know the material like the back of your hand, means nothing on those beyond specific tests. final is cumulative. take with caution

Very difficult exams because of the amount of detail that need to be memorized. Read and reread chapters from the book, not impossible to get an A. Go to his office hours!! He's very helpful when you show some interest in what you're learning
very difficult class, nice guy and good teacher but his tests are by far the hardest and most detailed youll ever take.  study for hours and hours and hope for a big curve

difficult to do well on tests but not impossible.  Go to class, but don't worry if you miss it, generally the material is more from the book than the lectures, although they are very similar, nevertheless.

Pay no attention to any of the negative comments! They are probably just the products of the pre-med weeding out process. Skromne will probably be one of the best sciences professor you can take at UM. He is very clear, wants you to learn, and cares about the students! Read the chapters before each lecture and man up and go to class.

He tests you on material not covered in lectures and not found in the book, and the questions that are from the book are so incredibly nit picky you will get it wrong unless you have photographic memory. To my understanding he gets his questions from a graduate level book, but doesn't tell you to buy that book so all year you study the wrong book.

his tests have almost nothing to do with anything. I love biology and its all interesting to me, but i fail all the tests. there is no way to study! The tests are HARD the questions are very detailed and about stuff that was never mentioned in lecture. he has no office hours, only one hour one day of the week. do not take him if you can avoid it!

Very funny and available to students. He is the most knowledgeable professor I've had at this school. Tough exams, but he curves. On the last exam, he curved an entire letter grade (10%). The textbook is extremely helpful in clarifying the material. You have to study really hard to get an A.

Tough class so be prepared for relatively fast-paced lectures and tons of studying for tests.  He uses iClicker for daily 'warm-up' questions which frequently show up on tests.  Look over old tests for extra help and follow the chapters in the book.  Otherwise, it's a difficult class but do-able.

His lectures were very clear and he presented the concepts in a clear straightforward manner. His tests are difficult as to be expected with cell biology, and you really have to know the material in depth to get an A. He is a very fair professor with his grades and he is very approachable and helpful. Definitely recommend him.

Awesome guy! He teaches students to THINK, not to simply memorize facts. He tries to get audience participation during class and draws a lot of figures on the board to clarify concepts. Negative comments on here are probably from ppl who didn't go to class and did poorly on exams. I hear he's getting a lot better each year! I Highly recommend him!!

One of the best biology professors UM has to offer. His lectures, although sometimes dry, are very informative and clear. His quizzes are easy to complete as long as you're willing to use the book. You get to drop a grade and the grade ranges are very large. This is one of the hardest classes in the Bio department at UM, so expect to do work.

I pitty da fool that Skromne.  Def. the worst teacher I have EVER had since elementary school.  I am graduating now and the ONLY class I ever got a B in is this one.  Thank God other teachers at UM aren't like this individual.  He is rude, ignorant, and thinks he is the smartest person in the world.  Grades matter for med school.  STAY AWAY!
not an easy class

His tests are not easy but from what i've heard he's become a better teacher with time. Attend class for his powerpoint notes since they're just like the book. There's only 3 assignments and the 6 quizzes but they are online so you can study a bit and then use your notes. 3 tests but he drops one.  Study for the final since it's 35% of the grade.

I don't know how I got an A. I had him during his first semester, 1 year ago. He was difficult! He taught at a graduate level for sure! Some exam questions were tricky and so detailed! Homework every week. Ridiculously difficult quizzes. I heard he is easier now but not much. He is nice, smart, very helpful, etc. Book sucks a lot. Average is C/C+.

Lectures are detailed and informative, but even if you understand the lectures and the readings, you will still do VERY bad on his impossible tests. Tests are tricky, worded very badly and incredibly difficult. Study for days and know every detail inside and out and you still won't do well...no one does. So thankful for the curve.

his lectues seem simple but his tests are damn near impossible.  Worst class ive ever taken, and so far ive had gaines and krempels who dont exactly have the best reviews, and i wish i was still in either one of their classes.  wouldnt recommend this class to ANYONE.  he had to curve a test 14 pts, not one person got over an 84 out of the 220.
Horrible class. Tests are impossible and questions are worded horribly. Teaches this course like its a graduate class. Barely able to hear him, even with his microphone on. I DO NOT recommend him.

This guy only cares about the specifics of the specifics. His tests are all about the little details of everything, not the big picture, making it very hard to well. Gives quizzes online once in awhile that are harder than the tests.  Hard to understand sometimes and talks very quietly. Although he's a nice guy, would not recommend Skromne.

This class is awful, his questions are tricky...like no matter how hard you study you will fail because every question on his exams is a trick question. Take him only if you dont care about your GPA because this class is awful...basically made me want to cry. I suggest taking mallery instead!
He is not the smartest.  He has a very strong accent.  He is very bad and grumpy.  BEWARE...not a nice or smart professor!!!
Excellent teacher, but grab a seat near the front. He doesn't project his voice well. Very engaged. A little difficult to take notes because his powerpoints have little or no text so LISTEN UP!
Great teacher misha.  Highly recommended.  Class not mandatory but go because his lectures are clear and understandable and fun.  He even bought the class bagels.

Horrible. I really don't understand the other comments left here.  Did he write these himself or was this before everyone got their grades.  Either way here's the truth. He couldn't teach if his life depended on it and he is oh so stingy with grading. Teach yourself and prepare to know yourelf inside out and do bad because thats the way he wants it

Mr. Skromne is an excellent teacher. The material covered by the class is difficult however he tries to clarify the information as best as possible. His lectures are quite helpful and act as a reinforcement to the readings. Attendance is required since he chooses participants randomly and issues quizzes. He grades on a curve which is helpful.

I would definately take him over Mallery. He is perfectly clear and his questions make sense-no tricks.  The answers are always justifiable. Also he curves big time especially on the final exam we took--oh yeah huge final curve.  Really big margins for A-/B+.He curved our finals and grades big time. Quizes are elementary. Midterm was a sinch.

Good professor, excellent powerpoints. As long as you pay attention in class and study every powerpoint, you will do well in this class. The material itself is difficult, and Skromne does his best to simplify the info. Class is a bit boring, but its important to show up to every class.

Skromne's intelligence is matched only by his flexibility. He basically catered the entire class around the suggestions of the students. The material is difficult by nature, but he is enthusiastic about helping and meeting the needs of the student.
quizzes and hw regularly, hard to understand..1 midterm which was close to impossible and a final as well

Professor Lindsay was one of the best professors I had in UM. He really cares about you doing well in the class, and helps you to improve your projects as he gives good feedback. I would take his class without hesitation. Take it if you want a break for other heavy classes and want to improve your GPA.

One of the best teachers at UM. He does a great job simplifying the Adobe suit and really cares about your work and you as a person. Takes the extra effort to help out his students and is a great person. Take this class
Gives you way more than enough time to complete easy assignments. Really easy class. He gives you creative freedom. Classes are short and fun.
I learned so much about photoshop and illustrator in his class. Very helpful, goes through everything step by step. Cares about his students.
Take someone else if you can.
He makes this class harder than it needs to be. Exams are super wordy but doable. Attendance is mandatory

Morales is really nice and cares about students succeeding. he tries to make the lectures as engaging as possible and he will show videos and real life examples, he also talks about examples from his work outside of UM. 2 exams + final + group project. no homework. exams are based on the slideshows. I would take him again.
Best Professor. He actually cares about his students and the material he teaches. Unlike a lot of the professors, he uses his outside UMiami experiences to help make the class more engaging and fun.

Professor Morales might be the most real and nicest professor at the U. I could not recommend him enough. If you work hard and prove to the professor you're always trying he will take note. 100p recommend.
Hard class. Good prof

This professor cares. At the beginning of the semester, it was hard didn't know how to study properly and was kinda  mess. This prof took the time to help and make sure that I had everything to get the best possible grade. GOAT prof. Definitely take him
This guy is the goat. Nicest Professor. Cares about his class and makes the most out of each class. Definitely the best prof for bte210

Very enjoyable class. Professor Morales cares about everyone in the class and makes the most out of every class time. He is always available outside of class. Definitely better than the other bte210 profs I've heard about. Definitely recommend.

Prof Morales is a nice guy and it seems like he cares He reads directly off the slides and class time is not very useful. Professor Morales is a very nice and understanding professor that is on top of everything.

Probably the best professor I've had at UM. I'm sad I could only take him for 344 I would take him for everything if I could. Learned so much and made the class interesting. 10/10.

She helped improve my writing skills. She is a hard grader but she WILL help you along the way!..She gets you prepared 4 higher english levels....you will learn!

shes a nice person- definitly only take her if you really want to improve your writing, she can really really help you. if u dont care about it, dont take this class!

she is a tough grader, the best way to get a good grade is by doing various drafts and giving them to her. she is beautiful which is one of the reason i kept attending class. great to look at
This has got to be one of the most boring classes I have taken so far.

Great teacher! Very clear in her instructions and all your assignments are relevant and have a purpose. One of my favorite teachers. Look no further!

Great professor.  She's a little tough on grading, but she's always willing to help you out to make your paper better.  She really taught me a lot of things I didn't know in writing. Hint: she loves the topic of diversity.
Wonderful teacher, very dedicated , make all materail relevent and interesting. I highly recommend her.
Amazing teacher! I love her!!!
Great class.  Isis does a great job at explaining writing techniques that she wants her students to use.  Look no further.

Very nice, helpful, and cares about her students. Do all of your work and you will do well in the class, MAKE SURE YOU ALWAYS ANSWER THE ASSIGNMENT PROPERLY! take advantage of her office hours too

Isis is a friend of mine, and I know she is a very passionate, dedicated professor. She honestly cares about all of her students, and is always working hard at making her classes more interesting and relevant.
