Do not take his classes if you chose marketing expecting to skate by.

Absolutely love him! Changed my major just because of him. He knows his stuff, is very experienced & takes considerable interest in his students. Wouldn't think twice before taking him for any MKT class he offers!
One of the best professors i've ever had at UM. Truly passionate about marketing and has a great teaching style. If you don't take Weinstock for this class you are missing out.

Extremely helpful and passionate about marketing. Stimulates interests and teaches very effectively through examples and analogies. His extensive experience in the professional world makes him a bit of a stickler with attendance, phones, and being on time, but totally worth it. One of the best profs at UM for sure.

One of my favorite professors ever! He is very strict about getting there on time, but honestly I'm not into interruptions either. He will also answer any questions you have without hesitation. He loves what he does and it shows! If you read the book and go over your notes, you will be fine.

Very nice professor. He makes the material really interesting with stories and personal experiences. He is a bit strict but definitely worth taking. You actually learn. Read the book and you should do well. Attendance is mandatory.

Very wise man who took his passion as his job. Knows his stuff but his tests are not easy, you have to know everything he says in class and the chapters in the books that goes for the test. He curves and is a fair grader. Very interesting proffesor, take this class if knowing more is more important for you than having a better grade

Weinstock is the MAN. Awesome professor, very clear in everything he does. He is very knowledgeable about the subject appropriately so. This was the first class I received all A's in. The course is somewhat challenging due to the amount of content, but study hard and READ BEFORE EVERY CLASS, it helps so much.

I've never rated a professor before but i felt compelled. fantastic teacher and overall great guy. very helpful and concise. lots of experience and interesting stories to add to lectures. not sure if attendance is mandatory? but this is one of the few classes i NEVER miss (and for me that's really saying something...)

GREAT class to take! One of the best professors at UM in my opinion. He's had so much experience in Marketing and has a lot of connections. Really cares about students, and class is never boring. Class wasn't mandatory, but I never missed one because I loved it so much! Great guy, definitely take his class!!

One of the best professors i have ever had. Teaches clearly and passionately and truly cares about his students.If you put in the work and effort you will do well and he will recognize your efforts and help you wherever and whenever you need it. Pay attention and take good notes, read the chapters and you will get an A if not A+.  great guy.
Great teacher. Not an easy class but his lectures are so interesting.

It was a great class overall. At first, I was not sure about his class because he is very strict with attendance (for example, he will not let you in if you come to class late). But he is one of the best professors I have had at the U. He cares about his students and his class is so interesting that i am taking another marketing class! TAKE IT!

he is a good professor but very strict. even though i didnt got the grade I expected i can say that it was worth taking his class. you are going to do well in this class if you take notes, read the book and attendance.

I really enjoyed his class. He genuinely cares about his students, and he's brilliant. He has a different method of teaching, which includes cases, a group simulation, lectures, and multimedia. It's easy to get a B+ in the class, but you have to put in the time if you want an A.

Stresses over and over about how lenient he is with the essays he grades, but that is a LIE. VERY hard grader despite how he says he's not. Tests are VERY difficult, some chapters he says that are going to be on it end up not on the test at all! Good at explaining things in class though

Very skilled teacher and extremely knowledgeable. Tons of industry experience. Fairly easy if you go to class, listen, and takes notes. Very strict about being on time and not having cell phones out. Laptops are allowed though.

Too serious! He makes Marketing SO HARD when it's actually the easiest thing in business. He's a good professor, explains well but VERY hard! His exams are crazy and not clear at all. There are FOUR essays on all his exams and 30 multiple choice! Do NOT take him under any circumstances :) or you'll regret it! he shouldn't be teaching freshman!

DO NOT BE LATE TO HIS CLASS! He is a nice guy but he is very picky and boring. I had his for a once a week class and we NEVER got out early, EVER. I probably would not take his class again. Also if you do take the class read the text book, and he'll be happy. Just a note, he looks like Bob Saget....

i loved this class. the tests are easy 4 short essays- choose 3. then a few common sense multile choice. attendance counts. he is a stickler for the rules and is very adamant about staying on schedule, but he tries to make everything interesting and involve everyone. he seems very knowledgeable and is clearly passionate about the subject.

He is awful, it is like talking to a robot.  He is very stiff and not relaxed.  He needs to get a social life i think.  way too strict, have Prof. Black come and teach instead, at least she is nice to look at.
Very picky and doesn't take into account other opinions or possible answers than his own.

I wouldn't take this class.  While he is very smart and experienced he expects WAY too much.  He watches you like a hawk in class making it stressful to be there at all, but is very strict about attendance.  The project is WAY too much work and harder than the other MKT301 classes.  His tests are also really difficult.

He has a lot of real world experience which is a plus and he really wants students to learn. I short essay portions of his exams are quite straightforward but the multiple choice is cumbersome. He is a nice guy, however his anal retentive personality and makes it hard for me to recommend him.
This class is so hard. Take another professor if possible!!! He is so impersonal and is like talking to a robot. Not very compassionate at all and his tests are way way way too difficult!

Class is not a cakewalk, but very interesting. He knows his stuff very much and has real world experience which is so valuable. Take him is you want to learn and be challenged, but not to a breaking point degree. : )

the project for this course is a lot of work. He is a difficult grader and his tests are hard. he's a jerk, he makes you wait until the break to come in if you are late, berrates you in front of the class if your phone rings or he sees you looking at it, and he doesn't allow laptops. i would consider taking someone efor this course if possible.

the project for this course is a lot of work. He is a difficult grader and his tests are hard. he is also kin of a jerk, he makes you wait until the break to come in if you are late, berrates you in front of the class if your phone rings or he sees you looking at it, and he doesn't let you take notes on your laptop. i would consider taking someone

Horrible teacher! He treats eveyone like they are in 5th grade! Super anal rentitive! If someone even whispers he stops the class!!! He is a black or white type of person. Worried more about covering all the content in syllabus than understanding the concepts!
No Comments

Professor Zhang is very caring! He was very empathetic & easy to communicate with. Lectures were very engaging as he cares about getting the class involved and encourages participation. He also gives great feedback on group work via email. Class was sometimes mandatory but other times attendance was not accounted for. Would definitely recommend!

Professor Zhang is very helpful and knowledgeable in the area of marketing. He has some of the most interesting lectures I've had so far in college. The course has some group work and a couple of individual assignments, but he is not that tough of a grader. Go to class and you should get a good grade.

Teaches at UO. Terribly boring class/lecture. Super easy class though, basically all definitions that are pretty easy. Never read the book. He goes on and on with easy examples which dont need to be explained for 15 minutes. He doesent really have a clear grading criteria for anything. 3 tests which was unnecessary along with 2 group projects.

AWFUL professor. you can't understand what he's saying half of the time and he is the most boring professor i have ever had. i have never been less motivated to do well in a class because he is just that bad
She was nice. The class was hard for a 200 level course. Not impossible to pass though.

I really enjoyed this class! Dr. Kaplan gets a lot of negative feedback on here, and I am not sure why. Read the textbook before class and then you are able to chill during the lectures and just enjoy them, they can be interesting. Rely on the BOOK not the LECTURES or you will do bad on the tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Only reads off of the PowerPoint slides. Tests are so specific that it is impossible to do good on them. Asks you the most irrelevant information on the exams that loosely have to do with what the class is about. Asks questions based on random things in the book that she does not talk about in class. directions always unclear. Be ready to read!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Kaplan is disrespectful; answers every student question with a passive aggressive tone and will not offer any sympathy no matter the circumstance. If you are confused on something, she will ignore you or explain it over again in the exact same way. Gave vague instructions for her final project and all students were left confused and frustrated.
Intelligent, gifted professor
Grades extremely hard

Professor Kaplan is an amazing professor. Her lectures are interesting, and she outlines the book through powerpoint, so you can get by without reading. However, the homework heavily relies on the book so it might be better to skim it once in a while. She is super accessible outside of class and is very considerate of any circumstance. 11/10

She assigns SO much homework. Every single class, except right before a test, you have to read an entire chapter of the textbook and answer A LOT of questions about it. Every homework assignment took between 2.5-7 hours to complete. Every. Single. Class. Attendance is required but she wont tell you anything that you didn't already read in the book.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Literally the most inconsiderate professor I've ever taken; had to file complaints with the department about how rude and unfair she was. MUST read the textbook EVERY single page of it because questions come from material that may not be on powerpoints. Refused to let me reschedule my final when dealing with a close death. grade is based on 4 tests
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Kaplan is the worst psychology teacher at UM that I have ever encountered. She reads from her slides which contain the absolute minimum amount of information and is inconsistent with the book. She does not make her own slides or exams. Her student helpers do everything for her including creating and grading exams and slides.
Very rude and condescending with students. I do not recommend her. Tests are highly subjective and short answer and if she decides she does not like you your grade reflects it.

She is disrespectful, will not listen to anything you say, is incredibly rude if someone asks a question. It is all about her, on first day she said "idc if you come to class to learn you need to come because I'm the star of the show." Literal narcissist, you won't learn anything, and a ridiculously tough and inconsistent grader. DO NOT TAKE!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: There is no extra credit, final grade is based on exam. This class was doable but a lot of students this semester had issues with her grading and the way she did the at home exams. However, i thought it was great and that the tests werent that hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Great psych teacher

She is a good person, but a horrible professor. Does not prepare you for the exam. the subject is interesting but she makes it boring. Just read the book as the questions come from it. She says you get extra points if you go to class (she takes random attendance) but she doesn't . Don't take it if you don't have to!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Tests aren't hard, just read the book carefully and you'll be fine. I highly recommend the online text for this class since it comes with quizzes you can do, and she sometimes takes stuff verbatim from those quizzes. Lectures are entertaining and she's a relatively easy grader on the papers. Overall very entertaining class, and friendly woman too.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Not a single thing on her lectures are on the exams. You have to teach yourself entirely through the textbook. I highly recommend not taking this class. The exams have the tiniest details from the textbook in them and she is not very helpful when asking for help. You do not get review guides, so this class is very difficult to do well in.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I took this professor for my major and I hated this class. It was a drag to go to class, she made you feel like an idiot for asking questions and made the class, in general, more complicated than it should. I feel like her lectures did not prepare me well enough for her exams and I would literally have to teach myself from the book.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Clear about expectations for the paper and on exams, and the lectures are entertaining!

The literature on personality is fascinating; this lecture was not. Do yourself a favor and read the literature yourself instead of sitting through horrible lectures. Kaplan reads word for word off of her slides and belittles students who raise their hands with honest questions. Test questions are often phrased badly. Grades can be arbitrary.
Super helpful during office hours and as long as you read the book and pay attention in class you'll be fine for the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She's very outgoing and makes class fun with videos, but I do not like her teaching style, although I do like her as a person. Not accommodating at all to students no matter how much they express their concern. Goes way too fast and if anything teaches the bare minimum, I rely on the book entirely and teach myself entirely and would fail if I didnt
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Literally had an 92.3 and she wouldn't give me an a in the class lol brat. like u have a son, wouldn't u want his teacher to be emphatic? what is .2 points going to do to u? you'll sleep at night. Lecture based, shows movies exams have q's on, must read textbook, 4 exams drops lowest, all memorization but easy study few days in advance
Loved Professor Kaplan. Took two of her courses, loved them both.

During class the professor reads off the slides word for word. There are four exams,  mostly based on questions from the textbook, and the lowest grade is dropped. Exams are all multiple choice so it is relatively straight forward. The paper project for this class is impossible, no clear topic, and little guidance from professor is provided.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Professor Kaplan is not a helpful teacher and she is rude to some students in the class. The tests are to the point from the slides and you have to do the paper, but she is not a teacher I would recommend for Psych at UM because there are so many other smart and nice teachers in the department for 200 level classes
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I took AP psych in high school and placed out of 110, so took 260 freshman year. Very easy if you read the textbook and show up to class, she gives extra credit randomly if you show up or do optional homework assignments. 4 tests and a paper, drop lowest exam grade and the final is the easiest exam all year so should help your grade.

Take her! She makes class enjoyable and although the daily journal entries can be a pain, they are easy and a huge chunk of your grade (50%), so they really help. She reads from her power points which basically tells you what is on the exam, but you need to read the textbook about each topic for more details. Not hard at all, would take again.

I loved her. Theres 4 tests and your lowest grade gets dropped. There are extra credit opportunities. Shes fun and makes the lectures entertaining. There are 2 papers to write but nothing difficult. Do read the textbooks bc her powerpoints will not help you pass. She says it herself that the test is based off the text but its easy reading.
I actually had Professor Kaplan for several classes. Easily my favorite psych professor. Very friendly, engaging, knows her stuff, and wants you to know it too.

Jill for Personality Psych was a great professor she makes it clear what she wants from you and what she expects you to do. She doesn't give much homework and gives study guides in order to pass her test. You will have to read the book in order to pass.

Took her for Intro to Psych during Summer A. TAKE HER IN THE SUMMER! She doesn't assign her super long papers during the Summer and doesn't give any tests in class. 80% of the grade was our online HW and Tests (which all answers are available online) and 20% was attendance. She is SUPER funny and always cracking jokes which helped for the long clas

I have mixed feelings. Sometimes I felt like she was on a roll with her lectures; yet, other times, it seemed that she was just reading off the slides. She always complained when we wouldn't read the whole chapter before attending her lecture on that chapter, and that actually really bugged me. The class is doable if you read, though.

While you do have to read all the chapters before a test, the class is definitely doable! She's pretty funny and loves to incorporate videos and little online surveys into her lectures. Attendance is optional, and she gives 5 extra credit opportunities! I'd take her again for sure.

Journals are such a pain... i'm not going to lie. If you know you're taking this for the fall, make sure you collect printed news articles over the summer so you don't try to look for one at the last minute. It's nice to skim the textbooks for exams too - there are things that are not on her powerpoint slides that are in the exams.

Professor Kaplan read directly off her slides every single lecture. All of this was verbatim from the textbook. She only supplemented any of the material with youtube videos. She was also rather rude to many of the students in our class. Grading of writing assignments was very subjective; if she liked you then you were in the clear.

Very fun instructor, I like the implementation of videos in lecture. Strict instructor in that she knows what she wants and she has high expectations of her students, but if you study, take your work seriously, and go to office hours, you can succeed. Also know how to do APA since there's an APA essay!

Dr. Kaplan is a wonderful professor, always funny and adept at making the material interesting and relevant to students. I would take any class she was teaching. Just make sure you understand APA for the paper!
I love her class. She's funny when you get used to her humor. Tests aren't hard if you read the chapters and studied the slides, which she puts online for you. I have had 3 classes with her already.

Prof Kaplan is a great teacher, everything any student could want. Attendance isn't mandatory, but she stimulates enough interest in the class that you usually want to come. Class is taught via powerpoint, but lots of discussion occurs on subject. Highly recommend.

She's a great professor, laid back, relaxed, her tests are either 40 Q's or 60, all straight foreword. She doesn't teach BS, just stuff you want to know if you take the class. She's fun :) TAKE HER GENDER CLASS ITS AWESOME. you'll never want to miss it

She is an awesome teacher!! Down to earth, laid back, and has kick-ass style. She makes the material interesting! I took her Gender Psychology and Personality Psychology and LOVED them both!! Read the book!! take notes attend class (she gives extra credit for attendance..Take her class you'll love it! I know I did.
Awesome.

The tests are based on the notes from the powerpoint which comes from the book. Not many people actually come to class, most just come to the tests. She doesn't really add much from the powerpoint besides stories to try to get us to pay attention (class is at 9:30 am). I definitely recommend PSY 209. Easy class.
hope she teaches another course I can take!!!
Hard class, but I learned a great deal-which I was not expecting.  Very current on events and media related to course material.

HORRIBLE CLASS. i am a biochem and psych double major with a 4.0 and i still thought this was hard.  i got an A but only because I worked for it.  the tests are horrible. she ruined the subject for me by those 100 question super-specific tests

Teaches straight from powerpoint, rarely does what she say come from her without first reading the slide. Material is easy, but her tests have 100 confusing wordy questions.  Passable, but make sure to glimpse the book as the powerpoints alone don't help.

She doesn;t know how to teach, i believed that if the publisher did have a companion site where she could get her power points she wouldn't know what to say.take her if you want to read the book, entire semester 659 pages covered(actually needed to pass the course)

professor kaplan was great.. her powerpoints were summations of the textbook content but she did use a lot of humor and real life examples that help with retaining the information.. you do need to read to do well though. she also gives a TON of extra credit opportunities that are very easy. take advantage of them and you can boost your grade a lot

Going to class is rather pointless, she really just summarizes the book to you. But attendance is 10% of your grade. Read and you will pass the tests. I wouldn't take her again I didn't get anything out of the class
No Comments

You have to be in class because she takes attendance but everything she says in class is pretty meaningless. She doesn't really answer peoples questions correctly. But if you read youll do fine. Also, take advantage of the extra credit article opps.
Loved this course! Opened my mind to what a documentary can be. You screen a film every week and write about it in blackboard. Class discussions are fun. Take it!

Professor Virga is awesome! I can understand why some people might not vibe with him because he is a bit intense at times, but it is only because he is old and wants the best for us. Deep down he is a true sweet heart! You will become smarter after taking his class.

Jim is the best professor in the documentary filmmaking department, this program wouldn't exist without him. Being in his class was an inspiration and a joy. He is authentic and will inspire you through his depth, experience and constructive criticism.

Professor Virga is my favorite professor at UM. MUST TAKE if you're actually passionate about film. Hates tardies and takes no excuses/B.S. Assignments: 3 group projects that are short films. Have to hand in rough cuts to get feedback and then final versions. also had to watch a few films for homework. Really cares about students that put in effort

Virga is great and fair. I really learned a lot from him. Only take him if you're majoring in film!! HATES TARDIES. There is a textbook that most people did not read, so they struggled on the final exam (multiple choice). Only one exam and three projects that are done with a partner. Teaches you basics of production (cameras and lights).
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Professor Virga is a good professor of classes. I like his lecture very much, and he cares everyone. He is very inspirational. However, he is in a bad mood at people who become late in his class. I understand his purpose is positive in order to motivate students not to be late, but I don't think the way he uses is helpful. Also, he is critical.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: He is intimidating at first but then you realize he's just pushing you to get the best out of you.

You have to make three movies. He grades them very toughly. I have learned how to use the camera very well in his class. He is a cool guy calls everyone "baby" but he rambles a lot and has a very odd sense of humor.

I loved the guy! He's hilarious and as long as you treat him with respect, he will treat you with respect. One rule is that you GET TO CLASS ON TIME. If you have an actual reason to be late or not show up, email him before but don't stroll into class late and say excuses. There were 3 total projects and they were pretty time consuming, but fun!

A remarkable person with an enormous amount of talent. I never worked harder at UM but never felt prouder of the work I put forth. Looking back on undergrad and grad school, I can say with certainty he is head and shoulders above every professor I have encountered. UM is lucky to have him and students should seize the opportunity to take his class.

Virga is AWESOME! He really wants everyone to succeed, & doesn't stand ANY drama. Just the way it should be. You learn a lot from his class, the book, & the projects. He's very helpful & also funny. If you go to class, listen, ask questions, & try your best without bringing any drama, you will go far in not only his class but in life.
Learned a lot from Virga. He's a bit intense at times. I plan on taking him again. He is a trip, though.
he's the perfect teacher -- also, why doesn't he have a chili pepper?

If you treat him and his classroom with respect, he will treat you with respect. I am a senior about 4 classes away from finishing his class and it's honestly been my favorite class. If you want to learn and challenge yourself with someone who is enthusiastic and will push you to do your best (and won't bull s**t you) take Virga.

If you ever have the chance to take a class with Virga, TAKE IT!! He's an awesome professor, and he pushes you to do your best. There's only one rule: Get to every class on time, and if you can't make it, call him ahead and let him know. I highly recommend him!!

Favorite professor I have ever had.  Makes you work hard for your grade, but he is willing to help you and really sparks a passion in you for telling stories.  He may seem scary at first, but he really cares about his students and wants to help you!  Best class I have ever taken.

This is one of the most demanding classes that I have ever taken, but it was well worth it. Jim does not take any BS and really makes you work for your grade. But you will learn so much in one semester, and if you're serious about journalism, this is a class to take.
You have to work hard, but it is worth it and you will learn A LOT. He wants effort from his students, and is not into excuses. I really enjoyed his class.
A total waste of money and effort! Professor Virga contradicts himself and plays favorites, one of the worst professors I ever had!

Demanding professor who is extremely passionate and caring. If you want an easy A, don't take him. If you want to really learn something about journalism and telling stories, then there isn't anyone I could recommend more!
Don't take him if want an easy A. Be prepared to go out EVERY weekend and take pictures, he's ridiculously hard to please and your grades will reflect it
insensitive, hyper-critical, subjective comments.  lacks a certain sense of empathy for other people, which is odd because it's a photojournalism class.

Jim is a great professor who has been there and really knows his stuff.  If you're genuinely interested and put in effort, he will help you out a whole lot. He can be critical and demanding, but it's all to help you out and in the end you will improve a lot. Highly recommended. If you're a CVJ major, don't graduate without taking him at least once.
BEST!

Jim is a great teacher.In reference to the first comment, you probably didnt get along because you were lazy.  Jim can teach you more than any other teacher you have if you are willing to learn and work hard.  He knows his stuff and is more than willing to help students with anything.
Jim is a fantastic teacher.  You need to want to learn to do well. He will help you with anything, but laziness isnt tolerated.

Jim is a great teacher.  He knows his stuff and you will learn as long as you are not lazy.  Take what you can from the class.  If you want to learn you will.  If you dont care, you wont be happy with the class.

Jim really knows his stuff. He is very enthusiastic and a little eccentric at times, but he'll be your best  friend if you show interest in the class. He wants effort more than anything. I learned more in his intro class than I ever thought I would. He's strict on assignments, and he's not afraid to tell you the truth about your photos.

Jim's a good guy who really wants to help you with your photography. He doesn't take a lot of BS, but if you're sincere and put forth effort you will go far in this class. Just be prepared to dedicate a lot of your time to photo. You will learn a lot about yourself and a lot about life in this class. It's very hard and taxing but very worth it.

I disliked going to every class. There is a class rank and seating chart. Class is overall boring and a waste of time, did not learn anything useful and would have done anything to have taken it with a different professor.

Professor Mysius was unaccommodating, unresponsive and inflexible. His poor managed attendance system and rigid policies made the class unnecessarily, stressful. Communication was liking, and grading. System was unclear overall this class offered little support or fairness, and I wouldn't recommend it.

Professor Mezias was unaccommodating, unresponsive, and inflexible. His poorly managed attendance system and rigid policies made the class unnecessarily stressful. Communication was lacking, and the grading system was unclear. Overall, this class offered little support or fairness, and I wouldn't recommend it.

The people putting these reviews are people who don't try in his class. Professor Mezias makes the class very engaging and interesting by giving examples and telling jokes. His quizzes are very straightforward if you pay attention and come prepared to class. He doesn't deserve these bad reviews. Highly recommend taking him!!!!

Professor knows he is tenured and unless something completely out of hand occurs he could care less about you.

He rates you amongst your peers for participation which makes 0 sense which makes it all up to him and his perception.

only positive in this class is that you get 100s for the required write ups.

Good Luck

I really don't know how this professor is still teaching, extremely bad teaching ways he will let u study for the quiz at your own and after the quiz is done he will go over the case that you have already got tested on which I think is very useless, he was so rude in class, no respect for other students, not supportive, doesn't help at all.
this is the rudest professor I've ever encountered. he is belittling and close-minded. honestly not sure why he's teaching since he seems to have no respect for anyone.

If you want to get disrespected in class , not able to drink any liquids in class, if you love exams that make no sense with the readings with a very strict time and hounds over you then this is the professor for you, if you want to learn and not have anxiety every second in this MANS class then please don' take him, I have never wrote a review....
After the exam is finished you can throw away all the photocopies, there is nothing essential to be remembered. Pretty useless class.

This class consists of a lot of cases, fairly easy but he doesn't read them. About 10 quizzes, one huge group project (which he won't give you an A no matter what) and a KILLER final exam. He is very strict and mean. Instead of trying to help you he wants you to do bad! Not supportive at all! I wouldn't recommend this professor to anyone.

Great teacher. Clear and explain things well. Cases were short and easy to read. He has case writeups, quizzes, final, and presentation. Final and quizzes were not hard. Case reports were an easy 100 if you did what he wants you to do. All in all I enjoyed the class.

Also had him first year out of NYU. He was terrible. Really had no business teaching grad classes especially considering what we paid in tuition. Should have cut his teeth on undergrad classes first. He's always right.  His standards were unclear so it made it hard to deliver what he wanted for cases and test. By far the worst class I had @ UM.

Had him in graduate school his first year out of NYU. Looking back I wish I had purchased my own copy of Porter's Competitive Strategy and read before I attended class. Still remember the 5 areas of company competition. He is a disciple of Michael Porter so familiarize yourself with his theories before class and you will gain great knowledge.

There is soooo much reading in this class...cases/chapters.  Then there are quizzes, a group project, and a final.  (As you can see, this class is a lot of work.) The final is tough b/c it is the only test in the class, and you are not familiar with the style.  Dr. Mezias tries to make the class fun with several in-class games/exercises.
Style is very aggressive, NY-liberal. Inserts politics into his teaching and conversation too often. A decent guy, though close minded.

Taught me while pursuing my MBA.  Great teacher, learned a lot.  A bit eccentric, but that's his style.  He's a no-nonsense kind of guy.  Do the work by following his rules to the T and you'll get a good grade.

The workload is not appropriate for the course. 25% presentation (he won't give u an A no matter how hard u work on it) and a 25% final which u can't properly prepare for because its the only test all semester. He will criticize you to no end and he is never wrong (or so he thinks). He'll get VERY defensive if you question the way he does anything.

Times have certainly changed. His class is extremely difficult now. You must take 8 short quizzes and are all done in the first 10 minutes of class..no more or less at all..his personality is extremely aggressive and he is always right...extremely hard final that is mandatory..classs has become very hard..he takes the curve thing to heart

Oh how times have changed.  The class is no longer easy...the final is now mandatory and it counts for 25%.  It is cumulative and really hard.  The project is huge and is a pain in the ass.  He is actually a good teacher but he can be very aggressive at times...def a NY personality.  Class is on a 3.0-3.3 curve...the B School is getting way hard!

Oh how times have changed.  The class is no longer easy...the final is now mandatory and it counts for 25%.  It is cumulative and really hard.  The project is huge and is a pain in the ass.  He is actually a good teacher but he can be very aggressive at times...def a NY personality.  Class is on a 3.0-3.3 curve...the B School is getting way hard!

I had always heard that the class was hard but he makes it really easy. At the beginning of the semester he gives you the choice of 8 quizzes or one final. The quizzes are reallllllly easy and you have a page write up from a case every week and thats it. He makes the class realllly interesting. TAKE HIM! You will enjoy the class@!!

Funny prof, tries to make the lectures funny and entertaining. The only annoying thing is he doesn't post lectures/slides and the exams are exactly what he says and whats on the slides. Easy to get an A in the class, you just have to go and take notes.

I have taken 3 classes with him and I think he's super great. Yes he can be a bit inappropriate but he told me it's a way to keep people attentive especially in large classes. He definitely cares about what he's teaching and your experience as a student. I hope to have him again
This guy is hilarious, pretty easy class as well. Would reccomend.

The reviews on this class are so dramatic. This is one of the easiest classes every because there's almost no homework. BUT you NEED to take notes in class. Study those notes before the exam and you will get an A on literally every test. He tells you what parts of lectures are test questions a lot of the time so just go to class and take notes.

Prof would use inappropriate & offensive language during every class. Making micro aggressive remarks on black women's skin color & created a sexually uncomfortable environment. Made constant connections to genitals, talked about sex, & visibly put female students in uncomfortable positions. Terrible grader, no feedback, bad instructions

This was one of my favorite classes. His exams are specific, but those who whine about it just did not study lol. He gives study guides a week before each exam. His lectures can get a bit boring but some topics are really cool. Skipping is okay just make sure you get notes from someone or you'll be lost when you study.

DO NOT TAKE!!!!!! His exams are extremely difficult and deliberately designed to be tricky. Since the three tests together make up 75% of your grade, doing well is essential. Save yourself the trouble and avoid his class.

Funny youthful man who loves sex. Only problem with this class is that you actually have to show up, and on days that you don't, you need to get notes from somebody since he doesn't post slides. Exams are pretty easy too, if you pay attention, which is easy because he makes the class entertaining.

Tests are not hard if you study a lot but some questions are VERY specific. There are also 3 papers that are very doable and boost your grade. He is honestly so nice and wants you to do well but the lectures definitely feel long. I thought this class would be easier than it was but it is not too bad if you go to class and pay attention.

I took this class as an elective thinking it would be an easy A. For sure not an easy A. I have ended up putting more focus into this class than some of my core classes. Test are SUPER specific based on moments from class. One question was asking what a girl was wearing in the minute long video he showed in one class. Teacher is fine.

He is one of the funniest teachers I've ever had which made lectures very engaging. The exams are easy if you go over your notes and make a quizlet. The papers were easy too--you just had to watch a movie and answer questions. Although attendance isn't mandatory, he doesn't post his slides so if you miss a class, you can't get the missed content!
This professor makes students feel uncomfortable talking about sex almost every class. He makes the exams almost impossible and seems like he wants his students to fail. take a different professor.

He does not post the slides on blackboard so even though attendance is not mandatory you should go. The class is an hour 15 and feels long because it is consistent lectures with videos in between. He gave 5 pop quizzes all in the span of 3 weeks at the end of the semester. The 3 exams are worth 75% of your grade so review. Easy class.

Prof Soliday is super nice! He will work with you if you need help with anything or need to redo anything (except for exams). The class had three major exams with one quiz that was online. There were three short papers with very clear grading criteria. Lectures do feel a little long at times but he does a good job keeping them fun. Good class!

Soliday was a pretty easy teacher for CCA 103. Lectures for most of the classes and there are 3 papers that you have to write about a film that you can choose out of a list (films are recent  ones you've probably watched). We had a few tests but not too hard. I would recommend him for the class.

Soliday is very nice and wholesome guy, but his class is entirely a lecture. He gives quiz assignments that aren't hard, but his tests have the most random, specific questions relating to particular moments in class. If you miss a class, there's no getting that question right. You'll really have to pay attention every class to know everything.
He's very sweet. It's an easy A

Tests are based solely on lecture material. Tests are extremely hard even if you listen in class. You must go to every single class or else you will likely fail. The tests consist of specific statements or images shown in class, if you blink for a second you will not get the question right. You can take all the notes in the world and still fail.

Soliday seems like a genuine guy but the lectures were just not that interesting. It can be very hit or miss with him. The "quizzes" are either watching a movie or some YouTube videos and writing about it. He also references sex too many times to the point where it just gets weird. Mid-term and final sometimes have the most random questions. Solid

Professor Soliday is a hilarious, engaging, and caring professorhis classes really made my Monday's and Wednesday's. In terms of course-work, quizzes were over the lectures, and the tests were over movies (from a pre-selected list). If you enjoy learning about film or need an elective in your schedule, you will not be disappointed with his class!

Professor Soliday is easily one of the best professors I have ever had. he is super sweet and funny and makes his lectures interesting. The class is basically 10 quizes that are all based on his lectures and slides, as well as 5 short essay tests that are based on a movie you chose from his list. He's a great professor and an easy grader.10/10

TAKE THIS CLASS!! CCA103 was the best class I've ever taken at the University of Miami. Prof. Soliday is one of the most kind, caring, and passionate professors at UM. Classes are very enjoyable. Quizzes are based off the lectures so just make sure to pay attention during class. Tests (papers) are just based on movies that are watched on your own.

TAKE THIS CLASS. Easy assignments, you actually learn, and his real world experience is to die for. This class was the highlight of my week. 5 tests, 10 quizzes all super easy and straight forward. You get to review movies and quizzes are open notes and open lectures so definitely review and ask classmates for help.

Professor Soliday is a hilarious and engaging professor who really cares about the subject he teaches and cares even more for the students in his class. I recommend taking notes and paying close attention if you want to get the best grade on assignments you can which is easy due to his engaging lectures. He knows his stuff and how to teach.
If you do the work, you will have no problem getting an A. Soliday is very funny and such a nice man. Definitely would take a class with him again.
Professor Soliday LOVES his job. He cares about his students and wants you to succeed. If you need help he is happy to lend a hand. I wish I could take him again x10

Professor Soliday is extremely caring and gives engaging lectures! His lectures are a little out there and out of left field, or full of weird tangents- but they're pretty engaging. He handled the switch to online classes during the pandemic so well- much respect. He gives his students a chance to get a great grade with extra credit.

John's famous slideshows have student loving or hating him. He is charming but also can get on peoples nerves because he makes many sexual metaphors. I learned a few things in this class but it is mostly making silly movies that are less quality than the CIM151-251 classes. Pretty easy, dont need to buy the books.

He is one of the funniest teachers I've had. His lectures are very interactive and entertaining. I've learned a lot from him so far. His exams are easy if you study. The only problem is he never posts his PowerPoints on Blackboard. Other than that I think he's great.

This class is a complete waste of time.  Soliday is funny, but he barely talks about actually directing.  All he cares about is composition, which has nothing to do with the class.  He gives you a lot of work that has no value.  It's just busy work.  I strongly recommend not taking this class, especially if you already have experience in directing.

He is the most hilarious man ever. He gives long lectures and moves through his powerpoint slides rarely quickly. Definitely take notes during the lectures or you will not pass the class. He provides study guides before all 3 of the exams, all of which are very straight-forward. No other grades.
Very fun.
You have to be a great note taker to get a good grade in his class. He does not post his powerpoints on blackboard.

Soliday's by far the coolest professor I've ever had. He really knows how to engage his students and make lectures fun and interesting. Attending class is a must because he doesn't post lecture notes online and makes test questions from videos seen in class. The tests are reasonable if you study. He sometimes goes through the notes too fast though.

pretty interesting guy, loves to talk about his alumni and who he knows in the industry though. he lectures on ppt and can fly through pretty quickly so be prepared to take quick notes or just ask him to go back and he will. 3 tests were super easy, got As on all. have to attend 6 movies at the cosford, no biggie bc tons offered. dont need textbook

He gives MASSIVE amounts of worksheets, has redone the syllabus 3 times already. When giving a "lecture" he wonders off topic, always manages to throw in a story or two about his daughters and his alumni. The syllabus work is near impossible to keep up with and plainly unrealistic. Does not teach the subject correctly, he has to reinvent the course

I enjoyed this class a lot!!! I don't know what the heck people are talking about him. Yeah, some of his test questions are tricky but it's not the whole test plus if you ask him about it you won't have doubts. I got A's on all 3 tests. He does go fast on the slides so you better type/write fast. Overall, he was great, I loved his class.

He's a cool guy. Funny and nice and interesting and all that. Don't take this class, though. Even if you memorize all the notes, you're not guaranteed an A because his tests are tricky/random... lots of True/False. Also, the material you cover is kind of boring- it's like the history of film. And the entire class is almost pure memorization.

Really interesting guy but a little eccentric to say the least. EXTREMELY passionate about the subject. You pretty much need to go to class and write down everything as fast as you can because he does not slow down. Tests are pretty tricky but if you study your notes and memorize it, you'll get an A. John's mah boy!

Blazes through notes, test are supposed to be easy but you have to know EVERYTHING he says, he also has about 5 different exams, i dont know how fair that really is.  Really don't learn anything and you just have to type tons of ntoes that he will never go online.  When you ask him to go back to copy something down he either says its not important.

Awesome guy, very funny with some of the best stories ever. Tends to go off-topic, but the in-class exercises are a great start for beginning directors. He also covers a lot more than just camera technique, from casting to costuming. He is definitely knowledgeable of the industry. Oh, and don't buy the books.

I can't really describe this class without getting angry. John speeds through meaningless notes for tests that are 100% memorization. You can get A's, but only if you can decipher his typos. He proclaimed before the first test that it was "meant to trick you." Beyond frustrating. I didn't learn what I expected to, but I did learn to type faster...

I thought his class was very interesting and relatively easy.  Yes he did go much too fast with the notes (which he does not put online either) but I found that writing down as much as possible was good enough (I got an A on all three exams).  He was a bit eccentric but very nice and willing to answer questions after class.

People love John because he is charismatic and funny. However, this class is VERY basic. The exercises feel more like games, which is fun, but you won't really draw from what you learn in this class too much when you're out shooting your own films. Take it if you're a freshmen. If not, you're better of taking Lisa Gottlieb's directing classes.

Soliday clearly knows his stuff and he obviously loves it. He's moves fast, but I used my laptop to take notes and I was able to keep up. Gotta go to class cause he doesn't provide notes otherwise, and even thought there's a text it's never used, bu it's still an awesome film book if you're a fan. Overall, I really enjoyed attending his classes.

He talks fast, goes through the notes even faster and has a lot of information to share. He loves what he does and he cannot gush enough about it. After getting to know him better, I would take ANY class he teaches. Write as much of the notes as you can down and study, you'll get an A. He's extremely funny. Made me want to go to class

I would agree completely with what has been said below. Soliday intentionally tries to confuse you on the exams especially the T/F and MC. TOO MANY NOTES AND HE IS NOT CLEAR AT ALL. He doesn't post notes on blackboard. He will say the exam is not cumulative but then throws on something from the last exam or something you have never seen before.

Soliday is a knows a lot about film. Unfortunately, he is quite incosistent with his notes and talks extremely fast. He gives at least 5 pages of notes per class. He will try to TRICK you  on the exams. The exams have some COMPLETELY UNRELATED QUESTIONS on them. He sneaks some material from the previous exams as well. OK CLASS.

He is an interesting and funny guy but talks SO FAST. It is extremely tough to write down the notes fast enough and his tests are quite tricky. He purposely puts some irrelevant information on the tests. The movies are fun. You MUST ATTEND CLASS b/c the notes are not on Blackboard. There are a TON of notes. Decent class overal but not great.

Soliday is the man! Just go to class and listen to him talk...funniest quotes ever! He is really hard to follow because he talks so fast and has major ADD, but he's a good teacher. Three tricky but not hard exams. Definitely possible to get an A especially if you are International (gives you 15 bonus points per test if you are from another country)
cool professor. TONS of notes. notes NOT posted online. Tests cover some irrelevant information.

Great Teacher. Really enjoyed his classes. He is a bit inconsistent with notes, but nothing terrible. He is very funny and knowledgeable. His test are average difficulty. Definitely take him if you can.

Really fun teacher who is a great lecturer. Anyone who is interested in the history of film will LOVE his class. He tells some hilarious stories and seems to love talking to everyone. His tests aren't hard; just make sure you take good notes while he is talking and read the very little reading he actually assigns.

Honestly a hard class in general. Professor does his best to make it enjoyable however the course has changed and its extremely hard to get a good grade on the final. Told my class an 80% on the final was extremely high. Final just unnecessarily hard. Good guy though.

Professor Martinez is an amazing business law professor; he turns a class that should be difficult into something manageable and organized. He's funny, shows interest in the course, and cares about all of his students. Highly recommend!

Professor Martinez is the GOAT! People say how hard this class is but with him it was not difficuilt at all. He is pretty easy grader and tries to entertain the class. He covers everythig you need to know in class so do not spend a lot of time reading the textbook because he skips a lot of content from there. Take him!

The best advice I could give is to lock in on the textbook and in class. This class is pretty difficult but everything he covers in class is what he gives on the quizzes. He's a super nice professor and makes the class challenging but it never felt too difficult or impossible. I would highly recommended him.
Goat. He was great, interesting even when explaining seemingly boring topics.

Amazing prof. Very funny. 2 exams midterm primarily on 1 chapter and final is technically cumulative. We got a cheat sheet - you just need to ask for one. You watch Silicon Valley and do a discussion post once a week. Def not a typical BSL class but I really enjoyed it. Group memo that you later revise and presentation. Go to office hours 100%

Business law here is honestly just a hard class in general but I really think he is the best professor to take. If u pay attention in class and actually go it's not bad at all. Just study a day before the quizzes and you'll be good. He definitely prepares well for the final which I know a lot of other professors didn't

class has completely changed from previous semesters. No "tests" but your whole grade is 3 quizzes and a final. loves trick questions on mcqs, easy grader on written parts. Hes a nice guy but his teaching is everywhere and lacks organization. Loves to turn everything into a riddle and will never give you an actual direct answer

This professor was great; he clearly knew what he was talking about and made the course very easy to understand. All sections have a lot of quizzes (read the book, it will help), and some of them were easier than others. He's always interested in helping students; sometimes the content is hard (which is out of his control).
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: 8 quizes each semester cumulative final amazing amazing teacher however all students show up every day
Do not take ols

He is a very nice man and is super funny but his lectures are hard to follow at times. his notes are messy!! quizzes are straightforward and if you lock in a day before the quiz, you will be fine. be prepared to have a quiz almost every week tho. he takes attendance every class and it is a big part of ur grade. he is always willing to help students

Professor Martinez-Evora is genuinely a nice guy, which is why his rating is so high, but I wouldn't take his class again. He constantly changes the syllabus and forgets to discuss information that will be on tests. Better profs in the BSL department to take
Professor Martinez-Evora is a fantastic man. This course is definitely very reading heavy, but as long as you can understand all the components of each chapter you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: what a g. only professor i rated cuz i love this man. 10/10 class and professor for slackers who want easy classes.

I'm not sure why this professor has good reviews. He is not a good lecturer and is very unclear. The grade is made up of 5 quizzes and a final which he grades completely subjectively. He is disorganized and frequently misses mentioning information important for the quizzes. I would not take him again.

Prof Evora is good. He's not amazing which is why I didn't give him a 5 but really no complaints. The only complaint I have is you gotta really pay attention because the lectures aren't really online so you'd have to study out of the book. BSL212 is just a hard class in general. Somewhat tough grader. Solid 4.5/5.

Professor Martinez is such a nice guy! He is always joking around and bonding with his students. Also super accesible outside of class for whatever you need. His quizzes are kinda hard but if you prepare you'll do good.
Great professor. super available outside of class, quizzes are easy if you prepare and study. no final, only final paper and presentation.
A great BSL212 professor, goes through content in an understandable way, lots of practice questions, cares about students and makes class fun. Tests are a little subjective but he is fair.
Does not give clear deadlines and places all the blame on students who struggle.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of my least favorite professors I have ever had. Not because the class was hard or because he was a bad teacher, but because he made so many unfunny jokes during lectures that it totally ruined my interest in the course. If you want an easy business law class, this is perfect (all tests are open note). If you want to learn, pick something else.

Don't get me wrong, Evora is a caring, respectful, funny and good GUY. But, when it comes to teaching I don't understand how people think he is a good professor. His lectures are all over the place, and he doesn't explain things in a digestible major. Quizzes are open note, but very hard because the notes are from his confusing & messy lectures! :(

One of my favorite professors that I have had at the University of Miami, as he truly cares about making sure that his students understand the material. His grading isn't harsh either, very understanding. 

W professor

Professor Evora is a good professor but an even better person. He always brought jokes to class and made the class interesting. I would say the course is hard in general but Professor Evora does a good job at using real life examples to explain things. Attendance is mandatory as nothing is really posted notes wise to follow along on.

Prof. Evora is great. He actually teaches you and explains things thoroughly instead of reading off of slides like a lot of other teachers. He makes jokes and is really kind. He wants to help you and it's clear he cares about his students. Quizzes can be a bit tough at first but you get used to the format quickly. Take him if you can!

I loved professor Evora! He had a very clear teaching style and was able to successfully simplify complex content. There are no surprises in this class and you can tell that he really cares about the success of his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Martinez is kind and makes a lot of jokes. Lectures can be boring, but not all too often. The quizzes aren't too difficult but he uses particular language that can make the questions tricky. There is a final group project that takes a lot of time but is easy to do well on. Definitely not a very hard class for level 400.
Very personable guy who is always willing to help his students! He makes hard concepts easy to understand. Ask questions and participate!
Best professor I've had at UM if you need to take BSL get Evora.

He is a very nice guy, but his teaching skills are not great. Everything that is important, he says in his lecture, and it's hard to pick up on it. He also grades quizzes very hard. You have to know literally everything from the chapter and write it down. Not a bad guy overall, but I personally wouldn't take him again.
Participation is really important and also the final project. Ask questions! He helps a lot with the final project and with the course overall. He really wants to help the students.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Evora was incredible, and probably the best teacher I've ever had, he brought so much energy to class and made business law understandable, comprehensible, and his lectures were extremely entertaining. A lot of people got bad grades on the first 2-3 quizzes, but if you know the rules and how to interpret them you will do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Evora is my favorite BSL teacher at Miami. I took him for 212 and again for 412. He is kind and his lectures are very interesting. He prepares you well for the quizzes and drops the lowest one. There is one big group project (10-20 pg paper and presentation) in place of the final. I wish I could take him again!

Cool guy. Made a very dense subject super interesting to learn and actually had us engaged. The class can be a little tough to keep up with sometimes but Dr. Martinez really takes his time in answering any questions you have and won't move on until everyone understands. Really funny and quite the character. So grateful I took him for this course.

Professor Evora is one of the best professors I have ever had. He is nice and makes learning a difficult subject entertaining and clear by giving examples and real-life situations. One thing you should know is he doesn't give the best notes however notes can be made from the textbook easily.
He actually teaches and is easy to understand even if you dont like the topic. As long as you go and take notes you will pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Gives good feedback--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He is a great professor. His lectures are interesting and he always tells jokes and tries to relate to his students. The quizzes are a bit confusing sometimes but he grades leniently and they are all open note. As long as you listen and take good notes you should get an A. The two projects are easy A's. I am taking him again next semester!

Awesome! The first quiz will be kind of hard as you get used to his teaching style. After you get it everything gets so easy. You learn and ton and the class is kept light-hearted and fun. One of my favorite Profs at UM!!!

THE BEST TEACHER EVER. He really does care about all of his students and you can feel it in his lectures. Sometimes lectures are hard to follow. His class takes time to understand because it is a different way of testing. His tests aren't too bad just pay attention and take good notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Great professor. Makes learning business law very interesting and fun. I strongly suggest taking him. His tests are very straight forward and as long as you pay attention in class.

Super genuine guy with only good intentions. The class is based off of notes and open note quizzes. Take good notes and youll do well in the class. The final was pretty hard but it was just an extended version of the typical quizzes. Would definitely take him again.

I had Professor Martinez for the Fall 2020 semester, and he was great. I had some students in my class think it was difficult, but sincerely I think they weren't the brightest. Take this guy. Everything is open notes, he is entertaining, and you do not need to study for the quizzes. But really make sure to just take good notes & listen in class
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: One of my favorite professors this semester. He was caring and genuinely wanted his students to learn the material and succeed in his class. He would answer questions that students had, sometimes even going off on a side note, because he wanted to connect with his students and help them the best way he knew how. Would definitely take again!
Great Professor, explains everything for the test, if you show up to class, you'll do good.
Best Professor ever. Really awesome nice guy

Professor Martinez-Evora is a great professor! He really cares about teaching BSL and does his best to make complex ideas easy to understand. He is funny and wants to make sure you are prepared for the quizzes. Definitely take him if you have the chance you will learn a lot and the class is not too difficult if you put in the work.

Professor Evora is one of my favorite professors at the University of Miami. He is extremely passionate about both the subject matter and his students. The content is somewhat difficult, but he does an amazing job of teaching it. If you take good notes and study them, you will do very well.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Evora is very knowledgeable and cares about the course material, however at least for this class his lectures were all over the place. It was hard to follow along and understand the abstract material. I didn't enjoy his teaching style, but ended up with a A in the class due to the open book quiz and final paper. Not the worst but not the best

reviews.comment: The best!! BSL212 is definitely challenging but Prof. Martinez makes it interesting and exciting. He is always enthusiastic about everything and sometimes brings in food for class. Pay attention, participate, and study, and you will do well in this class. You are to work for it, but Prof. Martinez makes it fun for sure. he always answers questions
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Evora is awesome! His class is confusing at first and the material is overall challenging, however his outlines work well for studying. Make sure to ask questions and go to his office hours to understand the material. He genuinely cares about his students' success and knows the field really well!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: THE BEST! Take him for BSL 212 and you will not regret it. The Business Law material and class itself is difficult so the quizzes and final are hard, but he explains the material so well. Excellent teacher and genuinely has a passion for teaching. He is my favorite professor at UM. Life changing class. Take him and thank me later.

Prof Evora is a great professor and really cares about his students. The course has 6 quizzes, a paper, and a final. The class overall is really tough, but he tries his best to outline the chapters and helps you understand cases from the book. Go to his office hours, because class can get confusing.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: he is a really good proffesor. gives plenty of good examples and he is very organized. I would take him again for sure! You have to pay attention and go to class, but its worth it

Great choice for 212. Doesn't usually take attendance but he knows when you're not there. He gives really good examples and explanations which are really helpful for the quizzes and finals. Overall really great prof that understands that not everyone wants to be a lawyer.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Really good choice for 212. I wish I paid closer attention to his outlines during class because they are good for summarizing the whole chapter (important laws, concepts, cases) into a concise, easy to study thing. Really accessible, caring and going to his office hours (for quizzes and final) helps a lot. 6 quizzes and phat final, class par 10%
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: You get about 6 quizzes in the semester, one paper on a movie, and an exam. The quizzes are opened ended but if you pay attention in class and study, you will be fine.
Took his class in Spanish and it was amazing. He really wanted to bond with his students. If you had a question, he would respond it clearly. Most caring and incredible professor I've had at UM.

Amazing teacher, super nice and caring! He gives really clear outlines on the chapters, you don't even have to read information from the book! Also, there is no homework at all, all you have to do is study for the bi-weekly quizzes. He makes BSL212 less boring and difficult, take him!

Love him. He makes a hard class easy. Course is based on quizzes, one paper, and a final exam based on the quizzes. Lots of writing but that's what this class is, despite the professor. Definitely go to his office hours, he loves when students do this. He doesn't take attendance but he knows when you're absent so don't skip! Never studied much :)
Excellent professor that genuinely cares if youre learning. Teaches in simple terms, so that the class is easy to understand.

The sweetest, most caring professor ever. Always smiling and genuinely loves his job. As long as you put in your full effort, it is manageable to get an A. If you skip class, it will be extremely difficult to do well as the crucial information is in his lectures as opposed to the textbook (you only use the textbook to look at case studies).

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I have had at UM, he genuinely cares about you doing well and is so passionate about what he's teaching. The class is hard and you have to read the book for sure but he gives great examples to help explain things.

Professor Evora is a great professor. He is very easy; if you don't understand the criteria he will go through it until you comprehend. Very easy. Willing to help and definitely wants his students to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Take this class! Evora is a really nice and funny guy. He talks about the cases like stories so his lectures are interesting and enjoyable and if you take notes on the outlines he makes in class, you really don't need to read the textbook (but you still need it for the cases). 6 quizzes, a short paper, group assignment, and cumulative final.
excellent teacher, he is on YOUR side and wants to see you succeed. Very approachable. added a business law minor because of him

He is a very nice professor. He wants to see you excel. If you don't get anything, he's saying then he will give you multiple examples to make sure you understand the concept. The Survival Guide is beneficial for when those tough concepts that come up. Easy Grader. BSL is very interesting. I would definitely take again!

My favorite professor so far! He is very experienced and gives great and informative lectures. He really makes law understandable and applicable to life, which is interesting. Doesn't teach you anything useless and is straight to the point. very cool guy.
He enjoys teaching. funny professor. He is the best

Professor Martinez is an amazing professor and a great person! Always willing to help and give advice. Read the book and pay attention in class and you should do well on the quizzes. Three quizzes and one group project which was interesting. He creates a positive learning environment and makes class really interesting. Would definitely take again.

Great at explaining material! You can tell he enjoys the subject through his excitement while lecturing. Emphasizes what we "may" see on the quiz and provides helpful examples. No surprises on quizzes.

Lectures are informative, clear, and precise. Take good notes and read chapters before class and course will be a breeze. Professor gives relevant examples which help you memorize  important topics and information  Take advantage of his office hours, where he is extremely helpful.

His lectures are clear and he will answer all your questions without it stopping the entire class. Very easy to take notes, he explains super well and if you study from what he taught in class, you're more than prepared. You can always refer to the textbook for more but I barely opened it. You can skip 2 quizzes and make it up on the exam.
Quiz every Friday but studied for them the day of for about 30 minutes to an hour each and did well. Easy grader on the two papers you do during the whole semester.
Not good, would not recommend. His lectures are all over the place it was so confusing!
Decent teacher overall. Read the book.

If I remember correctly the course was like 6 quizzes and a final and also 2 papers on the same movie.  Evora grades pretty easy compared to other professors for BSL212. You can get a lot of partial credit even if you didn't study too much for the quizzes. He's pretty straight-forward though and he gives great outlines for the chapters. Take him
Awesome professor who listen and understands his students. Extremely interesting class. Loved the mock arbitration exercises!!!

Cool guy; teaching style was wayyyyyy all over the place. You are never fully sure what he is going to cover in class. Quizes are 60% of the grade, but not too hard. The MC is weird, but the free response was graded mainly as a participation grade. Not too hard to get an A, but if you need organization, this is NOT the class for you.
nice professor and interesting class. lots of cases to read and power points which make up most of the quizzes. not the easiest class but worth taking it with prof evora
I loved Professor Evora!! I went to his office hours before every quiz and always got an A. He is extremely helpful and nice. I would recommend him to anyone taking BSL212.
Mr. Evora is great very helpful. Quizzes will be hard only if you do not attend class. He will boost grade if you go to office hours. Lets you out of class early

Prof. Martinez is superrrrr funny! He's one of the best prof. I've had. I loved this class, although you have to study sometimes a lot, this class is worth it, you learn so much! I would hands down take his class over any other prof. Watch out for the final exam, very challenging!!!
Best BSL professor, he is extremely helpful. If i had to take any other BSL classes i would take them with him again!!

Genuine professor who really tries to help out his students.  He is extremely corny, but he always tries to be respectful, give out reviews if the class asks, etc.  I didn't even take the prerequisites for the course and he told me to take the class and he would help me through it, and he really did!

Good dude.  Great class.  Everything is easy there are 2 papers a page each and i think 16 quizzes.  all easy. Final is brutal.  But you won't end up with less than a B unless you don't study.  But overall fun class good dude.

He grades a little tough, but once you how he wants it written it becomes easy. He reviews before every quiz, but if you read and understand the book it is extremely easy. His powerpoints are corny sometimes but funny nevertheless.
awesome guy! love this proffesor..he is awesome ! very understanding and dedicated! defenitely reccomend him...will be taking him again!!!!!

only professor i would bother to rate. fantastic human being (kind, helpful), EASY quizzes (as long as you study notes and terms for around 30 minutes), and he has a unique sense of humor that makes learning business law material bearable. you're a fool if you don't chose him for bsl212.

Very nice guy. Gives 8 quizzes, 2 short papers, and a final. Basically gives the answers to the quizzes right before you take them. You can be on Facebook the whole time and he won't care. Make sure you read the textbook and the cases in it. Very fair grader and make sure you participate in class.
Nice guy. Pretty funny too. I enjoyed this class, and learned a good amount from him.
Confusing, kind of talks in circles
Goated, do not hesitate to take any of his classes.  Down-to-earth and relatable but very professional, super smart, and truly cares.
Respectable teacher
Great class
Very useful architectural design tips
It is a Portfolio class which I think is really useful since everyone need a portfolio. I am not sure when can I finished my portfolio without professor Juan. Take it
Absolutely loved this lab. Professor Saltzman is a great lab instructor and always took time to make sure students understood the lab and received help when they needed it.
Very understanding and kind lab instructor, highly recommend! She explains concepts thoroughly and is super helpful throughout lab answering questions.
Awesome! So nice and caring. Allows you to retake pop quizzes although almost no one does bc they're so easy.

Professor Saltzman went above my expectations. She was understanding, helpful, and made the class fun with her jokes. She balanced professionalism and treated us as equals. Her quizzes were fair and from the material she gave us. I highly recommend her because she truly cares about her students. WE LOVE YOU KING JULIA!!

Professor Saltzman was by far the best professor I've had here! She lets us turn in assignments over, until we get the grade that we want. The pre-lab quizzes are all open note, and she leaves extra credit questions for us. If you miss a day of lab, she allows us to come into another section and make up our attendance! We love King Julia!!

Julia is an amazing teacher. She was really patient with every student and accommodated to our needs. She made sure every part of the lab was understandable and provided help to any student who needed it. I HIGHLY recommend her to any freshman's taking Bio 151.

Julia was absolutely amazing! She was my TA for BIL151, and she was super kind and all together a joy to be around. She gives you back the pre-lab quizzes, and lets you correct any mistakes for credit. The pre-lab quizzes were also open manual, and super easy. Highly recommend!
Ms. Saltzman was my lab teacher and was amazing! She explains lab procedures in detail and is always there to help if you don't understand something. Take her!!

Ms. Julia is a great lab instructor. She makes quizzes clear and concise, doesn't give an overwhelming amount of homework, and is willing to answer any questions and make labs as understandable as possible. She's very nice and willing to communicate too!
Good professor, easy class.
