reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Loved Ritzinger so much. Just be aware that his class does require a lot of reading to be successful on his papers and exams. Don't take this course for credit and expect it to be an easy A. I am so much more confident with approaching religion now because of him. Very much looking forward to taking another class with him.

This teacher is horrible. Always keeps class way over time and doesn't post his slides. For comments on readings half the students would blatantly say "we are confused with the reading" and the professor would continue to move on.

He takes attendance before class starts and then class runs late each time. He makes you take so many notes and it gets confusing. He does not upload PowerPoints so studying is VERY challenging. It is really hard to get an A- or A. I feel worried to participate because he corrects everyone so much and I feel like I am always wrong.

Ritzinger is the best. I'm in his karma class & it's my favorite this semester. He's really caring & understanding. Not strict on deadlines, gives you lots of opportunities for grades. Some of the readings are confusing, but if you email him any questions he'll respond quickly

Ritzinger's lectures are super interesting, and it is obvious he knows what he is talking about. Super engaging, funny, and caring. I loved the class, and although the readings are a lot to swallow, he bases class off of the readings so you understand what you read. I would take every class he teaches.

reviews.comment: Prof. Ritzinger is freaking hilarious and cares so much about his students. Don't miss a lecture or you'll fall behind. Super approachable and flexible guy. Love him and you won't regret taking his class.

Professor Ritzinger knows what hes talking about and can explain it to make sure you understand it. Def one of my fav teachers. reviews.comment: Yes, he's a hard grader, and yes, he assigns a good bit of work (readings/reflection writings), but by the end of the class you will know a lot about Asian religions. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: Prof. Ritzinger's a really great teacher who's passionate about Chinese Buddhism (The subject of the class I took with him) He leads awesome discussions in small class settings, just make sure you come prepared or you won't get the most out of it or enjoy it as much as you could.

Ritzinger is an awesome professor! His powerpoints are entertaining and colorful and he himself is very funny  and engaging and really cares about the students. His class does require effort though. There's a decent amount of reading every week and and a bit of writing to do. However, the reading is always relevant and class is well worth taking!

I took him for two courses (Karma & Intro to Buddhism) and they were both very enjoyable and informative. Not only did I learn about the topics, I learned how to read critically and think academically about religion. He's also super nice and funny & gives POSITIVE FEEDBACK and gets to know you so I felt valued as a student, which made me care more

UM is lucky to have Professor Ritzinger on faculty. He's intelligent, knowledgeable, and very accessible. He's a really cool professor if you have the opportunity to take him. His lectures are to the point and interesting, and his grading policy is clear and fair. I honestly found the class so interesting, I've continued to study Buddhism.

Professor Ritzinger does an fantastic job of keeping students interested and engaged, classes are discussion based and fast paced. He's always willing to work with you if you need help and he's easily accessible. He also uploads a lot of the course's reading materials himself which is nice. If you have the chance, take him.

Professor Ritzinger is the best. If you have one elective to take, take a course with him. If you have lots of room in your schedule, take all of his courses. You won't regret it. If you have even the slightest interest in Buddhism, Chinese religions, China, Taiwan, or related subject matter, take him. He's funny, kind, and ridiculously smart.

Very difficult professor. Contradicts herself all the time and very tough grader. She has to like you to give you a good grade and has her favorites in class. The only students that don't do well in her class and ones that complain and don't enjoy learning. Sure her class is challenging but isn't that what we have come to college for? HARD HARD HARD! but she is a very nice person, very helpful... but almost impossible to get an A in the class...if you wanna learn take her but if you only want to get an A, dont!

the worst professor ever! don't take her!  HARD HARD HARD, and useful.

2 exams which are LONG and HARD. No curves. and  1 final which is also long and difficult. He failed most of the class including myself.  Avoid if possible.

He grades tests unfairly and impartially, & will give some students partial credit and others none. Worst teacher I've ever had, would not recommend. Ever.

Easy material taught by someone who made it seem a lot harder.

This was definitely the worst class ever. He knows his stuff but doesn't know how to explain it and he'll only help you if you go to his office hours. Horrible Professor, does not explain clearly and has trouble answering students questions. If you take any course from him, get a tutor to help you outside of class or else it'll be very difficult to pass.

very unclear russian accent. He assume that you understand everything . unfair grading.

very confusing test questions but the homework was ok

kap runs a crazy class. I had no idea what was goin on but i ended up w/ a good grade both semesters. If u stick w/ it the end result is good
Kap runs a good class. He is very fair in his grading, and makes the class quite fun. He is willing to meet anytime and does his best to make hard material as feasible as possible. Good Guy.
Awsome guy

She's a tough grader, but she's extremely laid back and nice. You can revise papers for a better grade. I didn't think she assigned too much work at all. She's young and really understands college students. I honestly hate English but she made it bearable, even fun. If you get the chance, TAKE HER!

Not a good teacher but easy A. If you are smart or creative at all this class will drive you crazy. Most the people in my class were pretty dumb which makes a discussion based class not enjoyable. She taught at their level so I basically took nothing out of it.
Great class, would definitely recommend.
A ton of work for a creative writing class, in which most students take as an easy elective. 3 writings due per week not too mention a lot of busy work

She gives out a lot of annotated readings , 3 essays, and 1 project. She's a tough grader and usually 2-3 people will get A's on the essays. The class can either be really boring or interesting depending on the day. Attendance is mandatory and there's a lot of extra credit opportunities.
She is a great but extremely difficult teacher.  She gives ALOT of work, but if you keep up with the work then the class is not too difficult to do well in.

She's really cool and really nice. Good teacher, but it is hard to know exactly what she wants from you. Assigns more work than most other ENG106 sections. She grades very critically, but at the end of the semester it's still very possible to get an A if you work hard on your final drafts.

She's really nice but it's hard to know what she wants because there aren't sample essays. Sometimes she can overload you with work, but in the end she knows if you tried and will give you a good grade.
Great professor, always there if you need help and great personality. Pretty funny and she provided a laid back classroom environment. I definitely recommend her.

Alright, this class was OK; not great, not too bad. I can't say i learned anything about English considering the class was about the wire (tv show). I would NOT recommend this section, just because of the over speculation on the tv show, which gets old real quick. She means well, but this class was a waste of time.
She is extremely nice and not intimidating. Class can sometimes get boring. We do a lot of revisions of our 3 main essays and you don't have to turn stuff in until the end.
She is really layed back and chill. learned a lot in her class. always sees the positives and helps you see where there needs to be inproving. believes strongly in revision. LOVED HER

this is the kind of class you look forward to. she covers interesting, current topics and makes it fun for her students. it's a very relaxed atmosphere. for this class we'd write 3 blogs a week, each between 250 to 500 words each.  2 would be about the weekly topic we were discussing in class and then 1 would be of our own choosing.

she made class fun even if the topic was boring

reviews.comment: Very inattentive to students and messy lectures. Tests are online but very ambiguous
I love this professor. He is the GOAT. He makes it so easy to succeed, truly. Just commit a little time each week to this class and you'll do well.

No matter what you'll get an A or B in the class as long as you go to discussions. All of the tests are take home. Class is super easy and the professor is really passionate about the class. Show up to the discussion, get an A or B in the class. All the tests are take home and you get like a week to do it. Felt kinda bad cause sometimes id show up and the class was literally empty. Regardless, easy A or B.

Free A or B. Top half gets an A, bottom half gets a B. Then they get rounded up to an A+ or B+. You don't have to show up except for the workshops which are usually short. All tests are take home with a week to do them. Open note, textbook, whatever you want. Put minimum effort and took home the A+. If you need a stress reliever class, this is it.

McCracken was a great professor. he is a very chill guy, attendance is not mandatory. he is really cool and funny, HOWEVER, the one thing I disliked was his grading criteria. it was very unclear and would often send you a random grade with no feedback. I ended with a B in the class, bc written exams were very harshly graded.

For 160, everyone gets an A or B in the class guaranteed as long as you show up to the workshop. Graded by 3 exams and the final. Not the best option to learn but if you want an easy grade, go ahead

reviews.comment: Dr. McCracken's class is lecture heavy and he often gets side tracked. Lectures are boring and hard to keep up with. I wouldn't take him to learn bio 2, just to pass the class.
Very patient, It wants us to learn, good lectures. He gives you + if you deserve it.

reviews.comment: This professor is not professional and you don't know your grade till the very end. He only gives As and Bs but not sure if everyone learns in the class.

Dr. McCracken is a kind professor who wants to help his students succeed. Genetics is easy-attendance is not mandatory and no textbook is necessary. Everything you need is on his ppts. 3 multiple choice exams + a short term paper. Read the ppts well and you will get an A. He doesn't test on minute details. He could be more engaging

Pretty boring class, he reads straight off his powerpoint lectures. Tests are entirely based off the powerpoint, but are actually pretty difficult. He does not explain things well AT ALL. 3 tests, plus a paper that is pass/fail and can be on anything related to genetics.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Very strange person and incompetent teacher. He was clueless the entire semester, planning it as he went along  and randomly deciding to add in night classes. Your entire grade is based off of 2 or 3 tests and a paper, though he is super confusing about grades and scaling. I didn't know my grade until report cards. Would not take again.

He does not seem very interested in lecturing. The tests are all fill in the blank and write in, and maybe an essay, so it is very difficult. Final was not allowed to be taken if you wrote the optional 5% extra credit research paper. Class was very boring; it was hard to pay attention. Overall I don't think I learned much Genetics.

The course was not very clearly organized. I found myself wondering what my grade is throughout the semester. Only had 2 tests so do well. Reads off of slides and put minor details on test. Study past exams to do well.

Dr. Jacobs has the talent of making complicated topics digestible and easy to understand. He also keeps a very organized class structure and delineates what is going to be on each exam. Ignore the reviews stating his exams are difficult. If you take notes and study with 4-5 days in advance, you'll understand his tests are very fair.

The class is very content heavy, but if you start studying at least a week in advance for each test you'll be fine. Professor Jacobs provides a lot of information, but the tests are very fair for the content he presents. Make sure you take advantage of office hours and reviewing each test.

Attendance isn't mandatory, but go to class & PAY ATTENTION. Test material is from slides & what he says in class. I advise taking notes before & adding to them during class. Tests are not easy-- doing well will require studying several days, if not at least a week, beforehand. Don't be afraid to ask questions-- he is super patient & helpful.

Dr. Jacobs is very understanding and very student focused. He is very knowledgable about the material he teaches and is very willing to answer questions students have. Be aware that all grades from Dr. Jacobs are Exam grades. The material is directly from the presentations he provides. Attend class, study the presentations 2-3 day; you'll get an A.

Amazing professor. Tests are very hard and designed so you must know the material very well. The grade is solely based on 4 exams, no homework or textbooks. One of the best professors in the KIN department

Class is hard bc material is hard but if you understand it you'll do fine. There's a short answer and fill in the blank sections of the test which usually gets most ppl. Explains the material really well but can be confusing/difficult to follow if you don't have basic knowledge on what he's talking ab so take Wes's physio class first (KIN 232)

Jacobs is one of the best teachers I've taken at UM. He is always there to help you if you are confused. Basically everything you need to know for exams is given during lectures. It is not an easy class and you have to work for a good grade, but Jacobs makes the class enjoyable.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The best professor I had at UM. Lectures were extremely easy to follow and he explains everything very clearly. Always accessible for office hours- especially before exams. Doesn't assign unnecessary work and genuinely cares about his students. Also ridiculously smart.

Not sure what the last person is talking about, but Dr. Jacob's tests are very directly correlated from his lecture slides. Possibly a better teacher than Wes. I look forward to going to his 321 class. Very clear, very helpful. Can't say enough good things about him. Make sure you show up to class as his tests can be difficult.
BEST PROFESSOR EVER. must study for the test but there are no surprises just need to know the material. Fair grader and always there for extra help
LEGEND!!!!

Not an easy class. I was often confused about information presented in the lectures because he moves a bit fast but he was always friendly and willing to meet with me. Blocked off time for me weekly to go over any questions I had. Exams are difficult but fair.

Great professor. Very knowledgeable on the topic. Don't buy the book, his notes are all you need. His tests are not easy because you have to memorize a lot, but they are fair. He does not pull questions out of nowhere, they are all from his notes. A great professor, I learned a lot.

Had to take class twice, along with many others.  2 tests (50%) and 1 final (50%).  The tests are extremely difficult, comprising multiple choice and short and long essays.  His lectures and slides are very to the point.  Is always willing to help and very understanding.  TESTS ARE EVIL.  Must study hard to succeed.  My roommate thinks he's hot.
classes run very smoothly. challenges students.  tough with grading but earns the right to be, considering how thoroughly material is presented.

Cool and funny dude. He makes the information very detailed and accessible on blackboard. The class group projects are enjoyable to create, and it's cool to see others' presentations on brands as well. Very practical and useful class!

Prof Lancaster was great! Graded on two group projects/presentations and he lets you pick who is in your group. He is very clear about what is required and gives feedback after each presentation. Also walks you through what you need to do for each project in class. Would definitely recommend taking this class!

He has very clear grading criteria, is always willing to provide ample feedback, and is an easy grader if you put effort in and follow directions.
super easy class. 2 group presentations and reports, you choose your group and can pick any brand. Kent is boring, but a good guy and will help you if you need it.

Honestly not a hard class. A few group projects and thats it. As long as you do them correctly and do a good presentation, you'll pass. Even though the class lectures are a bit boring, the class itself is fine and attendance is not mandatory. Overall he's a good guy.

If you end up with a bum lab group, just put in the effort and make sure ur final symposium eats. Trust, you'll love Miya.

If you're going to take anyone for a lab, let it be Miya. She is honestly one of the funniest and nicest instructors at UM and is also super helpful if you are confused with anything. She's super understanding as well so if you have any problems you can talk to her. She's super genuine and cares about the students in the lab
A great TA for the class. I'm not even a bio major or anything related but took the class and luckily had her. Is super caring and understanding, please take her!
Extremely friendly and casual during class, extremely professional and willing to help when you reach out. Just wish her the best and not to drown in graduate research.
the queen herself. u guys should take her.
Shes the best love her
I loved taking her this semester! Hopefully I can take her again :)
She is so nice. She makes lab easier and is so helpful.

Miya has been the best TA I've had. She genuinely wants you to do well and cares about all her students.If you are confused about a part of the lab, she explains it perfectly and somehow never misses to make you laugh.She also makes the labs enjoyable! 
PSA: let us know what section you have for BIL 161 next semester so we can enroll in it pls!
Lectures are highly entertaining. Very funny. Wants all students to both succeed and enjoy the course material.

Dr. Khan made his entire section of the course so engaging and interesting. You can tell he is very passionate about what he teaches and always asked if he needed to repeat a concept for us to better understand it. The best professor in the Microbiology & Immunology department!

Taught the first part of immunobiology. Was probably the most engaging professor in the course. Included a variety of teaching methods like videos to keep us focused. Didn't expect a lot of random memorization and put the focus on knowing concepts instead which was really nice. The exam questions matched the lectures and textbook readings.
Great professor

Dr. Khan cares so much about his students and is clearly passionate about the material he lectures on. It makes the class more enjoyable. He doesn't try to trick you on exams, they are straight forward. overall 10/10

MIC 202 with Dr. Khan was really a great time. The majority of the class is made up of lectures and a few presentations which are more focused on overall effort than anything. The tests were clear and they prepare you adequately. Would definitely take another class with him if possible. If you have the chance to take this class then do it.

Dr. Khan engages the class in a way that makes learning a hard topic easy. He promotes critical learning through discussion, encouraging all questions and is very approachable. His inspirational sentiments are great whether you are pursuing a career in science or not. easily one of the best professors at UM. attend class its worth it you will see

Dr. Khan is one of the most incredible individuals I have had the pleasure to meet at the University of Miami. His style of teaching would benefit and captivate quite literally anyone, regardless of major or interest level. He values a deeper understanding over the typical learn-for-exam only style. Such an honor to learn from this amazing person.
Prof Khan went above and beyond to make sure we understand the materials and did it in a fun and scholarly manner.

Dr. Khan truly wants you to understand the material. Although he may go off on tangents during lectures, his tangents are actually interesting & what matters is that he is still VERY blatant about what he's going to ask you on the exam. He also tries to incorporate fun activities during class to make it more interesting - which I find refreshing!
Great experience!
One of the seven instructors who co-taught MIC 321 (immunobiology).  Khan was decent -- not bad, not great -- in terms of his teaching and his quiz.

Worst photography prof. I have ever experienced. has no respect for student opinions and thinks she is right on everything. The material she teaches she teaches wrong was as well. I don't understand how shes even a prof. she should quit and go focus on the cruddy art she talks non stop about as if its good. I hope no one else takes any of her class

She is a good and understanding person but her teaching skills are well below average. She will spend all class talking about non sense for the most part and complains about there being enough time. No offense if you laid off the personal biographies every single class you would have time to teach. She teaches the material the wrong way as well.

The worst and most pointless instructor at MCC. She spends HOURS talking about herself then complains how classtime is too short. The entire class learned absolutely NOTHING! She is disorganized, passive-aggressive, scatter-brained and sloppy! Choose another instructor if you have to take this class. You have been warned.

She is  a great professor! Her passion for photography is very evident in class and she does her best in explaining and making sure the students understand the material. Class consists of projects, small exercise, and a final projcet. She is very nice and funny and treats the students with respect She also gives many opportunities for extra credit!

Lamia is so helpful and knowledgeable- I don't understand these bad reviews! Do your work and be involved and she's a wonderful professor! She is very up to date on contemporary art and obviously loves photography.

Expects a few outside of class fieldtrips on weekends.. keep this in mind if you dont have transportation.  Critiques of prints take FOREVER and really limit in class darkroom time.  Expect to be there every weekend as well to make up for lost time.  Quizzes every other week are simple and dont count for a lot. She is really nice though.

I took photography class to leads smith about photography. However, the shoe focus was on quality of prints. It was all about darkroom. She is very unclear and disorganized. Her classes are usually in the mornings and she is always late. THe whole class was just a big irritation the whole semester.

shes alright. her intro class sucked, but her more advanced photo classes are better. i like her cause she lets you work on YOUR art, not hers. but unorganized and tries to intimidate but she fails. get on her good side!

Not a class/prof if you already know photo or want freedom of expression.  structured, perfectionist, made me buy alot of things i didn't need and print stuff that was a waste of paper. Try and get a different prof or skip the intro course. She's very unorganized, and told everyone to come on time tho she never did. she's nice. not challenging.

When I look back at my time in college, Shane's class will stand out. I never thought I could do animation, but he made it feel possible. He's a tough but incredibly rewarding professor who truly cares and pushes you to be better. One of those rare mentors who actually changes how you see yourself.
Love this prof. He was funny and caring, and he only wants you to succeed. He has a few facts for every aspect of the assignments, so if stuck, he helps. He kept the class engaging and interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Kinsler was excellent. He takes time to help each student individually and has no problem meeting outside of class. You will learn a lot from him!

Professor Kinsler is passionate about what he is teaching, is very caring and funny, and supportive. He keeps the class fun and engaging. I really enjoyed learning about film and applying it to the three film projects we did over the course. I would definitely recommend him for this class!!!!
This professor is amazing!
He mad nonchalant and shi

Professor Kinsler is fun, easygoing, and clearly knows his stuff. The class has three big projects and an easy midterm. The projects are time-consuming and cover a lot of new material, but he's a fair grader and values effort. If you're willing to put in the work, this class is definitely worth taking!

Professor Kinsler is hands down one of the best professors I've ever had. He cares a lot about film making and it shows, and he does an excellent job at sharing his knowledge. It is making three films, though, so don't expect a free A for showing up. As long as you put forth a solid effort and listen to feedback, you're guaranteed a good grade.

Professor Kinsler is always open to helping students and creates a positive class environment. Its clear that he is passionate about his work and the experiences that shaped his career. He has some really cool stories to share, so if you decide to take his class, be sure to ask him about them. Overall, he is personable, helpful, and insightful!

Really fun class! You work on one major project throughout the whole semester. Prof Kinsler is a nice guy who actually cares about what he is teaching. I recommend just make sure you have the time to work on your project outside of class. Also weekly homework assignments and one midterm exam which isn't hard. Good class!

Overall a pretty good film class. It's not super hard, but lowkey, knowing some students haven't done a film class before, he does grade pretty hard. There are three main projects, the first one feels pretty rushed as you have to find actors and film it pretty quick. There's one midterm exam that is super easy. Just go to class you'll be fine.

This class can be a bit challenging, especially if you aren't that creative / don't know how to draw etc, but Professor Kinsler does an amazing job at supporting everybody, regardless of their skill level. There is a ton of homework, but with a bit of time management and communication, you can definitely get a good grade in this class.

Professor Kinsler is the best!! He posts all of his lecture material on black board and is very passionate about filmmaking. He's also super accessible outside of class and is willing to help you if you need it,

He's a caring and sweet professor and learning about his background in the film industry was very interesting. Also enjoyed the hands-on learning workshops. Midterm was quite easy as well. However, I felt like he didn't quite prepare us enough to be able to film the projects on our own so accomplishing the projects were quite overwhelming.

Professor Kinsler was a great teacher. We only met once a week but he was very accommodating to those who had to attend the class virtually. His passion for the subject is evident, and he was more interested in creativity than grading strictly against a rubric. He took the time to get to know his students and was overall a fantastic professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Only his 2nd year of teaching? Give this guy tenure already! This dude has been at every level of film production and gives an amazing glance into the industry throughout this course. I said he was a tough grader because he wants you to be passionate about your short films, this is a serious class for majors/minors.

Mr. Kinsler is a great professor who does a great job teaching animation with After Effects. He gives weekly homework in the form of AE assignments and the only project given in class is a final project due at the end of the semester. Also, no exams save for a mid-term test! I highly recommend this class if you want to start learning After Effects.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Committed to helping/encouraging you learn instead of giving you a bad grade. Showing up to class really makes a difference. Make sure you at least skim the readings too. Ever accessible, very knowledgeable/experienced, & more than willing to work w/ you. Course isn't easy because of the nature of film making, but couldn't be easier thx to Kinsler.

Awesome professor! Very funny, easy going class. He lets the students determine the pace of the class. All assignments are to help you with you animated video, so it doesn't feel like work. You can choose to do an animated music video or an explanation video.

Class was very fun and I learned a lot about animation histroy!

10/10 fun and easy class

Prof Kinsler's knowledge in the industry makes textbook reading come to life. There is a lot of creative freedom, and many practical applications to relevant films to connect the textbook to practice. He is accessible outside of class and will spend as much time with you as you need to ensure you present something you are proud of. Great class!

Kinsler is truly one of the coolest professors in the cinematic arts/interactive media dept. Super knowledgeable and understanding. The animation class has 3 main components that all add up to one final project. He also gave us multiple opportunities for extra credit. I would definitely take this course if you're interested in animation! 10/10

Good guy overall, just participate and show up. 3 film projects and a midterm. Bro gave us like 10 opportunities for extra credit just for going to Cosford and writing about the screening or panel. The film grading is kind of weird but if you put effort into it you can't get lower than a B+

Kinsler was a great prof for CCA 151. Class are lectures and demonstrations with the cameras that we use. We do 3 films throughout the semester and one is a group project. Gives a good amount of time to film but you have to reserve cams ahead of time. One midterm test but every other grade is from the films

I took him for CCA 394 and he was a great professor. He is super approachable and always answers your emails quickly. He explained everything carefully and actually showed real examples which made the class super fun. Would definitely take him again!

Professor Popendorf is an amazing woman who's respected in her field. She has lots of office hours and is always available to meet with there students. popendorf is amazing and if u can take her for any class you should. very very knowledgeable and respected in the field. really wants you to succeed.

She is so amazing and nice. She really cares about every student and will have you laughing during class.
Great professor- taking her again for ASL207 because could not imagine doing it with someone else. Take her for sure.
Amazing professor! Truly one of the best at UM! If you need a language class take it with Kirsten!

Love her, I took her for ASL 1,2, and 3 and I'm taking 4 now. Shes awesome and super nice. Make sure you practice outside of class and you'll be fine. I have taken asl classes outside of UM before taking these and from my experience her class is an easy asl class.

I highly recommend this professor if you are just learning ASL. She makes it so simple and is extremely caring. She is very much accessible outside of class. I liked the introductory class that I would take two more courses with her. In total I have taken three courses with her including a Summer course which she made extremely easy to pass.

I have taken her for TAL 107, 207, and now 307... and all I can say is TAKE HER! She makes learning ASL fun and engaging. Professor Schwarz is also kind, knowledgeable, and is always willing to lend a helping hand.

LOVE HER! best ASL professor by far. if you want to fall in love with the culture and language take her. the class is an easy A for everyone. only a few homework assignments i am obsessed with her 10/10
I took Kirsten for TAL 107 AND TAL 207 and i absolutely adored her. Her little quizzes, exams, and projects were so easy. I definitely recommend her and would take her again if i could!
Amazing professor. Treats everyone like a human being & makes learning so exciting. I wish there were more professors like her, truthfully.
i know why you're here. take her. And tbh i was watching hawkeye and there was a deaf convo and i understood it sheesh
Such a sweet professor who genuinely cares about her students. She made learning ASL fun and engaging. Such an easy A.

Kirsten is literally the best professor I have ever had. The class is very chill and easy to pass, as long as you show up and practice before your quiz. Kirsten is so engaging and funny, making everyone feel comfortable enough to sign in front of everyone. I wish I could take every course she teaches.

The sweetest woman to ever walk the Earth! I came in knowing NOTHING about sign language and after a few weeks I can have a basic conversation I was so amazed. She is amazing! This is a great class. Minimal work if you show up for class
Kirsten is a fantastic professor. Her classes are very engaging and she makes learning ASL easy. I would definitely recommend taking her class.

Kirsten is an AMAZING professor! She made sign language class so much fun for me. She's always helpful and she answers questions outside of class promptly. She's the best!

Kimberly is a really tough grader and doesn't offer help at all. Grading criteria is not  clear!!
as long as you write enough drafts and do enough revision, you can get an A. whole class is based on a portfolio

If I could select more tags I would. I took PHY321 with Dr. Klein but it was not an option on here. He is caring, practical, accessible, and reasonable. His lecture content is exactly the same as his HW, and his exams are easier, more straightforward versions of the HW. He sets clear expectations in prep for exams. One of the best professors.

I'm someone who is notoriously bad at math and physics, and would've probably gotten a much worse grade if I had any other professor than Dr. Klein. He is an incredibly funny and kind person and made it easy to get a higher grade in the class by giving us many opportunities to bump our grade. His tests were mostly conceptual.

He was a caring teacher and accessible outside of class. Lectures were fast paced and a lot of info. BUT, see him every week for extra help, ask questions, and understand the material CONCEPTUALLY. For exams, really study the past quizzes and paper HW. Pearson HW doesn't matter. If you do that you will be prepared for the exams which were fair imo.

He is incredibly smart and truly passionate about physics... if you are not good at physics, you will hate his class. I wish he made the class easier and gave us practice exams :(

reviews.comment: Dr. Klein is awesome, he is a very chill and funny professor and he does a really good job of teaching. He provides a lot of different ways for you to get points in his class, which is good because it keeps you practicing physics all the time. Super cool guy and easily one of the nicest and best professors at UM. Excited to have him next semester!

An absolutely awesome professor who made introductory physics (and even mechanics) genuinely interesting. Dr. Klein is super attentive towards his students and always has a great attitude and humor when lecturing. His tests are also very fair. For my first time ever taking a physics class, I'm really glad I had Dr. Klein as a professor.

Professor Klein is awesome. He is genuinely hilarious, and he doesn't even know it. The material itself is difficult, but his grading scale for your overall grade is super fair, and he is very helpful during office hours. The exams are super similar to the written homework every week. The class and studying does require a lot of effort.
Klein was great, his lectures give you all the knowledge you need for the exams and homework is manageable. Most people end up doing well in his class.

Nice guy but was forced to take here. 101&102. Almost everyone else I know took it elsewhere and was much easier/joke. I didn't really have a summer break tbh. Felt burnt out throughout. If u really wanna learn physics, take this hilarious man! Biggest diff from past physics courses I've taken was that he teaches physics different. Not a plug n chug class like gen chem. Summer B 2021. Lots of material in a short period of time. 1 semester in 6 weeks. He actually cares about students but I feel like it's the university that makes professors cram so much material in a summer semester. I have friends who took it elsewhere and were chillin. Awesome but hard.

Dr. Klein led our Physics discussion section and he is absolutely incredible. His ability to explain and summerize physics concepts is amazing and I would argue he presents material better than our actual physics professor (or anyone I had teach me). He also very personable and riculously funny, but its just so natural that he does not even know it
LOVE THIS MAN. He's so funny but you can tell he doesn't know it. He is accessible outside of class and his tests are doable.

KLEIN IS AMAZING! 10/10 best professor ever. Beats all my grade school teachers, too. He presents the material very efficiently and makes it easier to understand with his killer demos. The content is tough because it's physics but Klein makes it fun. He really connects with his students and is VERY understanding. Try hard, and he'll have your back.
Professor Klein is an extremely sweet professor. However, his tests are one of the hardest ive ever taken. His lectures barely reflect the test questions.

reviews.comment: The class was overall pretty good. Dr. Klein tries to keep physics exciting and accessible. There is A LOT of homework though, online and paper homework every week, plus pre-lecture assignments and quizzes every week in discussion. He is very helpful, answers emails quickly and is very accommodating. Overall a good experience with physics.

Amazing physics teacher. He made everything so easy to understand and went over many examples in class that were almost identical to homework and test problems. He actually engaged the class which made lectures a lot more interesting. Unfortunately he left mid-semester on paternity leave and is not teaching next semester :(
Best physics prof ever. I love Dr. Klein. He cares about his students and gives amazing lectures. He is a smart guy and the best one in the physics department.

Dr. Klein is an amazing professor.  His lectures are engaging, and he is so nice and funny.  He expects you to work hard, but considering it is University Physics 2, that makes sense.  He is a very fair grader, and his tests are typically straightforward.  If you are able to take Dr. Klein for any physics course, I definitely recommend it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: I lode Dr. Klein!! Physics is not at all my favorite subject but he makes it fun! If you attend class, do the homework (weekly) and take good notes you will be fine. He is super fair and always wants to help the students. His class is super funny and he is a really nice guy.

I loved Dr. Klein.  He is an amazing lecturer and very clear with expectations.  However, this does not mean that this is an easy class.  This was the hardest I have ever had to work for an A, but in the end, it was well worth it.  Keep up with the class as it moves at a VERY fast rate, and you will do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Klein is the best teacher I've ever had. The class is a lot of weekly homework, but its not bad since you understand everything he says in class. Make sure you do your homework and the practice tests, as they're similar to the exam. He's hilarious and entertaining. Also, its University Physics, so don't expect an easy A. Just take the class.

Dr. Klein is an awesome professor. His exams are less stressful, only 3 problems and 60 points in total, which gives you plenty of time to complete the test. so boring its unbelievable, literally just sit there the entire time he reads the slides, and no one speaks for an hour and a half, and we are expected to know a ridiculous amount for the exams. DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASSES
