Not quite sure how his exams are graded with the free response section, but if you pay attention, you should do fine.

Very lecture heavy, he discusses things in class that are NOT on the slides. Can be kind of rude.  Lots of expectations for a cognate/elective class. No technology use in class. Makes you read a 250+ page book for the end of class. He does offer study guides for all exams and responds to email pretty well. I wouldn't take him again though.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lots and lots of reading. Lengthy assignments about readings. Exams aren't too bad as long as you study. He's a little disorganized. You have to go to lectures in order to pass because he discusses topics in class that aren't explicitly said on the PowerPoints. Gets to know everybody's names which is nice. But lot of work for a cognate credit.

I would definitely recommend taking any of his religion courses! Dr. Kling is such an amazing professor who sincerely wants his students to learn and his classes are very interactive. The content is easy to understand because of how in-depth these topics are explained. He prepares us very well for the exams and provides us with study guides.

Great professor with interesting personality. He really wants to get to know his students. His lectures can get a little boring (but hes very knowledgable) and theres a LOT of readings. The class was still interesting with him he's pretty goofy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Incredibly smart and understanding professor. I'm not a religious person myself, but he definitely does not hide his protestantism bias.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Kling is a very knowledgeable and humble man. He knows his students by name and remembers a specific thing about each. His class was tough because it was very lecture heavy and a lot of reading! It can be boring and overwhelming at times. One has to make sure to take notes of everything and comprehend the material. Tests are hard & no hw.

Dr. Kling is knowledgeable and explains material very well. He is a nice person, knows each student by name, and tries to get to know them as much as he can. He lectures for the whole class so it can get boring on some days. Most importantly, you need to read a lot for this class and take good notes for the tests and occasional quizzes

Dr Kling's class requires students to be discipline in the readings(lots) and comprehension of the material. He starts each class with a quiz of the material being taught, which helps a lot. Take notes. His vocabulary is admirable and complex. It is an opportunity for English as second language(ESL)students to improve their English vocabulary.

One of the sweetest, nicest teachers I've ever had. The class itself is pretty hard  but Dr. Kling is so helpful and just an all around great guy. I took this class as a freshman which might be why I struggled a bit but Dr. Kling takes a personal interest in each of his students and wants them all to succeed, and I really benefited from that.

Dr. Kling is, plain and simple, the man. His lectures are, for the most part, very interesting, and he just comes off as a very humble and helpful guy.  His tests aren't easy, but if you study and go to class, they should be manageable. Make sure to always do the reading for the quizzes as that is a key component of your grade.

Gentle, seemingly meek personality, but with a subtle gravitas and sense of humor.  Makes for a good professor, but his tests are not just difficult, but in some cases full of hyper-technical questions such as "Which Church uses leavened bread, and which uses unleavened bread?"  I still don't know which does which, even after getting it wrong

One of the best teachers I ever had! However, you either sink or swim in his class. LOTS of reading, a quiz every week and the exams are very hard. Hated the work but I'm glad I took the class. This one of those classes you'll never forget...if you pass it!

This Professor is good but hard.  He gives a lot of informaitonw which can be overwhelming at times. He uses a book that is written by him so it it hard to get away with anything.  There is a lot of reading not recommended for short semester unless all you want to do is read. His tests are KILLERS!  Be prepare for anything to come at you.

One of the best professors I've had.  He covers lots of material but keeps your interest. Good sense of humor & supplements lectures with interesting movies.  He gives a short weekly quiz that is hard to pass unless you read assignments before hand. If you take good notes and read assignments you should do well.

Dr. Kling's lectures are informative and interesting as well as engaging. He incorporates primary sources, personal anecdotes and passages from our readings. No powerpoint usage, he relies on the blackboard. Kling is a nice guy and a good professor. We had quizzes every class based on our reading. I enjoyed the class and recommend him to others!
Boring class with a lot of material. He outlines his lectures and wants you to do well, but for the most part he does not stimulate genuine interest among the students.
Boring guy, really not the religion teacher that should be called religion teacher. He gives statistics and talks about religion as it is a science. Not recommended at all.

Great teacher and nice guy. I had him for 3 classes: REL 131, 405, 232. 131 was a really interesting class. REL 405 was my favorite class because half the class was watching movies! LOTS of time for discussion. REL 232 is not a bad class, but has ALOT of material and very little time for discussion. Not the easiest, but certainly not the hardest.
No Comments

Perhaps the best professor at UM. His lectures are clearly outlined before class, and the reading assignments actually match what lectured. Very knowledgeable of subject matter. Exams reflect lectures and gives relevant extra-credit opportunities. Returns work promptly. However, this is a lecture class and all he does is lecture.

I'm suprised at the number of good remarks he has. He is one of the most boring teachers I have ever had. He talks at you instead of to you. The amount material in this course is so much that unless you know alot before hand you will probably not get a good grade. His visuals consist of tiny outlines and disorganized notes on the board.

Tests are Multiple Choice, True/False, and some short answer. No homework, but offers extra credit. A lot of quizzes (announced). The true/false can be hard, and sometimes the multiple choice too. You have to take the class seriously to get a good grade. Good lecturer though!

Excelllent professor. You will not only learn your subject but you will learn a lot about yourself, if you pay attention! Aproachable, intelligent, encourages participation, fine sense of humor. Recommend: take lots of notes! He makes you study hard but it's worth every effort.

He gives you a lot of material. You have to know your stuff to pass his tests.. If you just want to "cruise along" and cut corners in this course dont take his class.  For those who want to do well :TAKE LOTS OF NOTES...and study them and you will be fine. He is a great lecturer and very willing to help online etc. --Great Teacher.
Probably the most boring professor out of the religion group. It feels more like he's preaching rather than teaching...and his test questions weren't exactly as easy as the previous exams.

Apparently the other students found this teacher to be amusing but I and many of my friends had extreme difficulty just staying awake in his lectures.  We found him to be excessively boring at times and the questions he gave on his test were not as easy at Sapp's or Patrella's.  He might be good for other classes but not for REL 101.

Dr. Kling is one of the best professors I've ever met.  He knows his stuff, stimulates interest in class, and genuinely cares about his students.  I think I've taken just about every course he offers.  Highly recommend... especially the Religion & Film course.  :o)
Very intelligent and has an enormous wealth of knowledge to share.
The class is interesting because Dr. Kling is a great lecturer.  His lectures, which involve the students, are actually interesting.  Even at 8 AM, I was able to stay awake to listen to him.

You have to attend the lectures to do well in the class. If you are present consistently the course is fairly easy; he gives opportunities for extra credit, and will give away topics that will appear on his exams in lecture. He's often willing to work with you IF you can get a hold of him, which is a challenge since he rarely replies to emails.

Klaus is a very interesting man he gave one in person exam on 309 and then the rest were online. However, for papers and other exams he would not really stick by the rubric and when going to his office hours he "told" you what to do/add but even when you do add/remove things he recommends he still DOCKS POINTS off of you when you do everything!
Never write positive reviews but I love Professor Klaus! Nicest man ever.

Paying attention to lectures is crucial if you want to do well on the exams. They are very specific and hard, but he is also a very lenient grader. Labs, presentation, and projects seriously lift your grade too. Overall a very fun and pleasant professor!
Super nice guy but lectures are extremely boring, and labs are tedious. Exams are not easy and his exam review sessions are often misleading. There are two group projects that are huge pick me ups.

Dr. Klaus is a great guy who is very knowledgeable about the subject. That being said, I did find myself to be very bored during his lectures, but that could just be me. Tests are not a breeze, but he is definitely worth taking.

Dr. Klaus is a really fantastic professor. He makes a subject (geology) that most people find horribly boring come to life. He loves making corny jokes and the labs are really fun. He tells you exactly what's going to be on all of the tests, so if you do poorly, it's on you. All lectures are posted online and attendance isn't mandatory.
Dr. Klaus makes geology extremely fun and interesting. If you show interest in the class he will take the time to help you. He is the man!

Seeing as I never went to class, he was very generous w/grading. Dr. Klaus is a great professor who really wants his students to succeed. It's a rare quality you'll find in a professor - one that can be compassionate and willing to accommodate personal situations and really *sympathize* with the needs of his students - unlike some other professors.

Klaus is awesome! He's super friendly, funny in a corny kind of way, and his tests are really easy as long as you put in a substantial amount of time the night before. Favorite professor at the school.

Such a nice professor! He's very helpful and loves the subject matter along with his students.  The tests were all very fair. Exactly what he goes over in class is what he will be testing on. Unfortunately, his lectures can get a bit boring but I definately recommend taking him!!

Horrible professor. makes exam questions out of nowhere. never curves and never gives extra credits. I don't understand why he is rated so high here. Never take him unless you are a marine science or geology major!

It's really not a fun topic, but he makes it as interesting as possible. He gives you a LOT of opportunities to make up your grade and tries to curve things if the whole class does poorly. He honestly cares about his students and tries his hardest to make you understand. Super cool guy and really funny. I highly recommend him!

Klaus is an awesome guy. He is very funny. All the material comes from his power points. I used the book at the beginning, but honestly it's useless because all the material on the tests is from his power points. If you study you should do fine, but actually study! I liked him so much that I'm even taking him next semester for GSC380

From the get go, Klaus is a funny guy. Class can be boring occasionally, but Dr. Klaus always knows how to lighten the mood with a joke or two. Attendance is not mandatory, and lectures are taught with powerpoints. Great guy, a pretty straight forward class as long as you study a sufficient amount for each test. Recommended for MSC or GSC majors

class is pretty boring. teacher is pretty boring. he is kinda funny, in a super lame way. labs and tests are mostly easy. no homework except for a few easy projects.  easy class if you can stay awake through the powerpoints.
Nice guy, pretty funny too. All the material is from the powerpoints, but expect to spend a fair amount of time covering it. Good teacher.

Great class. Great professor. I would 100% recommend taking this class or any other class just to have this professor. His lectures are entertaining and he posts the slides so you don't have to go to class ( I would recommend going).
Lectures are easy to follow. Take home quizzes and discussion posts come straight from slideshows that he posts on Blackboard and he does drop low grades.
Professor Klofstad is a fantastic professor.

Really intelligent guy who knows what he's talking about. His exams come right from his powerpoints, which he gives to you. Weekly quizzes and discussions that are both online to do outside of class, a few of which he drops if they're low grades. Usually lets you out of class early. Would recommend for an easy A, he's great.
Great, professor. Lectures are easy to follow along with.
He's alright but do yourself a favor and do not take his class for any upper level poli sci course. An A is a 96 and he refuses to budge on that. NO

Although attendance is not mandatory, he does ask occasional exam questions about stuff that isn't necessarily on the slides. You do have weekly discussion posts and daily quizzes, however the answers to the quizzes are in the slides that he posts. You still definitely need to study (especially for the first exam) because there's some theory.
Scary and makes slight hints that go against my personal beliefs that are not appreciated. He says he's not biased but he clearly is.

Prof. Klofstad seems like a nice guy, but his grade scale makes it virtually impossible to get an A. Your grade is almost entirely determined by 4, 30 question tests and a 96 or above is an A. None of my other classes have this high of a standard for an A. I enjoyed the class, but it unnecessarily hurt my GPA.

Took him for the DaVinci class, and definitely enjoyed his class. I am not usually interested in political studies, but his material was fun and his lectures are interesting. He is definitely an easy grader if you show effort and try, however there can be a lot of homework: it isn't hard, but the amount of reading can be time consuming.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Klofstad is an amazing lecturer, and engages the students in class throughout his lecture. Always open to having a discussion. Take him if you can.

This is actually a POL 504 class. We have 2 homework assignments/week where we come up an open-ended question and respond to a classmate. 5 quizzes and no final. His lectures are really interesting! He replies to emails quickly and is very understanding. If you have to take a POL class, I definitely recommend Professor Klofstad!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Respected

reviews.comment: He is so boring and monotone. Definitely very knowledgable but having him for a 3 hour class is extremely rough.
Great class! Very informative.

Super easy class. It's a lecture so you don't have to really attend class but its good if you go just because his ppts are super plain and never have enough information on them for the tests. For quizzes, there is a post-lecture quiz you take after each lecture and both of the answers are usually found in the ppts. About 40 pages of reading a week.
He is a great professor, test material comes straight from PowerPoints, but to get an A you need a 96. It is very easy to pass his class.

Prof seems like a nice dude but he was so boring so I only went to one lecture, then the rest of the semester only showed up to the exam days. He pretty much just reads the powerpoints out loud, and the exams are solely questions he asks on the "baby quizes" he gives you to take online after each lecture. I got an A doing pretty much zero work

He gives amazing lectures and is super knowledgeable. The class is pretty easy to do well in but to get an A you need to have a 96 average so that is really hard. For what it's worth to get an A- you only need an 88.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you have taken AP gov in high school this class is really easy. He doesn't take. attendance he comes in lectures for about an hour and leaves. He reads off the PowerPoints and doesn't say anything much different. His test are exactly what was on the powerpoint. I went to 7 class total and got an A in the class. Easy class for a required course.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Kfofstad is amazing. His lectures are very clear and easy to follow along. He is very passionate. Assigns reading outside of the class but I never read any of them and still passed his exams with an A. As long as you study the PowerPoints , youll do just fine.

He is incredibly intelligent and clear. Super interesting lectures and explains things really well. He assigns outside readings in addition to studying the powerpoints (which you must study- MUST); I didn't read any of them and ended with an A-, although I did take super thorough notes. Def take him!!! :)
made taking online classes a breeze. easy A-, work a little harder for an A. def take him!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Took Klofstad for POL201 and I can say that he made remote learning with COVID much easier. Was thorough and clear with answering questions, available to meet with students during office hours, and engaging with the material of this course. An easy A if you don't miss quizzes and read the required readings, which you'll need to read for the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: fantastic professor.

Prof Klofstad was an amazing teacher to have this semester with COVID. He teaches primarily with PowerPoint and lecturing. Very easy to follow and makes every topic understandable. Easy to pass as long as you pay attention and don't miss quizzes. Only 3 exams throughout the semester.
I love Professor Klofstad and his class, but I did not like the exams. I memorized everything in lecture and got an A-. Brought my GPA down.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: A very kind and approachable professor! Professor Klofstad makes POL 201 very accessible and all of the lectures are very chill, you just have to show up and take notes. Getting an A isn't easy, but an A- or a B is not hard at all and frankly, if you show up, it's almost guaranteed. Most of the grade is based on 3 exams, which aren't super bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Not sure what the review below is saying, the tests are NOT extremely difficult and in fact, 6/30 questions on each are usually covered at the beginning of lecture. Just study the slides well and you will get an A-, but if you want an A, you really need to memorize every word cuz u need 96%. Hes a very nice and polite guy and teaches well.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The content of the class is not hard, but the tests are extremely difficult. Getting a B is very easy, but getting an A is nearly impossible. Make sure you write down every single thing he says in lecture!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: 3 test each one worth 30% and 10% is participation which counts through icliker so YOU HAVE TO GO TO CLASS. Test are heavy, not cumulative but required a lot of memorizing. Class is large so its difficult to keep up. However, he loves what we teach and is passionate about. POL is not my major, it was a difficult class for me
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Take him!!!!! An awesome class that's super easy if you simply go. I'm a stem major but still loved going to class.
Very approachable and kind. Presents the material in an interesting manner. My only complaint is that his exams are written very ambiguously.

No textbook needed for the class as all of the information that is on the test is in the Powerpoints that he provides. Easy grading scale, a 73 is considered a B in his class. Overall great Professor and willing to help if you have any questions.

he has powerpoints for every class and the test information is based off of the powerpoints and brief readings. he is not trying to trick you, and it is easy to get an A- but you need to get a 96 in the class to get an A. super knowledgable and chill, do recommend taking!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Loved this man, best prof I've had at UM. attendance mandatory and counted by iclicker, but he really tries to connect with his students and make lecture as interesting as possible. Took AP gov in hs and this class is literally the same exact thing, barely paid attention and got an A. 10/10 would take again
Both him and the class were boring. Everything he said or lectured about was basically wrong or extremely opinionated. Would not recommend.

Klofstad is an awesome professor. Super straightforward with what he wants, there are no surprises. 3-4 exams for the semester (including final, which isn't cumulative). Great lecturer, and even though attendance is mandatory, he makes it worth going. There are readings for each lecture which honestly aren't that necessary.
Great teacher. Hard to get an A but an A- or B+ is definitely attainable. 3 exams and a short paper.

Really nice guy. Knows what he is talking about and makes the class really interesting. It's a small class so you get a lot of individual attention and really learn a lot. I'd recommend him to anyone.

If you attend class, you don't need to read the book at all and barely study for tests. He is a great lecturer and all his tests are based off his powerpoints which are put online. It's hard to get an A, but easy to get an A- or B+.

Love Klofstad. Fantastic teacher and lecturer. All info for the tests can be found in the powerpoints; I only read the bolded words in the book. Tests can be easy if you study and pay attention in class, very straightforward. And the final is pretty easy essay. Definitely recommend this teacher.
great teacher-only 3 tests, no final just a short paper. pretty easy and really nice
You're graded on 3 exams and a paper so if you test well this is the class for you.  Every class is a powerpoint which are simple but extremely boring.

He really knows the subject - his CV is amazing by the way - there was a lot of reading so it was a challenge to keep up but worth it since you learn a lot about the subject from a prof who knows it inside and out and actually cares about teaching it, too.  Highly recommended.  And he looks like a sailor.

Teaches off his powerpoints based on the textbook. tests based on powerpoints and key words throughout the chapters. know the key words in detail because the test is whether or not you understand them. fairly easy, recommended
Great professor- funny and nice. He makes everything super simple and easy to understand. Tests arent hard at all if you read the notes and study keywords from the textbook.

Very enthusiastic about what he teaches. He's young, so most of us related to him really well, and weren't afraid to approach him. The lectures we're a little long-winded sometimes, but in a POLI SCI class, that's to be expected. I BOMBED the midterm, and managed to still get a B+ at the end of the term. Some of the readings were hilarious! Niceguy

Took him for a high-level class. Material wasn't too hard, he made it pretty easy to understand. The only thing that sucked was the class never participated so I felt bad for him. We needed to also do a powerpoint, two tests, paper as the final. YOU DO NEED THE BOOKS in this one.
This was a cool class. The prof is enthusiastic and he made the material pretty interesting. Plus, he is hot, and wears cool shoes.

for some reason i did so bad on his first test, then got a high A on another, and god knows what i got on the final, and still ended up with a A-.  i believe he curves a lot a the end, so just study really hard the power points, nothing else, DO NOT BUY THE BOOK! what a waste.

Super cool lady and professor. Group
Project/paper, midterm and final. She takes attendance sometimes. Calls on you by name by second class so she knows when you miss. Class is engaging and interesting

She makes the class very relevant to the real world. She asks provocative questions applicable to the real world that make the class discussions interesting. She gives her students first dibs at internships. She really cares about her students.
Shes super cool. Very understanding and makes the class engaging.

Professor Kligman is approachable and very well respected as a thought leader in HR. She brings guest lecturers that also bring great perspective to the subject matter. She cares about students. There is no “gotcha” approach, rather shes invested in you doing your best. A-lot of group work, assessments, and a research paper due. Shes engaging.

He is a nice professor but a lot of things are confusing... We had 4 different types of homework on different platforms which made it really confusing when, how, and what to study or do. Lectures are boring.

Lectures are boring, his tests are easy but he writes the tests. He does not write the final which he does not prepare you for.  I recommend Peterson. His tests are harder but it prepares you for the final.

He is a good teacher overall. A lot of people are complaining that his exams are hard, but as long as you study the notes he posted online very well, there is no reason that you don't get an A. Take him!

Great guy but tests are extremely tough. Average on each test was a C and he does not curve. I have close to a 4.0 and this class is one of the hardest classes I have taken. Should have taken Peterson for 302.
The class is super easy,  u will get an A if u go to class

Professor Klevan is a very sweet man. He cares deeply for his students and will go out of his way to help and offer advice when he can. The class is hard. You need to really work hard, study, and do your homework. The more time you put in, the better the grade.

Homework are really hard and do not teach you anything. She is a passionate professor, but the lectures are pretty boring and sometimes she overcomplicates things, so studying yourself would be better

I dropped out of difficulty. This is the type of class that is the top of your priority - 1 quiz (5-30mins) and 1 HW (30 mins- 90 mins) due before every class. Class is faced paced and you need to know all of your math very fluently. 

Very passionate, intelligent, and caring. Would have loved to take this class when I had more time in life.

use Pearson plus to learn on your own. her examples in class are useless because she skips so many steps and makes you feel stupid if you ask questions. she doesn't help in office hours and favorites certain students. negative textbook use and you never know what to expect in the tests. her grading is super weird and she doesn't curve but scales

Her caring personality doesn't save her. She gives really hard homework followed by really hard tests. Her lectures aren't the best since she will skip over information and steps necessary in understanding the work. I did a lot of learning outside of class, but even then, the class is super hard. Avoid having her if you can.

Dr K is very knowledgeable and passionate about the subject. Really makes an effort in her lectures, but spends too much time deriving formulas instead of actually dumbing them down and applying them. Taught myself for half the course. HOMEWORK! prepares you for exams but is a lot. Essay HW is a lot harder than the exam questions.

It feels like the intro physics class follows 2 different types of content: content following Dr. K's exams and essay HW, and the content following the online HW and textbook. There's very little overlap between them so it's hard to figure out HW or study for exams (because it feels like 2 different classes). The final curve is a lifesaver though.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Homework was often harder than any problem she would give on tests, and she gave a lot each week. Her lectures were alright but not interactive at all. We often spent a lot of time deriving equations in class. She also did plenty demonstrations during class.

I scored lower on the exit physics mechanics test than when I took it at the start of the semester. She made me forget physics and killed any desire I ever had to care about the subject. I recommend anyone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Korotkova is a very friendly and outgoing person. Unfortunately, she gives unreasonably difficult homework problems that are virtually impossible to derive on your own even with the information she gives in the lecture. Spent lots of time learning concepts on my own as most homework concepts were not gone over in class.

Very nice lady but she doesn't teach the material correctly. The lecture is spent deriving extraneous formulas that will rarely be used or will already be given to you during a test. You're on your own to figure out how to apply these formulas, which is the difficult side of physics. Attendance is required but you're better off teaching yourself.

Professor is passionate about subject & cares that students understand. Lectures are good, but most learning is done outside class (hours of studying). Homework & quizzes every class, but weren't bad. Grade is reflective of how much work you put into it. If you can study 3 hours everyday, you might get an A. I only recommend if you have time.
Great professor that cares deeply about her students and class. Difficult course but earning a high grade is doable if one puts effort into preparing for the exams.

Excellent with Physics Demonstrations. Very poor at lectures. Would be a perfect Physics Lab professor. Struggles with communication in English. Attendance should not be mandatory because you will teach yourself. Insane amount of Homework without coherent teaching. Rushes through examples. Doesn't like questions because her lectures are scripted.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Fantastic professor. She's probably one of the smartest people I know. Her lectures are very organized and clear to understand. We would get lots of homework (but manageable) but she was more than willing to help you if you had trouble.

She's a very organized and always ready to help out students. Even though her classes are mandatory, I enjoyed all of them. She puts a lot of time and effort into the coursework so the students succeed. There is a lot of homework but it's not as bad as you think.

Great professor! Very organized and comes prepared to each class. Tests are draining and extremely hard but the curve truly makes up for it. I would recommend taking her class, as you will learn a lot more than other professors.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The class is tough, its a lot of lecture, the textbook is hard to read, and there are 10 online homework problems and 1 long written homework problem per week. That being said, she is a good professor and in comparison to my peers, the best for phy205. She is available to help with questions outside of class and curves well.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. K isn't a bad professor, this is just a super hard class. A lot of class time is devoted to deriving theorems which in theory will help you apply them to problems, but in reality helps with nothing. The tests are 10x harder than the homework, but she uses a pretty lenient scale.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Her lectures are helpful for understanding the tough concepts in this course, but to get a good grade you need to practice problems regularly. She is almost always in her office after class if you want to ask her questions. I would definitely take another one of her classes.

You won't find much easier science professors than Dr. K. She may still not be the best, but she definitely does a better job than other professors for the same subject. The class rides a lot on the effort you put into it, but the lectures and notes taken during lectures are exactly what is covered on the test, but in much more applied terms.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: 3 dimensional vectors are occasional, examples and discussions are fantastic if you ask thoughtful questions without obvious answers, but these tests are Physics GRE worthy, so testing in this class is like playing Demon Souls. Don't take if you aren't serious about physics classes.
Best physics teacher EVER!!!!

She is a terrible teacher. All she does are derive theorems and it doesn't help you understand or visualize what is going on at all. She's a nice lady and a smart woman but a BAD PHYSICS TEACHER! She also writes extremely small

If you don't have a strong background in physics, such as AP classes, you're screwed. Although she is very nice and occasionally funny, her exams are ruthless and nothing like the homework. She spends 99% of class deriving equations that are straight from the textbook rather than doing examples. Exam averages in low 50's; the curve is a lifesaver.

The class is really hard. Prior Calculus and Physics are necessary in order to understand what is going on. Lots of equation derivations instead of examples done in class. She is a really nice person, just the class is way to hard. Overall, I like Korotkova, just not the class she teaches.

This course is extremely difficult mainly because Dr. K takes more time deriving equations than actually doing problems that relate to the homework and exams. It is not hard to pass with a C but understanding the material  was more important to me than just passing; unfortunately that did not happen.  Exam Avg: low 50s.
Terrible teacher, do not take Physics 205 if you have not taken Ap physics C in high school, tests are extremely hard

Her tests are impossible, you have no chance at passing the class without the curve at the end. First two test averages have been in the low 50's. Lectures are boring and she spends way too much time deriving equations instead of doing examples.

A strong understanding of at least Calculus 1 (college level) is required, as it was being used by the end of week 1. Her "short" homeworks are ruthless, often exceeding 40 questions (my current homework has a "question" with 36 actual questions inside). Also, online code for additional homework is required. Not a light class, moves extremley fast.

Nice person and decent instructor but absolutely ruthless with exams. Tests weren't similar to homework, discussion, or practice tests (first exam average was 53% and she made the next ones 'much harder'). The final was totally unlike anything presented during the semester. If you take her,  hope she's feeling generous on exam days!
Very attractive.  Explains everything very clearly.  Go to class, take good notes.

Professor Korotkova is a delight. Her lectures are well prepared and challenging. She is engaging and Socratic and funny. She expects you to take the class seriously, like you should everything in life. Give her a chance and you will learn a lot. (all the premeds complaining are just angry someones forcing them to think and not just memorize)

She is a good person but a horrible professor I recommend to stay away from her. The tests are very difficult and always curved ridiculously. She expects you to know everything and doesnt explain it well. Has a bit of an accent which doesnt help.
Great person but not a good 101 teacher. She excepts you to know everything before she teaches, and on top of the hw and test are nothing like the material she teaches in class!

She's a great person but not a great teacher. She expects you to have a very thorough, SOLID understanding of all of trig/geometry/algebra, and has more fun with the math than actually testing physics. she's WAY too hard for a 101 class. went to maria every single week and is the only reason i did well is because of her. korotkova taught me nothin

I took this class expecting it to be hard, and it really is. The test are nothing like the homework or what is taught in class. Class requires a lot of dedication to pass with a good grade. Nice lady but not a good 101 teacher.

I agree with the person below me. This lady is not easy. I got an A on the first test but the next 2 killed me. I have mercy for you if you take this lady, but if I was you I would go professor shopping.

Not sure who is ranking her on here, but she is NOT clear. She rushes through critical material and her HW questions do NOT reflect the material on the exams. Exams are very difficult. She's okay, but not great.
good prof
Korotkova is AWESOME. She knows her stuff, knows how to teach *and* sounds really cool all at the same time. Not for lazies; tests are not easy.
Have gone to office hours and still struggle in the class. I'm barely passing and I study 10+ hours a week. Exams are nothing like the homework. Better than Zane, but still difficult to learn from.
Dr. OK is the best!!! She makes physics easy with all her experiments. Dr. OK is always willing to help her student.  Totally recommend her for physics.

Her English is not the best, but she is a great professor.  I was struggling with the class, and she was willing to help me, which helped me pass the class.  The only thing is that she embarrasses students when they get to class late, or leave early.  Overall, I recommend Dr. Korotkova
She really cares about her students and gives plenty of practice exercises.

This class is very difficult and overwhelming. You leave every class with at least 3 quizzes to take at home and on top of that the SAS portion of this class is taught very fast and poor. This should be two separate classes and taught way slower. Class is also 3 and a half hours long.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Tough class but great professor!

Arrogance. Sometimes egotistical.  Grammar is critically poor. Not trying to deteriorate her status but it's important because some cases (biostatistics) you have to fully understand the context (contingency tables) and her grammar makes it super confusing. Her spelling is fine but her grammar never gets proof read for assessments...

Dr. Korniotis is the best professor I have had at UM. He prioritizes learning above all else and genuinely cares about his students. If you have aspirations to work with equities or be a portfolio manager, I highly recommend taking his class.
Awesome Professor! He truly cares about making the class fun and easier for students. Very approachable and knowledgeable. He makes finance simpler.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Korniotis is a lot of fun, and you'll really enjoy his class. He grades very quickly, and I'd definitely recommend him. However, I'd give him an 4 - because I'm not convinced why I didn't get an A, even though I worked really hard and aced all the exams.
Very interesting guy, his classes provide detailed material and timely answers. The exams and grading are fair and not too difficult :)

Favorite professor I have ever had throughout all of my education. He is willing to teach you step by step, and answer any questions. Very nice, fair tests and grading. He gives reviews before each exam. If you do not pass, you did not study. Explains finance in a way you will understand.

The man. Wants you to pass, doesn't make the tests (theres only 2) very hard at all. learn a lot about basic statistical aspects of finance and portfolio construction. Pretty funny, someone I would be friends with had he not been my teacher (an 25 years older). Take his class for 320 and you won't be sorry.

Quirky guy, but pretty funny and good environment and a very good teacher too. His tests are also very clear and he prints out in detail the notes for you. The information isn't exactly easy but Dr. Korniotis presents the material in a great way. Definitely glad I took him, and would recommend others to take his class.
Really nice guy who's passionate about his subject.  The course is very interesting and well-taught, but can be challenging at times.
Super nice guy, just getting his feet wet this year. I would take him if you value getting an A over taking away valuable insight.

He is a very good calculus professor. The class is just a hard class in general, but if you study and put in the time, you will do fine. Attendance is not mandatory, and he recorded the lectures. Weekly quizzes, but it's manageable. He is extremely monotone, but he explains things well; you have to force yourself to pay attention because it helps.

Moses is THE MAN. This is my second time taking Calc, and while the course inevitably is hard, Moses is the only one who was able to actually teach the material in an easy and comprehensible format. He records lectures, and attendance isn't mandatory. he's a little awkward...but great!

As long as you focus during the lectures, do the homeworks on web-assign, and study for a decent amount of time (review lecture notes and hws) you'll get an A. Also, he posts every lecture online to watch over or if you missed class.

Huge shoutout to Moses my dawg, he's a real g. Big hand talker, lots of pizazz. A lot of homework and quizzes almost weekly but is manageable and the questions aren't too difficult. He's great at explaining the concepts and will answer any questions really well.

Amazing professor really fair grader as long as you show up to class and participate in lecture you will be fine, I really like the way he teaches the material and structures the class it makes it very easy to follow and excel
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: so it turns out hes the boy

He really explains very well and goes into depth with examples so even if your lost, he will provide plenty of examples. He gives tons of chances for extra credit, and is really understanding. Sends out emails anytime he has office hours and acessible outside of classroom anytime.

Had him for calc I and he is definitely the best. Lectures are super clear and he can answer any question super well, which I appreciated. Gives practice exams that are very similar to real ones. Koppendrayer is the GOAT and probably the best math professor at UM.

Dr. Koppendrayer is the best math prof at UM!! Exams are just like the reviews, great teacher/explainer, and overall just a great class! He records lectures and posts notes, so you can review the lectures outside of class. If you pay attention, put in the effort, and study this course is VERY simple!!

I honestly really liked Dr. Koppendrayer. I did have prior calculus experience, however, I did feel as though Dr. Koppendrayer really took the time to explain each of the concepts in detail. All the quizzes and exams were very fair. As long as you put in effort in and out of class, this course shouldn't be very difficult.

I already took this class in high school, so I was annoyed at doing it again, but Moses helped assuage any frustrations. He was very clear in his notes and explanations. He always stopped to ask if anyone had questions and was patient. Homework and tests were both quite fair. Not the most engaging lecturer, but not dreadful either. Highly recommend

reviews.comment: calc is hard asf but he made it very understandable. Accessible outside of class and is a super chill dude

reviews.comment: Dr. Koppendrayer is by FAR the best Calc 1 professor at UM. This is one of the best math professors I've ever had. Im so mediocre at math and shocked at how good I'm doing in this class. He is such a patient teacher, he doesn't expect you just to know things like many math professors at UM do. He constantly stops and asks if anyone has questions. He grades so thoroughly and provides great feedback. TAKE HIM
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great teacher. The homework is tedious, but it overprepares you for exams. Most likely will take again for a higher level course.

I had an A on almost every test and quiz but the final was way harder, and with the limited amount of time given, it was hard to finish the problems with the terrible numbers given on the questions as well.

Dr. Koppendrayer is knowledgable and doesn't go too fast, he pauses to see if a student has a question. He also will explain the small things with no frustration. reviews.comment: Absolute goat greatest math teacher I have ever had. Made learning easy and fun as long as you put in the work you will get an A. Go to his office hour very helpful and kind.

Amazing calc teacher! He doesn't go too fast and makes sure everyone understands before moving on. Very open to any questions and he takes his time explaining everything. He does a lot of examples in class which is helpful. Quizzes basically every week, they're not as hard as the homework. Exams are also not bad but there's no curve at all.

Professor Koppendrayer is an amazing teacher. Very knowledgeable and willing to help his students.He teaches with many examples and his lectures are easy to understand. reviews.comment: best math professor out there! even if you suck at calc, you can get an A (happened to my friend). he is super understanding and cool. He is always willing tob help in office hours and answer questions in class. DO THE REVIEW GUIDES. Overall, W man, some may say the goat of umiami calc 1.

All classes are recorded and posted online and he explains the material well. He drops multiple quizzes and will replace a midterm with the final grade if higher. His homework is hard but it is way easier than the actual quizzes and exams.

He's just mid. Super monotone and boring in class but he does know what he's doing. The class/material is extremely difficult and he doesn't go slow in class so be prepared to spend lots of time outside of class doing homework and reteaching yourself the material.

THE BEST CALC PROF I'VE EVER HAD! The content is hard but office hour helps a lot; he's shy but he's willing to help, also funny if you get to know him a little bit. He takes attendance but they don't count towards the grade, I have no idea why he has so many bad reviews.

This is just a difficult class, Prof Koppendrayer does a reasonable job explaining the content.  His exams are fair and are based off of what we learn so there are no surprises.  Will have to put in study time to receive a high-quality grade.  Would take him for the class again I had other circumstances not allowing me to study as much as I wanted.

the goat. had him for calc1 and honestly calc2 was easier. responsive to emails. took 9 quizzes only 5 count, 4 exams total including final. small extra credit on the webassign homework. take him if u can!!!

His tests are ten times easier then the hw, quizzes and practice problems.  You do have to make sure you understand what you are doing tho but it was very manageable.  It was the easiest class I had in my semester.  He doesn't talk very much but if you speak to him first he will.

Super chill professor. The class is pretty easy if you show up and do your homework on time. He even offers extra credit if you do your homework early. It may seem like a lot of homework at first, but it is more manageable over the course of the semester.

HORRIBLE. if you want to fail take him. I have studied, gotten tutors and he still failed me and I got great grades on quizzes and homework. He is a tough grader. Please listen and do not take this man!!!!!!! RUN.

Professor Koppendrayer teaches very well does not go too fast and is open to questions during class. WAYYYYYYYYYYYYYY too much homework. Other than that GREAT person and GREAT teacher, was really able to learn calc well and apply it to other things effectively because of his teaching. Professor Koppendrayer is a solid professor he takes time to answer any questions during lectures the notes are all online organized by section and the the review sheets he gives cover every thing that will be on the exam and the quizzes are easy. If you pay attention go to class and do the reviews for the test there is no reason you can't pass.

this course is challenging even with prior calc knowledge. however, he is extremely helpful during office hours and patiently explains hard concepts. assigns a lot of homework but that's pretty much all math classes anyways - do them early on as they count as extra credit. overall a chill prof & definitely not as bad as what the other reviews say.

reviews.comment: He is a very fair professor, content is hard, but he explains it very well. Do the homework and study for the tests, and you should be fine.

Very bland personality, but a nice professor. He will stop and answer questions during lecture and is available during office hours. Manageable class if you put in the effort. Homework is long and tedious but is a grade boost, and the final was hard- definitely do the review guide and the Webassign before. Much better than what other reviews say.

His lectures are slow and can be boring most of the time but he explains the content "well". I dropped the course because I was not prepared for this class. He's not the worst choice but still there are better teachers.

Always, always, always wears a black N-95 mask. The entire semester, students never saw their instructor's face and who was teaching us. Dishonest, and lies to all his students. Any other Professor is worth taking instead of Professor Koppendrayer. I am sorry for my bitter honesty but this man isn't a good lecturer that knows how to handle a large class of students.
Professor Koppendrayer has no mercy on students. He likewise doesn't have any pity. He should be ashamed of himself. DO NOT take this Professor. He is OVERRATED!

Not sure why there are so many negative reviews. If you actually go to class unlike most students and pay attention you'll be fine. Don't be fooled by the good rating. If you would like to jeopardize your educational career, make sure you take Professor Koppendrayer. very hard

I hate when students that just suck in class give horrible ratings. Like it's not the profs fault that you're stupid. Dr. Koppendrayer may come off as weird, but he genuinely cares about his students. His easy exams make up for boring lectures. Provides great study guides for exams. He is not the most engaging guy, but his expectations are clear and he explains things well. Also, he is really generous with partial credit and gives an easy extra credit assignment at the end of the semester.
Homework is very very hard compared to the exams. Exams are like the inclass notes

He is not terrible at teaching but does not engage with his students at all so its intimidating to ask questions. There are def better options but he's not the worst. His tests are fair (they're like the study guides) and he gave extra-credit at the end.

Dr. Koppendrayer is definitely a snooze and I just stopped showing up near the end of the semester, especially to the night session because of how slow the time would pass in his class. He was a good professor for MTH 140, but for MTH 141, we were not given enough time to complete some of our exams, other classes had easier quizzes and more bonus points, and the study guides (especially for the final!!) did not reflect what was tested on the exam.

He seems like he doesn't care about what he's teaching at all and it makes it really difficult to want to focus in his class as he shows no enthusiasm. It was a pretty easy class to pass it was just really boring.

I miss the good days, when teachers were passionate about their craft. They used to inspire me to get up out of bed, and learn new things. I used to be vastly interested in math, my tiktok feed was full of interesting math equations, my youtube full of math facts. I even got a 36 on Math on my ACT. This killed my interest for my passion.

HORRIBLE. The homework is a TON per week and it is on webassign. The material does not match the quiz/test material so it's time consuming and does not even help. Professor Koppendrayer seems like a very nice guy, but I did not enjoy this class. The lectures were very difficult to pay attention to, especially with online learning. He was overall okay. He is very monotone and not the easiest to follow at 8am. Dr. K gives extremely fair and easy exams, but does assign a lot of web assign, yet not nearly as much hw as I heard other professors do. He teaches very clearly and prepares u well to get an A. Def take!!!
He has extra credit. but I found the tests to be hard, coming from CALC BC.

The dawg Moses. Lectures can seem like they go by fast and you don't understand but just practice it's not that bad. Moses is an absolute bro for making the tests as straightforward as they are. Study notes and reviews because the exam is literally that. Tests are so straightforward with no tricks. Made Calc 2 @ Miami > any other school.
