reviews.comment: Moses was so so helpful. If you show that you care about the class and learning, he takes notice. He works in the math lab so he is super accessible outside of class and so helpful. He is young, but it is obvious that he is so knowledgable on the subject and wants to help. I never feel that he is looking down on me. 10/10

While he may be young, it is apparent he knows the material very well and is very very accessible outside of class. He tutors in the math lab and people from my class commonly went there and he was very willing to help. The course is somewhat difficult only because it is calculus but if you show up and do the work you will do just fine.

Very young professor. Doesn't quite know how to teach properly and doesn't explain things very well during lectures. Goes by very fast and doesn't give students a chance to really understand. Class is already difficult enough and he doesn't seem very confident in teaching anyways. 10/10 would not take his class again
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Lots of extra credit
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr Knecht is a very nice guy. Definitely go to his office hours to get to know him and ask him questions. However, make sure to study old practice tests and lots of self-studying as the tests are very difficult and are more difficult than he makes them out to be.

Best Professor for the gen chem department, Has a great way of lecturing with mostly using problems to explain the concepts. The chemistry department tests genuinely are really bad and unjust so nothing can prepare you for that, but he's the best of the bunch.

Professor Knecht is a solid option for a chemistry professor. Attendance is mandatory and recorded through Iclicker and there are multiple problems done through iClicker during lectures. His lectures are good for note-taking and he occasionally makes jokes, keeping the mood light. Practice more difficult questions if you want to do good on tests.

For a chem professor, he is good. His lectures are engaging and he goes over lots of examples that are very helpful for learning, homework, and studying. The class itself is very difficult as it is so much material fit into one semester. Many schools split this content into two semesters. The curve at the end is crazy.
Dr. Knecht is a funny and good professor. Just find as many practice tests as possible because the homework is extremely easy compared to the exam, which is extremely difficult.

Dr. Knecht was a great Gen Chem professor. Considering this course is hard, and the exams even harder, I couldn't have asked for a better professor. Class consists of 5 exams, 1 final. Lowest exam is dropped. Attendance is graded through IClicker + discussion is part of your grade. This course is hard, so practice out side of class is a must. 10/10

I personally loved taking him. He does a lot of practice problems in class, gives a lot of resources to study, and is super accessible outside of class. The class was extremely difficult because of the exams, but that's due in part to the fact that three professors teaching different material are making it. Go to office hours!!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Take any other professor. Genuinely does not know how to teach. He is very smart, but he is a researcher, not a lecturer. This class is challenging, but choosing a good professor can make it easier. Marc is not that professor. I started attending other professors' lectures to understand the concepts because he was so bad.
Its chemistry, so you need to study on your own outside of class. He is pretty good at explaining lectures and records them to watch them before the test. Would recommend!

Chemistry is a class that requires effort outside of lectures. I think Dr.Knect did a good job of teaching the content but if you want to do well it takes a lot of practice on your own as well. He's accessible in his office hours and willing to help his students.

This class is very difficult if you don't put in the required effort, as many classes are. However, Dr. Knecht was very inconsistent in how well he explained concepts. There was inconsistency between lecture difficulty compared to that of homework and tests. Tests were extremely difficult and I never felt well prepared, which is partly my fault.

This Professor was awful. I took his class my first semester of my freshman year and my experience was terrible. He is incredibly vague. I went to his office hours one day and asked him where I could find the formulas to study for the exam and he did not want to tell me. In class, he goes extremely fast and always seems to be in a rush.
Unorganized and doesn't thoroughly explain things.

The material covered in class was oftentimes different than the material in the homework, exams, etc. This class is a large time commitment. There is a separate discussion once a week, and tests are not held during class time. The class itself was extremely difficult, and I felt as if I did not learn the material well.

Dr. Knecht is a really nice guy who is always willing to help his students. If you show up to office hours he will make an effort to get to know your name and will help you with your questions However, he is not that great of a teacher and often skips over basic content and opts for problems rather than understanding.

CHM121 is pretty much the same no matter what professor you take it with. All tests are the same for 121 regardless of the prof. If you study enough you should be fine just stay on top of your work and go to office hours/workshops. Knecht is a good lecturer and explains things well.

I thoroughly enjoyed taking Dr. Knecht for CHM 121. The class is challenging, but Dr. Knecht made lectures very accessible and the information was easy to digest. The tests were hard but standardized for all professors so it doesn't matter who you take. Also very funny and would make jokes during lectures.

Knecht lectures quickly and is less interactive but his powerpoints are good reviews. If you prefer slower-paced, I'd suggest Leslie or Gonzalez. Marc is straightforward and available during office hours or appointments if you need help. Take any extra credit opp, Do Mastering EARLY, textbook problems and past tests help the most for exams

Dr. Knecht's presentations are pretty good as a review of material before the exam and has good practice questions. Reading the textbook and redoing the homework problems helped me the most to prepare for his exams. There was a small curve at the end of the semester as well and take advantage of the extra credit opportunities.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Knecht moves quickly and for some people that can be confusing. I really liked that the class was fast-paced and straightforward because it forced me to pay attention. Skipping the lecture is a very bad idea but videos are posted if you do. Go to office hours if you have questions and do the homework before the day it's due and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He does a good job of giving a lot of examples to each problem, however he only briefly covers each topic because he gives the examples, forcing students to learn on their own through the examples. However, it is possible to be sucessful and the examples so help. Recommend taking a different CHM professor if possible.

lots of homework that's much more challenging than what's covered in lecture. available for office hours so utilize them w specific questions. failed the first exam and he told me to drop pre med because i "didn't have it". not supportive of students struggling. exam averages were always failing. finished w a 90 on the final and never looked back.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Knecht is a great lecturer. He's funny which keeps you focused and goes over content in depth. Most lectures are spent doing practice problems which prepares you for exams. You def have to put the work in for this class and taking AP Chem helps a lot. He's also super helpful during office hours so make sure to use them as well as review the hw

kind man, horrific teacher. Wanted to end it all at various points in the semester. Went from being a straight A student to barely passing this class. Lectures are super unclear and indirect, making them extremely hard to reference during homework. wife can't teach either
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Knecht is very humorous and likable as a person but unfortunately his class made me question my entire life. If you do not have a strong background in chemistry I strongly advise you not to jump straight in to CHM 121. It is extremely fast paced, and he will not be slowing down for you. It was a very humbling and emotional experience.

Knect is a really tough teacher who gives lots of HW. He explains things very good however the course itself is so much there is no time to linger on each subject long. Use all the points you can get from HW and weekly quiz to help out with the four tests of the semester. The tests are standardized for the whole course but it is the same as the HW
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: All the reviews saying this class wasn't bad are from people who have taken this class before in high school so don't be fooled. The test averages were always failing (this is a gen-ed class so you can imagine how ridiculous that is) and there was an endless state of panic. They did curve at the end but the entire semester was torture.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Make sure to attend lectures and office hours are helpful too. Funny guy who cares about students. Put in the work and it will work out okay, but stay motivated all semester. Class material is tough but the resources are there to succeed and past students can be really helpful too. Love the Knechts.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This was the most unorganized, unnecessarily difficult class I have ever taken. All the teachers give the same exact exam but they go over different things in class so you never know what to expect. I studied a week in advance for every exam, went to office hours and workshops but only ended up passing because of the curve at the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Quite difficult class. Exam FRQ sections are similar to the homework
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I had a 4.0 in high school and took AP Chem so I thought I would be fine no matter who I got as my professor. I was SO wrong. The tests are extremely hard and almost always had a failing class average and Dr. Knecht does not care. Go to workshops from the beginning if you end up having to take him
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Everyone on here that is rating Dr. Knecht badly just got a bad grade in his class. Everyone knows gen chem is hard, but if you can't get Leslie Knecht, Marc is the next best thing. Personally, I like Marc's teaching style better. Go to lecture it's literally only 50 minutes but it will help you so much.

He is sarcastic sometimes which I found funny but others may not. AP Chem helps. His office hours/exam reviews are you bring your own questions rather than him going over practice problems for what is important. He makes an effort to know your name if you go to office hours and show him youre putting in the effort.

He makes the content seem easy in class but the exams are impossible to pass. He also gives quizzes on the weekend and at least 3 hours of homework every week, separate from the book problems you are expected to keep up with.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: TERRIBLE!! Your grade in this class is entirely based on how you perform on exams and the average for the exams was almost always failing. Even after taking AP chemistry this class was an endless struggle
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This was the hardest class I have ever taken!! The exams are nothing like what he teaches, and other teachers for this class give their students more resources to do well. If you have never taken AP or IB Chem, take the four sequence chemistry instead of the three sequence. If you end up taking him, make sure to go to his wife's exam reviews!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Man I never meet a someone who gives quizzes on Saturdays also I wanted to die from homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Marc Knecht is a really great guy and really nice but that can only take you so far. His lectures are pretty decent and going to class helps but what he teaches is only partially what you will face on the exam. He does a poor job in preparing you for it and doesnt give enough questions or even teaches you the right concepts to prepare you.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: A really nice person but this is honestly the hardest class I have EVER taken. Knecht is super knowledgable and is willing to help you if you need help but even with all of that, it was still awful. Had to spend an insane amount of time doing the homework/studying everyday that I didn't have time to focus on other classes. Lots of exams

I took professor Knecht for CHM 121 as a first semester freshman. This class is hard. It's all of AP chemistry in one semester. That being said, I liked professor Knect. His lectures are filled with info bc of the pace of the course, but he will answer questions when asked/in office hours. He will try to help you understand, but not help your grade

Dr. Knecht is a great lecturer and goes over many problems each class. Read the textbook (understand concepts), do the suggested chapter problems, and do the ALEKS reviews and you will do well!! AP chemistry definitely helps, as he goes a little fast. He's easy to access and has so many resources to help you do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He doesn't explain things thoroughly and barely goes over any practice problems. The lectures also jump chapters; he never did the intro chapters but rather just jumped into the chemistry, which is unfair since most people start in this class. He is not very accessible outside of class and is an unreasonably tough grader. I had to repeat the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Knecht makes a class that is hard for a lot of kids easy. If you took ap chem, this class will be super easy. The exams require that you study and read the textbook, but if you take good notes in class and do the suggested problems, you'll feel prepared. He is very accessible and overall the class was enjoyable. I would def recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Marc is lovely! Great lecturer, very patient and answers questions thoroughly! The class is nothing too terrible, especially if you took AP Chem in high school and did well. Highly recommend!

Knecht is pretty great, he gets a bad rap but honestly, I liked him. He was very willing to help and explains things pretty well. His office hours aren't always the most helpful, but still not bad. The reason I did so badly was because I constantly skipped class and just wasn't in it to win it if you get what I'm saying. Anyway, good prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Hilarious

reviews.comment: i unfortunately did not take ap chem before this class, so gen chem was definitely a challenge from the beginning. you HAVE to take advantage of the office hours for dr. knecht. he is willing to help as best he can, but come with specific questions. DO THE TEXTBOOK PROBLEMS. tests are challenging. hardest class i have ever taken
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Take the 4 sequence chem if possible! 3 sequence is VERY fast paced. EXTREMELY difficult exams (average was never above a low C all semester). Often, I studied harder than ever, thought I did well on an exam, then got a C or lower! Lectures straight from the powerpoint. Does TopHat during class for 2% of the grade. Do the textbook problems!

To be fair, I had not taken AP Chem in high school so the material was difficult, but Knecht was a terrible teacher. Spends class reading through slides and doing a few problems on the board with little to no explanation. When I went to office hours, he acted as if he was speaking to a large lecture hall, extremely impersonal and unhelpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Nice guy but not a good prof
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: This professor and his wife champion the 3 semester sequence. As far as I know, the 3 semester is about the same rigor as the 4 semester for organic chem but harder for CHM 221. Dr Knecht makes his lectures engaging with problems and his jokes. He is very ready to meet with any student if they need help and it is clear he cares so much.

Honestly, I have a weird amount of respect for the Knechts. Marc and Leslie are two of my favorite teachers on campus. HOWEVER, this three-semester course was the hardest thing I have ever done and I put in a disgusting amount of time for a lousy B. The tests are INSANELY difficult if you don't have a chem background. TAKE CHEM 111

Dr. Knecht is an amazing professor. His lectures are always funny, enjoyable and he makes things easy to understand. It is clear that he cares a lot about his students and their success in the class. He has office hours and always answers emails and questions. Tests can be hard but he prepares you well. A lot of points can be earned to cushion too!

I am a Biology major taking Dr. Knechts class for CHM 121. I was quite interested in Chem before taking this class but was worried that this class would make it too hard for me but it did the exact opposite. Dr. Knecht is available whenever you need, hilarious, and is on of my favorite teachers. He has also inspired me to double major in Chem!

Dr. Knecht is a super nice guy that really really wants his students to succeed. A lot of people struggled inevitably because his exams can be easy. However, if you look over the homework and suggested book problems, you should be great in shape for an A in the class. Hilarious guy, made chemistry enjoyable, awesome.

He is a good teacher and he is HILARIOUS but if you do not have an extensive background in chemistry I would recommend that you just take the normal 4 semester sequence. This class goes through the material very quickly and the exams are EXTREMELY difficult. If you care about getting a high grade in chem take the normal class.

He's an amazing chemistry teacher.  He's really funny and clearly wants to interact with his students.  The class is undoubtedly hard, but he makes the experience really worthwhile.  He's really funny, and he's a good person to get to know.  Always willing to help out as long as he can see you are putting in the effort. 10/10 recommend.

This class was so hard. I worked so hard and studied so much for every test, but they would always put one question on there that tripped me up. It's very frustrating cause if you get one open answer question wrong you automatically can't get an A because they're weighted so heavily. I would take his wife over him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: He's a pretty good Chem teacher. The class is designed to be difficult but he does a decent job explaining everything. The lectures are decent, but reading from the book helps alot. The first 2 tests aren't bad if you had Honors or AP chem, but the second two can be tough. Make sure to do all the practice problems and tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Knecht is a nice, accessible professor but his course is extremely difficult. Unless you have an extensive background in chemistry (beyond AP Chem), this course is absolutely awful. You get to drop a test, which helps, but the average for his exams is usually a 70 or below. Definitely a class meant to weed people out.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Very lively and quirky guy, made lecture entertaining, though he was difficult to follow because he tends to move quickly through slides. Leaves blanks in the powerpoints and top hat for extra points. I regret not setting time to read the chapter before and doing the end of chapter questions. Tests are very difficult, be prepared to study a lot

Dr. Knecht is a nice guy. He knows his class is hard, and is accessible. His test are extremely difficult, start studying WEEKS in advance and w friends. This class is nonstop studying but I definitely did learn a good amount. Theres 4 tests, with one makeup which helps, and some grade boosters on hw and tophat. brace yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: He is really funny and wants his students to succeed. If you are willing to work hard in his class, then he is more than willing to help you outside of class. He understands that his class is hard, so he gives a boost to your grade with Top Hat and discussion. He tries to make his lectures engaging and sometimes gives EC. Stop by his office hours!

Knecht tries to make his lectures funny but it quickly becomes irritating. In order to fill out the blanks in the powerpoints he uses, you must come to class, but even then he goes too fast to copy everything . The tests are super hard and there is only 4, but you can retake one. He assigns hw for each chapter online. The TB problems help for tests
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Knecht was HILARIOUS. Chemistry is a challenging subject, so it  was not easy,but his lectures are helpful
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I really don't know what to say for this class, other than that it was hard for me given that I did not come in with a strong background in chemistry. Professor Knecht tries so hard to tech well but I just never succeed at understanding him. My test scores for this class are in the low 70's, even when all of my time is dedicated to this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Knecht does really well instructing this class; however, some tests are hard! There are 3 tests. The 1st one is easy if you took AP Chem or even Chem Reg/Hon in high school. The other 2 tests are hard! I advise doing all of the suggested book problems he assigns; he uses some of them as test questions. Study hard, and you will do  well!

Dr. Knecht is a very funny guy. When it comes to his lectures, sometimes the examples on his powerpoint aren't accurate, probably because he isn't even the one making them. His tests are tough, so really study the optional practice problems in the book. You need to study everyday. I would recommend his wife Dr. Leslie Knecht before him. Got a B.

Good professor, personally think wife is more clear. Tests are very hard, this year multiple choice included with written problems. Ends up giving extra credit, go to class on days with expected low attendance. Office hours help sorta, he works out problem for you. Quizzes, final, tests, hw factor in grade. Drops 2 lowest quiz+hw grades

Both Knechts are great teachers. You will learn a lot and he is very engaging and entertaining. Only problem is that their tests are unnecessarily hard, but extra credit/curves are given at the end of the semester. Make sure to study problems in book for exam.
His powerpoints are very helpful and he's pretty thorough in class but his exams are very tough although he'll usually adjust them

Knect is awesome the class isnt easy and he moves through material pretty quickly but he offers alot of help during his office hours. He makes class fun with a little humor and real world examples, easily a top ten professor at UM.

He runs through the slides pretty slickly, and his tests are unnecessarily difficult, so difficult that he had to give the ENTIRE class a 20 PERCENT CURVE. Study a lot and practice a lot for this test. Also, sit in the front cause his slides are hard to see from the back. He also makes pop culture jokes that can get a little stale.  Good luck.
Awesome lecture. Mediocre office hours.

Dr. Knecht is awesome! He is so funny and makes a class that could be boring an enjoyable and fun experience. He is extremely clear in class and is more than happy to answer questions or slow down if asked to. The tests are tough. They are usually just 7-10 short to long answer questions, no multiple choice, but if you study a lot you will be fine.
Prof. Knecht is wonderful. He is very helpful and approachable. Tests are a bit annoying since there are only like 6 questions which each worth 20 pts.

Dr. Knecht was by far the best teacher I had this semester. While CHM111 is a weeder course designed to trip up most premeds, the 121 sequence was helpful and clear. Lectures were concise and clear on material, and his unique humor kept me entertained and actually interested. Very helful in office. Take this class, I promise you will not regret it.

Tests are extremely difficult and only 6-7 questions, but they have a good curve. For our class a 60% was a B (this is not always the case). Each test is 20% of your grade, hw is 10% and quizzes are 10%. His lectures are good and clear.

Go to class and make sure you understand his examples! The tests are very much like the examples he gives in class. If you don't understand something, he's super helpful during office hours way way better than taking CHM111

Dr Knecht was a good professor. I missed class often but studied from the book and still did well. He was entertaining and kept you awake at 8AM. His explanations are clear and he seems willing to help. His tests are not multiple choice and only 6 to 7 questions so if you do not know how to do one it's hard to get an A on the test.

I never took AP chemistry and did not have a strong chemistry background and its easy. He is a great teacher and his lectures r very clear and easy to follow. The examples he does on his Power Points are the same as on the test except he changes the numbers around. His tests r pretty easy i have an A in the class. highly recommend him for premed

I absolutely love this professor. He is willing to help you and wants you to come to his office hours. His tests are not multiple choice so make sure know how to do the problems thoroughly. Much of the test material is based off of similar problems from the power points and book so make sure you do all the problem that correlates to his lectures.

Good professor, comes off as really nice & chill but actually not as much as he seems...not in office hours the way he says he is, kind of a not nice guy outside of class though. Wants to see everything written out his way or he will deduct points so a ridiculous grader before you figure it out. Would recommend as a chemistry professor though.

Everything so far is correct, overall I wouldn't advise taking CHM 121 at all unless you already have a strong strong background in chemistry. The class is extremely accelerated regardless of how they advertise it. Also Knect is never in his office to help after or before a test.

He seems nice and energetic in class, which is good for 8 ams. He's willing to help during office hours if you need extra clarification. His test questions are fair, only stuff that you go over in class but IF YOU DONT SOLVE THE QUESTIONS THE WAY HE TEACHES THEM THEN HE MARKS YOU OFF AND YOU DONT EARN ANY POINTS EVEN IF YOU GOT THE QUESTION RIGHT
The class is kind of challenging, you just have to study it outside of class and go to his office hours. But, he is very helpful. He was an amazing teacher. His jokes were really funny!!

Dr. Knecht teaches a specific section of CHM111. It's a program in which you finish inorganic chem and organic chem in 3 semesters, as opposed to 4 semesters. The class was a challenge. Every week, in addition to lecture, you have a recitation class, with a quiz. It helps, but study from the book, not just class notes.

Dr. Knecht was amazing! She gives a lot of resources to study outside of the class and used a flipped classroom so you're really learning before class using videos/the book and then practicing all class. The tests were really difficult, but she holds a lot of office hours and the homework/participations count for a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Orgo sucks no matter what lol. My biggest tip would be to study past exams and do as many practice problems!!!!!

She is the best in the school. Of any department. Such an amazing teacher, super caring, gives great feedback, always willing to help and explains things so well. I genuinely enjoyed Orgo 1 with her. The flipped classroom forces you to practice in class and sets you up for success. I'll really miss her when she leaves this summer.

Very difficult class, misleading for an easy minor. Avoid if you struggled with general chemistry because it is genchem ramped up. She did random attendance for otherwise recorded lectures which is how i personally studied.

She is the best chem professor by far. I have had her twice and enjoyed both classes. Her exams are hard but fair and reflect what she taught in class but require a deeper understanding of the chem and not just math. A lot of homework but it is helpful for the exams and reflects what the problems are like. Very willing to help outside of class.

Very good at teaching, makes the content digestible. Not an easy class and she holds students to a high standard. Nothing unexpected though if you put in the work she is there to help you. Just study, if you ask her questions super helpful.

Dr. K teaches in a flipped style, meaning you watch lectures at home and do problems in class, which was really helpful! I passed because she genuinely cares for her students and WANTS them to pass with a good grade. She is very accessible out of class as well! Chemistry is hard, but taking it with her definitely lightens the load by a lot.

Leslie is absolutely amazing. I love her so much. U have to do a lot of work for chm121 so be prepared for that but 100% take her. she actually explains the material and doesn't just skim past things.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: by far the best chemistry professor ever at the U. i loved her flipped classroom. her videos were accessible all the time, which is important if ur a slow learner. if you watched the videos, the practice in class prepared you thoroughly for exams. even if you missed a video one class, you could catch up. just don't fall behind. shes straightforward

She simply doesn't teach in class, going to class is  pointless because practice problems in class and in her lecture videos are nothing like the exam questions. Her lecture videos are oversimplified, 5 minute long videos that leave you unprepared for her exams unless you have time to go to office hours. I would never take her again

She is the best chemistry professor at UM! Her flipped classroom style was effective, using class time for practice rather than lectures. Her straightforward videos allowed for note-taking at your own pace. In lectures, she provided challenging questions and encouraged group work. Office hours were also great for homework and textbook questions!!

AMAZING!!!! LIGHT OF MY ACTUAL LIFE. She saves the whole entire Umiami chem department and I owe all of my chem understanding to this angel. She explains things in a way that is very digestible and she really helps her kids understand through in class practice problems. I find her videos really helpful. If you struggle with chemistry take her!
Orgo is tough, but Professor Knecht's flipped classroom and personalized support make it doable. Supplement with resources like unstuck ai for efficient study prep.

Dr. Knecht didn't teach anything in her class. She did practice questions for 1.5 hrs and then sent you home to watch her videos, which are oversimplified and unhelpful for the ridiculously tricky exams. She does not work with the Prof. she is teaching with, so there are discrepancies in the material between sections. Do NOT take her!

Dr. Knecht is a good teacher when she isn't in front of class. I can't pass this class in the current format it's in. I need a lecture to learn the material and practice problems out of class and in office hours to master the material, and this class currently reverses this and makes it impossible for me to succeed and have a life outside of class

I LOVE DR. KNECHT! Be prepared to LEARN. A lot of her class is outside work but she gives you all the material to be successful, so it's your responsibility if you do that or not. Her lectures are very interactive and fun, keeping you engaged. Orgo 1 is hard in general so you are going to need to study no matter what but Dr. Knecht was perfect.

Knecht is not a good teacher. I decided to listen to reviews but it seems they're outdated. Her teaching style is nonexistent, literally. She only does practice q's in class no actual teaching. Lecture is useless and does not prepare u for exams. They are VERY hard. She also took 2+ months to grade exams. Taking a harder class next semester to just to avoid her.

This class isn't easy. It requires a lot of work, and the tests are made to trick you. Leslie is by far the best professor for this class, though. She is by far the BEST professor in the chem department. If you have her as an option as a professor, take her!!!! Orgo 1 is a very hard class, but she explains the concepts in a clear way.

Definitely a nice professor, but didn't approach teaching the class in the best way. Lectures arent very informative, u need to do a lot of studying and teaching on your own. this class has truly made my semester so much more stressful. chem is hard, but dr. knecht doesn't make it any easier. lectures consist of her doing examples that u have to follow along w rather than actually teaching the material. exams are nearly impossible to pass and are the bulk of ur grade. consider taking this class outside of UM if u can as all professors follow the same curriculum for 121.

Dr. Knecht and the entire Chemistry department at UM is absolutely phenomenal. I am so sad I will not have her for Chem 221 as she is an amazing professor. I do not get the hype over Dr. Knecht. Exams are very hard and do not reflect material and practice problems covered in class. reviews.comment: Orgo is a very difficult class, but Dr. Knecht made this class enjoyable! LESLIE WAS AWESOME! she was very entertaining. if chem is not your strong suit in general, you could prob struggle regardless. Absolutely loved her. She is so sweet and caring. If you listen well in lectures, she will tell you things about the tests. The tests are fairly hard and you will need to study a lot. But, she is just an amazing lecturer and very kind person.
The class has many exams and a lot of content, but she explains everything well. She makes you enjoy chemistry in her lectures, definitely take her!

She is by far the best teacher for this class. It is a very hard class in general, but she definitely helps explain as best as she can and is very nice. She is a very good teacher and I recommend her for this class.

CHM 214 is so difficult! I don't recommend it. I took one extra chemistry course to minor, however, I completely regret it. Advice from seniors: We took her class for 3 years. She is the most annoying/toughest professor you will encounter in chemistry courses. This class is very hard. The exams involved knowing all the details about chemical instruments and specifics were expected. Dr. Knecht's lecture style was pretty good at explaining the material, but for most of the course the learning involved creating group presentations about the topics which were hard to study from for the exams.

Best Professor Ever! Do not hesitate to take her you are doing yourself a favor. The material is hard but she breaks it down in a very easy way and is patient and caring enough to sit with you to help you. Geniounly cares for her students

Best Professor Ever! Do not hesitate to take her you are doing yourself a favor. The material is hard but she breaks it down in a very easy way and is patient and caring enough to sit with you to help you. Geniounly cares for her students!

i love leslie so much shes perfect if anyoe leaves a bad review they r mad they failed and didnt put effort shes the most kind caring hard working professor at UM shes way better then her husband #girlboss we love leslie all our nonSTEM friends even know of her shes famous around here she is a 10/10 chemistry queen shes amazing at teaching

BEST PROFESSOR I'VE EVER HAD!! She has amazing lectures, is very accessible outside of class, and gives you every possible resource to excel. Best teacher ever, choose her and go to class with passion

One of the best professors on the University of Miami campus. She explains Chemistry so clearly and so well even though Chemistry is complicated subject. I would take her if I can. Whatever you do, stay with the Knecht family when it comes to Chemistry.

Dr. K is so great! The material is organic chem so its naturally tough but the way she presents it and helps you in and out of class makes the material MUCH more manageable. Dr. Knecht is honestly a great teacher. The material itself is very challenging but she makes it as interesting as possible, and she really knows what she's talking about. You'll have to work hard but the way she explains things in class and during lecture helps a lot.
The best teacher I have ever had at UM. Makes chemistry as enjoyable as it can be. She is the sweetest, most helpful teacher on campus by far.

Dr. Knecht is a miracle worker. Dr. Knecht's teaching methods are just incredible, she knows exactly how to explain something in a way students will understand. Chemistry is a difficult course, Dr. Leslie Knecht goes above and beyond to make sure that her students succeed. Amazing individual and instructor. Truly wants her students to succeed. Great Professor. Learnt a lot. Be prepared to work hard.

Professor Rodriguez is very knowledgeable about media design and really cares about helping his students improve. For the most part the class is not stressful and you will do well if you put in effort.

Professor Rodriguez is a very passionate and caring professor. He works hard to create a fun and creative class for his students. May be the easiest class I've ever taken. Professor Kramer is a character - you will be laughing a lot. If you write the papers you get an automatic A. Would take again.
Take this guy if you have the option, he is amazing
My favorite professor in Freshman year is honestly the most down-to-earth and caring. Definitely would recommend it if you want to have an amazing freshman first-year writing course.

Awesome professor! Cares so much about her students and making sure they receive the grade they deserve with the work they put in. Very organized and keeps to the syllabus. Gives the class lots of discussion times, but make sure to participate!

awesome!
