The class is easy to understand and exams are straightforward. The two group projects are pretty intensive but she lays out her expectations clearly and grades fairly. Definitely take her!

Not a fan. Yes, she can be nice, but she takes her class too seriously and lessons can often get really boring, predictable, and robotic. Felt treated like a high schooler, with the rules being too uptight, behavior-based, and "by the book." If you want a decent grade take her, but don't expect to develop any interest in Marketing.

Prof. Kulkarni is so nice! She makes class pleasurable and interesting. Her tests and projects are fairly easy and the class is engaging and clear. You work with a group on 2 big projects at the beginning and end of the semester and you can't change groups between projects, this was fine for me but it could be stressful for others. Great professor!
The class and subject matter are simple enough. She takes attendance but you don't really need her lectures. Her tests come straight from the powerpoints she posts online. She's an ok teacher.

Prof Kulkarni is a kind and caring professor. The class is kind of common sense at times, so class gets a little boring. There is no homework in the class, 3 tests including the final, and 2 group projects. Just study notes and powerpoints and you'll do fine
Professor Kulkarni is a great professor! Fairly easy exams and the final is not cumulative. Rarely gives homework except to read cases from the textbook. Definitely recommend.
She's a really great marketing professor but is a bit old-school on her marketing knowledge, especially relating to social media marketing.

Professor Kulkarni is the sweetest lady ever! She is so kind and really cares about her students. She found some way to make marketing engaging. She has 3 tests total, including the final which ISN'T cumulative and 2 easy group projects. Definitely take her, especially if you are on the fence about which sector of business you want to major in!
Really nice lady, makes class not so boring.

Professor Kulkarni is a great professor! She's very clear about what will be on the tests and what is expected for group projects. For tests she gives study guides that are very helpful! Her class is actually interesting. I had her at 8:00 am Mon, Wed, Fri and I actually enjoyed going to class!

Professor Kulkarni is awesome. One of my favorite professors at UM. She is super kind and accommodating. She is super clear with her expectations and what you are responsible for, so it's a matter of if you follow through. Group projects: start ASAP and divide the work. For tests, read the textbook and you'll be fine. I recommend taking her class.
AMAZING LADY TAKE HER!

Amazing prof would 100% take again. Participation is important and she asks very reasonable questions. Completely accessible outside of class and is willing listen and work with you. Pretty simple tests, just read the her notes, supplement with textbook and you're golden. Attendance is key as she teaches well and gives great supplementary videos!
I really enjoyed this class and learned a lot. Not boring
Would definitely take again. Very clear and really cares about her students.
Not inspirational at all. Thick accent. Class is very boring.

She is one of the best professors at the university and really enjoys teaching the subject. She uses lots of videos to really hammer in her points. Two group projects but they are easy if you pick a good group.

I love Kulkarni! Her class is super interesting and she makes it easy to participate. You have to go to class, but I actually enjoy going. You can tell she really cares about her students and will take the time to help you if you need it. There are tests and two group projects. The tests are a little hard, but if you study the PPT's you'll be fine.
She is such a great professor! Her exams are based off of her power points that she posts online! She makes the classes and lectures very interesting, one of my favorite professors so far!
The exams are super easy. She gives you a study guide right before and a practice test. There are two group projects. Theyre pretty annoying but if you ask her any questions shes happy to help.
Fairly easy, projects are a little tedious, but almost no homework and tests are fairly easy. Class is enjoyable, she's funny and shows a lot of video clips

Dr Kulkarni is really nice. She lectures off of ppts but throws in videos and encourages discussion (don't worry, I didn't participate much and still did well) which makes it more interesting. Review ppts for exams and you won't need the textbook. Group projects. Overall pretty easy class.

Prof Kulkarni is extremely nice & knowledgeable. Each lecture is detailed and clear. She uses examples of videos, social media, etc. to make it relatable to the students. She gives a practice test and study guide before each of the 3 exams. She gives rubrics and is accessible outside of class for projects. Put in the work & it will be an easy A.
She is very clear and even gives study guides for exams so you know what to study. Read the textbook for exams and you're fine. The group projects are difficult so make sure to get a good group.

she really knows what she is talking about.  easy and great class, you learn a lot.  study guides are given for every test-- use them and you will get an A.  two group projects, pretty easy.  she is awesome!
A great professor. She keeps the class very engaging by showing examples of current marketing problems. Very easy grader and the final is not cumulative !!!

There are lots of group projects in this class so beware of that. This professor is kind of rude and doesn't create the best learning environment. That said, the material is not too difficult where it should make a big difference.

TAKE HER IF YOU CAN!! just show up to every class, participate as much as you can and pay attention in class and you will do well.  The tests are straight from the power points.  She is really nice and helpful but she gets frustrated when no one participates which is understandable.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Lectures are clear and interesting with lots of current examples. Material is very simple and easy to understand. If everyone made an effort to participate it would actually be a fun class. 2 group projects that are annoying but doable. Tests aren't bad as long as you study. Use the book to supplement because she rushes through topics sometimes

Professor Kulkarni is a great professor! She is very nice, and is always willing to help. Lectures are great because she shows relevant commercials/ads to enhance the material. There are 2 group projects. She gives you practice exams with a similar format to the exam. Exams are not hard if you study.

Take her!! Her lectures follow the book and she gives detailed study guides for tests plus a practice test during class so you know exactly what to expect. She assigns two projects and as long as you follow the rubric, you will get a good grade. She is very helpful and you can tell she knows what she is talking about.

Highly recommend her. The tests and lectures are completely based on the textbook so read that but class is helpful because she's straight forward and gives examples. There are a few group projects but she gives a good amount of time for them.

Follow the rubric strictly for the projects.  Memorize any kind of chart, table, etc for the test and you'll be fine.  Participation is worth way more than I would have liked for it to have been.  She also seemed to ignore the emails I sent her during the semester.  The course is overall very easy.
I loved her as a professor. She is incredibly helpful, and I learned a lot about marketing.

My least favorite professor. Class content is really annoying. Funny accent. She is willing to help if you ask for it. Always take attendance. You almost need to memorize the whole text book in order to take her exams.

Ms. Kulkarni is a great professor and her class is easy if you read all the material and listen in class. There were four tests and two group projects. She stresses participation and attendance. She knows her stuff and is willing to give you feedback if you ask for it.  Just attend class and ask for clarification if you need, and you'll do fine.

Professor Kulkarni is a great professor and every class is relevant. She grades harshly on the group projects however so spend extra time on those to make sure they are great. Her tests are difficult but it is nothing that she hasn't covered in class, so make sure to pay attention. Easy B but a little extra push is needed to get the A.

Had her at 9am but she made class entertaining by almost always showing a 5-10 minute video. Gives out study guides for each test. She is kind of a harsh grader, but read the chapters and master the study guide and you'll be all set.

Pretty helpful. She provided study materials on blackboard and was always available in her office. Class was awful, though. Kulkarni rambles on ENDLESSLY during lectures and gives a boatload of examples and you have no idea what material is unimportant and what you need to know. The textbook is filled with a bunch of useless crap, too.

She was a decent teacher but I did not enjoy this class. Expect to memorize a bunch of ridiculous, meaningless marketing jargon (i.e. 7-step communications process). She does have a tendency to ramble on during class but thankfully she hands out study guides listing all of the material you need to know for the exams.

She is the greatest professor I have had the pleasure of taking. The class she teaches is very clear and straight forward. The tests, as long as you take her study guide and make it as detailed as possible, an A or high B is definitely possible.

Definitely take her!! She is an amazing professor who clearly wants her students to succeed. She shows videos almost every class based on the topic being discussed, making class much more interesting as she relates the material to the outside world.4 non cumulative tests,2 group projects. Amazing person/professor, take her if you can!!

Dr. Kulkarni is a great teacher. She makes it very easy to understand the basics of marketing. She teaches off of her powerpoints, but uses real world examples to get you to understand. No homework. Tests aren't difficult. Two group projects are very easy. Absolutely take her if you can.

She is a great teacher! She gives examples for everything and makes sure you understand it all. Pay attention because she'll ask you your opinion on topics. She likes when people get involved. Overall, she's extremely nice and very knowledgeable. Definitely take her!

Class was clear, to the point, and interesting.  She's a nice lady and as someone stated, she offers good real-world examples for all the various concepts.  Focus HEAVILY on the text, do read every chapter and take your own notes apart from lecture notes.  If you read every chapter, take good notes, and memorize the notes you'll get an A.

Professor Kulkarni is extremely knowledgeable of the subject and she has a real world example for every concept she teaches. She makes sure to keep you engaged throughout the entire course and she is always available for office hours. Tests aren't bad at all as long as you pay attention to her lectures

She is an interesting and easy professor. SHe keeps class engaging and if you really listen to her, you are not bored at all. Tests are not that hard at all. And even if you skip the class you can find all information in the text book. She is a very nice professor.

A very nice and easy going person. Class can get a little boring at times as Marketing has jargon for even the most simple concepts. Pay attention in class and review the textbook to get a good grade. The professor is knowledgeable and willing to help anyone. She takes attendance, so beware of that
Easy teacher, engaging, keeps class interesting.

Great teacher.  Very clear in explaining concepts and very helpful when speaking after class or in office hours.  Tests are based off her study guides but you need to read the book to do well on the tests--only read the parts that she puts on the study guide though.  Good class, solid teacher, not a ton of work but go to class and study moderately.

I think she's awesome teacher. You don't even need to buy the Text cause the tests come from her Powerpoints. She gives you what material is going to be on the Test. She does take attendance be aware!

Attendance Mandatory.  Hard to understand.  You use the book a lot but most of the tests are from the notes.  Tests aren't too difficult.  The group project is 40% of your grade and she never tells you what you get on it.  It was difficult to sit through her lectures but you see a video every class which is fun. Not hard, but take at your own risk

Solid class, solid teacher. Tests come from powerpoints, and she posts a study guide prior to each test. There is a mandatory marketing plan at the end of the semester which is a big portion of your grade. Overall a good class with not much work required.

She's a good teacher.  I really enjoyed this class. I really liked all of the videos she made us watch because it helps break up the class time.  The tests are easy as long as you study what she puts on the study guides.
i really enjoyed her class. She made the material seem easy and clear. She always had a video to help us understand the topic she was about to teach. highly recommended
Very easy, tests come straight from the book or assigned articles. Mandatory marketing plan.
She's nice, never very much homework.  Kind of rambles about random stuff, but just study from the book and you'll do well--the tests are easy.  Nice woman, strong accent. I would take her again.

She has a very strong accent and treats us like we are still in kindergarten. She'll ask everyone to write something down and then we will ALL have to share. (It's a class of like 50). Boring  boring boring and she just banned computers from the classroom.
Very simple assignments if you actually tried. Many extra credit opportunities. Very boring lectures and forced discussions.
Super nice. Be prepared for meme filled slideshows and heavy lectures but shes honestly so sweet and you will get an A if you show you care.
She is amazing and so nice everyone should take her its an easy A
Amazing class!
I really enjoyed this professor and found her to be very kind. There is a fair amount of coursework but if you do the work you'll receive a good grade.
Not good at all
Awesome. Super caring and nice. All of the assignments are super easy but she does give a lot of work. The class was a highlight of my freshman year.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Her classes are delightful, and her vibe makes you feel it's a good class. I wouldn't take it again because she sends way to much work, but other then that she is a great professor.

Very knowledgeable in the subject of creative writing. Grade is 50% participation and 50% your final portfolio so make sure your engaged in discussions. She is a very lenient grader when it comes to assignments and if you put in effort towards all the assignments you'll receive a 10/10. There is no final. Overall very nice and good professor.

I don't know why there are no ratings about her! She is so kind and caring. She is very passionate about creative writing and she is a very lenient grader! If she gives weekly homework (which isn't heavy) and if she sees you made an effort she will alway give a 10/10. I completely recommend! You will love her and the classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: I had Jacqueline Ballantyne as the instructor, who teaches the class - Dr. Krempels designs the labs/assignments and provides materials. Labs not too hard. There is pre-lab homework. You'll usually finish lab early and might have stuff to complete after. Attendance mandatory. Easy final presentation. Jackie explained the labs well and supported us.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Took Bio150 Lab with her TA Jacquelin, great class. Jackie explained everything well and did her best to not make the lab too long. Open note quizzes before class each week and a end of year quiz not really based on the class, just regular biology knowledge. Interesting class.

Quirky but honestly a great prof. Exams are usually open-note, so as long as you reference the lectures, you'll do great. She also offers bonus points if you go to class. Sometimes she will bring in her rabbit.

oh my gosh i am a senior and this is the worst class i taken at UM.  its so bad the tests are impossible & contradict what she teaches. if she tells u smth is right in class it  still be marked wrong on the test. I had an easier time in organic chemistry II and physics II than this plant class. She directly throws shade at pre-med students in lect

Professor Krempels' BIL160 class is challenging, but engaging if you stay focused. The open-note exams are tricky, so utilizing resources like Unstuck ai alongside thorough note-taking can really help. Overall, a worthwhile course if you're willing to put in the effort.

All tests are online, open note, internet, and anything that is not a "living being" so AI is on the table too. Due to this, the tests are VERY difficult and end up being curved heavily. Take notes and make them easy to refer back to and you'll do great. Go to class, because there are extra credit opportunities in almost all of them.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The tests are online and open notes which is great! but its so easy to do poorly on them because if you get one wrong in a matching section it can take away all the points you actually got. I studied for hours and only got up to an 80 which was so annoying because I actually knew the material.
Great Professor. Her atheism made me uncomfortable.
Was a good teacher but was really confusing at times and tests were really hard but were online
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Krempels was a great professor and I really enjoyed her lectures; they were easy to follow and applicable to exams. Her tests were sometimes challenging, but open note and she offers a lot of extra credit. She was a wonderful person and very knowledgeable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment:
Frustrating, Unavailable, Lazy
1. "Office hours" by appointment only but won't respond to emails
2. Makes errors on exams then creates excuse why won't change grade even if she's blatantly wrong (or admits its wrong but wont change anyway)
3. Says it's application class for general understanding but asks hyper specific questions ab dates/people
Very lecture heavy with extremely  boring lectures. Exams are open note but worded very difficultly, making it much harder to do well. Take another BIL 160 professor if possible.

Easily the worst BIL 160 option. Grades only based on exams, workshop, and bonus points (you must keep track). Knowing your grade before the final is nearly impossible. Had 4 exams while every other section had 3. Hardest exams I've taken in my entire life. Studied for HOURS and got a C every time. Boring lectures and a disorganized class website
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: tests are extremely difficult the curve for tests leaves almost everyone with a C which can be good or bad depending how you look at it, bonus points given throughout are helpful shes very funny but her class is very unorganized

Krempel's class has a lot of information to take in. Getting an A is very manageable if you test well and put in the effort to study. She is a nice person and she really does care about the information she is presenting. Would easily take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Taking this class was my biggest regret at UM. Tests are impossible despite being open note, and the curve is not as big as people say it is. Go to  class to get all of the bonus points, they help a lot! She wants this class to be a weed out so badly because she has a grudge against pre meds. Try to take someone else.

Professor Krempels was hard. Her exams are open note, but it doesn't mean they're easy to any extent. You still need to study A LOT in order to get at least 80 or above on every exam. There are bonus points which do help, but the exams themselves are super thorough & require you to actually understand the topic instead of just memorizing it.

DO NOT TAKE FOR BIL 160!!! you will actually fail I have As in all my classes even Chemistry and I think i have a C in this class when it should be so easy. Her tests are actually impossible everyone gets Cs and Ds and the way she curves gives everyone a C. if you are pre-med her class will ruin you. also the lecture is the most boring thing ever
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: BIL160 the hardest thing I have ever done in my entire life. I have never gotten a bad grade until I took this course. lectures and website unorganized, hardest tests ever, makes no sense. its so awful and I had a 4.0 my whole life until I took this class and now I fail everything after studying for 8 hours a day. curve not fair at all. horrible.

You need to understand the material well for the tests since the multiple answer questions make it difficult. Since my class was remote, the tests were open book, so I was able Ctrl + F through my notes. Idk how I would've done it wasn't open notes... You'll learn a lot, but take her if you have the time to really study. She's funny too!

Her class was really interesting to take because she knows a ton about very specific topics. A problem with that is that she is can get off topic pretty easily, leading students to have to take the lead and go through the slides on their own time. The way she grades is also pretty confusing but it ends up working out gradewise.

I love Dr. Krempels! She's the sweetest lady ever. Her tests were really difficult though (in my opinion). The curve is very generous. Make sure to do every bonus question in her lectures and workshops.

i love dana. 160 is a rollercoaster review of organisms, so its a lot of memorization and understanding. but when i tell you that i would go to lunch and listen to her life story, i mean it. she makes class interesting, and she really wants to form relationships with her students. searching for another of her classes to take.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Tons of bonus points but the exams are extremely difficult. More than half the class averages around a D for every exam. The lectures are extremely boring as well.
She is the best for BIL 160 hands on. Just read her powerpoints and you will get the A.

Krempels is a gem. I am so bad at biology but her class actually didn't make me want to spiral into a manic episode. During the final exam she lets her bunnies hop around the lecture hall and it was distracting because they are so cute but it gave me the serotonin levels I needed to continue on. She's great and she the prof I would take for BIL160
THE CURVE & BONUS POINTS WILL SAVE YOU
Krempels is the best bio teacher at UM. Just memorize all the definitions in the textbook and you will be fine. She also gives a gigantic curve.
I love Dr. Krempels! Her class is hard but she makes you learn. The class also boosted my GPA.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is the best for BIL 160. I got an A but this is an insanely hard class. Her tests were the hardest I have ever taken... BUT she realizes that, and gives an insane curve and 40 bonus points that can being you from a D to an A. Just get an 80+ on every test and you're chilling.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Best choice for BIL 160. She gives a lot of bonus points but you HAVE TO BE IN CLASS! Lectures are definitely boring, just memorize EVERYTHING from her website. She's also very scatterbrained but like just study as much as you can and show up to class and you can get an A.

Krempels is the top choice for BIL160. She gives great lectures, has great notes, and gives out study guides to help with the tests. She doesn't take attendance but gives you extra credit opportunities if you go to class, take advantage of these, they got me from a B to an A. She also curves the class so it's a lot easier to do well. TAKE HER.
I took this class a few semesters ago and it was a challenge. However, she is the best teacher for 160. Hands down. Just memorize every single word on the website and you will be okay.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Krempels is really passionate biology, but she can be frustrating as a professor. The whole class is based on exams and workshops. Exam material comes directly from her website so forget the book. Make sure you go to class for bonus quizzes. I found workshops and studying in groups really helped for this class. I would def recommend taking her.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Krempels is one of the most intelligent professors at UM, but she assumes that we are all as intelligent as she is... She is great at teaching, but her BIL160 class is extremely challenging. The first two exams are extremely hard. The last three are nearly impossible. There's a reason why she curves so much and gives out so many bonus points.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class shouldn't be as hard as she makes it out to be... She is a great teacher however. You really have to work hard to get an A. Pull off three all nighters before the test and you should be fine. Her curve and the bonus points can save you from failing.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: This was the hardest class I have ever taken, but she is the best teacher I have ever had. She really challenged me, and now I know so much about evolution and biodiversity.
Dr. Krempels is amazing! Had to work very hard, but worth it.

Dr. Krempels classes are some of the easiest to pass in all of the bio department. The exams come straight from her website (memorize every word and youll get an A for sure). I believe a 48-50% ended up being a C, and like an 85 was an A. Also, she gives a lot of bonus points in lecture and usually a few on the exams too. Not a difficult class

I love Dr. Krempels so much, such a sweet lady and SO funny. The color scheme for her lecture presentations could use some work. Very easy A for the PRISM section of BIL160. Has extra credit opportunities daily in class. Super snarky (in a good way) and makes a very boring subject fun to learn. Curves the class very generously.

Dana knows her stuff and gets students excited about it too. I took her for genetics and ecology. Seems like people here don't like that she puts the notes on a website, but it's SO convenient! You listen to her in class then study from the website later. By attending class you can get bonus points that are sure to boost your grade in the end.

Extremely intelligent professor, she teaches the class well, although the lectures are very long and contain a lot of information. This class requires a fair amount of studying and understanding of the concepts.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures are all online and in class she is completely useless. She says exactly what is on the lectures. She gives bonus questions but you have to be in class. Tests are VERY difficult and are the only grades. Would not recommend.

*BIL360 (Comp Phys): 5 tests total and in-class quizzes (some bonus). One of my favorite classes at UM. It isn't easy tho. You have to actually STUDY to actually LEARN. Great class for visual learners+ engaging. The Green brothers become your best friends. Only thing I didnt like was that sometimes class website was edited a few days before exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She only uses her lecture notes in class and has been for years. They are still full of mistakes and typos that make concepts much more confusing and difficult to understand. Seems to care a lot less about her class than most of her students as she hasn't taken the care to change these or make sure her notes made sense in the first place.
Personally, I enjoyed this class but also it is a lot of work especially if you are not a biology major. Kremples lectures are clear and she is very accessible and personable.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Very outgoing and friendly person, you can tell she loves what she does. Lectures however are very confusing, and her explaining them doesn't help much. Study her lectures both in class and separately. Tests ask both overall analysis questions & extremely specific fact questions. Heavily curved. An A is possible but really have to work for it.

Don't really know how I felt about this class the way she teaches is awesome and I love her lectures the bell curve just sucks sometimes and sometimes it does help but I rather have a regular curve I find myself wanting to do better than classmates rather than wanting to learn and I hate that it promotes competition a little and I'm not happy w/ it
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Good professor, very helpful in office hours. She has 3 tests and a final, and curves each of them quite heavily. For last two tests, an A was 84% and the first an A was 88%. I made a 92%+ on every test -- it's really not too difficult of a class if you just review her lecture notes and go to her office whenever you need clarification! No textbook
lecture notes are online so you dont really have to go, tests are pretty easy if you study
I literally never went to class and got 2 As and a high B on the 3 midterms. She posts all lectures online and reads directly from them in class. Good option for BIL160.

Dr. Kremples truly cares about the content she teaches, students, and her animals. She is very funny and tries hard to make sure lectures are fun. Her tests can be a bit difficult but she offers extra credit and curves each exam.

Her lectures are very long and she often resorts to using videos to teach rather than explaining topics herself. Her test questions tend to be very odd. She grades on a bell curve and assigns grades at the very end of the semester, so you never really know your grade until the very end of the semester. She does not post grades to blackboard.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is a really good teacher who is passionate about what she does.  The tests are hard but not if you actually put effort in and study a decent amount. She is really clear about everything that is going to be on the test so it's pretty easy to do well if you're willing to put in effort.

Took her for genetics over the summer, and she made paying $5,000 for one class worth it. So funny, straight forward material, her tests can be tricky but if you study her notes you'll be fine--her curve is incredible. I was so scard to take her b/c of these comments but she's fantastic!! Take her if you can, very nice lady, and very knowledgeable

Do not take even if you have to wait an extra semester to get bil 160. She goes off on random tangents every lecture that are irrelevant to the class. The tests have nothing to do with any lectures at all. Unless youve memorized every species of animals and their originals, along with the entire textbook, youll do terrible. Dont take this class

not a favorite class. If I went I showed up late and never really paid attention. In fact I'm in her class and really bored right now. I didn't like the way Dana lectures. It's hard to differentiate what she says that's important and what is her freaking out about how cool plants are! Overall nice woman, never paid attention still got an A

Very, very good professor. She makes lectures very entertaining and if you are interested in the material you will absolutely love going to class. There is a huge curve so most of the class receives As and Bs. Her tests reflect the material on the lecture notes so going to class is not necessarily mandatory. Definitely take her if you can!
Took BIO 106 with her, class was just to fill cognate. Easy A, she posts study guides telling you what to study for the exam. Barely went to class. Nice lady.
READ READ READ!!! The most important thing if you want to pass this class

WORST PROFESSOR AT UM. Yes, shes "nice". But that has nothing to do with being a horrible professor. Her tests are very unclear. 50 questions and most are a paragraph long. She trys to trick you in the exam. 80% of her (250 students) class got a 60 on her exams. Save your GPA!!!!

Dr. Krempels is hilarious, and very relatable. Yes, she does read STRAIGHT off the PowerPoints that she posts online, but still going to class is important because if you don't you have to work more to study. Just trust me on that. I went to every class, didn't pay attention much, and still got good grades. Other ppl didn't go and got bad grades.

Great professor. Extremely passionate about evolution & biodiversity, and posts all notes online. Many complaints are from people who think they can use these to skip class, and then are surprised if they fail the tests. For those who do attend, she makes everything enjoyable through fascinating videos and other visualizations. Highly recommended!

Dana Krempels is the worst teacher I have had at UM to this point. The only thing she does in class is she reads off her own notes which means you don't have to go to class but then her notes are not enough for the test which really sucks. Her tests are really hard and extremely unclear. Don't take Krempels for BIL 160.

I'm not sure how she is as a teacher, because I only had her for a freshman biology seminar. However, what I will say is that she is an INCREDIBLY lovely lady. She's very sweet and willing to help students with any biology-related questions they may have. She seems VERY knowledgeable about her subject. I would definitely take her for a bio class!

This teacher was awesome. I went to her office hours all the time, she'd answer my questions by email/ after class. got an A+ and I'm not a science major. really helpful and cared about students learning the material. I only felt bad for her because some of the freshman taking her class were so rude because they didn't want to do a lot of studying.

The class is pretty boring but Krempels is a great professor who makes class very entertaining by playing videos and sharing funny stories with us! Her exams are hard but manageable if you attend class and read the book. She gives extra credit which helps a lot and curves her tests!

I suggest Krempels over Sarkar for sure. While Krempel's tests aren't that easy, they're not impossible. Study the online lecture notes and read the book to help you better understand the material and you should get an A with the help of her curve. Curve depends on how others do, so it's different for every test. Also gives bonus points on tests!

To be honest, Krempels is very helpful. The test is hard which you need to fully understand the material. But she curved. Also this class is possible to get a good grade. Just like she said, if you paid attention to this classes, you will be fine.Once we have a class taught by Sarkar, to be honest, she is moody and worse than Krempels.

This class ruined my 4.0 GPA. And I'm a junior. She's a great person but this class was unnecessarily difficult and even when you think you understand everything, you are lucky if you get a B on the tests (with the curve already included). wah

One of my least favorite professors at UM...she reads straight off of slides despite claiming she's super passionate about Evolution, and the class becomes impossible to pay attention in...writes horribly worded tests, and answers your questions with just as useless pseudo-intellectual crap. Poor teacher, but the subject itself is not hard.

I didn't go to class practically at all and was able to get an A by studying her lectures online (really clear and straightforward) and backing it up with reading the textbook. She's a good professor and grades on a curve that will boost you up a few points. I definitely recommend this class for BA's that need to satisfy science credits

She is very interested in her subject and she encourages students to care as well. I liked her, but my one issue with her is the way she teaches. She spends all class reading from her online notes. This can get really boring (although she does sometimes have breaks to show us YouTube videos or other examples), and I've fallen asleep on lectures.

She gives hard exams, which is shocking because practice exams are given to use. They're not that helpful though. I attended class and had to read the book because she just doesn't do a good job at explaining the material. Science professors are in general very hard but if you can take someone else, do so.

Interesting topic but she reads right off of the slides. It is extremely difficult to stay focused the entire hour and 15 minutes of class. To give you an idea, it is a 20 lecture but only 40 or so show up on a regular basis.

Dr. Krempels gives extremely interesting lectures and is clearly very passionate about the subject. Her tests are pretty difficult, especially if you fall behind in any way. Reading the text isn't mandatory, but it definitely helped clarify difficult concepts. Dr. Krempels is always willing to help and is extremely approachable. Tough, but doable.

A lot of material, avoid cramming. She makes the material as interesting and as easy to remember as possible. She provides study guides and practice exams. Tricky exams, but if you really understand her notes you should at least get a B.

Dr. Krempels is perhaps one of the nicest people I have ever known. She is an amazing person but her course is very very hard. Only take her if you are willing to put in a lot of work. A lot of people complain about her curve, but in reality it only helps you. I would take her again and I am taking her again for Genetics. Wonderful professor!

shes entertaining and funny. huge curve for a C so youre always safe from failing. she does use applied knowledge questions so dont just memorize. you need to know it. gives extra credit chances that are pretty easy. great notes so study moderately a week before the test you should end up with at least B/B+. its not too horrible and shes helpful.

Her lectures are interesting, and shes very passionate and knowledgeable about the subject. Her tests are difficult if youre not strong in biology, but her bell curve will get you a C either way. So basically, take her only if you know alot about biology and are willing to study and can get that A, or dont and get a C.

she's ok, nice lady personally but it's that bell curve. It helps you if you are of the mentality of C's get degrees to to be honest in the average level of intellect and average workers it helps. however if your a typical b student who isn't the top 20% in smartness it screws you over a bit. so honestly judge your class if everyone is premed leave

Not very helpful and asked very odd questions on the tests. About 80% of the class gets a C or below. Her grading is ridiculous and doesn't reflect how hard you work and how well you understand the material.

Such an easy class. Take her if you have some interest in science. It can be boring and drag on at times, but it is pretty interesting usually. All her notes are online, so you don't have to show up, but it's helpful.

Attendance is not mandatory--practically no one ever showed up. When I did, I was bored out of my mind. She's a nice lady and is more than happy to explain if you have questions, however the material just didn't interest me. She puts all the notes and study guides online, which helps and is pretty much the only reason I didn't fail the class.

Great professor, she really makes genetics interesting. You really don't need the book, but it can sometimes help to clear up confusing topics that you don't understand in class. Her curve is not like how people say - she only lets it HELP you, not hurt you. Very challenging class, but it's worth it to take with her, I learned a lot.

First of all you dont need the book at all. Yes the class is difficult and the tests are pretty hard. You have to study and know how to apply things. Half of the things she said to study on the final wasnt, but by studying ALOT before the tests, it is manageable to  get a B or an A.

Wow I agree with the person below. I would rather eat a rabbit than take that class again. I was one of the 60% or so who gets Cs. I'm still trying to wrap my head around how it's possibly fair to do that. My advice to you: take someone else if you care about your GPA. She also isn't helpful. Stands there and reads her notes.

Ok, so here is my take on it.  If you don't want to do much work, take her.  I didn't go to class as she posts them all online.  Also, you don't have to sit and do all the problems like with Wilson.  BUT she is incredibly difficult and only 10% get As and like 70% get Cs or lower.  I hope I passed the final (twas hard)!
Super nice lady, but I would rather eat a rabbit than take this class again. GET HER OUT OF HERE.

Seriously, she's awful.  Take Sarkar.  Not only does her class suck, but so does her personality...not to mention she dresses like a hippie.  You will study SO much to get a low B which is very discouraging. TAKE SARKAR.
Good professor, incredibly hard exams... Do not take her if you don't expect to study every day.

For all non-majors, she is AWESOME! attendance is not mandatory and she puts her powerpoints and lectures online and ALWAYS gives a study guide in which u can just not go to class and learn the study guide before the test and get an A! Thats what i did!
She is an AMAZING teacher.... she is always willing to help and will make fun comments.... Eventhough im in a comm mayor y really enjoyed  her classes and would recommend her!

My honest opinion of BIL 162? Krempels- She curves, but on her tests you have to apply things not just memorize, and nothing is from the book. Sarkar- Prepare to memorize the book and she doesn't curve but do-able. Go to both, pick a teacher that can give you the info and prepare for the test. Since the topic itself is boring,I never went to class!

She is a very nice person to talk to and she is  enthusiastic. On the negative side, she makes you go to class when she reads directly from notes provided online. I studied everyday for 8 hours to get a C; my first ever. 270 pages (book) worth of notes and she gives a test based on less than 100 pages. Over 60% C, 15-20% D or F, 10-15% A or B.

Evolution and biodiversity isn't really fun. She's super enthusiastic about it though, I"ll give her that. She's super....creative? I thought her tests were hard cuz she gives you the info then plays out all these weird scenarios and asks you questions. It was hard. But really, I dunno that your other options are any better. Study ahead of time.
GOD, HATE this lady.

lots of info about plants and animals.  She grades on a curve so 60% of the class gets a C.  The material is hard but Professor Kremples is really enthusiastic about it.  She is quirky and fun to have teaching class.

She's a good person, and great to get to know... but just not my kind of professor. She reads off of her lecture notes and spends half the class going off on tangents,and provides an exact copy of her lecture notes online-but she expects you to come to class anyway. I don't recommend this class, but if you take it, try to get to know her.

Her lectures were clear and she was an enthusiastic lecturer. Her tests on the other hand were spotted with half-baked questions that better tested your ability to read her mind then recall and apply info
wors't class, I dropped with a W.
did NOT like this class!!!

A lot of views over Krempels. She is hard, but she grades on a curve which regardless what anyone has to say only helps your grade. I did not really read much of the book but tried to pay attention in class. You need to open up to animals/plants to be interested. She is funny, and quirky. TAKE ADVANTAGE of the extra credit and time for review Qs!

if you take this professor you are going to regret. i studied really hard from her notes and the book and i got a c. if you want to spend the weekend reading about evolution take her. she uses to grade her test an impossible curve.

Her Biology of Gender Class is easy and interesting. Some weekly reading and one group powerpoint presentation is all that's required. This class is about sex & evolution, and Dr. K always had some interesting things to contribute.

She is really hard. MEMORIZE all lectures, click and read ALL the links she links to. You don't really need to take notes or go to class that much because what she does is just elaborate a little on what's already on the notes. I studied for 3-4 days prior to the exam memorizing the notes and looking up things I didn't know from the book. Got an A

I'm a science major.B+ and A- in chems and bio 150.So i do my work and go to class, her tests are ridiculously hard.Her bell curve sucks, because you can easily slack off and get a C,or u can find urself getting much better grades than ppl but end up the same.She is not helpful at all in her office.She's gross.AVOID this class!I DDEESSPPIISSEE HER.

I may be biased because I work for her but she is the nicest person there is. Sure her tests may be a little hard but if you go to class or even just actually read the book and study u will do well in her class. You can't expect to be able to slack off. Her curve may seem bad but it keeps a lot of ppl from failing the class, a C is better than an F

lectures are boring but she does her best to help you make sense of the material. Very accomodating for pre-test reviews and extra credit opportunities. Answering exam questions requires strong comprehension of material and being able to "connect the dots", thus memorization alone wont help you. Sarkar might be easier, but no regrets on Kremples.

Her tests are very hypothetical and very tricky. Her lectures are great and interesting, but they do not at all prepare you for the test. In order to get a decent grade you must read the book and FULLY MEMORIZE and understand every word on the lectures. Expect to get nothing more than a C in this class given the impossible bell curve.
her tests are hard, no doubt about it. however, she explains everything so that you get it. extremely helpful.

First of all this woman secretly hates students. She also thinks she is a great writer and writes her tests like logic puzzles. Don't trust her she will try to mislead you. I honestly believe she is evil and should retire. Some people just shouldn't be teachers and she is one of them.

She is a cool person and an ok teacher,BUT her tests are ridiculous. When I went to her for help she admitted to me that she intentionally writes test questions to trick students. They are not a measure of your knowledge of botany, but instead how well you take her tests. Don't get me wrong I LOVE botany, but I HATE her class. It's just not right.

Botany wasnt as boring as I thought it would be.Remeber guard cells have chloroplasts unlike other epidermal cells, and you'll be find without the book. Study from the lecture notes. Expect HUGE curves. Test questions involve thinking. Can review your old test in her office before the final. Extra credit offered.

One of my favorite classes that I've taken at UM. Her lecture notes are clear, attend class and write addiotnal notes on them. Also, study the Campbell book... do the chapter quizzes at the end because a lot of the test questions come out of that (and the quizzes that campell puts online is another source for test questions)...I got an "A"..
Her test are almost impossible, and her curve sucks. She gives interesting lectures, which don't help for the test

So there's no point in going to class because she lectures straight from online notes & she always goes off on tangents. I didn't put much effort into this class so I can't judge her too much but when I did start to study(when finals came around), it was too late. That's when I finally learned something. She's nice but not helpful & her curve sucks

After taking this horrid class, I never hated animals, especially RABBITS, so much until now!  Going to class and paying EXTRA attention is a must; but honestly, how can you if the lady goes off on so many tangents with her google search?  Tests were irrelevant to the material she provided.  Don't believe that she'a great lecturer!

She is a really great teacher. She knows her stuff, and is really passionate about it. She is extremely difficult, though. Don't go in expecting an easy A. Her tests are all applications of knowledge, and she grades based on a bell curve. Take her if you want to learn, take someone else if you want an easy A.

She's kinda funny and interesting at times... googling images here and there that relate to lectures, in addition to narrating stories. Even so, the material can be nap-inducing and she grades so that 60% of the class WILL get a C. Not cool. Run away!!

Great lecturer, not so great tests.  Sooo much material, and the tests are picky with several "None of the Above" type answers.  If you study a lot though, you'll be fine. Very enthusiastic. Best lecturer I've had so far.

I took her Genetics class over the summer. It is completely possible to get an A with enough study. Loved her teaching style and wacky sense of humor. I would definitely take another class with this professor.

I took Dr. Krempels for genetics over the summer of 2006 and it was the best bio class I had taken. It was one of the easiest A's I have gotten. She was awesome over the summmer. I did however have her for BIL160 and she was a hard teacher and her test were very difficult - It was like having 2 different people.

The class was difficult, but I think she is the bet genetics professor at UM. She's a bit eccentric, but very interesting and knowledgeable. If you have to take genetics, I'd suggest taking it with Dr. Krempels.
No Comments

I love her weird style and her sense of humor. She provides all the notes needed for the class. All you need to do is attend class and understand what she is talking about. No need to read the book. She is very interesting and is by far the best science teacher I've ever had.

This class is way harder than it should be considering it's a 106 intro zoology class for NON-majors. It covers a ton of material. Lectures are boring and she posts all the notes on the course website. The tests are  tricky and VERY specific- you HAVE to study. She gives 2 extra credit opportunities during the semester, but still would NOT recommend

Excellent professor but tough! She knows her stuff and is passionate about the material. The exams are difficult and confusing but she is always accessible to students. Also she gives several extra credit opportunitities which is helpful.

This class is extremely boring. I recommend you do not take this class. The teacher goes on and on about boring animals. THe notes are posted online, however, the tests are extremely hard. The tests are very tricky. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS
She is a really good teacher. You' ll more learn than with other professors, but her test are really hard and specific even if you study alot
The class is not hard, no need to go to lecture because her notes are all online. Tests are difficult and definately require alot of studying. Good sense of humor

She reads directly off of online notes. I stopped going to lectures one month after the class began and still got an A. Exams were difficult so studying is necessary. The book can be helpful but all of the test material is covered in her notes. The topic of the course is boring so unless BIL160 is a requirement do not take this course with any prof

Course has a lot of material, though Professor Krempels puts all notes online, then reviews them in class.  Google image searches, along with the computer sometimes falling asleep make the class interesting.  Tests are multiple choice, but you need to study for them.  Overall, it's a course worth taking if you need a science requirement.
Krempels gives very interesting lectures, her tests are somewhat difficult but they are no problem if you study.
Boring subject, she'll teach it well enough. A plus to the boring animals is that she is funny.
Hate the class. tests are really hard! DO NOT TAKE HER!!!!!
Dr. Kremples is very enthusiastic and funny. She is a great professor. Her tests are kind of hard, but you will be fine if you study. Definitely recommended!

Professor Krempels is by far one of the best teachers I've ever had.  Her lectures are extremely interesting and easy to grasp and she makes the material come to life (constant google image searches for the different animals she talks about).  The test are multiple choice, but are tough, yet fair.  Not a gimme class by any means but fun.
No Comments

Dr. Krempels taught me everything I needed to know about life.  She is not only tough, but she's hilarious.  I nominate her for the Professor of the Year. And that rabbit fetish, forget about it.  Think of her as a freedom fighter in the name of rabbits everywhere.
Dr. Kremples was always available to help.  She once spent 2.5 hours explaining a concept to me, using 2 blackboards.  There should be more professors like her!

Let me just say that in spite of going to class when the lecture notes could be printed from online when I was there, and aside from the big a-- bunny/rabbit/dog she had running around her lab/office, I did some of the best experiments in this woman's class.  You'll definitely get out of her course what you put in, but don't look for her to entertain you.  Learn if you will....

First of all, she writes the lab manual for BIL161 - so when you take the lecture, 160, with her, you're really getting a good deal. She's extremely interested in all the topics - you are NEVER bored. She will make you laugh with her "google searches." For anyone who has to take a Biology class, see if she's teaching it - you won't regret it. And yes, she may be slightly obsessed with her rabbits, but so what? She's crazy cool.
No Comments

Zoology is really interesting but Krempels really saturates the class with a loy of information. It's a lot of studying, and she very willing to help. Her tests are very tricky, and overall she is a super nice person.

Krempels tests may be the trickiest I have ever taken. Fortunately the lab coincides with only her class.  If you aren't interested in evolution than I suggest taking another professor.  She is extremely intelligent on the subject of evolution and if you're not completely prepared she will make your bio grades miserable.
awsome lady, she is definitely a cool person

ok so this women is ungodly smart there is no doubt about that but her class is really hard. At first i thought i was ok to miss the lectures and just read all the notes but i got behind super fast. This is not the right class for a person who is not super interested in it
She's the smartest woman I've ever met in my life.
Nice lady.
For students who are not interested in science she can be hell. Extremely hard!
VERY HELPFUL AND FUNNY. SHE IS HARD BUT I LEARNED A LOT WITH HER. IF YOU WANT TO GET AN "A" NEVER LAG BEHIND HER LECTURES!!! TO ME, SHE IS THE BEST CHOICE FOR GENETICS
Definitely wacky. But she makes it interesting and at least the labs and class coordinate. Definitely study for this one. Its not as easy as it might seem.
she's nuts, but she's worth it! -- the lecture and lab go hand in hand ;) plus, even if you don't do well, you'll understand the material better than if you'd have taken it with someone else.
Hard as hell, take your class with someone else.
Really nice, Prof. Lectures were not mandatory for attendance, but labs were. Pretty straightforward class, he answers all questions and really will not let you fail.

If I were to recommend any class at UM, it would be this one. No exams, just show up and listen to all of his interesting lectures. I'm not very tech-savvy, and I found this class very easy. There are "quizzes," but they only make up a small percentage of your grade, nothing that you have to study for.

I had to take a computer science class for my major and I'm so happy i took this one. Professor Kuhl made the class so interesting and engaging and is also such an easy A. His class is fun! Theres no exams, lots of practicums that are fun, and not a lot of homework. He cares a lot about his subject though and passionate so definitely show up!
GREAT PROF TAKE HIS CLASS
AMAZINGGGG TAKE HIS CLASS

I couldn't recommend her class more. She is one of the sweetest most caring professors I have ever had, and is so understanding. She speaks from her personal experiences coming from Czech Republic and is extremely knowledgable and well-versed in INS topics. She is so passionate about what she teaches and it really does make the class more valuable.
Such a legend - very kind professor. Makes class very easy.

I could not hear a word of her lectures because she speaks so quietly, and I was in the 3rd row. In the first week of class, she let us pick how we wanted to be graded. Attendance was like 25% of the grade, and she had us do like 2 group presentations. So easy. If you actually talk to her, you will see how genuinely sweet she is, and get an easy A.

Dr. K is an extremely sweet professor yet she does not really teach. its pretty easy to get an A in her class and her guest lecturers are sometimes pretty interesting. Overall, extremely great human, not so great professor. even though shes very passionate about international relations and you can tell that she knows her stuff.

This class was the easiest I've ever taken, but in the "I learned nothing" way. Class is often story time about surviving the cold war (she is Czech) and her dogs. As a foundational class for INS, I was unhappy to have learned so little. On the other hand, we had not a single assignment or test the entire semester and we all got A+'s.

I loved Dr. Kubalkova. The stories about her life are actually interesting and often hilarious. Although it is true that her lectures are sometimes confusing and lack a clear directionpurpose, she is extremely intelligent, kind, and funny. Visiting with her individually was my favorite and most helpful part of the semester. Would take again.

She's a nice lady, but we honestly haven't learned anything all year. Class is basically an excuse for her to have story time about Gorbachev and the Soviet Union. Her powerpoints are INSANE and she tells the same stories over and over. Do NOT take this class.

She doesn't do anything and uses wikipedia as a resource. She has her story time and you get SUPER bored during her lectures. She repeats the same stuff that has nothing to do with the online book, then she tests you out of something she didn't teach you. My only recommendation, DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS IF YOU WANT TO LEARN.
No Comments

Terrible professor. Unclear conveying concepts. Classes were hard to follow, long, full of irrelevant information and boring. No ppts and took  an ungraded exam during spring break. Seems that students are paying $$$ for a Princeton/Oxford Resume and a lecturer and not for a professor. AVOID!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is very caring and respecful of everyone s opinion. Cared enough to schedule make up classes and asked doubts every time. Used graphic basic examples for complex topics, very appreciated. Cares a lot for seeing you on camera ALL THE TIME. Compared to my mediocre professors,he is a star. He will give you practice exams during the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--Tough grader

reviews.comment: We read the ENTIRE book, minus ch. 10&11. Open-book exam. Cold-calling, so read the cases! Very interesting class with room for debate and questions. Prof. is very knowledgeable, academic type. I think he graduated Harvard Law. He gave a 10 minute break. 3 quizzes are MC, and final is all essay. Not easy, but highly recommend!

Prof. Kubat is a great teacher who made the course quite enjoyable. The bulk of the class is learning how to solve circuits like they're puzzles. Kubat walks around class to make sure the students are following along and presents many opportunities to ask questions or receive clarification. The tests are just like the content in class and the book.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Easily one of my favorite professors at UM, Prof. Kubat is very interested in what he teaches and you can tell. He is not a harsh grader, but your grade comes from the exams. The key thing is to pay attention to practice problems he does in lecture because he is likely to reuse questions or do something similar to them. You should take him. No HW.

This guy is very sweet and he is great for explaining simple things! I took intro to programming and it was very fun! His explanations can be a little all over the place sometimes so be careful if you take him for something more advanced

Kubat made this class so enjoyable and welcoming! The subject of Machine Learning is sometimes pretty difficult to grasp and he did a wonderful job in simplifying it and offering to help outside of class. Honestly one of the best comp. sci classes I have ever taken at UMiami. Also, his textbook is wonderful so definitely rent and read!
The best professor that I've had at UM. Teaches very well and it is clear that he cares about his students greatly. Have taken two classes with him and learned a lot in both of them.

Taking two AI classes with him in one semester was manageable. They are high level course so You have to do the work. His tests are not hard and he is not harsh but once again its programming and ML so you have to study. I regret not taking him for Circuit theory because my grade would have been better. Very down to earth guy compared to other pfs

Dr. Kubat is a goldmine in Machine Learning and AI. His lectures incorporate theory with his practical experience examples. He wrote the book himself and Its easy to read. You have to put some work because there are projects involved. I took two courses with him this semester and I totally enjoyed them both. Go to his office he will help you.

Professor Kubat, is one of the reasons why I wake up on MWF. He reminds me of an Albert Einstein & Victor Frankenstein. He is a mad genius . His tests are completely fair and not meant to be tricks. He cares about his students and but is also challenging. He's overqualified for this job and I appreciate just learning from him. He's Inspirational

Kubat is an amazing professor. The first programming class I took was with him, and it only made me realize I had chosen the right major. He explains the material really well. He is always available if you have any doubts. Definitely would take another class with him.

Distinguished professor, he genuinely cares about his students and is always open to help you. He teaches programming at a great pace. His quizzes are not hard if you attend class and do the labs. Labs take a lot of time, but they will solidify your understanding for the test. Tests are challenging but he gives A LOT of similar practice tests.

Dr. Kubat is good professor. He has a unique teaching style. He goes around and looks at every bodies work. He helps you individually if you need help. Dr. Kubat has some flaws but he genuinely wants to help. His test and quizzes are not impossible. As for the other comments, Programming is a hard class. Not many professors can teach it well.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: Excellent profesor, helps you throughout the course, walks around the class asking if you have any doubts, a lot of practice in class to make sure you fully understand the topics. Professor is very kind, do not hesitate to go to office hours, he will always help you. Midterms very similar to practice done in class. So dont skip!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Doesn't teach anything, and exams are extremely hard. Class is boring, and he gives ridiculous pop quizzes. DON'T TAKE
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: His quizzes are often predictable once you know his pattern and you often can predict the dates of the quiz without worry. quizzes are often every two weeks it really depends on the mat. Towards the 3rd quarter of the semester quizzes occur every week so if there is six quizzes you usually end up having 2 quizzes in two weeks toward the end. p
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Never choose this class. The class content is heavier than you thought. Trust me, never choose this class unless you want to major in it.

His teaching methods aren't always clear, but you will learn a lot. He's a lot easier than Murell, and there's really no excuse not to get an A. Grades you based on each individual test question, and the final can be used to take the questions over and replace your grade for each individual one.

Kubat is an unintentionally hilarious nutjob of a professor. From his popped collar, to his fanny pack, to his white flowing hair, he presents an eccentric figure indeed. I had him for Machine Learning, which is his field of study, and I thoroughly his class. It was not difficult, and he managed to keep it interesting.

Terrible professor. He is unclear, unproffesional, and consistently unprepared. On Fridays he either cancels classes or chooses to rehash previous lectures, wasting everyone's time. His tests do not reflect actual knowledge of C++. Mistakes are easy to make and are extremely costly. 2-3 important questions per exam, but he allows a make-up final.

Kyle is an amazing professor! Even if you're not good at art, you'll leave his class learning things you never knew you could do. He is kind, helpful, understanding, and gives amazing feedback. The first day about safety is long and boring, but after that you're set for an awesome semester. I would definitely take him again if I could! 100/10 class
Amazing professor!! Very helpful and gives great feedback even if you are a beginner. Really made me enjoy making art! Plays great music during class too!
Love Kyle so much!!! His class has been my favorite in all my time at UM. He teaches in a way that actually makes you feel confident in your abilities.Take his class!!!
