Professor is knowledgeable, but there are very few traditional lectures. Class time often relies on outside materials rather than direct instruction. I had to use external resources to understand and prepare for exams. Best for students comfortable with independent learning.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Larrieu is nice and passionate in her career… the positives end there. She wastes class time with unrelated stories and can't get thru a single PowerPoint. If she says to focus on certain content for an exam you can guarantee it won't be on there. Reading the textbook won't help, expect to pull content from thin air. Near impossible to reach.

I took her for Pharmacology, she is VERY passionate about clinical practice as she tells lots of stories, but not a great teacher. She would say I know what UM can produce because her daughter graduated from there and so did she. I don't think it hit her that she is now a part of that process. She is new. Don't pick her!

Dr. Larrieu is very passionate about health assessment, has great clinical skills, and wants everyone to pass her class. But she frequently gets lost in tangential stories and doesn't like being corrected on her self-contradictions. Included content is usually not taught in their entirety, so lean on lab to teach you most of the practical info.

Easily the worst professor I've had. She does not know how to teach. Extremely self centered and condescending. Spends more than half of class time talking about clinical practice. The explanations are just word salads with no clear answers. Did you know she's an NP? Don't worry, she'll remind you. She's a nice person but should not be teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She spends the whole 2-hour class sharing life stories, runs over time without considering students' breaks, and emphasizes topics not on the exam. Test material often isn't covered in class, and some questions aren't in the slides or textbook, making it hard to prepare.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Contradicts herself all the time and refused to be corrected. Give excuses, and very self-centered - talks about herself all the time and gives clinical examples that's irrelevant to the lecture. Test will have materials from slides she skipped over in the powerpoint and from future lectures we haven't even touched to see "where we're at."
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Glad to be done with this class. The best advice is to get the book and read it. Showing up to the lecture is mandatory but a waste of time.

Condescending attitude, contradicts herself quite a lot in class, never finishes the lecture and expects you to finish on your own, barely responds to emails, spends the whole class talking about herself.

Her exams questions are easy and provides study guides that tell you what to focus on in the chapters. but the amount of content required to know per exam in such a short amount of time is inhuman. I worked full time and took this class for summer and I truly could barely keep up. She goes off subject in lecture. overall i did learn a lot though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She is very fair. Comes off as tough at first but she is very kind and wants only the best for her students. Great lectures. I recommend showing up and reading the book. I got an A and thought the class was straight forward and relatively easy. Some students didn't like her personality but I thought she was very sweet.

Dr. Briones is super helpful and always make sure you have all the resources to succeed! She is very nice and her lectures are straight forward. If you listen in class you will do well. She wants her students to do well. I would definitely recommend her.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Briones is the sweetest. She comes across tough at first, but her exams were EXACTLY what you need to know for boards. She is super easy IF you pay attention in class. the book is great, but sometimes its a little over the top on info- so don't go nuts with the book. loved her!

She is not a bad person and wants you to pass her class. However, she spends too much time talking about herself and what she has done in the past getting off tangent. You can be on the MSK lecture and she will start talking about her nephrology experience. Read the book, know the tests and signs, know differences between similar dz states. GL!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Unrealistic requirements are set. There is no real exam review, just read everything assigned.

Very kind and helpful teacher. Very welcoming and there whenever you need her. HOWEVER, Read everything including the figures and charts in the book. YOU NEED TO KNOW YOURSELF TO PASS. Nevertheless, at the end of the semester, YOU WILL KNOW THE MATERIAL due to excessive reading and trying to understand from every angle and will thank her. NP School

Professor Langbein is an outstanding teacher. He is exceptionally well prepared and his teaching goes well beyond the material required for the exam. His teaching reflects a deep intellectual breadth, including a strong understanding of the political context behind legislation. The final exam is demanding, but the grading fairly reflects that rigor

Posts all lecture recordings online which makes studying easier given that despite his content knowledge he is not a great speaker. Gives a practice test midway through the semester that helps with preparation for the final. Material is difficult and final was long but it was open-note, take-home. Challenging class but mostly clear expectations.

Miami Law should be ashamed. Avoid this professor. He openly says he shouldn't be teaching and shows little interest in instruction. Despite being intelligent, very little is taught. Grades aren't harsh, but learning is minimal. Disappointing experience, even as a student who earned an A. You have to teach yourself material since he refuses.

Just read the book and watch supplemental videos and you don't really need to pay attention in class (b/c he really confuses things/makes them sound more difficult than they are). Nice guy and funny sometimes but overall not my preferred teaching style. You can definitely still get an A / do really well if you cram.
The worst professor. BORING !!! DONT TAKE A CLASS WITH HIM !!!
Great professor, one of the best in the law school when you actually pay attention. Also really funny and brings his dog to class

I just went to class, and read very little.  The book doesn't help you at all, it's really useless (and he even told us this).  He actually knows what he's talking about, don't be fooled. Most of the things he talked about in class were on the exam. Just go to class, and only skim the book before the final, or when you don't understand something.
Interesting person, both in and out of class.  He is a fair grader who likes students.

I only went to the first 2 classes - realized he didn't make sense (stream of consciousness-style lecture) and went to the review session (and he still didn't make sense). He gives you an outline. Make sure you read it and flag it (and the text) before the open-book MC exam. Never read and got an A (but already knew some stuff from biz undergrad)

Gives his students latitude.  Most mistake this for excuse not to work.  Those who do the readings realize that the value he adds in his lectures is up there with the best of them.  Truly a brilliant man.  He wants to be nice so grades easily, and he gives people (too much) credit for being self-directed.

Interesting, a bit wierd, and no need to ever go to class. If you need an easy A to boost your GPA or you want a cake class before you graduate - this is the professor to take. No reading, no work, and an A.
i got an A on my banking law exam and i know exactly dick-squat about banking law. barely ever went to class and read maybe 20 pages of the 600 or so assigned. nuff said.
No Comments
Makes his class easy, which is good since the amount you learn is less than the information I've typed in this box.

Lani is very kind and helpful when working on projects. She encourages creative and unique ideas. There were five projects and a final artist statement at the end of the course. She provides helpful background information, clear guidelines, and examples for each project, which makes expectations easy to understand.

Professor Shapton was very kind and encouraging! She is a typical art teacher who encourages you to lead with your heart, but she also taught us technical terms and genuinely helped us develop better skills and techniques. She is the reason I now want to add an art minor. Just be aware of the time commitment associated with projects.

The professor for this class is very accommodating and helpful. She was very understanding and always willing to help when I felt confused and lost. She's very knowledgeable about the material. All assignments are able to be done by anyone even if you are not a strong artist, she grades based on
your effort and what you have made.
Taking for a cognate. Difficult in learning to use the materials and because I didn't think I could draw but easy in the concepts. Lets you redo assignments. She teaches well and is encouraging.

She is a good person and will let you revise your homework unlimited times. But not a very good professor. Although she teaches very clearly, her grading is extremely subjective with the fuzzy grading criteria. She seems to be a perfectionist.
Fun class and funny teacher!

Lani is funny, chill, and a great teacher no matter your art skills. Is a great art class to take if you want to take a fun art class, but if your serious about silkscreening/fine arts Lani will help you out and push you to improve. Supplies are expensive but I was able to make back all that by making and selling printed t-shirts
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: I took Lani for 2d design first. I'm not an art major and it was my first art class ever so I was nervous. But she was very encouraging and helpful when I didn't understand. As long as you work consistently in class you will have very little outside work. I'm now in silkscreen, definitely more work but artwork I've made is totally worth it!
Easily the greatest teacher I've had at Miami.
I love her! She's the best printmaking professor that I've ever had!

Lani is a great professor! She is hilarious and so much fun. She is very open minded and helpful. She respects students that work hard and come to class but class is fun! She knows so much about printmaking and is also very talented. She is the best. I would take her again in a heartbeat.

Lani is an awesome and genuine person. She is very knowledgable on everything silkscreen and always has been able to answer my questions. She is very understanding, but you definitely have to be committed to the class (not-blowoff). She is also hilarious and down to earth; I look forward to going to class. I highly recommend her and this class.
Lani is an amazing teacher. You definitely have to put the work in to get a good grade, but you learn a lot, and she makes bomb banana bread.

Most unorganized teacher I've ever had. Had an IClicker quiz every class (all MC). A reverse learning style, and doesn't cover most things in class. Really smart in economics, but just not a good college professor. Getting to know him/office hours was the only reason I got an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Ricardo genuinely wants his students to succeed. Class is structured in a way that makes getting an A very achievable. There are 1300 total points available, but you only need 900 to earn an A. Meaning you need a 69% overall for an A. Very passionate and knowledgeable about economics best economics professor Ive taken. LOVE HIM

Lago is a nice guy but I honestly couldn't stand his class. He's very unorganized, got mad when students wouldn't spend 4 hours weekly doing homework that did not need more than 30 minutes, and I genuinely think he went over the syllabus every single week. You might lose your sanity by the end of the semester but he's not impossible

I feel bad leaving this but this guy is so disorganized. For someone that should be very well versed in efficiency, being an economics professor, his grading system is anything but efficient. It constantly changes and his “point system” makes little to no sense. He also constantly rambles and yaps and exceeds class time doing so. Avoid.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He gets annoying very quickly. Sometimes doesn't understand simple questions, and the lectures are horrible but you need to stay for the iclicker quizzes he has in every class worth 30 points each. Attendance is mandatory purely because he has a quiz in every class. But allows for maybe 2 absences which will still lower your grade average.

Lago is an amazing professor who has lots of experience in economics. However, you need to get ready to read a lot. Lectures are basically a bunch of real world examples, which draws topics from lectures and homeworks. Make sure to sit on the front row and participate, he will give you so much extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Lago is very knowledgeable about economics. That being said, his lectures are disorganized and are really boring. Tests are simple and straightforward. If you want to do well in this class, just sit in the front and participate, he will grow to like you. Also make sure to do the homework, it's not hard but it sometimes is time consuming.

Professor Lago is amazing. He uses a reverse learning style, so expect lots of homework, but the questions are similar to the test. He's very caring and notices students who sit in the front. Participation and attendance matter—he gives extra credit easily. Stay engaged and you'll do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He is not a hard professor, just read the textbook and the videos. He cares about his students, sit in the front and participate to do well. He is pretty disorganized but go to class and know the homework stuff and your fine. People complain about him, but he is actually pretty good.

Prof. Lago is awesome. Huge points in the homework, and he gives out extra credit for everything including answering simple questions in class. If you go to class, participate and do the homework, getting an A is a cakewalk. The homework isn't nothing, but isn't too difficult. Overall great, friendly guy who truly wants his students to succeed.
I didn't learn anyhting in this class and the tests had nothing to due with what he talked about in class or what was on the homeowrk

Sit in the front. Ricardo is very knowledgeable about economics as a whole - that being said he is not a fantastic teacher. If you treat him like a human he will treat you with respect. His tests are pretty light & he gives extra credit out like candy. Sit in the front.

If you care about gaining a deep understand of awesome stuff like the stock market, the US and it's role in the global economy, and why the US is such a rich country, this class is for you. If you care about everything being super organized and someone holding your hand, then maybe this isn't.

The sweetest proffesssor ever, he really cares about studnets getting a good grade and gives wild amoutns of extra credit got a 50 on first midterm and 65 on second and somehow managed to have an 80 in the class relates the class to things in the world very intresting. big yapper tho
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He is the WORST. He changes his mind about everything. If your not big on talking in front of the class for participation do NOT take him. He gives extra points like it's water but he doesn't teach. You have 20 textbook achieve assignments every week and expects you to learn from them. His lectures are only about real life events. DO NOT TAKE HIM

Anything said in lectures is irrelevant and will assign 15-20 assignments a week. The worst part is that he changes his grading criteria every week. He recently decided that the homework was going to not count as much and just sprung a SECOND MIDTERM on us with less than a week to prepare. Keep in mind there is only 3 weeks left until finals.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE HIM! He spends the whole lecture talking about everything but what we are supposed to learn. Full on expects the student to learn all of the material themselves. If you can't teach yourself then you're out of luck.

Professor Lago prioritizes motivational speeches over teaching, making his classes feel more like self-help seminars. If he prefers inspiring over educating, a high school setting might be more suitable. His classes felt unstructured and frustrating. Overall, a deeply disappointing experience with little academic value.
Awesome professor who loves what he teaches to his students! Sit in the front row and make friends with him.

The easiest way to succeed in this class is to chat briefly with him after class. Participation plays a huge role in this class but it isn't really based on in-class performance. If you take a little time to make sure he recognizes you early on, you will do perfectly fine. Also make sure you stay up to date with achieve assignments

He is such a king and he was funny. The videos are very helpful. He made it clear he would right us a letter of reccomendation. He lowered the cut off so I did not even need forty percent on the final for an A in the class.

Professor Lago is an impressive and intriguing person to have as a professor. If you show effort to connect with him, he will be kind and helpful. Every student who reviews material and makes this effort should do very well in his classes.
Went to every single class and still did not get an A. He changed his point system last minute and everyone dropped down a letter grade.
I don't understand how there are people who gave bad ratings. He was a great professor if you went to every lecture and listened. He would review before exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He is a very caring and knowledgeable professor, not the best of teachers but the material isn't extremely hard. If you do the achieve homework and take notes you should have no issues on the midterms, and final. Participation is a must, build a relationship and answer questions in class, this will dramatically improve your grade.

Honestly, really nice and caring professor who sent me a whole personalised email to say that he enjoyed having me in his class, as I am sure he did for many of his other students. Such a fun and easy class with this professor, I'll genuinely miss him and this class.

The videos are a good addition to his lectures and they give a lot of extra credit/points to your grade. The grade is mainly based on participation, but that doesn't have to be raising your hand and answering questions, it could be just friendly chats.

I honestly don't know why this professor has a bad rating. He is honestly such a caring and nice professor. Despite the class being in the evening, and quite long, he always tried to make it funny and entertaining. He honestly really does try to connect with his students and learn all of their names and even where they're from.

Well-meaning guy. Get to know him (sit in first few rows). He knows his stuff and has a lot of real word experience. Not a great professor—erratic, disorganized, below average teacher. A bit of a language barrier. Changes grading criteria every other week. But, extremely easy. Do the minimum and you'll get an A+.

He is funny in a kind of "fun uncle" way, and he has made the class super easy for all of us to pass this semester. Gave us a lot of extra credit for going to econ events and talking in class, and he curved the final up about 33%. The problem is he definitely has picked out his favorites in the class, and his grading criteria makes no sense.
Really good IF YOU GET TO KNOW HIM. He's like a grandpa, be nice and he'll be nice back.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He was experimenting with different teaching styles the whole semester. Cold calls students to come up and present about the HW videos from the night before. He let us drop one exam grade. IClicker attendance. Experienced economist, novice teacher.

His class is subject to a new learning platform PETAL, but he's doing a bad job at managing it. Too many achieve videos assigned, we breeze through topics too quickly and far too much content to study for tests. He also treats the videos like a lecture (ie. he will expect you to understand the topic, ahead of class from watching the video) :(

He can not teach and doesn't teach anything new. 95% of his class is just reviewing the homework video's he assigned prior to the class.  you will not learn anything new in class due to him rambling on about the same thing for 3-5 minutes every 5 minutes. He will absolute Beam you with his eyes if you are sitting in the front row

You have to recite videos from the textbook in which you will talk about them for about 15 seconds until he cuts you off and rambles on about something completely different from the video. Sit in the back, if you are upfront he will look directly into your eyes and talk about something unrelated to the topic.

This guy cant figure out how to use iclicker or even the screens in class. He just makes the class watch videos then teach the rest of the class, meanwhile he goes off on random rants that are rarely meaningful. Lecture slides include information that is useless on tests and quizzes, yet doesnt teach what is needed. Awful professor

Professor was absolutely terrible. Often asked students to complete problems for him. Could teach yourself better than prof. Lago does. Really hard to learn and exhibit ideas because he always talks over you.
Available outside class

Not sure what im gunna get in the class and its the day before grades come out. Lago does not teach and makes extremely hard tests. He claimed we were getting extra credit but than is scaling everyones grades down and is making people fail. Totally unfair.

Nice guy tho
Run!

Professor Lago is very knowledgeable about economics, but he can't teach. He just says to read the textbook. He rambles about the same topic all class, and you never learn anything. The tests are also insanely hard, and you have to go to forums, and his zooms outside of class time just so you can get participation points. Don't recommend at all

This man knows economics but is a HORRIBLE professor. Rambles and wastes time. Tests don't reflect what is taught in class, basically anything in the text book is fair game. The 3 hour class is bad. You have to participate to get points towards grades and it's very meticulous so if you don't like participating this is not for you. Avoid!!!

He is very a very sweet and intelligent man. You can tell he knows so much about economics but he is just not good at teaching it. His lectures were very hard to follow and understand. If you dont like to talk in class, i dont recommend because he gives participation points based on if you speak or not.
Great Professor with a lot of knowledge of Economics and someone who truly cares about the students success. Overall, great professor who is passionate about his job
Great professor. He was very understanding.

Form a relationship with the teacher so he knows you by name and participate as much as you can in class. Has real world experience but doesnt seem like he has a lot of teaching experience. Not a hard class if you do your hw and study for tests. I never read the textbook so don't buy it if you dont have to. Very understanding and gives extra credit

Professor Lago is a very understanding and great professor- show up to class and sit in the front! Pay attention and take notes and he will respect your effort. 
You can learn a lot from professor Lago if you apply yourself, go to class, and read the text book!

Professor Lago is outstanding! With real-world expertise, he makes the challenging course manageable through frequent reviews. While there are only two exams, the extensive homework is rewarding. Active participation is key; asking questions earns valuable extra points. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
The lectures are long and can be a bit boring but if you show up to class and pay attention then the exams are easy and he is very lenient with grading.

WORST PROFESSOR EVER. Exam content does not match the material taught in class, talks about unrelated topics, & has no idea how to use technology. The syllabus does not reflect what is assigned. Exams often have many errors and students always have to correct them. Calls students out constantly & makes the classroom environment very uncomfortable.

He has great real-world experience but not real teaching experience and it is very clear because he is often disorganized leaving lots of students feeling confused in his class especially with homework and exams.

Professor Lago is amazing! While his lectures can be a little tedious due to it being 3 hours, he really knows what he's talking about, and it shows. He really wants you to succeed and will often incentivize you to participate. If possible, take him.

Professor Lago, for one, has so much real-world experience. He has been an economist at the World Bank, the EBRD, and InterAmerican Development Bank. He truly cares about the students, he constantly bumps up grades and extends homework deadlines & exam dates. Recommended 11/10! He really wants you to learn. He brings entertaining speakers.
Spends class time talking about unrelated topics, textbook has wrong answers, and exams are difficult.
Amazing Professor. Would take again!

Don't be misled by these ratings. My roommate recommended her and 100% recommend. I went to her office hours a lot and she is incredibly nice, patient, and helpful. if ur ever dazed or confused, in class, spending 10-15 minutes with her will get you a long way. I highly recommend her and as a graduating senior, she was one of my favorite teachers.

Absolutely fantastic professor! Dr. Pinto is highly intelligent and very well connected in the finance industry. She gives you excellent feedback on your work, and it is very evident how much she cares for her students. Her class has enticed me to consider taking up finance as my major, and I highly recommend that you take her class.

Overall nice and caring professor, exams are not that hard(only two), but there is a very hard project at the end worth 40%. I would recommend her just know it is a lot of work outside of the classroom.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Leila is someone you want to take, she brings high profile guest lecturers from a variety of industries, she's responded well to my emails, and most importantly she was an actual professor you can talk to. Show up to class, and you will pass. Study and you will get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Overall, Professor Pinto-Campillo is a great professor and cares about her students. She gives us homework that prepares us for exams, offers many extra credit opportunities, and even gives us a retake opportunity that replaces our lowest scores. She wanted her students to do well, and I enjoyed her class a lot.

Overall, it was a hard but good class. Professor Pinto-Campillo provided many opportunities to do well in the course, including a retake exam, extra credit opportunities, and weekly office hours. We were given homework that prepared us well for all exams. Overall, very friendly and cares about her students.
Very nice professor and class is relatively straight forward, can do everything on excel and 40% of grade is an easy group project. Lectures are boring and hard to get a hold of her outside of class.

Pinto is not a good professor. Her lectures are boring and do not help for the quizzes/exams. You must self teach yourself everything. You are not allowed to email her. She seems like she doesn't like teaching and gets mad at the class saying we do not put in enough effort rather than looking in the mirror and realizing its her teaching style.

By far one of the most intelligent and friendliest professors. All of her lectures are genuinely interesting and she truly cares for her students. Lecture notes + recording online, as well as additional resources are always posted promptly. Be present in class, as most of the in person questions/examples are like the ones on the quizzes/exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: By far one of the best professors I've had. She provides multiple resources for success and help, posts all the class notes and recordings, and genuinely wants her students to do well. You will need to pay attention and do the work in class to fully comprehend, as most of the problems/examples in class are similar to those on quizzes/exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: No attendance and not much need to go to class. 4 online out of class quizzes worth 10%.  Do the hw for extra credit. Group project is vague and she loves to tell you infornt of thers in class when your porject isnt good enough.  Can resubmit after tho.  Final is from pool of questions study the questions and it is easy.  Overall pretty ease class.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: No attendance and not much need for the class.  Online outside-of-class quizzes are worth 10% each.  The group project is vague, and she loves to let you know in front of people if yours was not good enough, but lets you resubmit. final is from a pool of questions. Study the questions, and the final is very easy.  Do the homework for extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Leila is a very caring and itelligent professor. The classes are interactive and she does in-class activities to understand better the material. The class consists of 4 quizes and the final, just pay attention and go to her office hours, she is really helfull and kind, I would definitely take her again.

The class goes from being ridiculously easy to overwhelming in the last three weeks of school. There was not a lot of clarity on the group project, and she told us our project was bad in front of the entire class. Be prepared to study for two weeks for the final, since any 60 questions from the review could be pulled.

Leila is the nicest professor. She really cares about you understanding the material and goes over so many practice problems (including the HW which is extra credit of 5%) to prepare you for the quizzes. There's no exam except the final online which I loved. The topics can be tough if you're not into finance but she provides resources
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Amazing professor who cares deeply about her students. The course includes two news analyses, five quizzes (with retake options), extra credit through homework, and a group project. There's also a final exam, which she provides a study guide for. Overall, she's a caring and dedicated professor who clearly values what she teaches.

Leila is an amazing professor! She cares about her students and ensures we understand the material, even when it's tough. We presented two news articles, had five quizzes with two attempts, and very helpful homework. The group project was fun, and she also provides a helpful review for final exam. Very organized and approachable, take her class!

Honestly she's a great professor but is important that you teach yourself many stuff because she takes an approach that is more practical and if you don't catch it up quickly, you'll need to learn yourself. She gives A LOT of extra credit and 40% of your grade consists of 5 quizzes that you have a week and two tries to complete them.

This class is relatively easy compared to other finance teachers. However, what you gain out of this class is the effort you put into it. You can technically still get a good grade even if you don't attend class, but the information she teaches can help set you up to have a good mindset and knowledge about finance. I would recommend her.

Wonderful professor! Material could get challenging but she is easy to reach out and get help. Homework was great practice for the quizzes. The final project was fun and interesting if you are going into portfolio management.
I loved her, she gives you all the material you could need to succeed in the class. Quizzes are straight froward and she gives you 2 chances for each quiz
Rambling lectures, puts students on the spot regularly, grades extremely savagely in context of poorly planned lectures.

Leila is an exceptional professor at the University of Miami, dedicated to ensuring students understand complex topics like stock evaluations. My enriching experience in her course prompts a wholehearted recommendation to all students. Leila is undoubtedly a valuable asset to the university.

I am sure that students that have her low credit is because they failed the course. She is caring and teaches finance in a comprehensive and organized way. Her assessments include quizzes, homework and a project which gives us plenty of opportunities to succeed. Best professor for 302. Take her class if you have a chance!

She rambles on during class and doesn't stick to one topic for long. She also doesn't help us at all with items we are struggling with, she just moves on to the next topic quickly in order to make sure she covers everything. I could've read a finance book and learned more than her rambling on for almost 2 hours in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Awful, learned absolutely nothing. Half of the class we have to work on group assignments, but we don't know how to do them. We go to school to learn not to do homework in class. She is nice tho, just not a good professor in my opinion.

She is a great professor! I am not a Finance major and was anxious about the class, she was very helpful and taught the material in a comprehensible way. She will take the time to answer your questions and she is very nice and caring. With hard work and dedication you will be able to earn a great grade. I highly recommend her.

Finally, I get programming. The class is very difficult, but he tries his best to teach us programming.

reviews.comment: I'm not a tech person and I'm not so much into it, but I have to say he really taught us interesting topics with motivation and energy.

Very difficult class, very useful 2. When I started this class I had no clue, as assignments were passing I realized how much I was learning being able to complete those by myself. The last one was so fun, I implemented my own version of a computer game. I was able to get an internship just by telling this experience.

reviews.comment: I knew a bit coding because of a class I took with CompSi b4 but this is truly the next level. Super hard class but rewarding. Espinosa will push you to learn and succeed. Great guy.
He truly does the best possible to motivate you for BTE. C++ is a very very very hard class for a beginner like me, but I couldn't have chosen a better professor.

reviews.comment: I got to his class with the popular comments about how hard this class is, and how dry. Actually I loved it, I loved not only the class and the way he teaches it, but I loved the professor as you could see how much he cares about us and about our learning. I'm lucky to have taken this class with Prof. Espinosa. I really learned so much.

Excellent Professor! Definitely could be a hard class if you've never programmed b4 but Prof E goes above and beyond to help you learn (must go to class). Super caring/understanding and genuinely wants you to learn to code. Glad he is with the BTE deptmt and look forward to having again. Highly recommend!

Is the class easy? No, it's not at all. Is he the best professor? Maybe... Did I learn? OMG, I don't even recognize myself after this class. Never ever coded a line in my life and now I'm even coding games and hundreds of lines of code for assignments. I really liked his style for this class.
He is a very good teacher, just the class itself is not particularly easy, which is why I made it a 3. Overall, very good experience.

His lectures are very structured, makes you work on designing a real database that's fully functional from scratch, and he is willing to guide you through the designing process step by step. Not the easiest class, but it is definitely meaningful and fruitful. Go to his office hours and he will be happy to help with any trouble you have.

I was told and was totally true, this is the only professor worth for BUS 150. I recommend him with confident, I was able to get a job after this class. Couldn't have made it without the amazing lectures he taught for us. Yes a lot of work, yes a lot of textbook time, but totally worth it.

reviews.comment: I was really nervous when starting this class. Still a difficult material, but he will do all in his power to make you understand the topics. I'm not a fan of group projects, and I'm really enjoying creating a real database from scratch, who could tell me that. Recommended.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He is one of the few BUS150 teachers that truly know the material. Exams are similar to in-class practices (slightly more challenging though) and projects are fun. Attendance is mandatory. Definitely will take him again.
This is a very hard class, but he definitely helps you if you show interest.

reviews.comment: He truly cares about students and is very knowledgeable in the subject area. He's definitely there to help, but you have to practice outside of class. Exams very similar to cases in textbook and he tells you what to focus on. Two group projects - one has a peer eval, which I love. You will need the textbook and your laptop (Windows) every class.

Overall a good professor. Tests are hard if you don't practice a lot before hand, requires two group projects which are a breeze. Very open to helping outside of class. You can learn everything from the textbook very easily, but still show up to class as he's very strict with the attendance portion of the grade.
He truly knows the topics of BTE, I'm glad I picked him for this class.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GROUP PROJECTS--Would take again

reviews.comment: First I must say, he really knows the material, and he cares about his students, but of course, you have to show interest in the class. Hope he teaches other classes so I can take him again.
He cares very much about his students and is very accessible. Knows very well his material.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: caring professor, yes! he always had time for my questions, I really appreciate the time he took to help me.
Very caring professor and his passion for the class shines through.

Very hard class, but this teacher makes it in a way that all makes sense at the end. What a tremendous journey, I came from no clue at the beginning of the semester to almost an A at the end, honestly, if you follow his instructions, you can make it.
With BTE210, you're either good at it or not. Every class is hard but he is the better teacher. To do well on tests, have to read textbook no matter who you have.

I thank Dr. Espinosa for so many reasons, I went to him so many times and he always answered my questions in kindly manner, and gave me awesome feedback on assignments. I would take him as a professor for sure if he is teaching other course.
He is inspirational, the class is divided into regular lectures and a final project where you put in practice all learned in the 1st part.

First I was scared because he looks really young, and I prefer professor with experience. Later on I realized that he has the perfect blend, young but experienced and makes us work just on the right things. I would definitely take him again.
He cares so much about us, great lecturer.

He is inspirational, always making emphasis on the importance of technology at every business area. I liked it and really learned a lot here. Pity I dont see any other class where he is the professor.

The class was pretty basic the first part of the semester, I didn't even study for the tests and got good grades. The project is basically the entire class, make sure that you do a great project and presented well, he is very picky with details on the project. overall great class.

He is very punctual, never missed a class and cares for his students. Some lectures are long, some others are very practical, especially the ones for elaborating the group project. Thank you Mr. Espinosa for a good semester.
Cool guy, put on me some passion for technology. First part of the semester is where we may acquire the background to then later apply knowledge into a project during second part of the semester.

Mr. Espinosa is a really nice guy! He loves what he does and he is willing to help his students. Make sure you pick a good group because your project is worth 55% of your grade! Not a difficult class. Totally take him!

She definitely makes it clear who she has more patience for, and if you're not one of them, you'll notice pretty quickly. Thankfully, I wasn't the target of her verbal attacks. Take her if you don't mind some rudeness, the class is pretty easy. Brace yourself lol.

the easiest cognate/writing intensive & is a refreshing class to take on top of a stem-intensive sem. prof is super passionate abt poetry. sharing poems in front of class was slightly mortifying but by far one of my fav classes taken at UM!

Mia is an easy-going professor, but she does have things she is tedious about. Attendance is mandatory, and you HAVE to show up or your grade will be impacted. She grades super easily and gives decent feedback. She LOVES poetry and will talk about it. She is liberal, so keep Republican views out of her classroom. She LOVES to cuss every day!

Do NOT take Professor Leonin if you care about your grade or actually want to learn anything. She comes off as chill and approachable at first, but she is not. Take someone else if you can, unless your goal is to lose points unfairly and be nit picked by her.

She's amazing! Anyone who doesn't like her just refuses to take things seriously. Extremely passionate about what she does, very caring, excellent feedback, and wants everyone to do well. Put some effort into taking her seriously and participating, and you'll be rewarded.

I loved Mia so much. Very knowledgeable writer and educator, very caring and real. DO NOT TAKE IF YOU CAN'T TAKE THINGS SERIOUSLY. Go take 209 or something if you don't want to improve or help others improve. I really enjoyed the selected reading for the class, the format of workshop, and the volume of assignments.

Mia is okay. Compared to other poetry teachers she is probably the worst though. Attendance is mandatory and the whole class is writing poems and sharing them aloud. The poem can suck and she will give you an A as long as you come and participate. She takes everything so serious and does not understand its just a poetry class and no one cares.

Mia is OK. I wouldnt call her a sweetheart, but she is really passionate about writing. Also, attendance is mandatory, and if you're late twice its an absence and she'll take points off your final paper which I think is ridiculous.

Note that you will be asked to free-write and share your poems aloud in each class. You can pass on days where you don't feel like it, but for the most part, get to know the sound of your own voice. She never grades your poems or writing style, rather, she grades your ability to revise and question yourself.
Great professor! I loved her assignments and the required readings, all of which were worthwhile.

Professor Leonin is such a sweetheart. You can tell she genuinely cares for her students and she really puts in the effort to make the class interesting and manageable for her students. Seriously one of the greatest English teachers I've ever had. She truly wants her students to do well and the class is graded off simple assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Such a sweetheart, the epitome of a quirky teacher. This class overall is therapeutic and she does her best to make sure her class isn't any added stress. You don't need to be Shakespeare in this class; If you do the work, you'll get an A.

I love this class because it really allows you to write freely about a lot of relatable topics. There are a few short books that are assigned for certain modules, but it's nothing complicated. The books are actually really interesting so it doesn't really feel like hw. Great professor!
Good teacher. She's laid back in class, but you have to do every assignment to pass the class. Do the work, participate, etc. If you try and sneak by you may not do well.

Professor Leonin is all around a good teacher. She's flexible, clearly states what she wants from her students, and her class is semi engaging. She will keep you the entire time. If you want a good grade, make the changes she suggests to your work and participate in class discussion.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Leonin tries to be funny even though she really isn't but she really cares about her students and puts in a lot of time grading all of their things. creative writing can be very subjective and you do write everyday but the class allows you to be creative (obviously) and it's a fun class for English credit

Leonin is such a sweet lady. She makes you feel comfortable sharing your work, and helps you improve your creative writing. If you're feeling iffy about some of your work, she's willing to give you feedback before you turn it in. You revise your work before submitting a final portfolio. Just put effort into your work and you'll be fine.

Great teacher. Funny and nice. Class isn't terrible, it's fun and the work is pretty easy. I took this class during the summer, so I can't imagine her regular semester classes being too difficult. Don't let her niceness fool you, submit assignments on time and go to class. There's poetry and fiction in this class, it's really an enjoyable class.

She is an extremely nice lady. Really cares about each of her students. She seemed to enjoy learning from our class as much as we did from her. She is very fair. I definitely recommend her Creative Writing course, especially if you enjoy Cuban heritage.
She's amazing. Hands down, best class I took at UM.

I cannot say enough good things about Mia. She was so helpful with her comments. My poetry improved tremendously. She's very approachable and goes out of her way to help her students. My only complaint is we had to read a lot of other people's poetry, but that's expected of a workshop class, I guess. Definitely participate and work hard.
To the person who said she never gives solid A's, I got a solid A. Do the work, speak up in class, and if you have to write a final evaluation of your work make sure to be self-critical.

Very nice lady. Takes her time going over assignments and genuinely cares about her students and is interested in their work. Very helpful throughout the semester. If you listen to her feedback, you should get an A on your portfolio!!

Pretty decent teacher. Very nice and helpful. Obviously, be prepared to write. 2 short stories, each with a couple drafts, peer reviews and sometimes, a small summary on an author's work in the textbook. Feedback is very useful, but you'll have no idea about grading until you submit the final portfolio.

She's a nice lady - that's about it. If you actually enjoy poetry, do NOT take her introductory course. It is tedious, boring, and you WILL be subjected to some awful poetry by your peers. Attendance is mandatory. I enjoy poetry but taking this class took much of the joy out of it for me. I wouldn't recommend taking her class.

This lady can't teach. I felt I was back in middle school with her. She's really biased in her grading and is not open in accepting different writing styles. She wants you to write in a very formulaic way that is just annoying. She doesn't like  to give A's and she makes going to this class a drag. Stay away from her!!!!

Nice lady but NEVER gives solid A's. She makes you work hard in a class that should be easy. Most people work hard for B+. Take her if you are extremely confident with your writing and believe you are good...if not, then forget it.

Nice lady, but tough grader. as an author herself, she expects us to match up to her somehow. you have to work hard for this class even though it should be a gpa-booster. if you arent great with essays, i do not recommend her as she seldom gives out A's..

This lady sucks.  She gives busy work homework thats just a pain in the ...  It was all useless.  She is a very reluctant to give A's, and even sometimes B's.  An A is manageable if you put enough effort into your final portfolio, but the readings, useless H/W, boring class, make me want to say stay as far away from this class as possible.
No Comments
Basically I worked my ass off for a B+.  However, the football player who had "hard practices" magically got an A.  His papers were incomprehensible.  She's very biased in her grading.

I had her for Two Cubas, and I thought she was great.  She was such a sweetheart and gave really great feedback.  Everyone I know from the class who at least put in some effort got A's.  The class was never boring.  She's a really cool, laid-back lady and I'd recommend her any day.
No Comments
No Comments
Engaging material. I like Prof. Letson and am glad I took the class.

I had a great time last semester in this class! It's true that the exams can be tough, but if you've been paying attention and attending class, you should be fine. The content was really interesting to me and I liked the assignments.

Letson means well and he enjoys what he teaches. However, his lectures/slides contain SO much info and his exams only contain 4 short answer questions, so its hard to know what to study and there is a lot of info to study within his slides. Grade is composed of 3 exams (30% x 3) and other (10%). Good prof but a lil boring and drones on sometimes.
Dr. Letson is truly a great prof! I learned a lot, but would def recommend coming to class cause attendance is important

He's a tough grader (though he is very very fair and willing to have open discussions about adding), but hearing him speak is so valuable. He's very open to taking students input in class discussions, and is super accessible to talk to after class. Loved him and this class!

reviews.comment: I'm learning so much with Professor Letson and feel like I'm really understanding the material. His class has been so helpful for me in my major and I like his teaching style.
Prof Letson is a stellar professor whose class helped me decide on my major. I found his class really interesting and thought it was an average difficulty. Definitely happy I took this class at UM!

Letson is the best teacher I have ever had. He made me realize that I definitely wanted to study Econ. Really appreciate how he goes about explaining confusing concepts. Everyone should take this class

I was very surprised to read some of these negative reviews. I could really tell Letson was interested in the topic at hand which made me really excited about it. Hes a great teacher and really cares about his students. Would definitely take this class again!

I took decision making in the environment thinking it would have to do with decision making in the environment and it was more economics and psychology than anything with the environment. He would bore the class to death by reading 70 page slideshows and then give us a "4 Question" test that really had 10 questions in each one. very tough grader.

Terrible professor. Don't take his class unless you have to. His tests are so unfair. HE IS HORRIBLE at teaching too.

If you respect him, hell respect you. You can do well in this class if you try. Letson is fair and a decent guy that I was lucky to have. I learned so much in this class, his real world examples are so helpful.

reviews.comment: Okay so lots of people say he grades to harshly but theyre just pissed they didnt do well which is their own fault because of their study habits. Letson is a fair and resonating teacher that your lucky to get.

He lectures a lot but I find them to be very interesting. If you pay attention and work hard you will do well. Letson is very informed and welcome to helping you if you have questions. Overall, nice teacher and class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I learned a lot in this class. I would say it's the best one I've taken in college. Letson knows what he's doing.
Amazing! he really knows how to reach students. He is very knowledgeable on the concepts he teaches and I respect him greatly.

letson is very nice, but lectures can be boring. only take if really interested in class material. classes consists of just powerpoint lectures-tests based just on them. only grades in the class are 3 exams that are fair. he can be monotone, but i really appreciate what i learned in the class. the material is important to know in real life.

reviews.comment: Probably the most boring teacher I've ever had. I feel bad cause he means well but just can't hold the attention of a classroom. Also seems like he grades harder than necessary

okay kiddos, so here's the deal. Only take this classteacher if it is needed for your major. Very boring and not engaging. He is not very responsive and gives gauge feedback.

Dr. Letson is definitely a very knowledgeable environmental economist, but his class his boring with a capital B. He talks very slowly and with the lights dimmed he's pretty much asking me to nap. Being a senior econ major this class is way below my level, so going to class is a waste of time and exams are stupid easy.

Really nice professor. Sucks because his lectures are mandatory for attendance and generally don't consist of course content. Everything you need to know can be found on Canvas modules. Exams are easy as long as you study the MCQs and homework assignments over and over again. The questions asked on exams are generally same format/super similar.

Take this class if you're comfortable learning independently. Attendance is strict and can be challenging for commuters. Class discussions can sometimes go beyond core material. No study guides are provided, so success depends on staying consistent with homework and MCQs. Office hours are helpful.

reviews.comment: He is a great professor of this class, and great guy too. I'm a marketing major with 0 interest in accounting or finance and the class was fun. 2 homework assignments due every Sunday, will take you probably

Very straightforward course, the tests are just like the practice ones so if you do the assignments and practice tests it won't be bad at all. Professor Levine is very well connected, respected, and experienced, so try to learn as much as you can from him even outside of class.

Super chill professor who tries his best to make time for his students. Has great life lessons and stories about his business experiences. He cares a lot about his students. Tests are composed of homework questions, so not doing well is simply a lack of putting the work in.

PROFESSOR LEVINE IS THE ABSOLUTE LEGEND AND THE GOAT! Shares very interesting business stories and clearly outlines what success in class looks like, you also learn a lot from his professional expertise. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

Not sure what that last student is talking about. The professor clearly stated that the final exam was cumulative. He constantly reminded us to rework our HW assignments from the last 3 chapters.  Attendance and HW count, so be sure to show up. Opened up a Robin Hood account at his urging. If you put in the effort and pay attention, you'll be fine.

While Seth Levine isn't an awful guy he's an awful professor. Lecture the entire time literally scripted class after class. He redesigned his classes & we had 100 questions to review for the final. He won't even tell you that 40% of the "Cumulative Final" isn't on the review and comes from the last two classes before break. Never put in HW.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: 1 homework assignment each week (about 16 questions) / 1 individual very simple project online / 1 group project (5 page paper) / 3 regular exams and 1 cumulative final exam /gives practice exams online before each exam: unlimited attempts - practice exam has the exact same questions and in the same order as real exam just the numbers are different

I learned nothing in his class. I learned everything on my own by doing his homeworks. His lectures are an absolute waste of your time. He rambles on and on about topics that have literally nothing to do with the course material. His lectures blow. If you take him, I'd actually recommend tanking the 5% attendance portion of your final grade.
Professor Levine is great, but there is an annoying amount of homework every week. However, the exams are super easy. Just take the practice exam ~5 times and you'll get an A.

insane amount of hw every single week but ngl i did NOT pay attention and skipped many lectures and i'm still gonna get an A bc the exams are the EXACT same as the practice exam. i saw many students being sus while taking exams but i promise u will get a better grade if u just memorize the prac exams and do them multiple times. i get 97> every exam

super easy class. Engaging lectures for material that is really boring. If you are in accounting talk to him, he knows every accountant and accounting firm in the Miami area. For studying, just do the practice exams 2-3 times before the test. They're the exact same as the practice exams.
THE GOAT. Take him he is literally the best prof in the Accounting Dept.

Professor Levine is super engaging and keeps content current. He had study guides that were almost identical to the exams. I don't know how well I learned accounting but easy to follow and do well on exams. He also hosted multiple reviews for the final which were VERY helpful and he is super accessible outside of class.

Super sweet guy, there's not a lot of homework, and it's graded by completion. There were 3 exams, and if I am being completely honest, I never paid attention and would lock in the night before. He is a super-easy grader as well. At first, attendance was not mandatory, but he started doing it after spring break. He did 3 in-class quizzes.
Definitely take! If you study, you will get an A. Homework and a quiz every week, but super easy.
Amazing and super engaging professor. Attendance is mandatory, but lectures are fun. If you study and actually try in the class, it's easy to get an A
The goat accounting professor, very caring and super easy grader. TAKE HIM!
Professor Levine is amazing - explains material well and if very funny and caring. Take him for 211!
Prof. Levine is genuinely such nice person who is super enthusiastic about the course he teaches. He makes it clear that he wants all of his students to succeed.

Such a straightforward, easy-going professor, and there are no surprises in this class. As long as you do the homework and practice exams before each of the midterms and final, you're good. Practice exams are identical to the real exams. You will genuinely learn a lot in this class and not even realize it until the end. 10/10 professor.

The best Prof in business school must take for accounting.  Howework every week a few exams and a group assignment.  Overall easy if you take practice exams a few times and do the howework and he is great during lectures mixing his own experience with the topics.  Can not recommend him enough.
Exams are exactly like practice tests. Fantastic guy in and outside of the classroom.

Amazing professor. He genuinely loves his students and wants everyone to succeed. Also, he really knows his stuff, has a deep understanding of the content, and is a highly effective lecturer. Highly recommend.

Professor Levine is an amazing professor! He does his best to keep the lectures engaging and enjoyable, considering the course material is not the most interesting to most students. There is quite a bit of homework, but it is extremely helpful in preparing you for tests. He is very chill, so he is a very easy professor to talk to.

Funny and caring guy, is always willing to help. A decent amount of homework each week that he goes through each week and is very easy to get done. Genuinely if you do bad on the exams its on you. he gives you a practice exam that if you do at least 3 times you will be fine. Group project and cyber text project which are both doable.
Won't add me back on LinkedIn but stil great professor. Awesome class though, highly recommend.
amazing, clear, and very helpful inside/ outside of class

One of the best Professors I had met in my life. This guy genuinely cares about his students well being, and is very kind, genuine, and understanding. He is very lenient with late assignments, and his exams are just like the practice exams. He cracks jokes in class and is very funny too. There is a reason why his rating is so high on this website.

Super nice professor.  Attendance is mandatory but he is really chill with excused absences.  He asks you take notes by hand but it isn't the end of the world.  Homework reflects on the exams and he gives practise exams that you can take multiple times which are almost identical to the actual tests.

Professor Levine is an engaging instructor. The course has a heavy workload, but the exams mirror the practice tests. Leveraging unstuckstudy alongside the textbook and lectures helps manage the content.
Simply and certainly the GOAT.

Professor Levine is an awesome accounting professor, but the course itself is content heavy. His final is 100 MCQ and cumulative which does suck and there is lots of homework per unit (13 units total). Would recommend taking him just be aware of a lot of content (the projects are also really easy)

Professor Levine is an amazing professor who cares about all his students. This class is a bit of work, but if you do the work, it is such a free A. 3 test, and he gives you a practice test that is the exact same as the real test. Even though there is a bit of homework, every single question from the test comes from the homework. TAKE HIM!!!
Professor Levine is a very good professor who makes sure his students do well. He especially helped with our two building blocks projects.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I've ever had. Very clear in class and always available for extra help. There is a lot of homework, but if you sit down and actually do it you'll do very well on exams. Exams are exactly like the homework and it's easy to study.

Very knowledgable professor.  Very easy class as the exams are almost the exact same as the practice exams.  As an accounting major, I didn't learn as much content as I would've liked to.  Lectures were great at the start but started to go off topic and unrelated to chapters covered about halfway through the course, and had to teach yourself.
Take Seth Levine. He's great and if you pay attention and do the hw you will succeed in the class. He gives practice exams that align with the test.
Amazing professor, attend the lectures and do the homework. Study the practice exams and you will succeed. Very knowledgeable and would definitely take him again.
The practice tests are SAME AS REAL TESTS DIFFERENT NUMBERS. LOVE THIS MAN.TAKE HIM NO MATTER WHAT.

Absolutely GOATED! Wonderful Professor and even better person. Very charismatic and explains the material thoroughly. I truly enjoyed being in Professor Levine's class and would definitely take him again. Most professors at UM should strive to be like him and UM would surely be a better place. Take him!
Lovely Professor! He should have a 6/5 minimum! Great guy, very knowledgeable and experienced!!
I did not like him at first but I love him now.  I understand why he has so many 5-star reviews.

Really nice guy but his lectures are a major bore. Gives an INSANE amount of busy work every week (for relatively simple material) through online textbook homework. New mandatory attendance policy and just rambles on about unrelated stuff during lectures. Great man, not the best prof...

reviews.comment: Seth Levine is a great professor and great guy

Class is relatively easy. Going to class isn't necessary to do good because the tests are just entirely based off the homework which he doesn't even really lecture about. Didn't learn much because I just memorized answer patterns from the practice tests which are exactly the same as the real test. He made the final super hard which was annoying.

Overall good professor. The project he has us do is super time consuming start early. Homework is a lot but super easy to get through (look into college tools extension and chegg). All unit test are easy just do practice test enough times. Final was extremely difficult to study for just try to keep a high A all semester so it doesnt affect too much
Amazing professor. Really wants students to do well, so show up to class even though attendance is not mandatory--it will work it your favor!

Great Professor, easy A class if you try.  He is very nice and caring. Easy hws and assignments but long and time-consuming. 3 tests, very very similar to the practice exams, just study with that. Final is 100 multiple choice questions, very tedious but you'll be fine. 2 projects, hw due every sunday and 3 tests. Great person!
Dr. Levine is the GOAT. You will not have a better Accounting professor. Take him and you'll pass easily, he's so nice and very accessible outside of class.
go to class and you will be fine

Tests are super easy cuz he gives you a practice test before that is the same as the real one. Going to class is kinda pointless because he doesn't teach stuff on the homework. Honestly didn't learn much because the tests are just memorizing answers/patterns. He made our final super hard for some reason which was really annoying to study for.

Professor Levine is a great lecturer. The class has a decent amount of homework, but he goes over it before it is due. Course is graded by 3 midterms and a final, an excel project, and a group paper.

More than half of the class doesn't show up, and he feels disrespected because of this. 
Show up, ask questions, do practice exams and you'll be fine
Best professor, if you show you care you will get an A.
Hes alright, a little overrated from the rates I have seen on here. Assigns absurd amounts of homework tho.

Professor Levine IS THE GOAT. he is honestly probably the #1 professor I've had so far at UM. He is the sweetest, kindest and most patient professor ever. He genuinely wants his students to do good and would give us these study guides for each exam and the exam is word for word the study guide. just practice the study guides and u'll get an A

No words to describe Professor Levine. He is the BEST. Accounting is very interesting and has a lot to it and Professor Levine portrayed this subject in a very understandable way. Attend class, Do the homework and practice exams a few times.
Best Professor I took at UM. Professor Levine truly deserves more than 5 stars. Very knowledgeable and intelligent. Don't think twice, take him!

Professor Levine is a LEGEND! We need more professors like him at UM. He's an extremely experienced teacher with a brilliant sense of humor. He makes every class very interesting and share his insightful stories and knowledge of the business field. Class is a breeze! Just do the practice exams a few times! Highly Recommend. ThankU Professor Levine!
W mans and W teacher. The homework is time consuming and just do the practice exams several times but that's really it.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Best professor I've had at UM. Very nice man and loves it when you answer or ask questions during class. Gives you practice exams which is exactly like the exam (different numbers). Doesn't allow computers or phones during class but it is worth not being on a phone. Easy A if you actually do the HWs

Ive never written a ratemyprofessor review however Seth Levine is that guy and deserves one. He is the best professor I've had at UM and makes accounting interesting and easy to learn. I would 100% recommend this class.
Lots of homework. But tests are really easy and it is preatty hard to not get an A in the class. Super funny and caring guy.

I loved Levine, dope guy. There is a lot of homework tho. He is always willing to help (usually telling you the answer) if you stay after class or go to office hours. He also talks about things that have nothing to do with the material, and always likes to connect with students who share his interests. He wants to know you as a person not a student
Really great professor. Knows his stuff. Will meet with you outside of class and wants to help. A lot of grades besides the exams like project and homeworks.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Amazing guy. Sometimes the homework was long but it was doable. Lectures were great even at 8am which is rare. Attendance is required but I never went and got above a 95 on every exam because tests are MCQ Questions. Overall grade is based on 3 tests, all hw & 2 projects. Got an A- due to my attendance grade oh well I wish he taught more classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Doc. Levine was the absolute best. I do not have enough good things to say about him. He is kind and understanding, the class is well-taught, he is very well-informed about his profession, and he is easily the best professor at UM. I loved this class more than anything I have ever taken and would take him a million times over.

I took this class as it was a requirement of the business school, with no previous knowledge of accounting. Still, Professor Levine made the classes interesting each day.  There were three homework assignments per chapter, and we usually covered a chapter in a week.  He does however go over the homework in class usually the day before it is due.
Levine is the goat, hands down. Fair amount of homework per week, tests are a breeze. Definitely recommend

Take Professor Levine if you can! His class is very straight forward. There is a decent amount of homework but I didn't find it too difficult. Exams are VERY easy, just practice the MCQs. Levine is very kind, he will excuse any absences you have if you let him know that you're not going. He always responds to questions too!

Levine is an amazing person and I've never had a professor wanting to help you so much. Lectures are super engaging, however, they are not relevant to whats on the exam--only the homework is--they are very easy if you study. The homework are also ridiculously long. Amazing guy but would change some things

Honestly, I hated accounting. I didn't find it interesting. But Professor Levine was literally the best and so sweet. Tests were easy, if you do the practice exams, you will be fine. Lots of homework but it helps.

Had Prof Levine for several classes as part of UofM's online Master's Accounting.  Wonderful guy, great professor.  The online program was in its infancy when I was there, with quite a few tech issues and inattentive prof's.  Thankfully, Levine oversaw the program and was always there to assist, even for courses he didn't teach. Highly recommended!
I really like this professor. He was amazing super funny. The tests are just like the homework. He is caring and makes accounting fun. I can't praise him enough!

Best professor I have had at UM. He tells you exactly what to study for his exams. He loves when you come to his office during hours and he is extremely knowledgeable and helpful. His exams are not difficult as long as you put the work in and study. Take him you won't be disappointed.

Great professor. Tells you exactly what you need to know for exams. Only criticism is that the final is multiple choice when the previous exams were mainly fill in and had maybe one or two multiple-choice questions. Not having the practice for the multiple-choice questions led me to get a significantly lower grade on my final than onthe other exams

Levine is an awesome professor. He truly cares about his students and explains all the topics very well. He gives you all the exam questions in advance and teaches you how to do the homework in class. He takes attendance every day but class is acc interesting. The final was a little difficult but he curved the grades. Wish I could take him for 212!

He's the best professor. He teaches very well, he doesn't care if you pay attention, but he's so charismatic that it is hard not to. He helps a ton with homework. You will not regret taking his class. He takes attendance each day.

Homework and readings to do each week that aren't bad. Exams are exactly like the homework. Professor Levine tries to make accounting fun with his stories and humor. Would definitely take this professor again.

Single best professor I've ever had and makes accounting fun to learn. While the HWs are time-consuming you eventually get into a groove and he spends many of his lectures going through it in class. He also tells you what type of questions are going to be on the test. If you CAN take him, don't hesitate because he will be booked up.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Levine is honestly the greatest professor at the U. Accounting may seem very boring but he is a very charismatic guy and makes lectures super enjoyable. He is super down-to-earth and honestly the kinda guy I would want to grab a beer with. I highly recommend you take him any chance you get.

There's a lot of work for this class, no other way to put it. Easy to do well if you are dedicated. Professor Levine is great, but the workload is a little ridiculous for an intro to accounting course. That being said, you will definitely learn because of how much work you hav to put it.
hes one of the best accounting professors. loved taking him wish i couldve taken him for acc212
So easy, great professor. A lot of homework but you can Chegg literally everything. Strongly advise taking him.

Prof. Levine is a great guy. The class has a LOT of homework and it can easily get overwhelming. Definitely try to learn the material on your own first to do the homework early so it doesn't get too crazy at the end of each week with everything being due. Overall a solid professor

A really great guy and is super engaging during class. There is a decent amount of homework for each chapter and two long projects but honestly it was not bad. He is definitely the best one to take out of all the accounting professors.

Obviously online makes the experience a bit different but he goes above and beyond for his students and was the most passionate professor I had this semester. If you're bad at accounting then you won't like any ACC professor you have, so even then he is clearly the best one to choose from.
Yes the work is time consuming but get everything done and it will be the easiest A and accounting class you've ever taken. Also a very humorous guy, you won't regret taking him!

Good guy, but a very lazy professor. All the grading is completely automated, so he has absolutely no problem assigning you countless hours of homework and projects that will make you lose your mind. The work is not very challenging, just unbelievably long, time consuming, and boring
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: COOLEST acc professor ever. He is hilarious and curious about everything and will ask you questions about your personal life but not in a weird way. He is very smart and knows the topics VERY WELL, you will learn a lot. Respected man. Homeworks ( and the two projects) are VERY LONG but prepare you very well for the tests. :)

Professor Levine is a really good guy. His tests are easy, just like the homework. There's a good amount of homework, but do it and you'll do great on the tests. His lectures are good, he can get carried away sometimes. Projects can be a pain but he guides you through them. He responds to emails fast. Recommended!
He is great professor! Goes over the homework every week to make sure you understand every question. His exams are literally the homework. Study the homework and you'll get good grades.

Prof. Levine is awesome! He makes his lectures interesting and engaging. There's weekly homework on Connect Math, but the tests are exactly like the homework. There's 2 major projects but they are very doable and he helps you plenty. I highly encourage you to take him!

seth levine is the MAN. This guy's love for accounting is honestly inspiring. not one person in my class is majoring in accounting, but I'm pretty sure we're all considering it at this point. He is very relatable and very accessible outside of class - he loves when you go to office hours!! there's hw but not too bad, tests are legit the hw.

Levine is hilarious in class and lectures are pretty entertaining as he weaves random jokes stories into each class. Attendance isnt mandatory. My one warning with his class is the work. Be prepared to do 5-7 hours with the actual hw and the stupid smartbook for each chapter (there are 12) Other profs dont require the smartbook so keep that in mind

Prof Levine is the best! He only lectures every few classes, which go by quick because he's hilarious, the others he takes to go over the homework to ensure students know how to do it and what's going on. He prepares you super well for the final telling you exactly what material to cover and is always available outside class.

Took this class for the good reviews but class is overhyped. Stay away. He's a cool guy, yeah, but the amount of work you have to put in is insane. The homeworks and stuff are definitely doable and helpful, but then he does projects (building blocks especially) you have to complete as well which are EXTREMELY time consuming and miserable. Stay away
Love Prof. Levine... TAKE HIM IF POSSIBLE
