THE BEST PROFESSOR I HAVE MET AT UM IN MY FIRST 2 YEARS. Professor Levine is always willing to help and very caring. He is the epitome of what a great professor should be. MEN LIE WOMEN LIE NUMBERS DON'T

Prof Levine sparked my interest in finance and accounting that I never knew even existed. Wants you to learn and do well. He embodies the type of professor that all others should aspire to be. Take his class !

He is the best professor I have met! He's lecture is very interesting and himself is very nice. There are homework but if you attend the class, that will be very easy for you. The tests are also very easy, he will tell you which kind of questions he will ask. The questions in the tests are nearly the same as in the homework.
Great professor, patient and willing to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great Professor, definitive took this class. He made the class fun and enjoyable. He is caring, easy to reach outside the classroom and really wants you to learn and cares about his students. HMKs are covered during class and exams are based on the HMK. 2 projects which are long but easy.

Professor Levine is awesome! He is super charismatic, hilarious, and beyond knowledgable about accounting and tangentially relevant info. He makes lectures interesting with his humor and info on random, interesting topics. Weekly online homework and online exams with problems taken straight from the homework. Super easy class and a great professor!

If you are an accounting major you MUST take Levine for 211. The class might be slightly harder than other professors but you will actually learn the material. Levine is a funny dude full of dad jokes and the exams are challenging, but not impossible. Class is curved as well.

Seth Levine is a great professor, Accounting is not the most engaging subject for many so the material can be dense, but he does his best to make up for this by filling his lectures with humor and stories. If you enjoy sarcastic stories his lectures are very funny.

An overall good class for getting an introduction to accounting. Some of his tests were very hard not b/c the material was challenging, but b/c of the number of questions given and content covered in such a short testing period.

One of the best teachers at UM. He is hilarious and makes the course fun. The material is very basic and not difficult. Go to class and do homework are you will get a good grade. Kids who struggle in this class are ones who do not put in the work and wait until the last minute to study. Really great guy

He is a really nice guy, tries to make students enjoy his lectures. However, I did not like his teaching method, he goes too fast and writes excessive information on the board. The homeworks are VERY long and have nothing to do with the tests, but at least he shows how to do them before class.

Prof Levine is the best! Funny, enjoyable classes. Not totally mandatory attendance. Weekly homeworks are long but you can work with friends and he'll help you if you ask. I wouldn't have taken anyone else for the class!

Prof Levine made his lectures enjoyable and seemed like a nice guy. If you needed help, I'm sure he would be more than willing to give you a hand if you asked. If you do and understand the homework and the multiple choice questions he recommends for exams, the class won't be that difficult.
Professor Levine is really kind, responsive, and keeps his lectures interesting. He has a great personality, which makes the subject a lot more bearable.
Great professor, easy to understand. You have to show up to class. Weekly homeworks. One final project. Two exams and final.

One of the professors that actually cares about his students and will go above and beyond to help you. Hands down one of my favorite professors on campus by far. Class is super easy, and not mandatory but if you want a good grade show up. Homeworks are really hard but if you go to class he gives you the answers. Go out of your way to take Levine.

He is freaking awesome. Such a cool guy. Loves accounting. If you do the homeworks and the readings you'll be totally fine. Plus he is always quick to respond to emails and try to help you out. TAKE HIM.

Levine is one of my favorite professors at UM. His lectures are very enjoyable for teaching accounting. During class he goes over the homework problems before they are due so you can ask questions. His tests a pretty straight forward, just go to class and study his power points. Definitely take him if you can for 211.

Best professor at the U! He's insanely intelligent and helpful and such a funny guy. The homework may seem like a lot but it's very doable and honestly helps you understand the material so much more. If you're stuck on it, he helps you during class/outside of class. Learned so much in this class and got me excited for accounting! TAKE LEVINE

THE BEST! He's got a great sense of humor and make you actually want to attend class. I enjoyed his class so much and trust me i am someone that gets bored really easily! Take accounting with someone else and it's YOUR LOSS!
Great professor, it is enjoyable to go to class. If you pay attention and do the homework you should be able to get an A. One of the best professors at UM. Take him!!!
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Levine is the best professor that I've taken for Accounting. He makes up his own test so it is completely open ended. But he tells you exactly what is on it the class before. Keeps students engaged. Very helpful with the two projects that the class contains

Seth is a great lecturer and knows how to keep his students engaged. He's funny and makes the material not boring and easy to understand. The class before the test he tells you exactly what you need to know. The final is difficult but he curves it so it's not hard to do well on it. You don't have to go to every class to get an A. TAKE SETH!!
Great communication!  Very knowledgeable, and accessible.

He is a great teacher. DEFINITELY take him for ACC. His tests are very easy, he tells you exactly what is going to be on the test. Makes class fun especially for the 8am i'm in with him. He goes through the homework with the class. Overall, I would take him again if i could.

He is an amazing teacher, very helpful, explains the material more than once, he has a sense of humor and you have tests that are based on class discussions which makes them not so though if you take notes. I will definitely take him!

I took ACC211 with him and I'm happy that I took it with him. His lectures are amazing and you can learn a lot from his experience as an auditor. He goes over the homework questions in class and his two midterms were really similar to the homework problems. I would definitely recommend  taking the class with him.
I love Professor Levine. I thought he was great, and the homework is representative of the test. If you go to class, you will get an A

Awesome professor, goes over online homework in class, all/most of the questions from the tests are from the online homework. You can go to his office hours at any time and get help. Super helpful and very very funny. I took his class at 9am and it was still awesome even that early in the morning.
Levine is the best professor to take accounting with. He is so nice and helpful. Class not mandatory but you will want to go just bc he goes through the homework in class.

Not necessarily an easy class, but Levine is an awesome teacher who truly wants you to get a good grade. He has a lot of real world accounting experience and knows what he's talking about. Would take again!

Levine is awesome! He's one of the funniest people i have ever met, and he really knows what he's talking about when it comes to accounting. The tests are a bit tough but if you pay attention in class, then they shouldn't be a problem. He made accounting interesting, and gave great lifemoney advice. LOVE HIM

His lectures are interesting but he doesn't explain concepts very well. You should definitely read the text book and do the hw if you want to pass the exam. He's very nice and is always willing to help. Goes over hw the class before its due, helps with projects, and gives review for exam.

Great professor. The final was hard and I am an accounting major so definitely study hard for it. He is really enthusiastic and makes the subject interesting. I was a finance major until I took this class, now I am an accounting major.
THE BEST professor! He made the boring class content very entertaining. By all means take him!

Great professor! Makes everything very easy to learn with real life examples. Exams are easy if you read the textbook and go to class. He does great reviews before exams. Unfortunately, 125 question cumulative final, but I think that's with any ACC211 professor. Homework is easy and actually helpful. Projects graded easily.

Best teacher you could possibly have to take this class. Smart, funny, and organized. Keeps it interesting. If you do not take this class with Levine I'm sorry for you. He also throws away tough questions and almost always has a curve on top of that.
One of the nicest teachers at UM. Really clear and fair when it comes to the test and grading. Am not a fan of accounting, but this guy makes it interesting.

Cool guy, really funny. Boring class. I didn't learn much in class since all he ever did was go over the HW problems without explaining the logic behind anything. Read the textbook and do the online flash cards (I forget what they're called) and you'll be fine.
he is the man, take his class

HE is AWESOME. Makes the course interesting and FUN. Pay attention in his class and take notes because they are helpful for the tests. REALLY FUNNY and enthusiastic! DEFF. made ACCOUNTING experience a pleasurable one (:

Levine is a legend, very funny, makes jokes the entire class but still manages to teach well. Hes pretty engaging and goes over the homework in class before you have to turn it in. Tests are hard but you can easily get an A if your put in enough time
Great teacher. Easy to understand, goes over homework in class. You just have to read the textbook to keep up. class isn't mandatory, but some test questions are based on class discussions
Great guy, easy class. As long as you do the homework and pay attention this class is very doable. Professor levine is also engaging and entertaining. Highly recommend him

Professor Levine is a really nice guy who cares a lot about helping his students. The exams are difficult but he grades them on a curve. Attendance isn't mandatory but some classes are useful to attend since he gives you the answers to the online homework (which can be hard). Definitely take Levine for ACC211!!!

Accounting is a difficult course, with each project being only 7%, but Levine makes it good. We do the homework in class and can even check it before its turned in and fix it for correct answers, so easy 6% there. Tests are hard and more concepts than journal entries. However, Levine is a great professor and I recommend him.
great professor. Attendance not mandatory, good classes and easy tests. Makes a lot of jokes during class (some of them very bad but still funny!).
Great and funny professor

Attendance is not mandatory but he goes over the online homework (that hasn't been turned in yet) every class so it's worth it. He doesn't teach much, he mostly just talks about the stock market but he's really nice and very knowledgable. If you have any questions, he's willing to answer them. Definitely take him!
i enjoyed this class so much. he is a very nice guy. he reply you every email and explain clearly. need more reading before the class.
Doesn't teach, but it's easy to do well on tests if you pay attention to the homework and read the chapters.

He makes the content really clear and relates it to current events. Tests are multiple choice and not incredibly easy, but not hard or tricky either. He is pretty easy going and overall a great teacher. Highly recommend.

Read the book before going to class and you'll be more than fine. Exams are extremely straight forward and he's a hilarious guy. He actually made me change my major to Accounting from how much I enjoyed his class. Definitely the best 211 Prof.

He's cool. He always responds to e-mails and messages. He's a friendly guy and a good teacher and he's pretty funny. Only thing I didn't like was his ban on laptops. Other than that, I'm pretty sure he's the best ACC 211 teacher.
Just read the book and you'll do fine. Going to class is not really needed; you go over the hw in class. Hw helps with understanding the material. Tests are straight foward, JUST READ.

Great teacher, really nice guy.  Attendance is definitely not necessary since he usually just goes over the homework in class.  Tests are usually pretty long so watch out for that.  He made a 9am doable.  Loved him and def recommend

He is a down to earth nice guy, who is definitely willing to repeat things over and over until you get it. If you pay some attention while doing the homework, the class isnt terrible to get through, just time consuming. He made me not hate accounting as much as I thought I would.
hes awesome!!! what a nice, great guy. his class is very straightforward too..

He's great. He really loves accounting and he makes a case for why you should love it too. For me it worked because I switched my major. lol. But he isn't difficult. The exams are straight forward. Take him.

He makes the material as easy as it can be. He is nice and very helpful. Doesnt take attendence but you should definatly go if you want to understand the material. 3 exams, 2 projects, and weekly online homework that take about 2 hours to complete. Its not an easy class but if you have to take it, take him.

VERY HELPFUL. Attendance not mandatory but it will help in the long run when things get tougher and confusing. Online quizzes and 2 projects are a pain but actually helped me understand the material better, and you'll definitely want to take a lot of time to study for tests!!!

Hes a good teacher, you can def get an A if you put time into it, the key to doing well on his tests is: PRINTING AND STUDYING HIS ONLINE LECTURE NOTES. They are amazing and very clear. His tests are pretty short: think 50 multiple choice and hes not out to trick you. PROBLEM: his HW is ridic, its online and due every friday before midnight, so har

I would definitely recommend him. His class was more bearable than I expected an accounting course to be. The homework manager is annoying and got kinda hard towards the end. I studied more than most for the tests, go through the power points, do the online quizes, and read some of the book if you're unsure. You can get an A w/o too much trouble.
Levine is the man. He's hilairious and makes things clear. Very fun and informative class, easy too.

Loved him! Great teacher and very knowledgable. Gives you a lot of outside knowledge about the business world and current events. Reviews before every test and basically tells you exactly what you need to know. Easy A! Gives optional quizzes online and that's where the test questions come from so you can be easily ready.
Great professor. Presents materials clearly. Can self teach with the powerpoints online. Worth going to class to listen to his knowledge.
I used the book to teach me everything. Going to class isn't necessary if you are able to self-teach. I managed an A so it certainly is much easier than everyone is making it out to be.

he's very entertaining and almost worth waking up at 9 o'clock for just to listen to his jokes. he's a really good guy, but his tests are hard! make sure to try to understand the chapters as you go along and attend class...also im the only one that has serious homework from accounting

All Multiple Choice Tests, if you study and do the review questions then you are golden.  Must keep up with the homework.  Projects are easy.  If you do the homework, study hard, and go in for help when needed; you will do fine
he is a great teacher with multple choice tesat and easy projects. you ahve to keep up with homeworka nd study hard becuase the multiple choice tests are hard. mhis final is HELL
Easy, clear, and helpful. Do the homework and study hard for final. He has the least requirements when it comes to the red book. Take him over the other 211 teachers.
i would rather jump into a cactus pile than take this final! it was impossible!

love this guy. great teacher and super nice guy. very straightforward about the material and provides useful real life examples like stocks etc. wants you to do well in his class. i wouldn't take anyone else

Awesome teacher! Very straight forward and clear about the material. Shows interest in the class and wants you to do well. Gives you real life examples and tries to make it "fun". The tests are easy. I definitely recommend him!

FINAL WAS HELL...other exams all semester were hard considering he never really goes over the book and speaks his mind every class...exams r never about what he talks about...horrible class...good teacher but does not teach what is on his exams
Fun class but be careful: THE FINAL IS HELL, the regular exams are much easier than the final.
Loved his class, funny guy, makes class interesting, if you have the mind for business stuff then this class should be totally easy
No Comments
nice guy, very helpful

He's definitely the best Accounting professor I had at UM.  The test aren't too difficult, but the majority of your grade is based on the different projects like the redbook project, I see the light, and the byte of accounting.

The class is very easy if you have a clue about basic math and do the homework. The homework is done online and really encourages you to get it done completely and on time because it's fill-in-the-blanks.  The teacher really only repeated the stuff I picked up on my own from the homeworks.

Come on people,accounting really isn't that hard. His tests really aren't that hard.I barely studied for them and I got a B on all of them. He helps you out with so much easy extra credit there's no reason not to get an A in this class.He goes step by step through the I See the Light so it's cake.

He's not a bad guy, but he must not have a clue when it comes to creating tests. I had a 4.0 before taking this class and the best grade I have gotten on any of his tests is a 78 and I studied 36 hours. I now hate accounting and UM would be a much better place without him teaching!

It was so hard to understand him and his lectures were not the most interesting. He only teaches the last one third of the course though so that is a plus. I did well on his exam by studying the past exams and some of the study guide. Good luck!

The delivery of information is very difficult to follow/nonexistent. The class structure relies heavily on peer discussion rather than actual instruction, so be prepared to rely on the textbook to fully grasp the concepts. Feedback in class is very blunt; if you aren't prepared with the right answer, the environment is discouraging.

Dr. Licthenheld is very soft spoken and hard to understand with his thick German accent. His tests are much harder in content than the first two midterms and it is rather difficult to do well on. His lectures were interesting but a bit too specific for an intro course for the subject. He is very knowledgeable but hard to follow at times.

Literally switched minors bc of this class. Ended with an A+ but it was a FIGHT to get there. Lecture slides are quite literally just pictures and they dont record so you have to pay close attention to hear details which is hard bc you also cant understand him too well. They give study guides but exam is 10x harder. Attendance gives you grade boost

You could tell that he knows what he is talking about and cares about microbiology, the only issue is that the tests are very hard, and he has a thick accent. Oftentimes, i find myself not understanding what he says in the lecture and seems as if he is teaching the material in ways that only he is able to understand.

Taught the second part of immunobiology. Lichtenheld assigned the most textbook readings and expected us to know the most concepts, but it was helpful because I did the best in this section. Asked the class a lot of questions throughout the lectures to make sure we were following. Exam questions were less straightforward and make you apply concepts

Probably the least engaging out of all the MIC319 professors. Course is taught by 4 different professors and he taught the barrier cell section. Very knowledgeable but didn't present the information in an engaging way. I found this section the most difficult. Nice professor but difficult to follow at times and lacked a personable presence

he was nice and funny but his lectures were very confusing and it was hard to follow sometimes. however though the mic301 class being online was such a mess in general that in person hes probably different so i can not say much.

He teaches the immunology component of MIC 301. While I found this topic to be the most interesting in the class, it was also by far the hardest. He uses the same diagram in every class to explain different concepts which got confusing, and he mentioned a lot of topics that were not necessary for the exam. Very passionate about the subject!

I really don't understand these negative reviews. Yes, he is harder than the other two professors for 301 because he doesn't give you the answer in the question but if you just pay attention in class and review the slides before the test you will do more than fine in the class. Super friendly and fair

Probably the hardest section of the 301 course. Sometimes his lectures can feel a bit disorganized but he's a funny guy and keeps it entertaining. If Chase is your TA definitely reach out to her if you're struggling she's really nice and good at explaining things.

He's pretty hard to understand and is not really straight forward. If it was not for our TA in the class I probably would not have passed, she helped me prep for exams and gave me guidance that was missing from him. He made studying for the exams pretty difficult and almost dropped the class cause of his teaching but glad I stayed I still got an A.

Loved the MIC301 class but hated this section. Hes hard to follow and talks a lot about sections we dont even need to know. He can be hard to understand at times. 100% go to tutoring for immunology. The majority of the info in the lectures you dont even need to know. Also def reach out to your TA, ours was great and theyre a great resource.

Overall an easier course, but this specific section on Immunology with him was very difficult. His lectures are hard to follow, repetitive, and very specific. Definitely have to be put in the time to review topics taught by him because he doesn't make much sense.
i took mic 301 and mic 319 and he was one of the profs. he's good, but i always found his test questions to be the hardest. really nice guy though.

Course is taught by other lectures as well but I found his section to be difficult because of the way he lectures. He rambles on a bit and his accent is strong and talks a bit slow. Expect to stress out before each exam, there's A LOT of information & you have to kind of figure out what will be on the exam yourself. He is a nice professor though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Lichtenheld is an amazing lecutor and really knows his stuff. This isn't by any means an easy A but MIC is a difficult topic so it has to be expected. He is ready to help you understand the material and he does really care about his students! Great Professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I had Dr. Lichtenheld for both Innate and Adaptive immunity and I really liked his classes. He is very good at explaining immunology and makes it a fascinating subject. Besides being very approachable, he is one of the few professors who interact with students. This always pushed me to think and check my understanding. I highly recommend!

By far the single most challenging professor in the whole entire Microbiology Department. Asks the trickiest questions on his exams and quite difficult to understand, Dr. Lichtenheld really pushes you to your absolute limits. But in the end, it is worth it. He's the most brilliant professor in the Immunology Department and writes great rec letters.

One of the seven instructors who co-taught MIC 321 (immunobiology).  Lichtenheld is a really great guy -- friendly, approachable, etc. -- and a good teacher. Doing well on his quiz requires a good grasp of the material, but if you show up to his lectures and take notes and ask questions, you should be fine.
Almost all the microbiology classes are taught by more than one professors. Personally, I like Litchenheld the most!!! I love his accent and his tests are the easiest!

You will have a hard time understanding him, but he is by far the easiest teacher you will have in this class. You get taught my numerous teachers, one for every module. He is very willing to help, and he does have a sense of humor...sometimes. Work hard, go to every class, and you can pull off an A.

You have to go to class to understand what is going on. His powerpoints are just diagrams and everything else is what he says. it is all concepts and not facts. English is not his first language and you may have a hard time understanding him. Class is interesting and you have to put alot of attention, grading was fair and he's very helpful!

Really nice guy. This was his first time teaching, and he did an excellent job. The organization of this class has nothing but the student in mind. 7 quizzes, NO FINAL, drop a quiz. He also LISTENS to the students and improves his course. He knows his stuff. He really makes you think actively.

She has 2 exams which are multiple choice and fairly easy. The homework is generally harder than the actual exams, so make sure you understand the homework. She also cancels class very often to give time to do homework, usually one class is cancelled every 2 weeks. Her exams follow what she talks about in class too.

I love this woman. She is SO nice and will always try to help her students. take advantage of her office hours because they help. theres only two quizzes and the homeworks are easy. at the end of the semester she will reopen hw and allow retakes for quiz 1. she does take attendance often but she cancels class the day homeworks are due which is good

She is amazing, first class I have actually learned and been able to apply to the real world. Its 3 papers with a lot of reading. She goes over what she's looking for in the essays so actually show up on those classes.

Took attendance verbally (like a grade school substitute teacher) most classes, would lecture for about 10 minutes, and you'll be out early. She's very clear about what's on the exams (comes from the MyEconLab homeworks). Also she's super nice and caring
She is super sweet, but hard to follow.  Her lectures are kinda confusing and she has an accent.  I did not do well on the tests, but she gives changes to improve your grade.

Very chill professor, she wants you to succeed, and unless you are a bum you probably will. Homeworks are fairly easy (though time consuming), and tests are almost exactly the same as the homeworks except for some calculation questions. She is always very clear on expectations for the class and exams, so you should never be surprised.

Such a chill professor, material is straight forward and she makes the class very easy and understandable. 2 tests and homework for each chapter due towards the end of the semester. However, if you really want to learn about economics I would suggest looking at other professors. But if you are looking for something easy and chill, take her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: 30% exam 1, 30% exam 2, 10% attendance, 30% hw. It's super easy and super straightforward. She doesn't curve or do extra credit but you get a cheat sheet (front and back) on the exams (theres also no final) so it is super easy to get an A in. It's all lecture based but straightforward.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She gives a lot of writing. Be ready to write 3 papers. While she is very funny, her grading on her essays is very unclear and sometimes she is not clear with what she wants exactly written. She gives 60 page handouts for the essays sometimes. Besides the 3 mandatory papers, there is now HW or tests. Also she sometimes takes attendance.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Her class is easy. You will be graded on eight homework assignments and two exams that are open note, which works to your advantage. She takes attendance only sometimes and often cancels class. However, she is very rude to students and barely responds to emails. If you have any doubts, do not expect her to help.

Professor Susino is my favorite professor I've had here. She is the best! She is so kind and is amazing at teaching MacroEcon. We have two tests and the homeworks are counted for a test grade (mostly all the answers are on quizlet so easy A for a test grade) NO FINAL!! Tests are fairly easy and you get a cheat sheet! TAKE HER!!!!
The goat take her

Professor Susino is hilarious without even trying to be. Biweekly HW assignments that she gives you the day off to complete, and 2 exams make up the entire course. Study the homework's and take notes during the exam reviews and you will be fine!

Susino is so nice and chill. You don't have to go to class everyday and we get the powerpoints for all her lectures. She often cancels class to give us extra time for homework assignments that we have about every other week. She is a very good teacher and tries her best to make sure that everyone understands the material. Definitely take her class!

This class is so easy. She's a good presenter and engages her students when she presents information. The class is graded on homework assignments, attendance, and two tests that are similar to homework problems.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Awesome teacher! Lectures through PowerPoints but brings in outside text to tie things in. Only 2 tests and she will help you in any way she can to get you your A. Knows how to teach Econ to kids!! Love her!

This is by far the GREATEST Professor I took at UM! Take her with no extra thought. She makes class very interesting and is very understanding. She knows her material and most importantly knows how to present it in a way students would leave class with 150% understanding it. She is the BEST! 2 Quizzes, show up to class, and Enjoy Economics! ThankU!

Great professor! Only 2 tests and makes sure you are well prepared with two review days. She also lets you use a cheat sheet on the test which helps a ton. If you study you will do well. Homework is also a big portion of your grade which is a great booster. Take her!!!
The best economics professor. She inspired me to take more classes and now econ is my second major even though I originally had no interest in the subject. Love her and her class.

Professor Susino presented information well in class, and it mostly matched what was on tests and homework. She cancelled class half the time and we often left early. Her tests are based off of the homework questions and you get two tries. Easy class if you actually look at the material.

Prof. Susino is a gem. If you have the chance to take her TAKE HER!! She knows her stuff and the lectures are very interesting as she relates everything to our own personal lives. Put in the effort and you will make an A guaranteed. She is super caring and really wants her students to succeed.

Really great professor. Gives informative lectures. Her accent kinda forces you to pay attention better, which was really helpful. Whenever she assigns homework, she cancels class on the day it's due to give you time to do it. Also will move class online if it's raining so nobody has to walk to class in the rain. Really nice, would take again.

Professor Lorca is an AMAZING professor. She cares so much about her students. TAKE HER CLASS! I always struggled in Macroeconomics but because of her lectures and assignments, I love macroeconomics. Attendance is mandatory but take her class, you'll be guaranteed an A if you show effort in her class.

She is so sweet and cares so much about her students. Her tests are exactly like the homework and if you go to class and listen and do your homework you'll be totally fine. The answers to all the homework are on quizlets or are on the online textbook. If you want an easy A, take her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: she's an absolute gem

She is a really nice and approachable professor. We only had 2 exams and 8 homework assignments. As long as you read over the Powerpoints and do the homework you should do well in the class. Attendance is not mandatory, but I recommend attending lecture because she sometimes cuts out parts of the chapter and you would only know if you attend.
reviews.rating_tags: Tests? Not many--EXTRA CREDIT--Would take again

reviews.comment: She does not care if you show up to class or not and would prefer you not to come if you are not going to pay attention or distracting others.  Quizzes are open book and notes, tests are not. f you pay attention and review, you should be fine. Pretty funny at times.

Very easy class.  Her teaching is very solid and she will explain things if you ask in class.  She gives 3 (final is non-cumulative) exams that are 30-33 multiple choice questions with 5 extra credit questions.  No homework, your grade is the average of your tests.  Very nice lady outside of class as well.
Amazing. Love her and her class.best teacher ever

Had her for 212 and now have her 211. Attendance is not mandatory at all, only for tests and turning in MC assignments. Tests are all MC and TF and are somewhat challenging but not too bad. You have to teach yourself the material but she gives so much extra credit its very easy to get an A

Lorca-Susino is honestly a very nice and welcoming person. Her class is basically optional and she uses mainly the PowerPoints. However, her tests are ridiculous. The curve is harsh and most kids end up getting very poor grades in her class. She makes it difficult for anyone to know their current status in the class. WOULD NOT RECOMMEND

Lorca is very funny. She wants to give you a good grade. The class is boring and she will be the first to admit it. Usually she will teach everything she wants to before the time is up in the class and let you out early.
Just study the power points and you will do well.
She gets really annoyed when you ask her a question. You can tell she doesn't want to be there.

I was in the CIM 631 Co-lab class, and I didn't enjoy it. Your project management skills, which are essential for this class, need improvement. There wasn't enough communication with customers or the company, and the team wasn't supported. I believe that more preparation and a stronger grasp of the subject are needed for teaching this class.

Took her for CIM103. One of the best professors in Interactive Media. She is very open to helping students during the class and gave helpful tips. Her lectures were interesting and she was very clear and fair when grading assignments. For projects, she would always give work days to do them during class. She also gave a lot of great feedback.

Great professor, super smart and creative within her field. I've taken about 3 of her classes now and would highly recommend if you are interested in the more creative side of interactive media. The wearables technically class is great if you like interactive media and sewing, just be prepared that its a lot of hours outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed her class. You follow along with whatever she's doing on your own computer and use whatever you learn to do projects. She has workdays closer to the due date of every project where she plays lofi music and is there for questions. You don't have to stay for the whole class on those days if you don't need to.

Gives assignments that don't make sense and seems like busy work. Plays obnoxious music during quizzes. 
Her class is very tedious in lecture and projects.

You are very likely to pass her class, but it will be at grueling pace. 

6/10, not great but not bad.
I/O is interesting, but it's definitely on the abstract side and involves a lot of self-guided work. Your grade mainly comes from two midterms and a final.

The material presented within lectures was covered well, but the material on the exams was mostly reflective of online notes. Many topics were scarcely covered within lecture but are well covered within the review notes. Studying outside of class is necessary to do well on the exams. Easy to reach outside of class and has a passion for Econ.

Professor Locay is a good guy with a passion for economics. He's really good at teaching theory but he doesn't review the math applications at all.  One test will be take home, and he gives a pretty heavy curve at the end of the semester. His in person lectures are kind of helpful but the online ones, and the practice questions are better.

Professor Locay wasn't really all too bad. He doesn't teach well for sure, but he is a well of interesting knowledge that he will talk about in class all of the time. Doing well on exams wasn't extremely difficult if you have a math brain.

This class has absolutely nothing to do with econ. The entire focus is on old Hollywood movies and his obsession with them which is great for film nerds but not for anyone looking to take an econ course. There are weekly quizzes on the movies and the expectation is for students to watch ca. 2-3 movies/week. Students are treated like they are in HS.

Professor Locay is a horrible teacher. I took this class because I had no other option. He yaps about his childhood while talking to his two daughters, who aren't even enrolled. Feels like a daycare. He gives quizzes every class, each on new movies and each quiz is made to purposely trick you. DO NOT TAKE.

Luis's lectures are a waste of time. He never covers exam content, instead rambling about unrelated topics for most of class. He also assumes you have extensive economics background and provides zero foundational teaching. You'll learn more from his practice problems than from attending his lectures. I strongly recommend avoiding this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Luis' lectures all seem to lack clarity and he fails to cover course material effectively. His exams are unreasonably difficult and don't align with what's taught. Compared to his previous class I took (Eco 302), this class is marginally more manageable, but still challenging. Definitely don't recommend.

Everyone I talked to had the same complaints: the class was disorganized, barely any material was taught, the exams were unnecessarily hard, & there was almost no help outside of class. It's a shame this was the only option for 302 at UM. I wanted to like the professor, but the way the class was run made it frustrating & impossible to enjoy/learn.

Although it doesn't really help, I recommend attending just so he knows who you are. His material is very hard, especially for a 300 lvl class. He frequently interrupts the class for a phone call or will start eating in front of us. He doesn't teach, & his class is very disorganized. His exams are very difficult. This was my 2nd time in his class.

Hard to discern my grade, but it was very very hard. I got two C's in the first 2 exams, the final was impossible. Everyone I spoke to struggled. He announced curves for the tests, but nothing has ever been disclosed, nor have they been applied. When confronted, he told us that if we couldn't calculate the curve, then we shouldn't be in the class.

Barely passed the class, Teacher is awful. DO NOT TAKE!! Ton of students are having to retake. Take with someone else! He just rambles all class and attendance is mandatory, so you have to show up. His weekly quizzes don't help your grade. Exams are impossible.

Dr. Locay is one of the smartest professors in the economics department at UM. He is passionate about the material and his lectures are very straightforward. The class is relatively easy if you pay attention in class and read the lecture notes. The practice problems in the lecture notes and the multiple choice quizzes are the best way to study.

Since this was the only professor offering the course, I strongly recommend fighting with UM to take it at another school. He doesn't clarify exam content or useful materials. Instead of teaching, he rambles about personal life while reading slides. Don't waste your time - the class is disorganized and his teaching style is ineffective.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Luis doesn't care about struggling students. Multiple answer questions are impossible - he doesn't even clarify which ones are multiple answer vs. choice. Be prepared to study more than you would for 500-level courses. One missed answer choice means zero credit. If you're not a straight-A student in economics, avoid this professor at all costs.

Great Professor and Economist.  His class is well organized and the course materials are available via Blackboard. Be prepared to study, however, if you do you are going to learn and do well. He is one of the most decent professors at UM.

I am in this class and I pay attention the entire time but he talks about everything except things that are on the exams. 90% of the class is him talking about random things. He expects you to know everything about previous economics classes that you've taken. Learned more using the practice problems than sitting in class. Don't take this class

Locay is probably the best Econ professor at UM. He is an old-school type professor from UChicago who really knows about microeconomics (price theory) and teaches it with some interesting application problems. 512 is more math-based than 302, but it is not impossible; you only have to do the work.
A lot to share, a very good person and they type of scholar that you one to have as a professor. It is not a walk in the park, but we are in uni to learn!

One of the worst professors I have ever had, more than half the class will be spent on him ranting about irrelevant stuff. The questions on his tests make absolutely no sense and he isn't helpful when you ask him questions either.

The best professor I've ever had at UM. He's a tough, old-school type of teacher who's not for everyone, however is one that I've come to greatly appreciate. The course is difficult, but has a steep curve, and is extremely interesting. I'd say I've learned more in this course than any other so far.

Prof. Locay is clearly an extremely smart man. However, lectures can be hard to follow (and many times go off on tangents), so make sure you read the written lectures to understand the material. Besides that, tests are straight forward and always related to what you are learning in the practice problems. If you put in the work, you'll be fine.

One of the worst teachers I had at this university. His lectures are incredibly difficult to follow, with the vast majority of the lecture being off-topic tangents. He gets annoyed when students dont know the answer because his teaching sucks. Must read the lecture notes to have any chance in the class. Very smart man but horrible professor.

Professor Locay teaches like we all have a Masters degree already. When you ask him a question you can tell he gets annoyed. He constantly complains about the school and just brings negative energy. He wont tell you when he posts a quiz or when one is due. This is my second class with him after 302 and he's the same if not worse. AVOID HIM!!!

We didn't receive any of our grades until the end of the semester. The entire class had no idea where there standing was in class. He also never answers his emails so they only way to talk to him would be during class or the mere 5 minutes he stays after. Avoid at all costs. The material is extremely hard by itself taught by this man is impossible
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Pretty smart guy but a really bad teacher. The test were hard and the powerpoints didn't help much. He is not very good at answering questions and acts like you should already know everything before taking the class. I'd HIGHLY recommand taking Macroeconomic theroy before taking this class. No homework and attendance isnt madatory
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Had 3 tests the whole semester. The last two test averages were 50%, and he asked what our problem is... The material isn't too hard but he acts like he's too smart for everyone and doesn't explain anything. You can skip class because he posts power points and class doesn't help.

He isn't really that great of a teacher, because he doesn't know how to relay the info even though he himself is really knowledgeable. Attendance isn't mandatory, posts class lecture notes online. He kind of belittles students when they ask questions, and really doesn't hide his libertarian bias at all. Lectures are pretty boring.

Locay went to UChicago, so it's obvious he knows his stuff. Some of his tangents can be a little tone deaf. If you have a strong foundation with Econ, the material should be nothing groundbreaking. If you use the practice problems and quizzes from blackboard, you may not even have to go to class. Not my favorite professor but nothing unbearable.

Locay tried hard to appropriately allocate grades. He gives you EVERYTHING you need to do well and tries his best to teach it while also keeping you engaged with personal stories. I am majoring in econ and I have learned more from his classes than you will ever wish to learn in econ. (He comes from U Chicago)

He lectures a ton but has extremely relevant, and sometimes hilarious, examples. His ppts are clear, make complete sense, and perfectly reflect the exams. The exams are hard, but (of course) they are curved accordingly. If you plan to learn economics, this is your guy. He's lit.

No homework, no out of class reading, but beware, his exams aren't easy. He's very intelligent and can't understand why some don't understand the concepts. Study his practice quizzes not the lecture power points. You will learn a lot about the world from him, and you will learn to see the world from an economic point of view.

Has a distinct libertarian bias in his view of economics. Tries to pass off his view on many topics that are very much up for debate amongst economists as fact. Almost feels like he's trying to indoctrinate students into his viewpoints. Also, rambles on tangents about his personal life/kids that have very little to do about the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: If you don't like this guy you'd be insane. I missed every single Exam for bogus reasons and he let me take them whenever I felt like it. Classes are very optional but I'd recommend you go to them because the course is pretty tough (I never went. His tests are very hard but he lets you do take homes or solutions to raise grade. No homework at all .
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Tests are tough--Would take again

reviews.comment: This class is a bit less interesting than 460. Where in 460 he would use powerpoints with clear slides, in 420 Dr. Locay has detailed notes that are more like chapter summaries in text. Still a very interesting class. I think there are micro people and macro people. This is a macro class. 460 is a micro class. Both good but depends what you likemor
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Would take again

reviews.comment: I am extremely happy to have taken this class. Dr. Locay is one of the smartest professors I have ever taken a class with and his expertise in this class shines through. I greatly enjoyed his lectures, as he tends to include historical examples with the class concepts, and also found huge value in the lessons. This class is awesome for business.

I would avoid this professor. You will get nothing from the lectures, over half the time he just rambles about life and unrelated topics.  Everything he discusses in class is irrelevant for the exams. There are no other grades besides the exam (no participation/attendance, HW, quizzes, projects) and the exams are really tough. He is nice though
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: amazing professor take him!!!! you will learn something. only good econ professor at UM.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Great professor, incredibly knowledgeable on the subject.  He's one of the few professors that left me wanting more at the end of classes.  Focuses on the real world application of economics more so than it's fundamentals.  Reading the textbook isn't a must to do well, but can be helpful.  The textbook was very readable and interesting.

Pretty good teacher. He has online quizzes that are really hard but he doesn't put a lot of weight on them. If you study for the test, you'll do fine. He also gives you the powerpoints he teaches off of.

Intelligent and Funny. He will help you if you are interested but will let you sink if you aren't. Gives great real life examples but you have to pay attention to understand the tie-in. His exams are hard but the curve is really easy. His home quizzes are straight from the notes but will need to be clearly understood. You will learn a lot!
Smart guy, although he can be little boring. The tests are hard but there's a big curve. The online quizzes are difficult and take forever. Not an easy A, however you might actually learn something.

Has a wild curve (70% is considered an A). Reads off powerpoints and gives boring lectures. Tests are difficult. He enjoys asking tricky questions. Sometimes he makes sense but oftentimes no one will know what he's talking about. He doesn't even think global warming exists, despite the scientific evidence. DO NOT TAKE HIM IF YOU HAVE A CHOICE!!

Took Locay for industrial organization & economic growth. He is the most rational prof I ever had. He disregards "political correctness" and students should welcome this as an advantage over most other profs. I learned to think like an economist. Exams are challenging...go in with mindset to learn & not just to easily score the A. It's worth your $

by far the worst proffesor i have ever had. he teaches purely from power points. he assigns weekly online quizzes that you must spend hour studying for so that you get an A (the average on thses quizzes is always between a 40 and a 70%). he also likes asking "which of the following, if any,..." questions(there can be 4 correct answers or non at all

hard class to take in the summer...3 tests...9 quizzes...he posts practice test with answers to review for test..dont help very much...his grading scale rocks!!! a 50 is a C...impossible to fail...he favors girls...has tenure so doesnt care anymore...but take him bc no other teacher has a grading scale like he does...
Very difficult class but also very interesting. Locay is one of the smartest people ive ever met.
He's tough, but you won't regret taking his class, especially if you want to learn. Expect to work VERY hard for your grade.
Locay is old enough that he has tenure and doesn't really care anymore.  It's too bad.  When he's in the right kind of mood, he's very helpful.  Probably the smartest guy in the Economics Dept.
HARD CLASS but if ur good at econ, u learn a lot from him
No Comments

One of the worst teachers I had at UM and it seems that I managed to get the short end of the stick when I had his class. Apparently, in all semesters before I took him, he had open note, open book tests...BUT lucky me, when I got stuck in the class he had
Awful. Downright awful - didn't learn a thing.
Incredibly boring, slow grading.

Felt like I was getting no value from each super long lecture. Post really vague guidelines on massive assignments. We had assignments in September that didn't get graded until November. Gives massive readings and assignments to go along with them that you gain absolutely nothing from.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Absolutely do not take his class. Lomanno gives zero guidelines for the projects he assigns and then grades them extremely harshly even though he didn't give instructions in the first place. His lectures are boring and he assigns a ridiculous amount of work. I could go on. Take Butler's.
Worst. Incredibly dull lectures.

If you can take Butler's class, Lomanno's class is incredibly boring and he takes ages to grade anything. He also gave practically no instruction for the final project and all of the readings for the class are pretty useless.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Worst class I've taken at frost, he assigns 10 page articles to read for every class, he takes a month to grade anything, and he talks extremely slowly. His TA is also awful, she is terrible at grading and doesn't do anything. almost all of the assignments have basically no instruction and he doesn't mention them in class at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lokesh's classes are always amazing; however, this one was not my favorite. The classes were only 50 minutes long, and I feel like, for this class, you need more time for lectures because I felt like I was learning more by myself rather than in class. Whenever he would be coding in class, it was easy to lose focus, and I often felt lost.

Class is split between two professors, both aren't great, focusing on his half, no grading criteria or feedback. What he teaches your honestly better off watching a few YouTube videos. Tries to be creative with work but falls short, more frustrating than fun.

Lokesh is kind and approachable with a relaxed teaching style. We did case studies, zyBooks labs, and projects that covered the basics. I would've liked more hands-on, practical activities to make it feel more engaging. Overall, an easy and organized intro course.
Lectures are a little random but very easy intro level class
Great guy, very respected and cares for his students.

Lokesh is an AMAZING professor! He offers so many opportunities for extra credit, and his exams aren't hard at all especially if you study. I know that he has a lot on his plate to balance, but he always takes the time to get to know his students and his lectures are very easy to understand. He also does Kahoots for class sometimes.
Lokesh is great.

One of the nicest people in the entire engineering department. He wants you to succeed but what is holding him back is his ability to actually lecture and take advantage of the time he has to teach. Tests are super easy unlike his counterpart Stephan Murrell who is an actual menace and should be banned from teaching. Overall take his class he great

Professor Lokesh cares a lot about his students and makes sure no one is failing his class. He gives a lot of grade incentives so that no one fails and is always here to help his students. He gives practice exams before the actual exams to help practice for the exams, but the questions are not the same. There are labs due weekly and some are tough.

I learned so much and work was very manageable. All around amazing class and I was able to apply skills I learned to the real world which is awesome. Lokesh is a very good lecturer and will explain confusing topics in simple terms.
He is so good
Funny class.  I look forward to it every day. He cares about his students and his tests aren't hard.

Lokesh is awesome. He cares very much about his students and makes an effort to get to know everyone despite the fact he teaches a lot of different classes. He is a gem of the engineering department and is super easy to get a hold of for help. Take him if you can.

Lokesh is a great guy! He keeps the class engaging by switching up teaching format and using Kahoots. He seems to truly care about his students and their success in the classroom. I highly recommend taking a class with him if you have the opportunity!
Very easy class, weekly quizzes, and if you pay just enough attention you will do just fine. Professor is very understanding and flexible with tests, quizzes and homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Possibly the best computer science professor I have had so far at this school. He knows what he's talking about and he has years of industry experience to back it up. Lectures are interesting and he explains all of the concepts very well. Take lots of notes because he tends to go fast. Weekly assignments with 4 quizzes and a short paper.

One of the easiest and fun classes to do! You learn a bit of computer theory, Python and Excel. Kahoots everyday and online MCQ exams per month, a final group project at end. He explains in a very fun and enjoyable way and is very approachable and genuinely wants to help. This was the first time the class was offered so it was a bit disorganized.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Enjoyed the class thoroughly. Lot of work for the group project, but worth the efforts.

He is one of the nicest professors in the UM engineering department. Take his ECE 368 class because it will give you skills and more programming knowledge for the other upper level courses. He wants to help you reach your goals.
I asked my mom for a looped video of him saying "cash" for Christmas this year. Good at teaching. Also cute.

This particular class of his was easy and simple. The lecture slides were short and to the point. His lecturing was sometimes boring but not always. There is one homework assignment a week and a straightforward quiz every one to two weeks. There is a final group project at the end of the semester. Show up, study for the quizzes for an easy A.

Great professor. Really cares about teaching and knows how to teach. Really nice and understanding guy and tries to help you learn the material. If you see ANY class with his name on it, take it with no hesitation.

CSC314 is already quite a bit of material, especially for CS students not already familiar with the subjects, and this professor dos nothing to make the class any easier. Examples are rushed, test problems are difficult, and questions are rarely answered clearly. Would not recommend this professor for this course.

I pretty much took this class for the easy 'A'. You have to show up to at least 80% of his classes to get full credit in attendance. Other than that, he barely gave out any homework and the midterm/final exams were pretty difficult. However, if you study his lectures you should do well on the midterm and final.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Currently taking ECE118 with this man and he is the man. Super nice and more importantly knows what he is talking about. Love his accent. Easy to understand.
Nicest professor I've ever had. Cares about his students. Classes are very interactive and he wants everyone to participate. Lots of homework but they are simple and not long.

I think she's new at teaching Business Law 401 because it was the worst class of this semester. She makes the material more confusing to understand. I went to every single class, participated, did the homework, and went to office hours. Yet, I still failed every exam and felt hopeless. She doesn't use the full office hour time either.

One of the best professors I've had at UM so far. I wasn't good at public speaking but her class helped me a lot and completely got rid of my fear of presenting. She is very accesible outside of class and very caring for all of her students.
Shes the best. Shes chill about the presentations and gives clear guidelines of what she wants either way. Super loving and caring. Totally recommend.

There are 5 oral presentations (which other sections don't have!!!!!) and 4 writing assignments. She gives feedback, and if you follow her instructions exactly, it's an easy A. it can feel rigid and the class itself is pretty slow and not very engaging, you'll probably find yourself watching the clock

I think she was a great professor. If you can manage three writing assignments and speeches, I would reccomend this class. Had her for an 8 am and she was always amazing. Def one of the top professors at this school.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Took her at 8am and I never got below at A- on any of the assignments. There's 3 papers and 3 speeches for your whole grade. Participation does matter but I tried to raise my hand every so often and still got an A. I little to barely prepared for the speeches and still did well, found her critiques helpful.

I would not recommend this prof. Her guidelines are extremely unclear and she is such a harsh grader. You learn nothing in this class and she is not very helpful. She talks a lot and confuses herself and everything is unclear. 3 writing and 3 speeches is the whole grade, and you are LUCKY if you get A-. just take someone else if u want an A tbh.

Good Professor but her class is annoying. 3 written assignments and 3 in-class oral presentations. She is a very picky grader and is very strict with her rules. Takes points for every class you miss, no computers or phones and you have to participate for a grade. She is very helpful when you need help. Cold calls and expects you to participate.

Very nice lady, seems very smart. HOWEVER...

She allows for almost no laptop usage, and counts off of our grade if she sees us on them. It was an 1 hour 20 minute class, so that was pretty unfortunate. 

Lectures are very boring and I don't feel like I learned much. That's not her fault, it's more of just what the class is.

Super kind professor. Maybe she changed her grading style because she actually grades very easy. She gives a lot of critical feedback that you'd think would indicate a poor grade but then the grade is actually pretty good. 3 oral presentation and 3 writings. Loves when you go to office hours for feedback

I'm not going to deny that she is tough, but she is much more human and sympathetic than most UM professors. Her class was neither a hard nor easy A but if you ask specific questions she will give specific feedback. She is a super sweet person and I'd recommend her to anyone on the fence about taking her class.

Gives good feedback and guidance on assignments, especially if you go to office hours. 

You'll need to participate in class.

This class is very interesting to say the least... She is very nice and always makes herself available to work with students as long as you reach out. Classes are engaging because they are all discussion-based. I learned a lot of new things but it wasn't my favorite class because of the public speaking aspect. She is a bit of a harsh grader.

I have mixed feelings about this class. She was nice but expects a lot from students and can be a harsh grader. In order to do well in this class, you have to participate, ask for advice on papers, and rigorously practice your public speaking. I have heard that other professors are easier but she can make the class enjoyable and interesting.
Hard grader for no reason. Attendance is mandatory every day. Plenty of other professors to choose from that are better than her.
Smart teacher and definitely one of the harder graders. If you participate and do everything on time you should be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She seems nice but is such a tough grader. I recommend not taking her. Doesn't give enough feedback, pretends to care but doesn't.
Learned so much, relevant content, fair grader, a lot of helpful feedback. take her!!
Most caring professor at UM hands-down. Gives very individualized feedback to all students and will go the extra mile if you meet here half way. Really recommend her.

Probably the best professor I've had at UM so far! She truly cares about her students and makes an effort to get to know each one of them. Unlike many professors, she understands that public speaking can be challenging for some people and gives very helpful advice. Class discussions were always engaging. I highly recommend taking her if you can!

She is one of the sweetest professors I have ever met and she truly cares about her students success. I highly recommend her. You have to show up and participate while she lectures to understand the material and get a good grade, but the material is not hard. If you study the notes she gives in class you will do fine.
this guy is clearly on tenure. take this class if you need the credit. best class ever fr.

If you fail this class then you probably just don't care about your classes because this is one of the easiest professor to take all the answers are there on the review and be sure to make a group me group chat with the whole class and all your midterms will piece of cake.
Its a really weird math class, but the exams are online and its chill, so take him if you want to pass

Currently sitting in the class on the first day of classes (and potentially my last one in this one). Class starts at 12:30 and he's sitting on the phone for literally 10 minutes and then says "okay I gotta go teach now and hangs up." It's weird and rude. Typing this as he's mumbling the syllabus at us with his eyes closed... seems easy so idk.

This class is super easy! 5 midterms with the 4 best scores kept and one final project with a group. You never have to go to class just do the zoom review before the midterms and he'll tell you the test questions. His handwriting is very difficult to read and his lectures are super confusing. You will learn nothing about math but will get an A!

If you need math credit, 100000% take him. Easiest class at UM, barely ever held in person, and he will give you the answers to the take-home tests. Don't plan on learning anything, however. If you choose to go to the in-person classes, his writing is illegible and he's extremely confusing. But don't worry about that, take him if you need math!!

Ludmil is a great professor for non-STEM people at UM. Class was barely ever held in person. 5 midterms in which he gives practice questions which are the exact questions. Each midterm is 15 points and final project is 40 points for 100. It is hard to get below a 95 in this class. Take him for credit, a joke easy. Ludmil is the man.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He never unlocked the blackboard page, barely held class, and I couldn't understand a thing the man taught. But that didn't matter. Before "tests", he hosts a review Zoom, which basically has all of the answers for the test a few days later. These are take home. Group project final. Very easy. But now my math credit is done so, not a bad choice.
funny guy.

Easiest math class I've taken here. We learned the first chapter in a week and that was pretty much the basis for the first three exams. All exams are take-home open note and he gives you most of the day to complete them. There is one final project, but as long as he approves your topic, it's very easy to get an A.
I do not like math and it still was an easy A, may get lost in class just ask for help.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: There is no homework. There is always extra credit problems and essays. There is no book just note-taking on the problems he solves in class. Sometimes those problems are the same ones on the test. He never took attendance! There was a total of 5 tests and a final group project. His teaching is confusing but he is laid-back for turning in tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: Honestly, the easiest class you could ever take. Ludmil is the man he does not care at all. Literally email him a few times and you will get an A. lol
Hes funny...

Absolute easiest class at UM. The material is complex but he does a pretty bad job of explaining it, so you can rely on your peers for answers. You can never show up, but as long as you do the tests (which are 5 questions) and the group final (a quick powerpoint), then you will pass with flying colors.
Easiest class at UM. Assuming you won't need finite math in the future take 100%. If you do need it then don't, you won't learn a thing.

This was by far the easiest class I have ever taken. I did not learn anything but I got a 100. There is no homework and about 6 "midterms" that he sends via email and are due later in the day. He is a very nice man but if you want to learn about finite mathematics, I do not recommend this prof.

He honestly seems like he hates his life. He gave me no problems but his class sucks. It was mandatory so I had to deal with it, but he's hard to follow. If you're bad at math, show up to every lecture or there's a good chance you'll end up completely lost. There's no textbook. You just need to memorize what he's doing and you'll pass the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you show up, there is no reason you shouldn't get an A. He is really hard to understand and there isn't any other material that you can go to for help, but it really isn't that bad. He only teaches what you need to know. There are 5 tests, he only uses the top 4 and there is a group project that is half your grade. Easy A for liberal arts majors
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: I honestly suck at math and I got an A without putting any effort in. Highly recommend the course
easiest A ever

Wow. Finite math with this guy was the easiest class I have ever taken. Just go to the two classes before each test and he'll give you basically the exact test and then go through all the answers in detail. Just memorize what he writes on the board. A trained monkey could get an A in this class. A wild monkey could pull off an A-.

The professor almost never shows up to class, his assistant is the one who does the review, and this review have the same EXACT questions of the exam. No one needs to study, going to the review and memorizing 5 answers is enough to get an A. Yes, memorizing, there is no need to study.

All of us have A's and that is probably why no one ever tells anything bad about this professor; but I honestly feel someone should have done it earlier. It is unacceptable that we are paying this incredible huge amount of tuition and having classes likes this one.

Agreed, if you don't take all the chances he gives you to get an A, its on you.  He is a brilliant person who does everything to help the student be successful! I hesitated at first but am thankful I hung in. Math is NOT my subject and he made it easier in the end.

Basically, the few times he did show up for class, it was as much help as if he didn't at all. Heavy accent, chicken scratch writing. The only way I understood what was going on is when a student was called up to the board to explain. Easy A if you're able to teach yourself, otherwise find someone else.
If you dont get an A in this class, you are an idiot!
EASIEST A EVER!

Professor speaks with a very thick Slavic accent & his handwriting is like chicken scratch. He doesn't use a textbook. Often shows up late to class & is hard to locate during office hours. The final project is a headache. You are pretty much on your own, but luckily, he is an easy grader.

For real, he is the easiest prof here. It is really impossible to get below an A and so what if you can't understand him? You will do fine on the tests, and I actually know the material. You only need to go the class or two prior to the tests. The final presentation sucks, though.

He makes this class so ridiculously easy that I ended of staying. There are 5 tests and only your highest 4 count and a final presentation. He is no help and you can hardly understand him, but honestly, there is no way you can take his class and NOT get an A. I hardly went and got an A.

It is completely impossible to comprehend what it is he is trying to say or write because it appears to be chicken scratch. He makes his lessons appear much more difficult than they actually are and he is not very helpful at making you understand even when you tell him you dont understand but its basic math so its easy stuff. Good luck, pick anothe
Everything this man says is incomprehensible, but the class was so damn easy since it was math 103 and was basically pre-algebra
Her lectures are pretty interesting and she supplements with a lot news articles. Her exams align very closely with the lectures.

Easy A but Attendance was mandatory and I went a few times yet got no attendance points it was so useless to go cause you learn nothing; hw was not often and easy but I wish I took a different professor; she's funny and nice but bad professor

Very kind woman. I took this class because I am required to, and I'd say choosing her paid off. She rarely assigns homework, and when she does she cancels class for you to do it. She allows you to bring a cheat sheet to the exams (2 total exams) which helped me a lot. I haven't learned much but I have gotten through the class pretty successfully.

Ridiculously unorganized and would often cancel class or end it early on a whim. Had no structure in her lesson plans and does not provide clear instructions for assignment expectations. Frequently unavailable outside of class and does not provide any feedback. Fails to make full use of blackboard in providing progress reports. Would not recommend.

Class was totally disorganized. Lectures consisted of her reading from a word document. The worst part was the essays which she doesn't give guidelines for length. If you want a good grade you will write 20 pages of nothing but repeating the wording of the textbook. Total waste of time. Also provides 0 feedback on essays. Also rude.

The worst teacher I have had in my four years at UM. Never responds to emails or office visits. Very rude when you ask questions. Rushes students when they are taking an exam so she can leave. Honestly would not recommend.

I love Maria Lectures. It was about topics that actually matter in the world and she did a good job of explaining it to students with funny examples. If you go to class and make an effort to understand the material you will be fine, plus she gives heavy curve in the end. A light accent but nothing major. I love her!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Caring

reviews.comment: Never responds to emails, no clear rubric for papers, and doesnt provide clear help on the papers either. Went to office hours and the only answer I got was read the articles. Stay away until senior year if you plan on going to grad school
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Maria has a very organized lecture style, however, this doesn't extend outside of class. She changed her syllabus several times without warning, she didn't respond to a single one of my emails, and she didn't post grades anywhere. The upside is that she's a very fair grader and if you show up and put in the effort you'll get an A.

Doctor Lorca is very knowledgeable and easygoing. The class is a great place for debate, and she doesn't censor any opinions. Hilarious during lectures and a fair grader. Class can be a bit boring during the student presentations but the debate makes it worth it. You have to read many books and economic papers.

Great professor! Very caring, accessible, and most importantly she cares about her students.  Class is a unique experience, intellectual economics debates. Students learn by teaching the students their assigned chapters. One of the best profesdors I have had in UM.
The very worst class you can possibly have in the whole UM.  Absolutely take it if you want to learn absolutely nothing.
Easiest class ever. She is really helpful and care for her students.
Very easy going and nice teacher! Exams can be a bit tough, but she will answer your questions and explains the material. If you study you'll get an A.

She's an adequate professor. If you read the textbook on your own, there's no reason to go to class. She just reads PowerPoints and lets out early. No HW, just 3 tests (2 of which had EC) and 3 quizzes. Tests are a little on the hard side, but if you study you'll be fine.  She doesn't respond to emails but is nice if you go to office hours.

Professor Susino makes the topic of econ easy to understand. Go to class, do her practice exams, and read some of the book, you will be sure to get an A. Everything is pretty straightforward if you put some work in. She's also really helpful if you go to her office hours. Very nice teacher!

Professor Susino makes the topic of econ easy to understand. Go to class, do her practice exams, and read some of the book, you will be sure to get an A. Everything is pretty straightforward if you put some work in, if you don't put the work, then you'll be lost. She's also really helpful if you go to her office hours. Very nice teacher!

She read off PowerPoint slides; at first she was nice but then near the end of semester she bombarded us with readings she was always on her phone during presentations and dared to email us she wanted a graduate level essay. She marked correct answers wrong on our exams... waste of my time!
She rushes you during tests and is confusing in her explanations. Would not take again.

This class was the hardest one I took this semester. There were four tests and 3 quizzes. Even if you memorize the textbook, she throws on random questions on her tests that are impossible to figure out. She contradicts her self sometimes so what she says and what is on the test are two different things. Would not take her again.

Attendance is not mandatory, but she only tells you the quiz and test dates in class. 3 tests and 2 quizzes, and the quizzes are open book. I recommend going to class, especially when she says she's going to go over practice problems. If you go to class, you'll know exactly what will be on the tests and quizzes; but you do have to work for an A.

Professor Maria Lorca is one of the worst teacher I have had.  Her quizzes are harder than the exams and the exams are just impossible to understand. It is like landing on the moon with a washing machine.  She won't give you extra credits and contradicts herself in her explications. I attended every classes and still am failing her class.
I recommend not to take this class. Professor is not very helpful and unprofessional at office hours.
