Professor Lorca is awesome easiest class attendance not required at all no homework. Three tests worth 33% each that are all multiple choice and have tons of bonus questions, I got over 100 on all tests. Final is just the third test so it is not cumulative definitely take her!!
Amazing! love her and her class. Wish I could take her for ECO 212

She is the most unhelpful professor in UM. As someone who usually don't miss classes, it was extremely challenging to sit through her entire lecture... She reads the powerpoints, repeating again and again what the powerpoint says. She doesn't post any study guide and doesn't' follow the syllabus. Don't bother emailing/trying to talk to her...

Solely reads power points from book manufacturer to teach. She rushed through concepts to end class early. She's a nice lady but terrible teacher. Three tests, no final. Tests are hard, and straight from book...  Make sure you do all extra credit! I deserved a C in the class but got an A bc extra credit

Useless. Her power points are inaccurate the tests and her assignments are harder then anything. Only 6 A's in my section (out of 44 students). Don't take her, unless you enjoy being frustrated with another bad grade from the terrible economics department at UM

I love professor Lorca! I had her last semester for Micro and earned an A+ in the class. I am taking her again this semester for Macro and believe I am doing well again. Those who leave low comments obv do not realize that they are in college and need to study in order to do well. Even though attendance is not mandatory, GO TO CLASS, easy A.
She is the best economy teacher I have EVER had! she is comprehensive, helps a lot.... TAKE THIS CLASS!!!!! TAKE THIS CLASSS

Doesn't explain any of the concepts learned throughout the class.  Tries to adjourn class as quickly as possible and whips through the powerpoint notes.  Tests are from material strictly from the book, but she never covers it in class.  Assignments are a must and extra credit will be necessary to get a good grade! She is hot though...

The class is relatively easy. Her explanations are sometimes helpful, sometimes quite unclear, but I agree you can learn everything that will be asked on the exams from the book. She does give a lot of extra credit (which you need to be in class to do) and usually finishes class 15-30 minutes early.

im not really sure how she is as a teacher because i didnt go to class once. she gives 3 tests and you can learn all of the information just from reading and studying the textbook chapters and going over the practice quiz's she gives for each chapter. i literally never sat through a lecture and got an A
Uses powerpoints straight from the textbook company. Describes economic theory in terms of her personal life. Generally rude to students. Prohibits laptop use. AVOID!

The best teacher on the earth! You will never find anybody better than her! You can choose to be type a or b, so that you can not come to class or do the homework or not! exam will just be almost the same as practice quiz and something from ppt. She is the one!

This is my favorite class this semester. You don't have to read the book and she explains everything from the powerpoints very clearly. It's not a hard class at all if you go to class and listen to her explanations.

She gives you the powerpoints and in class repeats them word for word so you're better off reading the powerpoints and going through the book at your own pace. BIGGEST KEY TO SUCCESS?! use the practice quizzes she gives you! they are very similar to the quiz. So, in summary, choose the Type (A or B) that says attendance is not mandatory.
More memorizing than learning...

She's really nice but thats about it. She's a terrible teacher. All she does is put dumb powerpts up, no one shows up to class, she doesn't care abt what she teaches, she doesn't know the content at all. A waste of my time. And the tests aren't even that easy b/c u need to teach yourself everything

there are no words to describe how awesome lorca is. she teaches the material super clearly, you don't need the textbook you can learn everything from powerpoints and attendance isn't mandatory. i liked going to class tho because she's funny, makes it enjoyable.  grade based on 3 exams or 3 exams+essay, your choice. she's the absolute best.
tests not that easy but definitely easy to manage her class ! very nice !

Really sweet lady from Spain. She's also funny. The class is your basic econ, so it's not that hard at all. She lets you choose a plan on whther or not u want to come to class. those who do have hw once a week but their tests are weighted less. I reccommend that plan. Also, read her power points, those are all you need on the tests. Take her

One of the best professors at UM by far. she's so smart and so willing to help. her lectures are clear, you get the info quick n easy, she won't space off into another topic. super helpful, funny, makes the class enjoyable. had her as a guest lecturer in some other classes and loved her there too.
She's so funny and full of energy. She was always willing to help after class too! She is a very sweet lady and a good teacher. Definitely take her.

1. Great person and great teacher. Easy to approach and very understanding with students. 2. Easy going classes and lots of examples. She always answer emails, always, and in class takes all questions. 3. Few HW but to the point. 4. Very fair exams based con class material

Great Prof. Explains things really well. I'd definately take her again. Don't really like economics but she makes it as interesting as it can be. Gives pertinent examples of what she is discussing.  One of the nicest professors on campus.

Great prof. and very easy to talk to when dissaster strikes. Her class is very usefull and gives lots of extra credit. If you do not like her class... you are a moron!!!! Wish she teaches more classes at UM
She makes the class hilarious and easy. She's totally spacey but it's basically impossible not to get an A, so its worth it. Recommended.

The best prof I've taken so far!!!! great class lots and lots of info @ real and current issues. Very respectfull when discussing @ the US or any other country.Coming to class is not an effort but entertaining!and she's very HOT too!!!!! great pick!

She is a very fun loving teacher who makes coming2 class enjoyable! She makes econ interesting & easy to learn! Def knows how to dress well & is really entertaining;ull love her stories about her past students.The tests are really straight forward,and easy if u study for them! by far the best teacher I?ve ever had :)& she?s very understanding!

I did not want to take eco but I am taking her class and her class is incredible and she is the BEST. She is a lot of fun and great review of economic articles. Extremelly good and clear when teaching. She definetly knows how to teach. She is great and very good looking... take her any time.
Very very good teacher and makes things fun

She is great! I am taking now ECO 302 and I am missing her a lot, never though I would miss a prof... She is always willing to help, class is fun and interesting, great extra material to understand what goes on in the world. Needless to say she is Spicy HOT... I'll take her again anytime!!
She's really nice and makes class fun.  I didn't mind sitting in class at all. She can be funny and always keeps class light. She also lets the class out early a lot.  AWESOME teacher.

Great teacher! Extremely helpful and nice! She's very funny too and trust me, you'll defenitely learn some economics with her... she uses great examples to relevant daily life situations. I defenitely recommend her!

I took Lorca for 211 (fall 07) and 212 (spring 08) and this semester I have missed her much: her material is well-explained, gives lots of practices test, post everything on blackboard, she is ALWAYS willing to help you and easy office hours. What a great prof. Just pick her. Hope she would teach other material in the ECO dept

ONE OF MY BEST TEACHERS EVER!!!  Young teacher who understand her students extremely well.  If you go to her for help, she will do everything she can.  Always got out of class 15 minutes early.  Tests are kinda tricky, but cover the material well.

The best ever!!! She is charming and HOTTTTTTTTT and she is always willing to help you. Her quizzes are not easy but if you go to class and do HW it is ok. She makes the material intersting and lots of examples. She repeats ideas if you do not understand. You do not feel intimidated if you ask question is class. THE BEST!!!!! take her for sure!!!
She is a super professor, her lectures are super interesting, that you don't need to read the book. Just sit in class.

Prof. Lorca has restored my faith in the academic system. She takes theories that might be difficult or confusing and uses relevant, real life examples to make everything clear. She's extremely funny, and I love going to her class because I know I'm going to learn something and it won't be boring. Go during her office hours for free cookies!

Maria is one of the best professor I have had so far. She is very specific on what she wants from you when it comes to homeworks and exams. She let you decide if you want to be type a or b student which means if you wants to come to the lectures you can get points for attendance and for homework, so the exams are less worth. If you are not that typ
She is awesome and very hottttt. I love Eco because of her take her!

She is by far the best professor I've had at UM. She lets you choose if you wanna do hw or come to class or not. She is an easy grader and she will do anything to make sure yo do well. She is fun and entertaining and this really nice latin spirit about her! Definitely choose her!!!
Mrs. Lorca is great. Keeps the class entertained, lets you know what to study for the exam. Pick her
Best professor  ever. Easy material. Nice grading and funny classes! Just choose her! Her examples are easy to understand because are based on a normal life person

She says many things that some people find rude.  She says many things that are untrue of other countries.  Her stupid cell phone is always going off and she does grades tests and papers with bias.  Don't take this class.

she is the best not only is she charming and funny but she gets you interested in economics with her humor...i would no doubt take her for other classes by far my favorite professor at the university she is amazing you can choose type a or type b on whether or not your attendance will be counted and teaches material so its easy to understand
She is the best teacher ever, really nice, hot, just pick her dont doubt it.
great teacher, the term paper that is required is kind of boring but she grades it pretty easy, easy A
great prof.. highly recommend... pretty damn hot too.
Great teacher, i recomend her a lot, easy a
Only complaint is that she may be a little to easy for some people.. but you learn a lot about econ in the class and she helps you out a lot
amazing
She's amazing! Teaches well, tests are fairly easy, and she gives frequent quizzes that force you to keep up with the material.  Very understanding.  Highly Recommend!
Her class is based very little on how much you actually know about economics, and almost solely on how well you can memorize her powerpoints, word for word. Utterly useless.

She claims that she is here for all of her students, but I have seen how she speaks about students when they are not there and is not always willing to help. She does not like to be wrong and will bring personal issues to an argument. Her tests are straightforward with the exception of a couple of questions and can get personal when grading.

Class is super interesting, and the course load isn't bad at all. She's flexible and easy to reach and is really understanding. If you're not a stem major and need a course to fulfill your cognate i 100% recommend since it's pretty easy. Exams are all online and assignments are mostly in class and group work, so attendance is important. 10/10

Dr. Light is incredible. This was my favorite class I took at UM and she is one of my favorite professors. Her lectures are so engaging and I found myself talking about the class materials with my friends outside class and deeply thinking about our discussions. Dr. Light does "ungrading" so your participation matters and exams were online, at home.

She will let you argue any grade given if you make good points shes very likely to bring it up. Reading quizzes have 6 drops and happen almost every class. If you show up for all other days and a lot of reading quizzes you will be fine. All tests online.

Dr. Light is fantastic. For her first year at UM, I was impressed by how organized the course was. Communication was clear, lectures were engaging, and online exams were easy. Assignments were fair and expectations were always clear. She's kind, passionate, and makes learning fun. It was the perfect mix of an easy course while still learning a lot.

Dr. Perry is very nice and clearly cares for her students. Her lectures are attendance mandatory (participation points), lecture heavy but also discussion-based. She is easily accessible outside of class. However, classes can be somewhat disinteresting. Her quizzes on readings are quite difficult, so pay great attention to detail on those articles.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: The exams are not too bad, but you definitely need to study for them. You should especially review the case studies that are gone over in class. Attendance matters. There's usually a quiz every week that are kinda hard but everything, including the exams, are curved. She's also very understanding about needing to reschedule things.
Boring class

Dr. Perry is kind and offers many chances to raise your grade. Attendance is necessary to understand the lectures. Participation is also required, but not hard. Exams are SAQ but are fair if you take good notes, and she often curves them. The final 4–6 page paper and discussion posts are manageable. Overall, she wants students to succeed!

Worst teacher I've had the University, monotone voice, fill in the blank tests, and on the most important assignment in semester, leaves horrible feedback that does more harm than good. No pros to say.
the best!
Prof Lynch can be very hard at times. I wouldn't take this class or him again. It was always very difficult to get in contact with him. He also assigns essay's, very tough grader.

Dr. Lynch is so incredibly knowledgeable about linguistics that at times it was actually more interesting when he'd go off on a random tangent than stick to our original material because he has so much to offer. At times, some concepts can be difficult to understand, but he'll stay on it until he's sure the whole class understands.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Amazing lectures--So many papers

reviews.comment: Andrew is the GOAT. His class is the only one I actually look forward to attending. He is engaging, approachable, and extremely knowledgeable about sociolinguistics. He's published numerous papers, some of which we got to study in his class. I highly recommend taking a class with Dr. Lynch if you can!

I love Dr Lynch - he's funny, easy to talk to, and really knows his stuff. He's passionate about his field and about helping students understand it and pursue their interests within it. Great prof, great guy
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Andrew is without a doubt one of the best professors I've ever had in my life. He's extremely knowledgeable, organized, interesting, engaging, and passionate about linguistics, and he's always willing to talk after class and answer questions. Pretty difficult and lots of homework but I honestly didn't mind because I loved the class so much.
Don't take his upper-level courses if you're A. not interested in Spanish and B.not GOOD at Spanish.  He's a great teacher, though.

Prof. Lynch is the best! If you need to take Spanish at UM, you HAVE to take him. He works with you, he's funny and makes the class super interesting. He uses current events and keeps the conversation interesting. Take him and you'll see he's awesome!

Highly recommend! Passionate and extremely knowledgeable about course material, very engaging and enthusiastic. Extremely helpful and willing to meet with students. My favorite professor I've had at UM so far.

It's a class for Spanish heritage speaker-was able to use Spanglish in class. Lots of reading out loud. home work every week. Test were not hard, but need to study. No Final- needed to submit dossier of work done through out semester. Would take her again- really enjoyed her class & learned a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: You have to write answers by hand then take a photo and upload to BB. I uploaded two photos when it spanned two pages and got an F because she only grades the first one she sees. Ridiculous. Calls out students who are struggling in front of everyone. Does not follow syllabus. Changes expectations constantly. Some people shouldn't teach.

Cute but takes points off for petty reasons ie you have diff opinions. She can be moody but hilarious at times. All SPA prof speak 100% in spanish so be ready. Many students dropped when she told us you have to be fluent to pass - I wasn't fluent and I got an A-. Pay attn, learn, participate. In 107 you can use Spanglish in Lydda's class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This prof is amazing!! Extremely sharp, and a good human being :) Very accessible if you need help. I learned so much, and the workload was really manageable. I would 11/10 recommend to a friend.
Realist about the online situation and that there are issues, but cares about the students and if you need help just ask during office hours. Amazing professor that I hope to take in the future.

If you speak spanish, TAKE HER! She is amazing. Class is really easy if you're fluent in spanish. There is lots of work since it's a department syllabus what she's following, but she grades very fair and is willing to help you with anything you may ever need!

One of the most condescending professors I have ever had. Semester starts, she'll attend every class, then as time goes by nearing the end of the semester, she'll continuously cancel classes and assign a movie to watch and most times a paper based on that. She doesn't make her expectations clear, extremely unhelpful and unreachable out of class.

The worst professor at UM by far. She doesn't show up for class often, is the most unorganized person (not just professor) I've ever met, and makes it quite obvious that teaching this class is NOT a priority. 1.5 weeks left of class, still have 40% of assignments to do for grade, and still haven't heard a word from her. Terrible professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Carrillo is very experienced in media law and knows a lot but she juggles teaching this class along with her full time job. Because of that, she misses a lot of classes and sends in guests speakers or test proctors. The exams are mostly open ended so you have to study and memorize a lot. You will learn but the class is very difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Condescending and unclear. She is COMPLETELY unreachable outside of class. Wont answer emails and has no office hours. wonders why we do badly on her tests? Her lectures are overly complex as well. She calls on people randomly and literally makes you want to cry if you get the answer wrong. Her expectations on the test is u answer textbook def.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Carrillo is an adjunct, she usually teaches one class per semester at the U and spends the rest of her time  working as the head of the legal team at NBC Universal Miami. She gives tons of real-life applications to the cases in the textbook and is an AMAZING professor. Tests are short answer so you really need to study but it's worth it!

Tests are all written, not easy & mult. choice a lot of memorization & studying required. Book is used ALOT. She doesn't take attendance but if you miss one day alone, you miss a lot of info that's crucial. If you attend every class, take notes & study off them & the book guaranteed to pass. Dedicate a lot of time to her class if you want an A.

If you work hard and keep a positive attitude, then you will be fine.  She is a very demanding teacher, never really tells you what she wants, and believes her class is the center of the universe for the semester, but you will learn a lot.  i am glad i took her and feel a LOT more confident with my writing and journalism skills after her class!
She replaced Heidi Carr, who, by all accounts, was nice, nurturing, and helpful. Carrillo is none of those things. She is rude, demanding, and nitpicky. Avoid at all costs.

Although she is experienced in her field, she is not experienced as a teacher. Her manner is condescending, her assignments irrational, and expectation ridiculous. Expect daily quizzes,long assignments and lectures that seem unhelpful.

She's tough, but if you study you'll be okay. I got an A, but I worked for it. I really enjoyed the class, though, and would take her again if she taught other classes I needed. Lots of memorization... but it's the law class, so you can't escape the work no matter who you take.
No Comments
She's super sweet and will help you out with anything. The only problem is that we used figma and she didnt teach how to use it.
She's fine. Her class is boring, and you don't actually learn anything. She gives a lot of work that doesn't feel beneficial. It's should be an easy A though.

She really cares about her students and wants them to learn! Can tell that she enjoys what she teaches and is enthusiastic about prototyping. The course allows you to understand paper, digital, and physical prototyping.
CIM511/CIM299. If possible do not take this class. Easily the worst class I have taken in my 4 years of school. 3 hour class on a Friday is honestly rude.

Somehow makes a 100 level class one of my hardest. Nowhere near enough office hours available or time to meet 1 on 1 in order to meet the ridiculous requirements. VERY hard grader. Even your "rough draft" designs are graded hard.

She is very nice but so bad at teaching Figma to beginners. This a 100 level course that many students take to fulfill their cognates and it is such a bummer that it is so inconvenient to learn and to get help from her.

This was Prof. Martens first year teaching CIM102. Very fun class, almost all of it is in Figma. If you know what you're doing on it you're gonna get an A. She definitely was still figuring some stuff out, as some things we learned were useless, but just get the projects done and you're fine. She doesn't care if they're late either.

I took two classes with Dr. Durel while I was at UM and she was by far my favorite professor.  She truly challenged her students, and yes her exams were ridiculously hard, but she made you want to master the material.  She was an excellent mentor and anybody would be lucky to take her class and get to know her as a person.

She is a tough teacher but knows what she is talking about. Make sure you go to lecture as half of the exam questions come from that. Also, make sure you read the text. She loves class participation as well. Her exams are difficult, but if you develop the right strategy, you can learn a lot from a very challenging professor.

Her test are structured to say "According to lecture..." so make sure you pay attention to what she says. I thought her tests were rediculously hard, and in taking notes you just have to write everything she says because she doesnt have structured notes or presentation. Don't take her if you can avoid it.

Although her tests are difficult, Durel stimulates interest in psych & is a great teacher to have. The key to a good grade is great notes, and learning to apply all her little stories to the material. Also, know how she disagrees and agrees with the author of the textbook, as some of her questions will be about that. She's overall a great professor

The best prof Ive had at the U. Relates her material to understandable- real life situations, which in turn makes the material have qualitative value, that youll remeber for years to come. Really really an enlightining class and she is def an example to follow.

Fantastic prof and fascinating subject.  Much of the class is based around lecture (be prepared to take plenty of notes), attendance isn't mandatory but you'll definetely need to be there to get a good overall grade.  Durel knows her stuff and it shows, she's enthusiastic and always willing to help or to just have a conversation.

Very awesome class! Durel is very enthusiastic, tons of fun to just sit and listen to her, though you're better off taking notes! Doesn't care for memorization, not only must you know the information, you must UNDERSTAND it. Makes for highly fascinating lectures. I would definitely recommend her if you're into Psychology!

By far my favorite teacher at UM. Yes, her tests are challenging and the questions can be tricky, but if you know the material (don't just memorize everything) and go to class consistently you will get a good grade in the class. She's extremely helpful if you visit her during her office hours, and extra points are usually added to the tests.
very challenging and makes u think, but her tests are not impossible if you really pay attention. she loves when u go to her office hours. going over previous tests with her helps
professor expects you to work hard and think.....gosh forbid.
Insanely hard tests, but shes a really nice person, and works hard to make sure your on the right track in the class as well as your entire college career.  Definitely recommend her.

take this class, seriously. She's sarcastic and preachy, but there is no outside homework, and all you have to do is take notes to suceed on the tests...they are NOT THAT HARD. you'll learn so much, and its all really interesting stuff.

Durel loves the subject that she teaches, & it shows in her teaching. She can be preachy and mom-like, but if you listen to her preaching & come to every lecture, you'll barely need to study for exams. No final. A strong biology background helps and you MUST read the book and know what she thinks vs. what the author thinks. Go to her office hours!

She's a great teacher! Squaky and preachy, but w.e. Her tangents are relevant most of the time..this is teh way she makes teh class inetersting. Based 90% on lecture..thats what makes the class good..or else you could go to the bookstore and teach yourself. Make sure you introduce yourself. She's very fair and gives back lots of points on test.

Definantly one of my most interesting & likable profssors...but her tests are HORRIBLE! Seriously, she will screw you over with them, and she fully aknowledges that as well. Tests are based fully on lecture, don't even read the book. And though she's interesting, do not expect a good grade in this class.

This is by far one of the HARDEST classes I have ever taken.  She speaks too fast; tests consists of lectures not from book.  The material is very complex. But she is  a VERY nice lady, who is ALWAYS available for help and office hours!!

Her lectures are fast and alot of information, she constantly nags at the students what to do in life and that we will always remember her and thank her later. It got a bit annoying. She is a bit harsh too and bitter with some students, she is strict and everything has to be just so or she'll embarrass you. But she knows what she is doing and talki

not the definition of a good teacher....she might know and praise what she studied with her pigeons and beta blockers but definately does not know how to teach this course and who ever says she does they were either sucking up or lack persona in expressing their ideas b/c i know they would never ever take another course with this professor again!!!

Dr. Durel stimulates intrest beyond the course.Her tests require critical thinking and are based on details from the lecture and contridictions between her theory and the textbook.She is a good resource as a teacher and pre-med advisor. Her lectures remind me of a parental lecture, more than a teaching one which can get old.I enjoyed the course.

Her tests are based totally on the lecture.She should write her own book instead of rephrasing everthing said in Kalat's book.  If you are not in her honors class, she patronizes you and acts as if you can't write notes.  This makes her elitist.
she is nice but she does go off tangent and many times does not cover what is needed.
No Comments

She's got her head on straight with theory, but like everyone else has said, but I must reinforce, she gets WAY off topic.  My family and I pay $50 an hour to hear her talk.  I expect to learn more than her platitudes.
A lot off topic, but she is very interesting and you will find that you learn alot, not just memorizing. Study hard for the tests, and take good notes, her questions are specific to what she said
talks about everything other then what needs to be covered
all her notes are in question form.  The answer to every question she asks is survival and reproduction. half the test is questions about her family.

Great Teacher- yes, she preaches alot. Personally, I enjoyed everything she had to say. Makes you work hard, not just memorizing text. After all the hard work and note taking you will see it pays off in the end. I learned a great wealth of information
She preaches WAAAAY too much - she needs to stick to teaching psychobiology and let college students live their lives.

Dr. Durel presents the big picture of psychobiology, so you don't lose the forest for the trees.  She makes you work, but you see the payoff.  She is very clear about what she expects.  I highly recommend her classes.

Dr. Durel is a great teacher.  If you take one of her classes, you will learn alot.  She makes you think, not just repeat material on tests.  She is a wonderful teacher that personifies that "tough but fair."  Taking her class is very rewarding.
tough but fair

This professor does not cover the basic intro material that the class I signed up for does. He taught very specific rules and propositions that were at a much higher level than those in any intro course. Thick accent, doesn't talk to the class but straight to the blackboard. Do your best to avoid.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Have to go to lectures to make sense of hw and tests. Terrible communicator, writes the whole lecture with back turned. Absolutely avoid taking him. Very nice guy with no scope on the class. Uses obscure variables that are very hard to make sense of. Tests are very difficult, homework's are insanely long. I wish I could stress more not to take him.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This professor failed to cover a lot of very basic topics, such as cross product and dot product, in favor of exploring much more advanced topics. I would leave class feeling absolutely lost, and although there is a textbook, he doesn't really follow it. No notes posted online as he writes on the board. Thick accent, low voice, messy writing.

Even though he is a pretty nice professor, this class does not make any sense. The class was supposed to be an intro course, but went over the most obscure theorems and prepositions. 

If you're forced to take this class for credit, just wait until another class opens up: it's not worth taking this class with this professor.

DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!! Absolutely horrible, he is nice BUT his classes make no sense, Hmws take 10+ hours to do, you will NEVER finish his exams, people pass due to astronimical curve but you will learn NOTHING, he teaches concepts that make no sense and will not be useful. As someone that managed to pass, do not take this class.

He is a nice man BUT DO NOT BY ANY MEANS TAKE THIS CLASS. You will learn nothing in lecture, the homeworks take 10 hours and you wont even get full credit on them. The exams ask about RANDOM THEOREMS and you will never have time to finish them. People pass becuase the curve is INSANE. Many tears shed in this class.

I cannot even describe the level of sadness this man brings me. he might as well be teaching in french, DO NOT TAKE UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCES. every day is a struggle, the reviews are nothing like the exam, every lecture he writes on and on about information that doesnt even apply. i am losing my will to GO ON. please help.

Very positive and nice man but he has a couple huge faults: 1- has no idea how to teach in an intuitive way, 2- has no concept of scope. This is the type of class where a 50 curves to a 100 due largely to the fact that nobody gets the material. I do not deserve my A as I feel as if I do not even know what linear algebra is.

The worst professor I've ever had by far. He was not helpful during office hours, and his lectures were beyond confusing. He has a very heavy accent and speaks very low, so it is extremely difficult to understand him. He also will go on tangents to himself during class and when asking questions, he did not even seem to understand what he was doing.

AVOID AT ALL COST! He is very intelligent in this field but has no idea whatsoever about teaching. Very heavy French accent + shy personality + high ego= failure to understand the material. He is supposed to teach an intro class, however, he does not follow the curriculum and teaches concepts for Math Majors. Easy grader though

He is a very nice person, but he's genuinely the worst professor I've ever had in my life. I've never given up in a class before, but every day is a struggle to keep going. I've been trying my hardest all semester, and nothing I do feels worth it anymore. It's exhausting teaching myself all the material, especially in a class like this.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This is the type of professor that is so bad it calls into question the validity of the University itself. It is beyond the 350 character limit to describe just how incompetent he is at teaching. If his course/lectures were published to the world to see the university would lose a lot of status. Beyond bad, do better UM

I got a very good grade in his class. How I did it: You must attend class. Memorize his notes (specifically definition and propositions). Understand every homework/practice problem. Go to his office hours and ask every question. Very accessible outside of class and will teach you anything you need to be successful. Easy grader too.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Please avoid taking this teacher. This class is meant to be an intro class, but he teaches very advanced material in this class. His teaching is nonsensical, and it lacks linearity. He is a smart man, but he is not an effective teacher. Further, he is a disorganized individual, and he does not proofread his assessments before giving them.

AVOID AT ALL COSTS, I attended every lecture and did not once understand a single thing he was saying, I taught myself the ENTIRE course. He is a new professor and got better as the semester progressed, but at that point it was too late. He has a very thick accent, speaks very low, and makes linear algebra much more abstract than it should be.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Linear algebra was supposed to be one of the easier math classes I needed to take. I would avoid taking this professor until he learns the scope of the class. He is a new professor so maybe he will get better. This semester has been rough and I've spent a lot of time outside of class teaching the material to myself.
Amazing professor and class! Would recommend!
Great guy, actually enjoyable class.
He is great and takes time to better understand his students
Super nice guy, easy class. Ramps up during the semester, many group projects.
Amazing professor

Great professor. He is super passionate about what he teaches. The class is not very difficult, but attendance is mandatory. The class does not have exams, only easy quizzes. Participation in class is important, so if you skip a lot, you should not take the class. Involves lots of presenting and writing prompts.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: It's a free A+ if you show effort and attend class. This professor genuinely revived my interest in writing. She is incredibly caring and kind, and I highly recommend taking the course with her. Attend lectures, do the assignments, and it's an A+.
She is so kind and so caring towards all of her students. Her class is based off of 3 essays and there is no fina. I definitely recommend taking Prof. Ritchie if you get the chance!

She is an amazing teacher. Very straightforward and more than willing to help with essays and writing. Provides extra credit opportunities. Does not assign insane amounts of homework, and her class is very manageable. Would take her again 100%.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She is so caring and kind. You can tell she wants all of her students to do well. Class is based on one research paper that she walks you through the entire semester and she gives you so much class time for it. She is always available for help. I would totally take her again, she is awesome!
Awesome professor, easy class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I love this prof sm! super fun and easy class just do the assignments and you'll get an A. This class also definetley helped improved my writing even though it was out of my comfort zone at first.
Professor Ritchie's class is one of the best ones I've taken at UM. I had to push myself out of my comfort zone a lot, but I think I became a better writer for it. 10/10 recommend
dr. noya is super nice. you just have to study the lectures to receive a good grade. i found the class to be super easy in my opinion, but i studied, those who don't repeatedly fail tests.

Go to the lectures, you'll be fine. The tests are basically the same as the study guides she provides. In the beginning of the semester she came off as “caring” and “approachable” but you'll pretty soon see through that bs persona lmao.
Really easy class lmao

Lectures are fine and the course material is very interesting but it can be overwhelming. Each test has a lot of vocabulary on it so you should study for a while before. The course material isn't necessarily hard, but there is a lot of stuff to memorize. She gives a lot of extra credit which is super helpful.

Basically, she's a fine teacher to take but the ONLY grades in your gradebook will be from the exams and there are 4 of those including the final. Do with that what you will. She does give feedback if you make a meeting with her, but it's not going to help your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Had such a great time in this class. I recommended this professor to all of my friends who will be taking PSY 110. Her lectures are very interesting and I always look forward to her class. Just pay attention and you'll be fine. She even gives study guides before exams, which are really helpful, and she's a sweet lady. 100% recommend! Love her!

She was a good professor currently taking her online right now and no complaints. The study guides are like exactly what you get on the exams STUDY THEM OR PREPARE TO FLOP! Attend the lectures they are long but make them interesting and try to apply what you are learning to your life and you'll be fine. Review and revise your notes during la week.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is really nice, and accommodating. Her classes are boring and mandatory. Her study guides are nothing like the test. Her final is really hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She seemed bored by her own lectures so I was extremely bored by her lectures. Just do the work and study you'll be fine. Extremely manageable

Prof Noya is a decent professor. Her lectures are LONG and sometimes can be a bit exhausting. She provides a study guide for exams but they usually aren't fully accurate. There is some extra credit and its pretty easy.

Noya is so organized, understanding, and knowledgable. Her lectures are engaging but pretty fast paced. She gives lots of extra credit and attendance counts towards your grade. Just study your notes thoroughly and do textbook quizzes to succeed on exams.
Really boring but not difficult if you study. I took no notes and crammed before exams yet still did well. In my experience not very approachable either.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: tbh if you just study ur gonna be chilling class was an elective didnt need it at all so i barely studied for a bunch of the tests still did just fine but dont skip studying altogether. Extra credit clutched up would recommend
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: 4 tests are your grade plus research participation (ugh). Tests are similar to lectures and she gives good study guides. However, lectures are long and she moves SO FAST. Overall, a nice woman and a good professor
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is nice, but her lectures are very heavy and cover a lot of material. Her exams are pretty hard and make no sense. They include a lot of real-world scenarios, and you have to figure out what is going on. She gives a SG before the exams; they are helpful, but not everything is on them. This class is not easy, and you have to put in the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Noya is so caring and knowledgeable about psych. gives a lot of extra credit opportunities and is understanding. you do have to memorize ALOT of info for the exams and sometimes she puts random things on it that weren't in the notes, but she curves which is nice. For 230, we had 4 exams, cumulative final, and project, which was kinda overwhelming.

This professor makes the class do 4 exams, a cumulative final, and an extremely intensive final project on top of that. In other words, she makes you do the absolute most for no good reason. This class is a waste of time and effort.

Drink a coffee before lectures. The lectures are dense and cover a lot of material, but she makes it engaging and cute with her activities and PowerPoints. 4 Tests, but if you review the study guide and know that, you will be fine. Take good notes, study a little, you'll get an A in the class. Think critically and engage, makes the time faster.

Every class is a lecture where you are expected to take notes. She takes attendance every class, and your grade will be affected if you miss. She gives a review before every exam, study that and her in class presentations a lot and you should be fine on exams. She made my class create a toy for kids and graded very harshly on top of a final exam.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: There are a lot of extra credit opportunities. There is no mandatory homework. Study guides and extra credit were given for every test, so it was difficult not to succeed. My only complaint is that lectures were long and oftentimes hard to focus on. Besides that, she did very well ensuring everyone knew the material.

Professor Noya is a really great and caring teacher! Her lectures are actually really interesting and although it says you need to read the textbook I didn't and was completely fine. She gives a lot of extra credit and curves things, so as long as you study the lecture notes you'll do well on the exams.

Attendance is taken every lecture and is a part of the grade. Class isn't super exciting we just go through the slideshow. If you dont take notes fast I would recommend reading the textbook before lecture but if not you will be fine. In class activities are taken as extra credit and are huge grade boosters. Review sheets given before test are good.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor. Noya, is nice but the tests make no sense. The study guide is not what is going to be on the test. It makes it very difficult to study for the tests because there is random questions you never even covered. I took this course thinking it was going to be easy but it is FAR FROM EASY. Also this class has pretty heavy lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Amazing prof, really knows what she's talking about. Lectures in such a comprehensible way. Didn't go through everything that was on the test in class but gives a great study guide for every exam. USE THE STUDY GUIDE. Starting memorizing a few days before the exams were the only thing that saved me. Attendance is mandatory and effects your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took this professor this past semester, and got an A in her class. You can go to lecture because attendance is mandatory. Lecture slide material you can find in the textbook. I would just study the study guides through ACTIVE RECALL and fully understand and apply it to your life, because that's what is going to be expected on her exams.

Ended with a 97, but I would walk out of tests thinking I either knew every single thing, or nothing at all. She is a smart woman, good lecturer, but sometimes puts random things on tests which made studying SO stressful. She curves the final like crazy and is a nice woman, but her tests pissed me off a lot.

Nothing wowed me with Dr. Noya but it was an easy A. If you just read the textbook you can get by. Tests aren't that hard just know your stuff. Attendance was 1% of our grade and I never went to class. You can tell she's a very smart woman and you could probably learn alot from her if you asked. Easy class, learned a lot, I would say very relaxing.

This teacher is horrible. She will teach one topic for an hour and then not put it on the test, but rather test on one sentence that was said in one of the hundred videos we had to watch. The "study guides" she gives you before the test are never related to the test, and there are plenty of questions on topics she never teaches. DO NOT TAKE HER.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Worst class I've ever had, tbqh. If you have any respect for yourself, DON'T take it. Teaches pseudoscience as fact, very vague grading criteria, contradicts herself & the textbook, makes you pay for excessive project supplies and blames you if you can't afford them, requires doctor's notes or family death certificates for every absence, etc etc.

Dr. Noya is so sweet and chill. There are 4 tests (the last one is a final) that are the majority of your grade. Homework is weighted weird, make sure you get 100 on them. Pay attention in class or make sure you know the study guides perfectly. Tests are very straightforward and about general big ideas, not small details. They're very fair.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class is solely based on attendance, tests, and homework. Homework is super easy 10 min assignments (most answers are online). She also gives study guides for every test. If you're knowledgeable of the topics given, no doubt you should pass with an A. Not a bad professor at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She is such a caring professor but she's more a re-cap teacher rather than teaching from scratch. Her grading is also extremely harsh. You do need to read the textbook for the exams.

This class was a headache! Her grading criteria was not clear and very frustrating. She gives minimal homework, but when she does she you better hope you get 100 because if not it will destroy your grade. This class should be an easy A, but her test questions are so subjective and at times random incorporation of information. There are easier profs
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The class is difficult, if you work hard on making quizlets and preparing for the exams you'll do well. She's a great professor who shares interesting insights from her experience as a therapist. Very understanding and responsive, cares about her students.

reviews.comment: Please NEVER do this to yourself. Terrible teacher! Super unaccommodating, boring, tests do a terrible job showing understanding of the material (on random facts or tidbits) and questions are often subjective, poorly worded, or not spoken about in class. Multiple choice questions worth 3/4 points each. Shouldn't be teaching, class gave me stress

I took this class because everyone recommended it to me as an easygoing course where we would learn relaxation techniques, but it's just been lectures and exams. She often seems confused and can never give you a straight answer because she doesn't understand her own material. Requires a doctor's note for every absence or she tanks your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This course has made me incredibly stressed and has not helped me manage stress as I imagined. Attending lecture feels like a waste of time since the professor reads the slides verbatim and often shows long, loosely related videos. Study guides are also incredibly vague, often adding more confusion than clarification. Avoid this class if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Not very much homework at all- one or two homework assignments a week if any. Lectures aren't too bad but maybe a little boring. She lets you leave class early a lot of the time. Exams aren't too bad if you just start studying the exam guide a few days in advance.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do not take this course. The exams are unreasonably hard and attendance counts for a lot. If you can't go to class because you're sick you must bring a doctors note to excuse your absence. This is suppose to be a stress management course, yet I've honestly never been more stressed when taking a class. Again, don't take this class.

This is a stress management class, I have never been more stressed in my life or ever had a worse class. The exams are pretty annoying. Not sure I will end with an A and it is definitely not an easy going class. If you do not go to class your grade will DROP and no excused absences without a doctor's note. Complains about Gen Z a lot. Good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: No extra credit. amazing professor, loves what shes teaching. Always accessible by email, genuinely cares about students. Tests are a mix of short answer and multiple choice.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Big class, but if you go to her office hours she will know you on a first name basis. All tests straight to the point. Attendance non-mandatory but could help push your grade a percent if you show that you come to class. Easy content. Extra credit quizzes (up to 10% per exam). Overall, take if you can!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Meggs is amazing if you have the chance to take her for a class definitely do it! No exams just show up to class and participate. Assignments are easy and I honestly enjoyed them.

She made this class so enjoyable. Public speaking is scary but in the class, she made it feel approachable and less daunting. I'm very grateful for the opportunity to take her class, as I feel it genuinely helped me to improve. She is a wonderful and kind professor and so intelligent. Highly recommend!

You need to take her for public speaking. She makes it so easy to present by creating a positive environment. The homework is mostly just speeches and is very quick to do. She is just such a sweet professor unlike any other at the U and makes the class so easy.

I'm not sure why there are bad reviews.. He's a great professor who wants his students to do their best. Very fair grader and makes whats on the tests very clear. 2 group projects 2 tests and then 3 case quizzes which you go over before you take. Also adds 'completion' grades for surveys. Its easy to do well in this class, he's funny and very chill

Great guy! Very knowledgable. I never write rate my professors but I had to because I saw his ratings were so low. 

Go to class, study before the exams, genuinely put in some effort. This is not an easy A, so don't take this if your goal is to breeze through the semester.

I was terrified to take this class because of the reviews on here, but let me be the one to say these reviews are so far from what the class was actually like. He makes you want to participate because of how engaging his lectures are. His exams are completely fair and not hard if you study and simply pay attention and go to class. He is amazing!
If you do well on the exams and attend class, you'll be fine. He's very nice and funny, though the class is mostly lecture based.

The professor is somewhat engaging and adds small fun activities to break up mostly lecture-heavy classes. The workload includes 2 exams, 2 group projects, and 4 case studies. Projects are easy, but exams are tough, though his study guide slides are helpful if you study them well.
way too many boring lectures. tests are extremely hard since you have to memorize all of the 250 slides that he went over during those long lectures. This class was not worth it. drop it if you can

Professor Melzner is a really nice guy and really tries to keep the class fun and engaged with different activities. Theres not much work throughout the semester. Only one easy group project. But his exams are really hard and he doesn't give much guidance.

I struggled so badly in this class. His main method of teaching was lectures and gave us tests based on up to 250 slides of information. He also got annoyed with us when we told him it was hard and said we were trying to screw him over, even though we verbalized to him with were struggling with the material. Take this class at your own risk.

2 exams, 2 projects and 4 cases due throughout the semester. With the cases he is very nit picky with your answers so he'll take off .25 or .5 and it sucks because each case is only 3pts so if you get something wrong you get a bad grade. Very lecture heavy and exams cover so much material. In class, all he would do is read off ppt slides
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was extremely boring. There are only 2 exams and 2 group projects. There are also 4 case studies you have to complete. The tests had so much content so they were very challenging. Nice guy but beware class is very boring and you do not learn much.

It sucks cause he is a nice guy but not the best teacher. There are only 2 tests and 2 group projects. The tests had so much material on them and his lectures are very very boring. The projects were easy but only worth 10 points each. I wouldn't recommend taking a class with him if you actually wanna learn.

BEST PROFESSOR EVER. IF YOU CAN TAKE HIM DO SO. He is SO caring for his students. If you truly put your heart into writing he will appreciate it. He changed the way I viewed writing essays from a task into a fun activity. He makes the classroom feel like a very safe space and he shared his own stories which were super inspirational. Just TAKE HIM!

this class made writing and reading so fun and engaging. professor McFarlane is the sweetest man who just wants his students to succeed snd gives great feedback. he sometimes assigns readings and annotations but then the classes are just discussions about what we read. final project was a presentation and we had 3 essays
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: LOVED him. Super sweet and gave valuable feedback. Truly sets students up for success.

McFarlane is the best. Literally all you have to do is be present and speak up sometimes to get an A. You are mainly graded based on essays but he examines mainly your effort rather than the material itself so just try and you will do well.
He is the best professor in school. If you really work with him he will help you transform your life

Professor McFarlane is the best professor for UM writing classes. If you're a freshman reading this, try to take his class! If you're able to get a spot in one of his classes—which is nearly impossible these days—you won't regret it! By far one of the most caring and inspirational teachers I've ever had.
Great guy, nothing else to it. Lucky to have him as a teacher. hoping i get him for 106

Overall he is a good teacher and you know he cares. Gives random readings that are kinda dumb but besides that it is a good class to take. He is nice and understanding and not a super harsh grader would recommend.
Really great guy!

Super easy class, papers were short and very easy. For participation, talking doesn't necessarily even matter, just act like you care and at least make it seem like your paying attention. Really nice guy and overall great class that isn't any heavy lifting.

Professor McFarlane is one of the best writing professors on this campus! He really cares about students and gives great feedback. As long as you apply his feedback to your final drafts you will get an A on any assignment. The rubrics are also super clear, so if you meet all of the requirements of the rubric in your assignments you're good.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Great professor with valuable feedback on essays before they are due to help for the final draft. Also a very genuine and caring guy, would definitely consider him one of my favorite professors of all time (high  school and college) even though I don't love writing. Very passionate about his work and radiates that energy to his students. The GOAT.

Took him for WRS 105, great professor! Cares a lot about his students and definitely wants to see them succeed in his class.  His class was a very lighthearted environment and he was very understanding if I ever submitted a late assignment, as well as answered any questions about assignments I had outside the classroom.

If you can take Shane for a writing class, DO IT! He is so caring and as long as you show up to class and kinda participate you will get an A. Lectures are interesting, class isn't hard, EASY grader. I chose to take him back to back semesters for both writing classes because how amazing he was.

Super nice professor, super caring, easy class. Wants you to participate and write well, gives good feedback on essays if you seek him out. Very funny too, let us out early a good bit. I imagine he would be pretty forgiving if you aren't a good writer yet.

Would not take him again, the participation feels like middle school.  Getting handed little fake money for each participation feels immature.  Then at the end the participation grade is made up and he isnt reasonable.  I needed it to be moved up just a bit to get an A and he wouldnt do it even though participation is subjective.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Awesome professor 100% recommend. He does take participation very seriously (even hands out tickets which he adds up every class). There is a presentation towards the end, but super easy. Not a strict grader and is very nice and interacts with students.

Do NOT take this class. It feels like middle school, with participation points, constant busy work, and mandatory attendance. He didn't provide the rubric for any of the essays and took over two months to grade them, pass the due date of the next. He would unnecessarily drag lectures in class to keep us there, wasting our time. Look elsewhere.

He is genuinely a very sweet and chill guy that shows he cares about his students from day one. However he is a little unorganized which makes the syllabus confusing. It is a writing class so there are 3 papers and he makes you do peer reviews each time. He tracks participation with "money" Busy work at the end of the semester which was unnecessary
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Great professor.Def recommend taking
great professor, don't understand negative reviews

Had Professor McFarlane for 105 and 106 and he was great. Genuinely cares about his students and will do whatever he can to help his students. Assignments aren't too difficult or extensive. It is easy to receive a good grade in this class, as long as you do the work and participate. He is very flexible and very nice. Highly recommend
DO NOT take for 106 Idk about 105 bad teacher

Absolutely ridiculous with giving last minute busy work assignments. Students are busy and have lives!! Not a good professor bad feedback sloppy directions for the actual essays. DOESNT PUT HIS EXTRA ASSIGNMENTS ON SYLLABUS.  do NOT recommend. wouldn't take again
I would say take him for WRS105 but not 106.
The jokes weren't funny.  Writing is already a waste of my time so this professor just made me hate it more.

Several of us had him for 105 so we decided to retake him.  This is only his 2nd semester at UM so I don't think he knows nobody cares about first-year writing.  Take somebody else if you do not like to participate, he tracks participation even though it does not even matter.  Attendance is mandatory cause he doesn't know any better.
super annoying grading not helpful

Forgets students have other classes and lives outside of this class.super specific about some things and has horrible feedback.Tries to be funny but its annoying how seriously he takes a required class. Nice guy but don't recommend for this course at all.

I had this professor for 105 and I thought he was going to be chill for 106. He is super picky! There are a lot of assignments that contain mistakes made on purpose by him to make sure you pay attention. As college students we are so busy, just tell us what you want and we will do it. Don't make the assignments harder than they are supposed to be.

Instructions are somewhat hard to find, and Blackboard is rarely updated in advance, but overall, it is a fair writing class and he is a fair grader. Passionate and genuine but emphasizes participation within class.
Apply yourself on papers and make an effort in class and you should be fine.

I loved his class and would recommend him to anyone who needs to take WRS 105. He clearly cares for his students and had passion for the subject. The assignments were easy, but also kinda fun and interesting. Attendance is mandatory, but if you have an excuse he'll be very understanding.
1st year at UM so he seemed a little clueless but very friendly.  Overall a good teacher but he does take attendance which can be annoying.
Very nice guy and class is very easy. If you try your best on the assignments and show up to class, you'll get at least an A.
You can tell he really cares about each student, as well as a very passionate teacher. Made an effort to know everybodys names, and was very easy to reach out to. All around good person.
Feels like a high school English class.  Just show up to class participate once and turn in your assignments on time and you'll be fine.

This was his first semester at UM so he didn't really know how things work yet.  He really cares about his students and wants them to achieve.  Very understanding of issues outside of the classroom.  Uses a token system for participation in class.
The teacher skips a lot of needed material because he believes we already know it. He moves fast and expects us to already know all math. He will also call you out in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's a tough but funny guy. Always available for questions and kinda teaches off the slides but overall it's an interesting course and he makes it more interesting.
No reason to take MONEY it is a hard elective for no reason GPA killer (no extra credit or curve)

so caring. he is a tough grader, but he makes sure every student is heard and truly tries to make sure you understand the material. he genuinely cares, even though his class is difficult he does a great job at teaching and definitely knows his stuff. taught me so much about life as well!! hes amazing!

He's a very nice guy but he's very strict and makes the class harder than it needs to be. There are trick answers on the exams and he makes the exams very difficult, so if accounting isn't something you're really great at, you'll definitely struggle in this class. There's no extra credit. This class was the hardest I've ever taken.

The only reason I can think of for his relatively low grading is that he addresses students directly and asks questions to check if they're listening. Other than that, he's a great instructor who teaches the subject very well and connects it to real-life applications. Also overall super funny guy. Listen to him, and you'll get a good grade.

Best professor I have had at UM. He actively asked for feedback and applied it. He cared about each student's success and tailored the class to the needs of his students. We spent most classes doing practice questions that were highly applicable to the graded exams. He will stay on a concept until everyone understands it.

Class is not too bad, lectures are kinda boring and thats all he does. gets mad if you don't participate, but says that he just wants us to learn. Grade is based off mostly two midterms and one final, just review the homeworks and practice quizzes since he just copy and pastes those questions as test, no need to actually study the terms. EZ A tho

reviews.comment: Don't take him. Choose somebody else. Nothing else to say.

People are so soft. This dudes funny and a decent teacher.

He is one of the hardest professors, but honestly if you act like you care he will be nice to you. The tests are lowkey brutal though, especially since there are only three and they are the only things that count towards your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Funny guy if you get to know him he got dad humor.

He is always telling people to ask questions, it gets annoying and makes people not want to participate. Also he contradicts himself half the time and makes a lot of mistakes. Clearly his cognitive skills are declining.

Prof Sicre is hilarious and genuinely caring. His sense of humor made the class enjoyable, and he always made sure students felt supported. He would make sure to always answer questions that anyone had during class. Make sure to do the homework and put in effort to study, don't fall behind. One of the best classes I've taken, highly recommend!
Prof Sicre is a nice guy and very funny in class but compared to the rest of the accounting DEPT, he is defiantly the hardest prof to take.
Very funny dude. Not worth it though in my opinion. His tests are way too hard for the class he teaches and he also doesnt care what grade or how his students do.

I am not sure why he has so many bad reviews. Homework counts for a large portion of your grade and is a free and easy 100%, and for the exams he gives you practice questions that are exactly like what is asked on the exam. Do not be afraid because of the other reviews, if you care about your grades and have two working braincells you will do well.
This class was made so much more complicated than it needed to be. Just honestly unenjoyable.
Just don't bother, complete waste of time taking this guy
Terrible. Never take. I hate him so much. Does not prepare you for finals at all. I seriously dislike this man and I have never not liked a professor at UM thus far

He's the boy. You have to show up if you want a good grade and the material is not easily understood, but Sicre is a great professor and had me cracking up every class. He's stubborn and the class is definitely not easy. But I actually learned everything in the class and he's easily one of the best profs at UM.

The work itself and the topics are not difficult at all, but he is genuinely one of the worst teachers i've ever had. he didn't explain concepts at all and would rush through things and then just ask the class to ask their questions - without explaining how to do them. i did well in his class bc i just taught myself everything but don't take him

Average neolib boomer, knowledgeable about health insurance and auto loans, terrible opinions on taxation and the economy. He worked for the federal reserve, so that should tell you all you need to know.
Great content, great lectures, great guy. Overall an amazing experience.

Prof Sicre can be a nice guy but can also come across as mean and angry. Although his class time can feel useful I find most of the time I end up teaching myself. I took Prof Fonsecca for 211 and he was fantastic. Id look around at other professors before I would take Sicre. All in all. I would not take him again.

Professor Sicre is nice guy overall but HORRIBLE professor, all he does is want you to ask questions and then gets frustrated when people do not understand his explanations. There is zero extra credit... do not ask for it he will just get angry. Take any other professor over him, this course should be an easy A however is now going to ruin my GPA.

I wouldn't recommend this teacher. His tests are extremely difficult and he doesnt teach well. He bases his lecture off of us asking questions instead of him teaching. Tests are not what we do in class, and his makeup policy doesn't allow for any students to makeup a test, no matter if there is an emergency or not

Sicre is the goat. He's the best professor at the U. He cares about every single student and does everything in his power to make sure his students succeed and in out of the classroom. Class act. Couldn't recommend Sicre enough. Take his classes.

Absolutely the worst professor I've ever taken at the University. He does not teach at all, only 3 exams all graded heavily, get ready to be surprised by your grade at the end of the semester, and no matter how hard you try, you will barely pass. Decided to also give an exam worth 22% after 4 weeks of not having class due to him cancelling.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Here is his teaching style, if it works for you take him, if it doesn't maybe reconsider: Sicre doesn't really necessarily teach during class, rather he wants you to ask questions. This means you need to know the material before coming to class, mainly from reading the textbook. Exams are easy if you grind out the study guide.
This class is useless. Watch videos on youtube

He was okay— lecture based, 75% of your grade is exams so you have to do well. Can be intense at times, but he does care for all his students. He will work with you to help you understand. However, he is an acquired taste..
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Sicre is a great professor. Just need to stay on top of assignments and do well on tests, tests are very similar to the homework. Overall great guy
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Respected--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Sicre makes what is inevitably a boring class much more fun and engaging. Definitely take this class if you like asking questions, he strongly encourages it and never makes anyone feel dumb. Practice tests are exactly like the actual test. If you go to class and take the practice tests repeatedly then you should get an A.

He's a tough guy but occasionally throws a joke or two in. I taught myself everything in the class by reading the textbook, I don't think you'll do so well going off his slides. So important to pay attention in class or u can fall behind quickly. Also not afraid to cold call which can be painful

Sicre isn't everyones favorite but IMO he tries to balance being kind but also pushing you to understand the content. He provides you topics to review for both exams and the final and the 2 exams were similar to the Mcgraw Hill practice q's. He really wants people to pass and be comfortable, could be so much worse, taking him for acc212 100%

Not the worst but would not take his class again. Reads straight from the slides and yells to ask questions but goes through everything so fast. Had to teach myself everything. Tests like the homework, but I would not say this is an easy A. Making sure I don't have him for accounting, as this has been my least favorite class/professor this semester
His exams are more difficult than what he does in class. Also he cares less about you so dont bother to ask for help

reviews.comment: Super chill funny teacher took him for 211 and 212. You have to study for his tests but he will work with you, is understanding, and does not want to see his students fail.

Dr. Sicre is a chiller. Funny too. The class is not a joke tho despite my advisor and UM claiming it's an easy intro. He's great but his teaching isn't for everyone and u 100% have to focus and study HW. He can go over crucial material insanely fast and then demand we ask questions but sometimes it's hard to cuz u don't even know wtf just happened

guy is straight up disrespectful and acts like theres nothing wrong with failing his class and taking him again. literally nothing he does in class is on the test and he explains everything in the way that he understands but no one else does. try to avoid him at all costs. lowkey funny tho.

Sicre is a good teacher IMO but not a fav of others. Took him for 211 and 212. Your grade is made up of 2 projects, 3 exams and HW that is easy points. Sicre is the best teacher I have ever had. I had him for 211 and 212. He always made an effort to help in class and outside and his tests are the same as the practice problems
One of the best. Highly recommend.

This class is not hard. There is never any homework except some ridiculously easy online assessments that take maybe 10 mins and you get unlimited chances to correct your answers. Prof Sicre is funny and a good dude. Format of class is straight lectures so it can be boring at times but overall I would take this class if you need an easy cognate.

If you are a shy person - I would not recommend this professor. Overall I enjoyed this course, but he is so keen on students participating he practically scolds the class for not asking questions. Tests are straightforward and have the same questions as practice material. He comes off quite strong, but he's very knowledgable and I learned a lot.

reviews.comment: Really hard class. If you want to take ACC211 with him make sure to NOT skip class. All his test are multiple choice but aren't easy. Make sure to always pay attention when he speaks in class
Not an easy class, only graded by a few things. Professor can be very rude.

never took a finance class and found it hard for a BEGINNER class. exams are okay but he doesn't curve even when the class does badly. yells at students to ask questions but its hard to ask questions when he goes over the content so fast.

Skipped 2 classes, one of them being the only one in 2 weeks and right before our 2nd exam to play golf. The review he sends out is not specific and half isn't even on the exam. He is so rude and just a grumpy old man. Get ready to teach yourself for hours outside of class if you want above a C.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Sicre is a really great guy. While I feel like I struggled in the class when I shouldn't have, he was always looking for a way to help out. Do the homework questions to study for the exams, they are almost word for word. He sometimes gets annoyed with people not asking questions but all in all, he is a great man and very well-liked.

I didn't like his class. everyone says he's very funny and nice, which is true. but he goes so fast. He never clearly says what's going to be on the test. He's not the worst professor I've ever had but compared to my friends, he has harder tests and a teaching style compared to other accounting classes.

He's a nice guy, but he is disorganized(something that comes at the expense of students). The tests are difficult because he sends a "study guide" that is stuff that may come on the test, but it's pretty useless since it's extremely general and things outside the guide are on the test. Makes simple terms difficult, accounting is hard enough as is.
Sicre is a super cool guy. Super nice. He's a little boring but he's a solid teacher for sure.

reviews.comment: Funny and gets students involved.
Amazing, love him 1000% percent would take again!!!
Best professor at UMiami. Go to class and participate! He makes everything fun. He also really cares about his students!
Great Professor, will requiere some work but you will learn a lot.
The best. Always asking for feedback and asking whether or not you understand.
Go to class and you will be fine!
Professor Sicre is the GOAT. If you study, you will do fine. Don't be lazy.

Professor Sicre is the simply the greatest. Most fun Ive had in any course. If you study and attend class regularly you can count on an A. Hes super funny and understanding and he will give you the benefit of the doubt. Take this course, you will not regret it. Best professor. Great learning valuable real-life content as well. Love Sicre.

easy class. It is hard to get into. 10/10 would recommend.

Never taken a finance course and was pretty confused. Sicre is a funny and nice guy but practically yells at students to ask questions. Lectures sometimes have nothing to do with tests. Test questions are directly from homework and practice quizzes and most of the questions are online. You can get an A if you study.

If you are reading this! For your own sake and peace of mind don't take him! For the following reasons: Tests don't match practice quizes and homework questions. When confronted, the fault is ours not his, "he told us in class." (never). Very rude, on occasion, and complicates very easy terminology.

Ridiculously easy class for upperclassman business students. Probably still easy for everybody else. Really useful class for personal finance that gets you prepared for being financially independent. Test questions are identical to homework with only one or two curveballs per exam. Homework is easy. Can't recommend this class and professor enough.
