I can not say how he is for the other classes he teaches, but for BUS201 he was extremely easy in my opinion. The exams were very straight forward and often included problems nearly identical to some HW problems. However, he is not the best teacher and is very unclear with directions and explaining simple concepts. Pretty funny guy though overall

Sicre is an awesome professor. His class isn't easy but if you study, you'll get an A. I didn't pay attention in class much but I retyped and studied his powerpoints and ended up with a B+. If you miss a test, it's not the end of the world; if you have a good excuse he'll work with you to make it up.

This class was not an easy A. You have to work for it but Professor Sicre helps you a lot outside the classroom and he is always there to answer questions. If you work hard and go to him in the beginning of the semester wanting an A, he will help guide you there. Would take him again!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Likable and charismatic person. But unfortunately Professor Sicre will spend every class meticulously defining very simple terms or doing practice problems that are blatantly not relevant to his exams. When exams, come he has given no preparation. Additionally, he has failed to solve any problems I ever presented to him during his office hours.

ACC212 is an extremely difficult class with him. I have a 3.87 GPA so I consider myself a good student that work really hard, however this class has been impossible for me. I do all the HW and the textbook problems and his tests are impossible. Test is EXTREMELY LONG. The final was 65 questions! I would definitely NOT take anymore classes with him
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: DO NOT take ACC212 with him. He speeds through lectures. If you miss one class you wont know whats going on in the next. His first two tests are semi straightforward if you study, but the final is extremely long and tedious. Avoid if you can, there are other 212 professors much easier.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Extremely easy class if you're a business student. If you're not, its self explanatory and common sensical. If you don't show up to class as 80% of people don't, expect to be ridiculed when you show up for tests. EASY.
i AM A HUGE FAN OF PROFESSOR SICRE

Prof. Sicre is a good man in person. Kinda have a good sense of humorous. However, he makes this course way too challenging. Be prepared to read and do all the practices. Would not take his class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Speeds through lecture and pretends that students will know everything right away. He teaches through questions. He makes you work on questions from the book in class. Attendance is mandatory. Tests are based on formulas and math problems, almost no theory questions. Homework every week. Did not like his teaching method.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Sicre is a funny guy who wants his students to do well and understand the material. He refuses to move on if someone doesn't understand something; he really puts an emphasis on how important it is to ask when confused. Great lecturer and goes over problems in class. Would definitely take again.

Definitely pushes students to learn and addresses questions but is NOT clear during lectures. Spends most of lecture time doing practice problems that are difficult to understand even after a lesson is taught. Be prepared to read the whole book and teach yourself everything. Very difficult for an intro course.

Lectures are very unclear even though he makes a big effort to make sure nobody has questions. He focuses on clarifying topics that most students understand but not the ones that are misunderstood by most students. He moves very fast and most of his lectures consist of doing practice problems by yourself. Not an easy A for accounting.
Wants you to learn, too much work at times but he cares

He's always willing to help you either in class if you don't get something or during his office hours if you need more clarification. He wants you to succeed. Just show him you are willing to put in the effort. Go to class and participate. Practice from the book exercises, that's where he gets the tests from.

Tougher than a normal class but it curves to be about the same final grade wise.  As for the professor, probably the best teacher I have ever had.  Pushes you to learn, and frankly you will actually learn the material. He is a great dude too - crazy smart.  Refuses to go on unless he is sure everyone gets it (will call on you a lot).  Take him.

Manny is a great guy, very dead pan and funny, and EXTREMELY concerned that all his students learn the material and succeed. That being said, he can be very challenging, but that's because believes his students are capable so he sets the bar high.
very nice guy, go over the lectures and always willing to hep. tests are not bad if you study. would take again

He speeds through his lectures, but will definitely go back or elaborate on something if you ask questions. He takes attendance every class on a sign-in sheet. The homework and building blocks project are easy. The test can be VERY tough.  You need to study and go through SEVERAL examples to do well on the tests.
Simply the best, take him
simply the best for auditing class

I have no idea why this man is rated highly. I'm in his audit class, and i can honestly say he is the worst ACC professor I have taken. He seems like he's knowledgeable but it's all BS. We get SO much busy work for an upper-level class, and he treats us like middle schoolers. He's lazy and knows nothing so he gives us assignments to occupy time.
Prof Sicre is a great professor although his tests are a little bit challenge, but after all if you study, should be an easy A
Manny Sicre is the man. Always willing to help you out if you need it (though you shouldn't if you show up to class), and he makes the time fly by.
best professor ever, we love professor Sicre. I m a huge fan of him
Best ever, take him. Love him so much
He is the man, take him! hysterical sense of humor, but if you're an insecure and extremely shy person who can't take a joke or talk in class I wouldn't take him

Great professor. Very clear in his lectures and is always willing to help out his students and pushes everyone to do well. It is not an easy class but he has a hilarious sense of humor and makes the class very enjoyable. I HIGHLY reccomend him
he is basically pablo escobar, you mess up he will eliminate you, claims to be the most interesting man in the world, however I think he is a sociopath
He is honestly mean. He does not try and help students succeed. He is sadistic and does not give students a straight answer

He is a really good professor and is very clear in his lectures. It was a tough class but the financial accounting material is difficult none the less, regardless of the teacher you have. He is always willing to help you in and outside of class and wants the class to do well. He may call on you in class but he has a good sense of humor

Fantastic professor.  I left this class with a great understanding of the fundamentals of accounting, and a bigger love for accounting.  Pay attention to what he says.  He hates repeating himself about things like when homework is due, what you need to bring to the exam, etc.  He does not curve, but you shouldn't need that anyway.  Easy class!
Perfect professor, the accounting class is hard. But if you study, you will get an A
Great professor who encourages you to ask and he will make sure you understand it. Although with little accent, he's lecture is pretty clear and helpful.
Wish I appreciated him more when I had him. Got an A but I really earned it, he helped me get there too. I miss Manny.

Just had 1st exam. The average grade is 80. Kinda hard exam, as he said, the exams would be harder... He always wants to help students, but sometimes he couldn't understand what you try to ask... Notes are pretty clear and helpful. You need to read book by yourself and do all homework he requires. which has to be done by handwriting, not typing.
Clear lecture, helpful
Cool class.  A lot of work but professor tried very hard to make it interesting and gave real-life examples. Was there when I needed help. I recommend him.
Got the grade! Not easy but Sicre met with me outside of regular class a couple of times and that helped me a lot.  Funny but strict at times. I liked him and the class.
Tough subject matter, but great professor.  No surprises, just had to read and do assignments.  Wish I had him for more classes.
Passionate about class and the student's learning.  Tried very hard to have each student participate in class.
What UP! Great dude... he is the most interesting man in the world... STAY THIRSTY MY FRIENDS!

I was completely surprised with these good reviews. He is extremely mean and difficult! He is never available to help and if you ask any question he will embarrass you in front of the class! worst class I've ever taken.
He is rude and belittling. He does not help you improve your grade and is not helpful when you ask questions.

Awesome teacher, a typical miami cuban guy, he has a bit of an accent, but flawless vocabulary.  Just goes off the PPT, all the tests are MC.  Very simple class, very easy to do good in, just skim the text, and study the PPT's.
AWESOME GUY!!! Great professor. Makes accounting relatively easy to understand. Very funny. Will help you out with grades if the class collectively doesn't do great on a test. Definitely take him!

This dude is the man, awesome f'ing teacher, very helpful makes an otherwise unbearable subject fun to learn. i actually wanted to go to his class and i hate accounting so it speaks volumes, his tests aren't always cake but if you put some effort and thought into it you'll be fine.
Great professor!!! I came to class just to hear his jokes. Pretty easy tests for a difficult subject. He gives great lectures. I would definitely take him again. Highly highly recommended!

Prof. Sicre is the MAN! He is very funny and gives great examples from real life which makes it easy to understand the material. He is awlays joking around with somebody so even if you don't feel like listening you'll end up listening just cause he is so funny! I had never though about majoring in accounting until I took him! What a great guy!
this is the man. He makes accounting interesting and keeps you awake with his jokes. overall very solid. easy tests
Solid guy, solid class. Show up to class, take a few notes, laugh at that girl in the front of the class thats always asking dumb questions, Sicre is laughing at all of us on the inside, muahahaha
Overall a great teacher, really makes sure you understand. Gives a lot of work but is lenient with homework.  Read the book and the notes and the tests are extremely easy.

Great teacher.  Really helps you through the class.  A lot of work at once, but he will decrease the amount of homework if you tell him its too much.  All tests are SUPER easy Multiple choice and true and false.

Funny, nice, and caring prof. Her grading is unpredictable; she grades hard but on a curve. Wants you to ask questions and will answer outside of class, too. 4 exams count for 80% of the grade and 20% participation, so grades are really determined by exams. Really need to re-listen to lecture recordings if you can't follow along in class.

Professor McDonald is amazing. She is clearly interested in what she teaches and wants you to be as well. This course is difficult, as physiology is not easy to understand, but I found that learning diagrams and charts was very helpful for studying. Extra credit on exams based on assigned readings was very nice. Ask questions. Make a study group!

Such a tough class but such a knowledgeable professor :). Made it very easy to ask all the questions you need to in order to understand the topic being taught. Definitely could've gotten an A if I locked in lol
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I 100% recommend that people take any course they can with Dr. McDonald. She is such a nice person that genuinely cares about her students. While, MSC 403 is not an easy class, she did her best to make it accessible to students of different academic backgrounds. She was open to questions and feedback regarding the course.

This lab is set up like most labs at UM; an experiment, with a lab report afterwards. Her requirements for the lab reports are exact, but not unreasonable. Re-do the first two, follow the guidelines provided, and you'll figure it out. McDonald was very nice and knowledgeable, offered help where she could. A 300 level class, and treated like one.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I'll never forget this professor, and not in a good way. I showed up late for a test because I had such bad food poisoning that I physically couldn't leave the bathroom, the class still having 40 minutes to finish the test and she wouldn't let me take it. She is not afraid to chastise you in front of the entire class. Horrific experience overall.

She really knows her stuff and explains clearly. There are iClicker questions every class which usually appear on tests in one form or another (these are very helpful in understanding the material). I went over the power points and iClicker Questions (take photos of them during class) twice before tests and ended up with A with the optional final.

Give 5-7 days in advance of tests, and you can drop one and take the optional final. Iclicker participation gives a surprisingly big lift, and there's no homework. I had her in MSC230 also and she had the same setup, but it was her first time teaching it and she needed to know the material more, but she definitely is able to improve.

Worst professor I've ever had. I've seen her chastise students after her class when they have questions. One girl ended up leaving and crying. Just a mean lady, doesn't have a shred of human decency. Would never have taken had I have know how temperamental and rude she is.
Shes such a nice person. I used to love her lectures. Tests arent easy, you have to study harder and harder to get an A.

The tests are way harder than they should be, because she did not really understand the material herself. This made it difficult, because you need to read the book on top of the lectures the tests are full of trick questions, so even if you know the material very well, you might not do amazing.
Class was interesting, material was clear, and the exams were very reasonable. Great professor.

Excellent professor. Very good explainer that makes physiology fun and interesting.  Four exams, optional final, no curve.  Exams are challenging but fair.  Very responsive to email and gets exam grades back within a day or two.  Highly recommended.

There are four tests and an optional final. There is usually no curve. iClickers in class constitute 10% of the grade, so attendance is necessary. Material is fairly simple, but she does have some tricky test questions (one word making the choice incorrect). Very easy if you go through the PPTs a few times (no book needed). Would recommend.

One of the best professors I have had at UM. She really connects with her students and relates the material well. Very clear and keeps us interested. You do need to study though, the exam questions can be challenging. Generally there is no curve on the exams. I got an A. Optional final exam! Take her!

Her tests include only lecture material, so there is no point in buying the book! She is very clear. Attendance is not mandatory, but she does do iClicker questions for participation points. Her iClicker questions readily show up on her tests. She is funny,and friendly unlike many of the teachers at this school.Responds to e-mails quickly.Take her!

Obtained an A! Her 4 exams were ALWAYS fair. Optional final too! If you pay attention and study her notes hardcore you can get A+. If you memorize a lot you will get a A- guaranteed. If you have a brain you will get a B- which is her average; and NO curves. She IS nice, helpful, smart, funny, clear!  Material is tough so use book as reference.

The material isn't always interesting, but she tries to keep up interest. Class isn't mandatory, but a lot of her iclicker questions will be on the test.  Her powerpoints are pretty much straight from the book, so if you read, its very possible to get an A. A lot of her test questions have to do with comparisons she talks about in class.
I would recommend this professor for Comparative Physiology to everyone.  She's really nice and a fun teacher.  Tests are not difficult at all and easy to study for.

She is a nice person, but that does'nt help with the class. She makes it clear that grades are not a priority, she wants you to learn, btw  med school CARES about grades. Was not willing to curve that often, when she did it was only a point or two. I would go to another professor. She read a lot off slides and talks A LOT about her own research.

This professor doesn't know any more than what she teaches.  Her tests are  typically fair with just enough questions UNFAIR to make an A extremely  difficult.  She says it herself that she doesn't care about you or your grade.  The  material is sometimes interesting but more self-taught than anything.
No Comments
Class was difficult but interesting.

Class is basically just her reading off powerpoint for over an hour...which means I don't take many notes and zone out a lot.  I feel like she doesn't really relate lectures back to major themes in biology.  Every once in a while she'll ask "Pretty cool aye?" and usually it's not.

She does mandatory hw readings graded by AI based on how the AI analyzes you scroll rate through the document, and the "quality" of your comments. There is extra credit for showing up or answering few q's sometimes.
Super nice
Super unorganized and impossible to contact. Will give you a 0 on an assignment you did, then not answer her email. She is the most annoying teacher

Professor McCarthy definitely knows what she's talking about. She provides real-world experience in her lectures that make her seem more genuine. There is a lot of in-class work, but all assignments, projects, and tests are easy. She can be a little blunt, but she is overall really nice.

Professor is super nice and creates a great class environment. The material itself is not difficult. However she looks at the ceiling when she teaches. Some of her exam questions she tries to trick you a bit with wording which is annoying. A few group projects too she likes to keep it busy but overall should be an easy A.

I absolutely loved this professor! Easy A if you attend class and she will hear you out if you get an exam question wrong and give you points back (exams are very doable if you study even a little bit). She gives a many extra credit options and truly cares for her students. I would recommend taking her.
She's honestly really kind and cares a lot about her students. I don't know why she has bad reviews, shes super easy and she tries to make the class fun. Take her!

You have about 1 HW per week which takes 20mins, google it! The rest is about 3 projects but super easy genuinely such a good professor. The class might seem boring but she incorporates videos and simulations to facilitate the boringness. 2 tests and just 1 final paper. Take her to boost your GPA and to learn ADV ORG Behavior.

This professor cares about her students and tries to work with them to redevelop the Blackboard site to find everything more easily. Before Exams we were given a good study guide as well as practice multiple choice questions.

I recommend this class. McCarthy's reviews don't do her justice—she's a kind teacher who genuinely cares about her students. Though it's lecture-heavy, she makes it interactive. The study guides are clear, and there's plenty of extra credit. However, her Blackboard and grading can be a bit confusing.

I don't know why McCarthy has such low ratings. She's the goat. She gives lots of extra credit and gives you super straightforward study guides. She definitely cares for her students and wants everyone to get a good grade. You do have to participate in discussions but as long as you do the bare minimum, you will be fine. Take her 10/10 easy A.

Lovely professor! The class can be a bit boring but she tries her best to keep it engaging. Anyone who rated her poorly was probably lazy and was not paying attention. She gives you all the test questions in the review and she is really flexible and lets you argue your case for an answer. Just participate and do your work and you will get an A.
Easy class and tests are straightforward. Class is a lot of groupwork so it's not a boring lecture.
Tests are hard and you need the online textbook. Hard grader when it comes to group project.

Needed to write a second one to emphasize my point. So much work for what should be such a straightforward class. Even when the class doesn't want to answer her questions, she refuses to move on until someone does. Expects near perfection from people if they want an A. Definitely the hardest-earned B+ I've ever gotten. DO NOT TAKE HER!

Wow. Lots to say but not enough characters allowed. In class powerpoints only are about 70% of the tests, the rest you need to read to textbook on your own. Very hard grader on projects, expecting fully detailed papers to give out an A. Considering this is a "how to act at work" class, she makes this way harder than it should be. DO NOT TAKE HER!

The professor has little understanding on how to keep the students engaged. The lectures are super long and boring, so unless you love sitting through an hour of presentations, you won't like this class. Her exams barely match the material given in class. Very hard to actually learn, she wants to keep class fun, but the results are the opposite.

Incredibly rude and emotionally unavailable. Cold calls on specific targeted group of students (probs out of jealousy). Has horrible teaching style and an even worse lisp. Incredibly hard to understand. Assignments and due dates are incredibly hard to find and she refuses to tell students the due dates by mouth. Take her if you want a bad headache.

Mccarthy MGT304 class is the most boring and confusing lecture at Miami. She reads powerpoints word for word with no enthusiasm, also didn't post the powerpoints so I was left to read full chapters in order to study. Besides that she consistently has the wrong dates on blackboard and blames you when it's not done. Unorganized, terrible teacher.

Just avoid, this class made me want to never go but the attendance is mandatory and participation. Very nerve racking going to this class. My group was awful, they didn't do anything until the last minute. Too much homework and quizzes and short papers for cases. Projects suck and are expected to be 30-40 mins long. Unrealistic. She was nice tho ig

McCarthy stares at the ceiling when she teaches and does not teach the material effectively. There are 3 exams and a group project that are weighted pretty heavily. You won't do well on the exams if you don't read the online textbook and memorize all of the definitions. She cares about participation way too much. Take another prof if you can

She is so dull and boring and is also a difficult grader. The class itself is so stupid and pointless. The exams are hard no matter how much you study because its all random terms for things that are just common sense. 0/10 recommend. Group paper and project is so stupid and is graded very unrealistically. Any other teacher for mgt 304 is easier
Terrible professor; she has no idea what she is talking about. Her expectations are so inconsistent, and her lectures are a waste of time.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Not even lying I think this professor is brain dead. She lectures during class and either stares at the ceiling or the back of the class. You can sit on your phone the whole time and she'll never call you out. You would never have to go to class if she didn't take attendance. Easy homework's and easy exams.
harsh grader of projects and takes participation way to seriously
Super interesting class, he makes the class interactive and easy to follow. One of my favorite courses taken at UM.

Dr. McCabe is sweet, funny, and understanding. His lectures are interesting but dense, which can make exams challenging. However, he's always available to clarify confusing material. Your grade is based on 3 exams, and attendance isn't mandatory, but good notes are essential. If you're a strong test-taker, I highly recommend this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Exams based on lectures. Class not mandatory but lecture slides are only pictures so you need to attend class to get the information. Hardest part of exams is learning the parts of the brain and different chemicals. He is nice and easily accessible as a professsor.

You can tell he loves the topic, but he's so good that he expects everyone to know about it. If you don't go to lectures you're basically failing. No info on the slides and no textbook. He's really good at lecturing and keeps you engaged, attendance is not required but really recommended. The class by itself is tough and heavy so to study a lot.

He is super straightforward and also SO smart! Very accessible teacher who is always willing to help. There's 3 exams 1/3 of your grade each, final is non cumulative and tests are ENTIRELY based on lecture so attend class, take good notes and PAY ATTENTION and you will do well!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved this class and Dr. McCabe is very straightforward with the information. The tests are based purely off his lectures so if you go to class and take good notes you should do amazing. Highly enjoyed the material covered too.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. McCabe is an amazing professor. I'm a psychology (BA) major with very little background in science and I managed to keep up. While attendance isn't mandatory, you won't pass if you don't go to class because his tests are based entirely on his lectures. Take thorough notes (I'd even recommend recording his lectures because its a lot of info).
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: McCabe is an amazing professor! His class is basically all lecture-based so make sure you are taking good notes and paying attention during class. But don't worry because McCabe makes his lectures interesting. You have 3 exams but just like his lectures, he ask straightforward questions. If you took good notes you'll be fine. He's a sweetheart.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Best teacher I've had at UM. Exams are entirely lecture based so it's important to attend class. While it's difficult to take notes for 75 minutes, he's a great lecturer and keeps students engaged. Exams are not very difficult if you paid attention in class. He truly wants his students to learn the material and also be successful
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Best professor I've had at UM. Have to go to lecture and take good notes but the tests are 100% based on lecture and not hard to get A's on tests. He made me excited for my future in medicine because he makes the lectures interesting and easy to understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Awesome person and awesome professor. If you're having trouble with the class if you just go and talk to him, he'll work something out with you for sure.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Best teacher at UM

Tests are 100% based off of lecture notes, textbook is pointless. The tests are easy if you have the notes, but listening and taking notes for 75 minutes straight is hard. He is a good lecturer thought.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: EXTREMELY easy class and I need to study to get good grades. 100% lecture based, take good notes and study a week in advance, know the mechanisms, you'll be good. He will curve if you improve/show u care/tried. extremely nice guy. If you ask questions/go to office hours he will help you/give tips about exam. great letters of rec. do NOT skip class
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests? Not many

reviews.comment: One of my favorite classes and professors at UM. His lectures are amazing, and he presents complex information in a straightforward manner w/ the right amount of detail. Tests are 100% lecture notes, so if you pay attention/take good notes you should get an A. He is very willing to meet with students. I actually looked forward to going to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He's a really good lecturer but i never went to class. attendance isnt mandatory but his tests are 100% off of his lectures (literally). i got notes from a friend and i just memorized the notes and got an A. 3 tests with no drops. 3rd exam is during finals week (non-cumulative). should be a doable A if you can memorize the notes
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. McCabe is a great professor. His tests are all based on lectures which are very interesting. Go to class and pay attention and you don't need to read the book. He is always willing to help after class.  No curves on tests, they had high averages. Take this class if you are interested!

HE'S SO HOT. I hope he reads this too.  In actuality he truly cares about his students. He wants you to do well, and is passionate about what he's teaching. He makes complex  information simple, and gives straight forward questions on the test. Completely fair. You will love listening to him lecture, because he has a great voice and good stories.

He's a spectacular instructor and really stimulates interest of the subject in his students. Class attendance is definitely necessary since his exams come directly from the lecture. The book isn't needed. Start studying for the exams a few days in advance. They aren't extremely difficult, but they're harder than exams in most psychology courses.
A great professor. The class covers A LOT of material so attending class and taking notes is crucial to do well. Test are straightforward.

Probably the best professor I have had at UM. Lectures are extremely clear and he is very knowledgeable and approachable. Tests are very fair and are based almost exclusively on lecture notes. Average on tests is a high B - low A, and there is no curve. Go to class, take careful notes, and you will have no problem at all. Take the class!

Dr McCabe is one of the coolest professors at UM. His lectures are interesting and he mostly has just straight forward questions on the tests, nothing tricky. The book is way more detailed than the tests. He basically goes over the whole test at review sessions. Psych majors may struggle with the level of biology/neuroscience concepts.

McCabe is easily one of my favorite teachers at UM.  He's great at teaching difficult neuroscience concepts & is always willing to give extra help if needed.  His tests are extremely fair, attendance isn't mandatory but all of the material comes from his notes so you'll want to go.  He's really knowledgeable & has a lot of connections in the field
No Comments
Wonderful teacher, wonderful person...one of the best teachers in the Psychology department!
Great teacher and really hot!
Wonderful professor!
Super relaxed class and many opportunities for makeup work. Loved his personal anecdotes and ability to convey the current state of conservation.

He is the most lovely professor. I don't even care what grade I get in the course because of how amazing he is. You can tell how passionate he is about corals and reefs and marine science in general. The experience he's had in his field is just astounding. Absolutely take this class, or any of his classes for that matter, it's really rewarding.

He is the sweetest most easy going man. His class is very easy with two exams that he tells you literally exactly what you need to get 100 and a term paper. The term paper is tough because its ten pages single spaced but he gives everyone an A so just do your best. Also its not listed, but this course counts as a writing credit. Inspirational too!

Dr McManus is a great professor. Lectures are interesting and he is a funny and incredibly intelligent professor. One of my favorites at UM. Tests are exactly like the study guides he gives and there is one 10 page term paper that he gives you the entire semester to write. If you get an A+ on the term paper he gives you a letter of rec! Great class

McManus is the absolute best. This class is super interesting and is easy enough for people who've never coded before to just as well as anyone else. He's a little scatterbrained, but for good reason, he has so much valuable knowledge about the field itself that he often branches off and tells stories about how things have changed.

The only reason I took MSC101 was because I needed a science credit and a writing credit. Regardless, McManus took a subject I usually detest, and made it interesting. The exams were directly from a study guide and his course was very organized. If you're doing the research paper, make sure to pick a strong topic (it's 10 pages single spaced)

The course consisted of two easy tests--both of which he gives you a study guide for that has all the terms to know on it. Honors students have to write a 12 page research paper, but you have the whole semester to do it and no other homework. Overall, it was easy . All I did was study the terms and got 100% on both tests.

We had two exams for this class, both of which he gave a review sheet for; one didn't really need to read the book beyond that. He assigned a 12-page paper because it is an honors class, but if you manage your time, it's not too bad. Definitely a fun professor and a fairly simple class.

TAKE THIS CLASS!  I needed a science credit and I took the honors section and got an A+. He gives out review sheets about 4 days before the test that have every single thing you need to know on it.  If you show interest in the class by answering questions he will like you.  Good sense of humor, nerdy, but funny.
nice teacher

Very nice man but not a very good professor. His voice is monotonous, & he often appears disorganized. His lectures are basically from the book, but it is good to attend class b/c he sporadically takes attendance. Luckily, his exams are easy if you review the topics on his study guide. Honors students will probably have to write a 20-pg term paper.
Very understanding, there for students. Very intellectual.
I love professor McGibney. His lectures are heavy but he's the greatest guy ever.

Professor McGibney is a very nice guy. The classes are quite boring, but he tries to make them interesting with memes in the lectures. There are 3 exams each worth 25% of the grade and labs (which are easy) makeup the last 25%

The most boring professor I've ever had it's practically impossible to pay attention and no one shows up unless it's a lab day. You're graded on labs and 3 tests which are each worth 25% of your grade. They're 25 multiple choices so each question wrong is a full point on your overall grade. makes no sense.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor McGibney is a great guy. The content of the class is not the most exciting (shouldn't be a surprise for a stats class), but he does his best to be engaging. He's clearly extremely knowledgable about statistics and does a good job of putting complex ideas in simple terms. I highly recommend taking his course if you have the opportunity
So boring. Class is awful. Awful Content. Terrible Organization. Relies so heavily on TA. Lazy.

This professor was one of the best we have had. He genuinely wanted everyone to learn/understand the material and was extremely helpful and clear. The material was challenging but his preparation and thoughtful manner of teaching made it much easier to comprehend. He is an excellent teacher- wish I had more like him!

He's definitely super awkward but a nice guy. It's statistics so it's a pretty boring class but he works through problems with you and makes it easy to learn. He usually allows cheat sheets for tests so you get to understand the concepts without stressing about formulas. He wants you to do well, I'd recommend.

He has to be one of the most boring professors in all of UM. His class was hard to sit in sometimes but he really does love the subject and improved at teaching as the semester went on. His style of giving notes really helps on quizzes and makes the class pretty easy. Not a difficult A if you sit in class and pay attention. He wants you to do well.

He is new to the University this year (Fall 2016). He doesn't know how to completely teach the material; however, he is starting to get more comfortable. He is very helpful if you go to see him during his office hours. He has study sessions every week to go over homework that is due to next day or a quiz. The material is hard in general so prepare.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Great professor, kinda awkward but very approachable and helpful. Quizzes or Hw sets due every Thursday but helps you prep well for final & lots of grades go into your final grade. Hard class but he makes it manageable. Take him if you can.
Nice professor. The final was just much, much more difficult than the quizzes and was worth almost half of the final grade.

it's nice that attendance isn't mandatory, her homework vs quizzes are genuinely so different. Each quiz is like 5 questions and all of them including the final are so much harder than the work that we did in class. I would never take her again. Final exam "practice" is NOTHING like the final exam.

She cares about her students but she does not give in to excuses.  She drops 2 or 3 quizzes.  I think she may be a little paranoid about students manufacturing excuse letters but I understand that is why she doesn't allow makeups.  If you do the homework (and she goes over it in class), the quizzes are a breeze.

Worst experience with a class in my 3 years at this school. The worst teaching skills i've encountered with a professor. Expects everyone to have 5 years of experience in excel for the type of lectures she teaches. Grading is beyond harsh and won't explain why you're wrong in depth. Just 3 or 4 word explanations. Avoid at all costs

She is really not caring and borderline mean, she doesn't take a single excuse from anyone, you could be in the hospital dying of an infectious disease and she wouldn't help you at all, she don't gaf. If you are inexperienced in calculus, good luck. Honestly, just take another professor, it's not worth it.

So many people are saying others are being dramatic, trust me when I say if you haven't done Calc in highschool you will need to teach yourself a lot. A test almost every week 50% of your grade is the final and 40% is the tests. She takes no excuses for missing tests even if you entire family died she lowk dont gaf.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She's super easy going and quizzes are just like the work we do in class. Idk why people are dramatic, she's very nice and also you rlly don't have to go to class if you understand the work. She usually doesn't even take the whole class period to explain a chapter so I would just go anyway. The midterm was just like the quizzes.
Great teacher! Cares about her students. Best teacher by far for Mas201 or 202

If you have any medical or personal emergencies that prevent you from doing quizzes, even if you need to drop other poor performing ones, she will not work with you at all. Even if you try as much as you can to. I had to withdraw and take during the summer.

there are not a lot of options for mas classes, so compared to others professor mckenry is pretty good. we had 7 quizzes (lowest 2 are dropped), as well as a cumulative midterm and final. everything is on excel and you get a cheat sheet but still a tough class. would recommend but make sure you study especially for the midterm and final!

She has no sympathy, no kindness. She will grade you in a ridiculous way. She is hard to reach outside the classroom. No matter how you are doing in the semester, the final will make no sense and you will drop letter grades as a result.I had a A in the class the whole semester and finished with a C. It's so disappointing, as well as sad.
She is not caring or a good teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Marry McKenry is the GOAT I mean GOAT. if you can take her class, do yourself a favor and take it.

The best math teacher I have had in my life. There are 10 quizzes, and she takes 5, so it's easy to go into the exam with a 100. She grades quizzes harshly and doesn't really give partial credit on questions. She never shames you for asking questions, and she's super kind and funny. Going to class is optional, but she always ends it 20 mins early.
Take her class. Best professor for MAS110.

Best professor ever. No mandatory, attendance no mandatory homework. about 10 quizzes but only grades the best 5 and a final. Best math professor at the school by far. Clearly speaks English unlike the rest of the math department and class time is very valuable and she makes everything crystal clear. Definitely take any of her classes.

Prof McKenry is very nice and caring and wants everyone to do well. That being said, she teaches very fast and I fend myself teaching myself. The math department at the U is quite horrible and I would say she's probably the best you can get. Although im not a fan she's defiantly on the better side of Math professors at this terrible math program.

Mary's a little disorganized but this will be the easiest class of your life. It's 10 quizzes and 2 exams, all online in class. She gives you the excel formulas you need in the class before the exam, then you just regurgitate them for an A. Super easy, take her in a heartbeat.

I think that Professor McKenry is an overall good teacher. However, I am someone who is relatively good at math, and am a very fast learner. The entire class is built based off of minitab, which is much better than some of the other professors who make you do all the math. My only thing is if you get a problem wrong, she takes a lot of points off.

I BARELY passed Precalc with a B- and am ending business calc with an A. Super easygoing teacher - amazing compared to the other goofball teachers in the math debt. You learn everything in class, attendance isn't taken but GO cause it's sm harder teaching urself. She drops sm quizzes/ is easily convincible to move quizzes. Couldn't recommend more
Homework is optional. Class is optional. She even drops a bunch of quizzes which is great. Couldn't recommend more highly. She also is super normal and easy to talk to.

Class is easy if you show up and take notes. She gives pretty good lectures and allows you to have cheat sheets on the quizzes and final exam. Make sure you study hard for the final though cuz it's worth 40% of your final grade. She drops 3-4 of your worst quiz grades so you're fine if you bomb a few of them.
If you pay attention you will be fine but the class is boring

She is a decent teacher with no mandatory attendance, but the class assignments and quizzes are given about one class worth of notice so you need to be in class to know when they are. Did not take up a lot of time out of class, studying for maybe an hour max before each quiz will guarantee an A.

This class is an easy A, you get cheat sheets on the quizzes you have and only like 10/14 are graded, Prof can struggle teaching the subjects clearly at times but honestly, its an intro stats class so the concepts aren't hard, you just need to know how to halfway use excel.
4/7 quizzes are graded. go to class and youll be more than fine. Easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor is very good at breaking down the material.  If you go to class and do the problems the class is a piece of cake.

I wrote a terrible review from earlier for her 202 class. It was one of the hardest classes I have taken but I ended up with an A. I have no idea how. I calculated my grade and got a C+ with the final and final project. Got a 68 on the final. Test average was 75%. Ended with an A. Some kids still got B's though. Take this info with what you will.
I took this professor due to prior reviews and I found the opposite. This class was very hard she goes way too fast and gives little to no feedback on quizzes and exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Really the best statistics professor.  Saw other students complaining about her but she really cares about her students. She tells you what you need to know.

I honestly have no clue how she has any good ratings. She is hands down the worst teacher at the school. Does not respond to any emails and did not post the exam review until the night before the final. This teacher sucks.

MY GOD THIS IS THE WORST PROFESSOR. The most impossible class. I took her for MAS201 and I liked her. 202 was the hardest class I have ever taken. No textbook. Using a completely new software for math. Only explains in class. Doesn't have example problems. Doesnt record the class. Do not take her. I cant put into words how bad this class was.

I do not understand how she has such great reviews. Please take my word for it: DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR! Her tests and quizzes are impossible, and she gives slim to no partial credit for them. She is so rude and condescending when people ask questions. I have never done so poorly in a class in my life compared to this class.

Great teacher. She is straightforward, and teaches you what you need to know. I appreciate this because math can get confusing at times, but with her teaching style it was easy to follow. She is a tough grader, but she is also very understanding of her students. You can tell that she cares. If you struggle w math, choose her

She's awesome. One of the best math teachers I've had. So good at explaining things and always asks if we have questions before moving on. Tests and quizzes are super straightforward and easy (final was kinda tricky tho) because she allows a cheat sheet. Only counts 5 best quizzes out of 7-8. No attendance, but you'll be lost if you skip.

She's very nice, but she is a very tough grader. Her test questions are significantly harder than the quiz or homework questions. Her quizzes are fairly easy, and sometimes she'll give you a question that you can do with a partner as a quiz grade. Also homework is not mandatory.

I took her for 3 semesters! She allows you to use excel during quizzes and tests like you would in the real world. Shes friendly and open to answer questions you have. Personally, I am a good note taker and I study, so the class was a breeze. But if you dont take notes, do not pay attention, and dont do the homeworks, material is difficult.

Great professor. Explained material well and had open-note exams. Material was tough but using excel made it a lot easier to learn. If you put the work in and pay attention, you can get a good grade. Lots of quizzes but they are not worth a lot and she drops lowest 2 or 3. She was funny and I enjoyed class. Would definitely take her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Prof McKenry breaks down the material well and provides handouts through Blackboard. I think she has way more students now--there were 50 in our class, when my sister took her there were only 30. Open notes and allows you to use computer. She cares about students learning the material rather than memorizing. If you want to learn, take her class
you will have no idea what is going on the entire time. does not post grades or respond to emails. tests and quizzes way harder than homework and notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Not the best Professor but also not the worst, can come off as rude sometimes probably because she doesnt feel like explaining more than she has. She doesnt allow backtracking which is quite annoying, she also has high expectations for her students. She is still not that hard of a professor, take her if you dont have any other better options
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor is a nice person who knows how to teach. She does make her tests way harder then the class problems which can be annoying. The biggest thing for me is that she doesn't allow backtracking which is ridiculous because you can get stuck on these statistics problem for a long time.

Prof McKenry is a really good teacher. I think the hybrid course was not easy as there were some technical issues--I don't think they were her fault. She really cares and would answer everyone's questions. If you went to class (even online) and did the homework, you could do well in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Her lectures are pretty good and she always stops and breaks down everyone's questions step by step and never leaves a student behind. Messed up on the test grading with being online but she's understanding and a great professor overall. Also used Excel which is definitely easier than the calculator/hand method of working out the problems IMO.

Dr. Mckenry does her best to make sure students understand the material and learns from the class. She is patient and a great explainer when it comes to class materials. I took her MAS 201 and I truly enjoyed it. But MAS 202 was a lot more difficult. (maybe it's because it's online) I find myself being lost a lot of times and struggled a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Not sure how she was before zoom. Not much to say other than this: I have never received lower than an A in math since the day my momma gave birth to me. Tests and quizzes are intentionally more difficult than practice problems. DON'T miss a class. I also never took the time to rate a professor... I'm tryna save you guys...

Dr. McKenry is truly a gem. I had her for MAS 110 in the spring and MAS 201 for Summer A. She wants to make sure that each student does well and will go over the material, explaining each confusing part. She is the best professor from the entire MAS department. Take her, she is amazing!

Dr. Mary cares about her students. She would give class activities (and sometimes quizzes) that we could do in small groups so it allowed us to practice the material before we had a test on it. She really wanted us to learn. Her lectures were good--not too much theory but more applications.

While class attendance is not required, Dr. McKenry makes it worthwhile to go to class. Her handouts have all the material that is required to succeed. She has class activities that if you do them, they help your grade and you do well on the test. Great class for a business calculus class.

Dr. McKenry is a great person who is very nice and funny. Unfortunately, she puts nothing other than the syllabus on Blackboard and she is very very difficult to reach outside class, making your grade really a mystery until the end of the semester. That's especially stressful when you are graded only on the final, 3 exams and some small quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Amazing professor, probably one of the best in the Management Science department. Extremely straightforward and understanding of her students. She is willing to provide extra support if you need it. If you have the opportunity, highly recommend taking her. Great professor and even greater person.

She covers the material well and will gladly answer any questions or go over certain topics multiple times until you understand. Attendance doesn't matter as long as you're there for the quizzes (she drops lowest score, so you could miss 1 without penalty). The exams were super easy and you're allowed a cheat sheet for them and quizzes too.
Really good professor! The Excel and Tableau skills I learned in her class translated extremely well at my internship. Reasonable expectations, easily accessible, just a good all around person

Great class. Every class there is a lecture and then a "hands on" experience. This course is a real skill builder with application to work (no theory). She sometimes speeds up, but if you ask her a question, she will make sure you understand it. I wish all my professors were like her. Take Dr. McKenry for MAS 639!

She covers the material in the simplest way possible and if you don't understand something she will go over it again until you understand. We used the textbook for homework but for my class she would upload the homework pages onto blackboard so it wasn't entirely necessary to have the textbook. Best of all she tells you when the quiz is beforehand.

Very intelligent woman. You must attend class if you want to pass, that is because you won't understand anything if you don't go and won't know what to expect on exams. Assessments are very thorough so you need to know your stuff. I personally didn't like this class because McKenry doesnt take BS and can see right though your excuses. She's smart
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is super sweet and makes the course really easy. I still don't understand how some people in my class didn't pass. If you show up and pay a little bit of attention (you don't even have to do the HW) then you will be fine on quizes and tests. She lets you have a full sheet of paper front and back as a cheat sheet on ALL quizzes AND tests.

Taking McKenry's class was literally the best choice I ever made in choosing professors. She gives great notes packets and the content of the class is relatively easy. If you go to class and listen sometimes (not even all the time) you'll get an A. She lets you bring a full page of notes (front and back) to every quiz/test. Taking her again!
Real OG. Wants you to succeed. I've taken excel and 303 with her. Lays out the expectations. If you put in work an A is achievable, not an easy A; meet the expectations and do the EC
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests? Not many--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dr. McKenry is the best, took her for 4 courses at UM. She is not the most exciting lecturer but she covers what she needs to, tests on it fairly and if you put in a little work, you will do well
Everything is reviewed in the class. Attend classes and pay attention, and you will pass easily. If you have any questions or need her to repeat, she will gladly do it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Tests are pretty straightforward. The only bad thing about the class was that we had a group project and she didn't give clear guidelines.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: I have no idea what the previous reviewers are talking about. All you need to do is go to class and pay attention, NOTHING ELSE and you can get A+ in all the tests. Also, the group project is your final, which is pretty easy (again if you pay attention). 100% would take her again!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Still not sure how my final grade was weighted, but I can't complain. Her lectures seemed well thought out and put-together. She definitely cared about us learning the material. She's a solid choice for the class.
Took her for BUS150 as well. Favorite teacher here. Her lectures are so easy to understand and she hands out outlines. All quizzes and tests are fair and easy to study for but I still learn.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Nice because class doesn't last very long however her tests are very challenging and nobody finishes however she doesn't care, very specific and she doesn't really teach she just shows you once and expects you to know how to do it
Tries to make it interesting, but once a week class is hard the last 15 minutes.  She really cares that we learn the material.  Gives good examples in class and handouts.
Professor McHenry is wonderful.  She is patient, and clear with her requirements and will stop what she is doing at anytime to help you.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Easy class, she gives you handouts so you know what kinds of examples to expect on tests and quizzes. She explains clearly and lets you out early after finishing tests. Study her outlines and you'll do fine on tests. Would definitely take again!

The book is confusing but she makes outlines which are easy to understand and help you study for tests and quizzes. You can use a cheat sheet, and if you study her outlines you'll do well on her tests and quizzes. I had never taken stats and she made it easy to learn. Only need textbook for homework which is not really mandatory but really helps.
Tough but required class. McKenry over Barber. Tests are tough, study and attend class and youll get a B+ / A.

BUS 150, the excel class, sucks. This should be an online course considering I never went to class and everything I've learned came from youtube videos. She's a good teacher, but again, if you lose track of what she's saying you will be lost for the remainder of the class. The exams don't actually measure your knowledge of excel & are hard.

Her class is ok and I do think I learnt a lot. The problem is that her exams do not necessarily correspond to what she teaches in class. Some questions are silly and unexpected. Take another professor if you can.

Dr. McKenry is a good teacher. She is clear in her explanations of problems but oftentimes shows more simple problems than what you will see on the test, which is usually quite hard. There are 3 tests and a cumulative final (30%). She is a really obnoxious grader, taking off more points for small errors, like ECT (Error carried through).
Great professor!  Knows her stuff AND can explain it.  Do the homework and go to class and  you can do well.
Great professor.  Made statistics really interesting.  If you do the homework and attend class, then the quizzes and exams are straight forward.
Great Professor; really liked her class.  She wanted her students to do well.
She is a decent professor. She cares about her students to a certain extent. She normally ends class early, but covers the material in a timely manner.
Great Professor.  She really cares about her students and wants them to succeed.
She's a great teacher! Her test are not easy, but she is always willing to explain the work and cares about her students.
Very pleasant teacher. Willing to go back and repeat something if you ask.
Great professor.  Really concerned about the student.  Will provide additional examples of problems etc. when asked in class to do so.

She does explain everything quickly and sometimes rushes through things only to let the class out early, but if you go to every class and really focus and pay attention, then the material is not hard.  I think she's better/easier than the other business calc teachers.  I learned a lot in her class and got an A.

She gives out note packets which are really clear and useful. When teaching the material, she rushes through, making it hard to understand at first. If you put effort in and study for the tests its easy to get an A. Everything on the test is from previous notes or homework.

Very clear teaching style and the notes she gives for each section are beyond useful.  She understands the material very well and her passion about the subject makes you understand it well as well.  Take her! I am going to try to take a statistics class by her next semester too

After reading these past reviews I thought her class would be easier then it was. She gives you printed out notes that she goes over in class. She goes through examples very quickly so its hard to grasp what she is doing all the time. I dont reccomend taking the once a week class its hard to remember everything and you have a quiz every class.
She is great.  Very helpful and cares about her students.
Excellent professor I've ever had in UM. Take her!!!!!!!!!!!Exams are super easy and I got an A. She is nice and always willing to help.

one of the best teachers. very nice, goes through every question step by step. answers every question and knows what she is talking about. she never throws any curve balls on the test.. she wants you to do well and succeed
Great Prof--really cares about students
Hard class, excellent professor.  take her!
Excellent prof! Exams are predictable and well reviewed for with only a few curveball questions to delineate between the A+ and A- students. Only used the book for HW (haha yead right) and charts.

The material in general is hard but the tests tend to not reflect the things we went over in class. There were often problems that no one in the class recognized... But she is really helpful and understanding and will help you in any way she can. She's probably better than the other stats teachers though.

AWESOME TEACHER!!! she is so laid back and not a hassle to deal with.  for a business calc class, she makes it bearable.  only 4 tests and maybe 8 quizzes which are all relatively easy.  going to class makes the workload easier, but many people skipped all the time except for test days.  a lot of extra credit too! TAKE HER!!!

This lady is amazing. Shes the best overall teacher I have had at UM. She makes a tough subject easy and is a great person in general. She is really into her subject and it shows in her unmatched ability to present it perfectly. I dont have her class anymore but I still go to her when I have questions about my upper level math.  She is that awesome
I love mcKenry. she is a very good professor and I rarely get bored in her classes. She teaches quickly and leave the class early.
she teaches very quick but well. if you do the hw you understand the material more. the test arent hard. she is clear.

Great professor, she gives you printouts of the notes to fill in so you know whats going on. She never throws curve balls on the tests about material you haven't covered. Sometimes she's a little inconsistent with her grading like one test she'll give you credit for writing a problem a certain way while on another test she might mark it wrong.
she's very clear. produce notes for students. i never understood maths more than i do now so that's saying something.
she really couldn't be more helpful she goes through absolutely everything several times.  no studying needed to get a 90 or higher on every test/quiz

I think she's great! I had close to 100 in the class.. if you took any high school Calc, it doesn't even have to be an AP class, you will coast straight through this with an easy A. sHe always lets you out way early and has no problem cancelling class.

She's a good teacher but goes WAY fast over stuff and sometimes lets u out early from class BUT she's soo easy.. NO hw.. doesn't check anytihing.. just have to do well on exams which is CURVED lik crazy.. def. take her for a breeze compared to other teachers.. trust me!!
I disagree with the previous rating.  I found Ms. McKendry to be a very good teacher who is good at explaining the material.  I would recomend this class.

i hated this class so much.  so her tests dont reflect anything that we do in class or the homework, they are much harder. the class is totally boring and most people dont know whats goin on.  i got saved by the curve due to the hurricane, thank god for that....
Take him!!! He is so kind and passionate about what he does. You will get an A if you are a good student and do the work
Honestly he talks a lot and repeats something but it's just because he wants to make sure you know the material before the test comes. Super great professor I totally recommend him!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I LOVE professor Miller. He is easily my favorite professor so far. He is engaging and overall doesn't make you feel like you are taking to a professor. You can tell he cares about his students and wants us to succeed. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!!!!
Really enjoyed taking him. 2 (easy) exams, a few current events, a journal report, and a team presentation. He has a lot of great anecdotes about his time working for the government.

Professor Miller was the BEST! You can tell he loves to teach and had such great energy. There were 2 tests and 1 group project with a presentation for the final which was easy if you studied a little. He also had review sessions in class to cover the exact material for each test. One of my favorite professors BY FAR. Please take him if you can!!!

Take Professor Miller, I am a bit of a bad student, however I really enjoyed this class and his enthusiasm to help and teach. He's actually one of the few professors here passionate about teaching and his class was always the highlight of my day. So nice and considerate
soooo nice great for an intro PR class, loved his lectures, seems like good guy
very chill. attendance is barely mandatory. He does test reviews for tests which prepare students well. only two test and if you study well you'll get an A.
He is the absolute BEST professor EVER! Interactive and fun lectures and always super nice and caring. I would take all my classes with him if possible!

He is the best!! Definitely recommend STC 116 for Communication majors or anyone interested in PR. You will have 3 tests and they are all super easy if you go to the review days and study the material he talks about. There was 1 pop quiz that a lot of people missed so make sure you don't skip class often.
Super nice guy, lecture-based with a couple quizzes and tests with a group project. Super straightforward guy

Such a great professor. He is really kind and cares about his students. He wants them to be prepared for the real world and isn't just reading off a textbook. We had two tests, one pop quiz, and one project as our final. We only had a few homework assignments throughout the semester, and they were all really easy. would 100% recommend!

Professor Miller is the best! His lectures are very engaging with real life examples of PR. We didn't have many assignments — sometimes he would just cancel the quiz because he felt like it! Definitely recommend!

Professor Miller is a great teacher, and his lectures are engaging. However, we only got graded on four things, which made grades a bit stressful. The final project was an evaluation of a crisis and coming up with a plan; it is a big group project, so make sure everyone actually works on it because it is a lot for one person. This class is great!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: So nice and makes class very easy. I had one in class exam and a final project presentation. Takes attendance almost every class.

Most knowledgable professor and very experienced in the public relations field. Super easy and straightforward class with only one test, one paper, and one group project final. I highly recommend taking him!!!!

By far one of my favorite professors I've had. He is super kind and funny and easy going. The exams are easy and he always does a test review and tells us what to expect on the exam. He is very kind and has a strong passion for public relations. We only had 1 exam all semester, a few assignments, and a large group project. Would take again!

Prof Miller is the most underrated teacher at the U. He is so humble about his crazy successful past (he has so much lore). He is super laid back and nice and there is little to not work. He truly cares about his students. The best I highly recommend him.

The only negative I could say is he doesn't like laptops being used for note taking so he can be annoying about that but he doesn't necessarily outlaw it. Super nice and a crazy cool background so overall great.
He is a great professor always asking how you are and heavily respected. Really enjoyed taking this class and would take him again. take this class
Professor Miller is such a great professor. Very engaging and funny, and he's also sexy.

Professor Meltzer is an amazing professor. He cares about his students and cares more about his students learning about Public Relations than about grades. He made me fall in love with PR and switch my major to it. I recommend everyone to take his class.

Professor Miller might be my favorite professor I've ever had. He's funny, extremely intelligent, and I can honestly say I enjoyed his class so much. He is very engaging and makes himself relatable to the students. Be sure to listen in his lectures and get to know him! Such a cool guy.

Professor Miller was a great, engaging teacher. His lectures were always funny with good examples to make everything clear. We barely got homework, had 2 tests and 2 projects but he is not a harsh grader at all. He gives great feedback and is available outside of class too, he really cares about his students. I would definitely take him again!

This is a required class and I have no complaints. For the most part this class is just lectures and note taking, but he is funny personable and engaging. There's only 2 tests, 2 hw assignments, and 1 group project (paper and presentation) for the final, which are our only grades. He is so chill and nothing is busy work. such a lax class, no stress
Mostly lectures. Never used the book and still got an A. I recommend Prof. Miller because he is chill, doesn't give too much work, but you learn a good amount about PR. He's a solid choice!

Best teacher at UM. Makes lecture memorable- tells stories to help you understand concepts. Also gives great thorough reviews. Attendance not mandatory but he doesn't post powerpoints so to get the info, you have to go to class. Tests are straightforward and pretty easy if you went to class
Love him! He's so funny and knowledgeable. Would definitely take his class again.

He's the best. Learned a lot about public relations writing and all the styles/formats. He cares more about your final draft than your first draft, and gives great feedback in between. Just make sure you choose a good 'client' for your semester project, as you'll have to stay in touch with them. Keep up with the assignments and you'll be fine!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: His syllabus makes him seem like a hard-ass but he's more laidback than you would think. His tests are heavily weighted but if you do well on the final project you'll be fine. Be prepared though, the final project is a group project and he makes you rate the other members of your group.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: HE IS THE BEST! Such a great teacher, so nice, always available and very serious. If you work, you do well, if you don't, well that's on you. But Miller will always try to help and really doesn't wanna fail anyone. He also gave us so many opportunities for extra credit. I loved him a lot and am unfortunately on waiting list for another of his class

TAKE PROFESSOR MILLER'S CLASS! He has so many amazing experiences in the PR field and hearing these stories will help you understand the content. He's super nice, and really wants you to do well. Taking notes, listening in class and reading the chapters are essential for doing well on the tests. The class will only be stressful if you don't try.

An easy grader, but not the best professor. Really big on group work, but never gave a printed rubric for final group project after repeated requests for one. Also not the greatest with returning assigned papers. A nice person and interested in the subject, but just lectures from the textbook.
Really nice teacher. He gives a few paper assignments, test and group project, but overall not a hard class.

His  class is one of the only classes I got excited going to. Everything he talks about is interesting and he gives life lessons too. He cares about his subject and is passionate. Great lecture professor.
Can't understand him and talks way too fast. Hard to pay attention but have no choice as a requisite

His lectures can be intimidating, but he is very kind and is accessible every week. He is open to questions always, and if you are ever confused definitely go to his office hours. Although the content can be kind of heavy, he is a very nice grader and also curves. The class can also be attended online, but I recommend showing up.

Miserable lectures. I have never been able to follow anything he teaches about and it is entirely theoretical. Difficult material but 60% of exams are open computer and the exams are curved. Nothing interesting or enjoyable about this class in my opinion but you can get a good grade.

Truly one of the worst professors at this school. While his grading is somewhat lenient, you will not learn anything in his class. His class is purely quantitative and theoretical, so you will have no idea what anything means. Absolute joke of a professor and do not recommend you take him.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: For me, Morfov's ECO 430 unfortunately felt like a waste of time whenever I was in class. He is clearly caring and passionate about the class, but his pace and accent make it difficult to pay attention and keep up. I ended up learning everything on my own, which is fine but shouldn't be the case. I recommend taking him if this is ok with you!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The reviews are true. Stan is great. If you want a decent grade, take him. If you want to learn macroeconomic theory, don't take him. It's all online and open-note so there is no motivation/encouragement to learn. AI is bad for his problems so you do have to train it ahead of time. So, maybe learn.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Nice guy. Nobody goes to class so extra credit for those Who do, Tests are similar to homework and are open note. Quizzes are easy. Writing assignment is Iong, however he gives great feedback from your first draft.

Cracked and elite. He's straight-forward and passionate–which makes a big difference. If you try you will do well. I would take him again.  Literally the most cracked econ professor out there at the U. Be aware of the timeline of the quizes as they can go by quickly but he is very understanding of any mishaps. Like a true economist, he understands.
Nice guy. Great professor.

Nice professor and genuinely cares about his students understanding the material. The class, however, is set up so that you don't need to pay attention in class, so you don't learn much. All quizzes, homeworks, and exams (except final) are online, asynchronous, no lock-down browser. It's a low-effort class but not learning may come back to bite you

Stan the Man. Very simple structure for the class. 2 homework assignments, 5 quizzes (online, open note), 2 exams (online, open note), and a paper on whatever you want economics related. Class def can get boring and drag on and most ppl don't show up since not mandatory and he zooms every class but would 100% recommend him very easy and nice guy

Prof. Stan is pretty great. He's a bit boring and the class feels extremely long. However, exams are very reflective of the HWs. He often repeats smth 3 times, so if you get lost, you might catch on. Graded by only 1 midterm and 1 final. There's a bit of a jump scare with exams, but you are allowed to have all your notes.

when i tell you i this man right here, is the MVP of UM. he is the best economics professor. take this mans class you will not regret it. Stan is the man. Stan if you see this big dawg, you da real MVP

Great professor. I always make sure to take Econ classes with him. He is very clear, attendance is not mandatory and he gives you quizzes after lectures sometimes. Just make sure to look out for those. Good and easy grader, and overall great guy. Make sure to take him.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Really nice guy who cares about his students. Lectures are okay, most students don't show up as attendance isn't mandatory. There are 2 open note exams (1 midterm, final), a 10 page paper, 2 homework assignments, and 5 open note quizzes. He also curves the homework grades pretty intensely.  Overall was decent, however did not learn much.

Amazing Econ professor at UM. Grading criteria is super straight forward and forgiving. Exams are taken on your laptops, open note. 2 exams, 2 HW assignments, an essay, and 5 2 question quizzes. Just doing the quiz is an 80, and each one correct is +10.

I love this man. If you have to take econometrics take him. There are two exams and two homeworks, with 5 quizzes (all open note), quizzes are two questions (take it you get a 80, get one right a 90, etc). He goes over both homeworks the class before an exam and they reflect the exam. Curves heavy and is an all around super nice guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great professor, lectures can be a bit boring but he curves the class a lot when it is hard material
Very understanding and easy grader

Dope professor. Super understanding when things come up, very knowledgeable about the content, wants you to understand the subject matter and wants to give good grades. I specifically look for his name when enrolling in classes. 11/10.

He is very nice and a lenient grader. However, you will not learn anything in this class. He curves everything from the homework to the exams and nobody gets below a B. His accent is hard to understand and he talks very fast. Nobody goes to the lectures and he does not take attendance. If you don't care to learn then take him, otherwise AVOID!

Not sure why his ratings are so low. Great Professor. Very knowledgeable on the material. Makes sure you understand the concepts before moving on. Very generous grader and the exams are almost identical to the homeworks. I highly recommend him, you end up learning some important stuff.
