This dude is awesome. He does not care if you come to class and is pretty lenient with grading as his curves are huge. Really would recommend.

Ok so its macroeconomics so its a pretty boring subject, but he makes it pretty easy. All he does is lectures with power points and about once every other week there is 2 question quiz MC. Very simple. His tests are average as long as you study a little bit and you don't have to show up to class if you don't want. He doesn't care about anything.
Lectures are a little all over the place, and it is pretty hard to follow during COVID. Nice guy, could be much worse, could be more enjoyale.
Really nice guy. Easy grader. If you pay attention in class youll be fine... Would take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: really good professor. He doesn't take attendance. I feel like his accent is okay. I can totally understand it as an international student. He is really patient. totally recommend this professor!

Overall, this class is pretty easy because he gives a pretty big curve. As long as you don't leave your tests blank, the lowest grade you will get is a C. Once a week he gives a one question multiple choice quiz and he'll tell you when it'll be, but you don't have to go to class because he doesn't take attendance and uploads all his slides.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Really easy grader. Don't really need to go to class but he does give these one question pop quizzes once a week that are worth a pretty small portion of your grade.
Great professor if you do the problem set you will get an A. Very easy and Im not good at economics would 100% take him again.
Great econ proffessor doesent usually fail people.

He is patient and accessible outside lectures. He gave the tuitions patiently and will extend his office hours before tests. Attendance is required for taking 10 quiz throughout the semester but quiz is easy.

Out of the about 45 people in my class, about 7 people would attend his lectures. The lectures were pretty boring and his accent was really thick. In the end he curved everyone so the grade I got was not bad but if you want to learn something from the lectures, do not pick this professor.

Probably the worst economics professor I've ever had. Class is absolutely useless, no one ever has any idea what he is saying and his accent is very strong. The exams are based on practice problem and he curves it so much he doesn't give anyone a C. I'd still avoid this class and professor even though you'd get a B. Does not know how to teach
You don't need to show up to class except for the tests. The tests are based off of problem sets that he puts online a week before. They are tough, though. He doesn't give anyone below a B.

No point going to lectures. You won't learn anything anyway and attendance isn't mandatory. Tests are based on practice sets that he gives you the week before. He is also really unclear and makes the material so much harder than it has to be.
No clarity at all. Super long and boring lectures. Doesn't help you when you ask for help after class. Would never take this class again.
Dose not take attendance. REALLY EASY STEM cognate. Online quizzes every Friday (really easy). Definitely recommend. All tests and the final is online.
Literally has not replied to a singular email I've sent the entire semester lol. Kinda cold and boring I'd never take him again

He's a cool professor. This class is very easy, and the grading is clear. There's one topic per week, with an assignment and a quiz. The lectures are posted on Blackboard, but its better to go to class. Only two exams, a midterm and a final, and they're not cumulative. Very hard to reach outside of class.

Dr. Musto is a great professor. Lectures are interesting and he is very knowledgeable. He literally gives you the questions that are gonna be on the quiz/exams and how to answer them. He often cancels class because his main job is working in the wellness center

Musto is a good professor who really knows the material. Online quizzes, pretty straightforward assignments, helpful lectures. His downsides would be that class sometimes gets cancelled abruptly, and he is not very lenient with late work. Overall, pretty good.

Dr. Musto is very knowledgeable. He is the head of the Wellness Center on campus on top of teaching, which meant he had to cancel a few classes. Class structure is very clear: lectures M/W, online quiz Friday on the two lectures from the week. There is also 1 short assignment every week, a midterm, and a final. The exams are pretty short, easy A.
Quizzes are really weird and he barely ever shows up for class. It's like doing online modules.

Class was supposed to in person, almost always cancelled for a video. Impossible to reach outside class, so essentially always because class is always cancelled. Online quizzes are challenging for no good reason. Content is redundant and dumb.

He is a fair teacher who lectures Mon. & Wed. with weekly quizzes on Fri. based on those lectures. Nothing too difficult that can't be done with some effort. Only thing is he isn't the kindest nor approachable. Matter fact he's a little arrogant but if you gotta take this class its fairly easy and you can get past his personality and do your best.

Tony is a great professor. Works at the Wellness Center. His quizzes are a little difficult. The midterm is easy if you did the study guides and listened/went to the review session. The weekly homework assignments are also a good way to earn points.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Absolute legend to take. Very knowledgable about the course content and teaches it well. Also makes the class fun and easy to follow with articles and humor. We'd have class Mondays, Wednesdays but not Fridays and would have an online quiz (10-12 questions) based on the weekly material. Clear on what to know for tests! Take this legend of a prof!!

Tony really knows his stuff. Took this class MWF, so we'd have class on Mondays and Wednesdays where he lectured  then online quizzes on Fridays based on that week's material. Definitely take notes because some answers are not on the powerpoint. He tells you exactly what you need to know for midterm and final. Really an easy A if you go to class.

His class is basically just a lectures for two days a week and then a quiz. Not as easy as a class I thought it would be. Pay attention during the class, looking at powerpoints online isn't enough to do well on quizzes/tests because sometimes its hard to know what answer he's looking for on the quizzes and exams. No textbook.

Good professor, he does his best to make the class interesting and to make it easy for you to understand. Even though I am not a biology major, I like his class. The questions to his tests and quizzes are a little difficult to understand (Hard to know what answer he is looking for).
Prof Musto is chill and very knowledgeable. All of his tests are doable, but do not take them for granted. I learned a lot in this class.

Tony is awesome, just all the professors in the ex. phys. majors. He's easy going and down to Earth. Class is EXTREMELY easy, especially if you already know about diseases associated with not exercising. I barely went to class, just studied for the exams and passed easily (He even gives you study guides). Final was online. EASY!

You can literally not come to any classes, study for 2 hours before the test, take the exams, and get an A. Notes are on blackboard. Only thing is that he announces the test dates in class so you have to make sure you know someone that goes to class regularly for the alert. Midterms are m/c and the final is online essay form.

Great guy! Very interesting class and he makes it fun.  You can talk with him about whatever you want after class.  He is very approachable and laid back. He has a great sense of humor too! Take this class if you are at all interested in health/fitness. Easy class, great professor!
tony is an awesome teacher. he's  super laid back and he definitely stirs interest in learning. He heavily applies this class to every day life. definitely recommend

Sophia is super nice, actually! I see how she can be kinda scary at first, but she's very kind and always willing to help. You have to work in the same group all semester, and it's a lot of research work, but it's not that hard. She gives good feedback and genuinely wants everyone to learn and do well.
She's nice, and knowledgable for sure. But extremely OD and super tough grader- unless you go to her after class and get help on all assignments don't even bother expecting an A. She's very specific.

Not the worst professor I've had, but definitely not the best either. She does give clear directions on assignments, but she is a tough grader, and the papers, weekly quizzes, and weekly group projects especially are lots of work. She doesn't seem like she enjoys teaching compared to other professors, I haven't learned much this semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: She really knows what she is talking about. The class has 4 exams, the first three open note, open book but the final is closed book and cumulative, so prepare to memorize all the terms you learned throughout the semester. Her slides are quite messy as they are not organized at all. You also have group projects but they are really easy.
Great personality and teaching style. She cares about the topic and does a good job teaching it.

She is a great professor, very knowledgeable, the lectures get a little boring. The slides have little information, so looking at the textbook is more helpful. 6 random attendance popups. 3 tests, online open note. Final in-person closed note. 3 group creative assignments. Barely extra credit opportunities. Overall, very nice and pretty easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: So nice and supportive, very sweet lady. I learned a lot about African culture. Lotta homework, but a good class to take. My real knock is that she is pretty disorganized, like I didn't know my grade until the end of the class. But I would still recommend her for sure.
Enjoy all the readings that the professor selected. Fantastic discussions but sometimes awkward with small class sizes. Heavy back end of classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: knowledgeable, kind, and helpful!

Professor Munro was one of the best professors I've had at UM. The workload includes daily assignments and take-home essays, but it's manageable if you stay organized. She gives detailed feedback that genuinely improved my writing, and the course covered thoughtful, engaging topics.

Professor Munro is amazing. I took ENG210 "Refugee Stories" with her, and this class truly changed my life. She is so well versed with the world around us with an impeccable global perspective. She picks INTERESTING and relevant literature (I do not enjoy reading but finished every book she assigned). I only have good things to say about Munro.

Most personally significant professor my freshman year. Great teacher, knowledgeable in every way. Kind and understanding, will be flexible with you as long as you put in the work. Have to buy books and print paper copies of course materials, but will help if you have issues with that. Beware the backload though, the end of semester push is ROUGH.

Really interesting class, discussions were interesting but tedious. There's a lot of papers to read outside of class for discussion along with a lot of papers you have to write. The professor is really sweet and caring, but she is very disorganized. She sends out assignment details a week before it's due date, etc. The work aspect was frustrating.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: She is knowledgeable in her topic but SHEESH we have like 7 papers, all 3-4 pages long. Final group project is a 7 page paper that each group member has to do individually... She lost one of our paper grades, she is very unorganized. She makes up assignments as she goes and then emails you the assignment details which at times is not clear.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Munro is an amazing professor. She cares deeply about LGBTQ+ issues and has a wide range of knowledge. Class discussion is essential to the course. Be prepared for a lot of reading (but not an unreasonable amount) along with watching shows and docs. Extremely fair grader. Follows the syllabus and lets students know of any changes.

She is a very sweet lady and very knowledgeable in regards to LGBTQ+ issues. She always made sure we would get information on certain LGBTQ+ events that were happening not only in the University but in the world as well (passing laws, etc.) This class did involve a lot of writing and there was a 8-page research paper at the end but it wasn't hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Munro was amazing! She fostered such awesome class discussions and her input and reading selections were incredible. One of the best English professors I have had at UM. But you do need to put in work for the class. Show up with your reading done and valuable things to say about it. It will improve your grade and what you get out of class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I thought this was going to be a really interesting class but the material we covered wasn't interesting and the discussions are really boring. And the way she grades is ridiculous.
One of the best professors I've had at UM, her lectures are amazing and very interesting. She gives a lot of reading and assignments, but they were fun to do and she grades fairly.
Great professor. She is nice, funny, and engaging. A LOT of reading is required with a bunch of short write-ups and a few papers. Not too much work, but the class discussions are amazing.
Good teacher, good topics and engages you in the class. Only like 3-4 essays but they're easy. Class is an easy A and fun most of the times.

She was an amazing professor and presented articles that contained controversial and "new "view regarding sexuality and gender.  Her class really opened my eyes (even more) to how our world acts. One of the best classes I have taken at UM. She is an awesome teacher.

Professor Munro is one of the best teachers that I had ever had. This course was fresh, vibrant and interesting. The subject material was wide ranging and varied but all of it was enjoyable, especially Love themes for the wilderness, one of my favorite books to read in a long time! There is a lot of writing but mine definitely improved as a result

I had her for South African lit; by far one of the best teachers I've ever had. she knows tons about the subj but still wants to hear student opinions, so great discussion. there's a good # of papers but they're short & broad, and she doesn't grade too hard & gives really good feedback on them. take her if you're actually interested in the subject!
The only students that favor her is the ones that she pick that are her little puppets and work on organizing for her, hmmmm
A brilliant professor is one who engages with students and helps them become a better student, and she does not have these qualities.

Dr. Munro is undoubtedly one of the best professor I've had. For those who complain the course is "useless", you probably have no business taking a WGS course in the first place. Just because YOU haven't developed opinions on relevant subject matter doesn't change the immeasurable value of the course.

Not all the material is too enthralling, but the discussions can get interesting. Acts as more of a guide and lets the class develop on its own.  A really interesting class overall.  (There are required papers, though, which are a drag...but I'm just lazy probably.)
I completely agree with some of the postings. This class was useless. Anyone could do what she was doing. She tries to relate but she can't, simple as that. Yes, very arrogant. It's such a turnoff!

She's an amazing professor, I learned a lot in her class and she always welcomed students to her office hours (though barely anyone ever went). She's not arrogant at all, she's just very knowledgeable on the subject matter and wants to have as much participation as possible.

I had a perfect GPA until I took this class, instead of having a 4.0 I had a 3.9. This class was useless. I thought it would be fun, and it was my last semester, but what a drag She's very bland & I did participate, but I guess it was not to her liking. I really did not have much to say Most of the people in the class was crazy & would not SHUT up!
Dr. Munro is brilliant and her class was the best ever.
I don't underatand these types of teachers that come from another country and think they have it all figured out once they get here. She's very arrogant and relly not helpful at all.
I thought this would be a very interesting class, but I was wrong. Did not like her or her teaching abilities at all.

Super interesting lecturer. 3 exams, and only the best 2 go to your grade. Really approachable and understanding. Very funny personality too! Would definitely take again. I love the way the classes are set up with 2 lectures and then a lab.
Funny prof. Learned a lot but wasn't the fairest about grading (he put some things on the final that he previously said wasn't gonna be on it). He wasn't clear about everything. Overall good prof.

There are only 3 assignments and 2 exams that go into the grade book all semester. If you do the assignments, which he eventually gives the answer key to, and study for the exams that you get cheat sheets on then you will do fine. I had things come up that distracted me personally at the end, which is why I got a B. Otherwise would have gotten an A
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Only three homework assignments all year, which he gives you the answers to. You get a full cheat sheet for every test. If you prepare well, super achievable A. Attendance is mandatory but he only takes it a couple times a semester and its not a large part of your grade. Sometimes attendance is extra credit towards the next test.

His class was pretty standard. Nothing too out of the ordinary. Study and you will do well. He goes off on tangents and is political in his classes. But he's such an oddball that it makes class interesting. Will call you out for talking in class even though it's a massive lecture. You'll have to put in the work, no free grades, but he's not awful.

The way the course is set up, it's very hard to get below A/A-, maybe a B+/B. 
He only grades your top 2 of 3 exams, and the HW is mostly completion. and he gives review sheets, which are pretty similar to the test. Make sure to listen to what he says in class and honestly just take notes on everything said. Really good guy & interesting lectures
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very interesting teacher. You can learn a lot of both econ and everything that's not econ. Very approachable if you have any questions/etc. Overall would take him again, just make sure to study decently and lock in. Practice exams are very similar to the actual exams, themselves.

Professor Mullen is a nice person, but he often went off topic and discussed politics. I learned very little from the course. He made an error grading exams but didn't mention it, which confused some students. Exams are easy, though some questions are unclear. He's enthusiastic but should be more focused—be prepared to teach yourself.

While Brooks is one of the most engaging lecturers I've had, there were issues. First, grading is a mess; he graded the midterm wrong (fortunately, someone caught it), almost tanking people's grades. While I think his rants trashing the right are hilarious and agreeable, it's excessive, and lectures are mostly off topic. Insanely easy to get an A.
Professor Mullen is quite an opinionated guy, but his rants about random political nonsense make the lecture funny. I didn't go to class often, but every time I did, there was a good laugh.

Prof. Mullens is a great professor, who gives fast-paced engaging lectures. He has a wealth of knowledge (not solely micro related) and you will always come out of his classes learning a new fact. Grades come from easy problem sets with flexible deadlines, and 3 tests (with lowest dropped). Awesome, funny prof who is VERY worth taking.

When you are in class he says a whole lot of nothing. He just goes on tangents and is very hard to follow. This is an issue for tests because you feel like you have never stepped foot into an economics class and you have to teach it all to yourself. He is not a straightforward grader and will never answer emails. Do not take.

Very honest and fair guy. He sometimes goes on some tangents during lectures, but is overall is very straightforward of what to expect on the exams. He had 3 exams, and best 2 are graded. Interesting to hear what he has to say about things, even if you don't agree 100% of the time.
TAKE THIS CLASS

He is very opinionated and can go on tangents, but he genuinely cares about his students and if you go to his office hours, he is ready and willing to help you succeed. The class is also set up to be very straightforward. He gives you everything you need to do well as long as you put in a little bit of effort. 100% recommend him
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Mullen is pretty crazy and quite opinionated, but gives you every needed resource to succeed.

Class is graded on 3 tests and 3 problem sets. Honestly I didn't pay attention at all so I can't judge much, but he is good at lecturing. Dude also lied like 8 times about when our grades were going to be put in, and his test questions are worded so poorly. he drops one test grade though.

Goated! He was very genuine, always cared about making sure we knew what we were learning had true points and value behind it. Only the best 2 of the 3 exams (Exam 1, Exam 2, & Final) go into your exam.

Professor Mullen was phenomenal. He really cares for his students and explains the material so well. He is really funny too. I enjoyed his class so much. 3 exams, 3 homework grades, and he drops your lowest exam grade. Take this class with him even if you aren't an economics major, it is fantastic, thorough, and so much fun!!

Lectures were super entertaining but sometimes he went off on tangents that weren't really relevant. Grade is based off of 3 problem sets (one before each exam) and then three exams. Problem sets were basically the same as the exams. First two exams had a take home portion that was basically just all the math.

3 tests1of those counts as the final. the practice sets he gives before the test replicate the problems on the test. the breakout room attendance is mandatory and recorded. he goes on tangents for a long time but usually circles back to the main concept and elaborates with real world examples. HE NEVER PUTS IN THE GRADES it takes him two months.
Great Teacher highly recommend. Keeps class lectures really fun and engaging bringing in real world examples.

Very good personality. Rare to have professors here that you can genuinely bond with and have a legitimate personality. Tests are alright as long as you study from the given content and listen to his examples in class. As much as he may go off topic in class, listening to his examples are quite helpful.

Professor Mullen knows how to entertain a lecture class. His unconventional style of teaching may come as a surprise to some people, but if you pay attention he gives the best analogies and examples that make you understand the material. Test are relatively straight forward and open note and gives a lot of prep and review before the test.

Really good guy. He was getting his PhD this semester so he had a lot going on. The TAs definitely came in clutch when I came to helping out in the breakout rooms and outside help. Although he has his tangents, overall good guy, and always willing to stay after to discuss anything. Open note, and exams based on all the slides.

Lots of lectures with just straight up note taking, but he's super energetic and funny. Exams are open-note and come straight from the problem sets he gives you beforehand. Might seem like he's doing the most on the first day but his class is pretty easygoing and fun. Just take notes, make good formula sheets and you'll be good.

Stereotypical millennial who gives long lectures of straight up information. You can tell he really knows his stuff, but can make easy topics complicated. He also lashes out on kids in the lecture hall once a week. However he's really helpful and makes sure to explain stuff over and over... fair grader as well and cares about student well being.
wait a sem and take it with burt rosenberg
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class wasn't bad, 90% of the grade comes from assignments and projects, and the other 10% comes from attendance. However, people would skip class/not pay attention, so we started having pop quizzes :) so they became 15% of the grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Murrell should be banned from the ECE department! He doesn't teach. He just throws material at students, expecting them to already know the concepts behind it. IF on the rare occasion that he does give instructions, they are laughably bad. He tends to overcomplicate things to make it harder for students to cheat which just ends of backfiring.

This class was all over the place. Grading is very harsh and the assignments were one of the most difficult and hardest parts of the class. The class is split into 50% assignments and 50% exams. The exams were difficult as well. The professor also is a late replier and late grader. You're always on the fence of failing/passing. I do NOT recommend.

This course was painfully disorganized. Lectures were unclear, key concepts were skipped, and questions were met with impatience. Grading was excessively harsh and inconsistent, with vague feedback and no clear rubrics. Office hours offered little help. It felt designed to frustrate, not teach. Avoid if you value clarity or fairness. Choose wisely.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is 50% assignments and 50% exams. While my assignments were completed on time, most were graded after the semester ended, leaving no opportunity to resubmit them, so I ended up getting a low grade on most. Grading was very harsh. Midterms were reasonable, but the final was significantly harder and very different in style. Be prepared.

Very passionate but not the best lecturer. Course is basically completely self taught through the weekly labs, his exams are basically identical every year/ to practice exams. Grades on labs and exams vary wildly on the TA grading it

He is an amazing person, but not a good teacher. He uses different software for every lab, making it confusing how to use it. I spend about 8-10 hours on each lab each week and struggle to get them completed. I wish this course was not required, since I would drop it in a heartbeat. Even still its not too bad

His classes are kind of boring. The labs are very confusing. The exams were different from the practice exams he gave us to study. The only perk about him is that he cares about the material and explains everything in depth, but it's easy to lose focus considering how boring it is.
Do yourself a favor and do not take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do not underestimate this class. Even if you have coded before, you probably will struggle. The only way to learn from this class is from the labs and ChatGPT. Ask ChatGPT to explain concepts and the code he does in class. On the tests, there's only 3 questions. Focus and only do 2 Q's, save 1 question for the final. It will save you a lot of time.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The first two classes I had with him were 118 and 218, which were actually decent. However, after he realized that his whole class was using ChatGPT because of how horrible his lectures were, he decided to hand write everything, and make the assignments + exams unnecessarily difficult. Super unorganized, inconvenient office hours. Be careful.

Murrell can have boring lectures at times and you should come prepared with the basics of coding. However he is always willing to answer questions and you WILL learn. The labs are interesting and not too difficult and the tests are challenging but never unfair. Half the class dropped but I believe its more due to lazy students than anything else.

I have taken 3 classes with him. I enjoyed the first 2.  After chat gpt, though, he began making assignments and tests more confusing so that using AI would be difficult. This made his assignments and tests very long and confusing. By the end, he was so paranoid about AI cheating he hand wrote our tests and they were almost un-decipherable.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I think it's helpful to come to this class with a good foundation of coding already. Make sure to pay attention in lectures and ask TAs for help during labs, as they will be one of the best resources.

He is a very caring teacher if you get to know him, and bends over backwards to meet with students on their availablity. If you dont take advantage of it you will not understand the topics. Test have a great grading structure with the final you only having to do the questions you got wrong on the previous tests nothing more.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is a very kind professor, but lectures are disorganized and hard to follow, and can be boring. He records all lectures which is very useful. This is a hard class in general, so I think he does a good job despite the overall class not being great. Weekly labs which are hard but important to learn from. Hard work but not too much.

Brilliant in his area of expertise but definitely not a great professor. Classes don't really have any structure or follow any topical course outline. Lectures are also painfully boring. Assignments are somewhat difficult but he provides good feedback on them.
He is like a father to me. I love his hair
He helped me find myself

Murrell is a genius. His tests are fair and the class is generally challenging. His lectures get confusing at times but he is always available in his office if you ever have a doubt. He also has a unique sense of humor and his website is hilarious

Having just graduated ('16-20) I had him for 118 218 318 322 421. If you can listen to messy lectures in class youll learn. I cant & prefer reading a txtbk to followup in classes like this. It still sucks though bcuz he is all over the place w/ his lectures making the txtbk useless. You wont learn but trust me he wont give late grades its an easy A

Amazingly brilliant professor! If you are a SWE major, take 1/2/318s with Murrell and you will be well prepared! SM is very caring and genuinely wants his students to do well. Super approachable and unique sense of humor! Strongly recommend!

Lectures are all over the place ranging from quite helpful to a complete waste of time. He managed time incredibly poorly throughout the semester and tried in vain to make up for it in the end by assigning too much. Really likes the drawing library from 118, but it remains an incredibly poor and finicky tool not well suited for learning algorithms.

Probably the best professor in UM Engineering, cares deeply about what he teaches and very lenient on late work. I took him for my entire programming sequence and I can't recommend any other professor. His sections are a little tougher than other professors, but if you want to learn there is no better professor.

Dr. Murrell is a true God in programming. You could tell that he just loves what he does. If you are a Software Engineering major, make sure to register for his Intro to C++ because he will give you a great foundation of knowledge for the upper level courses. The tests are difficult - review all previous semester sample tests on Rabbit.

Don't take the intro to programming class if you don't already understand coding. Without background knowledge you'll be lost in his class. He moves very fast and the labs are on very different topics than what is covered in class. That being said, he seems like a nice guy.
He is very good professor and he teaches programming at a great pace. He is also a hot tamali.

He cares about his students and he is always open to help you. lectures and labs are largely unrelated though  When you are taking ECE118 - try to take a lab section on wednesday or thursday - you will most likely thank yourself later. Labs take up A LOT OF TIME - make sure to communicate with lab guys EARLY and stay up on top of your work.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Teaches the class using BCPL, a dinosaur of a language. He deviated from the syllabus and assigned a midterm out of nowhere, when originally we were only going to be graded on coding projects. At the end of the class I will have learned a programming language that does not exist anymore, and concepts that I could have learned on my own. Don't take
Dr. Murrell was the best professor I had at UM.  Strongly recommended.

He does not really goes over that basics. Extremely difficult to keep up with his lectures, not really help full. When he teaches he just talks with no correlation to a main title. You need to have strong basics to well on his class.
Really helpful, but the class is hard and tests are really hard
He is a good person  however is had to follow his lectures. this felt more like an intermediate class than an intro. Recommend having strong basics before taking this class

awesome professor, the best at UM. I took him for een218 , een318, een322, and now een521(the HARDEST of all) the graders are flexible with the deadlines most of the time. When you are in his class try to listen to every word because they are gold, even more if you are CS or Software Engineering.
Excellent teacher.  Will take the time to explain things and always willing to lend a hand.  Very easy going personality.
Hands-down best engineering professor at UM. I have taken him 4 times already, and I owe most of what I've learned about computers to him

This was THE HARDEST class I've ever taken at UM. Murrell is extremely smart, but most classes I simply could not keep up with him. He draws complicated diagrams on the board which are hard to understand later on, and the projects are ridiculous. In fact, NO ONE has ever finished the final project. Still, he is willing to help so ask him for it!
The best class ever, if you are learning at UM, ECE or CSC, you should take this ! One of the best teacher in the world !
For sure take him
Take him! one of the best professors at UM. Had him for EEN 118 and 218, really happy I took his class

Dr. Murrell is one of the two best teachers I've ever had. Seriously, if you can take a class with him, do it. Words cannot communicate how much happier and smarter you will feel after taking any of his C++ classes vs taking it with anyone else.

The man has been programming for I don't know how long, but still keeps his enthusiasm about the subject and teaching. Dr. Murrell is the rare instance where the professor is incredibly knowledgeable and also has the gift of instructing others in an efficient manner. Great human being.

Great teacher. Funny, and he is genuinely out there to help you. Programming is a naturally boring class but he makes it relatively painless. Labs are actually helpful, problem is if you have a hard week with a lot of tests your going to get behind on them and it will hurt your grade.
Dr. Murrell is the best teacher I've ever known and one of the smartest people I've ever met. Highly recommend you to learn as much as you can from him.

I had him for various programming classes and senior project. He is really smart, he really helped my team get through the senior project whenever we got stuck, rather than just provide general advice. I highly recommend him for Senior Project, he will not abandon you and he'll stay up the entire night before the final presentation helping you.
the way his finals works makes it easy to pass the class.

Not a bad professors very nice and helpful but class to me was extremely hard. I had taken programming classes before and things he taught didn?t make any sense. He has his own programming language that was supposed to make it easy but to me made it harder. Also labs had nothing to do with things taught in class.If you are computer engineering you

Great professor! Explains things very well and does not mind answering questions. However the labs are not explained well in class. I found myself to understand class notes and not understand the labs.
How many teachers use beer as a learning aid?!

Dr. Murrell is a great teacher. He approaches programming in a completely different way. As a beginner you will build a strong base, and if you are already strong in C++,like me, he will still make keep you interested with his fun lectures and questions. His test are fun and easy, and we don't use the textbook. Recommended for all who want to learn

He is one of the best programming professors at UM. he will challenge you with his weekly labs. the labs are kind of hard for beginners, but you will learn how to program at the end. I will recommend him to any one who wants to learn programming, but you will not get an easy A in this class, but you have to earn it.
excellent methods, challenges you to think. i HATED programming before him but he managed to interest me. funny guy as well if you catch his subtlties

He is the reason why I enjoyed college. He really cares about students and loves teaching. Also one of the smartest people I have ever met. Sometimes he doesn't stick to curriculum but what he teaches is extremely valuable. Going to one of his upper level classes is like listening to a story. He keeps your attention and still makes sure you learn.
The best programming teacher at UM.  If you really want to learn your stuff, start with him from the beginning, even if it takes having to delay starting programming classes for a semester.
Dr. Murrell is awesome
doesnt teach just shows you various programs & expects you to understand and be a whiz at it.  doesnt explain things well to beginners.

Best programming teacher ever. Learned a lot and got a job at Microsoft becuase of what I learned from him. Definately not the easiest teacher, but he will chalenge you to develop your skills and is always willing to help out.

if you want an easy, simple route to learning c++ programming, take helmers. If you want to learn a bit harder, yet much more interesting stuff, take murrell. Murrell is a genius, but if you dont get on his wavelength, you can really struggle. If you get it though, you learn a LOT and some really cool stuff

I found him great. He's the reason I got a Ph.D. and got into teaching myself. Very knowledgable, challenges you to think. Will not just provide answers, expects you to be creative but is not unreasonable. Project-oriented assignments, a lot of work but I learned and built confidence. If you're self-motivated you can get a lot out of his style.
Because of him, Kabuka and Helmers, I transferred to Computer Engineering.
No Comments
cool guy, kinda wierd
In the 1st class, i think he's like mr. bean ! But after class you gonna feel like wow ! he's so cool !!
da bomb
Dr. Murrell is the man, though he smells like cofee.
No Comments

The best professor I've had for math. He gives you practice exams and quizzes that are very similar to the actual exam, with no surprises on tests. He genuinely wants you to learn. I've always struggled in math, and he presents it in a way that is easy to digest. Definitely an easy A if you go to class and pay attention. 1000% take him!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Love him! Extremely fair and prepares you very well for exams and quizzes. Able to submit homework early for feedback & resubmit. Always willing to help with questions, especially with the final group project. Such a great professor 100% take him it's an easy A if you put in basic effort. No final exam, but final group project that's not bad at all

Fantastic. Super nice guy and his practice problems really prepare you well. I was usually a little late and he would wait for me since my name was at the beginning of the role call. He also waived a final to do a project instead. One of the best teachers I've ever had.

He's a pretty chill professor. He drops a quiz and they are just like the practice problems. The homework is nothing like what we do in class but go to his office hours or the ta will give feedback before it's due so u can resubmit it. He has a final presentation instead of test which is nice but it seems he grades it harder but gives extra credit.

Probably my favorite professor yet at UM. Best in the math department easily. He's very good at teaching and you're actually able to learn and understand the material with him. Can't say enough good things about him. Just take him.

10/10 professor. Very helpful in the way that he taught, wants students to understand, not just memorize equations. Quizzes are easy if you go to class, tests are just like quizzes. 1 final project and report, easy class just go and understand.

I loved professor Lim. He gives study guides before the quizzes and midterms that are almost identical to the real quiz or midterm. No final just a final presentation that was easy and fun, no stress in this class. He is actually the best math prof at UM, take him if you have the opportunity!!
Best math professor I've had at UM by a long shot. Take him!
Nice Guy, explains concepts extremely well, quizzes and exams look exactly like his review problems.
One of the best professors for stats. He explains it all really well. Super nice guy. Two midterms, many quizzes and a group project.
Very good.

Professor Myers is really strict about you doing the work, he is reasonably good at explaining things in different ways, and he is very patient. The material is difficult, and it is only applicable if you happen to be going into a research position. Although the work is hard, he is availible and wiling to meet with students to explain things.

This is a painful class to be in. You are inadequately prepared to use the material outside of class and the lectures spend too much time on material there is no foundation for and not nearly enough time on what you are required to know. His lecture style is somewhat condescending and he doesn't notice how frustrated everyone is. Take anything else

doesn't post grades onto blackboard, lectures are not engaging, does not provide feedback on exams, says attendance is not mandatory but grades you more harshly on exams if you miss class, reviews for exams are helpful, does not give out B+'s (it's either A, B, or C)

not engaging, lectures are boring, attendance is not mandatory and not factored into your grade but he will purposefully give you lower grades on exams if you don't go to class despite answering the exam questions correctly. doesn't answer emails and doesn't give feedback on how you can improve your exam scores

Dr. Murphy is very sweet, although he does tend to ramble. He will not respond to or acknowledge any emails you send him. Not a tough grader after the first exam, and you are allowed a one-page cheat sheet. He does give you the answers to every exam as well, because he wants you to answer his questions in a very specific way.

I had him last sem for SOC 401. U don't need to goto all of the lectures. U should def goto the review ones as he tells u what is on his exams. They r essays. You get 2-3 Qs. He tells u the Qs in his review sessions and what to write. He is super clear. Connect ur points, pay attention, and take good notes. U get to hv 1 pg of notes for t exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very interesting class, learned a lot. Make sure you're paying attention in class or you'll get lost
Professor Murphy was one of the most incredible professors I have ever had! As long as you take notes and pay attention in class, you will pass with an A. 10/10 recommend.

Attendance is not necessarily mandatory as he does not do usual attendance, but if you choose to skip class constantly, you are not going to understand the material fully as our notes are just whatever he writes on the board. With that being said, make a friend or 2 in the class just in case you miss class once. Your grade is based on 3 essay tests
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The best professor of sociology at UM! He's not a pseudo-intellectual who tries to couch every social problem inside some casual logic. In the end, he doesn't tell you how to think but allows for the space to think freely. Take him if you can and are the type that enjoys critical thinking.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I also took Dr. Murphy for SOC301 and this class seemed easier because it was a bit more structured and what he wanted to see on the test was very clear. The grading is only based on three exams so make sure you attend and take notes. Attendance isn't mandatory but he takes notice of if you're there or not.

He's the best professor and a mind changer. he gives student a whole new prosepctive to view things and understand the world differently in a great eye-opening way. I learned a lot and most of the student in my class would just love listen to him. He has tons of knowledge and lots of things to learn from. Great guy! Very Intelligent but not easy ;)

Dr. Murphy is a master educator. He's very well read, intelligent, and has a genuine passion for what he does. Tests are entirely lecture-based, so you need to attend class and take good notes. He's a very fair grader, and an all around wonderful guy. One of the best professors I've ever had!
all his notes come from the board so you have to go to class to make sure u get the notes. He is very nice and smart and knows alot about the subject. Interesting class and overall great teacher

He's a nice professor and passionate about what he teaches. You have to copy everything he writes on the board. No need to even buy the textbook, I didn't use it once. Tests come directly from notes. Easy grader as long as you mention key points. He tells you everything thats on the test a couple of classes before.

he's a little out there...picture jerry garcia circa 1985, but he's totally passionate about what he does and he gives great insight.  his grading on tests is inconsistent but other than that he's a good teacher.

Very easy class. Come to class because tests come directly from lectures.  Passionate about sociology and social reform, often goes off topic and gets into discussions witht the class.  Gives good test review.  His final is just a third test.

I have Murphy right now and am a junior he gave me an override to get into his class.  He's awesome, you need to go to class because thats all his tests are on..lecture.  He is very intelligent and funny and makes social theory interesting.  Take him!

Dr Murphy is passionate about Sociology and enjoys explaining the different theories. The material can be a little confusing but he enjoys explaining it. He is always willing to help. I really enjoyed his class.

The class was fully lecture based. I got 100% on every exam, and I don't think I was the only one. He explains things very well, just be ready to take a lot of notes. Exams are essays, pretty much asking you to regurgitate what you heard in the lecture.
Took him twice, learned a lot, got high A's both times, probably the best professor I've ever had

The class topic was way over my head, but Dr. Murphy brought it down to my level. He doens't expect any big grand conclusions on his essay tests, just wants you to tell him exactly what the lecture was about- no hidden info.  No need to buy the book because his lectures explain the information much better. If doing bad just show him you are trying.

Awesome teacher.  Probably one of the most intelligent teachers I have ever had.  He wants everyone to learn and do well, keeps class interesting and really prepares you for the essay tests.  Go to class and study and you will get an A.

Dr. Murphy is a great professor. I learned more in his class than in any other class this semester. He wants his students to succeed, and succeed you will if and only if you go to class. Material is purely from the lecture.

Dr. Murphy is an incredibly knowledgeable man with many years experience.  He has written many books analyzing the drug subculture, which he talks about frequently in class.  Tests are moderate essay-type, notes are very clear, and he tells you exactly what will be on the test.  Personally, I wouldn't have rather had sociology from anyone else.

He is a tough grading Marxist/socialist who publishes a lot of articles and has a national reputation. He gives essay tests, and it's nearly impossible to blow any BS by him, but the students like him, and you will learn a lot. Take good notes or die.

interesting course with a lot to cover. to that end it can be a little disorganized; discussion can be all over the place. more keyboard demonstrations would've helped. some final assignments very vague. but overall a very passionate+knowledgeable prof and i learned a lot from her.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Takao is an incredible professor! I'm so inspired by her as a professor and pianist. She just knows so much! I seriously wish I could live in her head, it's so amazing.
Dr. Takao is an energetic and fun-loving, good-spirited, knowledgeable, and competent teacher. It is enjoyable to be in her company. Friends with all the students.

Love him! He is super understanding if you turn something in a little late and he gives you 2 free passes to get a weekend extension or an absence excused. There is 4 papers, but they are pretty spaced out and there is no other homework. Your final grade is based off of revisions for the papers, there is no "final" per say.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Although there is 4 papers, there is no work outside of class. No homework or annotations or anything like that.  While this class was pretty easy, it definitely made me a better writer. He pushed me out of my comfort zone. He also let us write the papers on anything we wanted, so that was sooo fun. He is always there if you need help!

While I appreciate constructive feedback, I've found that the emphasis seems to be more on technicalities and less on fostering creativity. The current approach feels more rigid and focused on conforming to a specific set of expectations. I would appreciate more flexibility and encouragement to experiment with different writing approaches.

He is a great English teacher that cares about his students. When it comes to giving feedback on papers, he is detailed and helpful when it comes to brainstorming and writing. He gives weekly "pop" quizzes that are based on the homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Even though he has reading quizzes once a week, he is a strong English teacher. When it comes to giving feedback on papers he is detailed and is helpful when it comes to brainstorming and writing.

This is a writing based class so obviously it is not that interesting, but professor deyo made it easy and as interesting as possible. He made the assignments straight forward and the class got to create the rubric he would grade off of so that was nice. He usually let us out early too! I would 100% take this prof's class again!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Deyo is a good professor, I had him first semester and it was a easy 100. Grading criteria is straightforward and easy as long as you do the work. He gives you extensions if needed and the grading is all or nothing, but he lets you resubmit for full credit. There is also a good amount of reading with a simple follow up assignment but it takes time.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: The class was not hard. Everything is for credit, so you just have to do the work to get a good grade in the class. He was also super nice and understanding, and willingly gives extensions on big projects. None of the assignments were too hard, and he clearly outlines what you need to do to earn points. Definitely would take him again.

He's nice and all, but the work load is pretty intense, especially if you're like me and taking 20 credits. There is a lot of reading, and mostly all of the assignments are based on the reading. ALSO: One thing I wish I knew before enrolling is there is so much peer review. If you don't like doing that, do not enroll.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: Way to hard for an Engineering Majors. I didn't sign up for an Engineering degree for most of my homework to be uninteresting essays with crazy word count minimums to take up most of my workload. Hard grader, everything is "credit" which is 75%.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: People who say this class has a lot of work must've not been trying because the only real assignments in this class are the papers. There is reading that is "required" but he never checks if you've actually done it. Papers can take a few hours but he doesn't have strict criteria. Honestly enjoyed a couple of the projects. Take him if you want an A.

Deyo is a nice professor and you can tell he cares about what he's teaching. Reading the textbook wasn't really necessary. About 4 essays for the semester and alot of drafts and peer review. Everything was completion credit until the end where you picked the best work for a grade. Not difficult at all, do your work on time and you will get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Deyo requires you to put the effort to improve your writing. He is a hard grader but grades more on the quality of your writing than quantity. Be prepared to go back and use their feedback given to improve your paper quite a few times.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Deyo can be a hard grader if he doesnt like your writing style, but if you dont miss classes and turn in all your work you assure yourself a B in this class. There is a lot of unnecessary and boring readings for this class, that he later on discusses during class and it gets pretty boring. If you take him try to participate in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Deyo implemented a unique grading system that allowed for revision before final grades for essays were given. His comments were helpful and he was always willing to meet with students one-on-one to guide their revision or create drafts for upcoming projects. Peer review, textbook readings, and journaling were required.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Deyo deserves a higher rating! English is my least favorite subject, but I enjoyed his class and really learned from it. His class is straightforward, including 4 major essays and a final portfolio. As long as you attend class and turn in the assignments then you are guaranteed a B, and the final portfolio determines grades higher than B.

I'm surprised Professor Deyo isn't rated higher. He is a very fair professor and lays out exactly what you need to do to get the grade you want at the beginning of the semester. He gives constructive feedback on essays and is always willing to meet with you. The class itself is pretty boring but that isn't his fault, just the content.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Deyo is a great guy. He cares about what he's teaching. There will be a lot of reading that you probably won't be interested in but his feedback on your essays is pretty detailed. Personally wasn't my cup of tea but people seemed to like him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: He's a pretty good professor and very understanding. He makes sure you get the grade you want regarding essay corrections. He assigns a LOT of unnecessary readings though, and discussing them can get boring. Overall the class is fine and as long as you do the work and get all the requirements in you will get the grade you want.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Pretty average english class but he was really nice and an easy grader. Had a good amount of homework but I think all english classes do. He always emails back within like an hour and he is really easy to meet with outside of class.
Loved this class, pretty standard requirements for assignments and not difficult at all. The class is chill and as long as you do your homework you'll be fine.

Professor Deyo's class is not difficult grading wise, but there is a lot of papers and assignments. Lots of reading as well in this class. He expects participation in every class and attendance is mandatory.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: These reviews are tripping lol, I took Deyo for ENG106 and it was super easy and interesting even though I'm certainly not someone that was looking forward to taking an English class. We literally watched movies during some classes, and he lets you rewrite some papers for half the points back. Pretty solid, can't complain.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Deyo makes you work! The work seems confusing, overwhelming, and hard, however its not as difficult as he makes it seems. Hes actually quite nice if you talk to him I think he just is a little shy but hes smart and has a large vocabulary that he likes to flex. Youre going to not like the class while your in it but just dont over think it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Too many papers for an intro mandatory course. He's a nice guy but the class just had an unnecessary workload. His feedback on each paper is good though so you do better on the next. You also have the chance to revise every project/paper. He makes you see him during office hours 1+ times but is really no help.

Professor Deyo's class is pretty slow and he will try to fill up all of the class time even if the lesson he's teaching isn't that long. The class has a ton of homework assignments and papers but the grading criteria is clear. Not my first choice for a class but if you don't have a lot of options he is not a horrible teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: His class is so boring and the workload is unnecessary for an entry level English class. Take a different professor who is much easier and you will learn the same things, just with an easier class. He grades really hard and if he doesn't like your style of writing, he will grade even harder.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: He's kind of condescending if he isn't feeling your vibe. He's very opinionated in his grading so get on his good side. If you meet with him he won't help you unless you ask the right questions. Overall just not as helpful as you'd want for an entry-level English professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Deyo is great! He usually gives readings or small writing assignments for homework but it's easy. There's 4 major papers throughout the semester. He gives you feedback on each and you revise them for a higher grade at the end of the semester. I recommend taking him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Prof. Naami is incredibly kind, and the class focuses on speaking and participation, making it perfect for practicing French. there is homework everyday, but it is quick to complete. She ensures everyone feels heard and never embarrasses students for mistakes. I loved this class and would definitely take future classes with her.

I never write ratings, but Professor Naami is the one exception. She is by far the sweetest, most caring, and dedicated professor and person I have ever had a class with. She genuinely cares about the learning and engagement of her students and will go above and beyond to ensure it. It's a lot of work, but she really wants you to learn. TAKE HER!!!

Honestly, she has a beautiful and kind soul. She truly makes you want to learn. We always tease her: you come for the Arabic, you stay for Professor Naami. If you have the chance, take her class, it completely shifted my view of learning. She is genuinely the best teacher I have ever had and I always leave her class with a smile on my face.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: lots of work and challenging but shes very kind and grades kindly as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I highly recommend this class, my language skills improved drastically throughout the semester and I actually enjoyed learning French. This may be the first French class I have taken where I felt comfortable speaking in front of the entire class - she makes you feel so comfortable. There is a good amount of homework but it is all beneficial.

I loved having Mme. Naami as my foreign language teacher because unlike other language teachers, she is very patient and involved. She really wants her students to learn and will not embarrass you in front of everyone. She gives little homework which is mostly reading our French novel. I recommend her!

Professor Naami clearly adores French language and culture, and she wants her students to feel the same way. She is excited and passionate during every class, and she is very helpful and responsive to questions. There are many assignments throughout the semester, but they are not too difficult. Your French language skills will improve in her class!
She was a good teacher and allowed open notes/book for a test. I don't know how a teacher could get better than that. You can use anything? like that's unheard of. She was a good teacher

I loved this class and I loved the teacher! I think the concepts can be tough/she has a slight accent, but she is more than willing to help you understand your home works (easy) if you talk to her after class (she's also a nice grader). She also will give sample midterms that are identical to the midterms (also its open book). I would take again!

Worst professor I've ever had. Operations is an easy subject if taught properly which she did not do. Never gave clear answers, rushed through lectures, and obviously did not care about whether her students understood the content being taught or not. Never took the time to explain anything, and would rush students out of office hours.

AMAZING TEACHER!!! I was nervous for this class because it seemed intimidating on the first day, but if you show up to class every day and pay attention and it is easygoing. She is super helpful and clear during class, and in office hours she is so sweet and clarifies any questions you have. It was a fun course once you get the hang of it.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Hands down BEST professor to take STC 102. Super nice and helpful, explains things well. Class itself is overwhelming at first but just ask questions in class and/or go to office hours so you don't fall behind and you will get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took Neri for advanced graphic design and the class itself is tough, but she is a sweetheart. if u dont already know photoshop and illustrator it will be challenging but go to her office hours and she will help you out
I hate 8 am classes, however, this one was worth it.

she is such an icon. I LOVED THIS CLAAASSS! it is very intimidating at first especially if you know nothing about the editing softwares, but she walks you through everything step by step. Pay attention and you will pass. If you miss a class i fear you are doomed. Take advantage of the office hours they're very flexible and helpful to catch up

Prof. Garcia is my GOAT. She's really nice and helpful. Class is long, but it usually doesn't run the whole time, so we can leave a little early. I was low-key annoyed because people in my class asked so many questions, even though she went step by step. However, despite their millions of questions, she took the time to help and was very kind/funny
Awesome Professor, but there is a LOT of work.
As someone who has had trouble with graphic design. Professor Garcia is not only attentive when helping, she's a great person from my perspective.

Very nice professor who gives you very clear instructions on how to complete each project. She is also accessible outside of class and will give you lots of feedback on projects. I'm giving her a 4/5 because she does give way too much homework given the material we learn for an entry-level class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I thought that graphic design would be hard but Professor Garcia made this class so easy to understand. Had video tutorials for all homework and classwork step by step. Super easy to reach outside of class for office hours. And an easy grader if you put in the effort to show you care about the class. Sweet, DEFINITELY recommend her to take STC102!!
Sweetest lady ever. Must be in class and paying attention or else you will fall behind quickly!! She is very understanding and willing to help. Taking her next semester for STC202!

Neri is an absolute gem and a wonderful professor. The class was fast paced but she was clear about her expectations and was always available to help and give feedback. I enjoyed learning from her and she's really laid back.

As someone who was scared of photoshop and indesign (thought I would fail this class miserably) she explains things step by step. makes you do example mini projects with her so you can learn the tools and techniques. she is so helpful, understanding, takes time for everyone individually. definitely take her for stc102 since it is a requirement!

Prof Garcia is really flexible and helpful for a college professor. Never did I feel uncertain of her requirements or stressed because I was unable to do something. She was always willing to meet and help out.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Shes great and makes sure you understand what is being taught. Made learning photoshop and Indesign (something I had no clue about) easy.

I love Professor Garcia. She is so kind and you can really tell that she cares that her students learn and do well. She is so helpful and has made the transition to online learning seamless. I would definitely recommend her. She is an amazing professor and makes me want to do more in the graphic design field.

She's nice and wants to help, but she is just lost. Sometimes I think she kept forgetting things about me. I definitely felt like another one of the masses with her, not that she cared about me at all.

A very nice professor. If you do the work and come to class prepared it is super easy. She gives great feedback on your work, and if you follow her advice, you will definitely get max points on everything. I enjoyed this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This was my first time ever taking a graphic design class and she was very good at teaching all the skills. She took the time to make example projects and then went through step by step in photoshop how to do it. I would 100% recommend taking her for this class she will teach you all the skills you need.
average was like a 30 something bro could not teach
DO NOT TAKE HIM! You have been warned. Start praying if you do have him
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: STAY AWAY FROM THIS PROFESSOR AT ALL COSTS. Take it a semester or even a year later if you must. He will fail you and half the class with no remorse or sympathy at all. He is, single-handedly, the worst professor I have had, and I am shocked that he is still allowed to teach, given the number of people he fails. The past reviews are not lying!!!!

This professor is the worst professor I have ever had. He has genuinely ruined my life. The average test grades in his class range around 40%, yet he offers no curve. Please please please try to avoid him. Take it next semester if you must.

Do not take a class with this professor under any circumstances. He is extremely disrespectful to students and generally impatient and rude when asking for help. He fails half the class no matter how hard students try. Unless you want your life to be consumed by a single class, I would wait a semester and take Murthi instead.

Be ready to put in a lot of effort for the class. Reporting requirements are IEEE style paper. 7 two week project. And it will be an amazing journey. It is not difficult, specially with no tests. But the projects are creative, you will learn a lot, A LOOOT. Best course taken so far. *had 3 years of image processing experience, though in diff domain

five or 6 two weeks projects and 2 four weeks projects. If you take only one course a semester, this makes you feel 3 courses. If you want to get rest and learn something by yourselves, do not maltreat yourselves and drop this course.

Not clear on any of the material. His tests do not reflect what he goes over in class. He purposely tries to trick you whenever he can. Doesn't feel any remorse in failing a student no matter how hard they try. DO NOT TAKE AND WAIT FOR MURTHI TO TEACH IT.

Being a graduate level class, the difficulty level was normal. No midterms no final, so definitely have to start early on the assignments and projects. To get a good grade needs a high level of effort and interest though.  He wants the students to understand the material in the class which may be hard for some (depends on your background).
Terrible Professor. It is worth it to wait a semester and take it with Murthi. He is the only engineering teacher I have had that does not care one bit if he fails half the class. Which he did.

Class is very difficult, but not impossible. He grades based on effort and understanding. If you put in the time for homework, you'll do fine on the tests. Start early, because he is rarely in his office for support, as he travels frequently. Overall a great professor, but he expects a lot from the students.

Loads up powerpoints with general equations, sometimes so many that you cant tell what goes with what. Does not do any concrete examples, does not work things out in class. Expects you to be able to do everything on your own. Get it the first time he goes over it or figure it out on your own. Don't bother asking to go through "simple algebra"

His exams weren't tough but he didn't prepare us well enough to do good on them. He did not teach the material well. He expects you to just know stuff. The highest score out of 100 was like a 25. he is very hard on partial credit.  He did curve at the end, but not knowing EEN336 will only haunt u for EEN436. my advice: take Murthi instead.

Bad news. He did not follow his own syllabus. we were supposed to have three exams during the semester. He only gave us one then gave a make up exam because the grades were so low, then never proceeded to grade the make up. Tests are very hard because you do not have enough experience working through examples and seeing what actual answers are.
He is not a fair prof. Your grade is base on if he likes you or not. The exam and homework are very hard, and again your grade doesn't depend on what you do on the papers.

He is very passionate about the subject and what he does. Lectures can be boring at times but he tries to keep students engaged. Attendance is mandatory and graded. There are easy online quizzes each chapter and 2 performance reviews of the theater shows in school. Fairly enjoyed this course

What an amazing teacher!! This class was super practical and you don't just sit around a standard classroom looking at a screen. He is the loveliest, safe energy to be around. 
I LOVED that Brandon SHOWED us and prepared for each class a sample board. 
It's the difference between a coach telling you to run a lap, and actually running it with you

A delightful human being. For my first time ever taking a theater class, he really made sure his lectures are very informative. He will go above & beyond to help you. Never boring, coming from someone who gets easily distracted in class, i dont get distracted, bc he makes jokes and i wait for them.

He is a very fun and understanding professor. If you are confused he is more than happy to help. This class is a good theatre credit and the professor makes it even better. The assignments are very easy and creative.

Brandon is a great professor. Even as a non-theatre major I had a blast during his half of the class. If you're thinking of taking THA141, Brandon's the no brainer choice. Also he is just as funny as he thinks he is.
I really enjoyed taking this class, it wasn't difficult and I really enjoyed the lectures from Brandon. He makes the class easy and has a lot of knowledge about the subject.
boring class, thinks hes funnier than he is

Professor Newton was outstanding, whose passion and expertise transformed every lesson into an engaging and enlightening experience. Their ability to inspire and challenge me made learning both memorable and enjoyable.

He's so chill. We talk about lots of things not related to surfing along with the class. The beginning of the class was heavy Ancient Hawaii and origins of surfing, and then moved to California and other places around the world. He's super smart and overall a great dude. Highly recommend if you need an elective.

absolutely amazing professor with great lectures. Hawaii and surfing class is so interesting, I would recommend it as an elective 100%. not gonna lie, he is a bit of a tough grader, but a after the first take home exam u understand them better.

Best Professor at UM by a mile. Entire course is made up of 13 quizzes with 3 being dropped. Is forgiving if there's an upward trend in grades. I was dumb and missed his classes for about 3 weeks. Just go, take notes, and you'll get at least 8/10 on all his quizzes. Also hilarious, with great stories and music before class. Highly recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Nesvig is the BEST! Very chill and a cool teacher. He makes class very interesting and delivers the material in an understandable way. Extremely friendly, starts class with some music to set a chill environment. TA Camilo Vera is just as amazing. Grades quizzes very quickly with the grade up in no time. 13 quizzes, 10 count! THANK YOU!
Super engaging class. He doesn't take attendance but going to class and taking good notes is super helpful because the tests are 4 essay questions.

Prof. Nesvig is THE MAN. His classes are not stressful, there's never any confusion, and if there is, he has no problem clearing it up. Class grade is based on your top 4 "take home test" grades, and there are 5 total. In order to do well, all you have to do is go to class. the THTs are just 4, 1-2 page essays (double spaced) and it's not analyitc.

Amazing professor! By far one of the best courses Ive ever taken as an undergrad. He taught the material very effectively, showing how all of the material affected our lives while managing to be humorous to lighten the mood. Very beneficial and rewarding class that is never overwhelming!

This class is good for people who like history and for those who are just taking a cognate course because they need to. He is a pretty easy grader and the material he teaches was very interesting to me. He is a well-respected teacher in the history school and I see why, I really enjoyed his class ad was glad I was able to take this course.

He is a very passionate and interesting man to learn from, very knowledgeable. He cares about his students and is laid back about due dates. There is a decent amount of reading outside of class but it isn't too difficult and he wants you to understand the overall point of what you read rather than small details. I recommend this professor!

I took his class on How Surfing Colonized California and the World. It was so so interesting, I genuinely enjoyed this class and going to lectures, very cool prof! Every day we studied a new surf break geographically and its cultural nuances as well. I didn't know much about Hawaii and its rich history, this class is a great opportunity to do so!

Profesor Nesvig was such a great teacher. It was such an amazing experience to go to his class. He always explained his subjects with details and you can tell that he put many years and time into perfecting his lesson plan. It was not a hard class at all; the quizzes were super easy just a few short-answer questions. Awesome class.

This class was honestly the best class I had ever taken at the U. Not only was the material interesting and engaging but Professor Nesvig delivered it in a great manner! So grateful to have taken this course, take him if you have a chance!

The best professor I've had at UM so far. Classes are interesting and fun. He has a very witty personality and really cares about his students & their success in the class. Grade is based off 6 2-page papers. Attendance in class is extremely important as he covers a lot of what you will need to write the papers. 10/10 would recommend for any class.

Took him for "The Beach". Very cool and funny professor!
