He does have a couple of exams and a take home final, but you CAN do VERY well on the exams if you read the books he assigns for the class, which are VERY interesting and easily to read and memorize the main points of! I will warn you, he DOES use a bit of "language" in his lectures though!
Best history prof. at the U. He seems easy at first but he will challenge to do better. Wish I could pull off the way he mixes his patterns on his clothes!!!!

Dr. Nesvig is one of the best teachers I've ever had. He is incredibly passionate about the material and genuinely wants to see you do well. The class isn't too difficult if you put in the work. He's also hilarious and makes each class very entertaining. I'm so glad I decided to take this class! HIGHLY recommended!!

He is a great professor. Vey hilarious sometimes with the way he teaches, but overall he is awesome. Attendance isn't mandatory but missing one class can really mess up your notes. As long as you read the novels he assign (even though some are depressing as hell) and memorize the identifications he gives on the study guide, this class is a breeze.

Highly recommended professor. Makes an effort to have you connect to the class and material. He's very knowledgeable on the material and interested. Not one of these robot professors who just reads off powerpoints. Key to succeed: Review the class material prior to class, go to class and participate, show up for reviews and ask away.

He's really funny and interesting. He truly knows what he is talking about and he is organized in his lectures and topics. I didn't even sign up for this class willingly but I'm glad I took it because I learned a lot and he is a great professor.

Great professor, really enjoyed the class. Makes an effort to get to know all his students and is very enthusiastic about the class and subject matter. The class isn't too hard and the material is interesting.

He kept the class very interesting with his personal accounts of trips he has taken, relevant music and cultural discussions, and was very funny and knowledgable all around.  He even brought in Pre-Columbian chocolate for us to try.  Go to class, participate, do your work, and you will probably get an A. He really is a great professor.

you read about teachers telling funny stories..but this guy seriously tells the best stuff.. his lectures are half talking about his trips to different countires.. whenever we asked to go home.. 9 times out of 10 he'd say ya alright see you next time.. awesome teacher
Easiest class in the world, hardly have to show up. His lectures are boring but it's a guaranteed easy A. He does review sessions at the Rat before the midterm and pays for all your food :-)
Nesvig is a great professor.  His lecture are interesting and he really knows what he's talking about.  He's funny and tells great stories.

This guy was amazing. Class was extremely interesting and he also taught us more relevant things. Learned more than I ever though I would about the Mexican Revolution and in a good way. He always has the best stories too.
nesvig is one of the best teachers i've had. his class is easy and he is a really funny nice guy. hilarious.

This guy is the man! I've had him for a few classes already, and plan to have him for some more. He lectures a lot, but is willing to stop and explain everytime a hand is raised. Likes to show hollywood movies to get the point of his class across. Great teacher! Highly recommend taking all of his classes!
Very cool guy, a little odd but in a good way! Like's to start class with some music. Very funny and honest. He will make you do some work, but not to much. Great professor all around.
what an odd man. The class is easy. 4 5-page papers due throughout the semester. Every class was about 1.5 out of the 2.5 hrs its supposed to be. He also makes food for class.
he *so* rocks! he's clear, enthusiastic, really smart, and totally hilarious! he obviously loves the subject matter and enjoys imparting information. definitely take him!
Prof Needles has always been fair. His classes are interactive and interesting. Skills that are transferable to real life business.

Best professor I have ever had. This man does it because he loves it and will be real with you. If you're some slacker that's not serious look elsewhere but his classes are the ones that I am using right now to build something big. Nothing else.

Great professor! He is by far one of my favorites. I highly reccomend him. Professor Needles is a very good lecturer and always willing to help his students. I have learned a lot but I am not a management major.

he is ok but the class is terrible..everyone gets A or B+...he wastes too much time on administrative work and jus keep on rambling on class but does not teach anything at all.and he will treat pizzas before his final evaluation so that he can get high comments. He is not a phd holder and actually not a real professor.i am extremely dissapointed.
He is awesome, as was mentioned before...his class is tough, but you really learn from it (this goes for any class he teaches). Also, hes a real standup guy
You definitely have to work in his class to get the grade you want. Not for you if you don't want to be challenged.

Overall she was pretty good. A bright side to UM's..well um... interesting math department and can appreciate how organized her lectures were compared to other math professors. Was a little intimidating at first but you can tell she puts effort into getting to know her students and helping ensure their understanding in her class.

I took the flipped modality for Calc II and you definitely get out of it what you put into it. Dr. Gal is incredible and she made Calc II feel like a breeze. She cares for each student like her own child and she wants success for all. I cannot recommend her enough. Easily one of the best teachers I have ever had
She is actually really caring and tries to be friendly with us. She gives time right after the class if we have any questions.

Will help you if you show you actually care. Keeps you on your toes (she'll bully you a little bit, but it's helpful). Good lecturer but sometimes gets too technical to the point it's confusing, but she'll reexplain a concept if you ask she's very patient. If you stay on track with assignments and lectures you'll be okay
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: by far the most time consuming class ive ever taken. i'm good at math and catch on quick, but this one had me TEACHING MYSELF. it turned out fine but it WASNT necessary. i wouldnt have taken her class if id known it was flipped learning. if youre ready to put in MANY hours per day and cancel plans to study, take this class. i love her tho so funny.

Retook Calc 1 with Professor Gal and she's super sweet and helpful, but this class was still brutal. She usually teaches Calc 2 so she kinda expects you to know the basics already. If you're struggling or new to Calc, take Koppendrayer, he really breaks stuff down and makes calc 1 easier.

Best math teacher I have had here so far. She cares about her students and she memorizes everyones names within the first couple weeks. Her class is hard but so is every calc 2 class. She does drop less quiz grades than other professors but her excuse is valid which is that it forces you to study each week. You will struggle but you will learn.

Professor Gal is a tough but caring instructor. Her flipped learning style requires dedication, but pay attention in class and use resources like unstuck ai to succeed. Exams are challenging, but she wants you to learn.
Don't waste your time

This class is very very hard. She expects you to understand everything the minute you learn it. Flipped Learning has hours of homework every night. The class moves unbelievably fast with no time to actually grasp the concepts. She has weekly office hours and loves group work. I dropped it because it was too hard but others passed. A LOT OF WORK!!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Gal is an amazing professor. Calc 2 is a difficult class with a lot of material, but Dr. Gal made lectures engaging and was always willing to further explain difficult concepts. The exams were fair and reflected what Dr. Gal taught in class. Keep on top of the homework and redo class problems, and you will do well. I highly recommend Dr. Gal!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Coming from someone who retook Calc 2 with her, she is an amazing prof. It is fast, and she is tough, but she truly cares about your success and learning. Her lectures are super clear, and I learned a lot. She helped me improve my fundamental math skills and independence. If you have to take Calc 2, take it with her - you won't regret it!
Very good professor but don't take her if you struggle with math, she gets  annoyed if you don't understand. Exams are tough and would recommend requesting extra time at ODS.

I thought I would like flipped learning, but it was the hardest and most time consuming class I've ever had.  Homework every single night that has completely different problems compared to class.  She taught like we already knew calc 2 and over half the class ended up withdrawing.  Took Calc 2 with a different professor this semester and was great.
She is the GOAT! Take her!!! Calc 1 is hard but thats just the nature of the class. If you are struggling, she will help you. Also funny AF
Goes fast but is eager to answer questions. She does a great job of making it feel like the material matters.

definitely take her! She cares about her students success, and is a great teacher, and finding a professor that does both is rare. She will call you out for being on your phone. Weekly quizzes, except on exam weeks, but they help you prepare for the exams. If you put some effort, there should be no reason why you leave this course below a B.

She is pretty good. A bit rude though. Very fast paced class but that's just the class that's difficult. Sometimes she would rush through the material too fast, so make sure to read the supplemental materials. I liked that she would record videos explaining stuff.

Professor Gal is by far my favorite professor I've ever had. During lectures, she clearly explains why she does each step. Additionally, her weekly quizzes are very straightforward, and as long as you listened in class and did some review you should get a great score. While she rarely takes attendance, I strongly recommend going to class.

Professor Gal is AWESOME. There was more than one time where I couldn't be in class for a quiz or test, and she adjusted her schedule for me. She gives you individual feedback and encourages questions. Quizzes/exams aren't challenging. She is overall a wonderful and funny woman. If you pay attention in class you will do fine!! Take Professor Gal!

Dr. Gal is the best professor at this university. She is the type of teacher that wants to make sure all of her students understand what is going on and will work with you personally until you do. There are no surprises on exams, although, she is strict with how she wants the answers written but that is clearly expressed to you during class.

Prof Gal is a great teacher. She does do flipped learning, which can be challenging. However, she cares about her students and is passionate about what she is teaching. I dropped because it was too hard for me, but calc 2 is complex, so it is not on her. If you have to take Calc 2, she is a good choice, and I recommend her!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Gal was an amazing professor who is truly passionate about what she does. She is experienced and one of my favorite UM professor's so far. Calc is tough but if you put in the work and get help from Dr. Gal you won't be disappointed.

Absolute favorite professor of all of freshman year, hands down. She makes expectations crystal clear, I have never been surprised on a test. She genuinely loves teaching, and it shows; super caring and always happy to answer any questions. She will hold you accountable, but if you do what she recommends and work hard doing well is very doable.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Gal is the best math professor and cares about you succeeding. Although I accidentally enrolled in flipped learning, it ended up being fine. Beware of weekly quizzes but it will force you to stay on track w work.

Professor Gal is a very caring and wants her students to succeed. She has no say on the curriculum or how many tests/quizzes there are because the department chooses that. She is very easy to meet with and is super helpful during office hours. Would definitely take her if you have the chance. However she is strict about cellphones.

Professor Gal is a great math teacher, especially for calc I and II. She doesn't take attendance but I don't recommend skipping class. The course is a lot of work but she genuinely cares about students and is willing to meet outside of class. She is also flexible with deadlines and has moved exams when it benefitted the entire class.

I loved her. She was so relatable and easy to talk to. Her lectures were extremely good and accurately reflected what was on the exam. She was so kind and helpful during office hours. The only thing I did not like was that the course was very homework heavy and honestly was so much harder than the exams/quizzes. I miss her as a professor. Take HER!

I absolutely loved Dr. Gal. She is very understanding if you talk to her about what's going on. She moved my homework deadlines multiple times because I was so busy. Extremely nice and goes on personal tangents in almost every class. She's good but a lot of studying outside of class is needed to get a good grade.

Professor Gal is an amazing professor and the only professor I actually liked during my first semester at UM. She is very clear during lectures and prepares you for exactly what is on the tests. She is always happy to help and never makes you feel like your question is stupid. So excited to take her again for MTH 162.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I have always loved my math teachers, but she is the best one I have ever had. Her flipped section is phenomenal. Instead of memorizing, you are actually learning. She is also very flexible with due dates and quiz dates. Her grading criteria is also pretty easy too.

Professor Gal is by far the best math professor I have had at UM, and maybe the best professor overall. MTH161 is a difficult course no matter who the teacher is, as this is my second time taking this course. Her lectures are very engaging, and she clearly cares about her students. She has office hours available and she is such a good help.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Her tests are 100% fair since the problems are no more difficult or complicated than homework problems. The flipped class is incredible but as I said before if you slack off or do not do the work for this class you won't get a good grade. Unlike other professors, you can get an A if you care about the class and work hard.

She is one of the best professors I've ever had. Given the difficulty of the subject, she is able to teach it in a way that makes it much easier to understand. I took MTH 161 and 162 with her and can honestly say that I learned more in those two classes than any other classes I've taken at UM.

I didn't pass her Calc 1 first semester but that was mostly on me for not studying enough but absolutely love this professor. Amazing lectures and could actually hold attention. 2nd Favorite math class I've taken. Hard grader though so be careful lmao as I didn't pass.

I wish I could say that Dr. Gal was at least a nice person... sadly I cannot even say that. She clearly has a "holier than thou" attitude any time you have a question and approach her. I have never had a problem in any math course, yet Dr. Gal found a way to mess that up. If you want a FAIR teacher, DO NOT TAKE DR. GAL!!!

I took AP Calc AB in my junior year and was placed in Calc 2 my first semester. I was very nervous, but she's truly amazing and has her own sense of humor. Study for the quizzes from the textbook, do the homework, and ask questions, and you'll do great. She is very fast when she teaches, so do a preview of the lecture material before class.

Gal is an amazing professor. Although the class material is hard, she is extremely accessible and will stop at any time during lecture to go over anything that is unclear. Even pushed back tests a couple of days if we felt we weren't ready. The material is hard and outside practice is necessary to do well. She gives a study guide for extra credit
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Gal is the most amazing Professor. She very much cares for her students and is always there to help you. She is very good at explaining the material and there are no surprises on exams. You definitely should still study hard for this class, and if you do you will get a good grade. I 100% recommend taking her class

Dr. Gal understands math and explains topics with the math proofs/rules. She explains why we have to solve problems with certain details. She can talk about applications of topics beyond this course, which is very intriguing. Hard class and challenging material, but she wants you to understand. Super funny in class, best teacher I've had at UM.

Dr. Gal is super nice to the students that try hard and want to succeed in her class. That being said, THIS CLASS IS HARD. Lots of material is covered in a very small amount of time. It is very hard to keep up most of the time, but she loves kids who participate. If you show up to every class and do your homework, it is possible to get an A.

I took calculus in high school and i still had a hard time in the class. i had to study a lot on my own because she rushes through the curriculum. the tests are really hard and count a lot towards your grade. however she is there a lot for extra help during office hours.

reviews.comment: If you want to learn math, take her! Had her for Calc I for Eng and Calc II, and received a B and a Pass due to online classes during Coronavirus. Do NOT listen to any of the positive reviews on here. Unless you got a 5 on AP Calc AB/BC and are a complete suck up, you will want to kys as a result of this instructor. Such an amazing professor! Really tries so hard to make sure her students are doing well and offers a ton of extra help outside class. If you take her class you should be really prepared, its a really hard class especially Calc 2

Dr. Gal is the best math professor I have ever had. I had her for both calc 1 and calc 2 and i only wish i could have her for every math thereafter. She is nice and funny but its important that you try because the subject matter is not easy.

reviews.comment: Dr. Gal is an amazing professor!!! She taught me soooo much about Calculus!! The negative reviews on here do not do her justice. She really cares that her students learn. If you have the chance to take her, please do so!!!

reviews.comment: Among all the professors I've had in UM, she is the best, not one of, THE BEST. I love her sarcastic jokes. Wish she teaches Calc3. I got A+ for both
I had her for Calc 1 and 2 for engineering. I highly recommend taking Dr. Gal. She is no-nonsense and is a tough grader, but she is the most straightforward, clear, and helpful professor I have had.

reviews.comment: Gal is very organized with HW and structure (one 20 ish HW Qs per week). Her notes and test questions come from the book, so work on the practice problems before tests and quizzes. Study 2 days in advance and you should be fine.

reviews.comment: Dr Gal is probably the toughest Calc 2 teacher out there. Do not recommend taking her if you want to pass, she makes Calc 2 ridiculously complicated and the extra credit points are impossible to get.

reviews.comment: A great professor who will teach you everything you need to know for the tests so make sure you go to class. She is always available to help you. She is funny and very approachable. Her class is hard, but definitely worth it because you will learn so much.

reviews.comment: Honestly she is a good Calc 1 Professor but do not take her for Calc 2 under any circumstance. reviews.comment: Gal is one of the funniest and best professors I have ever had, however, she's not an easy one. Homework every week, quiz every week, and tests every few weeks. Calculus is tough but she is a great teacher and very reasonable too. If you go to all lectures and put in the work in and outside of class an A is definitely manageable.

Is very clear and helpful in her explanations, and if you are a good student you should be well prepared for the next semesters of calculus. Would definitely take again! (Also very funny, be prepared for sarcasm.) Don't slack off!

reviews.comment: Very good professor, grades reflect work and effort put into class. Attendance is not required although I highly recommend you attend as she covers the basis of most of her assignments in class. Do the necessary work and you will get a grade.
If you are a math person and want to learn something or you have Math for years, take her. Trust me you will feel great accomplishment.

reviews.comment: She goes extremely quickly during her lectures and it is easy to get lost. Go to her office hours because she is very helpful one on one
She speaks way too fast and her English isn't as good as you'd hope for a college professor

She goes way too fast in the lectures, never curves, and expects you to memorize every proof and explanation to the most minute details. She has no mercy for students and is a very unfair grader. I have never worked so hard in my life for one class and I wouldn't recommend this teacher to anyone.
Difficult class, makes you work for your grade, but also forces you to really learn material.

reviews.comment: Really good teacher, cares a LOT about you and really wants to make sure you will pass. Highly recommend taking, also the tests are WAYYYY easier than you would expect, class average on every test in Calc 1 is about a 85-90.
She's a great teacher

She's one hell of a teacher. Saved my math career. You'll get homework, but it's nothing out of this world. She' witty and sarcastic, so except jokes throughout the lecture. The tests are fair, she grades for process rather than answer. Weekly quizzes at lab, is always available to help you. WOULD TAKE AGAIN, and will for MTH162. No hesitation.

She is an amazing teacher! Loved her class. She is very sarcastic and tries to make her lectures interesting even for non-math majors. Theres a quiz and a homework assignment once a week, but half of the quiz is extra credit and a lot of the homework can be found in the book. Her tests come straight from the list of review questions.

Dr. Gal is very intimidating and somewhat difficult to understand at first. But after going to office hours almost every week, she became by favorite professor at UM. Showing up to class is imperative, almost every test problem comes directly from an example we did in class. She is very intelligent and genuinely wants her students to succeed.

Math has always been my strongest subject, got a 770 on the SAT. Fact is, professor Gal is  very good teacher but when it comes to getting the grade you deserve do not expect it. I put extensive amount of work into the class. I would get 3/5 on problems which were 100% correct. Very difficult grader even if you completely understand the concept.

A lot of the students in my class complain about Dr. Gal, but I have an A+ in the class with not an insane amount of work put in. I will say she may expect kids to know things they don't, but she'll explain everything regardless. She is very easy to get along with and her tests/quizzes are directly from the textbook, she really wants kids to pass.
Take her. Best Math prof!

Professor Gal is really a math professor for people who care about math. She is so passionate about it, but she won't just give you an A.  If you want an A, know that you'll have to put in a considerable amount of work.  If you're willing to do that, you can and will learn a lot from her.

Dr. Gal is an awesome professor! She's always willing to answer questions and clarify anything. If you do the practice problems she gives for the test you should be fine. Tons of opportunities for extra credit. Tests are tough and she goes a little fast, but you will learn the material. TAKE HER!!!
Super nice lady. She gives you tons of help. And the exam is from the class. If you go to class, you surly should make an A
super nice professor, she explains things clearly and an easy a

Though she is very kind, willing to help outside of class, and wants you to succeed, I don't think I can recommend her for students that have not taken Calculus or are not math geniuses. I felt her tests were not as fair as they could be, and one or two bad grades on tests will ruin your grade since there isn't many chances for extra credit.
clear lecture
Super patient and always available after class. Her tests are very fair and if you pay attention you'll be fine.

She was a great person and a nice teacher but her tests were somewhat unfair. She doesn't base her tests off of what was taught in class enough. There are usually a lot of tricky questions. Not simple at all! She knows what she's talking about but moves much too quickly.

Dr. Gal is one of the most patient professors at UM. Great sense of humor and wonderful disposition. Very smart and can sometimes move a little fast but she is willing to break the processes down so everyone understands. She is very accommodating and is willing to meet with students as often as necessary for them to understand the material.

Knows math very well, but she's the type of person to do half the problem in her head.  Very willing to meet outside of class hours and help with whatever problems you are having.  If your foundation is not strong in math, consider a different professor as her explanations are on the sparse side.  Loves proofs

Great professor. Very clear and fair. Is willing to help you with whatever and will go out of her way to make an appointment with you. there are no surprises on the test, if you do practice problems you will be fine. makes class interesting and not boring. take her!!!.. if you are going to put effort in.

I took this very same class with TWO other teachers and failed once, dropped another. This is the best math teacher at UM. Her class is not easy, but she knows the material very well and explains it simply. She gives practice problems, weekly quizzes (around 10 questions), and she encourages you to stop by her office. Definitely recommend.

She teaches at a really fast pace and is pretty cold. She is from Bulgaria so the mix of moving really quickly and the accent makes the class pretty tough. She's not a bad person but were here to learn and get good grades so i would avoid it unless your really good at math and can teach yourself then take it because attendance is not mandatory.

Teaches at a really fast pace which is hard to keep up with if you've never taken Cal before. Test question are like the hard questions from the book. Homework is handwritten so its harder to get an A. Weekly online quizzes.

She assigns the hw from the textbook, which makes it much harder than webassign esp to get an A. But she does give a lot of extra credit, about half a letter grade. Class is not mandatory. Her tests are doable but you need to make sure that you understand the most difficult parts of the chapter as those questions will be in most of the exam.

She reached at a fast paced and sometimes reached differently than the way I learned in high school. You def have to read the section before class and be prepared. Tests are doable. Just do practice problems, study, and do her extra credit (helps a lot). She is nice and down to earth, and knows how calculus well. I would take her again.

Dr. Gal is amazing!!!! If you need to take Calculus 2, take Gal! Her tests are doable, not extremely hard. She showed me how much i loved math. Because of her, i am going to major or at least minor in math! Take her!

She is a really good professor however, you have to spend a lot of time going over the homework. The tests are based off of the homework, so if you can do the hard homework problems you should be fine for the exams. She gives a lot of extra credit so take advantage of it. Show up to class because it really helps.

One of the best math teachers I've ever had. The course itself is pretty difficult but she makes it fun and enjoyable. She assigns a lot of homework but it helps in the long run. Test are difficult if you don't know the material but if you have kept up with the work, it should be fairly easy. Gives a lot of extra credit (about a letter grade)

She is an excellent professor who is enthusiastic about what she teaches. Her tests are very fair, there are very little if any surprises. Calculus is an inherently difficult subject. However, she is always willing to help students, you just have to show initiative and ask for help.  She is definitely one of the best math teachers I've had at UM.

Good teacher, nice, but will go with the pace of the majority of the class. If everyone is good at calculus, you better be prepared. She finished the class 2 weeks early because she went so fast. Lots of extra credit which is your saving grace. You HAVE to show up prepared for class.

Gal is amazing. Fell in love with calculus after taking her course. The tests are challenging but if you put in the effort, it pays off in the end. She has a sense of humor and is really passionate about what she does. Go to class and do the extra credit. Definitely recommend her as a professor!!
Not an easy A, but she's very helpful if you go in to see her. Assigns a lot of extra credit, so take advantage of that if you can, because her tests are tricky.

She was the best math teacher I've literally ever had. Explains things so well and answers all questions you have. Very chill, keeps it real, allowed us a cheat sheet for all exams. No crazy surprises on exams. If u study u will do well, id rec going to class but u dont have to

Her lectures are very long. Sometimes you might want to fall asleep during her lectures because she speaks very quickly in a monotonic tone. She follows strict rules for grading the exams. You have to memorize a lot if you don't have a good cheat sheet. Besides these downfalls, she is very smart and willing to help if you ask her.

You never see Ziebarth unless its test/presentation day.Attendance=random check. BME112 has a different lecturer every class.Some,cool some,boring.Two tests,basically memorize ppts-very specific questions.Grade mostly based on lab &final project which is research with a professor you choose. my groups going to the med campus to do research!

This class is on the easy side if one does an appropriate amount of studying in advance. Keep up with homework and notes you should be fine.This teacher is seemingly sweet and pleasant, but beware do not abuse of her patience. She is helpful to those displaying effort, and SEXXXXY!

Material on the midterm and final is very specific, but definitely can get the A if you study/memorize the powerpoint slides from the different professors. Class is usually boring and it doesn't help that attendance is mandatory. The lab reports are very long and tedious, but you work in a group. Other than that she is very polite and approachable.

Dr. Nuñez is one of the best and most accessible professors in the Chem Department at UM. He truly cares about his students and wants them to succeed. Orgo 2 is pretty much self-taught from Exam 1 on. There were 4 exams, including the final, and the lowest count as 10% of your grade. Please don't rely on a curve.

To be honest, you just have to go into this class with the expectation that you'll be teaching yourself everything. From the first exam on, it really doesn't matter who you have at UM. Study a LOT and just thug it out.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Not the worst, not the best. Really nice guy but his lectures could get really boring after a while and you probably won't even know what's happening in the class. Like every chem class, you end up teaching yourself most of the material anyways. S/O Organic Chemistry Tutor and Chads Prep.

Dr. Nunez is extremely nice and understanding. He doesn't use iClicker, so you won't lose points for missing class. He's also very flexible with deadlines and has opened late assignments for me multiple times, always allowing full credit. His lectures can be a little hard to follow, but if you learn best from the textbook, this class is a great fit

HE'S THE BEST LAB PROFESSOR OF ALL TIME. Everyone loves him! Haven't had him for a lecture yet though, but he is very supportive and highly accessible outside of class. He emails back at all times of the day and really wants you to succeed.

Nunez is super kind and accessible, but he can't teach. I signed up for St. Hilaire and got him instead—Homework was assigned late, exams unprepped, and he taught the opposite of what Hilaire does. If you want to teach yourself, take him. Honestly, orgo at UM means teaching yourself no matter who you get. Hate this class with a passion.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He was a good professor. This was his first semester teaching and he did take some time to get adjusted. I think his other reviews are a bit harsh. He is very lecture heavy and speeds through the exams. He does not require attendance which is nice. Orgo is pretty much a class you teach on your own anyway.

I signed up for St. Hilaire, got this guy instead. Not prepared for any exam, not assigned homework on time, and I heard that in the last week of class, he was still doing SN1/SN2 reactions (bad bad news guys). He's accessible outside of class, he's nice, but that's it. Do not take, for the love of god and all that you believe in.

Hard to understand. Never did iClicker in class and the practice problems he did give were hard to read and follow. Whenever people asked him a question, his explanations never made sense. Please try and avoid taking him if you want to pass. You can tell he understands and knows what he's talking about but he is not good at teaching the material.

Orgo is a hard course regardless of the professor therefore you need to be willing to read the textbook and stay on track with lecture speed. Nunez is ALWAYS accessible outside of class to go over exam grades or if you have any questions so utilize office hours. His accent is a bit hard to understand but the material is digestible if caught up.

Avoid this professor if you can. He speaks fast with a hard to understand accent, slides are disorganized, and lectures lack depth. Homework is already difficult but the tests are 10x harder and are most of your grade. He also posts the hw late, all at once, with little time. No practice problem answers or past exams for review. Please avoid him!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Drop class right away, Professor creates an unwelcoming classroom environment and exhibits behavior that undermines a respectful and productive learning environment. Responses frequently come across as impatient or demeaning, which makes participation uncomfortable intimidating. Success depends on enduring the attitude, not learning the material.
The goat. She convinced me to do ISE, and I have no regrets. IEN201 is very chill. As long as you go to class, you'll be fine.

alumni said this class was helpful in their job read the chapters; not long and helped me ace every homework and exam. such a well put together class, not really accessible for too long outside of class. group project is excel heavy but very similar to another assignment she gives beforehand. one time class got a bad grade she let them retake it

She's a really great teacher and its clear what she expects from you. The class is a lot of work but everything is graded really easily and the tests are not very difficult. She gives a lot of partial credit. Great class overall
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This is a more difficult class for me. The tests are questions from the end of chapter problems and go see her in office hours because she will give you points back on homework.

You have to be in groups for this class so make sure you know how to communicate with them. The tests are basically the homework/review guide with a couple of questions about the powerpoints. You don't have to show up to class but she doesn't post the powerpoints online so it definitely helps to go to class. She only gives flat grades so A, B, or C
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: My first time having her as a professor, she's not entirely like what everyone saying. It's not hard to get on her good side, being a hard worker obviously helps. Don't be afraid to go to her and ask questions, she can be vague at times but its because she wants you to be able to choose what information you think is important enough to include.

Conveys the information you need. Textbook helps but she provides her powerpoints and some in-class problems so if you study the notes and pay attention you can probably save the $. Expects you to go to her office hours. She can be rude but it's important to get on her good side as IEs will have her for many classes. Do your work and be patient.

I've had her for 4 classes so far, and I've had A's in every other IEN course except for 361. She's frustrating,  and her mood swings. She is sometimes vague on exams and assignments . Granted, it's not impossible to get an A, but now that exams are closed notes it's far harder. She doesn't dislike me, but she's been pretty rude to my classmates.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Easy grader, tests are easy and open note sometimes. Often ends lectures short, like 20-30 mins short. 3 tests, no final, weekly-ish quizzes, and 3-4 Minitab assignments. Very funny teacher, puts herself on the same level as her students which is what makes the class

She's a great teacher, knows a lot about the subject. More than just teaching, she gives experience because she was on the field for years. Sometimes she can be rude and offensive, but on other times she can be nice if you're a good student. Do not cheat or come off as a bad student, you will suffer..

She's a great teacher and her class was a delight. She may come of as rude. But if you work hard and don't goof of in class, she'll be very enjoyable. Class wasn't really hard, but I definitely learned a lot and reassured my decision to be an Industrial Engineer. Very helpful in office hours as well. I would definitely recommend her for any class.

Everyone says she is really nice on here, but she is rude.  Everyone tries to be nice to her, but she is just mean anyways.  She kind of sucks.  Not a bad teacher, but during office hours she is on her phone and does not seem like she cares about you.
Great Professor!! Enjoyed all four classes I took with her

Dr. M is very nice and helpful. She doesn't lecture everything covered in HW. The best way to study for exams is to review ALL HW problems. Her practice exams are misleading. Exams are straight forward. Great professor and wiling to help.
great teacher pretty easy and explains things well. 2 exams worth 25% each and 1 project worth 30% and hw is 20%
awesome

Dr. Miville is a great teacher and she was always willing to help her students out. Her homework assignments are harder than the tests but she's very willing to help on them. 3 tests, no final, and 4 homework assignments

Awesome teacher...tests are all open note and she gives you formula sheets and review tests...I aced all of the tests and she offers extra credit the class before the tests for doing problems...highly recommend..nice lady
No Comments

There are three tests, a case study, and a final.  All tests are open book, open notes.  Your lowest test is dropped.  Easy class.  She posts chapter outlines that you fill in during class.  I highly recommend her.  Attendance is not mandatory.

THE GOAT. Couldn't have asked for a better semester with this man and am praying to get him as my BIL 161 TA. Most interesting dude ever, genuinely wants you to pass, understands that the BIL 151 lab book is wrong, teaches you what really matters. So approachable and helpful its crazy.

Only issue is hard to email, but really aren't we all?
Can't make up quizzes, he didn't finish my grading but he is chill but don't get on his bad side. Embarrassing and yea just don't.
He's pretty easy going and understanding. Highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: This lab sucks no matter who you take. It's boring & barely kept my attention. Alex was a great lab instructor. He was fair with grading assignments & helped our group whenever we needed it and he answers emails pretty quickly. Lab attendance is mandatory so make sure you go & turn in your work on time. Study for quizzes b/c they do help your grade
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Alex Nyburg was the best lab instructor. You have to show up for lab otherwise your grade will go down, there are weekly quizzes based on the readings that are given. Even when the lab was boring Alex made the class fun, he's super chill and fun to talk to.
He was the guy in charge of our lab. He was very nice and chill and all around a good guy. Although I'm not sure you can choose your lab teacher, he was a great pick.
Don't take him if you want to pass
Sooo incredibly nice, very interesting class!!! I would reccommend him.

Very liberal Contemporary Moral Issues teacher. Very fun and interesting class though. Can be a moral torture but that's ethics for ya. Only 1 paper and another optional if you want a writing credit. Midterm is not too hard. Just read before class and talk a lot in class. He has his favorites.

He doesnt teach well, he just reads off of slides and talks at you. However he is not abysmal, just bad. If you can teach youself a bit, and pay A LOT of attention during the labs (taught by another professor or a TA) then you will be alright. Tests HEAVILY curved. 50% is a C because everyone does poorly.

I love Mitsu so much. This class was really hard for me, I completely bombed the midterm (I got a 40%, actually), but I was able to bring my grade back up by locking in on the labs, asking for help on the projects, and the final got moved online and open notes. DO NOT TAKE IF MBE! Any other credit would be more useful.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Y'all avoid this if you can. Puts me to sleep, and the tests are no longer online so its not a free A anymore. if you study you can get a good grade, but most CS majors chat GPT everything and call it a day.
Awesome professor. His lectures may be a lot of information at times but all of the work is super manageable and he is so sweet. He is a smiley guy and cares about the topic and teaching.

Pretty standard professor. His lectures can be boring and confusing, but you could get all the information from the slides. Also, he has a heavy accent so at times it can be hard to understand. His tests are open book and easy but long.

Dr. Ogihara is VERY knowledgeable about computer science, and very enthusiastic about it. This is an intro level Java class and you cover a LOT of material in this class very quickly, and it will feel overwhelming. If you want to get an A in this class, please be on top of all the material in this class, the midterm and final were pretty difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Brilliant and kind guy, worthless class. Heavy accent, strange inflections, long pauses, and winding lectures. I have to ChatGPT his slides into info I can understand. Not a hands-on class, no at-home text, and doesn't even lead his own lab, a TA does. Even the positive reviews here suggest self-learning: you're better off with online Java courses.
First time teaching CSC200. Mistu is a great professor. I would take him for any class you can. This class is very understandable if you go to class and do all the labs and homeworks.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Mitsu is very sweet. He says hi to all of his students, and he somehow knows the name of every student in the lecture hall. However, many students leave class feeling lost, but it is important to note that there are extensive explanations of every concept learned in class that can be found online for free (Stack Overflow, for example). Not bad!

Mitsu is an absolute g. He is so kind and cares about all of his students. he literally learns everyone's names regardless of if they've interacted with him. The lectures are pretty dry but between him and the lab TA's there's plenty of people to help you outside of class. This classis especially easy if you took AP compsci in highschool.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: He is the most passionate professor I've ever had. He is so inspired by the subject. I didn't like cs and didn't continue with the subject but that is in no way a reflection of this professor. The energy he brings to each and every lecture was awesome, and he cares about his students. It was a very big class and knew all of our names.

Professor Ogihara is very nice, he really cares about his students. If you have never taken a CS course before, you will need some time to understand the first few lectures, but the same is true for every CS course taught by any professor. If you have taken CS before (like me) you won't need to study more than 30 mins per week. Overall very easy!

I had him for csc120. The class itself is pretty hard and in all honesty, I struggled grasping the content. The thing is, he knows CS very well but can't clearly teach it. The lectures are intimidating and not simple. Labs are tough but tests even more-so. Teach java yourself on youtube it it will be a lot easier. Good guy but terrible at teaching.

The class in general is just so difficult. I can't understand anything this guy says and he doesn't really explain anything. With that being said, he's a fair graders and genuinely a really nice guy. Not everyone is meant to teach. Your grade is composed of a few tests, weekly labs, quizzes on pollev, and weekly homeworks.

If you can think logically, you'll probably get an A in this class. Tests have optional double sided printed cheat-sheets and the professor is very clear. You won't need the textbook. All you need is to listen to the lectures (also online) and you'll do great. Has a slight accent but still coherent. Very nice and available outside of class.

Mitsu is the nicest guy ever. His lectures are awful and there's no point in going to class, but even if you don't show up he still knows your name and is so friendly every time he sees you. The material you learn in this class is easy but he makes it confusing. Only a midterm, final, and labs. The grades are curved at the end of the semester.
Really not that great of a class, very confusing and long classes, but easy enough to do well.
The nicest guy I've ever met, perhaps to a fault.  Great teacher!  Tremendously sensitive to the nuances of phrasing.
Easy buffer grade. Nice enough guy.
Great mind, great attitude, the only thing I find somewhat disturbing are his ears. He Seems to be a little negligible when it comes to tuning.

Dr. O is one of the best professors of my college career.  He has such a passion for music, and he brings that out in each and every one of his students.  He has a genuineness and a care for people that make class a joy!

She is honestly a great lecturer and is super caring. She accommodates students by making class hybrid, which is great since it is an 8 AM. I think way more people would show up to lectures if class was later in the day. Quizzes are very reflective of homework and are easy. Homework is easy too. Class is pretty easy but I still feel like I learned.
I learned almost nothing in this class it is just an easy A.

Dr. Schwartz is a very kind, intelligent person. She made our 8am class hybrid which I really appreciate as someone that struggles to wake up early. I learned a lot, but I do wish the class had more coding rather than theory. Overall the class was manageable and worthwhile.

A really great professor! Prof. Schwartz is super kind and caring and you can tell she understands the material. The homeworks are pretty straight-forward and her exams are easy if you have paid attention in class. Great option for 317!!
Lectures can be a little long/boring, but she is one of the nicest CS teachers I've ever had. She made sure the tests were fairly easy for such a difficult subject.

Clear professor who let's you know what's expected of you to know for the test. Lectures can get kind of stale, but she's a good professor overall -- probably the best suited professor in the department to teach it.

One of the best professors I've had! The class feels like a safe space where everyone's opinions are valued. Grading is straightforward—just two papers, and he's just looking for genuine effort. He's understanding about absences and late arrivals, and active participation is appreciated. Even if you're not into philosophy, take this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: hes a true sweetheart 10/10 ! class is very interesting just get ready to read and do discussions
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Professor Odito really cares about his students and wants them to be well! ! It is really easy to talk in class and just give your opinion on any topic being discussed that day. There is a discussion board that allows more thinking about a certain issue being addressed, but it's optional. Professor Odito wants his class to be a safe environment!

Professor Odito cares way more about how much his students learn than any assignment he gives. He constantly checks on students and makes sure learning comes above all else in the classroom. He's the best.

outstanding professor. He really enjoys participation and is super reasonable with quizzes and grading. There are 2 quizzes, 1 midterm, 1 paper and a final. I would recommend him to ANYONE. Easy A and great teacher.
I never even bought the textbook and I still have received perfect marks on almost every assignment, and what is even better, I am actually learning.

Took Odito for PHI 130, you have 4 quizzes that make up 40% of your grade; a guaranteed 40% if you attend class. A pretty straightforward essay question midterm, a final and a philosophy paper to hand in at the end of the semester, with each making up 20% of your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: So ridiculously easy, but it was 101. Really nice guy who really cares about philosophy and appreciates debate.

I took professor Odito's intro to philosophy class and honestly had a great experience. I came into the class not expecting to like it much because I'm not big on essays, but professor Odito made every lecture interesting and engaging. There were 4 papers & 4 responses throughout the course & he also offered 2 extra credit essays. Very fair grader

Great Class. I really enjoyed taking philosophy with Prof. Odito. He is very knowledgeable and actually cares a lot for students and if you enjoy coming to class. Class is interactive with disscussions on philosophy topics and videos. There are 4 major essays and 4 reflections which he grades very fairly. Overall great class, definitely recommend!

Most amazing woman and professor I have ever had. If you have the opportunity to have her as a professor take advantage. The workload is heavy, but if you are willing to put in the time you will do well and the class itself is an easy A.

An absolute gem of a Spanish teacher. Super kind and approachable and will ensure that you do well. Very enthusiastic and supportive of students, despite the fairly significant homework load. Show up to class, complete the homework and other assignments on time and you'll be fine. Tests are not hard if you mildly prepare by studying textbook.

I love Professor Delgado. She is the best professor Ive met in the foreign language program. She genuinely wants you to get a good grade and will help you succeed. The entire Spanish program at UM has a set schedule, so there are no surprises. But there are a few pop quizzes in the semester, but study and youll be fine!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Participation matters

reviews.comment: she is really the cutest lady i've ever met. she has a lot of work, that's true. but she did an excellent job at teaching. definitely will take this class again!!!! don't miss her!

Professor Delgado was honestly the best teacher I have ever taken at UM. Yes, her class has tons of homework but it isn't hard at all. The kids that didn't get A's just were extremely lazy. I would recommend her fully, she is such a sweet lady and will help you out when it comes to exams. Best Spanish teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Definitely had triple the HW in this class than all my other classes. If HW isn't due the next day its an exam, oral exam, paper, or presentation but that's every Spanish class. Profesora Delgado is the sweetest though and never wants to set you up for failure. Goes at a steady pace while teaching effectively and tries to get everyone engaged
Very nice and caring woman. Her expectations are clear and enjoys it when you participate. She updates grades frequently so you know how you are doing.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: She's the cutest and sweetest older lady I've ever met. I don't think I'm going to get an A but it's definitely doable, just do all the work she assigns and study for her exams. Probably the best option for taking a Spanish class at UM.

While her class is a lot of work, it's the same for all Spanish courses at UM. She follows the syllabus and tries to make your time in class worth it. She is very helpful and friendly. Her exams are kind of difficult, but if you study a decent amount you should be fine.

Super nice. She definitely makes you work so you won't get an a without working and she isnt an easy grader but it is still easy to get an a as long as you do what you are given. she is s funny and so personal and i really recommend taking her. she makes class easy and is very understanding. she makes the lessons less boring and knows how to teach.
Helpful and approachable

Learning a different language is certainly not easy. Professor Delgado is one of the sweetest and most down to earth instructors that I have ever met. I had the pleasure of having her for both 105 & 211. She is always there to help if you are struggling or have any questions. Course material is set by the department, but she makes it a lot of fun!

By far my favorite prof this semester. She's so nice and actually makes me laugh during her class. Very easy to talk to and helpful with anything you need.  Class can get boring and homework is not hard but just a lot of busy work. Overall I really like her and would definitely recommend taking her. I wish she would teach 211 bc I'd take her again!

Professor Delgado is amazing She is the most helpful professor I have ever had. A lot of busy work but if you do it it's so easy to get an A in the class even if you don't get A's on the exams. She truly wants you to succeed and will help you until you do. Take her if you can!

She is a very nice teacher. She is very enthusiastic and makes some topics fun. However she gives a lot of busy work that doesn't count for mush of the overall grade. Her tests are extremely difficult if you don't have a lot of prior spanish experience. Her tests consist of all free response/ fill in the bank. She is a good teacher but difficult.
She's so enthusiastic and willing to help. I want to take classes with her again. There is quite a bit of busy work but it's not hard. TAKE HER CLASS!

Great spanish professor! If you have prior education in spanish then this class will be a piece of cake. However, you need to work hard and give a lot of effort, she really likes when you participate and show her that you've reviewed the material. This class is an easy A if you just study what she tells you. Highly recommend her!

She's such a sweet lady and really cares about her students doing well.  Likes kids to speak up if they're confused or have questions.  If you work hard in her class and put in the effort, you'll get good grades.  I would recommend her if you need to fulfill a language requirement. She's happy to meet with you if you need help with anything.

she is an amazing teacher and person.  she honestly wants you to do well in her class and will help you as much as she can.  she is always happy and has easy class activities, but the Spanish department requires her to have certain oral exams and compositions that are hard.  overall, anyone can get an A in the class if they put in a little effort

She's fun and adorable. I loved her class because it was easy and definitely helped me improve my spanish a lot. Participate in class as much as you possibly can and do your work, and she'll like you and help you in return.

One of the most pleasant professors around, is always upbeat and easy to understand. Lots of time-consuming assignments and exams (both written and oral), but this is true of any section of the same course. Requires a lot of work, but class is great to be in.

She is the cutest thing ever! As long as you've had a few years of Spanish, the class is no big deal. The tests aren't that hard, the homework is super easy, and a lot of times she spends half the class telling stories about her life. The oral exams take some preparation, but there's only a few of those. I highly recommend her.

This woman is amazing!! She's like the crazy, funny, Cuban grandma you never had - especially me, since I'm half Colombian. It's great with her because you get to converse with her and everybody else in class... in Spanish of course. My Spanish has definitely improved after taking her for 2 semesters - 143 & 243. Also, she's extremely understanding

She is a really nice person she will help you as much as she can and stay with you till you understand. But if you think you are going to walk in there and do nothing and get an 'A' BOY ARE YOU WRONG! She likes to see people try to do well and shes bothered by people who dont want to do crap and she lets you know. I had to work my butt for an A
She's a great teacher! She really knows her stuff and explains everything really clearly. She's very helpful and is flexible on turning things in on time (if you have a good excuse).

This lady is so freaking easy, and is one of the biggest push overs.  She always helps you when you ask for it, and really wants you to understand and succeed. I really suggest her for spanish 101. She may try to act all mean, but that image fades in like a week or two. So sweet.
very fun class, very fun teacher, funny, tells good stories, take her!
Very helpfull and friendly.  Be diligent with assignments and you'll be fine.  Practice a lot.  It can be a fun class
She is a very nice lady, she uses department exams as do all 211 teachers but shes a very fair grader.  Just be careful with those quizzes, make sure you study the night before.
Very nice teacher, however, she tends to rush through the material, and does not give reviews.

Great professor!  Straight-forward tests and assignments.  Will help if you go to her and put effort into the class.  At times, though, there is a lot of work (but this is true with all foreign language classes).  Overall, enjoyable class/professor.

Great teacher. Helps you if you need it. Great at explaining concepts and very considerate when it comes to work load. I highly recommend her, plus she's a really interesting lady and tells good stories. Need a good base in spanish to think it's easy, but with a lil work you will do fine. easygrader
Be prepared to do a lot of work. Vocab is not very important,but grammar is. If you have a good base in Spanish should be fairly easy.
super fun and is very clear
cool teacher, very fun class

This is Professor Odair's first semester teaching spanish. He is doing an okay job at teaching us the language. He does not speak spanish at all. He pronounces Hacer like (Haz-zar). He seems pretty easy. Sad he is leaving UM to teach at a school in Los Angeles. I learned the most from his instagram live reviews. Those are basically the test.
Professor Odair is the hardest spanish teacher ever. He doesn't even speak the language, yet this terrible department lets him teach it.

Mr. Odair is a very kind man. He brings in Chinese food every Friday class. Test reviews are done via Instagram live. He helps students achieve A's. 3% of the grade is following him on instagram. He has a strong social media presence. Take him if you can!!

Dr. Odair is a very good professor. He taught in China so he helps ESL students. 2 exams very hard but gives you extra points for re-doing them via Instagram. He likes to interact with his students. He will call you by your instagram name.
Seems really chill he writes in all caps and puts his Instagram on the syllabus and on whiteboard every day. Extra credit for shoutouts
Dr. Odair best professor at UM. He is a very cool dude and has Instagram to connect with students
gets angry easily sends email with all caps. DMs on Instagram too
The class was a joke. She tried to make it seem like she's a tough grader but in the end, everyone gets a good grade.

I really enjoyed Professor Goldberg's Class alot, she was able to help me when I was a bit lost at times. We did not need to use the textbook, which is great because I lost mine for most of the semester.
Professor Goldb.erg was quite helpful. I reciently asked for a letter of recomendation and she totally came through.  Her class was kinda hard but I learned alot
not a lot of work. hot
Interesting and informative, I didn't know what to expect but a good teacher overall.  Could use better organization for the course.
Literally useless! She doesn't teach, she has no idea what's going on and she grades according to how she feels that day/mood.  Waste of a course and tuition money.

Odelia is the dumbest teacher in the entire business school. She literally has no idea what is going on ever. She is completely unqualified to teach any class at any school. This doesn't mean she gives out all A's. She thinks she can only give a few A's and gives arbitrary grades for most assignments. In conclusion, she sucks.
Odelia is as dumb as a rock. The class is a joke. She's a joke. Avoid her at all costs.

She is a very interesting woman. This was her first time teaching so she is was kind of lost. I like her as a person, but she clearly needs to get more experienced as a teacher. I hate her curves. She said that people will get C's even if all papers are good because she needs to give C's. very unfair grader.
MGT100 is a pathetic joke, but Goldberg makes it even worse. She has no clue what to teach, nor does she really care. Terrible class.

I took him for FRE1130 at FIU and he was one of the best professors I'd ever had. He really cares about his students and is accommodating when it's needed. My class was a 6-week summer course, so the information was really condensed, but he was extremely helpful and graded easily. He's really involved and he's just a wonderful person overall.
Had him for FRE201 and it was a breeze. He is a really nice person and is willing to work with you outside of class. Just participate and you'll be fine!

Native speaker from the southern area of France, young guy (27 years old as of 2018). Easy to understand and learn from, and really a nice guy. The course is structured by the department and he doesn't get much freedom in the way he teaches or assigns tests/assignments, but he makes the experience bearable.

Great professor and everyone in the class (only about 10 students) had a lot of fun learning French. He is helpful whenever you ask questions and he also tries to help you with pronunciation a lot too. The only issue is that the tests were not made by him, basically, all of it was structured by the department. No one got above an A- bc of that.

She's a good person but her lectures are boring. Also, the she doesn't seem to like the papers she picks out for class so, idk, pick better papers?? I've heard she's better for genomics so maybe hold off on taking her until then. The class isn't hard just boring. I don't feel like I learned anything new.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I like her a lot as a person, but the lecture style didn't work super well for me. There was one midterm and multiple assignments which were all packed with questions that many people weren't able to finish within the class period. There are also discussions based on readings and a final debate which are pretty simple at least.
lovely professor. cares about students and their success in the course and beyond. made a good friend from the group projects.

This class is taught by both her and her husband. She stands there doing nothing most of the time while her husband teaches. The final exam which is a scantron takes them over a week to grade. Most of the learning material comes from information that is taught solely from students in the class through group projects that are large part of the grade
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: I became a better scientist because of Margie. She really does take the time to answer questions and explains things in a way that I can understand. I think she is a great person to be honest. Take this class and you will learn more than you have in any other lab class you have ever taken. Margie often leads you to answer your own questions!

I always thought that I was not a biology person, but she really takes my seemingly trivial questions and answers them. I quite admire her! She can be tough on your presentations, but I really think I am better scientist. I better appreciate the work of biologists and am looking forward to a genetics class because of her Bio I lab.
She is great and the T.A.s are very helpful too. Lab is very hands on. I had fun for a biology class.

Nice lady.  She teaches the HHMI Bio lab, and her lab is about DNA sequencing.  Although the lab is hard to follow and she may keep you late, she and her TA's are very helpful and grade relatively easily.  She pretty much reads off the powerpoint when she presents, but otherwise is really helpful.

This professor was not very good at explaining mechanisms. I had to go back to the textbook many many times. I studied for this class an average of 20 hours per week and still got failing grades on half of my exams, but he ended up dropping the lowest 2 test scores and curving the class average from a 60 to an 80. I would take him over Whalen again

Don't listen to any of the mean or bad reviews. Dr. Olivier is just really smart and won't give the time of day to students who don't study or don't reach out to him. His lectures are really good, and he tries his absolute best to help you succeed. I have never liked an Ochem professor more, and trust me, I've retaken Ochem 2 like 3 times already!

Dr. Olivier is knowledgeable and very willing to answer questions. He expects you to read the textbook before class to understand the big concepts and mostly lectures on the details and the exceptions. If you go prepared, the lectures are helpful. Study lots of the tests and you will be fine,

terrible. the tests were like 15-20 difficult multiple-choice questions that barely reflected what we learned. if you did textbook problems it was useless for exams. discussion was difficult too since they graded the worksheets harshly. so glad its over.

HORRIBLE is an understatement. I had high hopes for this class after doing well in CHM221 but I was so wrong. The tests were always on concepts that weren't taught in class and the multiple choice format made it hard to do well given there was no partial credit. Discussion was also unnecessarily hard, and weekly worksheets were graded strictly.

I did well in this class, but it was no thanks to Dr. Olivier. His lectures were confusing, his handwriting was illegible, and he had no office hours if we were confused on any problems. His tests were also all multiple choice with little to no room to mess up, and graded out of 15-20 points. Curve at the end was only 2%. Take Zhang!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Horrible, lazy Professor. The exam questions arent like the textbook or class PowerPoint. When I went to office hours and explained that I was doing everything asked of us and still failing the tests, he told me to study with other textbooks. If our textbook doesnt align with the course he should assign another one. Curve at the end was only 6%
Hardest class at UM but he's your best bet since he makes the majority of the exam out of the other professors. Still a solid professor and answers questions well
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This was the hardest class I have ever taken. The professor is very intelligent and I learnt a lot, but the exams were close to impossible. Every exam had a very low average (50s-60s) and nothing was done about it. A large amount of studying needs to go into this class in order to even pass.

Your best bet out of the other professors since he makes most of the exam. He's a tough professor, but take advantage of asking questions after class. He also gives good practice questions during lectures to prepare you for exams. You'll have to look for extra problems after book problems to study for exams and 1 week is prime time to study.

Terrible prof. He rushes through lectures and doesn't answer Qs in class. Office hours are a joke & he offers no real help. No amount of studying can help you on the exams.. the material is nothing like lectures or txtbook. Hw, discussion & "curve" don't improve grade. Exam avgs were in the 50s, most of the class was below. TAKE A DIFF CLASS!!
He was terrible. On the 1st exam 65% ish of the class failed & 75% ish on the 2nd exam. The exam where 75% ish failed, 34% earned
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class was very hard and very dense with lots of details that could make or break your grade. Lectures were taught much too quickly, he assumed we knew more than we did, and the test average was never over a 64% all semester. He told us near the end of the semester that he would curve because the average was just so bad. Save yourself!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Olivier is one of the best professors I have ever had. Take advantage of office hours because he is so willing to help you even with the simplest questions. Tests are extremely fair and cover only what is mentioned in class, but textbook reading on those areas is also necessary. All around a great and funny professor who made Orgo 2 doable.

Great guy 10/10. Very nice and creates time for office hours to go over tests. He gives points back but won't take them away like other professors in the chem department. Do a million practice problems to do well in this class. He also hosts study sessions before tests which are great so he does everything he can in order to ensure student success
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Olivier is very understanding that Orgo is a difficult class and is willing to meet with students on a daily basis. His tests are hard, like any other orgo class, but manageable if you do the practice problems in the textbook in advance. Keep up with the class and you can succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Dr. Olivier is definitely one of the best Professors on campus and arguably my favorite professor I have had. He makes chemistry easy to understand, and he will work very hard with you so that you can get a better grade. He truly cares for his students! His tests can be difficult, but he is very fair. And if you work hard, you will succeed!

Dr. Jean-Hubert is super nice and basically hilarious.  The class wasn't bad.  Reading the book the week before and doing the book problems the weekend before should guarantee you an A on the exams.  The class is only really graded based on your test scores so make sure to score well.  You do receive a drop test and normally exams are curved a bit.
Class is kind of boring, but worth going to for the practice problems. Decent Class, but you're gonna have to work hard cus its orgo. Curves the class.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Antonaccio is super sweet and very knowledgeable about criminology. I admit I was a bit hesitant at first since some ratings are rough, but after having her I don't understand. She's so kind, intelligent, and passionate about the subject. Classes are lectures with discussions. Her exams are fair, some writing assignments, and not too much work.

I don't get all of the negative reviews. If you attend class and pay attention, she practically hands you an A. Exams line up perfectly with the lecture material, she doesn't give any busy work assignments, and her lectures are pretty interesting. There is extra credit and she brings candy to the exams.

The lectures are very interesting, but sometimes feel repetitive, and she spends a lot of time on the same topics. Her exams are very doable as long as you take notes in class and study. The TA is a harsh grader and docked a lot of points for a minor mistake. Definitely take her, she's such an iconic queen!

Currently in her class and she is really great, not sure why some reviews are poor. If you study, read the book, and pay at least a little attention, you will get high 90s on all tests. She tells you a bunch of material that will be on the exams, gives really good study guides, and is super understanding/accessible. I recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Taking Dr Antonaccios class right now & I wanted to let everyone know in time for registration that she is so sweet and Id recommend her class! I show up to class and occasionally participate in some discussion but she sees that I care and she has been so understanding of my dilemmas (dont u dare take advantage of her). Very smart and kind woman!

She's a very nice professor, but a lot of the information in the exams are things that she talked about for 5 seconds or was in the textbook, not the lecture. Read the textbook and take notes during class and you'll be fine. She also gives a lot of extensions, is very understanding, and does a lot to help you study/understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She absolutely demolished the passion I had for criminology, I ended up changing my major all together. Was extremely condescending to those who ask for help. On the final, she "gave" us the Qs that would be on it to study, then put different Qs on the exam just to pull one over on her students. Honestly a disgrace to UM's standards. DO NOT TAKE.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor made going to class feel like a chore even though the material was interesting.  Over explains concepts, very repetitive, and hard to focus in class.  Strict attendance, but feels like a waste of time going to class because you still have to put in a ton of studying outside of class for exams.  Exams had confusing/trick questions often.

not that bad tbh. definitely do the study guides!! the topics listed on there are somewhat broad, except she does study reviews on zoom day(s) before the exam so you can just ask her there. she does round for the overall grade. gave only 1 extra credit opportunity.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Seemed nice at the beginning of the semester, but her exams got worse and her criteria for writing assignments is so specific. Her assistant is the one who grades and she grades very strictly. Instead of the final being a bit easier and less specific compared to previous exams, it was way harder with so much writing. Don't take her. She's awful.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Three exams and three writing assignments. Also attendance grade each class. She expects you know every detail for her exams and expects a lot from students just for an introduction to criminology course. Her exams get more intense each time and a lot of writing involved. Take any another professor but her. Save yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Her lectures are more like a history class. You will not be learning the criminology you were expecting. Exams are hard you have to read a lot to get a good grade. The lectures are not very interesting and you have to be there every class for participation points. She is not helpful with answering questions. Very sad I took this class with her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I would not recommend this teacher to a friend.  Her tests are super-specific and unfair.  The tests seem to be made to trick you.  She does give a comprehensive study guide, but it is very broad.  Her classes are boring and hard to follow.  She makes criminology not fun.  Nice woman, accommodating for issues, but did not enjoy her teaching style

You have to put in the maximum effort into every exam and all of her questions are trick questions. The study guides do not help you study for the exam and she asks insanely specific questions. Literally take any other professor. Would not take again.

A few assignments that are graded easily that help bring up exam grades. Exams are fair, need to study but not too tricky. Some extra credit throughout, she's very nice and accomodating when it comes to making up in-class assignments and missing exams.
