reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: The lectures were long and boring at 8am with tests worth 25% of the final grade and little to no extra credit. The amount of reading I did for this class is absurd. As a criminology major in a criminology class, I am disappointed to say that this course made me lose interest in criminology as a whole.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Way too much reading for an introductory, undergraduate course. She's pretty boring, not very engaging with the material and expects students to be lively at 8am. Also, there is way too much material to organize for the final exam, even though its noncumulative.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Knows material very well and is a very kind person. Very understanding of whatever situation as long as you email her. But VERY talkative and boring. Also SO MUCH MATERIAL. It gets worse with the exams you must put in MAXIMUM effort to prepare. She gives study guides. Overall 3 exams 3 writing assignments & discussion/participation points.

Prof. Antonaccio is the sweetest and made this class enjoyable to attend. Attendance is not mandatory but there are participation sign ins in class which count in the end for the final grade. One midterm and one final which are both a good amount of material but exam is straightforward and you are given a study guide. Also, pop quizzes!

One of the sweetest and most caring professors ever! Took her twice because her classes are straightforward and her lectures are very clear. Gives study guides for all exams, pop quizzes are on what she teaches that day so you just have to listen in class. If you go to class and listen you will get an A. Love her and her classes. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: She is caring and sweet. The pop quizzes were definitely the worst part of class, but besides that it wasn't that bad. There are a couple writing assignments as well as a lengthy midterm and final. You have to put maximum effort to prepare for the exams, but it's expected as it is a 400 level course. She is very knowledgeable on the subject.

Gives PPs and study guides that you have to fill out. Exams were long ,65+ questions of T/F, MC, and essay. Do not recommend her, it was very hard to prepare for the exams and she wasnt willing to help when you would go to her office hours, she would just say that you did not study at all and was quite rude at office hours if you didnt get an A
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She is one of the best professors I've had at Miami. She gives you a study guide for each test and if you show up and listen you'll do fine. Minimal effort will get you an A. She's also really sweet, a fair grader, and will go out of her way to help you. You can tell she really wants everyone to get an A.
Amazing professor!! Gives clear lectures that are interesting and easy to understand. Tests are easy as long as you pay attention and study. Literally the nicest lady ever she is so sweet.

I really like Professor Antonaccio. She is a very lenient grader on writing assignments and understands that you can't memorize all the material - as long as you understand each theory enough to write about it you'll be fine. Her lectures feel a bit stretched out and all over the place occasionally but the slides she posts help.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Show up to class, take notes based on the study guides, and break out the text book before a test and youll easily get an A. This class isnt meant to be difficult as its just an intro to CRIM and Antoaccio understands that, however if you do want to know more she is happy to help and is very knowledgeable. I think shes a great teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She has a thick accent- I can understand her well enough, though. I've never used a book in her class, powerpoints are pretty straightforward. For a guaranteed A, feel free to read. I find her grading (on writing assignments not exam related) is fairly lenient. The class overall is isn't hard, but isn't easy. Basic memorization/regurgitation.

Do not take this class unless you absolutely have to. I can truly say that I learned absolutely nothing and there was no direction when it came to study material or lectures. The class is boring and the tests are tricky to the point where it seems like you're supposed to fail. I was really looking forward to it but it ended up being my worst class

Okay professor. strong accent while speaking. Class wasnt super hard, but not super easy. It was pretty fair. class consisted of 3 tests, 3 writing assignments. attendance mandatory. in class work with groups for participation grade. overall an okay professor.

SHE'S A GOOD TEACVHER, BUT MOST TIMES ITS HARD TO UNDERSTAND HER ACCENT. CLASS IS BASED ON POWERPOINTS/BOOKS AND ATTENDANCE IS MANDATORY SINCE SHE GIVES OUT CLASS ASSIGNMENTS. TESTS ARE EASY TO PASS IF YOU STUDY AND READ THE BOOK. THREE WRITING ASSIGNMENTS ARE ALSO GIVEN OUT.

Criminology. Required for major. She's cool; Ukrainian so a bit of an accent that takes a day or two to get used to. Class is entirely powerpoint/lecture based (that you can access online). Have to attend class since she gives out in-class assignments. 4 tests, multiple choice and fill in the blank. Easy if you look over slides/notes.
Just go to his office hours a couple of times during the course asking for help and extra credit and you'll receive an A hopefully.

Great Class, professor is a bit confusing at times but as long as you understand the material, the tests are okay. Gives a ton of extra credit and isn't a tough grader. also very helpful during office hours.

Professor Onyango was one of the most helpful architecture studio professors I have had. He believes in working hard during class and giving minimal work to do over the weekends. However, he is very strict on deadlines. Teaching this type of balance is a rarity in the architecture world and I applaud him for teaching us this way. A+ to him

Onyango is a great teacher and really cares about all his students. It does take a while to be able to understand him easily but he is more than happy to clarify, and spend time explaining things out of class or over email. Super knowledgeable - if you want to learn about structures he is the one to go to

Onyango is a really cool and nice person to just sit and chat with in the courtyard but as a professor of Buiding Tech I he sucks.  His heavy accent is very hard to understand.  His tests are hard and you never know what material to study.  Sometimes it seems as though he just pulls random questions from thin air.
Amazing professor, not much work but graded by few things

Dr. Omachonu is one of the best professors at UM and this class is his masterpiece. I would highly recommend to every IE who is looking to go into management. 513 - Quality in the Service Industry - has reshaped my outlook on businesses and process execution. Amazing professor, great lectures and class discussions. Homework is lengthy but worth it.

Such a nice man, but probably better suited for engineering courses. Tough to reach even during his posted office hours. Average professor, but a really good guy who cares about his students as much as anyone I've come across at UM.
Best professor I've had at UM so far. He only teaches one section of MGT303 each semester so if you can get it, don't take anyone else.
LOVE this guy! He knows what he's talking about and teaches informally. The class material isn't very difficult.
Amazing professor! Great course!!

Dr. Omachonu sets a higher level of standards for professors. It's worth taking his course just to have an excuse to spend time with him! This is a grad level course in Quality Management in Service Organizations. You learn so much you'll never feel the same as a customer again.

Dr. Omachonu is extremely inspiring and helpful. He is an expert in every course he teaches and motivates you to learn. He makes every topic seem simple and easy to do. His notes and class examples are perfect tools to study for his exams, which will allow for easy A's while still having a full understanding of the course load. He's amazing!

Mentor-quality professor. He's really funny, really nice, and if you ever ask a question in class, he'll make sure to tell you how fantastic of a question it was. Could tell he got a bit visibly annoyed having to dumb down content for us business school students, though (he's normally teaching engineering students).
He is incredible professor that is full of energy that makes a subject that I didn't previously think would be interesting very exciting. Thank Dr. O.

Best teacher you will ever have in your life. Never have i had a teacher that has inspired me to succeed and to push my self further within this field. His knowledge and passion for his subject compliments his energy and charisma. He is the Industrial Engineering Guru. By not taking his class, is losing out on an opportunity in life. He's packen!
whenever i tried asking this professor questions he was always either not there or too busy.

Amazing professor, I highly recommend taking any Spanish class with him. He grades very nicely, his class is super interesting, and the work is completely manageable. He is clear with instructions and he goes over every homework so I was never confused. An absolute sweetheart, he WILL try to convince you to become a Spanish major.

Dr. Vargas is the best! He did a great job of stimulating interest in the course and topics discussed. He really cares about students and is very understanding if you're confused, need extra help or have personal struggles during the semester. I'm so glad I got to have a class with Dr. Vargas!

Omar is a great guy. He can ramble on sometimes but makes things interesting. Definitely the easiest Spanish class I've had at UM so far, but you still have to put effort in. Three tests and three essays with a final essay.

I cannot say enough nice things about this man. He was always understanding and helped me when I didn't know exactly how to say something, always willing to help, so passionate about the class, and wants everyone to succeed. In all, he is such a nice person and makes you feel so comfortable in class that you will want to participate.

Omar is the BEST Spanish teacher I've had at UM. He is so intelligent, and it shows in his lectures and class activities. The reading is a bit hard but very interesting, and exams are an appropriate level of difficulty-- it is not hard to get an A if you put in the effort. He cares about every single student. I wish I could take his class again!
Omar was the best Spanish professor I have taken. I was nervous about taking 300 level courses, but he still respects all of his students and takes passion into what he teaches.

Omar is the homie. This was a one-off course he taught for the da Vinci program. No matter the subject, he is an amazing professor and a wonderful person. If you ever have the option, take as many classes with him as possible.

LOVED Prof. Vargas. Always animated and super knowledgeable, on top of being easy to understand. Presents ideas clearly and thoughtfully. Class was also REALLY fun - no activity was useless, everything was interactive, and you'll learn a lot! Clear grading and assignment expectations. 1000% recommend.

One of the best teachers I've ever had in all my academic career. He simply is too good of a teacher to be teaching anything less than 300 level courses or higher. He is the best teacher in all of the foreign language department and I would advise anyone that has the chance to take him.

Had a wonderful experience this semester with Vargas. His assignments and exams are difficult enough to present a challenge and get you interested in the material, but not too difficult it feels impossible. Good introductory selection of reading, and a very nice and sweet guy!

Easiest Spanish class I have yet to take at UM. He is extremely friendly and easily approached. He really wants his students to succeed. There is a pretty large amount of reading and essays, so if that is not your thing, I would not recommend this class.

Professor Vargas was very helpful and very clear in teaching the material. His lectures were interesting and he took on a more philosophical approach sometimes in analyzing the stories we read in class. Great professor, loved the class and I feel like my Spanish grammar got very good.
Amaaaazing professor. My favorite class this semester. He is so nice, understanding, and really loves to teach and interact with students. Would love to take him again.

I had to go on this website to say that Dr. Vargas is, as other reviewers have put it, one of the nicest people you will ever meet. He prepares study guides for every text we read, so there is absolutely no reason to do poorly in his class. I would definitely recommend this teacher to anyone!!

Professor Vargas is an amazing professor who definitely knows his stuff. He is extremely passionate about literature and grammar, maybe a little bit TOO much, bc he literally will go on & on about his obsession w Spanish as a language. The class gets boring bc he talks way too much &  doesn't involve the students for interesting discussions.
Omar is the best spanish teacher at UM. Extremely understanding and helpful. Nicest man you will ever meet!!!

Professor Vargas is AMAZING. Probably the BEST professor at UM. He's kind,fair and knowledgeable. He's super accommodating y buena gente. For me -it was an absolute privilege to have taken the class with Dr. Vargas

Prof. Vargas is not only a great professor, but an overall kind and friendly person. Really wants to see his students excel and really cares about them. He is funny and his class is interesting, and not difficult at all if you put in a little effort. Definitely take him.

The best professor I have ever had at UM. Do not hesitate if you are thinking about taking him! He is extremely kind and passionate about what he does. Few homework assignments, 3 essays, and 3 tests.

He has been my favorite professor in UM. You can tell he really enjoys teaching and makes the material very interesting and easy to learn. There is no busy work and he always returns exams and essays the class after they are due, which is always great. He is also extremely nice and very generous with his grading.
He is very nice and the class is easy. He tells you what's going to be on the test- so there's no surprise. Definitely take him!

Omar is AWESOME! he is very nice, always willing to help students and make boring material pretty interesting. He tell's you the exact format of the exams, which are pretty easy. He is very nice, understandable and very interested on the material.. DEFINITELY TAKE HIM if you want an A
Only graded by a few things, very interesting

Took this class to learn more in depth about the Holocaust and although it has been sad, it also has been very enlightening. Professor Omer-Sherman is an amazing teacher and person who cares about his students, what he teaches, and the world. Throughout your class with him you will gain knowledge that will stay with you forever.
Great class. He really lets you explore your own writing style. No grades besides two papers. A decent amount of reading, but overall a wonderful teacher and class.

A professor truly immersed in his material who shares his texts seamlessly in-class and out of class. Engaging lectures and discussions guaranteed every time the class met (assuming you've read) as he addresses larger scale issues outside of the course's text. Fantastic professor, manageable workload, understanding, and rewarding.
I got an A- in his class because I had terrible attendance. If you do his little extra credits you're sure to get an A.

Requires a good deal of reading of various literary genres which are discussed in great detail in class. Provides students with many opportunities to wrestle with material and offers his own  analysis as well. Many choices for writing papers as well as opportunities for extra credit. Use of multi-media including print, film, and graphic novels.

Professor Omer-Sherman has been perhaps my favorite and most supportive professor of my college career. His lectures were interesting and he found a way to weave in everyone's views. I actually looked forward to going to class and almost always felt inspired walking out.
Captivating and charismatic. His lectures are great and I also found him truly interested in the perceptions of his students and he was very skilled at getting everyone to talk.

Writes ghost numbers on the board at a million miles per hour and you sit there and think where those numbers came from. doesn't stop to explain the material so the student understands it. Also, low key eye balls you when your doing class assignments to see if you are doing the assignment and you get the lecture or not.

GREAT CLASS TO TAKE. most helpful prof. explains everything from slides and then posts them for us to study from. 2 tests and we're allowed a cheat sheet each time. HW is time consuming but isn't often and is a decent part of final grade. Def show up bc the class activities get graded as participation. Nothing but positive to say about Dr. Omori.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Omori gives very good slides with all the information you'll need for the homework. The class is over 50% homework, and some of them take a long time to complete, but she does allow a page of notes on the test. Participation is only about 5% so attendance is technically not mandatory but the small activities she assigns during class are helpful
She's awesome! Would definitely recommend. If you put in effort and actually try, you'll get an A,
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I took SOC378 with the writing credit. Dr. Omori is a nice lady, but the lectures are dreadful.  She claims you don't have to go to class but she sometimes gives points for participation so.. class is basically mandatory. Blog posts and a term paper is all you need for the class. Pretty easy.

This is a really straight forward stats class. The information tested is all on her slides which she prints for you, and she lets you have an entire page of notes for the tests. Homeworks are honestly more difficult than anything you'll see on the tests, they take a while but if take the time to complete them your grade will be an A.

Professor Omori is a great professor. She really wants her students to do well and is always willing to help with any questions. She is fairly new to the material but she tries her best to explain and give supplementary support. Do homework and assignments on time and pay attention. This is basically a stats class. Fun class activities!
Must work for your grade. However, she does a good job at presenting the information in class.  Very understanding if you email her or go to her office hours.
A very nice woman personally, but has poor teaching skills. Most lectures simply repeat the readings. Classes are often pointless, but attendance is required...
No Comments
ONE OF THE BETTER POLI-SCI PROFS. VERY CLEAR AND INTERESTING CLASS.

I have nothing against Professor Ooi, that being said I would not, in a million years, take this class again. The course itself is an absolute drudgery. I forced myself to class each day hoping I would somehow stay awake to take in the poorly planned notes and drawn out lectures. Do yourself a favor and take another professor.

Took her for IPE... AVOID AT ALL COSTS!! She talks in circles and is impossible to understand anything she is talking about. Her tests are ridiculous, so much material and picks 3 definitions and a long answer, very hard grader, marked off 3 points for forgetting a comma!
Please do not take.

This class was way harder than it needed to be. He teaches everything through a pre-med lens and talks to us like we're PhD students instead of undergrad non STEM students. He made the material feel overly complicated, and getting explanations without a condescending tone was almost impossible. I ended up having to teach myself most of the course.

Professor is genuinely reliant on AI. All of your coursework will be generated by an LLM. Class is disorganized, grading criteria is unclear, and feedback is often confusing and unhelpful. Additionally, he can be unprofessional and rude. The topic of the course is not challenging material whatsoever. It was just made to be overly complicated.
He can tell if you're smart or not lol. He's tough but wants you to succeed. Would recommend.

Dr. Ortega is definitely an interesting professor. He didn't seem to personally like my class since we didn't participate often and he held it against us. He's definitely sassy, sometimes funny, and will call you out. For the 1st exam he said someone got a 30% and that they should drop in front of everyone. Exams are okay as long as you study!

Dr. Ortega was great i was a little thrown off by his style at first lol but you get used to him and his personality and learn to love him lol. He's extremely funny once you warm up to his sense of humor. Aside from that his study guides are great, he's a fair grader and always lets you know exactly what will be on the exams 10/10 would take again

Prof. Ortega is one of the best instructors I've had. He made patho the most interesting class during a very stressful semester (ABSN summer). He's extremely knowledgeable, uses real-world examples, and everything he teaches shows up in clinicals. He tells you exactly what to study—no surprises. 10/10 prof!

He was probably one of the best professors I've had during nursing school. He was always available to talk or meet whenever needed, and he never hesitated to repeat material in class if someone didn't understand. We didn't receive study guides, but his exams were fair, and his questions were excellent, some even showed up on the actual HESI.

Dr. Ortega is the BEST professor ever. He moves super fast during lecture, but he's so intelligent and funny. His exams are super fair. He gave us study guides for exams. If you know everything on the study guide you're guaranteed to do well on his exams. The hard part comes from learning so much information in so little time. wonderful professor
He's honestly amazing I don't get all the bad reviews. I would literally retake the class a million times. He's so smart and funny and he's always willing to meet if we have any issues.

Dr.Ortega was amazing! I was skeptical about taking him based on the previous reviews but thank God I  decided to take him anyway. He is hilarious and makes class entertaining. I love his personality. He is very knowledgeable and passionate about his content. Yes his accent is heavy but he records the lectures and has no problem repeating!!

Dr. Ortega is an amazing professor! He's knowledgeable, passionate, and hilarious—he keeps you engaged and makes class fun. His exams are fair, and while he has an accent, he's easy to understand and always willing to repeat. He records lectures and uses blank slides to keep you involved. I'd definitely take him again—he truly keeps you engaged!

Dr. Ortega will keep you engaged and entertained throughout the lecture. He is very knowledgable about what he is teaching, and has been teaching this course for awhile so he gives you ALL of tthe tips and tricks on how to excel in this course. He is an amazing professor, and sets you up for success..and a bonus is that is is hilarious!
He is the worst. Super conceded and condescending. Please don't take the nursing trip with him. If he deems your group not worthy of his presence, he'll make the trip a living hell.

Please write the key points on the slides. It's very hard to understand your accent and when you test on things that you haven't written down... it makes our lives as students very hard and it is not conducive to a good learning environment. The point of Role Transition is to prepare us for an Exit HESI, not trick us into failing.

Dr. Ortega has a very very hard to understand accent that makes it difficult to follow along in lectures. His repetition of material does little to help as his accent remains thick despite attempted enunciation. This would be less of an issue if he included all pertinent information in the power points... but the does not, leaving many slides blank

I can't understand a word this person says. He sound like gay Dracula, despite his presence in the United States for 30+ years! 

Nobody shows up to his class because we can't understand him, he pauses the recordings so he can exclude information that with be on the exams.. The slides are blank.. I am trying to not use unprofessional language.

Dr. Ortega wants you to learn, comprehend, and succeed. He is reachable and his positive energy is motivating- something quite rare within this program. 

His exceptional teaching skills, coupled with his warm and approachable demeanor, undoubtedly leave a lasting impression on all who have the privilege of learning from him.

He is amazing! He does have a thick accent, but if you ask him to repeat it, he will spell things out for you. Very knowledgeable and helpful in & out of class. Answers e-mail in the same day. He will teach you everything you need to know for the tests, which are super fair - just listen to the lectures. He will advocate for you, which is great.

Abandon Ship! 1,000 EAQs, 5 journals, 3 SOAPs, case studies, & 600 UWorld. Pop quizzes at 8am sharp for attendance. Accent is so thick that you can't understand him from the 1st row. Powerpoint slides are basically blank. Don't bother asking him to repeat himself cause he'll tell you No. Oh, he rushes through lecture so he can leave early.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment: Amazing. Ignore any average/negative comments. You are in good shoes! Dr. Ortega is amazing! He advocates for his students, he is always here for us for learning, responds to emails quickly, helps us learn and prepare for what is covered on the exams. He is great, couldn't have asked for a better professor.

Dr. Ortega is a nice guy. He tells you everything that will be on the exam, which I felt was a little juvenile. He doesn't explain things very well, he just kinda yells when he wants you to pay special attention to certain things. The book is great, but don't use it to study for the exams. the final exam was iMPOSSIBLE however he curved HEAVILY.
Unhelpful, you are on your own

Wonderful professor.  Write down everything he says and you will get an A.  If repeated, WRITE IT DOWN. Don't bother getting the books for the class because he covers what he thinks is important.  He is entertaining and makes dull content more exciting.  Go to class, take notes and study like crazy and you will pass with flying colors.

It's not mandatory to go to Ortega's class but he goes over all the exam content in lecture so if you don't wanna read the book, then go to class. I had him for Patho and Role Transition, got an A in both, and NEVER opened the book. But I did attend every lecture and sometimes listened to recorded lectures at home. And yes, his accent is thick.
