I am currently in class as I write this. It is week 4 and I haven't picked up a thing in the course. She is an incredible speaker, highly articulate, very passionate. But everyone in my vicinity, including myself, has not stopped looking at Netflix or games. She doesn't captivate the class, she yaps endlessly, and doesn't check in with the class.
a very passionate professor that tries her best to help you succeed. Explains everything clearly and puts you in the best position to succeed. Textbook not mandatory.

You probably won't find a student who was more anxious about public speaking than me. However, Professor Orrego made the class feel so comfortable and she was so understanding when we were nervous. She made it very very clear what she wanted from us, and was available to help at every step of the way. Take her class, you won't regret it!!!

Knows what she's talking about & is there to make you a better public speaker. Speeches have to be a little long, but she gives you outlines and past examples of what she expects in return for an A. She also schedules in-class meetings before the really big speeches to make sure you're on track. If you try she notices, if you don't try she notices.
Amazing Teacher

She is so easy and awesome. She gives a very clear outline of every speech, and as long as you follow the instructions you'll get an A. She is very understanding and knows that different people may be nervous, so she is very nice. Favorite class of the semester.

She gives you a clear outline of what is expected for speeches.  She uses similar outlines for all of the speeches, which is unfair, as some topics/speeches simply work differently, and not always so concretely.  If you're nice and respectful, she is nice and respectful.  I overall enjoyed her class.
She is highly professional

she is very clear with expectations and tells you exactly what to do and include in speeches. she isn't the most warm, comforting teacher at first for such an intimidating class (public speaking), but if you do what she tells you, then its honestly an easy A. shes actually a nice lady and its a very very useful and rewarding class.
This teacher is amazing. She is very helpful and her tests are straight from her powerpoint, no need for the book. She helps you every step of the way and and is very straightforward and clear.
Do not take this teacher, she assigns so many papers, all she talks about is her kids, and her lectures are so boring. worse teacher for cos112 AVOIDDDD!!!!!!!!!

Her class is extremely hard. You have to memorize every little detail and then practically recite it back to her on the tests. Tests are confusing and tricky. Lots of paper but they help bring up your grade.

Definitely one of my favorite classes. Professor Orrego is a great teacher. There is a lot of writing, but it's all relatively easy, and is graded by the TA. The tests are only difficult if you don't pay attention. Highly recommended.

Really easy which is weird because I had her for COS 112 and she was so hard. Memorize the lectures, the TA grades your papers. Class is all common sense stuff don't need to buy the book. She rambles alot and sometimes I want to fall asleep but she's really smart but this class is just boring. Not a lot of work but a lot of information.

She assigns way too much. You don't have to read the textbook just know the study guide all multiple choice. COS 112 you have to write 3 papers, a bibliography, a bunch of assignments. She's really anal about ppl using AIM and stuff on laptops. Constantly talking about being Latina and her personal life.

this class is easy if you just go and study all the notes for exams. she lets you bring a laptop so aside from taking notes you can do whatever you want. it's all lecture, sometimes boring but if you pay attention she is really sweet and kind of funny. i liked this class a lot
It is a very easy class but she does not stimulate any interest in the course whatsoever. Tests are easy since she gives you the study guide and all you have to do is study the powerpoints.

She is really nice and really passionate about what she teaches. Class is often boring but you can bring a laptop. It seems to take her forever to get through one powerpoint slide because she goes on and on. If you do pay attention it can be pretty interesting. Book is the most boring thing ever. Tests are not too bad if you memorize ALL the notes.

i fall asleep almost every class and i am still able to learn the material by just reading her notes, which are mostly superfluous anyway. if she had a way of engaging us more in the material and using examples OTHER than those from her life (ex. her husband and michigan) than i think we would've gotten much much more out of the class.

I hate her. All she does is talk about her life and she's so boring and I want to kill myself when I'm in her class. Her tests are pointless and you have to memorize EVERYTHING. you don't read the book but you probably should for the tests since all of her notes are lists and don't make sense.

I imagine that the reviews being given are a result of  what is considered a "great" professor these days, which is basically a teacher who gives you an "A" for signing up for the course.  Dr. Orrego is extremely knowledgable about her subject.  She is straightforward about what she expects from you.  If you really want to learn, sign up.
Terrible, awful. Likes to dominate discussions. Extremely harsh grader. Not available outside of class.
I don't know why everyone is complaining. I took her and thought she was great ... she comes off as very stern on the first day, but it's all an act. She's a good teacher.

She was hardly never at class. Her TA did all of the work. She is a horrible teacher. Her lectures are "copy and paste" right out of the book. I do not recommend her. She give like 5 projects that she barely explains. You feel so overwhelmed with the projects because you have no idea what you are supposed to do.

Her TA does the majority of the lecturing and grading. She rarely comes to class. I know she is involved in many other things besides teaching – it seems like she spreads herself too thin. When she decides to make an appearance, her TA still does the lecturing sometimes while she listens. I would not recommend her.
Good professor, just wish she cared about the class more. Most of the time she's not even there, and it's the TA in there.
No Comments
I loved her. Do your work, come to class and read. She pretty much tells you what will be on the tests - do the freakin' study guides and you'll be fine. She's very interesting and entertaining.

I don't know why others on this board didn't like her teaching, because I thought she was one of the best teachers I've had at UM.  I learned so much in that class and she made it very interesting.  It's not a fly-by course, and shouldn't be, but you really learn the material and don't dread going to class.  I thought she was great.

I just had to reply after seeing the other reviews. I had her as a freshman for com 250 and I thought she was great. She may go off on tangents but, it all relates to what we are learning. I thought the class was really interesting, actually. As long as you pay attention and read the sections of the book that are assigned for tests, you'll be fine.

Oi.  Had her for 110.  That class is pointless and she made it bearable.  She was interesting, at least.  Then had her for 250 and it was the most horrible, worthless class I have ever taken.  Terribly taught, boring, completely without creativity.

She's tough, but manageable. Ignore the first reviewer - you'll need to attend every class to get more thorough notes, because that's exactly what she'll test you on. Simply printing out the lecture outlines won't get you anywhere in her class, trust me.

Terrible professor, boring, and she's not helpful at all - she'll always blow you off and refer you to the TA for help. In addition, she gives pointless assignments, and her tests are pure memorization - meaning you probably won't learn a damn thing. I sure as hell didn't. She's an awful teacher.

Her method of teaching is awful - she rambles incessantly on garbage that has absolutely nothing to do with what she tests us on. Going to class is basically a waste. Just print out the lecture outline and study that for her tests. Tests aren't hard, you just have to memorize A LOT of information.

Jubis is a passionate professor but his classes feel so slow & boring because he just talks the whole time, no presentations. He takes long pauses in between to gather his thoughts. Some topics are interesting but most aren't. Grading is on 2 exams & 1 criticism paper. You can ask him a question and he'll give a long answer that doesn't actually it

He is overall a great professor. His lectures are interesting but very boring. He can talk forever but has extremely long pauses and doesn't engage the classroom. When asking him a question it will take him forever to get you the answer or not even answer the question at all. He gives two quizzes and one final essay and takes attendance every class
Really nice guy, super friendly and great to chat with. Very straightforward and passionate about what he's teaching.
On of the best accounting professor at UM so far

I am an Alum of UM, and had the distinct pleasure of having Dr. Holzmann as an accounting professor for several courses. He is by far one of the most knowledgeable and distinguished professors that I have encountered. You would be fortunate sit in on his course lectures. He is always there for all of his students and strives to ensure their success

Very nice man, but not a great teacher by any means. You'll most likely end up teaching yourself the material by reading the textbook. Class material itself is kind of boring but not awful. His tests are pretty unpredictable -- may be easy/straightforward or extremely difficult and full of curveballs. 2 midterms, 1 project, final exam.

I liked his class and actually learned a lot in it. He's a nice man, and he basically uses the textbook as a guide. It is essential to read the book and do ALL the problems. The problems on the test are straight from the book. The class is not an easy one so be prepared to study a lot.

I learned a lot in this class.  You really have to read in depth to understand what he is talking about.  Really study the textbook as MUCH AS POSSIBLE.  If you have trouble, meet with him during office hours; he is good at explaining concepts one on one.  His tests are hard and you need to really understand the material.  I would recommend him.

worst accounting professor I have ever had so far in my college career. handouts are unclear. does not teach material just states what you should know. as a person he is a nice guy but he should have retired years ago because it is obvious in class that he does not want to be teaching. impossible to contact.
DONT TAKE HIM!! doesnt explain anything...assumes you already know everything...hes nice but doesnt teach anything...if you want to suffer then take him...

Prof pressured me to finish exam after classmates were gone. This was 1:10 after exam began (grad-level test time 2 hrs maybe?). Wanted to write much more and felt very pressured to wrap things up (e.g., "how many points off for every minute now"). He wanted to go home and obviously couldn't have cared less. This cost me important pts on exam.

he is a very nice guy. he does use examples but his exams only have problems that seem to be the exception or with information that you do not need, or might, who knows?....this class could have been taught better, he tries to trick you
Not very organized, but he did lots of problems in class that were similar to his tests. No suprises and he is a very sweet man. Also, very helpful during office hours.

Great professor! Attendance is not mandatory yet it is recommended. She provides many extra credit opportunities and is a fair grader. If you read the text, go over her power points, and do practice problems it shouldn't be difficult to get an A.

Awesome professor, just WAY too slow of a grader.  Should not take a nearly a month to find out a grade on a test.  She is a grad student, so I understand she is busy, but we still need to know our grades promptly.  If she can assign homework and make it due the next class period, she should pick up her pace with the grading.

She has an extremely subtle accent that is very sexy. My guess is Brazilian. Fear not though, she is perfectly understandable. young and down to earth. Realizes that statistics isn't our major.  Makes up her own example problems that are relatable to a college student (most popular beer at a bar, examples from TV Shows). Fair tests & offers extCred

Leticia is pretty awesome.  Attendance was not mandatory, which was right up my alley. Even knowing I never attended class, she was always willing to meet with me on her own time to explain things I was confused about.  She posts power points on blackboard that outline the textbook n contain everything you need to know for the tests (5 of them) are
Graduate Student in the Psychology Department. She is down to earth, but the subject matter can be quite difficult at times and she grades pretty harshly.

Honors section.  Super helpful! Just go to every class or you'll probably get pretty lost pretty quickly.  The tests are pretty hard cause they're long but totally doable.  To study, he gives a practice midterm which is really useful and a bunch of in class exercises. I recommend.  If you just put effort into studying, you'll be fine
Not engaging. Very hard to understand. Nice guy and willing to help but the tests are very hard and he does a terrible to job of teaching.

LIBERAL - He will utilize class time to state his personal opinions. But if you challenge him he will say he doesn't have time to discuss it (so why did he bring up the topic in the 1st place?). Class was boring unless completing exercises and tests were unfair. He can be nice but condescending and unclear.
Nice guy, really loves his economics. He's very helpful too. Only downside is, the tests are slightly hard and problem sets are due every 2-3 weeks.
Best econ teacher at UM. Knows what he's doing, and makes sure you understand the material well. Just go to class and you won't have to study for the test. Definitely recommend :D
He does not know how to teach. Really bad professor. Try to avoid him! A lot of homework (when I say a lot it is a lot)Exams are hard.

One of the brightest professors I've come across at UM. He truly loves what he does, and even though he might seem to be going too fast, if you go to his office hours he will do his best to help you understand the material. Problem sets & tests are challenging, but never impossible.
Nice buy but really boring.  Never went to class.  First test really easy but second one really hard.  Theres no book.  2 Tests, 4 problem sets, and a final
Horrible professor for econometrics.  Thinks too highly of himself.

If you go to class and have a pulse, you should pass this class...the practice tests and problem sets are harder then the tests so if you do your work you will be fine on the tests...you dont have to go to class if you understand the concepts or just want to read the powerpoints he posts online...

The only positive is he's a really nice guy.  Probably one of the worst teachers I've had at UM.  His class is unbearably boring, you never know what he's talking about and he doesn't do many examples.  The tests are very hard, even with a practice test!  Don't trust the prac. tests b/c the real test is completely different.  Would not recommend!

Pretty tough class to get through. I would not recommend him. He has trouble explaining the material, but I do see some students who get good grades in the class, so its not entirely impossible to pass. Utilize his office hours, he does help you out if you ask.
Yeah, this guy is more for research than teaching.  I found him helpful in office hours, however.

Half the class leaves or falls asleep every single day. He has an accent but its not that bad. He gives work and tests on stuff that we havent even covered. Just a bad teacher. Wouldent recommend him to anyone

accent is not that bad.  He's not here because he is an incredible teacher, he's here because he works his ass off doing research.  He's in the department working until midnight pretty regularly and he's almost always back in his office by 9:00 a.m.
Has a heavy accent, is boring and incoherent. Doesn't speak english all that great.

He's not nearly as bad as the previous reviewer makes him out to be. Anybody with half a brain should be able to earn a B in his class. It's very straightforward - I'll agree that he sucks at explaining, but if you read the book and do his assignments you'll be fine. His accent is not a hinderance.
This guy barely speaks English and doesn't explain anything. Every assignment we get is followed up with an e-mail saying that his questions were worded wrong. UM should toss this guy.

Prof. Oxman mainly stands and talks for the whole semester. He rarely uses visual aids or writes on the board, but I can't hold that against him because most professors are like that. He does not cold call. He will call on you only once during the semester, and it will be about a question he gave in an assignment, so there will be no surprises.

Oxman is a legend for a reason. He is an internationally renowned lawyer in marine law. The man exudes brilliance. Go to class and just listen to him. If you're lucky to have him in the fall he will likely invite you to a party at his condo. Go. Yes, the reading load is intense. The exam is fair and he typically gives options. Keep up and do fine.

Attend class but do not pay attention to lectures. Heavy reading load. Final exam is based solely on reading assignments. He does not address many of the concepts in class but expects you to know them for the exam. Find old outlines/commercial outlines to help you condense concepts during the final exam.

Class attendance is mandatory however the exam/final paper is not based on lectures. Heavy reading load. Do the readings and create your own notes for the final exam. It will be the difference between an average performance and a good grade.

The best prof to teach you about the UNCLOS bar none. He takes interest in students who enjoy challenging themselves and recognizes and rewards hard work. One of the most intelligent profs at U Miami Law. He does give a lot of reading and expects a lot from his classes. Always be prepared for class as he will grill you on the finer details.

One of the best teachers I had in law school. Now that I have been practicing for a while I realize the impact this professor has on my career. He was tough but excellent. I appreciate and admire him.

Definitely Socratic, will really turn you around and make you look dumb in class. Can be entertaining. Very harsh grader though. Overall a good professor, but grades are more important than learning 1L fall semester, so if you get him you'd better hustle.
Class is extremely difficult but he is still a great teacher.
worst prof. i have ever had. . . rude, doesn't care about his students and is the harshest grader i have ever had. heard he is just as bad for upper level classes.
He's extrememly intense and scary. You'll definitely learn torts though.
Once you get past the fear of being called on, it's a fun class. He's hard to understand sometimes, but overall very funny. Class is not easy though.

worst prof i've had in law school. the only thing i liked was standing up to this bitter bully. arrogant and condescending and unecessarily harsh in class. it's torts for crying out loud. who knew it was possible to make such easy material difficult and make such a random exam. avoid at all costs!

Intense socratic method. Oxman can see through everything you say. You will learn more in this class than any other your First Sem. Problem: everyone uses Emanuels, etc. so they get things you're not supposed to get; to compete in class, you really have to do the same--sucks. Exam is fair (but weird) and fairly graded. Participation irrelevant.
By far the hardest class you will take in law school.  That being said, he is a brilliant mind to listen to.  Watch the exam though, because you are repsonsible for everything.
Why would someone change their exam and put things that his students were entirely not prepared for? Is there a nice way to say someone is a jerk?

I didn't like this class. He teaches in an intimidating socratic style that is old fashioned. My gut felt that he is burned out with teaching and is bitter. Says the same thing over and over. You will learn the material though (out of fear of embarrasment), a fair exam, and for our class, old exams didnt matter.

If you like a flamboyant drama queen for a prof you'll love the OX!  He's actually not bad if you have to have him at 8 am b/c he's entertaining, but if you want to speak with him one on one he's terrible, and for grading he sux.  PS Enjoy the MY FAIR LADY reference.
Great Professor.  Hard Class.  Must do the reading and prepare for class or you will be embarassed.
A fun, entertaining professor but torts just didn't do it for me. He seems bitter that people don't think it is the most important law school class, too. :P
Amazing, passionate, and entertaining professor who gives challenging exams. Preparation in class is a must. His exams are difficult, but fair.
Excellent lecturer, gives you a clear understanding of torts.  However, his exams are incredibly difficult.

Be careful if taking this course in summer--lot of material.  Oxman will tell you that items will not be on the exam, and the materials which were not covered in class will show up on the exam.  A clear speaker, exam focuses on textbook not lectures.
Mrs. Owusu, top notch professor!
I love professor Owusu, she is accessible outiside classes, that meant alot to me.
I was very pleased with the professionalism she executed with.
she cares about her students' success a lot and does her best to educate you enough to pass. she will call on you so participation is important but it is not a hard class at all.

Dr. Owusu is forgetful all the time. When she did the online portion, she did not teach. She basically wasted our time as we show up to a Zoom class and she comes on says hello and tell us she recorded the lecture and we can leave. When in class she does not teach and instead we do activities on the lesson plan that we did not learn. Exams are hard
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Osuwu is amazing! She's passionate, clear, and truly inspiring. Her teaching style made complex topics easy to understand. 10/10 would take again.
Awesome -helpful -practical

This is a class that doesn't really matter in clinical practice but you're forced to take it; has no real relevance to your career. Owusu takes it way too seriously and makes it harder than it has to be.
She is greeeeaaatttttt!!!!
She is awesome!

Mrs. Owens is a very good professor. I honestly never enjoyed English class throughout my entire high school time, but she is very passionate for what she does, therefore she transmit this great energy to all of us in class. She is very flexible with her assignments, and one of very few professors that actually cares about our busy schedule.

Sydney is a super cool professor and she really cares about her students and making the class interesting.  I got a poor grade but it wasn't because of her.  Would be easy to get an A if you do the assignments.  The only thing is I wasn't very interested in the topic, which made reading the books pretty dull.  Again, not her fault! Great professor
Awesome!

Probably one of the easiest courses I have ever taken.  Probably the easiest course I will take in college.  Sydney is sweet and very very nice.  She can be a bit confusing at times, but she does her best to explain the assignment.  You will not have a problem getting an A in this class as long as you do the three assignments you get all semester.

Anyone complaining about this professor just wants to coast. She is very caring & is concerned about the quality of learning you are getting, which should be appreciated when you take into consideration how much money you pay for a class. To do well  go to class, pay attention, review the  power points, & put forth effort on the group project
Tests are fair if you go to class and read the textbook.  Doesn't give much feedback, if any.  Somewhat hard to understand during class.  Work hard on the group project and she will love you.

Power points do not have much information, but if you take that information and read about it a little bit you will do fine. There is not a lot of information on the test so it's not too bad of a class.

She know's what she is talking about, but too well. Her grades seem fairly arbitrary and many MC questions have two correct answers. If you can argue your answer she may accept it. Cumulative final. Very nice woman if you give her a chance. Pay attention to her BORING lectures and you will get an A, but paying attention is near impossible.

I did not like her method of teaching one bit. She is hard to understand, and she enjoys calling on students and embarrassing them. The tests and quizzes can be tricky. There are also a lot of assignments and projects. Granted, I took her class during her pregnancy. Still, she is not a good professor.

This is not the easiest class and will be difficult for mkt majors who were looking to avoid math, however Oza is a good professor. I did well in her class and didn't find the tests or quizzes to be very difficult. All the test & quiz material comes straight from the slides and is covered in class. I don't think she even looked at the group project

SOME TIMES SHE IS A BIT HARD TO UNDERSTAND BUT, SHE TRIES TO HELP AND EXPLAIN THINGS TO YOU. HER EXAMS ARE A BIT HARD BUT THE COURSE AS A WHOLE IS HARD. SHE GIVES YOU TONS OF WORK BUT ITS HELPFUL BECAUSE EACH EXAM IS WORTH 12% INSTEAD OF 25% OF YOUR GRADE. SHE IS NOT AN EASY PROFESSOR BUT SHE IS NICE!
I took her marketing class at maryland. She is very good, only lazy students will complain. Read your books and you can try to justify your answers. She speaks perfect english.

She confuses you during the lectures and  intentionally throws trick questions from the text on the exams to throw you off.  Her quizzes also have trick questions on them. She always says she wants to help, but if you go to her office hours her explanations are so long and confusing that you still don't understand. Watch out for cumulative final

She is hard to understand, but her lectures are even more confusing. I'm fairly confident that she does not know what she is teaching. She changes deadlines without telling anyone. After thinking I got 100's on every test, i got 80's on them because of trick questions. You don't get exams back, and you never know how you got screwed. Avoid Oza!

She is a BAD professor. She can't speak English properly and adds a bunch of cheap questions from the textbook readings on the exams and quizzes. The quizzes are annoying and difficult. The exams become very hard once the class moves into statistics. She grades the project very harshly and the final is impossible b/c it's cumulative. AVOID HER!

By far the worst professor I have ever had.  She puts cheap trick questions on the test, and constantly contradicts herself while teaching the material, which makes learning very difficult.  STAY AWAY!!!

She is possibly the worst professor in the Marketing department. She can't speak English and she throws cheap questions on the quizzes. She grades the cases unfairly and changes the deadlines for the project. Once the class turns to statistics watch out because she makes the quizzes and exams extremely difficult. AVOID!
Try to avoid her if you can!!!Her class is not organised, easily being lost. Difficult to understand due to accent.Exams have many tricky questions

Her accent is very tough to understand. She rushes through the material and gives 12 very tough quizzes. There are 3 exams plus a cumulative final. She grills everyone during their final project presentation. The three cases are tough and she abruptly changes from qualitative to STATISTICS without any transition. Don't take her.

She is probably the worst teacher I have ever had. Not only is she boring but she tests you on textbook material and doesn't give you the pages. The workload is completely unnecessary for the material. Trust me, don't do it.

Professor Otis was a great teacher. I took writing about animals with her and she chose interesting articles that were engaging. Be ready to participate in her class as there are lots of class discussions. There is one long-term research paper but she gives you plenty of time to complete it and offers a lot of guidance.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: She was such a friendly professor and she made the class super interesting but not overbearing at all. It was a fun and easy class that really didn't take up too much of anyone's time.

A lot of homework and reading responses on different papers. Grades very strict on papers and did not give feedback from rough draft to final so hard to gage what she really wants yet took off points for rough drafts.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Worst professor I ever met. Sooooo many works need to do and occupy a lot of time to do her homework every day. You need to finish almost 20 pages of the final paper. She will put you in a group and some group members are not responsible. the assignments are not clear. I will never take her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: Great prof. this class was a bit tedious, but my group was great so made it more bearable. research paper was a bit of work, but crank it through april break and you'll be all set.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Amazing teacher! She gives good feedback on your writing and is helpful when you are struggling with an essay topic. Good amount of reading and responses. Perfect class to take as a freshman. I will be taking it with her again. Do ALL the extra credit it is very helpful in the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She's kinda scattered in class. Just show up, participate, and like be generally nice. she'll like you. I'm taking her next sem too.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Amazing. One of the best teachers I've ever had.. It's pretty easy to get an A and on top of that she truly helped me become a better writer and her course taught me a lot about many things outside of just writing.

This professor was very unorganized when it came to giving instructions for assignments. It seems she herself does not understand the prompts and directions of her own assignments. If you take her be prepared to be confused about every essay you write.

Do not take her! She judges students if she doesn't like their comments and can make you feel like your opinion is wrong. Shes quirky and I didn't learn anything. If you are going to take her class, take a MWF because an hour and 15 minutes in her class is time wasted.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: a little quirky, but she cares about her students and she'll give you the grade that you earned, sometimes better than deserved but never worse. Excellent professor to take for college English.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Prof. Otis us a great professor who I definitely recommend. Attendance is required, but you can make up for missed classes with frequent, short extra credit assignments. There is typically a short reading and response due every class and then for the papers, you are basically free to choose any topic and not required to mention the reading.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Otis was a solid choice. She assigns 3 papers a semester, nothing too difficult (if you ask for feedback on ideas she will gladly assist). She wants you to think outside the box and if you do and clearly state what you learned in the paper you are set. Lots of reading responses (1 pg), but overall great teacher. Take her! I learned a lot.

Otis is fair and nice, a very motherly type figure. She's willing to meet you halfway if you are. Assigned a few short readings where we had to bring in typed responses, but were easy to do. Offers extra credit. 3 papers the whole semester, which were kinda confusing, but she's helpful when you ask for help and gives good and thorough feedback.

PROFESSOR OTIS IS AWFUL!! DROP THIS COURSE! YOU NEVER KNOW WHAT SHE WANTS, AND PATHETICALLY, NOR DOES SHE. AND SHE GAVE ME C BECAUSE SHE DID NOT GRADE MY FINAL PAPER!!! SHE IS SO INCOMPETENT! I WISH SHE WILL BE KICKED OUT FROM UM NOW! ANYWAY, DO YOURSELF A FAVOR!, DROP THIS CLASS!!
Just do exactly what she asks for and you'll get an A. She's a hard grader in the beginning but by the final paper she grades easy. Attendance is mandatory.

She's really nice and thoroughly goes over your 1st paper to help you out but she is a bit crazy. Her nature theme was a bit much for me but overall she's a nice person and it isn't hard to get a good grade.

A little corky but nice, down to earth, and really tried her best to make class engaging. Whole semester is dedicated to writing one research paper on any topic you want. There are one page response papers that you have to write but those are easy... Most classes are dedicated to helping each student with there research papers. EASY A+!

I love Professor Otis! I took her English class my first semester, and she really took the time to make sure we knew what we were writing about for our papers. Interesting topics if you let yourself see it from another perspective. Many people didn't like it because it was nature, but it's really easy if you put the effort into it!
she is a hard teacher and she gives alot of H.w. she is very harsh in grading. The good thing is that she offers extra credits.
Great teacher, really helps you understand what you are doing even when her paper topics seem confusing at first, easy to get an A if you put in the effort.

She's not that hard, but it is not a fun class. She has no clarity at all. Very confusing directions. She doesn't even really seem to know what she wants. If you take this class, be prepared to do so sucking up.

Overall, a pretty great teacher. She assigns homework every night but it really helps your writing and critical thinking skills a lot. Don't text and DO NOT go on Facebooko since she'll totally flip out.
Really nice lady! Cares about her students. You do a lot of short response essays and one big term paper, but she gives you a lot of help. Take her!

Decent professor. She's passionate about her topic (nature). The topic of the 3 essays of her class are somewhat interesting. She likes participation and she get really annoyed about cell phone uses, sleeping(she will call you out). There's a lot of reading responses due for the class (1pg). Overall easy class.
a lot of ec, shes kinda weird and doent make sense sometimes    easy but a lot of short stories and responses
Good teacher but advertises too much about paid tutor service

Otis is interesting.Her class is all about nature&science.You write 1 essay in this class for the entire semester but in the begining you read a story and write a 1/2 pg response for almost every class.Chill class though, a bit too much work for ENG but she loves the subject,easy to talk to,helpful.Attendance is mandatory but i was late. Take her!

Nature, the topic of her class, has never been my thing, but I got through it fine, and with an A+. I didn't even do all that well on my papers so it remains to be seen where my grade came from, but I'm not complaining.

You never know what she expects of you when you turn in her papers. For a creative writing class, it wasn't all that creative. She nickpicked on the littlest details that she didn't mention in your first draft. Don't take her.
easy teacher. a lot of extra credit. very lenient grader
TOO MUCH WORK!  Papers are often short, but there is one due pretty much every day.

AMAZING! attendance is 'required' but i was tardy all classes, & absent 1/2 the time. Will accept late work. attend conferences with her They're short & count as class participation. You can BS all your essays just cite sources. I never read more than half the readins for discuscussions & got As. want an easy fun A, take Otis. Shes so cool.
She is eccentric. I never got a perfect score on my essays, but she lets you rewrite one.

She is a little weird and slightly unorganized, but very nice. As long as you attend class and put in some effort you will get an A. She is also very willing to help you during her office hours. Take her.

Professor Otis is a very strange lady, but she is also very nice. The topic of the class is nature, which sucks, but she grades very fairly. If you are looking for a good grade take this class, but if you want a challenging class that will make you a better writer, don't take this class.
i really love her she is great

she genuinely loves teaching english and is good at it.  if you attend and participate in class, and put at least minimal thought in your essays, your set. she will always help you in her office hours, she is really nice, topics dont have to be the course topic (about nature)you learn a lot about how to write essays with her.
really helpful teacher.  cares about the students and allows you to write about topics of your choice.  if you go to class a fair amount and put a little work into your papers, you will do well.
She is the sweetest teacher I had this semester. If you care and go to class, you're set. She likes when you participate in class and she's always there for anything you would like to know.

She's a very nice professor but the topic of the class (nature) just was not helping. She tries to help, but only made the paper that much harder to be honest. She's a strict grader and the discussions in class are nice. However, you have to truly commit to the class to pass.
Very passionate about the subject and gives great feedback on rough drafts
Nice professor.. You learn a lot with her and also easy grader..
Easy class, interesting topics. She also loves when you participate and that will help your grade out in the end, too.
Class feels more like a psychology class than an English class. Takes nature a little too far. She wants philosophical answers to the dumbest topics and it's really hard to stay focused in the class.

I didn't want to take this class but it was the only 106 that fit into my schedule. Ended up loving it! Otis is a great professor, she's really helpful. Her assignments are different but if you put effort into this course you will surely get a lot out of it. She's an easy grader as long as you come up with unique thoughts about the course material
hated her! grading was hard. i didnt like the way the class was layed out. she gave silly topics of what to write about. before going into the class i was interested but hated it coming out.
didn't know what she was talking about half the time.
Professor Otis is brilliant, and if you have any grasp whatsoever of the english language, you won't have too much trouble. She grades pretty easily, too. i recommend her, she's really sweet!
ok teacher. pretty lenient grader, i should think. seems sort of clued out sometimes when explaining things. a little kooky/weird. nice overall. not a bad class.
Dont listen to the bad ratings, shes AWESOME. Take her!
WEIRD lady...doesn't teach all that well, yet is still a picky grader.

I'm not sure Otis is even sure what she's teaching.  We were her "experiment" class, which proved to be disastrous.  Her instructions were always unclear, and she lacked the words and examples to explain them further.  Also, she grades paper crucially and offers no advice on how to better them.  English was always easy for me, but not with Otis.
DO NOT EVER EVER take this class...it is the most frustrating, annoying, worthless class i have EVER taken in all these years of school.
AWFUL, worst teacher I have ever had.
great teacher!! although i hate English and writting, i gotta admit i liked her assignments
Cool teacher, but when I asked for help on a paper, she would help me out and then mark everything wrong that she helped me out with. Kind of confusing.
Great class, nice teacher :)
No Comments

Amazing teacher.  The topics she chose to teach were interesting to begin with and she made them more interesting.  She had very good suggestions to improve the writing of the students of the class.  Overall, I loved her!
SHE'S A REALLY COOL LADY. I DON'T WHY BUT MY CLASSMATES AND I WOULD ALWAYS GET PERPLEXED WHENEVER SHE'D ASK THE SIMPLEST OF QUESTIONS. IT'S JUST THE WAY SHE ASKS QUESTIONS IS CONFUSING.
Take this class with a different professor.
Fantastic teacher and class. Truly tries to make you better in Spanish. Workload is very simple.

Super nice and easily available for extra help but I wouldn't recommend. She makes everything harder than it has to be. Didn't give us a study guide until the last exam (other classes in 102 got it for every one). Super nice woman, but makes class harder for no reason. try to get another professor.
Super nice and funny. Will let you get away with just saying you don't know. Wants to help you understand it better and will meet with you outside of class to help. Doesnt give out the study guides.
Made me absolutely hate what used to be my favorite subject, give directions only in Spanish so it is very hard to learn.
All I have to say is she has one of the worst class averages I have ever seen and this class is the reason I am going back to therapy for anxiety and depression.

Her class follows how all UM Spanish is structured, but she is a super nice and friendly teacher. She will actively call on students if no one volunteers, so make sure you pay attention and at least attempt her questions. She is a lenient grader and wants the best for her students. Attendance matters!

Great professor, can be intense at times but if you participate in class and she will like you. Don't even have to be good just try to answer questions. Very passionate about what she teaches and just wants everyone else to be as passionate as her. Fair grader and is willing to meet with you and explain topics if you don't understand.

This was class was super easy but can be taken with a better professor. Maria Pardo plays favorites and makes It very obvious who she does and doesn't like. I did very well in this class but since I sat near people who didn't she deemed me as "bad" and ignored me and would roll her eyes at any questions I asked.

Maria is the best spanish teacher I have ever had. She is such a nice person as well as great professor, and she helped improve my spanish so much. All of her lectures were very clear and she grades very fair. She is always helpful if you have any questions, and I overall really enjoyed being in her class. I 100% recommend taking her.

I do not recommend taking her. She is not clear about a lot of things. Directions can be extremely confusing on assignments. Class consists of busy work and does not prepare you for exams. Never knew what would be on exams because the only thing she says to do is study the chapter but hardly gives any guidlines to know what will be on the exam.

Best ever. Loved this class withe her. I took her a year ago but she made me much more confident in speaking in front of people and in Spanish. She is always there to help you no matter what. Take her!!
One of my favorite professors, but get ready to do a lot of work outside of class. Lots of writing and is very technical, but I learned a lot from her.

Great professor. Difficult class for me because my Spanish is not the best but I definitely improved with her help. Super understanding and knowledgable teacher. Be prepared to write essays in class and complete lengthy homework though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Maria Pardo is a great person and professor. Her class was not difficult in terms of content. However, it did involve alot of busy work and effort outside of the course as it is a very technical course. Despite knowing spanish, her class was the one I looked forward to the least. Yet, she is a sweet woman and you will likely pass with an A or B.

TAKE HER!!!!!!!! i was so nervous taking spanish in college as a freshman and she made the class fun and easy. she really does care about her students and will help you with anything. there is a lot of homework on mindtap, but that was the only negative. she gives partial credit and is so lenient with grading. would 100% recommend!!

I loved this class with her. Homework wasn't bad, only when we got to reading the book. I downloaded the audiobook it was much easier. Grades easy on the papers. I would take her again and again. Made my Spanish much better!
Can be a little confusing at times but a nice lady and means well. Tests are a little confusing but if study a lot then will do well
Best teacher ever. Dra Pardo is so kind and understanding and genuinely cares about her students and wants them to succeed.  I would take her for every Spanish class if I could. Highly recommend

Maria is very kind and enthusiastic. The class was online, so it was very difficult to stay focused. There are a decent amount of mindtap homeworks but nothing horrible. The exams are by far the most difficult and hard to prepare for. For other assignments, she is an easy grader. Would definitely recommend

Such a kind lady but goodness she does not let up on the homework. She gives us pages worth of homework from one class to the next. It is just not realistic. Very kind but also talks very fast. My spanish is bad so it is hard for me to understand what is going on.

Professor Pardo is amazing! I took her this semester and she is very knowledgeable about the Spanish language and culture. There is homework and the previous class work due before the start of every class but she is great and very helpful. She is the type of professor that really focuses on making sure all her students succeed.

Maria Pardo is my favorite professor I have had a UM so far. She is beyond caring and understanding. She gives a very clear syllabus and you know exactly what to expect for the entire semester. There are activities every week on MindTap but they are not difficult and as long as you do them and participate in class you should get an A. LOVE HER!!

This class was pretty easy as far as foreign languages go. Not too difficult, but participation matters and be ready to review. There were a few issues due to COVID and online learning, but she made it work and made the most out of the situation. I definitely recommend her if you haven't taken a Spanish course before, she makes it easy.

I love Professor Pardo. She's so sweet and genuinely wants you to do well in the class. She grades fairly easy and is very lenient. There's homework due every night before class, but it's never difficult. The extra credit helped boost me a whole letter grade. Would definitely recommend taking her.
I love Professor Pardo. She is so sweet and cares about her students. There are a lot of extra credit opportunities if you need them, which was very helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Flipped classroom model, so you learn from the textbook and apply in class. Lots of homework but it is fairly easy and a grade booster. The exams were moderately difficult, but easy to bring up grade with other assignments. The nicest and most caring professor, always available and extremely understanding. I recommend her.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This professor is an absolute gem. She is so kind and understanding. She treats you like a human being and not just some person she needs to grade. She really showed so much compassion when I spoke to her about personal issues. she's truly an angel and made my final semester at UM so much better <3

Kindest teacher and super understanding. there online homework due before every class but its not hard at all. Shes very sweet and is there to talk if your having issues to need help. Definitely would take her again!

Sra. Pardo is the best spanish teacher at UM. I never take the time to write these things out but I did for this. Before I came to UM in high school I never was able to learn spanish at all so on the first day I already felt behind but with the help of professor pardo in her office hours I am now able to share my story with everyone in spanish.

The sweetest woman ever. I was struggling with my mental health and she was my rock. Very understanding and very caring. She is very passionate when she lectures which made class a lot more interesting, and she is a very fair grader. Take her if you have the opportunity.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Very nice professor, and will certainly work with you if you are having ANY issues. She talks a little fast and in my class, there was a lot of political discussion so I couldnt easily follow all of the time. If your Spanish is extremely shaky, Id recommend a different professor unless youre up for the challenge. Youll definitely learn a lot.

She is such a sweetheart. She really wants you to learn the language and is very happy to help. Exams are made by department but she prepares you well. Passionate about her home country (Venezuela) which really resonated with me. Wish I could take her again for 202!

She is an easy grader. You will have a bit of busy work but luckily they are for completion and those are easy 100s. She knows her stuff but she isn't the best lecturer because she gets side-tracked often. Tests are fair and not difficult. Readings are challenging at times but doable. Do your work and you'll get a good grade.

Ive never had such a kind, compassionate, caring teacher until Pardo. She's so understanding and is always looking for EFFORT, conversation, interest. If you attend class and show enthusiasm to the subject, she will have your back. She loves discussion (esp about Venezuela). She's super knowledgeable. I RECOMMEND HER more than any other prof in MLL

I would consider this class to be high school leveled. Not because the coursework is easy, but because high school education is where this teacher should have capped out in her professional teaching capabilities. Demeaning, under qualified, and enjoys providing excessive busy work to her beloved students. Have fun.

LOVE Pardo!!!! yeah students complain about how many papers she assigns or how she talks in Spanish a lot (she doesn't always) but that's how YOU LEARN!! If you enjoy Spanish TAKE HER CLASS! She is 1 of the sweetest people I've ever met & she is super helpful and accessible outside of class. She has real concern for students & no class on her bday

Sra. Pardo is seriously the best spanish teacher you will get at UM. Took her for 201 which can be hard if you have a bad professor but she is so sweet and caring!! She said she doesn't believe in grades but she just wants us to really love spanish!

I was so afraid to take Spanish in college and I am convinced Professor Pardo is the only reason it was doable. She does things in a much simpler and more straight-forward manner than a lot of the other professors in the department. She is kind and helpful and her expectations are very reasonable. Very thankful for her! TAKE HER
Professor Pardo is great! She is very understanding, especially considering the course is taught in Spanish. I would definitely recommend her!

Dr. Shockley is the kindest professors I have ever had. He actually cares about his students. Classwork is not too bad and there are a ton of extra credit opportunities. He will try his hardest to make sure you do well, just show interest and communicate.
easy class. Prof Shockley is a very kind and smart professor. easy to get an A, just don't do what I did and hold off from doing the assignments till the last minute
Dr. Shockley is an amazing professor. He is very kind and funny in class. He cares about his students and his class is easy. I recommend taking him!

Great professor, projects could take a bit of time but definitely worth it. Gained a whole new understanding of religion from taking this course. Professor Shockley is one of the best professors at the University of Miami, even if his jokes don't always land.

Doc Shock is truly such a great guy. His lectures are pretty interesting, especially if you are passionate about animals or the enviroment. There are 3 projects you have to do which I enjoyed and 1 final paper. He is very caring and ikind. Please talk if you take this class, it contributes to the convo and he likes to hear different opinions!

Nice guy and interesting lectures, but he grades absurdly tough for a class that nobody but him actually cares about. 4 research papers requiring lots of citations, original religious theories, etc. Requires cameras on in an online class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: 2 essays and one easy video project. No other grades and very easy grader. Just do the work and his class can be actually super interesting

Super easy A. Wonderful guy really cares about his students. Lots of reading in class which is enforced through class discussions after finishing books. Helped me better understand myself and religion in general. Super interesting topic.

Dr. Shockley is a fantastic professor. His lectures are engaging, and his passion for the subject makes the class even more enjoyable. He is a very kind and understanding teacher, and it's evident that he wants all of his students to succeed. He created a safe and welcoming classroom environment and was accessible outside of class when needed!

Doctor Shockley is an amazing person & even more amazing professor. He truly knows his stuff, & teaches using lecture based class discussions, which allow students an interactive way to learn course material. Lectures are interesting, and often entertaining, as his southern drawl and unique sense of humor draw students in. 'Preciate you, Doc Shock.
Very engaging and honestly a great person. Easy A and the work load is very small. Only one essay for midterm and one for a final. He is a great teacher and I would recomend to everyone.

Great professor who clearly cares about his students and wants them to succeed even after graduation. The class was engaging, the workload was manageable, and the material felt applicable to real life. One of the most useful classes I've taken in college. Could not recommend Prof Miro more!

Professor Miro genuinely wants his students to succeed.... not only in this class but in life! The assignments are realistic and help you to prepare for what's coming next. He creates an environment where students can feel completely comfortable and actually have a little fun. 10/10 professor.

Pablo is an amazing professor! He brings in advertising professionals from across the industry to tell us about their experience. He is passionate about his job and a really nice guy! Also he is very understanding and treats his students as professionals. Take him if you need an advertising credit senior year you will not regret it!

Pablo is the best advertising professor I've had during undergrad! He is very dedicated to not only teaching, but to being a resourceful mentor helping students grow professionally. He provides honest feedback on projects and his assignments/lectures are actually important to understand in the real world. Such a personable and inspiring guy!

Professor Miro was awesome. Truly treated his students as young professionals and did a great job of preparing  us for post-grad and searching for jobs in the ad industry. If you need an upper-level ad course definitely take him.
Professor Miro, is very good at teaching what he wants to get across to students with inspirational talks and real life examples. He truly is a mentor.

Pablo was not just an amazing professor, but also a mentor to each student in his class. If you are looking for a professor who is willing to put in the time to work with you to achieve your personal goals, and thrive in the industry, take Pablos class. He is a motivating, genuine, and really awesome person who will help you to achieve great things
Pablo Miro was one of the best professor's I've had at UM. Would definitely recommend anyone to take his class!

Great Professor! Has a lot of real world experience that can teach a lot to students. Teaches many valuable lessons as well as tips and tricks to students looking to work in advertising. Willing to go the extra mile working with students to help them do their best.

Professor Perez was very nice and responsive. Participation and attendance are very important, it is time consuming to study for the exams since you need to memorize+apply rule of law. She's sweet and sometimes brings donuts on Fridays. Overall a great woman so I enjoyed being a part of this class even though it was my hardest one, it was my fav.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Making sure all professors (and students) realize that Rate My Professors allows false ratings from unregistered non-members, both good and bad, to be posted on this site.

If you are taking BSL212 take her she is by far the best professor. The best grader and makes it very interesting to understand. If you study for this class and stay on top of your notes you will be fine especially with her. For sure take her if you have the choice.
Great professor, explained topics well, made a 3-hour lecture go super quick. 100% recommend taking her I learned so much through her class.

Professor Perez is such a great professor. You can tell that she is passionate and knowledgeable about what she teaches. Participation does matter and there's so many opportunities to participate. Also working on case study problems every class truly helped me understand the material. I truly enjoyed taking her class. Strongly recommend taking her!

Gives really clear and quality lectures about business law. Make sure to really read and understand the textbook, and you will be fine. She answers all questions enthusiastically and is a pretty fun professor. If you read the chapter, participate, and take notes, you'll be set.

Professor Perez was incredible! She provides clear explanations, often supplemented with funny stories that really help in understanding the concepts. She was very accessible and always willing to clarify any questions. Her quizzes aren't too bad, but you definitely need to study before each. Wish I could take her again!

Mr. Resnick really cares about his students and wants them to succeed. If you are interested in sports administration I would recommend taking this class and getting to know Mr. Resnick. He provides many opportunities to get involved in sports and provides a very collaborative class atmosphere.

Such a chill dude. He's truly passionate about what he does and is an outstanding person to know in the sports industry. Genuinely wants to see his students succeed. Also this class is so free. Just do all your work and you're chilling.
Talks a lot, only tells you what's due in class but it's an easy A

Easy class when you submit assignments on time. Submitted two things late and was barley given credit. You can't work ahead and he left almost half the assignments for the last couple days of the semester and had to learn it ourselves. Also had to pay $100 for a sports subscription we barley used. Overall did not learn anything and was repetitive.

Mr. Resnick is one of the most genuine and helpful professors I've had. He truly wants students to succeed and makes class feel meaningful. Assignments are all online memos—great for real-world prep, but he should be mindful of ChatGPT use. Overall, awesome guy and a great class.

At first, this class was interesting, but it turned repetitive. He pretty much talked about current events, and we watched March Madness in class. If you do all your work on time, you are pretty much guaranteed a 100%. DON'T turn anything in late, or you can get like a 50-70%. We missed 2 units and had to learn them ourselves for finals.

He is very good teacher. Most assignments are easy. He is a clear grader so when you mess up its more on you then anything.  He doesn't let you redo assignment's but again if you are on top of your things you'll get a good grade.

You won't learn anything in this class. He takes 50% off if you mistake the sources in the journals, non-negotiable. I explained that it was a simple mistake and I copied the wrong link then resubmitted and he said he doesn't regrade. Felt like I was wasting my time in the class. Rambles endlessly. Makes you pay $100 for website used maybe 7 times.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Good professor and really helps you on internships and preparing you for the sports world, but honestly just rambles about a bunch of things and you feel like you don't learn much.

Entire class was just him talking and showing a presentation off Zoom, not super engaging most people didn't pay attention. Attendance not mandatory, but he announces what is due in class. You don't know what assignments to do or when it's due since he doesn't post due dates on Blackboard for things, so it's super frustrating unless he announces it

Resnick is a great professor who is passionate about what he teaches. Has an impressive resume and  is someone that you can trust in the industry. Simple assignments, but strict with late work. Really cares about his students and takes time engaging the class as well as  frequently sending emails on possible internships. Wants to see you succeed.

Mr. Resnick is a great professor! I took his online course; everything was straightforward and easy to understand. You must attend class, as he only announces the assignments in class, but otherwise, as long as you are present, this is an easy and enjoyable class.

Professor Resnick is fantastic. This class really made me feel equipped for a future career in the Sports Industry. If you're a Sport Admin major/minor, you should be looking forward to taking this class, it's so much fun, and a very easy A. Really gets your degree off to a great start.

Best professor I have ever had. I have taken him for 3 of my KIN courses and in each one, he is amazing. Not a tough grader at all as long as you get the assignment done with his rubric (always include APA citation for sports journals) you will get an A.

Professor Resnick is a GREAT teacher that I learned a ton from. He really cares about his students. He released opporitunities for the class all semester, allowing us a chance to get involved and make connections. My journey in sport administration could not have started on a better note. TAKE RESNICK WHATEVER YOU DO!

Very knowledgeable in the field if you're pursuing sport administration. I was bummed I had to take him online instead of in person. He loves what he does and you can tell! Makes lectures easy to digest and isn't monotone.
Prof Resnick was genuinley my favorite professor at the U. He is knowledgable and makes classes interesting and fun. Would love to take a class with him again.

I took this class asynchronous. Assignments consisted of 8 discussion board posts, 8 journal reviews (1 page article review), 4 short quizzes, and a paper. All assignments were super super easy, and guartneed A.

Mr. Resnick is a cool professor. The class provides a good overview for sports admin majors/minors, although it can feel like the content moves slowly. He presents a lot of exciting sports admin-related jobs and internships for KIN201 students to build and improve their resumes. Overall wants students to do well and is very caring and respectful.

Resnick's KIN201 course excites you for your major / minor in Sport Administration. Great professor; super engaging and loves talking sports. Graded by easy quizzes, discussion boards, and sports business journal reflections. There is a final on the syllabus but we never ended up taking it. Attendance is optional but you should definitely still go.

I do not understand this class, I found it a complete waste of time, most of the classes we just wasted time, Resnick is super ok as a teacher, nonetheless, it is an easy class but again better have a way to entertain yourself for over an hour as the info is useless. Wasted $61 on a subscription for the most useless assignments. Bad time manager.

The only issue for me was learning online in general. It was very hard to reach out to other classmates because I didn't know or ever know a single one. (coming in a freshman online class) . Other than that, this a great professor.

Very knowledgeable and very kind. Grading criteria is very clear so you know what to expect. Pretty easy A as long as you put in some effort and participate in class a little bit. Very lenient in grading.
A really great professor and has great conversation like lectures.

Professor Resnick is probably the most lazy professor I've had in my 2 years at UM thus far. During this COVID-19 semester, he stopped having lectures all together, he tries to make the tests easy but doesn't even take questions from the texts he gives (which he claims have all the answers). His questions are also worded weirdly. Not a good Prof!!!

Mr. Resnick is a fantastic professor! He genuinely wants to see his students succeed in the sports industry. Doesnt make the class about grades rather that you understand the material and are building connections in the sports industry. He tells great stories and assigns very interesting and cool projects.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Tremendous professor with an incredible amount of knowledge from working in the sport industry. Extremely intriguing lectures on what it takes to work in the industry and very open to giving advice on how to do it. Be sure to take advantage of office hours to build a solid relationship with him. Projects are quite interesting and help you a lot!
Resnick is a great professor!
Great professor who really cares about his students. Course is not difficult!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Lecture-heavy, take notes if you want, if you dont youll probably be fine. A couple major projects, not very hard to do. You have to volunteer for one, and interview someone in the sports industry for another. Most helpful prof ive ever had. Office hours were very helpful for opportunities, networking, internships, etc. He can be a great resource.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: SUPER easy class, you have to be really dumb not to pass. He's a nice guy, but really weird. He's also a very boring guy, I struggled to stay awake for most of his lectures. Just show up to class and you'll pass with flying colors.

Resnick is my favorite Sports Admin professor. Truly he's the best in the department. Great guy, great professor and will always help you outside of class with questions or with getting internships!! He's a great person to know at Miami. Take his intro class! I wish he offered more classes! I would take him again happily

TAKE HIM FOR THE INTRO CLASS!!! Amazing guy, and teacher really KNOWS what hes talking about. He makes the lessons very interesting work is easy if you like sports, and he really enjoys what he does. You wont be disappointed.

Everything you could ask for in a professor. Very nice, funny, super interesting, has the experience in sports to back it up. None of the projects were too hard and he's willing to help you out when you reach out to him. Has helped me realize this is the right career for me. Even if just as a gen ed, if you like sports or business, take this!
I have no words to describe how awesome he is. Go to class and take notes and you'll definitely get an A!

He is a great teacher.  He knows what he is talking about and is very helpful.  He has a lot of connections and it in charge of internships.  The tests are really easy as long as you go to class and take notes.  Just put effort into work and hand it in on time.  One of the best teachers I've had so far.

Great professor, he is nice and helpful, and encourages everyone to participate in class when not taking notes. All you need to do is reach the deadline on all projects which are fairly easy to complete and write exactly what is written on the powerpoints and i promise you will get atleast an A-. also attend every class.

Lectures can be boring sometimes but he cares about what he teaches and it's the best way to get good grades.  I did the best on exams when I was attending the lectures.  He gives clear instructions on what will be on exams and practise problems.

reviews.comment: Not a tough course at all if you study his notes.. Learnt a lot..
One of the best professors I have ever met. Clear board notes and presentations. Always willing to help. Not only state theories but also give examples and ideas behind the theories.
Really nice man, and willing to help you with homework. Goes over all the tests and fair grader.

Pestien is a very knowledgeable professor and straight forward. His tests are a bit long for the time that we are given but he usually give similar questions to the examples we do in class. For his office hours, once he stops telling you to look at the notes from class that of course I personally didn't take, are very helpful.

Very helpful lecturer. In one of the comments I have seen that he is not helpful once we've been to his office, but that is not true. He is really helpful and a great teacher. If you take statistics with him he will even teach how to use R and we can actually use it for homeworks which is great. I really like that class.

My only complaint is that in my class he rushed through difficult things and spent much time on tangents and reviewing basic concepts, but overall he is a knowledgable professor and explains what you need to know for tests and quizzes very clearly.  Also, the curve he uses is very helpful.

Nice Guy who gives help when you ask but he tends to ramble on problems for too long and can't hold my attention. I ended up learning the math on my own. Also he is rather specific on how problems should be done and wants you to show mundane steps.

Professor Pestien was a very entertaining guy, and a good professor. His tests and quizzes were difficult, but not impossible (with a lot of studying). There really isn't enough time on the exams, so you have to get used to working quickly.

He is the worst math teacher I've ever had. He does not give you enough time for tests, and is very rude if you go to his office hours for help. The problems he assigns do not relate to his tests. I've heard he is better at higher level math- but he doesn't like students in lower math classes.
Fantastic math professor
Tests are similar to homework problems.  Homeworks aren't hard but can be very long.  Also, if you don't understand a homework problem you can ask him and his hints practically give away the answer.
I wouldn't pick him. He is very confusing. Tests are ridiculously hard and he doesn't give you enough time. BAD CHOICE

I took Discrete Math from prof. Dvorsky and got a D because I just could'nt understand him. Then I took it from Pestien and actually enjoyed the course. Hes an excellent teacher and I got a B the second time around. He makes the subject matter interesting and clear. I will try and take all of my remaining math classes from him.

Dr. Pestien is a good Midwestern man. He is a little eccentric and sometimes wacky but he is a good teacher and easy to understand. I had him for honors Calc II. It had been a year since I took Calc I and I was worried I would struggle starting off, but we reviewed some calc I and the moved into Calc II so I never really struggled. quizzes and exam

Linear Algebra is tricky to catch onto, but Mr. Pestien went out of his way to help myself and others and structured the test/hw structure in a way that it was easy to bring up your grade if you did lousy at the start. Fun guy, if a bit wacky.
No Comments
I got a B in this class not because i didnt know the material but because I would not have time to finish the tests.Very good teacher though...you can get an A if you can work quickly and study hard
His class was not that hard and I understood everything, but his tests were long and having to take them in 50 mintutes you fun out of time, and you rush to finish.

I absolutely love him and ahd him for HIS 333 and 334. He is clearly so passionate about what he teaches and has a deep knowledge of the material. He is also kind and genuinely cares about his students. As long as you show you care and try your best, you will do well in the class.
Wonderful professor, loved both his classes!

Honestly, professor Harling is a very nice person, just not the right professor for me. He moves very fast pace and drowns you with readings. I have never received a poor grade on an essay until this class. I really wish I had a better experience. He cold calls on you so be prepared, and read.

reviews.comment: I LOVE this man. Really fascinating lectures and genuinely cares about his students. Take him!

I have had the good fortune to take two classes with Dr. Harling, and his passion for the courses he teaches truly does shine through his lectures and discussions. reviews.comment: Prof Robins truly cares about his students. He is always available to help students if they're struggling. Pay attention in class and it will be easier. A really great guy who's extremely knowledgable about the world & economics. He's a great professor.

I did not find him to be a good professor at all. His lectures were really boring and honestly useless because he read straight off the powerpoint. I found that his tests were nothing like the practice tests. If you aren't too keen with economics I would take a different professor!

I enjoyed his class and he was a nice professor! His lectures can be "dry" at times, but he keeps them "on point" and interesting! reviews.comment: DO NOT SKIP CLASS. If you miss less than three classes (or none) he gives you an entire letter grade boost at the end of the year. It was a big class so I wouldn't try to kiss up... Good prof!

reviews.comment: He is very knowledgeable, and can be helpful if you reach out. I learned a lot in his class, and though it was stressful at exam time, if you read the powerpoints you'll do OK. reviews.comment: Straightforward class, exams weren't too difficult. Gave a full grade boost for extra credit if you missed two or less classes(B to A, B- to A-, etc...).

Prof Robins is a nice guy, not a bad teacher. We had 4 tests (1 take home), that we're moderate in difficulty. For the most part, he reads right off his Powerpoints, but sometimes he does get side tracked. He always let us out 15-30 min early. He bumps up grade a full letter if you don't skip more than twice.

Professor Robins is a quality professor at UM.  Does not use powerpoints so attendance is important and classes are lecture/discussion-heavy.  Offers extra credit at the end of the semester if you dont miss more than 2 classes.  If you go to class everyday and pay attention, this course will not be too difficult. Highly recommend this professor.

If you have no interest in Economics, please refrain from taking this course with him. The class is structured quite simple, yet his teaching habits are not clear. He gives your practice tests in the notes that are similar in structure, so that does help a little. If you want to be spoon fed, he is NOT the guy for you.
4 tests 25% a piece.  if you get a 87 average you'll get an A- with the curve.  great teacher really funny and tests are 100 percent off power points.  good class i would recommend him.

He is a great professor! However he sometimes loses his focus during class... for this reason he sometimes rushes the subject during classes, pre study is totally necessary for this class. Totally recommended him tough. Great explanations and always willing to help :)

Professor Robins is an awesome professor.  He is professional, but keeps class interesting.  Attendance is mandatory and you get extra points if you don't have any unexcused absences at the end of the semester.  I never opened my book all semester.  Powerpoints and practice quizzes are all you need.  Curve on your final course grade. :)
was extremely rude to me and asked me to drop the class because I was not a business major.

Great guy. 3 exams and a final all non-cumulative and only MC. His exams are mainly based on powerpoints, you dont really need the textbook. I've gotten A's studying a day before. Definitely do the chapter reviews that he gives you. Pay attention in class too.

I thought Econ would be the most boring class ever, but Professor Robins did a wonderful job of keeping me interested. He does take attendance, but the tests are all multiple choice and super easy. I would definitely recommend him.
pretty easy but very boring...do not need to buy the new text book at all...his slides are an outline of each textbook chapter he only gives four tests now so not as easy

this guy should have retired.. he's completely boring. Dont waste almost 200 on the book he says its mandatory and then doesn't even use it. you have to go to all the classes and he always takes attendance and he gave a test the day after halloween.

nice guy...reminds me of the guy from the "clear eyes" commercial. he is fair, but the class is tricky. if you try u can get an A if u dont u can get a B/B-. if u can, take him cause he teaches off powerpoints that are helpful
BORING. Least favorite class at UM. Tests are unfair and impractical. DONT TAKE

Very boring, but nice and very easy teacher.  He gives 8 quizzes and a final and you can drop the lowest quiz.  Some of the quizzes are tricky so study the practice quizzes because the questions are virtually the same as the quiz

Prof Robins is a great teacher! He makes economics easy to learn! Attendance is a must but if you don't miss any days you get 16 extra points. PS: he hates BillGates and his felt tip pen!
he is really easy and can be funny. 9 easy big quizes that are not cumulative...i jujst studied the powerpoints right before the quizes and had no problems

Easy Class.  Attendance mandatory

Just a terrible all around professor. In an engineering school with such great professors, Dr. Liu stands out as clearly the worst. He is terrible at explaining things. Pretty interesting class, however, he is somewhat boring. If you're willing to put in a little bit of effort and read the assigned chapters none of this is very difficult.
Waste of time.

She is a very considerate professor and gives sound advice !
