Excellent presenter of subject matter. She very passionate about teaching and her students understanding the subject. She is articulate, helpful, thorough, challenging, great personality, and ethical. I would recommend taking any class she teaches - you would not be disappointed. She's also easy on the eyes.

Excellent Professor!  Very knowledgeable on the subject, motivates students to learn and participate in class.  The syllabus was very reasonable.  Great class, would take other courses with this professor.  I definitely recommend her.

she's the coolest!!!

Professor Shwind is great. He's really funny and he makes the class interesting by keeping people engaged. This class demands quite a bit of reading, so be prepared. Otherwise, the topics discussed are very interesting and as long as you make an effort to keep up, you'll be fine.
Very Intelligent Professor! Really wants his students to care

I really liked this class! He is a great professor who truly cares about the material. He does have an accent, but you should have no problem understanding him. This class demands around 3 hours of reading per class.

I really enjoy taking his class. Very motivated, well prepared. He has a slight accent, but I had no problem understanding him.
this dude is ok. cant understand has an annoying accent but if you just go to class youll be fine

Dr.Pinto is a great teacher. She is very knowledgeable, and she cares about her students. You will get a good grade if you just engage with the material a little. If you have any interest in environmental issues, I strongly recommend taking this class.

Professor Pinto is a wonderful professor—kind, supportive, and always encouraging. I love that she makes the class so engaging. In ECS 113, there are no exams or quizzes, which makes it a relatively easy class where students can focus on learning the course content.

This is one of the easiest classes here, only graded by weekly two-page reflections and no exams or quizzes. Dr.Pinto is so kind and is there to answer any questions you might have. There's a final public notice presentation, but she also talks you through that. I took for my minor but also a great cognate class. Taking her again for ECS 310.
Super smart, good lectures, super easy maybe one or two exams. Weekly writing assignment and one big writing project at the end. Very accessible and very excited to get people into this field!

Love Professor Pinto. She is super sweet and the class is not hard at all. As long as you turn in the weekly assignments you will do good. There are no exams, but if you aren't interested in the content it can be a little boring.
Was a very easy class to do well in. You can tell Dr. Pinto really cares about her students and as long as you turn in all the work on time you should do well.

There are weekly reflections, but they aren't super long to write and she grades them pretty leniently. There's also a final writing assignment that is spread throughout the entire semester. Overall, a really nice and caring professor who makes class pretty easy to succeed in.

Dr. Pinto is an amazing and interesting person and she really cares about her students. She loves group participation and hearing your thoughts about topics discussed in class. She struggles with technology sometimes which can interfere with class, but usually ends class early. She is a very easy grader so you should have no problem doing well!

She is the absolute nicest prof and has such a cool career background. The class is very writing intensive but shes an easy grader. Its very hard to stay focused in class because she jumps around topics and doesn't finish her sentences (which can get annoying). One dense final paper, not outlined very specifically, but not strict grading. She rocks

Dr. Pinto is such a nice, interesting teacher. I find ECS 113 lectures really cool. I highly recommend her for 113, she's funny, caring, and reasonable.

I had Professor Pinto for ECS 112 (NOT 113). I have had her for other courses and she is a very impressive, kind teacher. Her grading is easy and she provides helpful feedback. However, she is very much all over the place and unorganized. She rarely finishes her sentences as she jumps from topic to topic. But get to know her and take her classes!

Professor Pinto is a genuine and kind person. She is super knowledgeable about environmental science and policy from her work as a researcher and lawyer. Very easy grader, as well. She brought in some great guest lecturers for the Thursday classes. However, her lectures aren't fluid, as she often doesn't finish her thoughts.

very sweet and cool! she has had lots of work experience and is very knowledgeable, but makes it harder for her to explain basic concepts. will jump around subjects and can't finish a full sentence. only writing; we write a 2 paged reflection each week and a final paper (that will not be explain well at all) but she is a super easy grader. no tests

I loved Professor Phillips; she really made herself accessible, and the assignments were easier to understand. I was never lost with any assignments, and it was like each assignment was built on the last one, which I really liked. The only thing is she's really serious about no tech (laptops, cellphones, etc.).
Phillips is a sweet professor and a very easy grader. It is super easy to do well in her class. At times it can be hard to understand what she means and she yaps a lot.

Prof. Phillips is one of the most amazing writing teachers I have ever had. She is super kind and very understanding. None of her assignments are difficult and she gives plenty of time to do them. Your grade comes from a couple essays and maybe like 3 other discussion assignments. Loved her so much I am taking her for eng 106.

reviews.comment: WRS105. Super nice person, and I really appreciate how she was willing to work with me on some personal matters that affected my attendance. This is a very easy class, but I don't think I improved as a writer whatsoever, since I never got 1 piece of feedback. Her classes were annoying because we just sat there, but better than more work.
This was the easiest class and she was a very easy grader. Lectures are boring and assignments are often confusing and unclear, but she kinda accepts anything.
She is a super easy grader. Classes can be boring and seem like wasted time but the assignments are really easy. Take her if you want to get an easy A.

Professor Phillips might be my favorite professor I've ever had. She is so kind, interesting, and funny. She genuinely cares for her students and likes to get to know you. She's super flexible, gives good feedback and is an easy grader. Take her if you can it will be very worth it.
She's great, this class is super easy and she is not a tough grader.

she is so amazing and kind! her essays arent very hard and she gives you a lot of time to write them. shes so sweet and is really flexible. I would definitely recommend her. please take her if you can!

BEST PROF EVER!! She is super caring, and her lectures have taught me so much. I will 10000% take a class with her again. Her grading criteria is super clear and is an easy grader. I enjoyed every moment in her class and formed good relationships with my classmates too. The class was like a second home. Take her if you can you won't regret it!!

Just a WARNING - this woman will ramble on for hours about nothing and drive you insane. TRIGGER WARNING: she turns one comment into a full discussion and doesn't shut up. But, it's the easiest A you'll ever get. If your other options are hard classes, take her but just know you'll be trauma bonded with your classmates!

This professor has a simple and clear guideline for what she expects on your papers. 4 papers throughout the semester that allow revisions for a higher grade. Attendance is expected and mandatory as you have only so many absences until your grade drops. Professor Phillips was such a sweet and understanding professor.

Take her for writing, although we wrote 4 papers, they were all very easy and everyone in the class got between a 95-100% on each one. The only other responsibilities for this class were one grammar presentation and one current event presentation which are extremely easy. The grading criteria is super easy to understand. Great teacher.

reviews.comment: She was an interesting professor, she's super nice and understanding. I love the way she reads papers and the feedback she gives. Definitely an easy class as long as you show up and do your essays.
TAKE HER CLASS!!!! Just do yourself a favor. She is the absolute sweetest lady ever with such a kind soul. You will enjoy going to her class. You can have real conversations with her. Take it!

HIGHLY RECOMMEND! Phillips is an amazing profesor who cares about her students. Class is very easy going and not stressful at all. She is very kind and loves her job. Not mean at all, and very respectful. Assignments are not difficult and gives lots of time to complete. If you do not like your grade she allows you to resubmit for a better grade.

I did not enjoy Philips. She is not mature emotionally and often said insensitive things in class. With that being said, the class is easy - like VERY easy. She also always says "Can we disconnect?" implying that everyone is on their phones (which they are). That just bugged me. If you can look past that then take her but she is annoying at times.

reviews.comment: She's honestly kind of annoying but such an easy grader it's worth it. The classes themselves are boring and pointless but your grade is just 2 easy papers and a final project so it's really not difficult at all. She's a very nice lady, just slightly irritating since she talks so much about absolutely nothing.

A little weird and crazy, loves to ramble, sometimes even interrupting students, but she doesn't do it out of spite, she's just a little crazy. All of that is worth the easy grading, though. She doesn't expect or ask for a lot, gives great feedback, and allows you to do essay corrections. Very easy class.

Professor Philips is so kind and a great professor. I definitely recommend her 105 class. There are only 4 papers a semester and she usually gives credit for revisions if you are not satisfied with your grade. Attendance is mandatory but the classes are interesting and interactive so the time goes by fast.

Professor Phillips was a great teacher for a required class and doesn't ask too much of us. Not allowed to be on electronics in class and she has a strong liberal perspective so I tend to alter my papers to lean that way. Overall simple class and I recommend.

Love this professor. She genuinely cares about your mental health. 4 papers over the semester but you can advise any of them if you don't like the grade. Very chill in class and doesn't expect too much from us. Definitely recommend taking her.

I loved Prof Phillips! She is so down-to-earth and engaging. You have 4 essays the entire year with a reflection at the end. If you like to write and write about something you're interested in, you will get a good grade. She loves people who like to share their work and who go in to meet with her over their essays. 100% recommend.

reviews.comment: Professor Phillips is the best. Actually cares about students mental health and passing. Super easy A if you just show up. Lets you revise any essay you want for a better grade and super approachable.

She is the sweetest professor at UM. Seriously, if you have the chance to take her, do yourself a favor and DO IT! You will not regret it. We had four assignments and she gives you a chance to revise every essay to improve your grade. She was very considerate of other stress factors this semester which I really appreciated. LOVE HER.

One of my favorite professors so far. I took her for English 105 and 106 (both online only) and she was so considerate, engaging, understanding, and also taught us important information very well. I had an A both semesters and barely received homework, she's not a hard grader at all. I wish she taught more classes but so glad I had her this year!!

Professor Phillips is so sweet. She really cares about her students and wants them to do well insides and outside of the classroom. She doesn't grade too hard and doesn't pile on too much work. Took the class online and she didn't seem to take attendance or care too much.

My favorite professor by far! She cares a lot about her students and will make sure you understand her material. I only had 4 papers to write for her class, and she made sure we liked what we were writing. She is very understanding too.
Professor Phillips was my favorite teacher. She truly cares about her students. There were about 5 total papers that weren't hard at all, and she grades pretty easily. No final or midterm

It's a very simple class, but it's a little boring
I love Samantha Phillips! She was an amazing professor. Clear grading criteria. Also super easy grader! Take her!

Professor Philips is such a sweet woman. I really enjoyed taking her class and I really felt as if my writing got better at the end. Her classes are fun and when asked she gives good feedback. It's four papers and every paper you have the chance to rewrite it to get a better grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: The best professor ever. She is always so helpful and gives good grades. She motivates her students a lot and you can never get bored in her class.

Prof Phillips is the best english teacher and very kind. Classes are easy, just sit there. There are four papers, she's not a harsh grader at all and you can also revise an essay to get a better grade. Take her if you can.

Professor Phillips is a nice and caring woman, however I found her class to be extremely boring and not challenging at all. If you are looking for an easy A this is the class for you, but if you are looking for your writing to progress I suggest another professor.

The best professor I could've had at the beginning of my time here at UM. She is so welcoming, the most accepting professor, has so much knowledge on the topic, and if she sees that you're putting effort in, she will give you a good grade. A great person too, as she gets to know you as a student also.
sweet lady, not super hard class, she is a little off and takes a while to get used to but would definitely recommend. .
Professor Phillips is super nice and gives great feedback on your essays and assignments. The class is pretty dry though, especially when people don't participate.

Professor Phillips is absolutely great and cares about students! Are you a CS major? Then her tech-related 106 class is going to be your best bet! The class consisted of two papers, a pitch for the final project, and the project itself (video, magazine, website, or presentation). Very few assignments, so that you can focus on your papers / project.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Phillips is super friendly and gives a lot of good feedback on papers. you do have to write several papers but not more than any other teacher for this class. topics are also very broad so you have a lot of choice in what you want to write about. class isn't that exciting but it's also pretty easy

SUUUUPER easy eng105 class.  If you aren't a big fan of english, this is probably the best class for you.  There are only 4 papers and the topics are basically open.  If you write every paper and show up, you should receive the easiest A of your life.

Professor Phillips is such a sweet person. She's genuinely caring about her students and if you don't do well, she lets you rewrite it and takes the higher grade. There are 4 essays having to do with the topic of teens assigned frackers in advance and an end of course reflection paper. Class attendance is mandatory or your grade will suffer.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Extremely sweet, wants her students to do well. If you show up and ask for feedback on your papers, it's an easy A. Homework is super rare and assigned in advance, and there's no assigned reading. If you want an easy A with a nice professor, take her class.

Easy class. Just four papers, each one you can revise, and she'll take the higher grade for each with no downside. Easiest A you will ever get. She is incredibly nice, and can be flexible with due dates. Need to take English 105? Take her.

Professor Phillips was really chill. Enligsh 105 consisted of four papers all of which you are given a lengthy amount of time to complete and she is a relatively easy grader. She does take attendance even though during class you don't really do much. As long as you stay on top of your assignments and show that you care, you should get an A

100% RECOMMEND TAKING HER TECHNOLOGY ENG106 CLASS. I absolutely hate English & writing papers but I ended up w/ an A because Prof. Phillips is amazing! The material was super interesting and relevant, and she is willing to help you so much. 2 papers and 1 multimedia project, but she gives you so much time to work on everything. Definitely recommend

She's such a nice person and very lenient at grading. English is my least favorite subject so I was just getting it over with but she made the class really easy and tolerable for people with no interest in English. We didn't really do much in class besides talk, watch videos, and find interesting articles on the internet. Definitely recommend!

Professor Phillips is awesome. She is lenient grading papers and is always willing to help you. She sparks an interest in the subject and makes students look forward to her class. Even though English is my least favorite subject, I really enjoyed the class! Take her!
If you participate, she will love you, and you are guaranteed a good grade if you write decent. She is very helpful and kind.
Topics were mildly interesting but I learned pretty much nothing in the class and found it to be a waste of my time.
I was on the border between an A and an A- and she bumped me up to an A. She is a great person and keeps class fun. I hate English but I enjoyed this class. I definitely recommend her.
Class was very easy! She is very nice and grades very easily. She is very helpful and her subjects are fun. I hate english and I even loved this class. Highly recommended!
good teacher. very helpfull
shes a great teacher

I wask skeptical before taking this class, but the topic is very interesting and easy to write about, "Teens and the Old/New Media". She is an easy grader and is enthused about the class. She allows 2 paper revisions. The final paper was actually a project and could have even been a movie.
Easy

She is adorable. She's so helpful and so genuinely nice. She's always excited to share current events and stories. If you participate in class at all she will really like you and give you a better grade, I'm taking her again next semester along with my entire class, we all love her!

This teacher is really nice. She's quirky and funny. She like s to share current events involving teenagers in class. She always comments papers and really helps you when you're stuck and can't write. I enjoyed her class :)
Take her comments seriously and rewrite the papers according to her comments.  Participate in class and get on her good side.

The class is hella easy but soooooooooooooooooo boring. I mean, yeah the topic of teens can be intering but i didnt really experience that. You wont learn a thing but at least if you do bad on your papers, you can revise them.

Easy class if you are a decent writer and she gives you the opportunity to revise 2/3 essays. I don't recommend this teacher if you are looking to broaden your writing skills and if you enjoy english class; however, this is an extremely easy class.
SO EASY.
talk to her alot and she will like you. really easy but not the best english teacher if it's your major

really easy teacher. we sit in a circle and discuss stories. you have to write 2 stories. we usually go off topic and discuss something else. i feel like i am in middle school when i am in this class. its a funny class

She is pretty easy and the class is about teenagers so the papers are interesting and easy. Its possible to get an A in this class. If you ask her to read your essay during the peer review it is really helpful. Take her

I guess I'll be the first to rate her - The class I took was based on teenagers in the US, it should be retitled to Female teens in the US b/c this teacher was pretty feminist to me.  Overall she's a pretty nice lady that means well and is really easy in class. She grades you based on essays, if you're a girl most likely you'll get an A, if your a  guy you'll probably get a B+ and just have to revise it to get the A or A-.  You pretty much have to write what she wants to hear and then you'll get on her good side.  You don't really do anything in class, I missed 7 classes, never did any peer reviews, just revised essays and ended up with an A-.

Nice guy but this class will take up all your time. He takes forever to grade, the semester is over and I still haven't received a grade for my first essay. He also assigns way too much work, hard for students to keep up and hard for him to keep up with the grading.

The guy is chill & will respond to emails/willing to give extensions but the workload is insane. He assigns about 3 "STARs" (LONG readings, annotating, and answering questions) every week, which aren't hard to do but SO time-consuming. He also takes so long to grade assignments, like our essay due on Mar19 still hasn't been graded to this day.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This class needs a lot of your time, but every assignment has a purpose. He assigns 5-10 articles a week that you will have to annotate and answer questions on. While it is time consuming, I genuinly feel like I got a lot of out of it and became a better writer. He is super nice, understanding, and gives chances to recieve extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This class is the absolute DEATH of me. It's the most amount of work I've ever done for any class I've taken at UM and it's a first year writing class. Papers are complicated and very specific, and he grades extremely hard so if it's not a great paper, then you will not get a good grade.

IF YOU ARE AN LGBT+ STUDENT: Please be aware that you may feel uncomfortable in this class. In ENG106, Pici focuses a lot on "primal mating habits and desires" that influence the way we date today. Everything was sexualized in an extremely heteronormative way, and honestly it made me very uncomfortable. Very mysogynistic alpha wolf pseudoscience-y.

There's way too much work to keep up with and lots of work over breaks so you need to work overtime to catch up. He loves to ramble about unimportant topics and would leave the most interesting topics for the end so we always got out late.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He is passionate about the topics, and I personally find them interesting, but he leaves so much homework. Lots of lectures and gave me back my paper 1 the day before paper 2 was due.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I really liked Pici. Nice guy and knew what he was talking about. I found the essays difficult but got As on all of them. If you go to the writing center you get a grade boost so that helped me a lot. He made the class interesting and engaging I would definetely recommend.
Pici is a great and very intelligent teacher. If you are a curious person and are willing to do some extra work then definitely take this class!

Pici is a very good teacher, just A LOT OF WORK. I recommend him as a good teacher but his course has an ungodly amount of homework. Please take this into account, if you are someone that puts off homework, do not take this class. There is a lot of readings so you need to keep up with it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Pici is a very nice professor, but, his homework includes reading several articles and journaling on each one. The lectures are very dense and the papers are incredibly complicated, with almost no time to write them. He gave me my grade back for the first paper the night before the second was due. Class is very homework-heavy, beware.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: There is so much work in this class. HW due before every class, and there's usually about an hour and a half of reading and journaling for each HW. Good teacher, though. He has super interesting lectures with videos and discussions. Would never take Pici again, but not complaining, even though there really is an ungodly amount of work.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I am an English major, and this class was EXTREMELY difficult. He assigns an excessive amount of busy work that takes forever to complete with little to no pay off. His papers are incredibly specific and long, yet he only gives us about a week to complete them. The subject was interesting, but definitely not worth it. This class really drained me.

Professor Pici is a nice guy and tries to be engaging in class, but the class is just not it. He assigns way too much reading which is followed by journal entries every class. Major assignments are not difficult, but his instructions are very vague. Also material is just not what I thought it would be. It's very BORING.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Really enjoyed his class but I will say you definitely need to be passionate or heavily interested in the topic if you want to succeed. Does give more than average amount of homework but is very lenient with due dates so as long as you turn them in at a reasonable rate you will be good. Very generous person who makes class worth attending.

The Good: cool teacher and the lectures are interesting, covering a large scope of texts in the topic (The Psychology of Love and War). The Bad: the readings. So many readings. Every class he will assign anywhere from 4-10 articles ranging in length, some upwards of 20 pages in a scientific journal. And he assigns one 8, 10, and 12-page paper.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Pici, oh Pici. This class has SO MUCH homework. Readings and journals for every class. There were 3 essays and one had nothing pertaining to the topic of psychology of love and war. The others required close readings of MULTIPLE articles and short stories. Hes a cool guy, but also a little weird and has uncomfortable eye contact.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: SO much homework for a gen ed. DO not take him if you aren't willing to put in more time than necessary. Really nice and understanding guy
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Hes a nice guy, but gives waaaaaaay too much homework. This was my most time consuming class and I was taking classes like calc which gave less homework than this. Def a nice guy tho.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Such a great teacher, you can tell he cares about his students and the course material is really interesting. The papers you write are long and cover a lot of information but as long as you keep up with readings you should be well prepared and he is usually flexible with due dates. Definitely take him if you have the option!

Amazing professor. Really cares about his students and is very understanding. This class is extremely thought provoking and rewarding. Just be prepared to write but he will take you through step by step.
Do not pass up on the opportunity to be in his class!! One of the most interesting, fun, engaging classes ever. He cares about each student and is extremely fair.

Pici is an AMAZING professor. Even with the switch to online due to the virus he continued to make the class simple and understands everything is different now. Very engaging class and not challenging. Best professor I have had.

Professor Pickens is such a great professor, I adore her! She is very knowledgeable, kind, and informative. She is very open to many different perspectives and opinions. The class I took was a breeze, not stressful at all. She is also super organized and it's nice for students who need structure. Would def take her again

Professor Pickens is a nice lady, and super understanding. The class is an easy A as long as you make sure to turn in your response papers that are only 1-2 pages long. The only thing is that since she makes class very discussion/participation (participation isn't mandatory) based, class can be a bit dull sometimes.

I cannot express how much I LOVED having Dr. Pickens as a professor. She is so helpful and gives incredible feedback on papers. She does contract grading so you're basically guaranteed an A. The writing is very open ended so it's always easy. Highly recommend this class.
Pickens is a super nice lady and good at giving feedback, but her lectures can be quite boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great teacher. Gave great and honest feedback on papers. Also, she is very nice and caring when you meet with her. I would take one of her classes again in the future if possible.

She's quirky, and her lectures can be a pain, but she's an easy grader and she genuinely cares. She gives great feedback on your rough drafts, and as long as you follow her advice you'll definitely pass.

Awesome professor. Such a nice person and always makes sure to give one-on-one feedback on rough drafts to ensure a good grade. Takes attendance so make sure to go to class but you will enjoy this class and it will most likely be an easy A

She is a very nice lady who is willing to help you whenever you need it. Her essays are interesting and explained very well so you always know what to expect from her. Overall nice experience and I really enjoyed writing about the prompts that were assigned. I recommend her.

I love Professor Pickens!!! She is great. She makes the class interesting and gives great feedback on papers and writing assignments. I missed class a lot last semester because of track and we went over the notes and my papers in her office hours. She is very flexible when it comes to meeting with people in her office hours! Effort is important!

Pickens is a great professor! She is super nice and flexible and offers meetings to discuss the essays which helps tremendously (and you get the whole week off during this time!)! Class focuses on one theme, there are 3 essays and a final portfolio which includes revised versions of all 3 plus an intro and conclusion that links them together.

She's a sweetheart <3, working with her is easy and she gives good grades even if you're not that good. However, you have to show her that you're making some effort. Her goal is always to make you write better and write in an advanced and interesting way. I just love her!!! she is also very understanding...

Really easy teacher who is more than happy to help you. Some of her essays are a little difficult to get started on but she's an extremely easy grader. Her class isn't the most interesting but it's worth it if you want an easy A.
The best english teacher I have ever had in my whole life! take her!!!
Easy class, just do your essays. Prof. Pickens is very helpful and kind.
THE BEST!!! She actually made English so interesting even at 8:00am. You learn so much & expand your mind!

the essays she assigns are pretty open-ended so can be complicated to get started on, but she really helps you with your topic. all you have to do is speak up in class, try your best, and ask for help if you need it and you'll do fine.

Although the professor and I bumped heads, she was very nice and helpful. If you're an analytical student and tend to overthink things, I don't recommend you take this course. Very easy overall, make sure to be very specific when writing. No final, worth it in the end. Show up to class and participate, she likes that.
TAKE HER!
Amazing Professor! Willing to help with essays pretty much anytime. Only 4 essays total and no final. Really easy A if you write well and use the text to support your writing.
Excellent professor, coming from an individual that almost dropped the course because it sounded intimidating at the beginning. Only 4 papers no final. She is extremely helpful.

A very good teacher. Will go out of her way to help you and is a very nice professor. You have to do a decent amount of work, but if you put your time into the class, you will receive a good grade. I would definitely take her again in the future.
She is excellent! Very helpful, only 4 essays and no final. She is wonderful. Very sweet and smart.
Professor Pickens was great! She made the class fun. Only 4 papers. No final. She's also very flexible! Take her if you can.
She is extremely nice and is always avaliable to help. Her class is easy. 4 papers and no final. She's flexible in turning in papers if you need more time. I'm taking her again for 106! =)
This guy is the most condescending man ever. Literally speaks down to students as if they are less than him and is so unhelpful. Wish the University would not hire guys like him.

TA for the class didn't really matter, the physics department has the easiest labs, compared to orgo labs-- these are a JOKE. We did all of our reports in class and 3 quizzes throughout the 12 weeks with no final. Class is just pre-labs, lab reports, and quizzes and that's it. Although did NOT like that reports were graded like percentile.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: condescending and belittling, i dropped the class as soon as i spook with him, professor like him give higher ed a bad name, the disrespect shown by this individual to3ard students and staff is embarrassing. please trust me and save yourself any trouble and not take any class with this "professor"

Easy class, but the lectures are boring to follow, prof gets quite loud, and he treats students as unaware and explains things over and over as if we are elementary school children. Assigns a lot of homework and makes sure to take every class right to the very end (attendance also mandatory). Would avoid - lots of easier bird courses out there.

He is such a nice guy & a great professor; he is super passionate about what he teaches! Super lenient with everything, he just cares about people learning. All the evaluations and the final are online, very straightforward.

Ali is awesome. Seriously cares about his students and deeply cares about climate change / inspiring each student to make a change in the world. He's accessible and responds almost immediately, many opportunities for extra credit, and overall an amazing teacher. Take this class!!

Professor Pourmand is such a nice guy! He is extremely enthusiastic when it comes to lecturing and can sometimes get really loud but other than that, he is the best. Attendance is not mandatory and all of his tests are online, his class is overall an easy A. Going to miss how flexible he is!

Ali is an amazing professor and an even better person. He always brings great energy to the classroom and I actually learned so many new things in this course. Super caring and understanding as well. I wish every professor at UM shared his passion for teaching.

I have never written a review but professor Pourmand is hands down one of the best I have ever had in my life. His lectures are great and overall class is easy. Makes science interesting and accessible to everyone. Highly recommend to anyone

Professor Pourmand is a great teacher and very understanding, most people take GCS 107 as a cognate and he understands that, allowing the class to be intresting and fun while extremely easy to maintain a good grade. If u have the chance take him!!

Dr. Pourmand was a great professor, really cares about his students, and is extremely passionate about climate science/geology. He inspires his students to care about the material and was an extremely interesting lecturer (though he does stray off topic). The class has only a few easy assignments and tests are open note and taken as a group.

Ali is great and this class is relatively easy, but it does have a lot of extra work. It's very different from the course description but I didn't mind. There are weekly quizzes and other assignments, and only one test which is the final. Don't sit in the front row, he tends to get passionate about the topic and will shout.
This professor gave great lectures. It was impossible to not pay attention to him; he is clearly passionate about what he teaches. The classes are not too interactive, it is mostly just lecture.

Such a great, friendly professor. I took this class as my cognate and didn't know much about the topics, but prof. Pourmand made this the only class that I looked forward to going to. He's a very easy grader and makes the lectures very clear and engaging. Such a nice and understanding guy! Would definitely take him again.

Professor Ali is literally COOL! He has a vivid sense of humor and makes class both Fun and Interesting. He is a very determined instructor that loves his subject. Grading was very clear. Make sure to do Chapter evaluations and participate in regular assignments. He is also understanding and lenient with his students. Don't think twice, take him!

Pourmand is an incredible lecturer, his passion for scientific subjects exudes in his presentations. You'll never get bored. I'm a non-science major, but if I was I'd be running in line for his next class. Makes complex concepts fun, exciting and engaging while remaining highly educational. I loved my time in this class, excellent elective choice.

This guy is such a dawg for GSC 101. Actually a very good speaker during his lectures. Just read the chapters before the exams and it will be so easy. Plus, he legitimately just helps you during the test if you ask him a question. If I was an actual GSC major or whatever I would've loved to keep having him.

Literally the kindest, most patient and understanding professor ever. He genuinely cares about what he teaches. He knows most of his students aren't GSC majors so he makes his lectures easy to understand. Exams are typically 15 multiple choice questions, open book. I learned a lot from this course and 10/10 recommend this professor.

This class had a lot of information but he made it a lot easier and related past history to today's issues. He really cared about you learning the information and loves when people get involved in the discussion. I would definitely take him again he has such positive lecture. You take the tests in groups and theres a couple homework assignments.

I am not a GSC/MSC major and not only did I learn a lot from him, but also did really well in the class. There are in class chapter quizzes online after each chapter that you can work on as a group. The final is also a group final. Ali is extremely knowledgeable and enthusiastic about what he's teaching. I would 100% recommend.

Dr. Pourmand's lectures are pretty much a regurgitation of the textbook, which is actually pretty useful and interesting to read. The exams are hard though, even when they are open book. Be sure to read the book carefully before the exam, and know where things are, or the exams are going to be difficult. No homework.

There's a quiz on every chapter so you have to read the textbook in order to get a decent grade on them. Theres's no midterm and the final is questions taken straight from the quizzes. Overall an easy class, although attendance is apart of your grade. Overall an easy class with a genuine professor who loves what he does.

There was a quiz every class but they were online and directly from the text.  But the midterm and the final is extremely difficult for a non-major.  The climate science is so hard and is a lot more math than I thought.  However, Ali really worked with me and helped give me extra credit opportunities.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Prof. Powell is very passionate about her Origin Language, so sometimes she can come off as mean but she is very caring. She wants you to do well but isn't going to hold your hand. If she see you trying she is more than willing to help. Overall French is a tough language but she's a great professor 9/10

Every time I joined this class, I was nervous. She is hard, unforgiving, showed no mercy, and sometimes edged on mean. You never know if she is going to be happy or mad in class. I would not take this class if you enjoy french and want to learn. The quizzes are near impossible. I was always afraid to ask questions. If you aren't fluent, dont take.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I got an A in French 201, and I came to her class french 202 and I am seriously struggling, she expects you to be fluent and have perfect grammar. She is not helpful and will often answer with attitude if you have a question. Our entire class is struggling but she thinks it is our fault and we are not trying but that is not the case.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment:
Really great professor. I love his cases because they provide real-life examples of successful business strategies. He really cares about student success and often asks for student input. 
Definitely take.

Professor Derayati is a great person and professor! He cares a lot about his students and does everything he can so students can get a good grade! The class topics may be boring, but he really enjoys the information and wants his class to share his passion for MGT

grades are based on a variety of things including quizzes, project, attendance, and a final exam. It's easy to make up in one area if you lose points in another. attendance is mandatory but he's flexible if you miss classes and have a good reason.
you'll get a good grade if you attend and pay attention. he is always accessible if you need help.
He's not good at explaining anything. Doesn't make an effort to help maybe because he doesn't really know much. Is not approachable. Don't waste your time.

Good teacher in my opinion, exams are pretty straightforward from the slides and he does walk you through the slides to make sure you understand them. Final project he does a good job of making sure you understand whats needed. Id take his class.

Absolute GOAT professor. Lectures are very chill, and he has a lot of insight in his teaching. Very knowledgeable about AI and great to talk to outside of class. The 2 exams are basically straight from the slides, and the group project is an easy A because he tells you everything you need to fix before you submit.

Course work is not heavy. Pick a good group for this class because it'll determine your grade for the rest of the class as it's all group MOU's. He's engaging as a speaker---stories are funny at times and starts off the class with current events. However, he's bluntly racist at times.

Although participation may not be mandatory, you should show up because attendance and participation is worth 20% of your overall grade. This class is reading heavy so if that isn't something you like I would avoid. Sometimes will randomly call on you so be prepared!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Super funny guy. Attendance is not mandatory just make sure he knows your face and you try to participate. Never missed class because he honestly is a great laugh and kinda inspirational sometimes. No homework or tests, just 4 group papers and 1 individual final paper. Super laid-back class. 10/10

A total waste of time. He thinks he is funny, but actually, he is NOT. Maybe his jokes were a thing in the '70s, but you can't be going out there in 2024 with these racism or gender-related comments. I just don't understand how the University allows this.

Classes r lectures about whatever he wants to talk about. grade is based on one page papers that u do WITH A GROUP(he forgot to mention this and ppl got 0s). Get a good group initially bc that is rlly going to determine ur grade. he is a tough grader. attendance isn't 'mandatory' just make sure he knows ur face, answer Qs and try and do readings

This class is relatively unfocused yet still a solid class. Make sure you have a good case group because you will most likely be stuck with them for the rest of the year. You will end up with a decent grade if you turn everything in. I would highly suggest trying to participate since there is a bit more leniency if he likes you. Very political.

Dr. Plant is pretty good. The lectures are conversational so he's actively asking questions. I'd recommend participating. It helps the time pass and there's no pressure. Take him if you're a BT major (he's the head of the department). It's not a 5, because I'm gonna be honest, I'm not sure what I've learned yet. It'd be a good senior class.

This guy is hilarious. Just show up to class and participate occasionally and you'll get a good grade. Don't take his classes if you're a snowflake with no sense of humor because you'll probably just get triggered. Otherwise, I highly recommend him because he's incredibly knowledgable and makes boring topics interesting!

The class was easy it was 3 group case studies and 1 individual final case. He doesn't take attendance ever and ends up giving you a terrible participation grade at the end of the class. He thinks he's a lot funnier than he actually is, and I'm not sure how he is the department head. He also makes very weird racial remarks.

Professor Plant is a quirky british guy. Most of the class was graded based on three exams and a final paper. Most people did not get good scores on his tests, but the class is heavily curved in the end. He is respected and has many connections that might help if you are in the field.

Dr. Plant may have been the strangest teacher/professor I've ever encountered. Least clear expectations of all time. Everyone failed his exams because we literally weren't taught the material then he threw around A's and B's to people for free at the end. He's funny and the class is easy if you don't stress about F's knowing he'll pass everyone

Talks about things that don't matter more than he talks about the class material, which makes the tests hard since you have to teach yourself everything. He claims he knows Elon musk and is neighbors with Lebron and the 76ers owner and he owns a Ferrari and Porsche. He acts like he's all that. I know more about him than tech for sure.
Great Professor. Class is graded on 3 exams and a group project - exams are difficult but curved at the end of they year. Enjoyed this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: You'll get an A in the class but you won't learn. Although he's funny & has a background in tech, he can't teach which is shocking as he's head of the department. Grade consists of 3 group case studies and 1 final individual one. Makes casual comments toward different races which can be construed as derogatory and attendance isn't taken.

Dr. Plant is arguably one of the best teachers I've had. His class structure really forces you to think and develop creative solutions to real world business problems. There are few classes nowadays that truly help you develop important skills. He is also very intelligent and interesting, I would not miss the opportunity to learn from him.
He is a chill professor. The class is based around case studies and class discussions. No exams.

super hard, you have to guess his mind, grades hard does not explain everything clearly at all

Great class; very understanding; material easy to understand

He is a hilarious british guy, knowledgeable, reachable, flexible, understanding. You learn lots of real life experience with him, and he travels a lot. My favorite teacher at the business school. Got me interested in the IT aspect of business. Hilarious, entertaining, but very smart. If you listen and do the work, you will learn plenty.
Great professor! Makes class interesting and entertaining.

She is a good professor.

amazing professor
Best teacher at UMiami!! Really caring, and really socially aware
best teacher at umiami!!

She's an amazing teacher - very kind and willing to help. She wants you to succeed! French is a lot of work to learn though, definitely have to take the time to study to do well. There is extra credit tho that also helps you study.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Primov is a great teacher. FRE 105 is structured differently from other French courses because its an accelerated class that combines 101/102. very clear about what is expected of you in terms of tests, assignments, participation, etc.; the "teaching" is done mainly by you via textbook, but she will clarify anything in class. a decent amount of homework, but also gives out study guides for quizzes & grading rubrics for essays; wants to see you succeed!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The class itself isn't too hard but her grading, especially on the written exams & essays can be subjective. Some weeks you'll have practically no homework and some you'll have tons. If you're reading the book just take notes during class so you're not scrambling for information on your written/oral exam/dissertation. Not particularly easy or hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Great professor, very kind and patient. Always answers questions and gives great feedback! Probably one of the best professors at the school! Especially in the language department, but get ready to do some work, its not a killer but it requires some effort.

Primov is incredibly kind when you go to her office. Class is hard though because she isn't very clear in what she expects from you and moves very fast because it is an upper level french class. There are a ton of homework assignments each night as well. Expect to have grammar exercises, a lecture/reading, and questions related to the reading.

One of the best professors on campus. She is neither easy or hard, but gives way TOO MUCH homework. Sometimes you will have to skip some of it. Her class improved my French dramatically, and she is ALWAYS willing to help you! Take her!

She is not particularly warm, but it helps to show interest in the francophone world. You have to participate in class. She will stare you down or call on you if you stay too quiet. All the participation helps, though, especially if you don't practice speaking often. She is a tough grader, especially on essays, and gives lots of assignments.

She's not particularly easy or difficult but the thing that really gets you was ALL THE ASSIGNMENTS! You end up having so much homework for her that you can never really focus on any of it fully. I don't think it helped me improve my french. But its what you make of it. Like I said, she's not bad but it was TOO MUCH, i didn't enjoy going to class.
Had her for FRE 214. Be ready for challenge, but as long as you can meet her halfway, she'll work with you. She's pretty easy going, and flexible. One of the best professors I've had on campus

As far as 105 goes she is probably the best teacher to take. Though you may feel overwhelmed you'll soon get use to the routine.

ABSOLUTELY IN LOVE WITH HIM, best professor, really funny, did my open note exam without good notes and got a 23/25 because i remember what he taught in class, and the second exam i did bring my notes and got a 24/25

Actually the best teacher I have ever had. He is the kindest and most entertaining teacher you could think of, and makes class super fun and easy. Dean Priepke is that guy.  You're making a mistake if you don't take his class.  Best professor ever, so chill and easygoing, and still deeply cares about all of his students.

He is the BEST professor I have ever had! You are making a HUGE mistake if you don't take him! He wants everyone to succeed and is extremely clear about the grading criteria and class assignments. He is the best and I am so happy I was able to have him as my professor!
best professor ever. so funny and such an easy A for a class. I recommend taking this class if you want to laugh :)

Very kind and caring professor, and funny too. His criteria for grading is clear and wants you to succeed in his course. As long as you show up to class and work on the skills he tells you to for every presentation, you will be golden and it will be a very easy class.

Dean Priepke is literally the man - he's actually really funny and he makes his lectures entertaining too. There's 5 oral presentations throughout the semester. Participation / attendance definitely matters but if you show up do your presentations / work - you'll get an A. I wish he taught more COS classes would definitely take him again.
Really great guy who is passionate about what he teaches and wants you to succeed. Fun class!

He is a very good professor. About 5 speeches. But they are not hard at all. He is really nice about grading. You get points for showing up. Class is worth 100 points so each speech isn't weighted that much.

BEST PROFESSOR EVER!! Extra credit! TAKE!

Professor Puccinelli is great and really one of the best in the psych department. Super nice and accommodating and the class is really interesting. The grade is 4 exams that are super straightforward and fair but do get harder as they go on. He gives points back if most got them wrong and there was a huge extra credit assignment. 
Def take him.

The most whimsical person ever. He's the reason I'm going to pick up a geology minor. His lectures are so informative and engaging, and the field trips are so fun and educational. Purkis is a great teacher. He is super funny and is passionate about what he teaches. There are usually three tests and he gives you an idea of what to study before the test. Easy class for a STEM cognate.

Class was a true pleasure. Would rate him a 10/5 if I could. Amazing lectures, he was not only extraordinarily passionate but explained concepts clearly. I learned so much from Professor Purkis and he made class enjoyable! I loved going on field trips to see real world examples that he was teaching in his lectures. He is always super engaging and is a true geologist. I would take him for any class he offers!

Everyone loves Sam. Good teacher and very easy yet informative class.

Nice professor but is really bad at teaching.  I can barely understand what she's saying.  The book does a better job at explaining the materials than she does

HORRIBLE PROFESSOR!!!!!!! I regret so much to take this class with her. She is a good person, but definitely does not know how to teach the subject. Her exams are not easy and you really need to read the book.

she is one of my nicest professors in UM, she is really helpful and wants you to learn. she tries to talk to you after class (so nice). if she is not retired next semester take her!! i think it will be the easiest managerial acc teacher.

She is easy and very helpful. Go to her office hours and she will always help you on HW and project. Yes, she is boring but the class material itself is very dry. Take her, do the home work prior to exams and get an A.

Ms.Quintana loves what she does and if you get on her good side she is very helpful and willing to take as much time as she can to make sure you understand the subject. I found this out a little too late. Her classes are very boring but I also think the subject itself is boring. Go to her office hours before tests and ask her  help whenever you can
The worst teacher i have ever met!!!

Terrible professor, I had to drop the class so that I can take accounting next semester and actually LEARN the material with a competent professor. Nice lady, gets along with the students, but I just  can't see how she has the job.
She is the worst professor I have ever had, and I have had a few at UM...

I prayed every day before class that she would die and be replaced by a competent teacher. Completely useless as a teacher. Would just read her weak powerpoints word for word which taught you nothing. Had to self teach myself yet had to go to class due to mandatory attendance. She's an obnoxious old woman that single-handedly made me hate accountin

Easily one of the worst professors I have had. Doesn't know how to teach and just reads straight off the powerpoints, which are just as useless in understanding the material.Incredibly boring class, which attendence is mandatory.
This lady doesn't know how to teach, she just reads off the powerpoints.. so expect to learn everything on your own. Exam questions were very unfair. Take someone else if you can.

Worst teacher I have ever had. Attendance is mandatory yet attending is useless. Doesn't teach at all.  Just reads off the PPT slides and goes off on random tangents. Sure she helps you with the project, but it should be her responsibility since she teaches you none of the material. Be ready to do a lot of self-studying.  Take any other teacher.

She is really nice and will help you with the project as much as you want but she can not teach the material clearly. If you can teach yourself the material which is not that difficult then you will get an A. I would recommend her over other ACC teachers.
funny and nice but did a poor job teaching the material.
sweet lady. go to her office hours for help w the project! boring to listen to in class though:(

probably one of the best professors ive had. nice and very helpful. she wants everyone to do well in her class. helps everyone with the project as much as she can and tests are easy as she tells you exactly what to study for them.

Not as difficult and time consuming as ACC211. HW is not checked/collected. Attendence is taken and factored in as participation grade. There is 1 computer project - she helps you with it throughout the course that's the easies way to get it done - 2 exams and the final exam. Exams are multiple choice and not that hard but you have to study.
Watch out for her! She seems nice but she'll get ya!

Terribly boring, both the material and her style.  She drones on in monotone reading to you dreadful powerpoint slides.  A sweet lady, but not very effective.  Also, the Building Blocks project is a complete waste of time.  The spreadsheet is easily crackable which reveals the answers enabling you to do the whole thing in under 20 minutes.
No Comments
No Comments

Easiest accounting class you'll ever take if you don't listen to her. Read the slides or the book and you'll pass her multiple choice exams. she is eccentric at times and goes on a lot of tangents, so just stick to the book.
Wonderful human being.
Make friends with him, pay attention in class, or you will regret it. One of few professors in the engineering school that will go out of his way to help you.

Siva's classes are fun and dense with information. However, if you do not put in the necessary work, you will do badly. Make sure you pay attention to what he says in class, your exams are usually from those discussions.
Siva is the goat. The class will be tough but you will get a lot out of it. I would definitely take his class again.
He's so goated

Take Purcell if you want to be mocked and discouraged. I woke up early every MWF for this 8 am, and his voice would attempt to put me back to sleep. I was actually AFRAID to ask him for help because I thought he'd make fun of me. He's blatantly rude to all his students and very unapproachable. A tutor or workshop is a must if you want to learn.
Horrible and boring. Pretty much 90 percent of the class got a C. I like chemistry and this guy puts me to SLEEP. Not to mention not helpful when you ask something.

Awful.  Ridicules anyone who asks a question, and is rude for no reason.  Explains everything in painful detail, except what will actually be on the test.  Completely useless, and is a poor face for the university.

Really monotoned. but if you can get passed that he's not that bad. Examples in class go well with book. I just read the book a lot and reviewed his notes a lot. Chem111 is not easy but purcell is easier than lewis

wasted $ renting the t.book. taught poorly. VERY discouraging. could not answer questions well, POLITELY, or plainly. accomplished little in class. On top of being at 8, HE made it hard to go to class in the morning.BORING overall (the subject is interesting, but the material was hard to follow). would DEFINITELY go out of my way to avoid him again

Purcell gets a bad rap but he's a good teacher. Strange personality but made chemistry easy for me to understand even tho I had never seen chemistry before in my life!!! Powerpoint presentations are a huge help, if you do those along with the lecture problems and end of chapter questions you should be fine. Very generous curve;)

Exams are pretty fair. He is extremely boring during class, but his examples help with the hw. his old exams are extremely helpful for studying for the exam. The powerpoint solutions also help alot in studying. He provides you with all you need, but sometimes the exams are a bit hard.
Extremely boring teacher.  Talks in a monotone voice.  Would have learned the material better by not attending class and simply doing the reading that accompanies the lectures.

Purcell's class comes down to his exams.  He provides examples of previous questions in his lectures, however, offers no recourse if you make a single calculation error in a string of related questions.  He is condescending and shows no real interest in the students.

Can you say perfect monotone! His voice alone makes you want to go to sleep, add to that the fact that the class was at 8 AM. The book is key to passing this class, you need to do all the assigned homework from the manual plus all the problems in the book if you want to get an A. His final was intense...
What Purcell lacks in personality he makes up for in generous curve. Sorry engineers, unless you take Chem outside UM, you can't sidestep the guy. The guy is <as I shrug my shoulders>, "eh".

Clear prof. Though, DON'T underestimate exams [of which there are only 3 that leap in difficulty]. Partial credit's nonexistent. Solution is exact or wrong. Being a course of about 100 bright up-and-coming engineers with 1-2 HS chems under our belt, impressive GPAs & egos to match, the class avg was a humbling 66% exam after exam. Don't get cocky.

Lectures are useless because he over complicates everything. It's easier to learn it on your own. All three tests were easy but a bit tricky. Final was kind of hard but overall easy A. Reuses a lot of old questions so use the tests from premed 411 and you'll get an A. I know it's an 8:00am class but take him!

Many test questions depend on what type of assumption you make. Don't bother askng any questions during the exam because the TA's don't know and he will actually tell you the wrong assumption to make and then deny it when you ask him about it later....believe me.....it happened to me....coulda gotten an A in that class if not for all his tricks.

So boring. I fell asleep in class everyday. He talks so slow so you only get through 3 problems a day. Tests aren't that hard just do the workbook problems and lecture problems and you will do fine. I hated the class but its not too hard. hes a terrible teacher and isn't that willing to help you. He doesn't explain things well either.

Worst teacher ever! Has been teaching for too long to care about what any of the students think. Makes you feel horrible about asking a question. Tests are impossible even if you study a week before and don't even bother getting a tutor. Drop the class before you even get in or simply don't take it. I'm sorry you are an engineer. Good luck!

This professor is extremely arrogant and rude. Don't ask questions in class because he will shoot you down and make you seem stupid even if your question was reasonable. His homework is easier than the tests because he puts a lot of trick questions on the test to purposely fool you. He is an old bitter man who could care less about his students.

First of all, this has got to be the most boring prof I have ever had! He Doesn't use the book or homework, and the test often contains different materials that wasnt in the lectures. His favorite pasttime seems to be making fun of whoever asks a question, and then spends his lecture time talking about how no one pays attention in his class. he als
Tests extremely difficult, an A is impossible, so don't even bother. Take Lewis because he just sucks.

The material is out of the book. If you do all your homework and all the practice problems, you'll get a good grade. Don't even think about asking a question in class. He is condescending, rude, arrogant and always needs to be perceived as the smartest person around. being the professor you wouldn't think he'd be so insecure.

Class extremely hard things he teaches are not the same things that are on the test. Also he drags on with just talking and making no sense. I got a tutor and he didn?t? even understand the things he was talking about. Try to find a different professor.

He is without a doubt the worst professor I have ever had in college. Im about to graduate so I can honestly say that. He knows ppl think he's easy, so he know is a lot harder than the past. be prepared towork alot. He is so rude and just plain mean. STAY AWAY. Go for Lewis, as of now she is def a better bet. I truly think he should not be teaching
Awful class. You do not learn anything. Tests are easy only if you can teach yourself the material.

This man is the meanest person I have met in my entire life. If you ask him for help he is condescending and rude. I really don't know what his problem is. If he truly hates students as much as it seems he shouldn't be a professor. He'd be better suited for a job at the DMV, where he would fit right in...
Totally useless. Rude, boring, and condescending. Treats biology majors like crap. Insulting and often times outrightly rude to students. DO NOT TAKE.
easiest A on campus. Seriously, way easier than lewis! TAKE HIM. he's just dumb but his tests are just as easy.

ugh! I hate this professor. His lectures are sooo boring, he doesn't care about his students and makes people who ask questions feel stupid. The material is not very difficult but his teaching style makes it more painful than it should be..

Material was rather easy but lectures were boring like nothing else.  Purcell tends to make anybody who dares to ask a question look stupid in front of the class.  Would NOT recommend taking CHM151 with him.
EASY! but one of the most arrogant mother******* ive ever met in my life. he looks at you stupid everytime you ask a joke. tke lewis shes harder but way more clear.
Dr. Purcell is a very good Chemistry Professor. His lectures are pretty boring, but if you show up to all of his classes you will end up with a B- or better.

It's an easy A but the lectures are so boring. I really wanted to fall asleep during class because he talks so slow. But his exams are easy multiple choice and it would be hard to get anything less than a 90. But if you ask him for help he talks down to you and makes you feel stupid. So take him because you learn the material and you get an A.
horrible! i hate his teaching style
He is unintentionally hilarious because of the way he talks.  No, he's not interesting.  Tests are easy.

he is an alright teacher. you cannot ask him a question without him being mean. homework is harder than the tests. tests are really easy since he gives you lecture problems from old tests. just sucks since its an 8 am class.
never use textbook... exams are quite easy... but can learn nothing from the lecture...

I don't know about the other chem professors, but Purcell's class is pretty boring + it's at 8 am, so it's a bad combo.  He talks really slowly and everything is very clear, but if you ask a question you will get a sarcastic answer - not helpful.  I don't think he likes kids.  Tests are easier than HW.
A bit sarcastic at times and can be a real smart ass

He goes over things relatively slowly which is definitely not a bad thing. The powerpoints we could download for the homework really helped. The tests aren't bad at all if you study the homework problems. A bit of advice: the first test is the easiest so really try to do well to have a bit of cushion for the other (harder) ones!

explains things really well, and tests are a breeze if you do the homeowork. Posts very detailed powerpoint solutions to all homeworks. Also, a 76 is a B-! Chem is hard no matter what, but its def. doable with purcell
the teaching isn't that good, the tests are hard, and you must study alot to keep in track

As far as chem professors go, Dr. Purcell is pretty good, but the class is still boring.  The tests are hard because they are so short and not graded for partial credit.  If you do and understand the homework the tests are ok; if not, you'll miss most of the questions.  I suggest getting a study buddy and doing as many practice tests as possible!
No Comments
worst teacher ever!!! Very rude!! Never helps ! Tests seem easy but are tricky, and talks slower than anyone youve ever met in your life making lecture TORTURE!

He is a smartass. Lectures are boring. Weekly HW assignments from the lab manual. Tests seem easy but he puts a lot of trick questions on them. Do not ask him for help. He will make you feel like an idiot and will not directly answer your question.
Good teacher but a bit sarcastic when answering questions. I hated chemistry but understood it with him. for the tests, make sure to go over the lecture notes.*side note: looks like Chapetto

class is extremely easy but just because the material is easy, he is not helpful at all and his class is extremely boring. also, don;t even try to talk to him or ask him any questions, if you need something ask a peer or get a tutor.

guy is a complete ass. If you want to be friends, or even speak to your instructor in class or out, then dont take him. Class is pretty easy though, be sure to get the old tests from previous students, they are really helpful for studying.
Compared to the other teachers he's easy. There's not too much material per exam and his tests are like the homework form the lab book. Prepare and you can pull of an A
No Comments
One of the easier teachers for Chem. at U of M...but most of the science professors are not very good teachers!
Has a pretty good pace when teaching, but doesn't like questions during class... and not approachable after class either.
He makes the class simple. His tests are not really hard, but he asks A LOT of trick questions, so be very careful. Otherwise, he is a good professor.

Purcell is a smartass. Plain and simple. You ask him a question and he makes you feel like an idiot for asking. His lectures are clear and well-structured, but he'll make smart-alec comments like "2 neutrons and 2 protons make 4. At least in the school I come from". Yeah, thanks Purcell!
Only had for a few classes but so far he has been a good prof. He has explained everything thoroughly enough to learn it adequately. Seems like a cool guy.
Horrible professor. Not only is he a bad teacher but he is really mean if you go to him for help. His test aren't hard but you learn nothing.
He isnt very helpful one on one...Can be rude...but overall not bad

I hear is is the best to take out of all the other prof that teach chem 111. He is slow which at most times is a good thing. His lectures could be a little more structured. He is cool though. Exams aren't too hard, but they are short so if you get a few wrong your down to a C.
decent proff
An impressively chaotic individual masquerading as a professor. Apparently, having one's life in order and maintaining a consistent class schedule are optional professional standards in his world.
The course was excellent, and the instructor was outstanding. I would take any other course taught by this instructor.

He's an ok lecturer but also a terrible person. He's cancelled class 10 minutes before it started and has taken points off HW from students that came into class 1 minute late. Exams are reasonable for the difficulty of the class and there's a cheat sheet. The HW and final project are very long. Best tip I can give is to never believe what he says.

reviews.comment: great course overall! one of the best teachers I had!

reviews.comment: Very intelligent and willing to help if you ask.
Great teacher, knows the area very well. one of the best courses I took at UM.

reviews.comment: he is one of the best in the department, the project is very helpful to learn the material, the extra handouts are great too, always available after class.
lots of assignments , great teacher, lots of office hours

Has very little control of the classroom and does not have the respect of the students. In office hours he seems like he does not want to deal with any simple problems. Not compliant with disability services. The material is semi-straight forward but he is abysmal at teaching it.
Very nice guy, always willing to help out in office hours and wants the students to do well.
nice and  patient, clear lectures,  very organized power points

He's not the best teacher I had, but he wasn't the worst. The class wasn't the easiest, but it certainly wasn't the hardest. He was kind of help, but not the most helpful. Honestly, this wasn't the best experience, but it certainly wasn't the worst. He is just a really middle-of-the-pack teacher. You won't love him, but you won't hate him.

After his class I feel super powerful; I can model any real life optimization problem. Cares a lot for his students, listens, has long office hours, answers emails instantly, tells you exactly how to succeed, uploads a lot of helpful information. Gives six 2hr HWs, a long group project, and 3 exams. If you can, take him. Won't regret.

Love himmmm! He's such a sweet professor and actually cares about his students. Class is basically all exam based so do well on those and you'll be fine. Attendance wasn't mandatory but it helps to go.
Professor Ramirez was a great teacher. Overall made MTH101 easy and always started class with jokes. I recommend him ten times out of ten.

Professor Ruiz is a wonderful professor. He is kind and understanding. There are 8 quizzes, but he drops the lowest 2. 4 tests, 1 final. Homework is online. Offers extra credit. Always willing to explain any problem. Great guy take him!

I've never had a professor be more full of themselves than this professor. Teaches a masters level class and speaks to us like we're third graders and even threatened to take away our laptop privileges at one point. Here's an idea, if you made the subject and lectures more interesting students would actually pay attention.

One of my favorite professors. No BS work, the homework assignments are just for you to learn from and are always useful. Doesn't give pop quizzes or unfair questions, just do the homework and listen in class and you'll do well and actually come out with knowledge

This is the most brilliant professor I've ever had. I learned so much. If you pay attention you will do well, drops 3 lowest quizzesis very generous after exams with opportunities for extra points. If you pay attention he explains everything beautifully and I always feel ready for every quiz after lectures. You need to put in the work to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Inspirational--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: For graduate degrees that do not have a business background is person is highly NOT recommended. He only teaches to people who have studied and are masters in accounting code/language, YET the university charges x10 what other school charge so you LEARN. He is not there to teach but just to REMIND business concepts.

It was definitely a hard topic and class to follow given my lack of accounting background and while this professor was tough and expected us to work for our grades, he was very accommodating and always open to helping you outside of class hours. His teaching style is not traditional but I learned a lot which ultimately is his goal.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Loved this prof. 1. Exams straightforward - to succeed do lots of practice problems - All you need! 2. No busy work, gives buffer points 3. Lots of partial credit 4. Very understanding, holds numerous help sessions, works with you if you have conflicts Have to work for your grade. Incredibly usefuI. Wish I took this class 5 years ago.

He lectures by writing illegibly over the class notes, it's extremely hard to follow. Then you are quizzed at the end of every class on the material that was just presented, so you don't even have time to study. One of the most unproductive classes I've ever taken.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Flies thru material, then says, "stop me if you have questions", but you don't even know what to ask. Classmates asked for him to re-explain a concept, and he's pointblank said NO. Won't take questions via email. GO TO ALL VOLUNTARY STUDY SESSIONS. Tests weighted heavily w/ few questions, miss 1 question you're already at a C. Terrible.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He is literally the worst professor at UM, It is a graduate class and he treated us like children. We have quiz every class. He needs to realized that most of us got a job and need to pass the CPA exam and that is way more important than his stupid quiz.
Worst teacher ever. Gives you a quiz at the beginning of each class without reviewing the material first. 50% of the grade is the final. Stay away from this teacher.

OH boy, this is the worst man i have ever come across in my life. How did he become a professor. He is so ridiculous. I believe professors are trying to lighten other ppl's world while he did exactly the opposite.

This guy is unreasonable, gives quiz every class and did not teach at all. He doesn't allow laptops in class so that you will listen to him. How did you expect ppl to listen to you when you talked useless stuff all the class???
Great Professor. Very nice when grading, clear and objective lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Great Professor: really knows his stuff.  He is one of the MOST PATIENT Professors I have come across.  He will help you until you understand.

His lectures are clear. Excellent tone of voice that keeps class engaging. The grade you get is what you earned. He doesn't like to use the book very much and gives nice note packets that are easier to understand. Expect quizzes and homework every class! (MBA). He is very passionate about accounting and makes it interesting.  I loved this class.
