He's ridiculous and proud.  He is tough, and that's fine, but his exams are so ridiculously hard.  You could understand the material, but then his exams won't test that per se, rather they will test your ability to remember every fact from every class and from all of the papers you read - oh wait, it's much harder than that! Avoid if possible.
Awesome professor and you learn a lot. Study hard.

Oh my god this class was SO DIFFICULT but dont let that deter you from taking his class. The amount I learned was incredible. He wants you to learn, not memorize, and gives you very practical advice for your future. Not a textbook guy: wants to change the accounting world. I was always so conflicted because I would get bad grades but learn so much.

do NOT buy or rent the book.  He gives out quizzes and his tests are hard, but you will definitely come out a much better accountant. He can multiply and divide numbers that your calculator has a hard time doing (slight exaggeration, but it's nuts!).  I swear if you give him the number 103,493,776/0.2973 he'd know the answer is $348M.
Horrible class because of the tests and the pop quizzes.

The tests are really hard. However, the worst part was the pop quizzes. He will quiz you on the material that he will teach you in class that day! So you have to teach yourself everything because you will be tested on it before he ever talks about it.

He definitely has a lot of knowledge of the material. He does all his math in his head, it's unbelievable sometimes. Sometimes he goes through the material a bit fast and it the tests seem pretty hard, but the curve balances it all out. Definitely recommend.

This is the first accounting class where you apply what you learn to realistic situations. Ramnath is unbelievably sharp and will explain everything in detail. This is not an easy class by any means but if you truly care about learning the fundamentals of financial accounting then it doesn't get any better than this.

This is by far the best accounting professor I've had. He is incredibly organized and puts a lot of effort into his lectures. He makes sure you actually understand the material- this is the first class where I've actually understood the logic behind present value of an annuity. He's also very friendly. Take him!!

One of the best teacher you can have. He explains everything throughly and if you dont understand he will explain to you as many times as you need. He makes time out of class to help which not a lot of teachers do. He is really brialliant and shows passion for what he teaches. I will take another class with him, enjoyed it very much.

This guy really knows his stuff and does a pretty good job at teaching it. He's very serious and it even surpises you when he tries to crack a joke.  Not only were his class presentations clear but he also made time outside of class to help us. If you work hard in this class, it will pay off. If not, forget it. He truly was excellent

Terrible teacher who tries to be intimidating. He gives multiple pop quizzes on material he hasnt taught yet, but then teaches it right after the quiz. His notes are so disorganized and his tests/quizzes can never be completed on time
really hard professor. the only way to do good in teh class is to study way before. he moves so fast during class that you will get lost if not prepared before hand.

Great professor. Always willing to help, super nice, although kinda intimidating. Never be afraid to ask, he really likes that. The tests do have curveballs, but he wants to make sure you know more than just memorizing problems. He wants you to know the concepts and be prepared to make good accounting decisions. Take him for sure!

He's really not that hard.  Yes the class is difficult but certainly not impossible.  He's a good teacher but somewhat intimidating.  Just know the notes and the homework inside and out and you'll do fine.  He does like to through curve balls on the test though.
Good Professor. Review notes and do homework problems and the problems he goes over in class. Make sure you analyze and understand the transactions given in each problem.
Test are very hard and tricky..Not like the notes he hands out... Very helpful though but good luck if you take him

Loved this class! He is a genius and really loves accounting. The exams are difficult, but it is just a true test of your knowledge of the material. I don't think I've ever learned as much in one class as I did in this class.
His exams are all problems. No MCQ etc and very tricky. Not as easy as the notes make it seem. The test is pretty hard so you have to really put in a lot of effort. He is very helpful.

Dr. Ramnath previously taught MBA students at Georgetown and expects us to be at that level. The class is tough, although he is always willing to answer questions in and out of class, and he is willing to set up several review sessions before a test.

John Redmond is one of the best professors I've had during my time at UM. The class is super chill, you're just graded on attendance and three exams over the course of the semester. Not only does he teach the textbook content, he provides real life examples / stories as well. Would definitely recommend taking his course.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor with a good personality. Not allowed to use technology in class but his lectures go by fast and he'll make you laugh.
Best professor I've had in college. Hard not to like this guy. Tests are take home but still semi difficult. I would take this class 10 times over if I had to.

Great professor! Very informative and funny. You will do well in the class if you just show up and pay attention to the lectures. Online, open note tests only which are really easy to get an A on if you just pay attention. Great class.

John is a super funny and chill professor. Theres only 3 tests which are open note and you can take the exam any hour within an 8 hour window. He also gives points back on each test if lots of people missed a specific question. Hes always available to talk after class also. Easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: John Redmond is the best music business teacher by far. Has a ton of experience and knows what he's talking about. He is absolutely hilarious and is very open about his life experiences. You are missing out if you don't take his classes
Man is actually a gem. One of the smartest people when it comes to music industry and is honestly the best
Redmond is super funny and an engaging lecturer. His publishing class is especially interesting because that is where he has the most experience. Class is not very difficult and always entertaining.
Great professor for all music related classes! It helps to show up to his optional lectures online.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: John Redmond is hilarious and has lots of great stories from his background in music business. He is also a talented musician! Absolutely take this class when you have the chance. The lectures are clear and he tells you exactly what to study for the tests. One of my favorite teachers!
Honestly, I took his class as a business major for my minor, and he has been my favorite professor I've had at UM.

Does a good job making a pretty boring subject (copyright) interesting. Great guy and easy tests if you study. Only bad thing is because there are only three tests, if you mess up one your grade is screwed. Luckily I did well on all three.
He has a great personality! His lectures are filled with stories and funny jokes, unlike the boring lectures my other professors give. Great guy! Great class! Skip class and you wont pass!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Would take again

reviews.comment: John knows what he is talking about plain and simple. He inspires good character and a light heart. Always there to help and give critically honest feedback.

He is by far the greatest professor I have had at UM. He is hilarious! He goes off on tangents about his life experiences but it helps put things in perspective. Only has 3 tests,that's all the assignments. He is always there to help you if you have trouble. Go to class for the personal knowledge  but as long as you look at the PPTs you're good.
He rants a lot about his personal experiences, but he's a super easy teacher. If you study exactly what he tells you to, then you will definitely make an A.

My favorite professor I've had so far. Very knowledgable about the music business. He teaches the class in a humorous manner that makes you enjoy every single class. Absolutely hilarious. Exams are your grade and are easy.
One of the coolest and funniest professors I have ever had. Very knowledgable, but also very lenient.

He is very knowledgeable and relates to real life situations that makes the class incredibly interesting. especially for people that want to be involved in the music business. Makes it very hard not to get a B or higher. One of my favorite teachers of all time.
Good teacher! Sometimes really crazy. However, he is very knowledgeable and a good connection to have in the music business
His class is fun to be in. The only complaint I have is that he sometimes comes to class blazed.
Helpful, real life experience. Best professor in the music school.
Best Professor in the Music School.  I loved his class.
He is an awesome teacher, gives you answers to the quizzes the day before them.
chillest teacher at miami
One of the only music business professors that actually teaches valuable stuff. Great guy. Take his class!

She's soooooo kind, caring and generous with grades. Feel like a mini-family when studying SPA101 with her. Stuff might be a bit awkward sometimes, but her genuine enthusiasm helps everyone connect so much. Would recommend her again and again. Excited to be taught by her again.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Reina Barreto is the best professor here at UM and genuinely cares about how you do in the class. It is a super homework heavy class but every language course here is. Her tests are exactly like the study guides/practices quizzes and she is a very forgiving grader. 100% recommend taking her for a Spanish course here.

Great professor to have for this class. She does her best and tries to help you when she sees you need it, she cares a lot about her students. Very straightforward with what you're getting graded on and offers lots of practice. Spanish requires lots of homework and assignments but she's not a tough grader.
She's the best! So kind and if you go to class will give you everything you need to do well on the exams.

As someone who does not speak spanish at all this course was amazing. I have dropped out of SPA201 multiple times because it was too challenging but I needed the course to graduate under the Arts and Science school. Professor Barreto is kind, understanding and all she wants to see if effort. If you communicate and try your best you will succeed.

Dr. Barreto is a kind and understanding professor who is forgiving with grading and genuinely wants her students to succeed. If you have the option to take her class, I HIGHLY recommend it! Her class is enjoyable, you'll learn a lot, and you won't feel nervous about participating or asking questions.

Took this professor for 101. Great professor, very generous grader, cares about her students. Lots of extra credit opportunities. Always willing to help and provides great feedback. Definitely recommend her.
best teacher ever
Barreto is great, and I enjoyed 201 a lot!

Best professor I've ever had, wants all to succeed, and offers numerous extra credit opportunities. She is a generous grader on top of this. She genuinely cares for the students and the lectures are engaging, and she even brought brownies from her bakery to class. She has a passion for Spanish and I would 100% recommend taking her course.

To study for this class literally all you have to do is look over the review powerpoints she makes for the exam. The exams are super straightforward if you studied, and she gives tons of extra credit.

Despite her lectures getting pretty boring at times, she's really sweet and genuinely wants everyone to do well. She does a review lecture before every exam and quizzes are take-home and open all semester. It didn't take me much studying to finish with a 98 in the class. Definitely take her for this class if you have to!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: SUCH AN EASY CLASS. She can be boring to listen to, and lectures feel long, but you dont have to go to class. Before each exam, she gives a review lecture that covers exactly what's tested. Exams are very straightforward and easy, nothing tricky. Homework stays open all semester. If you have to take this class, take her.

Her lectures are kind of boring, but if you want an easy A, this is the class for you. She gives extra credit opportunities, a review lecture for each exam that covers EVERYTHING that will be on the exam, and quizzes that can help with exams/final. There are 4 exams (one gets dropped) and a final. Exams are extremely fair you just need to study.
Rieger's class is painfully easy, however, you aren't going to learn anything. Doesn't really teach. All you need to do is read her lectures, and you will be fine.

You could not pay me to take her again. She doesn't respond to emails, has no office hours, and will direct you to clueless TAs. Lectures are usually 50-70 slides, barely touched on in detail, and always finished early when nobody knew a word she was talking about. She has an accent, and I felt that skipping lectures was a better use of my time.

I LOVE Prof. Torres. He begins his lecturers with any questions/comments about recent events/markets and it is so helpful and important. He is super smart, a really nice person, and genuinely just wants to share his knowledge and help. Participation/attendance matters, homework super light, and exams not bad if you practice.

Best professor I've had at UM. Works as a global macro PM during the day. Extremely smart + kind. Starts off the first hour of the lecture talking about the markets - the way Prof Torres breaks down complex geopolitical issues and how they will affect financial markets primes the class for success in doing the same on our own. Tests are very fair.
GOAT take him, best professor and actually have you understand finance using real world examples and talks about recent news.

Incredible professor with highly relevant experience in Hedge Funds. Lectures begin with one hour covering markets - as a student applying for summer internships on Wall Street, this was by far the most beneficial part of my week and helped me a lot during my interviews (I mentioned some of the ideas we discussed). Highly recommend for everyone.

Super smart guy. Spends the first hour talking about the market/current events. First test was hard but the final was identical to the review. No attendance, homework's are a huge part of your grade but extremely easy.
Prof Torres market knowledge is invaluable.  His ability to explain how the concepts in class are applied in the real world is a unique strength of the class.

So clearly a very knowledgable professor and a great guy. His depth of knowledge on all things markets/economy related is impressive and makes for a great conversation. Tests are straightforward and classes always begin with markets discussion which is fun. Quite easy and definitely worth taking.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The best and most knowledgeable FIN professor here. I recently accepted a job and his class helped me ace the technical interviews. He does a great job preparing students for the real world by talking about the markets at the start of each class and is clearly passionate about what he teaches. Make sure to ask questions.

Professor Torres does an excellent job relating the subject matter to current world events. His knowledge in the financial markets and news topics makes the course extremely engaging as everything can be related to what is going on today in the world. The lecture slides are a bit overwhelming but otherwise everything is taught extremely well

Torres is the most qualified Professor to be teaching a finance course due to his extensive experience working in the industry. First 30-45 mins of class are spent talking about the markets, current events, and answering student questions; this has been invaluable to my knowledge of the way markets work, this is by far my favorite part of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: great teacher!! you can tell hes actually passionate about teaching student real life situations. hes extremely clear with what is going to be on the exam & is super helpful. he gives real applicable real life advice that i will forever remember throughout my investing & financial journey, esp coming from a family that doesn't have that background.

my least favorite prof in FIN. does not help in or outside of class and does not respond to emails ever. His lecture is long and boring. Exams were super hard and he doesnt give enough time to prep his reviews are so last min and dont help.

Torres was one of my favorite professors at UM. Exams are similar to the homework. I enjoyed the beginning part of class where he would dedicate an hour to talk about the markets. He's knowledgeable and well respected. Runs a hedge fund.

Probably the best FIN teacher at UM. His lectures are long and sometimes hard to keep up, but do the homework and review the slides yourself before the test and you'll do fine. Exams (for both FIN320 and FIN303) are in person, on paper, with a front and back cheat sheet. Honestly really recommend him
Super cool and chill guy. Definitely do the homework and take note of key ideas in the lecture slides for the tests and you'll do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Very experienced in the topics he teaches. -1 point because it really is just a lecture class and not so interactive, doesn't really go over problems and just kind of reads them off the powerpoint.

The exams are extremely similar to the homework.. hint hint.
35% of the class is MC homework, 20 on a midterm, 20 on final, and the rest on attendance

Professor Torres is hands down the best Professor I've had at UM. His style of teaching is much more engaging, and I have learned more about the market from his class than I have all my other classes combined.  He does a great job of teaching the material and always keeps the class engaged.  So lucky to have taken this class with him.

He is very knowledgable about the financial market; seems like he cares more about talking about the current news then actually teaching. Reads off slides and never goes over what will be on the mid/final exam, even though he claims he would. Participation is HUGE for grading. His "teaching style" will probably loved by some students or irritating

Professor Torres is very passionate for the subject,professional, caring, confident, not afraid to make mistakes and willing to admit to ignorances. As a matter of fact, he is my favorite business professor at UM, he just doesn't teach by the books, he teaches by heart. Thankful for the course. I enjoyed every minute of his lecture. I got inspired!
He is one of the best professors that I meet, he is very nice and gives us very clearly important knowledge, take him! very wonderful professors!!!
Great Professor. Is very real-world oriented with his lectures. Tests are straight forward and similar to the Homeworks although the homework can be long and tough.
Love Professor Torres! Very knowledgeable and expectations are clear. Tests are fair as well. Would take again.

Professor Torres does well to incorporate his financial experience into the coursework to offer a real-world application to the concepts learned in class. The professor also does well to explain complex financial concepts in simple terms that are much easier to process and understand.
Great professor with remarkable perspective from the real world. My favorite professor at the University of Miami!

Professor Torres was one of my favorite professors at UM. He taught the class in a way that made difficult topics a lot easier to understand. I also really enjoyed how he would spend time each class discussing current events in the industry to increase the class's overall financial literacy.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Torres is great and helps students succeed especially ones that reach out to him for professional career advice.
Prof. Torres did a fantastic job of bringing in real world examples of the topics we were covering and making it a classroom discussion rather than simply a lecture

There was a lot of information to learn in this class, a little too much I think for a non business major class but the professor  made it interesting and had a good sense of humor.  Only two exams and hws can done in groups.

Good class.  Professor is a hedge fund manager which made it interesting.  If you're interested in investing or the financial markets this is the professor to take.  Hw's can be long and only two exams but workload wasn't too bad.
Cool professor.   Creates a very good working environment and keeps everyone motivated and participating.

Not a business major so I was worried but prof Torres made the class much more interesting than I expected.  He's a hedge fund manager and always had real life anecdotes.  HW's are long but he allows it to be done in groups.  Tests aren't too bad but definitely go to the review session.  He wants you to do well.  Good class to learn about investing

Not an easy class but professor Torres made it more interesting than I expected. If you're interested in the financial markets this instructor is great.  Exams closely follow the text so get the book.
Loved the class and how we related material to the current markets and what was going on in the financial world. Would recommend this instructor to anyone interested in the financial markets.

If you  want to go into finance or investments this is the professor to take.  He runs a hedge fund and knows the industry well and is really willing to help students. He even helped me with my resume.  Tests are similar to the problem sets and he does review sessions to prepare.  He always brought the material back to the real world  application.

He is not a difficult teacher. He spells out for you what is going to be on the exams. Example, will say there is 12 questions and then say what each question will be about, like "one problem will be similar to chapter 10 number 6"
He really is a good professor. Test and quizzes just study and you will do fine. HW out of text.  He knows the investment industry very well and helped some classmates get internships.

Not a regular professor.  Professor Torres is a hedge fund manager so this was one of the more interesting classes where practice was combined with theory. Brought the material to life with his anecdotes and trades.  Very funny at times.  Grading was fair with mid term and final making up most of grade. Definitely a cutie
Professor Weisskoff is very knowledgeable and about passionate his job. So far, I have learned so much in his class.

Professor Weisskoff offers students a chance to have a truly unique course, one that takes you off campus for field trips and really get to know your classmates. Additionally, he is a very kind human being that cares about his students and what they take away from the class. The only thing is that his class is disorganized and spontaneous.

Professor Weisskoff is such a genuine and nice human being. Lectures are mostly based on a singular case study, and there is really not a lot of work. You are graded on a portfolio you are responsible for putting together. Overall easy class but most of the time you won't know what is going on.

Professor Weisskoff is an amazing professor and truly cares about his students. That being said, this course was very unorganized which made it difficult to figure out what my grade was. If you miss class you have to do makeup assignments and there are a lot of random projects that he assigns as well.

Prof. Weisskoff is amazing. He has so much knowledge to offer and teaches in a fun, unusual way. 
You won't have a lot of homework, he just makes you do group projects that are really interesting because they are focused on actual projects he works on himself outside of class. (and field trips).

I think everyone should enroll in a class with him.

Absolute angel, I genuinely do not believe this is a real person. He's so cute and funny, take a class with him if can. He will never ever remember your name or who you are but it doesn't really matter he will give you an A if you do all the work by the end of the semester. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS IF YOU DON'T LIKE TO WAKE UP EARLY OR SING.
not a typical lecture or seminar class. always doing something different each week. hands-on learning experience. professor is a good guy but class has no structure. would take him again!

This class is so weird, he is so weird. You will not have any structure and he won't teach you anything about International Relations, just make you read articles and summarize them. Oh and field trips. He is really nice, but if you want a class where you don't have to stand up and talk everyday, don't take it. Super easy A, though.

Weisskoff is not a good teacher AT ALL He gave a syllabus at the beginning of the semester and did not follow anything on it except for the country project. If you go to all the lectures and do everything he tells you to, you will get an A. TA's very helpful. I did not learn anything about global economics. Class is all over the place. Disorganized
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Overall, the class was an Easy A. You have a few simple projects here and there accompanied with Economist articles that are due every week. However, the class was given a syllabus that it did not follow and our final project was assigned a week before it was due. No final exam but beware of random assignments and expect to not learn much.

He's a very nice and friendly guy; however, the class was pretty cringeworthy. It was all over the place and did not follow the syllabus or have any semblance of a plan. Easy A if you do the work required but you will not learn much.

Though there was a clear syllabus, the class did not follow it at all. The lectures were scattered and at the end of the day, I feel like I learned nothing about global economics. There was only one test and a group presentation for the final. Mandatory field trips, also. Very unclear grading criteria.

Weisskoff is my hero. He loves field trips and hearing about people's perspectives. He is sweet and enjoys.I took global dvlpmnt/enviro econ and I loved it. Easy A. Group projects were fun. No tests or final. He listened to us and taught how we wanted him to. Flexible due dates. Family tree at the end to analyze patterns- interesting. Attend class!

easy A, but i learned nothing about econ all semester. was a waste of time and effort- we really dont learn much about economics at all- listen to music and eat food in classes. lots of busy work. Few short essays and map tests. Portfolio at the end of the semester. Pass or fail class. If you want to learn DONT TAKE HIM
He's the best professor I'll ever have the honor of caring to know.

Professor Weisskoff is a really great guy, but not necessarily the kind of guy you want to teach you. His grading criteria is very unclear (we received little to no feedback throughout the semester) and he does not give out a clear syllabus. It was an enjoyable semester, but I feel like I could have learned more and saved myself the frustration.

Attendance is mandatory because you have to turn in/discuss most assignments.  Easy A, either A or F so do your work and you'll get an A. Fields trips are long but enjoyable. He's a great guy, but sometimes unclear about what the assignment is. Portfolio is due at the end of the semester along with a project.

This is one of the greatest professors I've crossed paths my whole life. His teaching method is different and keeps students engaged. There a lot of short assignments but they are enjoyable. I fully recommend taking this professor; it is a great learning experience you won't forget.
Greatest guy ever. So nice. We watched a bunch of movies and went on a few field trips. One major project defines your grade but if you do it correctly its an easy A

He's super knowledgeable about the subject that he teaches. He's participated in all sorts of studies and court cases revolving around environmental economics, and he goes over these with you. If you do the weekly readings and summarize them, participate in discussions, and do the few projects (not hard at all), you'll get an A. You can't fail.
Extremely smart and helpful. Different teaching style to most profs at UM - makes everything much more interesting. Definitely take him.

A nice teacher. His class is easy. But he made us buy like 6 books and in the end, exam was optional, we could chose btw exam or a final project. Go to the field trips, watch the movies, participate in class, and you will be more than fine.

THE smartest man on this planet. Fun, easiest class ever. if you watch the movies, read & attend his amazing & highly recommended field trips, go to class, you will learn so much. no real assignments, but class is worth every min. Listen to him!! He is amazing!! (& google his resume! went to Harvard!) even my bf would skip his school 2g2 his class!
he is the man, mad liberal but very nice and its the easiest A you will get in college

Took him for a course on Terrorism and he is excellent!  Excellent choice of books, the material is super enlightening.  Would take him all over again.  Try to be on time for class and show up everyday because he does take roll.  VERY FUNNY!!!

i took this professor on several occassions because it's an unstructured, fun class. What you learn is really up to you because most of the work is reflective essays on books that you don't really have to even read. He's a great person, and he's unlike any other proffesor at UM. You do have to go to class, but it's a painless, stress free class.

The most amazing professor I have ever had in this university. One of the most amazing, intelligent, influential people I have ever met. Please take him. Your life will be changed for the better because of him, but do take his assignments seriously. Don't waste your time if you think you'll get an easy A. He's worth just coming to class and listeni
Such an interesting teacher.  You should have an open mind for this one!  HE makes you think but as long as you try you will do wel..
She is very sweet and clear, she actually cares that you do well in the class, very organized and to the point. She doesn't like AI or computers, which makes the class feel very personal.

She's not bad but she LOVES to assign pointless readings. She's like weirdly passive aggressive and very particular about how she likes things done. Avoid taking her class if you can but if you don't have a choice you'll be ok.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: LOVE this course. I learned so much. You have to read articles before each class but it is very manageable and interesting. There are 3 writing projects you need to complete, but you have time to complete them. I HIGHLY recommend going to class. You should definitely take this course for WRS 106, it really taught me a lot about women's stories.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Not organized and hard to understand what is due. She never responds to emails. Like ever. With class twice a week it's hard. Lectures are not engaging. Grading is harsh. We are required to print documents and annotate every class. When I raised concerns, she was rude and dismissive. Overall, I would not recommend this class or professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Ngl thought I would hate this class once enrolling but she quickly changed my mind. Her lectures can get boring at times, but just put the phone down and lock in for an hour and you'll walk out with an A
DO NOT TAKE! No computers, in person writings, if u want to have zero fun an english class then this is ur best bet.

Her class isn't the easiest to navigate. She teaches with an old school mindset, which in turn means all readings have to be printed by the students and annotated by hand. She is also relatively slow when it comes to grading things. She emphasizes organization and is very meticulous about how papers should be handed in. No electronics in class also
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I loved Professor Reyes. She challenged me with my writing quality and has taught me so much. Class discussions were interesting. Participation makes the class a lot more interesting and actually doing the readings. Professor Reyes is understanding of certain unforeseen circumstances but doesn't give in to nonsense as she should. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

10 "assignments", 10 points each: 3 essays, 3 peer reviews, annotations, a reflection notebook, and participation. Professor Reyes is a simple instructor, and the structure of the class is not confusing. Attendance is mandatory, but she gives you 3 excused absences. Her class average 94% which is an A. No laptop policy is flexible. Excellent prof.

She is condescending and not helpful w/ questions. Harsh grader. Final essay needed a "scholarly article" that was almost impossible to find and she would not give assistance when I repeatedly asked. Class itself is easy but boring.

Details for each assignment can he hard to understand, but Prof. Reyes is not that hard of a grader. Gives a lot of easy ways to get grades up and lets you out of class early. Attendance is mandatory so go to class. Do the annotations and readings as they are graded. Write in the notebook and do well on your craft presentation. Nice to talk to.

Super nice professor I highly recommend. Super easy grader and lectures are very easy. She gives not homework and is super chill. If taking WRS 105 and have the ability to take her I would! You won't regret. She also lets you out of class early many days and on the last day she lets us leave an hour early and brought is chocolate and cookies.

I loved Professor. Reyes. She is positive and truly cares about her student's success. She is knowledgeable and  very passionate about what she teaches. I honestly wish I could have her be my professor in every class. She is funny and can be stern but she definitely makes her classroom a positive environment. She also likes participation!

Has only graded 1 of the 3 essays for the course. You have to go to class if you don't she will fail you. Frustrating not knowing what your grade is in the course. Class itself is extremely boring but not difficult. Discussion board posts can become tedious but aren't end of the world. She is a nice prof but if you want to learn don't take.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I love her! She only gives 3 papers for the semester and a small assignment after the lecture but also gives time during class to do it. She really cares about literature and loves when you participate. You HAVE TO go to class, two absences and she fail you. She really doesn't ask for much, just show up and do the work, you'll have an A.

She is boring. I have her 5-6 pm and always fell asleep in her face but she was nice. She rarely assigns homework, just journal entries which are meant to be completed in class. Doesn't like laptop or iPads. She grades VERY slow I turned in an essay on halloween and did receive a grade until 2 days ago. However only 3 essays are assigned.

Don't miss class. She is very kind and understanding, and will give extensions on big assignments if you give a good reason and some advanced notice. Interesting discussions and overall good vibe. If you take it Tu/Th @ 7:40, a dog will walk into the classroom every 6 classes or so. A lady routinely walks her dog w/o a leash by the class.

As long as you show up, this class was very easy to get an A in. Strict attendance policy (miss 3 classes=fail). 3 papers, 1 presentation, and 3 peer reviews, but everyone gets an A for peer review. I found her to be an easy grader, but she took a long time to post grades. Most lectures were pretty boring but she often let us out early.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She's nice but she has graded only 1 of our 3 essays and they were already all due, so we have no clue what our grade is which is annoying. Showing up is a complete waste of time but attendance is mandatory. The class is so boring and not a great experience overall, but not that hard.

Attendance is mandatory and strictly enforced, if you miss 3 classes all semester you automatically fail. The essays are relatively easy and grading is pretty fair. 30% of the class is peer review grades (3 auto A's). The lectures are super boring though, and with the other cons, unless you are super interested in her class topic, take another prof
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: One of the nicest teachers I've met, really understanding and not a tough grader at all. Little homework and easy essay topics

Prof. Reyes was nice but this class is absolutely not it. So boring and seems to serve almost no purpose in real life. She encourages deep thinking but the topics covered didn't. I can say that I really didn't learn anything. Also, there are no small group in class assignments. It was lecture and writing. This teaching style facilitates nothing.

This was a fairly easy and relaxing class. Professor Reyes sets up her class in a way that minimizes the stress of her students. She is extremely accommodating and often moves deadlines to fit the needs of her class. Homework readings usually take 5-20 minutes. She is a very fair grader. Overall I highly recommend Professor Reyes!

Professor Reyes is a great professor. She gives 3 essays that are 3 pages, but they are 3 detailed, well-written pages. She gives 3 weeks to complete each one as well. If you do the short readings for class and participate often, you will be in good shape. If you don't participate or read before class the material may be confusing or boring.

Absolutely loved Prof. Reyes. As long as you show up to class having read what you need to have read and participate you should be good. She always gave me high grades on my essays so I can't speak to whether or not she was a harsh grader but I enjoyed this course and it was one of my favorite classes I've ever taken.

My class was asynch. & we never even met on zoom, but Mrs. Reyes was an AMAZING prof. So kind, chill, and willing to accommodate/give extensions whenever needed. The entire grade was based on discussion posts every T/Th and 3 essays. She was very clear in her expectations & the class was beyond easy--just submit everything on time and you'll pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Reyes is such a cute lady and while I do have so much respect for her, as a teacher I would not take her class again. The work was not bad and if you are looking to sit through a boring class that feels like time takes years, then maybe she is for you, but that's not me. Classes were pointless to the point where I wish I was online.

I took her for an aspects of the feminine focused English class and enjoyed it very much. The class itself is relatively laid back and just discussions or reviews of what we read ahead of class. The out of class readings can get a little long and wordy but theyre relevant to the work we do so I never felt like it was a waste.

Professor Reyes is the best professor I've had at UM. She is very laid back/personable, in addition to being extremely knowledgable on the topics we cover. Her grading system is very clear cut, she provides excellent feedback on papers, and responds to emails quickly. She has made me a much better writer. Overall couldn't recommend her enough.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: tough grader
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: DO NOT and I repeat DO NOT take her class. Worst professor I have ever had. She is extremely condescending, you wont learn ANYTHING in her class. Makes you feel humiliated and her grading is extremely unfair. Very inaccessible and she wont respond emails. Said "I dont really care about you guys' opinion" multiple times in class. SHE IS HORRIBLE!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Reyes is not only a great professor but a very very kind person. Very understanding and spends a lot of time explaining and helping students understand.

Easy class in terms of work load. Incredibly boring class but attendance is mandatory. FYI you will not learn anything. She is incredibly condescending,  gives no form of grading criteria or rubric, her expectations are incredibly vague, gives little to no feedback, and gets angry when you ask for specifics on any of the above. Would not take again
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: This class is very repetitive, presentations every class & a discussion on the homework reading and class is ABSOLUTELY mandatory. 3 absences  fail. She is also a very tough grader on everything, so be warned, you may get a C even if you've always gotten A's before. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. She is also very unpleasant and extremely unavailable.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Wasn't much fan of her as a person but as a teacher she is okay. Three papers that you also give a  presentation on in front of the class. Class is really boring and you either discuss a reading assignment or watch presentations. She grades kinda hard on presentations but essays she is fair.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Really bad class. First of all, you only get 3 absences per semester including all your sick days within those 3 absences. Second, she grades insanely hard and does not give you feedback, you have to present your idea of you paper before and she will not tell you what to improve upon and will then just tell you on the paper. Very bad class. Avoid
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This was the worst class I've ever taken. English has always been my favorite subject until I took her class. I found myself dreading going three times a week. She does not teach, all she does is have students give presentations on their essays for the whole class period. She is condesending and a really hard grader, but she doesnt give feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: The class itself is great, there are 3 papers all about 4 pages long and a short presentation on each one. I found the course interesting and essay topics fun to write. She has good intentions and is a nice person but can be annoying at times and come off as quite stuck up and rude. She hates when people leave the room during class.
Reyes is a very nice teacher. She gives reading material every week. Overall, the paper is kinda easy, and she gives a higher grade. It's a easy class for just a credit.
Great English teacher. Boring class but overall very respectable and enjoyable English class. Highly recommended.

This is such an easy class. She is nice, funny, and makes this class super chill. She gives you three excused absences no matter what. You literally have to write three papers in the entire semester and you get over a month for each with two revisions. In between, you read these little essays and submit responses on blackboard, and movie included.
Very stuck up seeming, always had her nose in the air and was looking down on all students. Insulting and not very helpful. Avoid if possible.

She is super nice. Class is based on feminism, which was interesting. Each class you are supposed to read an excerpt and then discuss. There are 3 papers, each with a small presentation of what your paper will be about. Got A's on all 3, and an A in the class. You need to go to class, I think more than 3 absences you will fail.

I was unsure about Reyes at the beginning of the semester but she has turned out to be a really great teacher! Only grades are 3 essays, 4-5 pages long. I got A's on all of them. As long as you make a claim and stick with it you'll do fine. Wasn't into her topic (feminism) but it really wasn't that bad. Simple class. Would def recommend her!!!
The class is all focused on feminism and it's a lot of work but the assignments are clear and she isn't a tough grader. 3 essays and presentations

I LOVE HER! She is so intelligent! I just soaked up everything she said because it was always so eloquently said and insightful. She inspired me to focus on women's studies as my concentration for my English major. She is such a boss.

FYI - her course focuses ALL on feminism. Everything. Very nice lady who truly cares about the wellbeing and success of her students. I heard she's a rough grader, but I got an A on my first paper. The most annoying part of the course is that you need to present every paper via powerpoint to the class, but it can be helpful

FOr somebody who is definitely not interested in feminism, her class was pretty decent. She is a good teacher and keeps discussion interesting. Her grading can be a little rough but you get the chance to revise your essays.
All her classes are interesting. She teaches business writing as well, the class is always engaing, never boring.
Very nice teacher, friendly, tough appearance but sweet core. Her lectures are fun, she DOES NOT favor men at all and if extreemly fair.

I really loved this professor. By far my favorite thus far. She's really lively and she keeps you interested. The assignments are a little hard to understand sometimes, but she is glad to answer any questions

bad teacher! she favors men, i got all Bs and As on all my essays and presentations and she ended up giving me a C+, tried contacting her to ask her for reasoning and she ignored all my emails and calls to her office, DO NOT TAKE HERRRR
Try hard and participate in class and you'll do great. Very nice teacher and helps you improve your writing, takes a little long to return essays but overall good.
Does not explain how to do actual assignments. Going to class is useless, but mandatory. Terrible grader and takes forever to grade papers. DO NOT TAKE THIS TEACHER.
Condescending when she speaks. Does not value your input. Doesn't have a justification for your grade.
i honestly hate this class. Feminism is not really my forte. as a teacher, she's horrible. she insults your writing ability and doesn't take the time to help.
To succeed in class all you need to do is show a little effort and do what she wants  and its a guaranteed good grade

I came out of the course with a B because I made a D in attendance. GO TO CLASS. She's a pretty cool lady, as long as you get to know her she'll be willing to help you with your work. However she can be condescending and rather humorless so unless you can work through that and essentially teach yourself, don't take her.

this class was easy for me because all the essays are personal. she likes to see that you have gone to the writing center. she makes you keep a journal, which she says you should write in just about everyday and it is so annoying. her class consists of reading articles, then the next class she asks a bunch of questions about it. really boring.

Cool and down to earth teacher.  Must go to class. Attendance is mandatory and she loves participation. Not an easy class but if you participate and work with her on your essay before you hand it in, you will do very well. 3 essays a semester and we had to keep a journal.

Would never take her again or recommend her to anyone. Her class is pretty easy,  read boring pieces, show up, listen to her talk and tell you shes right and you're wrong. She makes it very obvious that she feels poor people are better than the wealthy, and is obnoxious about her background. She is rude, and doesnt seem to take her job seriously.
I love her! We always get into really good class discussions.
I really enjoyed this class. The methods Reyes used really expanded my writing abilities. She has me looking at literature in new ways.

although her class is pretty easy when it comes to assignments and reading, she is terrible with feedback and cannot justify the grade she gave you on a paper. she notes your attendance, even though class time is spent dragging things out and being off-topic. the best final grade she gives is an A- and that's only if you work your butt off.

RUN FOR YOU LIFE!!!  She's horrible!  Reyes is probably one of the worst English teachers I have ever had.  Sometimes she wont even leave comments on your final paper.  It's as if she didn't even read it in the first place.  I learned nothing in her class.

The class isn't too hard, just writing essays which you'll get forever to do but the journal entries we have to write got a little annoying. She will take forever to grade your papers and may just not write any comments on your paper to tell you why you got the grade you got. She seems to grade however she feels like.

I don't know what criticisms could be launched against her, the course is pretty straightforward. No homework, just writing. She expects a lot from your writing because 80% of the course is the 3 papers. Come on. She does take very long to grade papers, but her comments are concise. I considered taking her again for 106

She is a tough grader. She can be challenging, but fair. Really accessbile during office hours and generous with her time and feedback. She's a passionate teacher and creative in her approach, but will expect a lot from your writing.

She has no set criteria for grades. She can't take critisim and is closed off to any type of questions that contradict her simple mind. She will dismiss you with a laugh if confronted. She is constantly putting on a façade. She takes forever to grade papers and never comments. Her criticisms are very superficial and have no real basis. STAY AWAY!

She is incapable of TEACHING. She has no set criteria for grades nor does she have standards. She is very aware of her inabilities and is closed off to any type of questions that contradict her simple mind. She is constantly putting on a façade to allure students into a false sense of security. If she tells you your paper is “interesting,” DO NOT b
Inspiring teacher, really makes you grow as a writer.
Best teacher I ever had!

I like Lisa Reyes, she allows you to expand your writing beyond the typical English class that is monotoneous work. Her assignments are unique and allow for a lot of interpertation and free writing. There is no book and heavy, heavy reading... she grades fairly as long you show effort ( fixing her corrections, office hours, and writing center).

at first i was interested in the class because her teaching seemed easy and very interpretive, but i got my first essay back with a C and was very confused. i wrote a very interesting and well-written essay according to all the dumb peer reviews and her feedback, but i didn't "accomplish the goal of the essay." also condescending towards students
assignments are easy but even though you get all As you will end up with a B or lower.

Absolutely silly.  She spends so much time letting other students edit your work that there's no possible way to perfect your own writing (judged by a fellow peer?  I don't think so).  She doesn't listen to what you have to say about your own papers and comes off as very condescending.

Really cool, nice teacher. She greatly encourages creative thought and values student feedback. Her teaching style is very nouveau and cosmopolitian. Sometimes she may seem a bit vague but that is because she wants the students to think for themselves, which is something I've noticed that not many teachers want...

Not the greatest english teacher. Her lectures are boring and overall pointless, and she tries to make her view seem cool and her ideas always right. Never gave good feedback on essays, and when asked how to get an A in a class, said, "Teachers can't teach you how to get A's" - not helpful.
Relies way too much on "peer editing". Wouldn't not even look at one of my rough drafts, there were only 3. Lectures are a bore and brings her New York attitude to class.

Very nice lady. Knows lots about the subject.. I took her 2 semesters in a row. Some of the assignments are foggy in that they encourage creative thought, but she'll explain anything to you when asked. very poetic at times in her speech, has a great handle on the english language. attractive in a mysterious, intelligent way.

Really nice, and seems easy at first but when it comes time for paper grading its a whole different story. Also with revisions on your papers, she dosen't give that much imput as to what to do to make your work better.
Nice lady, weird style of teaching and writing.

The class is run by TAs but he did not leave them with much instruction so a lot of the time in the lab I felt like was wasted. He also was not the most friendly when you would email him about questions. Attendance is mandatory, and you get a quiz every lab. 10 page report at the end. Two exams. If you try and study you will do great!

Roger puts the lab in the hands of the TAs but does not give them enough guidance, since we consistently would begin lab late due to the TAs being confused or not prepared due to lack of support from Roger. He was very condescending in his emails and otherwise was out of the picture for the most part. The lab itself is very unorganized sadly

I can't grade for the professor because it was the TA's who carried the class, but the class is fun and easy; if you go to class every day, you'll be fine. There's a quiz every week, and there are so many extra credit opportunities. Highly recommend!

Williams/TAs were both amazing. It was my absolute favorite class and was very stress free. Every week there's a quiz (like 10 in total) but they're from the lab manual so skim it and you'll get 100%. Each quiz has EC+exams too. Graded off a easy paper that has many draft revisions, 2 exams and a practical. If you do well, you can skip final. EasyA
All I can say is that he made me love his class.

I literally have seen him twice this semester so SHOUTOUT to the TAs that ran section 3!!! Learned a lot with you guys and y'all were chill. As for Roger, I really can't give him a grade bc he literally did nothing. Like I said, probably seen the guy maximum three times.

THIS IS HOW ALL UM LABS SHOULD BE! Had fun, learned a lot, and was never stressed about my grade. Worth 3 credits (way easier than the 1 credit Chem lab). Study the slides + lab manual for the weekly quiz. Roger + TAs will tell you what to know for the midterm and lab practical (easy). Lots of EC. Unknown report was long but fun. Did not take final
Roger is a great guy. His lab class is super manageable. The tests are not hard as long as you study for them and the grading is very fair. Would definitely recommend

I took the MIC 304 lab which was mainly taught by TAs but Roger made all the instructional videos. Very funny guy! The quizzes and tests are really easy, just review the lab manual and PowerPoint 5 minutes before class. The most time consuming part of the class is the unknown project which is a 10 page paper, but he provides a lot of guidance

I absolutely hated the final paper you had to write and the TA's were VERY an*l about how they wanted it and I was missing feedback in multiple areas as well just thank GOD that this was a writing class and that I got a B only because the professor gave a last-minute optional exam to switch your grades out.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: I took this class for a writing credit but there were too many professors teaching this class and I never ever paid attention in class and I still got a B+ so yea :P

took his lab class. was mostly taught by the ta's but it was super easy. quizzes and exams were really easy if you just read what they told you. only somewhat difficult part was the lab report but they directed you exactly what to do and gave feedback so it was super easy. when we saw roger he was very nice and was willing to help with anything.
Super easy 2 credit lab. Exams were very easy-- I studied for the final for all of 30 minutes and got an 88. Read the manual for quizzes and exams and you'll be fine. Interesting lab too.
Roger is the biggest sweetheart ever. He's very fair and will answer any and all questions. The lab that he runs is extremely fun.
Roger is pretty cool but his pup is on a whole different level. Swagalicious champ

Roger is THE man. He is such a hardworking man who genuinely cares about what's best for his students...no other advisor can even compare to Roger. He's a hilarious guy, fun to be around and very understanding. He takes the time to take students' opinions into consideration, and he makes learning enjoyable. 5/5 WOULD RECOMMEND.
This man is the best. Great teacher, easy grading, don't need to go to class. But memorize the powerpoints and read the book a little. Roger is the best advisor at UM as well

Roger is the best advisor ever! No other advisor compares. I'm a double major and Foote Fellow here and my other two advisors aren't as amazing as he is! Hilarious guy, super helpful in lab. If you're thinking of switching to Microbiology, DO IT!!! He and Dr. Lopez are the best <3

Roger is the best advisor ever! If you are thinking of making your major Microbiology, just go talk to Roger once and you'll be changing your major the next day. He is there to listen and extremly helpful. He makes Micro Lab the funnest ever (beats Eve by a landslide) and what you do in lab is a reinforcement of what you do in class.
Thats backup!!!!

Roger is the greatest. He cares for students and is always there to help them. He is very down to earth and laid back. I have known him for years and know that he is an excellent adviser and coordinator.

Roger has made such an impact on my life and my future.  He is an asset to the program and should be given a raise.  On the side, he is a good natured person that is always willing to help out us students.  When is the government going to place his face on currency.
the exams are so easy if you study and the rest shes just yapping its not hard to do rly good
This class is brutal to begin with and Dr. Rush makes it ten times harder.

Reviews are dramatic. Would def take the online BTE 210 course rather than in person. The weekly assignments are short and you're going to get full points if you just try. The exams r easy i just chatted a study guide and it was the exact definitions on the exam. She cold calls on the zooms but it's nothing and she just answers her own questions.

The reviews are definitely dramatic but honestly if you don't listen during the lectures it makes it better. The tests are pretty easy if u study a little bit for them and it's literally all group projects which is super annoying at times but easy. She cold calls a lot but I would still take this online version of BTE over in person.
Ok, i think the reviews are a bit dramatic. Tests are HEAVILY curved, do well on individual assignments, work with your group and communicate, be involved with professor and TA. really not that bad.

The class grade basically boils down to your 2 test grades and final project grade. There are weekly assignments that are easy busy work. Exams are easy if you study 2-3 days in advance. Class attendance is mandatory but easy to skip lol. End of the day it's an old woman teaching college students how to use AI so be prepared to teach yourself.

NOT A FAN so much yap about same thing every week. so screechy in the voice its unbearable on zoom, def tries to be nice but is just too much, need to be communicating with group for weekly assignments, loves to cold call, graded so much on busy work (homework/quizzes) but easy and it could be much worse, exam 1 also got curved heavily

Its really not bad like the reviews say. Join zoom classes. Do the wiley with gpt and the other assignments are following instructions but not hard. Study review sheet for exams. No final. She does talk a lot but shes nice.

Quite literally the worst academic experience I have ever had. This class is taught online, and the professor talks about the exact same thing every single class. The weekly assignments are utterly useless, but they are still graded harshly. I have never had such an awful experience with any class or professor in my entire life, DO NOT TAKE.

All she does is a YAPPER and nothing is about the actual course work. she over spends 40 minutes to explain how to do the homework and the other 35 talking about random stuff. and she cold calls people on the 1% of course material she actually teaches. she over talks and explains everything to the point it isn't worth asking for help.

"how can i use a chatgpt or another bot to teach IT for under-graduate business students along with a professor. i want the chatgpt or another AI bot to teach along with me, any ideas? and give me specific examples in IT for business"

This woman covers no textbook material in class and spends the first 45-50% of EACH CLASS talking about how we are on a zoom call and that zoom is a virtual meeting platform. I genuinely don't understand how she can say the same three sentences over and over again in different ways for 30 mins. Very irritating.

Yapper. thats probably the best way I can explain her, class is online but theres 2 exams in person which blows, pretty impossible to study for exams but its whatever, then theres a final project which gets ur grade up, this class is curved because of how horrible everyone does. I got a 67 and a 75 and still ended up with an A. Be cool w the TA!
DOOOOO NOTTTTTT TAKEEEEEEEE

The tests are based off the wiley quizzes which have 2 attempts. The course teaches you how to use some practical software, although it does feel like the course goes a little slow. 2 Tests (multiple choice with 2 short answer questions, curved) and a project to make a wix website. Not hard to do well, just put in minimum effort. (It is an intro)
I just came to rate my professors to say I have no idea what is going on. Help yourself and don't take this class.

This is the worst class I've ever taken. Do not take this class with this professor under any circumstance. She does not teach at all, will randomly call on people to ask questions about Zoom, and exams are in-person all about the homework that she never discusses in class. 10x worse than what you are imagining
Actually never had a worse teacher. She's an actual mess. All she does during class is talk about zoom and never knows what shes doing.

I'm a senior and I've never met a yapper who yapped like this. I had her for 70 minutes and boy did she take the entire time for nothing learned. Asking questions of students like "what's this cloud mean?" on a figure with a cloud labelled "Internet" is just a huge waste of time. She says the same thing over and over, impossible to listen to

She would be incredible with AI technology research, she just should never be a professor for students. She does not foster a good learning environment, is not nice if you ask her questions, stacks random assignments, her lectures make no sense, and her tests have nothing to do with what was discussed in class. Exams are in person. do not take.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do not take her. We talk about zoom the whole entire time and tests/HW assignments have to do with totally different things. The tests are so hard and the study guide she gives you is only 25% of the information on the exam. There are so many pointless assignments. Do not take her if you are looking for an easy A despite the class being online.

Most unorganized, sloppy teaching I have ever received. Took her on Zoom and she just rambles for an hour and 15 minutes straight. None of her directions are clear and even the software she uses for the textbook and assignments is confusing. The content that shows up on exams she only goes over shortly before the exam and doesn't actually cover it.
Shes wholesome but like she goes off topic a lot and most of the time idk whats going on.

Horrible Professor. All she does is rant about random useless topics that we don't even need to know. Spent a whole class explaining how zoom works even though you can just google everything. Is very rude to TA's and demands everything. Haven't learned anything and we are already halfway through the semester. Never take waste of my time.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: What a mess. Never had a more unorganized class in my time at UM. Rushinek is nice, but she's everywhere. Exams are straight from test guides so they're easy, but class is painful. Wing your group project and pretend to pay attention and you'll be fine.

i never, never, never write reviews, but my god she is a nightmare. she is super sweet and wants the best for her students, but she is a horrific teacher. she just yells out words and tells us to google them and read off the results. she has powerpoints but never follows them. exams are super obscure. the grading criteria is completely random. bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Easy A but you have to sit through the class before you can get it. If you can stand listening to the most aggravating person on earth and want to learn nothing then this is the class for you. APPLIES TO ALL HER CLASSES.

Everything said in the comments below this one is 100% true. Don't expect to learn anything about BTE. The class is absurdly disorganized, its very frustrating because you never know what's due. She seems like a nice lady, but I would not recommend her as a professor. I wouldn't even say she's an easy A.
Avoid at all costs. She spends about half of each class period rambling about irrelevant nonsense. She constantly interrupts students during presentations and is just simply a horrendous professor.

I have never met a more disorganized person in my life. She assigns more vague tasks than any professor I've taken at this school. I love the U and I have no idea how she was hired/how she's still employed. The material isn't hard but the fact you have to teach yourself the entire course makes it difficult

Class is tremendously unorganized, please don't expect to learn anything about "business technology". With that being said, the class is based on a group project you work on for the majority of the class, if you put enough effort into that your grade should be fine. 95% sure she didn't grade the quizzes or 2 tests, only the project.
If you know, you know. Don't take this class if you don't know.

Class is a breeze and tests are exactly like the online quizzes. She's also a super nice lady but if you're a BTE major and are actually trying to learn and aren't just looking for an easy A I wouldn't take her

She is really really annoying, but actually a nice lady and will definitely help you. The EHR certification and presenters made it really interesting, although other parts of the class are tough to sit through. You have your computer though

Useless class, professor doesn't know much and deviates from the book. Lectures on topics she knows nothing about. I surf the web while in class. If you don't bring your laptop to campus, just skip. Easy A though.
its a painful class. very difficult to get yourself to go to class and when you do its nearly impossible to follow what shes saying
ARCHITECTURE MAJORS! DO NOT TAKE THIS DUDE ... he teaches the architecture courses like they are engineering courses and goes way too heavy on theory.
Dr. Pestana is a great professor! He definitely appreciates feedback from the class and will give great feedback in return. I learned a lot from him and highly recommend him!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Rating for CAE213. The best professor I have had. Class was extremely organized. Homework was more challenging than test. 2 test. Professor was speedy and elaborate when applying to emails. Always encouraged students to come to office hours and ask for extra help. Truly cared about the well being of students and their success.

Best professor I have had in college of engineering. Plenty of examples in class, answers all questions, takes it slow, helpful in office hours, homework reflects difficulty of tests. You will not pass if you don't practice A LOT from textbook. Tough grader but very understanding. Participation matters. Very hard final exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Homework is optional, but you should definitely do all of the assignments. Do some extra practice from the textbook and you should be fine. Going to the lectures helps but actually practicing the problems & going to office hours will get you through the class.

Honestly the easiest class I have token this semester. Dr.Rodriguez is legit one of the easiest teachers to learn from. Only graded on extra credit and 3 online exams that are really easy if you look at the study guide. Class is optional but if you go, she will likely take down your name and give you an extra boost on your next exam. Take for GPA.

Dr. Rodriguez is clearly passionate and knowledgeable about the topic, which is kind of cool. I took this class because it was the only thing that fit in my schedule, so I had no passion. This made going to class hard, but it's really just a lecture so it was fine. No homework, just 3 exams and extra credit. I recommend you only take if interested.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Thick accent makes it difficult to understand what she's saying, and the material can be long and boring. Attendance is not mandatory and all exams were online via LockDown Browser, including the final. She also gives two extra credit (long writing) opportunities

Very hard to understand this professor due to a very strong accent. Three tests, online on lockdown browser, 2 writing extra credit opportunities. Exams based on lectures which she posts online. You definitely should study before exams with the guide she provides. Otherwise, you'll probably be fine. Easy class in hindsight.

The class is centered around giving a presentation about specific topic chosen by her. She has very specific guidelines but if you ask questions and meet with her you should be ok. Make sure you do it the way she wants even if it seems wrong. There is one exam but it's pretty straightforward. There is somewhat of a language barrier!

Only graded by 3 tests and some extra credit. Class is extremely easy if you study before the exams which are online. Says attendance is mandatory but you really don't have to show up. Her lectures are extremely boring she just goes off on tangents and you can't really take notes. She posts lectures so take notes on your own and you'll do great.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: really nice prof. easy class if u study

Your entire grade is only three exams but there are two extra credit papers you can write. The material on the tests isnt super hard but her lectures are totally unclear and she just goes on tangents about random things in class. Go over the study guide and go to the review class before each test and you'll do well. The tests are online.

Rodriguez says attendance is mandatory, but she only took it like twice. As long as you complete the study guide before taking the test you should be fine. You can only get an A+ if you do the extra credit but it involves watching and commenting on random 2-hr long lectures. She answers emails pretty quickly.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS I AM BEGGING YOU. none of the content makes any sense. just a bunch of big words thrown on powerpoints made in 1998. margarita hardly speaks english which makes this class 10x harder. genuinely the material learned in this class is gibberish. it will help no one in their career ever. save yourself the time i promise u.

she references the textbook a few times, but the exams are based on lecture, and you can do well without buying the book. lectures are kinda boring, but overall interesting. she provides study guides for each exam, and as long as you fill them out from the lectures (which she posts online) exams are easy, 2 or 3 extra credit opportunities as well
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Really boring but easy class if you studied and used the guides that she gives out. She practically tells you everything that is on the test via the study guides. The test themselves are what makes up your grade along with two extra credit papers. Test are easy and common sense if you are familiar with the terms.

The class isn't hard however the teacher can be very rude when you reach out for assistance (she shoves downfalls in you face a bit). she only grades off of three exams so you have to make sure your average is good.

I think I went to class a total of four times and each time was very boring which sucked because sociology can be so interesting with the right professor. Overall, easiest class you'll ever take, 3 exams with a study guide that tells you exactly what'll be on the test and only 2 assignments that are extra credit. Easy class for a cognate.

I literally never went to class, its just a few tests and thats it. She gives two extra credit opportunities. The few times I went to class I was bored to death. Take another professor if you can because sociology can be fun.

SO. EASY. I skipped every class and tanned. she had random pop attendance checks, but I dont think I rlly counted that much. I got like 95/100s on every exam. study, but basically common sense and she isn't trying to trick u. when I did go to class it was so boring and taking notes felt pointless. BUT EASY COGNATE

Grade only based on 3 exams. Just memorize the lectures she gives and you will do fine on exams. They are taken directly from lectures. Takes attendance a few times for extra credit, but if exams are really easy. Very lecture heavy and doesn't explain some things clearly, but overall the class is very easy.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Exams are easy; there are only three throughout the year, and the final is just the last few units, so there's no need for mass studying. Lectures are really long and boring, attendance is not mandatory but on a blue moon she gives extra credit if you're there. Overall, it's fine, just boring and might make you lose interest in the subject.

There are only 3 grades in this class which are 3 exams. She gives extra credit assignments. Attendance is not mandatory and lectures are extremely boring. She is a super nice and funny lady, very intelligent. She gives study guides for the exams which are quite similar. Would definitely take again.

Prof. Margarita is a very intelligent woman who knows a lot about her field. However, her lectures sometimes can get very confusing, going from topic A to H and come back to D, so you need to pay attention in the class.  Overall, it's a pretty interesting class.

Just overall confusing teacher, her lectures never made any sense and tried to change the syllabus grading half way through the year but does offer extra credit and if fill out the study guide and know it all then tests are easy

Although it's easy to get a grade in this class, it's not the most exciting class. She reads straight off the PowerPoints and isn't the most entertaining. Our first exam was in person and the other two were at home, recorded, and those are the only things you're graded on. She says attendance counts, but she never took it.

It is extremely easy to get a good grade in her class, its only based on three true or false exams. The lectures are so so so boring, thus you lack motivation to show up. If you want an easy A I recommend, but if you want engagement and to learn meaningful information, this isn't the class for you.

The 3 exams are the only grades but they are so so easy-multiple choice with only 2 answer options given so 50/50 shot. and she gives you a review weeks in advance that is exactly the test. She makes success in the course very easy. I agree with everyone else her lectures are boring so I never went to class and taught myself the material.

Prof. Rodriguez's class was one of the most boring experiences of my academic career. Every class was just a straight-up lecture; VERY little student participation. Your grade is also determined by just 3 tests (including the final). However, the tests are pretty easy, and if you tune out the lectures and just read the slides, you can do fine.

If you want an easy A take this class. The tests are all multiple choice, and there are only two options to choose from. The lectures can be boring but this is a very easy class if you want an easy A.

Dr. Rodriguez is such a knowledgeable professor, you can tell that she knows what she's talking about. This class is honestly such an easy A and anyone who says otherwise was just too lazy to show up. I liked most of her lectures and they were always on interesting topics, though sometimes they could drag. She's sweet and the class is a breeze.
Honestly one of the nicest professors I've had, just look at the presentations and you're fine. Really understanding
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Rodriguez is not the best professor, but she is very sweet and caring. The tests are easy, with only two answer choices for every question, and you have a chance to get extra credit points before each test. The final is not cumulative which helps as well. The lectures can be a little confusing, but she tests mostly on the obvious concepts.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Rodriguez is a very nice person, but is a terrible teacher. Her slides are confusing and due to her thick accent it's hard to understand her.
