This class is lecture heavy & the lectures are really boring. Tests are meh but has many typos and the questions can be hard to comprehend. This was a waste of a class and won't take her again.

I didn't think this professor was as easy as everyone else rates her. There are three tests, and they are around 25 questions and out of two options. But you still have to study to do good. She gives study guides but you have to fill them out yourself and it's confusing. I wouldn't take again. she started making attendance mandatory by the end.
Easy class, I enjoyed her. Lecture heavy and no real class discussion. Study for the test the week of.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: no time to interact with your classmates and discuss topics. took this class with the hopes of having conversations and making at least one friend, but there's no space to socialize. lectures are the entire class and boring, sometimes hard to follow. exams/extra credit are easy but always submit early, she gave me ish for submitting on time.

Overall a very easy class because the study guides are super helpful. However, it's super lecture heavy, which can get boring. You have some in-class discussions based on HOURS of videos/articles for extra credit, but as long as you speak once you get the points. I recommend for an easy A, but not if you actually want something engaging/fun.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Tests are so easy and she makes it very obvious which one the right answer is (out of only 2 options). Cares a lot about her students and is very flexible with makeup exams. Difficult to understand with her accent and lectures are boring but you just need to write down what's in the ppts. No homework other than a couple extra credit discussions.

Imagine not letting your students ask questions until the end of lecture so they can forget their questions. Easy A but sheesh, she talks as if we're all SOC professionals. Super hard to understand concepts in class. The fact that one kid had the audacity to sleep tucked in bed with his camera on says it all. This class needs wayyy more engagement

Professor Rodriguez is a really good professor for sociology. She teaches via powerpoints and gives out a fill-in-the-blank study guide before every test which makes it extraordinarily easy to pass. I would def take her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: It's an easy course with 3 exams each being 25MC and she gives study guide prior. BUT she's a horrible professor. Lectures are boring she even sounds like she doesn't know what she talking about sometimes and she's super inconsiderate. She makes no exceptions for students, Don't even email her if your sick or you have a broken leg. just take the L

I had her 8am SOC101 class. I slept through it 11 times and got a 102 for my final grade. Its based off of the average of two exams (a midterm and a final), each being 25 easy mult. choice questions. She also gives you a study guide and outlines everything you need to know. She even curved the exams. Lectures are boring, but class is an easy A.

I took this class online, showed up to 2 classes, and got an A+. You definitely need the textbook but you can easily find the PDF online. She gives study guides before every exam and she's super literal when she says the test is based off the study guide. The final had two mc options and she makes it SO obvious which one is the incorrect answer.

Professor Rodriguez was honestly such a delight! She is extremely passionate about what she teaches and offers two forms of extra credit (take advantage of them!!!). Prof. Rodriguez truly just wants to make sure that every one of her students succeeds. IF you put in the effort, you will most certainly pass the course.

Professor Rodriguez is very easy. During the lectures, she does make it very understandable. She also doesn't know how to work "the Zoom platform" and she always says it is the "fault of the student" when they do not know how to work the "Respondus technology". Overall, she is very easy!

This class is easy. THE BOOK IS YOUR BEST FRIEND. I found it online. Dr Rodriguez posts study guides 10 days prior to exams, so use them to make outlines of the material using the book. Final Grade based on two midterms (no cumulative final) & potentially drop one of them if both exam grades 80%.

Dr. Rodriguez is very passionate about Sociology, while she presents a lot of information, her tests cover the general ideas. The class is note heavy but everything makes sense and is easy to comprehend.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She may come off as strict, but she is very nice and always willing to help. She wants her students to participate in class and really appreciates it when you do. I am actually gonna miss her.

I would not recommend Professor Rodriguez. She teaches this International Studies class as though its a graduate class for a PhD. Each student is required to participate in a group project resulting in an in-depth 10 minute presentation accompanied by a 15-20 page research paper (per person and worth 50% of your grade). Lectures are confusing too.
I love Steve Rucker
Great person / genius educator on drumset.

Steve is one of the most inspiring and dedicated profs I've ever had. Amazing teaching practices implemented with relaxed intensity and a true caring nature. Motivates you to be a better musician by illustrating salient points and telling it like it is, and he doesn't resort to intimidation tactics or the promotion of fear-based playing. All class.

This guy is one of the worst professors I've ever had. First, he secretly takes attendance the entire semester: be aware of that. 

A lot of his questions came from the textbook and homework, so just study those. Be prepared to perfect those questions because he does not offer partial credit. 

Absolutely awful professor

. the homeworks are graded on accuracy and do not have partial credit or any curve, and exams provide the hardest possible questions of the most obscure parts of the chapter and also dont have a curve or partial credit. test averages were usually under 50%. he does not want nor care about you or your grade, and is prepared to fail 70% of thr class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Homework is worth a lottt. The professor can be monotonous and faces/stands in front of the board while he teaches. Exam problems are taken almost exactly from the homework. He said attendance wasn't mandatory then at the end he told us he took attendance all along. Not too bad of a class.
Prof. Ruan gets ALL of his examples from the text book and nothing extra. Very heavy accent. Test questions come straight from the homework.
Just Reads straight out of textbook. Does not give extra examples. Hard to understand because he does not speak english well. When he talks he blocks the board so you cant see his notes.

He's a really nice guy, but he basically reads the book to you during lecture. He really wants to make sure everyone understands the material though. His homework is definitely doable and not too much. His tests are very fair, he doesn't try to trick you or anything. Its not bad if you study and attend class because he likes participation.
Very hard to understand what hes teaching.  If u have not already taken AB in high school you have to teach yourself everything.  His teaching is writing the txtbook on the board.

Very intelligent and straightforward guy. Hard to understand like most have said Gives weekly homework assignments that are worth 30% of your grade (they are easy). Test questions come directly from textbook so if you do a little review before, the test should be a joke. If you do the homework, show up to class and study it should be an easy A.

It's pretty much impossible to understand what he says, and if you can it doesn't really matter because all he does is copy the textbook on to the board. If you've taken calc AB you should be fine, but if you haven't taken calc you may struggle.Only3 tests and final, gives review problems for each. Gives graded HW assignment every week.
Very difficult to understand. Class is not helpful at all so just go to exam days.

I hate to say this but he is the worst professor ever, he has a heavy accent and you can't understand what he is teaching. His homework are kinda difficult and the reviews for the exam are useless. Take someone else.

He doesnt speak much english, but he is so easy! he gives reviews with sample questions, that are nearly identical to the actual quiz questions, and lets you take it to the quiz. if you need to take an easy math, this is it!

Avoid this class. Dr. Ruan doesn't speak much english and spends the entire period copying pages from the textbook onto the board. If you are put in this class, don't bother attending except for on test days (he doesn't take attendance).

Truly one of the sweetest professors I've had at UM. Super understanding and genuinely cares about students. If you just show up and listen to every lecture, you'll do well. The class is a mix of lecture and discussion. He's insanely smart, well-connected, and kind. He makes class fun. If you do like the subject, it's amazing.
Incredible professor who goes above and beyond for his students. My favorite courses at UM were with him. If you have the opportunity to take a class with him, I cannot recommend it enough.
Such a cutie! I love Prof Russo. This class is literally a book club with food. Take the class. Russo is caring and likes to get to know everyone. Really a kind person.
The best professor Ive had in all of UM! Hes engaging and loves to hear everyones opinions. So accessible outside of class and super motivated and knowledgeable about what hes teaching!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Russo is a great lecturer with a lot of passion for what he's talking about. Participation actually leads to a good discussion and he never makes you feel stupid for asking questions or giving your own interpretations. Highly recommend taking him if you get the chance

Professor Russo is a 10/10 professor. He really cares about you as a student and will do whatever he can to help you. He doesn't care about grading it all about learning with him. The class overall is a weekly book club. There is a group essay in the class that the professors help you write. This is the class if you want to talk about big ideas.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Books that Matter was such a great class mainly for him. The other professor was condescending and scared people from talking, but Dr. Russo always encouraged people. He is so kind and he helps you in every way he can. 10/10 prof tbh

Amazing professor. Extremely polite and well-learned. Getting to know him allows for fantastic conversation. Books that Matter is a very enjoyable course, and many return for more after their first semester!
Russo is one of the kindest people I have ever met!! Excellent for facilitating discussions, brilliant teacher, and polite and interested in all students.

Such an adorable man! Lectures can be boring, but he always ties in artwork with the stories at the end,which was really interesting. A really smart guy that knows and is passionate about what he teaches. If you do the reading you'll do great!

He is practically a total stranger to me.  His class size necessitates it being a lecture course, and yet the superior quality of the single book he assigns is so overwhelming and immersive, the lectures are obsolete.  I literally attended less than 6 classes in the entire semester, and still passed with a B+.  Few test questions come from lecture

You can really tell he knows his stuff, but I think you can tell that 101 class isn't his passion and doesn't bring out his teaching potential. Sometimes he seems to ramble and go off in random directions. The test questions never seem to be from his lectures..maybe somewhere random in the text? Always study the guides he gives though.

Professor Russo is the most adorable old man in the world. Although the class is lecture, I would advise everyone to try talking to him for a few minutes after class. He is thoughtful and caring and GENUINELY cares what students have to say. He makes you feel intelligent and can have great discussions with you!

I didn't get to know Russo well, but I found his lectures boring and hard to take notes off of. He really knows his stuff but sometimes it sounds like he's rambling so you don't really know what is important. Class was pretty easy though if you paid attention and did all the readings..
A lot of reading!! Regardless, a very nice professor and really passionate.

Great Professor. Always willing to help in any way he can. The reading can be very intense sometimes but just stay reading throughout the semester. Dont leave it until the weekend before the midterms and you'll be fine. Easy A.
One of the most wonderful professors I've had. He's VERY passionate about his subject. He's really sweet and always helpful. Grades are based on tests which are easy anyway. Take him! :)
Whoever said "teachers don't care about their students" never met John Paul Russo. This guy is the greatest teacher you will ever have.
Dr. Russo is the man! He is very approachable and incredibly passionate about English / Classics. There are 2 papers, 2 exams, no mandatory attendance, and a lot of good reading material! A+
i learned an immense amount of classical thingsand enjoyed every minute of it. i am now smitten with a yearning for learning!
No Comments
Best teacher I have ever had. Very interesting. I would recommend him to anyone.
Best professor at UM
Great teacher...
Dr. Russo is an excellent human being and a pretty darn good teacher. I strongly encourage anyone interested in taking whatever class he is teaching to do so; be prepared to read a lot though.

One of the precious few professors that make the material come alive and inspire you to go beyond the minimum requirement.  INCREDIBLY helpful, always listens, and brilliant.  If I could I'd take his class again just for Fu@#ing fun.
A wonderful teacher and scholar. In his class you come to understand why literary studies were for so long a prerequisite for any educated person, and why they should be so today.
Without a doubt, one of the best professors ever! He is a brilliant scholar, a humanitarian, and an avocate of the love of learning.

If there is a case against tenure, look no further than Professor Schnably. Lectures hard to follow (he's not a great speaker) and the exam was really tough. What I disliked the most, however, was his lack of willingness to really provide a practical  overview of constitutional law. I'll have to basically relearn con law for the MBE.

Schnably is an absolutely horrible lecturer. Goes all over the place, sometimes without a clear direction, while most of the class is shopping online or gaming. He fails to tie the material together in a coherent way and you are on your own as far as conceptual learning. Prepare accordingly. Best of luck!

You MUST pay attention in class. He loves hypotheticals and will take you down the rabbit hole. However, the hypos are usually interesting, and he is pretty funny (whether he means to be or not!). He will cold-call you if you look like you are doing something else on your computer, but even if he does, he usually will guide you to the answer.
He is a great professor he really cares about property and wants to make sure everyone learns. He makes it really obvious what he likes to focus on. He loves hypotheticals.

Schnably is a considerate, caring professor who sets his students up for success. He makes you work for it, but gave 3 practice exams with personalized feedback throughout our semester. Without him, I would not have done as well on my other exams. Lots of reading, but very insightful prof who makes you consider every single perspective! Loved it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: One of the most fair and reasonable professors at UM. Gives multiple practice tests with feedback. He curves every one of his practice tests and provides model answers, so you will know exactly where you stand in the class. Participate in class, and he will probably give your grade a boost.
Typical issue-spotter law school exam, but he is very helpful if you go to office hours.

Con law I with Schnably was at times a torture. Con law is such a dry class and he did not make it more interesting. His lectures are confusing and when you ask a question, it's hard to understand his response. The Emmanuel and Chemerinsky will be your best friends for this class.
An extremely helpful professor.
He comports to the true socratic method. If you do the reading and make a good outline, you will do well on his exam. He has a forgiving curve.

Int'l Human Rights.  Great class, very interesting.  You don't have to do much of the reading really, just write down what he says about it and put it in your exam.  The exam is long but not hard. He is passionate of the subject, so his reviews for the Property class might not apply here.  He is very enthusiastic and energetic about human rights.

For me, very boring and very dry.  I understood the material, but he said my grade basically came down to my wirting style, which every other professor appeared to like (based on my grades received).  I think he was totally unfair and he couldn't even explain why he gave me the grade.  Nice man, but very shady, and neurotic, seriously, just wait!
Prof. Schnably is an amazing professor - he really cares that students master the material.

The class can be quite dry.  He sometimes has a glimer of humor, but mostly just pretty dry.  He does have a good understanding of the subject and is helpful if you need to talk to him after classs.  This was my worst grade by far in on a final that I felt good about.

True, class isn't the most exciting - But he truly cares about his students and wants them to do well - as witnessed by his exam prep and accessibility. Exam is fair and he gives you every opportunity to do well.

Commenting on his position as Dean.  He is an absolute waste!  He purports to care and says he'll help, but in the end, going to him with a problem is an absolute waste of time.  Oh yeah, by the way, if you do go, don't expect an answer, positive or not.
No Comments
Insufferably boring, but comprehensive. Relies too much on socratic method for teaching. In class questions are usually difficult. Exam is tough, and open book.
Course materials and lectures do not vary from year to year.  Gives the same lectures every year.  A bit of a mumbler, sit up close to hear him.
Teacher is very passionate but his actual ability to teach comes up very lackluster.
don't take him.
way too many assignments

Was experienced in the sports facilities field, not so much as a professor. Nice guy and gets enthusiastic into the content. A lot of papers, but most are just busy work, not too difficult. Only test is final; kind of difficult to study for because he does not post slides. Goes over the time limit in class almost every day and tends to ramble.

Professor Scott is a great professor and the grading for the mini papers in this class is clear. His tests do have random questions on it but they relate to modern problems or situation surrounding colligate athletics. Just listen and participate and the class is easy. Don't listen to the others who gave him a negative ratining.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Test material was difficult and some questions were just random UM trivia that have nothing to do with the class and are just if you know, you know type questions. Also never puts grades in. Really nice guy but the class is very unorganized.

Most of the assignments are pretty easy. The tests have random questions that were not discussed in class and a lot are on random UM trivia. If the tests were not so tricky I would say it is an easy class, but the tests threw me off.

He is boring! You write lot of papers! We made a study guide for his test but barely any of them are on the test he creates! HE makes it seem like it's easy but then he says some answers are more correct than others! SO if you dont put the correct answer it's fully wrong. Nice guy but he really isn't good.

Dave is the nicest guy in the world. He is sometimes a little out there, but he means well and cares about his students. As long as you try on the assignments and tests, you will pass with ease. He is also more than happy to have you get additional experience by volunteering with FIU. There's no textbooks - just stories about his real experiences!

Dave Scott is your quintessential collegiate lecturer; for it being almost a 3 hour class, this man literally bored me to tears with tales of the amount of poultry required to feed a football team. Overall, not a terrible guy, but be prepared to write about pointless stuff... a lot
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Easiest class I ever took here at UM. It's impossible not to get an A. You can miss 3 lectures without points being deducted. No lockdown, and everything is unlimited attempts and stays open two days past the deadline. Assignments are reopened at the end of the semester for you to do again if you missed some. Take this if you need a stat credit!

You have to try so hard to not get an A in this class. Prof Schick is super kind and every grading criteria is very clear. Unlimited attempts on online HWs and Exams with a ton of extra credit offered throughout the semester. Recommend 100%

Literally phenomenal professor -- if you can take this class, then DO take it!! She explains everything super clearly and makes everything easy to follow. She does lots of examples during class that make the content super easy to understand. Literally the best professor, she's amazing!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Schick was awesome! So kind and caring. Gave so much extra credit and unlimited attempts on homework, quizzes, AND exams (seriously not joking). You'd have to try so hard not to get an A in this class. She posts all lecture slides so its easy to review and she always asks if anyone is confused before moving on to ensure everyone is on the same page

Such an extremely nice professor. All her quizzes and exams are unlimited attempts and she lets you use outside resources as well. Attendance is graded by polls that she does during class so you have to attend class to receive  those points. This class is a guaranteed A.
Professor Schick was awesome she gave so much extra credit and every exam is on blackboard open for the entire week
The sweetest professor. Highly recommend her. She is very nice and takes everything nice and steady. If you fail the class, its on you!!!

Makes everything super clear in the powepoints and also is available if you have questions. HW, quizzes, exams have unlimited tries. So you can keep doing them till you get a 100. I learned a lot and wasn't stressed about exams. Also gives tons of extra credit. Attendance does count tho. If you don't do well it is honestly on you. TAKE HER!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I had him for Mechanical Behavior and Intro to Composites. Great guy, very interesting and engaging. Be sure to ask questions during lectures because he is sometimes confusing.

Amazing teacher, the best in this department for sure. A real gem, do not miss the opportunity to take his classes. Always trying to help students. Attendance is not mandatory but who in their right mind would miss his classes. I took composites with him and exams were take home, as it requires some coding, not much complicated.
Great person, very kind and always available. Unfortunately he's not as good as a teacher. I didn't find his classes to be clear, I don't think he explains things in an effective way.

Great person and professor. Professional in and out of the classroom and is always willing to help students succeed. Understands what is important in real world engineering and doesn't waste time on topics that the book covers that aren't relevant in real world applications. I definitely suggest Dr. K!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Would take again

reviews.comment: Dr. Lake is awesome. He's a nice guy, and a fairly easy grader. Attendance is mandatory.

UM has a wealth of professors who are very passionate about they do, and Prof. Lake is one of them. PHI is NOT an easy subject, but he takes as much time as necessary to help you understand it. Keeps dedicated office hours if you need help, and he's always there when he says he will be. He makes class fun and is receptive to his students.
One of the best at UM. To the commenter below - Phi 2010 isn't taught at UM?
no way again.
Mr. Lake presents the material very well. The class discussions were my favorite.

Prof. Lake is a great instructor for such complex material. Also, he's a really fair grader and extremely easy to approach. He's always willing to help you if you need it. Just make sure you READ the homework assignments, because he sometimes gives multiple choice pop quizzes,which are super easy and the readings are what his lectures are based on.

Excellent teacher. Puts all of what he says on the board so its easy to get down. Tests are VERY fair and easy. They come from the study guides. He instantly replies to emails all of the time. Finally his discussions often got very interesting. The best part is he knows what he is talking about.
How could you not like Mr. Lake's teaching.  He is awsome.  I took so much away from his class.  I feel as though I could have failed it just to take it again!
A good teacher on a very difficult subject.  He explains things clearly and is willing to help.  His tests are difficult, but he has reading quizzes that help your grade (if you read).
Tough grader, but he does a great job at explaining things, and he's always willing to help. I've learned a lot from this class so far!

Cash is super sweet but beware of doing the absolute most when it comes to assignments. Compared to other writing classes she requires a lot of in-class work and extra assignments that are super repetitive.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: I would definitely recommend taking Prof. Cash. Be aware that there is a good amount of work you will have to put into the class but she doesn't give any real grades (besides on quizzes which are simple open book questions) and instead focuses on our development as writers rather than slapping a grade on papers. She is very kind and understanding.

She's very nice and cares about her students. Very helpful and gives good feedback. She's very understanding and helps you through the writing process. The workload isn't heavy because a lot gets done in class with her help and peer review. Easy grader.
She is annoying.  A lot of work.  Not necessarily hard, but definitely annoying.  She emphasizes how you should be spending 6 hours on homework for her class every week.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: I LOVE her so much; she is a very genuine and caring professor. She helps you a lot with your work. There are only two essays and they are both fun to write. I would highly recommend it.

Definitely take professor Cash if you can. She is such a sweet and caring person and is always willing to work with her students. Lays out all assignments at start of semester. If you do the assignments on time you will do just fine. Overall the class is very easy as everything is pretty much graded based on its completion rather than just quality
Definitely gave work but gives 100% on everything and is very easy. Graded on completion.
Do the work and put in some effort and you get an A on every assignment. She is very nice and caring. Does have some homework every week but nothing too long.

LOVEEE her. she is such a queen and is seriously the nicest professor ever. take her! work in minimal and easy A, grades on completion. sure wrs106 can be boring, but she is the absolute best. everyone take her, NOW.

Dr. Cash was the best teacher I had this semester, and the best writing/English teacher I have ever had! She is so kind and you can really tell she cares about each and every student. She is a very fair grader, and unlike many teachers, her criticism is actually constructive and really helps with the improvement of your writing.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Nice and helpful. Ability to meet outside of class hours. Easy grading.

She's amazing! At the beginning of the semester, she gives you a clear syllabus of how the course is supposed to go. Her grading is mainly completion as long as you follow the rubric. She's easy to talk to as well as super understanding.

Dr. Cash is quite literally the best prof. She really cares about each one of her students, and will do anything to help you write the best version of your paper. Three papers in the class, but she spends a lot of time with each one and guides you on what to do. Fairly easy class considering having to write a lot. If you can, take her!

Dr. Cash is very smart and super kind. I never worried about going to her class because she made her assignments clear and was flexible when you didn't understand something. She appreciates participation and if you read the pre class work, you will do very well. She wants to see you succeed! Definitely would take again.
HIGHLY RECOMMEND. basically a completion grade, although there are a lot of assignments if you just complete them you get an A. Super straightforward.
She is a very sweet professor who is very caring. She grades work on completion as long as she sees that you put in the work for her class! She is an amazing professor! Take her!!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: Great professor. If you simply do all of the assignments, you are guaranteed to get an A. She is caring and only grades writing based on completion & revisions because she believes writing is subjective. Only thing I didn't like about the class were the frequent group discussions because others tended to not participate. Take her if you can!
Class was extremely easy!! She is super sweet and understanding. Three papers are given and due at the end of the semester, grading done on completion.
Professor Cash is Amazing! Extremely easy class and easy grader as well! All assignments including papers are graded upon completion! Cash is definitely the best English professor in the department!

Professor Cash is a really nice, caring, and passionate professor who meets one on one with students, which I think is awesome. The grading criteria is super clear. Meeting the requirements you're getting an A. The class is very easy. I wasn't pushed hard enough, but if you're not great at English and want an easy A then she's a gem.
most empathetic professor I've had in a while. Cares about her students and is incredibly dedicated to student success!

Professor Cash is one of the kindest people you will meet here. She is understanding and very helpful. She has a philosophy of grading on competition but that doesn't mean she will let you get away with turning something terrible in. She will work with you and help you become a better writer. Take her!

Professor Cash is one of the best professors on campus. She explains the material very clearly and make sure everyone excels and is happy. Don't be afraid to write essays, she will always give you feedback and steps you can take to improve. Extra Credit will always be offered for you to do better. She is a very caring and understanding professors!

Dr. Cash is such a queen. Class expectations are simple and clear. She wants her students to do well. Class was never stressful or work-heavy (which is what it should be as a class lots of students need as gen ed). I am taking her 8am next semester because I loved her so much. 10/10 recommend.
Easy but boring. Doesn't believe in "grades" you get an A just for doing assignment and revision.
Don't buy the textbook you barely use it. Amazing teacher super easy grader and very understanding. Sweetest lady ever. Lets you do zoom if you email her first
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Absolutely loved Professor Cash. She doesnt believe in grading, so as long as you do the assignments , she will give you an A. Only 3 papers and she lets you revise them all at the end. Very easy class to pass and she is very passionate about what she teaches.

Dr. Cash used contract grading for my class which was super great. If you followed the benchmarks for each assignment and turned it in on time, you get a 100% on it. She likes when people talk in class, so get on her good side by doing that. She's not unfair or even subjective on papers. It's an easy class and you still learn.

Dr. Cash is my favorite professor so far. She cares so much about her students and is extremely kind. There's three papers, and she takes the time to do an individual conference with every single one of her students. She's very organized and has everything laid out week by week for you to access. Her rubrics are clear and detailed. Take her.

Only 2-3 good papers and your final project which is 8-10 pages long which a presentation along with. Dont get scared of the Final cuz you get a whole month and she guides you through it. She basically wont let you fail and is always understanding with any problem you have. You get to revise your papers at the end of semester for higher grades.

He is q Great professor but be ready to study hard. He is strict but always available. Although I finished with a B+ I will take this class with him all over again.

Great professor, his lectures are easy to understand and include all the material he will put on the exam. Studying for his exams needs to be thorough, but not really necessary to use extra materials other than the lectures.

Dr. Sarmoen sets a great example of how teaching should be. He explains complex pharmacology clearly, using real-life examples and humor to keep lectures engaging. reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback
