She cant speak english and it being a class of over 150 students she has no control over the class and it is sooo boring.  Very bad teaching skills.  SHe knows alot but cant teach or speak english

She is hard to understand and the class can be VERY boring, but it is EASY. You don't need to attend class, just get somebody to do the "question of the day" for you and copy the notes off the internet. I got an A+ in this class and worked on my fantasy football team more than anything else. Enjoy.

Boring class, but bring your laptop and you'll be alright. Just don't talk to your neighbors, it ticks her off. Three exams and a question of the day to turn in every day (that accounts for 5% -- attendance portion). Difficult to hear what she's saying sometimes because of her Indian accent. Nice person, pretty easy class. RECOMMENDED.

Easy class, don't need to read the textbook or pay attention to pass the tests. Attendance is required (has a question of the day every class for participation/attendance purposes) but is not a big chunk of your grade. You can miss class, pass the tests, and still make a 95 at the highest. Has extra credit assignments if necessary.

Unclear, contradictory, and potentially biased grader. I took this course despite many other students' reviews that each grade he gave was a B, thinking that if I put in the right amount of work on my papers, I could be an outlier. Unfortunately, I was wrong. I strongly recommend that the PHI department review his behavior, curriculum, and grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Being able to take a class with Dr. Slote is an amazing opportunity. He is an expert in this field and is so knowledgeable about literally everything. All the philosophers we discuss he personally knew. Can be easy to get lost but if you put in the effort and ask questions he will explain it. Cannot recommend enough if you like philosophy

Do not take unless you want to either sit alone in a room with him for three hours a week and still get a B, or just never come to class and get an even worse grade. He is in his 80s, bro needs to go to bed. Do not take.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I believe Professor Slote is the best philosophy professor at U.M. I took PHI 530, and although the material was difficult, it was explained thoroughly in each class, and any questions we had were answered by Professor Slote. Grade is concentrated on two 10-page essays, but if you pay attention and put in the effort you can get an A.
You literally dont have to show up to class. The course revolves around 3 papers that he gives everyone a B.

This was the most boring class I have ever taken. The man literally sits at the front of the classroom and reads old books word for word and doesn't bring any energy into his class. His papers are very vague and he grades them very harshly. My first a paper I was given a B/B+, so which is it? Overall horrible experience that dropped my GPA by .10.

This class is incredibly boring. You do not need to show up to class in order to write your papers. The prompts are pretty generic and he wants it to be off your opinion not so much about the philosophers approach. In class he rants about philopsophy and ends up on some tangent not relevant to the philopsopher you are studying at the time.
His lectures require zero class participation. Most classes, his voice is the only voice you will hear. 3 papers that are not particularly easy nor particularly difficult.

Professor is very smart and an expert in normative ethics. Lecture heavy. 3 papers the whole semester, harsh grader (everyone I knew got Bs on all the papers). Class is very lecture heavy, sometimes boring if you're not a philosophy major.

Slote is an expert in his field. He paces when he talks but is incredibly smart. I learned a lot from him and he was always available during his office hours. Relatively easy reading and 3 short papers. If you can focus on his lectures, it's 100% worth it.
Great professor. Lecture-only class and you learn a lot, he knows so much on philosophy. If you find material difficult, record it! 3 papers, graded easily. He's helpful and will push you to think.
Really passionate about teaching but does not tolerate absence and does not meet with students

Real smart guy, just isn't very good or interested in teaching.  Grade is based on 3 papers that are a doozy to get through but are graded fairly easily.  Doesn't so much teach as speak about his views on each ethical system we learn about - class isn't mandatory.  Rather boring, rather tedious, but not difficult.

Material is really boring but he is so excited about it so its almost interesting. Very intimidating because he teaches grad style and he is extremely accomplished. Only 2 ten page papers for the term and he is very willing to help with topics. As long as your argument is well reasoned, you will do well on the papers.

He really knows his stuff and if you are into the stuff he teaches, then you will enjoy his class.  He was always so helpful out of class if I had questions on something he said or with my papers.  He was definately provacative

Complex, brilliant fellow...  He knows his stuff. Nobody better to learn criticisms of all modern ethical theories from. He seems aloof and arrogant at first, but as you chat with him you learn that he's actually quite warm. Also intellectually honest - open to critiques, if they are intelligent.

It was a 500 Level class.  Teaches pure grad-style.  No writing on the board.  Demanding in grading.  Hard to follow in lecture, but if you tape-record and re-listen, you should be okay.  Lectures don't matter, because you choose your topic for essays (anything goes).  Intimidating, but actually nic

This class is fun and not difficult at all. She is an understanding person and as long as you try your best and get your work done you get an A. This class only meets twice a week off campus so it's important you show up and/or miss only a couple of classes.
She is very funny and helpful. I liked her, just beware that the class is kind of boring in my opinion. You just do pencil drawings and it can get really repetitive if it's not something you enjoy.

Amazing professor! she is very caring if you have to miss a class. I will say she talks the entire class when explaning a new project, which can get super boring but its fine. The class is super interesting, but is very long. if you finish a project early she allows you to leave. I would definitely recommend and take her again for sure.
Professor Slavkovic is great, and always willing to help you improve your skills.  If you show up to class and make an effort, you should get an A.

I looooove Professor Slavkovic!!! By far my favorite class I've taken at UM. She is so funny, understanding and truly passionate about art. Grades were based on projects and she's forgiving if you miss class / can't participate. If you can take her, please do.

I loved this class. Professor Slavkovic is very thoughtful. She helps the students to achieve their full potential. This is a very inspirational and encouraging class. Even though I had no notions or previous knowledge in drawing, I actually learned good techniques and had fun. I truly recommend this class to others.
Lidjia made this class very interesting. It was a breath of fresh air compared to traditional classes were all used to taking.   The class overall was fun
Great conductor and leader. Demands excellence and hard work, but it pays off. Whole orchestra always sounds incredible.
LOVE this guy. Amazing conductor and person.

He let us use chopsticks instead of buying an acual baton!  =)   Easy to understand, obviously knows and cares about the subject and is very helpful and understanding both in and out of the classroom.
He's the crazieset, coolest, conductor. His hair is so much fun to watch while he conducts and he makes the orchestra sound great!
Lot of reading, So much writing took her eng class for transfer students. content was interesting but so much writing. only take if you have the time. o see her for help.
helpful and open-minded--goes through all of the literature and each class is an open discussion interpreting essays, poems, plays, and other forms of literature

This class is extremely easy to get an A. Not only is she very clear on how she wants things done, but is also very considerate of your schedule outside her class. There's only a midterm, final and two papers which are very straightforward. She's really young,can relate to us and is willing to work due dates and stuff to help everyone. Loved her!!!
very helpful, allows you to tie in your interest into somewhat strange topics. best teacher so far at UM

An excellent instructor. Takes some getting used to at first, as you grow to learn what she expects from you. She teaches you how to really write a solid analytical paper. Learned a great deal from her-HIGHLY recommended.

If you all thought she was hard.. then your High Schools sucked and you shouldn't be at UM. Slivka was fair, not very easy but not hard! She is a grad student, so she is cool and understands students (because she is one), Irish Lit. was interesting.. Overall, I highly recommend her. very sweet, grades FAIRLY, offers Extra Cr, TALK to her for help!

It's funny that Slivka is an English teacher because she can barely put a sentence together herself. Her comments and "feedback" often do not help at all. Her idea of assisting you on a paper is using words like "vague" along the margins. I also found her assignments to be rather unclear and rambling. Also, the class is boring and she grades tough.

At the beginning the class did not seem so bad. I wish she would have had more ratings before taking her. She makes the class way too hard and it seems she only thinks her class is the only one we're taking. Don't recommend her.

this class is AWFUl!! it's a huge waste of time. shes nice but you learn nothing and shes SOOO boring. she wastes tons of class time on stupid activities and gives no time for her many, ridiculous essays and homework assignments. shes a flake and does not work to your benefit. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS.
Very cool and personable. I would take it if I were you.
Excellent
Awesome professor

I must say in all my years at UM I have never had a more pompous teacher who did not know how to teach. While the  class topic is  thoroughly stimulating- her rude, overbearing opinions ruined her ability to get any point across. Whatever you do, stay away from this professor!
Dr. Skelley was really engaging, interested in what we as students had to say, and provided great feedback and tips for her assignments. She really was invested in our success!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Skelley is truly one of my favorite professors. Not only is she clear about every assignment, but she is also a very easy grader. I am not good at English and still got an A. On top of this, she is very easy on the eyes.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Skelley has 3 essays, multiple Blackboard discussion entries, readings that need to be done by the time you have her class and some writing workshops. In my class, we only had one pop quiz all semester. She is very clear with her grading criteria, providing the rubric and explaining it thoroughly and what to avoid for her essays.
I don't like writing, and I loved her class.  Take it if you want to learn a lot but don't mind being challenged.

Dr. Skelley is one of the most caring teachers I've had. She is very interested in her students and wants them to excel. That being said, her hard-headed attitude does conflict with students that don't put in the effort she asks. If you do the work, she'll like you.

No professor on the planet is more loveable than the amazing Dr. Chelsea Skelley. She is the honestly the realest: she lays out all her policies at the beginning of the semester and warns you that you're going to have to put in the effort. Many jump ship, but if you stick around you are rewarded with one of the best professors on the planet.
Had her for business communication. Prof knows what she is talking about and will help with real world projects if you do the work in class. She's also the hottest teacher at the U

Dr Skelley is a hard teacher. She knows a lot and expects a lot from you. Do the work and you'll be fine. You'll also learn stuff from her that is useful because she knows science, tech and business. No finals and you don't have to read typical crap from other English classes
Prof Skelley basically teaches rhetoric so it's harder than other classes, but she makes it fun and useful. She's also beautiful! So funny. I had her at 8am and actually wanted to go to class
I had Prof Skelley for business writing. She's smart and knows her stuff. Hot! She looks like Jenny from The League and is funny as hell!
She is brilliant and funny. You can't skip class though, not ever. But she's hot!
You have to come to class or you won't pass, not a chance. She has very high standards, but she's helpful and very smart. Also attractive.
She's too harsh
Excellent professor. Cares that the students learn. I really enjoyed her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Made fun of me and I liked it. Best professor I've ever had.
Mrs. Skipp is a wonderful professor. She gives valuable feedback to help you become a better writer. There are lots of assignments, but all are achievable. I greatly enjoyed this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She definitely has a passion for what she does and I think she means well (?) Her expectations are extremely high. she will penalize you for unexpected reasons
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She belittles students if they make mistakes. She rarely fully explains assignments or posts them online, and she is amused if students ask her to elaborate.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Catharine Skipp is an amazing, witty, and well-respected professor. There are certain things that she will count off a lot of points for, such as spelling someone's name incorrectly, but everything she is strict about has a valid reason behind it. She is genuinely passionate about her students and wants them to do well in the industry.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: If you're thinking of taking a different teacher for JMM108, just don't. You may be stressed at times, but you will learn so much!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Skipp is the most amazing prof ever, period. You have to write a lot of papers, but she gives a massive amount of feedback so you can easily improve. She's absolutely hilarious, and really cares about her students. She wants you to succeed! Her class is fun and she loves her students, and she's a massive help when it comes to writing.
I love Professor Skipp! She is the best. Take her! She is very particular about attendance (you can't miss a class), but other than that she is AMAZING!! Love her!

She is very explicit with instructions for her assignments and strict with attendance. She only allows one absence per semester, and any tardiness is deemed an absence. If you follow her instructions closely and go to class, there is no reason why you shouldnt get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Great teacher. Can be vague with directions and expectations for certain assignments, but wants you to do well. She works for the NYT for a while and knows the field inside out. Attendance (being on time too) and Participation is mandatory as they count towards your grade, but she's awesome.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Skipp is AMAZING. I've had the pleasure of taking her course (JMM 108 is the only class she teaches) and would do it all over again if I could. Gives invaluable feedback, you can tell she really wants you to learn. Super approachable after class, but hard on deadlines so don't (no pun intend) skip any assignments. My writing improved tremendously!

Skipp is the GOAT. Attendance is extremely mandatory, she does not play around with that, but if you go to class and do all of her little homework assignments (theres a lot, but its all easy point opportunities) you should pass. She is super helpful, funny, and probably my favorite professor. You learn a lot with her, she's worth taking.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Skipps is THE best professor. Just do your assignments and come to class. She's really cool but she has no tolerance for lateness- in class and on assignments. Comes off intimidating but once you get to know her she's really nice. totally recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Comes off kind of intimidating at first, but is actually approachable and helpful. Make sure you're signed up for a time that you'll actually go to-she takes attendance at the beginning of every class and is strict with tardies.

I highly recommend Professor Skipp. Her class is challenging and a lot of work, but you learn a lot! She is strict in class and when it comes to punctuality, but she really cares about her students and wants everyone to do well. If you don't want to waste your time and improve your writing skills, she is the right professor for you! :)
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: Great professor who genuinely cares about you. She cares a lot about punctuality, but if you make the effort to show up it will pay off. Highly recommend her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Skipp is very funny and nice. Classes mainly consist of Harkness discussions and in class assignments. She gives good feedback and is easy to talk to. However, she is very strict on attendance and tardiness which can be annoying if you have it at 8 am. Other than that, I would recommend her.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Great professor. Really wants you to do well. Ask for feedback and talk to her after class and she'll love you. Cares about tardiness and attendance, weekly homework and in-class discussions. Textbook is required, only used for homework. Easy A, gives great feedback, super nice.

Elton is truly a prof that covers the needs of every student in the realm. From the foreign exchange student that doesn't speak english to the full ride to law school chick who's a little crazy, everyone loves the man. Hats off to Albania for sending us this gem, and props to those who's GPAs doubles after taking this man 4 semesters in a row.

Skendaj is a really genuine professor and you can tell he really cares about teaching and getting through to the students. It was definitely an easy A, he basically gives out the exam questions in class so if you show up regularly or read the powerpoint/textbook if you don't, you're definitely going to get an A.

You really need to go to class.  A lot of the test questions are from his lectures so if you don't go to class, you're putting yourself at a major disadvantage.  Also, 10% of your grade is from class participation, so definitely go.  Some test questions can be tricky and are in the textbook so read! Great professor and kind man!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Lectures are question driven and a lot appear on the tests so makes the tests way easier definitely would recommend taking this class
Really nice guy and very smart. Not necessary to go to class to get a good grade but going does help. I would definitely recommend taking a class with him.
He's so nice and easy. The only issue I had was that the class was a bit dry, but then again, it might just be because it was in intro class.
Great prof, learned a lot in this class and it was fairly simple.

Skendaj is pretty easy. My class with him was in a big hall and he's big on participation, but it worked out well. Basically gives you the questions that are on the test and it's not hard to get a good grade at all of you go to class and study a little.

The guy knows his stuff but as a teacher, he is way to easy. If you take class with him, do not be fooled. Read the book and pay attention in class, but DO NOT SLACK OFF AT ALL! It may be tempting, because the class seems ridiculously easy but really, heed my advice. Otherwise, nice guy and if you are a responsible student you'll be totally fine.
He was very nice, the class was interesting but to too difficult.  The test questions are the same as or very similar to the questions in his lectures, so take notes

Took him for Summer. He assigned 2 five page papers on really interesting topics (creative writing). The tests are all multiple choice and straight from the book. He also gives a few multiple questions during class for discussion, but they appear on the tests so everyone wrote them down. Awesome teacher!!! He did not take attendance.

Expect to see a lot of people from frat and sororities in this class. He basically hand out test questions in class and if your read the book once you are guaranteed to get an A. Its ridiculous that people don't show up for a class at 1pm. Probably the easiest class I've ever taken.
Really boring lectures.... but he does give good material. If you put in a decent amount of effort, it's an easy A.

There is only a paper, midterm and a final so there is a lot of weight on those for your grade.  His lectures sometimes feel like they take forever but he tries very hard to keep everyone involved.  He is very into discussing questions with groups, so get ready to talk.

Probably one the easiest college classes you will ever have. If you read the textbook you will get an A even if you don't show up to class. Very nice guy, has a lot to offer and respects your opinion. His tests are based on the book and not his lectures, so start reading. Its about 10 pages a week. I just don't understand why people can't do that!!

Pretty straightforward class, only 1 quiz 1 test and the final. Attendance isn't mandatory but  its a small class so he'll notice if you never come. Also you go over multiple choice questions every class and a lot of them are on the test.  He's passionate about what he teaches and tries to keep it interesting with little group activities.

Attendance not mandatory, but he gives you multiple choice questions that you need for the test. First exam about half of the questions he had given us in class. You get into groups and discuss the questions and then answer as a group, makes lectures better but can sometimes can drag on. study book before exam and notes and you'll be fine

hes so interested in the topic and therefore makes students interested as well. gives a compressive study guide. i received and A in the course without doing any reading but attendance and at least an attempt at participation are necessary

easy course if you do the work. he gives a compressive study guide and posts all of the lectures on blackboard so attendance isn't too necessary. however, if you attend lecture he throws multiple choice questions on the power point and uses these questions word for word on his exams and quizzes. super nice guy and always willing to help.
His test questions are vague but his lectures are somewhat interesting.

Interesting lectures but questions on exams had multiple answer choices that could work and hope its what he wants. Exam questions are vague and misleading.  Your better off reading the book for the exams.

Walked out of class feeling like I didn't learn anything. A lot of pointless group activities. Heavy reliance on long, boring readings and on the textbook. As long as the reading assignments are thoroughly completed, you should do fine. Wording on tests is sometimes overly complicated and unclear. Helpful to students and offers extra credit.

He is a great professor! Absolutely loved him! He is very good at teaching and helping the class understand through group activities! Attendance is not mandatory but make sure to do the textbook readings if you want above a C+/B-. Really enjoy having this class with him and would definitely recommend him!
Really nice prof. Class is also super easy. Attendance is not mandatory but class is interesting. He likes to have little group participation activities.

Professor Snell is one of my favorite teachers I've ever had. She's really nice and funny, and makes an effort to make class exciting and fun. Some projects that must be done in class but notes and study guides are very clear. Would totally take again and a pretty easy class overall if you just pay attention
She is the worst. Do not take this class. She is a mean, evil person who does not care about her students.
Easy A if you don't miss any assignments.
easy class.  show up because she tells you what's on the quiz/tests.  really cool and funny.

Attendance isn't mandatory, but she assigns unannounced classwork-if you miss that day, you get a zero. Tests and quizzes are easy if you study. Textbook isn't required, but can be helpful-her powerpoints come mostly from the book. Posts her powerpoints online before tests, so if you miss class you're not screwed. Funny, approachable.
Easiest A at UM. Very funny and she only takes attendance twice a semester and tells the class that if they have friends that aren't there to call them and make sure they come. Its a joke

Love her! She is fun and grades are easily earned by some class assignments and tests. Tests are super easy if you read power point slides. You don't have to do readings from the book. She gives very practical examples and her lectures are super useful

Professor Sonia Chao's course was very disorganized with inconsistent communication. The syllabus rarely matched class activity, and expectations were often unclear or changed last minute. Students were frequently left figuring things out on their own, making the course unnecessarily stressful.

Professor Chao is a dedicated professor who cares about her students. The resilience course I took with her featured excellent guest lecturers and provided me with practical and relevant knowledge. The course projects were interesting and mirror the kinds of work one might be assigned in the field of practice.

Shes literally the best professor Ive ever had in the Architecture school, she is very inspiring, shes a total expert in sustainability and resiliency. Shes going to push the best of you, listen to her advices and you will be successful.
by far the worst professor I've ever had, very controlling and whatever you do she only the negative things that you have if it's a project or a presentation.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Has mandatory symposiums on Saturdays from 9:00AM until 6:00PM, and does not inform you until the first day of class.

Absolutely no comprehension of time management. Essentially all we learned for the entire semester was LEED certification. Relied on outside guests and movies for the lectures, and the majority of the grade consisted of a project which nobody comprehended. Many students still don't have a grade for the class.
She is inspiring.... you can tell she believes in what she teaches. I learned alot about Green architecture.
she has no concept of time in helping a student plan to complete a project on time, making extreme last minute changes. doesn't really let you design things. basically, projects are HERS
really easy class but it's honestly not as helpful for getting internships as advertised, unless you get really lucky with your ta. just get your free a and move on

Very clear lectures. This class was difficult and took a lot of studying, but it was interesting. The best study method was actually speaking through the content with someone. Very interesting and useful. All profs teach differently

For 1 credit this mandatory class for all Business school students has an enormous amount of annoying busy work. Not everyone wants to go to Wall Street and yet everyone is lectured to by Shapiro about the roadmap for a Goldman (etc) internship. The TA's look at resumes and were zero help. My mother knew 10x more than he did about buffing a resume.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Super easy 1 credit class. I found the material really useful for real life. Shapiro is a good lecturer and he likes to keep you engaged. one short quiz every class based on material covered.

I appreciated this class, he gives lots of good tips about going into the workforce. It also helped me feel more prepared for interviews. You must complete a short quiz at the end of every lecture for attendance, just skim over the articles in the syllabus before class. Otherwise, he's a pretty good prof.
All the rumors are true he's one of the best. Difficult class but he makes it easy and enjoyable. All the glazing is completely warranted.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I've taken Prof. Shapiro now for BSL 212, MGT 199, and BSL 476 and he has been nothing short of amazing in all of them. He is a highly engaging lecturer that connects everything we discuss in class with real-world examples. BSL 476 focuses on tort law and insurance and connects directly with his own law practice. Highly recommend this course.

Easily one of the best professors and classes at UM. Law of Risk is a niche topic focused on negligence tort and insurance law, so be ready for a significant, but super interesting project and tests that require a strong analysis of the law. Put a little effort in and you'll absolutely love this class. Highly, highly, highly recommend

Taking Professor Shapiro for BSL 212 as a Foote Fellow will CHANGE YOUR LIFE! He made me willing to wake up for 8AMs on TTh (not MWF because of ThirThur) and engages you in the content more than anything. 

He uses real world examples that actually makes sense to teach you which helps so much! Definitely look forward to taking him.

Shapiro is great for any business student who wants advice for their career in the future. He has a great background and knows what he's talking about. The class isn't too hard; some of the TAs make it better/worse. The assignments do force you to do things in the real world. However, this class really helped me get an internship!

This professor was a huge disappointment. The class felt pointless, he hands off all real teaching to the TAs, and he spends most lectures talking about himself instead of the material. He's completely disconnected from students and shouldn't teach such a large class. One of the worst courses I've taken.

Professor Shapiro is truly an asset to the business school. He goes above and beyond to support students and is actually invested in our future after graduation. Lectures are engaging and a lot of current events were incorporated into our study which I enjoyed. If you show up and pay attention, there is absolutely nothing to worry about.

Such a jolly fella. You can tell he's really passionate about his job and gives great advice on the internship search/ jobs/ working/ etc. A great professor connection to have and taught me a lot. Pay attention to what he has to say.

Did the assignments the right way and still got a worse grade than classmates who clearly cheated. Really frustrating to see my GPA drop for doing the honest work. Reached out but didn't feel like it was taken seriously. Not a fan of how unfair the grading felt.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Shapiro is a great professor and honestly a really good resource for internships+jobs. I will say he is a tough grader and there arent many things he grades you on but overall i recommend him, hes very smart and kind.
Professor Shapiro is an absolutely amazing professor, the best in the business law department. The course is definitely tough, but if you work hard you can do very well. A must take!!

Professor Shapiro is the best Professor at this school. He can explain complex subject matter in a way that makes it easy to understand. You will have to work and study a lot for this class and definitely do not skip class because you cannot teach yourself for this course. But Professor Shapiro really does make class enjoyable.

This class is easy if you pay attention. Shapiro is very knowledgeable and has established himself in the business world to equip us with the foundational things we need like interview prep, job search, resume etc. The assignments are all practical and helpful. Shapiro is so busy but still so available for students with any questions and advice.

Shapiro's BSL212 class was by no means easy, but your success depends on your studying habits and quality of note-taking. He was a great professor and understands the subject matter well, and it's worthwhile to be on his good side.

This was my hardest class at UM so far. Final grades are 90% tests. You need to go into every quiz or test very prepared by memorizing handwritten notes from lectures. Lectures are straightforward and entertaining. If you put in a reasonable amount of work you should not walk out of this class with lower than a B+. Shapiro is great!
One of the best professors I took at UM. Took him for 476 and 485. Very difficult to get into his classes, they fill up quickly.

This class consists of quizzes (5 questions) every class about the material learned that day and only a few assignments which are graded pretty heavily. Make sure not to leave anything for the last minute and use the grading criteria as you are completing assignments. It is very easy to not get an A in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Shapiro is the absolute best. This class was test heavy (6 quizzes and a final made up most of the grade) and challenging, but so worth it. Learned a ton and wouldn't want any other professor teaching it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Shapiro gives great lectures! He is very engaging and uses a lot of examples to teach the material. He is easy to talk to and tries to connect with every student he has. He is a very fair grader, giving a lot of partial credit on quizzes. The final is a little tough, but the quizzes aren't bad. As long as you study, you'll be good.

Prof Shapiro is the best, making a complex topic easy to understand. To do well, you have to pay attention and take detailed notes, every class is so much content. To study, go over the examples in class and quiz - you have to know EVERYTHING. I found the textbook to be confusing, and just used it to clarify terms. Hard but super rewarding!

TAKE THIS CLASS! Fun, interesting, smart professor who clearly cares about the material and the students. He moves fast, but if you ask questions, he'll take it easy. He's also a big person in the business school who it's good to get to know. Just... get ready to memorize.
The class can be a lot of work (studying), but it is worth it. Phenomenal professor. If you have an opportunity to take him, do not pass it up.
Don't bother with the textbook. Lectures are very engaging and interesting. Great teacher, cares about his students. Take thorough notes and study hard and you'll get an A
Most valuable professor for career guidance at UM.

This class will actively get you ready for jobs. You get what you give in the class so I would suggest listening. Be on time and you will be on time. He is a solid listener and he responds to emails on a consistent basis. You won't have a choice of teachers for this class but he is still good
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: By far the best professor I've had at UM! His lectures are very engaging and fun. The class covers the principles of contract law ... topics are highly-technical and involved. As long as you take notes and study for the quizzes you'll end with no worse than a B+. Take him!

Prof. Shapiro is a must-have in the business school. I took him for the Honors section. He doesn't give homework, but there's lots of notes in class. Quizzes are kinda hard but since it's law, there is not a single answer. The textbook sometimes doesn't line up with his lectures, so don't use it. Very interesting & interactive. Recommended 11/10!

You have to take Dr. Shapiro for MGT199. I won't be talking about him too much (he's good). Here's advice for the class: read all the readings in the syllabus before (or in) class. The quiz will be on it. Stay on top of the deadlines. You'll be fine as long as you do and the class is great to prepare for post-grad/finding internships.

I found this class to be very helpful for educating student on the job/internship process. As a first generation student, I don't have many personal resources to help me with this stuff but Professor Shapiro was very knowledgeable and helpful. The class also didn't add a large load to my pre-existing course schedule, and was very manageable.

I really enjoyed Professor Shapiro's class. However, I feel that he is involved in too many different things at the business school and too busy to dedicate enough time to everything he does. In class he's great, but he truly doesn't have time to help every student. He really should ask for some assistance so he has time to give everyone attention.

Anyone who says it's too much work just doesn't do any work. Yes, there are a couple of assignments but they aren't a waste of time at all. Stuff like building a resume, LinkedIn, and practicing for interviews. Theres a quiz at the end of each class but it isn't hard to do good on them. Good guy. Also ver well known in the school.

Professor Shapiro is a very personable and kind instructor, always making himself available for questions and discussions. However, his workload can be overwhelming and his assignments can be very tedious. While his friendly demeanor helps to create a comfortable learning environment, his high expectations can cause unnecessary stress for students.

MGT199 is way too much work for a one credit class. It is also a colossal waste of time, and although I understand the intentions behind this course, it's not as practical as one might think. I don't think Mark Shapiro is special in anyway, and most of what he says in class is common sense.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I truly do not understand the hype around Professor Shapiro. He comes off as extremely arrogant and brags all the time how he is personally responsible for the success of the business school. Shapiro is knowledgeable about certain subjects, but requiring every student to take his class is just ridiculous. Easily the most overrated professor at UM.
This is, in my opinion, a hard class. However, Professor Shapiro makes sure everyone understand each topic taught. There are weekly review sections and he is very generous grading.
a great teacher and a fun class that taught me a lot and was interesting. quizzes take a lot of studying but he guides you well

If you go to class, take notes, and then give two to four hours of studying per quiz, you should do very well. Shapiro makes the information clear and completely nullifies the need for the textbook. The class is entirely lecture based but he makes it very engaging by using students in examples of the law.

It can not be stated how important he can be if he knows you. But beware to not go up to him and ask questions just for the sake of putting your name in his head, he will see right through that. I only got to meet with him as a result of unpredictable events but having him know me has definitely been a huge win for me

If you have the opportunity to take any of his classes, 100% do it. Even if your grade suffers, if you get to know him, he is one of the most important connections you could make at UM. He never forgets you once he knows your name, and is always willing to talk (As long as he's not busy). Genuinely wants to get to know his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: the best prof youll have at this school most likely. Extremely thorough and makes sure everyone understands a topic.

One of the best professors at this school. He managed to make business law interesting and he's a really good lecturer, all the material is clearly presented. The class is a lot of memorization so be prepared for the quizzes and cumulative final. Overall, he's such a nice and helpful person who makes his classes pretty engaging and enjoyable.

Amazing professor, but NOT an easy one. He was a contract lawyer for 20 years and and you can tell he knows his stuff. I got an 80 and 77 on the first two quizzes because I didn't study. After that I made note cards for all the rules/terms and got 96-98 on the remaining quizzes. If you manage to get a spot in his class just make sure to study!!!

He is the best professor and this class was really helpful. Made resumes, LinkedIn profiles, and did mock interviews. Best class yet at the business school and he definitely knows what hes talking about.

The professor is awesome and teaches super well! However, you are going to need to study a lot for quizzes. I recommend starting studying 2 weeks before the final exam because it requires a lot of memorization.

Professor Shapiro is a GEM. His lectures are extremely interesting. He expects a lot from students which makes his class difficult but fair. Lots of quizzes and papers; youll always have something to do. He is super accessible outside of class. He is one of those professors that leaves a lasting impact. If you can, do yourself a favor and take him
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great Teacher, made class really entertaining and I learned so much from him. Would highly recommend him.

Amazing professor! Teaches with examples to make everything easier to understand. Doesn't record lectures, so be ready to take good notes every class and DON'T SKIP or you'll be so lost. Tests aren't too difficult, but it's a good amount of memorizing/ studying. Very fun guy, all my homies love Mark Shapiro
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Fun, witty and very willing to accommodate questions and concerns. Tests can be difficult if you go in unprepared but otherwise they're fair.

Prof. Shapiro is one of the best professors at UM. He doesn't only care about his students inside the classroom, but outside of it as well (despite my class being fully remote). The class is lecture heavy, hard, and sometimes confusing. But he is an entertaining lecturer, a lenient grader, and makes class always fun and interesting!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Shapiro is a famous guy at Miami. He truly cares about each one of his students and tries to get to know them on a personal level. He always makes himself available and gives great advice. Likes to play devil's advocate, and it can get annoying. However, I know he's just trying to get people participating in discussions. As far as the class, easy
He's a tough grader but truly an amazing professor

He's everyone's favorite Professor. His background in law is very inspirational and his lectures are enjoyable. Not an easy A, as there are quizzes and participation grades in addition to a major group project. His grading is also pretty fair, but every point matters. If you put in the work and don't treat it like an easy A then you'll be well off.

Shapiro is an entertaining teacher. He is very overrated he does not curve your grader and no extra credit. He is one of the few business school teachers who thinks being unnecessarily tough on grading will raise the school in rankings. Everyone likes his lectures but would you exchange entertainment for a higher grade elsewhere? Stay Away for an A
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Shapiro knows his stuff. He is really great at making the material comprehensive. It is really important to know the cases ahead of time so you can participate as well as starting the group project early/going to him with questions.

He's challenging, but challenging in the best way possible! He's very inspirational when he talks and teaches, and that's why he has near-perfect attendance for his lectures. Despite having so many students look up to him and respect him, he really goes out of his way to make you feel engaged and valued. Wish I could have him forever!
One of the best and most respected professors at the U. Great combination of gaining both admiration from the students while still being able to connect on a personal level. Highly recommend.

He's a well respected teacher and very approachable outside of class. He's a tough grader and gives really good feedback. I'm a little hesitant to take him again as he is a little harder on minute details but he challenges you and you will learn a lot. Overall, a really good professor!

Shapiro is such a great man. He genuinely cares about the success of each of his students and will do anything to help them achieve that. He can be a tough grader and enjoys to argue with you (he used to be a lawyer), but overall he's one of my favorite professors.

Dr. Shapiro is hands down my favorite professor at UM. He is a quintessential professor in and out of his field. I have taken him for 2 separate classes and never once felt bored during his lectures, he is engaging and exciting all while imparting so much knowledge on the students. additionally form a relationship with him he is an asset to have!

Professor Shapiro is one of the best assets the Miami Business School has to offer. He cares about his students, is an expert in his field, and also serves as the director of Undergraduate Career Resources. If you have the chance to, you should form a relationship with him, it should benefit you both in the classroom and down the road.
He really knows what he is talking about and you can tell he cares about his students. He is hands down an amazing professor and anyone would be lucky to have him.

Dr. Shapiro is an excellent professor! He keeps students engaged and offers many opportunities to meet outside the classroom. As long as you participate and listen in class, you will do fine! I recommend for students to take this class and any class offered by him! He is one of the top professors at the University of Miami! Strongly recommend!!

Professor Shapiro is probably the best teacher for BUS 101. He definitely knows the material really well and provides great examples during lectures. He is always engaged in class and really wants to know his students (he knew everyone's names in a 120 person lecture on the second day). The exams are difficult but the curve is helpful.
Tough Grader... subject matter expert in Torts. Insurance Lawyer, his advice and lecture may help you seek counsel later in business transaction.

This is a required course for all business majors. This was his first time teaching this course. The test were hard because the powerpoints and books and common sense and test are not. Good luck. You'll still pass, but not with flying colors

He is a vey tough grader and offers little to no explanation as to why you received the grade you did. I would not take him again because even though the final is made by every teacher, he is the one who grades your class's final.

Best Professor I've ever had. Has non-mandatory attendance but  you want to show up to class. Not an easy class, but certainly not the most difficult if you're willing to put the work in. Shapiro is super helpful and always willing to help his students. He's very humble given his success, I'm grateful for his role in my education.

Maybe one of the best professors that I took at UM by now. Shapiro is hard but he is also a good and amazing human being. He makes you want to understand business law in order to understand what he is talking about. Go to class and take good notes. You will do just fine!

One of the best teachers I have ever had. Will make you want to show up to class, quizzes can be a little tough sometimes but if you pay attention you more than likely will do well. TAKE NOTES! Will make studying for quizzes much easier.

Professor Shapiro is a nice funny guy. However, he talks too fast and he is a super HARD GRADER. My English teacher gave me B+ or A- all the time, even she is rated not easy teacher here. However, my two papers only got average 8.4. Quizses are hard, as a hard grader, he makes them harder. I tried hard, but still only can get a B I think.  Harddddd

Mr. Shapiro is an amazing teacher. Bus212 is not an easy class no matter who your teacher is, but he is a super smart guy who explains everything clearly and makes class interesting. I look forward to going to his class. It is not the easiest class, and you do have to study to do well, but he will help you if you need it.

Easily one of my best profs. BSL can be trickyalot of memorizing but he makes it much easier! Very clear during class, uses students as examples, cracks some jokes, and is super nice. He's always at Starbucks on Sat. on campus for a few hours and is willing to talk. Tries to give you the best grade possible on each of the 8 quizzes.
makes the class super interesting, definitely one of the better bel professors I've heard about

Extremely successful lawyer at Ackerman, cares genuinely about the students and preparing them for work/law school following graduation. As of this posting, I think his easiness rating is a bit low.  The studying requirements aren't bad (for this class, BSL 212 requires studying) and the project was pretty easy to complete.

Shapiro is the first and only teacher at the University of Miami who I truly respect. He is a successful and brilliant lawyer who teaches part time out of passion rather than necessity. He is clear, concise, fair, and helpful. Take his class and you will actually learn something. If you screw up this class then you are the problem, not him.

Definitely one of the best professors at UM. He truly cares about his students and makes a sometimes dry subject incredibly interesting. He is a full-time lawyer, so he directly relates personal experiences to book cases. I would highly recommend him for BSL 212, there are no surprises with his tests and if you study the material, you will do well.

Great teacher. Very clear and engaging, drawing from extensive personal experience to illustrate the various topics. Very enjoyable class, makes the material relevant and interesting, definitely take him.

Best teacher! Makes the class interesting and is very good at explaining. Memorize the laws and you will do fine on the quizzes. Final isn't the same one that all the other classes take so it's not as hard.
Amazing teacher. I learned so much in this one class, it made me want to consider Business Law as a major. Great great great teacher. Not an easy class but definitely do-able.
highly recommended !

If you take this class seriously, you will learn the material -- period. Professor Shapiro helps you to not only understand the concepts of contract law, but also improves your technical writing capabilities. I highly recommend this class, and I hope you enjoy it as much as I did. If you want to learn business law, Dr. Shapiro is simply the best.

Great teacher.  Loves his job, doesn't need to teach but he chooses to.  He wants you to do well.  Go to class, take notes, and study the notes 30 minutes before class starts and you will get atleast a B.  Study for an hour and you will get atleast an A-.  2/3s of grade is based on 8 quizzes and 2 one page papers.

Very, very hard class. You *must* be descriptive when writing the rule of law applicable on quizzes, the correct rule of law just won't cut it. He will, however, help you out if you ask. Class was very interesting.
Great teacher!!!! Highly recommended.Gives easy examples to explain hard material. Make sure you take good notes. Very helpfull...

Probably the best teacher I have ever had. True, he tests based off of the notes, but his notes are often much more useful than the book.. You'll understand what I mean once you see the book.. Very helpful professor. Makes the material much easier to comprehend.

He thinks he is gods gift to the world.  He doesn't like answering questions and is very snide and cocky.  He speaks EXTREMELY FAST, which makes him hard to follow and hard to take notes for.  Every quiz and the final is based on HIS NOTES.  Only read the textbook for the cases.  Doesn't respond quickly with email either. Poor teacher quality.
AWESOME TEACHER!!!!! very helpful, gives weekly quizzes that are not extremely difficult, interesting lecutres
Great teacher, explains things very well and is a great resource for leagal information.  He is a practiceing attourney and only teaches on monday nights.  Great Professor.

She's fine within usual circumstances, my classmates all have quite bad prounciations, but were encouraged to speak.
But wouldn't tolerate medicals. I got a fracture and other life issues, she was reluctant to give accomodations, which was unfair. I know it's supposed to be procedurally fair to other students but I am sure that violates RA and ADA.

Dra. Behar is a very fair professor. All exams have a review session beforehand and lectures and engaging. Class material/homework is manageable and even enjoyable. She's very approachable and wants her students to succeed. Very fair and transparent grader.
THE BEST. She without a doubt cares about each and everyone of her students and makes sure they succeed. Just show up to class, participate a bit, and do the homework which is very manageable.

she is an actual angel, this was my first spanish class at UM and it was the best experience ever. she will make sure you do good in exams (which are usually not long), by reviewing either class of or before. theres 3 exams, 3 quizzes, 3 short assignments and 3 essays, plus a final paper. she walks you through it. recommend her a thousand times!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: A queen. She is the best spanish professor I have had ever. I learned an insane amount in her course. She is empathetic with a great personality and the assignments are easy but you still learn. Class is chill and mostly discussion which helped expand my vocabulary.

What a wonderful professor. Outside of being very thorough and having great classes, she is so sweet and understanding. The material is engaging and, while there is a decent amount of writing, she gives great feedback. Grammar is also included, but also sulee easy. Her class was a great break from the science and math classes I had this semester.

Profesora Behar is a really sweet lady who teaches SPA203 in a nice, relaxed manner while also getting her points across beautifully. Her class wasn't super hard, but in the moments where I needed help, she was always ready and happy to assist. Just come to class and get the work done early... she posts the whole sem's plans the first week.

I loved Professor Behar! Her lectures were always really well done. There is definitely a lot of homework, but that's true for any spanish class. As long as you follow the rubric and her note sheets you can easily get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She is the sweetest and most engaging professor. Her Spanish is very easy to understand yet she speaks at a high level and pretty much strictly in Spanish. I found the course content to be very engaging and a reasonable course load. You definitely do need to keep up with the homework and show up to class though. I would definitely take her again!

Professor Behar is amazing. She does not cold call on students, and she gives very clear and informative lectures. She gives amazing feedback on essays, and she is a very clear grader. Overall, she is very kind and she works humor into her lectures, which makes class overall enjoyable. Very great professor!!

Professor Behar was such a good professor, she always made sure to tell students exactly what was going to be on the quizzes, essays, and tests. There is a lot of studying you have to do if you want to get a good grade but it is all manageable. Would definitely recommend!

I want this woman to adopt me. She is so funny, nice, and she absolutely slays. She's very engaging in class and a really easy grader. I would take her for every spanish class for the rest of my time here if I could. 10/10 reccommend.

I absolutely adore this woman. She is so funny and sweet and just an overall great person. Her classes are very straightforward and she grades pretty easily. Lots of assignments over the course of the class, but again, not graded harshly at all. Just go to class and do the homework and you should get a pretty easy A.

Had her in 207 when she was nice but then in 208 everything was fast-paced and difficult and she completely changes her class structure; reviewing homework, homework due dates, exam difficulty. She just completely changed from being warm in 207 to a cold-hearted queen in 208 I couldn't take it anymore so I withdrew.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Prof Behar is one of my favorite teacher's of all time. Her homework consists of reading short stories or watching a movie and answering questions, some one page essays, and some regular essays. She goes over the stories in class so you rlly understand them, and she gives great feedback on the essays. I highly recommend her, she is great :)

She gave a ton of work but she matched it with her effort. My favorite professor at UM so far. Super funny and caring, but get ready to work. Highly recommend this class to someone with a real interest in Spanish, because its a lot. Great class overall, just be prepared.
Professor Behar has been one of the best professors I have taken. Participation matters. She is caring and very helpful.
I unbelievably appreciate this woman. She really is willing to work with you if you show that you actually care about the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: She is one of the nicest professors I have ever had, if you work hard and are a respectful student. She brings essential oils to class and is a really good professor. Big fan. But you need to put in the work and participation and preparation for class.

She was really nice, and sometimes I forgot to submit hw and she'd email me a reminder to turn it in and she's really nice and lenient and the class was a tiny bit difficult for me since I was shy and I didn't talk much but I liked how much she was willing to work with not just me but everyone else in the class during the pandemic. <3

I am so grateful to have had Dr. Behar as my 1st Spanish professor at UM. She is amazing and the way her class is organized makes it so easy to really learn the content and be well prepared for the exams, and activities. I was always excited to attend her class (even if over zoom) as she was lively and a fun teacher. 10/10!!

Dr. Behar was my favorite teacher by FAR. She was so understanding of these tough times and wasn't trying to make our lives harder. 201 is a lot of work, but that's how every 201 is at UM. She made class so fun and was very helpful. I was worried to start at 201, but it ended up being great! Always do the textbook (online book) work prior!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Prof Behar is the best! Grades by many small assignments, and heavily weights easy As like homeworks and participation that make it easy to get an A overall. Exams are very fair and based exactly off the homework. Very kind lady, just show up and take notes on the textbook pages she assigns and you'll do fine.
Amazing Professor, definitely loves to help her students learn and succeed!!

Dr. Behar is the best French professor I've had in all of high school & college. While a lot of the learning is done on your own through assignments & textbook, she is amazing at teaching the material & helping you pass. You can't learn a language unless you put the work into it, but choosing Behar as your professor is not something you'll regret.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: I LOVE HER!!! Best teacher at UM! She is very attentive and loves to help her students learn and succeed. I would take her over and over again!

Dr. Behar is engaging and makes you excited to learn French. She is understanding that 101 is for elementary level speakers, but you get out of her class what you put in. If you truly want to apply yourself and improve she is the teacher for you.

Professor Behar is the best French teacher I have ever had. A truly amazing woman who in my opinion is overqualified and should be working at the French embassy in Paris. UM students are beyond lucky to have the opportunity to learn from her. Nothing negative to say at all about Professor Behar!

Amazing. She understands that this class is demanding, but makes sure it's as stressless as possible. She is someone who wants you to do well and really cares about her students. Very accessible outside of class.

Tests are hard but you're graded by a lot of things so it's not so bad. Grades are weighted. Can only miss 3 classes or you lose points but some classes are mandatory. But, she was very understanding when I overslept a composition and let me take it during her office hours. LOTS of homework tho. Not terrible but a lot of work for an intro class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: GREAT TEACHER who wants you to do well but hard tests and grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Professor Behar is great! She moves at a good pace, and she is very helpful inside and outside of class. This teacher gives students every opportunity to succeed, and she is very understanding.
The best
She is very hot and cold. She wrote an email to our class about how she would call in the UM police if anyone disturbed her train of thought. Crazy latin lady

Behar is a WONDERFUL professor!!!!  She is definitely the best language prof i've ever had.  Makes you learn french inside and out, the pronunciation, and she's not a hard grader.  Just do the work, practice how to say "tu," (and she makes you laugh when you have to repeat it over and over,) and you'll be set.  Guaranteed A.  Almost.
This lady is a fine professor who truly cares about her students.

Behar is a great french professor. She has an animated personality and makes you laugh during class. She is always willing to help. If you are a good student who respects her and tries, you will succeed in this class. Not a difficult class just keep up with the syllabus. If a class with her is available, she's a good choice.
Shes a great teacher, funny,energetic, would recommend
Excellent professor, but I think she left. Very willing to help students. Highly recommended. However, she does get angry if people mess around in her class or don't participate.
Great professor. Very animated personality. Her class was one of my favorites. Excellent teacher. Very helpful, fair grader, easy to understand.

I've taken Song for phys 1 and 2 so me and him are very close friends (he has no idea who i am).

His midterms are typically just reused homework and in class problems, so theyre layups if you memorize. Lectures are useless, skip and do the in-class problems from home. There are worse physics profs out there, despite the controversy, he is my goat.

Prof. Song has good intentions, but his lectures are so hard to follow. He does not speak good English and you are going to have to learn the material on your own. Get ready to read the textbook a lot and seek outside help.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Ended up not listening to lectures as they did make sense, had to rely on AI for most of my learning. Way too much homework and you have to memorize it for the exams. As long as he's grading, he's nicer than others and gave a curve for the final grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Man, I just suck at physics. Prof. Song totally threw my physics 1 class a bone w/ how he created our midterm exams. Would make the multiple choice section (50%) entirely just reused in-class questions, then the free response (50%) would be pulled from the homeworks. Saved my skin, but I didn't actually learn.. Still got a B- cause I'm dumb hahaha
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Song was by far the best physics professor I have had. It is clear he is really smart and knowledgable, but he is still able to explain concepts well to beginners. Tests were VERY fair, just do your homework and study questions done in class. He definitely cares about his students success and wellbeing, not sure why so many bad reviews.

Just follow what he says to study for the tests (LCs, Homework, and Worksheet questions) and that will be the test. He is a little hard to understand, but he'll explain again if you ask and he's very patient. Helped us out during the quizzes too if we were stuck. Also REALLY good at responding to emails!

Much better than everyone says, physics isn't necessarily easy and I understand some problems with understanding him but he's really a great professor and is pretty clear with expectations and generous with grading.
He is very clear and understanding, don't know why people complain. Got an easy A by only going to lectures and doing homework.

DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. Zero interpersonal skills and a VERY thick accent that makes him impossible to understand. Clearly very smart, but couldn't explain a concept if his life depended on it. Never finishes practice problems he starts on the board. Tests WAY too hard. Makes you feel stupid for asking for help. DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Just absolutely awful. Horrible lecturer, never completed a single practice problem on the board all the way through. His handwriting is absolute garbage, and he CANNOT speak English for the life of him. I've never even left a review on here, as I find most professors agreeable, but this is the absolute worst teacher I've ever had in my entire life
Just terrible. He doesn't care about the students and never makes any effort to help students understand. Save yourself from a torturous experience and DON'T take him.

Literally the worst "professor" (if you can even call him a professor) of all time. He doesn't care about you as a student or person and is extremely disrespectful. He is so socially awkaward that he can't teach a coherent lecture and assumes if a problem is easy for him then it is easy for us too. Overall he is terrible.

This class was moving in general, but Professor Sokol-Katz really made the class that much more special. She speaks with great passion for the subject, is open about her personal life and opinions, and deeply cares for students both academically and personally. She brings very cool guest speakers, offers tons of EC opportunities, & exams are easy.

being honest, she is the best. her lectures are super interesting and u learn a lot. she brings in a ton of guest speakers and rly open your mind to many different parts of the world. if i can take another class w her i 1000% will.

i took 2 courses with her this semester. she is amazing and literally the best professor you can ask for. she is super caring, accommodating, and wants u to do well. if i can take another class w her i def will. I'm so excited to do my honor thesis with her and she is also the best club advisor. she rly pushes u to grow and is just the best.

BEST PROFESSOR AT MIAMI! I am about to graduate and out of all my classes this class stands out. I learned a lot and enjoyed this class so much. Professor Sokol-Katz is a true gem. Take this class.

Professor Sokol-Katz is an angel! She's so sweet and she genuinely cares about how her students do. Power points and lectures are really well-organized. Just study, do the homework assignments and you'll be fine. She made the class very interesting and fun!
repetative!! read your book and try not to fall asleep in class..

she is very confusing, i basically had to learn everything myself from the book but she makes an effort. If you can learn things on your own you can follow her powerpoints which are very useful. most of the time she comes in tired and not concentrated. boring class

I'm going to take her for whatever classes i can. Extremely helpful and makes test look easy because she actually knows how to teach it! You need the book for homework but her notes are power points and extremely helpful.

The best profeser at UM. I loved her class you learn a lot. Does have some week paper to write but they are a paragraph to a page long nothing to hard. Extremely helpful compelte sweet heart. If you are a Sociology or Criminology major you must take this profeser you will not regret it.

EASY CLASS, YOU DON'T NEED THE BOOK TO STUDY FOR THE TESTS JUST STUDY FROM THE POWERPOINT SLIDES (VERY EASY TESTS)... YOU ONLY NEED THE BOOK TO ANSWER EXTRA CREDIT QUESTIONS AND FOR THE FINAL PAPER THAT WOULD BE BASED ON ONE OF THE READINGS IN THE BOOK

An incredible sweetheart and one of the nicest professors at UM. Take her class and enjoy the discussions. Tests are very fair and she outlines what is on them. No surprises. She is always willing to meet. Her power points are clear and posted on blackboard. I highly recommend her!
She is the SWEETEST professor I have EVER had at UM. She is always willing to help and give extra credit. There is no reason to get ANYTHING lower than a B or C in her class. Best professor yet! :)
I LOVED THIS CLASS!!! Great professor, can come off as being anxious, please please participate in class, sit in the front, I really learned alot!!

Her textbook choice and powerpoints are terrible. She's kind of anxious, repeats herself a lot and gets confused. If you have trouble with stats, she tends to make it even more difficult. She's a really nice lady, but not someone who should teach stats.

Great way of teaching, and helps understand all topics throughly

Super engaging and interesting guy! Clearly passionate about what he's teaching. Quizzes and tests are all online on your own time but do go to lecture because stuff not on the powerpoints but rather what he says will be on it. Class teaches you things you will use outside of it.

literally the best, most knowledgable, and interesting professor/class ive taken so far and this is end 3rd year. good class

very knowledgable and personable but SO BORING. lectures are him reading from the book. tests are hard even though he gives detialed study guides.

great job for a survery course highly recommended

He is a REALLY great teacher.  He raw as hell joe, and he's very easy going.  And if you go talk to him, he's willing to help.

She's the most unorganized professor I've ever seen. She's very unclear, confusing, and her power points aren't helpful at all. No one else to take this class though so just make sure you need it. THE SCHOOL OF COMM IS FAMOUS FOR STICKING YOU IN CLASSES YOU DON'T NEED TO GRADUATE
Great professor. Do her study guide for the tests and you will do well in her class. Definitely recommend!!!!!!!!!

She is a very likeable professor, and very knowledgable, but her grading is EXTREMELY nit-picky. That being said, learn what she looks for in her grading, and please have perfect grammer and you should be okay. Somehow I got an A although it seemed she hated all my work, so there is hope.
You will never want to practice PR after her class.

She knows her stuff but can be nit-picky about every single detail. Has her favorites (how annoying). Not the hardest class but because grading of your press kits is somewhat subjective even though you work hard, you still may end up with a B/B+. Two mc tests were easy though, make sure to get A's on those (must read your textbook).

Good professor, good person. Really wants to see her students succeed, and is very helpful. Even though she is passionate about what she's teaching, classes tend to be pretty boring. There is definitely a good amount of work involved with the assignments, but overall the class is not too difficult and pretty relaxed.

Amazing person. The course content was very boring and stuff you already learned in CAP202 and CAP232. But overall she is a good professor- very understanding and is willing to do everything to see her students succeed.
She's very helpful. You do a lot of writing, but she lets you rewrite stuff a lot and she's understanding.

Have never seen a professor so smart and dedicated. Sometimes he goes off on tangents and can be hard to follow but overall super caring and a really hardworking guy. He doesn't grade things until the end of the semester which can be annoying but if you get the work done you will do well.

Wes is the best; he has a pdf with all of the course's content on it which i found very helpful, and otherwise he's extremely knowledgeable! Super nice guy, and you have his number if you need to reach him about anything

Wes is a great professor and extremely knowledgeable about the topic. Can be hard to digest sometimes but he is always willing to clarify. His exams are NOT easy. Definitely need to take good notes based on what he says in lecture because his blank slides are not helpful for studying.

Wes is genuinely a great professor! this class was fairly easy considering it is a advanced writing course. i took this class to fulfill my minor and its super chill and very low pressure. i definitely recommend taking Wes in any class you possibly can because he makes himself super easy to reach and you will definitely learn so much information!

reviews.comment: This class was very difficult but Wes made it entertaining! His lectures are very applicable to the real world so it isn't just a bunch of memorization. reviews.comment: His lectures are so interesting, but, go by fast. Take notes by rewatching the online material. He simplifies things well but goes extremely in-depth and fast. But, you only need to know the basic concept. So many funny stories and makes the material applicable in daily life. It is easy to get in contact with him outside of class.

If you're an exercise physiology major Wes is unavoidable. There is almost no work for the class until midterms and then the work doesn't stop. The lectures are interesting, but half of the material and his stories aren't on the test. A very cool guy, but maybe not the best professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's a super nice guy and makes the class super interesting and applicable. ONly thing is, the quizzes and exams are online and can be very difficult. Lots of information and difficult to study for. But, the enjoyment of the class was worth it for me.

He is so passionate about physiology and definitely knows what he's talking about, but with that being said, he goes fast. His lectures are confusing, especially if this is one of your first KIN classes in college, and his quizzes are difficult. Covid makes it especially difficult as you are teaching yourself. Study hard.
