reviews.comment: Wes is a nice person. His exams are very hard. His class grade is solely based on quizzes and tests. COVID was hard because you had to teach the material to yourself and the tests were very hard. Pre-Covid Rating: 4/5 Covid Rating: 3.5/5

He's really nice but not the best at teaching. You can tell he cares and is passionate and he definitely makes the class interesting, but he just kind of doesn't know how to slow down and simplify things. Loved him but would not recommend or want to take again

The absolute best. He really knows his stuff. All you have to do is show up and listen and you will learn everything you need to know for the course. Everything he teaches has practical applications for your own lifestyle.

Awesome guy. Relates to college students. Very funny. He makes a difficult subject fun and easy to understand. I truly learned a lot. He is a very relaxed grader and gives tons of extra credit so long as you attend 80% of the lectures. If you have an issue with an exam date, he is extremely flexible to rearrange a time for you.

You can tell how truly passionate he is about what he does. Amazing, interesting lectures. Quizzes were so easy and half of them were take home. Tests you had to really study for, but there were only 2 and he did online video review sessions the day before which was extremely helpful. As long as you put in some effort you'll have no problem.

Took this class because of recs from friends & good reviews. Hurricane Irma happened, & Wes didn't handle it well. Instead of over 10 quizzes, 3 exams, & a project to boost your grade, we got 4 quizzes & 2 exams, & changed deadlines for these tests several times over email. Exams are loaded with typos and different answers than what was reviewed.
reviews.rating_tags: Tests? Not many--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Wes is an excellent teacher and very knowledgeable. He stays up to date with the latest research and makes everything he teaches extremely interesting, engaging, and relevant. He's very helpful and wants you to succeed. Only con: quite inaccessible outside class. Does not respond to/check emails. Only real way is to call or meet in person
Wes is the man, would take him again 10/10. Highly recommend.

Honestly, Wes is one of the best professors I have ever had at UM. The dude really cares about his students and will do whatever he can to make sure you succeed. On the other hand, you can't take that for granted. You have to do your part and seriously grind to get a passing grade in this class. I had him for 2 other classes too, he's great.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: he talks really fast, you can't understand a single thing he explains in class. you need to learn by yourself specially if you're not a science major and taking a cognate with him.
love him and definitely take him for 201 but if you're taking KIN as your cognate don't take KIN365 it's all grad students and physiology majors

Wes is THE MAN. It's hard not to become wildly passionate about exercise and nutrition after taking a course with him. Go to his class. Pay attention. Become enlightened.   Additionally, call him if you want to get in touch with him. He is horrific with his email but will always take a call.

Professor Wess is so cool. I am not a Kinesiology major and this was my first KIN class so the material was new and hard for me to understand. HOWEVER, he helped me out SO much! Show him you're putting in the effort and he will help you out, explain concepts, etc
It is very doable to get an A but you really need to put a lot off effort into studying.  Test questions can be tricky but if you study well, you should be able to get the grade you want.
This guy is an unbelievable professor. If you can take a class with him, do it. He's the absolute best.

He is a humorous guy and I can see why he is liked by many. This class was filled with very fascinating facts, and a great deal of helpful information. His lectures were very interesting, although I felt he would usually go a bit fast through it. Overall, I felt the class was a bit disorganized and he failed to truly communicate effectively.

There's no denying it. KIN221 is a hard course, especially the biochem portion of it. But Wes will do everything he can to make sure every person in the classroom understands everything. On top of that, he will give extra credit and he will give you a study guide that outlines exactly what you need to know. Go to class, study, and you will get an A

Great professor and great guy. I can't say enough good things about Wes. He's my favorite professor I've had at UM. He teaches off a prezi (which is general) and you need to go to class to get all the specifics. If you go to class you will get an A in this course. He will repeat many times throughout the semester that he wants everyone to get an A.

Dr. Smith was my favorite professor at UM. He's so smart and wants to answer any question you have.  He just wants everyone to enjoy the class and his lectures ar so interesting.  Also very helpful when it comes to your grade.  Very kind.

The class is really easy despite the tests being a little more detailed than I expected.  Lectures sometimes drag on as well, but I found the information to actually be very helpful as far as having a healthier diet.

Best professor at UM by far! I have had him for multiple classes and he is good in every single one of them. You have to go to class, but his lectures are actually not that boring. He helps out a lot and explains everything really well. UM needs more Wes's

My favorite professor at UM. I liked exercise physiology before I took him, now I love it. Anatomy could be an extremely dull course, but Wes makes it fun and exciting. He makes you want to come to class. This class in particular is straight memorization, so if you don't study you won't do well because your whole grade is a midterm and a final.

Fantastic professor. Makes himself extremely available to his students and wants everyone to get an A. With that said, there are only two exams and a few quizzes so if you don't go to class and study you're going to fail. The tests are fairly easy if you study for them, but can bring down your whole grade for the course if you mess up one of them.

Dr. Smith took my interest in exercise science and transformed it into a passion. Every aspect about his teaching, from his in-depth knowledge in all things related to human physiology and health, to his insatiable desire to impart motivation through education, make it a privilege to participate in any or many of Dr. Smith's multi-faceted courses.
More material than a harder physiology course but Wes makes it easy by going over things and providing online lectures for additional review. Great course and professor
The material in this class is hard but Dr. Wes makes its easy to understand. Taking Dr. Wes for this class will definitely help you for future classes as well!

Dr. Wes is definitely my favorite professor at UM because he makes a stimulating learning environment for his students and genuinely cares about his students. Definitely going to take his other classes!

Dr. Smith always presents the most up to date research for his classes and is one of the most knowledgeable in the field. He is passionate in what he teaches and this translates into the way he teaches. My favorite teacher at UM and would highly recommend taking him if you want a class where you will learn a lot and learn it in an easy way.

Dr. Wes is hands-down my favorite professor I have had at UM. He makes himself available to you 24/7, giving out both his email and cell number at the beginning of the semester. His classes are difficult and you need to go to class to take notes, but he makes the class worthwhile and teaches you applicable information. Would definitely recommend.

He along with Dr. Jacobs are staples to the KIN department. Hands down the best professors in the department.   I can text him at midnight asking questions and he'll be there to help. Even if they are questions outside of his class

By far one of the greatest professors at UM. He's passionate at what he does and that translates through every class he teaches. He wants you to succeed and will provide all the tools necessary to do so. Take him, you won't regret it!

Super cool guy who makes lectures really interesting. One of my favorite professors at UM, really engaging teacher who is there for you all the time. He wants his students to succeed. Gotta go to class, as a lot of test material is presented in class, and even he admitted to his powerpoints not being sufficient to study. Great guy, would take again
Amazing class
I like the class, you are very nice and do a good job.
I like the class

People love Wes and he is a great guy. If you're not ExPhys, AT, or a science major, careful tho because he isn't clear about a lot of background info on nutrition you're just supposed to know. His Prezis are really hard to study from and study guides incomplete.  Test questions worded confusingly. Great, smart guy but not as great of a prof.

Wes makes Biochem as easy as it can be. As long as you go to the classes you should be able to pull out a good grade. Wes is always there for his students and willing to meet at anytime. He even gives students his number to call if they have any questions. He is by far the most helpful professor.

Very detailed class and you will learn a lot if you attend and take notes. Wes generally speaks very fast, but once you get the hang of his teaching style, it is easy to follow his lectures. His slides are informative, but definitely pay attention to what he's saying. He's also full of fun facts on the subject. Great professor!

Wes can make any topic interesting because he's so passionate about what he's teaching. He is very friendly, reachable, and willing to help you with any issues you might have. Each class is loaded with information, so take detailed notes. He speaks fast, but if you don't understand something, he will repeat it until you do.

Biochemistry is NOT EASY. This is not just an entry level class.  Do not rely on the study guide.  Do attend online help/class sessions.  The Prof. have no clear lesson plan - make sure to record every class as he speaks super fast.  Also jot down ALL drawings/notes he does on the white board.  GOOD LUCK.
Wes is cool. Class is easy.  Study the study guides and you'll do fine.

KIN202 is an easy A and an easy writing credit. As far as nutrition goes, it was just basic knowledge and I wouldn't recommend it if you actually want to learn a lot about nutrition. Sometimes Wes is all over the place with his lectures. Overall he is a good professor, just sometimes hard to follow.
Best Professor to ever inhale oxygen, Good at explaining things and enjoys the Brooklyn Nets
literally the best and hottest teacher i've had at the university of miami. He is such a nice guy and makes the class very relatable and interesting. Love himmm
Hands down, greatest professor ever. Always willing to help, makes jokes during class, up to date on latest research. The Man!
His classes are hard, but he's the best teacher at UM. I learned so much and he's very accessible and willing to help.
One of the best professors i've met. Makes anatomy fun and invents great ways to memorize everything.
I don't think you can find a professor as passionate about his field or his students than Wes.

This class was made harder than it needed to be. This class was very simple. I did not attend regularly which I do not suggest because the final is purely based on notes in class. I had to do 30x the amount of work I did the entire semester for the final just because I didnt go to class. I do recommend you take him. Wes is an awesome professor.

As for prof. Wes he's awesome. The class itself is just basic memorization. Be careful with his T.A., he adds things to the exam that Wes doesn't hold us accountable for. So you might want to make sure they're both communicating. 2 exams. Allows extra credit.

LOVE this prof. He's extremely knowledgeable and couldn't be a nicer, more approachable guy. Granted there is A LOT of information so you are going to have to know your stuff but the online quizzes really help. My advice: if there is ANY class he teaches that you need to take you should go for it.
probably the best teacher at the school
Best teacher at UM. Even if your not an ESS major, you'll understand everything cause he knows his stuff. He actually cares about his students and wants everyone to get As. Plus he's gorgeous
By far the best professor at UM! He is very knowledgeable about his subject and loves to teach it. He is helpful and a great professor. Highly HIGHLY recommend him!!!

Simple, interesting. He is really understanding and actually realizes his class is at the 100 level (unlike other professors I've had). If I were you I'd take this class if you wanted an A. Tests are on blackboard. And you get a writing credit. Now thas what I'm talkin bout!!! (he loves Scrubs)

Best class I have ever had at UM hands down.  The class size is great and Wes explains the material thoroughly and gives great examples. Physiology really ties your biology in, and I HIGHLY encourage you to take it with Wes no matter what major you are.  Also, this class helps tremendously for med school. Great class.

The best teacher I've ever had hands down. Makes everything crystal clear by giving examples and has at home quizzes to reinforce the material. Nice to look at too ;) too bad he's married... Anyways, I love physio because of him and if you dont take him you're stupid.
Great professor, who really knows his material! He is very enthusiastic and will work with you in any way to make sure you get a good grade!

Wes is a genuinely good teacher who cares. The class can go either way if you want to take a class for credit its good because he doesn't want you to fail. But at the same time if you really want to learn he is extremely knowledgeable. But either way I guarantee you will leave with something from the class. Everyone learns something with WES.
awesome teacher. makes things really interesting and cute too.

Wes is a great teacher. He is extremely charismatic and keeps class interesting with tons of practical examples. It is a great class for premeds. I learned more in here about biochemistry than I did in cell molec. I would recommend the course to anyone enthusiastic about exercise or cell biology.

Advanced Nutrition was a great class, very intersting and insightfull. Wess is a great teacher, stimulating interest in the course in every area of study. He is very easy to approach and knows a lot about what he is teaching!

Great teacher! Presents material very clearly and always makes sure that everyone understands before moving on. He wants you to pass. The class consists of two tests and a final exam. He always applies what you're learning to real life and it stimulates interest in the course. Wes is a good guy and I highly recommend him!

She really is a sweet women, and she is very lienent, but it is clear that teaching is not her priority and she has other stuff going on, which is amazing as an individual but sucks as a student, can count on two hands that amount of classes that she has missed due to personal reasons leaving just the class being textbook heavy.
She doesn't really care about French, but she's super nice and an easy grader.

The most goated professor in the modern language department is, without a doubt, an expert in her field. She's also an incredibly caring and attentive person. If you're into the Middle East, you need to take her course, especially for Islamic studies—she's the best. Just make sure to show up and participate in class.

reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is really sweet and helpful. I enjoyed taking her class even though she was sometimes a bit unorganized but eventually she pulls through.

This class was tough and had a lot of assignments but it was made clear that this class was taught the same way across the level. You gotta be prepared to work and stay on top of assignments but she's really nice and always available to meet with you if you need help.

Professor Sawafta is a talented professor. Her literature courses are reading and writing heavy so be prepared to work. That being said, it's totally worth it because you learn a ton about the Arab World. Really looking forward to taking more classes with her.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Sawafta is a caring, understanding, and hard-working individual. It was a pleasure being taught by her this semester.

Amazing Professor, really passionate about her work and brings lots of stories into the classroom. Not a hard grader at all, but attendance and participation will get her to like you more and give you a better grade. Normal respect goes far in the classroom setting. Have taken her twice already and would definitely take her again!!

Dr. Chatterjee is an exceptional professor, and I would highly recommend that students take GSS 315 with her. She makes the class very fun and interactive. The exams are not difficult as long as you stay focused on the readings and lectures. Dr. Chatterjee is super kind and willing to answer any questions regarding the course's material.

reviews.comment: Dr. Chatterjee is a really understanding professor. GSS315 expectations were clear, do the readings (she doesn't check or test until midterm and homework reflections) but as long as you don't fall too behind on those the assignments are easy. One group project in the semester which is a good chunk of your grade. Overall super nice woman!

Easily one of the best professors I've had at UM. She's super sweet and keeps the class engaged with her lessons. I've taken two classes with her already and she's great. You definitely should take her class if you're thinking about it.

Really enjoyed this class and Dr. Chatterjee! Grading is based off of 2 papers and a weekly writing response based off of the readings. PLEASE COME TO CLASS. Participation is graded due to weekly class discussions. Very informative and fascinating class.

Chaterjee is respectful if you respect her. Respect is a HUGE thing with this teacher dont ever be not paying attention in class. Papers are extremely general and she grades kind of arbitrarily with no real grading rubric or explanation for why you received a certain grade. Not the best but her class is somewhat tolerable

Feminist Inquiries. Not the most in-depth class in the world but she does touch on many feminist issues. Bases a lot of it on personal anecdotes and her experience in India. 6 short papers (mix of analysis on readings and opinion) and take home final. Expects a lot of reading to be done since that is what is discussed in class

Seems to have a decent knowledge over the material however is very general. She is often unclear about her expectations as far as papers goes and is often inconsistent. She also talks more about her personal background that his similarities to the subject matter rather than its current relevance in western academia.

She very helpful and the class is very interesting but you have to read all of the material. Seriously. It helps with class discussion which is part of your grade. And it helps with the exams. She's super nice. I would highly recommend her.
Great lecturer, but a lot of writing and reading!

She is just AWESOME. Her lectures are clear and well prepared. She loves and cares about her students being more than happy to read your papers before the due date for corrections. Her classes are interesting and as long as you read the material, attend class and show that you have an interest she will give you a good grade.
Ok-she is great. Comes off strict at first but soon enough you find she cares about the students. LOTS of reading. Interesting class. Loved it and would take it again.

Professor Chatterjee has spent a great deal of time studying the subject, and it showed in her lectures. She held very interesting lectures, that were both concise and clear. She is very strict on attendance and punctuality, and both will affect your final grade.
Great lecturer, interested in teaching and in her students. Lost of written work. A TON of reading
Passionate and knowledgable with regards to the material. Enjoyed her class.

This professor is everything wrong with academia. You better hope you get on his good side. His grading scale has no reason, he is impossible to talk to because he views you as lesser than. He is impossible to reason with. He is extremely vindictive if he does not like your class. Unfortunately this review is capped so I cannot provide examples.

Teaches material well and is brief, once he does the theory and some examples, lets you go with homework for next class. Homework can be impossible sometimes, but most is on chegg and you can call him by phone (not the most helpful, but worked for some)  If he sees you try, you will get a B, even though I and others got a C on blackboard.

Old fashioned. Take notes!! Takes attendance every class. Very messy handwriting. Lets you decide everything about the class including the weight of exams and final to how many problems on the test. Gives you his phone number to call him whenever you have questions. Make the final worth a lot so if you fail the tests you can redeem on the final.

reviews.comment: Intro to senior design was the easiest course ever. You basically have to show up and not even everytime as long as one person from your group goes to class that's okay. He gives good feedback on papers. If you hand it in early he will let you change what he thinks needs to be better to get a better grade.

I had him for Mechanics of Solids II and Engines I and II. Very smart but is disorganized and tends to ramble. My advice is this: 1) ask a lot of questions in class to slow him down and reduce the amount of material he covers, and 2) take METICULOUS notes of every word he says.

reviews.comment: Dr. Swain's class was great. He presents the material very clearly and makes the class very straightforward. He is always available at any time for you to call or text him with any questions you have. He is also a very nice guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: He's quiet, you have to sit close. In the past, we chose the grading scale (usually 10% hw, 1% tests, 89% final) but he can't do that anymore, it's preset. You might be able to choose the number of tests & the number of problems on each test. You have to do the hw AND THEN SOME to do well. Tests are unassigned hw, including the final.

Smartest professor at UM. Very helpful and open to students.  The class is tough but very important for MAE.  Work hard and do well on the 3 tests, choose 89% weighting for final and average is always a 78%.
BEWARE OF CURVE. Choose 89% Final. You will learn what that means.

HWs are a bit tough, tests are reasonable. You can call him if you've got q's. To the upcoming class: Don't just follow tradition and vote like previous classes making final 89% of grade. Those who blow the ceiling off finals (yea we all know you're brilliant), are likely to not take it anyway. To those who sincerely struggle, decide accordingly
He's a nice guy but always makes life hard. His test is not that difficult but his samples are REALLY hard!!!! Anyway, he's a nice guy and take his class.

Great professor. One of the few engineering faculty that cares about their students. The average is curve up to an 81. So you decide your fate. Final is optional. Class was interesting and challenging.
The short answer exam at the end of the course IS tough so make sure to make it to every class after the second exam. Recording the class is not a bad idea.

The first few tests are easy if you do the homework and ask questions...the last few tests with short answers are extremely hard and  make sure you UNDERSTAND what he says.  Also, record the class, he's so into his teaching that he is too fast to get everything

He is a good teacher, however he lacks people skills. If you ask a question, sure he will explain every detail about the problem at hand, but be prepared to be talked down to. Also, usually his explanations will tend to ramble on. But don't worry, he is not retiring anytime soon, as he (and his brother) teach almost every class you'll need as an ME

Material can be challenging.  Explanations can sometimes be complicated.  Read the book.  Grades based on a normal curve with a 78 average, so people who do poorly get bigger curves.  He lets the class decide how many exams you have and how much the final exam is worth.

GREAT TEACHER!!! by far the best teacher i've come across yet in engineering, beyond Ram, his tests are challenging but do the homework and review and you'll be fine.  The average is always a 78, so you choose your fate, he curves, and his classes are completely moldable, meaning u choose how much each test is worth, finals are optional.GREAT CLASs

Statics 2. Swain is an awesome teacher. He structures his class democratically, giving you a lot of say in how many tests you want to take, and gives the option to cancel class or push back test dates occassionally. He knows the material like the back of his hand. He's kind of hard to understand so be prepared to ask a lot of questions. Good Prof.
No Comments
For your peace of mind and overall sanity avoid at all costs!

Do yourself a favor and don't take any of his classes.

Do yourself a favor and don't take this class.

reviews.comment: Gives 12 pop quizzes so if you miss a class you most likely will miss a pop quiz. They are on trivial matters based off the reading so you basically have to do the readings. Tests aren't hard if you are good at memorization. Content isn't that interesting but you can doze off in class and still get by. He is very open minded and liberal!

He likes to talk a lot, but he's generally a nice guy. Fair. Makes the topic more interesting then it really is- at least thats my opinion. A LOT OF READING, 12 Quizes, he drops the lowest two. Tests are RIDICULOUSLY hard. But he's a nice guy. Challenging class though.

Avoid him if you can. It's online and attendance isn't mandatory so it seems appealing, but it's actually quite a hard class. 65.6% of students this semester got a flat B or lower. reviews.comment: LOOK AT ME!

IDK how he is so high rated here. Isn't clear on what exams are on and doesn't go over any practice problems, and doesn't provide any of the solutions to the practice problems. Very vague on grading, and has big ego. No textbook, only his vague powerpoints, which he rushes through the important material since he likes to repeat on unneccesary stuff
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor is overrated for sure. No homework except group project/presentation, a huge part of your grade and he is very picky on every tiny detail. Goes on long repetitive rants about stuff we discussed in previous classes, and rushes through everything that is neccessary to study for at end of class. Doesn't really go over whats on exams
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Best professor in the Finance department. While the lectures are intense, he manages to make them entertaining. His class is crucial for understanding finance, so put in the effort and truly grasp the material. If you attend every class, work through the Excels, and complete his practice tests, you'll likely perform well on the exam.

Tie Su is an exceptional lecturer—arguably the best professor I've ever had. His way of explaining concepts is remarkable and captivating. While he may seem tough, he's incredibly kind outside of class. Paying close attention in his lectures is essential, as he provides valuable hints for the exams. However, I'm not a fan of his test format.

super difficult course, good professor but hes pretty adamant that the course isnt difficult just know how to do every single slide :| score is determined from 3 30% exams online but super difficult and the averages are anywhere from 50s-70s.
Rough course but something is seriously wrong with him.

Extremely organized class. Only reason I have a B is because I didn't study as hard as I should have on the mid term... do not let it deceive you... it's open note but hard. 

Graded by 10% attendance, 20% group project, 35% mid term, 35% final.

Dr Su is very knowledgable in Wealth management. If you're interest in WM take this class.
Really excellent professor. Took as part of MBA program. One of my favorite professors. Very fair, very good at explaining, very approachable.

Just took his first exam. Definitely need to study to do well but he was so accessible leading up to the exam and answered all my questions. His lectures are fun and engaging. UM should give him a raise.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Something is wrong with this guy.
He is the best finance professor hands down! Always willing to meeting outside to answer questions. 427 is a tougher class, so come prepared to study
3 exams 30% each class average is around a 70 DO NOT TAKE!!

*Fin 302* He's the absolute best. he's always happy to help his students. tests are online and open note, but don't let that deceive you, they are pretty hard so you definitely need to study beforehand. his class isn't easy, but if you pay attention and put in effort then you'll do fine.
Probably the best Finance Professor at UM.

So this class was basically organized where he would do lectures on tuesdays and then on thursdays it would be student presentations for every week of the semester. You don't have to go but he really knows what he is talking about for wealth management. Everyone said exams were impossible but they are very similar to what we do in class.

Amazing would be the word to describe my experience with Dr. Tie! Wealth Mgmt is an essential topic that EVERYONE should take & Dr. Tie manages to explain everything in great detail and yet in a simple manner. He holds a CFA and is passionate about the idea of helping out his students with in-class material and any real-world financial questions!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: One of the best professors in the finance department, 412 teaches you how to manage your personal finance, which is important. If you're interested in wealth management, take this class. But don't expect this to be easy. You need to pay close attention and take down notes every class.
Tests are difficult but curved a lot. One of a kind. Defiantly would take him again.

One of the best Professors in UM. Gives amazing feedback, extremely patient to answer all questions in class. He is hilarious, knowledgable, genuine, empathetic, amazing lectures, respected. You need to read a lot of ppt slides and take very good notes, otherwise, you won't take an A. By far the most interesting class in UM, everyone should take it

This man gives slides, practice problems, and an old midterm and final to study from. Dont look at the mid term or final, that mustve been his first year teaching considering how easy those are, and what he actually gives on an exam. If you dont completely get each slide, youre screwed. Exams are outta this world hard. Great dude though.

Class is probably really helpful and insightful for those with little finance background. There is ZERO math in this class. Entirely conceptual. It is one of the easiest courses I've taken in the business school and implore everyone who needs an easy elective to take this. Exam is from the book so just get a test bank from someone. Nice guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: No homework, grade is 2 exams + excel project. Didn't enjoy this class, Tie is a good professor though. The material was very dry and not presented well. He explains well but when asked to repeat or explain in a different way, he kind of refuses and refers you back to the notes. Passionate about finance and his students, hard class and exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Tie Su is the best finance professor at UM. He is definitely one of the best lecturers at the university. His class is very challenging, but his lectures prepare you for it if you put in the work. 10/10 would recommend him for any finance class.
He is so passionate to the class and very patient when you ask questions.
He is very passionate about Finance. He has countless research paper and once nominated for Nobel Prize. He gives 5% of extra towards your overall grade.

One of the best professors in the department. He is extremely passionate about the subject and it reflects in his lectures. No laptops and prints power points out for you. It's a good strategy because you have to pay attention to him during lectures. He is very math based, fair tests, and gives extra credit when you answer questions in class.

Great professor. So incredibly knowledgeable (he holds a CFA) and passionate about finance. Ask him anything about marketssecurities and you'll get a great answer. Funny guy, too. He keeps you engaged, makes you think, and rewards you with exams that are very fair and reflective of what you do in class. Difficult material, but highly worth taking.
You'll have to study on your own, no easy A.
He is an awesome professor. Passionate and helpful. Great sense of humor and very smart.
best professor I have ever had

One of the best instructors I have has at UM. The rater that said Prof Su was unhelpful must not have engaged the professor in the least.  Dr. Su is always responsive and helpful and very clear in his lectures. He will take his time when needed.
Dr. Su is passionate about finance and does a lot to make the class enjoyable.

Straight forward and easy to understand lectures.  Expectations were clearly defined and attainable for anyone willing to take the time to study.  Book was not necessary as the exams were based solely off of the power point slides.
he is one of the worst teachers i have ever taken and i am in graduate school. he goes way too fast and doesnt like explaining things in detail or the uses of the models for real life applications
whoever wrote the above must be really smart because this class is grueling and miserable

Very good professor.  His exams come straight from his lectures.  No surprises.  He makes it very possible to get a good grade in the class.  Study his ppt. slides and sample exam questions and you can't get anything lower than a B.

Super disorganized and not clear during lecture. He doesn't know very much about philosophy or maybe this class isn't in his area, but he contradicts the readings and himself. Struggles to answer questions. No one learned much.

overall his class is pretty challenging, but his lectures are very clear and he is straight to the point; he doesn't take attendance but if you don't go to class you definitely won't pass because his exams are straight from his lecture notes; he also gives 7 pop quizzes, one of which is dropped, a vocab quiz and a final paper
nice guy and a good teacher-not an easy class though. attendance is not mandatory but you need to go in order to get the notes

Lectures are pretty boring but he can make them entertaining sometimes. He's also a pretty nice guy who will help you if need it. Quizzes and tests are pretty straight forward but the essays are extremely long and a bit difficult. Overall hes good but its not an easy course

Doesn't really seem to understand philosophy very well (especially compared to other profs in the department - including other grad students). Has a hard time answering questions, his discussions of the readings are not clear. Not recommended, find someone better

Take another philosophy professor. He would give readings but would argue against them during lectures. His lectures were super boring. He waited until the last two weeks of school to give out the writing credit. He is so unorganized and doesn't do what the syllabus says. Attendance was not mandatory but he said he would give pop quizzes

Con: Such a bad teacher that no one knows what he's talking about. Pro: He weights all the tests because no one passes. Con: Other profs in this dept are way smarter. Pro: No attendance policy. Overall: wouldn't recommend.
Should not be teaching at UM. Assigns reading but then contradicts it. No knowledge of subject matter. Take another grad student or you will be bored and confused!
Awesome professor who makes classes fun, interesting, engaging, and thought provoking. Great guy. Take him if you want to learn something while having a good time.
Awesome philosophy professor. Actually fun sitting in class and even the readings are interesting.. Take him!
Cool guy and interesting class. Discussion topics are from current events and the readings aren't bad.
One of the better philosophy profs at UM.
He makes philosophy seem current. We had interesting discussions and the readings weren't too bad. You do need to study for tests but if you ask him for help he's approachable. Recommend!
Poor approach and knowledge of subject matter overall. Would not recommend.
He is very helpful and knows a lot about the subject. Interesting to listen to and he gets students talking so it's not all lecture. Take his class!

Prof. Swanson presents the material in an interesting way and he's really knowledgeable.  He's laid back but  strict about due-dates. I really recommend this class, I learned a lot.  If you do the work you can get an A.
He is probably the best teacher in the school.

Very likeable professor and makes difficult content easy. He set up review sessions a day before big tests and he was a very reasonable grader. While attendance isn't mandatory his lectures are amazing and you build a great relationship with him. My big thing is that he went out of his way to remember each student in the class by first name basis.

He's very nice and available for students, but he just makes exams more difficult than they should be. A literal majority of students got failing grades on two of the three midterms. He ended up adding a very heavy curve at the end, but it just goes to show how ineffective his teaching style must've been.

Dr.Syed is a very smart and kind guy. He wanted everyone to succeed. But, this class was impossible. He did not explain concepts very well and his tests were very hard. This class is hard on its own, probably one of the hardest classes at UM. Expect to try and learn it on your own with very minimal extra help (no free tutoring for this class).

223 is the hardest compared to 221 and 222, but Syed did a fair job. Read the textbook though (!!!), get an outside tutor if office hours aren't helping. Only FRQs from the practice exam are a good way to GUESS what you'll see on the exam. Tip: understand the concepts from FRQs, ace them on the exam and you're already sitting above the average.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He cares about students but his exams are ridiculously difficult. I kept getting 50's on exams despite studying hard. I appreciate his curve on the final grade, but I would have rather had more intuitive tests. Theory lectures are fun, problem solving ones did not help me.

Very engaging and caring but makes the course more difficult than it needs to be. Lectures lagged behind HWs & shows easy examples while HWs & exams has difficult ones. Very few stuff appears from practice exams so be prepared to learn all yourself! Big curve makes up for it. 82%>=A, 70%>=B, 59%>=C so there is still hope. Use office hours for help!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The grade consists of: 20% for exams 1-3, 40% (2 x 20%) for the final, and 20% for attendance, HW, and quizzes. He drops the lowest 20%. You must attend class because he does not go in the order of the textbook and skips around. The exams are extremely difficult, but he is great with partial credit. Advice: really understand both homework types!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I had a miserable time in Physics because of Sheyum. His tests are next to impossible and have very little to do with any of the homework or quizzes that are assigned. Honestly, you're better off reading the textbook and trying to teach yourself everything but even that won't help. He teaches well in class but his exams sadly do not reflect that...
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Shocked to find Syed has same teaching style as me. Couldn't resist noticing. I am him. He is me. The lord is my shepherd. If u don't go to class ur hardwiring urself to fail. I learn all current material in discussion bc I'm usually doing something in parallel with the lecture, however profound they are. Oh no, I've reached the text capacitance.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Professor Syed is my favorite Professor so far. I took him for PHY 207 and got a B+ in the class.  His lectures were very helpful if you actually paid attention. He is very accessible  outside of class and will answer all of your questions. His tests are hard but if you do the long problems he assigns every week they help a lot.
gotta work hard but you will get your reward in exams! Material is tough but he is easy to understand

Tests are ridiculously difficult and much harder than material presented in class. Nice guy, but not at all helpful as a teacher. Wouldn't even give a list of practice problems or post solutions to quizzes to study from even when he promised he would. Simultaneously manages to assume that everyone knows physics and that everyone doesn't.
knows his stuff. clear, concise in lectures. happy to meet with students and very helpful. tough grader though...can't be lazy in this class!

Nice guy, not a good professor, even if it's his first year teaching.  He makes frequent mistakes in lectures, only changes them when students correct him. Tests were much harder than material presented in class. Agreed, lecture time would be better spent reading textbook on your own. Also takes random attendance and calls on people from the sheet.

wether he's nice or not is IRRELEVANT. This was his first semester teaching PHY lecture. No doubt he's smart he just DOESN'T KNOW HOW TO TEACH big lectures. the time you spend going to lecture could be better spent reading the book and practicing on your own or take Korotkova.
Cool prof, speaks perfect english. a rarity in the phy dept. super nice guy, material is tough so you have to work at it but doable.

She is SO NICE. Her class was fun and engaging. There were lots of in class discussions which were very helpful. She is caring and positive and she clearly loves what she teaches. I 100% recommend taking her class!

Professor Shamblin is so nice. During the entire semester, she was always unbelievably positive. We had a lot of class discussions which were fun and helped everyone engage and come up with ideas to write about.

This class is boring and you have to actually read the books which are so boring. She does pop quizzes. Do not take this class if you want an easy A also her pages are graded tough and have to be 4.5 pages long at least. She is not clear at all in her lectures either. Would not take this professor again.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Shamblin is one of the most caring professors Ive had thus far. She cares about her students well-being so if you ever need accommodations speak to her after class and she will gladly suggest alternatives. Weve done 3/4 essays and theyve all been about very interesting topics and other assignments were discussion boards. Take her!!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Ms. Shamblin is very sweet, understanding and cares about her students and the students interests. She is available to meet outside of class. She wants you to be able to write on topics you enjoy and are passionate about. As long as you show improvement from the first to final draft and complete the discussion bored posts its an easy A.

super boring, and she was not very helpful outside of class. slow grader and slow at responding to emails. 4 papers, discussion board posts and class participation count towards your grade. grades hard for a literal eng106 class. overall would not recommend!

I was a student for Professor Shamblin for English Composition I. During a COVID-19 semester, she was very caring and kind. The readings are difficult at times, but there are in-class discussions and in-depth explanations. There are also peer reviews that helped with my writing and we would have two drafts before the final. Would highly recommend!

Syrquin, especially in the beginning, may come off as unclear. She does have trouble explaining intially but will explain further if asked. The papers assigned may seem difficult but they are actually doable, she is there to help anytime. She is very interested in her students and their success in the class, and she is very approachable! Recommend!
super unhelpful, doesn't give actual prompts, essays don't actually have to do with readings, rude, has an attitude problem

Doctor Syrquin is a very nice lady and a good instructor. Kinda boring but hey its an english class... She has a tough time explaining things at first but she is very approachable and you'll eventually understand. VERY easy grader and not too many assignments! Take her!!

The class can get boring at times but it is very easy. The professor sometimes can get hard to understand but for the most part she is helpful and understanding of your issues. I would go ahead and take her, very nice lady.

At first I felt that this was a frustrating class because the instructor has some difficulty in conveying what it is she wants but in the end I felt that she did care for her students' work and improving their writing. She is definitely not a hard grader and after a while the class does become clearer and easier.

Genuinely one of the most confusing instructors I have ever had. Everything was made more difficult by the fact that she wouldn't be clear in her expectations. Overall the course isn't too hard but I found it to be very frustrating. At times it felt as if we did not understand each other at all. I would recommend another just to avoid the stress.

She tends to be very very confusing; when you think you have understood something you're far from being close. She is kind of a control freak and has a soft voice that at times is difficult to hear. I would pick her if you have the choice. I guess she strives to  make more knowledgeable but maybe doesnt choose the best method to do so.

I'm very glad I took 106 with Dr. Syrquin. Although the class can get boring, she dedicates a lot of time to asking our opinions, reviewing our work, and giving detailed feedback. She's very approachable and cares about her students a lot. If you attend class and give a little effort it's impossible to do poorly in that class. Not a hard grader.

He is a smart man, but has no business teaching INS 102. His sentence starts when he walks in the door and ends when class is over. Running away from global econ after him. Really avoid if possible. Could be extremely rude when help is asked for.
I've never felt more belittled by a professor. He is such a bitter person and I learned nothing in this class.
One of the worst professors I've ever had. Is sometimes downright rude to students. Class wasn't extremely difficult but I would definitely try to avoid him.

If youve taken an econ class before INS102 is a breeze. If not, be willing to put in some work. Kids w/ no ECO background tend to find Syrquin difficult bc of clarity. If you understand the textbooks & do the readings you should be fine.  Hes not a very tough grader and he actually cares about his students learning. Very willing to work w/ students

He does not speak english that well and has a really hard time getting his point across.  He knows what he wants to teach but the class does not really understand.  He is not really a professor, he just happens to be telling some students about economics.  His tests were unfair and I would recommend trying to avoid him
Writing the reports sucked! The mid-term I did horrible on, I got a D. I don't know how I did on the final, but I ended up with a B in the class even with the D.
No Comments
His class is SLOW. He isn't at all interesting, but his grading rocks.
The gy is really boring, and his class seemed to drag forever.....the tests are pretty hard, and the way he grades reports is kind of unfair....

Gives weekly assignments that are not graded but are used as participation and in the end to boost your grade up. Class is boring and she can be a little awkward at times, but she is really nice once you get to know her. Midterm and final papers are 5 pages long and had hard time getting the grade I wanted.

She is one of the most intelligent and inspiring professors at this school. Very smart and kind, and always willing to help. Her classes are interesting and not too challenging, but I have learned A LOT from this professor.

Dr. Lipschultz is a wonderful professor. She is extremely intelligent and knows everything about the subject, and she is one of the nicest professors at the university. I've taken two classes with her and plan on more! Her classes are perfect - full of discussion, and easy to get a good grade in if you take an interest in the subject.

One gets the distinct impression that Dr. Lipshultz's main objective is to avoid responsibility. She cancelled almost one-half of the classes scheduled during my semester. Her classes had no structure and I think it was mainly because she chose not to prepare for them. I found her totally uninspiring. Frankly, I would stay away from Dr. Lipshultz.

I have always loved history, but this class almost made me want to change my major. Horrible teacher, just goes on aimless self-righteous rants. She does not take her job seriously at all. Run far and fast from this teacher, she is not worth a penny of your $30,000 tuition.

Possibly worst professor I have ever come across. Does not stick to the syllabus, does not provide any decent information, always late and generally lazy and undedicated to this class. Worst class ever.
cannot believe she's still teaching here... worst prof ever.

Probably one of the worst professors I've ever had. She likes to think that because she's teaching a WGS class, she is the end all be all of feminist theory. This woman doesn't have a clue. She's more interested in talking about her daughter (who seems about as annoying as she is) or going completely off topic (to things like her old boyfriends).
completely ignorant and arrogant

I took her twice and there is one major problem. She gives extremely broad paper topics in the hope that you will analyze it in your own way. The papers are only 5 pgs and every time she gives them back to you she comments that there is something else you should have added. You can never write about EVERYTHING in 5 pgs. I wont take her again..

Lipschultz seemed to give up entirely on providing readings or doing any class planning whatsoever about halfway through the semester, never responded to emails, and then refused to allow us to do faculty evaluations, saying we had been too hostile.  Class time was spent chatting aimlessly about television shows and relationships.  Among worst @ UM

I took her for HIS 376 and 374. Her Constitutional History class was fun- no lectures only class discussion. Women's History class is mostly lecture but it's worth it to listen to get background history for your papers. She takes into consideration if you do better on later papers. One of best teachers at UM!

Before taking this class I was psyched. But she doesn't post the readings on time, and we NEVER talk abou them in class. She rambles about her kids & random stuff and frequently spends the two-hour class showing outdated movies that put everyone to sleep. She doesn't actually do any *teaching,* so if you want to learn stay out of her WGS class.
Funny and crazy

At first all the reading is a bit daunting but its pretty easy you just have to get through it.  As for the papers (2 of them for the semester) they are easy, she only lets you uses the sources used in class and class discussions.  Shes also a pretty easy grader.  Participate in the class discussions.  She is very liberal but who cares!?

Lipshultz rambles alot, the lectures are kinda interesting but they feel like alot of revisionist history (note that mine is a very unqualified option). she is also very left wing, be careful what you say. grades were distributed half-hazardly, without comment or methodology.

This class was certainly an adventure.  There were many, many arguments.  However, Lipschultz's lectures were VERY interesting (despite the extreme liberal slant).  Make sure to side with her opinion on all of your papers.  If you mess up on the first paper, just follow her suggestions closely and youll ace the last paper and get the grade you want
Best professor ever, Dr lipschultz is a pleasure to learn from and work with!
I love her! She is the best professor at UM, I love you Dr. Lipshultz!

reading wasn't bad and not a lot of work but she tends to grade people on how much they agree w/ her opinion and gives guys who are "aware" better grades than girls who know the same stuff..overall nice lady but classes are very off subject so if you don't mind sitting in a class for a couple of hours and not discussing the pertinent ideas, great teacher

Dr. Lipschultz is an inspiration ... her lectures are filled with passion and excitement. Before meeting her, I dreaded taking any history course at UM. Surprisingly enough, Dr. Lipschultz turned out to be a breath of fresh air. I highly recommend her clas
She is one of the best teachers at UM.
Make sure you don't contradict her (even if she's wrong) cause she'll never forget that.

She's awsome and hilarious.Some of he ideas are kinda out there so you can't help but laugh.There are no tests just three 2-3 page papers. It's cake, no reason not to get an A in here and she's a great professor even if you give her a hard time in class over some of the crazy things she says.

Don't take this class! He spends tons of time with useless "analysis" that he thinks helps you but its a waste of time. You have to read the book and learn for yourself anyway. I would not recommend him.
Good Professor. Knows the material. The in class quizzes are a joke, though the exams are designed to be brutal. Attendance and participation are mandatory. Solid class, funny guy, worth taking.
He is a really nice guy who actually makes this stuff funny and interesting. You have a lot of opportunity to ask for help. He is a really good teacher and a nice person!
DON EVER THINK TO TAKE IT
rambles so much gets out of breath and its hard to follow what she means because shes not very articulate.
Super nice and sweet professor. Her exams are straightforward, just study the slides and you will do well in the class. Highly recommend.

Dr. Szeto was an amazing professor. The course was really interesting. Her tests were fair (4 tests), and her study guides were helpful. I loved how we'd learn many different topics and she'd switch from videos to lectures to keep you captivated. I learned a lot from this course.

She's SO nice and helpful. Seriously the best. The lectures are a little dense but if you're good at note taking and memorizing, this is an easy class. The tests are very straightforward, and attendance not mandatory.

Sweetest professor! Science is not my thing at all, I'm taking this class for my Psych minor but I've been able to get A's on all the exams so far. She consistently highlights info throughout her lectures so we can remember it. You definitely have to study but she makes a study guide for every exam & they're pretty straight forward. Def recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is a super sweet and kind professor! Although you are only graded the four exams, they are very fair. She posts her lectures and attendance is not mandatory.
Szeto is a kind and compassionate professor who relays the course material effectively while keeping the exams fair and doable.

Very kind professor and genuinely wants to help students understand. She is very accommodating and all slides from the lecture and study guides are posted online. Exams are pretty easy if you use the study guide and have gone over the slides. Lectures can be a bit boring at times but it is not mandatory to go.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She's great! The class is easy to excel in if you pay attention to the material in the lectures, which she posts everyday if you can't make it to class. The study guides are really helpful for the exams, which aren't too hard or too long.

Very kind woman, always willing to answer any questions. I think she tries her best to make the lectures engaging but personally, it wasn't exactly. However, you can look back at the slides yourself. Three exams and the final exam, not cumulative. No other work aside from that. You'll likely do really well if you study, even a little. 100% rec.

10/10, HIGHLY RECOMMEND! Professor Szeto was an absolute sweetheart and was so accommodating to students who needed extra help. She tried to relate the course content back to us so lecture was relevant and clicked. Even though I skipped a lot of classes because attendance was optional, I still learned a good amount and got A's on all exams.

Exams were based on slide material. I stopped going to class later in the semester and just read the slides. Exams are all multiple choice and mostly easy - only hard questions are like remembering parts of the brain.

Sweetest woman ever! She genuinely wants you to learn and if you show interest in her class she will help you as much as you need. She took time to go over the study guide with me for an hour and made sure I was prepared for the exam! Material of class isn't the most interesting or easy, but she does her best for us to understand!
Sweetest proffessor I have ever had. She actually cares for her students to do good and learn. Never tricks us on exams and if it's not on the study guide, it's not on the exam.

Great professor! Very caring for her students, if you show her you're interested in the class she will help you!! Class is tough and there is a lot to learn, but she makes everything clear and concise in her lectures. Awesome study guides.

Szeto is amazing. She is kind, caring, and invested in the success of her students. Is she the best teacher? Eh, not really. But, she does a great job at assessing knowledge on exams! If you skim her study guides and come to class you should do just fine. One of the sweetest professors I have had at UM, I would take her again in a heartbeat!
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: So kind and caring for all of her students! barely went to lecture and was able to get an A on every exam. she is so accessible in office hours and will tell you directly what you need to study. the information is interesting too and she is so passionate about it it's adorable.

Seems like a nice woman but that doesn't matter when it comes to teaching. One of the worst teachers I've had, no one even shows up to class because they know there's no point... This class is up to you to teach yourself and is graded on only 3 exams which no one does well on. She doesn't respond to emails and don't bother trying to take notes.....

Tests are fair and comprehensive study guides were provided. Lecturing is a little fast-paced, so I often needed to check slides and take notes after class to know what was going on. However, the slides are usually complete and have the necessary information on them. She does good reviews for quizzes and tests, so come to class on those days.

I love Dr.Szeto!  I wished she taught more classes b/c I would take every single one of them.  She genuinely cares about her students and her topic which makes her class so great.  She goes more in depth in the slides than she ever does in the exams which is nice.  Great teacher and class!

Amazing sweet genuine person, but would never take her again as a teacher. Went through lectures WAY too fast, I never learned a single thing in class. Better to go through slides on your own so you can actually take in what they say as she also reads DIRECTLY off of her slides. Again, very very kind woman but not the best teacher.

She is a very sweet lady, but not the best teacher. VERY confusing at times and doesn't know how to answer a lot of questions asked to her in class. Her tests are pretty fair but material is pretty much left up to you to teach yourself. I love her as a person, but as a professor, I would not take any of her classes again as I feel I haven't learned

I highly recommend this professor to students that are just learning about psychology.

professor szeto is such an amazing and caring person but I do not prefer the way she teaches as do many of my classmates. Excellent professor and good at teaching. Very helpful. I would recommend taking her classes. Teach directly for the PowerPoint and easy test.

professor Szeto is amazing. Not necessary to go to class as long as you go over her slides on your own or join the zoom. I usually just go the day before the exam for the review and for the exams themselves. If you have taken AP psych this class is pretty much the same just a few more terms to memorize.

Loved this class! Prof. Szeto is so caring and makes the information easy to understand. It is a lot of memorization, but as long as you take time to read the powerpoints, you'll do fine. Her exams are very fair. Mostly recall with no trick questions.

Very easy professor! Only 4 exams, no homework. Class attendance isnt required because she teaches straight off the PowerPoints but they are loaded with information. Definitely an easy class as long as you study. She is very nice!
Excellent teacher. Actually cares about her students. Exams are ok. Quizzes are very helpful and easy. Just study the powerpoints and you'll do very well.

reviews.comment: Best professor I have had at UMiami!! Such a nice and sweet woman. She genuinely wants to know about her students and always shares stories about her life. She is very approachable and a very good grader. Take her if you ever can!!

Easily the best teacher you will have throughout your four years at this university.
I have had this professor for all of 10 minuets and I already know she's the GOAT. She even brought chocolate.
The greatest teacher to ever walk the face of the Earth.
The greatest teacher to ever walk the face of the Earth.

Simply put, Ms. Sue is the best teacher here at the U! She is the sweetest woman out there. She cares a lot about her students and does everything she can to help. reviews.comment: Dr. Tao's class was lecture heavy. This class is an easy A if you just do the assignments and study the study guides for the exams. The lectures are pretty boring. The quizzes are easy. She is very knowledgeable in this subject.

pretty boring - she reads off the powerpoints and is not engaging. this is good if you're looking for an easy class, the attendance wasn't mandatory and the quizzes are online (except for 2 in-person tests). she's also an easy grader. however, if you're actually interested in learning more about PR don't take this class it's very uninspiring.

Dr. Tao seems nice and knowledgable but I found the lectures and content boring. Only 2 exams and a bunch of online quizzes that were word for word from textbook or powerpoint. Also had a few writing assignments but nothing outrageous. If you want a class that is the definition of mid I would take this. Tao is nice though!

Dr. Tao is nice and easily accessible for office hours. Her class on the other hand is extremely boring.  I would use her class on zoom as background noise as I did laundry and other things around my apartment.  I also had an 88% and she didn't round up.

Prof Tao is a nice person but the class is literally her reading off a script. if you want an easy A, take the class; however, if you actually want to learn then this might not be the best class. literally just a 50-minute lecture of reading words off a powerpoint.

Great professor overall, made online learning much easier than it was for me senior year of high school. Her tests were not hard as long as you complete the study guides she provides. reviews.comment: Very nice professor and a very simple class. Everything is laid out clearly and her instructions are simple to understand. She answers her emails quickly and is very kind and helpful. The course material is more common sense than anything else. The workload is reasonable too.

Her syllabus is intimidating but she is very sweet and is willing to work w/ u if u show effort. There's two tests and if you know the study guide u will make A's on both. Do the assignments, I think 3 "pop-up" and 6 others, and show effort and u will do fine. If her lecture confuses u read the corresponding chapter, helps a lot!

Don't let her syllabus scare you, this class is really not hard. Weekly quizzes and some homework that involves reading the book and answering questions. Graded on a midterm and final test that you definitely should study for. Overall, if you go to class and take notes and pay attention you will be fine!

I took stc 116 with this teacher (intro to public relations) and it was so easy considering it is college. Gives 100 on all assignments if u just do the work!

I loved this class. Professor is very passionate about PR and brings that energy to the class along with real world scenarios. If you actually want to learn, this class is for you. reviews.comment: Good teacher overall. The class is really boring and she does not make it any more interesting. You go there to learn the material and thats it. It is 80% lectures with weekly/ish quizzes. She post the power points after each class. Its not hard, but her class is really boring

Nice professor, so easy but make sure you actually do assignments on time or else you get a 0 no exceptions. reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Don't let the long syllabus scare you. She has been one of the sweetest professors I've had, and always there to help. Her class is very well organized and grading is clear. Amazing teacher. She is super nice. There is a lot of work to do but she is an easy grader. You have mini quizzes almost every week but they are super easy. She tries to make her lectures interesting and always has videos to show. She is always there to help you. Definitely would take her again!

Weiting is such a nice professor. She is really funny and tries to make her lectures interesting. She always finds videos to relate what we're learning to the everyday world. Everything you need to know are on the powerpoints. Quizzes are so easy, and only 2 tests for the whole semester. Gives you a study guide and thats everything you need to know

Tao is one of the easiest professors I have ever taken. Her quizes are on the powerpoints she gives you. She gives 2 test a semester, but she gives you the study guide which is the test. You do need the textbook for some assignements, but i never used it for the test.

Professor Tao's syllabus makes it seem as though she is a tough grader and it will be one hard class to pass but its by far one of the easiest classes I've ever taken. Her syllabus makes her sound horrible and mean, but don't let that scare you. Dr. Tao is an incredible professor who is very sweet. Quizzes are easy. Exams are a bit harder. Show up to class because the days that many people don't show up, she will hand out extra credit because you attended.
Would definitely recommend. She's fun and very organized. She makes the class enjoyable and you learn. If you give effort and participate, you'll breeze through it.

This professor was really unfair in the grading. She does not like answering questions and is not a good professor at this school. UMIAMI needs to be better because we pay so much money at this school to have professors who don't want to see you succeed.

One of the hardest classes I have ever taken and not because the subject was hard but because the teacher makes it impossible. She only gives you three exams and they are near impossible to pass. makes the class a lot harder than it should be.

She is phenomenal. Nicest teacher I had this semester.   Her class is easy if you attend. She will do everything for she can to help you. Would recommend over any other teacher hands down.
Professor Tang is a very nice lady. She puts a lot of effort in her class. Some kids just don't care. I think she is well organized and explain things very clearly. Enjoyed her course!

Dr. Tang was one of the most miserable teachers I have had at UM. Impossible to understand, doesn't engage students and makes subject matter much harder than it should be.  Do NOT take this class, any other professor is a better option.

Amazing class! loved it! The teacher is hilarious and makes the class much more entertaining... Got an A-

reviews.comment: Great professor. He identifies the students that make an effort to learn the material and makes sure you excel in the class. Get to know the guy for sure. Great job asking students for feedback on the course and adjusts to meet realistic needs. This is for symbolic logic btw

Professor Che was great! Highly recommend for anyone taking into-level PHI classes. Super understanding of college workloads, fun topics, and good paper recommendations, as well as feedback. Class has some difficult points but he does his best to make sure everybody understands effectively

reviews.comment: She's a very nice and understanding professor! Highly recommend taking her if you have the opportunity, enjoyed having her as a teacher. She gives really good feedback on all assignments which is greatly appreciated!!

the goat fr

One of the most knowledgeable professors (and people) I have ever met. You can ask her any question and she will likely know the answers off the topic of her head. I learned so much in this class that sticks with me today, 5 years after taking the class. I could not recommend Dr. Sylvia Ann Thompson enough. She taught me everything about how our political process works.

Professor Thompson truly is my favorite teacher I have had here. Her passion for the subject shines through her lectures. Only 3 exams with 75 true or false questions but some were worded weird which made me question my answers a lot of the time. I will say I'm not that interested in politics which is why I didn't get much of what was taught so if you're the same, don't take this. You have to pay attention a lot to fully understand. She is funny and sweet tho

Criteria is very straightforward and the class is very easy to pass. You are graded by 3 exams composed of true/false questions. It is very easy if you listen in class. She is very chill and sweet. I recommend her 100% The textbook is helpful but not necessary at all.

she is super nice but the material is difficult and not useful in the slightest. 4 exams that comprise your grade that are impossible to pass. don't take if you can help it.

Loved taking Thompson for POL 201. She's a great professor, cares about her students, and tells great stories. If you took AP Gov, this class will be a piece of cake. Prof Thompson is such a sweet person. She definitely cares about her students and her profession; she is very smart! Sylvia Thompson is the best lecturer I've ever had. She is clear and precise; you always understand what she is saying. I learned so much in this class.

Professor Thompson is one of the better political science professors. Her classes only consist of lecture and can be boring from time to time but all questions on her exams are from lectures. Dr. Thompson is a very good professor. Her tests are very easy as long as you show up to class and pay attention. She does not use powerpoints, so you have to take your own notes. You're allowed up to 2 missed classes. It is honestly an easy A, you just have to put some effort into it.

Prof. Thompson is the best. She comes in to class and basically just talks about the subject for the next hour and is always interesting. Her class is super easy. Never cracked the textbook and hardly took notes and cruised to an A.

She is honestly the best. I want to be her when I'm older. This is the third class I take w/ her. You MUST go to class and pay attention, but I personally find it easy because she's interesting! If you're even remotely interested in the subject, you'll enjoy her classes. Attend, pay attention and write everything she says, and you will be fine!

Dr. Thompson is my favorite professor at University of Miami. You do have to do the reading and show up to class, but if you do those things, you will be perfectly ready for the exams. Her lectures are perfectly to the point and she has a wonderful dry humor. I also took her American Politics class my first semester. Great class.
If you're gonna show up to class, take her.

Her lectures are long and boring, but going to class is the ONLY way you'll ace the tests. The tests are based off of what she says in class and the handouts, so they are very straightforward. If you go to class and  be engaged with her, write down everything she says, and read the handouts, the tests will be no problem and you'll get an A.

Mrs. Thompson is the coolest lady. She walks into class smiling, dressed to the T, with her super cool sunglasses on. She greets us every class saying I hope you've been having a fabulous day. She is SO smart!!! I want to be this woman when I'm older!! You have to go to class to pass, bc her lectures are pretty much what the tests are based on!

Very Tough. Currently a 1L at GW Law, found out that most of what Prof. Thompson taught is completely irrelevant to the field of law. I advise anyone considering law school to take Con Law IN LAW SCHOOL. Do not fall into the trap: "taking this class will prepare you for law school" Avoid this class!

Thanks to all smart people that are the only one that took the time to write good things about her I got a bad grade. I got a C. Her test are very hard. Not clear of what to study. If you have taken any other government class maybe it would help. But if you have never taken a government course then don't take her. Her test are extremely hard.

Take Thompson! You have to write down everything she says in class to do well, but if you have good note taking skills class is very easy. You cannot skip and expect to do well, but if you show every day there'll be no problem. Memorize your notes for the 3 tests in the course, and they'll be easy As. Final isn't cumulative.

great prof. very very simple course if you attend lectures. if you take notes in lecture and study those notes you have no reason not to get an A. gives a compressive study guide and tests are very clear.

I love Mrs. Thompson's classes, if you go to the lectures and take notes, you will learn a ton and do well on the tests.  What I loved about her is that she kept me guessing as to what political party she belonged to. She also has a great dry wit to her, and he's very knowledgable. Absolutely wonderful course and professor. Also, there was no stupid busy work, just the reading, lectures, and the exams.

She is the easiest teacher ever IF you can bring yourself to go to class. She stands and lectures the entire class- it is painfully boring. However, the tests are extremely easy and based on the handouts she gives. The book does not help.

Easy course, she allows to miss 2 classes so attendance is pretty important.Most say she is boring, but she is very clear and knows exactly what she is talking about.Very helpful, sticks to the agenda and tests are straightforward. Tests are piece of cake if you go to every class and take notes.Her studyguides are awesome.Highly recommend.

The most boring class I have ever taken. She is very knowledgable, but incredibly monotone. Tests aren't HARD if you go to class and pay attention (the hardest part)... Her wording is odd on several questions, which is the only thing I found difficult about her tests. If you can avoid it, don't take the class

The class is interesting but her test are very difficult. She's into fooling her students what will be on the test. If you are good at paying attention the whole time while taking notes and is willing to know the textbook word for word then you'll be ok.
Very interesting class! She knows her stuff! Very prepared. Go to class and you will have zero problems

BORING! she speaks like she is about to fall asleep. her tests are long and some questions are confusing, but if you go to class and, even if it is REALLY HARD, take notes you should be fine. if you are not required to take this class, don't take it, extremely boring class.

DO NOT TAKE HER unless you are amazing at paying attention, can make the time to read the book chapters (even though i dont know what in the book is going to be focused on on the test)... idk how im doing so bad but only 3 tests whole semester so if u do bad ur screwed. thought itd be an easy class but no, dont take it!!!!!!!
Informative lectures, yet very boring. Tests are hard, too hard for a Pol Sci class.

Extremely easy professor.  All multiple choice tests with one clearly answer and 2 clearly wrong answers.  Class is a bit boring, but if you can sit through it, it will be worth it.  Always willing to help.  Final is not cumulative.  She gives extremely detailed study guides.  Definitely recommend!!

if you can just go to every class and sit there, you'll get a guaranteed A. tests are incredibly easy and the final isn't cumulative.  I def recommend for an easy A with pretty interesting info.  She does write stuff and gives out test reviews so everyone before me probably just did horrible in the class. She's not that bad at all
Talk , talk and more talking. Her lectures are boring but only 3 exams count for this class.

She is an AWFUL teacher. NO test review, nothing written on the board or powerpoint or blackboard, just her lectures that go on and on and have countless irrelevant tangents.  She's absolutely the worst professor I've ever had.  Avoid her please.
pretend to be nice but not

A+! If you just read the book you will do okay, if you just go to class (and pay attention with strong note-taking) you will do great, and if you do both of the above you will get an A+ for sure! Exams are 99% STRAIGHTFORWARD, honestly. Thompson is great professor with a sly sense of humor, although she does talk a bit much. Seriously, TAKE HER!
