Talks and talks and talks and talks. Notes never written on the board or anything so it's hard to know what's important.  Not very clear about what will be on tests and no test review.  Get out late EVERY day guaranteed because she never stops TALKING.
i hate this woman. She pretends to be nice but she's not. She is a mean professor. I do not recommend. Her grade range is too narrow. Take it at your own risk

She explains everything very clearly, and her tests are pretty easy...they're straight off her lectures and from the book (though you can get by easily without the book).  Her paper's the hardest thing, but as long as you answer the question, you'll be fine.

very nice lady. she loves it when you ask questions and prompt discussions during the lectures. if you go to class you'll be good. the content is super simple. every test is all multiple choice with only 3 answer choices.

Excellent professor! Going to class is not a chore because she is a great lecturer and she is always crystal clear. She will repeat difficult concepts 2-3 times to ensure that everybody understands. Her tests are extremely easy, but she is a tough essay grader. 3 tests, 1 essay, each worth 25%. I definitely recommend her to anybody, she's great!

Excellent professor, she's helpful and knows her stuff.  Attendance isnt mandatory but her exams are based on her lectures for the most part, take good notes. Don't really need the textbook but glancing at it wont do harm. She gives 3 exams and each question only has 3 choices but they're very wordy. Definitely recommend her

by far the best professor! if taken in summer two exams, final is not cumulative...take A LOT of notes and just study all your notes before the exams, she is the BEST - knows her stuff!! Great Professor!!

She's very nice, if a little dry. I tried to attend because, you know, at $3000 a class I figured I should show up, but you really don't have to. If you miss class, definitely get notes from someone else. Easy A, especially if you have any knowledge whatsoever about American government.

I really enjoyed this class.I had it M-W-F and missed about 1 class/week. Attendance is not mandatory but you should get the notes from someone if you miss class. I got B's in all my tests studying the night before (and not too much). Overall easy class, great teacher, and very interesting. I'm an international student and learned A LOT with her:)

Seems strict and even scary on first appearance but turns out to be quite a pleasant person to listen to. Is enthusiastic about subject matter, easy to understand, and happy to answer any questions. Exams are on the difficult side, not the least because many of the questions are mind-bogglingly long.
Presents material very clearly. Gives handouts and sends emails telling what to study for test and clarifying ambiguous terms
easiest class at UM- if you're a US citizen you should already know everything in this class

This woman knows her history. Extremely smart and able to teach.  Attendance is not mandatory, but HIGHLY suggested as it will save you from having to open the text.  Class is kinda dry, however she does her best to draw students in.  Overall great teacher!

I took her during my freshmen year. She was great! She is very helpful and all of her tests are multiple choice, however be prepared to read a lot on the test. Her tests were like reading a novel. Overall I liked her and the class.
great!! clear straight to the work with her lectures....a must take
very tricky questionsss!! and  she is very boring!

Helpful and concise professor. Book is not necessary. However, attempt to attend every class. Otherwise, make sure whomever you copy notes from is good at taking them. Everything in the tests is in the lecture and handouts. Study them well. She never lets out early, in fact, be prepared to stay an extra 5 minutes or so if she's running behind. She

She is an awesome professor and extremely responsible. She is very knowledgable and can answer whatever question you ask. Her classes are long, sometimes boring, but very useful. I highly recommend her!!!

Easiest class I've taken at UM thus far. Just go to class and write down what she says. She's very monotonous so it can get boring but stay awake because her tests are exactly what she says in class. Pay attention to detail because she does! Her tests are multiple choice with 3 options but there all very alike. If you study, you'll know the answer

Sylvia Rocks! One of the best teachers at UM. She is so down to earth (look at her tattoos)! She is kinda monotonous and repeats a lot of things she said, but that is a good thing cause then it gets stuck in her head.  I really enjoyed her class.  She tries to stay politically neutral but she is clearly Liberal
Easy class.  Good professor.  She can be dry and those 50 minutes never end quick enough, but she makes sure you know the material for the tests.  No book reading involved.
Great pofessor! Very interesting if your into what she's teaching. Recommended to all
class is boring, seems like it lasts forever, teaches every class from start to finish never get out early, but shes very nice and the exams are pretty easy.

Favorite teacher at UM by far. She makes the lectures as interesting as possible and encourages class participation. If you go to class and take good notes there's no reason you shouldn't get an A. Don't need to read the book at all!! Just the notes and handouts. Awesome teacher! Would definitely recommend.

Thompson is awesome. This is the most boring PoliSci class but she makes it barable. The tests aren't hard if you've gone to class and read the handouts. DON"T buy the book. If you are conservative in anyway you have to hold your tongue because she's pretty liberal but you can hold back and get an easy A
Test are impossible and do not reflect anything covered in class. I highly recommend taking another teacher.
Very Hard Class. Avoid at all costs.  Least favorite of this semester.
horrible. don't take if you want to pass pol 213. Any one else would due.

GO to class! take notes and read her handouts and you'll get an A. She doesnt take attendance but her tests are what she says in class. She's a good professor and overall its a good class if you enjoy Pol Sci.

Interesting class, not difficult. I'm a former poli sci major so I did hardly any studying here, but even if you're not a big fan of the subject just going to class and paying attention should be enough to get no less than a B.

Her lectures are pretty interesting and easy. If you think she is boring it is simply because Pol. Science is not the subject for you. I thought the book was a waste of money because she covers most of the material in her lectures and handouts. Only 3 tests, fairly easy. Some of the questions can be a bit tricky. Overall good class and good teacher

Interesting lecturer, if you ask her questions she will answer, read the book material and the handouts because she asks question from those as well as her lectures.  The tests are really easy, 50 MC with 3 choices (normally one is completely wrong).  If you think her tests are hard then you just don't know the material.
This woman is the devil.  Her class is absolutely boring and puts trick questions on the test.

If you think her lectures are boring, then you shouldn't be taking political science classes.  Just like any other class-you have to read and go to class and take good notes.  Three test with 50 questions and three multiple choice answers to choose from.  If you attend class and read, you should get an A.

She's an interesting lecturer. Oftentimes she asks questions which no one can answer. Also her tests aren't the best. They're rather hard with trick questions. It doesn't help that there's only three. I got a B in the class so it's not too bad.

Don't take her. People say she's easy but that's because she doesn't count attendance or give homework. She only has three tests, but the multiple choice is really tricky. She doesn't explain clearly what's on the best and is really boring to listen to! I had to drop her class. Try to avoid at all costs!
So helpful and nice that it's not even funny. Can get a little boring here and there. You could do worse then this easy A.
she is a nice teacher. the tests are long for a 50 minute class. you have to read through all 3 answers to make sure which one is the real correct answer.
very good communicator, but exams are kindof hard
boring and monotome..skip that**** if you have her friday mornings
she's not as easy as everyone says she is. i went to almost all the classes, did the reading, and still got a B+. the multiple choice on her exams ****ed me up all the time.

She is not a difficult professor; her multiple choice tests are tricky -- you have to attend class, take good notes and read the chapters b/c even though i would do that, on the tests i would end up getting B's b/c they're tricky. However, i would reccommend this prof for this class.
Not that bad. She explains very good, but her exams are confusing, 3 choice multiple-choice. You have to go to class to get a good grade

this professor seens easy, though, her tests are very very hard.  She doens't give anyone extra-credit. Do not take this professor on Summer.  She gives 70 questions exam, half of that are short answer questions.  She is clear when speaking, however her tests are not.
I thought she was great!  She made a topic I thought I would hate really interesting.  Information and exams are very straightforward.  She's not difficult at all, I got an A+.
She was so hard. Her exams were ridiculous
Easy A, yet learned a lot

Not as easy as everyone else says. If you drank away most of your hs poli sci knowledge like me your ****ed. Need to either do all reading or go to all classes and take notes to get a good grade. I did neither and barley passed first test.
Great person, easy course! earned an A attending once a week and not reading the book
Great time for sleeping or playing on the computer. This class is so easy, I could have taken it three years ago and aced it just as well as I'm doing now.
very easy class, very fair, doesn't take attendance, i got an A plus
easiest class ever, and actually interesting.  I got an A+ in it, and it actually made me decide to switch my major to Poli Sci.  I wish she taught more poli sci classes!!!
Friendly, approachable, VERY EASY!

Nice guy. VERY boring, but I think all MGT401 classes are. Business jargon slop. Assigns two people each class to literally track other students raising their hand for participation points. 6 quizzes (lockdown, in class), a midterm, a final (only 2nd half), and a final presentation. Just memorize the slides if you want to do well on the tests.
Super friendly and approachable guy. He is always there to help if you have any problems and values student feedback. Easy class too.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great professor, very nice and wiling to help. Not a hard class and he is very educated in the field.

She is a very nice person but the class is SO boring. Her in-class lectures feel like an overly complicated middle school english lesson. I do not feel like I actually learned in her class BUT we only had 2 main essays throughout the entire semester. She has an interesting criteria for them but it made the class pretty easy.

She really cares about participation. If you don't talk she will drop your grade for participation. She will also call on you if you don't talk. She gives feedback on shadow grades which is nice, but it's not very in depth. She takes this class way too seriously for a class that must be taken and that nobody wants to be in.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Toughest grader ever. Zero mercy. Run away as fast as you can.
stay away.

Prof. makes the class harder than it should be just by being a difficult person. Classes are boring and uninformative yet expects max participation and comprehension on everything. Has an attitude, doesn't like to help, repeats herself to intolerable extent, tough grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Gives minimal feedback, does not allow extensions ever, no matter the circumstance. Has mandatory attendance and grades you per class on how much you participate. No office hours and doesn't comply to technical issues.

I have a 4.0, and I am going to finish with a B in what should be tolerable class. She is unhelpful, won't directly help you, an unfair grader, and unclear on what she is grading on. I try hard in school, participate, go to her after class, and still can't meet all her "requirements." This woman likes her power and will give you bad grades.
Dont take her
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Not a hard professor, but not a great professor either. You just have to follow exactly what she says and show effort, and you'll probably get a good grade. She gives vague feedback and seems to value attendance/participation a lot. If you have to take her, she's not bad, but don't expect any profound learning experience.

She is a very kind professor, but lectures as though she is reading the textbook for the first time. If you read ahead, you will be fine. Feedback on the final research project was vague, sometimes incorrect, and largely unhelpful. The class is easy, but extremely menial and oftentimes confusing.

There'll be one big paper for the semester. The syllabus will tell you when all the deadline is, but she'll clarify the work as you move throughout the semester. She's a lovely professor if you put in some effort into the class! She might be unclear in certain aspects of assignments, but if you approach her she will tell you. Love her class

Not great at teaching and overall rude, forgetting that students pay for their education. Would probably be a great grade school teacher, but has too much of a control issue to be teaching a college course. Don't take this class if you are introverted or learn in an untraditional manner.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: AVOID AT ALL COSTS

Zero respect for her students and just all around generally awful if you have actual interest in the content. Please avoid her at all costs--does not even have a degree to be able to clearly talk about her topics and changes all lectures to favor her personal opinions.

For the Civic rights course the one major writing project is kind of a pain to do but the class isn't necessarily hard but I did not like the writing project. Participation and attendance is graded daily and very necessary.

nice woman and wants you to do well, but the class itself is boring. Whole class REreading whatever chapter you read for homework the previous night, and gets upset when participation is low. the textbook is elementary school writing, and you have to write a 3 part essay (like 25+ pages total) with little to no direction or time in class from her.

In this class, you need to pay attention and participate. Ask questions as you need for the rubric. The rough drafts of a paper matter, if you are confused go to her office hours! It helps because she literally let me turn in an assignment late past the due date because I met with her outside of class and asked questions. Shes so kind.

You can tell she cares about her students, but she is a very confusing and frustrating grader. We had different ways to get grades for class, but the most significant way was from the big paper we were given about societal issues/civic engagement. The prompt itself was not that confusing, but she is unclear about directions and grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Loved her so much

Professor Bradley-Cousins is a very nice person. Her class though is terrible. 
She assigns 4 papers towards the end of the semester based on one "societal issue" and is so vague about what she wants. 
I've asked her multiple time to clarify and she gives back the most vague and confusing answers. 
You will be lost the entire semester. 
Good luck

Prof Bradley-Cousins is a great professor. She is very caring and accessible. She stresses two big projects throughout the semester: the Final Project Paper and Small Moments Journal as you are required to join a Community Service org to base your paper. Overall, if you show participation in her course, she will help you out with anything.

I took WRS106 instead of 105. She's a very sweet lady, but I took her 8 am section worst decision of my life. She teaches very simple elementary school writing stuff and just lectures off the textbook. The whole class is riding off one final paper and some little response questions here and there. Theres better professors out there for this class.

Dr. Bradley-Cousins runs her class very inefficiently. Every class is spent with her lecturing the students about elementary-level writing topics, or with us sitting there "preparing for our final paper". The class is a mere formality rather than a place for students to truly be engaged and fascinated with new concepts, and inspired to learn.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Must participate in some community service organization out of class as a part of the class. She isn't an easy grader but not too terrible. Aside from that, very chill in class time and almost no homework until last week or two with the final paper. Make sure to try really hard on the stuff at the start that is graded because it is worth a lot.

Prof Bradley-Cousins is a very nice woman and she will care for you if you show her you care about her class. You are required to join an organizational group and then write about your experiences with said group. She gives great feedback. Directions to the final paper were confusing but if you ask her to clarify she will.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: For ENG 106: Definitely better professors out there. You are required to join a service organization at the beginning of the semester and write about it in a journal. Final paper is putting together all of the experiences. Directions for final paper were VERY unclear and confusing. Lectures and discussion questions come from the textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: (I actually took 106) She is a great and caring person and really does care about her students. HOWEVER, I did not like the topic of the course and she didn't really explain it well. You have to join a volunteer org and write one paper due for the whole semester based off of that, it's worth a lot of ur grade and she did not rly help at all with it

Missed almost no classes and my grade still suffered. Even when I had the flu she did not excuse my absence which resulted in me attending class sick. Lots of papers but you can do them the night of. I found it frustrating because I had to practically dumb down my papers to get a good grade. I did not learn a thing in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I myself did not do bad in this class but there were six papers assigned one after the other. So much work and so little time. My friend got sick and could not fly in which she did not excuse after her saying it would be fine. This really negatively affected his grade. She as well grades very harshly. If you don't attended every class it'll be bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The most ridiculous teacher I have ever had. Assigns an unfair amount of papers on top of a dozen other assignments. If you can choose another teacher do it. Oh yeah, and if you're sick she won't care, if you're not there for any reason even for a serious one it does not matter. On top of all, that she grades your essays as hard as a publisher.

Professor Bradley is honestly the most amazing professor Ive ever had. Shes super sweet and caring, gives great feedback and is willing to meet privately to improve your papers. As long as you put in the effort, you will be fine in her class. 10/10 recommend to anyone who wants to become a better writer or improve writing skills.

I would 100% recommend Dr. Bradley-Cousins. Not only was she a great professor and always made class enjoyable, but she truly cares about her students and wants them to improve. She gives opportunities to improve grades on all papers if you meet with her and take her feedback. I hope to have her again and learned a lot in this course.
Unprofessional and difficult to reach. Doesn't want to help students, even if she sees how much they have worked for her class.
does not seem confident or passionate about the topics taught.

She is a unprofessional, unreliable, and unethical Professor at UM. She berates her students, causing drama and stress beyond manageable. She delays writing letter of recommendations for her Music Therapy students for miniscule and petty reasons. Every cohort has issues with the way she conducts herself in her relations with her students every year

He is super sweet and funny. The class was easy; the tests and papers were all self-explanatory. However, it is a three-hour class, and it will feel like it. He's a slow talker and gets sidetracked a lot. But overall, great professor. I recommend it if you can endure the long lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Murphy has been one of the best professors I've ever had at UM. Sure the lectures are long- I would assume that for any 3 hour course- but he does his best to incorporate interesting anecdotes and experiences that supplement the material. If you have the chance, definitely take his class.
Murph is the most boring lecturer at UM, so if you have a low attention span tread carefully.

Pretty easy going professor. The class was 3 hours long so it gets boring at times, but he makes it interesting since he's pretty funny. One major paper and two exams, so those are the things that really matter. Overall, as long as you show up to class you will understand the material just fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is good for the math department here. Clear expectations for the class. If you do the homework you should be fine for the quizzes and exams. I'm good at math but not at trig so if you have any questions he's always willing to help. The final exam was crazy hard for our class though and felt unprepared. Also kinda annoying when he shows up late.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Quite possibly the worst teacher i've ever had in my life. Showed up late to every single class and proceeded to doodle on the board for an hour and a half having explained nothing. Asks the students to check his work if he did it correctly and takes an entire class period to go over one singular problem. Do not take him.

He showed up late up to every class and some times would come late up to 20 minutes. He also has 0 confidence in his teaching and always asks students if he solved the problems correctly on the board. Most of the times you teach him instead of him teaching you.
I always love Dr. Hood. ECS301 is pretty straightforward if you go to class. No tests or papers, just lots of small research projects throughout the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: I love Dr. Hood. ECS 415 is a great class to work closer with her. Super easy, a small project and mainly just weekly gardening.
Love Dr. Hood! She's really engaging and has hilarious tee shirts. As long as you show up and pay attention it's an easy A and fun stuff too.

She's super cool and genuinely interested in making sure everyone learns the material. I've thoroughly enjoyed her class, as she has clear grading criteria and is upfront about her expectations. She assigns a very reasonable amount of work and makes geology interesting. I intend on taking 2 more classes with her in the future. She's excellent!
A few small assignments (mainly in class) with three tests. Tests follow the powerpoints and lectures exactly, no textbook necessary. Dr. Hood is very helpful and happy to talk about the class.

Class is usually just for ECS ppl. It was an absolute mess. Absolute no direction, she ran around panicked all the time. She had to dumb down our final proj because got so hectic, she had to lower expectations. Need geochem background to know whats going on. Ended up being easy assignment, but too hectic. learned nothing. constant stress/confusion.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Hood is one of the nicest professors I've took in UM. Attendance is not mandatory but she occasionally has some in-class exercises but as long as you have them handed in before last day of class you do have credits for that. Exams are not hard and straightforward. She's willing to help and a really nice person.

Professor Hood is the best! This class is perfect for non STEM majors. She explains the material really clearly and uses lots of examples to make class more interesting. Graded by two exams, a one-page book review, and easy in-class assignments.

The woman has 0 flaws. mentored me outside of class & helped prepare me for the real world. Always eager to help and to brainstorm together. Cares about others' opinions & beautifying the school (sustainable suburbia  class project). We gardened a few hours a week it was super therapeutic, informative (she knows everything) fun, & a good workout

Very cool and college student pro professor! Her class is VERY EASY to get AT LEAST a B in but you WILL have to work for it! Has exams and a non-cumulative final but offers 20 extra credit assignments as well as up to a C on the Final with an extra credit assignment! Also assigns mandatory essay assignments from books on the topics taught.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: AMAZING 1-credit class!! 1x a week 1 student & I had to take care of the plant-wall in the Ungar bldg. We watered them, trimmed dead leaves, & on our own decided to add terrariums next to the wall so THood bought us glass orbs to hang and small succulents to stick inside. She is a wealth of knowledge and very sweet. She cares & wears funny t-shirts

Dr. Hood is a really great teacher. Even though her tests were harder than I expected, I would take her again. Her class is based on Assignments and 3 tests (the final isnt cumulative). She also has 2 optional assignments for extra credit that can add 20 points to one test. Attendance is mandatory cause she doesnt post the pp on bb.
Great teacher, really holds my interest in class.  Not an easy A but if you do your work you will be fine.

Dr. Hood is a delight! She's very sweet and presents the material in a way that is very graspable. The class itself is very interesting. You do need to study but you will learn a lot about a bunch of fascinating topics. I definitely recommend this class!

Class is easy, attendance is mandatory. All material is presented in class on power points. They are not posted on BB, so must copy in class. Exams are based strictly off those, no book use at all. Study guides are given by her, and directly relate to the exam-she forgot to put something on the study guide and realized it and excluded it from test.
Great class, easy A, engaging professor - all of the above.

Absolutely great professor. Clearly tells you what needs to be known and tests on that material. My class was excessively easy to the point that I literally felt bad that I got credits for it. Not only is the class simple but Dr. Hood as a person is top notch, I have had her for multiple classes and would not hesitate to take her again. She's great
SUCH AN EASY CLASS...NEEDS TO GO EVERY CLASS TO GET THE NOTES BUT THE TESTS ARE JUST NOTES FROM THE CLASS...SHE MAKES IT SO EASY THAT ITS IMPOSSIBLE TO FAIL

Terri Hood is a great professor, knows what she's talking about and knows how to say it so everyone can understand, makes it impossible to fail. down to earth, practical attitude, take her for a natural science requirement. you will have to go to class everyday and take notes, tests are based off of her pp's. i pity the fool that dont take her.
There's food!  Getting a seat in this class is a gift.
very thought provoking class and easy only one credit though

You have to go to class to get the notes and for the in class assignments which are a  percentage of your grade. The tests are not that easy, you have to study. What makes this teacher easy is that if you miss any assignment you can make it up and you can redo the test if you dont like you grade.

She is the sweetest, the most helpful teacher. You have to attend class b/c she gives slides (doesnt posted on BB) and random assignments (you are able to make up ANY assignment and they're EASY) if you dont do well on the tests you get to make them up (1st test is EXACTLY the same) such a sweet heart!
Dr. Hood is awesome!!!!!!!!!

Lecture notes are only available period they were presented. Very entertaining woman and effective way of teaching. Power point grades and some small activites. Midterm and Final and one book report. Take it!!!!!!

In class assignments make you attend class but if you miss them you can make them up, they are short and easy.  Midterm & Final are EXTREMELY easy and she gives you a review sheet telling you exactly what is and isn't on the test.  If you take notes and study a little bit, you will definitely get an A...easy teacher I've had at UM
everyone pretty much said it. shes awesome. take her.

Best professor @ UM, no question. Easy class, 2 test & 1 paper. SUPER nice women who has the Sexiest Legs, she loves to wear little skirts and funny t shirts. Also very bright & keeps the concepts short & easy to understand, no BS you wont need to due well in this class. HIGHLY RECOMENDED.Her classes fill up the first day of registration.GreatClass

This is potentially the sweetest woman at the Unversity of Miami. She wears the cutest tshirts and mini-skirts everyday. She loves her fossils too...The class is easy, only two tests and one book report. I am learning a lot.

Participation isnt NECESARY, you wont fail without it, but it helps a lot. He makes everything fun, is a very fair grader, and is more than willing to discuss or review extra drafts. Super knowledgeable and smart. Absolutely would take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Such an enjoyable class if you like reading. I didn't feel like I had to force myself to participate because we had awesome discussions. Totally recommend and would definitely take another class with him!

He's a cool guy and leads really interesting discussions. The grade is made up of two papers, a final & participation. Highly recommend this class to people who enjoy reading good books and talking about them!!

Participation matters, but he always makes the discussions open, engaging, and interesting. I didn't feel like I needed to force myself to participate. There is a lot of reading, but all the books we read I GENUINELY enjoyed. There's two papers and we turn a rough draft in first were he provides great feedback. HIGHLY recommend this class.

Has english accent which is always a plus.  We read tons of books but they are enjoyable.  It was just like being in a fun book club.  Two papers and final.  Brought cookies to last day of class.  Willing to work with you.  Honestly love him.  Such a sweet guy.

Dr. Watson made the contemporary theory class much more interesting than I thought it was going to be. Very tough readings some weeks and people struggled with them but guided discussion. Some people clearly did not do readings and said little or nothing all semester causing resentment among student who had done the work.

This man is the reason I'm continuing on in English. He was great at leading discussions, he makes you want to participate, the books he picked for class were great and made me want to read. I'm looking forward to taking him again.
He blows for the Sixties class, and the smart ones in the class blew him off and skipped his lectures.  Seems pissed that people don't come, but can you blame us???

I wish I had seen all the good things previous people have said about this professor. As it is however, I saw him as extraordinarily boring. He seemed to drone on and on without actually making or even having a point. Not recommended.

I cannot tell you strongly enough not to take the 1960's history class.  Watson is really boring. I can't wait for this class to be over. The grading is just ridiculous. It is not what we expected at all.
Really great in-class discussions and lectures. Grading is a bit tougher than I had expected. MUST do reading but the assigned reading is good. He is adorable!
Fantastic teacher! Big on discussion, so be sure to participate. Lectures were always informative and interesting. An all-around cool guy. I genuinely enjoyed the class.

Wonderful teacher! Very clear (gotta love that British Accent!), good about talking about mechanics of reading and writing as well as the actual reading/writing, class discussion every day, come prepared to talk! Opportunity for revision on papers, gives excellent comments. Hates bad attendence, people who don't talk, late blackboard posters.

He's one of the best teachers. I still talk about the books that we read, and lend a bunch of them to family and friends. He's so helpful and really cares about what students have to say. I loved the idea of posting an idea/question/observation once a week on Blackboard, to get the people who didn't really like to talk, engaged in the topics.
He's literally the best TAKE HIM!! This class is interesting and he is so passionate about teaching and what he does. You will get a good grade just go!! Its so chill

He is by far my favorite professor I've had. His class is beyond engaging, no homework, projects done in class, such a breeze. He really cares about his students, and barely lectures. Take him if you can he's the best.

One of my favorite professors at UM, he's so funny and kind. He gives you lots of great feedback and actually knows how to teach. No tests and very little homework, he just wants you to care and be engaged.
Great for STC 231, participation really matter for this class!

STC234:
Professor Timiraos is the best professor I had all sem! He is super passionate and chill about his class and is one of those professors who likes to have conversations rather than lectures. Your workload is light and he just wants to see you learn something from his class rather than give you a bad grade. No exams. Take him if you can!!!
Best and most nice professor ever, take him.

STC384 with Professor Timiraos was an overall great experience. He always found ways to make it an engaging course and encouraged students to collaborate with one another. His passion, expertise, and dedication to the students created a supportive and fun learning environment. You learn so much about advertising by taking this course with him!

One of the most caring professors I have had. Always takes the time to get to know his students on a personal level. The class is clear and easy to succeed in, and is composed of a few group projects. Uses his own experience in the industry to provide insightful lectures to the class, always tries to make it fun or engaging. Would recommend.

Prof Terilli was so respectful and eager to help. It's very lecture based but if you get the textbook PDF you should be able to get by on the tests. Final grade was ONLY 3 tests. Didn't like that at all but he was willing to meet with us after each one to discuss feedback and grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I LOVE Professor Terilli, hands down the best teacher I've had at UM so far. He's extremely intelligent and absolutely hilarious, which make his lectures really engaging. While he doesn't give homework, his tests are really involved and require a ton of writing. If you don't keep up with the textbook readings or go to class, it can be tough.

Most boring lectures I've ever sat through. If you aren't interested in law, this class will be super boring for you. In every lecture, you cover a lot of material and if you skip class you will fall behind.

You have a total of four grades. While he's knowledgable in this field, he should have stuck with being a lawyer instead of a professor. He is kind but not very helpful. All his advice is generic. Grades tests hard and doesn't communicate exactly what he's looking for. No homework. Just major assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Best class ever because he is an amazing teacher. 3 tests and one paper. This semester if you got an average of 93 or above you didn't have to take the 3rd test (the final). He takes attendance. Not hard if you pay attention to the court cases. Super interesting and helpful. MC is easy if you pay attention.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: By far the most boring lectures I've ever sat through. If you aren't interested in law, this class will be a bore for you. Very lecture heavy, if you skip one class you get very behind. However, Terilli is VERY knowledgable on what he lectures about. The exams were all short answer and he required super in depth answers

He was my favorite professor this semester. The course is very information-heavy but I always looked forward to class because his style of speaking makes lectures super interesting. You definitely have to study to do well but he holds extra reviews and is always willing to help you if you need it. Awesome professor, definitely take him!

Terilli's lectures are so interesting, and he keeps the class engaged by showing clips that relate to the topics (one time he showed an episode of Family Guy to debate the legality and moral issues of profanity/obscenity in media, was hilarious). Tests are hard when there's multiple choice on textbook, but he's lenient on writing section. Take him!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: One of my favorites professors at UM. Paying attention isnt hard since the info is interesting and hes passionate about it, and if you do that, youll get an A.
I loved him, strongly recommend. Just study for the tests.
Loved taking this class. He is a bit lecture heavy but he keeps them interesting. He could be a bit more clear about the material covered on test. Study guides are not provided. Overall good teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Great teacher! I loved this class so much. His lectures are really engaging and if you take good notes you will do well on the exams. The exams are multiple choice and a long essay at the end which is the majority of the points. So you have to apply what you learned. It isn't an easy class, but you will learn tons.

this was the 1st semester Terilli used TopHat and I have to say that I think it MAJORLY took away from the course. I would've gotten so much more out of it if I wasn't distracted by my comp -I just couldn't focus along with everyone else.  I think this is why I really didn't enjoy the course. I know people that have taken it in the past loved it

He makes his lectures really funny. Take lots of notes on what he's saying, he'll give you the powerpoints later. The tests are multiple choice with one really long free response question at the end, and you have the opportunity to get extra credit on every test. Overall, he was a great professor.
He is great! Just make sure you read.
Great guy. He is a lawyer, so he teaches a bit vague on some topics. You must read the textbook.

He is the man. Very smart and teaches the class very well. His lectures sometimes run long but he does an amazing job keeping you engaged. His tests are pretty hard but they all have an open response at the end where you can fake your way though it and get most of points. His passion is contagious. Great guy.

Terilli is on the best professors I have ever had! His classes are some of the most interesting ones I have taken so far because he really does know the material. He only gives three tests and I Aced all of them. Read the chapters and pay attention in class and you'll do fine. I definitely recommend to anyone.

Great professor overall, although his lectures can run a little long, he tries to keep it interesting by showing different clips from Family Guy, The Chapelle Show, etc. Only about 3 tests and a short paper make up your grade. Attendance is taken every day. Read the text book and pay attention in class  easy A.

Attendance is not required. Don't take notes from the PowerPoints because you'll get them before the tests. Take notes on the specifics that he says that are NOT on the powerpoints. READ EVERY CHAPTER and take notes. Essays on the tests are worth a lot, but he's a very lenient grader. Just show that you know the concepts and your opinions.

My favorite teacher I've had at UM. I have zero interest in law and he made me love this class. Won't take attendance but he remembers faces come the end of the semester so it's worth showing up. Great guy to get to know.

Professor Terilli is a nice and thoughtful teacher, but sometimes has long, winded lectures with no consequence. The three papers you'll write are more based on the textbook and that you write logically.
Very genuine, understanding and cool. He wants all of his students to do well in class. One of the best professors in UM

He is extremely helpful and a wonderful professor! He keeps class interesting and is very clear. He is also willing to help you when ever you need it. Definitely one of the best professors in the communications department- I'd recommend taking his class.
Excellent teacher, very helpful, nice guy, I'd recommend him.

I had Terilli from freshman year  (History of Journalism - you'll survive) to my last semester of college. Great man, advisor, professor. He genuinely cares about you and wants to see you do well in his program. When he says, "I'd have no problem giving each and every one of you an A," he means it. It's yours to lose.

This was a great class. We watched videos like Jon Stewart and SNL to discuss how they're part of communication. He's very clear, great lecturer. The exams aren't too hard and he's really helpful. Very friendly and really wants students to do well.

Great professor. Really wants students to do well. He'll curve exams if he needs to. Likes class discussion and has interesting ways to tie subjects together to prove a point. The subject matter of this class and the book are really boring but he makes it much better.
Great professor. Take as many journalism classes with him that you can. A fun guy who tries to make class fun, while still teaching.
Great professor! Tests were over both lectures and readings so definitely go to class. He's a lawyer so he likes the sound of his own voice and tends to talk a lot.

Terilli is great! He's really friendly and wants students to do well. The subject is kind of dull, but he really tries to make it interesting by showing South Park and Family Guy episodes that relate to the topics in class. As long as you read the book and go to class, the exams aren't too hard either. Take him!

Awesome professor. He's funny, witty, edgy and has a good collection of shows and movie clips he'll share in class. He uses his great sense of humor to really get through to students. His tests are a little hard but nothing you can't prepare for and he'll even do study sessions prior to exams.
One of the best professors at UM!

Really nice guy. He cares alot about his students and tries to help his students as much as possible. He is an extremely easy grader. I probably deserve to fail this class and I got a B. Attendence not mandatory but you need to be in class to get the notes and to get a good grade.

A great guy, but this class can be painful at times. Very boring, especially the first half of the semester which deals with colonial period. His first test is rather difficult. Study hard! They do get a bit easier as semester goes on. Seems like a great teacher outside of this class. If you're not required to take this class, don't.

Excellent professor! You learn so much without even realizing it because his class is so much fun and so interesting.  I always looked forward to going to his class and even though attendance wasn't mandatory, I went to every class. I hope I can have him as a professor again. I highly recommend him for this course.

He is real down to earth and funny. He is a lawyer and sometimes he talks a lot (still in lawyer mode) and the point to what he is saying is often jumbled and he doesn't straight out say what he means. It's sometimes hard to understand him. His teasts are multiple choice and essay. They are hard if you don't know the court cases.
extremely helpful and interesting.....integrates things like family guy, the colbert report, and the daily show into class
He's a great teacher!  He makes class really fun and interesting.  I definitely recommend him to anyone especially since he is rather easy and he hardly ever refers to the book during class.
One of the Com School's best. Hilarious, fun, easy, lets you turn in papers late. If you get on his good side, he can help you immensely. You'll learn a ton, too. Great lecture style.

He is awesome. His first test is hard, so study your ass off, but he does it to whip you into shape. His second test is really easy. He lets you turn in papers late and they can't be more than two pages. I have him for Media ethics now and he plays the Daily Show almost every time. He's also very personable and helpful.

Terilli is awesome! The material is pretty boring when it comes from the book, but he teaches so much of the class with South Park, Chapelle's Show, and Family Guy. It's awesome! He's a really nice, helpful guy, and he obviously cares about how his students do. Take him if you want to actually appreciate this class. The other professors are bad!
possibly one of the best teachers at UM...you can turn in your papers whenever you want and he gives extra credit...plus, he's cool as****
No Comments

I highly recommend him.  I hate law classes and managed to pull off a B.  You have to study for his tests but his paper isn't too bad.  I skipped a class at least every other week because it can get boring... but overall, he's a really nice guy and good teacher.  I think he teaches because he actually likes it, which isnt common.

Probably the better professor to take for the course.  Does not take attendance, has a mid-term and a final along with a 3-page paper.  Tests were somewhat difficult and required studying, but it's a law class afterall. Paper also has a rewrite, and he is willing to discuss it with you.  For tests you gotta study both book and notes. Nice professor

Hmmm...he isn't clear at all as far as what is going to be on a test, but he grades very fairly and encourages students to e-mail or stop by his office for help. Tests are by no means easy, and they're frustrating to study for. Attend ALL lectures, and study both the notes and the book and you'll do ok. There's also a paper, but it's no big deal.

He's a very nice professor and a very easy going person.  However, he has a monotone voice and he tends to go on a lot of tangents.  Can easily put you to sleep, but he is very flexible when it comes to grades and due dates of material.  He really values his students.
Nice guy and fairly interesting even though the material for this class sucks.

Great teacher - his class was actually enjoyable. Made a terribly boring subject (Mass Media Law) bearable. Exams were a little difficult, but not impossible. He's also freaking HILARIOUS - you'll sometimes leave class cracking up. He could be a comedian. In any event, if he's available, take him, because you'll enjoy his class.

He's pretty good.  He likes to go on tangents in class.  However, he is flexible when it comes to grading.  He can be boring, but he has his entertaining moments when he wants.  He also relates material to current day situations.
Runs a very laid back class.  Usually doesn't give exams, just gives essays.  He's pretty entertaining too.  Classes focus on classroom discussion.

She is very kind and funny, but her teaching style is a bit too professional and she uses difficult vocabulary in her lectures, making it difficult to understand--she also rushes through topics at times.
so nice so smart so caring. so great so thoughtful amazing professor

This class is hard somehow if you are not expected to memorize those terms. The grade is based on 4 exams but each exam has two short answer questions that take 10%. She does provide some extra credits but anyway take another 200 level class if you are not good at memorization.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very sweet and passionate about psychology! 5 tests but you can drop 1 including the final. Take advantage of extra credit!

Professor Timpano is an extremely sweet and caring person and she does an incredible job teaching this course. She does an excellent job keeping the course interesting and students involved. Her class is not difficult and as long as you pay attention in class you will receive an A.
So sweet, very understanding. She's very clear in what she wants from you and I think she's hilarious.
Wonderful teacher. Kind, outgoing, intelligent, helpful, and excited about the subjects she is teaching. I hope to be able to take another of her classes.

I had Dr. Timpano for UMX and for 352. She is SO nice and sweet. Very knowledgeable and makes material relatable. You have to read and put in the effort, but you will be rewarded with as much effort as you put in. Very approachable, and overall just awesome!
Nicest professor you will ever meet!

She's a good professor, nice, but a little strict. The course is easy, there's a medium amount of homework and tons of quizzes, essays, and tests. Overall would recommend. Rounded my grade, without me asking.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Very easy class! Most of the class is spent going over homework with classmates and going over the questions/answers out loud (most of it you don't have to turn in). Very easy and understandable grader and tries her best to make you improve. All of the homework comes from the textbook so make sure you have it.
Good professor
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She never announces upcoming tests or quizzes in class. On top of that, she's an extremely harsh grader on tests. The workload is ridiculous, with tons of homework every single week that barely help with the exams. it feels like she's trying to make the class harder than it needs to be.

Great professor. There is a lot of homework but its the same in all Spanish classes. She follows the course policies and is strict about some things but as long as you participate and don't use your phone you will be fine. She's good at explaining grammar and careful not to talk too fast.

This is class is really easy, just do the work and study even a little bit for an A. Everything is super easy, it's just a lot of busy work that's annoying more than anything else, but that's common in any of the spanish classes. Also found her easier to understand than other professors during class.
Very fun class.
She is great and challenges you in all of the right ways. If you want to get better at Spanish and are willing to put in the work this is the class for you!

Took Prof. Shinbach for 101 and 102. One of the best Professors I've had at UM. The Spanish curriculum is the same throughout all classes so HW and tests don't vary. If you just show up to class and do the HW you're guaranteed at least a B-. Very easy to talk to, easy to speak with out of class, and understands not everyone is amazing at Spanish.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is a fair teacher. Yes, there is a lot of hw but that is to be expected from any SPA class as the department makes it. She gives good feedback, is available to help and overall a nice person :)

im terrible at spanish so listen up!! prof shinbach is awesome and so helpful. any spanish professor is gonna be hard but she makes it manageable and gives great feedback if you ask for it. the hw comes from department so there's a lot, but if u arent the best at spanish id def recommend her!! i wanted to take her again for 201 but couldnt get in:(
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Prof Shinbach is an extremely kind and approachable professor. The course does involve a lot of homework. However, this is determined by the Spanish department, not Professor Shin back. She makes lectures very engaging and interesting. There is usually some form of group work during the lecture time. She grades pretty fairly.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Course content was presented well and the homework prepares you a lot for the exams. I also think the exams were very fair and only included things that we've gone over in class. Amazing professor. She responds to emails very quickly and is very kind. The class has a lot of homework, but that's determined by the Spanish department, not her.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This class was way more work than it should have been. If you don't participate constantly she will force you AND she will still give you a poor participation grade. Attendance is mandatory with cameras on at all times. She's an insanely harsh grader and shows no sympathy. AVOID AT ALL COSTS.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She was very easy to contact and she held review sessions before the tests if we were struggling and really made it easier to understand rather than reading what the department tells her to or what the textbook says.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: The best professor for 201. She is very caring and is more than happy to help if you make an effort and go to her outside of class. Exams and homework can be difficult as they come from the department but she prepares you well for everything. Easily the best professor in the whole Spanish department.

One of the best language professors I've had, very clear and helpful. There is a lot of homework but the course requirements are set up by the department, not the instructors. The class is mostly group work so she doesn't lecture. Activities are fun but only if you prepare for class and participate. If you're not studying you won't do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Unnecessary amount of work for a 200 level class in my opinion. There is homework every night and she cares a lot about class participation and attendance. Can be a little condescending and rude when you don't answer a question exactly how she wants. Her lectures are boring and I learned little to nothing from this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She is very clear in what she expects and genuinely wants her students to succeed. Helps you out a ton by pointing out the relevant vocab that will be on the test. Overall, tons of busywork but that's not her fault, it's just the department. You kind of teach yourself so it might be hard for someone who hasn't had previous knowledge of the grammar.
She doesn't let you use any English, even to ask questions. Also lectures are not helpful to prepare for exams. I wish I had taken a different professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Professor Shinbach's Spanish is very clear. Participation is a very big deal for her, and she will call on you in class if you haven't answered a question or participated already. The class is structured by the department and the test are written by them as well, but she really tries to give you everything you need to succeed on them.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She really worked with but is definitely a tough grader.  She focused heavily on culture aspects instead of language use.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She is a really good teacher. Her first language is English, so if you do not understand what she is talking about in Spanish you can ask her after class to explain it to you in English. Do majority of the work outside of the class room. During class it is a review of everything you should have done outside. Really nice teacher. i would take her

She is super helpful and nice! Her Spanish is clear and understandable, and she is a native English speaker, so after class she will be able to understand/answer any questions in English. Class is fun and she is not a very tough grader.

A lot of homework. A lot was expected even though I had never taken spanish before. I had to work my butt off to get an A. Tests are really easy though. She was a nice person, willing to compromise and be helpful. Overall I liked her, but there was so much work, expect to be over your head.
She is a good teacher, nice and always willing to help. You can miss about 2 times, but the class is small and she notices if you are not there.

The Spanish department is very structured, so she follows its guidelines. She only speaks in Spanish during class, but will speak in English beforeafter if you have any questions. Even with no previous Spanish background, students can understand her because she is clear and uses easy vocabulary. Participationattendance is mandatory. She is great!

I really loved Profesora Shinbach.  Her class is a lot of work, there's a ton of assignments and if you fall behind you won't do well.  There's lots of self learning but she reinforces everything in class.  Tests were very easy.  She's very approachable and friendly.  She takes attendance and if you skip you'll probably fail though.

Very nice and helpful teacher, about the best you will find for SPA 211, but unfortunately the class is department run and she has no control over the assignments and tests. There are many portions to your grade, which is annoying, but she prepares you as best as she can and will help outside of class. It can be tough, but she wants you to do well.

It is a hard class but she is really nice. Ton of online homework though. They are ridiculously long and boring. She stressed a lot about vocab that is found in textbook but on the actual test there was only about 3 to 4 questions on it.. Yeah dont stress over vocab that much cuz only things you have to know are the ones that are done in class.

She wasn't great but wasn't bad either. She's nice and grades pretty easy. Tests are department made. At times there's alot of online homework. Only criticism is that she would spend 2 minutes on something I spent weeks doing in AP in high school. If I wasn't already half fluent going into this class I would've been lost.

really nice teacher. grades easy, enjoyable class, would recommend her. wants you to succeed and is always available for extra help. good amount of homework and busy work buts its all easy and she doesnt grade it, just gives you credit
No Comments

Although its been years since I took his class on Arthurian legends, I wish to share how kind and amazing Professor Goodmann was. He has a strong understanding of and a passion for the subject matter. The class isn't easy, and the reading material is extremely challenging because of the earlier English spellings and syntax, but it's well worth it.

this guy ruined my spring semester last year and was so not accommodating whatsoever, when i had a medical emergency and missed class/was late he said i should've scheduled it better and did not care when i explained what was going on, was also so rude with his response. DO NOT TAKE THIS GUY you will regret it he's also rly boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Very passionate teacher. Be ready to bring your 'A'-game. Very helpful outside of class. Friendly. Extremely intelligent and well-spoken, a nerd in the best ways, lenient to a certain extent/standard.

Professor Goodmann's class is definitely challenging and you have to put in effort/go to class. He assigns a lot of homework/reading & can be a tough grader - but consult with him, go to his office hours, get to know him. He wants to see you succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I'm sorry, but all ya'll complaining about the length of papers or his inability to comprehend that his students are taking classes other than his are just lazy--especially if you were taking an upper-level course. Classes are challenging and occasionally time-consuming but never anything unmanageable. And I've had him twice while taking 21 credits
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He knows what he's talking about course-wise, but can be extremely demeaning and treats his students like middle schoolers. He acts like his is the only class you're taking and doesn't approve of literally any time consuming activity outside of class. Classes are interesting but keep your head low.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He is nice enough but is overtly pompous, he also expects you to geek out over all the readings. I feel like he appeals to a certain kind of person, so maybe give him a chance during the add/ drop period but keep your options open
Middle English was brilliant, excellent choice in materials for class. Essays are difficult, but manageable. Highly encourage others to take this class. -Not an English Student

Dr. Goodmann is incredibly intelligent and passionate about his area of study. The class was difficult and had a hefty work load at times, but I learned a lot and definitely improved my writing skills. Take if you love literature and want to learn from an extremely knowledgeable and interesting professor.

If you aren't willing to attend lecture, read diligently, speak up in class, and grow as a writer, this class isn't for you. However, if you're looking for a riveting experience AND hard work, Goodmann will be one of the greatest and most memorable professors you'll ever have.  He is brilliant and passionate, and he really cares about his students.
This class started out seemingly easy, but it was the total opposite. Long ass papers, and he is meticulous with every aspect of it, and lots of reading. He is not a fair grader and is not very nice.

Dr. Goodmann is a brilliant guy and loves it when his students show initiative. Papers are easy if you engage in class discussions and visit him during office hours. He's super nice and loves to chat with students. His classes are challenging, but I definitely recommend him to all who are interested in medieval lit or Tolkien.
He's a quirky but fun professor. Its not an easy grade. His classes are meant for student discussion and when there is no student participation the class can get stale.

I was really interested in the topic that he picked for this semester, but it ended up being the class I liked the least. He rambles in class and returns papers too close to when his next paper is due. He was clearly very interested in engaging us as well as the topic, but he needs to harness his energy.
Great teacher. He is really passionate about the classes he teaches. Would love to take him for another class. Warning!!! Be ready to work for your grade.

Seriously, one of the best professors I have ever taken in my life.  Took one of his classes as a "filler" class, and was honestly surprised at how much he actually cares about what he teaches.  Has a terrific way of making the students interested in it too.  Bar none, one of the best professors I have ever had.

I'm working my butt off in this class, Some of the text he assigns is so out there I have to read it 3x over to understand what he says about it. Not easy at all. goes out of town when you need to go to office hours. Difficult.

He is very passionate about the subject, and knowledgeable too. Interesting books, but a lot to read (6 short novel length). Essays are expected to be top quality, not an easy essay grader. Willing to help at office hours, occasionally does class projects and presentations. Overall moderately difficult class. Don't take it w/o putting lots of effor

Goodman is the best professor ive ever had including my law profs at Columbia! He's amazing! He's super passionate about literature and VERY accomplished in his field. And he's also very knowledgeable on modern references to whatever he's covering. He's the only teacher who's class I wanted to go to, and he's the only teacher who I've ever wanted to take again. I recommend him to all English majors :D
Excellent professor, makes you think and accepts all opinions. He treats students with respect and is passionate about literature.
Sincere, excellent writer, I learned a lot from him

WARNING: DO NOT TAKE THIS GUYS CLASS. EVER. DROP NOW!Why? Professor Goodmann is not consistent, often grades based on his personal feelings and not on onjective criterion, and although he keeps class discussion on the topic, he is so arbitrary in his grading style as to make his class an excercise in chaos in that regard.
Good teacher but too many boring books to read

Dr. Goodmann is a very difficult teacher in the sense that you have to keep up on the reading and he expects you to remember details and apply theory to certain texts. If you aren't a strong writer (or at least put effort into papers) then his classes-especially the upper levels- aren't for you.  I love his style; he seamlessly integrates his years of knowledge into his classes in an interesting and fun way. He loves discussion and opinionated people so speak up! He is always available and helpful too!
Goodmann is the man.  Indiana Jones.  Hat and all.
He expects a lot, but he goes above and beyond to help students suceed.  That's the point of college.  I learned more in those classes than in most others.
No Comments

Very well read and speaks several languages. Also had him for ENG 211, where too many students were looking for an easy A and didn't try very hard, then complained when they did poorly. He's always available to meet outside of class, and is very helpful if you seek help; otherwise, you sink or swim on your own merits, and he won't cut you any slack.
I had him for literature on nature. And he was so boring. He is a good guy but he is very unstructured and seems to ramble on.
No Comments
This guy sucks, his class was a joke...if you are planning on being a journalist or some sort of writer, don't take his class - it's like high school English all over again.
He is Superman when it comes to medieval literature.  If you want to study literature such as Beowulf and LOTR, look no further than Professor Goodmann.
No Comments

A wonderful Professor - knowledgable, articulate, insightful... the list goes on and on.  This professor doesn't miss a beat, so if you are looking to slide by with an easy A or to not be challenged then his is probably not the class for you.

Mr. Goodman does not care about his students, does not prepare for class, and limits his mini-lectures only to what he perceives as important, failing to grasp the entire work with which he is supposed to be an expert.
Jokes about the**** scene in "Pulp Fiction." His favorite latin phase is "quid pro quo."

The class is interesting but not easy. Tests are short but there is a lot of content to study for each. Very lecture heavy and can be hard to stay engaged. Overall the class isnt confusing just a LOT of work.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: anyone complaining about the difficulty of his quizzes/tests have never taken stem exams

Super great for my first semester at UM. Met w/ me outside of class to discuss career after CAPS and my future on Zoom when I was stressed. People stress about his quizzes, but just study LOL. Use quizlet and put everything from ur notes/lecture in it and you'll get an A, it's that simple. Participate at least once on most days and ur good!

I liked the subject matter and Prof Warner was very knowledgeable. His quizzes were trickery. I always thought that I did well but managed to get a few wrong, which was the class average or slightly better. I did well on the paper and the final and still managed to get a poor grade. It's been my lowest at UM, so I'm disappointed.
So awful. Do not take him!!!!

Prof Warner is a genuinely amazing professor who has interesting lectures and easy to understand coursework. He is very helpful and makes his lectures interactive and fun. Theres a bit of reading but this class was super fun to take and I highly recommend if you're looking for an easy elective.

Work-wise, this class is painless. Dr. Warner assigns a few assignments and readings over the semester, but they all help you when writing the final paper. There are some guest lectures, but most of the class is spent discussing practicum experiences. He is super nice and willing to help you as much as you need. Final projects are pretty easy.

TAKE HIS CLASSES!! He is extremely nice and really cares for his students. The lectures have to do with relevant topics and he encourages the class to participate and state their opinion on various topics. His quizzes are kind of difficult. However, he is super available for any questions or concerns. Truly an amazing teacher.
Sweet guy, very understanding. His quizzes are abnormally very difficult, you def need to study for them, but otherwise its an easy class.
I love Professor Warner! I have taken him a couple of times and loved each of his classes. There are a lot of lectures, but he makes it interactive. He is very understanding and caring!

Prof Warner is a great professor. He gives very easy writing assignments (basically just writing a quick prompt). His lectures are sometimes boring but make a lot of sense. The group project was fairly easy as well. He loves when people participate so start speaking early. The only thing that was hard was his quizzes. Study hard for those.
He is hard I had to try too hard. I think he can be more understanding

Lecture heavy and make sure to take note since thats what his quizzes are based on. It seemed like the quizzes kept getting harder as the year went on so beware of that. He gives 3 writing assignments, all very simple and straightforward. Would take again.

Prof. Warner is a great professor. I took him for EPS420 and EPS361. I couldn't get a read on him at first but by the end of the semester I was glad I took him. Not too difficult as long as you pay attention and class and understand the concepts. Speak up in class!

Professor Warner wasn't very accessible outside of class & left that part more to the 2 TAs, but he was overall an excellent professor. His lectures were clear & interesting, & the readings perfectly connected to in-class topics. He explains concepts really well & in a relatable way. Very passionate & intelligent. Definitely take him if you can!!!!

I could not speak more highly of Dr. Warner. His classes are tough but if you do the readings and pay attention to lectures his tests are a breeze. He is SUPER passionate and knowledgable, you will learn so much. Go to office hours, he is an incredible person and gives great life and career advice. EPS/CAPS majors: TAKE ALL OF HIS CLASSES!!!!

Prof. Warner made himself available to speak to me outside of class regarding something unrelated to his class. He was very helpful and easy to talk to. He gave great advice and really helped me feel less discouraged about how the semester was going and my feelings towards changing my major. I recommend his Psych: children, families, & law class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Great guy, easy to talk to, and very helpful. Not so understanding in regard to absences, sick days, etc. You have to go to every class or have an excused absence. If you miss a quiz/exam, you HAVE to email him before and make it up ASAP. Deadlines are deadlines without any consideration for special circumstances. Otherwise, a great class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Warner is a great teacher that really cares about his students!
literally the least understanding, worst professor ever. Almost like he wants students to fail. don't take him
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS--Tests? Not many

reviews.comment: very easy grader bc she lets you lit work w ai, but her lecture are very ideological, so best bet is to go w her flow. Class is boring and not engaging- everything can be done last min outside class. attendance is mandatory but shes understanding. id take her again bc it was so easy- but if you want to learn and become a stronger writer dont.

Lets you use AI in self-grading and encourages AI use to improve writing. Lectures are very boring and revolve around activism, specifically veganism and environmentalism; they're not very engaging. Very easy A, but don't take this class if you actually want to come out with new writing skills.
super chill just talk about veganism and ur good

She is a very easy grader, but her classes are all about environmentalism, activism, and veganism. If you don't mind listening to these topics, her class is easy. Class is a little boring and not engaging. She lets you use AI to give you feedback on your writing. Overall a fine class if you follow her rubrics.

Easy assignments and lenient grading, but the class is very ideological and centered on activism and veganism. If you're vegan you might like it, but if you want freedom in your writing, avoid it. Attendance is required, but she's understanding. Class is boring with little discussion, try someone else if you can.

Easy assignments and lenient grading, but the class is very ideological and centered on activism and veganism. If you're vegan you might like it, but if you want freedom in your writing, avoid it. Attendance is required, but she's understanding. Class is boring with little discussion, honestly take someone else if you can.
I hope no one has to experience this

The class is very easy but it's such a joke and it's worth taking another teacher for. You won't learn anything in the class, all her lectures are the same, and the class will sit in silent when she asks a question because no one's engaged. It's an easy a but you can take this exact class with a much better professor.
Very boring lectures. Very easy.

Makes every class she has the same thing no matter the course description. Everything is about animal rights and/or climate change. Indoctrination at its finest. Does not allow for disagreements or even outside opinions.

Professor Torres is a very sweet lady. Her lectures were a little boring, and her class is centered around environmentalism and sustainability, so if that's not what you're looking for, don't take her. But besides that, she is a very lenient grader and all of the assignments were relatively easy. She also uses AI to help you improve your papers.

Really nice professor and offers a lot of time for deadlines, and extensions if you ask. Build a relationship with her and you will have no problem getting an A. Encourages a reasonable amount of AI use to edit and help with writing. Topics focus a lot on veganism and sustainability, just know how to adapt writing to fit the bias, very easy grader.

Torres is a great professor who cares about her students. Her lectures are engaging. She conducts fun writing workshops with AI and gives good feedback on drafts. Readings ranged from writing topics to sustainability, clean energy, plant-based living and environmental issues. I really loved the field trips. We got to write about the Arboretum.
Very kind and good teacher, very easy course and she is an easy grader. Just be ready to write a lot about veganism and environmental sustainability in every single chapter.

Prof Torres is generally really nice and a good teacher. Her class was easy, and she gives more then enough time to complete assignments. She gives solid feedback on essays and is not a harsh grader. The class is about the environment and veganism. The only thing I had a problem with was how opinionated and judgmental she is about veganism.

She's very chill and will give extensions and feedback for everything. Very easy A if you do all the assignments and listen to her feedback. She provided extra credit with almost every assignment. The only thing I didn't like was that the whole class was focused on sustainability the environment, and the principals of being vegan.

Torres is a good professor and grades easy. Usually leaves a lot of time to complete assignments and has extra credit options. She focuses her class a lot on the environment and sustainability. Understanding about absences and will occasionally bump up grades if you resubmit an assignment and let her know.
This was a really good class. Professor Herbert wants his students to succeed. Do the work and you'll be fine.
Pretty easy class. Study old exams and memorize notes. He's pretty boring and attendance isn't mandatory. I don't think he's very nice guy but whatever.
I studied from his lecture notes online and his practice tests. Since attendance wasn't mandatory, I only showed up on test days. Learned some interesting stuff by studying on my own.
Horrible class, horrible teacher. He is a mean person and does not want you to learn or get a good grade. I had a 4.0 before taking this class. Went to office hours for help and he called me stupid!
This class was just awful.
BEST CLASS EVER. Print out all his online notes and memorize them 2 days before the test. Also, study his online tests. I would recommend him to anyone. :D

Dr. Herbert...OKAY so Cell molec is NOT a super easy class BUT i loved the fact that Herbert was so clear and he does not try to trick you purposely on the tests. I appreciate this and recommend him to ANYONE. He does not try to screw you over, only wants you to learn. I wish all bio professors were like him.
