Dr. Herbert is my favorite biology professor. If you read his notes and study his old exams, you'll get an A in his class. The class is really interesting too.
Honestly, not a very hard class. Read the notes he gives online and do the practice test(s)- actual test has VERY similar questions- and this should be an easy 'A' for you.

I honestly left this class knowing nothing more than when I came.  He has a photographic memory, and expects everyone else to have one too.  If you memorize the diagrams and the old tests, you can do ok but you will learn absolutely nothing.  If you have a question, don't bother asking him because he has no interest in helping students learn.

There is no point in going to class; his explanations are not clear and he rambles on endlessly. The material on the tests is too specific, and he misses the big picture. I would not recommend him to anyone.
If u take notes , go to all the classes and review old tests  the class is passable with an A. He curves. Nice guy. Intresting class
Dr. Herbert belittles people, if you are not one to get an A on the first test....and then for the rest of the semester has assumes that you are stupid

He was hard to understand and not very good at explaining things.  I would not recommend him to take for a Biology class, because his exams are very hard, ans he will is not likely to help you understand the material.
Great teacher! Tries hard to makes the class fun and obviously enjoys the subject. Explains everything clearly. Tests are not too bad if you read the class notes carefully.

Herbert is a nice guy and all, but his tests are weird. He ignores the big picture and instead focuses on the smallest details that I can honestly say will never be used again. Class is boring, but its biology and I didn't expect much.

I wouldn't go so far as to say he is easy but if you show up to class and actually study the questions there is no reason you shouldn't get at least a B. I got an A without an insane amount of work(as did my 2 friends). Neg reviews are prob from people that didnt' study or put in any effort
He's ok. Jumps around a lot in lecture, but gives practice questions in the lectures which he uses to write the tests with.
No Comments
One of the most boring professors around.  Will give an easy test, then follow up with very difficult ones.  Very difficult final, finished with a B, and had an A all semester.

The tests cover stupid trivial facts while the main topics of the class are rarely covered on the tests.  Also, several trick questions are included on the tests.  If you study really well, you can do well on the tests, but the tests suck!
His tests ask trivia questions and the main concepts of biology are ignored.  His lectures are very boring and unclear.
Professor Herbert's lectures help elucidate the material and make it interesting.  The course is thorough, and the information you will learn is invaluable.

Unfortunately, Professor Lopez is very hard to work for. He does not know how to use the programs he assigns you to use. He could never answer any questions I had. You get 6 credits for doing work with him, however the process is MUCH more work than 2 classes would be.

This is a work on your own course. Professor Lopez is a nice person, but unfortunately he is too old fashioned. He has you working on programs that he himself does not know how to use. This causes a lot of problems when he makes requests that either are not possible, or if you have a question he can never answer it.
Easy and fun class.

Really knowledgable guy, it may feel like he  control your projects but at the end of the day he is right. Funny old cuban guy that you could easily see yourself having a beer with. Great professor one of my favorites.
He was my favorite teacher. I had him 1st semester my 1st year and he make me love my major.

Took his class during a mini session that was about Miami Architecture. Not an Architecture major but loved the class very easy fun and easy way to get a writing credit. Also have lived in Miami all my life and learned a lot of thing that I never new existed here in Miami.
THE BEST CLASS YOU WILL EVER TAKE AT UM

Professor Gottardi is GREAT! He is knowledgable and makes the course very interesting. He is a great architect and teacher. His crits are fair and helpful. I have taken several courses with him, even trips and I totally recommend them. He is smart, passionate about architecture and fun. You can really learn and become a better architect with him.
Went on a inter-session to Egypt. Earned 3 credits in 11 days. This teacher is very amusing. Had an absolutly amazing time.
The best of Design Techers. Works with you one on one.
She was so inspirational and was so enthusiastic about teaching which is what made her so great.
Best teacher I've had

An absolute gem of a teacher. She ended up leaving us due to a promotion about a month in, but she was easily my favourite professor while we had her. If she teaches again, I highly recommend anyone who can take her to do so. Such a caring person, very engaging lectures that I always looked forward to, and excellent feedback. Forever Dr. T!

Absolute stud was kinda sad at first because I didnt get Brian Breed after I had him for 105 but wow I Loved her class. Even though it was a 9 am, she always taught with great charisma and was truly an inspiring professor that leveled with her students and curated assignments to our tastes such as sci fi movie reviews etc

SHE'S THE BEST! Literally a hidden gem. Her projects were lengthy, and you have to write a lot of papers but honestly, I learned a lot from the class. She's an easy grader and is very understanding. She constantly moved deadlines for us when needed. Definitely take her.

One of the best english teachers ive ever had. I really improved in my STEM writing over the course of the semester. She's really such a kind person. Lectures were never a drag and I looked forward to them. Take her if you can!

Forever a Dr. T girlie. If you ever have the privilege of learning from this woman know you are blessed. Insanely knowledgeable and definitely made my stem writing better. No surprises, grades out of 100 points, and the assignments were so much fun and helpful. Laid back but in a good way. Please never skip over this woman and take her class!!!

Simply the best professor I've had at UM. She's a dean in College of Arts & Sciences so she only teaches one class and it's a hidden gem!!! I would 100% wait on the waitlist for her if you need to take WRS106. Super straightforward, grades you out of 100 points, no surprises. AWESOME person in general, super caring for students.

BEST TEACHER IVE EVER HAD. Truly cares about her students. Attendance counts but if you miss a few you will be fine. Exams are straight forward and the group project is fun. I wish she taught every class she truly is amazing.

Okay.. She is a great professor who genuinely wants you to thrive. I will say that she is unorganized, BUT she is aware of it and extremely lenient when you need help or extensions. She said "this class should be easy everyone should do well". Gives so many opportunities to succeed. The work is super easy and on your own time. Shes sweet & so chill

i LOVE her. If you like luxury brands and understanding how they market themselves you'll love this class. She knows what she's talking about. It's how chanel, dior, etc. create their brand image and luxury brands. SUPER interesting. people say she is all over the place but her lectures always have a meaning at the end and she pieces it together.

I'd probably be able to understand her better if she was teaching under water basket weaving. Do NOT take her if you can as the material taught in class and on the tests do NOT match up at all. You'll definitely be laughing in class cuz her class is a joke but she'll also make a joke of your GPA if you're not careful.
Learned nothing and went to every class.

Every powerpoint is 50% random photos that mean absolutely nothing. She's a nice lady and really kind but goes on tangents about her travels for easily over ten minutes every class. She definitely knows what she's teaching but is dismal at actually teaching it.

She's genuinely so nice! She just wants you to engage. The exams are not hard, the labs are quick and easy, and she grades the group project very nicely. The content is easy. I recommend not missing class, but she's not strict with attendance, especially if you reachout. Totally recommend, she's the best.

Callava will pull out some of the funniest one liners you'll ever hear. Her class is engaging and fun if you chose to participate. She cares about what she teaches, and is very well connected and knowledgeable. The tests can be hard.

Anyone giving her a good review took 301/201 with her. The reason they had a good experience is that the MKT department oversees those classes directly, so even though she might not be organized, the class still follows a specific structure. I got an A+ in 301 and took another class, and she's TERRIBLE. DO NOT TAKE it. I'm trying to save you.

I took this class a year ago, and I still get mad thinking about it. Stupid class, nothing you cover is useful at all, and the midterm was terrible. Had me wondering if I even knew English the way the questions were phrased. The textbook is a "how to start your own business" style book, and her book about silk was stupid. UNORGANIZED 100X

This course should not be this difficult. It's Intro to Marketing, yet the tests were overly complicated, confusing, and completely disconnected from what was actually taught. The material was scattered, many questions were poorly written, and almost nothing from the slides appeared on the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: love her, very easy to win super nice

Callava is very kind. It's true she may seem disorganized, but lectures are great and she knows what she's talking about. Only bad thing is that questions on her exams are worded weirdly; it is confusing and hard to understand most questions. The only grades were 2 exams and 1 project, so you have to do well on just three things to pass the class.
Recovered review. She is always seeming like she's drunk when she shows up to class.
TERRIBLE PROFESSOR
DO NOT TAKE THE MOST DISORGANIZED PROFESSOR EVER. TERRIBLE GRADING. DONT DO IT. Mkt 350 vs 301 is different structure
terrible. changes projects last min unorganized. test are not related to lectures. not clear criteria for anything. frustration
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: GOD AWFUL.
She's a good professor, all of the bad reviews come from generally soft people. Just show up to class, pay attention and do your work. Not that hard guys.

I don't know why she has so many bad reviews, she was a pretty good prof. Followed slideshows, asked for class participation, most of the class was lecturing. She used a lot of real world examples that made concepts easy to remember. She is a little hard to reason with but willing to help. For an intro class, I wouldn't complain.

After reading reviews of this class, I was initially skeptical about taking it. However, Professor Callava truly has such a passion and inspiration for luxury and how luxury has become what it is today. The end project was to create your own luxury brand, and it was very cool and fun to see your ideas come to life. Take her if you can!
THE WORST PROFESSOR  I HAVE EVER TAKEN IN MY LIFE. IF YOU WANT TO STRUGGLE IN COLLEGE GO AHEAD AND TAKE THE CLASS. JUST HORRIBLE
Sometimes guidelines for assignments can be confusing but overall pretty easy and the professor is always open to answering questions. She is hilarious too!! Love her

Her exams our worded weirdly and won't give curves (despite half the class not doing well). Lectures are very disorganized (a lot of talking and experience sharing, but not much presentation of content itslef) and require the student to do a lot of studying on their own.
I am fully convinced that she has ADHD, but this lady is awesome

A very scattered and all-over-the-place class for a concept that is pretty straightforward. We are graded just on two exams and a very unclear group project. The lectures are super unclear with sometimes whole lecture slides just being pictures. It is a very confusing class and I wouldn't recommend it just based on how confusing it is.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Callava's rating is interesting... she's a nice professor, but that's where it ends. It is a lecture heavy class. The one test I had was ehh and you have to do a lot of outside studying. I wouldn't recommend this professor but I also wouldn't say its the end of the world if you take her. If it's between Dr. C and a 1/5 professor, take Dr. C.

Professor Callava is so sweet. She is super knowledgeable in her field and sometimes goes off on tangents during class. She always uses her personal experience which is awesome but sometimes is hard to follow. Her tests are ridiculously hard but she curves them a lot. One group project which is also the final.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is very difficult. I wouldn't recommend unless you enjoy struggling in college.
Very hard prof. Her lectures are also very disorganized, which makes things even harder.

Professor Callava is very nice, but her lectures don't really mean anything. Attendance is mandatory if the majority of kids don't show up. The tests were unfair in my opinion since it's unclear what to expect on the test. I'd recommend buying the textbook and studying the slides but don't be surprised by more than one question on the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Her lectures were always jumbled and her powerpoints were always full of typos and confusing. Made marketing VERY confusing.

Quizzes were only on outside books we read, one midterm, group projects are easy if you're thorough and confident. Lots of videos and powerpoints in class. Some quizlets have the quiz answers. Not horrible just reading books and discussion boards, before midterm its a lot of work but after its not a lot. So-so its not that great but not the best

You can tell she's super passionate about the subject which makes the lectures interesting. Sometimes the lectures seem to go a little of topic so to do well on tests or understand the content fully you should read the textbook. I really like her and would take again, wish attendance wasn't mandatory because some classes are pretty unnecessary.

Dr. Trini is the absolute sweetest.  She uses a lot of real life examples and her lectures are very engaging.  The exams are rather difficult but if you study and prepare well you'll be fine.  Strongly recommend taking this professor!

Professor Callava is super nice and caring. However, her lectures are a mess. When tests came around, I never knew what to expect and was usually blindsided by more than one question. If you take time to read the textbook you'll be fine; just know that lectures aren't very helpful. She always curves tests. Easy enough clas; not very enjoyable.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is a mess and none of the lectures make any sense with the textbook. Talks about nonsense half the time. Makes you purchase 3 separate books and case studies that most are only used once, one of which is her own book she wrote. A nice person, but the class is poorly structured and messy.

She is a mess. Her rubrics dont make any sense, she gives little to no direction on what you need to do for projects or study for exams. Her way of structuring the questions for the quizzes is also a mess. She is rude and cuts people off all the time while they are talking. The subject of the class in interesting, suck up to her and youll be fine
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: Her class and assignment instructions are not clear at all. She makes you read the book she wrote for the midterm. Talks about things not related to luxury marketing. Take at your own risk.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I have taken three classes with prof. callava. She is one of the best professors I've ever had at UM. I'm always so impress and inspired by her passionate about marketing and truly learned a lot from the classes. She teaches with lots of real world experiences which I think are really helpful for business students. 10/10 recommend!

Callava is very nice and cares about her students. However, she is not good at explaining concepts and is prone to rambling and getting side-tracked. The exams were not really reflective of what we did in class, and what we did in class was basically useless for everything we got graded on. Make sure you ask tons of questions to clarify everything.

Her lecture is pretty boring, but also very easy. I didn't pay much attention on class, but her exam is very easy to pass. Also, she is very available outside class, if you have any questions you can just text her and meet her.

Callava is the kind of teacher who teaches more with life experiences, tangents and real life examples than with textbook definitions. She is really passionate about marketing and has taught me a lot about life and the industry. Her exams are difficult and unclear. I found that even if I studied a lot I would still get a lowB, though it was curved.

WORST prof ever in my 4yr at UM. it's a Luxury MARKETING and all she talks about is some useless philosophy and history. The whole course is very abstract and she is disorganized and awful at teaching. She also makes you buy her own book. DO NOT TAKE HER.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I love this lady so much I want her to adopt me she is so passionate about marketing and knows a lot about it enough to make her lectures very interesting. She has guest speakers come in and they're very informative and interesting. She made me love marketing enough to where I'm considering adding it as a major, easy grader too!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Her MKT 201 course is hard, but you will learn a lot. Her lectures aren't straight from the text books, so make sure you take notes. Her exams are tough and based on both lecture and text readings, so go to class and read the text book. She is always responsive via email and easy to approach at her office hours.

She just isn't quite there.  Not quite sure if she completely understands the material which really doesn't help in class.  Make sure you meet with her after tests because she does not grade tests carefully and will mark your whole answer wrong if she cant read a sentence of it.  Good luck finding her though, her office hrs. are 30 minutes a week.

So disorganized, unhelpful and rude. She has no idea what she is talking about, class is very boring. Her test are impossible even if you memorize the textbook. Her lectures are pointless and she is rude when you approach her. It's like she reads the book and talks like it's her words, but when asked to explain she has no idea. Curves heavily.
Very disorganized. You do not need the textbook. Her tests are harder than they need to be. Most students would not do well if it were not for the huge curve.
Terrible professor. Extremely disorganized. The tests are way harder the subjects we cover in class. DO NOT TAKE HER.

She is a bit disorganized so it's better to read the textbook; ATTEND her classes b/c she remembers who attends. She's very helpful and approachable. Make sure to speak up and you'll be fine in the class (her lectures are sometimes on exams)

Very disorganized. Read the book even if she never talks about it (it will help with the definition questions in the test). Take all the notes you can and make sure SHE grades your book project/paper.

I recommend her. She is very excited to teach and she motivates students to participate in class. Attendance is not mandatory, 3 exams, and 1 book assignment. If you go to class, take notes, and participate, she will help you and boost your grade.

She "tries" to help. Super vague. Tests are stupid difficult taking into consideration they have nearly nothing to do with what she lectures about. Don't take this professor! There are much better professors for MKT 201 out there.

Possibly the worst professor I've ever had. She's disorganized, incomprehensible, and lacks all knowledge on how to communicate to students. She tries hard but fails miserably on all levels. If she were to stop teaching it would be considered a public service.

So very disorganized. Passionate about Marketing, and a nice, accommodating person. But she is unclear about assignments and exams and even the material, her notes are all out of order. Hard to follow. Do not recommend.

The tests are pretty hard and not really related to what she talks about in class, besides the essay portions. Definitely read the book to understand better. She is really nice and tries to be helpful, but is a little confusing sometimes.

Not a good teacher at all... The tests are hardly ever what she says in class because what she says in class is common sense and general whereas the tests are not. If you MUST take here, I recommend reading the book as if it were your Bible...Went to ask her questions after school and such and it was of no avail.
Very passionate and excited to teach the class. I thought she did a good job teaching the basics and principles of marketing.

Don't know why she is getting so much hate. She is passionate about marketing and class is very easy if you read the textbook. Classes are boring, but Facebook isn't so who cares. I recommend this class so long as you keep up with your work.

worst teacher ive ever had. she has no idea what she is saying and is not even a nice person. unclear is an understatement. her tests are nearly impossible and have nothing to do with what she teaches and she gives no instruction for the projects. a word of advice: use the textbook and learn all of the definitions on your own. avoid her!!
weak sauce

She is a really nice person, but if she understands marketing at all, she certainly doesn't show it. Going to class actually made me more confused. The tests cover random things that you wont know. On the other hand, there's not excessive work required and she's willing to (try to) help you

Often very unclear when it comes to what to do for an assignment and what's going to be on a test. 3 exams that count for 65% of grade and 3 projects that count for rest. Attendance is not mandatory. Would recommend getting textbook to study from. Overall, not terrible to be stuck with, but definitely check your other options.
DO NOT TAKE HER! She gives tests that have nothing to do with what she teaches. And she has an accent that is hard to understand. Avoid at all costs

It seems that she's not a great math teacher, but when it comes to MKT she's great! Exams are easy if you pay attention, and she tells you exactly what to study from the ppt lectures. No cumulative final. Book isn't necessary. Also for projects if you forgot to include something she will let you hand it in late w/out taking off points.

Tests have absolutely nothing to do with what is taught, and then curves are not given when the majority fails.  She becomes defensive about this and is not helpful when you ask her questions during or outside of class.  Take any other teacher.

I think students would have a problem with this class if they haven't taken calculus before. That's a problem with those who set the criteria for MAS110, not a problem with the teacher. I took AP Calc before so I thought Ms. Callava's class was helpful and manageable. Keep up with homework and ask questions. Also, she curves fairly. Got an A+!

Teacher assumes that everyone has taken calculus (that is not the case for everyone) and jsut starts talking using calculus terms and doesn't explain any concept except what specific topic she is teaching. Homework is just random problems that she chooses and does not relate to the test. Not helpful at all! You mess up one test and you fail.
easy lower level business class, helpful teacher, hw is optional

consider dropping your real estate major / minor instead of taking this class. it will take a serious toll on your mental health. the amount of work becomes unmanageable as the professor tries to fit a full year of material and assignments into a single semester. he does not care about his students and it shows. i hope the school sees our reviews.

It is a shame that UM continues to allow Professor Troen to teach undergraduate students. This so called "real estate" class quickly turns into an unnecessary political rant from Troen looking to find any way possible to bash Donald Trump. Professors should let college age students form their own opinions instead of forcing ones upon them.
Would avoid his section at all costs!
Just like how some people shouldn't be allowed to own a gun, some people shouldn't be allowed to teach, especially at the college level.
I'd rather send my future kid to be taught by Quality Learing Center
this guy failed as a professional but bc he want to harvard he has a massive ego and enjoys watching students suffer. Avoid at all costs.

The class is very difficult and comprehensive. I think the class wouldn't be as bad if he didn't assign so much unnecessary HW. He also needs to lose the attitude and political bias, loses whatever interest students have left.

reviews.comment: worst class i have ever taken at miami

reviews.comment: very hard class with strict grading
assigns unrealistic amounts of pointless work and is rude to students. Does not teach well and shows political bias.
Guy's super funny but don't take this class if you're serious about journalism or writing. He will spend the entire class going on tangents. Do not take his class if you have the option.

I dropped this class last semester. If you're an anxious person who doesn't want to be a writer, do not take it. But if you're trying to be a journalist or writer, take it. I don't have the time to deal with someone who expects me to dedicate my soul to a class.

WARNING! DO NOT TAKE TREASTER!
The worst teacher I've ever had. He can't teach; he just yaps uselessly. His feedback is loud, public shaming, causing massive anxiety.He hasn't provided any grades all semester (I'm a freshman, nearly done!). His expectations are inflexible, and he lacks basic tech skills. Find another professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof.Treaster is the worst teacher I have ever had TRY to teach me. The only way he provides feedback is in front of the class, often loudly voicing his frustrations, making the class very uncomfortable. His expectations for assignments are insane. It is always my way or the high way. He also has no idea how to use technology. Do not take him.

Easiest class to get an A, barely any homework, teacher is awesome. Some people drop it cuz he has some contreversial takes, but if you take anything he says serious your weird. Take the class if you want a free A and brainrot lectures where he tells stories and picks on students. I mean that in a nice way.
Does not know how to teach. Think of nearly every quality a good professor should have and do the opposite.

everything in his class felt so unnecessary. he would just yap the whole class and not actually teach anything. I haven't finished the class yet but it feels like we do work that isn't even for a grade. he also gave me so much anxiety, felt like it was so easy to do something wrong in his class. however, he is nice when you talk to him privately.

Genuinely not a good teacher. Contradicts himself and picks on students over the smallest things that have nothing to do with the class. Makes weird remarks and goes on rants about nothing useful. It is a writing class and we have done no writing, and sit there every day listening to him yap.

Professor Trester's lectures were often unclear, with off-topic discussions and inappropriate jokes. He lacked patience in helping us improve, making it hard to meet his picky expectations. Many felt frustrated in class, and though he intended to help us improve, his work ethic and teaching style didn't align with that goal.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: always contradicts himself and yells at students for being confused by his contradictions. he makes inappropriate remarks and in general, disrespectful. He humiliates students, for example, criticizing the way they talk and asking if they have a speech impediment in front of the whole class. Plays favorites. Barely any work is only plus.

Extremely caring professor, really wants his students to learn! Had us write two short stories a week and then we'd review them in class. He's a very conversational guy, so he'll ask you why you wrote what you did and you guys will discuss it. Overall, learned a lot and would take him every year if I could. Also very easy A.

Treaster is one of the best professors I've had. He taught me so much about writing short concise news stories, using proper punctuation, and how to properly attribute quotes. The class helped prepare me for my JMM 208 class so well. Just pay attention in class and I promise you'll be fine. The workload isn't even bad you just must pay attention.

He is rude to his students and will publicly humiliate you in front of the whole class. He grades your papers infront of the whole class as well. He picks one student to like and the rest are treated like trash. If you don't understand something don't bother asking and save yourself the humiliation. I wish someone told me to not take this class.

This class could've been extremely valuable and applicable to the real world. Unfortunately he was extremely disorganized and I didn't learn as much as I would've liked. reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Take another prof. if you can. He was a tough grader, not online savvy,  + he jumped into the meat & potatoes of the course before fully explaining everything. If everyone is not doing well, the students aren't the issue. Doesn't respect our time, treated this like a grad school class. He cared too much. He's great at this but not a great teacher.

If you want to be a better writer, take JMM 108 with Professor Treaster. Your writing and work ethic will blossom in every class. I had a wonderful experience learning and applying the best principles of writing. Your participation and attentiveness during class will make or break you. He is always happy to help anyone outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: great if you participate and try in class/ssignments. Lots of assignments but they're really short. class is great for journalism or just improving your writing. always open to read your work and help w them but be prepared to get totally destroyed. Often contradicts his instructions. can come off as mean. means well and wants u to succeed.

have you ever experienced bleeding from your ears? well taking this class and listening to prof. treaster ramble about inappropriate, unrelated topics to the class will do exactly that. he is the worst grader and is so confusing, goes back and fourth on what he says. so contradictory. makes inappropriate comments to female students. DONT DO IT!!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Treaster is a dedicated Professor to say the least. If you're signed up for JMM 108 you better be ready to listen to every word he has to say. If you're not a good listener, then you probably won't do well in his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I took Writing for the Digital Age with Professor Treaster. I can confidently say, before the course I wasn't even half as good of a writer as I am today. It was a privilege to learn from one of the best in the industry. He offered a wealth of information in all facets of journalism. From the writing side to the business side. He's also a comedian.

An online class w no zoom meetings, sends lots of LONG emails w LONG instructions on blackboard. I understand that they r important notes & he is trying to help but it's overwhelming. Lets you submit assignment as many times as u want, & allows for one revision of each assignment to get a better grade. The assignments themselves r extremely short!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Amazing human being. Really lucky to have had him, not only as a professor but even as a friend sometimes. He has an amazing character that scares away judgmental and negative people. He wants you to get an A, and he will give you many chances to fix your grade. Really passionate with what he does! Truly inspired. Thank you!

Joseph B. Treaster. What a professor. Very lucky to have had him. He is very passionate for what he does. He is the real deal, he writes for the New York Times, and has been reporting since the Vietnam war, where he summited himself and risked his life to report from the enemy's side. He wants you to get an A, he'll give you many chances to improve

this man is literally insane but if you get on his good side he will love you and do everything in his power to make sure you do well. however he's a tough grader and nobody in my class really got over an 89 on assignments. the class is the same assignment over and over writing leads for a news story. new quizzes every week so read the news!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Hes definitely a tough grader but its only because he is very specific in what hes looking for. As long as you follow directions and listen to everything he says, youll be fine. Also, he does sometimes goes off topic but it really isnt anything to fret over. Hes just a very full of life type of person.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Joe Treaster is a tough professor but he'll show you what you need to write in the professional world. It may seem that he's trying to limit your creativity, but if you pay attention and follow directions your writing will blossom. Don't worry about your grade, focus on improving. If you take writing seriously, he is an invaluable resource.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Treaster writes for the NY Times- obvi knows his stuff. At first he can seem intimidating, and his directions become unclear at times and can change spontaneously, but he wants to see you succeed as long as you want to try. Easy to get good grades on assignments. He is adorable and I want to hug him. Reminds me of the Grandpa on UP. Great class
Disorganized
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He is a bit scary- will say whats on his mind ALL the time. Also you cannot miss class unless you have a valid excuse because he deducts points. The class is not hard at all- he's just a bit scary.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Come with an open mind to Professor Treasters class and with the willingness to accept constructive criticism. He has a lot of experience as a writer and knows what he is talking about. I am a better writer after taking his class and feel more confident about my work.

Be ready to write and read. I think that this class has taught me one of the most important tools in writing headlines and news stories that will come in handy in the future. Professor Treaster keeps you on your toes by always being engaging with the classmates. I enjoyed his class discussions and recommend others to take him for the experience.
I'm happy I transferred into his class. Most entertaining class that I have taken here at Miami. He is not boring and keeps the student engaged during class. Stay on your toes.

Professor Treaster is a professor who offers insight with his real world experience, Having wrote for the new york times for a number of years, I felt better off coming out of his class to continue my track in journalism.

He really wants his students to succeed. He will give you extra credit when you ask. He has a very specific way that he wants things done, but he tries to give examples to demonstrate. He is a little unorganized, but very smart and really cares that his students actually learn something.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE ANY CLASS WITH THIS TEACHER. I wish I had known how terrible of a teacher he was before I signed up for JMM 108. He makes multiple students cry and he doesnt care about anyone. He forgets everything and is so unorganized. please do not take any of his classes you will regret it he is the worst/ meanest teacher i've ever had.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Treaster is one of the smartest, talented and instersting person that I have ever met. If you really want to learn, he's the best choice. Tough grader, but you will definitely learn. It is impressive to hear his stories and he kept us very involved with current events. I personally enjoyed the experience.
i've never hated anything more than this class with him. worst professor i've ever had, extremely unclear and talks without ever making a point. Very rude to students and thinks he knows everything
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Professor Treaster started as a journalist for the NY Times so he knows what he's talking about!!  Students who want to be journalists should definitely take him! He's quite the character and wants his students to succeed.  He teaches things slowly and HW assignments are always the same so after the 1st couple you know exactly what to do.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Has social problems therefore unable to communicate properly, rude, does not listen, not clear with instructions, scatter-brained, unorganized, do not take this professor if you genuinely want to learn something
Very ADD, can be a little unclear but he's happy to help and just wants us all to learn.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Treaster is amazing! He give's great advice and is honest with you. If you're interested in journalism, you should definitely take this class with Professor Treaster, who will help you to improve your mass media writing.

Professor Treaster is a not a great teacher. He is rude and thinks he's always right and LOVES to pick at people in a bad way. He gives no helpful feedback and doesn't like to help.  The highest grade he'll give you is an 95%, and that's rare. He doesn't believe in 100%.
He makes the class in the beginning sound a lot more demanding and hard than it actually is, so don't stress. He is a very good professor but don't get intimidated.

Professor Treaster is the teacher ALL journalism students should take. He will either make you or break you (not in a bad way). In his class you learn whether you want to continue in this career. He is passionate and wants his students to perfect their writing skill. If don't you have tough skin, do not enroll in this class, and change your career.

Treaster is intense, but he has to be the best journalism professor at the University. In his first class he likes to scare students about working hard. Believe me when I say he is worth it. Every assignment was worth it  on how much I leaned in his class.

He is really discouraging at the beginning of the semester for you to take the class but don't be discouraged its not as hard as he says. The hardest part is dealing with him as a teacher (many assignments, he is spacey) but he is a good teacher. He is a very hard grader. He never gives As. He doesn't believe in a 100.
He's awesome

If you listen he tells you exactly what to do.  He loves to hear his own voice so it can be hard to get a word in sometimes.  But he is a very big deal as a person, worked for NYTimes, etc., though so it's probably good stuff to listen to.  also he gives example assignments from past years to further clarify what he wants.
Great class inspired me to become  a journalist minor.
Amazing teacher and hilarious. The class is easy if you can follow directions and have half a brain
Professor Treaster is awesome, but sometimes is a bit unclear. Ask a lot of questions, he likes that.

Professor, Treaster is great, he knows his material and has lots of experience in the field. He is very helpful, you can see him in his office any time for extra help. Assignments are not difficult, they are very basic, he allows you to improve your work for a better grade if you get a B or lower. I highly recommend to take him :) I got an A!

I learned more about reportingwriting in his class than I had in my previous five semesters in the SoC put together. You'll get to practice reporting during "press conferences" wguest speakers in class and in the field, all alongside this New York Times pro. If you're pursuing a career in journalism, it would be a mistake not to take his class.

He is one of my favourite professors in UM. He is always willing for help and gives a lot of useful suggestions. Also, he has a lot og real-world connections to help you do your project. I love this class :)

Treaster is a great professor. He is not particularly tough, if you attend class, ask him whatever doubts you have he WILL help you and you will get a good grade. He is very caring of his students and a very interesting man to chat with.

Professor Treaster is a very serious journalist who treats his classes like the real world. He demands simple, clear, and structured writing from his students. If you find topics such as grammar, AP style, and best journalism practices to be boring, do not take his class.  He is passionate about his art and wants enthusiastic students. Great guy

Nice guy, but he isn't always clear with assignments and his expectations. He's all over the place, its best to always ask several questions to clarify any confusion. He's VERY particular in grading. If its not done his way its wrong. It helps if you already have experience in journalistic writing.

Nice guy. Good professor? Not so much. He is very particular and a pretty tough grader. It is not clear what he is looking for when he grades assignments. Again, he's a really nice person but I wouldn't take him unless you have to.

Grades are pretty easy to get but be warned, editing previous work is hard because his handwriting resembles a lizard, covered in ink, rolling around the paper. His writing is basically illegible. He drones on and on, if you have another option at another professor, I suggest you take the other option. You require patience for him.
he is all over the place, he doesn't listens to any student and he corrects papers in a very strange and hard way

A bit hard to follow at times and can be demanding with assignments, but overall a very well respected professor. His class isn't really hard but you might be questioning how you are being graded. He isn't hardset on where the class will be going, which makes you feel comfortable. You won't get an A, but you will never fail either. Nice guy overall

If you're used to flubbing your way through journalism or can't take constructive criticism, don't take this class. If you have a really busy schedule and can't dedicate time to this class, don't take it. Otherwise, he's one of the best the COM school has to offer and very highly regarded/a great connection to the real world. He's worth it.

I would take Prof Santorine for every elective class if I could! His lectures are super interesting, and he is super passionate about what he is talking about. He just wants people to participate and respond in class. The study guides have everything that you will see on the midterm and final, super easy. Definitely recommend him!
He is an amazing professor. His lectures are interesting, his exams are fair, and he is super nice guy. Would absolutely take him again.
The Goat! Would retake his course in a heartbeat. Loved his class and he was a very kind professor.

Professor Santorine makes sociology interesting and easy to follow. The class is fun, not too hard, and he's a very chill and fair professor. My favorite class this semester. Would definitely take him again.
The class itself is fine but he will surprise you on some of the tests. The group project is time consuming so make sure you get a good group

Don't get the bad reviews one bit. Yeah, you gotta study for the exams, but I'm pretty sure every section you got to lol. If you study you'll be fine, and there is no homework other then a project that is kinda fun

Professor Tsiros is the kindest professor I've had at UM. His classes are mainly lectures with 3 exams and a group project. You have to study for the exams but they are not impossible. He really cares for all of his students and I would take any class with him again.

Not sure why he has bad reviews. Yes the material isn't exciting but pretty easy class! Just study/memorize the slides and you'll be good to go for the exam. Caring professor who enjoys talking to their students and always so welcoming. Can't complain much!

Wonderful professor! He actually so sweet and caring,its really nice to see someone care about their students and trying to get to know them. Group project relatively easy just time consuming but if you have a good group will be fine. Easy exams if you study! Brings guest speakers which are great to expose you to different fields. Highly recommend!

He was great this semester. Super straight forward - my friends and I all got A on exams - and you get to work on a group project all semester that he helps you with whenever you need. Super chill- not the most interesting though
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He is a super nice guy but his lectures are long, monotone, and boring. I struggled in all of my tests and even with my group project. I was just trying to pass the class at some point during the semester, luckily my group project helped me come through with a good grade. Also, prepare for a quiz every week.
In his class now. Takes attendance like a middle school teacher Is the MOST BORING class you will ever have. Everyone is working on stuff for other class. He could put anyone to sleep.
The most boring professor I've ever had in my life.  Class is literally painful.  Stay away.  Will not tell you what's on upcoming tests.  Makes the material so boring its impossible to learn.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This class is based on 3 tests and a group project that is worth the majority of your grade. Because the project is so in depth, plan to pick a good group. I was lucky to have an amazing group and did well on my assignments because of the group dynamic. Tests are very straightforward to the material explained in class.

I went to class most of the time and just picked up the key points. A lot of the class was just fluff that I didn't need to know for the quizzes or tests.   Mr. Tsiros is a good lecturer. He tells the information like it is. For me it was bland and I didn't listen to that much. He was fine if I was on my cell phone or computer doing something else.
Boring teacher. One of teh worst. Its obvious this guy doesnt want to be teaching a Grad course. Class felt like a waste of my time. I learnt absolutely nothing.

Totally boring, no structure and very confusing.  He's extremely redundant and thinks he's really clever. I was interested in learning about market research, but now I feel like I know just as little about it as I did before I took the class. I would NOT recommend him.

Boring subject that could be really hard, but he tries to make it interesting and keeps it really easy.  Pretty funny guy also.  Extremely easy, straightforward tests and quizzes.  If you have to take this class, I'd take it with him.
He is the absolute man. Very fair grader and makes the class fun and enjoyable. If you put in the effort and take notes you can easily come away from the class with an A.
Very nice guy. Class is pretty organized and no text reqired. He gives the outlines from which to study for exams.

Rude and expects everything and more from you. She always makes it seem like it's your fault and her opinion never changes no matter what you tell her. She is always giving back-handed compliments and is a headache to listen to.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She was one of the most confusing people I have ever met. She gives a million of projects and changes the deadlines and is unorganized and when she finally gives you a grade, she doesn't explain it and gives very little to no feedback. She is quite rude and an extremely tough grader. Definitely would NOT recommend.

I've never had such a love-hate relationship like this before. She is very nice to your face but the most demanding harsh grader i've ever encountered. She will give you an F on an entire assignment for 1 small mistake, it happened to me. I have never experienced such harshness before and I have taken many difficult classes. I Do NOT reccommend.

Wakhisi is very respectful and knowledgeable in this subject. However, she is a very harsh grader. She does assign a lot of short writing assignments and one big project. Unfortunately, you will not know your grade until grades are out at the very end of the semester. I found the class very interesting but it is not an easy A type of class.

Professor Wakhisi cares a lot about her students and is passionate about what she teaches. Her class has made me a better writer. However, this class is super unorganized. She is a harsh grader and wants something very specific from each assignment. I would not recommend taking her unless you are serious about Journalism.

takes forever to grade anything. doesn't use BB so you never know where you stand. doesn't tell you your grade till the very end. gives pretty much everyone a B or B- on every paper. Delayed reponses on zoom&email. you will work really hard on an assignment for her not to grade it. unfortunately, there is no one else who teaches the jmm208 course
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Hardest grader and worst class I've had to take. Don't do it unless you have to.

I have a love-hate relationship with this woman. She can be very unclear and I think is unaware of it. On top of that, she is an extreme grader and gives out TONS of work which you will work super hard on just for her to cancel it. That being said, she is the kindest woman on this planet. Talk to her if you have an issue. She really cares.

Really nice person, but it's just a lot of work. Her grading doesn't really make since and it takes her forever to give you feedback. If you have a heavy course load wait until you don't to take this or pick an easier professor.

AMAZING professor who cares about her students! She worked things out with me to make sure I got assignments turned in to her on time and understood I was taking four other courses! Her experience and her lectures are AMAZING! Can treat students a bit like Elementary School students at times, but that's no big deal! Wants you to ULTIMATELY succeed!
I love her. She is the best teacher I've encountered so far.

Professor Wakhisi will give a lot of homework that is graded in a tough manner but she is great! Honestly, one of the best teachers in the Communication School. Although her class may seem hard at times and overwhelming, she makes class interesting through her humor and kindness. Overall, great teacher if you have to take CNJ 108 take it with her.

Tsitsi is one of the nicest professors I've had, but also one of the pickiest. She's an extremely tough grader and if you make a spelling error or mess up a date you get an F for the assignment. She's adamant about attendance, although she barely teaches anything useful in class. She contradicts herself a lot. Expect a lot of homework and quizzes.

Tsitsi is the sweetest woman on the planet. She totally means well but is so picky about everything. There's homework pretty much every class but usually just short writing assignments. She tries to make class interesting with different speakers. Offers extra credit. The textbook is basically useless. She definitely makes you work for your grade.

Professor Wakhisi is the sweetest lady in the world, but also a very very tough grader. Her lectures were interesting but she gives a lot of short assignments that she grades extremely tough!! There are easier professors to take this class with
She is extremely nice, friendly and cares about her students, however when it comes time to grade she is THE MOST PICKY.

Sweetest professor ever! She is slightly unorganized but very helpful and genuinely wants every student to learn and do well. She's always there for anyone if they need help. I was so sad to say goodbye to her when the class was over. The class made me realize that journalism isn't for me, but it was still a really pleasant experience.

She is very sweet and caring but she's very unclear of what she wants. There's homework almost every class, usually due at midnight on the day of the next class. She grades hard, but lets you re-do everything. She also gives lots of extra credit opportunities.

She's very understanding and she'll work with you as communicate any problems you may be having. Her assignments are usually do at midnight on class days and you can always ask her question about them in class. She's pretty helpful. The only thing is she's a tough grader. Also, be prepared to write.

She was always very sweet and understanding with our class, and she's very easygoing. Attendance is a must to do well but not a part of the grade. The assignments can be challenging and at first the grading was a bit tough, but she's fair and I usually knew how I would do on the assignments

Yes, the class was hard. But so is life. Where else to get a trial? What's the point of spending $3,000 a class, just to get the grade without learning anything? I'll be honest, while I took the class I did grumble. It's not fun. But it's not supposed to be. I learned a lot. She will write you a recommendation and she's very respected in the area.

I never was sure I wanted to be a journalist until I took her class. I worked hard but her work mimics a real newsroom. She dyamic and a wonderful role model.  Talk about the importance of integrity in the newsroom! She  reflects the integrity that every newsroom should have.
Take this class with another teacher.  'nuff said.

Apparently, professors are allowed to review themselves. Anyway, I interned at the Sun-Sentinel, and I can tell you, this course in NO WAY mirrored my experience there. Neither, in my opinion, did it prepare me for work in the field. Irascible? Ha. Please. She was downright impetuous and inconsiderate.

People, if you can't handle daily deadline pressure and a slightly irascible editor, then you shouldn't BE in journalism. You get impressive clips for your portfolio, get your articles published in the Miami Herald and learn firsthand about a newsroom environment. This is one of the most valuable hands-on classes you can take. Challenge yourself!
This class will kick your butt.  It's like a job, and it's incredibly stressful!  Take someone else if you don't want the extra stress.

She's a hard ass. Expects a lot from her students, yet she's not particularly helpful. Picky grader. The only positive thing I can say about her is that she knows her stuff, a byproduct of her working for a large newspaper. I'd suggest taking a different teacher.

Although she is a tough grader, Dr. Sunny is an amazing professor. Her projects and tests are hard but if you put in the work and communicate with her, she recognizes that and your overall grade will reflect it. Her lectures don't rely on slides so take thorough notes, read the textbook, and look at previous Quizlets made. Guest lectures are great!

Not very clear about how she wants from you for the assignments. She talks down to the students which didn't create an environment that made us want to participate. Lots of readings and lots of writing so beware.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Great professor, no textbook or at least I didn't need one and only a few easy assignments. She gives a few short papers, two exams which are VERY hard and two projects! This class is a breeze but get ready to study for exams!

Tests come from lectures and book and are graded very rigidly. She is inflexible and unwilling to help. Also, her English is not the best so listening to her long lectures can be strenuous. She offers extra credit, and you're going to need it!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Really interesting teacher in class. Is your typical lecture style class but keeps you engaged through videos and examples. Tests are extremely hard. They're usually 50 multiple choice questions but they have nothing to do with the class lectures. The tests are strictly based on the test book so it's really important that you read it.

Horrible... Very vague about what's on the tests... Says that stuff from the guest lectures will be tested... but won't post the lectures online or allow you to record them If you ask a question to participate in class, and it is different from what she said, will be very condescending Unwilling to help outside of class Extremely hard grader
Dr. Tsai is very smart. You will learn a lot if you keep up with the work!

Professors Sunny is a great teacher to have for the subject. Attendance is virtually mandatory since she gives pop quizzes instead of attendance. But it is worth it for her helpful examples, and these quizzes are relatively easy.

Classes are taught via powerpoints that are posted online, so attendance isn't required. Tests are all multiple choice, pretty easy. Sunny does a pretty good job of stimulating interest, guest speakers from the industry drop by occasionally.

she is very nice and teaches great!! very interesting lectures with lots of examples of ads. the tests are mostly from her lectures, but sometimes she will put question from the book. she hasa study guide for tests but on the last test, there was a lot that wasnt on the study guide.

Sunny is a very nice professor and she knows what she's talking about. Nonetheless, her class requires A LOT of outside work as you will have three group assignments that will require you to research multiple hours at the library if you want to get an A. I recommend her, the class is challenging but she's the right person to take the class with.

Relies way too much on the book, class is useless but she makes you go by having three pop quizzes during the term.  tests are multiple choice and are more based on the book than lectures.  study the book!!!  avoid if possible, shes not great
Sunny is a great teacher. She does have an accent but you can still understand her. For a lecture class she still keeps it very intimate and interactive. I would recommend her!!

Dr. Sunny is a great professor. She's always there to help clarify things that seem unclear. Her tests are sometimes difficult because of her wording, but just make sure to read the text, and then use the slides to study.

I would definitely recommend this professor. She shows a bunch of commercial clips in class, doesn't require attendance, and exams are cake. Final is not cumulative and there were 3 quizzes and a lot of extra credit. She is very approachable and accommodating. The book is used and her exam questions are easy (although sometimes worded a bit awkward

AWFUL! I cannot stress how much you should NOT take this professor if at all avoidable. Her accent makes her lectures hard to understand, and they are very boring. Tests are VERY hard, especially for first year students. She gives powerpoints, and you must go into the book and EXTENSIVELY read about w/e she says in class. Grades big project easily.

Employs a methodical, no-nonsense approach in her lectures, following the material pretty much in the same fashion it's laid out in the textbook; eager to ask for student opinions and answer any questions. However, her accent and grammatically awkward exam questions are both difficult to understand.
creates all of notes and tests straight from the text book. she takes attendance so you have to go to class, but make sure to bring a laptop...i recommend a game like text twist to get you through it
people definitely overestimate her tests...they are not hard at all if u read...not even read just scan important stuff
Awful.

I liked her style except classroom management.  The class is so huge and full of frosh that if you don't sit in the front, forget about hearing anything she says.  She needs to be stricter about talking in class.  Other than that the class is pretty cut and dry.

The classes are interesting. She always give hard exams , i dont know why. 70 questions midterm? are you out of your mind? sometimes tricky , i hate those questions. She is good but too much to cover, every single chapter, every topic, too much to cover. It sucks.

I started off really excited about advertising, it was a major I just switched into. Safe to say, she's horrible. Her tests are hard for no reason, she's not clear, boring, and worst of all she made me reconsider advertising altogether- as in, I don't want anything to do with it. EVER.

Nothing she says in class is necessary to know for the tests. She does have you go to class, but it is a big class so just bring a magazine or your laptop. She does play some videos and short clips which are on the test, but other than that, everything is directly out of the book. Easy class. If you are looking to do close to nothing, this is good.

I don't understand how people could think this is a hard class. Tests are VERY easy- read the notes. Class is a little boring sometimes, but she throws in some interesting videos every once in a while. I would recommend her for an introductory class like this.

great teacher for 101- shows interesting videos and tests are very easy if you study the lecture notes and skim the text. offers huge extra credit project if you need it. she does have a heavy accent though, but it's not too hard to follow the lectures. short writing assignemnts are opinion based and not graded. i love sunny!
She reads from the ppt ,class is boring or it might be inetersting for pure beginners in advertising,do not recomend!She sounds easy in class but test are bad!

Her tests are difficult. She isn't specific about what she is putting on the test and she has these terrible group projects one worth 25% of your grade and the other project worth 15% of your grade. It is a lot of work for a 100 level class.

I can't understand her. Attendance is mandatory (!!!!?!??!?!?) and her tests suck because they are written how she speaks - incomprehensible. You don't know what she's asking. And she gives dumb writing assignments.

She is Chinese; therefore, she is hard to understand sometime. She does powerpoints everyday and basically just read verbatim off those (i.e. Not very interesting lectures). Her exams are very hard because there is so much material and she doesn't give a hint of what to study.

Professor T Lectures entirely from a projector. The in-class problems will most like show up on exams with slight variations. Take heed of his cues, which are very subtle. The final consist roughly of 75% last mater covered. Overall nice and funny guy don't be afraid to use office hours.

Mr. Tsai is very nice and funny. He Lecture 99%  using a projector. Mr. Tsai explain the material. All formulas used are derived in class. Test are very similar to the IN-CLASS problems. The Homework is through MATLAB. Final Exam is cumulative and most questions will come from the few last chapters. You must understand the concepts to pass.

I never write down a comment but today I want to. Mr.Tsai would be a good teacher if he could teach more things seem like math, instead of art. Ridiculous tests. Not very difficult to work out the question if you can understand what the meaning of the question.

Professor is the worst. He is totally uncooperative and his way of teaching is not useful. Really hard exams. All his classes have low average. Don't recommend unless you are Asian and you don't need the class to pass the test.

Really great guy. Super nice and willing to help any student. He teaches well, is knowledgable and is not hard to follow. Not a difficult class if you pay attention and study class notes. Curves really well.

He's a nice, happy guy, but he is not a very good teacher. He handwriting is basically chicken-scratch. During lecture, he will refer to things as "these guys" which further confuses me. His tests are hard, but he curved all of them (highest: 23 points; lowest: 9 points).It is an easy class, but you don't actually learn the concepts.

he only teaches 2 out of many math 113 classes, if you are placed in 113, do not take this professor. there's no textbook, no online recourse, and none of the material was anything i had seen before in my life. the focus is too great on art and very poorly explained. unless you go to his office hours and ask 100 questions, you'll do poorly

this class is pretty tough, was supposed to be one of the lower level math classes, i wish i had taken calc instead, at least you actually work with numbers in calc, his writing is illegible, has no accent tho so dont worry about that, the material is confusing and there is no book because he isnt finished "writing" it,too hard, get another teacher

My first PreCalc teacher was great and clear and loved teaching. He is nothing like that. He teaches in a confusing manner, you can't read his writing, he doesn't answer the questions directly, and his office hours aren't very helpful. The pace of the class is good, but he also teaches new material for 20 min before the test just to confuse you.

If you're worried about an accent, Prof Tsai does not have one. He explains the material clearly and really tries to help you understand. The material can be very difficult to grasp but he knows his stuff.
the material gets really complicated but he's an easy enough teacher. he tries to help you with specific questions and he has office hours that you can go to.

He clearly knows his material (maybe too well to convey it to the class).  Homework assignments mainly involve coding (matlab), take a huge amount of time, and are given almost every week.  He was funny and very flexible with assignments.  He took suggestions for homework and was understanding of late submissions.  Overall: good, but time consuming

One of the best professors ever. Very cool guy, very good teacher.  Makes sure that everyone in the class learns the material by making everyone participate in the class.  You won't fall asleep in his class unless you just ate a Benadryl or something - but don't- he'll call you out in a second-

Great professor. He wants students to learn but he is impulsive, would give pop quizes, very patience with students that don't understand. Will give one medium to hard project to do. Participate in class!!!
Gives horrible feedback, and is extremely unhelpful to talk to. I went to class, but it was completely pointless and won't affect your grade. Means well but is awkward and hard to follow.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Essay prompts are a little confusing, but turn in a paper and you'll be fine
Really easy class. If you want a solid grade take him.
Best English teacher I've ever had. 100% would recommend / take again.

I would recommend this class only to people who are not serious about English. Some of the course material is questionable but he encourages students to take charge. Professor Turner is definitely a little quirky but you get used to him. He is one of the nicest people you will ever meet. Very forgiving, and very student-friendly. Never cold calls.

Giovanni Turner is a wonderful teacher. His class can be boring if no one participates but he will never force a student to participate. You get out of the class what you put in. He is an all around cool guy and very helpful. I would recommend taking a class with him.
I really like professor Giovanni Turner, he is very nice and he gave us extra credit that is helpful for us to improve grades.

If you're looking for an easy A & not interested in improving your writing at all this is a good class to take. You rarely have to show up to class to do well. However, Turner is extremely awkward, never answers emails and must be reminded 100 times to do something. Also gives zero feedback on writing. Overall not impressed and would not take again

The class material isnt all that interesing but Professor Turner does his best. His stories make the class funny. The class doesnt have a lot of assignment but the ones that are assigned are worth A LOT of pts. There are NO TESTS , so no final exam! He offers ALOT of easy extra credit that you can do throughout the semester. Hes flexible & cool

Cannot brag enough about him. A couple easy quizzes that are opinion questions and only assigns the essays that the department requires. Easy grader. Play games in class and always get let out early. He's quiet but sometimes tells random funny stories. He's awesome. Participate in his class, it's not required but it means alot to him if you do

Potentially the world's most boring class. I found this was an excellent time to catch up on ESPN and Cracked. However, the class is way easy and he is a super cool professor. He is very flexible on deadlines (all you need to do is ask) and grades very easily. I usually would do the assignment in class the day it was due and get an A.

I love Turner. He is super helpful and very approachable. I would recommend his class to everyone. There's 4 section exams (a.k.a really easy quizzes) and 3 papers that make the majority of your grade. He also gives A LOT of extra credit. It's an easy A. You don't have to show up to every class, but you should because he always lets you out early.
Great grader. for the presentation i showed a 6 minute video, he called me a foo', than gave my ass a B-. easiest b- ever
He is the best English teacher I've ever met! If you can choose his class, you'll be the lucky one! Only three big essays and have many time to finish it. He is sooooo nice and easygoing.

really easy-going guy and usually easy to understand. gives plenty of time to complete assignments and grades pretty fairly. takes attendance but understands if you miss class, i personally enjoyed going and class was almost always let out early
Makes class fun. Sometimes I don't know what the heck he's talking about, though, doesn't break things down.

Turner is an amazing professor. If you enjoy analyzing music (i.e. it's lyrical content) then you'll really enjoy this class. He's easy to reach and more than willing to help. A LOT of extra credit opportunities.  Attendance is helpful since the notes should be used when writing your essays. Easy grader if your a good writer.

I liked Giovanni's class. As a music lover, I appreciated the things I learned, never thought about certain aspects about music. The only thing is that he's really unpredictable when it comes to grading essays. Very vague with feedback but gives a lot of extra credit. Essays are all on music and articles read in class.

one of the best teachers i've had! took him for English 106 (Determining the Artistic Value of New Music) and the class was so interesting and so much fun. he really knows his stuff and made me realize a lot about music i'd deff recommend taking his class.
Second time I've taken her. Yes she is boring but she actually is very nice and if you read and do your work, an A shouldn't be a problem.
She is a very nice lady, but class is VERY boring. She tends to not finish her thoughts so its very hard to follow along with discussion. 2 papers, a midterm and a final. She is a very easy grader.

She plays favorites so if your lucky enough to be liked then you will get an A without reading or putting any effort. If your unlucky, then GOOD LUCK! She always has a disheartened demeanor and sometimes I wonder if she's all there mentally. Anyway, point of the story is that you should not take her!

She is completely USELESS! I am an english minor and doing well in english except for this class. She has absolutely no guidelines to grading papers. She just randomly picks out grades out of a hat. DONT TAKE HERRR!!!!!!!!!

She's old and somewhat boring. She goes on very interesting tangents sometimes, though. One midterm and a final, which are open response, of course. The reading material is interesting, but I didnt read until exams. There were supposed to be in-class assignments, but we only had one. Easy A if you read.
Not good
Excellent professor! She is very interesting and incredibly smart. A+

Dr. Tucker is so great. I've been lucky enough to take another one of her classes, and she chooses the best books to read. They are relevant, interesting, poignant and really leave you wanting more. The papers are straightforward and so are the tests. She's always available to help students, and has a GREAT disposition. She's good people.
She's an amazing teacher with a heart of Gold. She's very understanding once you get passed the surface of her looking disinterested,
Good Teacher
I got by with an A without doing any reading, because sometimes class was off topic.

Knows what she's talking about in class discussions.  Isn't a "people person" by most definitions of the phrase.  She'll answer your questions in class or over email.  I never went to her office, so I can't comment there.
We had only 22 kids in the class and by the end of the semester she still didn't know my name.  Really mean and unhelpful when I went to office hours to talk about my essay.

He cares a lot about his students and replies to emails within 2-3 hours, even on weekends. He is very understanding of certain situations. You just have to show up to class and do homework on time like any other structured course.

Guys he's literally so boring that it has become funny to me. I never know what he's saying he talks like a dictionary but he posts exam questions before the exam so thats really nice and you'll know what is being asked always. Super boring, lots of papers and participation. Love him tho, have taken him 3 times and will continue to take more.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Twichell is a brilliant professor in both INS and POL topics and in methods.  Very helpful and inspiring, especially with the research project. BTW, I could not have produced my grant application without knowing what I learned in this course.
very willing to help students, but essentially the class is a bore and the lectures unorganized. try and avoid this class, there are plenty more interesting ins classes to choose from.
Nice guy and is very passionate about his subject, but the class is extremely boring. He is very willing to help students and with a little effort this is a very doable class.

He's enthusiastic about the course material, which could otherwise be boring.  He mixes it up with discussions about world events, and unlike other profs, he doesn't try to push his own political views, which is a nice change.  No exams, but take the full-semester research paper seriously, if you want an A.
He makes a boring topic as interesting as possible.  Very helpful guy, and replies to emails quickly.  The Powerpoints are great, too. Plus, hot!
Extremely easy class. Lenient grading, little textbook use, and mindless lectures. I didn't pay attention 75% of the time and still wound up with an A.
It's true, I took him and learned alot.  He sometimes uses complex language, but he's a good guy, and knows his stuff.
He is super easy! But you eventually learn a lot when you restudy all of the material for the tests. The only bummer is that attendance is mandatory. Def boring too

Not only does he know his stuff, Twichell's got what it takes to teach it to his students.  Those who say he's easy are ignorant and just don't appreciate a good professor when they find one.  Besides that, Twichell's a great guy and interesting to listen to in class.  Don't believe the prima donnas, if you love political science, take him!

He is REALLY easy, so if you want an A, take him, just be prepared to be bored out of your mind in class. There is a ton of reading, but it is unneccesary except on the week of your paper. Just read ppl's essays instead to study. On a personal note, he's scattered when teaching. Also very insecure and can be downright rude occassionally.
I had him as a TA for INS 101 but he's helpful. He is pretty tough when giving assignments but lenient when grading. Good to talk to about the subject outside of class.

Easy class. He gives you a ton of reading but his lectures are everything he wants you to know from the readings. Study the powerpoints intensely (with readings as a review if necessary) and you'll be fine. Essay tests with a matching section (10 usually and they come from prior quizzes), A 6 page paper that requires you to read that weeks readings

There is an unbelievable amount of reading in this class. 200-300 pgs every week.  It's boring, dry, reading.  He may only be interested in one paragraph from 50 pages of text, but there is no way of knowing that while you are trying to plow through all the (boring) information. Power points are helpful. Attendance it necessary.

Very knowledgeable and a legitimately nice and interesting person. The class is pretty dreadful but it would be that way with any other teacher. There's a lot of reading but you'll have plenty of time to prepare for exams and papers. If you absolutely have to take this class, take Twichell.
Great guy!! A LOT of reading. His exams were essay responses, but he tells you the topic a week prior. No worries, take him.

There's a lot of reading involved. ALOT. If you go to class and make some attempt at participation, he'll love you. Volunteer to do the first topic paper- you'll be his favorite person. He pretty much gives you an A unless you're absolutely retarded. The lectures are pretty boring. Lots of good facebook time.

Yes, it's a lot of reading, but he compensates for that with really fair grading on tests/essays. The tests are all essay based, with one topic paper.  As long as you show evidence that you payed a little bit of attention and know a little of the subject you should end up with an A.
