Be prepared to do lots of readings! About 200 pages a week. Doesn't really expain with much clarity. Lots of work.

I took her social and political philosophy class in Bilkent. She is a very cool teacher that you can ask about anything, chat or have a deep talk in any issue that comes to your mind. She is very smart and always ready to come with allegories to paint a clear picture for you. She encountered some anti-semitic students yet she was always prof. Best

I am having a great experience with Tzinman. She's funny in class but also gets the material across very well. We discuss assigned readings but even if you don't read it you'll do fine, although it definitely helps. She makes confusing theories easier to understand and clarifies the reading. Great class.

Not a good instructor. All we did was talk about assigned readings. Every lecture was just talking about a reading and nothing really pulled anything together. Tests were very difficult. Lots of true/false that are trick questions. Worst class I've taken at UM. Choose a different professor for PHI101!!!!

Horrible teacher. Do not take this class. It is extremely boring and the tests are very hard. She doesn't put the notes up and doesn't let you take laptops. Gives pop quizzes on reading assignments. Does not teach the material well at all. Worst teacher I have had at UM.

The class is extremely boring. Teaches the material poorly and makes the tests extremely difficult. Does not put the notes up on blackboard and refused to let us take in laptops. She made an exception for the last four weeks of class and told us we had to send her an email of the notes we took for that day. She gives pop quizzes and on readings.

She is a very nice teacher in my opinion. Her class is pretty straight forward come to class and take notes. She sometimes has pop quizzes but she will send an email (usually) hinting that there will be one. Her notes are all you'll need to do well on the tests if just copy word for word the notes and study them you"ll end up with an A for sure!

Dr. Martin is an extremely great person who brings energy to every class. He cares a lot about his students. The class is very difficult though, as he assigns a lot of assignments. He uses Kritik, so students grade each other, and you'll spend a lot of time out of class doing homework. If you want an A, get ready to work hard.

Tywan Martin was rude, dismissive, and unfair. Despite doing well on exams and all the work for group presentations (while my partners struggled), I got a surprisingly low grade. Left the program. Thrived in my master's in Sports Business at a superior program. I insist you take Resnick instead.

Dr.Martin is my favorite professor at UM. I had him for both KIN 403 and KIN 410 this semester and I would 100% take him again. He grades a little tough but not too harsh. Go to class and complete assignments on time / thoroughly and you will be good. He really does care about everyone and wants them to succeed.

Dr. Martin is one of the best professors I've had at UM. He is such a caring and wholesome guy who starts every class with a conversation on current events. He also goes out of his way to fist bump everyone every day. Though he does grade tough, he provides very in-depth feedback. He genuinely wants to see each student succeed in class and in life.

Professor Martin is amazing. He always keeps his students engaged in the lectures, while also connecting it to the modern sports world. He is a very funny professor and I would highly recommend taking him for any classes offered.

I don't get any of these bad reviews. Dr Martin always brings so much energy to class and makes every lecture fun and engaging. His homework and tests aren't nearly as bad as people here are making it. 

Yes, you need to actually put in effort and it's not a cakewalk. But he doesn't do it to be difficult. If you like sports, you'll love his class.

Prof Martin seems like an awesome guy at the beginning of the semester and in the classroom but as a grader he is horrible. He gives hard tests. He does not even cover most of the material in class as he goes on tangents and is hard to follow. He grades assignments really hard. If they are not done his way then they are wrong. Stay away if possible

Prof Martin is a great guy and a great professor. He really seems to care about his class and his students. He is my first professor to fist bump every student before a class. As for the class, 2 open-note tests, 2 easy projects, and a few in-class assignments. Overall an easy class and a good class.

He's not real good about posting things or using Blackboard, so go to class. You'll want to anyway because it is so fun. He started every class playing rap music, and he was very real and upfront, and realistic about things. Honestly, I enjoyed going to class. If you take him once a week, he will never use the full time.

I do not understand how professor Martin has a single negative review. He provided a class full of energy from start to finish and was so easy to talk to about grades or any issues you are having. If you like sports, you will love this class. Talk about sports for first 30 minutes of every class at least. Easy order if you do the assignments.

Really easy going teacher and wants everyone to succeed. He gives little homework, but I would make sure to get a good grade on the tests because of the lack of points. He loves to talk about ongoing sport news and makes the class exciting.

Amazing professor. Definitely top 2 of the SPAD major professors. If you show him you care about your education and your future, you WILL do well. This includes doing work, showing up to class, participating, and asking questions if you don't understand. He's very chill as long as you're not disrespectful or discriminatory to him or other students.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Martin is a good person and nice teacher!! He adjusted to covid well! He did have to adapt his course, which made it more student-friendly. Pre-Covid Rating: 4.5/5 Covid Rating: 5/5
Dr. Martin definitely keeps the lectures interesting, but you've got to read the textbook and take great class notes to do well on the exams. Personable. Funny.

Tywan Martin is not only a horrible professor but is a loser with no class at all. He treats students poorly and unfairly and is not even respected by his colleagues let alone those he teaches. Martin is a shame to the University of Miami.

GO TO CLASS. The tests are almost impossible to get if you don't go to class and read the book. All the assignments are easy, but the tests are hard. As long as you get an A on everything an attend to every single class, you'll only need a C on the midterm and final to still pass with an A. He is a great professor, take him!!

Best teacher. Easy grader. All assignments everyone in class that followed instructions got an A+. Only thing is exams are a little challenging. Make sure you thoroughly read the textbook chapters before you take the exams. Extra credit was easy too.
Really cares about his work and the students he is teaching. Doesn't blow you away with intelligent lectures or any fancy stuff, just really gets how the sport industry works.

The tests are soo challenging, even is online you can't find a lot of information from the ppt and your note etc. And he used lots of cases that discussed in the class for the exam question. Hey bro, honestly I can remember it all
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Class is pretty interesting and he's a mildly entertaining dude. However, tests are unreasonably hard. There are a few projects and SBJ Homeworks weekly. It's a class that really shouldn't be as difficult as he makes it.
Awful teacher. Felt like I could have taught the class better than him. Not even a nice guy. Not a fair teacher.

Like others here said, he's a pretty chill, entertaining guy who you will like at first, but the tests he gives are awful, he goes out of his way to try to fool you. It's all randomly selected from the textbook or from some throwaway comment in class, so there's basically no benefit to studying, you just have to hope you get lucky with guesses.

He seems nice at the start of the class and the lectures are interactive & enjoyable but his tests are very challenging and are not based on what he discusses in class. Make sure you read the book. He also called out students who showed up late so make sure you're always on time. You have to take him in SPAD for KIN 403 so no point in complaining.

He was also one of my least favorite teachers at UM. The first day you will think he is awesome, but as the semester goes on your opinion will quickly change. The tests are near impossible. Dreaded going to this class.

Very easy class, but it is pretty interesting. The powerpoints are boring but you basically talk about/debate sports the whole time. Tests are harder than class would suggest and you have to volunteer at a sporting event and do one presentation too. Definitely recommend Dr. Martin though, great, funny guy!

BEST TEACHER I HAVE EVER TAKEN AT UM. He is incredibly nice and extremely funny. Professor Martin is always approachable and is one of the few teachers that actually cares about his students. His test are actually pretty difficult but I TOTALLY RECOMMEND TAKING ANY OF HIS CLASSES!
Best teacher I've had at UM so far

He's the funnest professor at UM. He spends about 80% of class talking about what happened in sports the day before. Gives one project and 2 exams. The exams are harder than you would think since the class is such a joke. Def take him
He is a joyous person, who demonstrates charisma and passion in the classroom. He is not concerned with Environmental development, which is a flaw. skin flute.

Professor Uluorta is simply a joy. He's really passionate about the subject matter. His entertaining teaching style and the fascinating info presented make for an all-around great experience. It isn't going to be a breeze but if you attend regularly, take notes and do the reading, you'll do fine. Overall, I definitely recommend this class!

Really funny (kinda crazy) teacher. It is not at all necessary to attend class as long as you read the book and attend the TA meetings. Tests are not that difficult- I got an A + in the class after having attended like 5 classes all semester

Professor Uluorta is an absolute joy. He's a very intelligent guy and makes the class interesting. Of course there is quite a bit of reading and work involved, but if you keep at it and attend class, you'll be fine. The material is very interesting so you'll have a blast as long as you're at least somewhat interested in this subject.
Very interesting lectures but only tests on the readings. Difficult exams.
funny guy, decent teacher--the class itself is what was so awfuk

Alternative Futures class. Made our own syllabus: group presentations on a topic of our choice (an alt future) plus a 3-5 paper on our topic. Personally, Uluorta is an eccentric and lovable human who loves to challenge paradigms and share personal anecdotes. He makes you think, particularly in terms of capitalism and psychoanalysis. Would recommend
interesting class and amazing professor

How hard this class is depends on your work ethic and reading skills. I was scared by the ratings on this site, but I attended every class, went to office hours and kept with the syllabus - ended up with an A+. If you're into international issues, this class will be a joy to attend; Dr. Uluorta is a gifted lecturer and wants his students to learn.

he's an awesome lecturer, really hilarious- very passionate, however as has been previously mentioned he doesnt do the grading. he however loves lecturing and loves being engaged and he really makes lectures more exciting :)

One of the most interesting classes one can take at UM. But you must be interested in politics, history, or international relations if you want to take this course, otherwise you will get lost very quickly and will find it hard and boring. He explains almost perfectly and the discussion sessions help clarify the textbook.

He is a hard grader, harder than the TA's. often things are arbitrarily graded if you try to argue your grade he will most likely shoot you down. Either he likes you or not. Thats the way it goes. he should not be teaching 200 level classes since he is used to teaching 500 level. Get really friendly with the TA's that's the only way you will pass.

HE IS A GREAT PROFESSOR, BUT HE DOESN'T DO THE GRADING, EVERYTHING IS DONE BY THE TAS SO THEY WILL BE THE ONES GIVING YOUR GRADE, THE EXAMS ARE NOT EASY, ESSAY ANSWER , YOU WILL HAVE TO READ A LOT AND UNDERSTAND THE READINGS TO BE ABLE TO WRITE YOUR ANSWER PROPERLY ON THE EXAMS. THERE ARE ONLY TWO EXAMS ...

Not the easiest class at UM. The two exams cover a TON of material and there is a lot of reading not just from the textbooks, but also outside articles. The TA's grade really hard. If you are really passionate about INS and have no life outside of school, you'll be fine.
He is extremely unorganized.  Two tests, that cover a lot of material and an essay based on a movie. A lot of READING! As long as you read and attend your TA sessions, you will do ok.
TAs are very hard graders and even if you are passionate about the class, this wont be enough. He makes jokes which he only thinks are funny and goes all over the place with anecdotes

As a graduate student I was very fortune to attend two of his 500 level courses ? they are EXCELLENT ? providing impressive intellectual gain and a solid preparation for comprehensive exams. He also offered well informed academic advice that proved immensely useful ? completely trustworthy.

He's reallly smart and the class is interesting (while at times depressing). But be ready to work A LOT. This requires a ton of reading and his TA's are really hard on grading the papers so it's difficult to end up with an A. I still really enjoyed the class though.

Be cautious of what you tell him because he plays dept. politics desperate for tenure track and will hurt grad students in the process. He fails them at comprehensive exams on esoteric topics that never re-emerge on those students' second tries. Doing so shows his superiors that he can make tough decisions and therefore is worth hiring.

I worked my butt off - never missed a class, always did the reading, studying incessantly for the exams - and got a B+ overall. The paper topic is unclear and the TA's won't help with the edits. I'd avoid.

I really enjoyed this class. I thought he was extremely interesting and tries to have fun with the class. Attendance is not mandatory, but you really can't miss a class. All of the exams are from the lectrues and the readings are used to supplement, or to get more points on the test. He's extremely intelligent, helpful and interesting.

Uluorta is a genius. He knows his stuff. You are not required to attend lectures, but if you dont, you will fail. His lectures cover most of the test, but the readings cover some also. Clarity and detail are absolutely required on essays to gain full credit, although it was his TA's that graded and not him. Funny guy, but be prepared to do work.

I really don't see what's so great about this prof.  I couldn't wait for this course to be over with.  There are way too many reading assignments which I didn't even bother to read simply because it's way too much.   95% of the reading material weren't on the exams.  It is possible to get an A w/o reading the textbook.

The professor is extremely knowledgable and knows how to explain the subject to his students. He is funny at times and the readings he chooses for us to read are great. You must read the books in order to do good and the exams but you will learn alot. I highly recommend the professor.

Probably the best teacher I've encountered in the INS department.  He assigns a lot of reading, which I would still recommend doing, but if you go to class, his lectures are very clear and easy to follow and cover most of the reading.

Prof. Uluorta is probably the best professor I will ever have at UM. It's really sad that he's leaving, so get him next semester! He knows what he's talking about and tries to present context before delving into how it all connects. As for that person saying he belittles his students, he only does that to students who do obviously don't study!
This class was aweful. He rambles about nothing and is a hard grader. I learned NOTHING! He is also very full of himself and likes to belittle students. Avoid this prof.!!!

Uluorta is a really good teacher. He follows the syllabus perfectly, and tests are short and easy. He'll also make little jokes here and there, so even though lecture can get boring, if you pick up on his asides it's funny. Just one major paper, and daily 2-pg reflection journals (not graded on content!) TA does all the grading.

He is really a tough grader but I got an A. I learned so much. If you have a chance take a class from him - he makes it interesting, explains everything and is really passionate. He's one of the best profs I have had at UM. He's visiting prof so probably goes back to Canada? Take his class before he goes - you'll learn way more than other courses!

She is not clear at all about what she wants from her students. She seems like a very kind person, but she is an unreasonable grader at times. She really focuses on deep analyzation of characters and stories as a whole. DO NOT TAKE her "fiction" class it is mostly non-fiction you will be reading.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I know I'm a good writer but for some reason I could not get an A in this class. It is very hard to understand what she wants from you as a student as many times I overperformed just to end up with a mediocre grade in her class. Requires a lot of work to end up with an A in this class, buyer beware.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Chioma is so sweet!  Very caring teacher.  She's very willing to work with you and explain what she's looking for in your writing.  She can be a tough grader, but she's very reasonable.  It might take some time but this class is very do-able.  Most of the kids in my class were engineers and pre-meds.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Assigns online homework 2 times a week (usually takes about 15 mintues). She is a pretty tough grader regarding the three essays that are due throughout the semester. However, other factors influence the grade of the paper (rough drafts, homework, outlines). She is overall a pretty good teacher, if you show up and actually try you'll get a B+/A-
She definitely means well. Be prepared to teach yourself.

I can't believe I had to pay thousands just to listen to this woman just read off slides… she's chill as a person, but as a professor she needs better teaching skills. She's fair but you definitely have to teach yourself. All she does is read off her slides. I don't think I ever saw her pick up a marker and manually demonstrate anything.

Professor Melissa Valls is an exceptional educator who made learning accounting both engaging and understandable. Her teaching style is clear, well-structured, and supportive, even when covering complex financial topics.

Melissa Valls is awesome! She's very passionate about teaching transfer pricing and brings in real examples from current cases she's working on which is very interesting and engaging. The exams are challenging but she does plenty of review with students to help them do well.

I am currently taking her course. Although the course is difficult, she is very organized. She is very respected and a good person. You can tell she wants all her students to succeed. She is willing to help you with any questions you may have. Audit is not a fun subject, but she makes it better by using informational videos to make lessons more fun

I took 301; she is tough in all aspects, especially if you are a native speaker. The class participation is very stress-inducing, even if you answer something and it's not completely wrong, she will make fun of you. There is a lot of homework, and I couldn't imagine how much harder it is if you don't know the language well. She talks fast.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She always calls on you.She gave way too much homework, completely ignoring the fact that we all had other classes as well. The homework takes LONG HOURS to do. So if you have a job and school, this course it extremely hard to fit in your schedule. Overall, she was not open at all to extensions or extra credits.she grades unnecessarily difficult.

Do NOT take her for any Spanish course at this university. She grades so incredibly difficult, and if she decides she doesn't like you she won't give you an A on anything regardless of the amount of work you put into the course. She is condescending, and gives 0 feedback on quizzes or exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She was awesome! A lot of this class was doing work out of class and then doing the same thing in class. She was a clear instructor and funny. The class flowed at a nice pace.

She's a great professor. Open to any questions and critiques kindly. She's also fine with talking in English in class. There is plenty of MindTap homework but that's because of the Spanish department. Not a hard class. I would take again.
Prof is really sweet and caring but I would not recommend this class. More homework than my classes with labs combined. Made the Spanish language not fun. Take another prof if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: She is amazing!! Spanish isn't too hard for me in general but if you put in the work the class is really easy and you'll learn a lot. She is a great person and cares about her students. Your grade depends on a lot of things but all are easy A's. I highly recommend her!

I took SOC 211 and 212. Ended with a B- in 211 and an A+ in 212. The lab is extremely easy but 211 had a few quizzes which are 40% of your grade. I didn't do well on 2/4 and could not bring my grade up. Other assignments were fairly easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Olga Vega was suchhh an easy professor. I went to class once all semester and ended with an A. Just do the homeworks and assignments posted at the beginning of the semester and in reality, you could finish the entire class workload in 2 weeks.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The best professor I have taken at UM. Very caring and as long as you show up you will enjoy the class. She makes it interesting and you will want to participate in discussions (closer to talking to your friend than a class discussion). As long as you do your hw on time youll get an A.

I took victimology w/ her, and she is very clear about her expectations, sets the deadlines on the first day of class, and is super clear on what she expects. You will get an A if you do the work and hand in everything on time. She is also a sweet and caring person and wants you to succeed. I hope to take another class w/ her soon!

She's really a great prof, taking her class got me interested in taking more soc classes. All assignments and deadlines for everything is clearly stated at the beginning of the semester/in the syllabus, all very doable. Attendance isn't mandatory but I'd recommend going b/c she makes class/discussion interesting. 10/10:)

She is absolutley amazing. I have taken her for three classes now and am sad that I can't continue taking her. She is so beyond knowledgeable and so caring. She wants to you to succeed in her class. I have learned so much from her and would reccomend every person to take her class. She is truly an inspiration and the most wonderful professor.

Very chill and outgoing professor. Gives 1 quiz a week that is 10 multiple choice questions done at home (all answers directly from slides), a paper outline, then a final paper. Attendance is not mandatory and most of the classes are open and fun discussions talking about the news and our thoughts on topics. Would 100% take her again.

Didn't stand at the front of the room and lecture for an hour everyday. Instead she engaged us in conversation each class and I enjoyed that a lot. Didn't have any exams, just 7 quizzes, 2 papers, 4 discussions, and a presentation. She was an easy grader. Told a lot of stories and let us get to know her life story. Very enjoyable class!

Great, relatable professor.  All assignments posted at the start of the semester and can be completed on the students own time.  Attendance optional, but class was easy and actually interesting so I always went.  As long as assignments are turned in on time and you follow the directions, it's an easy A.

She is such a girl boss. Love her. Her class was so enjoyable and relatable. She used several different platforms of teaching and the grading guidelines were really clear, so I was never stressed about this class. Really fun and simple course. 10/10 recommend.

The class was never mandatory to attend and it's not very tough. She did not appear to grade too harshly, and the quizzes were all outside class and thus open-note. She gave us enough time for the essays/slideshows she made us too do. Fair enough.

Professor Vega is one of the best teachers I've ever had! She makes discussions very interesting and relates the topics to her life. Attendance wasn't mandatory, but I went because the class was fun to be in. There aren't too many assignments and if you do what she asks, it's a very easy A and there isn't a midterm or final.
class felt like an adventure, amazing professor,the experience however was a rollercoaster. Take her, she might be one of the most respectful professors there and she is very open minded.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: very patient professor, seeing that this is studio 1, it will be very difficult but if you do the work you will not fail. She is patient, just don't get too close, staff at UM are very unpredictable. She hasn't shown me any red flags personally though, just a general warning.
Good professor. Gives great feedback and is always here for help after studio hours.
One of the greatest professor for Urban Design.

I did not find her very helpful. She has ideas but they are mostly impractical and just whatever happens to be in trend.  Has no sense of scale, told me to draw a section of a PA city at a scale of 1/8.  That would require a drawing 100' long.
She was very sweet and dedicated to helping her students, often going out of her way to help people with design issues. Plus she is young, so it was easy to talk to/relate to her.
No Comments

Very dedicated to her students.  She maintained a nonbiased opinion of every students' work regardless of her personal opinion or disposition to them.  Is also very focused on how one presents their ideas.  Open space on a mylar is a big no no with her.

She is extremely nice and caring, you can tell she respects and cares a lot about her students. the course is homework heavy and the tests and assignments can be tough, especially if you struggle with languages. However there are many assignments that make up your final grade, so if you do badly in one area you still have a chance to do well.

Profe is just a great professor. Really cares about her students and asks what works best for them. A lot of homework though; all onn webassign due before the next class. Class is very manageable. Complete all the homeworks and just pay attention in class and you'll get a good grade. Highly recommended.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved her class! She is by far one of my favorite professors I've ever had. There was a reading assigned for every class (no textbook), but they were always so incredibly interesting I never missed one. She has such a unique perspective and is very open-minded and always willing to help. I miss her class so much.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Even though I knew this class would have a lot of readings, I was surprised by how well the Professor led the discussions in class. I really enjoyed it. Participation mattered. Professor Machado- Vento is very compassionate and offered up help via Zoom frequently when I needed it. She responds to emails quickly & gives very detailed feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: The class is administered in Spanish since it's intended for students who already speak the language but can't read or write it and have limited vocab. Lots of reading, but it's interesting, lots of class discussions, but they're engaging. She gives good feedback and enjoys getting to know and talk with her students. I'd take her again and again!
Great professor. Easy A if you just do the work and study for the exams. Go to every class bc it will affect your grade in the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Very kind. She cares about her students passing and will individually speak to you with any problem what so ever. She is very funny too and wants to make the class as best as possible. The only issue I had was that the homework was sometimes not the best of help with the subject.
I love her

Beware! This professora is the worst. She teaches Spanish 101 but she can barely speak English. She's not organized, difficult to understand, and grumpy. She makes her class repeat everything after her and half of the time nobody knows what's going on because she goes fast. I wouldn't recommend her at all. No bueno.
The best teacher ever, I sat in her class for the semester and enjoyed it so much!
She is the best! Wish I could take more of her classes. She is so nice and helpful and just wants you to try your best. Best English teacher at UM.

Professor Urbistondo is amazing, she makes this required English class a pleasure to attend because of her positive and caring attitude. She wants to bring the best out of every student so attending class is a must do to obtain good grades. Prob the best writing teacher I've had in my whole life!

Dr. Urbistondo is a great English professor. Attendance maters so make sure to go to class and participate. There is classwork but it's simple and it's due at the end of the semester. You will do really well in the class if you pay attention and ask for feedback on your papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: AMAZING professor. This was my second class with her and you honestly show up, sit there and do 3 papers and get the easiest A. If you need an extension she is so willing to give it to you if you just ask. TAKE HER CLASS
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Josie is a fantastic professor! She will give extensions if you really need one, is a pretty reasonable grader, and is just overall very nice and easy to work with. She also lets you turn in rough drafts and is usually available outside of class if you need to meet with her. I would highly recommend her!
Almost impossible not to get an A. She gives extensions all the time. Just show up to class and have her edit rough drafts and youll get an A.

Josie is amazing! Really easy going, and the classes are quick and fairly engaging. Most of the lessons help you with your papers (only 4 assigned and they're all based off of a reading that she goes over extensively). She's also super caring, really lenient, and doesn't expect to much. Would definitely take her again!
Great teacher

Josie is an AMAZING professor who really cares about her students. She's very approachable and is always willing to spend extra time helping out her students. There are 4 papers that make up the grade as well as some classwork. You have plenty of time to do each paper. She is very open to proofreading and editing  with you
The BEST english teacher I have ever had. Super sweet, super smart, very clear cut. LOVE her, would take her over any other teacher. highly recommend.

Josune is a great professor, she's relaxed when need be, but do the assignments she gives you, show up and actually be involved with the activities of the class. She's friendly and understanding. Would suggest taking this class.

Josie is the best english teacher I have ever had. Very helpful. She also cares about her student, so she would even help outside a class. She also always responds to email with a very helpful comment. She is the best!
Ms. Urbistondo is a great teacher. Her essays are pretty clear cut and she gives great feedback. Would definitely take her class again.

All around awesome professor and awesome person.  She is super nice and fun to have class with.  You only have 4 papers the whole semester and she's a very very fair grader.  If you show up, do the reading (theyre not hard and pretty interesting), and are a semi-decent writer you will definitely get an A.  1010 would take her class again.
ABSOLUTELY TAKE HER! Don't hesitate. She is the best. I'm an international student and she was very helpful and understanding. She cares a lot.

Mrs. Urbistondo is my favorite professor so far at UM. She is extremely nice but she is also very helpful and smart. She will help you become a better writer if you want, but she is a pretty easy grader if you follow her guidelines. Her class was very fun and she makes the most uninteresting topic, interesting.

Professor Urbistondo is one of my favorite teachers at UM. All of her assignments are relevant and you truly understand the theme of the class after finishing. She was incredibly helpful and so so nice. Would definitely recommend, its worth it

She is a great professor and it is preferable to read the novel. She wants all of her students to do well so if you do not do well on the rough draft paper then ask her for help. Also, in the class there are three 4-5 page papers and 1 research paper (8-10 pgs). Though it does sound like a lot of work she gives students plenty of time.

She was super nice and made class so much fun. Yes, it isn't super easy to get an A in that class but I also procrastinated on all of my papers so if I would've spent more time on it I prob would've gotten an A. The class is awesome. Take her!

Josie is by far the best English teacher I have ever had. She is one of the few teachers that actually wants to help you become a better writer and if you are willing to put in the effort I promise you will. She is cool, intelligent, and beautiful. I idolize her and recommend that you take her class if it's possible. You will not regret it!

Although Josie is a grad student, the girl knows her stuff. She's challenging, insightful, and very helpful. If you take her, get ready to work for your grade. In the end, you'll come out a much better writer. I have, even though I was the shizz to start off with!
Very nice lady, very lenient about grading.  Exams aren't a cakewalk but are definitely a step up from FRE101/102.  Just show up, take part a little bit and it's a pretty easy class.
Best teacher I've had in my college experience so far. The nicest and most understanding. Attendance is mandatory. I've learned more in her class than any other class so far.

Viviana is by far one of the best professors I have ever had in my college career. She is very nice, understanding, and flexible. If you genuinely do not have time to complete an assignment for the expected due date, she lets you turn it in later with no penalty. She always reviews before quizzes and exams. Will take her again for 203!

Viviana has quite literally been one of the most influential educators I have ever had. When I say she truly cares about her students, she really does. She has also helped me in other classes that she doesn't teach! She cares lots more about grammar than vocabulary. I cannot wait to take my next class with her! She is also a super easy grader.

Professor Villiers is a nice person but he takes the class way too seriously. He assigns long projects to do and on top of that gives a lot of unnecessary work which becomes very annoying. Also he grades the assignments harshly expecting you to resubmit them for a better grade. I think he is a nice person but I did not enjoy his class.

He is a very nice guy and wants you to do well. He gives easy projects and there is not a lot of work but the class is extremely boring. You'll have to do lots of unnecessary stuff which sometimes gets annoying. Great guy overall but his classes are boring
He was a very chill prof. He cares about his students. He's super sweet definitely take his class if you can.

I wish I could take her for 106. All the assignments are doable, and she gives in-class time to complete the work. I really liked her and her teaching style. The only con is that grading is slow, but in this class you can easily get an A if you do all the work — and the workload is not much compared to other classes.
if you want to feel like you are a prisoner locked up in something worse than hell take this class. she is the absolute devil and will hate you forever and grade you based off if u are friends w her.

She's a great professor everything is organized well on canvas which is helpful and the assignments are in class and then 3 papers so attendance is mandatory and you are graded on attendance but the class is fun and easy and she is nice would recommend
have no idea what my grade is because she hasn't graded things from the first week. Good teacher bad content in the class such a pointless class. She is super nice though

Take her for WRS 105. She is very nice, and the in-class assignments are very easy. The class has three major papers for the semester, and she is easygoing about extensions and always willing to work with you and help you. Attendance is mandatory, but you get five excused absences, and class typically gets let out early.

I like her as a person, she's very nice and a good teacher. However, she takes forever to grade things. It takes weeks if not months to get a grade on anything. She is very understanding and allows 5 excused absences which was really nice. She's a good teacher but nothing is super interesting that we do.

Very slow grader, only had two papers for the entire semester which took ages to get graded, lots of small assignments which also were not graded quickly. Boring lectures, often times arrived to the class just as class was beginning so was not very punctual. Attendance required, however allows 5 free absences, but attending was a waste of time.

Professor is knowledgeable but often goes on unrelated tangents, making note-taking and understanding difficult. He's rude, abrasive in disagreements, condescending, and mocks students. Injects unnecessary politics and personal beliefs into lectures. Grades harshly on few assignments that don't align with his explanations. But it is what it is.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class itself seems to have a great curriculum, yet when you get to class, the long lectures don't really adhere to the presentation are hard to understand and confusing. Taking notes is difficult, also few assignments that are all online.
Goes on random tangents. He is very obnoxious and rude. I cannot stand him.

Professor doesn't know what he is doing. All he does is yap and go on random tangents during class. Might I add he is very rude and abrasive in class, he will yell and make fun of you if you do not agree with him. He just makes fun of his students and is blatantly rude. His lectures have nothing to do with the assignments!

There are too many mandatory and unnecessary online group discussions, 
and it is difficult to satisfy him with his final paper.

Professor Deupi, is so amazing, he is one of the most hilarious professors you'll meet at the university, he truly cares about his students, and will push you to beat the norm and succeed artistically! Most definitely recommend.

He's not the easiest grader, but he is always ready to help and is a very wise professor!

Took him for History of Cities! A hilarious professor who cares VERY MUCH for his students! Offers at least one extra credit essay assignment! Very easy to get AT LEAST a "B" in his class WITH a little bit of effort!

She is always happy, good spirited, and encouraging. She has her own cannabis research that she shares about throughout her lectures. This class was a relief in my hard schedule because of her. Exams were online and not too challenging if you listen in class. Great experience.

Dr. Vidot made this class enjoyable. There isn't a lot of homework. Most of it is done in class. I found the tests difficult, but you will be fine if you attend class. She is very much into her research, which I liked.

reviews.comment: Such an easy class. Dr. Vidot is chill and talks a lot about her cannabis research- if that is not your vibe than prob not for you. Easy exams, easy assignments that if you do them you prob will get a 100. Class will always end at least an hour early, sometimes 2, Take her!

Dr Vidot is the best! Shes extremely engaging and funny. She genuinely loves epidemiology and her passion caries into her teaching and lectures. I learned so much from her, not just about the class content but also about her research. Its amazing everything shes managed to do! There is nothing I would change about this class!!

Dr. Vidot is an amazing professor and such a caring, kind soul. She is so enthusiastic. Personally, I did not enjoy the subject of the class very much, but she made the class very interesting. She is young and does cannabis research, so she definitely gets along with us. She is super cool and relatable.
This class is very interesting! Dr. Vidot is a great professor and really cares about her students. I learned a lot in this course and would recommend it to others.

Taking Dr. Vidot's class was one of the best decisions of the semester. The class is very straightforward in terms of the concepts. She is very enthusiastic about her work and makes class so much more interesting. The exams are on exactly what is covered in class -- there were no curveballs given. I would highly recommend!

reviews.comment: I love Dr. Vidot. She is very sweet and easy to access. She allows you a formula sheet for her exams and you only have two of them. She gives in class graded assignments that you work in a group to complete. Overall, I highly recommend her.

Amazing professor, who not only has interesting and engaging lectures but also makes sure to prepare his students for their future academic path. Terrible, terrible teacher. Impossible to understand. Impossible quizzes. Impossible to pass. AVOID AT ALL COST.

The labs sucked, but Vlad was so cool, he made it tolerable. He really makes you think, not just memorize  stuff. My best teacher so far!
incredibly cool
horribe horrible lab ta. his quizzes/tests have nothing to do with the lab material. aviod vlad!!!!

I love Charlotte, she was great. She really pushed me to step outside the box which ended up helping me progress a lot throughout the semester. I thought she was very nice and very knowledgeable; her critiques are okay but she kind of talks in metaphors. I would take her again ngl.

I'm surprised that I chose not to drop my major. I started developing wrinkles at a tender age. I was basically living a nightmare. This professor is very difficult and for teaching a first year class expects way too much from students. she is rude. has strong accent. she made me suffer from depression and i'm not joking.

She makes me think about changing my major and Im only the first year student. Hard to explain how Horrible she is .Save you self and good luck.

Professor Voss-Hoynes is such a great person and teacher. Made himself super accessible outside of class time and genuinely cares about our grade and well-being. His class made my look at writing in a completely different light and greatly improved my writing skills. Take this class!

Dr Voss Hoynes is the best English professor I've had so far, high school and college Eng classes put together. He is open-minded, respectful (so be it in return), and his assignments are very interesting not only by the subject they treat but by the structure and the material available to work on. Take a class with him if you can. BE PUNCTUAL.

Very dynamic, Dr Voss-Hoynes is available and always ready to help. Nice ambiance, amusing sense of humor, great feedback. He is VERY respectful, so be as well. Attend class (>3 absences lowers final grade), BE ON TIME. Many assignments, first four ones are rather short, it gradually becomes longer. I WOULD DEFINITELY TAKE A CLASS WITH HIM AGAIN.

Kurt is one of my favorite professors at UM. He cares about the subjects he teaches and works hard to make the class fun & relatable. He pays a lot of attention to detail in your writing and I cannot stress how much of a better writer he made me.

GREAT teacher. Very helpful and wants his students to do well. he would give everyone A+'s if he could. He's super understanding, gives extra credit, great feedback, and extends due dates if you need. Make sure you go to class because It is attendance mandatory
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Kurt gives you all the opportunities he can do get a quality grade in his class. He gives you five absences to use however you want, and he'll give you all the assistance you need if you ask for it. He's a nice guy that respects all of his students, what more can you ask for?

A truly great professor, he's funny, understands that students are busy with other classes, and is very flexible. He really cares about his students and always makes himself available! His assignments are broken up into small chunks, and he gives students PLENTY of time to complete them. The class topic (biopolitics) was also so interesting.

I have never been mentally stimulated in all my years of English classes from Kinder to Freshman year of college. I can honestly without a doubt say that Professor Voss-Hoynes has changed the way I read and write. Very engaging and extremely helpful. If you think you're bad at writing, pick this professor. I promise you will think different after.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Kurt is extremely accessible and is open to almost anything if it means improving your writing/grade. He gives you the opportunity to revise papers, as well as time in class to work on them. He is creative in getting you to engage in a class that is otherwise just a boring, mandatory english class. Overall a very genuine and nice guy.
Without question, Dr. Hoynes is the best literature/writing teacher there is. He actually wants you to learn. He is always accessible and understands individual students abilities.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: ENG 106 was one of the best classes ever taken at UM thanks to Dr. Kurt. Definietly take this course as he engages the class well and allows a bit of freedom with the assignments. He will also always be willing to help enhance your writting and critque it to make help increase your grade!

Kurt is awesome! Glad I took this class with him. He's very approachable and helpful whenever you need it. The novels aren't super interesting, but his lectures are because he draws parallels between the works and modern society. He's really cool, and I look forward to taking his class again! Highly recommend!

Listen - if you have to take  English 230 - you better take it with Kurt.  Awesome dude, really gives you the preparation and time to write stuff, and allows for you to rewrite for a better grade if necessary.  If you want an A and to improve your writing, take his class.

Kurt is the man! He creates a positive environment and he is always willing to crack a joke. The class material is boring and sort of stupid (resume, cover letter, memo) He allows student to work on assignments in class and to review 2 of the assignment before the end of the semester. Definitely TAKE HIM!!!

Kurt is honestly the man. He allows revisions for his papers as long as they're turned in before the last day of the semester. He leaves time in class to work on the paper and help us if we need it. Easily the greatest English professor I've ever had. I will definitely try to have him again before I graduate.

He's actually the worst professor u will ever take in your life. god bless u if u ever take this class. he made the experience miserable and he's an awful person. i really mean it save yourself. DO NOT EVER TAKE HIM you r gonna pray u r not there to take it
BAD, very very very bad

terrible teacher and late all the time. does not care about the students and the class is ridiculously difficult. do not take this spare yourself

the low ratings are bc of the nature of the class but the prof is a nice guy he might seem a little cold but if you go to office hours or ask a question in class he'll make sure you understand and cares that you do well. overall nice guy and does a good job at teaching. the homework helps soooo much on quizzes its not j busy work

Professor Bermudez is an overall great professor! He is really nice and understanding and although the tests can be challenging, it really is not on him and more the department. Horrible, stay away. Should've taken Joy Beverly. Don't be fooled by the honest reviews.

I loved Proffesor Bermudez. He's a caring teacher and is super readily accesible outside of class. There is a lot of homework but it doesn't take too long and he is willing to help if you get stuck. He is a good lecturer. Will answer any questions you have and his tests are fair. I would definitley take his class again!
This guy is awesome. I would take him again.

Very educational in the math material. Talk to him about math stuff and he was nerd out. Very caring professor. Weekly assignments that takes a minimum of 30mins. Would 100% take again and have a hot chocolate with him.

Professor Arias is a wonderful person and a great professor. 10/5 stars

grading was unnecessarily harsh, and the questions on the test are almost all memorization. if you do bad on one or two tests you're cooked. prof who is just here for the money and copies the slides verbatim, made me not even want to go to class since i could just read them myself.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Really good professor who teaches the concepts mostly through case studies. There are some terms to look out for but other than that the exams are quite easy and not cumulative. Just attend the lectures since attendance is mandatory and you'll get a good grade.

He is a great guy and very funny. However, taking his night class is hard considering it is already so boring. He is a tough grader on the group projects, but the tests get more manageable the longer you have been in the course.

He's excellent for an 8 am; usually starts closer to 8:10 which is nice.

The classes are engaging, and he really gets to know each student by name. Very accommodating too!! Exams are a little more challenging because there is no study guide; however, he reviews what he expects you to know in class before the exams, so make sure to write it down.

My favorite professor by far, his lectures are engaging and he uploads slides each class. Exams are medium difficulty and he provides ample study resources. Every class the entire class is full because his students respect him and actually enjoy his class. Also he is evidently very knowledgable on marketing.

SUPER funny guy, made it actually worth it to take his class at the worst hour of the day. tests are hard, but manageable. doesn't give out much homework besides group projects and reading textbook slides. take his class!!

reviews.comment: Great guy. Very much cares about his students and their success. Exams require a lot of studying, but as long as you show up to class and put in effort, you will do well.
Best teacher

My favorite professor of the semester. He is a very funny and nice guy. He's big on participation, which gets you extra points. His lectures summed up the textbook chapters we would read prior to class for homework. SOOOO supportive of students. He truly wants you to do well. Not a harsh grader. Enjoys when students come up after class to talk.
Nice man who cares about marketing.  His exams can be tough and he grades rather harshly.  Attendance and participation are factors in your final grade.
Great class

Walter is the best marketing professor you'll ever take. His lectures are always interesting even at 8am, class consists of three exams, two group projects, attendance and participation. If you make a quizlet of his slides for the exams you'll be more than okay. He really cares and connects with his students so don't be afraid to connect with him!

Probably the best MKT201 professor (compared to the other ones).  Every class consists of PPT lectures followed by a case study.  Grade is determined by 3 exams and 2 projects.  If you show up to class and participate you are fine.  Very nice guy.

He was my 8am teacher, he made me want to wake up and get to class every morning. His class may be difficult, but he is an amazing teacher and great person who genuinely cares about all of his students. I would 100% recommend his course
His middle name literally translates to "Human Sacrifice" in English. Do with that what you will.

Dr. Wang is a great professor who is always accessible for help. He is very accommodating with office hours, even meeting with students outside the scheduled times. Worst class ever taken!!! Lectures are very uninteresting and it's hard to understand him. I definitely wouldnt recommmend him

Boring lectures and the material that are on the tests are not made clear during class. Do not recommend

Her lectures are very disorganized, her handwriting is also extremely hard to read, and she doesn't have a fixed due date for quizzes. She also wants you to find your answers in a specific way, as in you'll get points marked if you use your own way to solve problems. Very nice, but do not recommend.

This class has been extremely frustrating. Her English is very hard to understand, and her rushed explanations make lessons confusing. Instructions change often, feedback is unclear, and the class feels disorganized. It's difficult to learn when communication and structure are this weak.

THE WORST! first of all she over explains and under explains in the same lecture, study guides don't help with the test whatsoever, there could be one version of the answer on the study guide but different on the test. She seems like a sweet person, but honestly does not know how to teach as its hard to follow. You CANNOT learn while she is demonstrating and teaches as if you already know the material as how fast she goes by things. When she asks if you understand she doesn't clarify or ask what you are confused or lost on but does another problem instead.

The most god-awful professor in the department. Gets her own problems on the board wrong, can't read her own handwriting, and quizzes and tests are significantly harder than other sections taught by other profs. DO NOT TAKE!
Great professor!!! Would recommend him to anyone. Really smart, and loves a good chat. MY BEST FRIEND.

I would HIGHLY recommend you take this course with another professor. The class was based off the PowerPoints and all of the questions on the quiz dont match what the PowerPoint says. He also only lectures for 20 minutes before letting you go and then you have to teach yourself on your own. Worst class I have taken.

Don't know why can't a student do the project by himself or herself, especially during the pandemic time, communication is very difficult. Also, 59 MCQs need to be done in 50 minutes. Don't know what he's thinking and I doubt his math ability. HARD TO COMMUNICATE. SELECT ANOTHER PROF IF YOU CAN!

Doesn't communicate well or speak clearly during class. Doesn't speak clearly during set-up interviews. Pushes back class assignments and reschedules assignments without giving you enough time to do them. He scheduled a group project to be done in three days because he said he had to fit it in to the semester. Had him for two classes. Don't do it
Great guy, not a great communicator since I showed up sometimes and found out then class was canceled. But very straight forward, turn in your work and your gonna pass no problem

Very smart man, but a little boring. He teaches straight from textbook and from powerpoint. If you read the textbook, you'll do fine in this class. The events are annoying to do but worth the extra points to do. The tests are multiple choice and true false (second test all true ) and are pretty basic, but if you don't study you won't do well.

The book has tons of interesting info, but his entire class is based around very basic and summarized info he picks out. Did well in the class but didn't learn anything new from it, only by reading the book
Nice guy, but doesnt post anything on blackboard, everything is straight from the slides and the slides are extremely vague. Get ready to teach yourself.
OK...
good professor very neutral personality use the power points only do not buy the text book
good professor very nutraul personality use the powre points only do not buy the text book

He is a very nice guy, but sometime his class gets a little confusing. He is willing to meet with you, but it doesn't really help. Just keep on top of the notes, and study every word he ever mentioned in class for the tests.

The timing stinks (8am), but thats really all the bad about this class. The material isn't stimulating, but the class isn't long enough to bore you. Doesn't use blackboard so write down all the notes from the powerpoints. Study for a few hours prior to each test and you'll be fine. Little if any homework. One group project. Easy "B", harder "A"
knows his stuff

Definitely take for Sports Psych. 7 quizzes make up the course, and the material comes straight from his slides and the text. The quizzes are open notes, and very fair in difficulty. Very friendly guy. He also gave me a writing credit.

Has no idea how to communicate with his students.  He often seems confused and unsure of what he is teaching about.  He is definitely a teacher that feels satisfied by doing the bare minimum.  In a sport admin. finance class we never once discussed a budget.  Lastly, the material on the final exam was hardly talked about during class.
Straight from the powerpoints, thats all he did, also he gave us a true false test in which every question was true.

class is him reading straight off of the powerpoints and occasional guest speakers. provides a good base for the rest of the program. tests questions come straight off of his powerpoints so study them and youre fine. also made final exam optional for those who attended every class.
Course was team-taught by Gillentine, Jordan, and Whisenant.  All teachers displayed vast knowledge of the field.  Dr. Gillentine wrote the textbook.  Definately take this course!!!

I see him on his bike all the time. He's a great guy and he once operated a whip for us while he demonstrated sound. Not the "hit the whip" kind, but the "I got the horses in the back" kind. It's been my phone wallpaper for the past two years.

Overall solid professor. You have to attend class if you want extra credit from the clickers and his lectures never got too confusing even with the most difficult topics. He has all his old exams on blackboard and he repeats a lot of questions so you can get a good grade if you put in the work.

Has clicker questions in every class, so attendance is kind of mandatory (these are extra credit but they also affect your grade a little). Otherwise, useless to go to class. He just writes formulas on the board that you'll never use. Study the clickers and the sample exams and you should be fine since there's a big curve at the end!

reviews.comment: Has kind eyes.  Participates in Hawaiian Friday.    Class wasn't too hard to do well in if you go to lectures and study.
Really weak teacher. Avoid at all costs.

He was no help whatsoever this year. Kahn Academy taught me more than he ever did. He assigns a ton of homework and makes it impossible to study for his exams as he wont give answers to practice problems, you have to discuss each one with him, which he doesn't event want to do. Avoid him at all costs.
The lectures are useless. He just writes equation on the board and does not explain the material well.

He is a good person and is very nice in office hours. Classes are interesting but can be confusing as a lot of the proofs and things done in class are not on the test. The tests are tough and seem a little unrelated to the homework and class material, but overall it was a good class. Not easy, but it is physics and its definitely challenging.

He seems like a really nice guy but he's just not a good teacher. The tests are completely different from the homework and you will have to either get a tutor or self-teach as the lectures do not help much, even though they are mandatory. Almost half of what you learn in class you will not be tested on.

Hes a good person, terrible teacher. The subject itself is confusing for people who havent done it before, and he doesnt help. If you want to do well, you have to put work in and go to him for help. Tests are very different from homework and hard. Clickers are part of grade, so go to class for sure.

You'll have to go to class, because he asks questions in class, which you'll have to buy an iClicker for. The homeworks are due every week on Tuesday, and will often be much harder than what he goes over in class. The tests aren't necessarily that much harder than what he goes over in class, but the grades on them are still pretty low.

Homework due every Monday and Tuesday, quiz every Tuesday. Only 3 midterms, but they can be hard if you don't understand physics. Attendance is basically mandatory because he does iClicker quizzes every class that are impossible not to get 100s but you have to show up for them. Not a bad teacher.

Dr. Voss is a great guy. Show up to class, sit up front, ask questions, and really put in a ton of time; if you do that you'll be fine. The class is not necessarily that easy, but definitely passable. Dr. Voss is very well versed and able to help (go to office hours).
Avoid. Nice guy but not a good teacher

By far the most ridiculous class I had to take. The material presented in class is not at all what is on the exams. Be prepared to teach yourself all of the material. The only reason I even went to class was for the clicker questions. The whole thing was really just a waste of time.

Not that great. Lectures are often confusing, and he constantly mixes up his variables on the blackboard or makes other mistakes that can result in confusion and misunderstanding for the student. Very nice guy, just not a good lecturer at all.
He forces you to go to class to learn nothing with his clicker questions. Honestly, just go to class solely to answer the clicker questions, don't listen to a word he says, and read the textbook.
Terrible professor, DO NOT TAKE HIM.

He teaches class as though we should already know physics, and it's an intro course.  He forces you to come to class and learn NOTHING by making "clicker" questions a part of your grade.  Essentially, every class is an impossible quiz in which every student cheats off each other.  Class is a complete waste of time Neil Johnson is the man! <3
Best teacher you will ever have!! Incredible, he really made physics interesting and fun to learn.  Always helpful and he is the only one who can rock a moustache!! Must take!!
I felt like I knew him like a father, great teacher
not a hard class but def more assignments than I expected. not necessarily an easy A because you have to put in some work

Dr. Witte is a great professor, she really wants her students to learn and really cares. Attendance isn't mandatory, but you won't do well in the class if you don't go because the exams test how much you've been paying attention. Many extra credit opportunities and group projects.
Great professor. Lectures are interesting and involving. Also lots of extra credit opportunities. It is definitely possible to end with above an 100 if you just put in decent effort

I enjoyed her lectures, and while she had an interesting perspective, I found all of the course content and her lectures to be biased towards veganism. I'm sure there's some truth to the health benefits of veganism compared to a non-vegan diet, but it gets to a point - I really like her and the class but I dropped it because of the obvious bias.
She is a really good teacher, really passionate about nutrition, but it's lowkey a bit harder than I expected. Good class tho, a lot of homework, which gets your grade higher.

She is amazing! Only class where I actually learn in my two years of college. She genuinely cares about her students and learning. The only assignments are group presentations and studying. I really enjoyed taking this class it was very interesting.

super sweet woman. I took this class as a stem cognate as someone who is not good at stem but was still able to manage. The course is very lecture heavy and although attendance isn't mandatory it's easy to fall behind if you miss class. Super interesting class especially if you have any slight passion towards nutrition.

Dr Witte is a very energetic and caring professor. I was in KIN 155 and this class was made way too hard for a 100 level course. 75% of your grade is based off the exams, which are very confusing. The content in the course is decent yet she does show a lot of biased towards things like veganism. Lots of easy group presentations.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Witte is an extremely caring professor, as she always brings enthusiasm to her lectures and is flexible on assignments. If you study at least 2 or 3 days in advance for her exams, you will pass with flying colors. She is also generous with extra credit and bumps up your grade (up to 2pts) if you are on the cusp of the next letter grade.
She is nice but her lectures are defiantly biased towards veganism. If you don't mind that its a solid class.
Great teacher, but lectures can be a little boring. Genuinely cares about her students and you can tell she loves what she teaches. 3 group projects throughout the semester are your big assignments.
Enjoyed 150 a ton, would take her again.

Dr. Witte is one of the best professors at Umiami. She knows how to break down complex ideas for the intro level. All her lectures were extremely informative, and she makes sure to answers any of your questions if you need extra clarification. Study guides given! 2 exams (20% each) plus final (30%). Barely any homework given. You won't regret her!

Gives basically no homework and everything said in lecture is on exams so go to class. Super sweet but tough grader. Super understanding and really values participation so talk during lecture. For exams read your lecture notes and do her study guide and you'll be fine. Final is rough but curved and it's not cumulative.

her lectures can get very dense, but her exams are not impossibly hard and she does very good reviews the class before. i would recommend you don't skip class. she gives no homework and the final isn't comitative. just get ready to study a lot. she's biased toward veganism and her lectures are built around this

This course and professor will enlighten you with amazing insights into what proper nutrition is and how to navigate your way through all the misinformation that has been perpetrated on society for decades.

Professor Witte is a great professor. Despite her syllabus saying attendance is mandatory, it is not, and the homeworks are very easy to keep up with even if you do not attend. The tests are relatively easy as well, as long as you review the lectures you will do well. She is also super nice and caring and makes accommodations when needed.
Easy class but don't take it with her if you actually want to learn about nutrition for yourself. Lots of misleading studies shown and reliance on very biased sources.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: the exams are horrible for a 100 level course she gives way too much information to know for each exam. i recommend you not to take this class at all. do yourself a favor. i'm a senior and i find this class of 100 level to be extremely difficult. she also talks so fast that its impossible to do good in any exam or to understand ANYTHING.
Amazing person, professor, and mentor

Love Dr. Witte! If you have the opportunity to take her, do it! Lots of lectures, but most of them are engaging and very interesting. Make sure you answer the end of lecture review questions and you'll be ready for the tests. The tests are very far apart and they cover a lot of information.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The lectures were good and she showed lots of relevant research and videos as well as the lecture notes. If you study the slides and the questions she gives you, you will do fine on the tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Witte is very passionate about what she teaches and her lectures are fun and colorful. She is also very caring and understanding and will help you if have questions. The class is pretty memorization heavy, and the tests are mostly just being able to recall knowledge and terms fast and quickly.

Dr. Witte is a very knowledgeable professor and lectures about current things happening in nutrition today which makes her very engaging. BUT she can talk very fast and there's a lot to know! Her tests are stressful and you don't have time to go back. She usually has a mixture of question types . 3 exams, projects and HW every week

This class is honestly a joke. The material is so basic it barely feels like a college course, so most people stop paying attention pretty quickly. There's no real challenge or depth, and it feels like you're just going through the motions to get a grade. The tests are extremely easy and don't really measure understanding.

Dr. Dees really cares about the subject of sports marketing. She gives great lectures, but the 3 hour format of my class made it pretty hard to focus. The exams were all super long (around 70-80 questions all multiple choice), but were all very easy, and were open book. Dr. Dees is a good professor, but the course format was tough to navigate.

Professor Dees was one of my favorite at Umiami so far. I'm a Finance major with a Sports Admin minor, so I  wasn't sure what to expect when taking this class. She made it so interesting and engaging and really valued our work. Tests were super easy and she was super sweet about everything. I wish I  could take her again.
Wendy Dees is a good professor. Her class was good but I did not enjoy her 500 wrd discussion boards. The class was great besides that.

Terrible. Tests straight from the books, very random and ultra-specific. Lectures useless, never on tests. Very self-interested. Makes you buy a Sports Business Journal subscription for $50 but never actually uses it. Quizzes are from all old, free articles. Forces you to attend Sports Business conference on campus to inflate attendance #s.

DO NOT BUY THE SPORTS BUSINESS JOURNAL SUBSCRIPTION. You will not use it! Required articles can be accessed w/o subscription, just use Google. I think she just gets a cut of profits if her students subscribe. Very beautiful and a nice person, but awful professor. Nothing in class is on the exams. Tests/quizzes are memorization, not learning. Avoid.

Dr. Dees is an amazing professor.  She explains sport in a way that even a dead turtle would understand.  She uses the rare teaching method of paronomasia in order to make class eggciting.  She exudes confidence , and does an eggcellent job dressing herself as well (chilipepper factor through the roof)
Very nice and understandable.

I love sports marketing but this woman made my life hell. She takes her rules way too seriously, even for EXTREMELY small things. Will take off points if late because the shuttle wasnt on time. Test average was always low. DO NOT recommend.
she is nice and very flexible... but all the learning is done through the textbook. If it wasn't mandatory attendance, I would never go to class and just read the textbook to get an A.
She's really nice and she stimulates a lot of interest in the course. Make sure you read the textbook and study the lectures if you want an A.

Her class is made up of 1 semester long group project, 3 quizzes and 3 exams. She keeps class interesting with her funny examples. Classes go by quick and its all her lecturing but her exams are harder than you would think. If you read the book and study the power points, you will get an A. Very nice and always willing to help

Thought at the beginning of the semester she'd be good.  Not at all.  Tries to make the class harder than it is.  BS assignments, treats you like you're back in high school.  Take someone else for Sp. Mktg

Lectures primarily consisted of following along and copying the professor's work for 75 minutes. While the professor is helpful during office hours and the projects are straightforward, the classroom lacked engagement. If you are looking for a deep conceptual understanding of the material, he may not be the best fit.

Decent professor, just go to the lectures and copy the code from class and you will pass. You could honestly have zero coding experince and do just fine in the class. Only downside is that lectures are a lil boring

This class is easy until you get to the final project. If you go to every lecture, you will be fine but the lectures do get dry and people tend to skip after the midterm. Both the midterm and final are websites you have to code. He is available for office hours all through finals week but I would recommend finishing up your final project asap.

Prof. Jattin is a cool guy. Can be a bit dry in his delivery, he's obviously a very skilled programmer but sometimes can't realize that students don't know everything he knows. Once he cracks a joke the class will get more engaging. This class was mostly copy-paste, but challenging toward the end. Wouldn't recommend for anyone who doesn't code.

He's a pretty cool guy. I found the class to be really boring, however. I did know a lot of the material beforehand, to be fair, but the class was really silent and he wasn't really engaging. I stopped going after a while and was able to keep up via Blackboard.
I took him for 101 so it was easy, but definitely the least competent teacher I've ever had in all my 18 years of life. Doesn't know how to teach, but easy class if you're good at math.
Wouldn't take again, professor is really confused. Had to take tutoring.

I would not recommend taking Professor Cho. This class was the worst class I have ever taken. I had to teach myself everything because nothing was accomplished in class. He was a very nice man, but a very bad teacher. Math is not my strong suit, which made this class even worse. I also as unable to see my grade the entire semester in the class.

I took Cho for MTH 101 and i do not recommend him at all. Hes a super smart guy, but doesn't know how to teach, or get his point across. T As far as grades it would take him weeks on weeks to grade exams, and he didn't grade homework, quizzes, or attendance until he had to post the final grade so I had no idea what my grade was in his class
take literally anyone else

Had him for MTH 130. You can tell he is an intelligent guy, but he has difficulties teaching. He will complete an example and ask if there are questions, but will respond to questions by essentially just restating his explanation. He seems like a very sweet man, however, the only reason I was able to pass this course was from my prior knowledge.

He is a nice guy, but attending his class is next to useless. I taught everything myself through ChatGPT and YouTube. He is just not a very good professor. 70% of my class ended up dropping. Intelligent guy for sure, but very bad at teaching. Also, he takes ages to grade tests, like months. The UM Math Dept. once again hiring a bad professor!

One of the best professors in UM's film program. Makes screenwriting super fun and interesting. All assignments are super creative and for the final project, he turns it into a competition. The best screenplays get sent to an actual Hollywood panel, & you'll get feedback from the pros. He took us to the Rat after finals, very chill.

Absolutely someone you need to take if you want to do screenwriting! He makes class fun and engaging and helps you grow so much. Did a lot of screenwriting exercises the first half of the semester and then final was the first act of a feature. Everyone in my class loved him to the point that he's teaching CCA 426 now too because we told advising

Jay is the BEST prof I've had at UM. He's a screenwriter so he gives helpful tips to students and knows a lot about the industry. Class is very collaborative and is like a real writer's room. We worked on one ~20 page script and he gave feedback every step of the way. Is always available to meet outside of class too so he's there for you. TAKE HIM!

Professor Wolf changed my life as a film major in CCA 126. He is a passionate guy who really cares about his students. He makes you WANT to go to class and the work is fun. One test, many assignments (most of semester spent working on same script). His grading is easy but fair. He is so well versed with screenwriting and the industry.
very nice and helpful with projects

Being someone that's taking this class for fun with no creative abilities whatsoever, I thought the class really helped me understand photography and editing As a stem major I was lost at times but Alyssa was always there to help give advice and answer questions. Definitely recommend and as long as you show up and do the work, you'll be fine

I thoroughly enjoyed my time in ART210 this semester. She created a really comfortable classroom environment that allowed for creativity and constructive critiques. Overall the professor was amazing and gave great feedback on all of the work I turned in. I would recommend this class if you're trying to improve your photography and editing skills.
She is a very kind teacher, I've learned a lot from the class and I really enjoy it! Don't hesitate to take this interesting course, you will have both fun and A!
