Great teacher. She is very knowledgeable about the class and willing to help you understand the content. She offers extra credit and many opportunities to do well; she wants you to succeed. I would suggest this class to anyone interested in photography. I learned so much in this class.
The class is not hard and the teacher is nice. Just make sure you stay on top of what you need to hand in and don't be scared to ask for help.

Take this class. Professor Wood is very understanding and knowledgeable about photography. She will help you and answer any questions you may have about the assignments in class and out of class. If you do the work and put in effort you will do well and the class is very interesting.

Alyssa really cares about her students and is super chill. She knows a lot about photography and taught me a lot. As long as you show effort and don't skip class, you will get a good grade. I don't really know why there are terrible reviews because in my class I felt like there was a mix of different students and no one was treated differently.

I learned so much in this class! The assignments were fun and unique and the classroom environment was very chill and supportive. Alyssa is very kind and helped me when I needed extra time on an assignment - I would definitely take a class with her again!
She is a very nice person that knows a lot about photography! She's open to helping out with any questions.

Prof Wheat was awesome.  She is funny, personable and I learned the perfect formula for writing a paper.  She "does not tolerate foolishness," but so long as you are a sincere student, you won't find yourself the butt of a joke.  I met with her during her office hours and she was really helpful.  I wish more profs were like her!
The worst! Seriously beware!! She messed up my GPA. Do NOT take her no matter what!! I swear I start to love a professor I used to hate after her.

I have no idea what everyone is talking about... Professor Wheat is the FUNNIEST teacher I've ever had for one! She's super sweet and quirky and makes the class go by smoothly. And there's really NOTHING super hard about her class... the paper's aren't complicated. I would take her again!

as an international student, she was fair with me. i thought she was going to give me a hard time because of these comments but she was actually pretty cool. Just make sure you let her know that you are interested in the class.
She is tough.  If you come to class her attendance policy allows you to tank a paper and still maintain a B. Re-writing a paper is near impossible.
She is cool. But not the best class i've taken at UM.

So, her personality was extremely annoying and tiring. She was a harsh grader, she refused to hand out A's and whatever. However, she was really clear on exactly what she wanted, and as long as you followed all of her rules and didn't focus on your own writing style (sucks, I know) I hated her, but she really improved my essay writing skills
stay away!!! i hope she leaves um

loved her. interested in what she's teaching, clear about what she whats. Mandatory is very important will lower your grade as it did mine if you miss more than three classes. essay topics are interesting and so are most of the assigned readings. takes time to make sure you understand. Highly recommend this teacher!

Prof wheat is smart and funny.  She makes class go by quickly and gives you lots of input on your papers.  Her attendance policy is a bit strict and some of the class wasn't doing the reading so she started quizzes!  That sucked, but still a good class.
Very helpful teacher.  Tough class, but if you put in the work you will at least get a B.  She is very clear during class and always has extra help.  Attendance is mandatory.

Prof Wheat is fantastic!  Attendance is mandatory, but she is funny and makes class go quickly. There are three papers and you can re-write two of them if you need.  She grades kind of tough but gives you a ton of feedback on your papers.  If you come to class, I think it would be hard to get less than a B.

Literally the worst teacher at UM, classes are boring and you don't learn anything, tough grader if she doesn't like you... not worth your effort. Wheat please leave, UM will be better without you. Change if you can!

She was an amazing professor.  She's the first professor to truly teach clearly and straight to the point how to write a research paper.  I would highly recommend taking her class.  We had three essays in total, each counting as 25% of our grade, remaining 25% was attendance/participation.

I had never had a class with so much writing and I kind of bombed the first paper.  Prof Wheat worked with me and I ended up with a B+ in the class.  She is a really good teacher, despite being a little on the tough side.
One of the best teachers I've had at UM!! She explains everything very clearly and really wants her students to understand the material. Plus she is an all around great person and amazing teacher.

Horrible professor! Extremely hard grader and going to class is absolutely pointless. Her lectures are insanely boring and so repetitive, but if you miss more than 2 classes, you drop your final grade by a letter every day you miss. Do NOT take her unless you expect to get out with a grade at least 2 letters lower than the grade you deserve.
Absolutely horrible, do NOT take under any circumstances.
Worst professor in UM, funny how the site deleted all the comments, and the person saying easy A well ummm it's not. maybe to you coz u kiss her a**
Loved this Class!  Great prof and fun class.  She is tough, but if you do your work, and come to class..  easy A!

I dont understand the bad reviews everyone is giving her. Her lectures may be a bit repetitive but the class isnt that hard. The key to getting a good grade is participating in class. It seems like people who participate get better grades on their essays so if you are the type of person that participates take this class.

Worst teacher ever, do NOT take this teacher! shes not supposed 2 b teaching. Her attitude is very bad, she literally told me that Im not gonna do good in the course, what she said to me is as if she is saying I cannot teach you! then what the hell is she doing i UM? she's not professional at all and like everyone is saying shes very disrespectful.

HARD class ! it should actually be easy!! English is a class where you get A's and B's easily to help get a good GPA. She's a nice teacher but sometimes she could be mean and disrespectful. But her class is VERY VERY VERY hard ! don't take her! take mrs. pickens! all my friends are getting A's with her.
She's a fun prof like she'll joke around with students but she's very tough. There were 3 essays and no final mixed with Think Pieces which were a pg long and not that frequent along with readings.

I hate this class. She's a nice person out of class, but she's a terrible professor. The class is a joke. She's extremely repetitive, most classes we discuss the same exact thing. Class is boring and essays are not even fun to write. She assigns a lot of useless readings that we don't even discuss in class. She's very tough at grading essays, too.
WORST PROFESSOR EVER , DROP DROP DROP !!!! i promise u! u will fail this class if u take her, she is the worst!
WORST PROFESSOR AT UM!!!

She is smart and funny. I've been to her office hours and she is really helpful. I like this class and don't understand the bad reviews. I guess it would be a tough class if you were dumb or could not tell time.
AWFUL TEACHER!! DROP, DROP, DROP!

Do not think about taking her classes! She is an horrible teacher. She lowers your grade for being absent or late (even 5 minutes). She is rude, self-centered, aggressive, egocentric, overconfident and irritating. I suggest you choose any other professor available in order to do well. If you stay with her you'll end up with Cs, Ds and Fs!

ITS ME AGAIN!!! I DROPPED THIS COURSE THANK GOD! I AM TAKING SOMEONE ELSE! WITH PROFESSOR WHEAT I GOT A " C+" AND WITH MY NEW PROFESSOR I GOT A "B" SO DONT LET HER GET TO YOU!!! IF U DONT BELIEVE ME ASK ANY SOPHOMORE!!! SHE HATES EVERYONE AND SHE GETS REVENGE ON THE GRADES!

WORST PROFESSOR EVER!!! DONT EVEN THINK OF TAKING HER!!! SHE DOESNT RESPECT ANYBODY IN CLASS AND SHE NEVER APPRECIATES HARD WORK!!! IF U WANT TO FAIL AN ENGLISH CLASS I RECOMMEND HER! IF U WANNA GET HIGH GRADES TAKE ANYONE BUT HER! SHE IS HORRIBLE! EVERYONE HATES HER! WHOEVER IS READING THIS DO NOT TAKE CARRIE WHEAT!!!! OR U WILL REGRET IT I SWEAR!

This class was only for serious students.  She lowers your grade for absences and for not participating in class.  Also, she is a tough grader.  If you don't want to work hard, take someone else.  BUT she taught me how to write an excellent paper.
Prof Wheat is tough but fair.  I've never been very good at writing, but this class pushed me to get much better.  I am glad I took this class and would advise any serious student to take Prof Wheat.
Prof Wheat is tough but fair.  I've never been very good at writing, but this class pushed me to get much better.  I am glad I took this class and would advise any serious student to take Prof Wheat.
WORST CLASS I HAVE EVER TAKEN. Wheat is probably the worst professor I have ever had... did not learn anything. I strongly recommend not taking ANY of her classes.

The class topic of the 60's could have been fun, but her harsh grading, rude comments and unpleasant assignments made it my least favorite class.  She has a very strict attendance policy and does not make exceptions for illness.  Overall she is quite unpleasant and unreasonable.

I believed the previous comments regarding C. Wheat as a good, easy, fun professor but was largely mislead. Her assignments are not that difficult to do well on, minus that she grades 100x harder on the final version of a paper than she does on the draft,but her personality makes the class horrible!!! DO NOT TAKE!!

You should take this class if you don't mind a relaxed atmosphere and someone that speaks their mind in an unconventional way. The people that complain about her probably don't know how to write! I you do, you will be fine with minimal effort.

This was probably my least favorite english class because all she does is complain about the class and how much she hates everyone.  She makes it clear that she doesn't really care about anyone in class.  If you don't do the papers EXACTLY the way she wants you will not get a good grade on the papers. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!

AWFUL.  She constantly makes snide comments. Does not respect anyone in the class. Does not help when you need help. Does not care about the kids. Very tough grader. Terrible teacher and does not know how to communicate with the class efficiently. DO NOT TAKE UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCES.

Worst teacher I've ever had. She's extremely hard, sarcastic and nasty. Her intellect is not credible and therefore it is tough to take B.S. from her because you can't respect her. Don't make the same mistake I did and listen to the moderate comments before this one. You will regret your decision. SHES ABSOLUTELY MISERABLE!
A great teacher. Although you may not receive the grade you want first, she will work with you. A fun class, recommended!
A tough prof, but she will keep you honest.  She expect excellence, but will get you there.
Young, fun, and smart.  This prof will teach you how to write a paper and think about the world around you.  She is somewhat tough, and expects punctuality and excellence...but she is fair.
loved her. not hard, interesting, fun. dont think itd matter what class you take with her. shes nice and helpful and funny
i didn't like this class. i thought she was too cheery and she tries too hard to relate to the students. a little high strung. grades moderately hard but you do learn something.

Strict with attendence, especially tardies, so be on time.  Very clear with what she expects to see, yet she is extremely helpful in helping you get there.  Responds to emails within a few hours tops.  Great professor.
One of the best Teachers I have ever had. Expectations clear, classes are very informative. She makes you think.

She can be very entertaining, papers have to be done the way she teaches you, or you won't get beyond a B on them. Very good about helping students and lets you redo a paper at the end. Adjusts due dates for papers. Strict with attendance. Overall not bad, although the class is boring.
She's really nice and sweet! She's a bit crazy but she keeps the class fun. At the end of the semester she lets you re-do a paper so don't stress out about papers. Its not a very difficult class.
No Comments

Professor Kohn Wood is by far the best professor I've ever taken at UM--her lectures are engaging and interesting and integrating cinema with as serious a topic as mental illness and stigma was amazing and made learning the material so much easier. Take her!!

Dr. KW was definitely one of my favorite professors at UM! The midterm was take home and there's no final--only a final paper that she gives class days off to complete. She's an extremely fair grader and makes class interesting by lecturing one day and then having you participate in an activity the next. Highly recommend!!!

Dr. Kohn Wood is possibly the best professor I've ever had at UM. She teaches in a way in which she engages you into the topic to the point where you start to love her work. She's also a little nutty and cheezy, but this makes her extra fun. Community Psych is one of the best courses ever at UM! Don't think twice about taking her for ANY course!

Very good professor. Takes time to get to know each of his students and really wants his students to learn the language. Would recommend this teacher: compassionate, kind, and spots in his class fill up quick! Easy A+!
Woo Laoshi is so nice and engaging! He's a very lenient grader and genuinely wants to help you learn Chinese. As long as you participate and put in some honest effort, it's not difficult to get an A.
Don't take! Extremely time consuming. Expect to spend 20+ hours a week on homework, assignments, projects, and studying for this class, alone.

Dr. Wright was such a fun professor to have. Her lectures are engaging and she is hilarious. She provides a clear study guide for every quiz and exam, and as long as you study it you will do well. The two major assignments are slowly developed over the semester and you have a lot of time to complete them.

Prof. Wright is a great professor and knows what she is talking about. She is very funny and lightens up the room. Although she is tough, a tough grader and gives one big project and a bunch of quizzes and tests every week. She gives study guides, which helps, but the tests are always hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: 4 tests, 4 quizzes, 2 main projects. It's lecture heavy but she makes them really interesting and engaging. She also gives all of the materials necessary to study and do the projects so it shouldn't be hard at all.

Loved Dr. Wright and her teaching. Recommends you buy the textbook at the beginning of the semester, but has Powerpoint presentations on each of the chapters/theories you need to know so the textbook is not necessary. Clearly loves teaching & often includes personal anecdotes/pop culture references to lectures & connects them to theories.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Not flexible with her opinions.

Kallia Wright was an amazing prof! She speaks really fast in her lectures so it can be hard to keep up, but she posted the powerpoints anyways. Quizzes and tests can be somewhat difficult, but if you review the notes you will get a decent grade. She really wants you to succeed and is so funny/nice!

Dr. Wright is awesome. Only professor I have had that has danced during class. She will try to get to know you and will always make you laugh. You will also learn a good amount about Jamaica in her course as well. If you have the chance to do COS343, take it. You do not need the textbook. One of the best professors I have had at UM.

Dr. Wright is an amazing teacher! As long as you pay attention and study her PowerPoints you will do well in the class. She does a great job making her class interesting and engaging! She is honestly my favorite Professor at UM.

good teacher overall. She is very passionate about her career and the things she teaches. Not going to lie though, she is very hard to get used to at first. She talks fast and gives a lot of work. the more you get to know her and her teaching, you like her a lot. I would forsure take her again, but people can say otherwise.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Kallia Wright is a nice professor but not when it comes to teaching. She gives so many assignments and the exams are so hard. She talks way too fast and doesn't give you a break to catch up. Don't get this professor!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I had a good time with Professor Wuchty. His lectures were a bit dry at first but I grew to really like them. Lectures mix basic notes with great examples. He tries his best to make jokes and make it fun. Come to class, answer questions, do the work and I promise you will do just fine. For how hard Java is, Professor Wuchty makes it quite easy.

The professor didn't show care for the class, and that reflected in dismal attendance numbers. Notes are taken from another professor (not even his), and could be more engaging. Study exam-style questions on each note page for exams, and you will be fine. Lab tasks and assignments can be hard and you don't really get feedback, so reach out to TAs.

Lectures were just pre-written notes that the professor reads. Very strict with grading code if you have any errors you will get a zero. I never got emailed back. Not the worst CS class but could have been better and more engaging.

the TA's grade everything, and it's impossible to access them outside of class. Emailing him is useless, he doesnt reply, and he shows almost no care for the class. TA's don't even run the labs, they just look at them and grade based on their opinions of good and bad. Not the worst class for CS, but with no care from the Prof it seems useless
I do believe what you put into this class you will get out. This professor is clear and takes his time answering your

The class itself isn't hard, but Wuchty makes it difficult. The lecture notes aren't even his, they're Sutcliffe and Dellis's. Class average was a 50 for the midterm, whole average banks on labs and 2 projects. Impossible to pay attention in class, just teach yourself. Not the worst class, but not very intriguing at all, unfortunate it's mandatory.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you get Wuchty for CSC 322, good luck. Lectures are incredibly boring, he just reads pre-written notes. EVERYONE WILL FAIL THE MIDTERM HE DOES THIS EVERY YEAR(he'll tell you its multiple choice, but its actually short answer). Overall, he makes the class incredibly boring and his exams are unnecessarily difficult. Go to TA office hours to learn.

For the first half of him trying to teach us UNIX he taught us concepts of the tc shell language, but the assignments were done in a different shell language, bash. The first midterm had an average grade of a 50%, he doesn't care enough to learn the names of the 20% of class that decides to show up for his lectures. Please go to the TA office hours

Very boring teacher, which is unfortunate since it is crucial to pay attention in class. Exams are tough and study guides should not be the only thing you study. Go over the powerpoints. The weekly codes are very strict and if there is even one compiling warning the entire assignment is a 0. Would not take again.

Not the most interesting or engaging class but not terrible. He uses TopHat to make attendance mandatory, but the questions are pretty straight forward. Office hours with the TA are extremely helpful. Short midterm and noncumulative final. Wuchty is a great guy and very knowledgeable and accessible outside of class. Just pretty boring unfortunately

Wuchty is kind and very smart! Issue is, he doesn't move from his chair at all and goes over a page of minimal notes for every class. You can tell he's not engaged so his students aren't either. Overall, not the worst CSC class I've taken but extremely monotonous.

Great teacher. 317 is algorithms and no programming which can be challenging but his slides are available online and so is the textbook, both are helpful. 401 is 4 programs related to the 317 course content which you write on your own.

My favorite CSC teacher so far. Lectures can be helpful if you pay attention but attendance isn't mandatory and all his notes and examples are posted on his website. Tests and homework are fair. Some semesters he does a large final project which is challenging and time consuming but overall a good class.
plz use whiteboard

The class is tedious, but how could it not be? The nature of coding in C is that it is nit picky, and the same can be said for Unix commands. For the few complex questions you have, just go talk to him, he will gladly help with anything.
Nice professor, easy tests, non cumulative finals. Everything that he says on class is on his website.

Cool guy, his lectures can get pretty boring, but he explains things very well and makes sure the class understands the material before moving on. Tests are doable as long as you study, and most of the assignments can be done within a couple of hours

Very nice guy, who means well. But the class itself is pretty tedious -- lots of example code, lots of straight up reading G. Sutcliffe's pre-written notes ... it can be tough to pay attention. Lab tasks aren't too bad, I usually did them in just a few hours. If you need help, he'll be there for you and encourages class participation and questions.

Has all of his lecture notes and examples of code online, and spends class reading through them and walking you through the code.  Not the most interesting lectures, but he gives thorough explanations and it's easy to reference the notes later.   Gives small assignments every week or two, they're not too difficult.   Friendly! Would take again!
very nice guy. hard to understand. repeats himself. does not per se teach, but simply goes over the online book in class by reading it aloud. it was disheartening how bad this class was

It was embarrassing to call her my professor. She's softspoken& nice but she has no expertise on anything, is very unintelligent, and barely speaks english. I feel bad cause i think she knows students dont like her because her course isn't baked in anything real & be prepared for a semester of sitting 75 minutes in a class & feeling irritated

Never had a professor that even compared to how awful she is. Utterly embarrassed that my tuition money is going to her class. Insanely unorganized, unable to get points across, changes her answer to questions every time they're asked, and does nothing efficiently. Cannot answer any questions from students and makes everything way more complicated

This is the worst professor I have ever taken. We are working on our first project and she has no idea how to get her points across. Unable to answer questions the entire class has. I was trying to stay optimistic based on her ratemyprofessor ratings, but I PROMISE stay away from this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: one of the absolute worst professors I have ever taken. she doesnt know how to interact with students. the way she teaches her course is not effective. everyone has to watch a 30min lecture and than she talks about nothing related to the course or video lecture during class time. she also gives out false facts during class about media industry.

So hard to sit through this professors class. Extremely boring, slow, and unentertaining. A little hard to understand the concept shes trying to get across. Would never recommend this professor to anyone. Very unacomadating.

she is the worst!! i don't mean to judge her accent but her words do not make any sense. it seems like she has not clue what she is talking about. it is a torcher taking her class! please double check if she is credential for such a nice university.

This is genuinely the worst professor I have ever had at UM. She makes absolutely no sense no matter how many questions you ask her and has impossible assignments. She seems absolutely clueless and someone should double check if she has proper teaching credentials. Please try to avoid taking her if you enjoy being happy.
Easy coursework. She knows what she's teaching and is an expert in academic research.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She's the worst professor I have ever had in my entire life. She's beyond disrespectful and offers no help or guidance when asked questions. She simply complains about the classes she has to teach and makes fun of her students for attending private universities. She will not let students voice their opinions and cuts them off. AVOID AT ALL COSTS

This is the WORST professor I've ever had. She's rude and disrespectful. She literally yells at students for not understanding the concepts she's teaching and asking her questions for clarification. She's absolutely no help, she's a crazy hard grader and will flunk you with no feedback on your assignments. DO NOT take her. Bad professor all around
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This is the WORST professor I have ever had. She is an absolute ditz and knows nothing about social media. She is rude and sassy to students and snaps at those who ask questions she finds to be "dumb" or self explanatory. Her project guidelines make 0 sense and take FOREVER to complete. Class is a COMPLETE waste of time. Do NOTTT take her!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: PLEASE take my advice and do not take this teacher. There was no RMP page for her and so I took a chance. I'll never do that again. She is the rudest, least understanding teacher I've ever had. DURING A PANDEMIC. She doesn't explain any assignment then yells at us for failing it. Her comments make no sense so you can't improve. AVOID!!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This is my 3rd degree at UM, and I've never had a professor who just reads from the slides like Dr. W.  Pathophysiology is all about "why" and "how", but I feel like she skips over those explanations.  I think it would be more beneficial to stay home, read the slides yourself, and read the book or watch videos for further explanation.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Show up to class listen to her lecture and you'll get an A. Quizzes are easy points and have 2 attempts. there is a group project which was easy.

Dr. Wunder reads off of the PowerPoints word for word for the entire lecture. She gives a content outline like others have said but it's very vague. Tests come from the PowerPoints. Waste of time, don't go to class. Such an important class and she doesn't even teach, you have to teach yourself.

you will have to be self taught. she gives you a content outline for each exam and this is what is on the test. test r str8 forward and she curves test grade. very friendly and does not make the class harder than what it has to be

Professor blatantly reads off slides and is clear she does not understand the information she is lecturing. Appears as though she has a complete disinterest in the course. Provides exam outlines that follow the exam exactly. You will be completely self taught in this course. Stopped going to lecture because it was a waste of time.

Get a good lab group for this class. 60% of the grade comes from group lab reports. Lectures are largely irrelevant, but occasionally interesting. 20% of the grade is in-class iClicker questions, so don't skip. 10% individual project. 10% individual paper. Don't buy the book unless you still have it from 241.

Dr. Wong is one of the few good professors I had in engineering. Very enthusiastic about his work and channels that enthusiasm well. Be aware though, that the class is not a cakewalk; you have to put in the hours. Got an A.

Thermo 1 (took year and a half ago) has provided fundamental knowledge, and has helped me succeed in Dr. Wong's other two classes, MAE404 and MAE420.  By understanding the laws of thermodynamics, practicing with digital tables, and asking Dr. Wong questions, I became much more prepared to solve complex engineering problems.

Applied Thermo gives students a chance to practice knowledge learned in thermo 1 in real world, practical scenarios.  Dr. Wong uses the textbook and clearly solves example problems from it in class.  Homeworks are based on examples and incorporate digital ttps tables.  Interesting topics include power cycles, psychrometrics, and compressible flow.

MAE404 is an interesting class that focuses on team based lab experiments spanning the mechanical and aerospace engineering curriculum.  Dr. Wong is very knowledgeable and passionate about the subject, and answers any questions students may have about the experiments.  Class incorporates MATLAB and technical paper writing in projects.

Applied Thermodynamics with Dr. Wong is a higly interactive class. Through the use of electronic tables, understanding the principles of thermodynamics is fast and easy. I highly recommend taking this class.
Wong is very helpful.  He also writes very good recommendations for jobs, grad school appllications, etc.

Extremely helpful in understanding the laws of thermodynamics in real world applications.  Use of a professional software to obtain thermodynamic properties was very convenient. Teacher is fair and approachable.

I took Applied thermo last spring with Dr. Wong. It was very useful but be prepared to spend some time on this class. It's a small class and therefore lots of participation. The work itself is very useful, specially if you have interest in a career in energy. Very interesting well taught class, would encourage anyone to take it.

I took Thermo 1 a year ago and it was one of the more useful classes I took at Miami. Dr. Wong is a good professor and is very interested in the subject. Not a tough class as long as you pay attention and read the book at least once. Walked out with an A without much difficulty and would recommend to anyone without hesitation.
Professor knows materials and knows how to transmit to students. Good professor, and examinations are easy if you do the homeworks and pay attention to what he says in class
When I took his class, his textbook was very good because Dr. Wong followed it closely.  You need to derive the missing parts, to get the most out of it!
I found his lectures and textbook very clear.  You need to participate in class, and get good iClicler scores too.
really good class, extreme useful if you really want to study well in mechanical engineering.
Thermo wasn't as bad as I expected.  Dr. Wong is very clear, so if you go to class and do the problems, you'll be alright
Good lecturer, fair grader. Just need to show up and pay attention and put forth some effort to complete assignments and you will be okay.
When I took this class, he was fair with grading.

Professor promoted interest and applications of theory in real world engineering. Helped the students think outside the box to provide tools for real world applications. Also the research paper is very helpful to understand new concepts and  applications of research in industry.

All the courses I took from him, I learned a lot and liked very much.  His style of teaching is powerful.  It is the question and answer style. Makes you prepare for classes and participate, not just sit back and take notes. His Intermediate Fluid Mechanics course is well suited for grads. Excellent professor recommended for all serious students!
Helpful to students.Learned a lot from his classes.
He's a....shall we say interesting...person. But he's not always very clear. He's helpful but makes you feel stupid. Tough grader.

This teacher gets a lot of negative feedback, but he is not that bad.  Make friends with him, become interested, and pay attention, and the class is not that hard.  Show him you want to work and be there and it is simple.
Pretty straightforward... tests can be very different from what he teaches. Get old tests and you will be fine.

Teaches at a rapid pace and never waits for students to grasp the material before moving on. Doesn't take questions seriously, always answers halfway and then rushes off (when there are no other students waiting to ask questions or raise their hands). I even believe the TA is a better teacher than he is. The teaching technique is flawed.

Dr. Wu's heart is most definitely in the class. He is very passionate with his lectures, however his accent and teaching ability comes to question. I took a 100 level lab and he often made simple concepts seem impossible to comprehend, often relying on our TA to direct what should be simple labs. The overcomplications often lead to wasted time.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: This lab was a nightmare. Each week was a new level of confusion. Dr. Wu and our TA disagreed on methods for every lab, instructions were unclear, and we were left to figure out at home after not achieving any significant progress during the lab section. What was supposed to be a fun intro lab was the bane of my semester.
No educational value of this class when he teaches it

This is the worst class I have ever taken in my life. Avoid at all possible costs. After having taken the MSC Unholy Trinity of Wu, Suman, and Meltzoff, I can safely say that Wu is the worst of the worst. You'll never know what's going on. You've got to write down every word he says to answer the homework and even then he'll tell you wrong info.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Wu grades based on how much he likes you based off of his arbitrary participation grade , and not on any legitimate grading criteria. Wu is not teaching next semester, and it is clear why he has been replaced. The administrations is aware that Wu is a weak professor.

The only reason I gave Wu a 2 and not a 1 is because he is genuinely passionate about this stuff. With that, this class is hard. If you do well on the quizzes you'll likely get an A in the class as he heavily curves the tests and the final grade. Its a struggle to pay attention in his class, but try and write down what he says is important.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Wu falsely accused me of academic dishonesty three times during lab class. While he was falsely accusing me of cheating in his class, he encouraged cheating in his lecture class by asking students to pay him money though a shady website for his solution manual. He falsely accuses students to divert the attention away from his own dishonesty.

Literally the worst class I have ever taken at UM, Wu offers little help or resources for the class (terrible power points and no book). Doing well on quizzes is solely based on your memorization skills rather than actually learning anything. You'll survive.

Wu is a rough professor. His lectures are heavy on his personal research and he strays away from the main topics often. The tests and quizzes are inconsistent with each other and questions are phrased poorly. He calculated my friends grade wrong and has not corrected it even though he acknowledged it. He gave a pop final exam which is not allowed.
AWESOME

Even though people say you can't understand anything he says, he's a good guy with great hair.  Textbook was written by the guy who used to teach the course, and the answers to half our work are still being researched, so you're not really learning anything concrete, but at least he cares.  Also, you might die of boredom.
Solid Prof

His lectures are EXTREMELY thorough! He covers everything super clearly. He has a thick accent, but is understandable. He posts all of his lecture notes online, and they're so thorough, you wont need to take notes in class. Exams are very similar to his posted practice exams, and hw is pretty much right out of the online notes. No reason to do bad

I'm shocked to see such a low rating for Chunzan. He is ACTUALLY the best professor I've taken at UM. His lectures are clear, well-organized and very interesting. He's very good at explaining concepts and will always explain thoroughly if someone has a question. He is a BRILLIANT guy but doesn't ask too much of his students. Not to mention, nice.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: If you work hard enough, this will be an easy class

Do not take this course unless you are a calculus wizard. The problem sets take hours, make no sense, and do not match up with his lectures. You will not like this class or learn anything without an extreme understanding of advanced calculus. Nobody in class ever has any idea of what is going on...
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Easy class if you pay attention. Homework and practice exams are similar to the actual exams. He has some accent but clearly cares about his students and is willing to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: This is absolutely the worst class I have ever taken. The teacher does no work at all. He copies the textbook into lectures and his homework is copied from either UPENN or another school. The material does not match and he gives no guidance or help. He has a thick accent that is impossible to understand and talks fast. He also is avery harsh grader
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. His accent is so thick and difficult to understand. His problem sets make no sense and make up 30% of your grade. When you ask him a question he doesn't really answer it and doesn't guide his students at all.

Reads off powerpoint slides for the entire class. Does not teach the material well. Difficult to understand. Assigns 3 problem sets per semester that the student is left to figure out on their own with no guidance. Tests and Problem sets are the entire grade and are very harshly graded. You will learn nothing and work hard for a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: A great professor for architecture drawing... very helpful and not really difficult as long as you want to learn and show your full effort. Also a very talented professional in both art and architecture

Definitely not the easiest BUT I learned a LOT! Participate & do your work and she will give you crit time. If not (one of my classmates) she will not give you much. FYI - pops in outside of class, even weekends, to see who is working in studio.
Is very very confusing at times. Leads you to do something only to correct you. Could be very good, but doesn't try hard enough.
Great professor. Knows what he is talking about, very smart. Course is not easy. It is demanding but doable. Very generous with partial credit. Makes class interesting and engaging.

Very smart. Knows his material. Makes class engaging and interesting. He knows what he is talking about. Class was somewhat difficult. Very generous with partial credit points. Great professor overall.

I did more work in this class than all my other MBA courses combined for the semester. His quizzes are tough and if you don't have a solid accounting background going into this course, you'll be taken for a loop. He's a nice guy, although a little too uptight.

One of the best teachers around. He is very tough but makes the material interesting to learn. He is one of the few teachers at the university that you feel like you want to learn from. Definitely a really smart guy and will push you to learn a lot.

He is a nice guy.. passionate about what he is doing. But he never gets all the way through the teaching he has prepared for any particular class. He kind of high sometimes, especially with the final project. But he lets you use a note sheet on the exam and curves at the end.

The best prof here and the reason I declared a major in French and I know several others who did just because of her. She does more than teach you, she transforms the way you think. French at UM will not be the same without her.

Mme Xavier is an amazing French teacher. She has high standards but is incredibly helpful and understanding. I wasn't the best student, yet she continued to push and encourage me until my work was actually good. She just gets it. The class is hard, but you'd be a fool not to take it. I got a C and I still adore this woman.

Among the very few best professor's I've ever had at UM. She's extremely passionate about everything she taught in Francophone Cultures class and you see it clearly. A lot of reading and expectations and I've always been the type to go for an easy A but I enjoyed every minute I spent doing work for her class because it was all sincere learning.

Dr. Xavier is the ideal young, modern professor. She is extremely hands-on and knows how to make the texts relevant to life. That being said, she does make you think and expects quality work, even if that means turning in an assignment late. She will get to know all her students and expects you to be honest with yourself and her.

She is the secret weapon of the Modern Languages department, the best professor hands down. You will learn more in one semester than you do after years in other classes... but she is super demanding and you have to go to class. Smart, pretty, sweet... but makes you work for your grade!

Dr. Xavier is one of the most enthusiastic and hard-core professors I've ever had. She is demanding, it is true. You'll probably have more work for her class than any of your others. However, she is an amazing teacher and really makes things interesting. The texts that we read were fascinating, although bear in mind there is a lot of lit analysis.

She is extremely helpful, but it is a very demanding class. I think she forgets that our 214 class is not one of her upper level french literature classes. There is a lot of writing and literary analysis, and your french will definitely improve. However this class required more work than any of the classes in my major

She is definitely not an easy teacher, but you leave her class having learned a lot more about french politics and french in general. She helped improve my writing so much.There is a lot of work for my classes and she will definitely challenge you, no matter your level. You must be ready for the challenge.

Great teacher who really works hard and makes class interesting.  I took French African lit. because it was the only french course that fit my schedule but it ended up being one of my favorite courses ever.  Definitely the best professor I've had at UM

extremely helpful, nice, esygoing and understanding.... it is a lot of work but shes very helpful and gives allowances... very knowledgeable and sweet and still very motivated... she makes you want to come to class

she's awesome it's just a lot of work. three essays for the class and 5 outlines that are graded harshly, but very fairly. you do get a writing credit, though. and no exams! class discussion every class meeting and several small in class group work, but not a big deal.
She's great...young new teacher here, lots of great ideas, very interesting, really pulls meaning from the literature. Its work, but definitely helped my french.
She is super sweet and the class use a software to do social media simulation which is fun to do. Easy grader, just do every homework and participate well in the simulation, you will get an A.

She is super sweet but her lectures are pretty boring. Thankfully she knows that students taking this class aren't math majors so she makes it easier. She goes over how to do the homework in class and as long as you take notes from the lectures you will be fine for the quizzes/exams.

Professor Jia is super kind and really cares about her students- she turned one of the exams into a take home exam so we had multiple days to complete it because she was worried about students' mental health. All quizzes and exams were open notes. Had a few homework assignments, but she normally did them with us during class.
Very accessible. However, a little too demanding.

Professor Xie is a great math, though her speaking is not crystal clear it is understandable and she prints out notes for each chapter that is gone over in class. NO BOOK!! Test are challenging, HMWK(sometimes graded), drops lowest quiz, and is extremely nice!! She carse about her students and learning! Great Teacher!

Professor Xie's class was many things: difficult, hard to understand, vague and very demanding. Despite this, Professor Xie is a very nice women who is ALWAYS willing to help if you are a studious student. She will not cater to you if you do not pay attention and do not show an effort. She is always in her office willing to help. Very hard class.

Do not take! I do not recommend her at all! She made my semester so much more stressful than need be. I would recommend anyone else. She is nice enough, but English is too big of a language gap and her class is too boring to really be able to pay attention. GO ELSEWHERE

ABSOLUTELY DO NOT TAKE THIS TEACHER. I promise you, you will regret it.  She is horrible and has no business teaching. It is disgusting that the school hires professors as terrible as her. You are better off taking one less class just to get out of her section! She is appalling.
STAY AS FAR AWAY FROM THIS TEACHER AS YOU POSSIBLY CAN. NO JOKE, AVOID TAKING THIS CLASS AT ALL COSTS.  I ensure you that you will regret ever enrolling in her section, I promise.

Awful.  It is an embarrassment that the school lets her teach here.  She did a great job of making the class boring, useless, and uninspiring.  Never allows for time for extra review problems.  Instead we had to learn about a chapter that wasn't even on the final.  Nice lady, but she is in the wrong profession.

It would help if the instructor knew English better.  She has trouble communicating with the students much of the time, especially when we have questions that she doesn't understand.  When she doesn't understand our questions, she ignores them and moves on.  The communication barrier makes this class much more difficult than it actually is.
She is from China and does not speak very good english, but she is very smart and is very willing to help you if you make an effort.  She grades homework and has weekly quizes. Final was hard.

She knows her subject area extremely well but is not good at teaching it.  Homework is strictly graded and is worth more than quizzes.  Can be helpful if you go to her office hours, but is still very hard to understand and does not explain things clearly.  The final was very difficult.  Try to avoid if you can...

Math is like this womans first language - however english isn't even on her list.  VERY BORING - and her final is impossible!!!  Avoid at all costs.  Homework and quizes not impossible - but don't reflect the final and midterm at all!!!  Nice lady - terrible teacher.

DO NOT UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCES TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. I would rather drop out of school then take this teacher again.  She absolutely ruined an entire semester for me just from her one class alone. I am appalled that my tuition money goes to pay a teacher this terrible.  She is unreasonable and lacks any ability to teach a class. DO NOT TAKE HER

She is super nice and the class is not hard if you study with the review she gives you. Super easy to go to class but it is not mandatory unless you want a grade bump at the end. Easy class tho and she's always answering emails within like one minute. Your grade is two out of the three midterms you take and a final project and the final.
Good class. enjoyable. Make sure you show up for reviews and tests.

She is a great professor, sometimes I have difficulty understanding her, but she tries to help all her students. Lectures can also be boring sometimes but not worse than other econ classes. The course is easy if you put in the work; if you show up to class, you will 100% receive an A. Overall she's a great teacher, and I would take her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hes really nice and gives a lot of chances to improve our grades

No pop quizzes. He grades fairly. You can redo your hmwk and get a better grade. If you do the practices on his ppt you will get a good grade on the exam. His lectures could be boring but the course itself is boring. His lectures and class notes are very helpful. He is also super helpful during office hours. REALLY wants his student to succeed!

He's definitely improved a lot and makes it very possible to get a good grade in the class. Makes it very clear what will be on the tests. Fairly easy concepts if you have stats experience from high school.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: amazing professor. made the class a lot easier this semester. total of about 7 homework graded for accuracy around every 2 weeks. theres 4 quizzes (2 are take home) and he drops the lowest quiz grade. hard information but he really wants his students to do well.

Jason is an interesting professor. His lectures are boring, straight from powerpoint notes, and does examples that are more confusing than his notes and are not helpful. One homework each week, can be hard to figure out but answers questions in class. Quizzes aren't too bad just study. Not my favorite, but not horrible.
He is very nice to students, and give us a lot opportunities to improve our score.
Standard stats class. If you put in the work it's not too bad.

He's definitely not the greatest teacher but to me it seems like most people in this class expect it to be a very easy class. The class is tough and his pop quizzes are annoying but the tests and pop quizzes are pretty much the exact same questions as the homeworks and practice tests with different numbers. Thick accent but no the worst teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: WORST professor I've ever had. He does not answer people's questions in class. He doesn't grade consistently with students (some people get partial credit and some don't for writing the exact same thing). Tests and quizzes are impossible. I would never wish this prof upon anyone. AVOID AT ALL COSTS
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: This class just makes no sense idk if its because of the teacher or the curriculum but don't take this class ever its awful

She is a very good professor who deeply cares about her students. The topic in itself is kind of confusing but she tries her best to explain everything as best as she can. I would highly recommend taking her, she is super caring about her students.
She is super friendly and understanding.

Avoid. She refuses to answer emails and is not reachable. Her teaching style does not help with material understanding. Very much a sink or swim mentality and I honestly found the class extremely disappointing.

She is wonderful! She has so much enthusiasm for philosophy of mind, which really helped wake me up at 9 AM. She loves when people participate and likes debating/having conversations about views she doesn't agree with too, which kept class interesting. Gives plenty of structure for the two papers but also allows you to propose a topic if you want.
reviews.rating_tags: Inspirational--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She's very nice and not a super tough grader. The class consists of 2 papers 8 pages each, easy homework points, and attendance/participation. She really loves when the class participates and tries hard to get people engaged in the convo. Missing a few classes definitely doesn't hurt your grade, but don't miss too many. Good lecturer and fair.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He gave me an A+ on every paper I managed to sh*t out the night before. His lectures were pretty interesting (coming from a guy who hates philosophy). Take his class for an easy A.

This is my only class on Fridays or before noon and I still look forward to coming. I was actually planning to drop the class at the beginning of the semester but liked it so much I ended up keeping it. I never have a problem paying attention and actually wish the class was longer. In class discussions are very interesting.

Very passionate about his lectures and uses current media related topics to help us better understand the content. He is very open minded and easy to connect with. Professor Yelle looks to have everyone succeed in his course, and does his best to make sure everyone is heard and understands the materials. Awesome professor, I highly recommend him!

He is a really nice guy, but very easily got confused with even his own teaching(especially the logic part.) When people asking tricky questions, he can be easily lead astray, even if somebody gives the right explanation. His class was super boring, and gave pop quizzes. I won't recommend taking his class, but if you have to, he is not horrible at least.

nice guy but took the course WAY TOO SERIOUSLY. In a 101 level made it like it was a 300 level. Even with reading the book and going to class still not guaranteed to do well. His tests were VERY objective and gives out pop quizzes randomly that don't reflect anything you are reading or being taught. so basically DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS
Awesome.
Curses like a sailor and is very opinionated, but overall pretty interesting and keeps you awake. Definitely recommend for an easy, enjoyable class

This class is my only 8 AM and it's the only one I actually look forward to going to! Ben is really fun to listen to and is really helpful with his students! He helped me on my midterm assignment, which wasn't too bad. There's weekly quizzes but they're not that hard and other than that a midterm and final...take this class you won't regret it!

Super easy class and somewhat interesting. Ben likes to push his liberal views but at least teaches the material and all of his test are open book online quizzes with 2 easy projects for the midterm and final. I recommend for the easy grade and subject even if you can't sit through the preaching.

He can't spell for his life, and he's practically useless before he's had his coffee, but his class is fun, and it's worth being awake at 8 in the morning. He manages to teach a subject with a high possibility of being hugely boring in a way that makes it fun and interesting. Not really a serious class, but definitely a good time.
very nice professor but extremely poor teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She cannot teach an intro level course (or any course for that matter). Only 10 people show up to class as sitting there is simply a waste of time. She often says "I don't know how to explain this" while laughing. No one finds that funny. The exams and homework are questions taken from Yale, Harvard, and MIT (confirmed this herself). DO NOT TAKE!!!

she is a new professor and is nice but does not know how to teach and teaches material thta is wayy too difficult for an intro class. the tutors at the camner center have no idea how to help any of us with her class as it is too difficult for them to understand
this class is impossible with her, most difficult professor of all time
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This is without a doubt the worst professor that I have ever taken. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. She is a completely ineffective teacher, has taught the wrong material the entire semester, and makes easy concepts way too difficult for an intro class. The entire class would fail if it weren't for the hw being worth 60% of the grade. Don't even consider.

Do not take this professor. I'm serious. She's very nice and very good at stats, but she cannot teach. She doesn't know how to explain any math concept except the way she knows how to do it which is very advanced and difficult. If you ask her to explain something she will not explain it well at all. Just take someone else.

The most difficult professor at University of miami.  She does not know how to teach, has poor handwriting, makes all the exams extremely difficult.  Expect to do poorly on all exams.  She gives midterm practice guides that are not similar to the questions on the exams.  50% of the class has failed both midterms that we have had so far.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Good class
Some of the test questions were challenging, but if you pay attention in her class they were covered by her lectures. She was very accommodating throughout the semester.

Professor Yoh is such a wonderful teacher! She is kind, caring, and understanding of her students. Professor Yoh teaches the materials in a way that kept me engaged and interested. Would take any and every class with her :)
So nice to us and such a fun class!!!

Taking this class with Professor Yoh was the best decision I've made. She is the kindest soul who made sociology so engaging and accessible. I truly learned so much and enjoyed myself doing it. I'm highly considering pursuing a PhD in sociology myself thanks to her.
She was so sweet and accommodating. The only class I enjoyed this semester.
don't waste your time on him

Professor Ying is such a gem to Frost. He is a very young professor, and in spite of his illustrious performance career and his incredible skill, he remains one of the most gentle, caring and modest men I know. He takes his time with his piano students, lecturing mostly on finding their personal sound. His musicality is such an inspiration to all.
Highly recommend Professor Ying. He is one of the best pianists I ever heard!! Very shy and modest man, but friendly and kind.

He is a really good professor, but you have to practice to get a lot out of lessons with him.  He has amazing way of interpreting music and transferring that musicality and technique to students.  Wish I had all the time to practice and cover more repertoire with him....
I'm learning so much from him-I think he's the best at UM in the piano faculty--i would highly recommend him--he's really inspiring--especially his playing.
Great professor and pianist!
he's really good.
Excellent DMA essay editor.  Offers in-depth suggestions and devotes alot of time to recital/lecture/paper preparation.
really good professor--pays attention to details in performing.  makes you work so hard to be better performer.
he's ok
Incredible professor and pianist.  You learn so much with his teaching.  You're lucky if you ever have a lesson or study with him.
PSY190 - If you need a one credit psych class, take her! she's so sweet, all you need to do is read a short research article, and write a one page paper on it. 10/10 recommend her.

Dr. Kim is a wonderful person and very accessible outside of class. Her lectures were pretty boring to be honest and her exams were difficult but the paper helps to balance out exam scores. Not my favorite class but a good choice for an upper level psych. Interesting topic but most of your learning will come from textbook readings

I enjoyed professor Kim's class a lot. She is funny and kind. The class material is interesting and easy to understand but some of the questions on the exams can be difficult. She gives extra credit opportunities and there is a huge paper due at the end of the semester

Prof Young is incredibly nice & accessible to students. She lets you turn in any assignment late- up until the final- with no penalty. She tries to make the lectures interesting with personal stories & by engaging with students. She answers emails and tries to get to know you (if you make an effort as well). She brings candy every class. Show up!

Easy teacher. Very nice lady. The class is however set up for you to fail but you pass with the curve at the end of the semester. Everyone fails the mid-term so don't worry about that. Majority of your grade is the group presentation that you present at the end of the semester.
Probably one of the worst professors at the U. Does not teach. Does not help. But she does answer emails.
By far my best teacher ever, perfect person, perfect lecture!
Best teacher.

She is a very easy professor. I have to say that the content of this class is stupid, and she has done a good job making it less painful. I got an A in this class but I don't know how I got it. Nice professor.

Professor Young is one of the best for MGT 100. Its a basic class and she understands that and does her best to make it go by and keep the students entertained. She makes sure that students who participate get a good grade.

She is a nice teacher, but I didn't learn hardly anything in the class. At the end of the semester, kids that got higher grades on every test than me ended up getting lower grades, leaving all of us wondering how the grading works.
She's the best teacher anyone could ask for. chill, relax, and you can get a good grade if you try semi-hard.
Gives candy every class. She is VERY understanding and nice and lets the class out early most of the time. She's the easiest and most laid back management professor.
shes amazing. so nice . and always give out candy

The class is chill, but the grading scale is harsh. She told us she wants to give us good grade for the class, but at the end of the semester she told us the class average is a B. I don't think B is that good of a grade.
She is very nice. She wants everyone to get good grades. However, I couldn't honestly tell you what the point of the class was

One of the nicest teachers I've ever had! She always has a giant bag of candy that gets passed around during class and she gave us all Starbucks gift cards for doing presentations. MGT 100 is a joke of a class though, everyone knows it, but it's mandatory. Very often she'll end class early.

Really really nice guy. Cares about the students learning although he is not always easy to understand. He knows his English is not the best so he lets you know exactly what to expect on the exams. Attendance is not mandatory but I recommend going to class because he tells you exact questions on the exam to reward attendance.

nicest guy in the world... but you need a translator for class. If you put in 50% effort its an A... a little bit is a B. But beware, you can fail this class if you fall behind with the online stuff. take it!

Easy class and I'm not even a business major. EXTREMELY HARD TO UNDERSTAND! And he gets lost himself sometimes. Don't buy the text book just do the quizzes and study hard. I'm getting an A in this class and i never took ECO 211. GO FIGURE!
Easy class! DO NOT buy the textbook, you don't need it at all! My only complaint is that I wish I didn't take this class at 8am and I wish he spoke English...

Max is the best professor at UM. he doesnt speak the clearest english but he is extremely helpful and as long a you show the slightest interest its an easy A. 85% of his tests you already have seen the exact same question.
attend most of his class.super easy A.
EASSSSSSSSSSSSSSY!!!

He may be nice but he is so boring! He teaches you that material but the quizzes are more complex. I new the being material so that was easy but towards the end i didn't learn much that will stay with me. Also his handwriting is bad.

Max is a really nice guy and definitely means well. Not the best of teachers, but always makes sure you know he's always available for help. Do not buy the text book, you won't need it since he never assigns anything out of it. His accent is not too bad, definitely understandable. You will be fine if you take him, but I hear petit-frere is the man

Great Teacher! Hard to understand at times, and class can get boring, but overall Yongmin (Max) is a great teacher. He is always willing to help and if he needs to he will change his office hours to accommodate the class. Problems sets are very simple and so are the tests. Take him if you have the opportunity, you won't regret it.

I really like Zang. His accent is that bad at all. He is a funny guy and really knows what he is talking about. He is very helpful during class and during office hours.Book isn't necessary but it does help you understand the subject though. Overall, I would recommend Zang.

Attendance not mandatory. Really nice guy, but not a good teacher. I had an excrutiatingly difficult time understanding his English and eventually just gave up. So it made for a VERY boring class. But he definitely has your best interests at heart and will go out of his way to make you pass. Emphasizes often that he is readily available to help you

Max is a great guy. He loves to help people out and does the best that he can to teach the material, but it is really hard to understand him sometimes. He also gives you lots of opportunities to get a good grade, including extra credit and outrageous curves.
Very nice guy. Cares about his class. Attendance isn't mandatory. The class is based off power points, and you basically teach yourself economics. But he can teach you how to talk chinese!
Nice guy, likes abercrombie and fitch, can teach you chinese if you ask him too but struggles to answer economics questions.

Professor Chen is very invested in his field and expect his student to be the same as well. I would highly recommend this class if you want to learn something, not just for an easy cognate. However, if you really follow his instructions you will get an A. You probably shouldn't take this class if you're not a philosophy student tho.

Professor Chen is an odd individual. You won't learn a single thing in one of his classes. His grading system is extremely meticulous, so don't expect an easy A. As a 4th year philosophy major, I strongly recommend taking a different professor.
Professor Chen is great! He is kind and respectful. His class was very interesting and easy.

Professor Chen is a grad student. He's a cool guy and you'll probably pass. The class was kind of boring. 60% of the grade is 1 paper (20% the first draft and 40% the final draft). 30% was 6 weekly prompts and 10% was attendance.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Idk how to feel about her really. On one hand, she gives hard quizzes that don't actually matter so her class was generally easy. But her people skills were not there. I finished with an 89.5 and she would not round it up despite her admitting I was one of the better students she had. If you take notes on a computer she assumes you're shopping also
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Not sure why there are so many negative reviews about her; she's not the easiest professor at UM but I've certainly had worse.  Quizzes are difficult but if you study the textbook/powerpoint ahead of time it's not too bad, exams and projects weren't that hard though.  She's also chill in person and very helpful in office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Unprofessional, stands and read the entire course from a piece of paper... I can read the same paper at home. Avoid her at all costs. Classes are mandatory but then at the end of the course she doesn't give credit for your attendance.

This class really upset me. I wish I did not have to go but I HAD TO because attendance is mandatory. The topic is already dull as it is and she makes it worse. There were so many tedious assignments and I did not learn anything. Please do not take her.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Awful professor. My 12 year old sister could teach this class better than she can. Class ends early every week (so you don't learn anything and have to figure out how to study for exams and quizzes) and she plays videos about the textbook instead of teaching. Worst class I have ever taken. Please take someone else.
She just reads off a powerpoint everyday and then gives tests on the textbook and not her PowerPoints Not a good teacher

She's terrible. You learn nothing, which makes you want to skip class, BUT you can't because she is insanely strict about attendance. Does not care about her students or the class she teaches. Do not take her.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Awful instructor, the worst ever. Her lazy teaching method is embarrassing. She makes class boring and dreadful but attendance in mandatory. Do not take this woman. You will regret it.

Worst professor at UM. She does not explain anything and expects us to test on it the next class. Be ready to study all the material on your own. 

Research project is most part of the grade and she is never willing to help you out nor explain how to do the steps correctly. Always with a bad attitude.

This is the worst course and Professor I have ever taken. I mean it. This woman does not care about her students. No PowerPoints, no handouts... In class, all she does is read the key terms from the textbook. Class ends early almost every time. Very unprofessional professor. That's all I have to say.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Worst class I have ever taken. How does one ruin kahoot? Take this class to find out

Dr. Holmes is the worst. She talks down to us like we're in primary school. The way she interacts with us makes us afraid to engage. She never taught and I didn't really learn anything in this class that I didn't teach myself. She tells us on the syllabus to participate in the marketing lab for extra credit but then doesn't actually take them.

I don't have much to say about Dr. Holmes except that she is friendly and an easy grader. Attendance is effectively 100% mandatory because there is a quiz everyday. She does not teach the subject well at all and it's very evident that she puts in as little effort as possible. I'm sure she's a smart woman but you can tell class is her last priority.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Really strict about showing up to class; I didnt learn much but if you want an easy A this is the class to take

Prof. Holmes is a g. You definitely need to go to class because she is strict with attendance and participation, but the material is so easy. She will give you a 100 on all assignments and exams if you write something relevant and use key terms. Study the topics she gives in review sessions and you'll be fine.

Such an unpleasant professor. She's so strict about participation and kicks students out of Zoom class if they're not paying attention. Only good thing is that the material is easy and she's not a tough grader. Horrible personality.

Profesora Gavela is amazing!! She really wants her students to improve their Spanish, and she makes class really interesting. There is A LOT of homework and the entire class is in Spanish, but if you put in the effort and participate in class discussion, you will get an A. She was my favorite teacher at UM so far!
Dra Gavela is an INCREDIBLE professor. I would advise everybody to take her. She is the sweetest woman and hands down, the best professor I have had at UM so far.
She was so helpful, kind, approachable. Hands-down one of the best Spanish teachers I have had at this school. It was an intimidating class, but it was so worth it.

The class was a lot of work but if you put in the effort you can do well, and she makes it worthwhile by giving you a great class if you keep up with it.  She's incredibly smart and engaging, not to mention an entirely friendly, sweet person.  One of my favorite profs at UM, and the class was one of the hardest and most rewarding I've ever taken.

Professor Gavela is one of my favorite professors at the University of Miami. She loves what she teaches which makes her class engaging and interesting. She is also incredibly friendly. I recommend her to everyone!

I ended up dropping her class because it was that difficult. She was teaching the native speakers class EXACTLY THE SAME WAY as the non-native speakers 301 class...totally unfair in my opinion. Very nice lady though, approachable, and willing to help.
Prof. Gavela was an incredible teacher!!! She's extremely knowledgeable and willing to help!

Is not that bad, but he do be kind of harsh( However, I am taking another CNJ216 this semester with another professor which is harsh as well, so I guess maybe it's not his problem). Not very clear about the topics but you do learn stuffs from him.

Very nice, caring man.  Very unclear on directions. One day will tell you to write one way, then the next you get points off for following his directions. Tough grader. Expects too much of his students.

WORST professor I have EVER had. Contradicts himself multiple times a class session. Very unclear and unhelpful but loves to pick on students and blame them for his unpreparedness and unclear directions. Very unfair grading. Makes students grade each others tests in class.

Colon really isn't that bad. His accent makes understanding him occasionally difficult but he has plenty of experience as a journalist. the assignments weren't long, although he is a tough grader. He taught me valuable lessons about storytelling. There's no textbook so this class isn't about memorization. It's about writing.
Definitely do not take! Best advice I promise.

This man makes my blood boil. He made me frustrated every day of class. He never assigns anything, just makes you look at his rubric which is all out of order. And then he decides that the class doesn't have to do an assignment but never tells you. He has no ability to notice style or flair in writing, just grades for grammar. Avoid at all costs.

I don't get this guy.  What does he have to be so upset about?  He doesn't try to make it fun, he tries to make it painful.  And trust me, it is. If it wasn't for the dumb quizzes every day, I wouldn't go No one's taking his class as an elective, I don't get why he doesn't even try to stimulate interest.  Don't take him.

Horrible Teacher. He has no rubric for his grading. If he likes your paper, then you get a decent grade. You can work your ass off and it wouldn't matter. He doesn't take into account the fact that you have other classes. If you can avoid him, I recommend it.
Simply expects too much from you. I love the idea of this class, but I simply don't have the time to be successful. Nearly impossible to get a good grade, which is frustrating.

He acts as if his class is your whole world and thus has unrealistic expectations.  He has no problem failing your papers and hard work is not rewarded.  He does have plenty of field experience though.
I would take this class again, one of the best professors I've ever had.

(took cos 391) This professor was honestly great. The material is not easy, but they explain it in a way that actually makes sense and doesn't feel overwhelming. The assignments were really interactive and kept me engaged instead of just doing busy work. I also liked how some of the assignments were more personal. Overall, I learned a lot!

Megan is the chillest professor I've had at UM so dar. Her classes feel more like a good conversation than a lecture, which I greatly appreciated and feel like it has helped me retain information better. No homework, extremely doable projects, amazing topics, and overall a class that will help anyone become a better person and communicator.
SHES AMAZING. She's the nicest professor ever. The class is really interesting, you learn a lot. She gives engaging lectures. Her class is really easy, I highly recommend.
BEST professor I have had at UM! She is amazing and super understanding of her students. The class is super interesting and fun. Highly recommend!

I had a great experience taking two courses of Professor Zangeneh and she was the absolute best! Her lectures are interesting and thought out as well as fun and engaging! Great professor and amazing person!

Professor Younkin is a GREAT statistics professor. He outlines material clearly and makes rather complicated concepts very simple. Although easy, you will learn a lot about statistical analysis. He teaches based on grounded business applications. EVERYTHING is posted online - lecture notes, past  current quizzes and exams, and helpful documents.

I hate this class, but he's a nice guy. I never thought a twice a week class would be too much, but I was proven wrong. Super boring, but the previous tests are online, and if you can do those problems you are fine. We never used the textbook. He is super precise about what needs to go into the projects, so be careful on that.

Very practical course. I learned a lot about analyzing problems and writing business reports involving statistics. At first I thought that the projects in a math class were weird, but they proved to be the best part of the class.

Decent professor. The projects, particularly the group project (in a math class, really??), are really annoying. When he starts teaching using mainly minitab, he starts glossing over small details in favor of the bigger picture, unfortunately you're still responsible for those small details. Still, not a difficult class, and he's a cool enough guy.
The class is pretty hard, but if you go to his office hours he'll really help you learn the material which makes the tests and quizzes substantially teacher. Overall great teacher

IF you took stat in HS, this class is the easiest A possible. If not, may want to look elsewhere. Has last semester's quiz/test online. 3 exams (40%), 1 cumulative final (25%), 2 projects (20%), 6 quizzes (15%)...drops your lowest 2. Attendance not mandatory. All notes are on blackboard. Easiest A by far BUT only because I had prior knowledge

Is sometimes not clear when presenting content, but is more than willing to help. Minitab projects are useless, but are really easy to get a A on. I bombed the first test (a review of MAS201) but got A's on everything else. If you do better on your final compared to a prior test, he will drop your lowest test score and double your final grade!
hardest class ever. avoid
He has high expectations of students' knowledge of minitab upon entering his class. Can be a bit useless at times

Dr. Younkin has great knowledge and enthusiasm for statistics. He focuses on what you need to know to do well in the business world. Provides an exceptional amount of support material. You don't really need the book. Great professional preparation. Take him!
Finally! I understand this stuff. Was lost when I entered his class and he helped me put it all together!
