I would not take him if you have a choice. His tests are not that hard, but he makes the class so boring! His handwriting is very hard to understand. The only plus side to his class is that he gives the previous quiz's and exams on blackboard to study.  I basically taught myself the entire class.
Best Professor ever!
Great professor in general.  I took him for both 201 & 202 and couldn't ask for a better understanding of the material.  Plus, his tests/quizzes are easy.  Take him.

He is an AMAZING teacher. I don't care how boring his class is. I barely passed my previous stats class but after taking Younkin, I now know so much more about stats. He's willing to stay after and answer questions and his tests/quizzes are almost identical to the ones from the previous semesters.  Take him!!!
Great guy.  Really wants his students to learn. No homework, just understand the problems he does in class and study his old tests which he posts on blackboard. Good Class

A very useful professor to have if you plan to go into business. I learned a lot about presenting statistical data...however I am still hazy on how exactly I got there sans MiniTab. Prof. Younkin is a nice guy - be sure to check out the facebook pic. Just put some effort into the class and you should be alright. It was my best math class yet.
Really boring class, You learn Minitab pretty well...........there is a picture of him in a thong on facebook it is pretty funny.

His class is really boring . but he really wants his students to learn. he provided quizzes and tests from previous semester (they are really helpful). those quizzes help you to prepare for the test. attendace isnot mandatory. he post all the class notes on blackboard.

Umm, his notes are so unclear and hes so vague, especially on take home projects.  Despite this, he's a nice and friendly guy.  If you want to kick butt in this class, do the practice questions in the book-they are extremely valuable.  If youre too lazy to do this, just study his old practice tests online, memorize the solving process,and youre set
good teacher, longest class of my life though. Wants his students to really understand the material and quiz's and tests aren't that difficult

The class is boring; however, I don't think statistics can be fun.  His tests are not too bad.  There are several quizzes, but the quizzes pretty much prepare you for the tests.  He really wants his students to learn the material, so he will help you out in class.  Should you take his class?...I honestly don't know...flip a coin

his tests arent that bad but if u want 2 actually learn something do not take this class...his voice puts me 2 sleep and he does not no how 2 make a joke...hes very easy on homework tho and will do anything 2 help u out and cares about feedback...not the best
An absolute legend. Records all lectures, exams are open note. The material itself is very challenging but he gives you all the resources you need and is a very easy grader.

professor zacharias is the kindest professor ever!! the class sounds scary but really isnt too bad, and professor zacharias is so willing to help. there are a couple partner homework assignments as well as a project, but besides that, there is just a midterm and final and he clearly explains what you need to understand. 100% take him!!
Take him! He gives you all the resources to succeed and is just genuinely a good person.

Class topic is new and a bit difficult but extremely interesting and useful. Professor has a slight accent and looks like young, handsomer Adam Sandler. He records all his lectures and goes slow to allow students to keep up.

The class can be dense but honestly, just push through and pay attention and you'll end off with an A. The material may not be interesting but Professor does a good job at explaining these difficult topic and is pretty chill. Everything is based on Python and Excel. 3 exams including the final and 3 HWs which you work on with an assigned partner.
The class can be boring and lecture-heavy, but Zacharias keeps it engaging with humor. It's focused on Excel and Python, with challenging concepts presented in an organized, understandable way.

The best professor I have EVER had. His lectures are well delivered and he keeps you interested. Well educated on the topics he talks about. I had him for both pharm and patho and he tries to make topics correlate to help you better understand the disease processes and how meds work. Try not to miss lecture because he gives important test info

Dr. Z is amazing professor! He is the best professor Ever! Lectures are engaging and you wish you can continue for hours. Information is clear and to the point. Tests are based on the lecture (PowerPoints) and what you do & learn in class. He is eloquent, and knows how to explain in a way that is clear and simple. I wish he did the whole program!

Dr. Z is one of the best professors I have EVER had. He is AWESOME. go to his class, because he is very eloquent in his explanations. His lectures will help you in patho too! He actually teaches patho during pharm better than Dr Ortega. Seriously- my favorite professor so far! Hilarious and awesome!

Dr. Zha cares about the subject that he teaches, and is skilled and respected in his field. His teaching skills, however, are not quite as impressive. He is extremely scattered, yet expects near-perfection and 20+ hours outside of class from graduate students to do all of his work that he doesn't grade until 2 days before the final exam :)
Always late and gets mad if your late.  Extremely intelligent guy, totally passionate about his work but in an entire semester he never once returned a hw or test.

The guy LOVES his field and his research.  Class is easy if you pay attention and learn the CONCEPTS instead of getting bogged down with the math. Tests are closed book which makes remembering everything hard because you don't get a formula sheet but - get the concepts get a decent grade. Homework varies-in difficulty but only counts 10%.
Really great at teaching the material. You can tell he actually cares and has a passion for this stuff. He's also very knowledgeable and can help you with any questions you may have.

Prof is great and super nice. He will help you accomplish whatever you want to accomplish in this class. Be ready for lots of outside-of-class work, though. Most students stay in the lab working on projects all night before they are due so don't procrastinate. Overall, it was a pretty fun and chill class. Would reccomend!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Really cool guy, down to earth. The class was mainly graded via 3 projects, that were pretty dependent on the student's organization. I struggled to organize and pace myself and handed in assignments late, but he still graded them fully. If you struggle with organization and time management, check in with him, and he'll work with you.

Zeven is a knowledgeable professor with an extremely organized class layout and clear expectations. He makes this course as easy as possible to understand and is very helpful one-on-one. The workload is manageable, there are no exams, he lets you correct project mistakes, and posts the recorded lectures so it's impossible not to do well.

Zeven made learning HTML, CSS, and basic web designing lots of fun. You learn the basics and get to take your creative spirits from there. He is very generous with deadlines and grading, making the class anything but stressful. His lectures, notes, and rubrics are clear as can be. He is always happy to help with any issues you come across.

He told us we would have a quiz and we didn't. Graded on just a few projects so go to class and pay attention and watch the zoom recordings back to know what you're doing. He lets you make corrections to all the projects and turn them in again to improve your grade. Monotone voice so hard to stay awake in class at times but overall nice guy!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: LOVED this class. You need to go to class if you want to understand what you're doing. Every project he lets you redo your mistakes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Take him whatever you do even if you have him at 8AM he is litterly so chill always works with you. Willing to change your grade a bit if you sit with him in office hours and explain why you should get more points. His tests are exactly how we shows the practice exams. THE hw are def pointless but make sure u do it and use chat for hw.

reviews.comment: 100% the best teacher for Calc 1. Tests are hard but they are for any Calc teacher. He is by far the most generous with partial credit. Prepares you well and his reviews are really similar to the questions on the test most of the time.
Take him even if it's an 8am. He is literally the best calc prof at Miami.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's really not that bad. He explains things decently well and gives good extra credit. He also answers quickly to questions on WebAssign which is really helpful! His tests are pretty hard but he posts reviews which prepare you pretty well as long as you do some extra practice on your own. He's one of the better professors here!
Literally the ideal math professor. Always responds within the day to questions on Webassign, has structured notes, and gives you study guides and reviews that are basically the same as the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I had this class 4 times a week at 8am, and it was awful. Despite passing the AP test in HS, I still struggled. There was no in-class practice or feedback, just long weekly HW WebAssigns with huge numbers that would never be on a quiz/exam, making them pointless. He is not below giving a quiz the day after Halloween with only 2 days' notice!

He is a great person and profesor. You just need to do all the assigned HW and he will always answer within an hour if you submit a question on the homework. He gives us an exam guide which includes all the exercises that could possibly be on the exam, and those have the same difficulty. Take him.
CHILLEST DUDE IN AMERICA

Prof. Liu is not a great lecturer but generally, calc 1 is a very digestable course. The exams are very easy but the homework is lengthy and difficult. Gives as much partial credit as he can on exams and is a reasonable grader. Always responds to emails within 5 minutes.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dude is so chill

I recommend taking Zedan Liu as he made MTH 161 easier than I thought it would be. He gives out extra credit and curve assignments. He also does not waste time in lectures which is nice since there is a lot to cover. He also gives a lot of partial credit on the exams and explains problems in a way where they do not seem difficult.

The class in itself is pretty difficult, however, he tries his best to understand things the best way he can. You can tell he cares for his students. He is very available if you ever need help outside of class and is very flexible. The exams and quizzes are hard, if you study from his study guides you should be fine. He has an accent.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Took him for mth161. He is a super nice professor and is understanding. Right before quizzes he will do a review and practice on the problems on the quiz so you know exactly what to expect. Gives out extra credit for exams 2 and 3 which is just doing study guide questions. Exams aren't too hard. The hardest part is the homework that is long

Super understanding, I missed 3  of the 6 quizzes due to conflicts and he allowed me to take them all out of class. Lectures can be slightly confusing because English is not his first language and the vocabulary he uses for specific calculus related things is often not what is commonly used. Super nice,exams aren't too difficult gives extra credit.

Professor Liu was great! I struggled my way through math in the past and was very nervous to take Calculus given the track record of the math department. However, he made the material easy to understand. He was extremely accessible outside of class and he just wanted his students to pass. He gave out a couple of extra credit assignments too.

Had him for Calculus 1. Nice guy, but his tests are impossible and he isn't the most generous with curves or really anything with that matter. Extremely tough class, but if math's your thing it should be easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Liu was a very good professor in a really hard class. He was understanding and accessible outside of class to meet. He wants to see his students succeed and does a lot of review for exams and final. He was the best math teacher I have had so far at this school and I would recommend to take him.

Very chill and nice professor. He will answer any questions you have. If you show up to class, take notes, and do the homework, it's easy to understand all the material. Tests are usually the same type of problems that show up during lectures so pay attention. Lot of homework but it is only 5% of your grade. Would recommend for MTH 161!

One of the best professors I've had. The course was interesting and not too difficult to understand. If you want to enjoy yourself and get a good grade I suggest this class. Graded off 3 exams but they're not too difficult to prepare for.

Great professor. He's funny and his lectures are interesting so it makes the concepts simple to understand. Exams are fair as long as you study, even if you are taking the class for a cognate. Overall, fun class. Sometimes he goes on tangents but he's easy on the eyes so it never bothered me.

I was excited to take this class bc I'd already taken his coastal&ocean law classes where I learned a lot. But this class is a joke and you won't learn anything. Only take if you need an easy elective and don't care about learning climate law. The class has no structure, he just vaguely talks about stuff from his other classes. Never used the book.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof is very nice and knowledgeable. Breaks down hard concepts easily. He is patient with questions -- don't be afraid to ask any! He purely lectures by ONLY talking (no ppts, handouts, visuals). this was hard to get used to bc it means you cannot zone out at all, or you'll miss a lot. Tests are very fair. Had to get used to his lecture style.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took zemantauski's climate law class and it was great. I learned a lot about our legal system (no prior knowledge) and enjoyed the discussion-based style. I'm not really sure what the grading criteria was (never got a grade back) but I believe everyone did very well. would take again and would suggest you take him!
Professor Zemantauski is the best. I wish he taught more classes because I already took all of the classes he teaches. I would recommend him to anyone of any major. Most enjoyable class on campus.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Z's lectures are great and his class is really easy so long as you pay attention in class. His exams are super easy and he gives a review session the class before every exam so that you can go over what you need to know. He makes the course content interesting and you'll actually learn a lot, too.

Don't take him. He's incredibly boring and definitely has nothing else to do so takes it way too seriously. If you're good at memorizing, his tests won't be too hard but you will never use the information you learn in his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He's really confusing, his tests are really specific and there's a lot of useless memorization and it's really dry and not interesting stuff. Unless you like fishing...

He's an awesome dude, the material is dry but I took his class for a second time because he makes it really interesting. The class is fair, his tests are fair, you just have to study. And while the material is boring, he's nice to look at in class
DON'T TAKE HIS CLASS. the guy is cool and all, but his class isn't. Your grade is only based on exams and he doesn't EVER give a study guide or curve the tests and his final is commutative.

it's true that Zemantauski is cool as a person, but the class itself is not.  His tests are hard, he doesn't give you a study guide, he also doesn't curve the exams and his final is cumulative. Had l known all that before taking his class, l wouldn't have taken it. There is no point taking his class if it's hard and he doesn't help students out.

Take Dr. Zemantauski's class! There are only 3 exams, which each take about 20 min. As long as you spend a few hrs memorizing the material it's an easy A. Attendance counts, but you get about 5 miss days. The material is a bit dry, but he often lets you out early. He gets off topic a lot and he tells funny stories so it's not quite so boring.
Amazing professor. We love TA Elnaz!
Super great professor! Very good at teaching, would highly recommend!
I really enjoyed her classes. one of the best TA that I ever had in the UM. Caring and punctual.

He understands that you are only human and his expectations are totally achievable. He is a very kind and caring soul. If you put in some effort, you will do well because he works with you and takes feedback from you to design the class to your liking. Very laidback and just wants you to enjoy his class and learn Spanish while you do so.

Carlo's class was extremely manageable and very well taught. He is one of the best teachers I have had the pleasure of having and is such an extremely caring individual. He loves his students and loves connecting with you academically and personally.
He is a very easy going teacher, very laid back class, and he also cares a lot about his students and wants them to succeed.

The homework readings are hard, but can be BSed easily.  As long as you improve each draft of your essay based on peer review and her comments you'll get a passing grade.  Note: after 2 absences, each absence becomes minus half a letter grade on your final grade (this is why the people below had such a negative experience i think). Pretty easy imo

You MUST attend every class to earn an A.  In terms of grading as long as you improve each draft of your essay based on peer review and her comments, you'll earn at least a C+.  I'm a good writer, and the essays were fun. Hardest thing is the readings for the homeworks, but the questions for credit can be easily BSed.  Overall pretty easy

Takes the class way to seriously. She teaches a freshman course expecting graduate level results. The book you read is pretty incomprehensible and way to sophisticated for freshman writing. Interesting and nice girl, but not a teacher you wanna be stuck with!

Out of no reason I was given a failing grade for the course, even though I submitted all my classwork and hw on time. She refused to grade my assignments even though they were submitted on time. It was brought to my attention that this university is too expensive for a teacher to yell at you  I dont wanna hear you, STOP talking, I dont care.

Great teacher. She is really nice and very understanding. She is willing to extend due dates if enough people in the class agree on it and wants to make sure as many people can get an A as possible. Write a decent paper and cite in correct format and you will get an A. Highly recommend!!
Excellent teacher
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: My favorite language teacher I've ever had. He really makes you work to read and write better.

Zisselsberger is not an easy professor but he is worth taking. You will learn so much! You will really improve your language skills and the homework is always interesting. There are papers but he gives a lot of feedback. The feedback is scary but it will improve your writing greatly. If you want to get something out of a class, you should take him

Zberg is the ABSOLUTE best teacher I've ever had, and the reason I want to continue my academic journey! He is brilliant to the point of eccentric, and that means that you'll work your butt off for him but he'll do the same for you. This is an ally you want to have in your academic life for sure.

Dr. Zisselsberger is BY FAR the best teacher I have ever had. He is so helpful and always available to assist you with assignments. He is very understanding, always notices when his students are struggling, and gives deadlines accordingly. He deserves and truly earns the respect of his students.
He is seriously the best teacher I have ever had.
Best professor at the University of Miami. Demanding class, definitely worth the time! I will miss this class greatly.

The most amazing and helpful professor at the University of Miami. If you are willing to put your effort in, there is no one better. Will improve not only your German language skills but critical skills in general. You won't regret it.
Great Professor.  Cares about his students.  Gives a lot of work, but you learn plenty.
The single most amazing professor I've had at the University of Miami. He cares so much about his classes in content and on a personal level.

Possibly the finest professor or teacher I have ever learned under in my life. He is difficult and demanding, but if you want to learn, and you are willing to work, you will be rewarded. Be prepared to write and have your writing scrutinized. He works hard at grading your essays and includes helpful revision suggestions. Highly recommended.

This class was honestly one of the best classes I've taken. The prof is very passionate about nutrition and that really comes across during lectures. I recommend this class to everyone, it isn't difficult if you pay attention to lectures and all of the lectures are available online. No textbook necessary. 10/10 recommend. Very kind prof too.

Professor Zito is an AMAZING professor! I have truly never met another prof as passionate about the course & helping her students! She makes u excited to participate and the material applicable to your every-day life so its easy to understand. The class is all lecture-based so make sure to attend class and participate! HIGHLY recommend her class!

I took this class for my cognate and loved it! Professor Zito is truly the best and makes KIN235 more interesting. The class is interactive and the material is extremely relatable to college students. Professor Zito was very approachable and made time for office hours whenever students felt they needed the extra support. One of my favorite profs!

Professor Zito is extremely approachable and teaches with passion. KIN150 online was a mixture of both pre-recorded and live lectures which allowed the students to watch the recordings at their own pace. The material is super interesting and Professor Zito goes over the material so the students can better understand everything. Highly recommended!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Genuinely one of my favorite classes I've taken at UM! Gina is seriously one of my favorite professors as well. She is super kind and helpful! I highly recommend taking KIN235 and KIN150 because some of the information overlaps. Tests are pretty easy in both classes, all you got to do is pay attention in class and go over her lectures!

Gina is seriously the best! She makes it so that the material is super easy to grasp. You'd honestly have to try super hard to do bad in any of her courses. Seriously recommended taking her!! She's super nice and will help you with any questions you have. Had an amazing experience with her.

Professor Zito is absolutely amazing. She truly cares about her students and puts so much effort into making sure that each of us has a chance to succeed in her class. The course consists of 4 exams and a final project. Everything is very manageable. For each exam she gives you a study guide and does a review session. 100% would recommend.

Although I took this for a class for my cognate, it was one of the most useful classes I've taken in college. Professor Zito is extremely kind and makes the class super interesting. She facilitates an engaging discussion, so it is easy to pay attention. She is also a reasonable grader and gives multiple opportunities for extra credit.

Professor Zito taught one of my favorite classes I've ever taken in college. She is extremely caring and engaging with her students and her lectures were never boring. She wanted us to do well and participate as we can all relate to the material in the class. As long as you take good notes and study in advance, you will do well on the exams.

Professor Zito is truly passionate about nutrition and it shows during her lectures. She genuinely cares about students and their wellbeing, which makes for a great class environment. Her exams are fair and she provides many opportunities to ask questions and get the help you might need. I'd definitely recommend her!

Zito is such a sweetheart. She knows most people take this class as a cognate and makes the material as easy as possible. She is accomodating and an extremely reasonable grader. A great prof who explains everything thoroughly and also made study guides before each test that helped immensely. Should be an easy A if you go through the guides.

Professor Zito is extremely knowledgable and approachable. The material is very interesting as it pertains to every living human, and Professor Zito presents it in a clear manner. There is a lot of material covered on dietary science, but if you go to class it is manageable. If I wasn't a senior, I would 100% have taken more of her lectures!!
Fun class, really good prof.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Amaaaaaazing class we are taking with Amine and Ralph this semester. Really mind-blowing, we are looking at the concepts of memory and oversight in French history from a totally new and interesting perspective. Thank you so much for such an eye-opening class! One of the best I ever took at UM
I wish he was teaching our second and third year Arabic... Honestly after going through the other teachers I appreciate even more his way of teaching
I had an amazing semester with Professor Zidouh. He cares and wants everyone to succeed. Attendance is mandatory and participation in class matters a whole lot.

Professor Zidouh is awesome. I really struggle with french and was terrified to take this class but can honestly say he helped me improve a lot. Overall a pretty easy grader but really cares about his students. Works hard with everyone individually to make sure they understand & succeed. Tons of group projects with a decent amount of homework.

I think the reason why Amine is so respected and liked by students is that he goes the extra notch.  He was always there and willing to meet with me, outside of class time or even office hours.  He really helped me a class I was kinda struggling with.
EXCELLENT Prof! He has helped me get through a really tough semester

We had a wonderful experience with Professor Amine this semester. I was sort of reluctant to take this class because I felt my level was very good and only needed to work on my communicative skills but the professor made it very clear from day one that communication was going to be our priority. We  took too many exams throughout the semesterthough
Amine has been my best professr this semester. Our class was a very nice group and he just made it a pleasure to come to class everyday.

Amine is one of the kindest teachers I've had yet. He cares about his students, and wants everyone to succeed. He has you do mostly speaking activities in class, so your speaking skills will improve, and tests and quizzes are a cakewalk. Excellent class, I'd recommend.

REALLY GOOD PROF. he is always there for you and the class is hilarious, he creates a good atmosphere to come and you will learn a good level of french... he always starts the class with amazing french music and it does not feel like a normal class it feel like you were learning with a friend and not with a professor

Very helpful and a very nice guy. If you are having trouble, he will try to help. 5 quizzes, 2 oral exams, 2 exams, 10-20 homework assignments, but none of it is too hard and if you pay attention in class its very easy to do well.
just wanted to add that participation is a must!!! but the atmosphere in class was so good that even the shy student would feel fine speaking. But class was definitely participation oriented

I took this class because it was a requirement and I was expecting it to be tough... But professor Amine really made it into such an interesting course. His energy just keeps you going and the class was really a happy medium between fun and super interesting. He also changes activities so much thatevery week was different and class was never boring
He makes class sooo interesting, I cannot wait to take another class with him next semester

This class was by far my favorite one of the semester by far and  professor Amine one of my top 2 professors I ever had! He creates such a good atmosphere in class that people actually come to class because they enjoy it and not just because attendance is mandatry

Well, the one thing I have to say is that he is there for his students. He cares about you as a person, and when you introduce yourself in the beginning of the semester you just don't do that for the sake of doing it. He remembers and then he will making class very personal to each one of his students.
Zisca is a caring, sincere, and wonderful teacher. Whatever she does in the classroom is for the sake of student improvement. She is a rare jewel in academe.

GREAT professor. She is so sweet and really does her best to help you get the best grade possible. About 5 papers in total and no tests. She even gives you a chance to revise your work at the end of the semester. As long as you go to class and do the work its pretty hard not to get an A.
One of my most memorable professors. Extremely helpful, caring woman with a beautiful voice...and yeah, she's a fox.

Wonderful teacher! She really stimulates interest in the course and really cares about her students. She really wants her students to do well and grades very fairly. Just put in effort and its easy to get an A!
She is a good teacher.  The class can be a little boring, a lot of discussions, watching films, and meeting with 3 or 4 students to discuss questions.  Overall pretty easy.  Not too hard of a grader.
SHE IS AWESOME.... HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!!!!

Z. Burton is a great, unbiased professor. She likes participation. Her tests are great because they test your knowledge of things that you want to know leaving the class. 7-10 page research paper for class, group projects.
foxy!

if u'r interested in learning then I fully recommed her to u. She is an excellent prof, enthusiastic, comprehensive, helpful. My experience in her class was more than wonderful/excellent. she really teaches.
Easy class, especially if she likes you.  Somewhat boring though.
She is impossible to please. Her grading is awful. Do not take her class.
easy class, apparently the classroom is frigid tho

Class is ok, but material is boring and dry. Zika is a cool professor, but not the most enthusiastic lecturer. Reads straight off the the powerpoints. Exams are manageable, just a lot of detail. If you are marine science or interesting in the environment, then take it. If not, take another class.

The most boring and useless class you'll take at UM.  You learn about the components of instruments, how they work, but you don't get to even use most of them!  Bah, and the tests were just pure memorization.

class is kinda boring... keeps teaching past the end of the class time which is really annoying.. hes really nice though! and he is a good teacher you just really have to be into environmental chemistry

Don't take Zika if you want to learn chemistry. You dont have to do that much work for the clas, but I don't feel that I've learned anything from Zika...any chem that I'v picked up has been from teaching myself and from my lab TA. Find another chem class.
Had him for honors and I had to drop...He barely went over the kinds of problems he would give on the quizzes...I wouldn't recommend his class except if you already have a strong chem background.

He is a good guy, but unfortunately his teaching style is flat and monotonous.  The presentations are a good touch, it helps balance out the grade.  His tests were all multiple choice, but were still difficult.  Basically teach yourself what you need to know, go listen to his stories, and don't mess up the tests.

He's a nice guy but class is incredibly boring. I never went except to take the quizzes and give my presentation, and I made an ok grade. He really tries to make class worth your while, but it's such a boring topic.

He is a nice person (He changed the 20 page paper requirement to just a five minute presentation.) but he is incredibly boring. He posts the presentations online so if you skip class you can either read the book or study guide examples or get the presentations from blackboard.

His class is pretty easy if you can teach yourself.  His teaching style just drones on and on, and me and several others can swear that what he teaches and whats on the quizes dont match up.  Very boring, but lil work.  He got rid of the 20 page paper thing and replaces it with everyone must do a presentation.  So public speaking is a must.

Rod is a good guy, and his class is pretty decent except for a few things. By his own admission, he is not a great teacher, but he does his best to get the point across. He is fair in his grading and offers help whenever asked. The 20 page term paper is tough, but I learned a ton from it.

Cons:  Hard quizes. Doesn't teach exams. Prof doesn't answer Q's but TA's help Pros: Easier to get A in hon. than with bad regular teachers. 20 page term paper helps boost grades Finals: mix: easy (examples in the book), repeats from quizes, and hard Q's  Quiz: book ex., like hw, 10 Q's total

BEST PROFESSOR EVER! She is a such a sweetheart. She always starts class with the mindful minute and takes attendance every class! Weekly discussions and assignments. Group mock negotiation and midterm. If you pay attention and show up to every class prepared, you will be good.

really enjoyed Professor Zovko and this course, she is a great professor, interesting and engaging class, a lot of assignments/work so make sure you keep up with them. Make sure you go to class as attendance is a big part of grade.

She's a great person and wants everyone to succeed. There is kind of a lot of work (discussion boards and an assignment pretty much every week) and only 2 tests the midterm and final. Attendance is mandatory.
Professor Zovko is the best!! She really wants the best for her students. Class is very relaxed and the assignments are manageable and not too difficult.

Very easy class if you like sports and law combined. Some work, ngl but fairly easy. It is almost impossible to get below an 80 in any assignment. Only a midterm and a final, no need to show up to class on the days you have something due. DO show up to class, she takes her attendance very serious and you'll be penalized at the end. Loved her!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Zoey Chen is an absolute Chiller

Not gonna lie, market research isn't the most exciting topic, but Professor Chen makes it work. She's straight forward, tells it like it is, and keeps the material relevant. She puts in solid effort with her lectures and actually wants students to learn. If you gotta take Market Research, take it with Chen. She's legit.

The best professor that Miami has period. She is so knowledgeable and I want to be her she's amazing. Lectures usually are short so the hour 15 class is doable and we get out early most days. There's a group project, 3 midterms, and that's it. She said we won't have a final. Take her if you can!!
Incredible Professor. She makes a pretty dull topic (marketing research) exciting. Wish I could take more classes with her.
She is the GOAT. I've never had such a smart and enthusiastic professor like Zoey Chen. Professors like her make me feel like my tuition dollars are worth it.

Zooey might be the best professor in the entire state. Attending her class is like going to Coachella, or going sky-diving because it gives you such an adrenaline rush. Zooey is always stoked and delivers thought-provoking lectures. Oftentimes me & my homies talked for hours about the class after it concluded. She doesn't put up with BS !
The only professor that is using lockdown browser, camera, you cant backtrack and you have no idea how much time you have left

What a great professor! I had Professor Chen for MKT302. If you go to class, participate, and study her PowerPoints a little before exams you will do good in this class guaranteed. She wants her students to succeed. Her class is incredibly fair and she does what she can to make the subject matter interesting. Take her if you can!

Professor Chen is awesome. Just finished taking MKT302 with her and she is very knowledgable and attendant to her students. Tests are easy as long as you take good notes in class and study! Highly recommend taking her!

Professor Chen is awesome! She really enjoys teaching students and really cares about how you are doing. The material was a review from MKT 301/201. There are three exams and a group paper/presentation. There is no Final Exam. Overall, she is amazing and you can go to her for help at anytime. I recommend taking her!
In the middle of taking her class and I have to say she's quite passionate about her field and is very engaging with the class. Clearly knows what she's talking about, making it easy to follow along.

This is my second semester having Saman, and I have enjoyed both of his classes. The material isn't complex at all, but it's all extremely useful. In 512 we actually watch videos about interviewing do's/donts, and answer common interview style questions. He lets you use your senior project for the project too if you want (he encourages it actually)

Second semester I've taken a class with this professor. He is extremely helpful if you meet with him, and the class is very project based. Two quizzes and a final exam, plus a project and a few homework assignments to complete (4 total this semseter)

Was the first semester he taught a class. Material was somewhat boring, but almost everything I learned came in useful during interviews. Class had 3 quizzes and 1 project (solo or group). Reviewing the slides and understanding what they talk about made passing relatively easy. Show up for lectures and pay attention and most everything is discussed

This guy should have retired 10 years ago. He's a horrible teacher. I'm still in the class, and it's just horribly unbearable to be in this class. He's an incompetent teacher, he confuses himself (which then confuses students), and his tests are difficult. The only to pass the class is to read the book. I hate this teacher. He belongs in a home.
Unsympathetic when you have actual things going on in your life that prevent you from going to class. No retakes. Easily Confused. Not clear.

He is very unclear in everything he "tries" to teach. He never explains fully any of the work he shows on the board nor does he finish the problems he starts. His notes have a lot of mistakes which is confusing. He constantly claims his tests are easy as long as you make a "free body diagram" yet the class averages on tests are 50% or below.
you understand nothing mostly...he post notes online and they have alot of mistakes that confuse you when you study...exams are written in a complicated way...

Zuhair is incredibly rude and has an impossible to understand accent. Takes points off from lab reports but refuses to justify why and if you ask for a reason, says that you are threatening him somehow. Assumes you are physics masters and does not like answering questions from those who are clearly making an effort and are trying their best.
He is an excellent professor
His attention to detail and intelligence inspire me to enroll in classes whenever I see his name.

He is not a good lecturer, BUT the exams are fairly easy and reflect the mastering homework and textbook problems. I don't go to lecture and instead take notes and do the problems in the textbook and I've gotten an A on both exams thus far. His accent and teaching is really hard to understand, but you can succeed by teaching yourself pretty easily.

Ben's the best! Took his special topics course on Film Sound Aesthetic, and while the subject material itself was great, his love and passion for the topic, as well as film in general, really made the class great. In-class discussions were great, workload wasn't difficult at all, and I looked forward to class every week.

I've taken 3 classes with Ben. If I wasn't graduating, I'd take a fourth. He is absolutely one of the best professors at UM. Class is always super fun because of how much he cares about what he's teaching. He's always down to talk about all things film related. Sound is so important and I think everyone should take at least one of his classes.

Mr.Zuiderweg is truly on of the best professors during my college years. You can tell that he is truly passionate about the subject matter and extremely talented. Very kind man who really knows what he is talking about. His ability to teach me was incredible!

Please take Ben... he is one of my favorite teachers on campus. He is such a down to earth person and you can tell he is genuinely passionate about pre and post production sound. I couldn't recommend him enough. I honestly think he is one of the most talented professors in the Motion Pictures department. You're missing out if you don't take him.

Ben is honestly the GOAT in every way. He's so extremely knowledgeable about Pro Tools and the sound industry as a whole, he's kind and deliberate in his lectures, and he is so patient for newbies like me who have never touched a DAW before. You get what you put into the class, and Ben will make you look at film sound in an entirely new light.

I cannot sing Ben's praises enough. This man is not only knowledgeable about the industry and the practice, but deeply passionate about it. This course is all hands-on; you'll be learning how to use all the equipment necessary for location sound. I went from knowing exactly nothing to being the sound recordist for 3 student films this semester.

Professor Ben is incredible with a lot of knowledge. The classes were very good and dynamic, with many examples and practical applications of the content studied. A lot of valuable information about audio production/mixing in filmmaking.

I took his class over the summer it was amazing and thought-provoking. You get what you put in. We learned music and audio mixing, using plugins and DAWs (I use Ableton, Pro Tools, Reaper), mixing dialogue, and using tools like compressors, de-essers, EQs, limiters, and more. The professor's expertise made the course truly exceptional.

First comprehensive Mixing Class and...
.
"It was awesome" 

One of the best professors I've ever had. Truly a great person and mentor if your looking to get into sound, or if you're just exploring in general. He really dove deep into music production, mixing, scoring, and mastering from all levels of scoring for film, or just songs in general!

Zuiderweg is one of the best professors in the film program! He's super passionate in film and will teach you so much about sound in just one class period.  He's extremely caring and supportive and I recommend everybody take one of his classes even if they don't want to pursue sound!

Ben is absolutely one of the best professors I've ever had. His lectures are always so engaging and informative. I would absolutely recommend him to anyone and would love to take another course from him in the future!

Ben's passion for sound has profoundly shaped my growth as a filmmaker. He makes complex concepts engaging and accessible while fostering a supportive learning environment. His energy, humor, and hands-on approach turn an intimidating subject into an exciting one. I highly recommend him and wish I could take his class again so please enroll ASAP!
His passion for sound is contagious. Changed my entire perspective on filmmaking and even if I never really considered myself an editor, but this class was easy to follow and I learned a lot.

I can honestly saying taking Professor Zuiderweg's class changed my life. The class was extremely educational and you could not ask for someone better to teach it. 10/10. I would take the class again if I could.

Ben is the best out right now. Nobody has more passion for his job. 
If you can take any of his classes, do it ASAP.
good professor, helpful in homework and test.
good professor but with accent , pretty easy A
World's most boring class. His goal is for everyone to receive an A. Everything is in the power points, and class he reads straight off of them. If you need the grade, take him.

I had the chance to take Prof. Zulueta's class for Humanities and it was great! He's very funny and keeps the class very entertained. No text book needed, EVERYTHING you need to study is on powerpoints, and no assignments just exams. To pass this class you must show up and you MUST study. Like it's an absolute must. Wish I could take him again.
I had him for HUM1020 this semester at Miami Dade College. No textbook, only powerpoints, and tells you EXACTLY what you need to know for the three exams. No homework. Just study well!

My favorite teacher at UM.  I learned so much in this international cinema history course!  He applies a lot of cultural and historical references when unpacking the films.  He taught me to analyze production, distribution and directorial language styles.  Great class!  He is very fair and expects attendance and participation in class.

Amazing professor!  Learned so much about cinema studies.  He is very charismatic and extremely well prepared.  Has a great sense of humor but does not like slackers.  If you are really interested in film he is the most amazing teacher.  Think of it as an honors level course.  Attendance and participation count so make sure you can attend.

Attendance extr mandatory and be punctual. Good class, learned a lot, participation counts. Reads off powerpoints and puts them up 5 days before test. I took notes. 50 multiple choice. Just read the ppts is enough. One essay about one film maybe a group film presentation.  Pop quizzes but they dont really change ur grade. Recommended.

Class was super interesting!  Packed with great information.  I definitely learned a lot.  Teacher is fun and very knowledgeable.  I took this class with another teacher and had to drop it!!  He is  so much more engaging and available.  Only thing is attendance is mandatory and doesn't like excuses for late work.

Very nice professor, always prepared for class. His lectures are power points and he basically reads right off of them. So if you want a more engaging class, I wouldn't suggest this one. Strict with coming to class & being punctual. Interesting material but the professor doesn't do a very good job at keeping students interested.

Amazing professor!  I learned so much about film history!  This was by far my favorite class at UM.  He actually teaches you to think critically about film.  I wish all my film classes were taught by Prof. Zulueta.

Great teacher!  Extremely prepared for class.  Great powerpoints with film clips embedded that he prepares for class.  I usually don't like lectures but his were very engaging!  I loved the class!  He is extremely fair but doesn't like excuses about attendance or turning in assignments on time.  If you do the work and come to class - you'll ace it.

Hands down the best class I've ever taken at UM.  Teacher was really passionate about art and his expertise was really inspirational.  I recommend him to anyone who wants to learn more than just technicalities about B/W photography.  The critics were really engaging and fun.  I loved it! (plus he's cute).

Dr. Z is one of the most caring PSY professors I've had at UM. He is engaging and accessible, and you should have no difficulty in his class. I wish he taught more courses... I would recommend him to anyone!

At first I thought Dr.Z was a sweet man. I quickly realized I was wrong. Grading is only 4 exams. He never met with us through zoom or had communication with us. He was extremely careless about your situation or worries. You had to teach yourself everything in the entire course. Very harsh grader and has zero comprehension for his students. AVOID!

Really good professor. Makes lectures interesting and fun to pay attention to. He is clear about what to expect on exams and assignments and you can easily get an A if you pay attention and study what he recommends. Very sweet guy, would definitely take again!

Great professor, highly recommend. There are 4 exams, each 25%. He drops the lowest exam and the final replaces the dropped exam and counts as the last 25%. He is very clear about the material, and even though he does not take attendance, he strongly prefers students who go to class. Must take for PSY 110. Highly recommend.
Barry is one of the nicest professors I have ever had. If you participate once or twice, he will love you for the rest of the semester. He is very understanding and accommodating to his students.

class is not hard at all. im and athlete and miss class multiple times and still managed to get an A in the class. and i also never used the textbook. he's an old and corny teacher but he can be way worse. doesnt take attendance. just go to class, take notes and you'll be fine.

the class wasn't hard and he tells you what's on the test if you got to review sessions and in class. The only issue is that he is boring especially for a 9:05. But he's a cute young man who makes jokes all the time but gets mad when you have your phone. the tests based on 4 midterms and a final but he drops the lowest test. Then there is research.

He was a meh teacher. He will tell you questions on the test and the tests are not that difficult. Extra credit can be on tests or if nobody is in class he will pass around a piece of paper and you will get credit for showing up.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Show up to class - he gives out test questions and the lectures are interesting. One thing though - don't have your phone out or he will be super upset. He also absolutely loves participation, and is overall a sweet guy.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Class was interesting & not difficult. Received B+ & always participated during class discussions. Can become easily ticked off. Requested a req letter after meeting in his office. Asked me to resend the link & got mad that it told him request was withdrawn which I had to do before the website let me send a new one. Also loves to talk about Trump.

Take Barry!!! He's such a sweet man. If you raise your hand every once in a while, he will love you. It's graded off 3 exams and the final. The exams are not hard at all, just study the terms and maybe read the text book the night before.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: The professor himself is good, but don't choose this class if you are just interested in and have no preparation of PSY. You have to read at least 10 chapters before each test and most of the knowledge he won't mention in class and handout.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed my class with Dr.Z! He does go a bit slow and doesn't allow technology, but he really makes sure everyone understands a topic before moving on. Tests are pretty easy... Just watch out for the write ins! (He usually lets you know which topics will have a write in question before the exam though) Would definitely take him again!

Sweet old man. His classes are straight forward and honestly you don't really have to go to class. Everything you need to know for his exams, he posts online on his blackboard. You still need to study though for sure, esp if you don't go to class . Final is matching on vocab. I recommend him if you are interested in psych and need an A.

Zwibelman is the sweetest guy ever. His class is easy and he is very straightforward with what material he wants you to know. He loves when you participate. The class tends to get boring though because he moves slowly and his voice might put you to sleep. Overall, I would recommend. The material itself is pretty interesting.
The equivalent of taking a class with your grandpa.  Really nice dude but moves through the material rather slowly.  Follow the study guides he posts and its an easy A.

Class was good, you actually learn but it is not difficult. He clearly knows a lot about psychology but doesn't try to make it difficult. He is very clear on what to expect and what you're suppose to know. IF you take notes and read the modules (book) it should be an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Zwibelman is one of the easiest psychology teachers. Tests are based on lectures and modules in the textbook. He usually tells students what to study/ what's on the tests. The final was matching definitions. Easy A if you put in a little effort.

His Abnormal psy class is pretty fair. He gives study guides for each chapter that is literally the exam. I used to go to class at the beginning but I stopped as it is useless. Study his study guides. Only gives tests.

Dr. Zwibelman was my all time favorite professor at UM. He is extremely fair, generous, and by no means wants to trick students. He is very knowledgeable and has a dedication for his students that no other professor at UM has showed me. 10/10 would recommend! Wish I wasn't graduating just so I could take his classes again.
Pretty clear and easy, tends to drag out some lectures but you can end up skipping and learning by yourself and getting the A

Dr. Z was a great professor. He knew a lot about the subject matter. He gave four test but dropped the lowest one. Although the book helped, I ended up studying more off his outlines and taking notes in class.

His stress management class might have actually saved my life. I was really struggling with stress and this class gave me all the tools I needed to deal with it. I still use it today, and it's probably the one class I will use throughout my life regardless of what I end up doing. He's AMAZINGGG. Buy the book. You're going to want to keep it.
He's a very sweet guy and very clear. If you ever need assistance, he will help you. He's very straight forward: no surprises. Loved his class.

Easy A. Posts all the powerpoints that he just reads off of, doesn't take attendance, straightforward tests, and very nice guy. Rarely showed up for class or opened the textbook and got an A. However, he speaks very slow, is very boring and you do NOT want to get caught using your phone.

Easy A, very straight-forward class. I thought stress-management would be super interesting, but he made it really boring. Most students were not paying attention during any of his lectures and he repeats himself quite frequently. Also, he gets really upset about cell phone and computer use. Take if you want an easy A, but super boring.

His intro to psychology class is quite interesting and easy, and he is very clear about what needs to be known and what could be on the exams. He cares about his students, taking time to remind them that the counseling center is available for troubled students and staying after class to answer questions.
Easy A, all you have to do is take decent notes, he posts them all on blackboard if you dont make it to class, most of the questions are from lectures and the book

Very helpful and easy A class. I loved the stress management techniques, and he was very helpful if you had questions. Extra credit was very helpful. If you go to class and read the book you can easily get an A+.

Great professor. He really cares about the subject and will look things up if he is unsure of the answer to a question. He can get wordy and sidetracked in lectures, but also offers his notes online. Tests are extremely easy; if you study, you can easily get 100. EC is sometimes given in class, but attendance is not mandatory. Take Dr. Z!

He has a sweet, old man personality but his lectures are boring, wordy,tedious and slow. He spends way too much time on irrelevant topics. He also has an annoying habit of clearing his throat. The grades are all based on tests which are easy, especially if you've ever taken a psych class before. Overall, I would recommend a different teacher.

This profesor is super boring. The guy makes such an intersting subject so boring that I have thought about switching majors. Thankfully the book is very explicative. Don't take him for Abnormal Psych unless you wanna ose your interest in human behavior. I heard he's better with Stress Managment but I doubt it. What a bore!!!!!

Great Professor! Cares about his students, doesnt make test difficult. You will learn from his lectures..HE gives you a version of his notes and basically you just add details to them, you have to read the ch from bk but they are very short ch. Guaranteed A. Also you have to write a paper towards the end but he grades very easy on it. Loved it!
Very nice guy but extremely boring and wordy. Come to class and you will pass this course with very little difficulty.

A very quirky but kind professor. The material is not that difficult but he does test on small details from lecture and from the book. This course is very interesting and easily applied to real life. I feel like I have the tools to deal with my own stress and the ability to share what I know with others. Definitely recommend this course!

LOVE this professor!! He is very nice and helpful, and this was by far the easiest class I have taken. Going to class is not at all mandatory, however I found myself wanting to go. he posts his powerpoints/class notes on blackboard, and 85% of exam questions are from the book. Make sure you keep up with the reading and you'll be fine.

Very good professor. He makes sure everyone understands the material and is on the same page. Attendance is not mandatory, but it definitely helps a lot when it comes to exams. Exams are based on a mix of class and textbook reading, but mostly on class material.

You should deff study ...if you do you will do fine. He does not curve his tests. Make sure you do good because it might affect your other grades. Hes a good teacher and make sure you go to class so you can take notes because a lot of what he says in his lectures are on the tests. Good luck
PSY 215: Really nice guy and a really easy, enjoyable class. If you're looking for an easy A, this is your class! I studied for about half an hour before each of the exams and got 95 and up on them.
great teacher, very likeable

He is a great teacher who is very enthusiastic about the subject. He makes the class funny and keeps the atmosphere lighthearted by incorporating relevant current issues into the discussions. I would recommend him to anybody interested in taking a class that covers serious issues with a dedicated and caring professor.

The class is fairly straightforward and and long as you come to class and take notes you will do fine on the tests. The book is also helpful and not difficult to read because chapters are only 10-20pgs at most.
Nice guy, don't have to come to class, relatively easy, although some test questions are non-sense. Don't even really need to come to class all that often.
I thought he was an odd ball but a fairly good teacher. I read the book once and found it useless. If you listen, pay attention and take decent notes you shouldn't have a problem with his class.
He's an OK teacher. Pay attention to his lectures and read the book. Sometimes there are questions on the exams on things he either didn't cover or didn't cover clearly, so read the book.
He is a very nice professor.  Sometimes he will go off talking about something random, but most of the test is taken directly from his lectures.

This class is soooo boring, he isnt a very good teacher, the best thing you could do is buy the study gide that goes with the textbook and just study that because there is no way your going to learn anything from him. If you do go to class bring your laptop so that you have something to entertain you for 50 minutes!

Doesn't always take role, but his lectures are very helpful when studying for the test, I think he is a really good teacher, he shows an interest in the class and is super sweet. His classes are not boring and as long as you take decent notes the tests should be pretty easy

This guy can NOT teach! He takes such an interesting subject and makes it terribly boring! I need this class for my future career and because of him, I won't get the knowledge I need!! I dread going to his class- its a huge waste of time.
His class is so simple. His tests are easy, straight from the review. Most of it comes from the lectures. He only takes attendance occasionally, when he sees the class is empty.

very easy class.  tests are basically memorizing vocab and learning a little about experiments.  go to the class before a test and he'll tell you what to study.  HIGHLY reccomend him as a professor if PSY is required....easy A

I'm not sure why he's gotten such terrible reviews b/c I thought that he was one of my better professors. Keeps the class very interesting & is very helpful outside of the classroom as well. No complaints here.
Tests not that hard..but classes are quite unstructured. Seems to get off tangent sometimes with no specific direction.

By FAR he is the worst teacher I have ever had!!!Once we had an exam with 9 chapters. He reads straight from the slides, has no clue what he is talking about, and he makes a VERY interesting subject seem so lifeless, dull, and boring. DON'T TAKE it with HIM.

He means well, but he has no idea how to teach.  He not only reads from his notes word for word, but when he writes something on the bored, it usually makes no sense. His class is random and has little direction. The exams do not correspond with the class, and his grading scale makes no sense.
Horrible professor. Does not teach and is very unhelpful. His grading scale sucks, and gives little or no curve. Worst professor ever. DO NOT TAKE.
He means well...but take it with Johnson instead
Class can be pretty boring, he just reads his notes off the screen. If you keep up with reading and read printouts you can do well.  His grading scale does kind of suck though.
Worst professor. Reads posted notes word for word. Has own, harder, grading scale. Gives ABSOLUTELY no help. Do not take his class!!
